en.description: Generates a colorful 1980s-style anime poster featuring a blue-haired girl, bold Friday lettering, and Memphis pop graphics.
en.prompt: Create a vibrant 1980s retro anime poster of a cute young anime girl in close-up, turned over her shoulder and looking toward the viewer with a surprised small open mouth. She has {argument name="hair color" default="electric cobalt blue with pink highlights"}, a short fluffy bob with sweeping bangs and dramatic windblown volume, huge glossy blue eyes with long lashes, pale peach skin, and a large hot-pink star earring on one visible ear. She wears a futuristic rounded jacket or shoulder piece in cyan and deep blue with a small pink button detail, and a white three-wave emblem on the lower right. Across the top, overlay the word {argument name="headline text" default="Friday"} in enormous bright yellow dry-brush script, tilted diagonally and partially covering her hair. Use a clean white background filled with 1980s Memphis design accents: exactly 7 visible decorative elements including a blue dotted square in the upper right, a hot-pink circle near the top right, a diagonal blue stripe near the top edge, a diagonal pink stripe near the top edge, a teal rectangle with a diagonal pink line on the left, a pink triangle with black dots near the lower left center, and a large blue circle cropped at the bottom left over a pale blue grid. Add small yellow stars and fine geometric line accents around the lower-left area. In the bottom right, include small white date text {argument name="date text" default="July 10, 2026"} and a delicate cursive signature {argument name="signature" default="Oyagi"}. Style should be crisp cel-shaded Japanese anime, glossy highlights, bold black linework, saturated cyan/blue/magenta/yellow palette, poster-like vertical composition, high-energy pop graphic design, no photorealism, no extra characters, no watermark beyond the signature.

zh.title: 复古动漫周五海报
zh.description: 生成一张色彩鲜艳的 1980 年代风格动漫海报，包含蓝发少女、醒目的“Friday”字样以及孟菲斯风格的波普图形。
zh.prompt: 创作一张充满活力的 1980 年代复古动漫海报，特写一位可爱的年轻动漫少女，她回眸看向观众，微张着小嘴，神情惊讶。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="电光钴蓝色配粉色挑染"} 的短发，蓬松的波波头带有飘逸的刘海和极具动感的蓬松感，巨大的亮蓝色眼睛配有长睫毛，肤色呈浅桃色，可见的一侧耳朵上戴着巨大的亮粉色星形耳环。她穿着一件青色与深蓝色相间的未来感圆领夹克或肩饰，带有粉色小纽扣细节，右下角饰有白色三波纹徽章。在顶部叠加 {argument name="headline text" default="Friday"} 字样，使用巨大的亮黄色干笔书法字体，呈对角线倾斜，部分遮盖住她的头发。使用干净的白色背景，并点缀 1980 年代的孟菲斯设计元素：共 7 个可见的装饰元素，包括右上角的蓝色点状正方形、右上角附近的亮粉色圆形、顶部边缘附近的蓝色斜条纹、顶部边缘附近的粉色斜条纹、左侧带有粉色斜线的青色矩形、左下中心附近带有黑点的粉色三角形，以及左下角被裁剪的大蓝色圆形，叠加在浅蓝色网格之上。在左下区域添加黄色小星星和精细的几何线条装饰。在右下角包含小号白色日期文本 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 7 月 10 日"} 以及精致的草书签名 {argument name="signature" default="Oyagi"}。风格应为清晰的赛璐珞风格日本动漫，具有光泽感的高光、粗犷的黑色线条、饱和的青色/蓝色/洋红色/黄色调色板、海报式垂直构图、高能量的波普平面设计，拒绝写实风格，不添加额外角色，除签名外无任何水印。

en.title: Dark Floral Japanese Editorial Portrait
en.description: A luxurious vertical fashion-art portrait combining a young woman with Japanese-inspired floral collage, ribbons, fans, and gold botanical ornamentation.
en.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic fine-art portrait of a young East Asian woman in an elegant dark floral gown, set against a deep matte black background. The woman has {argument name="hair style" default="short wavy black bob with soft bangs"}, porcelain skin, delicate makeup, and a calm melancholic expression, looking down and to the right rather than at the viewer. Her shoulders are bare under sheer black tulle, with a lace-like black choker and embroidered blossoms across the bodice. Around and behind her, compose an ornate Japanese-inspired abstract collage: exactly 5 prominent white satin ribbon streams spiraling vertically through the image, 7 large visible cream or white flowers, 4 red or rust circular paper fan/disc motifs, 3 dark folding fan shapes, many fine gold botanical line drawings, thin looping gold arcs, scattered bronze ink splatters, antique beige paper textures, and layered dried-flower silhouettes. The main decorative column rises from the lower center to the upper left, while the portrait occupies the lower-right third. Use a luxurious dark palette of black, ivory, antique gold, sepia, muted red, and warm bronze. Lighting should be dramatic and soft, with the face and shoulder gently illuminated from the front-left, glossy highlights on skin, and surrounding collage elements fading into shadow. Style: ultra-detailed photorealistic fashion editorial mixed with Japanese paper collage, lacquerware elegance, wabi-sabi textures, high contrast, shallow depth of field, no text, no watermark, no border.

zh.title: 深色花卉日式时尚人像
zh.description: 一张奢华的竖构图时尚艺术人像，将年轻女性与日式花卉拼贴、丝带、折扇及金色植物装饰元素相结合。
zh.prompt: 创作一张竖构图的电影感艺术人像，描绘一位身着优雅深色花卉礼服的东亚年轻女性，背景为深哑光黑色。女性留着 {argument name="hair style" default="带有柔和刘海的黑色短波波头"}，拥有瓷器般的肌肤、精致的妆容，神情平静而忧郁，视线看向右下方而非直视镜头。她身着透明黑色薄纱，露出双肩，佩戴蕾丝风格的黑色颈圈，胸前绣有花朵。在她周围及身后，构思一幅华丽的日式抽象拼贴画：画面中精准分布 5 条垂直螺旋上升的白色缎带、7 朵清晰可见的奶油色或白色花朵、4 个红色或铁锈色的圆形纸扇/圆盘图案、3 个深色折扇形状、大量精细的金色植物线条画、纤细的金色弧线、零星的青铜色墨迹、古董米色纸张纹理以及层叠的干花剪影。主要的装饰柱从左下方向左上方延伸，人像占据画面的右下三分之一。采用奢华的深色调，包括黑色、象牙白、古董金、棕褐色、柔和红和暖青铜色。光影效果应戏剧化且柔和，面部和肩部从左前方轻柔受光，皮肤带有光泽感，周围的拼贴元素逐渐隐入阴影中。风格：超细节写实时尚大片，融合日式纸艺拼贴、漆器美学、侘寂纹理，高对比度，浅景深，无文字，无水印，无边框。

en.title: Japanese Corporate Price Index Slide
en.description: Creates a polished Japanese 16:9 infographic slide summarizing June 2026 corporate goods price index statistics for business or economic presentations.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean Japanese economic infographic slide summarizing the corporate goods price index速報 for {argument name="report month" default="2026年6月"}.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal presentation slide, white background with very pale blue accents, ample margins, polished corporate report design. Use navy as the main text color and bright medium blue for numerical percentages. Add a small gray page number “01” at the bottom right.

Layout: Large headline at the top left reading “企業物価指数、{argument name="report month" default="2026年6月"}速報”. Directly below it, a blue subtitle reading “国内物価は前年比+7.1%、輸入物価は円ベースで+29.7%”. Center the main content as exactly 3 rounded rectangular statistic cards in one horizontal row, each with a light blue border, subtle shadow, faint blue gradient fill, a circular icon area at top left, a bold Japanese category title, a thin divider line, and two metric rows. At the bottom, place a small friendly white-and-blue robot mascot on the lower left, pointing upward, and a centered conclusion sentence.

Statistic cards: Use exactly 3 cards. Card 1: factory icon, title “国内企業物価”, metric rows “前月比 +0.4%” and “前年比 +7.1%”. Card 2: cargo ship icon, title “輸出物価（円ベース）”, metric rows “前月比 +0.4%” and “前年比 +20.7%”. Card 3: globe and container/warehouse icon, title “輸入物価（円ベース）”, metric rows “前月比 +1.3%” and “前年比 +29.7%”. Make the percentages large and bright blue, aligned to the right of each row label.

Bottom text: Centered near the bottom in bold navy Japanese: “6月の企業物価は、国内・輸出・輸入で上昇が続いた”.

Visual style: Modern Japanese business presentation, crisp vector icons, rounded corners, soft shadows, balanced whitespace, consistent alignment. No charts or extra decorations beyond the 3 cards, the robot mascot, and page number. Keep all Japanese text legible and exactly as specified.

zh.title: 日本企业物价指数 Slides
zh.description: 制作一张精美的 16:9 日本信息图表 Slides，用于总结 2026 年 6 月企业商品物价指数统计数据，适用于商务或经济演示。
zh.prompt:
目标：制作一张简洁的日本经济信息图表 Slides，总结 {argument name="report month" default="2026年6月"} 的企业商品物价指数速报。

画布：16:9 横向演示幻灯片，白色背景，带有极浅的蓝色点缀，留白充足，采用精美的企业报告设计。主文本颜色使用深蓝色，数值百分比使用明亮的中蓝色。在右下角添加一个灰色的小页码“01”。

布局：左上角放置大标题“企业物价指数，{argument name="report month" default="2026年6月"}速报”。其正下方放置蓝色副标题“国内物价は前年比+7.1%、输入物价は円ベースで+29.7%”。主要内容居中，横向排列 3 张圆角矩形统计卡片，每张卡片带有浅蓝色边框、细微阴影、淡蓝色渐变填充，左上角设有圆形图标区域，包含粗体日文类别标题、细分割线以及两行指标数据。底部左侧放置一个友好的白蓝配色机器人吉祥物，指向右上方，底部居中位置放置一句总结性语句。

统计卡片：使用 3 张卡片。卡片 1：工厂图标，标题“国内企业物价”，指标行“前月比 +0.4%”和“前年比 +7.1%”。卡片 2：货船图标，标题“输出物价（円ベース）”，指标行“前月比 +0.4%”和“前年比 +20.7%”。卡片 3：地球与集装箱/仓库图标，标题“输入物价（円ベース）”，指标行“前月比 +1.3%”和“前年比 +29.7%”。百分比数值需放大并显示为明亮的蓝色，与每行标签右侧对齐。

底部文本：底部居中处使用粗体深蓝色日文：“6月の企业物价は、国内・输出・输入で上昇が続いた”。

视觉风格：现代日本商务演示风格，清晰的矢量图标，圆角设计，柔和阴影，平衡的留白，一致的对齐方式。除 3 张卡片、机器人吉祥物和页码外，无需图表或其他额外装饰。保持所有日文文本清晰易读，并严格按照指定内容呈现。

en.title: Muse Japanese Infographic
en.description: A hand-drawn Japanese notebook-style infographic explaining Muse Image as a third option for Japanese image generation.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical hand-drawn Japanese infographic on dotted notebook paper explaining that {argument name="AI model name" default="Muse"} changes illustrated infographic creation, positioning it as a third option for Japanese image generation.

Canvas: Portrait 4:5 layout, warm off-white cream paper background with a subtle dotted grid. Use a cute stationery scrapbook style with sketchy navy ink outlines, pink masking tape, beige tape, tiny sparkles, leaves, paperclip doodles, arrows, and hand-drawn border lines. Color palette: navy blue, dusty pink, cream, soft gray, and small red/blue chart accents.

Top header: A wide pale pink ribbon banner across the top with bold dark navy Japanese headline text: 「{argument name="headline text" default="Museで図解制作が変わる？"}」. Under it, centered red subtitle: 「{argument name="subtitle text" default="日本語の画像生成、第3の選択肢"}」.

Main layout: Three white sketch-outlined content cards on the left and center, plus an illustrated presenter character on the right. Use dashed pink arrows to connect the cards and suggest a workflow.

Card count: Exactly 3 cards.
1. Upper-left card: Pink tape label with bold navy text 「従来AI」. Below, two lines: 「文字が弱い」 and a speech bubble 「日本語も崩れる」. Illustration: a messy pile of crumpled papers with chaotic scribbles, exclamation marks, and a small chart sheet with an alert icon.
2. Center card: Pink tape label 「正確さ」. Below, two lines: 「図表を作る」 and 「コードと検索」. Illustration: a QR-code-like square, a magnifying glass, a bar chart with red and blue bars, a wrench icon, and a gear icon.
3. Lower-left card: Pink tape label 「自己修正」. Below, two lines: 「描き直せる」 and 「手間が軽くなる」. Illustration: circular refresh arrows, a small eraser, and a mini chart sheet with check marks.

Right side details: Add a checklist with exactly 3 checked items, written in English: “Nano Banana Pro”, “GPT Image 2”, and “Muse Image”. Add a vertical side note near the lower right reading “Nano Banana Pro” with two small empty checkboxes beside the margin.

Presenter character: On the right, draw a friendly Japanese businesswoman in simple anime/chibi infographic style, about one-third of the image height. She has {argument name="character hair" default="shoulder-length dark brown bob hair"}, black round glasses, a white button-up blouse with sleeves rolled up, a navy pencil skirt, and navy flats. She smiles and points left toward the central card.

Decorative element count: Include exactly 2 pieces of tape at the top corners, exactly 1 paperclip near the upper right, exactly 1 blue tape strip near the lower left, several small sparkles and doodle curls around the edges, and thin hand-drawn border strokes at the top and bottom.

Visual style: Clean but handmade, Japanese social-media explainer graphic, legible hand-lettered text, thick marker-like navy outlines, slight imperfections, soft pastel fills, no photorealism.

Constraints: Keep all Japanese text accurate and readable, avoid extra headings or extra cards, maintain the exact three-card structure and the exact three-item checklist, no watermark, no realistic photography.

zh.title: Muse 日语信息图
zh.description: 一张手绘风格的日语笔记本式信息图，旨在解释 Muse Image 作为日语图像生成的第三种选择。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张竖版手绘风格的日语信息图，背景为点阵笔记本纸，解释 {argument name="AI model name" default="Muse"} 如何改变插图式信息图的创作，并将其定位为日语图像生成的第三种选择。

画布：4:5 竖向布局，采用温暖的米白色纸张背景，带有细微的点阵网格。使用可爱的文具剪贴簿风格，配以深蓝色手绘墨水轮廓、粉色美纹纸胶带、米色胶带、微小星光、叶子、回形针涂鸦、箭头和手绘边框线。配色方案：深蓝色、灰粉色、米色、柔灰色以及少量红/蓝色图表点缀。

顶部标题：顶部横跨一条宽大的浅粉色丝带横幅，上面印有醒目的深蓝色日语标题文字：「{argument name="headline text" default="Muse で図解制作が変わる？"}」。下方居中放置红色副标题：「{argument name="subtitle text" default="日本語の画像生成、第3の選択肢"}」。

主要布局：左侧和中心放置三张带有白色手绘轮廓的内容卡片，右侧放置一个插画风格的演示角色。使用虚线粉色箭头连接卡片，以展示工作流程。

卡片数量：共 3 张卡片。
1. 左上角卡片：粉色胶带标签，印有深蓝色粗体文字「従来 AI」。下方两行文字：「文字が弱い」以及一个气泡框「日本語も崩れる」。插图：一堆凌乱的废纸团，带有混乱的涂鸦、感叹号以及一张带有警告图标的小图表。
2. 中心卡片：粉色胶带标签「正確さ」。下方两行文字：「図表を作る」以及「コードと検索」。插图：一个类似二维码的方块、一个放大镜、一个带有红蓝柱状的条形图、一个扳手图标和一个齿轮图标。
3. 左下角卡片：粉色胶带标签「自己修正」。下方两行文字：「描き直せる」以及「手間が軽くなる」。插图：循环刷新箭头、一个小橡皮擦以及一张带有勾选标记的小图表。

右侧细节：添加一个包含 3 个已勾选项目的清单，使用英文书写：“Nano Banana Pro”、“GPT Image 2” 和 “Muse Image”。在右下角边缘附近添加一个垂直侧注，写着 “Nano Banana Pro”，旁边有两个小的空复选框。

演示角色：在右侧绘制一位友好的日本职场女性，采用简单的动漫/Q 版信息图风格，高度约为图像的三分之一。她留着 {argument name="character hair" default="肩部长度的深棕色波波头"}，戴着黑色圆框眼镜，身穿白色衬衫（袖子卷起）、深蓝色铅笔裙和深蓝色平底鞋。她微笑着，指向左侧的中心卡片。

装饰元素数量：顶部角落包含 2 条胶带，右上角附近 1 个回形针，左下角附近 1 条蓝色胶带，边缘周围有若干小星光和涂鸦卷曲，顶部和底部有细细的手绘边框线。

视觉风格：简洁但具有手工感，日本社交媒体说明图风格，手写文字清晰易读，粗马克笔风格的深蓝色轮廓，带有轻微的不完美感，柔和的粉彩色填充，无照片写实感。

约束：保持所有日语文本准确且易读，避免添加额外的标题或卡片，维持 3 张卡片的结构和 3 项清单，无水印，无写实摄影。

en.title: Kawaii Brick Moon Chibi Diorama
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a toy-brick celestial diorama with a smiling chibi girl seated on a crescent moon.
en.prompt: Create a whimsical toy-brick diorama in a cute Japanese kawaii style: a single chibi girl named {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} sits smiling on the lower tip of a large cream-and-gold crescent moon made entirely from interlocking plastic building blocks. She has glossy {argument name="hair color" default="black"} short bob hair with soft bangs, large sparkling brown eyes, rosy cheeks, a small open smile, silver star dangling earrings, and a delicate white frilly dress with lace-like ruffles, off-shoulder sleeves, layered skirt details, and white shoes decorated with tiny flowers. The scene is a dreamy night-sky nursery garden built from toy bricks: use exactly 1 large crescent moon arch behind her, 1 chibi doll character, 1 cream plaque sign in the front left reading {argument name="sign text" default="のぞむ"} with smaller roman letters {argument name="romanized sign text" default="NOZOMU"}, 1 glowing white lantern at the front right, 2 potted flower clusters on the left and right edges, and 7 visible hanging star ornaments suspended from strings in the background. Add translucent pastel flower studs, pearl-like bubbles, small clouds, tiny star accents, shelves, arches, and a blue tiled brick floor. The background should be softly blurred in deep blue and pastel tones with warm fairy-light bokeh, giving a magical celestial bedtime atmosphere. Render as a highly detailed macro product photograph of a collectible block-built scene, glossy plastic texture, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the girl and crescent moon, square composition, no watermark, no extra text beyond the plaque.

zh.title: 可爱积木月亮 Q 版立体模型
zh.description: 一个用于生成玩具积木天体立体模型的详细提示词，描绘了一个坐在新月上的微笑 Q 版女孩。
zh.prompt: 创建一个充满奇趣的日式可爱风格玩具积木立体模型：一个名为 {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"} 的 Q 版女孩正微笑着坐在由互锁塑料积木拼搭而成的奶油金配色大新月下端。她留着光泽感的 {argument name="hair color" default="black"} 短波波头，配有柔和的刘海，有着闪亮的大棕色眼睛、红润的双颊、小巧的微笑，佩戴着银色星星吊坠耳环，身穿精致的白色荷叶边连衣裙，裙子带有蕾丝般的褶皱、露肩袖、层叠的裙摆细节以及装饰着小花的白色鞋子。场景是一个由玩具积木搭建的梦幻夜空育儿花园：背景中包含 1 个巨大的新月拱门，1 个 Q 版人偶角色，左前方有一个奶油色牌子，上面写着 {argument name="sign text" default="のぞむ"} 以及较小的罗马字母 {argument name="romanized sign text" default="NOZOMU"}，右前方有 1 个发光的白色灯笼，左右边缘各放置 2 簇盆栽花卉，背景中悬挂着 7 个清晰可见的星星挂饰。添加半透明的马卡龙色花朵饰钉、珍珠般的泡泡、小云朵、微小的星星装饰、架子、拱门以及蓝色瓷砖积木地板。背景应呈现深蓝色与马卡龙色调的柔和虚化效果，并带有温暖的仙女灯光斑，营造出神奇的天体睡前氛围。渲染为一张高度精细的收藏级积木场景微距产品摄影图，具有光泽的塑料质感、柔和的影棚灯光、浅景深，女孩和新月处于清晰对焦状态，方形构图，无水印，除牌子外无额外文字。

en.title: Cute Summer Picture Diary
en.description: Generates a cozy overhead summer vacation diary scene with two hand-drawn chibi anime entries and nostalgic tabletop art supplies.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a warm, photorealistic overhead tabletop scene of an open summer picture diary drawn in cute colored-pencil style, as if made by a child, featuring the same small anime girl character in two diary entries.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 image, top-down view with slight natural perspective, cozy daylight on a wooden desk, high detail, realistic objects around the notebook, no digital UI or watermark.

Main subject: An open grid-paper notebook centered on the desk, showing exactly 2 illustrated diary pages. Each page has a large crayon-and-colored-pencil drawing at the top and neat handwritten Japanese diary text underneath. The character is a chibi anime girl named {argument name="character name" default="a cheerful blonde chibi girl"}, with short twin-tail hair, pale skin, blue-green eyes, a flower hair accessory, a patchwork colorful summer top, plaid skirt, patterned socks, and cute sneakers. Keep her consistent across both drawings.

Left diary page: Header date reads {argument name="left page date" default="7月20日（土）"}. The drawing shows the girl sitting on a wooden porch in daylight, happily holding a triangular slice of watermelon. Include a bright sunflower on the left, blue sky with fluffy clouds, a hanging wind chime near a wooden post, and a plate with exactly 2 watermelon wedges on the porch. Add a small red sun doodle near the date and a small smiling sun doodle near the lower right of the page. Under the drawing, write the diary text as {argument name="left diary text" default="おそとで　すいかを　たべたよ。\nあまくて　つめたくて　おいしかった！\nひまわりも　げんきだったよ。"}.

Right diary page: Header date reads {argument name="right page date" default="7月25日（木）"}. The drawing shows the same girl standing by a river at night watching a fireworks festival. Include a dark blue starry sky, exactly 5 large colorful fireworks bursts, reflections on the water, a distant town skyline with glowing windows, grass along the riverbank, and a small vertical festival sign reading 花火大会. Add exactly 2 small yellow star doodles near the top. Under the drawing, write the diary text as {argument name="right diary text" default="はなびたいかいに　いったよ。\nキラキラして　とても　きれいだった！\nドーンって　おとが　びっくりしたよ。"}.

Surrounding tabletop objects: Include exactly 4 loose crayons above the notebook, labeled by color in Japanese: peach, yellow, pink, and blue. Add a glass of iced tea on a woven coaster at upper left, exactly 1 cicada insect near it, exactly 2 seashells on the left side, a colored-pencil tin at lower left with visible pencils, a small blue pencil sharpener, pencil shavings, exactly 2 loose colored pencils near the bottom, a colorful fireworks crayon box near the bottom center, exactly 2 small toy figures near the bottom right, a folded towel at upper right with cute sea-creature embroidery and Japanese name text, a round paper fan at right with morning glory flowers, and a bowl at lower right containing watermelon slices.

Visual style: The diary drawings must look handmade with visible waxy crayon texture, uneven outlines, childlike proportions, soft pastel colors, and grid-paper texture. The surrounding desk and objects should be realistic, warm, tactile, and nostalgic, with shallow natural shadows and summer vacation atmosphere.

Constraints: Countable elements must match exactly: 2 diary pages, 2 appearances of the girl, 2 watermelon wedges on the left-page plate, 5 fireworks bursts, 2 yellow star doodles, 4 crayons above the notebook, 2 seashells, 2 loose colored pencils, and 2 small toy figures. Do not add extra diary pages, extra characters, or printed watermarks.

zh.title: 可爱的夏日绘图日记
zh.description: 生成一个温馨的俯视视角夏日假期日记场景，包含两幅手绘风格的 Q 版动漫插画以及充满怀旧感的桌面文具。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一个温馨、写实的俯视桌面场景，展示一本打开的夏日绘图日记，采用可爱的彩色铅笔手绘风格，仿佛出自孩子之手，并在两页日记中呈现同一个 Q 版动漫女孩形象。

画布：横向 4:3 图像，俯视视角并带有自然的透视感，木质书桌上洒满温暖的日光，细节丰富，笔记本周围摆放着写实的物品，无数字 UI 或水印。

主体：书桌中央一本打开的方格笔记本，清晰展示 2 页日记。每页上方均有一幅蜡笔和彩色铅笔绘制的画作，下方配有工整的日语手写日记文字。角色为一名 Q 版动漫女孩，名为 {argument name="character name" default="一个开朗的金发 Q 版女孩"}，留着短双马尾，皮肤白皙，蓝绿色眼睛，佩戴花朵发饰，身穿拼色夏日上衣、格子裙、花纹袜和可爱的运动鞋。请确保她在两幅画中的形象保持一致。

左侧日记页：页眉日期为 {argument name="left page date" default="7月20日（土）"}。画作展示了女孩坐在白天的木质走廊上，开心地拿着一块三角形西瓜。画面左侧包含一朵明亮的向日葵、蓝天和蓬松的云朵、木柱旁悬挂的风铃，以及走廊上放着的一盘正好 2 块的西瓜。在日期附近添加一个小红太阳涂鸦，页面右下角添加一个小笑脸太阳涂鸦。画作下方书写日记文字：{argument name="left diary text" default="おそとで　すいかを　たべたよ。\nあまくて　つめたくて　おいしかった！\nひまわりも　げんきだったよ。"}。

右侧日记页：页眉日期为 {argument name="right page date" default="7月25日（木）"}。画作展示了同一个女孩站在夜晚的河边观看烟花大会。包含深蓝色的星空、正好 5 朵绚丽的烟花、水面上的倒影、远处带有发光窗户的城镇轮廓、河岸边的草地，以及一个写有“花火大会”字样的竖直小祭典招牌。在顶部添加正好 2 个黄色小星星涂鸦。画作下方书写日记文字：{argument name="right diary text" default="はなびたいかいに　いったよ。\nキラキラして　とても　きれいだった！\nドーンって　おとが　びっくりしたよ。"}。

周围桌面物品：笔记本上方摆放正好 4 支散落的蜡笔，并用日语标注颜色：桃色、黄色、粉色和蓝色。左上方编织杯垫上放着一杯冰茶，旁边有正好 1 只蝉，左侧有正好 2 个贝壳，左下方有一个装有彩色铅笔的铁盒，旁边有一个蓝色小卷笔刀、铅笔屑，底部附近有正好 2 支散落的彩色铅笔，底部中央有一个色彩缤纷的烟花蜡笔盒，右下方有正好 2 个小玩具人偶，右上方有一条折叠的毛巾，上面绣有可爱的海洋生物和日语名称，右侧有一把印有牵牛花的圆纸扇，右下方有一个装有西瓜块的碗。

视觉风格：日记画作必须看起来是手工绘制的，具有明显的蜡笔质感、不均匀的轮廓、稚拙的比例、柔和的粉彩色调以及方格纸纹理。周围的桌面和物品应显得写实、温暖、有质感且充满怀旧气息，带有柔和的自然阴影和夏日度假氛围。

约束条件：可计数元素必须完全匹配：2 页日记、2 次女孩形象、左页盘中 2 块西瓜、5 朵烟花、2 个黄色星星涂鸦、笔记本上方 4 支蜡笔、2 个贝壳、2 支散落的彩色铅笔以及 2 个小玩具人偶。请勿添加额外的日记页、多余的角色或印刷水印。

en.title: Hooded Desert Wanderer Portrait
en.description: A cinematic fantasy portrait prompt for generating a mysterious hooded young woman against a softly lit dawn sky.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic semi-realistic digital painting of a solitary young woman in a weathered hooded cloak, shown in close-up three-quarter profile from the shoulders up. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark black"} loose, wind-tangled hair spilling from beneath the hood, pale olive skin, strong dark eyebrows, a delicate nose, slightly parted lips, and striking {argument name="eye color" default="clear blue-gray"} eyes looking off to the right with a quiet, determined expression. The cloak is {argument name="cloak color" default="charcoal brown"}, rough, dusty, frayed along the hood edge, with painterly folds wrapping around her shoulders; her muted worn tunic is barely visible underneath. Set her against a soft {argument name="background setting" default="dawn desert sky"} with warm peach light near the horizon and cool gray clouds above, using strong backlighting and rim light around the hood and hair. Style: high-detail fantasy concept art, realistic anime-inspired face, dramatic atmospheric lighting, visible brush texture, moody post-apocalyptic traveler aesthetic, shallow depth of field, vertical portrait crop, no text, no watermark, no extra characters.

zh.title: 戴兜帽的沙漠流浪者肖像
zh.description: 一个电影感奇幻肖像提示词，用于生成一位在柔和晨光下显得神秘的兜帽少女。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅电影感半写实数字绘画，描绘一位身穿破旧兜帽斗篷的孤身少女，画面为肩部以上的四分之三侧面特写。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="深黑色"} 凌乱且被风吹散的头发从兜帽下垂落，浅橄榄色皮肤，浓密的深色眉毛，精致的鼻子，微张的双唇，以及迷人的 {argument name="eye color" default="清澈的蓝灰色"} 双眼，正看向右侧，表情安静而坚定。斗篷为 {argument name="cloak color" default="炭褐色"}，质地粗糙、布满尘土，兜帽边缘磨损，带有包裹肩部的绘画感褶皱；内搭的褪色旧长袍隐约可见。背景设定为柔和的 {argument name="background setting" default="黎明沙漠天空"}，地平线附近有温暖的桃色光芒，上方则是冷灰色的云层，运用强烈的逆光和勾勒兜帽与头发的轮廓光。风格：高细节奇幻概念艺术，写实动漫风格面部，戏剧性氛围光，可见笔触，忧郁的末日旅行者美学，浅景深，竖构图肖像，无文字，无水印，无额外角色。

en.title: Chibi Anime Fishing Prank Crash
en.description: A wide anime gag comic scene showing two chibi girls using a fishing rod prank that makes a third chibi military girl crash into a utility pole.
en.prompt:
Create a wide 16:9 anime-style gag comic scene on a bright modern Japanese city sidewalk. The composition is split by a building corner: on the left, two chibi anime girls hide in the shadow of a gray concrete wall, and on the right, a third chibi anime girl has just slammed into a metal utility pole at high speed. Use clean cel-shaded illustration, crisp line art, vivid colors, exaggerated manga motion effects, and a playful slapstick tone.

Scene details: The background is an urban shopping street with glass storefronts, office buildings, vertical shop signs, a blue sky, and a long sidewalk receding in perspective. Place a tall cylindrical utility pole near the right foreground. The impact victim should be a petite chibi military girl with long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="pink-blonde"} hair, a black-and-red military cap, black tactical outfit with red accents, spiral dizzy eyes, open shocked mouth, and arms stretched forward as her face/body hits the pole. Add two large orange-and-black manga impact sound effects reading 「ドン!」, one near the upper impact and one near the lower right, plus a pink sound effect 「キュン」 beside the impact burst. Include orange starburst impact shapes behind her and strong horizontal speed lines trailing from left to right.

Left-side prank setup: Show exactly 2 hidden chibi girls. Girl 1, standing far left, is a short lavender-haired girl with glasses, a white naval-style cap, white-and-blue uniform, white boots, and a calm deadpan expression with crossed arms. Girl 2, standing center-left, is a cheerful short blonde girl in a black tactical outfit with gold trim and a small black cap, holding a fishing rod. The fishing line extends diagonally upward and then down toward the street, suspending exactly 1 small rectangular photo/card bait showing a dark portrait image. Give the blonde girl a mischievous smile as if luring the victim.

Speech bubbles: Add exactly 2 vertical Japanese speech bubbles on the left. The lavender-haired girl says 「スペックオーバーですね」. The blonde fishing girl says 「オーバースペックじゃね？」. Keep the text readable, black on white bubbles with thin black outlines.

Constraints: Keep the image comedic and dynamic, no gore or injuries beyond cartoon dizziness, no extra characters in the foreground. Maintain the 3-character count, the 2 speech bubbles, the 1 dangling photo bait, and the 3 visible sound-effect texts.

zh.title: Q 版动漫钓鱼恶作剧撞击
zh.description: 一个宽幅动漫搞笑漫画场景，展示了两个 Q 版女孩使用钓鱼竿恶作剧，导致第三个 Q 版军事风女孩撞上电线杆。
zh.prompt:
创作一个 16:9 的宽幅动漫风格搞笑漫画场景，背景为明亮的现代日本城市人行道。构图被建筑拐角一分为二：左侧，两个 Q 版动漫女孩躲在灰色混凝土墙的阴影中；右侧，第三个 Q 版动漫女孩正高速撞向一根金属电线杆。采用干净的赛璐珞插画风格、清晰的线条艺术、鲜艳的色彩、夸张的漫画动态效果以及俏皮的闹剧基调。

场景细节：背景是城市商业街，有玻璃店面、办公楼、垂直的商店招牌、蓝天以及向远处延伸的人行道。在右侧前景放置一根高大的圆柱形电线杆。受害者应为一个娇小的 Q 版军事风女孩，留着长长的波浪卷 {argument name="hair color" default="粉金色"} 头发，戴着黑红相间的军帽，穿着带有红色点缀的黑色战术服装，眼睛呈螺旋状眩晕，嘴巴张大露出震惊的表情，双臂向前伸展，脸部/身体撞在电线杆上。在撞击处附近添加两个巨大的橙黑色漫画撞击音效「ドン!」，一个在上方撞击点，另一个在右下方，并在撞击爆发处旁边添加一个粉色的音效「キュン」。在受害者身后加入橙色星爆状撞击图形，并添加从左向右延伸的强烈水平速度线。

左侧恶作剧设置：展示正好 2 个隐藏的 Q 版女孩。女孩 1 站在最左侧，是一个留着淡紫色短发、戴眼镜、戴白色海军风帽子、身穿蓝白制服、脚穿白靴的女孩，表情冷静淡定，双臂交叉。女孩 2 站在中左侧，是一个开朗的金色短发女孩，身穿带有金色饰边的黑色战术服装，戴着黑色小帽子，手持钓鱼竿。鱼线向斜上方延伸，然后向下垂向街道，悬挂着 1 张展示深色肖像照片/卡片的诱饵。给金发女孩一个调皮的微笑，仿佛正在诱导受害者。

对话气泡：在左侧添加正好 2 个垂直的日文对话气泡。紫发女孩说「スペックオーバーですね」。金发钓鱼女孩说「オーバースペックじゃね？」。保持文字清晰易读，黑色文字置于带有细黑边框的白色气泡中。

约束条件：保持画面幽默且富有动态感，除卡通式的眩晕外不要出现血腥或受伤画面，前景中不要出现额外角色。保持 3 个角色数量、2 个对话气泡、1 个悬挂的照片诱饵以及 3 处可见的音效文字。

en.title: Rainy Tokyo Yokai Gyaru Selfie
en.description: A cinematic photorealistic prompt for generating a Y2K gyaru fox-yokai girl taking a rainy neon Tokyo street selfie.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic cinematic vertical selfie of a {argument name="character type" default="Japanese yokai fox-girl gyaru"} wandering through modern Tokyo at night in the rain. The subject is a young woman with long black hair, large realistic fox ears with tan inner fur, subtle fang-like charm, glossy makeup, small star stickers or glitter under one eye, and a playful wink. She holds up a V-sign near her cheek while extending her other arm toward the camera as if taking a close wide-angle smartphone selfie. She wears a Y2K gyaru-inspired outfit: cropped pale pink fitted top, dark cropped jacket with wet reflective fabric, and a dark pleated mini skirt. She stands beside a brightly lit convenience-store or arcade frontage with red vending machines visible through glass on the left, neon green and warm orange signage reflections, wet pavement, raindrops, and colorful Tokyo street bokeh in the background. Include one transparent umbrella above and behind her, speckled with raindrops and catching rainbow lens flares. Mood: cute, mischievous, urban supernatural nightlife. Style: ultra-detailed realistic anime-cosplay photography, 35mm wide-angle selfie perspective, shallow depth of field, wet reflections, cinematic teal-orange lighting, high contrast, soft skin detail, visible rain droplets, lens flare and light bloom. Composition: portrait 3:4, subject centered slightly right, face sharp, outstretched forearm large in the foreground, background softly blurred but recognizable as rainy Tokyo. Avoid extra characters, text, logos, distorted hands, duplicate ears, or overly cartoonish rendering.

zh.title: 雨中东京妖怪辣妹自拍
zh.description: 一个电影级写实风格的提示词，用于生成 Y2K 辣妹狐妖女孩在雨中东京街头自拍的画面。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影级写实风格的竖屏自拍，画面主体为一位 {argument name="character type" default="日本狐妖辣妹"} 在雨夜漫步于现代东京。主体是一位年轻女性，留着黑色长发，拥有逼真的大狐耳（内侧为棕色绒毛），带有微妙的獠牙魅力，妆容光泽，眼下贴有细小的星星贴纸或亮片，俏皮地眨着眼。她一只手在脸颊旁比出 V 字手势，另一只手臂伸向镜头，仿佛正在用智能手机拍摄广角自拍。她身穿 Y2K 辣妹风格的服装：淡粉色短款修身上衣、带有湿润反光质感的深色短夹克，以及深色百褶迷你裙。她站在一家灯火通明的便利店或游戏厅门前，左侧透过玻璃可以看到红色自动售货机，背景中闪烁着霓虹绿和暖橙色的招牌倒影、湿漉漉的地面、雨滴以及多彩的东京街头光斑。在她的上方和身后放置一把透明雨伞，伞面上布满雨滴并捕捉到彩虹色的镜头光晕。氛围：可爱、顽皮、都市超自然夜生活。风格：超细节写实动漫 Cosplay 摄影，35mm 广角自拍视角，浅景深，湿润反光，电影级青橙色调，高对比度，细腻的皮肤纹理，可见的雨滴，镜头光晕和光晕效果。构图：人像 3:4，主体略微偏右，面部清晰，伸出的前臂在前景中显得较大，背景虚化但仍能辨认出是雨中的东京。避免出现多余角色、文字、Logo、扭曲的手部、重复的耳朵或过于卡通化的渲染。

en.title: Poseidon Sea God Warrior
en.description: A cinematic fantasy anime key visual of Poseidon wielding a golden trident amid swirling waves and a glowing water dragon.

zh.title: 海神波塞冬战士
zh.description: 一张电影感奇幻动漫主视觉图，描绘了波塞冬手持金色三叉戟，置身于翻涌的波浪与发光水龙之中。
zh.prompt: 创作一张具有戏剧张力的竖版奇幻动漫插画，主角为 {argument name="deity character" default="海神波塞冬"}，形象设定为一位年轻英俊的海神战士，伫立在发光的海水风暴中。他拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳的青蓝色"} 被风吹动的波浪卷发，锐利的蓝色双眸，神情冷静严肃，头戴精致的小型金冠或角状头饰。他身穿发光的晶莹水色铠甲，饰有金色花丝镶边，配有层叠的肩甲、护腕，以及一件如同海沫般飘逸的半透明蓝白披风。他前侧的手紧握着一把高大的抛光金色三叉戟，三叉戟拥有三根长矛尖，每一根都呈现出优雅的火焰状刀刃，并散发着神圣的光芒。在他身后，一条由半透明蓝色波浪构成的巨大蛇形水龙盘旋在背景上方，拥有棱角分明的龙头、冰晶般的鳍以及飞溅的晶莹鳞片。构图充满动感与英雄气概，采用低角度四分之三侧视图，三叉戟沿左侧垂直升起，角色略微偏右居中，翻涌的波浪在他周围形成一个圆形漩涡。背景使用深邃的夜海色，搭配青色生物发光高光、白色浪花飞溅、金色轮廓光、闪烁的水滴，高对比度，超精细数字绘画，精致的抽卡游戏主视觉风格，电影级布光，锐利的线条，璀璨的魔法特效，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

en.title: Whimsical Phoenix Mountain Kingdom
en.description: Generates a richly detailed fantasy valley with phoenixes, temples, travelers, and magical creatures for cinematic worldbuilding art.
en.prompt: Create a wide cinematic fantasy landscape in a bright, painterly Studio Ghibli-inspired storybook style. Show a magical East Asian mountain valley under a vivid blue sky with soft peach-white clouds, sunlit mist, and distant jagged snowy peaks. In the middle ground, place a peaceful village of red-and-white Japanese-style buildings with gray tiled roofs, including one tall red pagoda near the center, surrounded by golden rice fields, autumn-colored trees, streams, and small waterfalls. A clear turquoise river runs from the distant mountains toward the viewer, crossed by a small arched stone bridge in the center foreground with one small girl standing on it. Above the valley, include exactly 3 rainbow-feathered phoenix birds: 1 large phoenix centered high in the sky with wings fully spread and long trailing tail feathers, 1 smaller phoenix at upper left, and 1 faint smaller phoenix at upper right. On the right middle distance, show a floating rocky island with a grand red tiered temple complex perched on top, waterfalls pouring down from the island into the mist. Foreground details should feel whimsical and richly populated: on the left, dense flowering green bushes and a large orange fox sitting on a rock beside a tiny brown creature; nearby on the path are exactly 1 boy, 1 small gray dog, and 1 tiny colorful bird. On the bridge is exactly 1 girl. On the right path are exactly 2 human travelers, one taller adult with a walking staff and one shorter elderly-looking companion carrying a pack. Near them are exactly 4 fantasy animals: 1 large antlered goat-like beast, 1 small white rabbit, 1 small deer-like animal, and 1 enormous cream-colored spiral-shelled snail with blue and gold swirls. Add a large leafy tree on the far right with yellow, green, and violet foliage. Use luminous watercolor-and-gouache textures, intricate but soft detail, warm golden highlights, atmospheric depth, and a sense of wonder. No text, no logo, no watermark. The setting should feel like {argument name="fantasy kingdom style" default="a serene Japanese-inspired magical mountain kingdom"}, with {argument name="sky mood" default="clear blue morning sky with glowing clouds"}, {argument name="main creature" default="rainbow phoenix birds"}, {argument name="village architecture" default="red-and-white Japanese temple village"}, and {argument name="overall art style" default="painterly whimsical anime fantasy concept art"}.

zh.title: 奇幻凤凰山国
zh.description: 生成一个细节丰富的奇幻山谷，包含凤凰、寺庙、旅人和魔法生物，适用于电影级世界观美术创作。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅宽幅电影级奇幻风景画，采用明亮、绘本风格的吉卜力工作室（Studio Ghibli）艺术风格。展现一个魔法东亚山谷，背景是湛蓝的天空，点缀着柔和的桃白色云朵、阳光下的薄雾以及远处参差不齐的雪峰。在中景处，安置一个宁静的村庄，由红白相间的日式建筑和灰色瓦顶组成，中心附近有一座高耸的红色宝塔，周围环绕着金色的稻田、秋色的树木、溪流和小瀑布。一条清澈的绿松石色河流从远山流向画面前方，中心前景处有一座小石拱桥，桥上站着一个小女孩。在山谷上方，包含 3 只彩羽凤凰：1 只巨大的凤凰位于高空中心，双翼完全展开，拖着长长的尾羽；1 只较小的凤凰位于左上方；1 只模糊的小凤凰位于右上方。在右侧中远景处，展示一座漂浮的岩石岛屿，上方坐落着宏伟的红色层叠寺庙群，瀑布从岛屿倾泻而下，没入薄雾中。前景细节应充满奇幻感且丰富：左侧是茂密的开花绿灌木丛，一只大橙色狐狸坐在一块岩石上，旁边是一个微小的棕色生物；附近的小路上有 1 个男孩、1 只小灰狗和 1 只微小的彩色鸟。桥上正好有 1 个女孩。右侧小路上有 2 位人类旅人，一位是拿着手杖的高个子成年人，另一位是背着行囊的矮个子长者。他们附近有 4 只奇幻动物：1 只长着鹿角的大型山羊状野兽、1 只小白兔、1 只小型鹿状动物，以及 1 只巨大的奶油色螺旋壳蜗牛，壳上有蓝色和金色的漩涡纹路。在最右侧添加一棵枝叶繁茂的大树，叶片呈现黄色、绿色和紫色。运用发光的水彩和水粉质感，细节精致而柔和，带有温暖的金色高光、大气深度和奇幻感。无文字，无 Logo，无水印。场景应呈现为 {argument name="fantasy kingdom style" default="宁静的日式魔法山国"}，搭配 {argument name="sky mood" default="清澈的蓝色晨空与发光的云朵"}、{argument name="main creature" default="彩虹凤凰"}、{argument name="village architecture" default="红白相间的日式寺庙村落"} 以及 {argument name="overall art style" default="绘本风奇幻动漫概念艺术"}。

en.title: Moonlit Warring States Spy Poster

zh.title: 月下战国谍影海报
zh.description: 生成一张华丽的动漫风格角色海报，主角为一名转生至中国战国时代的奇幻间谍，包含日文标题和属性铭牌。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张细节丰富、方形的动漫奇幻角色海报，讲述一个中国战国时代的转生故事，以一名在月光古城中的年轻女间谍为核心。

画布：1:1 正方形插画，华丽的深海军蓝与古董金海报边框，高细节，电影级光影，无现代物体，无水印。

主体：一名可爱的动漫少女，约十几岁，蹲在瓦片屋顶上，带着平静而顽皮的微笑注视着观众。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="短而凌乱的银金色头发"}、明亮的蓝色眼睛、白皙的皮肤、红润的脸颊和精致的五官。她身穿优雅的兜帽刺客间谍装：带有淡蓝色内衬的白色兜帽斗篷、黑白叠层服饰、蓝色点缀、金色刺绣、悬挂的链条、符咒、小挂饰、珠宝、护臂、露指手套、腰带、小袋和隐藏工具。一只手握着一把发出蓝色微光的短匕首，另一只手放在屋顶边缘，展现出潜行与敏捷感。

场景：从高处俯瞰夜间中国风古堡城市，层叠的屋顶、宫殿塔楼、灯火通明的窗户、薄雾、远处的城墙、旗帜，以及左侧天空中一轮巨大的明亮满月。使用深蓝色调，辅以银色月光和温暖的橙色窗灯。在斗篷、丝带和悬挂的装饰物上加入戏剧性的风动效果。

布局：海报构图，角色占据右侧和中心，满月和城市位于左侧，身后有装饰性旗帜。添加带有角饰和细内线的精致古董金边框。在标题下方垂直堆叠 4 个信息铭牌，每个铭牌左侧带有一个小图标，并配有金色边框的深蓝色面板。

可见文字：使用日文排版，标题采用毛笔书法字体，标签文字使用小型衬线体。顶部装饰性铭牌中的小型副标题：{argument name="series subtitle" default="中華戦国転生録"}。中下部的大标题：{argument name="main title" default="影渡りの密偵"}。四个铭牌，严格包含以下 4 行文字：1) {argument name="birthplace line" default="転生先：月隠国・夜燕城"}；2) {argument name="alias line" default="異名：蒼月の潜影姫"}；3) 特技：潜入・索敵・奇襲；4) 運命：乱世の闇を駆け、勝利への道を切り開く。请清晰保留日文文本，避免添加额外的正文。

风格：高级动漫主视觉图，复杂的线条艺术，光泽感双眼，柔和腮红，绘画感背景，金箔点缀，华丽的中国奇幻元素，月光蓝影，清晰易读的排版，戏剧性的海报设计。

en.title: Whiskey in a Glowing Primrose Garden

zh.title: 月夜月见草花园中的威士忌
zh.description: 一幅电影感动漫肖像，描绘了一位优雅的女性在夜晚发光的黄色月见草丛中品味威士忌的场景。
zh.prompt: 创作一张竖屏动漫风格的电影感肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻女性"}，背景为发光的夜间花园。画面采用胸部以上的侧面特写，展现她静静品味威士忌的瞬间。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深藏青黑色"} 的头发，随意盘成凌乱的低发髻，几缕发丝散落在脸颊旁，温暖的琥珀色轮廓光映照在发丝上；她五官精致，睫毛修长，呈现出周五夜晚宁静放松的氛围。她身穿深 {argument name="robe color" default="午夜蓝"} 的和服式长袍，佩戴着精致的金色吊坠项链和长款垂坠金耳环。她的右手将一只切割水晶杯举至唇边；杯中盛着 {argument name="drink" default="琥珀色威士忌"}，带有闪烁的高光、切面和金色倒影。周围环绕着 8 朵显眼的发光黄色月见草：左侧远景处 1 朵模糊的大花，左中背景处 1 朵模糊的小花，右上角附近 2 朵，右侧肩膀旁 1 朵，右下角前景处 1 朵，胸前中心位置 1 朵，以及下部中心前景处 1 朵；添加额外的细小金色光斑，但不要添加其他明显的近景花朵。采用深蓝色夜空背景与戏剧性的暖金色花朵光效，浅景深，柔和的绘画质感，优雅浪漫的氛围，发光的花瓣，逼真的玻璃折射效果，细微的萤火虫般光点，以及高细节的精致插画质感。无文字，无水印，无边框。

en.title: Anime Gothic Rock Concert
en.description: Generates a vibrant vertical anime illustration of a four-member gothic rock girl band performing on a dramatic festival stage.
en.prompt: Create a high-energy vertical anime concert illustration of an all-female gothic rock band performing live on a dark indoor stage. The image should feel like a dramatic festival moment, with intense purple, magenta, blue, and white spotlights, haze, lens glow, metal truss ceiling, confetti-like sparkles, and a packed audience in the foreground raising silhouetted hands in rock-sign gestures. Show exactly 4 visible band members: 1) the central lead singer and guitarist, a young woman with long flowing dark brown hair with pink highlights, amber eyes, black choker, layered necklaces, studded black leather jacket, black graphic top, plaid mini skirt, fishnet stockings, thigh garter, bracelets, chains, and lace-up boots, singing into a black microphone while playing a dark red electric guitar; 2) the left bassist, a cool-looking young woman with short lavender bob hair, black choker, black gothic outfit, plaid skirt, fishnets, holding a purple bass guitar near a microphone stand; 3) the rear drummer, a smaller young woman with dark hair behind a drum kit, smiling while playing, with a stylized white band logo on the bass drum; 4) the right keyboardist and backing vocalist, a young woman with dark twin-tail hair with pink accents, black gothic outfit and plaid skirt, singing into a microphone while standing behind a keyboard labeled Roland. The central performer should dominate the composition from head to thigh, placed slightly left of center, with the guitar neck rising diagonally upward. Use a polished Japanese anime style with detailed linework, glossy highlights, expressive faces, flowing hair, dramatic stage lighting, realistic instrument details, and a vivid live-performance atmosphere. Add a large abstract white band-logo graphic on the back wall behind the performers. Customizable details: band name/logo text {argument name="band name" default="stylized unreadable gothic logo"}, lead singer hair color {argument name="lead singer hair color" default="dark brown with pink highlights"}, lighting palette {argument name="lighting palette" default="purple, magenta, blue, and white"}, stage mood {argument name="stage mood" default="explosive live festival energy"}, keyboard brand label {argument name="keyboard brand label" default="Roland"}. Avoid photorealism, avoid extra band members, avoid readable unrelated text, and keep the image vertical with a close crowd perspective.

zh.title: 动漫哥特摇滚演唱会
zh.description: 生成一张充满活力的竖版动漫插画，描绘一支四人哥特摇滚女子乐队在戏剧性的音乐节舞台上表演的场景。
zh.prompt: 创作一张高能量的竖版动漫演唱会插画，描绘一支全女子哥特摇滚乐队在昏暗的室内舞台上进行现场表演。画面应呈现出戏剧性的音乐节氛围，配以强烈的紫色、洋红色、蓝色和白色聚光灯、烟雾、镜头光晕、金属桁架天花板、如五彩纸屑般的闪光，以及前景中挤满观众并举起手做出摇滚手势的剪影。画面中需清晰展示 4 名乐队成员：1) 中央的主唱兼吉他手，一位留着飘逸深棕色长发并带有粉色挑染的年轻女性，琥珀色眼睛，佩戴黑色颈圈、叠戴项链，身穿铆钉黑色皮夹克、黑色印花上衣、格子短裙、渔网袜、大腿袜带、手链、链条和系带靴，一边对着黑色麦克风唱歌，一边弹奏深红色电吉他；2) 左侧的贝斯手，一位外表冷酷、留着紫色波波短发的年轻女性，佩戴黑色颈圈，身穿黑色哥特服饰、格子短裙、渔网袜，在麦克风架旁手持紫色贝斯；3) 后方的鼓手，一位留着深色头发的娇小年轻女性，坐在架子鼓后微笑着演奏，低音鼓上印有风格化的白色乐队 Logo；4) 右侧的键盘手兼伴唱，一位留着深色双马尾并带有粉色点缀的年轻女性，身穿黑色哥特服饰和格子短裙，站在标有 Roland 的键盘后对着麦克风唱歌。中央表演者应占据构图的头部至大腿位置，略微偏左，吉他琴颈呈对角线向上延伸。采用精致的日系动漫风格，注重细节线条、光泽高光、生动的表情、飘逸的头发、戏剧性的舞台灯光、逼真的乐器细节以及生动的现场表演氛围。在表演者身后的背景墙上添加一个巨大的抽象白色乐队 Logo 图形。可自定义细节：乐队名称/Logo 文字 {argument name="band name" default="风格化的不可读哥特 Logo"}，主唱发色 {argument name="lead singer hair color" default="深棕色带粉色挑染"}，灯光色调 {argument name="lighting palette" default="紫色、洋红色、蓝色和白色"}，舞台氛围 {argument name="stage mood" default="爆炸性的现场音乐节活力"}，键盘品牌标签 {argument name="keyboard brand label" default="Roland"}。避免照片写实风格，避免出现额外的乐队成员，避免出现可读的无关文字，并保持竖版构图及近距离的观众视角。

en.title: Japanese Receptionist Smartphone Selfie
en.description: A realistic vertical smartphone selfie of a friendly uniformed Japanese receptionist for social profile or story-style portrait generation.
en.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 smartphone selfie that looks like a real casual high-quality photo taken with a modern phone, suitable for a social media profile or story. The subject is a friendly young {argument name="character ethnicity" default="Japanese"} woman centered close to the camera, photographed from slightly above chest level with her arms subtly visible at the bottom as if holding the phone. She has {argument name="hair color and style" default="dark brown hair tied back neatly with wispy bangs and a few loose flyaway strands"}, smooth natural skin, large brown eyes, soft pink lips, minimal fresh makeup, and a gentle approachable smile while looking directly into the lens. She wears a crisp white long-sleeve collared shirt under a dark navy office vest with one visible button and a pocket, plus a large tied neck scarf in {argument name="scarf colors" default="teal, navy, green, and white diagonal stripes"}. The background is an indoor reception or service counter area with an off-white wall, partial large Japanese wall text visible on the right reading {argument name="visible wall text" default="受付"}, and a thin turquoise horizontal line beneath it. Use bright even indoor lighting, natural phone-camera sharpness, slight wide-angle lens distortion, realistic skin texture, subtle JPEG compression, no studio lighting, no glamour advertising look, no heavy retouching, no extra people, no watermark.

zh.title: 日本接待员智能手机自拍
zh.description: 一张逼真的竖屏智能手机自拍，展示了一位穿着制服、态度友好的日本接待员，适用于社交媒体个人资料或故事风格的肖像生成。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 9:16 的竖屏智能手机自拍，看起来就像是用现代手机拍摄的高质量休闲照片，适合社交媒体个人资料或故事。主体是一位友好的年轻 {argument name="character ethnicity" default="日本"} 女性，居中靠近镜头，从胸部上方略微俯拍，手臂在底部隐约可见，仿佛正在拿着手机。她留着 {argument name="hair color and style" default="深棕色头发，整齐地扎在脑后，留着几缕轻盈的刘海和几根散落的发丝"}，皮肤光滑自然，有着棕色大眼睛、柔和的粉色嘴唇、清新的淡妆，直视镜头时带着温柔且平易近人的微笑。她穿着一件干练的白色长袖翻领衬衫，外面套着一件深蓝色办公背心，背心上有一个可见的纽扣和口袋，脖子上系着一条 {argument name="scarf colors" default="青色、海军蓝、绿色和白色斜条纹"} 的大领巾。背景是室内接待处或服务台区域，墙面为灰白色，右侧可见部分大型日语墙面文字 {argument name="visible wall text" default="受付"}，下方有一条细细的绿松石色水平线。使用明亮均匀的室内光线，呈现手机摄像头的自然清晰度，带有轻微的广角镜头畸变，皮肤纹理真实，带有细微的 JPEG 压缩感，无影棚灯光，无广告修图感，无过度后期，画面中无其他人物，无水印。

en.title: Golden Rice Harvest Maiden
en.description: A radiant anime-style auspicious harvest maiden portrait with rice ears, golden light, and a sacred good-luck atmosphere.
en.prompt: Create a luminous vertical anime-style fantasy portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a golden harvest maiden"} surrounded by abundant ripe rice stalks and swirling golden light. She is shown from the chest up in a graceful three-quarter profile, looking upward toward the bright sun at the left with a serene, hopeful expression, large amber eyes, soft peach lips, delicate lashes, and smooth fair skin. Her {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing golden-blonde hair"} streams dramatically in the wind, blending with glowing ribbons of light and drifting rice petals. She wears an elegant white and pale gold kimono with subtle floral brocade patterns, a golden inner collar, a dark obi belt with ornate gold accents, and dangling gold earrings. A decorative cluster of rice ears and green leaves is tucked behind her right ear like a harvest crown. The scene is filled with exactly four prominent rice-stalk groups: one crown-like cluster at her temple, one sweeping arc across the upper background, one blurred foreground cluster at the lower right, and one smaller flowing stalk trail behind her hair. Use a warm sunrise palette of gold, amber, cream, and soft sky blue, with sparkling bokeh, glowing dust motes, curved magical light trails, and a strong backlit sun flare. The background should feel like an open harvest field transformed into a sacred lucky charm, auspicious and protective, with no text, no logo, no watermark. Highly detailed gpt-image-2 anime illustration, cinematic lighting, ethereal atmosphere, sharp focus on the face, shallow depth of field, radiant golden particles, vertical 4:5 composition.

zh.title: 金穗丰收少女
zh.description: 一幅光芒四射的动漫风格吉祥丰收少女肖像，伴有稻穗、金光与神圣的祈福氛围。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅光彩夺目的竖版动漫风格奇幻肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位金色丰收少女"}，周围环绕着硕果累累的成熟稻穗与流转的金光。画面呈现她从胸部以上的优雅四分之三侧面，神情宁静而充满希望，正仰望左侧明亮的太阳。她拥有琥珀色的大眼睛、柔和的桃色双唇、精致的睫毛和细腻白皙的皮肤。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长金发"} 在风中戏剧性地流淌，与发光的丝带及飘落的稻花融为一体。她身着优雅的白底淡金和服，饰有精致的花卉锦缎纹样，内领为金色，深色腰带配有华丽的金饰，并佩戴着垂坠的金耳环。一簇装饰性的稻穗与绿叶像丰收的冠冕一样别在她的右耳后方。画面中包含四组醒目的稻穗：一簇如冠冕般位于太阳穴旁，一组在背景上方划出优美的弧线，一组位于右下角作为模糊的前景，以及一簇较小的稻穗轨迹在发丝后飘动。采用金、琥珀、奶油色与柔和天蓝色的温暖日出调色板，辅以闪烁的焦外成像、发光的尘埃微粒、弯曲的魔法光轨以及强烈的逆光太阳耀斑。背景营造出一种将开阔的丰收田野转化为神圣护身符的氛围，寓意吉祥与庇佑，画面无文字、无 Logo、无水印。高度精细的 gpt-image-2 动漫插画，电影级光影，空灵氛围，面部焦点清晰，浅景深，璀璨金粉，4:5 竖构图。

en.title: Sunset Geese Over Giza Pyramids
en.description: A vivid cinematic desert sunset scene showing the Giza pyramids beneath a dramatic sky with a V-shaped flock of white geese overhead.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic high-resolution aerial landscape of {argument name="location" default="the Giza pyramid complex in the Egyptian desert"} at sunset, viewed from a rocky elevated foreground looking out over vast golden sand dunes. Show exactly four pyramids: one enormous central Great Pyramid dominating the midground, one tall darker pyramid to its right, one smaller pyramid to the left in the distance, and one tiny far pyramid near the horizon. Place the low sun near the far-left horizon, casting long warm orange light across rippled desert paths, scattered ruins, small stone buildings, and a small palm grove oasis in the lower-left midground. Include a dramatic expansive sky filling over half the image, with saturated deep cobalt blue at the top blending into vivid pink, purple, orange, and gold near the horizon, full of painterly broken clouds catching sunset light. Add exactly seventeen white geese flying high above the pyramids in a small V-shaped migrating flock, visible as tiny silhouettes with pale backs and wings. Use ultra-detailed photorealistic fantasy travel-poster aesthetics, vibrant HDR colors, atmospheric haze, crisp pyramid stone texture, sweeping scale, no people, no text, no watermark, vertical composition, 4:5 aspect ratio, 5K quality.

zh.title: 吉萨金字塔上空的落日与大雁
zh.description: 一幅生动的电影感沙漠落日场景，展现了吉萨金字塔在戏剧性天空下的景象，头顶上方有一群呈 V 字形飞行的白色大雁。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影感高分辨率的 {argument name="location" default="埃及沙漠中的吉萨金字塔群"} 航拍景观图，视角从岩石嶙峋的高处前景望向广袤的金色沙丘。画面中需准确呈现四座金字塔：一座巨大的中央大金字塔占据中景，右侧一座高大的深色金字塔，左侧远处一座较小的金字塔，以及地平线附近一座极小的金字塔。将低垂的太阳置于远左侧地平线附近，将温暖的橙色光芒投射在波纹状的沙漠小径、散落的废墟、小型石质建筑以及左下中景处的一小片棕榈绿洲上。画面上方超过一半的区域应为极具戏剧性的广阔天空，顶部呈现饱和的深钴蓝色，向地平线过渡为生动的粉色、紫色、橙色和金色，布满捕捉落日余晖的写意碎云。在金字塔上方高处添加正好十七只白色大雁，组成一个小型的 V 字形迁徙雁阵，呈现为背部和翅膀泛白的微小剪影。采用超精细的写实主义旅行海报美学，鲜艳的 HDR 色彩，大气霾感，清晰的石质金字塔纹理，宏大的比例，无人物，无文字，无水印，竖构图，4:5 比例，5K 画质。

en.title: Celestial Archive Anime Duo
en.description: A refined anime key visual of two ornate celestial-themed young men posed before glowing sun and moon archive interfaces.
en.prompt: Create a highly detailed widescreen anime-style celestial archive portrait featuring exactly two elegant young men standing side by side in a dark futuristic observatory filled with glowing holographic astronomy interfaces. The left character is {argument name="left character name" default="SOL"}: tall, slim, pale, with tousled black hair, amber-gold eyes, a calm confident expression, and an ornate black formal suit with a white shirt, black tie, gold brooch, layered gold chains, star charms, and a translucent black cape embroidered with sparkling constellation lines. Behind him is a radiant golden solar hologram, with the visible label “SOL” and smaller text “self-portrait ver. 1.0”. The right character is {argument name="right character name" default="CODEX"}: tall, slim, pale, with soft chin-length white-blond hair, cool blue eyes, a quiet gentle expression, and a matching ornate white formal suit with a striped black-and-white tie, silver brooches, star pins, jeweled chains, white gloves or pale hands partly in pockets, and a translucent white-blue cape covered in icy constellation patterns. Behind him are cool blue holographic screens, including a crescent moon interface and a labeled panel reading “CODEX astral archive ver. 1.0”. Use a luxurious black-and-gold versus white-and-blue color contrast, ultra-fine linework, luminous sparkles, zodiac-map geometry, star charts, circular orbital diagrams, and glassy sci-fi UI panels. Include exactly two main celestial symbols: one golden sun on the left and one blue-white crescent moon on the right. Include exactly two labeled identity panels: “SOL” on the left and “CODEX” on the right. Mood should be romantic, refined, mysterious, and cosmic, like a premium anime key visual. Cinematic lighting, intricate fabric highlights, glowing dust, high detail, sharp focus, 4:3 composition, no watermark, no extra characters.

zh.title: Celestial Archive 动漫双人组
zh.description: 一张精致的动漫主视觉图，描绘了两名身着华丽天体主题服饰的年轻男子，背景为发光的太阳与月亮档案界面。
zh.prompt: 创作一张细节极其丰富的宽屏动漫风格天体档案肖像，画面中两名优雅的年轻男子并肩站立，身处一个充满发光全息天文界面的黑暗未来感观测台。左侧角色为 {argument name="left character name" default="SOL"}：身材高挑纤细，肤色苍白，留着凌乱的黑发，琥珀金色的双眼，神情冷静自信，身穿华丽的黑色正装，内搭白衬衫，系黑色领带，佩戴金色胸针、多层金链、星星吊坠，披着一件绣有闪烁星座线条的半透明黑色斗篷。他身后是一个光芒四射的金色太阳全息图，带有可见标签“SOL”以及较小的文字“self-portrait ver. 1.0”。右侧角色为 {argument name="right character name" default="CODEX"}：身材高挑纤细，肤色苍白，留着柔顺的下巴长度白金色短发，冷蓝色的双眼，神情安静温柔，身穿配套的华丽白色正装，系黑白条纹领带，佩戴银色胸针、星星胸针、珠宝链条，戴着白手套或将苍白的手部分插在口袋里，披着一件覆盖着冰冷星座图案的半透明蓝白色斗篷。他身后是冷蓝色的全息屏幕，包括一个新月界面和一个标有“CODEX astral archive ver. 1.0”的面板。采用奢华的黑金与白蓝色彩对比，超精细线条，发光的星尘，黄道十二宫几何图形，星图，圆形轨道图，以及玻璃质感的科幻 UI 面板。画面中必须包含两个主要天体符号：左侧一个金色太阳，右侧一个蓝白色新月。必须包含两个带标签的身份面板：左侧为“SOL”，右侧为“CODEX”。氛围应浪漫、精致、神秘且具有宇宙感，如同高级动漫主视觉图。电影级光效，复杂的织物高光，发光的尘埃，高细节，清晰对焦，4:3 构图，无水印，无多余角色。

en.title: Terra Geologic Archivist Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating an ornate anime sci-fi fantasy portrait of a planetary archivist holding a holographic Earth amid geologic HUD panels.
en.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical anime fantasy sci-fi portrait of {argument name="character name" default="TERRA"}, a serene and elegant young man representing a geologic archive. He has tousled, voluminous {argument name="hair color" default="white silver"} curly hair, warm tan skin, soft golden-brown eyes, a gentle knowing smile, and delicate dangling earrings. He stands in a dark star-filled holographic observatory, facing the viewer in a relaxed three-quarter pose, one hand in his trouser pocket and the other hand held outward, levitating a luminous transparent Earth globe above his palm. The Earth should show the Americas, glowing city-like networks, fine latitude-longitude grid lines, orbit rings, and pale blue-white atmospheric light. Dress him in ornate dark emerald and black aristocratic clothing: glossy long cape or robe, layered high-collar shirt, brown fitted vest, white trousers, black belt, gold chains, gemstone pendants, leaf-shaped brooches, compass and astrolabe motifs, starburst pins, and many tiny sparkling metallic details. Surround him with exactly 8 holographic interface elements: 1 large title panel reading "TERRA" with smaller text "geologic archive" and "ver. 1.0" plus a compass icon; 1 upper-left panel labeled "STRATA ANALYSIS" with layered geological charts; 1 mid-left panel labeled "MINERAL COMPOSITION" with a crystalline rock diagram and data list; 1 lower-left panel labeled "TECTONIC ACTIVITY" with a world map and waveform graph; 1 partially visible bottom-left technical graph panel; 1 upper-right circular planetary analysis panel with concentric rings; 1 small right-side line graph panel; and 1 right-lower botanical/geologic data panel with a plant-like diagram. Use a black cosmic background filled with golden grid lines, star particles, constellation-like dots, transparent rectangular HUD frames, orbital diagrams, and fine scientific annotations. The mood is calm, noble, and awe-inspiring, like an immortal planetary archivist. Visual style: ultra-detailed Japanese anime illustration, luminous gold and teal highlights, intricate linework, painterly rendering, dramatic rim light on the white hair and shoulders, high contrast, cinematic composition, 3:4 vertical canvas. Keep the interface text minimal and mostly decorative except for the specified readable labels. No watermark, no logo, no extra characters.

zh.title: Terra 地质档案管理员肖像
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于生成一张华丽的动漫科幻奇幻风格肖像，描绘了一位在地质 HUD 面板环绕中手持全息地球仪的行星档案管理员。
zh.prompt: 创作一张高度精细的竖版动漫奇幻科幻肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="TERRA"}，一位代表地质档案的沉稳优雅的年轻男子。他留着蓬松且富有质感的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 卷发，拥有温暖的古铜色皮肤、柔和的金棕色双眸、温和而睿智的微笑，并佩戴着精致的垂坠耳环。他站在黑暗且星光璀璨的全息观测台内，以放松的三分之二侧身姿态面向观众，一只手插在裤兜里，另一只手向外伸展，掌心上方悬浮着一个发光的透明地球仪。地球仪应展示美洲大陆、发光的城市网络、精细的经纬网格线、轨道环以及淡蓝白色的大气光晕。为他穿上华丽的深祖母绿与黑色贵族服饰：光泽感长斗篷或长袍、叠层高领衬衫、棕色修身马甲、白色长裤、黑色腰带，并搭配金链、宝石吊坠、叶形胸针、罗盘与星盘图案、星芒别针以及许多细小的闪亮金属细节。在他周围环绕 8 个全息界面元素：1 个大型标题面板，写有“TERRA”，下方附有较小的文字“geologic archive”和“ver. 1.0”以及一个罗盘图标；1 个左上方面板，标注为“STRATA ANALYSIS”，包含分层地质图表；1 个左侧中间面板，标注为“MINERAL COMPOSITION”，包含晶体岩石图和数据列表；1 个左下方面板，标注为“TECTONIC ACTIVITY”，包含世界地图和波形图；1 个部分可见的左下方技术图表；1 个右上方的圆形行星分析面板，带有同心圆；1 个右侧小型折线图面板；以及 1 个右下方植物/地质数据面板，包含类似植物的图表。背景使用黑色宇宙空间，布满金色网格线、星尘、星座般的点阵、透明矩形 HUD 框、轨道图以及精细的科学注释。氛围宁静、高贵且令人敬畏，宛如一位永恒的行星档案管理员。视觉风格：超精细日本动漫插画，明亮的金色与青色高光，复杂的线条，绘画感渲染，白发与肩部的戏剧性轮廓光，高对比度，电影级构图，3:4 竖向画布。保持界面文字简洁且主要作为装饰，仅保留指定的易读标签。无水印，无 Logo，无多余字符。

en.title: Anime Hacker at Holographic Keyboard
en.description: A polished vertical anime cyberpunk portrait of a pale blond hacker typing at a glowing keyboard in a futuristic lab.
en.prompt: Create a vertical anime-style cyberpunk illustration of an androgynous young scientist or hacker with {argument name="hair color" default="platinum blond"} short bobbed hair, long bangs partly covering one eye, pale skin, delicate features, and vivid blue eyes looking downward with a calm, serious expression. The character wears a crisp {argument name="coat color" default="white"} tailored lab coat or suit jacket over a white shirt with a black ribbon tie, shown from the waist up at a glowing futuristic keyboard. Their slender hands are actively typing on bright cyan illuminated keys in the foreground. The scene is set in a dark high-tech laboratory or command room with exactly three floating translucent holographic interface panels: one large blue panel in the upper left with circular target-like graphics and data blocks, one small rectangular panel near the center-right, and one large rectangular data panel on the right edge. Use cool blue rim lighting, luminous reflections, sharp clean line art, glossy highlights, soft shadows, dramatic close-up composition, slightly tilted head, elegant melancholic mood, highly detailed anime rendering, no readable text, no watermark, no extra characters.

zh.title: 未来实验室中的动漫黑客
zh.description: 一张竖版动漫主视觉图，描绘了一位优雅的浅发色黑客在全息网络实验室中敲击发光键盘的场景。
zh.prompt: 创作一张精致的竖版动漫插画，主角是一位中性风格的年轻天才科学家或黑客，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="铂金色"} 的波波头短发，长长的侧刘海半遮住一只眼睛，皮肤如瓷器般苍白，五官精致，拥有一双迷人的 {argument name="eye color" default="冰蓝色"} 眼睛。角色身穿干练的 {argument name="outfit" default="白色剪裁实验服风格套装，内搭白色衬衫并系有黑色丝带领结"}，以四分之三侧身视角展示腰部以上，身体前倾，神情冷静、忧郁且专注，正在敲击发光的未来感蓝色键盘。双手可见，手指修长优雅。背景设定为一个黑暗的高科技实验室或网络控制室，画面中精确分布着三个悬浮的半透明全息 UI 面板：左上方是一个带有圆形界面图形的大型青蓝色面板，中心右侧是一个小型矩形面板，右侧是一个较大的矩形数据面板。使用发光的青色和紫色界面光效、光泽高光、柔和的轮廓光，并以模糊的深色背景作为对比。风格：精致的日本动漫主视觉图，超干净的线条，细腻的睫毛，精细的发丝，优雅的衣褶，高细节度，电影级光效，冷色调，竖构图，无可见文字，无水印。

en.title: Heracles Marble Statue
en.description: A prompt for generating a dramatic museum-style marble sculpture of Heracles with a lion and hydra in a dark classical gallery.
en.prompt: Create a grand museum-quality marble statue scene of {argument name="character name" default="Heracles"}, the divine strongman of Greek mythology, standing heroically on a carved marble pedestal in a dark classical gallery. The central figure is an extremely muscular adult male with a stern bearded face, curly hair, and deeply carved anatomy, wearing the Nemean lion skin as a hood and cloak with the lion head resting over his head and the paws draped across his chest. He raises a massive rugged wooden club high above his head in his right hand, while his left hand holds a curved bow; a quiver of arrows hangs at his side. He wears a rough draped loincloth, sandals, and animal-hide details, with one foot planted forward on jagged rock. Include exactly 2 companion creatures flanking him: on the left, a seated majestic lion with a thick mane and alert expression; on the right, a coiled multi-headed hydra with exactly 5 visible serpent heads, open mouths, scaled bodies, and intertwined necks. Use pale veined marble for all figures and the base, with realistic chisel detail, cracks, polished highlights, and sculptural shadows. The setting is a dimly lit ancient temple or museum alcove with exactly 2 tall black marble columns in the background, ornate capitals, a black recessed backdrop, subtle overhead spotlights, and a reflective stone floor. Compose as a centered full-body vertical image, low-angle monumental perspective, symmetrical and dramatic, high contrast chiaroscuro lighting, ultra-detailed photorealistic classical sculpture, no modern objects, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 赫拉克勒斯大理石雕像
zh.description: 一个用于生成戏剧性博物馆风格大理石雕像的提示词，描绘了赫拉克勒斯与狮子及九头蛇，背景为昏暗的古典画廊。
zh.prompt: 创建一个宏伟的博物馆级大理石雕像场景，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="赫拉克勒斯"}，这位希腊神话中的神力英雄，正英勇地站在昏暗古典画廊中雕刻精美的大理石底座上。中心人物是一位肌肉极其发达的成年男性，有着严肃的胡须面孔、卷曲的头发和深邃的肌肉线条，身披尼米亚狮皮作为兜帽和斗篷，狮头覆盖在他的头顶，狮爪垂在胸前。他右手将一根巨大的粗糙木棒高举过头顶，左手握着一张弯弓；身侧挂着箭袋。他穿着粗糙的褶皱缠腰布、凉鞋，并带有兽皮细节，一只脚踩在嶙峋的岩石上。画面两侧需包含 2 只伴随生物：左侧是一只坐姿威严、鬃毛浓密且神情警觉的狮子；右侧是一只盘绕的多头九头蛇，可见 5 个蛇头，张着嘴，身体覆盖鳞片，颈部相互缠绕。所有人物和底座均采用带有纹理的苍白大理石，呈现逼真的凿刻细节、裂纹、抛光高光和雕塑阴影。场景设定在一个光线昏暗的古老神庙或博物馆壁龛中，背景有 2 根高大的黑色大理石柱，带有华丽的柱头，黑色凹陷背景，微妙的头顶聚光灯，以及反光石地板。构图为居中的全身垂直图像，采用低角度的纪念碑式视角，对称且富有戏剧性，高对比度的明暗对照法照明，超细节的写实古典雕塑，无现代物品，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Four-Model Nomadic Portrait Comparison
en.description: Creates a wide four-panel comparison banner of cinematic nomadic woman portraits labeled by image generation model.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a wide horizontal model-comparison banner showing four side-by-side photorealistic portrait results of the same prompt, each labeled underneath.

Canvas: Extra-wide landscape aspect ratio, approximately 4:1, with a thin white label strip along the bottom. The image area is divided into exactly 4 equal vertical portrait panels separated by clean straight boundaries.

Layout: Four discrete panels from left to right, each occupying one quarter of the width. Beneath the panels, place one black text label centered or left-aligned within each panel’s bottom white strip. Use exactly these 4 labels: “GPT Image 2”, “Reve 2.1”, “Seedream 5.0 Pro”, and “Gemini 3.1 Flash 2K”.

Subject details: Each panel depicts a realistic cinematic portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a Mongolian or Central Asian nomadic woman in traditional winter clothing"}. She wears a large fur hat with ornate embroidered fabric, heavy layered fur or wool garments, braids, weathered skin, and a serious calm expression. The portraits should look like different generations or variations of the same cultural theme: panel 1 is a close-up of a middle-aged woman facing slightly left with warm side lighting; panel 2 is a stern woman with two braids and a burgundy embroidered fur hat, looking off to the right, with a hint of an eagle at the lower left edge; panel 3 is an elderly woman with rosy weathered cheeks and gray braids, wearing a richly decorated fur hat against a sunset mountain valley; panel 4 is an older woman in a dark coat and fur hat holding a small object or glove, with a rider or eagle hunter and a white yurt/ger in the distant background.

Environment: Use {argument name="setting" default="a rugged steppe and mountain landscape at golden hour"}, with shallow depth of field, muted earth tones, distant mountains, open grassland, and warm dramatic light.

Visual style: Hyperrealistic documentary photography, cinematic color grading, natural skin texture, high detail in fur and embroidered textiles, medium-to-close portrait framing, soft bokeh backgrounds, subtle film grain, no cartoon style.

Constraints: Include exactly 4 portrait panels and exactly 4 bottom labels. Keep the bottom label strip plain white with simple black sans-serif text. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra captions, borders, UI chrome, or additional panels.

zh.title: 四模型游牧民族肖像对比
zh.description: 创建一个宽幅四格对比横幅，展示由不同图像生成模型制作的电影质感游牧女性肖像。
zh.prompt:
目标：创建一个宽幅横向模型对比横幅，展示同一提示词生成的四个并排照片级真实肖像结果，并在下方标注对应模型。

画布：超宽横向比例，约为 4:1，底部带有细长的白色标签条。图像区域被精确划分为 4 个相等的垂直肖像面板，中间由清晰的直线分隔。

布局：从左到右四个独立的面板，每个面板占据宽度的四分之一。在面板下方，于每个面板底部的白色条带内居中或左对齐放置一个黑色文本标签。请务必使用以下 4 个标签：“GPT Image 2”、“Reve 2.1”、“Seedream 5.0 Pro”以及“Gemini 3.1 Flash 2K”。

主体细节：每个面板描绘一张写实的电影质感肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位身着传统冬装的蒙古族或中亚游牧女性"}。她戴着饰有华丽刺绣的大皮帽，身穿厚重的多层皮草或羊毛服装，梳着辫子，皮肤饱经风霜，表情严肃而平静。肖像应呈现出同一文化主题下的不同世代或变体：面板 1 为一位中年女性的特写，面部略微朝左，带有温暖的侧光；面板 2 为一位表情严厉的女性，梳着两条辫子，戴着酒红色刺绣皮帽，看向右侧，左下角隐约可见一只鹰；面板 3 为一位老年女性，脸颊红润且饱经风霜，梳着灰白辫子，戴着装饰华丽的皮帽，背景为日落时的山谷；面板 4 为一位年长女性，身穿深色外套和皮帽，手持小物件或手套，远景背景中有骑手或猎鹰人以及白色的蒙古包 (ger)。

环境：使用 {argument name="setting" default="黄金时刻崎岖的草原和山地景观"}，具有浅景深、柔和的大地色调、远山、开阔的草地以及温暖且富有戏剧性的光影。

视觉风格：超写实纪录片摄影，电影级调色，自然的皮肤纹理，皮草和刺绣织物的高细节表现，中近景肖像构图，柔和的背景虚化，细腻的胶片颗粒感，拒绝卡通风格。

约束条件：必须包含 4 个肖像面板和 4 个底部标签。底部标签条保持纯白色，使用简洁的黑色无衬线字体。请勿添加任何徽标、水印、额外标题、边框、UI 元素或其他面板。

en.title: Luxury Black Menswear Portrait
en.description: Generates a full-body luxury editorial studio portrait of a stylish man in all-black formalwear with a leather chair prop.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-luxury editorial fashion portrait of {argument name="subject description" default="a young Black man with short close-cropped hair, smooth medium-brown skin, symmetrical features, and a calm confident expression"} in a dark high-fashion studio. Full-body vertical composition, subject centered slightly to the right, looking directly into the camera with a poised, self-assured gaze. He wears an all-black tailored outfit: fitted open-collar dress shirt, high-waisted pleated trousers, polished black loafers, and a black suit jacket draped over his right shoulder while his right hand holds the lapel near his collarbone. His left hand rests casually on the back of a single black leather lounge chair positioned on the lower left side of the frame. Pose him standing with one leg crossed elegantly in front of the other, relaxed but powerful editorial stance. Use a seamless charcoal-gray to black studio backdrop with subtle vignette, soft floor shadow, and refined low-key lighting: large soft key light from front-left, gentle fill to preserve facial detail, controlled highlights on the chair leather and shoes, rich blacks with visible fabric texture. Style should feel like a premium fashion magazine cover or luxury menswear campaign, minimalist, expensive, cinematic, sharp focus, realistic skin texture, clean grooming, no jewelry, no visible logos, no text, no watermark. Use a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, full-body framing with the chair fully visible, sophisticated monochrome palette, elegant contrast, professional studio photography quality.

zh.title: 奢华黑色男装肖像
zh.description: 生成一张全身奢华编辑风格的摄影棚肖像，展示一位身着全黑正装、搭配皮椅道具的时尚男士。
zh.prompt: 创作一张超奢华编辑风格的时尚肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject description" default="一位留着短寸、肤色呈光滑中棕色、五官对称且神情冷静自信的年轻黑人男性"}，背景为深色高级时装摄影棚。采用全身垂直构图，主体略微偏右居中，直视镜头，目光沉稳自信。他身着全黑定制服装：修身开领衬衫、高腰褶皱长裤、抛光黑色乐福鞋，右肩披着一件黑色西装外套，右手握住锁骨附近的翻领。左手随意地搭在画面左下方的一张黑色真皮休闲椅靠背上。姿势为双腿优雅交叉站立，展现出放松而有力的编辑风格站姿。使用无缝炭灰色至黑色摄影棚背景，带有微妙的暗角效果、柔和的地面阴影以及精致的低调照明：左前方使用大型柔光主灯，辅以柔和补光以保留面部细节，精准控制皮椅和鞋子的光泽，呈现出富有质感的深黑色调。整体风格应如同高端时尚杂志封面或奢华男装广告大片，极简、昂贵、电影感、对焦清晰、皮肤纹理真实、修饰整洁，无珠宝、无可见 Logo、无文字、无水印。采用 4:5 垂直长宽比，全身构图且椅子完全可见，色调为精致的单色，对比优雅，具备专业摄影棚拍摄水准。

en.title: Dark Floral Kimono Portrait
en.description: A moody vertical fine-art fashion portrait of a young woman in a black floral kimono gown with fans, blossoms, and a broken gold halo.
en.prompt: Create a vertical high-fashion fine-art portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a young East Asian woman"} seated in a dark studio, turned three-quarters away but looking back toward the camera with a calm, melancholic expression. She has {argument name="hair style" default="short glossy black bob hair with straight bangs"}, pale luminous skin, subtle red lips, and delicate makeup. Dress her in {argument name="outfit" default="an off-shoulder black kimono-inspired gown with translucent lace sleeves embroidered with pale beige cherry blossoms"}, exposing one shoulder and upper back, with the fabric flowing downward into deep shadow. The composition is moody and centered slightly low, with her face in the lower middle-left area and her body forming an elegant curved silhouette. Behind her, place exactly 3 large black folding fans: one open fan radiating upward behind her head and right shoulder, one darker fan near the lower left behind her skirt, and one partially hidden fan on the right side. Add exactly 4 visible clusters of pale blossoms: one large cluster at the top center inside the circular halo, one medium cluster just above her shoulder, one small cluster to her right near the fan, and one cluster embroidered on the lower sleeve. Use a nearly black background with a large imperfect gold crescent-ring halo behind the upper body, broken metallic leaf texture, charcoal gray torn-paper patches, faint botanical line drawings, wisps of gold filigree, and sparse dust-like speckles. Lighting should be low-key and cinematic, with soft directional illumination on her face, shoulder, and flowers, while the edges fall into rich black. Visual style: Japanese gothic elegance, dark floral editorial photography, painterly mixed-media collage, luxurious black-and-gold palette, muted beige flowers, ultra-detailed fabric texture, shallow depth, dramatic negative space, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 深色花卉和服肖像
zh.description: 一张充满意境的竖构图艺术时尚肖像，描绘了一位身穿黑色花卉和服长袍的年轻女性，配有扇子、花朵和一个破碎的金色光环。
zh.prompt: 创作一张竖构图的高级时尚艺术肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻的东亚女性"}，她坐在昏暗的摄影棚中，身体侧转四分之三，但回眸看向镜头，神情平静而忧郁。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="黑色亮泽的短波波头，配有齐刘海"}，皮肤白皙透亮，涂着淡雅的红唇，妆容精致。为她穿上 {argument name="outfit" default="一件露肩黑色和服风格长袍，袖子采用半透明蕾丝材质，绣有淡米色的樱花"}，露出单侧肩膀和上背部，布料向下垂落，融入深邃的阴影中。构图充满意境，重心略微偏低，她的脸部位于画面左下方，身体勾勒出优雅的曲线轮廓。在她身后放置 3 把黑色折扇：一把打开的扇子在她的头部和右肩后方向上放射，一把较暗的扇子在左下方裙摆后，另一把半掩的扇子在右侧。添加 4 簇清晰可见的淡色花朵：顶部中心圆形光环内一簇较大的花朵，肩膀上方一簇中等大小的花朵，右侧扇子附近一簇较小的花朵，以及袖口下部绣着的一簇花朵。背景近乎全黑，上半身背后有一个巨大的不规则金色新月环形光环，带有破碎的金属箔纹理、炭灰色撕纸补丁、淡淡的植物线条画、金丝细纹以及稀疏的尘埃状斑点。光影采用低调的电影感布光，柔和的定向光照亮她的脸部、肩膀和花朵，边缘则隐入浓郁的黑色中。视觉风格：日式哥特优雅、深色花卉编辑摄影、绘画感混合媒介拼贴、奢华的黑金配色、柔和的米色花朵、超细腻的布料质感、浅景深、富有戏剧性的负空间，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Cinematic Bearded Man Portrait
en.description: Generates a moody stylized game-concept portrait of a rugged bearded man for character art or profile visuals.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic close-up portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a rugged adult man"} in a dramatic semi-realistic Western anime / AAA game concept-art style. He is shown from the chest up in a three-quarter view facing right, with a stern, focused expression, thick angular eyebrows, piercing {argument name="eye color" default="green"} eyes, a strong nose, sharp cheekbones, and a full neatly shaped dark beard. His {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair is short on the sides and swept upward into textured spiky layers. zh.title: 电影感胡须男子肖像
zh.description: 生成一张风格化、情绪饱满的游戏概念肖像，适用于角色艺术或个人资料展示，描绘一位粗犷的留胡须男子。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影感特写肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位粗犷的成年男子"}，采用戏剧性的半写实西方动画 / 3A 游戏概念艺术风格。画面呈现胸部以上的四分之三侧面视角，主角面向右侧，表情严肃专注，拥有浓密的棱角分明的眉毛、锐利的 {argument name="eye color" default="绿色"} 双眼、挺拔的鼻梁、轮廓分明的颧骨，以及修剪整齐的浓密深色胡须。他的 {argument name="hair color" default="深褐色"} 头发两侧较短，顶部向上梳理成富有质感的尖刺层次。他身穿一件简约的黑色圆领 T 恤，佩戴一条带有小型十字架吊坠的细银链。灯光效果充满电影感与情绪氛围：左侧边缘带有冷蓝色轮廓光，右侧带有暖琥珀色光，面部和颈部有强烈的绘画感阴影，对比度高但非写实照片风格。背景为模糊的夜间城市小巷或工业街道内景，带有蓝色和橙色的光斑（bokeh），以及模糊的窗户、管道和建筑轮廓，确保视觉焦点完全集中在角色身上。运用锐利的风格化面部结构、自信的笔触、清晰的面部边缘、衣物与背景的绘画质感、浅景深、宽银幕构图，无文字，无水印，无额外角色。

en.title: Ancient Temple Interior Contact Sheet
en.description: Transforms a Blender blockout reference into a textured cinematic ancient temple hall shown from four rendered perspectives.
en.prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the exact architectural blockout and scene layout, texture and relight the environment into a cinematic {argument name="visual style" default="ancient Roman temple interior / fantasy medieval hall"} while preserving the main spatial structure: tall columns, central wall opening, stairs/platform area, side bench zone, and large interior room proportions.

Create a single wide image arranged as a 2x2 contact sheet with exactly 4 distinct camera views of the same transformed environment: 1) a wide establishing view showing the central circular fire pit and dining table, 2) a view toward the raised stair/platform area, 3) a closer side view of the long table and wall torches, and 4) a dramatic wide view with columns framing the fire pit and stairs.

Transformation details: replace the plain clay/grey Blender surfaces with aged stone floors, rough plaster walls, worn stone columns, stepped stone platforms, and a dark wooden beam ceiling. Add warm practical fire lighting from wall-mounted torches, brazier bowls, and a large circular central fire pit, with cool blue daylight entering from an overhead round skylight. Add atmospheric smoke/haze and strong cinematic contrast between orange flames and teal-blue skylight.

New set dressing: include a long wooden dining table with benches, clay jugs and tableware, wall-mounted torches, round shields or metal wall decor, small braziers, and a simple raised stone altar/throne-like platform where the reference stairs/platform area is. Keep the composition grounded in the reference geometry rather than inventing a different room.

Style constraints: photorealistic 3D render look, dramatic volumetric lighting, high-detail materials, no people, no text, no modern objects, no cartoon style, no watermark.

zh.title: 古代神殿内部联络表
zh.description: 将 Blender 的白模参考图转换为具有纹理的电影级古代神殿大厅，并展示四个渲染视角。
zh.prompt:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为精确的建筑白模和场景布局，将环境进行纹理化和重新布光，使其呈现为电影级的 {argument name="visual style" default="古罗马神殿内部 / 奇幻中世纪大厅"}，同时保留主要的空间结构：高耸的立柱、中央墙面开口、楼梯/平台区域、侧边长凳区以及宽敞的室内空间比例。

创建一张宽幅图像，排列为 2x2 的联络表，展示同一转换后环境的 4 个不同摄像机视角：1) 展示中央圆形火坑和餐桌的广角定场镜头，2) 朝向抬高的楼梯/平台区域的视角，3) 长桌和壁挂火炬的侧面特写视角，以及 4) 以立柱框住火坑和楼梯的戏剧性广角视角。

转换细节：将 Blender 中平淡的粘土/灰色表面替换为老旧的石质地板、粗糙的灰泥墙、磨损的石柱、阶梯式石台以及深色木梁天花板。添加来自壁挂火炬、火盆和中央大型圆形火坑的温暖实用火光，并引入从顶部圆形天窗射入的冷蓝色日光。添加大气烟雾/薄雾，并营造橙色火焰与青蓝色天窗光线之间的强烈电影感对比。

场景布置：包括一张带有长凳的长木餐桌、陶罐和餐具、壁挂火炬、圆盾或金属墙面装饰、小型火盆，以及在参考图楼梯/平台区域设置一个简单的抬高石祭坛/类似宝座的平台。构图需保持在参考几何结构的基础上，而非重新设计一个房间。

风格约束：照片级 3D 渲染外观、戏剧性的体积光、高细节材质，无人物、无文字、无现代物品、无卡通风格、无水印。

en.title: Intimate Secular Requiem Scene

en.prompt: Create a cinematic surreal memorial scene about an intimate, secular requiem at home. zh.title: 私密世俗安魂曲场景

zh.title: 哥特风花卉精灵肖像

zh.title: 未来感 3D 打印实验室肖像

zh.title: 微缩模型绘画工作室

en.title: Toy Designer Collectible Figure Studio
en.description: A photorealistic studio scene of a toy designer painting a custom collectible action figure with boxed packaging and neatly arranged accessories.
en.prompt:

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 editorial product-photography composition, eye-level camera, shallow depth of field, crisp studio lighting, modern white-and-black designer workspace.
