文本内容：左上角使用醒目的大号中文标题：{argument name="headline text" default="漫画的\n创作逻辑"}。下方添加较小的加粗中文文案：{argument name="subheadline text" default="就这么水灵灵的被\nGPT-2 解锁了"}，其中“GPT-2”使用大号珊瑚红色，其余部分使用深青色/黑色。添加一条绿色下划线和较短的文案：{argument name="tagline" default="这个思路，真是让人好生喜欢"}。在标语附近添加装饰性的珊瑚色小闪光符号和手绘爱心。

功能卡片：在左下方垂直堆叠 4 张圆角横向卡片，每张卡片左侧有一个圆形图标，右侧为加粗中文标签。卡片 1 为浅绿色，配有打开的笔记本和铅笔图标，标签为 {argument name="card one label" default="日记转"}。卡片 2 为浅黄色，配有从书中升起的灯泡图标，标签为“知识转”。卡片 3 为浅桃色，配有冒热气的爱心马克杯图标，标签为“鸡汤转”。卡片 4 为淡紫色，配有纸飞机图标，标签为“各种转换，\n玩的飞起”。从 4 张卡片各引出一条虚线箭头指向右侧飞出的漫画素材；使用相匹配的柔和箭头颜色。

右侧主体细节：在右上角绘制 1 把巨大的浅绿灰色开锁挂锁，锁身上有粉笔画风格的涂鸦：微小的对话框、漫画缩略图和简单的角色草图。在锁孔中插入 1 把金色钥匙；钥匙柄为钢笔尖形状，象征着书写解锁漫画。让锁孔发出温暖的黄色光芒。

飞出的漫画素材：展示 6 个从打开的书本向锁孔漂浮的纸张/漫画元素：1 张小型肖像草图纸、1 张四格漫画页、1 张带有黄色图像块的单页布局、1 张双人对话漫画页、1 张粉色小纸条和 1 张较大的横向漫画条。在它们周围添加弯曲的运动轨迹、闪光、小爱心、箭头和对话框，但保持漂浮纸张的总数为 6 个。

底部插图：在右下角绘制 1 本打开的漫画书，左页可见漫画分镜和一个可爱的简笔角色；使用细深青色线条和浅黄色高光。在海报底部边缘添加柔和的云朵状浅绿色形状。

视觉风格：可爱的中文社交媒体海报美学，手绘线条艺术，圆润的无衬线中文字体，复古印刷颗粒，马卡龙色点缀，清晰的层级，奇思妙想的教育风格。

约束：保持 4 张功能卡片和 6 个飞出的纸张/漫画元素。不要添加额外的重大板块、额外 Logo、水印、二维码或除“GPT-2”之外的英文解释性文字。

en.title: Golden Hour Hatirjheel Fashion Portrait
en.description: An ultra-realistic editorial fashion portrait of a lone South Asian woman on the Hatirjheel waterfront in Dhaka at golden hour.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic editorial fashion photograph in vertical 3:4 orientation, shot at golden hour on the Hatirjheel lakeside promenade in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The scene contains exactly one person: a beautiful young {argument name="model ethnicity" default="South Asian"} woman in her early 20s, full-body view, standing beside a decorative black metal waterfront railing with one hand resting lightly on the rail, relaxed posture, looking to her left with a calm confident expression. She has {argument name="hair color and style" default="long straight dark brown hair parted in the middle"}, natural makeup, and warm rim light on her face and hair. Outfit: exactly four main visible clothing/accessory items — a fitted ribbed {argument name="top color" default="cream beige"} long-sleeve knit top tucked into high-waisted black wide-leg trousers, black pointed flats, and a black wristwatch. Background: Hatirjheel water glowing with sunset reflections on the left, one large white arched bridge softly blurred in the distance, one vintage black streetlamp behind her, one black rectangular sign on a pole to the right displaying {argument name="sign text" default="হাতিরঝিল, ঢাকা"} in white Bengali lettering, and a row of palm trees along the promenade with about five visible trunks receding into the background. Use shallow depth of field, 50mm editorial portrait look, realistic skin texture, natural proportions, warm cinematic color grading, soft haze, and high-end fashion magazine composition. Keep the model as the only person in the image; no men, no other women, no crowds, no tourists, no photographers, and no vehicles in the foreground.

zh.title: Hatirjheel 黄金时刻时尚人像
zh.description: 一张超写实的编辑风格时尚人像，拍摄于达卡 Hatirjheel 湖畔，画面中是一位处于黄金时刻的南亚女性。
zh.prompt: 创作一张超写实的编辑风格时尚摄影作品，采用 3:4 竖构图，拍摄于孟加拉国达卡 Hatirjheel 湖滨步道的黄金时刻。场景中仅包含一人：一位美丽的年轻 {argument name="model ethnicity" default="南亚"} 女性，20 岁出头，全身照，站在装饰性的黑色金属滨水栏杆旁，一只手轻轻搭在栏杆上，姿态放松，向左侧看，表情平静而自信。她留着 {argument name="hair color and style" default="中分长直深棕色头发"}，妆容自然，脸部和头发上有温暖的轮廓光。服装：明确包含四件主要的可见衣物/配饰 — 一件修身罗纹 {argument name="top color" default="米色"} 长袖针织衫，束进高腰黑色阔腿裤中，搭配黑色尖头平底鞋和一块黑色腕表。背景：左侧是映照着夕阳余晖的 Hatirjheel 湖水，远处有一座柔焦处理的大型白色拱桥，她身后有一盏复古黑色路灯，右侧立柱上有一块黑色长方形标牌，上面用白色孟加拉语显示着 {argument name="sign text" default="হাতিরঝিল, ঢাকা"}，步道旁有一排棕榈树，约五棵树干向背景延伸。使用浅景深，50mm 编辑人像风格，真实的皮肤纹理，自然的比例，温暖的电影级调色，柔和的雾气，以及高端时尚杂志的构图。保持模特为画面中唯一的人；前景中不得出现男性、其他女性、人群、游客、摄影师或车辆。

Outfit: a fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top tucked into high-waisted wide-leg black trousers, black pointed flats, and a dark wristwatch. Background: calm lake water with soft reflections, the white arched Hatirjheel bridge on the left in the distance, palm trees on the right, a paved walkway, low landscaping with green shrubs and small red flowers, and a dark signboard reading {argument name="sign text" default="হাতিরঝিল, ঢাকা"}. Lighting is warm sunset/golden hour with gentle rim light, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, crisp fashion editorial detail, natural colors, 35mm full-frame photography look, high resolution. Constraints: the model must be the only person visible; include exactly one person, one visible signboard, one arched bridge, and two prominent palm tree trunks; no men, no extra women, no crowds, no tourists, no photographers, no foreground vehicles, no distracting logos, no watermark, no text other than the signboard.

zh.prompt: 创作一张超写实的编辑风格时尚肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位美丽的南亚年轻女性"}，她正独自站在孟加拉国达卡的 Hatirjheel 湖畔步道上，时间为黄金时刻。她位于全身垂直构图的中心，对着镜头温暖微笑，一只手插在裤兜里，另一只手轻轻触碰耳边的头发。她留着柔顺的棕色长发，带有细微的挑染，妆容自然精致，姿态优雅自信。着装：修身米色罗纹长袖针织衫，搭配高腰黑色阔腿裤，穿着黑色尖头平底鞋，佩戴深色手表。背景：平静的湖水映衬着柔和的倒影，左侧远处可见白色的 Hatirjheel 拱桥，右侧有棕榈树，铺设整齐的步道，低矮的景观绿植和红色小花，以及一块深色指示牌，上面写着 {argument name="sign text" default="হাতিরঝিল, ঢাকা"}。光线为温暖的日落/黄金时刻，带有柔和的轮廓光，皮肤纹理真实，景深较浅，呈现出清晰的时尚编辑细节，色彩自然，具有 35mm 全画幅摄影质感，高分辨率。约束条件：画面中只能出现该模特一人；必须包含且仅包含一个人、一个可见的指示牌、一座拱桥和两棵显眼的棕榈树树干；禁止出现男性、其他女性、人群、游客、摄影师、前景车辆、干扰性标志、水印，以及除指示牌文字之外的任何文字。

zh.prompt: 创作一张超写实的时尚杂志风格照片，拍摄对象为 {argument name="model description" default="一位 20 岁出头、容貌姣好的南亚女性"}，地点位于孟加拉国达卡的 Hatirjheel，时间为黄金时刻。画面中仅有模特一人，她优雅地坐在湖边宽阔的石阶上，面朝镜头，神情从容自信。她留着栗棕色的长直发，中分，妆容自然，有着温暖的棕色双眸，面部光线柔和均匀。她身穿 {argument name="top" default="一件修身的米色罗纹长袖针织衫"}、{argument name="pants" default="高腰黑色剪裁长裤"}，脚穿黑色平底鞋，佩戴着一块精致的手表。姿势要求：一条腿向上弯曲，另一条腿向前景斜向伸展，一只手放在膝盖上，另一只手放在身旁的台阶上。背景展示在日落余晖下泛着橙光的湖水、背景中虚化的桥梁、棕榈树、修剪整齐的绿植、温暖的步道灯，以及右侧一块写有 {argument name="sign text" default="হাতিরঝিল, ঢাকা"} 的绿色指示牌。采用浅景深和奶油般柔美的虚化效果，呈现真实的皮肤质感、自然的比例、时尚杂志的构图、温暖的电影级调色以及高分辨率的单反相机细节。保持前景完全清爽：没有男性、没有其他女性、没有人群、没有游客、没有摄影师、没有车辆、没有多余的人、没有杂物、没有水印、没有扭曲的手部、没有多余的肢体。

zh.prompt: 创作一张超写实的编辑类时尚摄影作品，拍摄一位美丽的年轻 {argument name="model ethnicity" default="南亚"} 女性，她独自坐在孟加拉国达卡 Hatirjheel 的木质公园长椅上，时间为黄金时刻。画面中只有她一人，姿态优雅，一只手臂靠在长椅靠背上，双腿交叠，眼神略微看向镜头外，表情沉稳自信。她留着深棕色的长直发，中分，妆容自然精致，身穿修身的米色罗纹长袖上衣、黑色高腰剪裁长裤、黑色尖头平底鞋，并佩戴一块深色手表。在她身后，包含一个蓝色的路边指示牌，上面印有白色的孟加拉语文字 {argument name="location sign text" default="হাতিরঝিল, ঢাকা"}，安装在金属柱上。场景为干净的湖畔长廊，铺设着温暖的瓷砖路面，配有黑色金属栏杆和系船柱、修剪整齐的绿植、棕榈树、复古风格的路灯，静止的水面反射着琥珀色的夕阳，背景中隐约可见一座混凝土桥梁。使用温暖的电影感黄金时刻光效、柔和的阴影、浅景深、真实的皮肤质感、清晰的时尚杂志构图、85mm 镜头效果、高动态范围、自然色彩，避免过度磨皮。严禁出现其他任何人物、人群、游客、摄影师、男性、女性、儿童、前景中的车辆、杂物、标志和水印。

en.title: Desert Fashion Bandeau Portrait
en.description: A high-contrast fashion prompt for a woman in a desert landscape, emphasizing realistic film grain and midday sun lighting.
en.prompt: A {argument name="ethnicity" default="young Korean woman"} wears a {argument name="swimsuit style" default="camel bandeau swimsuit"} with a white gauze wrap trailing across the {argument name="setting" default="cracked desert floor"} behind her. Midday sun is directly overhead, producing hard contrast and minimal soft shadow. Medium close shot, slightly low angle, her gaze directed off-camera, desert ridgeline visible but heavily out of focus behind her. Vertical portrait orientation, 2:3 aspect ratio. Render with photographic realism: subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, avoid over-smoothed CG textures. Skin: subsurface scattering and micro-texture. Hair: subtle natural imperfection.

zh.title: 沙漠时尚抹胸人像
zh.description: 一款高对比度的时尚提示词，描绘沙漠景观中的女性，强调逼真的胶片颗粒感和正午阳光照明。
zh.prompt: 一位 {argument name="ethnicity" default="年轻韩国女性"} 穿着一件 {argument name="swimsuit style" default="驼色抹胸泳衣"}，身后拖着一条白色纱巾，置身于 {argument name="setting" default="龟裂的沙漠地面"} 上。正午的太阳直射头顶，产生强烈的对比和极少的柔和阴影。中近景拍摄，略微仰角，她的目光看向画外，背景可见沙漠山脊线但处于深度虚化状态。竖构图人像，2:3 纵横比。以摄影写实风格渲染：阴影区域带有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，避免过度平滑的 CG 质感。皮肤：次表面散射和微纹理。头发：细微的自然瑕疵。

en.title: Rocky Desert Halter Swimsuit Portrait
en.description: A prompt for a close-up cinematic portrait of a woman in a rocky desert, focusing on harsh light, shadow interplay, and natural skin details.
en.prompt: A {argument name="ethnicity" default="young Korean woman"} stands on {argument name="setting" default="rocky desert ground"}, wearing a {argument name="swimsuit style" default="white halter swimsuit"} with a pale linen wrap draped loosely over one arm. It is midday, with harsh overhead sun creating hard-edged shadows across her collarbone and shoulders. Shot at eye level with an 85mm lens, close-up framing on her face and upper torso as she turns three-quarters toward camera, blurred sandstone cliffs behind her. Warm desert tones, high contrast light and shadow. Vertical portrait orientation, 2:3 aspect ratio. Render with photographic realism: subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, avoid over-smoothed CG textures, preserve natural imperfections throughout. Skin: subsurface scattering and micro-texture, not digital smoothing. Hair: subtle natural imperfection, not geometric perfection.

zh.title: 岩石沙漠挂脖泳装人像
zh.description: 一张关于女性在岩石沙漠中拍摄的电影感特写人像提示词，侧重于强光、阴影交错以及自然的皮肤细节。
zh.prompt: 一位 {argument name="ethnicity" default="年轻韩国女性"} 站在 {argument name="setting" default="岩石沙漠地面"} 上，身穿一件 {argument name="swimsuit style" default="白色挂脖泳装"}，手臂上松散地披着一条浅色亚麻披肩。正值中午，强烈的头顶阳光在她的锁骨和肩膀上投下边缘清晰的阴影。以 85mm 镜头平视拍摄，特写她的面部和上半身，她向镜头转过四分之三侧身，背景是模糊的砂岩悬崖。暖色调沙漠背景，高对比度的光影。竖构图人像，2:3 宽高比。以摄影写实风格渲染：阴影区域带有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，避免过度平滑的 CG 纹理，保留整体的自然瑕疵。皮肤：呈现次表面散射和微纹理，而非数字平滑处理。头发：呈现自然的细微不完美，而非几何般的完美。

en.title: Cinematic Subway Face Reconstruction
en.description: A detailed prompt designed for reconstructive portrait photography, placing a face from a reference photo into a cinematic subway scene with realistic lighting and motion blur.
en.prompt:
Upload one reference photo of your face. Using the uploaded image, accurately reconstruct your face and place yourself in this exact {argument name="location" default="subway station"} scene as an upper body portrait only. You are standing on the platform, body slightly angled left, head tilted upward and to the right at 20 to 25 degrees, looking up past the camera with a deeply introspective, melancholic expression, not looking at the lens.

{argument name="glasses style" default="Thick black rectangular frame glasses"}. {argument name="clothing" default="Dark black high collar structured overcoat"} buttoned up. Directly behind you, a subway train is rushing past at full speed.

Extreme horizontal motion blur fills the entire background, silver grey train body blur with vivid electric blue stripe streak and warm orange light streak within the blur. Cool teal blue green fluorescent overhead lighting falls naturally on your face and hair from above. Subtle blue train light catches the edge of your right shoulder. Cool cinematic color grade with teal shadows and cool skin tones. Fine film grain.

Do NOT paste your face. The cool fluorescent teal light must fall naturally on your face from above with realistic shadows, a subtle blue rim light on your right shoulder, and a consistent cool color cast across your face that perfectly matches the underground subway environment. 1:1.

zh.title: 电影感地铁人脸重构
zh.description: 专为重构肖像摄影设计的详细提示词，将参考照片中的人脸置于具有逼真光影和动态模糊的电影感地铁场景中。
zh.prompt:
上传一张你的面部参考照片。利用上传的图像，精准重构你的面部，并将你置于这个特定的 {argument name="location" default="地铁站"} 场景中，仅限上半身肖像。你正站在站台上，身体微微向左倾斜，头部向上并向右倾斜 20 到 25 度，目光越过镜头向上看，表情深沉忧郁，不要直视镜头。

{argument name="glasses style" default="加粗黑色长方形框架眼镜"}。身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="深黑色高领结构感大衣"}，扣子扣好。你的正后方，一列地铁正全速疾驰而过。

极端的水平动态模糊充斥着整个背景，银灰色车身模糊，伴随着鲜艳的电光蓝条纹和模糊中温暖的橙色光带。冷青蓝色的顶置荧光灯从上方自然地投射在你的脸部和头发上。微妙的蓝色列车光线映照在你右肩边缘。冷色调电影级调色，青色阴影，冷肤色。细腻的胶片颗粒感。

请勿直接粘贴人脸。冷色调的青色荧光必须从上方自然地落在你的脸上，形成逼真的阴影，右肩带有微妙的蓝色轮廓光，且面部呈现出与地下地铁环境完美匹配的冷色调。比例 1:1。

en.title: Ethereal Morning Sunlight Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed Japanese-style portrait prompt for GPT Image 2, capturing a woman in a bright bedroom during the morning, emphasizing soft lighting and graceful posture.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Fingertips scooping light"}

Main Character:
A {argument name="age" default="woman in her 20s"} is kneeling on a bed in a bright bedroom, stretching her upper body gracefully. The person occupies a large part of the center of the screen, and her arms stretched overhead and the lines of her legs spread to the left and right fit within the vertical frame. Floating her hips above the white bedding, the natural curves of her torso and her thin waistline are clearly visible.

Person & Expression:
Light ivory beige skin with faint pink blood color and natural texture. Delicate highlights on cheeks, tip of nose, shoulders, and collarbone. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink brown eye makeup, thin long eyelashes, natural tear bags, soft brown eyebrows, and clear pink beige lips. Mouth slightly open, turning a calm and sleepy gaze toward the camera. {argument name="hair color" default="Bright milk tea ash brown"} medium-long hair. Thin see-through bangs and layers around the face, hair ends loosely curled inward, flowing naturally to shoulders and back.

Clothing & Pose:
White-based, short room wear layered with very thin chiffon and soft gauze. Half sleeves are slightly translucent, with thin ruffles at the collar and hem, and a small light blue ribbon and faint plant pattern on the chest. The fabric caught in backlighting is softly translucent, but the chest and waist are elegantly covered with thin matching lining to avoid explicit skin exposure. The hem ends slightly below the base of the legs. Both arms stretched high overhead, wrists bent inward, and fingertips slightly open. Right knee in the lower right of the screen, left leg extending to the left, slightly arching the waist and placing center of gravity on both knees.

Background & Light:
A quiet bedroom based on light wood grain and white, with a large window in a wooden frame. White duvet and light blue small flower pattern blanket in the foreground, person in the middle ground, thin curtains, foliage plants, wooden wainscoting, small photos, and daily sundries in the background. Strong warm morning sun enters diagonally from behind from the window, brightly translucently illuminating arms, hair, shoulders, and edges of clothing. Soft reflected light from the white bedding hits the face, and the person's shadow is cast faintly to the lower left of the screen. Background text is blurred to an unreadable degree.

Composition & Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Eye level looking down slightly from the bedside, slight Dutch angle. Full body from above the knees to the fingertips overhead, with the face placed slightly above the center of the screen. A small amount of white space above the head, leaving wide soft folds of bedding at the bottom of the screen. Natural perspective equivalent to 35-50mm. Focus on face and upper body, gently blurring the background.

Texture & Style:
Japanese-style portrait photography utilizing natural light. Bright high-key tone, low contrast, warm cream and light blue color scheme. Skin is not excessively polished, leaving fine peach fuzz and natural shadows. Carefully depicts the fibers of the translucent cloth, wrinkles in the bedding, and thin highlights on each strand of hair. Soft film grain and a clean magazine photo finish.

zh.title: 空灵晨光人像
zh.description: 一款专为 GPT Image 2 设计的高细节日系人像提示词，捕捉清晨明亮卧室中的女性，强调柔和光影与优雅姿态。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="指尖掬光"}

主要人物：
一位 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁的女性"} 跪在明亮卧室的床上，优雅地舒展上身。人物占据屏幕中心大部分区域，头顶上方伸展的双臂以及向左右两侧延伸的双腿线条均处于竖构图内。臀部悬于白色床品之上，躯干的自然曲线与纤细腰线清晰可见。

人物与表情：
象牙米色皮肤，透出淡淡的粉色血色与自然质感。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀和锁骨处有细腻的高光。淡玫瑰粉色腮红，香槟米色与粉棕色眼妆，纤长睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和的棕色眉毛，以及清透的粉米色嘴唇。嘴唇微张，向镜头投去平静而慵懒的目光。{argument name="hair color" default="明亮的奶茶灰棕色"} 中长发。轻薄的空气刘海与脸周层次感，发尾向内自然卷曲，顺滑地垂落在肩部与背部。

服装与姿态：
以白色为主的短款家居服，叠穿极薄的雪纺与柔软纱布。半袖微透，领口与下摆饰有细褶边，胸前点缀着浅蓝色小丝带与淡雅的植物花纹。背光下的织物呈现柔和的半透明感，但胸部与腰部优雅地覆盖了同色系薄衬里，避免过度裸露。下摆垂至大腿根部下方。双臂高举过头顶，手腕内扣，指尖微张。右膝位于屏幕右下方，左腿向左侧延伸，腰部微拱，重心置于双膝之上。

背景与光影：
以浅木纹与白色为基调的静谧卧室，配有木框大窗。前景为白色羽绒被与浅蓝色小碎花毯，中景为人物，背景可见薄窗帘、观叶植物、木质护墙板、小照片及日常杂物。强烈的暖色晨光从窗后斜射入内，明亮地照亮了手臂、发丝、肩膀与衣物边缘，呈现出半透明感。来自白色床品的柔和反射光照亮面部，人物阴影淡淡地投射在屏幕左下方。背景文字模糊，不可辨认。

构图与摄影：
竖构图 3:4。从床边略微俯视的视平线角度，轻微的荷兰式倾斜。全身构图，从膝盖上方至头顶指尖，面部置于屏幕中心略上方。头顶留有少量留白，屏幕底部留有大面积柔软的床品褶皱。相当于 35-50mm 的自然透视。焦点位于面部与上身，背景轻微虚化。

质感与风格：
利用自然光的日系人像摄影。明亮的高调风格，低对比度，暖奶油色与浅蓝色调。皮肤未过度磨皮，保留了细微的绒毛与自然阴影。细腻地刻画了半透明布料的纤维、床品的褶皱以及每一根发丝上的细微高光。带有柔和的胶片颗粒感，呈现出干净的杂志摄影质感。

en.title: Luxury Instagram Product Collage
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a premium 3x3 product campaign collage with an editorial aesthetic, featuring macro textures, lifestyle shots, and consistent branding.
en.prompt: Create a premium luxury 3×3 Instagram product campaign collage in a {argument name="aesthetic" default="warm beige editorial"} aesthetic with {argument name="lighting" default="soft golden-hour"} lighting, {argument name="background" default="creamy neutral"} background, elegant shadows, ultra-realistic commercial photography, and cinematic color grading. Every panel features the same product with consistent branding, packaging, proportions, and colors. The 9 images include: (1) hand holding or interacting with the product, (2) dramatic floating hero shot with ingredients and dynamic particles suspended in mid-air, (3) extreme macro close-up highlighting premium texture and fine details, (4) artistic splash or motion scene matching the product theme, (5) minimalist premium poster with large elegant serif typography displaying the product name and brand, (6) flat-lay of key natural ingredients and supporting elements, (7) luxurious lifestyle product beauty shot in a styled environment, (8) cinematic serving, pouring, cutting, spraying, or usage action depending on the product category, (9) happy lifestyle model naturally enjoying or using the product. Editorial luxury advertising style, Apple-level commercial quality, ultra-photorealistic, soft diffused light, shallow depth of field, crisp focus, premium packaging design, high-end branding, refined composition, clean minimal aesthetic, magazine-quality product photography, 8K, HDR, award-winning commercial advertising.

zh.title: 奢华 Instagram 产品拼贴图
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于生成具有编辑审美、包含微距纹理、生活方式镜头和一致品牌形象的 3x3 高端产品营销拼贴图。
zh.prompt: 创建一个高端奢华的 3×3 Instagram 产品营销拼贴图，采用 {argument name="aesthetic" default="暖米色编辑风"} 审美，搭配 {argument name="lighting" default="柔和黄金时刻"} 灯光和 {argument name="background" default="奶油中性色"} 背景，呈现优雅阴影、超写实商业摄影效果和电影级调色。每个板块均展示同一产品，并保持品牌形象、包装、比例和色彩的一致性。这 9 张图片包括：(1) 手持或与产品互动的镜头，(2) 极具戏剧性的悬浮主体照，配以悬浮在空中的成分和动态颗粒，(3) 突出高级纹理和精细细节的极致微距特写，(4) 与产品主题相符的艺术飞溅或动态场景，(5) 极简主义高级海报，使用优雅的大号衬线字体展示产品名称和品牌，(6) 关键天然成分及辅助元素的平铺图，(7) 在精致环境中拍摄的奢华生活方式产品美照，(8) 根据产品类别呈现的电影级倒出、喷洒、切割或使用动作，(9) 模特自然享受或使用产品的快乐生活方式照。编辑级奢华广告风格，Apple 级别的商业品质，超写实摄影，柔和漫射光，浅景深，清晰对焦，高级包装设计，高端品牌感，精致构图，干净极简审美，杂志级产品摄影，8K，HDR，屡获殊荣的商业广告。

en.title: Street Style Fashion Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for a candid, sunlit street photography shot of a woman in casual fashion, perfect for achieving a realistic DSLR look with specific clothing and accessories.
en.prompt: A candid full-body street-style photo of a {argument name="subject" default="smiling young woman"} walking confidently through a sunlit parking lot. She has dark hair tied in a high bun and wears narrow oval black sunglasses. She is dressed in a {argument name="top style" default="fitted black halter tube top featuring a large graphic print of a white cat wearing black sunglasses"}, paired with high-waisted black pinstripe wide-leg trousers. A small {argument name="accessory" default="metallic silver shoulder bag with a chain strap"} hangs from one shoulder. She carries a flat cardboard pizza box under one arm while holding a pair of sunglasses and a small black key fob in her other hand. She has subtle tattoos on her arms, a smartwatch on one wrist, and a bright, cheerful expression. The background shows parked cars, green trees, and a roadside with storefronts under clear afternoon sunlight. Natural lighting, realistic colors, casual fashion photography, eye-level perspective, sharp focus, high detail, photorealistic, DSLR quality, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field.

zh.title: 街头时尚人像
zh.description: 一份用于生成自然、阳光明媚的街头摄影风格照片的详细提示词，主角为身着休闲时尚服饰的女性，非常适合实现具有特定服装和配饰的逼真单反相机效果。
zh.prompt: 一张抓拍的全身街头风格照片，主角是 {argument name="subject" default="一位面带微笑的年轻女性"}，正自信地走在阳光明媚的停车场中。她留着深色头发，扎着高丸子头，戴着窄框黑色椭圆形太阳镜。她身穿 {argument name="top style" default="一件修身的黑色挂脖抹胸，上面印有戴着黑色太阳镜的白猫大图案"}，搭配高腰黑色细条纹阔腿裤。单肩背着一个 {argument name="accessory" default="带有链条肩带的银色金属质感单肩包"}。她一只手臂下夹着一个扁平的披萨纸盒，另一只手拿着一副太阳镜和一个黑色小钥匙扣。她的手臂上有精致的纹身，手腕上戴着智能手表，表情明亮愉悦。背景是停放的汽车、绿树以及午后阳光下带有店面的路边。自然光，色彩逼真，休闲时尚摄影，平视视角，焦点清晰，高细节，照片级真实感，单反相机质量，35mm 镜头，浅景深。

en.title: Ultra Realistic Korean Style Smartphone Selfie
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a candid, casual smartphone selfie of a young East Asian woman. It emphasizes natural lighting, skin textures, and a cozy bedroom environment to avoid a synthetic AI look.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic smartphone selfie, genuinely looks like it was casually captured with a mobile phone, not a DSLR or AI render. A {argument name="subject" default="beautiful young East Asian woman"} with very fair porcelain skin, a delicate V-shaped face, soft almond-shaped brown eyes, subtle Korean makeup with natural pink lips, light eyeliner, and a {argument name="haircut" default="short shoulder-length pastel pink bob haircut with airy wispy bangs"} framing her face.
She is sitting comfortably on a neatly made bed inside a {argument name="setting" default="cozy minimalist bedroom"} with warm cream-colored walls. The background features a small aesthetic collage of pastel art prints and floral posters, creating a soft Korean-inspired room decor. She wears a cute white knit sweater with pink ribbed collar and sleeve cuffs featuring a vintage cartoon kitten graphic, giving a cozy, feminine, and youthful aesthetic.
She leans slightly toward the camera with both arms naturally extended as if holding the phone herself, wearing a gentle smile with one eye slightly squinting in a playful expression. The framing is a close upper-body selfie from a slightly high handheld angle. Soft natural daylight enters through a nearby window, producing flattering diffused lighting and realistic skin tones.
The image includes subtle smartphone HDR processing, slight sensor noise, natural skin texture, mild edge softness, realistic indoor exposure, authentic white balance, and a tiny amount of handheld imperfection. No professional lighting, no studio setup, no AI-perfect sharpness, no excessive beauty filter, and no exaggerated bokeh. It should feel spontaneous, cozy, and exactly like a real flagship smartphone front-camera selfie posted on social media.
Aspect Ratio: 3:4
Style: Ultra-photorealistic, natural smartphone selfie, candid indoor portrait, Korean aesthetic, cozy bedroom, authentic mobile camera quality, realistic lighting, high detail.

zh.title: 超逼真韩系智能手机自拍
zh.description: 这是一条高度详细的提示词，用于生成一张年轻东亚女性的抓拍感、随性智能手机自拍。它强调自然光线、皮肤纹理和舒适的卧室环境，以避免产生人工合成的 AI 感。
zh.prompt:
超逼真的智能手机自拍，看起来就像是用手机随手拍摄的，而非单反相机或 AI 渲染。画面主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="美丽的年轻东亚女性"}，拥有白皙如瓷的皮肤、精致的 V 字脸、柔和的棕色杏仁眼，妆容为清透的韩系妆，搭配自然的粉色嘴唇、淡眼线，以及一款 {argument name="haircut" default="齐肩粉色波波头，配有空气感轻薄刘海"} 修饰脸型。
她舒适地坐在整洁的床上，身处一个 {argument name="setting" default="温馨简约的卧室"}，背景墙面为暖奶油色。背景中装饰着几张美学拼贴画和花卉海报，营造出柔和的韩系房间氛围。她穿着一件可爱的白色针织毛衣，领口和袖口带有粉色罗纹，并印有复古卡通小猫图案，展现出温馨、女性化且充满青春气息的审美。
她身体微微前倾，双臂自然伸展，仿佛正在自己拿着手机拍摄，脸上带着温柔的微笑，一只眼睛微微眯起，表情俏皮。构图为从略高的手持角度拍摄的近景上半身自拍。柔和的自然光从附近的窗户射入，带来均匀的漫反射光线和真实的肤色。
图像包含细微的智能手机 HDR 处理效果、轻微的传感器噪点、真实的皮肤纹理、轻微的边缘柔化、真实的室内曝光、自然的白平衡以及少许手持拍摄的不完美感。没有专业灯光，没有影棚布置，没有 AI 带来的过度锐化，没有夸张的美颜滤镜，也没有过度的虚化。整体效果应显得随性、温馨，就像一张发布在社交媒体上的真实旗舰手机前置摄像头自拍。
长宽比：3:4
风格：超写实摄影，自然智能手机自拍，室内抓拍人像，韩系美学，温馨卧室，真实的手机摄像头画质，真实光影，高细节。

en.title: High Contrast Rim Lit Portrait
en.description: A prompt for a stylized profile portrait featuring dramatic red-orange rim lighting and high contrast. It describes a woman taking a mirror selfie with specific fashion and makeup details.
en.prompt:
Don't change your features
3:4 aspect ratio
A close-up portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} in sharp profile against a {argument name="background" default="pale, neutral background"}. She is wearing a slightly oversized, light burgundy baseball cap backwards, with the brim tilted upward. {argument name="lighting" default="Dramatic, intense red-orange rim lighting"} illuminates the right side of her face, highlighting her defined features, sharp black winged eyeliner, and glossy, slightly parted red lips. A hand with dark nail polish is positioned near her mouth; she is taking a mirror selfie with her face turned to the side. The left side of her face is in shadow, creating high contrast. The composition is tight, focusing intensely on the subject's expression and the striking lighting effect.

zh.title: 高对比度轮廓光人像
zh.description: 这是一个用于生成风格化侧面人像的提示词，具有强烈的红橙色轮廓光和高对比度效果。它描述了一位女性拍摄镜面自拍的场景，并包含了具体的时尚和妆容细节。
zh.prompt:
Don't change your features
3:4 宽高比
一张 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 的特写人像，以 {argument name="background" default="浅色中性背景"} 为衬托，呈现清晰的侧面轮廓。她反戴着一顶略显宽松的浅酒红色棒球帽，帽檐向上倾斜。{argument name="lighting" default="戏剧性的强力红橙色轮廓光"} 照亮了她脸部的右侧，突显出她分明的五官、锐利的黑色猫眼眼线以及光泽感十足、微微张开的红唇。一只涂着深色指甲油的手靠近嘴部；她正侧着脸进行镜面自拍。脸部左侧处于阴影中，形成了强烈的对比。构图紧凑，聚焦于人物的表情和引人注目的光影效果。

en.title: Editorial Lifestyle Magazine Cover
en.description: A sophisticated prompt for creating a Japandi-style magazine cover. It features a woman in a minimalist setting with high-end tech and furniture details.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic editorial lifestyle magazine cover featuring a {argument name="subject" default="thoughtful Korean woman"} in a relaxed oversized cream cashmere knit and wide-leg linen trousers, eyes gently closed in deep listening pleasure, one hand resting on a {argument name="speaker" default="Sonos Era 300 speaker"} on a {argument name="furniture" default="minimalist walnut shelf"} beside her. Glowing warm skin, zero-makeup fresh look, soft hair in a loose low ponytail. Background: warm Japandi-style living room — low walnut furniture, warm diffused lamp light, linen textiles, soft bokeh plants. "MONOCLE" masthead in bold clean modern sans-serif. 50mm lens, ultra-detailed Sonos mesh fabric texture and walnut base, 8K photorealistic warm lifestyle. 

Negative: cartoon, blurry, cluttered, watermark, cold tones.

zh.title: 编辑风格生活杂志封面
zh.description: 一个用于创作日式北欧风（Japandi）杂志封面的精致提示词。画面展现了一位身处极简主义环境中的女性，并包含高端科技产品与家具细节。
zh.prompt:
超写实编辑风格生活杂志封面，主角为一位 {argument name="subject" default="若有所思的韩国女性"}，身穿宽松的奶油色羊绒针织衫和亚麻阔腿裤，双眼轻闭，沉浸在聆听的愉悦中，一只手轻放在 {argument name="furniture" default="极简主义胡桃木架"} 上的 {argument name="speaker" default="Sonos Era 300 音箱"} 旁。皮肤散发温暖光泽，清透裸妆，头发松散地扎成低马尾。背景：温暖的日式北欧风（Japandi）客厅——低矮的胡桃木家具、温暖的漫射灯光、亚麻织物、柔和的虚化植物。杂志刊头“MONOCLE”采用粗体、简洁的现代无衬线字体。50mm 镜头，超精细的 Sonos 网布纹理与胡桃木底座，8K 照片级真实感温暖生活风格。

负面提示词：卡通、模糊、杂乱、水印、冷色调。

en.title: Character Quad View Reference Sheet
en.description: A structured prompt for generating a four-panel character reference sheet, including a three-quarter view and facial close-ups against a neutral background.
en.prompt: Generate a character three-view drawing with a {argument name="background color" default="gray"} background and nothing in the hands. Add a close-up of the character's face for a total of four character photos. All four panels should be arranged in vertical order without text, and the character's face should be facing the camera. The face close-up should be clearly visible, while the smaller faces should be pixelated. Aspect ratio {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"}.

zh.title: 角色四格视图参考图
zh.description: 一个用于生成四格角色参考图的结构化提示词，包含四分之三侧视图及中性背景下的面部特写。
zh.prompt: 生成一张角色三视图，背景颜色为 {argument name="background color" default="gray"}，手中不持有任何物品。添加一张角色面部特写，总共包含四张角色图像。所有四格画面应垂直排列且不含文字，角色面部需面向镜头。面部特写应清晰可见，而较小的面部图像应进行像素化处理。长宽比为 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:9"}。

en.title: Hyper-Realistic Macro Eye Portrait
en.description: A specialized prompt focusing on extreme close-up facial details, realistic skin texture, and intricate eye anatomy using macro photography styles.
en.prompt: [Character] Fully refer to the face and hair of the character in the reference image I uploaded. Cinematic ultra-photorealistic extreme close-up portrait photography, with an 18-22 year old adult male/female as the main subject. The gender can be replaced as needed, or a character reference image can be uploaded to maintain consistency in facial features, hairstyle, and identity. Maintain the character's original facial recognizability while presenting a more natural, gentle, and approachable state. The character's temperament is quiet, confident, and natural, not deliberately posed, like a moment captured in real photography. [Expression] The character shows a very playful smile, corners of the mouth turned up, with real laughter in the eyes, facial muscles naturally relaxed, and slight natural changes in the apple muscles. The smile is warm and healing. [Composition] The image shows only about half of the face, with one eye as the sole visual focus. The character stares directly at the camera. The composition is bold, with strong visual pressure and artistic tension. [Skin Texture] Real and natural skin texture, completely preserving pores, fine vellus hair, subtle skin tone fluctuations, slight freckles, local redness, small acne marks, shallow textures, and other real skin characteristics. No skin smoothing or beautification treatments. The skin has natural oily highlights and real subcutaneous texture. [Eye Details] Exquisite and natural eye makeup, clean and smooth eyeliner, soft eyeshadow layers without excessive exaggeration; the iris presents a complex radial fiber structure, the pupil edges are sharp and clear, the cornea has real wet reflections, and highlights comply with physical optical laws; eyelashes vary in thickness and are naturally arranged; eyebrows are thick and grow in a specific direction, retaining a small amount of messy hair; the nose wings, lips, and facial edges have real skin textures, and the lip lines are delicate and natural. [Hair] Hair strands are real and natural, including fine strands, fluff, and slight flyaways. The character's facial structure conforms to real human anatomical proportions, with no AI deformities, no over-editing, no plastic skin, and no wax figure texture. [Lighting] Uses soft cinematic rim lighting combined with weak contour light to shape three-dimensional facial layers. Dark areas retain rich details, with natural light and dark transitions. The lighting is soft and full of atmosphere, without harsh shadows or HDR effects. [Background] The background is completely blurred, retaining only soft color blocks and environmental atmosphere. An extremely shallow depth of field highlights the eye focus. The overall aesthetic has high-end editorial magazine, documentary portrait, and museum-grade art photography qualities. [Camera Specifications] Real photography style, RAW original photo texture, 85mm Macro lens, full-frame camera, f/2 large aperture, ultra-high resolution, real color science, high dynamic range, delicate micro-contrast, cinematic film colors, slight film grain, without any beauty filter processing. [Style] Award-winning editorial portrait, museum-quality fine art portrait, documentary realism, ultra photorealistic, cinematic portrait photography, physically accurate lighting, razor-sharp eye focus, authentic skin texture, natural imperfections preserved, realistic anatomy, high fidelity facial details, premium fashion editorial, masterpiece.

zh.title: 超写实微距眼部肖像
zh.description: 一个专注于极致面部特写、真实皮肤纹理以及复杂眼部解剖结构的专业提示词，采用微距摄影风格。
zh.prompt: [角色] 完全参考我上传的参考图中的人物面部和发型。电影级超写实极致特写肖像摄影，主体为 18-22 岁的成年男性/女性。性别可根据需要替换，或上传角色参考图以保持面部特征、发型和身份的一致性。在保持角色原有面部辨识度的同时，呈现出更自然、温柔且平易近人的状态。角色气质安静、自信且自然，非刻意摆拍，如同真实摄影捕捉到的瞬间。[表情] 角色展现出非常俏皮的微笑，嘴角上扬，眼中带着真实的笑意，面部肌肉自然放松，苹果肌有细微的自然变化。笑容温暖且治愈。[构图] 画面仅展示约半张脸，以一只眼睛作为唯一的视觉焦点。角色直视镜头。构图大胆，具有强烈的视觉冲击力和艺术张力。[皮肤纹理] 真实自然的皮肤纹理，完全保留毛孔、细微绒毛、微妙的肤色起伏、轻微雀斑、局部泛红、小痘印、浅层纹理等真实皮肤特征。不进行任何磨皮或美颜处理。皮肤具有自然的油光和真实的皮下质感。[眼部细节] 精致自然的眼妆，干净流畅的眼线，柔和的眼影层次，不夸张；虹膜呈现复杂的放射状纤维结构，瞳孔边缘锐利清晰，角膜有真实的湿润反光，高光符合物理光学定律；睫毛粗细不一，排列自然；眉毛浓密且有特定的生长方向，保留少量杂毛；鼻翼、嘴唇和面部边缘具有真实的皮肤质感，唇纹细腻自然。[头发] 发丝真实自然，包含细发、绒毛和轻微的碎发。角色面部结构符合真实人体解剖比例，无 AI 畸变，无过度编辑，无塑料感皮肤，无蜡像质感。[光影] 使用柔和的电影级轮廓光结合微弱的侧光，塑造立体的面部层次。暗部保留丰富细节，明暗过渡自然。光线柔和且充满氛围感，无生硬阴影或 HDR 效果。[背景] 背景完全虚化，仅保留柔和的色块和环境氛围。极浅的景深突出了眼部焦点。整体美学具有高端杂志编辑、纪实肖像和博物馆级艺术摄影的品质。[相机规格] 真实摄影风格，RAW 原片质感，85mm 微距镜头，全画幅相机，f/2 大光圈，超高分辨率，真实色彩科学，高动态范围，细腻的微对比度，电影胶片色彩，轻微胶片颗粒感，无任何美颜滤镜处理。[风格] 获奖编辑肖像，博物馆级艺术肖像，纪实写实主义，超写实，电影级肖像摄影，物理精确光影，锐利的眼部对焦，真实的皮肤纹理，保留自然瑕疵，真实的解剖结构，高保真面部细节，高级时尚编辑，杰作。

en.title: Photorealistic Modern Corridor Fashion Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for a high-fashion portrait of an East Asian woman in a modern architectural setting with cinematic lighting.
en.prompt: Hyper-realistic fashion portrait. Adult East Asian female, {argument name="age" default="over 21"}, standing in a modern sophisticated outdoor corridor near a white-painted brick wall and tall black-framed windows. Slightly to the right, framed from the waist to mid-thigh. The left side of the frame retains ample architectural space, with windows and the walkway extending into the distance. Strong vertical lines from brick pillars and dark window frames create a clean contemporary geometric background. Figure: Torso mostly forward, shoulders rotated very slightly toward the viewer's left. Relaxed, elegant, and confident posture. One arm hangs naturally by the side; the opposite hand elegantly raised toward a hair strand near the temple, fingers lightly touching a loose lock. Head upright with a slight tilt, looking directly at the camera—a dignified, low-key confident expression, a faint closed-mouth smile. Hair and Jewelry: Very long glossy black hair, soft voluminous waves, center-parted, falling over shoulders, natural strands framing the cheekbones. Realistic shine, fine individual strands, gentle movement, rich tonal variations from deep black to soft charcoal gray highlights. Medium-sized bright gold hoop earrings. A thin low-key ring on the raised hand. Makeup: Sophisticated and natural—glowing fair skin, real pores, fine tonal variations. Soft brow shape, refined brownish-black eyeliner, long thick lashes, restrained peach blush, gentle cheekbone contouring, low-key rose nude lips with a soft satin texture. Natural elegant facial proportions; no excessive airbrushing or exaggerated features. Clothing: Fitted {argument name="top color" default="dark coffee"} sleeveless turtleneck top—soft, matte, fine knit, high neckline, clean armholes, fine elasticity, realistic seam structure, gentle folds at the waist, slight tension lines on the torso. {argument name="skirt color" default="champagne beige"} high-waisted satin midi skirt from the hips down—smooth silky luster, flowing drape, fine diagonal highlights, soft creases, elegant neutral tones contrasting with the dark top. Scene: Minimalist upscale urban corridor—white neat brick pillars on the right, large floor-to-ceiling black metal window frames on the left, light stone or concrete paving. Faint reflections of green trees in the glass, soft-focus blurred interior visible through the window. Background is low-key, modern, and uncluttered; the corridor forms a natural leading line extending to the left. Lighting: Soft diffused daylight from the front-left, similar to a bright overcast day. Gentle highlights on forehead, cheekbones, hair strands, shoulders, arms, gold earrings, and satin skirt. Delicate shadows under the jaw, neck, inside hair, and around the waist. Cool neutral architectural tones balanced with warm skin, dark coffee brown, champagne satin, and gold accents. Camera: 85mm, eye-level, f/2, sharp focus on eyes and face, smooth background separation, realistic skin and textile details, sophisticated neutral tones, soft contrast, clean dynamic range, fine natural bokeh.

zh.title: 写实风格现代走廊时尚人像
zh.description: 这是一个高度详细的提示词，用于在现代建筑背景下拍摄一位东亚女性的高级时尚人像，并配以电影质感的灯光。
zh.prompt: 超写实时尚人像。成年东亚女性，{argument name="age" default="21 岁以上"}，站在靠近白色砖墙和高大黑色边框窗户的现代精致户外走廊中。略微偏右，取景范围从腰部到大腿中部。画面左侧保留了充足的建筑空间，窗户和走廊向远处延伸。砖柱和深色窗框形成的强烈垂直线条，营造出简洁的现代几何背景。人物：躯干大部分朝前，肩膀向观众左侧略微旋转。姿态放松、优雅且自信。一只手臂自然垂在身侧；另一只手优雅地抬起，手指轻触太阳穴附近的一缕发丝。头部直立并略微倾斜，直视镜头——表情庄重、内敛自信，嘴角带着淡淡的闭口微笑。发型与配饰：非常长的亮泽黑发，柔软蓬松的波浪卷，中分，垂在肩上，自然的发丝修饰着颧骨。逼真的光泽，细腻的单根发丝，轻柔的动态，从深黑到柔和炭灰高光的丰富色调变化。中等大小的亮金色圆环耳环。抬起的手上戴着一枚精致低调的戒指。妆容：精致自然——透亮的白皙皮肤，真实的毛孔，细腻的色调变化。柔和的眉形，精致的棕黑色眼线，长而浓密的睫毛，克制的桃色腮红，柔和的颧骨轮廓，低调的玫瑰裸色嘴唇，带有柔和的缎面质感。自然优雅的面部比例；没有过度的磨皮或夸张的特征。服装：修身的 {argument name="top color" default="深咖啡色"} 无袖高领上衣——柔软、哑光、细针织，高领口，干净的袖口，良好的弹性，逼真的接缝结构，腰部有柔和的褶皱，躯干上有轻微的拉伸纹理。{argument name="skirt color" default="香槟米色"} 高腰缎面中长裙，从臀部向下——平滑的丝绸光泽，流动的垂坠感，细腻的对角线高光，柔和的褶皱，优雅的中性色调与深色上衣形成对比。场景：极简主义高端城市走廊——右侧是整洁的白色砖柱，左侧是大型落地黑色金属窗框，浅色石材或混凝土铺地。玻璃中映出绿色树木的淡淡倒影，透过窗户可以看到虚化的室内景象。背景低调、现代且整洁；走廊形成了向左延伸的自然引导线。灯光：来自左前方的柔和漫射日光，类似于明亮的阴天。前额、颧骨、发丝、肩膀、手臂、金耳环和缎面裙上有柔和的高光。下颌、颈部、发丝内部和腰部周围有细腻的阴影。冷色调的中性建筑色调与温暖的肤色、深咖啡棕、香槟色缎面和金色点缀相平衡。相机：85mm 镜头，平视角度，f/2 光圈，焦点清晰对准眼睛和面部，背景虚化平滑，皮肤和纺织品细节逼真，精致的中性色调，柔和的对比度，干净的动态范围，细腻自然的焦外成像。

en.title: Vintage Train Commuter Portrait
en.description: A cinematic prompt capturing a nostalgic summer travel moment of a woman inside a vintage train with realistic lighting and wind effects.
en.prompt: Create a realistic vertical lifestyle fashion portrait of an East Asian adult female over 21 years old, standing inside a vintage commuter train or an old-fashioned bus on a bright sunny day, next to a large open window. The composition spans from her upper thighs to her head, positioned slightly to the right. Her torso faces the camera while her hips are angled slightly toward the window, creating a relaxed S-curve. She leans gently against the beige interior wall below the window, with her arms outstretched—one hand on the metal windowsill to the left and the other on the window frame to the right. Her shoulders are relaxed, and she gazes directly at the camera with a warm, confident expression and a subtle, natural smile. She has long deep brown hair with soft layers and a slight side part. A strong gust of wind blows through the open window, dramatically sweeping her hair toward the right side of the frame. In the sunlight, several strands of hair glisten as they flutter; fine wisps scatter softly across her forehead, cheeks, and shoulders as her long hair sways gently. Her makeup is refined and natural: fair, translucent skin, soft peach blush, well-defined brows, light brown eyeliner, long curled lashes, subtle contouring, and a soft rose-pink lip gloss. She is wearing a cropped light ivory top made of thin, semi-transparent fabric dotted with tiny peach or coral spots. The top features short puff sleeves with soft elastic cuffs, a deep V-neck wrap design, pleated stitching, and a tie knot at the front, revealing just the right amount of skin at the waist. This is paired with slim-fit dark indigo denim shorts featuring a high-waisted design, rolled hems, gold contrast stitching, belt loops, metal buttons, front pockets, and a small embroidered detail near one pocket. The denim should exhibit realistic fading, stitching, texture, and slight wrinkling around the hips. The scene should simulate the interior of an old train car or vintage public transport, such as beige metal wall panels, exposed screws and seams, a large rectangular sliding window with brushed aluminum trim, and a dark navy blue vinyl bench visible in the lower right. Through the open window, a sunny suburban street scene is visible: light-colored buildings, lush greenery, roadside scenery, and soft-toned vehicles, all rendered with a shallow depth of field and slight directional motion blur to suggest the vehicle is in motion. Strong natural light streams in from the upper left and behind the subject. Soft rim lighting is created around her hair and shoulders, with bright highlights on her cheekbones, arms, waist, shirt, and jeans, filled in by soft reflected light from the light-colored interior panels. Subtle shadows under the chin, around the waist, and in the folds of the clothing are preserved to enhance depth. The overall atmosphere should be fresh, breezy, and summery, natural yet slightly nostalgic, like a sophisticated travel photograph taken during a daytime trip. Camera and Composition: Vertical 2:3, eye-level or slightly low angle, approximately 50mm lens, shallow depth of field with the subject in sharp focus and the exterior softly blurred, subtle movement in the hair and background, realistic perspective, balanced frame, with the large window forming a bright rectangular frame around her. zh.title: 复古火车通勤人像
zh.description: 一个电影感提示词，捕捉了一位女性在复古火车内怀旧夏日旅行的瞬间，包含逼真的光影和风吹效果。
zh.prompt: 创作一张逼真的竖构图生活时尚人像，主角为一位 21 岁以上的东亚成年女性，站在阳光明媚的复古通勤火车或老式巴士内，靠在一扇打开的大窗户旁。构图范围从她的大腿上部到头部，位置略微偏右。她的躯干面向镜头，臀部微微转向窗户，形成自然的 S 型曲线。她轻轻倚靠在窗下米色的内壁上，双臂伸展——一只手放在左侧的金属窗台上，另一只手放在右侧的窗框上。她肩膀放松，直视镜头，表情温暖自信，带着微妙、自然的微笑。她留着深棕色的长发，带有柔和的层次感和轻微的侧分。一阵强风从打开的窗户吹入，戏剧性地将她的头发吹向画面右侧。在阳光下，几缕发丝随风飘动时闪闪发光；细碎的发丝轻柔地散落在她的额头、脸颊和肩膀上，长发随风轻轻摇曳。她的妆容精致自然：白皙透亮的皮肤、柔和的桃色腮红、轮廓分明的眉毛、浅棕色眼线、纤长卷翘的睫毛、微妙的修容以及柔和的玫瑰粉色唇彩。她穿着一件浅象牙色的短款上衣，采用薄而半透明的面料制成，上面点缀着细小的桃色或珊瑚色圆点。上衣采用短泡泡袖设计，配有柔软的松紧袖口、深 V 领裹身设计、褶皱缝线以及前襟打结，在腰部露出了恰到好处的肌肤。搭配修身深靛蓝色牛仔短裤，采用高腰设计、卷边裤脚、金色撞色缝线、腰带环、金属纽扣、前口袋以及口袋附近的小刺绣细节。牛仔裤应展现出逼真的褪色、缝线、纹理以及臀部周围的轻微褶皱。场景应模拟老式火车车厢或复古公共交通工具的内部，例如米色金属壁板、外露的螺丝和接缝、带有拉丝铝饰边的矩形大推拉窗，右下角可见深海军蓝色的乙烯基长椅。透过打开的窗户，可以看到阳光明媚的郊区街道：浅色的建筑、郁郁葱葱的绿植、路边风景以及色调柔和的车辆，所有这些都以浅景深和轻微的定向运动模糊呈现，暗示车辆正在行驶中。强烈的自然光从左上方和主体后方射入。她的头发和肩膀周围形成了柔和的轮廓光，颧骨、手臂、腰部、衬衫和牛仔裤上有明亮的高光，并由浅色内壁反射的柔和光线填充。下巴下方、腰部周围以及衣褶处的微妙阴影被保留，以增强深度感。整体氛围应清新、凉爽且充满夏日气息，自然而略带怀旧感，就像白天旅行时拍摄的精致旅行照片。相机与构图：竖构图 2:3，平视或略微低角度，约 50mm 镜头，浅景深，主体清晰对焦，背景柔和模糊，头发和背景有微妙的运动感，透视真实，画面平衡，大窗户在她周围形成一个明亮的矩形框架。保持自然的人体解剖结构、逼真的手部和手指、准确的织物纹理、细腻的皮肤质感，并使用暖象牙色、阳光米色、深靛蓝色、柔和绿色和淡桃色进行电影级调色。风格：写实旅行摄影、成年模特、凉爽的火车窗边人像、明亮的自然阳光、风吹发丝、白色前系带短款上衣、深色牛仔短裤、复古地铁内饰、自然的夏日氛围、逼真的皮肤和织物纹理、高细节、构图干净、无文字、无水印、无 Logo、无其他人、无扭曲的解剖结构、无重复肢体、无人工塑料感皮肤、非卡通或插画风格、无强闪光、无过度模糊、无露骨裸露。

zh.title: 黄金时刻时尚特写肖像
zh.description: 一张紧凑的时尚特写肖像，聚焦于质感、服装和温暖的傍晚光线，呈现出精致的编辑风格。
zh.prompt: 超写实竖构图时尚特写肖像，成年女性，21 岁以上，户外时尚活动或后台现场，黄金时刻。从大腿上部到嘴唇上方的紧凑构图——眼睛和大部分前额被裁切，聚焦于领口、肩膀、躯干、手部、面料和造型。模特略微偏右，身体正面朝向，头部轻微转向观众左侧。人物：温暖的白皙至浅肤色——真实的毛孔、自然的色调变化、锁骨区域有淡淡的雀斑或美人痣。亮面柔和裸粉色唇妆，低调而精致。发型为整洁的低发髻，耳部和颈部附近有几缕受控的碎发。服装：修身灰粉蓝色无袖连体衣——宽肩带、干净的方圆领、高开叉裤腿，平滑的弹力结构。哑光科技针织质感：细密的针织纹理、自然的张力线、胸部和腰部的小横向褶皱、精确的边缘缝合，面料上有柔和的夕阳高光。搭配宽松的低腰浅色水洗牛仔裤，在连体衣高开叉下方敞开穿着——褪色的浅蓝色牛仔布、真实的编织纹理、皮带环、前口袋、深色金属纽扣、拉链门襟、金棕色缝线、柔和的接缝、腰部和臀部自然的褶皱。姿势：端庄沉稳。一只前臂水平横跨下腹部，手轻轻搭在对侧腰部附近。另一只手放在牛仔裤敞开的腰带或前口袋处——手指修长放松，指甲干净自然。解剖结构准确的手臂：精致的肌腱、柔和的肌肉线条、真实的手部比例。背景：柔焦模糊的高端户外活动或秀场——白色建筑帐篷或天幕、深色设备、大型黑色扬声器、模糊的就座宾客或工作人员、低调的结构形状。所有背景人物均不可辨认且处于失焦状态。奶油炭灰色、白色、灰色以及微妙的蓝色光斑。光线：来自观众左侧的电影感自然黄金时刻光线——左肩、锁骨、颈部、上臂、手部和牛仔裤腰带上有温暖的高光。右侧有较冷的自然阴影以实现平衡对比。下颌线下方、领口周围、交叉手臂下方以及连体衣接缝处有柔和的阴影。色调：灰蓝色、浅水洗牛仔色、温暖肤色、炭灰色阴影、细腻的琥珀色高光。相机：竖构图 2:3，85mm 镜头，平视视角，f/2 光圈，高分辨率肖像，低调奢华色调，真实的皮肤和纺织品细节，清晰的缝线，柔和的背景虚化。无塑料感磨皮，无夸张比例。负面提示：无文字，无水印，无 Logo，无珠宝，无多余肢体，无畸形手部，无重复手指，无卡通感，无强闪光，无过度曝光，无露骨裸露。

en.title: Cinematic Acropolis Fashion Portrait
en.description: An elegant wide-screen fashion portrait of a woman at the Parthenon, featuring Mediterranean sunlight and linen textures.
en.prompt: Cinematic realistic fashion portrait, Acropolis of Athens, widescreen 16:9. Stylish young adult woman, slightly to the right, framed from mid-thigh to top of head. Relaxed three-quarter pose—torso gently leaning left, face tilted slightly up toward camera right. Eyes nearly closed—tranquil, sun-kissed, contemplative atmosphere. Lips slightly parted, calm and confident expression. Character: Short, voluminous chin-length dark brown wavy hair, loose and airy, with fine strands naturally lifted by a breeze around the forehead and cheeks. Warm, soft glowing complexion. Low-key elegant makeup: natural skin texture, soft brow shape, subtle rose-red lip color, delicate eyeliner, soft warm-toned eye shadow. Jewelry: Small sculptural gold drop earrings, very fine gold necklace with a tiny pendant, and a second delicate chain hanging just above it. Clothing: Lightweight ivory linen button-down shirt—soft, slightly wrinkled texture, loose and breathable, sleeves casually rolled below the elbows. Top buttons open to create a relaxed V-neckline. Shirt hem tied in a soft knot at the right hip, fabric gathering and draping naturally. High-waisted wide-leg cream trousers—fine front pleats, structured waistband, belt loops, tonal belt with a subtle metal buckle. One hand casually in a pocket, the other arm hanging naturally at the side. The entire outfit maintains an elegant monochrome: warm white, ivory, oatmeal, and light beige. Scene: The Parthenon occupies most of the left and central background—weathered light-colored stone columns, entablature, and partially damaged pediments, slightly out of focus but clearly recognizable. Bleached marble blocks, uneven archaeological stone surfaces, broken columns, and scattered ruins extend into the background. One or two tiny, blurred visitors in the distance for scale only. Lighting: Bright natural Mediterranean daylight, late morning or early afternoon, sun from upper left/front left. Glowing highlights on cheekbones, bridge of nose, hair, shirt folds, and shoulders; soft warm shadows in the jawline and fabric folds. Slightly hazy pale blue-grey sky, dry sun-drenched atmosphere. Stone background in understated chalky white, light sand, weathered beige, and cool grey. Skin and gold jewelry provide restrained warmth. Camera and Color Grading: Full-frame 85mm portrait lens, f/2–f/2.8, shallow depth of field, smooth creamy bokeh, gentle background compression, sharp focus on face/hair/jewelry/upper clothing. Real skin pores, individual hair strands, natural linen fibers, real clothing folds, accurate hands, authentic ancient stone texture. Soft film tones: warm highlights, slightly cool neutral shadows, low to medium saturation, slight fine grain, restrained contrast, airy high-key quality. Elegant, quiet, sensual but not provocative, visual balance—sky and architecture extending on the left, figure anchored in the center-right position. Negative constraints: No strong artificial lighting, no heavy retouching, no plastic-looking skin, no over-saturated orange tones, no modern logos, no crowds, no distracting accessories, no text, no watermarks, no distorted columns, no distorted hands, no repetitive limbs, no excessive blur on the subject.

zh.title: 卫城电影感时尚人像
zh.description: 一张优雅的宽屏时尚人像，拍摄于帕特农神庙，展现地中海阳光与亚麻质感。
zh.prompt: 电影感写实时尚人像，雅典卫城，16:9 宽屏。时尚年轻女性，略微偏右，取景范围从大腿中部到头顶。放松的三分之四侧身姿势——躯干轻微向左倾斜，脸部微微向上朝向镜头右侧。双眼微闭——呈现宁静、被阳光亲吻、沉思的氛围。双唇微启，表情冷静自信。人物：短款蓬松的下巴长度深棕色波浪卷发，自然飘逸，几缕发丝随微风在额头和脸颊旁自然扬起。温暖柔和的肤色。低调优雅的妆容：自然的皮肤质感、柔和的眉形、淡玫瑰红色唇色、精致的眼线、柔和的暖色调眼影。饰品：小型雕塑感金色水滴耳环，一条非常精致的金色项链配有微型吊坠，上方叠戴一条细链。服装：轻盈的象牙白亚麻衬衫——质感柔软、略带褶皱，宽松透气，袖子随意卷至肘部下方。领口上方纽扣解开，形成休闲的 V 领。衬衫下摆在右侧腰部打了一个柔和的结，布料自然褶皱垂坠。高腰阔腿米色长裤——前部有细褶，结构感腰头，带有皮带环，同色系腰带配有低调的金属扣。一只手随意插在口袋里，另一只手臂自然垂在身侧。整体造型保持优雅的单色系：暖白、象牙白、燕麦色和浅米色。场景：帕特农神庙占据了背景左侧和中央的大部分区域——风化的浅色石柱、柱顶盘和部分受损的山墙，略微失焦但清晰可辨。漂白的白色大理石块、凹凸不平的考古石材表面、断裂的石柱和散落的废墟延伸至背景中。远处有一两个模糊的游客作为比例参照。光照：明亮的自然地中海日光，上午晚些时候或下午早些时候，阳光来自左上方/左前方。颧骨、鼻梁、头发、衬衫褶皱和肩膀上有明亮的高光；下颌线和布料褶皱处有柔和的暖色阴影。天空略带朦胧的淡蓝灰色，干燥且阳光充足的氛围。石质背景呈现低调的粉笔白、浅沙色、风化米色和冷灰色。皮肤和金色饰品提供了克制的暖意。相机与调色：全画幅 85mm 人像镜头，f/2–f/2.8，浅景深，平滑奶油般虚化，柔和的背景压缩，焦点清晰对准脸部、头发、饰品和上衣。真实的皮肤毛孔、清晰的发丝、天然亚麻纤维、真实的衣物褶皱、准确的手部细节、真实的古石质感。柔和的胶片色调：暖色高光，略带冷色的中性阴影，低至中等饱和度，轻微的颗粒感，克制的对比度，空气感的高调品质。优雅、安静、感性但不挑逗，视觉平衡——天空和建筑向左延伸，人物锚定在右中位置。负面约束：无强人工照明，无过度修图，无塑料感皮肤，无过度饱和的橙色调，无现代标志，无人群，无干扰饰品，无文字，无水印，无扭曲的石柱，无扭曲的手部，无重复肢体，主体无过度模糊。

Natural smartphone HDR, realistic skin texture, soft indoor daylight mixed with warm purple ambient lighting, subtle sensor noise, authentic white balance, slight handheld imperfection, natural exposure, no beauty filter, no AI over-sharpening, no watermark, no text other than the floral "rhodezio" wall decoration.

zh.title: 真实感薰衣草色系美学自拍
zh.description: 一个关于真实感智能手机自拍的提示词，主角是一位身处梦幻薰衣草主题卧室、背景带有花卉墙面装饰的女性。
zh.prompt:
超逼真的智能手机自拍，看起来就像是用旗舰手机前置摄像头随手拍摄的，而非单反相机或 AI 渲染。

一位 {argument name="subject description" default="令人惊艳的 20 岁印尼女性，留着长长的丝滑波浪紫发"}，头发垂至胸部以下。她拥有柔和的印尼面部特征、温暖的中等肤色、大而富有表现力的深棕色眼睛、自然光泽的粉色嘴唇、精致的韩系妆容、毛茸茸的眉毛，以及带着俏皮眨眼的可爱青春笑容。

她身处一间舒适的美学卧室中，整个房间采用 {argument name="room theme" default="薰衣草和淡紫色主题"} 进行装饰。墙壁、床品、枕头、窗帘、装饰品、LED 灯光和配饰都遵循和谐的紫色调。房间氛围温暖、柔美、梦幻且奢华。

她身后的墙上安装着巨大的装饰性文字“{argument name="wall text" default="rhodezio"}”，完全由新鲜的紫色花朵组成，花朵字母间穿插着微小的暖色仙女灯。花卉装置是房间的核心装饰。

房间的其他细节包括紫色蝴蝶装饰、装裱的美学画作、毛绒玩具、紫色梳妆角、玻璃花瓶中的薰衣草、柔和的氛围 LED 灯带、舒适的毯子以及营造诱人氛围的细小仙女灯。

她穿着一件舒适的薰衣草色大廓形针织开衫，开衫从一侧肩膀滑落，内搭一件可爱的白紫相间花卉吊带背心，带有精致的蕾丝边和细小的紫色丝带细节。她的整套穿搭都与紫色美学相得益彰。

她仅用一只伸出的手臂拿着手机自拍。另一只手在脸颊旁比出一个完美的手指爱心（韩式比心）。**仅限两只手臂和两只手。** 解剖学结构正确的手指。没有多余的肢体。没有多余的手指。没有第三只手。

从略高的手持角度拍摄的上半身近景自拍。自然的智能手机 HDR，真实的皮肤纹理，柔和的室内日光与温暖的紫色环境光混合，细微的传感器噪点，真实的白平衡，轻微的手持不完美感，自然的曝光，无美颜滤镜，无 AI 过度锐化，无水印，除了花卉“rhodezio”墙面装饰外，没有任何文字。

长宽比：3:4

风格：超写实主义，真实的智能手机自拍，舒适的主播卧室美学，梦幻紫色主题，Pinterest 美学，可爱风房间装饰，逼真的光影，旗舰手机摄像头画质，8K。

en.title: Luxury Night Apartment Portrait
en.description: A cinematic night portrait prompt featuring a woman in a high-rise apartment overlooking city lights, wearing elegant white evening attire.
en.prompt:
A luxurious night fashion portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="East Asian woman over 25 years old"}, sitting on a light gray padded window bench in a modern high-rise apartment, overlooking a glowing city skyline. Positioned slightly to the left, leaving ample space on the right for the floor-to-ceiling windows, deep blue night sky, and soft-focus city lights. The composition is a three-quarter seated shot from mid-thigh to slightly above the head, at eye level with a subtle cinematic angle.

Pose: Sitting diagonally on the bench with the torso upright but leaning back slightly. Her right hand rests behind her on a cushion with fingers naturally extended. Her left hand is raised toward her collarbone as if touching a necklace. Hips are angled toward the lower-left, with one thigh extending into the foreground and the other tucked along the seat. Shoulders are relaxed and bare due to the off-the-shoulder neckline. Her head tilts gently toward the left shoulder, looking directly into the lens with a dignified, confident expression, slightly parted lips, and a calm, intimate gaze.

Hairstyle: A voluminous, intentionally messy high bun with loose curls and flyaway strands framing the face, forehead, and neck. Individual hair strands show realistic highlights and deep shadows with subtle movement.

Makeup: Sophisticated evening makeup with luminous fair skin showing real pore texture. Soft brow shape, smoky brown eyeliner, long dense lashes, subtle contouring, and glossy nude-pink lips.

Clothing: An {argument name="outfit" default="elegant white off-the-shoulder two-piece evening set"} featuring light translucent chiffon layered over opaque lining. A cropped top with an elasticized neckline and long translucent sleeves, paired with a fitted wrap-style mini skirt showing asymmetric draping and sculptural folds.

Jewelry: {argument name="accessories" default="Large polished gold hoop earrings"} and multiple layered gold necklaces of varying lengths. Delicate gold bracelets and rings complete the look with subtle highlights contrasting against the cool ambient night light.

Scene: A sophisticated contemporary apartment or luxury hotel suite at night. Large floor-to-ceiling windows showing high-rise buildings below with bokeh city lights in blue, cyan, and purple. Minimalist interior with dark paneling and soft architectural shadows.

Lighting: Low-key and cinematic, dominated by cool tones. Soft blue moonlight or city glow from the back and right creates a delicate rim light on hair and shoulders. Soft diffuse beauty fill light from the front-left illuminates eyes and skin without breaking the nighttime mood.

Camera: 85mm, f/1.8, sharp focus on eyes and face, smooth background bokeh, realistic low-light dynamic range, subtle film grain, high contrast with controlled highlights, and accurate body proportions.

zh.title: 奢华夜景公寓人像
zh.description: 一个电影感夜景人像提示词，描绘了一位身着优雅白色晚装的女性，坐在俯瞰城市灯火的高层公寓中。
zh.prompt:
一张奢华的夜间时尚人像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="25 岁以上的东亚女性"}，坐在现代高层公寓浅灰色软垫窗台上，俯瞰璀璨的城市天际线。主体位于画面偏左侧，为右侧的落地窗、深蓝色夜空和虚化的城市灯光留出充足空间。构图为四分之三坐姿，从大腿中部到头部上方，视线平齐并带有微妙的电影感角度。

姿势：斜坐在窗台上，躯干挺直但略微后倾。右手自然向后撑在靠垫上，手指自然伸展。左手抬起靠近锁骨，仿佛正在触碰项链。臀部朝向左下方，一条大腿延伸至前景，另一条腿收在座垫上。由于露肩领口设计，双肩自然裸露。头部轻轻向左肩倾斜，直视镜头，表情端庄自信，双唇微启，目光平静而亲密。

发型：蓬松且刻意营造出凌乱感的丸子头，带有松散的卷发和碎发，修饰脸部、额头和颈部。发丝呈现出逼真的高光和深邃阴影，带有微妙的动感。

妆容：精致的晚宴妆容，透亮的白皙肌肤展现出真实的毛孔质感。柔和的眉形，烟熏棕色眼线，浓密的长睫毛，微妙的修容，以及光泽感的裸粉色嘴唇。

服装：一套 {argument name="outfit" default="优雅的白色露肩两件套晚装"}，采用轻盈半透明雪纺叠搭不透明内衬。短款上衣配有松紧领口和半透明长袖，搭配修身裹身式短裙，呈现出不对称的褶皱和雕塑般的垂坠感。

珠宝：{argument name="accessories" default="大号抛光金质圆环耳环"} 以及多层长短不一的金色项链。精致的金色手链和戒指为整体造型画龙点睛，在冷色调的环境夜光下呈现出微妙的金属光泽。

场景：夜晚精致的现代公寓或豪华酒店套房。巨大的落地窗外可见下方的高楼大厦，以及蓝色、青色和紫色的城市灯光虚化效果（bokeh）。极简主义室内设计，配有深色镶板和柔和的建筑阴影。

灯光：低调且具有电影感，以冷色调为主。来自后方和右侧的柔和蓝色月光或城市辉光，在头发和肩膀上勾勒出精致的轮廓光。来自左前方的柔和漫射美颜补光，在不破坏夜间氛围的前提下照亮眼睛和皮肤。

相机：85mm 镜头，f/1.8 光圈，焦点清晰对准眼睛和面部，背景虚化平滑，真实的低光动态范围，细腻的胶片颗粒感，高对比度且高光控制得当，身体比例精准。

en.title: Elegant Floral Satin Fashion Portrait
en.description: An elegant portrait prompt featuring a woman in a floral satin mini dress, set in a traditional modern Chinese interior with sophisticated lighting.
en.prompt:
A hyper-realistic luxury fashion portrait of an {argument name="subject" default="East Asian woman over 21 years old"}, elegantly seated in a sophisticated East Asian-style interior. Positioned slightly to the left, with balanced negative space on the right for ceramics and dark wood furniture. Framed from knees to slightly above the head, eye level, in a subtle three-quarter view.

Pose and Chair: Seated on a honey-colored wooden armchair with straight armrests, visible joinery, and a woven rattan back. Rich royal blue chiffon or silk drapes from the seat, extending dramatically to the floor in wide, flowing folds. Legs are elegantly crossed, with one forearm resting on the wooden armrest and the other hand placed lightly on the knee. 

Subject: Long dark brown hair in glossy loose waves with a side part. A calm, confident expression with a subtle closed-mouth smile, cat-eye eyeliner, and glowing natural skin. Wearing a thin silver necklace with a small floral pendant.

Clothing: A {argument name="outfit" default="fitted strapless mini dress in ivory satin or structural silk"} featuring {argument name="print" default="large royal blue roses, leaves, and painterly floral vine prints"}. Clean horizontal neckline, corset-like cut, and realistic fabric sheen with rich blue tonal variations. Clear open-toed mule heels.

Scene: Elegant traditional-modern Chinese interior. To the left is a tall wooden lattice window with warm sunlight filtered through sheer cream curtains. Behind the chair is dark wood paneling. To the right, a tall black wooden display stand holds a large celadon ceramic pot.

Lighting: Warm, soft, and cinematic light primarily from the left window. Golden rim lighting on hair and shoulders with soft reflected fill light on the face and dress. 

Camera: 85mm, f/2, sharp focus on eyes and floral dress, with ceramics and background lattice in soft bokeh. Realistic skin texture, fine hair details, and balanced wide composition.

zh.title: 优雅花卉缎面时尚人像
zh.description: 一张优雅的人像提示词，主角身着花卉缎面迷你裙，置身于传统与现代结合的中式室内空间，光影精致。
zh.prompt:
一张超写实的奢华时尚人像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="21 岁以上的东亚女性"}，优雅地坐在一间精致的中式风格室内空间中。人物略微偏左，右侧留有平衡的负空间，用于展示陶瓷和深色木质家具。构图从膝盖到头部上方，平视视角，呈现微妙的三分之二侧面。

姿势与座椅：坐在带有直扶手、可见榫卯结构和编织藤条靠背的蜜色木质扶手椅上。浓郁的宝蓝色雪纺或丝绸从座椅垂下，以宽大、流畅的褶皱戏剧性地延伸至地面。双腿优雅交叠，一只前臂搁在木质扶手上，另一只手轻轻放在膝盖上。

主角：深棕色长发，呈现光泽感的松散波浪卷，侧分发型。表情冷静自信，带着微妙的闭口微笑，画着猫眼眼线，皮肤散发自然光泽。佩戴一条带有小型花卉吊坠的细银项链。

服装：一件 {argument name="outfit" default="乳白色缎面或结构感丝绸材质的修身抹胸迷你裙"}，带有 {argument name="print" default="大型宝蓝色玫瑰、叶片和写意花卉藤蔓印花"}。干净的水平领口，束腰剪裁，面料呈现出真实的质感与丰富的蓝色调变化。搭配透明露趾穆勒高跟鞋。

场景：优雅的传统现代中式室内空间。左侧是高大的木质格栅窗，温暖的阳光透过米色薄纱窗帘洒入。椅子后方是深色木镶板。右侧是一个高大的黑色木质展示架，上面摆放着一个大型青瓷罐。

光影：温暖、柔和的电影感光线主要来自左侧窗户。发丝和肩部带有金色轮廓光，面部和裙装上有柔和的反射补光。

相机：85mm 镜头，f/2 光圈，焦点清晰地对准眼睛和花卉裙装，陶瓷和背景格栅呈现柔和的虚化效果。真实的皮肤纹理，细腻的发丝细节，以及平衡的广角构图。

en.title: Skateboard Campaign Board Design
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating a high-end diagonal five-panel skate culture campaign board, featuring street-art graphics and technical skateboarding action.
en.prompt: 为 Girl Skateboards 打造一款超高端的五面板对角线广告板，保留斜置五条的编辑结构和真实的街头滑板动作逻辑，䄦将整体视觉效果彻底重构为更响亮、更具图形感、更具旗舰青年品牌特色的广告。背景系统须采用夸张的霞虹色块写、喷绘地面、超大城市图形符号和更强烈的街头艺术设计语言，同时滑板和滑手仍是核心视觉焦点。最终画面应呈现出世界级青年运动时尚大片感：超写实、叛逆、饰和、锐利，䄦品牌特色鲜明。核心概念：将 Girl Skateboards 呈现为一个融合䄆滑板、色寙、态度、设计与城市地表的完整青年文化宇宙。保持对角线五面板动态结构，䄦将环境转化为风格化的街头图形世界：霞虹写域、图形化彩绘混凝土、喷漆纹理、大型抽象符号、方向箭头、硬核几何色寙和高端杂志设计质感。滑板为核心主体，环境则应像为滑板文化定制的品牌化城市乐园。五面板对角线结构：采用高垂直海报布局，由五个䄎上而下堆叠的大斜面板组成。每个面板保持相同的倾斜角度，䅿海报具有前冲动感。五个条带像一段连续的青年能量和滑板文化展示台。面板 1：爆发力的品牌开场英雌动作；面板 2：图形化城市区域中的快速技术动作；面板 3：夸张绘图环境中的动感与速度面板；面板 4：带有滑板压力和街头强度的近距离冲击视角；面板 5：生活方式与䄧品结合的收尾，滑板依然占据视觉主导。这种结构需䄠达出整个品牌广告在城市中疾驰的即视感。动作方向：展示䄍同年轻滑手在相关空间内完成的真实䄓䄪街头滑板动作。采用身体语言利落、具备真实技术和强烈个䄺风格的健康西方年轻运动员。包括：爆发性的 ollie 或翻板、硬核刻滑或䄧滑、阶梯或台阶相关动作、䄎角度落地冲击力，䄥及最后一个展示态度和板面存在的面板。动作需真实、技术流䄦有力，避免平庸或摆拍。滑板必须清晰可见䄦重要。滑板真实感：滑板需还原真实街头规格：真实的轮子、准确的桥（trucks）、真实的板面弧度、逼真的砂纸纹理、适时的板底图案展示、真实的划痕和缘边磨损，䄥及高端板类摄影的真实感。通过板类文化、图形态度和真实的滑板公信力来䄓现 Girl Skateboards 的品牌身份。环境重构方向：保持街头滑板逻辑，䄦将视觉推向更夸张的旗舰青年广告环境。䅿用：巨大的霞虹色块写、喷绘沥青、超大涂鸦符号、大胆的几何图形、彩绘车道线、图形箭头、酸性䄎色写面、荧光橙或热粉色混凝土区、霞虹蓝阴影面、流漆纹理、海报撒裂碎块䄥及植入城市空间的强图形系统。环境应显高端䄦经过糢划，而非杂䄱的城市垃圾。背景应增强滑手和滑板的视觉冲击力。视观䄎相机逻辑：䅿用极具冲击力的视角。摄影风格应遵循广角或微鱼眼的运动杂志逻辑：前景巨大的滑板、深度延䄳的城市线条、䄎角度跳跃、压缩的对角线建筑、冲向镜头的滑手。보个面板要有独立冲击力，同时受统一品牌色寙和图形世界约束。图形处理：强化设计系统：大型街头符号、地面图形、喷绘渐变、手绘标记点缀、分层海报缘边、滑手䄎背景的图形冲撞、细微的手写涂鸦。海报应具有提升到奢䄨商䄓设计高度的滑板杂志文化感。设计需大胆、年轻䄦受控高端。排版：采用受手写涂鸦影响䄦布局控制力强的英䄦风高端滑板活动排版。主标题：‐GIRL SKATEBOARDS‐；副标：‐COLOR HITS HARD‐；辅助文案：‐Five slashes of motion. One street attitude.‐ 排版应稀疏、锐利、都市化䄦高端，自然融入布局。包含极简官方风 Logo 及精细层级。避免臃肿文案。灯光：精致的户外城市光，具有明䄮清晰的色调和抛光商䄓感。胮肤、衣物、轮子、桥、板面及彩绘纹理都要显得敏锐、昂贵、高光利落。阴影透气䄦细节䄰寙。整体清爽、图形化，䄍沉闷。色寙方向：更大胆的旗舰青年色调：电橙、热粉、酸黄、霞虹珊瑚、鲜艳青、深鐴蓝、青柠绿点缀、喷绘白、凜光黑砂纸、阳光䄋的城市灰。色寙响䄮䄦具图形感，高端有序。氛围：叛逆、年轻、爆发力、饰和、技术感、都市、高端、无畏、图形化、时髙、全球品牌感。渲染风格：超高端 Girl Skateboards 活动板，五面板对角线编辑布局，真实街头滑板动作，霞虹色块写，喷绘地面，强城市图形系统，手写涂鸦风格排版，超写实运动摄影，8k，䄓界级商䄓影像品质。负面提示词：工䄷滑板䄠单，滑板可见度差，虚假滑板硬件，巧妙身体动作，杂䄱涂鸦，浑浊色寙，幼稚街头艺术，然火摆拍，塑料感胮肤，䄎分辨率，凌䄱排版，通用青年海报，随机背景杂䄱。

zh.title: 滑板活动项目设计
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于创作高端对角线五面板滑板文化活动项目，融合街头艺术图形与专业滑板动作。
zh.prompt: 为 Girl Skateboards 打造一款超高端的五面板对角线广告项目，保留斜置五条的编辑结构和真实的街头滑板动作逻辑，将整体视觉效果彻底重构为更响亮、更具图形感、更具旗舰青年品牌特色的广告。背景系统须采用夸张的霓虹色块、喷绘地面、超大城市图形符号和更强烈的街头艺术设计语言，同时滑板和滑手仍是核心视觉焦点。最终画面应呈现出世界级青年运动时尚大片感：超写实、叛逆、时尚、锐利，且品牌特色鲜明。核心概念：将 Girl Skateboards 呈现为一个融合了滑板、色彩、态度、设计与城市地表的完整青年文化宇宙。保持对角线五面板动态结构，将环境转化为风格化的街头图形世界：霓虹色域、图形化彩绘混凝土、喷漆纹理、大型抽象符号、方向箭头、硬核几何色彩和高端杂志设计质感。滑板为核心主体，环境则应像为滑板文化定制的品牌化城市乐园。五面板对角线结构：采用高垂直海报布局，由五个从上而下堆叠的大斜面板组成。每个面板保持相同的倾斜角度，使海报具有前冲动感。五个条带像一段连续的青年能量和滑板文化展示台。面板 1：爆发力的品牌开场英雄动作；面板 2：图形化城市区域中的快速技术动作；面板 3：夸张绘图环境中的动感与速度面板；面板 4：带有滑板压力和街头强度的近距离冲击视角；面板 5：生活方式与产品结合的收尾，滑板依然占据视觉主导。这种结构需传达出整个品牌广告在城市中疾驰的即视感。动作方向：展示不同年轻滑手在相关空间内完成的真实硬核街头滑板动作。采用身体语言利落、具备真实技术和强烈个人风格的健康西方年轻运动员。包括：爆发性的 ollie 或翻板、硬核刻滑或侧滑、阶梯或台阶相关动作、低角度落地冲击力，以及最后一个展示态度和板面存在的面板。动作需真实、技术流且有力，避免平庸或摆拍。滑板必须清晰可见且重要。滑板真实感：滑板需还原真实街头规格：真实的轮子、准确的桥（trucks）、真实的板面弧度、逼真的砂纸纹理、适时的板底图案展示、真实的划痕和缘边磨损，以及高端板类摄影的真实感。通过板类文化、图形态度和真实的滑板公信力来体现 Girl Skateboards 的品牌身份。环境重构方向：保持街头滑板逻辑，将视觉推向更夸张的旗舰青年广告环境。运用：巨大的霓虹色块、喷绘沥青、超大涂鸦符号、大胆的几何图形、彩绘车道线、图形箭头、酸性配色面、荧光橙或热粉色混凝土区、霓虹蓝阴影面、流漆纹理、海报撕裂碎块以及植入城市空间的强图形系统。环境应显高端且经过策划，而非杂乱的城市垃圾。背景应增强滑手和滑板的视觉冲击力。视觉与相机逻辑：运用极具冲击力的视角。摄影风格应遵循广角或微鱼眼的运动杂志逻辑：前景巨大的滑板、深度延伸的城市线条、低角度跳跃、压缩的对角线建筑、冲向镜头的滑手。每个面板要有独立冲击力，同时受统一品牌色彩和图形世界约束。图形处理：强化设计系统：大型街头符号、地面图形、喷绘渐变、手绘标记点缀、分层海报缘边、滑手与背景的图形冲撞、细微的手写涂鸦。海报应具有提升到奢侈商业设计高度的滑板杂志文化感。设计需大胆、年轻且受控高端。排版：采用受手写涂鸦影响且布局控制力强的英文风高端滑板活动排版。主标题：‐GIRL SKATEBOARDS‐；副标：‐COLOR HITS HARD‐；辅助文案：‐Five slashes of motion. One street attitude.‐ 排版应稀疏、锐利、都市化且高端，自然融入布局。包含极简官方风 Logo 及精细层级。避免臃肿文案。灯光：精致的户外城市光，具有明亮清晰的色调和抛光商业感。皮肤、衣物、轮子、桥、板面及彩绘纹理都要显得敏锐、昂贵、高光利落。阴影透气且细节丰富。整体清爽、图形化，不沉闷。色彩方向：更大胆的旗舰青年色调：电橙、热粉、酸黄、霓虹珊瑚、鲜艳青、深邃蓝、青柠绿点缀、喷绘白、凛光黑砂纸、阳光感的城市灰。色彩响亮且具图形感，高端有序。氛围：叛逆、年轻、爆发力、时尚、技术感、都市、高端、无畏、图形化、时髦、全球品牌感。渲染风格：超高端 Girl Skateboards 活动项目，五面板对角线编辑布局，真实街头滑板动作，霓虹色块、喷绘地面，强城市图形系统，手写涂鸦风格排版，超写实运动摄影，8k，世界级商业影像品质。负面提示词：工业滑板单调，滑板可见度差，虚假滑板硬件，巧妙身体动作，杂乱涂鸦，浑浊色彩，幼稚街头艺术，燃火摆拍，塑料感皮肤，低分辨率，凌乱排版，通用青年海报，随机背景杂乱。
