zh.prompt: 创作一个 16:9 的电影级写实体育奇幻场景，背景设定在重大决赛期间座无虚席的现代足球场内。在前景右侧中心位置，展示一只身材修长但极具威慑力的红龙吉祥物/支持者，它伫立在球迷之中，拥有长颈、尖角、张开咆哮的嘴、高举的拳头和宽大展开的皮革质感翅膀，鳞片呈红橙色，腹部为淡金色。让这只龙身穿红色西班牙足球衫，佩戴红黄相间的西班牙围巾，其中一只爪子拿着一杯啤酒。周围环绕着狂热的西班牙球迷，他们身穿红色球衣，高举双臂欢呼，挥舞着西班牙国旗，手持红黄旗帜；在人群右侧加入少量身穿浅蓝白相间球衣的阿根廷球迷。球场应显得真实且宏大，配有弧形玻璃屋顶、明亮的泛光灯、密集的看台、烟雾或信号弹产生的薄雾、五彩纸屑以及悬挂在看台周围的国旗。添加 3 个主要且清晰易读的文本区域：左上角的大标题，以粗体红橙色 3D 立体字显示“¡Vamos, España!”并带有阴影；中央球场记分牌显示“Soccer2030 FINAL”，配有西班牙和阿根廷国旗、标签“SPAIN”和“ARGENTINA”以及比分“0 - 0”；左下角有一个微妙的水印风格标题，写着“Dragon’s Heaven”。使用戏剧性的暖色调灯光、强烈的景深、充满活力的动感以及世界杯决赛的庆典氛围。自定义主标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="¡Vamos, España!"}，主角球队为 {argument name="featured team" default="Spain"}，对手为 {argument name="opponent team" default="Argentina"}，比分为 {argument name="score" default="0 - 0"}，水印为 {argument name="watermark text" default="Dragon’s Heaven"}。

en.title: Twilight Japanese Ryokan Parlor
en.description: A cinematic prompt for generating a serene traditional Japanese reception room with tatami mats, garden windows, piano, scrolls, and tea cabinet at dusk.
en.prompt: Create a wide cinematic digital painting of a quiet traditional Japanese reception room in an old ryokan-style house at twilight. The room has an expansive tatami mat floor with dark border lines, dark wooden beams, plaster walls, and a high ceiling, viewed from a low eye-level corner perspective with the empty tatami space dominating the foreground. On the left, show a full wall of wooden-framed sliding glass doors and transom windows looking out to a veranda and a lush garden filled with hydrangeas, trees, and a wooden fence under a purple-blue sunset sky; place exactly 1 wicker chair on the veranda. At the back center, place exactly 1 upright piano against the wall with exactly 1 wooden piano chair, lit by exactly 1 small warm oil lamp sitting on top of the piano. Beside the piano, include exactly 1 open shelving unit containing rolled scrolls, plus exactly 3 bamboo flutes or long bamboo rods leaning vertically near it. On the right wall, include exactly 2 hanging calligraphy scrolls in a tokonoma-like alcove and exactly 1 small decorative cloud-shaped window showing the twilight outside. In the right foreground, place exactly 1 low dark wooden tea cabinet with exactly 1 open folding fan displayed on top and small tea utensils visible inside. Use moody warm interior lighting contrasted with cool blue-purple evening light from the garden, realistic anime-background detail, painterly texture, no people, no animals, no modern electronics, no text, no watermark. The atmosphere should feel like a refined guest parlor rather than a lived-in bedroom.

zh.title: 暮色日式旅馆客厅
zh.description: 一个电影感提示词，用于生成宁静的传统日式接待室，包含榻榻米、庭院窗户、钢琴、卷轴和茶柜，呈现黄昏氛围。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅宽画幅的电影感数字绘画，描绘一间位于古老日式旅馆风格建筑中、宁静的传统日式接待室，时间设定在黄昏。房间铺设大面积带有深色边线的榻榻米地板，配有深色木梁、灰泥墙和高挑天花板，采用低视角的角落构图，前景为开阔的榻榻米空间。左侧展示一整面木框推拉玻璃门和横窗，望向外面的走廊和郁郁葱葱的庭院，院内种满绣球花和树木，并设有木栅栏，背景是紫蓝色的夕阳天空；在走廊上放置 1 把藤椅。在后方中心位置，靠墙放置 1 架立式钢琴，配有 1 把木制琴凳，钢琴上方点亮 1 盏小型暖色油灯。钢琴旁边放置 1 个开放式置物架，架上陈列着卷轴，旁边垂直靠放着 3 支竹笛或长竹竿。右侧墙壁设有一个类似床龛的壁龛，内挂 2 幅书法卷轴，并设有一个小型装饰性云形窗，透出外面的暮色。右侧前景放置 1 个低矮的深色木制茶柜，柜顶展示 1 把打开的折扇，柜内可见小型茶具。运用富有情绪的室内暖光，与来自庭院的冷色调蓝紫色晚霞形成对比，呈现写实的动画背景细节和绘画质感，画面中无人、无动物、无现代电子产品、无文字、无水印。整体氛围应营造出精致的会客室质感，而非生活化的卧室。

en.title: Summer Cafe Anime Wolf Boy
en.description: A vertical anime character illustration prompt for creating a stylish animal-eared young man in a relaxed summer cafe outfit.
en.prompt: Create a polished vertical anime illustration of an androgynous young man with black wolf/cat ears and a calm, slightly aloof expression, seated in a bright summer cafe. He has long layered {argument name="hair color" default="glossy black hair with deep violet-purple streaks and a white front section"}, violet eyes, pale skin, and soft elegant facial features; his bangs partially cover one eye and his long hair flows over his shoulders. Dress him in a refreshing relaxed cafe outfit: a wide-brim natural straw hat placed over the animal ears, an oversized open white button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, a beige-and-cream striped inner shirt, loose olive khaki cropped pants, white low-top sneakers, a brown leather wristwatch, a thin silver necklace, and purple-blue gradient sunglasses hanging from his chest. Pose him sitting casually by a light wooden cafe table, one leg bent forward, one hand resting on or holding a takeaway coffee cup with a white sleeve, the other arm relaxed. Use a sunlit indoor cafe background with large windows, soft white furniture, leafy green plants, and bright diffused summer light with gentle bokeh. Style: high-quality modern Japanese anime, delicate linework, luminous skin shading, soft pastel highlights, airy atmosphere, subtle chromatic glow, detailed fabric folds, reflective sunglasses, clean composition, vertical portrait framing, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 夏日咖啡馆动漫狼耳少年
zh.description: 一个用于创作时尚兽耳少年的竖版动漫角色插画提示词，展现其在轻松夏日咖啡馆中的装扮。
zh.prompt: 创作一张精致的竖版动漫插画，描绘一名拥有黑色狼耳/猫耳、神情冷静且略带疏离感的雌雄莫辨少年，他正坐在明亮的夏日咖啡馆中。他拥有长长的层次感 {argument name="hair color" default="亮黑色头发，带有深紫罗兰色挑染和白色前额发束"}、紫罗兰色的眼睛、白皙的皮肤以及柔和优雅的面部特征；刘海遮住了一部分眼睛，长发垂在肩上。为他穿上清爽休闲的咖啡馆装扮：戴着一顶宽檐天然草帽（帽檐盖在兽耳上），穿着一件超大号白色开衫衬衫（袖子卷起），内搭米色与奶油色条纹衬衫，下身穿着宽松的橄榄卡其色七分裤，脚踩白色低帮运动鞋，佩戴棕色皮质腕表和细银项链，胸前挂着紫蓝色渐变太阳镜。让他随意地坐在浅色木质咖啡桌旁，一条腿向前弯曲，一只手放在桌上或拿着一个带有白色杯套的外带咖啡杯，另一只手臂自然放松。背景使用阳光充足的室内咖啡馆，配有大窗户、柔软的白色家具、绿植，以及明亮柔和的夏日漫射光和轻微的虚化效果。风格：高质量现代日式动漫、细腻的线条、明亮的皮肤阴影、柔和的粉彩高光、空气感氛围、微妙的色差光晕、细致的布料褶皱、反光的太阳镜、干净的构图、竖版肖像构图、无文字、无水印。

en.title: Japanese Pricing Comparison Thumbnail
en.description: Generates a high-impact Japanese social media thumbnail comparing a crossed-out high subscription price with a cheaper monthly plan.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a bold Japanese YouTube/X thumbnail about subscription pricing being too expensive, using a dramatic comparison between a crossed-out high monthly fee and a cheaper monthly fee.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 thumbnail, 768×1024 style, optimized for mobile readability. Use a dark navy-to-deep-purple gradient background with a subtle spotlight glow behind the person. Keep all main text inside safe margins and make it extremely large, high-contrast, and legible.

Layout: At the very top, place exactly 2 hanging price tags suspended by thin strings: left tag is red, tilted slightly, with the text {argument name="old price text" default="月15,000円"} in bold white and a thick white diagonal strike-through line; right tag is neon green, tilted slightly, glowing, with the text {argument name="new price text" default="月3,000円"} in bold white. Below the tags, center a huge white headline with black shadow: {argument name="headline text" default="その課金、まだ早い"}. Under the headline, add one bright yellow rectangular banner spanning nearly the full width, with bold black text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="月3,000円で足りる21の使い方"}.

Subject details: In the lower half, show a realistic studio-cutout portrait of a smiling young Japanese woman with long black hair and bangs, wearing a beige knit sweater. She faces the camera, raises her left hand open toward the viewer in a clear “stop/wait” gesture, and holds a gold credit card in her right hand. Use natural skin tones, clean beauty lighting, and a crisp cutout edge.

Decorative elements: Add exactly 3 small floating gold yen coins with embossed yen symbols: one on the left upper-middle area, one near the lower-left edge, and one on the right-middle area. Add exactly 2 white speech/chat bubbles with three dark dots: one on the left side near the raised hand and one on the right side near the headline/shoulder area. Do not add extra coins, bubbles, icons, logos, or watermarks.

Visual style: High-impact Japanese social media thumbnail, glossy 3D accents, strong drop shadows, neon glow on the green tag, clean compositing, sharp typography, saturated colors, professional viral-cover design. Make the text accurate and not garbled.

zh.title: 日语定价对比缩略图
zh.description: 生成一张极具视觉冲击力的日语社交媒体缩略图，通过对比划掉的高额订阅费与更便宜的月度套餐，突出价格优势。
zh.prompt:
目标：制作一张醒目的日语 YouTube/X 缩略图，主题为订阅费用过高，通过对比划掉的高额月费与更便宜的月费来营造强烈的视觉反差。

画布：垂直 3:4 缩略图，768×1024 比例，针对移动端阅读体验进行优化。使用深海军蓝到深紫色的渐变背景，人物后方带有微妙的聚光灯效果。将所有主要文字保持在安全边距内，确保字体超大、高对比度且清晰易读。

布局：在顶部正中央放置 2 个由细绳悬挂的价签：左侧价签为红色，略微倾斜，文字为 {argument name="old price text" default="月15,000円"}，使用粗体白色字并带有醒目的白色对角删除线；右侧价签为霓虹绿色，略微倾斜并带有发光效果，文字为 {argument name="new price text" default="月3,000円"}，使用粗体白色字。在价签下方居中放置巨大的白色标题，并带有黑色阴影：{argument name="headline text" default="その課金、まだ早い"}。在标题下方，添加一个几乎横跨整个宽度的亮黄色矩形横幅，文字为粗体黑色：{argument name="subheadline text" default="月3,000円で足りる21の使い方"}。

主体细节：在下半部分，展示一张写实的摄影棚风格剪影，主角是一位留着黑色长发和刘海、身穿米色针织衫的年轻日本女性。她面向镜头，左手张开向观众做出清晰的“停止/等待”手势，右手拿着一张金色信用卡。使用自然的肤色、干净的美容布光以及清晰的抠图边缘。

装饰元素：添加 3 枚浮动的金色日元硬币，硬币上刻有日元符号：一枚位于左上中部，一枚靠近左下边缘，一枚位于右侧中部。添加 2 个带有三个黑点的白色对话气泡：一个位于左侧手势附近，另一个位于右侧标题/肩部区域附近。请勿添加额外的硬币、气泡、图标、Logo 或水印。

视觉风格：高冲击力的日语社交媒体缩略图，具有光泽的 3D 质感、强烈的投影、绿色标签的霓虹发光效果、干净的合成、锐利的排版、饱和的色彩以及专业的病毒式封面设计。确保文字准确且无乱码。

en.title: Mythic Baroque Storm Collage
en.description: A cinematic mythological music-poster scene of a mother protecting her child amid divine jealousy, storm waves, and Baroque instruments.
en.prompt: Create a dramatic wide cinematic digital collage inspired by Baroque opera and classical mythology: in the center, a terrified {argument name="mother figure" default="young mother in a torn cream linen dress"} rises from a violent dark teal ocean while clutching her {argument name="child" default="small curly-haired child"} protectively against her chest, both lit with painterly golden highlights and looking upward in fear and defiance. Behind them, looming in the upper left, place a monumental stone-gray goddess bust representing {argument name="mythological antagonist" default="Juno"}, wearing an ornate crown and radiant fan-like halo, with one huge raised hand emerging from storm clouds as if controlling the tempest. Surround the scene with crashing waves, sea foam, wind streaks, splashes of gold paint, and swirling engraved music-staff lines, creating the feeling that the ocean, wind, gods, and music are all fused together. Include exactly five visible musical elements: two long Baroque flutes crossing diagonally from the left edge, two golden natural horns floating in the upper right, and one abstract vertical lyre/string motif along the right edge. Add decorative red and pale pink treble-clef-like curls and circular staff spirals woven into the waves. Use a dark palette of deep navy, teal, black, antique gold, ivory, coral red, and weathered stone gray. Style: ultra-detailed cinematic mythological poster, mixed-media oil painting plus etched musical notation, turbulent water realism, dramatic chiaroscuro, high contrast, epic album-cover composition, no readable text, no modern clothing, no watermark. Aspect ratio 16:9.

zh.title: 神话巴洛克风暴拼贴画
zh.description: 一幅电影感的神话音乐海报场景，描绘了一位母亲在神灵嫉妒、风暴巨浪和巴洛克乐器中保护孩子的画面。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅受巴洛克歌剧和古典神话启发的戏剧性宽屏电影感数字拼贴画：画面中心，一位惊恐的 {argument name="mother figure" default="身穿破损米色亚麻裙的年轻母亲"} 从汹涌的深青色海洋中升起，怀中紧紧护着她的 {argument name="child" default="卷发幼童"}，两人身上映照着油画般的金色高光，神情惊恐而倔强地望向天空。在左上方，矗立着一座巨大的石灰色女神半身像，代表 {argument name="mythological antagonist" default="朱诺 (Juno)"}，她头戴华丽的王冠，身后是放射状的扇形光环，一只巨大的手从风暴云层中伸出，仿佛在操控这场风暴。场景周围环绕着翻滚的巨浪、海沫、风痕、金色的泼漆以及盘旋的雕刻式五线谱线条，营造出海洋、风、神灵与音乐融为一体的氛围。画面中需包含五个清晰的音乐元素：左侧边缘有两支斜向交叉的长款巴洛克长笛，右上方漂浮着两支金色自然号角，右侧边缘有一个抽象的垂直里拉琴/弦乐母题。在海浪中融入装饰性的红色和淡粉色高音谱号卷纹及圆形谱线螺旋。采用深海军蓝、青色、黑色、古金色、象牙白、珊瑚红和风化石灰色组成的深色调。风格：超细节电影感神话海报，混合媒介油画与蚀刻乐谱，湍急的水流写实感，戏剧性的明暗对比，高对比度，史诗级专辑封面构图，无可见文字，无现代服装，无水印。长宽比 16:9。

en.title: Felt GPT Image 2 Apple Design Banner
en.description: A handmade felt-style hero banner for an article about GPT Image 2 and apple-design UI animation experiments.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a wide article hero banner in a soft handmade felt-and-fabric craft style, introducing {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 × apple-design"} and six moving UI examples.

Canvas: Horizontal 2:1 banner, warm cream fabric background, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, tactile stitched materials, felt appliqué letters and plush objects.

Layout: Left half is bold text typography; center shows two smartphone UI mockups with animation/comparison annotations; right side has a cute plush cat assistant character holding design-review props.

Text content: Large stacked headline on the left reads exactly “GPT” in dark teal felt, “Image 2” in red felt, a small dark teal “×”, then “apple-design” in red felt. Under it, add a stitched divider line, then Japanese subheading text: {argument name="subheading text" default="6つの動くUIを作ってみた"}. At the bottom left, add a dark teal rounded stitched label with cream text: {argument name="bottom label text" default="Image Gen から実装・比較・修正まで"}.

Central UI mockups: Show exactly 2 tall rounded smartphone cards. Each phone has a circular apple icon at the top, three stacked list rows below, and one bottom rounded button area. The list rows use exactly 3 icons: cherries, heart, and gear, each with gray placeholder text lines. The left phone looks slightly less refined and washed out; the right phone looks polished, brighter, and cleaner.

Annotation elements: Between and around the phones, show exactly 4 comparison/measurement callouts: 1 top dashed pill showing alignment/spacing with a red measurement line, 1 central dashed box reading “44 px”, 1 bottom transformation callout with a red X leading by arrow to a green check, and 1 dashed outline around the polished right phone’s bottom button. Include exactly 2 red X badges and exactly 2 green check badges. Use cyan dashed guide lines connecting the callouts to the UI areas.

Right character: Add a small beige felt plush cat mascot with stitched seams, red round glasses, large blue eyes, tiny whiskers, and a curled tail. It holds exactly 2 props: a black magnifying glass in one paw and a red magic wand topped with a raspberry-like pom-pom in the other. Character mood is cheerful, clever, and instructional.

Visual style: Apple-inspired clean UI composition translated into soft felt craft, embroidered edges, raised fabric letters, rounded corners, cozy handmade texture, shallow depth of field, cream/red/dark teal palette with cyan annotation lines and gray UI placeholders.

Constraints: Keep the banner uncluttered, readable, and centered. Preserve all visible Japanese text exactly as specified. Use no watermark, no photo-realistic metal or glass, and no extra UI cards beyond the 2 phones.

zh.title: Felt GPT Image 2 Apple Design 横幅海报
zh.description: 一款手工毛毡风格的英雄海报，用于介绍 GPT Image 2 和 apple-design UI 动画实验的文章。
zh.prompt:
目标：创建一个宽幅文章英雄海报，采用柔和的手工毛毡与织物工艺风格，引入 {argument name="headline text" default="GPT Image 2 × apple-design"} 以及 6 个动态 UI 示例。

画布：水平 2:1 海报，温暖的奶油色织物背景，柔和的摄影棚灯光，微妙的阴影，富有质感的缝合材料，毛毡贴花字母和毛绒物体。

布局：左半部分为粗体排版；中心展示两个带有动画/对比标注的智能手机 UI 模型；右侧有一个可爱的毛绒猫咪 Agent 角色，手持设计评审道具。

文本内容：左侧的大型堆叠标题文字为：深青色毛毡材质的“GPT”，红色毛毡材质的“Image 2”，一个小的深青色“×”，以及红色毛毡材质的“apple-design”。在下方添加一条缝合分割线，然后是日语副标题：{argument name="subheading text" default="6つの動くUIを作ってみた"}。在左下角，添加一个深青色圆角缝合标签，内含奶油色文字：{argument name="bottom label text" default="Image Gen から実装・比較・修正まで"}。

中央 UI 模型：展示 2 个修长的圆角智能手机卡片。每部手机顶部都有一个圆形 apple 图标，下方有三行堆叠列表，以及一个底部圆角按钮区域。列表行使用 3 个图标：樱桃、心形和齿轮，每个图标旁都有灰色占位符文本行。左侧手机看起来略显粗糙且色彩暗淡；右侧手机看起来精致、明亮且整洁。

标注元素：在手机之间及周围，展示 4 个对比/测量标注：1 个顶部虚线胶囊形状，显示带有红色测量线的对齐/间距；1 个中央虚线框，标注“44 px”；1 个底部转换标注，用红色 X 通过箭头指向绿色勾号；以及 1 个围绕右侧精致手机底部按钮的虚线轮廓。包含 2 个红色 X 徽章和 2 个绿色勾号徽章。使用青色虚线引导线将标注连接到 UI 区域。

右侧角色：添加一个小型米色毛毡毛绒猫咪吉祥物，带有缝合线、红色圆框眼镜、蓝色大眼睛、细小的胡须和卷曲的尾巴。它手持 2 个道具：一只爪子拿着黑色放大镜，另一只爪子拿着顶部带有树莓状绒球的红色魔法棒。角色情绪欢快、聪明且具有指导性。

视觉风格：将 Apple 风格的简洁 UI 构图转化为柔软的毛毡工艺，刺绣边缘，凸起的织物字母，圆角，舒适的手工质感，浅景深，奶油色/红色/深青色调，搭配青色标注线和灰色 UI 占位符。

约束：保持海报简洁、易读且居中。完整保留所有指定的日语文本。不使用水印，不使用照片级真实的金属或玻璃材质，除 2 部手机外，不添加额外的 UI 卡片。

en.title: Fox-Eared Girl on Sunlit Market Street
en.description: A detailed vertical anime prompt for creating a romantic fox-eared kimono girl in a nostalgic flower-lined market street.
en.prompt: Create a delicate vertical anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a young fox-eared girl"} standing in profile on a sunlit old-fashioned shopping street, looking back over her shoulder with a soft melancholic smile. She has very long {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair with straight bangs, pale skin, gentle pink eyes, exactly 2 large fluffy animal ears, and exactly 1 large fluffy white tail visible at the lower right. Dress her in an ornate {argument name="kimono color" default="dusty rose pink"} kimono with layered lace trim, embroidered floral brocade, a wide tied obi bow at the back, and dangling tassel ornaments. Add an elaborate hairpiece on the right side of her head: exactly 3 prominent flowers, a metallic leaf-and-jewel ornament, long chains, purple tassels, and a translucent ribbon bow, plus a small round hat or halo-like cap behind the ears. Set the scene in a nostalgic Japanese-European market lane with warm morning backlight, cobblestone walkway, wooden storefronts, leafy trees overhead, and a soft blue sky with scattered clouds. Include exactly 2 vintage street lamps on the left, one tall black lantern and one smaller glowing lantern, plus 1 oval hanging shop sign that reads {argument name="shop sign text" default="owa days"} with a small paw print beneath it. Show background pedestrians in muted kimono-like clothing walking away, softly blurred and not competing with the main character. Place large blooming flowers in the lower left foreground, including pale pink and lavender blossoms. Use highly detailed linework, romantic pastel colors, luminous rim light through the hair, intricate fabric patterns, shallow depth of field, dreamy watercolor-and-ink anime rendering, vertical 9:16 composition, no modern objects, no watermark, no extra readable text beyond the shop sign.

zh.title: 阳光集市街上的狐耳少女
zh.description: 一个精细的竖版动漫提示词，用于创作一位在怀旧花丛集市街上的浪漫和服狐耳少女。
zh.prompt: 创作一张精致的竖版动漫插画，描绘 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻的狐耳少女"} 侧身站在阳光明媚的复古商业街上，回眸露出一抹淡淡的忧郁微笑。她拥有极长的 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 直刘海长发，肤色白皙，温柔的粉色眼眸，头部有且仅有 2 只毛茸茸的动物耳朵，右下方可见 1 条毛茸茸的大白尾巴。为她穿上一件华丽的 {argument name="kimono color" default="灰粉色"} 和服，配有层叠的蕾丝边、绣花锦缎、背部宽大的系带腰封以及垂下的流苏装饰。在她的头部右侧添加精美的发饰：包括 3 朵醒目的花朵、金属叶片与珠宝装饰、长链条、紫色流苏、半透明丝带蝴蝶结，并在耳朵后方戴上一顶小圆帽或类似光环的头饰。场景设定在一条怀旧的日欧风格集市巷道中，伴有温暖的清晨逆光、鹅卵石路面、木质店面、头顶的绿树以及点缀着云朵的柔和蓝天。左侧放置 2 盏复古街灯，其中一盏为高大的黑色灯笼，另一盏为较小的发光灯笼，并挂有 1 个椭圆形的店铺招牌，上面写着 {argument name="shop sign text" default="owa days"}，下方带有一个小小的爪印。背景中，身着素雅和服风格服装的行人正缓步走远，画面经过柔焦处理，不会喧宾夺主。左下角前景处放置大簇盛开的花朵，包括淡粉色和淡紫色的花卉。使用高精度的线条、浪漫的柔和色调、穿过发丝的明亮轮廓光、复杂的布料纹理、浅景深效果、梦幻般的水彩水墨动漫渲染风格，采用 9:16 竖构图，画面中不包含现代物品，无水印，除店铺招牌外无其他可读文字。

en.title: Tense Romantic Drama Collage
en.description: Creates a realistic four-panel cinematic collage of two characters in an emotionally tense hotel lobby confrontation.
en.prompt: Create a realistic cinematic four-panel scene collage from a modern romantic drama, arranged as a clean 2x2 grid with thin white dividers and no captions or text. The scene takes place at night in a warm, upscale hotel or apartment lobby with dark wood floors, beige walls, framed art, stairs, table lamps, and soft amber practical lighting. Feature exactly two characters in every panel: a young blonde woman and a young man. The woman has long straight blonde hair, blue eyes, fair skin, and wears a camel blazer over a muted rust-orange blouse with white trousers; she holds a dark navy or black folder/binder against her chest in most shots, looking anxious but composed. The man is tall with fair skin, short curly light-brown hair, slight stubble, and wears a fitted black button-up shirt and dark trousers, with a serious conflicted expression. Panel 1, top left: wide full-body shot in the lobby, the woman stands on the left clutching the folder and looking up at the man, the man stands on the right in profile with one hand in his pocket, tense distance between them. Panel 2, top right: close-up over the woman’s blurred blonde shoulder, focusing on the man’s face as he looks at her with a furrowed brow, shallow depth of field. Panel 3, bottom left: close-up of the woman from the front, holding the folder to her chest, eyes glossy and vulnerable as she looks toward the man, his dark shoulder blurred in the foreground. Panel 4, bottom right: intimate medium close-up side profile of both characters facing each other very closely, the woman on the left looking up, the man on the right looking down, emotional tension and soft lamp glow behind them. Use natural skin texture, realistic photography, cinematic color grading, warm shadows, shallow depth of field, high-end TV drama stills, no watermark, no visible noise, no distorted faces, no extra people in focus. Character customization: {argument name="female character" default="young blonde woman in a camel blazer, rust-orange blouse, and white trousers holding a dark folder"}; {argument name="male character" default="young curly-haired man in a fitted black button-up shirt and dark trousers"}; {argument name="setting" default="warm upscale hotel lobby at night"}; {argument name="mood" default="tense romantic confrontation"}; {argument name="grid layout" default="2x2 cinematic collage with thin white dividers"}.

zh.title: 紧张浪漫剧集拼贴画
zh.description: 创作一张写实的四格电影感拼贴画，展现两名角色在酒店大堂进行情感紧张的对峙。
zh.prompt: 创作一张来自现代浪漫剧集的写实电影感四格场景拼贴画，以整洁的 2x2 网格排列，带有细白分割线，无标题或文字。场景设定在夜晚，地点为温馨的高档酒店或公寓大堂，配有深色木地板、米色墙壁、装饰画、楼梯、台灯以及柔和的琥珀色实用照明。每个画面中必须包含两名角色：一名年轻的金发女性和一名年轻男性。女性留着长直金发，蓝眼睛，皮肤白皙，身穿驼色西装外套，内搭柔和的铁锈橙色衬衫，下穿白色长裤；在多数镜头中，她将一个深蓝色或黑色文件夹/活页夹抱在胸前，神情焦虑但保持镇定。男性身材高大，皮肤白皙，留着短卷浅棕色头发，略带胡茬，身穿修身黑色衬衫和深色长裤，表情严肃且充满矛盾。第 1 格（左上）：大堂内的宽幅全身镜头，女性站在左侧紧抱文件夹仰视男性，男性站在右侧呈侧面，一只手插在口袋里，两人之间保持着紧张的距离。第 2 格（右上）：越过女性模糊的金发肩膀拍摄的特写，焦点对准男性的脸部，他皱着眉头看向她，浅景深效果。第 3 格（左下）：女性的正面特写，她将文件夹抱在胸前，眼神湿润且脆弱地看向男性，男性的深色肩膀在前景中模糊处理。第 4 格（右下）：两人面对面近距离的亲密中景侧面特写，女性在左侧仰视，男性在右侧俯视，情感张力十足，背景中有柔和的灯光。使用自然的皮肤纹理、写实摄影、电影级调色、温暖的阴影、浅景深，呈现高端电视剧剧照质感，无水印，无可见噪点，无扭曲的面部，焦点内无其他无关人员。角色自定义：{argument name="female character" default="身穿驼色西装外套、铁锈橙色衬衫、白色长裤并手持深色文件夹的年轻金发女性"}；{argument name="male character" default="身穿修身黑色衬衫和深色长裤的年轻卷发男性"}；{argument name="setting" default="夜晚温馨的高档酒店大堂"}；{argument name="mood" default="紧张的浪漫对峙"}；{argument name="grid layout" default="带有细白分割线的 2x2 电影感拼贴画"}。

en.title: Sunlit Train Window Fashion Portrait
en.description: A photorealistic vertical fashion portrait of an adult woman leaning by a sunny train window, useful for editorial lifestyle or fashion imagery.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical fashion portrait of an adult East Asian woman, about {argument name="age" default="24"} years old, standing inside an older commuter train beside an open window on a bright sunny day. She is leaning forward with both hands resting on the metal window ledge, torso turned back over her shoulder to look directly at the camera with a soft, calm expression and slight smile. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long dark brown hair"}, loose and windblown across her face and down her back, natural makeup, clear skin, and delicate facial features. Outfit: a semi-sheer pale beige short-sleeve cropped top with side tie strings and fitted blue denim cuffed short shorts with visible back pockets and stitching. Composition is a three-quarter rear view from mid-thigh upward, centered slightly to the right, with the train window framing her upper body and a blue vinyl train seat partially visible at lower left. Background outside the window is overexposed and softly blurred, showing green trees and indistinct buildings. Use natural backlighting, warm sunlight, airy highlights, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, soft lens bloom, subtle film-like color grading, and high-detail editorial photography. Canvas: vertical 9:16 smartphone aspect ratio. Constraints: adult subject only, tasteful fashion photography, no nudity, no explicit pose, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

zh.title: 阳光列车窗边的时尚人像
zh.description: 一张写实的竖版女性时尚人像，展现了靠在阳光明媚的列车窗边的女性，适用于编辑类生活方式或时尚摄影。
zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的竖版时尚人像，主角是一位大约 {argument name="age" default="24"} 岁的东亚女性，站在一辆老式通勤列车内，靠在明媚阳光下的开窗旁。她身体前倾，双手搭在金属窗台上，上半身回转，越过肩膀直视镜头，表情柔和从容，带着淡淡的微笑。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色长发"}，发丝随风飘动，散落在脸庞和背部，妆容自然，皮肤通透，五官精致。服装：一件浅米色半透明短袖露脐上衣，侧面系带，搭配合身的蓝色牛仔翻边短裤，可见后袋和缝线细节。构图为从大腿中部向上的四分之三背影，略微偏右，列车窗框勾勒出她的上半身，左下角可见部分蓝色乙烯基列车座椅。窗外背景过度曝光并经过柔焦处理，隐约可见绿树和模糊的建筑。采用自然逆光、温暖阳光、通透高光、浅景深、写实的皮肤纹理、柔和的镜头光晕、细腻的电影感调色，以及高细节的编辑摄影风格。画布：9:16 竖版智能手机比例。约束条件：仅限成年主体，高雅的时尚摄影，无裸露，无露骨姿势，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

en.title: Lonely Sci-Fi Harbor Wallpaper
en.description: A cinematic oil-painted sci-fi harbor wallpaper featuring a solitary figure facing misty megastructures and hovering spacecraft.
en.prompt: Create a wide cinematic science-fiction wallpaper in a cold, lonely oil-painting style: a vast misty futuristic harbor city under a pale gray-blue sky, with towering vertical megastructures and needle-like skyscraper silhouettes fading into atmospheric haze. In the lower left foreground, place a single tiny solitary human figure standing on the edge of a dark concrete pier with simple metal railings, looking out across reflective water toward the immense city, emphasizing isolation and scale. Include exactly 12 visible flying vessels: 2 large horizontal capital ships, one long massive ship crossing the upper left-center with a faint warm orange engine glow, one bulky rounded ship hovering on the right; 6 medium airships scattered through the mist at upper left, upper center, center, right-center, far right, and lower left; and 4 tiny distant craft as small silhouettes in the background sky. The city should be extremely detailed but softened by fog, with platforms, docks, antennae, spires, faint lights, and mirrored reflections on calm water. Use a muted palette of icy blue, gray, pale teal, desaturated beige, and subtle warm orange-red accent lights. Render with thick textured brushstrokes, impressionistic oil paint, worn canvas grain, soft edges, diffuse overcast lighting, maximalist sci-fi detail in the distance, melancholic atmosphere reminiscent of a quiet coastal drama. Compose for a 2:1 landscape desktop wallpaper, no text, no logo, no frame.

zh.title: 孤独科幻港口壁纸
zh.description: 一张电影质感的油画风格科幻港口壁纸，画面中一个孤独的身影面对着雾气缭绕的巨型建筑和悬浮飞船。
zh.prompt: 创作一张宽屏电影质感的科幻壁纸，采用冷峻、孤独的油画风格：画面展现一座广阔且雾气弥漫的未来主义港口城市，天空呈现苍白的灰蓝色，高耸的垂直巨型建筑和针状摩天大楼的轮廓在朦胧的雾气中若隐若现。在左下角的前景处，放置一个渺小的孤独人类身影，站在带有简单金属护栏的深色混凝土码头边缘，眺望对岸倒映在水面上的宏伟城市，以此强调孤独感与尺度感。画面中必须包含 12 艘清晰可见的飞行器：2 艘大型水平方向的主力舰，其中一艘长而巨大的飞船横跨左上中部，带有微弱的暖橙色引擎光，另一艘圆润笨重的飞船悬浮在右侧；6 艘中型飞艇散布在左上、上中、中心、右中、最右侧及左下方的雾气中；另有 4 艘极小的远方飞行器作为背景天空中的微小剪影。城市细节极其丰富，但被雾气柔化，包含平台、码头、天线、尖塔、微弱的灯光以及平静水面上的倒影。使用冰蓝、灰、浅青、低饱和度米色以及微妙的暖橙红色点缀灯光组成的柔和色调。采用厚重的纹理笔触渲染，呈现印象派油画质感、磨损的画布纹理、柔和的边缘、漫射的阴天光线，远景具备极繁主义的科幻细节，营造出一种类似静谧海岸剧情片的忧郁氛围。构图适配 2:1 的横屏桌面壁纸，无文字、无 Logo、无边框。

en.title: Hand-Drawn Wedding Couple Invitation
en.description: Generates a soft watercolor chibi wedding invitation with a bride, groom, floral ornaments, and editable name lines.
en.prompt: Create a horizontal 16:9 hand-drawn wedding invitation illustration in a soft Korean/Japanese watercolor children’s-book style. Use a warm terracotta-red rounded rectangle background with rough dry-brush edges on a white canvas, subtle paper grain, tiny white sparkles and floating hearts. On the left half, draw exactly 2 cute chibi-style wedding characters: 1 groom and 1 bride. The groom has {argument name="groom hair color" default="dark brown"} softly tousled hair, a black suit jacket, white shirt, rust-red tie, gentle dot eyes, rosy cheeks, and a small boutonniere. The bride has {argument name="bride hair color" default="dark brown"} hair in a soft updo, a delicate flower crown, sheer veil, off-shoulder white wedding dress with translucent sleeves, dot eyes, rosy cheeks, and holds a bouquet of coral, peach, cream, and green flowers tied with a red ribbon. Include exactly 4 main floral decorations: the groom’s boutonniere, the bride’s bouquet, a lower-left floral sprig near the couple, and a right-side floral cluster with a large pale rose and small blossoms. Add a delicate decorative wedding name frame on the right half: thin white ornamental lines forming a loose rounded rectangle, a small heart at the top center, a bow flourish at the bottom center, and two blank name lines separated by an ampersand, reading “{argument name="left name" default="______"} & {argument name="right name" default="______"}”. Add exactly 1 decorative bow motif in the upper-left corner made from thin white lines and dotted floral ornaments. Keep the composition airy and romantic, with muted pastel colors, soft pencil outlines, watercolor blush shading, no photorealism, no harsh shadows, no extra people, and no watermark.

zh.title: 手绘婚礼新人邀请函
zh.description: 生成一张柔和的水彩 Q 版婚礼邀请函，包含新郎、新娘、花卉装饰以及可编辑的姓名栏。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 16:9 横向的手绘婚礼邀请函插画，采用柔和的韩式/日式水彩绘本风格。使用温暖的赤陶红圆角矩形作为背景，在白色画布上呈现粗糙的干笔触边缘，带有细微的纸张纹理、微小的白色闪光和漂浮的心形图案。在左半部分，精确绘制 2 个可爱的 Q 版婚礼角色：1 位新郎和 1 位新娘。新郎拥有 {argument name="groom hair color" default="深棕色"} 的蓬松短发，身穿黑色西装外套、白色衬衫，系着铁锈红领带，有着柔和的豆豆眼、红润的脸颊和一枚小巧的胸花。新娘拥有 {argument name="bride hair color" default="深棕色"} 的柔和盘发，戴着精致的花冠和透明头纱，身穿露肩白色婚纱，袖子呈半透明状，有着豆豆眼、红润的脸颊，手中拿着一束由珊瑚色、桃色、奶油色和绿色花朵组成并系着红丝带的花束。包含 4 处主要花卉装饰：新郎的胸花、新娘的手捧花、新人附近左下角的花枝，以及右侧由一朵大淡粉色玫瑰和小花组成的花簇。在右半部分添加一个精致的装饰性婚礼姓名框：由纤细的白色装饰线条构成一个宽松的圆角矩形，顶部中心有一个小心形，底部中心有一个蝴蝶结装饰，中间有两条由“&”符号分隔的空白姓名横线，显示为“{argument name="left name" default="______"} & {argument name="right name" default="______"}”。在左上角添加 1 个由纤细白线和点状花卉装饰组成的蝴蝶结图案。保持构图空灵浪漫，采用柔和的粉彩色调，使用柔和的铅笔轮廓和水彩腮红阴影，拒绝写实风格，避免强烈的阴影，不要出现多余人物，且无水印。

en.title: Modern Editorial Fashion Collage
en.description: A polished magazine editorial prompt for creating a minimalist, contemporary fashion collage with layered portraits.
en.prompt: Create a modern editorial collage poster featuring four vertically stacked rounded-rectangle panels in the background, each displaying cinematic black-and-white portraits of the same {argument name="subject" default="stylish young man"} in different high-fashion poses and camera angles. In the foreground, place a high-resolution full-color cutout of the same man, confidently posing while wearing an {argument name="top" default="oversized red shirt"}, {argument name="bottom" default="black tailored pants"}, black sunglasses, and fashionable sneakers. Use a clean white background with subtle soft shadows and layered depth for a premium magazine editorial aesthetic. The composition should feel minimal, luxurious, and contemporary with smooth edges, crisp details, realistic skin texture, dramatic studio lighting, and high contrast. No text, no typography, no logos, no letters, no watermark. Ultra-realistic, fashion campaign, premium editorial photography, 8K resolution, sharp focus, elegant composition.

zh.title: 时尚编辑拼贴海报
zh.description: 一个精致的编辑拼贴提示词，旨在创作一张杂志风格的海报，通过电影质感的黑白画幅与全彩时尚主体形成鲜明对比。
zh.prompt: 创作一张现代编辑拼贴海报，背景包含 {argument name="panel count" default="四个"} 垂直堆叠的圆角矩形画幅，每个画幅展示同一位时尚 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男性"} 在不同高级时装姿势和拍摄角度下的电影质感黑白肖像。在前景中，放置该男性的高分辨率全彩抠图，他自信地摆出姿势，身着 {argument name="outfit description" default="超大款红色衬衫、黑色定制长裤、黑色墨镜和时尚运动鞋"}。使用干净的白色背景，辅以微妙的柔和阴影和层叠的深度感，营造出高级杂志编辑的美学效果。构图应呈现极简、奢华且现代的风格，边缘平滑，细节清晰，皮肤纹理真实，具有戏剧性的影棚灯光和高对比度。无文字，无排版，无标志，无字母，无水印。超写实，时尚大片，高级编辑摄影，8K 分辨率，焦点清晰，构图优雅。

en.title: Futuristic Glass Panel Fashion Portrait
en.description: A high-fashion cinematic prompt featuring a man walking in a misty, mirrored studio with multiple reflections.
en.prompt: Using uploaded face 100 percent same & realistic. A hyper-realistic, cinematic portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="handsome young man"} with thick styled dark hair, a mustache, and a beard. He is confidently walking forward, looking slightly off-camera with a subtle smile. He is wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="tailored light beige suit jacket and matching trousers"}, a plain white t-shirt underneath, and {argument name="shoes" default="clean white sneakers"}. One hand is casually resting in his trouser pocket. The setting is ethereal and futuristic, featuring a highly reflective, glossy floor with low-lying white mist or fog rolling across it. Behind him stand four tall, vertical rectangular mirrors or glass panels. Each panel displays a slightly different reflection or alternate version of the same man in various poses and different outfits. Bright, clean studio lighting with a mix of cool and neutral tones, highly detailed, photorealistic, editorial fashion photography style. Keep original face and hairstyle 100% reference

zh.title: 未来感工作室镜面肖像
zh.description: 一款高端时尚编辑提示词，呈现男性主体与未来感工作室场景中复杂的镜面反射效果。
zh.prompt: 使用上传的人脸，实现 100% 相同且真实的效果。这是一张超写实、电影质感的肖像，主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="帅气的年轻男子"}，留着浓密的深色造型短发，蓄着胡须。他自信地向前走着，目光略微偏离镜头，带着淡淡的微笑。他身穿剪裁合身的 {argument name="jacket" default="浅米色西装外套"} 和配套长裤，内搭一件 {argument name="shirt" default="纯白色 T 恤"}，脚穿干净的白色运动鞋。一只手随意地插在裤兜里。场景空灵且充满未来感，地面光亮如镜，低处弥漫着白色的薄雾。他身后矗立着四块高大的垂直矩形镜子或玻璃板。每块面板都展示了同一个男人在不同姿势和不同服装下的略有差异的反射或替代版本。明亮、干净的工作室灯光，融合了冷色调与中性色调，细节丰富，照片级真实感，呈现编辑类时尚摄影风格。保持原始面部和发型 100% 参考。

en.title: Multi-Ethnic Editorial Fashion Portraits
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for magazine-quality fashion portraits featuring specific poses and descriptions for European, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese models.
en.prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic editorial fashion portrait in a minimalist photography studio with a seamless charcoal-gray backdrop. Soft cinematic low-key lighting using a single large softbox, premium magazine-quality aesthetic, clean composition with no props, Sony A7R V, 85mm f/1.4 lens, shallow depth of field, ultra-realistic skin texture with visible pores, natural makeup, true-to-life colors, 8K. Outfit: elegant {argument name="top" default="olive satin camisole"} with a modest slightly lowered neckline, {argument name="bottom" default="cream high-waisted wide-leg trousers"}, no glasses, minimal accessories.

1. European Girl
A naturally beautiful European woman with soft brown eyes and dark brown hair in a loose messy bun with face-framing strands. Seated on the floor with one knee raised, one hand resting behind her for support and the other gently touching the side of her neck. Calm, confident expression looking slightly above the camera.

2. Japanese Girl
A young Japanese woman with fair skin and long black hair tied into a soft low bun with loose strands. Sitting cross-legged with both hands resting naturally on her knees, shoulders relaxed, head slightly tilted, serene expression looking directly at the camera.

3. Korean Girl
A young Korean woman with luminous skin and dark hair in a relaxed updo. Sitting with one leg folded and the other bent, one arm supporting her from behind while the other rests lightly under her chin. Soft confident expression with eyes directed toward the camera.

4. Chinese Girl
A beautiful Chinese woman with smooth fair skin and long dark hair in a loose bun. Sitting sideways with both legs folded to one side, one hand resting on the floor for balance while the other rests gently on her raised knee. Elegant posture with a composed expression and gaze slightly off-camera.

zh.prompt:
超写实时尚杂志人像，拍摄于极简摄影棚，背景为无缝炭灰色。采用单一大尺寸柔光箱的柔和电影感低调光，呈现顶级杂志质感，构图简洁无道具，Sony A7R V 相机，85mm f/1.4 镜头，浅景深，超写实皮肤纹理可见毛孔，自然妆容，色彩真实，8K 分辨率。服装：优雅的 {argument name="top" default="橄榄色缎面吊带背心"}，领口微低且端庄，搭配 {argument name="bottom" default="奶油色高腰阔腿裤"}，不戴眼镜，极简配饰。

1. 欧洲女性
一位天生丽质的欧洲女性，拥有柔和的棕色眼睛和深棕色头发，梳着凌乱的低发髻，脸颊两侧留有碎发。坐在地板上，单膝抬起，一只手撑在身后，另一只手轻轻触碰颈部侧面。表情冷静自信，视线略高于镜头。

2. 日本女性

3. 韩国女性

4. 中国女性
一位美丽的中国女性，皮肤白皙细腻，深色长发梳成松散的发髻。侧身坐着，双腿折叠在一侧，一只手撑在地板上保持平衡，另一只手轻轻放在抬起的膝盖上。姿态优雅，神情从容，视线略微偏离镜头。

en.title: Morning Sunlight Roomwear Portrait
en.description: A detailed cinematic portrait prompt capturing a calm morning scene of a woman in roomwear by a sunlit window with soft, realistic lighting and textures.
en.prompt:
Subject: {argument name="theme" default="Morning light on damp hair"}

Subject: A vertical portrait of an {argument name="person" default="adult woman in white roomwear"} sitting on a rug by a bright window. The subject is positioned largely from the center to the right of the screen, showing from the top of the head to the thighs. The upper body occupies about two-thirds of the screen, leaving a soft background margin and the window on the left.

Character/Expression: Natural black semi-long hair. Thin strands of hair, slightly damp as if after a bath, run along the cheeks and neck, with thin bangs falling over the forehead. The head is slightly tilted toward the upper left of the screen, with a quiet gaze directed out the window. Relaxed eyes, slightly parted lips, and a calm expression with a hint of sleepiness remaining. Minimal makeup centered on pale beige and pink, showing natural skin with pores and fine hair.

Clothing/Pose: A white camisole with thin shoulder straps and delicate lace, and matching shorts. Small buttons and soft gathers at the chest, with the light fabric falling naturally with gravity. A cream-colored, coarsely knitted cardigan is dropped from the shoulders, hanging loosely over the elbows and forearms. The body is twisted slightly to the left, sitting with one leg bent toward the front in a natural posture with slightly offset shoulder heights.

Background/Light: A large window on the left. Outside the window, green leaves bathed in morning sun spread out in soft bokeh. A white cup, a small glass vase, and thin branches are placed sparingly on a wooden table by the window. The primary light is warm natural light streaming from the window at the top left. It creates soft highlights on the cheeks, bridge of the nose, collarbone, shoulders, arms, and thighs, while the right side of the hair and the back of the room sink into gentle shadows. Pale reflected light bounces back from the white cloth and floor.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 2:3. Close-up shot looking down from a slightly high position. A triangular composition with the face at the top center, the chest in the center, and the bent leg at the bottom left. The margin on the window side emphasizes the direction of the gaze, and the background is heavily blurred. 50mm equivalent, shallow depth of field near wide open. Focus is on the eyes and face, with the leg in the foreground and the window in the background softly blurred.

Texture/Style: A photorealistic indoor portrait shot only with natural light. Based on bright ivory and pale wood grains, with healthy skin tones and the green outside the window as subtle accent colors. Not overly smoothed, but precisely depicting skin texture, fine hair, the clumped feeling of damp hair, and the fibers of lace and knit. Low contrast with soft gradations like an elegant film photograph.

Negative: Underage-looking persons, unnatural faces, unnatural gazes, asymmetrical eyes, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of limbs, collapsed shoulders or joints, clothing digging in, unnatural transparency of fabric, hair or clothing defying gravity, shadows inconsistent with light sources, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 晨光与湿发肖像
zh.description: 一个高度详细的提示词，用于生成一张写实风格的竖版肖像，描绘了一位身穿白色居家服、坐在阳光明媚的窗边、头发微湿的女性。
zh.prompt:
主体：{argument name="subject" default="晨光下的湿发"}

主体：{argument name="person" default="一位身穿白色居家服的成年女性"} 坐在明亮窗边的地毯上，竖版肖像。人物主体较大，位置略微偏向画面中心右侧，取景范围从头顶到大腿。上半身占据约三分之二的画面，左侧留出窗户和柔和的背景负空间。

人物与表情：自然的黑色中长发。发丝纤细，如沐浴后般微湿，贴合在脸颊和颈部，薄薄的刘海垂在额前。头部微微向左上方倾斜，安静地凝视着窗外。眼神放松，双唇微张，表情平静，带着一丝睡意。自然的皮肤质感，可见毛孔和细小绒毛，妆容呈现淡淡的米色和粉色调。

服装与姿势：白色细肩带吊带衫，带有精致的蕾丝装饰，搭配同款短裤。胸前有小纽扣和柔软的褶皱，轻薄的面料自然下垂。一件米色粗棒针织开衫从肩头滑落，松散地挂在从手肘到前臂的位置。身体略微向左扭转，一条腿向前弯曲，坐姿自然，双肩高度略有错落。

背景与光影：左侧有一扇大窗户。窗外，阳光照耀下的绿叶呈现出柔和的虚化效果。窗边的木桌上零星摆放着一个白杯子、一个小玻璃花瓶和几根细枝。主光源是来自左上方窗户的温暖自然光。脸颊、鼻梁、锁骨、肩膀、手臂和大腿上形成柔和的高光，而头发右侧和房间后部则沉浸在柔和的阴影中。白色布料和地板反射出微弱的光线。

构图与摄影：2:3 画幅比例。从略高位置俯拍的特写镜头。采用三角形构图，脸部位于顶部中心，胸部位于中间，弯曲的腿部位于左下方。窗户一侧的负空间强调了视线的方向，背景经过深度虚化。等效 50mm 焦段，接近全开光圈的浅景深。焦点对准眼睛和脸部，前景的腿部和背景的窗户则呈现柔和的模糊感。

质感与风格：仅使用自然光拍摄的写实室内肖像。以明亮的象牙白和浅色木纹为基调，肤色和窗外的绿色作为微妙的点缀色。不追求过度平滑，精准描绘皮肤纹理、细小绒毛、湿发的束感以及蕾丝和针织品的纤维感。低对比度，具有类似优雅胶片摄影的柔和渐变。

负面提示词：未成年人形象、不自然的面部、不自然的视线、不对称的眼睛、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、破碎的肩膀或关节、衣服勒入皮肤、面料不自然的透明感、违背重力的头发或衣服、与光源不一致的阴影、过度的皮肤修图、塑料质感的皮肤、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Summer Sunlight and Alleyway Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for a cinematic summer portrait of a woman sitting against a concrete wall in a Japanese residential alley.
en.prompt:
Subject: {argument name="subject" default="Summer light over knees"}

Subject: A single {argument name="person" default="adult woman sitting on the ground leaning against a concrete wall in a narrow alley of a quiet residential area"}, depicted in a vertical composition. The person occupies a large portion of the center to right side of the screen, pulling both knees close to her chest and wrapping her arms around her legs. A close-up portrait that captures the whole body while strongly emphasizing the upper body and legs.

Character and Expression: A natural and realistic woman with a calm adult look and softness. Not too thin, with a moderately mature body, showing feminine roundness in the lines of the shoulders, décolleté, arms, and thighs. Dark brown semi-long hair with light layers and thin see-through bangs. Fine wisps of hair around the face are translucent in the light. She tilts her head slightly, resting one cheek gently on her knee while looking straight at the camera. Her expression is quiet, gentle, and slightly ennui. Makeup is natural Japanese-style, with soft brown eyes, pale coral blush, and pink-beige lips. Small earrings on her ears.

Clothing and Pose: An {argument name="outfit" default="ivory-toned white sleeveless dress"}. Thin shoulder straps, modest ruffles around the shoulders, fine embroidery and eyelet lace from the chest to the waist, a lightly cinched waist, and thin, soft cotton material. The length is short, naturally showing the thighs in the seated posture. Both legs are extended diagonally toward the front left while holding the knees high, with both arms crossed in front. Fingers are placed naturally near the ankles without tension. On her feet are white thin-strap flat sandals. A delicate silver bracelet on one wrist.

Background and Light: The background is an alley with a lived-in feel typical of a Japanese residential area. A light gray concrete wall on the right, a black downspout in the back, a wooden door, and blurred potted plants or small greenery are arranged. The time is a sunny afternoon. The main light source is strong natural light streaming from the upper left, creating bright highlights on the hair outline, shoulders, cheeks, arms, knees, and tops of the legs. Dappled sunlight shadows fall on the ground, and reflected light from the wall softly lifts the shadow side of the face. The air is dry and bright, with the stillness of summer.

Composition and Camera: Vertical 4:5 portrait composition. The camera captures from a low position at close range, placing the feet at the bottom left and the face at the upper center. The person's body is toward the right, leaving the depth of the alley and the negative space of dappled sunlight on the left. The gaze is directed at the lens, with sharp focus on the face and front knee. The background is softly blurred with a shallow depth of field to highlight the person. Natural perspective ensures the extension of the legs and the holding posture look beautiful.

Texture and Style: Realistic photographic expression. A transparent natural portrait like a summer snap in a fashion magazine. Skin is not overly smooth, leaving natural texture. Fine clumps of hair, delicate eyelet patterns of cotton lace, the roughness of the concrete wall, and the thin straps of the sandals are carefully depicted. The color scheme is elegant and soft, centered on ivory, beige, and gray, with a small amount of green from the background as an accent. Moderate contrast, without excessive overexposure, resulting in a calm, high-end finish.

Negative: Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, childish body type, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, twisted arms or legs, unnatural gravity, poor contact with sandals, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 夏日阳光与巷弄肖像
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于创作一张电影质感的夏日肖像，描绘一位坐在日本住宅区巷弄混凝土墙边的女性。
zh.prompt:
主体：{argument name="subject" default="膝盖上的夏日阳光"}

主体：一位 {argument name="person" default="坐在安静住宅区狭窄巷弄的混凝土墙边，成年女性"}，采用竖构图。人物占据画面中心至右侧的大部分区域，双膝抱胸，双臂环抱双腿。这是一张全身肖像，重点突出上半身和腿部。

人物与表情：一位自然写实的女性，神情沉稳，气质柔和。身材不过分消瘦，具有适度的成熟美，肩部、锁骨、手臂和大腿线条呈现出女性的圆润感。深棕色中长发，带有轻盈的层次感和薄透的空气刘海。脸颊周围的细碎发丝在光线下呈现出半透明感。她微微歪头，脸颊轻轻靠在膝盖上，直视镜头。表情安静、温柔，略带一丝慵懒。妆容为自然的日系风格，柔和的棕色眼影，淡珊瑚色腮红，粉米色唇妆。耳畔佩戴着小巧的耳环。

服装与姿势：身着 {argument name="outfit" default="象牙白无袖连衣裙"}。细肩带，肩部有简约的荷叶边，胸部至腰部饰有精细的刺绣和镂空蕾丝，腰部微收，采用轻薄柔软的棉质面料。裙长较短，坐姿下自然露出大腿。双腿向左前方斜向伸展，双膝高抬，双臂在身前交叉。手指自然地放在脚踝附近，没有紧绷感。脚穿白色细带平底凉鞋。手腕上戴着一条精致的银色手链。

zh.prompt: 创作一张超高端奢华时尚杂志肖像，主角是一位令人惊艳的 {argument name="model" default="东亚超模"}，拥有完美无瑕的自然美感、透亮肌肤、轮廓分明的面部特征、光泽柔顺的波浪卷发，以及自信的高级时尚表现力。她优雅地坐在一个极简主义哑光黑色立方体上，双腿优雅交叠，凸显修长美腿。一只手自然地撑在身后的立方体上，另一只手轻抚秀发，呈现出一种既放松又充满力量的杂志大片姿态。下巴微抬，双肩舒展，眼神直视镜头，充满自信。她身着一件 {argument name="gown color" default="深红色"} 液态绸缎高级定制礼服，采用挂脖领口设计，胸前有精致的镂空细节，腰部剪裁修身，配有极具戏剧性的高开叉设计，超长的拖尾在反光地面上优美地铺展开来。金属金色细高跟鞋、精致的红宝石耳环以及极简的奢华珠宝点缀，使整体造型更加完美。背景：深红奢华摄影棚，采用无缝深红背景幕，带有微妙的烟雾质感，一道电影级斜向聚光灯穿透薄雾，地面为光泽反光的酒红色，营造出柔和的氛围扩散效果，呈现干净的奢华时尚摄影棚美学。布光：专业好莱坞美妆布光，使用大型头顶八角柔光箱，柔和的前置主光，微妙的暖色轮廓光，柔和的红色边缘光，自然的阴影，以及逼真的光线衰减效果。调色：浓郁的深红色调，温暖的肤色高光，高级 HDR 对比度，真实色彩，优雅的电影级质感。使用专业全画幅相机搭配 {argument name="lens" default="85mm"} 人像镜头拍摄，光圈 f/2.0，呈现浅景深效果，背景虚化柔美，带有微妙的电影胶片颗粒感，超精准的皮肤微纹理，逼真的织物纹理，自然的头发丝细节，物理级精准布光，顶级杂志奢华时尚摄影，完全实拍，绝无 CGI 感，超写实 8K 分辨率，焦点锐利，博物馆级细节。

en.title: Cinematic Café Portrait at Blue Hour
en.description: A moody urban photography prompt capturing a woman in a retro diner through a window with city light reflections.
en.prompt: Ultra-cinematic lifestyle portrait photographed through a {argument name="setting" default="café window"} at blue hour, {argument name="subject" default="beautiful young woman"} seated alone in a cozy retro diner booth, relaxed and contemplative expression, long dark slightly messy hair framing the face, minimal natural makeup, {argument name="clothing" default="oversized cream sweatshirt"}, one hand resting on the table beside a ceramic coffee cup. Shot entirely through reflective glass with layered reflections of city lights, passing cars, glowing neon signs, soft lens flares, light streaks, and subtle ghosting. Warm tungsten café lighting mixed with cool dusk ambient light creates a dreamy cinematic contrast. Rich bokeh, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, soft highlights on the face, moody urban atmosphere, reflections partially obscuring the subject for an editorial storytelling look. Kodak Portra 400 film aesthetic, subtle film grain, soft bloom, muted color palette, natural imperfections, Leica M11, 50mm Summilux f/1.4, photorealistic, high-end fashion editorial, intimate composition, 8K ultra-detailed, award-winning street photography, authentic candid moment.

zh.title: 蓝调时刻的电影感咖啡馆人像
zh.description: 一组充满情绪的城市摄影提示词，捕捉透过窗户看到的复古餐馆中女性的身影，并带有城市灯光的倒影。
zh.prompt: 极致电影感生活化人像，于蓝调时刻透过 {argument name="setting" default="咖啡馆窗户"} 拍摄，{argument name="subject" default="美丽的年轻女性"} 独自坐在舒适的复古餐馆卡座中，神情放松而沉思，长长的深色微乱秀发垂在脸颊两侧，清透自然妆容，身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="米色廓形卫衣"}，一只手放在桌上的陶瓷咖啡杯旁。画面完全透过带有反射的玻璃拍摄，层叠着城市灯光、过往车辆、发光霓虹灯的倒影，伴有柔和的镜头光晕、光束及微妙的重影效果。温暖的钨丝灯光与清冷的黄昏环境光交织，营造出梦幻般的电影感对比。丰富的焦外成像，浅景深，真实的皮肤质感，面部柔和的高光，充满情绪的城市氛围，倒影部分遮挡主体，呈现出杂志叙事风格。柯达 Portra 400 胶片美学，细腻的胶片颗粒，柔和的光晕，低饱和色调，自然的瑕疵感，徕卡 M11，50mm Summilux f/1.4 镜头，照片级真实感，高端时尚杂志大片，亲密的构图，8K 超高清细节，屡获殊荣的街头摄影，真实自然的抓拍瞬间。

en.title: Pixar-Style 3D Caricature Transformation
en.description: Transforms a real-life photo into a stylized 3D caricature with Pixar-inspired proportions while maintaining the subject's unique identity and details.
en.prompt: Using the uploaded photo as the only face reference, create a hyper-realistic 3D caricature while preserving 100% of the person's facial identity, skin tone, hairstyle, facial features, and expression. Transform the subject into a {argument name="character style" default="stylized character with an oversized head, large expressive eyes, exaggerated facial proportions, and a small realistic body in a playful Pixar-inspired style"}. The subject is {argument name="pose and clothing" default="crouching confidently while holding a large takeaway coffee cup, wearing a fitted black T-shirt, gray pants, casual sneakers, and a silver bracelet"}. Place the character on {argument name="background" default="a seamless vibrant orange studio background and floor with soft cinematic lighting, subtle shadows, and clean reflections"}. Preserve realistic skin pores, curly hair texture, clothing fabric details, and highly detailed coffee cup textures while maintaining the stylized proportions. Capture the scene with an ultra-wide 18mm lens from a slightly elevated angle for a dramatic perspective. Ultra-detailed 3D rendering, Octane Render, Unreal Engine 5 quality, ray-traced global illumination, cinematic color grading, 8K resolution, premium advertising illustration, vibrant colors, masterpiece.Negative prompt: low quality, blurry, flat lighting, distorted face, extra limbs, extra fingers, duplicated body parts, watermark, text, logo, noise, AI artifacts, low-poly, cartoon outline

zh.title: 皮克斯风格 3D 卡通形象转换
zh.description: 将真实照片转换为具有皮克斯风格比例的 3D 卡通形象，同时保留主体独特的身份特征与细节。
zh.prompt: 仅以上传的照片作为面部参考，创作一个超写实的 3D 卡通形象，同时 100% 保留人物的面部特征、肤色、发型、五官和表情。将主体转换为 {argument name="character style" default="具有大头、大而富有表现力的眼睛、夸张的面部比例以及小巧写实身体的皮克斯风格卡通角色"}。主体为 {argument name="pose and clothing" default="自信地蹲着，手里拿着一个大号外带咖啡杯，身穿合身的黑色 T 恤、灰色长裤、休闲运动鞋，并佩戴着银色手链"}。将角色置于 {argument name="background" default="无缝的鲜艳橙色摄影棚背景和地面上，配以柔和的电影级灯光、微妙的阴影和清晰的反射"}。在保持卡通比例的同时，保留逼真的皮肤毛孔、卷发纹理、衣物织物细节以及高度精细的咖啡杯纹理。使用 18mm 超广角镜头从略微仰视的角度捕捉场景，以呈现戏剧性的透视效果。超精细 3D 渲染，Octane Render，Unreal Engine 5 品质，光线追踪全局光照，电影级调色，8K 分辨率，高级广告插画，色彩鲜艳，杰作。负面提示词：低质量，模糊，平淡光照，面部扭曲，多余肢体，多余手指，身体部位重复，水印，文字，Logo，噪点，AI 伪影，低多边形，卡通轮廓

en.title: Swiss Editorial Underground Music Poster
en.description: A premium music event poster design featuring bold Swiss typography, streetwear fashion elements, and a sophisticated editorial layout.
en.prompt: Create a premium underground music event poster with a bold Swiss inspired editorial layout and modern streetwear aesthetic. Portrait 4:5 composition. The background is {argument name="background texture" default="an off white textured paper with subtle grain, halftone noise, soft shadows, and minimal concrete texture"}. A gigantic condensed black sans serif word dominates the center vertically, extending nearly the full height of the canvas, creating a dramatic typographic backdrop. Place a {argument name="subject" default="stylish young woman sitting on the floor in the foreground, wearing an oversized black hoodie, baggy cargo pants, and black and white high top sneakers"}. She sits casually with one knee raised, one arm resting on her knee, looking confidently at the camera with a relaxed, slightly serious expression. Use an ultra wide angle perspective with the closest sneaker appearing oversized due to lens distortion, adding depth and a dynamic fashion editorial feel. The floor features thin perspective grid lines converging toward the horizon, enhancing depth. Floating blurred flyer sheets appear in the foreground on both sides, creating movement and depth of field. Use shallow depth of field with foreground motion blur while keeping the subject sharp. Typography is clean, modern, and highly organized. Include {argument name="information blocks" default="multiple information blocks positioned around the composition using condensed sans serif fonts with varying sizes and weights"}. Display event date, venue, guest artist, genre, ticket information, hashtags, barcode, age restriction, website, and schedule in a structured magazine inspired layout. Add thin divider lines and generous spacing for a premium editorial look. Include a handwritten gold script overlay crossing part of the main headline for contrast and luxury. Add subtle oversized transparent background typography layered behind the main title for extra depth. Color palette consists of black, white, light gray, warm beige, and subtle metallic gold accents. High contrast yet minimalistic. Lighting is soft studio lighting with realistic shadows and slightly muted tones. Matte finish, luxury street fashion campaign aesthetic, premium magazine cover design, underground bass music festival poster, Swiss typography, brutalist graphic design, fashion editorial, clean composition, realistic photography, ultra detailed, professional graphic design, 8K resolution, crisp typography, cinematic perspective, print ready quality.

zh.title: 瑞士编辑风格地下音乐海报
zh.description: 一款高端音乐活动海报设计，融合了醒目的瑞士排版、街头时尚元素以及精致的编辑布局。
zh.prompt: 创作一款高端地下音乐活动海报，采用醒目的瑞士风格编辑布局和现代街头美学。4:5 竖构图。背景为 {argument name="background texture" default="带有细微颗粒感、半色调噪点、柔和阴影和极简混凝土纹理的米白色纹理纸张"}。一个巨大的黑色压缩无衬线字体单词垂直占据画面中心，几乎延伸至画布全高，营造出极具戏剧性的排版背景。放置一个 {argument name="subject" default="身着超大号黑色连帽衫、宽松工装裤和黑白高帮运动鞋，坐在前景地板上的时尚年轻女性"}。她姿态随意，单膝抬起，一只手臂搁在膝盖上，神情放松且略显严肃，自信地注视着镜头。采用超广角透视，利用镜头畸变使最近的运动鞋显得夸张，增加深度感和动态时尚编辑感。地板上绘有向地平线汇聚的细透视网格线，增强深度。前景两侧漂浮着模糊的传单页，营造出动感和景深效果。使用浅景深，前景带有动态模糊，同时保持主体清晰。排版简洁、现代且高度有序。包含 {argument name="information blocks" default="使用不同字号和字重的压缩无衬线字体，在构图周围布置多个信息块"}。以结构化的杂志风格布局展示活动日期、场地、嘉宾艺人、流派、票务信息、标签、条形码、年龄限制、网站和日程安排。添加细分割线和宽裕的留白，以呈现高端编辑质感。加入手写金色草书覆盖在部分主标题上，形成对比与奢华感。在主标题后方添加微妙的超大透明背景排版，以增加深度。配色方案由黑色、白色、浅灰色、暖米色和微妙的金属金色点缀组成。高对比度且极简。灯光为柔和的摄影棚光，带有逼真的阴影和略微柔和的色调。哑光质感，奢华街头时尚广告美学，高端杂志封面设计，地下低音音乐节海报，瑞士排版，粗野主义平面设计，时尚编辑，构图简洁，写实摄影，超高细节，专业平面设计，8K 分辨率，清晰排版，电影级透视，印刷级品质。

en.title: Professional Marble Print Fashion Studio Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed studio photography prompt for creating high-fashion portraits featuring an East Asian woman in a marble-print evening gown, emphasizing realistic skin textures, sophisticated lighting, and high-quality fabric rendering.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic full-body studio fashion portrait. {argument name="character description" default="Elegant young adult East Asian female"}, minimalist studio, from head to floor, three-quarter back view. Slightly to the right—generous smooth negative space on the left and above the head. Body angled away from the camera toward the right; head looking back over the left shoulder, looking directly at the camera. Dignified, calm, understated confident expression—lips relaxed, soft photographic gaze.

Character: Slender and elegant figure, warm light-to-medium skin tone, delicate features, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, soft brow shape, small refined nose bridge, natural rose-red lip color. Exquisite understated makeup: glowing skin, light blush, gentle cheekbone contouring, fine eyeliner, neutral eye shadow, soft lip color. Real skin texture, fine pores, natural shoulder blades, spinal contour, gentle highlights on the back.

Hairstyle: Dark brown-black hair pulled into a loose, slightly messy low bun. Stray strands around the temples, cheeks, neck, and crown. A few fine flyaway strands catching strong backlighting—forming a delicate glowing rim light halo on the top and right side. Elegant but intentionally not rigid, not a perfectly neat hairstyle.

Dress: {argument name="gown style" default="Floor-length haute couture evening gown—ultra-low backless design, very thin spaghetti straps"}, with almost the entire back exposed nearly to the lower waist. Fabric gathers at the upper hips and lower back into a soft draped cowl shape. The dress fits the waist and hips before falling into a long, narrow flowing column to the floor. The hem pools softly around the feet, with a small train extending toward the bottom-left and bottom-right corners.

Marble Print: {argument name="print pattern" default="Exquisite natural marble pattern—flowing organic swirls"}. Tones: ivory white, warm beige, sand, caramel, taupe, smoky gray, charcoal, understated brown, and occasional near-black veining. Similar to polished travertine, onyx, or flowing stone, with longitudinal veins naturally wrapping along the body. Upper hips and waist feature lighter cream and tan marble veining; lower skirt has deeper brown and charcoal flows; dramatic dark stone-like textures near the hem. Fabric is smooth, lightweight, slightly glossy, with realistic tension, drape, folds, and specular highlights.

Arms and Accessories: Left arm gently crosses the front of the upper body—left hand resting on the right shoulder, fingers relaxed and elegant, natural light nude nails, anatomically accurate joints. Right arm slightly curved hanging at the side, hand relaxed near the outer thigh. A very thin, low-key gold bracelet on the right wrist. No heavy jewelry, necklaces, earrings, or distracting accessories.

Background: Seamless warm gray studio backdrop—a smooth gradient from medium warm gray at the top to a brighter off-white near the floor. Floor and wall blend seamlessly with no visible horizon. No equipment, no props, no cluttered elements.

Lighting: Bright diffused light source from behind the model slightly to the right—glowing halos on hair, right shoulder, arms, waist, and right edge of the gown. Large soft frontal fill light from the top left to present face and dress details while preserving dimensional shadows. Clear rim light, soft facial contouring, warm skin glow, gentle highlights on shoulder blades, smooth shadow transitions. A long strip of soft-edged gray shadow casts diagonally to the bottom left corner.

Camera: Full-frame 85mm, medium depth of field—woman and the entire dress are sharp and clear, background completely smooth. Natural and flattering perspective, minimal distortion. Accurate proportions, realistic hands, fine fabric rendering, individual hair strands, fine marble texture. Luxurious haute couture editorial, elegant and restrained, refined neutral color palette, high dynamic range, slight film softening.

Negative: No text, no logo, no watermark, no furniture, no props, no background objects, no extra people, no excessive jewelry, no deformed bodies, no extra fingers, no duplicate limbs, no plastic skin, no cropped heads, no cropped skirts.

zh.title: 专业大理石纹时尚工作室人像
zh.description: 一个高细节的工作室摄影提示词，用于创作高端时尚人像，主角为身着大理石纹晚礼服的东亚女性，强调真实的皮肤质感、精致的布光以及高质量的面料渲染。
zh.prompt:
超写实全身工作室时尚人像。{argument name="character description" default="优雅的东亚年轻女性"}，极简工作室背景，从头到脚，四分之三背影。身体略微向右——左侧及头顶留有充足的平滑负空间。身体背对镜头向右倾斜；头部越过左肩回望，直视镜头。端庄、冷静、内敛且自信的表情——双唇放松，眼神柔和。

人物：身材苗条优雅，暖色调中等肤色，五官精致，杏仁状深棕色眼睛，眉形柔和，鼻梁小巧精致，自然的玫瑰红唇色。精致内敛的妆容：光泽感肌肤，淡腮红，柔和的颧骨轮廓，细眼线，中性眼影，柔和唇色。真实的皮肤质感，细致的毛孔，自然的肩胛骨，脊柱轮廓，背部有柔和的高光。

发型：深棕黑色头发盘成一个松散、略显凌乱的低发髻。鬓角、脸颊、颈部和头顶有零星发丝。几缕细小的碎发在强烈的逆光下捕捉光线——在头顶和右侧形成精致的轮廓光光晕。优雅但刻意不显僵硬，并非完美整齐的发型。

礼服：{argument name="gown style" default="拖地高级定制晚礼服——超低露背设计，极细吊带"}，几乎整个背部裸露至腰部下方。面料在上臀部和后腰处聚拢，形成柔和的垂坠褶皱。礼服贴合腰部和臀部，随后呈长而窄的修身长裙垂至地面。裙摆在脚边柔和地堆叠，裙尾向左下角和右下角延伸。

大理石纹：{argument name="print pattern" default="精致的天然大理石纹理——流动的有机漩涡"}。色调：象牙白、暖米色、沙色、焦糖色、灰褐色、烟灰色、炭灰色、内敛的棕色，以及偶尔出现的近黑色纹理。类似于抛光洞石、缟玛瑙或流动的岩石，纵向纹理自然地包裹着身体。上臀部和腰部呈现较浅的奶油色和棕褐色大理石纹；下裙摆有更深沉的棕色和炭灰色流动感；裙摆处有戏剧性的深色石材纹理。面料光滑、轻盈、略带光泽，具有真实的张力、垂坠感、褶皱和镜面高光。

手臂与配饰：左臂轻轻交叉于上身前方——左手搭在右肩上，手指放松且优雅，自然的裸色指甲，关节解剖结构准确。右臂自然下垂于身体一侧，手部在右大腿外侧放松。右腕佩戴一条极细、低调的金色手链。无厚重的珠宝、项链、耳环或其他分散注意力的配饰。

背景：无缝暖灰色工作室背景——从顶部的中性暖灰色到靠近地面处更明亮的灰白色，呈现平滑的渐变。地面与墙面无缝衔接，无可见的地平线。无设备、无道具、无杂乱元素。

布光：明亮的漫射光源来自模特后方略微偏右的位置——发丝、右肩、手臂、腰部和礼服右边缘呈现发光光晕。左上方有大型柔和的正面补光，以呈现面部和礼服细节，同时保留立体阴影。清晰的轮廓光，柔和的面部轮廓，温暖的肤色光泽，肩胛骨处有柔和的高光，阴影过渡平滑。一条边缘柔和的灰色长条阴影斜向投射至左下角。

相机：全画幅 85mm 镜头，中等景深——人物和整件礼服清晰锐利，背景完全虚化。视角自然且修饰身形，畸变极小。比例准确，手部真实，面料渲染细腻，发丝清晰，大理石纹理精细。奢华高级定制时尚大片，优雅克制，中性色调精炼，高动态范围，轻微的胶片柔化效果。

负面提示词：无文字，无标志，无水印，无家具，无道具，无背景杂物，无额外人物，无夸张珠宝，无畸形身体，无多余手指，无重复肢体，无塑料感皮肤，无头部裁剪，无裙摆裁剪。

en.title: Hyper-Realistic Restaurant Smartphone Photo
en.description: An extensive prompt for generating a candid smartphone-style photo in a BBQ restaurant, featuring intricate realism and optical distortion.
en.prompt: Vertical smartphone restaurant snapshot portrait of a young adult East Asian woman, {argument name="figure" default="slender and well-proportioned"} figure, {argument name="skin tone" zh.title: 写实风格餐厅手机人像
zh.description: 生成一张写实风格、手持手机视角的餐厅女性照片，采用广角镜头效果和自然光照明，以减少 AI 生成的痕迹。
zh.prompt: 一张竖构图的餐厅手机抓拍人像，主角为一位 {argument name="age" default="年轻的东亚女性"}，身材苗条匀称，肤色呈暖白色自然质感，精致的鹅蛋脸，深棕色杏仁眼，柔和的自然眉形，眼线清晰但不浓重，睫毛纤细，鼻梁小巧挺直，淡珊瑚红色嘴唇，嘴角微微上扬，露出放松自然的微笑。黑色长发，部分发丝垂在肩前。佩戴小巧耳环，身穿一件 {argument name="top" default="银色亮片白色挂脖迷你裙上衣"}，点缀着细小亮片，颈间佩戴一条极细的银色项链。坐在暖光餐厅的深棕色皮质卡座中，面向镜头，身体微微前倾，左肘撑在桌上，左手托腮，右前臂搁在桌沿，直视镜头，表情柔和放松。双腿自然地从桌下伸向摄影师方向，双脚交叠并搁在摄影师的膝盖上（穿着深灰色长裤）。脚趾放松，涂着 {argument name="nail art" default="Hello Kitty 图案"} 的脚趾甲油，边缘有轻微磨损和不均匀感。桌上摆放着一大盘蘑菇、几个黑色陶瓷碗、深色蘸料、木质筷子、小杯子以及一盘切好的肉。背景为深棕色皮质卡座、木质餐桌、粗糙的灰色水泥质感墙面、黑色天花板以及几根垂直的铜色烧烤排烟管。主体位于画面中心，头部位于上方三分之一处，餐桌横跨画面中部。从桌下的双脚到画面底部摄影师的膝盖呈现长焦透视感。3:4 比例，手机主摄近景拍摄，位置略低于视线并向下倾斜。24–28mm 等效广角镜头，使前景的脚部和膝盖显得较大，上半身较小，模拟真实的手机透视效果。线条有轻微的广角畸变。中等景深的自然虚化；面部、餐具和前景的脚部清晰，远处的卡座和管道略微柔化。没有使用人像模式抠图或夸张的背景虚化。混合照明，来自暖白色射灯和吊灯；面部由前上方柔和的暖光照亮。前额、鼻梁、脸颊和肩膀有高光。背景和桌下区域较暗。铜管和油润的木桌上有暖色反光。中等对比度。色调为暖棕色、铜色、黑灰色、珍珠白、暖肤色和鲜绿色。自动白平衡略偏暖。呈现真实的皮肤毛孔、轻微的肤色不均、手臂关节纹理、自然的足部质感，以及木材、皮革、金属、陶瓷和生菜的纹理。具备标准 Android 旗舰机或 iPhone 主摄的画质。手持拍摄，计算摄影自动曝光，多帧夜景模式合成。轻微的自动 HDR 降低了高光眩光并提亮了桌下阴影。动态范围有限，阴影处有细微的高 ISO 噪点。降噪处理带来细微的纹理涂抹感。面部和餐具边缘有克制的数字锐化。前景清晰，远处细节略微柔和。有轻微的 JPEG 压缩痕迹。自然的构图偏差。无磨皮，无美颜滤镜，无商业修图，无影棚布光，不追求 8K 超高清画质。真实生活中的手机照片，去除 AI 生成感，比例 4:5。

en.title: Urban Mirror Selfie Beauty Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a realistic mirror selfie of a woman in a dark gray tiled urban bathroom, focusing on natural lighting and textures.
en.prompt:
Subject: Getting ready in the mirror

Main Subject: A fictional adult woman holding a smartphone towards a mirror in an urban bathroom with uniform dark gray tiles. The shot is a 3:4 vertical composition with the person occupying a large portion of the center-left, showing from the top of the head to the mid-thigh. Her hand holding the smartphone is in the upper right, and her hand resting on the washstand is in the lower left, centering the curves of her leaning body and her gaze through the mirror.

Person/Expression: A woman with calm maturity and healthy definition. {argument name="hair style" default="Long dark brown straight hair"} hangs naturally to her chest, with thin strands from a center part falling over her cheeks. Japanese-style natural makeup: soft parallel eyebrows, delicate eyelashes, pale beige-brown eyeshadow, light rose blush, and wet-look pink-beige lips. Her face is turned slightly to the right, looking down at the smartphone screen with a quiet and natural expression.

Clothing/Pose: {argument name="top" default="A short gray sports camisole"}. Thin shoulder straps, stretchy ribbed material, and a compact length ending near the underbust. The bottom is {argument name="bottom" default="ivory white high-waisted sports shorts"}, expressing soft stretch material and natural fabric tension with fine wrinkles following the hip and leg movements. She leans forward towards the mirror, with her hips shifted gently to the right. Her right arm is bent to hold the smartphone vertically next to her face, and her left hand supports her on the washstand. 

Background/Lighting: A compact, high-quality bathroom in a Japanese urban apartment. Walls are matte charcoal gray large tiles, and the floor is fine gray tiling. Warm white light from the top left creates highlights on her hair, collarbone, and stomach.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4, close-range fashion snap through a mirror. Eye-level camera position with a slight wide-angle feel. 

Texture/Style: Realistic indoor photo as if taken with a smartphone. Meticulous depiction of skin texture, fine hair, and the difference between rib and stretch fabrics.

Negative: Young face, unnatural gaze, hand confusion, extra fingers, distorted smartphone, mirror image contradictions, plastic skin, watermarks.

zh.title: 都市镜面自拍人像
zh.description: 一份用于生成逼真镜面自拍的详细提示词，场景设定在铺设深灰色瓷砖的都市浴室中，重点呈现自然光影与质感。
zh.prompt:
主题：镜前准备

主体：一位虚构的成年女性在铺设统一深灰色瓷砖的都市浴室中，对着镜子手持智能手机。画面采用 3:4 竖构图，人物占据画面中左侧大部分区域，展示从头顶到大腿中部的范围。她持手机的手位于右上角，另一只手支撑在洗手台上，身体前倾的曲线与她透过镜子的目光形成构图中心。

人物/表情：一位成熟沉稳且体态健康的女性。{argument name="hair style" default="深棕色长直发"} 自然垂落在胸前，中分发缝处有细碎发丝垂在脸颊两侧。日系自然妆容：柔和的平眉、精致的睫毛、浅米棕色眼影、淡玫瑰色腮红以及水光感的粉米色唇妆。她的脸微微向右转，低头看着手机屏幕，表情安静自然。

服装/姿势：{argument name="top" default="灰色短款运动吊带"}。细肩带，弹性罗纹材质，长度刚好及胸下围。下装为 {argument name="bottom" default="象牙白高腰运动短裤"}，展现出柔软的弹力材质，面料随着臀部和腿部的动作产生自然的褶皱张力。她向前倾身靠近镜子，臀部轻微向右侧偏移。右臂弯曲，将智能手机垂直举在脸侧，左手支撑在洗手台上。

背景/光影：日本都市公寓中紧凑且高品质的浴室。墙壁为哑光炭灰色大块瓷砖，地面为精致的灰色瓷砖。来自左上方的暖白光在她的头发、锁骨和腹部勾勒出高光。

构图/相机：3:4 竖构图，透过镜子拍摄的近距离时尚快照。平视视角，带有轻微的广角感。

质感/风格：如同智能手机拍摄的逼真室内照片。细腻刻画皮肤纹理、细发以及罗纹面料与弹力面料之间的质感差异。

负面提示词：幼态脸、不自然的目光、手部混乱、多余的手指、扭曲的智能手机、镜面影像矛盾、塑料感皮肤、水印。

en.title: Summer City Street Fashion Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed, professional fashion portrait prompt of a woman on a sunlit urban sidewalk, featuring intricate nail art and realistic lighting.
en.prompt:
Subject:
Summer light reaching the fingertips

Main Subject:
A realistic 3:4 fashion portrait of {argument name="person" default="an adult woman"} standing on a bright city sidewalk, extending one hand toward the camera. The subject occupies a large portion of the center of the frame. The extended right hand is prominently in the foreground, creating a natural depth of field with the face and body behind it.

Person and Expression:
A woman with a calm, mature presence. Long dark brown straight hair with thin bangs, with a few strands naturally falling on her cheeks. Bright, translucent skin with natural texture. Rose-beige lips, pale blush, delicate brown eye makeup. A gentle expression looking slightly downward at the lens with her head tilted slightly to the right.

Clothing and Pose:
{argument name="outfit" default="A plain ivory-beige cap without logos. A short-sleeved, ribbed V-neck mini dress."} The dress naturally follows the body line with delicate gathers. Weight shifted to the left leg. The right arm is extended toward the camera with fingers lightly curved. Elegant nail design with milky white and nude beige gradients, featuring small pearls and transparent stones.

Background and Lighting:
{argument name="background" default="A clean urban sidewalk alongside modern buildings."} Street trees on the far left and a modern building made of stone and glass on the right. Soft natural light from the top left creates highlights on the hair, cheeks, and shoulders. Subtle shadows under the chin and on the right side of the body.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Low angle looking up from near the ground. High-precision portrait photography as if taken with a modern full-frame mirrorless camera. 35mm equivalent lens, F1.8, low ISO, Eye AF. Focus on the face and eyes while keeping the fingers and nails sharp, with a smooth bokeh background.

Texture and Style:
Outdoor portrait style from a high-end fashion magazine. Detailed rendering of every strand of hair, rib fabric, and nail decorations. Natural skin texture and complexion. Bright and clear tones with soft contrast.

Negative:
Underage appearance, unnatural face or eyes, extra/fused/missing fingers, distorted nails, broken joints, blurred hands, inconsistent shadows, excessive skin retouching, plastic-looking skin, brand logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 夏季城市街头时尚人像
zh.description: 一个高度精细、专业的时尚人像提示词，描绘了阳光照射下的城市人行道上的女性，展现了精致的美甲艺术和逼真的光影效果。
zh.prompt:
主题：
夏日阳光触及指尖

主体：
一张 3:4 的写实时尚人像，描绘了 {argument name="person" default="一位成年女性"} 站在明亮的城市人行道上，向镜头伸出一只手。主体占据了画面的大部分中心位置。伸出的右手位于前景显眼处，与后方的面部和身体形成了自然的景深感。

人物与表情：
一位气质沉稳、成熟的女性。深棕色长直发，留着薄刘海，几缕发丝自然地垂在脸颊上。明亮、通透的肌肤，带有自然的纹理。玫瑰米色嘴唇，淡雅腮红，精致的棕色眼妆。表情温柔，头部微微向右倾斜，视线略微向下看向镜头。

{argument name="outfit" default="一顶无标志的纯象牙米色鸭舌帽。一件短袖罗纹 V 领迷你连衣裙。"} 连衣裙自然贴合身形，带有精致的褶皱。重心移至左腿。右臂向镜头伸出，手指轻微弯曲。优雅的美甲设计，采用乳白色和裸米色渐变，点缀着小珍珠和透明宝石。

背景与光影：
{argument name="background" default="现代建筑旁整洁的城市人行道。"} 最左侧是行道树，右侧是石材与玻璃构成的现代建筑。来自左上方的柔和自然光在头发、脸颊和肩膀上形成了高光。下巴下方和身体右侧有微妙的阴影。

3:4 竖构图。从地面附近的低角度仰拍。高精度人像摄影，如同使用现代全画幅无反相机拍摄。35mm 等效镜头，F1.8，低 ISO，眼部自动对焦。焦点对准面部和眼睛，同时保持手指和指甲清晰，背景呈现平滑的虚化效果。

质感与风格：
高端时尚杂志的户外人像风格。对每一缕发丝、罗纹面料和美甲装饰进行细致渲染。自然的皮肤纹理和肤色。明亮清晰的色调，对比度柔和。

负面提示词：
未成年外观、不自然的面部或眼睛、多余/融合/缺失的手指、变形的指甲、关节断裂、模糊的手部、不一致的阴影、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、品牌 Logo、水印。

en.title: Extreme Beauty Close-up Lip Portrait
en.description: An incredibly detailed GPT Image 2 prompt for an extreme facial close-up focusing on the texture of the skin, eyes, and a woman biting her lower lip.
en.prompt:
Subject: Gaze lingering on the lips

Main Subject: A realistic 3:4 vertical beauty portrait. An extreme facial close-up of a woman in her 20s, cropped from the top of the forehead to just below the chin. The face occupies most of the frame, showing the eyes, nose, lips, and jawline clearly. No neck or clothing visible, focusing entirely on expression, skin, eyes, and lip texture.

Person/Expression: Smooth skin with a bright ivory-beige tone and a natural pinkish glow. Slender oval face. Head tilted slightly, eyelids heavy, looking straight into the camera. Small clear catchlights in the eyes. Mouth slightly open, biting the inner side of the lower lip with the upper front teeth, creating natural pressure and gloss. A moment of elegant sensuality.

Background/Lighting: Warm greige to light brown plain studio background with shallow depth of field. Large soft diffused light from the top left creates delicate highlights on the forehead, nose, and lips. 

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4, super close-up with the face taking up 90% of the screen. Shot with an 85-105mm medium telephoto macro lens to prevent distortion. Focus on the eyes and lips.

Texture/Style: {argument name="hair color" default="Bright milk tea ash brown"} hair with see-through bangs. Elegant doll-like Japanese makeup. Lips with {argument name="lip gloss" default="sheer pink-beige"} gloss. High-definition beauty advertising style keeping fine pores and peach fuzz.

Negative: Underage appearance, unnatural face, asymmetrical eyes, distorted mouth, plastic skin, excessive skin retouching, watermarks.

zh.title: 极致美感唇部特写肖像
zh.description: 一个极其详尽的 GPT Image 2 提示词，用于创作极致面部特写，聚焦于皮肤纹理、眼睛以及女性轻咬下唇的细节。
zh.prompt:
主题：凝视唇间的瞬间

主体：一张写实的 3:4 竖版美妆肖像。20 多岁女性的极致面部特写，构图从额头顶部裁剪至下巴下方。面部占据画面大部分空间，清晰呈现眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇和下颌线。不露出脖子或衣物，完全聚焦于表情、皮肤、眼睛和唇部纹理。

人物/表情：光滑的皮肤，呈现明亮的象牙米色调和自然的粉嫩光泽。纤细的鹅蛋脸。头部微微倾斜，眼睑低垂，直视镜头。眼睛里有清晰的小光点。嘴巴微张，上门牙轻咬下唇内侧，产生自然的压痕和光泽。展现优雅而感性的瞬间。

背景/光影：暖灰褐色至浅棕色的纯色摄影棚背景，具有浅景深效果。左上方的大面积柔光营造出额头、鼻子和嘴唇上细腻的高光。

构图/摄影：竖版 3:4，超近距离特写，面部占据屏幕 90% 的空间。使用 85-105mm 中焦微距镜头拍摄以防止畸变。焦点集中在眼睛和嘴唇上。

纹理/风格：{argument name="hair color" default="明亮奶茶灰棕色"} 发色，带有空气刘海。优雅的日系娃娃妆容。嘴唇涂有 {argument name="lip gloss" default="透亮粉米色"} 唇彩。高清美妆广告风格，保留细腻的毛孔和绒毛。

负面提示词：未成年外观、不自然的面部、不对称的眼睛、扭曲的嘴巴、塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、水印。

en.title: Sunset Beach Reflection Portrait
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for a serene sunset portrait of a woman standing on a beach with water reflections, using a medium telephoto lens style.
en.prompt:
Subject: Turning around by the water mirror

Main Subject: A 2:3 vertical photo of an adult woman standing on a shallow beach at dusk. The person is placed slightly left of center, showing from the thighs to the top of the head. A quiet portrait looking back at the camera with her upper body while her back faces the camera, set against a calm sea and wide sky.

Person/Expression: A woman with natural transparency. {argument name="hair color" default="Long dark brown hair almost black"} blowing in the sea breeze. Tucking her chin slightly and looking straight at the camera. Slightly open pale pink lips. Pink-beige blush and delicate brown eye makeup.

Clothing/Pose: A white thin-strap camisole layered with {argument name="shirt" default="a sheer chiffon overshirt"}. The bottom is {argument name="skirt" default="a white short skirt with fine vertical stitching and light ruffles"}. Hair and chiffon fabric fluttering in the wind.

Background/Lighting: Shallow sea just before sunset. The foreground is a sandy beach with a thin layer of water reflecting the sky and clouds. The sun is low on the right, illuminating hair and shoulders in gold. Soft bluish reflection from the water keeps the face visible.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 2:3, medium-long shot. Eye-level from chest height, 85mm lens equivalent with natural compression. Precise focus on the face and eyes.

Texture/Style: Delicate fashion portrait photography. Keeping natural skin texture and depicting the thinness and seams of the white chiffon. Low saturation palette of sky blue, white, and peach gold.

Negative: Underage appearance, unnatural face, hand fusion, unnatural transparency, distorted horizon, contradictory shadows, watermarks.

zh.title: 日落海滩倒影人像
zh.description: 一份全面的提示词，用于创作一张宁静的日落海滩女性人像，包含水面反射效果，采用中焦镜头风格。
zh.prompt:
主体：水镜前的回眸

主要主体：一张 2:3 的竖构图照片，拍摄一位成年女性站在黄昏时分浅滩上的场景。人物位于画面中心偏左，展示从大腿到头部的部分。她背对镜头，上半身回眸看向相机，背景是平静的海面和广阔的天空。

人物/表情：一位具有自然通透感的女性。{argument name="hair color" default="长长的深棕色头发，近乎黑色"} 在海风中飘动。微微收下巴，直视镜头。淡粉色的嘴唇微张。粉米色腮红和精致的棕色眼妆。

服装/姿势：白色细肩带吊带衫，外搭 {argument name="shirt" default="一件透明雪纺罩衫"}。下身是 {argument name="skirt" default="一条带有细竖缝和轻微荷叶边的白色短裙"}。头发和雪纺面料在风中飘动。

背景/光影：日落前的浅海。前景是沙滩，覆盖着一层薄薄的水面，反射着天空和云彩。太阳位于右侧低空，将头发和肩膀染成金色。来自水面的柔和蓝色反射使面部清晰可见。

构图/相机：竖构图 2:3，中远景。从胸部高度平视拍摄，等效 85mm 镜头，具有自然的压缩感。焦点精确对准面部和眼睛。

质感/风格：精致的时尚人像摄影。保留自然的皮肤纹理，细腻刻画白色雪纺的轻薄感和缝线。低饱和度的天蓝色、白色和桃金色调。

负面提示词：未成年外观、不自然的面部、手部融合、不自然的透明感、扭曲的地平线、矛盾的阴影、水印。

en.title: Japanese Summer Indoor Lifestyle Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a relaxing summer indoor scene in a traditional Japanese room, featuring a woman on a sofa with soft sunlight and high-fidelity textures.
en.prompt: Subject: A gaze that unravels the summer. Main Subject: Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. In a bright Japanese-Western style room reminiscent of an old Japanese wooden house, a fictional adult woman with mature curves is sitting relaxedly on a beige low sofa by the window. The person is positioned slightly to the left of the center, in a full-body composition from head to bare feet. The person occupies about 75% of the frame, leaving space for the sofa and the window on the right. Person/Expression: A woman with a calm, adult atmosphere. A well-featured, slightly long face with naturally rounded cheeks and an elegant, soft jawline. Her hair is glossy dark brown long hair with thin see-through bangs and layers around the face. Part of her hair naturally falls on her cheeks and shoulders. Makeup is delicate Japanese style, featuring pink-brown eyeshadow, thin eyeliner, natural tear bags, and coral beige lips. She tilts her head slightly to the right and lightly rests her cheek on the back of her right hand. Her gaze is directed at the camera in front, her mouth is closed, and she has a quiet, slightly listless expression. Clothing/Pose: A white ribbed summer top with thin straps and pale ivory short frilled shorts. A sheer white summer knit cardigan is loosely draped over her shoulders. The clothing is clean summer indoor wear, with exposure of the chest and legs kept within a natural range. The upper body is lightly rested against the back of the sofa, and the left arm is lowered to the side of the body to support the seat. Her right elbow is placed on the back of the sofa, and her right hand supports her cheek. Her right leg is bent significantly toward the front, and her left leg is tucked under it to the side, with the ankles naturally crossed. The waist and thighs have natural roundness typical of a mature figure, accurately expressing the center of gravity and the wrinkles in the clothes. Background/Light: The background features large wood-framed windows reminiscent of a summer Japanese house, shoji-style fittings, tatami mats, a rattan low table, and a small retro electric fan. Outside the window, deep green trees are placed with a heavy blur. A rattan tray and a transparent glass with ice are placed in the lower left foreground. Strong summer sunlight enters diagonally from the upper right window, creating thin highlights on the hair outline, shoulders, thighs, knees, and the sofa surface. Shadows fall softly toward the lower left, and pale reflected light from the tatami and white clothes lifts the shadow side of the face. The interior is warm-toned, and the outside is bright green, creating a natural temperature difference typical of summer. Composition/Camera: Vertical 9:16 for smartphones. The camera looks down slightly from a position a little higher than the person's chest. Natural compression equivalent to 50mm shows the face, upper body, and front legs three-dimensionally. The focus is precisely on the face, the texture of the hair and clothes is clear, and the outside of the window and the fittings in the back are softly blurred. The front legs are shown slightly larger while keeping the perspective natural. There is little headroom, and the feet are naturally cut off at the bottom of the screen. Texture/Style: High-definition realistic photograph. A Japanese lifestyle magazine-style portrait making use of natural summer light. The skin is a bright ivory beige, leaving a natural complexion and fine texture on the cheeks, shoulders, and knees. Avoid excessive skin correction, and carefully describe the material differences between vellus hair, fine hair bundles, ribbed fabric, openwork knitting, rattan, tatami, and upholstered sofas. Low-saturation ivory, beige, wood brown, and summer green are the main colors, with soft film grain and moderate contrast. Negative: Young face, unnaturally thin body, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, twisted legs, unnatural gravity, poor contact with clothes, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, garbled characters, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 日式夏季室内生活方式人像
zh.description: 一份用于生成传统日式房间内放松夏季场景的详细提示词，包含坐在沙发上的女性、柔和阳光以及高保真纹理。
zh.prompt: 主体：一段解构夏日的凝视。主要主体：垂直 9:16 纵横比。在一个让人联想到古老日式木屋的明亮和洋折衷风格房间内，一位虚构的成年女性，拥有成熟的曲线，正放松地坐在窗边的米色矮沙发上。人物位于画面中心偏左位置，呈现从头部到赤足的全身构图。人物占据画面约 75%，为右侧的沙发和窗户留出空间。人物/表情：一位散发着冷静、成熟气息的女性。五官端正，脸型略长，脸颊自然圆润，下颌线优雅柔和。她留着光泽的深棕色长发，带有轻薄的空气刘海和脸部周围的层次感。部分发丝自然地垂落在脸颊和肩膀上。妆容为精致的日式风格，采用粉棕色眼影、细眼线、自然的卧蚕和珊瑚米色唇妆。她头部微微向右倾斜，右手轻托脸颊。目光直视前方的镜头，嘴唇微闭，表情安静且略带慵懒。服装/姿势：白色细肩带夏季罗纹上衣，搭配浅象牙色短款荷叶边短裤。肩上随意披着一件透明的白色夏季针织开衫。服装为干净的夏季居家服，胸部和腿部的裸露保持在自然范围内。上半身轻靠在沙发靠背上，左臂自然下垂支撑身体。右肘置于沙发靠背上，右手托腮。右腿大幅度向前方弯曲，左腿叠在下方，脚踝自然交叉。腰部和大腿呈现成熟身材特有的自然圆润感，准确表达了重心和衣物褶皱。背景/光线：背景为让人联想到夏季日式住宅的大型木框窗户、障子风格的隔扇、榻榻米、藤编矮桌和一台小型复古电风扇。窗外是深绿色的树木，带有强烈的模糊效果。左下角前景放置着一个藤编托盘和一杯带冰块的透明玻璃杯。强烈的夏季阳光从右上方的窗户斜射进来，在发际轮廓、肩膀、大腿、膝盖和沙发表面形成细长的亮光。阴影柔和地投向左下方，来自榻榻米和白色衣物的浅色反射光提亮了面部的阴影侧。室内色调温暖，窗外是明亮的绿色，营造出夏季特有的自然温差。构图/相机：适用于智能手机的垂直 9:16 比例。相机位置略高于人物胸部，呈轻微俯视角度。相当于 50mm 镜头的自然压缩感，立体地展现了面部、上半身和前腿。焦点精准对准面部，发丝和衣物的纹理清晰，窗外景色和背景中的家具呈现柔和的虚化效果。前腿在保持自然透视的同时略微放大。头部留白较少，脚部在画面底部自然截断。纹理/风格：高清晰度写实摄影。采用自然夏季光线的日式生活杂志风格人像。皮肤为明亮的象牙米色，保留了脸颊、肩膀和膝盖的自然肤色和细腻纹理。避免过度磨皮，仔细描绘绒毛、细发束、罗纹面料、镂空针织、藤编、榻榻米和软包沙发之间的材质差异。以低饱和度的象牙色、米色、木棕色和夏季绿为主色调，带有柔和的胶片颗粒感和适中的对比度。负面提示词：年轻面孔、不自然消瘦的身体、不自然的面部、不自然的目光、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、扭曲的腿部、不自然的重力、衣物贴合度差、透视错误、与光源不一致的阴影、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、乱码、Logo、水印。
