en.title: Hyper-realistic East Asian Fashion Portrait in Ancient Village
en.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for generating a high-end fashion portrait of an East Asian woman in a traditional Jiangnan water town, featuring intricate lace textures and natural lighting.
en.prompt: Hyper-realistic vertical full-body outdoor fashion portrait. A {argument name="subject" default="stylish young adult East Asian woman"} standing in the center of a {argument name="background scene" default="narrow historical ancient village alley"}, facing the camera. From the top of the head to about mid-calf—the lower part of the pants extends beyond the edge of the screen. The head is in the upper middle of the screen, the torso along the central vertical axis, with enough surrounding architectural environment to establish a sense of place. Relaxed posture, one hip slightly shifted, arms hanging naturally, hands close to the upper thighs. Head tilted gently toward the right shoulder, looking directly at the camera with a warm, natural smile. Subject: Slender and elegant figure, warm and fair skin, exquisite features, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, soft arched eyebrows, refined nose bridge, natural rose-red lip color. Friendly, quiet, and approachable expression—not an intentional pose. Minimalist makeup: glowing natural skin, light peach blush, thin brown eyeliner, soft eyelashes, neutral eye shadow, bright coral pink lip color. Real skin texture, faint pores, exquisite facial highlights, smooth and realistic color transitions. Hairstyle: Extremely long, thick deep brown-black hair extending below the waist—loose natural waves, slightly parted, with soft volume at the crown. Most of the hair falls over the left shoulder and flows along the front of the torso; another long section flows behind the right arm. Fine strands of hair around the forehead and cheeks suggest a slight outdoor breeze. Soft edge lighting highlights individual hair strands without artificial gloss. Clothing: Fitted {argument name="clothing color" default="nude beige"} lace camisole—extra-fine spaghetti straps, soft scalloped neckline, exquisite full floral lace pattern with fine interlocking vines, circles, and embroidered flowers. Tonal skin-tone beige soft lining—exquisite tonal effect, no transparency. Fits the body, stops at the natural waistline, with real tension, small folds, and visible lace relief. High-waisted ivory or warm cream wide-leg trousers—the waistband fits just below the camisole, elegant front pleats open into loose vertical folds, wide trouser legs, flowing drape. Slightly warm off-white rather than pure white; delicate woven texture, soft shadows within the folds, natural wrinkles at the waist and hips. Accessories: Small shiny gold pendant necklace—a rounded abstract pendant on a fine chain located on the upper chest. Delicate and low-key stud earrings. A thin gold bracelet on each wrist, and another extra-fine bracelet near one wrist. Short clean nails painted in a light neutral color. Hands are anatomically accurate: relaxed fingers, real joints, natural spacing. Scene: Quiet traditional Jiangnan water town or historical ancient village alley. An old rectangular grey slate road stretching from the lower foreground to the distance—uneven and weathered, irregular gaps, faint moss, small cracks, low-key beige-grey variations. The slate road serves as a strong leading line to guide the eye deep into the alley. Left side: A tall light-colored plaster wall close to the camera—delicate stains, discoloration, signs of aging. Behind the woman's left shoulder: A dark wooden doorway under an exquisite traditional roofed corridor with carved structural details. On the left edge, there are lush green shrubs growing in a rough raised stone flower pot. Right side: A white plaster building with dark roof tiles, an embedded doorway, stone foundations, and a narrow overhanging eave—the building extends toward the central background to form a soft-focus blurred corridor. In the upper background, there are several mature green trees rising above the roofs—low-key olive green and sage green naturally blend into the cream walls and grey roofs. Shallow depth of field: The woman is sharp and clear, the nearest architectural edges retain some texture, and distant doorways/roofs/vegetation turn into creamy bokeh spots. Retains enough recognizable architectural structure to convey a real historical ancient village atmosphere. Lighting: Soft diffused late morning sunlight from the upper left and front, filtered through light clouds—with exquisite highlights on the forehead, cheeks, bridge of the nose, collarbone, shoulders, lace top, and forearms. There is a restrained warm rim light on the edges of the hair. Soft open shadows under the jaw, hair, and trouser folds. No harsh direct sunlight or strong cast shadows. Color Tones: Cream white, nude beige, light stone grey, weathered charcoal grey, low-key green, soft brown, restrained gold. Glowing warm skin tones, no orange saturation. Soft cinematic tones, smooth highlight transitions, slightly low-key background colors, transparent and elegant contrast. Camera: Waist to chest height, full frame 85mm, f/2–f/2.8, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on eyes and lace texture, smooth background separation. High-end lifestyle fashion or exquisite travel photography quality—natural, elegant, romantic, sophisticated. Negative: No text, no logo, no watermark, no extra people, no modern vehicles, no street signs, no wire clutter, no exaggerated glamour makeup, no plastic-looking skin, no deformed fingers, no repeated limbs, no deformed architecture, no over-saturated colors, no artificial HDR, no strong studio lighting.

zh.title: 古村落中的超写实东亚时尚人像
zh.description: 一份详细的电影级提示词，用于生成一位东亚女性在江南水乡古镇的高端时尚人像，展现细腻的蕾丝质感与自然光影。
zh.prompt: 超写实竖构图全身户外时尚人像。一位 {argument name="subject" default="时尚的东亚年轻女性"} 站在 {argument name="background scene" default="狭窄的历史古村落巷道"} 中央，面向镜头。画面从头顶延伸至小腿中部——裤装下摆延伸至画面边缘之外。头部位于画面中上部，躯干沿中心垂直轴线分布，周围保留足够的建筑环境以营造空间感。姿态放松，一侧髋部微斜，双臂自然下垂，双手靠近大腿上部。头部轻微向右肩倾斜，直视镜头，带着温暖自然的微笑。主体：身材修长优雅，肤色温润白皙，五官精致，深褐色杏仁眼，柔和的拱形眉，鼻梁挺拔，唇色呈自然的玫瑰红。表情亲切、安静且平易近人——非刻意摆拍。极简妆容：透亮自然的肤质，淡桃色腮红，细棕色眼线，柔软睫毛，中性色眼影，亮珊瑚粉唇色。真实的皮肤纹理，隐约可见的毛孔，精致的面部高光，平滑逼真的色彩过渡。发型：极长且浓密的深棕黑色秀发垂至腰部以下——自然松散的波浪卷，中分，头顶蓬松有质感。大部分头发垂落在左肩并沿躯干前侧流淌；另一束长发垂在右臂后方。额头和脸颊周围的细碎发丝暗示着户外微风。柔和的轮廓光勾勒出单根发丝，无人工光泽。服装：修身 {argument name="clothing color" default="裸米色"} 蕾丝吊带衫——极细肩带，柔和的扇形领口，精致的全蕾丝花纹，带有细腻的藤蔓、圆圈和刺绣花朵图案。同色系肤色内衬——精致的同色调效果，无透视感。贴合身体，长度至自然腰线，具有真实的张力、细微褶皱和可见的蕾丝浮雕感。高腰象牙白或暖奶油色阔腿裤——腰头位于吊带衫下方，优雅的前褶展开为宽松的垂直褶皱，裤腿宽大，垂坠感极佳。色调偏暖的灰白色而非纯白；细腻的织物纹理，褶皱处有柔和阴影，腰部和臀部有自然的褶皱。配饰：小巧闪亮的金色吊坠项链——细链条上挂着一个圆润的抽象吊坠，位于胸前上方。精致低调的耳钉。每只手腕各戴一只细金手镯，其中一只手腕附近还有一只极细的手镯。指甲修剪整齐，涂有浅中性色指甲油。手部解剖结构准确：手指放松，关节真实，间距自然。场景：安静的江南水乡或历史古村落巷道。一条古老的矩形青石板路从前景下方延伸至远方——路面凹凸不平且饱经风霜，缝隙不规则，带有淡淡的青苔、细小裂纹，呈现低调的米灰色变化。石板路作为强有力的引导线，将视线引向巷道深处。左侧：靠近镜头的一面高大浅色抹灰墙——带有细腻的污渍、变色和岁月痕迹。女子左肩后方：一座精致的传统廊檐下的深色木门，带有雕刻的结构细节。左侧边缘有生长在粗糙凸起石花盆里的茂密绿色灌木。右侧：一座带有深色瓦片的白色抹灰建筑，嵌入式门洞，石基座，窄小的出檐——建筑向中心背景延伸，形成柔焦模糊的廊道。背景上方，几棵成熟的绿树高出屋顶——低调的橄榄绿和鼠尾草绿自然地融入奶油色墙面和灰色屋顶中。浅景深：人物清晰锐利，最近处的建筑边缘保留一定纹理，远处的门洞、屋顶和植被转化为奶油般的虚化光斑。保留足够的建筑结构识别度，以传达真实的古村落氛围。光影：来自左上方和前方的柔和漫射晨光，经由薄云过滤——额头、脸颊、鼻梁、锁骨、肩膀、蕾丝上衣和前臂上有精致的高光。发丝边缘有克制的暖色轮廓光。下颌、头发和裤褶下方有柔和的开放式阴影。无强烈的直射阳光或浓重的投影。色调：奶油白、裸米色、浅石灰、风化炭灰、低调绿、柔棕色、克制的金色。温暖透亮的肤色，无橙色饱和度。柔和的电影色调，平滑的高光过渡，背景色调略微低调，对比度通透优雅。相机：腰部至胸部高度，全画幅 85mm 镜头，f/2–f/2.8，浅景深，焦点清晰对准眼睛和蕾丝纹理，背景分离自然。高端生活方式时尚或精致旅行摄影质感——自然、优雅、浪漫、高级。负向提示：无文字、无标志、无水印、无额外人物、无现代车辆、无路标、无杂乱电线、无夸张的浓妆、无塑料感皮肤、无畸形手指、无重复肢体、无畸形建筑、无过饱和色彩、无人工 HDR、无强烈的影棚灯光。

en.title: Black and White Street Fashion Snapshot
en.description: A detailed documentary-style prompt for a high-contrast black and white street photograph featuring a stylish woman at a city bakery window, emphasizing realistic textures and film grain.
en.prompt: A realistic black and white street fashion snapshot, 2:3 vertical. A {argument name="subject" default="fashionable young adult woman"} stands inside or by the window of a {argument name="setting" default="small urban bakery"}. Framed from mid-thigh to slightly above the head. The subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, with a bakery display case filling the left third to create a layered environmental portrait. Close-up, natural eye-level perspective, body slightly tilted left, parallel to the glass counter. Subject: Long straight black hair parted in the center, naturally falling over shoulders to below the chest. Smooth but not over-styled, with a few loose strands around the cheeks. Round dark sunglasses with thin metal frames—subtle reflections of the bakery interior and window light in the lenses. Looking slightly down at a smartphone in her hands. A calm, focused, and slightly satisfied expression—relaxed lips with a subtle hint of a smile. Clothing: An {argument name="outfit" default="oversized light-colored button-down shirt"} in soft cotton or linen—pointed collar, visible chest pocket, slightly wrinkled fabric, sleeves casually rolled below the elbows. Loose natural drape with realistic folds at the shoulders, elbows, waist, and where tucked in. Dark high-waisted jeans or trousers with a dark leather belt and a simple rectangular metal buckle. An elegant vintage analog watch with a thin metal chain strap on the left wrist. All accessories are minimalist. Smartphone: Held horizontally and slightly upward with both hands at waist height, as if typing or reading. Accurate hands: realistic finger spacing, natural joints, short nails, no anatomical distortion. Display Case: A large glass pastry case extending diagonally from the bottom-left foreground toward the top-left background. Rows of donuts, pastries, bagels, and glazed baked goods on metal trays. Closest pastries are identifiable but slightly soft-focused—reflective icing, uneven handmade surfaces, powdered sugar dusting, and occasional paper liners. Reflections, smudges, faint streaks, and layered interior shapes on the glass. Background: Dense layered city streets behind the woman and through the reflective glass—blurred pedestrians, storefronts, signage, lights, and architectural forms. All background figures are anonymous and heavily bokeh-ed. Bright circular bokeh highlights and diffused reflections in the top-left and top-center background. Vibrant metropolitan feel; no identifiable brand names or locations. Composition: Classic documentary style—the woman stands out clearly against the busy, blurred background. The display case serves as a strong diagonal leading line from the bottom left toward her hands and face. Head located in the upper right quadrant; the smartphone as a secondary focal point near the bottom center. Slightly asymmetrical, natural snapshot framing, non-perfect pose. Black and White Tones: Rich, wide grayscale range—deep blacks in the hair, sunglasses, trousers, and shadows; luminous light grays in the shirt and skin highlights; layered mid-grays in the glass, pastries, and urban reflections. Strong controlled contrast, detailed shadow information, soft highlight transitions, and slight coarse-grained analog film texture. Lighting: Diffused daylight through the storefront window—soft front-left lighting on the forehead, cheekbones, bridge of the nose, lips, shirt collar, hands, and watch. Deeper shadows on the hair and the right side of the body. No harsh flash or glamour lighting. Window and glass reflections overlap parts of the subject without obscuring the face. Camera: Classic 35mm B&W film feel, approximately 50mm full-frame, medium-wide aperture, shallow to medium depth of field. Face/sunglasses/hands/shirt/phone are sharp; foreground pastries and distant streets gradually blur. Fine silver grain texture, slight halation around bright bokeh, subtle vignetting, authentic glass reflections, and gentle edge softening. Atmosphere: Intimate urban solitude in a crowded city, stylish but effortless, quiet focus, nostalgic documentary authenticity, and sophisticated street photography. Negative: No color, no text, no readable signs, no watermarks, no logos, no extra sharp-focused people, no studio background, no exaggerated smiles, no heavy makeup, no plastic skin, no distorted glasses, no deformed hands, no extra fingers, no repeated pastries, no excessive blurring of the subject, no artificial HDR effect.

zh.title: 黑白街头时尚快照
zh.description: 一份详细的纪录片风格提示词，用于生成一张高对比度的黑白街头摄影作品，画面主体为城市面包店橱窗前的一位时尚女性，强调写实的质感与胶片颗粒感。
zh.prompt: 一张写实的黑白街头时尚快照，比例 2:3 竖构图。一位 {argument name="subject" default="时尚的年轻女性"} 站在 {argument name="setting" default="小型城市面包店"} 内或橱窗旁。取景范围从大腿中部到头部上方。主体占据画面右侧三分之二，左侧三分之一为面包展示柜，营造出层次丰富的环境肖像感。特写镜头，自然的平视视角，身体略微向左倾斜，与玻璃柜台平行。主体：黑色长直发中分，自然垂落在胸前。发质柔顺但不刻意造型，脸颊周围有几缕碎发。佩戴圆形深色细金属框太阳镜——镜片上隐约映出面包店内部和窗外的光线。目光微微下垂，注视着手中的智能手机。表情平静、专注且略带满足——双唇放松，带着一丝淡淡的微笑。服装：一件 {argument name="outfit" default="浅色廓形衬衫"}，材质为柔软的棉麻面料——尖领设计，可见胸袋，面料有轻微褶皱，袖子随意卷至肘部下方。自然垂坠，在肩部、肘部、腰部及束腰处有写实的褶皱。深色高腰牛仔裤或长裤，搭配深色皮带和简约的矩形金属扣。左手腕佩戴一款优雅的复古模拟手表，配有细金属链表带。所有配饰均走极简风格。智能手机：双手横向持握于腰部高度，略微向上，仿佛正在打字或阅读。精准的手部细节：写实的手指间距、自然的关节、短指甲，无解剖结构畸变。展示柜：一个大型玻璃糕点柜，从左下角前景向左上角背景斜向延伸。金属托盘上摆放着成排的甜甜圈、糕点、贝果和糖霜烘焙食品。近处的糕点清晰可见但略带柔焦——反光的糖霜、不规则的手工表面、撒上的糖粉以及偶尔出现的纸托。玻璃上有反光、指纹、淡淡的条纹以及重叠的内部形状。背景：女性身后及反光玻璃外是密集的城市街道——模糊的行人、店面、招牌、灯光和建筑轮廓。所有背景人物均为匿名且经过重度虚化处理。左上角和左中背景有明亮的圆形光斑和漫反射光。充满活力的都市氛围；无任何可辨认的品牌名称或地点。构图：经典的纪录片风格——女性在繁忙、模糊的背景中清晰突出。展示柜作为一条强有力的对角线引导线，从左下角延伸至她的手部和面部。头部位于右上象限；智能手机作为次要焦点位于底部中心。略显不对称，自然的快照构图，非刻意的姿态。黑白影调：丰富且宽广的灰度范围——头发、太阳镜、长裤和阴影处呈现深黑色；衬衫和皮肤高光处呈现明亮的浅灰色；玻璃、糕点和城市倒影处呈现层次分明的中间调灰色。强力且可控的对比度，细腻的阴影细节，柔和的高光过渡，以及轻微的粗颗粒模拟胶片质感。光线：通过店面橱窗的漫射日光——前额、颧骨、鼻梁、嘴唇、衬衫领口、手部和手表上有柔和的左前方照明。头发和身体右侧有较深的阴影。无强烈的闪光灯或美颜灯光。窗户和玻璃的反射部分重叠在主体上，但不遮挡面部。相机：经典的 35mm 黑白胶片感，约 50mm 全画幅镜头，中等光圈，浅至中等景深。面部、太阳镜、手部、衬衫和手机清晰锐利；前景的糕点和远处的街道逐渐模糊。细腻的银盐颗粒质感，明亮光斑周围有轻微晕影，细微的暗角，真实的玻璃反光，以及柔和的边缘处理。氛围：拥挤城市中的私密都市孤独感，时尚而不费力，安静的专注，怀旧的纪录片真实感，以及精致的街头摄影风格。负面提示：无彩色，无文字，无清晰可辨的招牌，无水印，无 Logo，无额外清晰对焦的人物，无摄影棚背景，无夸张的笑容，无浓妆，无塑料感皮肤，无扭曲的眼镜，无畸形的手部，无多余的手指，无重复的糕点，无对主体过度的模糊，无人工 HDR 效果。

en.title: Professional Snack Packaging Mockup
en.description: A professional prompt for creating high-resolution packaging mockups, allowing you to visualize labels and logos on realistic pouch or box textures with studio lighting.
en.prompt: Design a professional packaging mockup for my {argument name="product type" default="snack product"} using the uploaded {argument name="branding" default="label/logo"}, realistic {argument name="container material" default="pouch or box material"} texture, studio lighting, plain background, high resolution.

zh.title: 专业零食包装样机
zh.description: 一个用于创建高分辨率包装样机的专业提示词，让您能够在逼真的袋装或盒装纹理上可视化标签和 Logo，并呈现摄影棚灯光效果。
zh.prompt: 为我的 {argument name="product type" default="零食产品"} 设计一个专业的包装样机，使用上传的 {argument name="branding" default="标签/Logo"}，逼真的 {argument name="container material" default="袋装或盒装材质"} 纹理，摄影棚灯光，纯色背景，高分辨率。

en.title: Extreme Wide-Angle Cat Photobomb Selfie
en.description: A fun and creative prompt that creates a hilarious, wide-angle selfie. It captures a person laughing while an orange cat playfully presses its face against the camera lens in a cozy café.
en.prompt: A hilarious, extreme 0.5x wide-angle low selfie looking up, ruined by a {argument name="pet" default="pet"}. An enormous {argument name="pet description" default="fluffy orange cat"} presses its giant pink nose and whiskers directly against the camera, filling most of the frame in soft blurry detail. Behind the cat, a {argument name="person description" default="cheerful young woman with shoulder-length dark hair"} wears a cozy cream knitted sweater, laughing helplessly. They are sitting inside a warm aesthetic café filled with wooden furniture, hanging plants, pastries, and soft golden afternoon light. Curved perspective, casual slice-of-life, candid moment, high ISO smartphone photography, natural imperfections.

zh.title: 超广角猫咪乱入自拍
zh.description: 这是一个充满趣味和创意的提示词，可以生成一张滑稽的广角自拍。画面捕捉了一个人在咖啡馆里大笑，而一只橘猫调皮地将脸贴在镜头上的场景。
zh.prompt: 一张滑稽的 0.5 倍超广角仰拍自拍，被一只 {argument name="pet" default="宠物"} 乱入。一只巨大的 {argument name="pet description" default="毛茸茸的橘猫"} 将它硕大的粉色鼻子和胡须直接贴在镜头上，占据了画面大部分区域，呈现出柔和模糊的细节。在猫咪身后，一位 {argument name="person description" default="留着齐肩黑发、神情愉悦的年轻女性"} 穿着舒适的米色针织毛衣，正无奈地大笑。他们坐在一家温馨的咖啡馆里，店内摆满了木质家具、悬挂的绿植和糕点，沐浴在午后柔和的金色阳光中。弯曲的透视效果，随意的生活片段，抓拍瞬间，高 ISO 智能手机摄影风格，带有自然的瑕疵感。

en.title: Premium Ice Cream Commercial Storyboard
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a detailed 9-scene storyboard for luxury food advertisements. It uses a professional Swiss editorial grid to display cinematic scenes with action and visual descriptions.

en.title: Japanese Garden Fashion Portrait
en.description: A detailed professional fashion photography prompt for a woman in a Japanese garden, focusing on texture, lighting, and composition.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="theme" default="white cloth knot"}

Main Subject:
A realistic 3:4 vertical fashion portrait capturing an adult woman from behind, standing by a pond in a {argument name="garden" default="lush Japanese garden"}. The subject occupies a large portion of the center-right of the frame, captured from the top of the head to the thighs. Her back is turned toward the camera, her upper body slightly twisted to her right, revealing a refined profile over her right shoulder.

Person and Expression:
An adult woman with a natural and calm atmosphere. Her hair is a shiny {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} short layered bob, reaching from below the jaw to the nape of the neck. The tips flare slightly outward, with thin bangs and fine stray hairs around her face along her cheeks. Pale pink-brown eye makeup, thin natural eyelashes, soft eyebrows, and subtle rose-beige lips. Her face is tilted slightly downward, eyes quietly cast toward the bottom right, with a pensive expression and relaxed mouth.

Clothing and Pose:
A long dress made of layered thin, soft ivory-white chiffon. It features a design with a wide-open back from the shoulders; the translucent outer fabric has an elegant skin-toned opaque lining inside, subtly revealing the body's silhouette while naturally covering necessary parts. The fabric from both sides is tied into a thick knot in the center of the back, slightly above the waist, with long ends flowing downward. Her right arm hangs along her body, her right hand lightly pinching the hem. Her left arm is tucked into the fabric at her side. Her weight is on her left leg, creating a slight difference in shoulder height.

Background and Light:
On the left of the frame is a calm pond with tree reflections, and on the right are moss-covered natural stones and the veranda of an old wooden building. In the background are shoji doors, pillars, and deep green trees, forming a quiet Japanese garden. Warm morning light shines from the top left, softly illuminating the hair's outline, nape, shoulders, and upper back. A thin bluish-green reflection from the pond is added to the shadow side, with dappled sunlight spots falling on the rocks and veranda.

Composition and Camera:
3:4 vertical. The person's face is in the upper center-right, and the back and fabric knot are in the center. A bright space of the water surface is widely framed on the left, with depth created by the diagonal lines of the veranda and stonework on the right. The camera is positioned slightly to the right behind the person, at roughly shoulder height. Equivalent to 85mm medium telephoto, shallow depth of field. Focus is on the face, hair outline, shoulders, and knot, with the pond and buildings smoothly blurred.

Texture and Style:
Elegant Japanese-style fashion photography. Fine skin texture is preserved, avoiding excessive skin retouching. Precise depiction of transmitted light through chiffon, the shading of overlapping fabrics, fine wrinkles, the thickness of the knot, and the natural shine of individual hairs. Centered on white and pale skin tones, combined with deep green background, dark brown wood, and blue-green water. Soft contrast, natural three-dimensionality, and a serene magazine-quality finish.

Negative:
Underage-looking person, excessive exposure, explicit nudity, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, poor contact between fabric and body, unnatural knots, floating fabric, broken shoulder symmetry, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 日式庭院时尚人像
zh.description: 一份详细的专业时尚摄影提示词，以日式庭院中的女性为主题，重点关注质感、光影和构图。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="theme" default="白色布结"}

主要拍摄对象：
一张 3:4 的写实竖构图时尚人像，拍摄一位站在 {argument name="garden" default="郁郁葱葱的日式庭院"} 池塘边的成年女性背影。主体占据画面中右侧的大部分空间，取景范围从头顶到大腿。她背对镜头，上半身向右微转，露出右肩上方精致的侧脸。

人物与表情：
一位气质自然沉静的成年女性。她留着一头有光泽的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 短款层次感波波头，长度从下颌下方延伸至颈后。发梢微微外翘，脸颊两侧有稀疏的刘海和细碎的杂毛。淡粉棕色眼妆，纤细自然的睫毛，柔和的眉毛，以及淡淡的玫瑰米色嘴唇。她微微低头，双眼静静地看向右下方，表情沉思，嘴角放松。

服装与姿势：
一件由多层轻薄柔软的象牙白雪纺制成的长裙。设计特点是肩部大露背；半透明的外层织物内衬优雅的肤色不透明内衬，在自然遮盖必要部位的同时，隐约勾勒出身体轮廓。两侧的织物在背部中心、腰部上方一点处系成一个厚实的结，长长的裙摆垂下。她的右臂自然下垂，右手轻轻捏住裙摆。左臂收在身侧的织物中。重心落在左腿上，使双肩呈现出轻微的高低差。

背景与光影：
画面左侧是倒映着树木的平静池塘，右侧是覆盖着苔藓的天然石块和古老木建筑的走廊。背景中可见障子门、柱子和深绿色的树木，构成了一个幽静的日式庭院。温暖的晨光从左上方照射下来，柔和地照亮了头发轮廓、颈后、肩膀和上背部。阴影侧叠加了来自池塘的淡淡蓝绿色反光，斑驳的阳光洒在岩石和走廊上。

构图与摄影：
3:4 竖构图。人物脸部位于中上方偏右，背部和布结位于中心。左侧大面积留出明亮的水面空间，右侧通过走廊和石构件的对角线营造出深度感。相机位于人物后方偏右侧，大约肩部高度。相当于 85mm 中长焦镜头，浅景深。焦点对准脸部、发丝轮廓、肩膀和布结，池塘和建筑呈现平滑的虚化效果。

质感与风格：
优雅的日式时尚摄影。保留细腻的皮肤纹理，避免过度磨皮。精准描绘雪纺透光感、重叠织物的阴影、细微褶皱、布结的厚度以及每一根发丝的自然光泽。以白色和浅肤色为主调，结合深绿色背景、深棕色木材和蓝绿色水面。柔和的对比度，自然的立体感，呈现出宁静的杂志级质感。

负面提示词：
未成年人外貌、过度暴露、露骨裸露、不自然的脸部、不自然的视线、多余的手指、手指缺失、肢体融合、关节断裂、织物与身体接触不良、不自然的结、漂浮的织物、肩膀对称性破坏、透视错误、与光源不一致的阴影、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、乱码文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: 3D CG Candy World Magical Girl Poster
en.description: An intricate prompt for a high-quality 3D CG character poster featuring an adult magical girl in a candy-themed oriental fantasy world with dynamic low-angle perspective.
en.prompt:
9:16 vertical, high-precision 3D CG oriental fantasy cool and sweet magical girl character poster. Anime-style 3D CG character art, semi-realistic 3D character render, full body portrait, low-angle looking up perspective composition. The main subject is a clearly adult young oriental fantasy female character, visual age approx. {argument name="age" default="20–24"} years old. The overall vibe is agile, cute, playful, dreamy, sweet, and cool, with a high-end feel of candy fairy tales and oriental fantasy magic. It's not a flat illustration, but a high-completion 3D CG character render with exquisite character modeling, realistic material performance, bright candy-colored lighting, and a high-end virtual character poster texture.

The character has an exquisite and cute oriental beautiful face, a small and soft oval face, fair and delicate skin with a slight transparency and soft skin coloring. The eyes are large and rounded, with a gradient of pink-purple, light blue, and candy orange. The pupils have a star-like glass texture and high-gloss reflections, with an innocent, agile, yet slightly mischievous look. The eyelashes are long and curled, the eye makeup is light and transparent, the lips are small and soft in a light pink candy color, and the expression is cute, surprised, and curious, looking right at the camera.

The hairstyle is a short curly bob or medium-short hair, mainly lavender purple and light pink-orange gradient. The ends curl outward slightly, and the hair is smooth and fluffy, featuring high-precision hair strand modeling and candy-like soft highlights. She wears a white bear-eared hood with pink heart patterns inside the ears, enhancing the fairy tale feel and character identity.

The outfit is an oriental fantasy candy magical girl style short skirt set, primarily white, pink, light blue, mint green, with small bright yellow accents. The top is a loose short cape-style hooded top with an exaggerated light green bow at the chest and a heart gem in the center; the sleeves are rounded and cute with a pink-blue color-block structure. The bottom is a layered short skirt made of light blue ruffles, a pink outer layer, and a white gauze layer, rich in layers and light and fluffy. A small candy box, bag, or heart accessories can be hung at the waist to increase character interest. She wears pink, blue, and white striped over-the-knee socks and pink platform Mary Jane shoes with gold heart decorations on the toes. The overall outfit resembles high-end 3D CG game character design for a "candy-system oriental fantasy magical girl."

The character holds an exquisite magic wand, pink and gold in structure, with a gold star core, small white wings, and ring decorations at the top, having a clear magical girl feel. The pose is floating or jumping from a low-angle perspective, with one hand reaching toward the camera, fingers naturally spread, and the other hand holding the magic wand. The legs extend forward and downward, creating an exaggerated sense of perspective, with one foot closer to the camera to enhance visual impact. The overall look is like a magical girl flying toward the viewer from a candy dream, with movements that are playful, light, and energetic.

The background is an oriental fantasy candy dreamscape, not a common flat rainbow background. The background is based on a soft pastel gradient space, incorporating subtle oriental fantasy elements such as cloud-like scrolls, light gold circular barrier patterns, floating light spots, dreamy colored clouds, and soft halos. A large number of candy and heart elements float around, including lollipops, hard candies, wrapped candies, hearts, stars, ribbons, bubbles, and small dessert decorations, creating a rich sense of space, overall like floating in a sweet and dreamy candy wonderland. The background should be clean, bright, layered, dreamy, and high-end, not cluttered.

The lighting uses bright and soft high-key studio-style dreamy lighting, supplemented by colored rim light. The character's face, hair, clothing edges, candy, and magic wand all have clear highlights. Fabrics, metals, plastic candies, gems, sock textures, and shoe surfaces all have realistic and clear PBR material performance. The overall color palette is dominated by pink, light blue, mint green, milky white, light purple, and bright yellow. The image is exquisite, lively, sweet, and transparent, with the quality of a high-end collectible 3D CG oriental fantasy magical girl character poster.

zh.title: 3D CG 糖果世界魔法少女海报
zh.description: 一份用于制作高质量 3D CG 角色海报的精细提示词，主角为糖果主题东方幻想世界中的成年魔法少女，采用动态低角度视角。
zh.prompt:
9:16 竖屏，高精度 3D CG 东方幻想风酷甜魔法少女角色海报。动漫风格 3D CG 角色艺术，半写实 3D 角色渲染，全身肖像，低角度仰视构图。主体为一位清晰可见的成年东方幻想女性角色，视觉年龄约 {argument name="age" default="20–24"} 岁。整体氛围灵动、可爱、俏皮、梦幻、甜美且酷炫，具有糖果童话与东方幻想魔法的高级感。非扁平插画，而是高完成度的 3D CG 角色渲染，具备精致的角色建模、真实的材质表现、明亮的糖果色灯光以及高端虚拟角色海报质感。

角色拥有精致可爱的东方美女面孔，小巧柔和的鹅蛋脸，白皙细腻的皮肤，带有轻微的通透感和柔和的肤色。眼睛圆润硕大，呈现粉紫、浅蓝与糖果橙的渐变色。瞳孔具有星状玻璃质感和高光反射，眼神清澈灵动，又带有一丝调皮。睫毛长而卷翘，眼妆轻盈通透，嘴唇小巧柔和，呈淡粉色糖果色，表情可爱、惊讶且充满好奇，直视镜头。

发型为短卷波波头或中短发，主色调为薰衣草紫与浅粉橙渐变。发尾微微外翘，发质顺滑蓬松，具备高精度发丝建模和糖果般的柔和高光。她戴着一个白色熊耳兜帽，耳朵内侧有粉色爱心图案，增强了童话感和角色辨识度。

服装为东方幻想糖果魔法少女风格短裙套装，以白色、粉色、浅蓝、薄荷绿为主，点缀少量亮黄色。上衣为宽松短款斗篷式连帽衫，胸前有夸张的浅绿色蝴蝶结，中心镶嵌爱心宝石；袖子呈圆润可爱的粉蓝拼色结构。下装为层叠短裙，由浅蓝色荷叶边、粉色外层和白色纱层组成，层次丰富，轻盈蓬松。腰间可挂小糖果盒、包包或爱心配饰以增加角色趣味性。她穿着粉、蓝、白条纹过膝袜，以及粉色厚底玛丽珍鞋，鞋头饰有金色爱心。整体服装类似于高端 3D CG 游戏角色设计，属于“糖果系东方幻想魔法少女”。

角色手持精致的魔法棒，结构为粉金配色，带有金色星形核心、小白翼和顶部的环状装饰，具有鲜明的魔法少女感。姿势为低角度视角下的漂浮或跳跃状态，一只手向镜头伸出，手指自然张开，另一只手握着魔法棒。双腿向前下方延伸，营造出夸张的透视感，一只脚更靠近镜头以增强视觉冲击力。整体形象如同从糖果梦境中飞向观众的魔法少女，动作俏皮、轻盈且充满活力。

背景为东方幻想糖果梦境，而非普通的扁平彩虹背景。背景基于柔和的粉彩渐变空间，融入了云纹卷轴、浅金色圆形结界图案、漂浮光点、梦幻彩云和柔光晕等微妙的东方幻想元素。大量糖果和爱心元素漂浮在周围，包括棒棒糖、硬糖、包装糖、爱心、星星、丝带、气泡和小甜点装饰，营造出丰富的空间感，整体如同漂浮在甜美梦幻的糖果仙境中。背景应干净、明亮、有层次、梦幻且高级，不杂乱。

灯光采用明亮柔和的高调摄影棚式梦幻灯光，辅以彩色轮廓光。角色的面部、头发、衣物边缘、糖果和魔法棒均有清晰的高光。织物、金属、塑料糖果、宝石、袜类纹理和鞋面均具备真实清晰的 PBR 材质表现。整体色调以粉色、浅蓝色、薄荷绿、乳白色、浅紫色和亮黄色为主。画面精致、活泼、甜美且通透，具备高端收藏级 3D CG 东方幻想魔法少女角色海报的品质。

Use a striking color palette of matte black mechanical components, cream-white armor plates, and vivid red markings. The armor has exactly three main cream-white spotted zones: both forearms covered in red circular spots, both lower shin guards covered in red spots, and large rounded hip/thigh armor panels with black socket-like holes and a bold red number-like marking on one side. Include exposed joints, pistons, screws, circular ports, cables, layered plating, and asymmetrical mechanical detailing throughout. The character holds one oversized futuristic rifle vertically downward in both hands, centered between the legs, with black metal construction and red accent glyphs and panels. Feet are rabbit-like mechanical paws with clawed toes. Render in a high-detail anime mecha concept art style, sharp inked edges, subtle cel shading, clean negative space, no text, no logo, no environment, no cropped limbs, full body visible from ears to feet, vertical {argument name="aspect ratio" default="2:3"} composition.

zh.title: 女性兔型机械生物概念设计
zh.description: 一个全身动漫机甲角色提示词，用于生成带有武器、斑点装甲且呈现简洁概念艺术风格的女性兔型仿生机器人。
zh.prompt: 创作一张全身角色概念插画，主角为 {argument name="character type" default="female rabbit mechanoid"}，以自信的正面姿态站立在纯净的暖白色工作室背景中。角色身材高挑且健美，拥有流线型的黑色生物机械躯干、纤细的腰部、修长的机械腿以及一对高耸的兔耳；头部为一个光滑的浅色兔形面具，配有细长的橙色眼睛，额头处饰有一个红色的蝴蝶结状符号。采用引人注目的配色方案：哑光黑色机械部件、奶油白色装甲板以及鲜艳的红色标记。装甲有三个主要的奶油白色斑点区域：覆盖红色圆点的双前臂、覆盖红色斑点的双小腿护甲，以及带有黑色插槽孔和一侧印有醒目红色数字标记的圆形大腿/髋部装甲板。全身包含外露的关节、活塞、螺丝、圆形接口、线缆、层叠的装甲板以及不对称的机械细节。角色双手垂直向下握持一把超大型未来主义步枪，置于双腿之间，步枪采用黑色金属材质，配有红色装饰符号和面板。双脚为带有爪状脚趾的兔形机械爪。采用高细节动漫机甲概念艺术风格渲染，边缘线条锐利，带有细腻的赛璐珞阴影，留白简洁，无文字，无 Logo，无环境背景，无肢体裁剪，从耳朵到脚趾全身可见，垂直 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="2:3"} 构图。

en.title: Blue Moonlit Sari Portrait
en.description: Generates a cinematic cool-blue nocturnal portrait of a woman in a sari posed before a glowing full moon.
en.prompt: Create a low-key nocturnal vertical portrait of {argument name="character description" default="a young South Asian woman"} from upper torso to head, centered slightly below the upper half of the frame, with a huge luminous full moon directly behind her head like a halo. She has long loose wavy {argument name="hair color" default="black hair"} parted near the center, a calm introspective expression, her complete face visible, eyes looking down and slightly to her left, soft lips, and a small nose ring. Use a monochromatic cool-blue moonlit color grade with deep navy shadows, subtle rim light on the hair and shoulders, and smooth realistic photographic skin texture. She wears a dark navy sari draped diagonally over one shoulder and a matching short-sleeve blouse with a wide neckline. Include exactly three visible tattoos: two symmetrical black leafy branch tattoos across the left and right collarbones, and one small centered chest text tattoo reading {argument name="chest tattoo text" default="FEEL ME"}. The background is almost black with faint star specks and negative space, while the oversized moon is softly detailed with craters and a blue glow. Mood should be quiet, cinematic, mysterious, and romantic, with shallow depth of field, high contrast, soft moon haze, no extra people, no added text besides the tattoo, no watermark, and a polished editorial portrait style.

zh.title: 蓝色月光下的纱丽肖像
zh.description: 生成一张电影感冷蓝色调的夜间肖像，描绘一位身着纱丽的女性在明亮满月前的姿态。
zh.prompt: 创作一张低调的夜间竖版肖像，主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一位年轻的南亚女性"} 的上半身至头部，构图位于画面上半部分略偏下方。她身后是一轮巨大的发光满月，如同光环一般。她留着长长的波浪卷 {argument name="hair color" default="黑发"}，中分，表情平静而内敛，面部轮廓清晰，双眼向下并略微看向左侧，双唇柔和，鼻翼处戴着小巧的鼻环。采用单色冷蓝色调，阴影呈现深海军蓝，发丝和肩部带有细腻的轮廓光，皮肤纹理真实细腻。她身穿一件斜披在肩上的深海军蓝纱丽，搭配同色系宽领短袖上衣。画面中需包含三处可见的纹身：左右锁骨处各有一处对称的黑色叶片纹身，胸口正中有一处小巧的文字纹身，内容为 {argument name="chest tattoo text" default="FEEL ME"}。背景近乎全黑，点缀着微弱的星光，留白适中；巨大的月球细节柔和，带有环形山和蓝色光晕。整体氛围宁静、具有电影感、神秘且浪漫，采用浅景深、高对比度、柔和的月光雾气效果，画面中不包含其他人，除纹身外无额外文字，无水印，呈现出精致的杂志肖像风格。

en.title: Luxury Garden Save-the-Date Card
en.description: Generates a romantic editorial wedding save-the-date card with a golden-hour couple portrait and elegant calligraphy typography.
en.prompt: Create a premium romantic save-the-date editorial photo card for a Muslim couple. Use a square 1:1 canvas with a luxurious wedding stationery look. The top two-thirds should be a warm golden-hour portrait of a young Black couple standing close together in a lush garden aisle framed by flowering greenery and soft bokeh sunlight. The groom stands on the left, facing forward with a calm elegant expression, wearing round glasses, a navy double-breasted suit with gold buttons, white dress shirt, blue tie, pocket square, and wristwatch. The bride stands on the right, leaning into him with one hand on his chest showing a ring, wearing a fitted long-sleeve ivory dress and a flowing muted rose-and-brown patterned hijab, with polished bridal makeup and a serene smile. The scene should feel cinematic, high-end, softly retouched, and photorealistic, with shallow depth of field, creamy highlights, warm sun flare in the upper right, and white/pink roses in the background. The lower third should fade into a soft ivory mist overlay for typography. Add centered elegant wedding text: small spaced serif uppercase “SAVE THE DATE” in gold; below it, very large black calligraphy names “{argument name="couple names" default="Abduraheem & Khadijat"}”; below that, small spaced gold serif uppercase “ARE GETTING MARRIED”; then a date line with “SATURDAY” on the left, a large gold “{argument name="day number" default="25"}” in the center, and “{argument name="month and year" default="AUGUST 2026"}” on the right, separated by thin vertical gold lines. Add delicate gold ornamental flourishes above and below the date area, and a small cursive line at the bottom reading “{argument name="bottom note" default="Formal invitation to follow"}”. Keep the card refined and uncluttered, with perfect typography alignment, no extra text, no watermark, and no border.

zh.title: 奢华花园风“预留日期”邀请卡
zh.description: 生成一张浪漫的编辑风格婚礼“预留日期”邀请卡，包含黄金时刻情侣肖像及优雅的书法字体。
zh.prompt: 为穆斯林夫妇创作一张高端浪漫的“预留日期”编辑风格照片卡。使用 1:1 正方形画布，呈现奢华婚礼文具的质感。上方三分之二为一对年轻黑人夫妇在郁郁葱葱的花园小径中的温暖黄金时刻肖像，周围环绕着盛开的绿植和柔和的焦外成像阳光。新郎站在左侧，面朝前方，神情沉稳优雅，佩戴圆框眼镜，身穿海军蓝双排扣西装，搭配金色纽扣、白色衬衫、蓝色领带、口袋巾和腕表。新娘站在右侧，靠向新郎，一只手放在他胸前展示戒指，身穿修身长袖象牙白礼服，佩戴飘逸的柔粉棕色印花头巾，妆容精致，面带宁静微笑。画面应具有电影感、高端感、柔和修饰感及照片级真实感，具备浅景深、奶油色高光、右上角的温暖光晕以及背景中的白粉色玫瑰。下方三分之一应渐变为柔和的象牙白雾面叠加层，用于展示文字。添加居中的优雅婚礼文字：顶部为小间距衬线大写字母“SAVE THE DATE”（金色）；下方为非常大的黑色书法名字“{argument name="couple names" default="Abduraheem & Khadijat"}”；再下方为小间距金色衬线大写字母“ARE GETTING MARRIED”；随后是日期行，左侧为“SATURDAY”，中间为巨大的金色“{argument name="day number" default="25"}”，右侧为“{argument name="month and year" default="AUGUST 2026"}”，中间以细长的金色竖线分隔。在日期区域上下添加精致的金色装饰花纹，底部添加一行小巧的草书文字“{argument name="bottom note" default="Formal invitation to follow"}”。保持卡片精致简洁，排版对齐完美，无额外文字，无水印，无边框。

en.title: Candid Parking Lot Street Fashion
en.description: A realistic lifestyle fashion photo prompt for generating a stylish woman walking through a sunny shopping-center parking lot.
en.prompt: Create a realistic candid street-fashion photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a smiling young woman with dark hair in a messy bun"} walking through a sunny suburban shopping-center parking lot at midday. She is centered slightly left in a wide horizontal frame, laughing and looking off to her left, wearing small black oval sunglasses, a black halter-style tube crop top with a large grayscale cat face wearing sunglasses printed on the front, and high-waisted loose black pinstripe trousers. She has visible arm tattoos, a black smartwatch, a small shiny silver shoulder bag on a chain strap, and she carries two discrete handheld items: 1) a flat brown cardboard takeout box in her left hand, and 2) car keys plus black sunglasses dangling from her right hand. The environment includes rows of parked cars on both sides, leafy green trees, a brick-and-stucco retail building with shaded storefronts on the left, bright blue sky, strong natural sunlight, crisp shadows, and shallow depth of field with the background softly blurred. Use a natural documentary look, 35mm lens perspective, realistic skin texture, authentic motion, warm summer color grading, no text, no watermark, no posed studio lighting.

zh.title: 停车场街拍风格抓拍
zh.description: 一个写实的生活方式时尚摄影提示词，用于生成一位时尚女性走在阳光明媚的购物中心停车场的画面。
zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的街拍风格抓拍照片，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着深色乱发丸子头、面带微笑的年轻女性"}，正走在正午阳光明媚的郊区购物中心停车场。她位于宽幅横向构图的左侧，正笑着看向左方，佩戴着黑色小号椭圆太阳镜，身穿黑色挂脖式抹胸短上衣，正面印有戴着太阳镜的灰色猫脸图案，下身搭配高腰宽松黑色细条纹长裤。她手臂上有明显的纹身，佩戴黑色智能手表，肩背一个小巧闪亮的银色链条包，手中拿着两样物品：1）左手拿着一个扁平的棕色纸质外卖盒，2）右手拎着车钥匙和一副黑色太阳镜。环境包括两侧停放的车辆、绿树、左侧带有阴凉店面的砖石结构零售建筑、湛蓝的天空、强烈的自然光、清晰的阴影，以及背景虚化的浅景深效果。采用自然的纪实风格，35mm 镜头视角，真实的皮肤质感，自然的动态感，温暖的夏季色调，无文字，无水印，无摆拍的影棚灯光。

en.title: Titanium Smartphone Triptych
en.description: Creates a premium editorial comparison image of three flagship titanium smartphones with brand labels and dramatic accent lighting.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a premium editorial comparison triptych of three flagship titanium smartphones side by side, photographed from the rear at matching three-quarter angles, like a luxury tech magazine ad.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal composition, dark charcoal-to-black gradient studio background, subtle smoky texture, glossy reflective floor line at the bottom, dramatic rim lighting and soft bloom.

Layout: Place a huge thin uppercase headline centered at the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="TITANIUM"}. Directly below it, add the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="Three brands. One metal. Zero agreement."}. Put a small black rounded rectangle badge in the upper-right corner with bold white text {argument name="badge text" default="GPT"}. Center the three phones across the lower two-thirds with equal spacing and identical visual scale.

Subject details: Show exactly 3 smartphones. Left phone: iPhone 16 Pro in Natural Titanium, warm champagne/gold body, rear Apple logo, three large camera lenses in a square camera island, warm gold accent lighting around the edges. Center phone: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra in Titanium Gray, dark gray rectangular slab with squared corners, rear Samsung logo, five separate rear camera/sensor circles, electric blue rim light along the right edge. Right phone: Google Pixel 9 Pro in Obsidian black, rear Google G logo, horizontal black camera bar with lenses and flash, green accent rim light along the side.

Visible labels: Include exactly 3 product label groups near the phones. Left label reads "Apple iPhone 16 Pro" on the first line and "Natural Titanium" on the second line. Center label reads "SAMSUNG" on the first line, "Galaxy S24 Ultra" on the second line, and "Titanium Gray" on the third line. Right label reads "Google" on the first line, "Pixel 9 Pro" on the second line, and "Obsidian" on the third line. Add a small creator handle centered at the bottom reading {argument name="creator handle" default="@TechWithYami"}.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic 3D product render, premium editorial lighting, metallic surfaces, soft reflections, crisp lens glass, shallow studio haze, high contrast, cinematic color accents: gold left, blue center, green right.

Constraints: Use exactly three phones and exactly three product label groups; keep all text clean, legible, and minimal; no extra devices, hands, people, charts, or clutter.

zh.title: 钛金属智能手机三联图
zh.description: 创建一张高端编辑风格的对比图，展示三款旗舰钛金属智能手机，包含品牌标签和戏剧性的强调照明效果。
zh.prompt:
目标：创建一张高端编辑风格的对比三联图，将三款旗舰钛金属智能手机并排展示，以匹配的三分之四角度从背面拍摄，呈现出奢侈科技杂志广告的质感。

画布：宽屏 16:9 横向构图，深炭灰色至黑色的渐变摄影棚背景，带有微妙的烟雾质感，底部有光泽的反射地面线条，戏剧性的轮廓光和柔和的光晕效果。

布局：在顶部居中放置一个巨大的细体大写标题，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="TITANIUM"}。在标题正下方，添加副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="Three brands. One metal. Zero agreement."}。在右上角放置一个小的黑色圆角矩形徽章，内含粗体白色文字 {argument name="badge text" default="GPT"}。将三部手机居中放置在下三分之二区域，保持等间距和相同的视觉比例。

主体细节：展示 3 部智能手机。左侧手机：iPhone 16 Pro（原色钛金属），温暖的香槟金机身，背面有 Apple 标志，方形摄像头模组内有三个大镜头，边缘带有暖金色强调光。中间手机：Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra（钛灰），深灰色矩形板，边角方正，背面有 Samsung 标志，五个独立的后置摄像头/传感器圆圈，右侧边缘带有电光蓝轮廓光。右侧手机：Google Pixel 9 Pro（曜石黑），背面有 Google G 标志，水平黑色摄像头条带包含镜头和闪光灯，侧面带有绿色强调轮廓光。

可见标签：在手机附近包含 3 组产品标签。左侧标签第一行显示 "Apple iPhone 16 Pro"，第二行显示 "Natural Titanium"。中间标签第一行显示 "SAMSUNG"，第二行显示 "Galaxy S24 Ultra"，第三行显示 "Titanium Gray"。右侧标签第一行显示 "Google"，第二行显示 "Pixel 9 Pro"，第三行显示 "Obsidian"。在底部居中添加一个小型的创作者账号，内容为 {argument name="creator handle" default="@TechWithYami"}。

视觉风格：超写实 3D 产品渲染，高端编辑照明，金属表面，柔和反射，清晰的镜头玻璃，浅层摄影棚雾气，高对比度，电影级色彩点缀：左侧金色，中间蓝色，右侧绿色。

约束：使用 3 部手机和 3 组产品标签；保持所有文字清晰、易读且简洁；不要添加额外的设备、手部、人物、图表或杂乱元素。

en.title: Axolotl Kigurumi Fashion Poster
en.description: Creates a pastel Japanese street-fashion magazine poster featuring a cute axolotl-themed kigurumi outfit with labeled style callouts.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese kawaii fashion magazine poster featuring a full-body young woman modeling an axolotl-inspired "kigurumi daily outfit" on a softly blurred residential sidewalk.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 composition, airy pastel editorial style, bright natural daylight, shallow depth of field, soft beige city street background with plants and apartment walls. Keep the subject centered slightly right, full body visible from hood to shoes.

Subject details: A cute young woman with long flowing dark brown hair and bangs, fair skin, soft makeup, gentle expression, looking slightly up and to the side while twirling. She wears a pink axolotl hood with black button-like eyes and six fluffy gill fronds, a pale pink cropped sailor-style top with navy sailor collar and bow, oversized puffy sleeves, a navy pleated mini skirt with pink frills and tiny star details, white thigh-high socks with pink garter bows, and chunky black platform Mary Jane shoes decorated with small pink flower charms. Add a round pink axolotl shoulder bag with a smiling face and a long curved tail-shaped pouch hanging at her hip.

Counted fashion callouts: Include exactly 5 arrow callouts on the right side pointing to these items: 1) axolotl hood, 2) fluffy sailor top, 3) navy-and-pink frill skirt, 4) tail-shaped bag, 5) thick-soled shoes. Use thin hand-drawn pink arrows and small rounded Japanese annotation text.

Text content: Large vertical Japanese title on the left reading {argument name="main vertical title" default="着ぐるみさんの日常"}. A small rounded vertical sidebar label on the far left reading {argument name="sidebar slogan" default="私は毎日フワッとスタイル"}. Bottom-left vertical caption in a delicate dotted frame reading {argument name="bottom caption" default="ふわふわ可愛い着ぐるみで、今日もごきげんにおでかけ♪ ピンクとネイビーの魔法で、"}. Right-side callout text should read {argument name="callout labels" default="ウーパールーパーフード｜ふわっとセーラートップス｜ネイビー×ピンクのフリルスカート｜しっぽつきバッグ｜厚底シューズ"}. Add small white sparkle doodles, dotted loops, and tiny flower icons around the title area.

Visual style: Photorealistic fashion editorial mixed with cute Japanese magazine graphic design, pastel pink and navy color palette, soft glow, clean typography, delicate decorative strokes, high detail fabric texture, whimsical but stylish rather than overly costume-like.

Constraints: Exactly one model, exactly one axolotl hood, exactly one round axolotl purse, exactly one tail-shaped pouch, exactly 5 labeled arrow callouts. No extra people, no watermark, no logo, no English text in the poster.

zh.title: 六角恐龙连体睡衣时尚海报
zh.description: 创作一张柔和色调的日本街头时尚杂志海报，展示可爱的六角恐龙主题连体睡衣，并带有标注样式的说明。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张竖版日本卡哇伊时尚杂志海报，展示一位年轻女性在柔和虚化的住宅区人行道上，全身模特展示六角恐龙风格的“日常连体睡衣穿搭”。

画面：2:3 竖构图，轻盈的柔和色调编辑风格，明亮的自然光，浅景深，背景为带有植物和公寓墙面的柔和米色城市街道。主体略微偏右居中，从兜帽到鞋子全身可见。

主体细节：一位可爱的年轻女性，留着飘逸的深棕色长发和刘海，皮肤白皙，妆容柔和，表情温柔，在旋转时微微抬头看向侧方。她戴着粉色六角恐龙兜帽，兜帽上有黑色纽扣状眼睛和六个毛茸茸的鳃状装饰，身穿淡粉色短款水手风上衣，配有海军蓝水手领和蝴蝶结，袖子宽大蓬松，下身穿着海军蓝百褶迷你裙，裙边带有粉色荷叶边和小星星装饰，搭配白色过膝袜和粉色吊带蝴蝶结，脚穿厚底黑色玛丽珍鞋，鞋上装饰着小粉花挂饰。在她的胯部挂着一个圆形的粉色六角恐龙单肩包，包上有笑脸，并挂着一个长长的弯曲尾巴状小包。

时尚标注：在右侧包含 5 个指向以下物品的箭头标注：1) 六角恐龙兜帽，2) 蓬松水手风上衣，3) 海军蓝配粉色荷叶边裙，4) 尾巴状包，5) 厚底鞋。使用细细的手绘粉色箭头和圆润的日文标注文字。

文字内容：左侧为巨大的竖排日文标题 {argument name="main vertical title" default="着ぐるみさんの日常"}。最左侧有一个圆润的竖排侧边栏标签，文字为 {argument name="sidebar slogan" default="私は毎日フワッとスタイル"}。左下角为精致虚线框内的竖排说明文字 {argument name="bottom caption" default="ふわふわ可愛い着ぐるみで、今日もごきげんにおでかけ♪ ピンクとネイビーの魔法で、"}。右侧标注文字应为 {argument name="callout labels" default="ウーパールーパーフード｜ふわっとセーラートップス｜ネイビー×ピンクのフリルスカート｜しっぽつきバッグ｜厚底シューズ"}。在标题区域周围添加白色小闪光涂鸦、虚线圈和微小的花朵图标。

视觉风格：照片级真实的时尚编辑风格与可爱的日本杂志平面设计相结合，采用粉色和海军蓝的柔和配色，柔光效果，干净的排版，精致的装饰笔触，高细节的织物纹理，风格奇幻且时尚，而非过于夸张的戏服感。

约束条件：仅限一位模特，仅限一个六角恐龙兜帽，仅限一个圆形六角恐龙包，仅限一个尾巴状小包，恰好 5 个带标注的箭头。画面中不得出现其他人物、水印、Logo 或任何英文字符。

en.title: Moody Neon Engagement Invitation
en.description: Generates a cinematic wedding engagement invitation with a running couple, misty mountain meadow, and glowing neon calligraphy text.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic vertical engagement party invitation poster using a romantic wedding-photography aesthetic, moody atmosphere, and elegant editorial typography.

Canvas: Vertical 9:16 invitation design, full-bleed photo background, dark dusk color grade, soft film grain, high-end luxury wedding stationery look.

Background image: A wide grassy meadow at twilight after rain, with misty evergreen forest, dark blue-gray mountains, low fog, and a dramatic cloudy sky. In the lower center, show an engaged couple from behind running away hand-in-hand through the field: the man on the left wears an ivory suit and carries a small bouquet with trailing ribbons; the woman on the right wears a flowing white slip wedding dress and lifts the skirt slightly as her long dark hair blows in the wind. Add a tiny warm-lit cabin or estate building far in the right background for depth.

Main visual effect: Across the upper and middle sky, place a large glowing neon handwritten script reading {argument name="main script text" default="We're Engaged"}. The neon should be coral-pink, oversized, flowing, imperfectly cursive, with bright inner light, soft red halo, and long sweeping strokes extending toward the left and right edges.

Text content: Include exactly 6 discrete text blocks, all centered and in thin, widely spaced uppercase serif or small caps except the neon script. 1) Top small line: {argument name="top invitation text" default="PLEASE JOIN US FOR AN"}. 2) Below it: "ENGAGEMENT PARTY". 3) Main neon script: {argument name="main script text" default="We're Engaged"}. 4) Bottom date/time: {argument name="date and time" default="06.21.2025\nAT 6:00 PM"}. 5) Venue block: {argument name="venue name" default="GREENFIELD ESTATE"}, with address underneath: {argument name="venue address" default="123 MEADOW LANE\nWILLOWBROOK, OR"}. 6) Final small line near the bottom: "RECEPTION TO FOLLOW".

Layout: Put the top invitation text in the upper sky with generous letter spacing; place the neon script dominating the sky and overlapping the mountain area; keep the couple in the lower middle third; place the date, venue, address, and reception text stacked in the lower grass area with enough contrast but subtle elegance.

Visual style: Moody romantic editorial photograph, cinematic depth, natural motion, soft haze, subdued greens and charcoal blues, glowing coral neon calligraphy, premium engagement invitation design, minimal and refined.

Constraints: Do not add borders, logos, QR codes, extra decorative icons, or additional text. Keep the couple small enough to emphasize the landscape and typography. Maintain legibility of all six text blocks.

zh.title: Moody 霓虹风格订婚邀请函
zh.description: 生成一张电影感订婚邀请函，画面包含奔跑的情侣、雾气缭绕的山间草甸以及发光的霓虹书法文字。
zh.prompt:
目标：使用浪漫的婚礼摄影美学、忧郁的氛围和优雅的编辑排版，创作一张电影感竖版订婚派对邀请函海报。

画布：9:16 竖版邀请函设计，全出血照片背景，深色黄昏色调，柔和的胶片颗粒感，高端奢华婚礼文具风格。

背景图像：雨后黄昏时分广阔的草地，背景是雾气弥漫的常青森林、深蓝灰色的山脉、低垂的雾气和戏剧性的多云天空。在画面下方中央，展示一对订婚情侣手牵手背影，正穿过田野奔跑：左侧的男士身穿象牙白西装，手持带有飘带的小花束；右侧的女士身穿飘逸的白色吊带婚纱，轻轻提起裙摆，长长的深色秀发在风中飘动。在右侧远景处增加一座微小的暖光小屋或庄园建筑，以增强深度感。

主要视觉效果：在天空的中上方，放置一行巨大的发光霓虹手写体，内容为 {argument name="main script text" default="We're Engaged"}。霓虹灯应为珊瑚粉色，超大尺寸，线条流畅，呈现不完美的草书效果，具有明亮的内部光感、柔和的红色光晕，以及向左右边缘延伸的长长笔触。

文本内容：包含 6 个独立的文本块，除霓虹书法外，其余全部居中对齐，采用纤细、字间距宽阔的大写衬线体或小型大写字母。1) 顶部小字行：{argument name="top invitation text" default="PLEASE JOIN US FOR AN"}。2) 下方："ENGAGEMENT PARTY"。3) 主要霓虹书法：{argument name="main script text" default="We're Engaged"}。4) 底部日期/时间：{argument name="date and time" default="06.21.2025\nAT 6:00 PM"}。5) 场地信息块：{argument name="venue name" default="GREENFIELD ESTATE"}，下方附地址：{argument name="venue address" default="123 MEADOW LANE\nWILLOWBROOK, OR"}。6) 底部最后一行小字："RECEPTION TO FOLLOW"。

布局：将顶部邀请文字置于天空上方，保持宽阔的字间距；霓虹书法占据天空主导位置并与山脉区域重叠；情侣位于画面下方三分之一处；将日期、场地、地址和招待会文字堆叠在下方的草地区域，确保对比度适中且保持优雅感。

视觉风格：忧郁浪漫的编辑摄影风格，电影级深度，自然动态，柔和雾气，低调的绿色与炭蓝色，发光的珊瑚色霓虹书法，高级订婚邀请函设计，简约而精致。

约束条件：不要添加边框、Logo、二维码、额外的装饰图标或额外文字。情侣比例要小，以突出景观和排版。确保所有六个文本块的可读性。

en.title: Minimalist Klein Blue Typography Poster
en.description: Generates a sparse editorial hero poster with bold condensed typography, production crop marks, and a black-and-Klein-blue print-system aesthetic.
en.prompt: Create a minimalist editorial landing-page hero poster on an off-white coated-paper background with subtle dust speckles and scanned paper grain. Center a single vertical rectangular print sheet slightly above the middle of a wide landscape canvas, leaving large empty margins. The sheet has a thin imperfect black ink border with a slightly rough printed texture, plus four small Klein-blue crop/corner registration marks just outside the rectangle, and one small blue circular registration target centered on the top border. Inside the sheet, use stark condensed bold uppercase typography like a printed production document: a tiny tracking-spaced eyebrow at the top reading {argument name="eyebrow text" default="A FILM & AI IMAGE PROMPT WORKBENCH"}, then a large stacked headline in black reading {argument name="main headline" default="SAY THE PICTURE IN YOUR HEAD."} across five tight lines, followed by the final word in vivid Klein blue reading {argument name="accent word" default="CLEARLY."}. Add a tiny tracking-spaced caption beneath the headline reading {argument name="caption text" default="THE PICTURE, PULLED INTO REGISTER."}. At the very bottom center of the canvas, far below the poster, add a thin vertical black line and tiny uppercase text reading {argument name="bottom label" default="SCROLL"}. Use only three colors: warm paper white, black ink, and intense Klein blue. Keep all corners square, no rounded UI elements, no shadows, no gradients, no illustrations, no photos, no extra text.

zh.title: 极简克莱因蓝排版海报
zh.description: 生成一张极简主义编辑风格的主视觉海报，采用醒目的紧凑型排版、印刷裁切标记，以及黑与克莱因蓝的印刷系统美学。
zh.prompt: 在带有细微灰尘斑点和扫描纸张纹理的米白色涂层纸背景上，创作一张极简主义编辑风格的落地页主视觉海报。在宽幅横向画布的中上方居中放置一张垂直长方形印刷纸张，留出大面积的空白边距。纸张边缘带有细微且不完美的黑色墨迹边框，呈现出略显粗糙的印刷质感；矩形外侧有四个小的克莱因蓝裁切/角点套准标记，顶部边框中心有一个小的蓝色圆形套准目标。纸张内部采用如同印刷生产文档般的醒目紧凑型大写排版：顶部是一行字间距较宽的小字眉题 {argument name="eyebrow text" default="A FILM & AI IMAGE PROMPT WORKBENCH"}，随后是占据五行紧凑空间、以黑色呈现的大号堆叠标题 {argument name="main headline" default="SAY THE PICTURE IN YOUR HEAD."}，最后是醒目的克莱因蓝结尾词 {argument name="accent word" default="CLEARLY."}。在标题下方添加一行字间距较宽的小字说明 {argument name="caption text" default="THE PICTURE, PULLED INTO REGISTER."}。在画布最底部的中心位置，即海报下方远端，添加一条细长的垂直黑线和一行微小的大写文字 {argument name="bottom label" default="SCROLL"}。仅使用三种颜色：暖纸白、黑色墨水和浓郁的克莱因蓝。保持所有边角为直角，无圆角 UI 元素，无阴影，无渐变，无插图，无照片，无额外文字。

en.title: Sepia Pianist in Vintage Room
en.description: A detailed sepia manga illustration prompt for creating an elegant nocturnal pianist scene with vintage interiors and album-cover mood.
en.prompt: Create a vertical sepia-toned anime-style album-cover illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a refined young male pianist"} seated at an upright piano in a dim vintage room at night. The character is shown in three-quarter back view, slim and elegant, wearing a fitted black suit, black gloves, and polished black shoes; he has {argument name="hair color" default="long pale blond hair"} tied in a low ponytail with loose bangs falling over his face. A small {argument name="pet animal" default="hamster"} sits on his right shoulder. He is playing the piano with one hand while turning or holding a loose sheet of music with the other; an open music book full of handwritten staff notation rests on the piano stand. A light-colored coat is draped over the back of the wooden chair, hanging down almost to the floor. The room has dark wooden floors, heavy wall paneling, and tall glass windows or sliding doors on the left revealing a shadowy garden outside. Place exactly two warm light sources: one glowing oil lamp on a small wooden drawer cabinet beside the chair, and one faint warm outdoor lantern visible through the window. The mood should be quiet, melancholic, aristocratic, and intimate, like a late-night private performance. Use highly detailed fine ink linework, crosshatching, textured paper grain, muted sepia and black-brown palette, dramatic low-key lighting, realistic piano keys and wood grain, delicate facial features, and elegant manga illustration quality. No modern objects, no visible text except abstract musical notation, no watermark, no bright colors.

zh.title: 复古房间里的深褐色调钢琴师
zh.description: 一个精细的深褐色调漫画插画提示词，用于创作优雅的夜间钢琴师场景，营造复古室内装饰和专辑封面的氛围。
zh.prompt: 创作一张竖构图的深褐色调动漫风格专辑封面插画，画面主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一位优雅的年轻男钢琴师"}，深夜时分，他正坐在一架立式钢琴前，身处昏暗的复古房间内。角色呈现四分之三背影，身材修长优雅，身穿合身的黑色西装，戴着黑色手套，穿着擦得锃亮的黑色皮鞋；他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的浅金色头发"}，扎成低马尾，几缕凌乱的刘海垂在脸颊旁。一只小小的 {argument name="pet animal" default="仓鼠"} 坐在他的右肩上。他一只手弹奏着钢琴，另一只手正在翻动或拿着一张散落的乐谱；钢琴谱架上放着一本打开的乐谱书，上面写满了手写的五线谱。一件浅色外套搭在木椅靠背上，一直垂到地板附近。房间铺着深色木地板，墙壁镶嵌着厚重的护墙板，左侧有高大的玻璃窗或推拉门，隐约可见窗外阴影笼罩的花园。画面中仅设置两处暖光源：一盏放在椅子旁小木柜上的发光油灯，以及透过窗户可见的一盏微弱的暖色户外灯笼。整体氛围应安静、忧郁、具有贵族气息且私密，如同深夜的私人演奏。采用高细节的精细墨水线条、交叉排线、纹理纸张质感、柔和的深褐色与黑褐色调、戏剧性的低调照明、逼真的琴键与木纹、精致的面部特征以及优雅的漫画插画品质。禁止出现现代物品，禁止出现除抽象乐谱外的可见文字，禁止出现水印，禁止使用明亮的色彩。

en.title: Sunflower Fairy World in a Bottle
en.description: Generates a whimsical fantasy illustration of a tiny glowing sunflower fairy kingdom enclosed in a corked glass bottle.
en.prompt: Create a highly detailed fantasy illustration of a miniature enchanted world sealed inside a large clear glass apothecary bottle with a cork stopper, standing on an old wooden desk in a dim magical study. Inside the bottle is a glowing fairy-tale sunflower kingdom at night: one tiny sunflower fairy girl with long wavy golden-blonde hair, translucent wings, and a layered flower-petal dress in warm orange, yellow, pink, and purple tones stands on a small arched stone bridge over a sparkling canal, holding or surrounded by sunflowers. Behind her, show a dense miniature village of exactly three main foreground cottage clusters with warm lit windows, red-pink tiled roofs, lanterns, vines, and flowers, rising toward a luminous hilltop castle with many slender towers and pink roofs. Add a crescent moon, starry deep-blue sky, tiny glowing particles, bunting flags, ornate street lamps, reflections in the water, and abundant sunflowers and pink blossoms around the bridge and houses. The glass bottle should dominate the frame, with realistic curved highlights, refraction, thick rim, rounded shoulders, and a visible cork at the top. Outside the bottle, keep the background softly blurred with warm bokeh: one lantern on the left, dark shelves and books on the right, and cozy amber-blue magical lighting. Use an ultra-detailed anime-fantasy storybook style, cinematic depth of field, jewel-like colors, warm golden window light contrasted with cool moonlit blues, intricate architecture, romantic whimsical atmosphere, vertical composition, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 瓶中的向日葵仙子世界
zh.description: 生成一幅奇幻风格的插画，描绘了一个装在带软木塞玻璃瓶中的微型发光向日葵仙子王国。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅细节极其丰富的奇幻插画，描绘一个被封存在大型透明药剂玻璃瓶中的微型魔法世界，瓶口塞有软木塞，放置在昏暗魔法书房的一张旧木桌上。瓶内是一个夜晚发光的童话向日葵王国：一位留着波浪长金发、拥有半透明翅膀、身穿橙黄粉紫暖色调花瓣裙的微型向日葵仙子，正站在一座横跨闪烁运河的小型拱形石桥上，手中拿着或被向日葵环绕。在她身后，展示一个由三个主要前景小屋群组成的微型村庄，小屋有温暖的窗灯、红粉色的瓦片屋顶、藤蔓和花朵，并向一座拥有许多细长塔楼和粉色屋顶的发光山顶城堡延伸。加入新月、星光熠熠的深蓝色天空、微小的发光粒子、彩旗、华丽的街灯、水中的倒影，以及桥梁和房屋周围茂盛的向日葵和粉色花朵。玻璃瓶应占据画面主体，呈现逼真的弧形高光、折射、厚瓶口、圆润的瓶肩以及顶部的软木塞。瓶外背景保持柔和模糊，带有温暖的焦外成像效果：左侧有一盏灯笼，右侧是深色的书架和书籍，营造出舒适的琥珀色与蓝色交织的魔法光影。采用超细节的动漫奇幻绘本风格，电影级景深，宝石般的色彩，温暖的金色窗光与冷色调月光形成对比，建筑结构精巧，充满浪漫奇幻氛围，竖构图，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Girl Sewing Goblin Plush
en.description: A cozy watercolor anime scene of a smiling girl in a sunlit craft room with a handmade green goblin plush doll.
en.prompt: Create a warm watercolor anime illustration of a cozy sunlit craft room in a fantasy Mediterranean or Central Asian-inspired town. A young girl named {argument name="character name" default="April"} sits at a wooden sewing table, leaning on one hand and smiling softly with large brown eyes, rosy cheeks, and tousled {argument name="hair color" default="light chestnut brown"} bob-length hair. She wears a simple sleeveless white cotton dress with tied shoulder bows. In front of her sits exactly one handmade plush doll: a small green goblin-orc character with round ears, stern eyebrows, black bead eyes, a stitched nose, brown leather-like vest, dark trousers, boots, and a narrow patterned scarf, posed sitting upright on the table. The room is filled with handmade textile details: exactly three visible potted plants on the sunny windowsill, exactly three thread spools on the table, one round pincushion full of pins, one pair of brass sewing scissors, one small folded letter or pattern sheet, and several patterned fabric scraps and embroidered cloth pieces. The background includes an open window with blue-green shutters, a distant pastel townscape outside, a bed with pink and geometric pillows, a wooden cabinet with books and small bottles, and colorful woven rugs or tapestries with tassels hanging on the wall and draped over the chair. Use soft golden afternoon light, delicate ink outlines, transparent watercolor washes, intricate embroidered patterns, gentle shadows, and a dreamy storybook atmosphere. Keep the composition horizontal 4:3, centered on the girl and plush toy at the table, with no text, no watermark, and no photorealism.

zh.title: 女孩缝制哥布林毛绒玩具
zh.description: 一幅温馨的水彩动漫场景，阳光洒满的手工室里，一位女孩正微笑着，身边放着一个手工制作的绿色哥布林毛绒玩偶。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅温馨的水彩动漫插画，描绘一个充满阳光的手工室，背景设定在具有奇幻地中海或中亚风格的小镇。一位名叫 {argument name="character name" default="April"} 的年轻女孩坐在木制缝纫桌前，单手托腮，面带柔和的微笑，有着大大的棕色眼睛、红润的脸颊和凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅栗棕色"} 波波头。她穿着一件简单的白色无袖棉布裙，肩部系着蝴蝶结。在她面前坐着一个手工制作的毛绒玩偶：一个绿色的小哥布林兽人角色，有着圆耳朵、严肃的眉毛、黑色珠子眼睛、缝合的鼻子，穿着棕色仿皮背心、深色长裤、靴子和一条窄窄的花纹围巾，呈坐姿放在桌上。房间里充满了手工纺织细节：阳光明媚的窗台上摆放着 3 盆植物，桌上有 3 个线轴、一个插满针的圆形针垫、一把黄铜缝纫剪刀、一张折叠的小信件或纸样，以及几块花纹布料和刺绣布片。背景包括一扇带有蓝绿色百叶窗的开窗，窗外是遥远的柔和色调小镇景观，一张铺着粉色和几何图案枕头的床，一个放着书籍和小瓶子的木柜，墙上挂着带有流苏的彩色编织地毯或挂毯，椅子上也披着织物。运用柔和的午后阳光、细腻的墨线勾勒、透明的水彩渲染、精致的刺绣图案、柔和的阴影，营造出梦幻般的童话书氛围。构图保持 4:3 横向，以桌前的女孩和毛绒玩具为中心，画面中不含文字、水印，且不追求写实风格。

en.title: Luxury Spring Peony Fashion Poster
en.description: Creates an elegant vertical women’s fashion advertisement with a poised model, pink peonies, and refined Chinese luxury-brand typography.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical high-end women’s fashion commercial poster for {argument name="brand name" default="QZHZ"}, combining luxury editorial photography with a romantic spring floral theme.

Canvas: Tall vertical poster, 2:3 ratio, soft ivory cream background, premium magazine-ad composition, airy negative space at the top and dense flowers at the bottom.

Main subject: A young East Asian woman model standing slightly right of center in a confident elegant pose, viewed from about mid-thigh upward. She has smooth fair skin, refined natural makeup, soft red lips, dark hair slicked back into a low neat bun, and small gold floral earrings. Her expression is calm, poised, and slightly distant, looking toward the viewer. She wears a sculptural ivory-white high-fashion suit: long-sleeve fitted top with high collar, layered peplum waist, slim white trousers, and a pale beige leather belt with a rectangular buckle and one long hanging strap. Hands are held behind her back, posture tall and graceful.

Floral environment: Surround the model with abundant pink peony blossoms. Use one very large blurred pink peony petal mass in the upper left foreground, many sharp pink peonies clustered across the lower half, several flowers on the right side, green leaves and stems visible among the blossoms, and a soft misty pink foreground blur near the bottom edge. The flowers should feel lush, fresh, and springlike, framing the model without hiding her face or outfit.

Layout and typography: Use refined rose-pink serif typography with a luxury fashion magazine feel. Place an oversized cropped brand masthead across the top reading {argument name="top masthead text" default="QZHZ"}, very large, thin high-contrast serif letters, partially behind the model’s head. Place a small Chinese seasonal slogan on the upper right reading {argument name="season slogan" default="春日焕新"} with a thin horizontal line underneath. Place a lower-left text block over the flowers with elegant spacing.

Text content: Include exactly 7 visible text elements: 1) oversized top masthead “QZHZ”; 2) upper-right slogan “春日焕新”; 3) lower-left small brand “QZHZ”; 4) lower-left main headline {argument name="main Chinese headline" default="春醒时刻"}; 5) lower-left subheadline {argument name="Chinese subheadline" default="真实的自己 最动人"}; 6) a smaller Chinese body copy block reading “在每一个崭新的清晨\n唤醒内心的光芒，优雅绽放”; 7) a small English tagline at the bottom of the lower-left block reading “Awaken in the springtime.\nBe your truest self.\nElegant, radiant, unstoppable.”

Visual style: Luxury fashion photography, soft natural studio lighting, warm cream and blush-pink palette, polished skin, high detail clothing texture, shallow depth of field, foreground flower blur, delicate romantic atmosphere, clean commercial poster design, premium women’s fashion brand aesthetic.

Constraints: Keep the composition uncluttered and elegant, with the model dominant and flowers forming a frame. Do not add extra text, logos, watermarks, borders, or additional people. Maintain accurate readable typography and the exact 7 text elements listed.

zh.title: 奢华春日牡丹时尚海报
zh.description: 创作一张优雅的竖版女性时尚广告，包含姿态从容的模特、粉色牡丹以及精致的中国高端品牌排版。
zh.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="brand name" default="QZHZ"} 创作一张竖版高端女性时尚商业海报，将奢华的编辑摄影风格与浪漫的春日花卉主题相结合。

画布：高竖版海报，2:3 比例，柔和的象牙奶油色背景，高级杂志广告构图，顶部留有通透的负空间，底部点缀繁茂花卉。

主体：一位年轻的东亚女性模特，站在画面中心偏右位置，姿态自信优雅，取景范围约为大腿中部以上。她拥有细腻白皙的皮肤、精致的自然妆容、柔和的红唇，深色头发梳成整洁的低发髻，佩戴小巧的金色花朵耳环。她表情从容、优雅且略带疏离感，注视着镜头。她身着一件雕塑感的象牙白高级时装套装：长袖修身立领上衣、叠层腰摆、修身白色长裤，搭配一条浅米色皮带，皮带扣为矩形，带有一条长长的垂坠带。双手背在身后，身姿挺拔优雅。

花卉环境：模特周围环绕着繁茂的粉色牡丹花。左上角前景使用一团非常大的模糊粉色牡丹花瓣，下半部分簇拥着许多清晰的粉色牡丹，右侧点缀数朵花卉，花丛间可见绿色叶片和茎干，底部边缘带有柔和朦胧的粉色前景虚化效果。花卉应呈现出繁茂、清新、春意盎然的感觉，在衬托模特的同时不遮挡其面部或服装。

排版与字体：使用精致的玫瑰粉色衬线字体，营造奢华时尚杂志感。顶部放置超大号裁剪过的品牌标题 {argument name="top masthead text" default="QZHZ"}，字体纤细且对比度高，部分位于模特头部后方。右上角放置小巧的中文季节性标语 {argument name="season slogan" default="春日焕新"}，下方配有一条细横线。左下角花卉上方放置文字块，字间距优雅。

文字内容：包含 7 个可见文字元素：1) 顶部超大标题“QZHZ”；2) 右上角标语“春日焕新”；3) 左下角小号品牌名“QZHZ”；4) 左下角主标题 {argument name="main Chinese headline" default="春醒时刻"}；5) 左下角副标题 {argument name="Chinese subheadline" default="真实的自己 最动人"}；6) 一段较小的中文正文块，内容为“在每一个崭新的清晨\n唤醒内心的光芒，优雅绽放”；7) 左下角文字块底部的一句简短英文标语 “Awaken in the springtime.\nBe your truest self.\nElegant, radiant, unstoppable.”

视觉风格：奢华时尚摄影，柔和的自然影棚光，暖奶油色与腮红粉色调，细腻的皮肤质感，高细节服装纹理，浅景深，前景花卉虚化，精致浪漫的氛围，简洁的商业海报设计，高端女性时尚品牌美学。

约束：保持构图简洁优雅，以模特为主体，花卉形成边框。不要添加额外的文字、Logo、水印、边框或其他人物。确保排版清晰可读，并严格包含上述 7 个文字元素。

en.title: Starlight Airplane Café
en.description: A richly detailed anime fantasy scene of a Victorian mystery café beneath an old airplane wing, ideal for whimsical story illustrations.
en.prompt: Create a highly detailed vertical 4:5 anime fantasy illustration of an impossible nighttime travel café built into and under the wing of an old weathered propeller airplane. The scene is warm, cinematic, and storybook-like: a star-filled blue-to-violet sky with the Milky Way behind a large vintage aircraft nose and propeller on the left, while the right side becomes a cozy open-air café counter covered in vines, white flowers, sheer cream curtains, hanging brass lamps, and glowing star ornaments. Show exactly 3 human characters and 1 cat: a Sherlock-Holmes-inspired young detective in a deerstalker cap and brown cloak seated at a small wooden table, writing in a notebook beside an unfolded map while thoughtfully touching his lips; a gentle café waitress with braided light-blonde hair and a cream apron pouring pour-over coffee behind the counter; and a Watson-like gentleman in a brown Victorian three-piece suit standing on the right, smiling as he receives a small glowing star from an orange tabby cat standing upright on its hind legs with a tiny satchel. The cat should hold the star up toward the gentleman’s hand, making this the emotional focal point. Include exactly 5 readable chalkboard menu items on a hanging board: “Drip Coffee 600”, “Cafe au lait 650”, “Starry Latte 700”, “Moon Cookie 300”, and “Star Cookie 300”. Include a second chalkboard sign at the bottom left reading “Café Starlight” with small decorative stars and the words “Coffee”, “Sweets”, and “Starlight”. Add a constellation board on the right labeled “Orion”. Fill the foreground with crates, old books, a lantern, coffee jars, star-shaped cookies, wildflowers, lavender, wooden planks, and brass café tools, but keep the composition readable. Use glowing amber café lighting against cool cosmic blues, fine linework, painterly texture, intricate mechanical airplane details, lush botanical details, and a nostalgic Ghibli-meets-Victorian mystery atmosphere. Customize the café name as {argument name="café name" default="Café Starlight"}, the detective character as {argument name="detective character" default="Sherlock-Holmes-inspired young detective"}, the companion character as {argument name="companion character" default="Watson-like gentleman"}, the cat color as {argument name="cat color" default="orange tabby"}, and the menu theme as {argument name="menu theme" default="Starlight Blend"}. No modern objects, no photorealism, no watermark, no extra characters, and preserve the dreamy impossible-night mood.

zh.title: 星光飞机咖啡馆
zh.description: 一幅细节丰富的动漫奇幻场景，描绘了旧飞机机翼下维多利亚风格的神秘咖啡馆，非常适合异想天开的故事插画。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅高度精细的 4:5 竖版动漫奇幻插画，描绘一家不可思议的夜间旅行咖啡馆，它建在一架饱经风霜的旧螺旋桨飞机机翼内及下方。场景温暖、具有电影感且如童话书般梦幻：星光璀璨的蓝紫色天空，银河映衬在左侧巨大的复古飞机机头和螺旋桨后方；右侧则是一个舒适的露天咖啡吧台，上面覆盖着藤蔓、白花、奶油色薄纱窗帘、悬挂的黄铜灯具和发光的星星装饰。画面中需包含 3 个人物和 1 只猫：一位受福尔摩斯启发的年轻侦探，戴着猎鹿帽，身披棕色斗篷，坐在小木桌旁，一边沉思地摸着嘴唇，一边在地图旁边的笔记本上写字；一位温柔的咖啡馆女服务员，留着浅金色编发，系着奶油色围裙，正在吧台后冲泡手冲咖啡；以及右侧站着一位像华生一样的绅士，身穿棕色维多利亚风格三件套西装，微笑着从一只后腿站立、背着小挎包的橘色虎斑猫手中接过一颗发光的小星星。猫咪应将星星举向绅士的手，使其成为情感焦点。在悬挂的“项目”上包含 5 个清晰可读的黑板菜单项：“Drip Coffee 600”、“Cafe au lait 650”、“Starry Latte 700”、“Moon Cookie 300”和“Star Cookie 300”。在左下角添加第二个黑板招牌，上面写着“Café Starlight”，并配有小星星装饰以及“Coffee”、“Sweets”和“Starlight”字样。在右侧添加一个标有“Orion”的星座“项目”。前景填充木箱、旧书、灯笼、咖啡罐、星形饼干、野花、薰衣草、木板和黄铜咖啡工具，但要保持构图清晰。在冷色调的宇宙蓝背景下使用温暖的琥珀色咖啡馆灯光，展现细腻的线条、油画质感、复杂的飞机机械细节、丰富的植物细节，营造出吉卜力与维多利亚神秘风格交织的怀旧氛围。自定义咖啡馆名称为 {argument name="café name" default="Café Starlight"}，侦探角色为 {argument name="detective character" default="受福尔摩斯启发的年轻侦探"}，同伴角色为 {argument name="companion character" default="像华生一样的绅士"}，猫的颜色为 {argument name="cat color" default="橘色虎斑"}，菜单主题为 {argument name="menu theme" default="星光特调"}。禁止出现现代物品，禁止写实风格，禁止水印，禁止添加额外角色，并保持梦幻且不可思议的夜晚氛围。

en.title: Futuristic Cooling Poncho Street Fashion
en.description: A photorealistic fashion editorial image of a young woman modeling a glossy hooded cooling poncho on a sunny city sidewalk.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic full-body fashion editorial street portrait of a young woman wearing a futuristic cooling poncho outfit on a sunny urban sidewalk. The model is {argument name="model description" default="a tall young blonde woman with long windblown hair, fair skin, blue eyes, and a calm confident expression"}, walking toward the camera with one leg forward. She wears {argument name="poncho color and material" default="a glossy translucent white hooded poncho made from lightweight technical fabric"}, oversized and cape-like with a high zippered front, short white shorts barely visible underneath, and white strappy high-heel sandals. The poncho has exactly 6 visible technical details: a clear structured hood/visor, a central dark zipper, two vertical side zipper seams, two dark rectangular mesh ventilation panels near the lower sides, and small blue-gray trim accents suggesting built-in cooling fans or airflow channels. The outfit should feel like a chic summer UV-protection cooling garment, airy and protective while leaving the legs exposed. Set the scene on {argument name="location" default="a modern city shopping street with glass storefronts on the left, leafy green trees and planters on the right, and distant pedestrians softly blurred"}. Use bright midday sunlight, sharp highlights on the glossy fabric, dappled tree shadows on the pavement, gentle breeze moving the hair and poncho hem, shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, realistic lens perspective, high-end fashion photography, vertical 4:5 composition, full body centered, no text, no logos, no watermark.

zh.title: 未来感降温斗篷街头时尚
zh.description: 一张照片级写实的时尚大片，展示了一位年轻女性在阳光明媚的城市人行道上身穿光泽感连帽降温斗篷。
zh.prompt: 创作一张照片级写实的全身时尚街拍肖像，展示一位年轻女性在阳光明媚的城市人行道上身穿未来感降温斗篷。模特为 {argument name="model description" default="一位高挑的年轻金发女性，留着长长的秀发，肤色白皙，蓝眼睛，表情从容自信"}，正迈步向镜头走来。她身穿 {argument name="poncho color and material" default="一件由轻量化科技面料制成的光泽感半透明白色连帽斗篷"}，斗篷呈超大斗篷状，前襟带有高拉链，内搭隐约可见的白色短裤，脚踩白色绑带高跟凉鞋。斗篷需具备 6 个清晰可见的科技细节：透明结构化兜帽/遮阳板、中央深色拉链、两条垂直侧拉链缝线、下摆两侧各一个深色矩形网状通风板，以及暗示内置冷却风扇或气流通道的小型蓝灰色饰边。整体造型应呈现出时尚夏季防紫外线降温服饰的质感，既轻盈透气又具防护性，同时露出双腿。场景设定在 {argument name="location" default="一条现代城市购物街，左侧为玻璃店面，右侧有绿树和花坛，远处行人背景虚化"}。采用明亮的中午阳光，光泽面料上呈现锐利的高光，人行道上有斑驳的树影，微风拂动发丝和斗篷下摆，浅景深，自然肤色，真实的镜头透视，高端时尚摄影风格，4:5 竖构图，全身居中，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

en.title: Anime Alley Kick Transformation
en.description: Transforms a simple mannequin kick pose reference into a cinematic neon-lit anime action scene for character concept art.
en.prompt:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the pose and camera-composition guide, transform the plain mannequin into a dramatic anime action character while preserving the core motion: a low-angle, close perspective with one booted foot thrust toward the camera, the body twisting forward, one knee lifted, and the arms posed for balance/guard. Replace the mannequin with {argument name="character type" default="a dark-haired anime gothic lolita fighter"} wearing {argument name="outfit style" default="a frilled dark blue-black dress with lace cuffs, gold accents, and tall black boots"}. Add intense facial expression and dynamic hair motion.

Create a cinematic night setting not present in the reference: a narrow rainy urban alley with wet reflective pavement, overhead power lines, storefronts, glowing signs, and neon blue/pink lighting. Emphasize speed and impact with motion blur, smoke or energy streaks around the foreground shoe, strong rim lighting, deep shadows, and dramatic foreshortening. Use a highly detailed modern anime illustration style with filmic contrast, saturated neon reflections, and a vertical poster composition. Avoid a blank studio background, avoid a white mannequin look, and keep the action pose as close as possible to the reference.

zh.title: Anime Alley Kick Transformation
zh.description: 将简单的模特踢腿姿势参考转化为电影感十足的霓虹灯风格动漫动作场景，适用于角色概念设计。
zh.prompt:
以 REFERENCE_0 作为姿势和镜头构图指南，将普通的模特转化为极具张力的动漫动作角色，同时保留核心动作：采用低角度近景视角，一只穿着靴子的脚向镜头踢出，身体向前扭转，一侧膝盖抬起，双臂保持平衡或防御姿势。将模特替换为 {argument name="character type" default="一位黑发动漫哥特萝莉战士"}，身穿 {argument name="outfit style" default="带有蕾丝袖口、金色装饰和黑色高筒靴的褶边深蓝黑色连衣裙"}。添加强烈的面部表情和动态的头发效果。

创建一个参考图中不存在的电影感夜间场景：一条狭窄且阴雨绵绵的城市小巷，地面湿润反光，上方有电线，两侧是店面、发光的招牌以及蓝粉色的霓虹灯光。通过运动模糊、前景鞋子周围的烟雾或能量轨迹、强烈的轮廓光、深邃的阴影以及夸张的透视效果来强调速度感和冲击力。采用细节丰富、具有电影对比度、饱和霓虹反射的现代动漫插画风格，并使用竖版海报构图。避免使用空白的工作室背景，避免呈现白色模特外观，并确保动作姿势尽可能贴近参考图。

en.title: Chibi Prison Meal Comic
en.description: A two-panel chibi anime prison comic showing a selfish meal scene inside a cell while two observers comment from the corridor.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a two-panel chibi anime prison comic scene about one girl selfishly eating a prison meal while another cries, with two other girls commenting from the corridor.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 illustration, split into exactly 2 vertical panels by the prison bars and wall division. Use a moody gray stone jail background with soft anime shading, detailed but not photorealistic.

Layout: Left panel shows the inside of a small jail cell; right panel shows the corridor outside the cell. Keep the composition symmetrical enough that the left panel feels like an enclosed room and the right panel feels like observers standing outside the bars.

Left panel details: Show exactly 2 chibi girls in the cell. Girl 1, {argument name="greedy eater name" default="Anis"}, sits at a small square metal table on the left, wearing a dark military-style beret and black/orange outfit, eyes squeezed shut in smug delight, cheeks messy with rice and sauce, holding food close to her mouth as she monopolizes the meal. Girl 2, {argument name="crying prisoner name" default="Miranda"}, sits on the floor to the right of the table, wearing a navy police-like cap with an emblem, a dark uniform, twin ponytails, and boots; she looks tearful and hungry, clutching her knees. Show exactly 7 visible meal items or dishes in the cell: 1 large rice-and-brown-stew plate on the table, 1 small metal cup or bowl on the table, 1 soup bowl on the table, 1 empty plate on the floor near the crying girl, 1 plate with a bit of rice outside the bars at lower left, 1 plate with brown food at lower left, and 1 small bowl on the floor at lower left. Add crumbs, spilled rice, and tiny food bits around the table. Include a bunk bed against the back stone wall, a small sink and faucet on the far left wall, cracked blocks, stains, rust, and dirty concrete floor.

Right panel details: Show exactly 2 chibi girls standing in the corridor outside the barred cell. Girl 3, {argument name="red beret observer name" default="Rapi"}, stands left in the corridor wearing a dark military uniform with red accents and a red-star beret, blonde hair, neutral unimpressed expression, looking toward the cell. Girl 4, {argument name="white uniform observer name" default="Neon"}, stands right wearing a white sailor-style uniform, white cap with wing emblem, glasses, lavender bob hair, white thigh-high boots, and a calm expression. The corridor has tall black iron bars on the left, a dark receding hallway, stained concrete walls, and gray floor tiles.

Speech bubbles: Add exactly 2 white speech bubbles with black Japanese text in the right panel. The left bubble above the red-beret observer says {argument name="left speech bubble" default="アイドルよね？"}. The right bubble above the white-uniform observer says {argument name="right speech bubble" default="元アイドルですね。"}. Use clean manga lettering, black text, and simple tails pointing to the speakers.

Visual style: Cute chibi proportions with large heads, small bodies, expressive faces, soft cel shading, muted prison colors, subtle grime, high detail in costumes and props, humorous but slightly pitiful mood. Keep all characters full-body or near full-body where visible.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 characters, exactly 2 panels, exactly 2 speech bubbles, and exactly 7 visible meal dishes/items. Do not add extra characters, extra dialogue, modern UI elements, watermarks, or captions outside the speech bubbles.

zh.title: Q 版监狱餐漫画
zh.description: 一幅两格 Q 版动漫监狱漫画，展示了牢房内自私的用餐场景，同时两名观察者在走廊进行评论。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一幅两格 Q 版动漫监狱漫画场景，内容为一个女孩自私地吃着监狱餐，另一个女孩在哭泣，同时另外两个女孩在走廊进行评论。

画布：宽幅 16:9 水平插图，通过监狱栅栏和墙壁分割精确分为 2 个垂直面板。使用带有柔和动漫阴影的忧郁灰色石质监狱背景，细节丰富但不追求写实。

布局：左侧面板显示小牢房内部；右侧面板显示牢房外的走廊。保持构图对称，使左侧面板感觉像一个封闭的房间，右侧面板感觉像观察者站在栅栏外。

左侧面板细节：在牢房内展示 2 个 Q 版女孩。女孩 1，{argument name="greedy eater name" default="Anis"}，坐在左侧一张方形小金属桌旁，戴着深色军用风格贝雷帽，身穿黑橙色服装，双眼因得意的喜悦而眯起，脸颊上沾满了米饭和酱汁，将食物紧贴嘴边，独占了整顿餐食。女孩 2，{argument name="crying prisoner name" default="Miranda"}，坐在桌子右侧的地板上，戴着一顶带有徽章的海军警帽，身穿深色制服，扎着双马尾，穿着靴子；她看起来泪眼汪汪且饥肠辘辘，紧紧抱着膝盖。在牢房内展示 7 个清晰可见的餐点或餐具：桌上 1 个装有米饭和棕色炖菜的大盘子，桌上 1 个金属小杯或碗，桌上 1 个汤碗，哭泣女孩附近地板上 1 个空盘子，左下角栅栏外 1 个带少量米饭的盘子，左下角 1 个装有棕色食物的盘子，以及左下角地板上 1 个小碗。在桌子周围添加面包屑、洒落的米饭和细小的食物残渣。在后方石墙上加入双层床，最左侧墙壁上有小水槽和水龙头，以及裂开的砖块、污渍、铁锈和肮脏的混凝土底面。

右侧面板细节：在栅栏外的走廊里展示 2 个站立的 Q 版女孩。女孩 3，{argument name="red beret observer name" default="Rapi"}，站在走廊左侧，身穿带有红色装饰的深色军装，戴着红星贝雷帽，金发，表情中立且不以为然，看向牢房。女孩 4，{argument name="white uniform observer name" default="Neon"}，站在右侧，身穿白色水手风制服，戴着带有翅膀徽章的白帽，戴眼镜，留着淡紫色波波头，穿着白色过膝长靴，表情平静。走廊左侧有高大的黑色铁栅栏，背景是深邃的走廊、染色的混凝土墙壁和灰色地砖。

对话气泡：在右侧面板中添加 2 个带有黑色日语文本的白色对话气泡。红贝雷观察者上方的左侧气泡内容为 {argument name="left speech bubble" default="アイドルよね？"}。白色制服观察者上方的右侧气泡内容为 {argument name="right speech bubble" default="元アイドルですね。"}。使用清晰的漫画字体、黑色文本，以及指向说话者的简单尾巴。

视觉风格：可爱的 Q 版比例，大头小身，表情丰富，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，柔和的监狱色调，微妙的污垢感，服装和道具细节丰富，氛围幽默但略显凄凉。尽可能保持所有角色全身或近乎全身可见。

限制：使用 4 个角色，2 个面板，2 个对话气泡，以及 7 个清晰可见的餐点/餐具。不要添加多余的角色、额外的对话、现代 UI 元素、水印或对话气泡之外的标题。

en.title: Anime Girl Generation Grid
en.description: Creates a 12-card comparison gallery of a pink-haired anime girl in kimono variations for showcasing image-generation outputs.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a contact-sheet style comparison grid of anime image generations featuring the same character in multiple variations.

Canvas: Wide landscape canvas, approximately 16:9, with a clean off-white page background and generous margins. Arrange exactly 12 rounded-rectangle image cards in a 4-column by 3-row grid with narrow white gutters between cards.

Subject details: Each card shows the same cute anime girl, {argument name="character name" default="a pink-haired manga artist girl"}, with a short fluffy bob haircut, large bright blue eyes, round wire-frame glasses, pale skin, and a cheerful curious expression. She wears a soft pink kimono with white flower motifs and a dark navy obi decorated with red and yellow crisscross cords. Her poses vary slightly but keep a consistent thoughtful gesture: hand near chin, cheek, mouth, or collar, with occasional leaning or tilted framing.

Card count and visible variations: Include exactly 12 generated-image thumbnails. Row 1 has 4 cards: 1) girl holding a drawing pen in a bright studio, 2) girl at a drafting tablet with hand near mouth, 3) girl leaning forward in an art room with desk lamp, 4) girl seated beside an orange chair with sketch papers behind her. Row 2 has 4 cards: 5) close-up tilted pose with hand near mouth, 6) centered pose in a colorful classroom-like studio, 7) thoughtful pose beside a drawing desk, 8) bright close-up with a softly blurred art-room background. Row 3 has 4 cards: 9) dramatic diagonal close-up against orange and turquoise graphic background, 10) low-angle portrait with hand at chin, 11) centered portrait against the same orange/turquoise diagonal background, 12) reclining tilted portrait with hand near collar.

Backgrounds: Use a cheerful manga studio or art classroom setting in most cards: bookshelves, pencils in cups, drafting tables, sketch sheets, lamps, bulletin boards, pastel geometric wall decorations, plants, and warm daylight. For the bottom row, use a flatter bold graphic backdrop with turquoise and orange diagonal shapes in at least three cards.

Visual style: Polished modern anime illustration, crisp black line art, glossy eyes, soft cel shading, pastel color palette, clean high-resolution look, bright and friendly. Make each thumbnail feel like a separate generation with small differences in crop, pose, and background, while maintaining character consistency.

Interface overlays: On every card, add a small semi-transparent gray control strip near the lower-left corner. The strip contains tiny round utility icons and a visible label reading {argument name="quality label" default="2K"}. Some cards may include a small bar-chart style icon at the far left of the strip. Add a subtle rounded up-arrow floating button near the lower-right edge of the overall canvas.

Constraints: Preserve the exact 4 by 3 grid and exactly 12 cards. Do not add extra characters. Avoid text other than the repeated small {argument name="quality label" default="2K"} overlay. Keep rounded corners, consistent spacing, and the feel of a screenshot from an image-generation gallery.

zh.title: 动漫少女生成网格
zh.description: 创建一个包含 12 张卡片的对比画廊，展示身着不同款式和服的粉发动漫少女，用于呈现图像生成结果。
zh.prompt:
目标：创建一个联系表风格的对比网格，展示同一角色在多种变体下的动漫图像生成结果。

画布：宽屏横向画布，比例约为 16:9，背景为干净的灰白色，留有宽裕的边距。将 12 张圆角矩形图像卡片排列成 4 列 3 行的网格，卡片之间留有窄窄的白色间隙。

主体细节：每张卡片展示的是同一个可爱的动漫少女，{argument name="character name" default="一位粉色头发的漫画家少女"}，留着蓬松的短波波头，有着明亮的大蓝眼睛、圆形金属框眼镜、白皙的皮肤和开朗好奇的表情。她穿着一件带有白色花朵图案的柔粉色和服，腰间系着深海军蓝色的腰带，并饰有红黄相间的交叉绳结。她的姿势略有不同，但保持一致的思考动作：手靠近下巴、脸颊、嘴巴或衣领，偶尔伴有身体前倾或倾斜的构图。
