zh.title: 超写实豪华汽车自拍
zh.description: 一份用于在黄金时刻生成豪华汽车内高保真自拍肖像的综合提示词，强调面部一致性和写实的摄影细节。
zh.prompt:
使用随附的参考图像作为 {argument name="identity reference" default="身份参考"}，创建一张超写实的图像。确保主体与参考图像中的人物高度相似，保留相同的面部特征、面部比例、肤色和整体相似度。保持面部完全自然，不进行美颜、重塑或改变任何面部特征。不要有鼻环。

低角度特写自拍 {argument name="location" default="在豪华汽车内"}，身体略微朝向镜头，右臂自然伸出进行拍摄，头部微微倾斜。

柔顺的深棕色中分直发，极简自然妆容，亮面粉色嘴唇，{argument name="outfit" default="黑色吊带背心"}，左肩斜跨深色安全带，纤细的黑色猫眼太阳镜，精致的金色项链配有小圆形水晶吊坠，吊坠上方有一个微小的轮廓心形纹身。

豪华汽车内饰，全景天窗外可见明亮的蓝天。强烈的黄金时刻阳光营造出极具电影感的对比，面部洒满暖光，车厢内部呈现深邃阴影。

使用 Sony A7R V 拍摄，35mm f/1.4 镜头，自然的广角自拍视角，主体焦点清晰，背景虚化柔和，超写实皮肤纹理，高端杂志摄影风格，细节极其丰富。

负面提示词：低质量，模糊，平淡光线，面部扭曲，身份偏移，面部特征改变，多余肢体，卡通，动漫，CGI，塑料感皮肤，水印，标志，文字，鼻环。

en.title: Japanese Washitsu Morning Portrait
en.description: A detailed Japanese language prompt for a high-quality, realistic portrait set in a traditional Japanese room with morning sunlight.
en.prompt:
Subject: Gazing at the morning garden

Subject: A vertical photograph showing an adult woman standing by a window in a traditional Japanese-style room, captured from the thighs up. The subject is positioned slightly to the left of the center, with the upper body occupying about half the screen. The result is a quiet indoor portrait while preserving the shoji screens, wooden frames, and the garden in the back.

Character/Expression: A woman with a natural, calm, and mature atmosphere. Her {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown close to black"} hair is styled in a low, loose bun, with a thin fringe and a few strands of hair left along her cheeks. Her face is tilted slightly to the left of the screen, and her gaze is directed toward the shoji near the bottom left. The corners of her mouth are slightly relaxed, giving her a gentle and contemplative expression. Light coral blush, brown-beige eye makeup, and naturally glossy pink-beige lips. Her skin is bright, with fine texture and a soft complexion.

Clothing/Pose: A {argument name="lingerie" default="delicate greige lace bra"} and high-waisted short bottoms of the same color. A sheer white thin shirt is dropped from the shoulders and loosely wrapped around the arms and the outside of the waist. The body is turned slightly to the right from the front, the shoulders are relaxed, and a natural S-curve center of gravity is created at the hips. Both hands are lightly overlapped in front of the lower abdomen, with the fingertips naturally bent without force. Realistically describe the lace of the clothing, the wrinkles of the thin fabric, and the contact with the skin.

Background/Light: A wooden shoji on the left, an open porch and a lush garden in the back right. Warm wooden frames are in the foreground, the character in the middle ground, and blurred leaves, stones, and eaves in the background to create depth. Low morning sunlight enters from the back left of the screen, warmly illuminating the left shoulder, cheek, collarbone, arm, and white shirt. On the opposite side, faint green reflected light from the garden is added, and shadows are cast softly to the bottom right.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 4:5 ratio. A medium portrait from the waist to the top of the thighs. The camera is at chest height, almost at eye level, with a gentle compression equivalent to 85mm. Leave a slight margin above the character's head and use the shoji on the left as the vertical axis of the composition. Focus on the face and upper body, and blur the garden significantly. Natural depth of field, no excessive wide-angle distortion.

Texture/Style: A realistic portrait like a high-quality photo book. Warm natural light, modest contrast, soft highlights, and delicate film grain. The skin should not be too smooth, leaving slight pores and fine downy hair. Carefully express the differences in materials between lace, thin fabric, wood, shoji paper, and garden leaves.

Negative: Underage-looking person, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, confusion of left and right hands, fusion of limbs, collapsed joints, poor contact with clothes, distorted body shape, floating cloth, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 日式和室晨间肖像
zh.description: 一份详细的日语提示词，用于生成在传统日式房间内、伴有晨光的写实风格高质量肖像。
zh.prompt:
主体：凝望晨间庭院

主体：一张竖构图照片，展示了一位成年女性站在传统日式房间的窗边，取景范围为大腿以上。主体位于画面中心偏左，上半身占据约一半画面。在保留障子门、木质框架和背景庭院的同时，呈现出一幅宁静的室内肖像。

角色/表情：一位散发着自然、沉稳且成熟气质的女性。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="接近黑色的深棕色"} 头发梳成低松发髻，留有薄刘海，脸颊两侧垂下几缕发丝。她的脸部略微向画面左侧倾斜，目光投向左下方的障子门。嘴角微微放松，流露出温柔而沉思的表情。浅珊瑚色腮红，棕米色眼妆，自然光泽的粉米色嘴唇。皮肤明亮，纹理细腻，气色柔和。

服装/姿势：穿着 {argument name="lingerie" default="精致的灰褐色蕾丝内衣"} 和同色的高腰短裤。一件半透明的白色薄衬衫从肩部滑落，松散地包裹在手臂和腰部外侧。身体从正面略微向右转，双肩放松，臀部呈现自然的 S 型重心。双手在下腹部前方轻轻交叠，指尖自然弯曲，不带用力感。真实地刻画服装的蕾丝质感、薄织物的褶皱以及与皮肤的接触感。

背景/光线：左侧为木质障子门，右后方为开放式缘侧和郁郁葱葱的庭院。前景为温暖的木质框架，中景为角色，背景为虚化的树叶、石头和屋檐，营造出空间深度。清晨的低角度阳光从画面左后方射入，温暖地照亮了左肩、脸颊、锁骨、手臂和白色衬衫。在另一侧，加入了来自庭院的微弱绿色反射光，阴影柔和地投向右下方。

构图/相机：竖构图 4:5 比例。从腰部到大腿上部的中景肖像。相机位于胸部高度，几乎与视线齐平，采用等效 85mm 镜头的轻微压缩感。角色头部上方留有少许空间，以左侧的障子门作为构图的垂直轴线。焦点集中在脸部和上半身，庭院进行大幅度虚化。自然的景深，没有过度的广角畸变。

质感/风格：如同高质量写真集般的写实肖像。温暖的自然光，适度的对比度，柔和的高光，以及细腻的胶片颗粒感。皮肤不应过于平滑，需保留细微的毛孔和绒毛。精细表现蕾丝、薄织物、木材、障子纸和庭院树叶之间的材质差异。

负面提示词：未成年人外观、不自然的脸部、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、左右手混淆、肢体融合、关节塌陷、服装接触不良、身体畸形、漂浮的布料、与光源不一致的阴影、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Luxury Penthouse Mirror Selfie
en.description: An ultra-realistic prompt for a vertical mirror selfie in a luxury hotel penthouse, featuring a city skyline reflection and sophisticated interior aesthetics.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic luxury hotel suite mirror selfie captured after sunset inside an elegant penthouse with panoramic glass walls overlooking a dazzling metropolitan skyline. The expansive windows create layered reflections of illuminated skyscrapers, colorful city lights, and soft nighttime bokeh, blending seamlessly with the sophisticated interior. A beautiful young woman with long {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut-brown"} hair styled in loose, glossy waves sits casually on the edge of a modern {argument name="furniture" default="cream leather chaise lounge"}, her body angled slightly away while looking toward the mirror with a relaxed, effortless smile. She holds a matte black smartphone in one hand at shoulder height, naturally covering part of her face in an authentic social-media-style selfie. She wears a {argument name="outfit" default="silky ivory-gold satin midi dress"} with slender shoulder straps and a fluid drape, the luxurious fabric reflecting the warm ambient lighting with a subtle pearlescent glow.
**The upscale suite features rich oak wood accents, contemporary designer furnishings, textured neutral décor, and a sleek marble side table topped with a crystal water glass, a designer clutch, a scented candle, and a luxury coffee-table book. Warm indirect lighting from recessed ceiling fixtures and elegant floor lamps creates an intimate atmosphere while the reflections of the vibrant skyline merge beautifully with the room's interior. Cinematic framing, realistic smartphone photography, soft depth of field, premium travel aesthetic, editorial fashion feel, natural skin texture, authentic lighting, high dynamic range, ultra-detailed realism, refined luxury lifestyle, Instagram-worthy composition, captured on a flagship smartphone in a vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

zh.title: 奢华顶层公寓镜面自拍
zh.description: 一个用于在豪华酒店顶层公寓拍摄垂直镜面自拍的超写实提示词，展现城市天际线倒影与精致的室内美学。
zh.prompt:
在日落后的豪华酒店套房内拍摄的超写实镜面自拍，背景为拥有全景玻璃墙的优雅顶层公寓，俯瞰着璀璨的都市天际线。巨大的落地窗形成了发光摩天大楼、绚丽城市灯光与柔和夜间光斑的层叠倒影，与精致的室内设计完美融合。一位美丽的年轻女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色"} 的长发，发丝呈现出自然光泽的波浪卷，随意地坐在现代 {argument name="furniture" default="奶油色真皮躺椅"} 的边缘，身体微微侧向一边，对着镜子露出轻松自然的微笑。她单手在肩部高度拿着一部哑光黑色智能手机，自然地遮住部分脸庞，呈现出地道的社交媒体风格自拍。她身穿一件 {argument name="outfit" default="丝滑象牙金缎面中长裙"}，细肩带设计，垂坠感极佳，奢华的面料在温暖的环境光下泛着细腻的珍珠光泽。
**这间高档套房拥有丰富的橡木装饰、现代设计师家具、质感中性色调的装饰，以及一张光滑的大理石边桌，桌上摆放着水晶水杯、设计师手拿包、香薰蜡烛和一本奢华的咖啡桌读物。嵌入式天花板灯具和优雅落地灯发出的温暖间接照明营造出私密氛围，窗外充满活力的天际线倒影与室内空间完美交融。电影级构图、写实智能手机摄影、柔和景深、高端旅行美学、时尚杂志质感、自然皮肤纹理、真实光影、高动态范围、超细节写实、精致奢华生活方式、Instagram 风格构图，以旗舰智能手机拍摄，垂直 9:16 画幅。**

en.title: Hand-drawn Black Marker Doodle
en.description: A prompt that transforms a reference photo into a simple, hand-drawn black marker doodle with a warm editorial aesthetic and sky blue accents.
en.prompt: Draw a simple hand-drawn doodle of the attached photo, as if it were sketched by a person using a {argument name="tool" default="black marker"}. Use natural marker strokes, slightly wobbly outlines, subtle hand-drawn imperfections, slightly open line endings, and create a warm editorial doodle aesthetic. Avoid clean vector-style graphics and overly polished digital perfection. Keep the illustration simple, airy, flat, and understated. Use {argument name="accent color" default="sky blue"} only as an accent color.

zh.title: 手绘黑色记号笔涂鸦

en.title: Luxury Commercial Poster Template
en.description: A universal template for high-end luxury advertising posters, featuring symmetrical composition, minimalist aesthetic, and editorial typography.
en.prompt:
[UNIVERSAL PREMIUM LUXURY COMMERCIAL POSTER PROMPT]

Create a premium luxury commercial advertising poster featuring {argument name="subject" default="[SUBJECT]"} centered in the frame, facing directly toward the camera with perfect symmetry. The subject gently holds {argument name="product" default="[PRODUCT]"} between its [NATURAL CONTACT POINT] without damaging or deforming it. Its expression conveys [EMOTION/MOOD]—symbolizing confidence, strength, elegance, and satisfaction.

Use a soft {argument name="primary color" default="[PRIMARY COLOR]"} gradient studio background with abundant negative space, creating a sophisticated minimalist luxury aesthetic. Illuminate the scene using soft diffused cinematic studio lighting with realistic highlights, natural shadows, subtle rim lighting, and premium reflections on the product surface. Preserve ultra-detailed photorealistic textures of the subject, including realistic surface details, natural anatomy, and highly accurate material rendering.

The product should appear premium and naturally integrated into the composition while remaining clearly visible and realistically proportioned. Showcase realistic metallic, glass, matte, or glossy material properties depending on the product design.

Design the layout with modern editorial typography. Place a large uppercase headline behind the subject using a bold condensed sans-serif font with low opacity, creating depth without distracting from the composition. Add a clean thin sans-serif product title positioned in front of the subject with a small subtitle beneath it. Maintain perfect alignment, balanced spacing, elegant hierarchy, and premium luxury branding throughout the design.

zh.title: 奢华商业海报模板

zh.prompt:

创作一张高端奢华商业广告海报，将 {argument name="subject" default="[主体]"} 置于画面中心，正对镜头，呈现完美对称。主体以 [自然接触点] 轻柔持握 {argument name="product" default="[产品]"}，且不造成任何损坏或变形。其表情传达出 [情感/氛围] —— 象征着自信、力量、优雅与满足感。

en.title: Professional Studio Profile Portrait
en.description: A prompt for generating a high-resolution professional studio profile photo while maintaining the exact identity and facial structure of a reference image.
en.prompt: A professional, high-resolution profile photo, maintaining the exact facial structure, identity, and key features of the person in the input image. The subject is framed from the chest up, with ample headroom. The person looks directly at the camera. They are styled for a professional photo studio shoot, wearing a premium smart casual {argument name="outfit" default="blazer in a subtle charcoal gray"}. The background is a solid '{argument name="background color" default="#562226"}' neutral studio color. Shot from a high angle with {argument name="lighting" default="bright and airy soft, diffused studio lighting"}, gently illuminating the face and creating a subtle catchlight in the eyes, conveying a sense of clarity. Captured on an 85mm f/1.8 lens with a shallow depth of field, exquisite focus on the eyes, and beautiful, soft bokeh. Observe crisp detail on the fabric texture of the blazer, individual strands of hair, and natural, realistic skin texture. The atmosphere exudes confidence, professionalism, and approachability. Clean and bright cinematic color grading with subtle warmth and balanced tones, ensuring a polished and contemporary feel.

zh.title: 专业工作室个人形象照
zh.description: 一个用于生成高分辨率专业工作室个人形象照的提示词，同时保持参考图像中人物的身份和面部结构不变。
zh.prompt: 一张专业的高分辨率个人形象照，保持输入图像中人物的面部结构、身份和关键特征不变。主体采用胸部以上构图，顶部留有充足空间。人物直视镜头。整体造型为专业摄影棚拍摄风格，身着高档商务休闲装 {argument name="outfit" default="炭灰色修身西装外套"}。背景为纯色“{argument name="background color" default="#562226"}”中性摄影棚背景。采用高角度拍摄，配合 {argument name="lighting" default="明亮通透、柔和且均匀的摄影棚布光"}，柔和地照亮面部，并在眼中形成细腻的眼神光，传达出清晰感。使用 85mm f/1.8 镜头拍摄，具有浅景深效果，焦点精准聚焦于双眼，呈现出优美柔和的虚化效果。清晰展现西装面料的纹理细节、发丝质感以及自然真实的皮肤纹理。整体氛围散发出自信、专业与亲和力。画面采用干净明亮的电影级调色，色调温暖平衡，确保成片精致且具有现代感。

en.title: Premium Industrial Product Design Generator
en.description: A sophisticated prompt for generating industrial product designs by inferring design DNA from a reference theme while maintaining functional core features.
en.prompt: Generate a {argument name="product" default="[PRODUCT]"} inspired by {argument name="inspiration" default="[THING]"}. Rules: - do not merely decorate the product with the subject - infer DESIGN_DNA from {argument name="inspiration" default="[THING]"} - preserve FUNCTIONAL_CORE of {argument name="product" default="[PRODUCT]"} - translate THING’s visual identity into the industrial design language of the product - the final object must feel like a believable premium real-world product, not a novelty prop - infer MATERIAL_SYSTEM, SIGNATURE_FEATURES, and CONTROL_LANGUAGE automatically - map PRODUCT components into THING-inspired functional forms - integrate subtle branding or symbolic cues derived from {argument name="inspiration" default="[THING]"} - place the product in an inferred or specified ENVIRONMENT that enhances its luxury and usability - no hard-coded materials, features, controls, logos, colors, or parts unless supplied

zh.title: 高端工业产品设计生成器
zh.description: 一个复杂的提示词，通过从参考主题中推断设计基因（Design DNA），在保持核心功能特征的同时生成工业产品设计。
zh.prompt: 生成一个受 {argument name="inspiration" default="[THING]"} 启发的 {argument name="product" default="[PRODUCT]"}。规则：- 不要仅仅用主题装饰产品 - 从 {argument name="inspiration" default="[THING]"} 中推断出 DESIGN_DNA - 保留 {argument name="product" default="[PRODUCT]"} 的 FUNCTIONAL_CORE - 将 THING 的视觉识别转化为产品的工业设计语言 - 最终物体必须感觉像是一个可信的高端现实世界产品，而不是新奇的道具 - 自动推断 MATERIAL_SYSTEM、SIGNATURE_FEATURES 和 CONTROL_LANGUAGE - 将 PRODUCT 组件映射为受 THING 启发的函数式形态 - 整合源自 {argument name="inspiration" default="[THING]"} 的微妙品牌标识或符号暗示 - 将产品置于一个能增强其奢华感和可用性的推断或指定 ENVIRONMENT 中 - 除非另有提供，否则不得硬编码材质、特征、控件、徽标、颜色或部件

en.title: Character Orthographic Reference Sheet
en.description: Creates a professional, multi-angle character turnaround sheet including front, back, and detail views, perfect for character design and consistent reference.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic full-body {argument name="character subject" default="character turnaround sheet of a delivery courier"} wearing a {argument name="outfit style" default="modern green-and-dark-charcoal waterproof uniform"}. The layout includes front view, back view, left side, right side, 3/4 front, 3/4 back, a clean head-and-shoulders portrait, and a first-person POV looking down at both arms. The character wears a {argument name="details" default="green baseball cap, green crew-neck shirt, green hooded rain jacket with dark charcoal side panels"}, reflective silver strip near the hem, black slim-fit pants, and black athletic sneakers. White vertical branding printed on the jacket front panel and horizontal branding across the back. Neutral facial expression, athletic build, realistic skin texture.
Studio product photography, {argument name="background" default="seamless light gray background"}, soft diffused lighting, perfectly centered framing, consistent scale, orthographic reference style, highly detailed fabric texture, waterproof material, realistic stitching, clean folds, accurate proportions, fashion catalog quality, photorealistic, 8K, ultra-sharp, no shadows distracting from the subject, professional apparel design presentation.

zh.title: 角色正交参考图
zh.description: 创建专业的、包含正面、背面及细节视图的多角度角色转面图，非常适合角色设计和一致性参考。
zh.prompt:
超写实全身 {argument name="character subject" default="快递员角色转面图"}，身着 {argument name="outfit style" default="现代绿色与深炭灰色拼接防水制服"}。布局包含正面、背面、左侧面、右侧面、前 3/4 侧面、后 3/4 侧面、清晰的头部及肩部肖像，以及第一人称视角俯瞰双臂。角色佩戴 {argument name="details" default="绿色棒球帽，绿色圆领衫，带有深炭灰色侧拼块的绿色连帽雨衣"}，下摆处有反光银条，搭配黑色修身长裤和黑色运动鞋。夹克前襟印有垂直品牌标识，背部印有水平品牌标识。中性面部表情，运动型身材，写实皮肤纹理。
演播室产品摄影，{argument name="background" default="无缝浅灰色背景"}，柔和漫射光，构图完美居中，比例一致，正交参考风格，高细节织物纹理，防水材质，写实缝线，自然褶皱，精准比例，时尚目录级画质，照片级真实感，8K 分辨率，超清晰，无干扰阴影，专业服装设计展示。

en.title: Modern Pop-Art Female Portrait
en.description: A striking pop-art portrait prompt featuring an East Asian woman with vibrant yellow headphones against a bold graphic background, inspired by Japanese poster design.
en.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed modern pop-art portrait of a {argument name="ethnicity" default="confident East Asian woman"} in a clean left-side profile, looking slightly upward with a calm, determined expression. She has a {argument name="hair style" default="sleek chin-length bob haircut with soft wispy bangs"}, silky jet-black hair with a subtle natural shine, softly arched eyebrows, expressive dark brown almond-shaped eyes, delicate eyelashes, a refined nose, naturally full lips, elegant feminine facial contours, a graceful jawline, and smooth luminous natural skin with subtle pores and realistic texture.

Dramatic studio lighting with soft shadows, ultra-clean composition, crisp edge definition, premium digital illustration, hyper-realistic mixed-media rendering, smooth gradients, vibrant high-contrast colors, poster-quality artwork, modern branding aesthetic, centered composition, 8K resolution, Adobe Illustrator + Photoshop hybrid style, flawless detailing, magazine cover quality, minimalistic luxury design, contemporary visual identity, no text, no watermark, no logo.

zh.title: 现代波普艺术女性肖像

en.title: Red Satin Silence Bedroom Portrait
en.description: A detailed cinematic fashion portrait prompt for a mature woman in a cozy, lived-in bedroom setting featuring satin textures and soft natural lighting.
en.prompt:
Subject Theme:
{argument name="subject theme" default="Red Satin Silence"}

Subject:
A realistic 2:3 vertical fashion portrait of a fictional adult woman kneeling on a white bed in a bedroom decorated with magazines and photo cards on beige walls. The subject occupies a large portion of the center-left frame, shown from the head to the thighs. Open magazines, photobooks, postcards, and a small black camera are naturally scattered around her.

Character and Expression:
An adult woman with a calm allure and mature presence. A healthy, naturally rounded, adult-like physique. Her long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair is slightly messy, with thin bangs and strands of hair around her face brushing her cheeks. Her head is tilted slightly, directing a quiet, steady gaze at the camera. Her lips are lightly closed in a gentle, effortless expression. Her skin retains a natural flush and fine textures.

Clothing and Pose:
A white ribbed camisole with thin shoulder straps. The neckline is a distinct V-neck bordered with lace, with a short length that naturally follows the body's curves. The bottoms are made of a {argument name="clothing color" default="deep red"} satin material with fine gathers at the edges. She is kneeling on the bed, with her left leg extended forward and her right leg folded back. Her upper body is nearly frontal, with only a slight twist at the waist. Her right hand lightly rests its fingertips on the edge of the red satin, while her left hand is naturally placed near the opposite edge. The interaction between fingers and clothing is depicted realistically without pulling the fabric too hard.

Background and Lighting:
A lived-in bedroom with messy white sheets and pillows. The wall is irregularly plastered with covers of women's magazines, indoor photos, cityscapes, flowers, and strips of paper; the text is blurred to an unreadable extent while maintaining a Japanese-like atmosphere. An open photobook is in the foreground, the subject and black camera in the middle ground, and a wall collage in the background. Warm sunlight shines in from a low angle on the upper left, illuminating the left side of her face, shoulder, chest, and thighs. It casts distinct shadows on her right side and the wall, with soft reflected light from the white sheets.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical 2:3 ratio, with the subject occupying about 70% of the frame. The face is in the upper third, the waist in the center, and the knees and magazines at the bottom. The camera is at a slightly low angle, nearly the same height as the bed, with a natural perspective of around 50mm. Focus is on the eyes and face, with background papers slightly softened. There is moderate space on the side walls and the bottom of the bed, with scattered magazines guiding the gaze toward the subject.

Texture and Style:
A warm-toned, magazine-style realistic photograph. Features subtle film grain, soft highlights, shallow shadows, and a base of calm beige and white, with the red satin serving as a strong color accent. Skin shows pores and fine shading, avoiding excessive retouching. Different textures of hair, ribbed fabric, lace, satin, sheets, and paper are clearly distinguished.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, poor contact between clothing and hands, distorted V-neck, floating fabric, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, illegible garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-like skin.

zh.description: 一个细腻的电影感时尚肖像提示词，描绘了一位成熟女性在舒适、充满生活气息的卧室场景中，展现绸缎质感与柔和自然光影。
zh.prompt:
主题设定：
{argument name="subject theme" default="红色绸缎静谧"}

主体：
一张写实的 2:3 竖构图时尚肖像，描绘了一位虚构的成年女性跪在白色床上。卧室背景的米色墙面上装饰着杂志和照片卡。主体占据了画面中左侧的大部分区域，展示范围从头部到大腿。摊开的杂志、摄影集、明信片和一台小型黑色相机自然地散落在她周围。

人物与表情：
一位散发着沉静魅力、气质成熟的成年女性。拥有健康、自然圆润的成年女性体态。她留着一头深 {argument name="hair color" default="棕色"} 的长发，略显凌乱，稀疏的刘海和脸颊两侧的发丝轻轻拂过面庞。她头部微倾，向镜头投去安静而坚定的目光。双唇轻闭，表情温柔且自然。皮肤保留了自然的红润感和细腻的纹理。

服装与姿势：
身穿一件白色罗纹吊带背心，肩带纤细。领口为独特的蕾丝边 V 领，短款设计自然贴合身体曲线。下装采用 {argument name="clothing color" default="深红色"} 绸缎材质，边缘有细密的褶皱。她跪在床上，左腿向前伸展，右腿向后折叠。上半身近乎正面，腰部有轻微的扭转。右手手指轻轻搭在红色绸缎的边缘，左手自然地放在另一侧边缘。手指与衣物的互动描绘得非常逼真，没有过度拉扯布料。

背景与光影：
充满生活气息的卧室，铺着凌乱的白色床单和枕头。墙面上不规则地贴满了女性杂志封面、室内照片、城市景观、花卉和纸条；文字模糊不清，无法辨认，同时保持着一种日系氛围。前景是一本打开的摄影集，中景是主体和黑色相机，背景是墙面拼贴画。温暖的阳光从左上方的低角度射入，照亮了她脸部的左侧、肩膀、胸部和大腿。在她的右侧和墙面上投下明显的阴影，并带有来自白色床单的柔和反射光。

构图与摄影：
2:3 竖构图，主体占据画面约 70% 的空间。脸部位于上方三分之一处，腰部位于中心，膝盖和杂志位于底部。相机处于略低的视角，与床的高度几乎齐平，采用约 50mm 的自然透视。焦点对准眼睛和脸部，背景纸张略微柔化。侧墙和床底留有适度的空间，散落的杂志引导视线看向主体。

质感与风格：
暖色调、杂志风格的写实摄影。具有细腻的胶片颗粒感、柔和的高光、浅淡的阴影，以沉稳的米色和白色为基调，红色绸缎作为强烈的色彩点缀。皮肤展现出毛孔和细微的阴影，避免过度修图。头发、罗纹织物、蕾丝、绸缎、床单和纸张的不同质感清晰可辨。

负面提示词：
不自然的脸部、不自然的目光、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、衣物与手部接触不良、V 领变形、漂浮的布料、不符合重力、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、难以辨认的乱码文字、Logo、水印、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤。

zh.prompt: 1. 角色身份摘要： 名称：Cigar Cat 角色：主要反英雄 年龄：成年猫 情感功能：带有黑色幽默的自信、好奇心、街头智慧 视觉特征：精瘦短毛猫，超大且富有表现力的眼睛，窄口鼻，长胡须，标志性的强烈凝视，嘴边叼着一支雪茄 连续性重要性：极高，面部比例、眼睛大小、毛发图案、体型、雪茄位置及姿态在每一帧中都应保持一致。 2. 完整角色设定表提示词 创建一份专业的角色参考表，基于既定的故事板角色，描绘一只精瘦的成年短毛猫。这只猫拥有窄长的猫科面部、非常大且富有表现力的杏仁眼、突出的鼻子、细长的胡须、短而平滑的毛发、苗条的运动型身体、长腿、直立的尖耳朵，以及略带顽皮、街头智慧的表情。保留该角色的独特视觉标识：超大且富有表现力的眼睛、可辨识的窄口鼻、强有力的鼻型、长胡须、精瘦的身体比例、短而平滑的毛发、自信的反英雄态度、自然叼在嘴边一侧的雪茄（作为标志性道具）。 展示：正面面部视图、左侧面视图、右侧面视图、3/4 面部视图、背面剪影：全身站立姿势、行走姿势、低蹲姿势、面部特写细节、中性表情、怀疑的眯眼表情、自信的露齿笑、惊讶的警觉表情、强烈的凝视。 服装：无。 配饰/道具：仅一支雪茄，与既定的故事板道具一致。 姿态：放松但具有主导感，胸部微挺，动作受控，自信的屋顶流浪猫肢体语言。 视觉处理：干净专业的制作角色设定表，单色电影感铅笔与墨水画，写实的猫科解剖结构，必要时包含精确的构建线条，中性浅色背景，各视图比例一致。 灯光：柔和的中性摄影棚灯光，以确保设计清晰。在所有视图中保持完全相同的面部比例、眼睛形状、耳朵位置、体型、毛发长度、胡须图案和雪茄风格。 3. 一致性说明： 面部：保持相同的窄长猫科头骨结构、鼻型、口鼻宽度和异常大的眼睛。 眼睛：大而富有表现力，略带强烈感。切勿缩小或大幅改变其形状。 毛发：全身为短毛且平滑。无长毛变化。 体型：精瘦、敏捷、长腿，写实的猫科解剖结构。 情绪：自信、顽皮、略带威慑力，除非场景明确要求，否则不要表现得过于卡通可爱。 标志性道具：只要出现，雪茄的大小、形状、位置和视觉处理必须保持一致。 连续性行为：从极近特写到远景，这只猫应保持相同的面部特征。 4. 负面提示词： 无面部改变，无眼睛大小改变，无品种改变，无长毛，无类似毛发造型的变化，无身体比例改变，无随机年龄偏移，无服装，无帽子，除非后续要求否则无项圈，无额外配饰，无额外角色，无重复的猫，无扭曲的爪子，无解剖结构错误，无多余肢体，无人手，无夸张的卡通变形，无不一致的雪茄大小，无水印，无 Logo，无海报排版，无文字密集的布局。

en.prompt: An {argument name="subject" default="adult East Asian woman"} walking slowly in the shallow waves of a {argument name="location" default="tropical or Mediterranean beach"} during the evening golden hour. Full-body shot from slightly above head level to the wet sand. Profile view positioned in the center-right, facing the open sea to the right. Head slightly lowered, looking at the water in quiet contemplation. Tall, slender, natural athletic build, warm fair skin, exquisite facial features, a delicate nose bridge, soft lip shape, and an elegant posture. Right leg stepping forward in shallow water; left leg trailing behind with the heel lifted and toes touching the wet sand—a slow pace pausing at the tide line. Left arm hanging naturally; right arm near the front hip. Realistic and understated human proportions. Hairstyle: Very long black hair falling below the middle of the back—strongly blown to the left by the sea breeze, creating loose strands and sweeping curves behind the head, neck, and shoulders. A few fine strands cross the cheek and partially obscure the profile. Delicate golden rim lighting, real individual hair strands, slightly disheveled. Swimwear: {argument name="swimwear" default="minimalist white halter-neck bikini"}—softly ruched triangle cups, thin neck ties, and thin waist ties. White bikini bottoms at the natural hip. Opaque, well-fitting, no logo. Sarong: Lightweight white translucent beach sarong tied in a soft knot at the front right of the waist. Draping asymmetrically over the upper thigh, revealing the bikini bottom while providing modest coverage. Long sections of fabric drape dramatically to the left—blown by the wind. Fine woven texture, translucent layers, delicate wrinkles, soft edges, and glowing backlit highlights. Light and responsive to the sea breeze. Waterline: A thin layer of clear seawater covering a smooth reflective sand surface. Small foamy bubbles curl around the feet, extending diagonally from the lower-right foreground to the mid-left distance. Subtle reflections of the legs and feet in the wet sand, softened by ripples. Fine splashes around the lifted back foot; the front foot creates a natural indentation in the sand. Sea: Right half of the frame—pale blue-gray, soft silver, and understated teal. Gentle irregular wave ripples, exquisite white foam, with sunlight dancing and sparkling on the surface. The coastline extends from the bottom center to the far left—a strong diagonal leading line. Left beach: Wide, smooth, warm beige, with a slightly darker band of wet sand near the tide line. Background: Far left—a blurred row of umbrellas, lounge areas, trees, and a few tiny anonymous tourists, heavily out of focus. Beyond the coastline are dramatic rocky islands or coastal mountains—towering narrow central rock spires with steep vertical ridges, with lower dark slopes dropping toward the sea. Atmospheric, slightly hazy, not sharp. Upper background: Glowing light peach-gray sky with thin horizontal clouds. The sun hangs low outside the frame in the upper left—warm backlighting, misty atmospheric perspective, and a soft golden glow over the mountains and beach. The distant view gradually loses contrast and saturation, enhancing the sense of depth. zh.title: 黄金时刻海滩漫步
zh.description: 一份全面的提示词，用于生成女性在日落时分于热带海滩浅滩漫步的全身电影感镜头，具备高动态范围和胶片颗粒质感。
zh.prompt: 一位 {argument name="subject" default="成年东亚女性"} 在 {argument name="location" default="热带或地中海海滩"} 的傍晚黄金时刻，在浅滩中缓慢行走。全身镜头，视角略高于头部，直至湿润的沙滩。侧面视角，位于画面中右侧，面向右侧开阔的海面。头部微垂，静静地注视着水面，神情沉思。身材高挑纤细，自然运动型体格，肤色白皙温暖，五官精致，鼻梁秀气，唇形柔和，姿态优雅。右腿在浅水中迈步；左腿在后，脚后跟抬起，脚趾触碰湿沙——步伐缓慢，在潮汐线处停顿。左臂自然下垂；右臂靠近前侧髋部。人体比例写实且内敛。发型：极长的黑色长发垂至后背中部——被海风强烈地吹向左侧，在头部、颈部和肩后形成凌乱的发丝和飘逸的曲线。几缕细发掠过脸颊，部分遮挡了侧脸。精致的金色轮廓光，真实的单根发丝，略显凌乱。泳装：{argument name="swimwear" default="极简白色挂脖比基尼"}——柔软的褶皱三角杯，细颈带，细腰带。白色比基尼底裤位于自然髋部位置。不透明，贴合身形，无 Logo。纱笼：轻盈的白色半透明海滩纱笼，在腰部右前方系成一个柔和的结。不对称地披在在大腿上部，既露出比基尼底裤又提供了适度的遮盖。长段布料向左侧戏剧性地垂落——随风飘动。精细的编织纹理，半透明的层次，细腻的褶皱，柔和的边缘，以及发光的背光高光。轻盈且随海风摆动。水位线：一层薄薄的清澈海水覆盖在平滑且具有反射感的沙面上。细小的泡沫在脚边卷起，从右下前景向左中远景呈对角线延伸。湿沙中映出腿部和脚部的微妙倒影，被涟漪柔化。抬起的后脚周围有细小的水花；前脚在沙滩上留下自然的压痕。海洋：画面右半部分——淡蓝灰色、柔和的银色和内敛的青色。轻柔不规则的波浪涟漪，精致的白色泡沫，阳光在水面上跳跃闪烁。海岸线从底部中心向远左侧延伸——一条强有力的对角线引导线。左侧海滩：宽阔、平滑、温暖的米色，潮汐线附近有一条颜色稍深的湿沙带。背景：远左侧——模糊的遮阳伞、休息区、树木和几个微小的匿名游客，处于深度虚化状态。海岸线之外是壮观的岩石岛屿或沿海山脉——高耸狭窄的中央岩石尖塔，带有陡峭的垂直山脊，较低的深色坡面朝向大海倾斜。氛围感强，略带朦胧，不锐利。背景上方：发光的浅桃灰色天空，带有细长的水平云层。太阳悬挂在左上角画面外——温暖的逆光，朦胧的大气透视，山脉和海滩上笼罩着柔和的金色光芒。远景逐渐失去对比度和饱和度，增强了空间深度感。光影：来自后方和左后方的温暖漫射黄金时刻光线——头发左侧边缘、肩膀、上臂、腰部、腿部、纱笼和脚部有精致的阳光轮廓光。来自水面和浅色沙滩的柔和正面反射保留了面部和身体的细节。柔和的开放式阴影，平滑的高光过渡。色调：象牙色、暖米色、浅桃色、烟蓝灰色、柔和青色、炭灰色山脉色调和克制的金色。精致的电影级调色：略微去饱和的阴影，温暖发光的皮肤，精致的朦胧感，以及微妙的怀旧胶片质感。无强烈的饱和度或橙色皮肤。相机：腰部高度，全画幅 85mm，f/2.2–f/3.2。主体/泳装/纱笼/脚部清晰锐利；远处的山脉/海滩活动/树木溶解在奶油般的大气虚化中。自然的透视压缩。奢华度假摄影，高端泳装大片，模拟胶片颗粒，柔和的高光晕影，高动态范围，电影级写实。负面提示：无文字，无 Logo，无水印，无明显的额外人物，无品牌标识，无畸形的手或脚，无多余的手指或脚趾，无重复的肢体，无夸张的姿势，无透明泳装，无塑料感皮肤，无强烈的直接闪光，无过饱和色彩，无人工 HDR，无畸形的几何山体，无杂乱的前景元素。

en.title: Minimalist Japanese Editorial Portrait
en.description: A refined prompt for a cinematic portrait of an East Asian woman in a warm, minimalist Japanese interior, focusing on realistic skin details and soft natural lighting.
en.prompt: {argument name="subject" default="A young adult East Asian woman"} with black hair loosely tied up and natural wisps. Her features are clear and delicate, with almond eyes, soft brows, a slender nose bridge, and naturally moist lips. Wearing light makeup and a fair, warm skin tone, the skin retains real pores, fine downy hair, and natural texture without smoothing. She wears a {argument name="clothing" default="black thin-strap halter top"}, revealing her neck, collarbone, and upper chest lines. The composition is a close-up to half-body portrait, with the subject centered slightly to the left, facing the camera directly with a calm, steady gaze and a slight gentle smile. The right hand is naturally raised, fingers lightly touching the side of the face and jaw; the left forearm is placed horizontally in the foreground, with the hand below extended naturally. The pose is relaxed and elegant, not exaggerated. The background is a {argument name="background" default="quiet Japanese interior space"}, with soft-focus shoji windows or wooden frames faintly visible; the environment is minimalist, clean, and warm. The light is soft natural side lighting with a touch of warmth; transitions on the face and shoulders are delicate, shadows are soft, and highlights are restrained. Overall low saturation and contrast, dominated by beige, wood tones, soft gray-green, and black. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, focus clearly on the eyes and face, background softly blurred, high-end editorial portrait, authentic photographic texture, cinematic but not overly stylized, photorealistic. Avoid: Cartoonish feel, CG look, plastic skin, wrong fingers, deformed arms, over-sharpening, heavy makeup, exaggerated smiles, cluttered background, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 极简日系杂志风肖像
zh.description: 一份精致的提示词，用于生成在温馨极简日式室内空间中，东亚女性的电影感肖像，重点在于真实的皮肤细节和柔和的自然光影。
zh.prompt: {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的东亚女性"}，黑发随意盘起，留有自然的碎发。五官清晰精致，杏眼、柔和的眉毛、纤细的鼻梁，嘴唇自然水润。妆容清淡，肤色白皙温暖，皮肤保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛和自然纹理，未经过度磨皮。身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="黑色细肩带挂脖上衣"}，露出颈部、锁骨和上胸部线条。构图为特写至半身肖像，主体略微偏左居中，直视镜头，目光平静沉稳，带着淡淡的微笑。右手自然抬起，手指轻触脸颊和下颌；左前臂水平放置在前景中，手部自然延伸。姿态放松优雅，不夸张。背景为 {argument name="background" default="安静的日式室内空间"}，隐约可见柔焦的障子窗或木质框架；环境极简、干净且温馨。光线为柔和的自然侧光，带有暖意；面部和肩部的光影过渡细腻，阴影柔和，高光克制。整体低饱和度、低对比度，以米色、木色、柔和的灰绿色和黑色为主。摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，浅景深，焦点清晰对准眼睛和面部，背景柔和虚化，高端杂志肖像，真实的摄影质感，电影感但不过度风格化，照片级真实。避免：卡通感、CG 感、塑料皮肤、手指错误、手臂变形、过度锐化、浓妆、夸张的笑容、杂乱的背景、文字、水印、Logo。

en.title: Traditional Courtyard Fashion Portrait
en.description: An intricate cinematic prompt for a portrait in a traditional East Asian courtyard, highlighting textures of raw silk, linen, and willow-weaved elements.
en.prompt: An {argument name="subject" default="East Asian woman"} stands under a weeping willow in a sunlit courtyard. Low-angle shot from the top of the head to the calves, centered, with her body slightly turned to the left, a calm expression, lips slightly parted, and chin slightly raised. Slender figure, warm fair skin, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, a straight nose, and coral-rose lips. Editorial makeup with translucent skin, peach-pink blush, brown eyeliner, and warm-toned eyeshadow. Real pore texture, with fine highlights on the face, neck, shoulders, and arms. Deep brownish-black hair in a loose low bun, with wisps falling over the cheeks, neck, and shoulders; a single damp strand clings to the left shoulder and chest. The stray hairs on the crown are illuminated by sunlight, looking rustic and slightly messy. A {argument name="top" default="cream-beige off-the-shoulder crop top"} in an asymmetrical draping raw silk linen texture, with narrow ties knotted at the back of the neck and a bow at the side of the waist; a high slanted collar with the hem reaching above the navel. Featuring dark brown, olive, and pale gold floral embroidery, with handcrafted stitching texture, opaque and well-fitting. A dark olive charcoal long skirt with vertical pleats in matte fabric, with a rust-brown terracotta cloth strip wrapped around the waist, loosely knotted at the front left with the tail hanging to the skirt; a coarse linen scarf with frayed edges and tassels at the left hip, giving the waist ornament a handmade feel. Left arm hanging at the side, right arm extended diagonally to hold the handle of a large willow basket. Hands show accurate knuckles and natural, clean, short nails. A large dark-brown willow-weaved basket sits in the lower-right foreground, with a wide round body, a thick arched handle, and dense hand-worn strips; the sunlit edges contrast with the dark interior of the basket mouth, occupying the lower-right quadrant as a secondary focal point. The setting is an {argument name="setting" default="ancient East Asian wooden house courtyard"}: weathered wooden walls, lattice windows, carved door frames, wooden pillars, and a tiled roof. The wood grain is coarse, beams are irregular, and the interior is dimly lit. A light-colored hanging cloth hangs over a dark doorway behind the left shoulder. Weeping willow branches and leaves traverse the top, with green leaves of varying density crossing over the eaves and surrounding the head and shoulders without obscuring the eyes, creating scattered dappled light and shadow. Below are coarse stone bases, stone steps, slabs, and grass; the distant view is softened to highlight the figure, clothing, and basket. Warm sunlight filters from the upper right front like early summer midday shade; highlights are bright on the shoulders, arms, cheeks, neck, waist, and basket handle. The face and body have soft reflected light, while cool-toned shadows fall under the hair, chin, arms, clothing folds, and eaves. Dappled willow shadows fall across the skin, clothing, wooden walls, and basket; highlights are warm, and shadows are cold olive-brown. Earthy color palette: cream parchment beige, dark olive, weathered brown, charcoal gray, rust-colored terracotta, willow green, and warm skin tones, with restrained saturation. Soft film grain, highlight halation, transparent shadows, and atmospheric perspective. Full-frame 50–65mm, f/2.8–f/4, focus on eyes, face, embroidery, knots, and the right hand on the basket handle; distant view blurred but retaining texture, with a slightly low-angle statuesque feel. High-end rural fashion editorial: natural beauty, handmade clothing, traditional architecture, pastoral elegance, realistic skin texture, distinct hair strands, precise embroidery, basket texture, aged wood, natural hands, and cinematic realism. No text, logos, watermarks, extra people, modern objects, plastic skin, deformed fingers, duplicate limbs, deformed basket, oversaturated colors, artificial HDR, or harsh studio lighting.

zh.title: 传统庭院时尚人像
zh.description: 一个精致的电影感提示词，用于拍摄传统东亚庭院中的人像，突显生丝、亚麻和柳编元素的质感。
zh.prompt: 一位 {argument name="subject" default="东亚女性"} 站在阳光明媚的庭院中，身旁是一棵垂柳。低角度拍摄，从头顶到小腿，居中构图，身体微向左转，表情平静，双唇微启，下巴微抬。身材修长，肤色白皙温暖，杏仁状深棕色眼睛，鼻梁挺直，珊瑚玫瑰色嘴唇。编辑级妆容，皮肤通透，桃粉色腮红，棕色眼线，暖色调眼影。真实的毛孔质感，面部、颈部、肩部和手臂上有细腻的高光。深棕黑色头发梳成松散的低发髻，发丝垂落在脸颊、颈部和肩部；一缕湿润的发丝贴在左肩和胸前。头顶的碎发被阳光照亮，显得质朴而略显凌乱。身穿一件 {argument name="top" default="奶油米色露肩短款上衣"}，采用不对称垂坠感的生丝亚麻材质，颈后系有窄带，腰侧系有蝴蝶结；高斜领设计，下摆位于肚脐上方。饰有深棕色、橄榄色和浅金色的花卉刺绣，带有手工缝制的质感，不透明且合身。搭配一条深橄榄炭色长裙，哑光面料带有垂直褶皱，腰间缠绕着锈棕色陶土布条，在左前方松散地打结，尾部垂至裙摆；左臀处系有一条边缘磨损并带有流苏的粗亚麻围巾，赋予腰部装饰手工感。左臂自然下垂，右臂斜向伸出，手持一个大柳篮的提手。手部指关节准确，指甲自然、干净且修剪整齐。右下角前景处有一个巨大的深棕色柳编篮，篮身圆润宽大，提手粗壮，带有手工编织的致密条纹；阳光照亮的边缘与篮口深邃的内部形成对比，占据右下象限作为次要焦点。场景为 {argument name="setting" default="古老的东亚木屋庭院"}：风化的木墙、格栅窗、雕花门框、木柱和瓦顶。木纹粗糙，梁柱不规则，室内光线昏暗。左肩后方的深色门洞上挂着一块浅色垂布。垂柳枝叶横跨顶部，疏密有致的绿叶穿过屋檐，环绕在头部和肩部周围，且不遮挡眼睛，营造出斑驳的光影。下方是粗糙的石基、石阶、石板和草地；远景经过柔化处理，以突出人物、服装和篮子。温暖的阳光从右前方斜射而来，如同初夏午后的阴影；肩部、手臂、脸颊、颈部、腰部和篮柄上有明亮的高光。面部和身体有柔和的反射光，而头发、下巴、手臂、衣褶和屋檐下则有冷色调的阴影。斑驳的柳影投射在皮肤、服装、木墙和篮子上；高光温暖，阴影呈冷橄榄棕色。大地色调：奶油羊皮纸米色、深橄榄色、风化棕色、炭灰色、锈陶土色、柳绿色和温暖的肤色，饱和度克制。柔和的胶片颗粒感、高光晕影、通透的阴影和大气透视。全画幅 50–65mm，f/2.8–f/4，焦点集中在眼睛、面部、刺绣、结扣以及握住篮柄的右手上；远景模糊但保留质感，具有轻微低角度的雕塑感。高端乡村时尚大片：自然美、手工服装、传统建筑、田园优雅、写实皮肤质感、清晰的发丝、精准的刺绣、篮子质感、陈旧木材、自然的手部细节和电影级真实感。无文字、无标志、无水印、无额外人物、无现代物品、无塑料感皮肤、无畸形手指、无重复肢体、无畸形篮子、无过度饱和色彩、无人工 HDR、无生硬的摄影棚灯光。

en.title: Lifestyle Portrait in Japanese Cosmetic Shop
en.description: A comprehensive structured prompt for creating a photorealistic 2:3 lifestyle portrait of a woman in a bright, natural cosmetics store in Japan.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Glance through the shelves"}

Main Figure:
A realistic lifestyle portrait in 2:3 vertical aspect ratio. In an aisle of a bright natural cosmetics shop, an adult woman holding a smartphone with both hands leans slightly forward from her waist and looks at the camera as if turning around. The person is positioned slightly to the right of the center, captured in a large shot from the head to the upper thighs. The person occupies about 65% of the screen, with white space of the bright aisle on the left and a long view of product shelves on the right.

Person & Expression:
A natural and elegant adult woman. Shoulder-length dark brown bob hair with light inner curls and thin see-through bangs. Pink-beige eye makeup, thin eyeliner, natural tear bags, and pale coral lips. She tilts her head slightly to her left, tucks her chin slightly, and gazes at the lens with a soft smile. The skin is bright and smooth but retains pores and natural shadows.

Clothing & Pose:
{argument name="clothing" default="An ivory ribbed camisole with thin shoulder straps, worn with a loosely dropped open-knit summer cardigan. A tiered mini skirt with a light peach floral pattern and lace trim."} Delicate gold necklace and bracelet, a beige shoulder bag with a small white stuffed animal charm. Holding a white smartphone with both hands below the chest, fingers naturally touching the screen. Leaning the upper body forward while pulling the hips back, supporting the center of gravity stably with both legs. Natural gravity and fine fabric wrinkles on the cardigan sleeves and skirt hem.

Background & Light:
{argument name="background" default="A clean, natural cosmetics shop in an urban area of Japan."} On the wooden shelf on the right, brown pump bottles, white or beige cosmetic boxes, and small beauty supplies are neatly arranged. Price tags and poster text are blurred and unreadable. On the far left, a glass entrance and pale green plants are visible, with a natural sense of perspective leading down the aisle. The main light is soft daylight coming from the entrance on the left. It creates bright highlights on the left side of the face, shoulders, collarbones, and arms, while casting thin shadows on the right side of the person. Warm reflected light comes back from the wooden shelves, keeping the overall palette in ivory and light brown.

Composition & Camera:
Vertical 2:3, medium-full shot taken from slightly above eye level. The face is positioned in the upper center, the smartphone to the lower left, and the bag and charm in the right center. A bit of shelf and poster remains at the top edge, and the bottom edge naturally cuts off at the thighs. 50mm equivalent, F1.8. Precise focus on the eyes and face, sharp hands and clothes, with smooth blur on the back shelves and entrance. A quiet, dynamic composition created by the person's tilt and the shelf's horizon.

Texture & Style:
High-definition photorealistic photography. Meticulous depiction of natural skin texture, fine downy hair, individual strands of bangs, open-knit fibers, and details of ribbed material and lace. Bright exposure with suppressed blown-out highlights, low contrast, creamy highlights, and pale film-like colors. A finish resembling clean snapshots from Japanese fashion magazines or cosmetic brand lookbooks.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, overly young appearance, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands, poor contact with smartphone, distorted arms or legs, unnatural forward lean, floating clothes, broken bag straps, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, readable product names, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-like skin.

zh.title: 日本美妆店生活感人像
zh.description: 一份全面的结构化提示词，用于创作一张 2:3 比例的写实风格生活感人像，展现一位女性在明亮、自然的日本美妆店内的场景。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="浏览货架"}

主要人物：
一张 2:3 竖构图的写实生活感人像。在一家明亮、自然风格的美妆店过道中，一位成年女性双手拿着智能手机，腰部微微前倾，仿佛转身般看向镜头。人物位于画面中心偏右位置，采用从头部到大腿上部的中远景拍摄。人物占据约 65% 的画面，左侧为明亮过道的留白，右侧为延伸的商品货架。

人物与表情：
一位自然优雅的成年女性。齐肩深棕色波波头，带有轻微内扣和轻薄的空气刘海。粉米色眼妆，细眼线，自然的卧蚕，以及淡珊瑚色唇妆。她头部微微向左倾斜，微收下巴，带着柔和的微笑注视镜头。皮肤明亮细腻，保留了毛孔和自然的阴影。

服装与姿势：
{argument name="clothing" default="一件象牙白罗纹吊带背心，外搭一件宽松垂坠的镂空夏季开衫。一条带有浅桃色花卉图案和蕾丝边饰的层叠迷你裙。"} 精致的金色项链和手链，一个带有白色小动物挂件的米色单肩包。双手在胸前下方握住白色智能手机，手指自然地触碰屏幕。上半身前倾，臀部后撤，双腿稳定支撑重心。开衫袖口和裙摆处呈现自然的重力和细微的织物褶皱。

背景与光影：
{argument name="background" default="日本市区内一家整洁、自然风格的美妆店。"} 右侧木质货架上整齐排列着棕色泵头瓶、白色或米色化妆品盒以及小型美容用品。价格标签和海报文字经过模糊处理，无法辨认。最左侧可见玻璃入口和淡绿色植物，营造出过道延伸的自然透视感。主光源是来自左侧入口的柔和日光。光线在人物左侧的面部、肩膀、锁骨和手臂上形成明亮的高光，同时在人物右侧投下淡淡的阴影。木质货架反射出温暖的光线，使整体色调保持在象牙白和浅棕色。

构图与摄影：
竖向 2:3 比例，从略高于视平线的位置拍摄中远景。面部位于上方中心，智能手机位于左下方，包包和挂件位于右侧中心。顶部边缘保留部分货架和海报，底部边缘自然截断在大腿处。50mm 等效焦距，F1.8 光圈。焦点精准对准眼睛和面部，手部和衣物清晰锐利，后方货架和入口处呈现平滑的虚化效果。通过人物的倾斜和货架的水平线营造出一种安静而动态的构图。

质感与风格：
高清写实摄影。细致入微地刻画了自然的皮肤纹理、细小的绒毛、发丝、镂空纤维以及罗纹面料和蕾丝的细节。明亮的曝光，抑制了过曝的高光，低对比度，奶油般柔和的高光，以及淡雅的电影感色彩。呈现出类似于日本时尚杂志或美妆品牌 Lookbook 中干净快照的质感。

负面提示词：
不自然的面部、不自然的视线、过于幼态的外观、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手指粘连、与手机接触不自然、手臂或腿部扭曲、前倾姿势不自然、衣服悬空、包带断裂、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、可辨认的商品名称、乱码文字、Logo、水印、过度磨皮、塑料质感皮肤。

en.title: Fashion Week Candid Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a realistic fashion week runway portrait of an East Asian woman wearing high-end linen apparel.
en.prompt: Hyper-realistic fashion week portrait. An elegant adult East Asian woman walks toward the camera through an outdoor fashion show or high-end venue. Shot from head to mid-thigh; face in the upper-middle frame. Walking diagonally forward—one hip naturally shifting with the gait, right shoulder slightly forward, right arm hanging down, right hand relaxed near the bottom right corner. Slight sense of motion. Slender and dignified figure, warm light-to-medium skin tone, defined cheekbones, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, soft arched eyebrows, straight delicate nose, neutral rose-beige lip color. An expression that is {argument name="expression" default="dignified, confident, and quietly focused"}—gaze slightly past the camera to the left. Lips lightly closed, facial muscles relaxed. Exquisite, restrained makeup: glowing natural skin, light warm blush, subtle brown contouring, fine brown-grey eyeliner, neutral eyeshadow, satin nude lip color. Real pores, fine texture, small natural beauty marks, under-eye details, highlights on forehead/nose/cheekbones/collarbones. No over-editing. Hairstyle: A {argument name="hair style" default="neat and low-key low bun"}, slightly off-center front part, smooth hair swept behind ears. Very fine loose strands at temples, ears, and nape of neck catching warm side light. Modern, minimalist, editorial look. Outfit—Three-piece taupe-grey color scheme: A {argument name="outfit" default="fitted ribbed stone-grey tank top"}—wide round neckline, thin straps, fine vertical ribbing, slight torso tension, soft horizontal wrinkles at the waist. Ends near the waistband of the trousers, with only a very narrow sliver of skin showing on one side. A large, lightweight coat in a slightly warm grey-beige—wide lapels, lightly structured shoulders, long open front, sleeves pushed up to about three-quarter length. Thin washed linen, silk-linen, or micro-crinkled suit fabric: real wrinkles, fine weave, subtle sheen. One side of the coat swings out behind the right hand—suggesting forward motion and a breeze. High-waisted wide-leg trousers in a light mushroom brown-grey—wide waistband, belt loops, front pleats, flowing drape at the hips. Accurate tailoring, shallow pleats, soft diagonal tension lines, delicate fabric color variations. Trousers extend beyond the lower edge of the frame. Jewelry: Only tiny, low-key stud earrings. No necklaces, bracelets, handbags, sunglasses, or logos. Right hand: Long, relaxed fingers, natural joints, short nude glossy nails, gentle movement at fingertips. Scene: Sophisticated outdoor event space under a canopy or temporary structure. Foreground background: White tent wall, light-colored structural panels, vertical grey support column to the left of the head, large matte black rectangular speaker at the top right. Fashion week atmosphere, no readable brand identifiers. Middle and left background: Formally dressed audience and photographers—dark suits, black coats, and understated clothing, standing behind low metal barriers. All background figures anonymous and heavily blurred—blurred faces, dark silhouettes, raised hands, blurred camera equipment. Dark textured crowd background emphasizes light clothing and glowing skin. Lighting: Warm afternoon sun from slightly above the left front—golden highlights on the left forehead, cheek, nose, neck, collarbone, upper chest, coat lapel, and forearm. Soft, detailed shadows on the opposite side. Restrained rim light along the hairline, ears, shoulders, and swinging edges of the coat. Natural directional warmth; no orange tints. Tones: Mushroom grey, warm tan, stone beige, charcoal, black, cream white, soft skin tones. Honey-gold sunlight highlights on skin and fabric. Medium contrast, rich open shadows, smooth highlight transitions, natural saturation. Camera: Chest height, full frame 85mm, f/2–f/2.8. Shutter speed fast enough to freeze face and upper body while maintaining slight movement in the coat. Eyes/face/ribbed top/lapels/forearms sharp and clear; crowd/barriers/tents/equipment dissolved into soft bokeh. Fashion week snapshot: minimal luxury, effortless tailoring, confident motion, analog film grain, gentle lens softening, magazine quality. Negative: No text, no logos, no watermarks, no brand names, no sharp-focused extra people, no deformed hands, no extra fingers, no duplicate limbs, no deformed clothing, no exaggerated proportions, no plastic skin, no harsh flash, no artificial HDR, no oversaturated colors, no messy elements obstructing the person.

zh.title: 时装周抓拍肖像
zh.description: 一个高细节提示词，用于生成一张写实的东亚女性身着高端亚麻服装的时装周走秀肖像。
zh.prompt: 超写实时装周肖像。一位优雅的成年东亚女性正走向镜头，背景为户外时装秀或高端场地。拍摄范围从头部到大腿中部；面部位于画面中上方。身体斜向前方行走——臀部随步伐自然摆动，右肩略微前倾，右臂自然下垂，右手放松地靠近右下角。带有轻微的动感。身材修长端庄，肤色为暖色调至中等色调，颧骨轮廓分明，杏仁状深棕色双眼，眉毛呈柔和的拱形，鼻梁挺拔精致，唇色为中性玫瑰米色。表情为 {argument name="expression" default="端庄、自信且专注"}——目光略微越过镜头看向左侧。双唇微闭，面部肌肉放松。精致且克制的妆容：透出自然光泽的肌肤，淡淡的暖色腮红，细腻的棕色修容，精致的棕灰色眼线，中性色眼影，缎面裸色唇膏。呈现真实的毛孔、细腻的纹理、天然小痣、眼下细节，以及额头、鼻梁、颧骨和锁骨上的高光。无过度修图。发型：{argument name="hair style" default="整洁低调的低发髻"}，前额发际线略微偏分，柔顺的头发梳至耳后。鬓角、耳边和颈后的细碎发丝在暖侧光下清晰可见。现代、极简、杂志大片风格。服装——三件套灰褐色系：{argument name="outfit" default="修身罗纹石灰色背心"}——宽圆领，细肩带，细腻的竖向罗纹，躯干处略带紧绷感，腰部有柔和的横向褶皱。背心下摆位于裤腰附近，仅露出一小片侧腰肌肤。一件轻盈的灰米色大衣——宽翻领，肩部线条自然，前襟敞开，袖子推至约七分袖长度。材质为轻薄水洗亚麻、丝麻或微皱西装面料：呈现真实的褶皱、细腻的织纹和微妙的光泽。大衣的一侧随右手摆动向后飘起——暗示着向前的动感和微风。高腰阔腿裤，呈浅蘑菇棕灰色——宽腰头，带腰带环，前褶设计，臀部垂坠感极佳。剪裁精准，褶皱柔和，带有细腻的斜向张力线，面料色彩过渡自然。裤脚延伸至画面下方之外。配饰：仅佩戴极小的低调耳钉。无项链、手链、手提包、墨镜或 Logo。右手：手指修长放松，关节自然，短款裸色亮面指甲，指尖动作轻柔。场景：位于遮阳棚或临时结构下的精致户外活动空间。前景与背景：白色帐篷墙面，浅色结构板，头部左侧有一根垂直的灰色支撑柱，右上角有一个大型哑光黑色长方形扬声器。时装周氛围，无可见的品牌标识。中景和左侧背景：身着正装的观众和摄影师——穿着深色西装、黑色大衣等低调服装，站在低矮的金属护栏后。所有背景人物均匿名且高度模糊——面部模糊、深色剪影、举起的手、模糊的摄影器材。深色纹理的背景人群凸显了浅色服装和透亮的肤色。光线：左前方略高处的午后暖阳——左额头、脸颊、鼻梁、颈部、锁骨、上胸部、大衣翻领和前臂上呈现金色高光。对侧有柔和且富有细节的阴影。发际线、耳朵、肩膀和大衣摆动边缘有克制的轮廓光。自然的定向暖光；无橙色色调。色调：蘑菇灰、暖棕褐色、石米色、炭黑、黑色、奶油白，以及柔和的肤色。皮肤和织物上带有蜂蜜金色的阳光高光。中等对比度，丰富的暗部细节，平滑的高光过渡，自然的饱和度。相机：胸部高度，全画幅 85mm 镜头，f/2–f/2.8 光圈。快门速度足以定格面部和上半身，同时保持大衣的轻微动感。眼睛、面部、罗纹背心、翻领和前臂清晰锐利；人群、护栏、帐篷和设备溶解在柔和的焦外成像中。时装周抓拍：极简奢华，随性剪裁，自信动态，模拟胶片颗粒感，柔和的镜头虚化，杂志级画质。负面提示词：无文字，无 Logo，无水印，无品牌名称，无焦点清晰的额外人物，无畸形手部，无多余手指，无重复肢体，无变形服装，无夸张比例，无塑料感皮肤，无强闪光，无人工 HDR，无过饱和色彩，无遮挡人物的杂乱元素。

en.title: Night Rainy Tropical Forest Portrait
en.description: A cinematic and highly detailed fashion editorial prompt for a woman standing in a night-time tropical rainforest under heavy rain, surrounded by lush banana leaves.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Arms embracing tropical rain"}

Main Subject:
Depict a single adult woman being hit by rain in a tropical rainforest at night. The person stands slightly to the left of the center, in a vertical three-quarter portrait from the top of the head to the middle of the thighs. The person occupies about 70% of the screen, surrounded by huge wet banana leaves above and to the right.

Person/Expression:
A well-featured woman with natural skin texture. Her black hair is wet from the rain and tied back low, with thin strands of hair sticking to her forehead, cheeks, and neck. Her face is slightly tilted to the left, her eyes are quietly closed, and her lips are slightly open in a calm expression. A relaxed atmosphere, as if surrendering to the sound of the rain.

Clothing/Pose:
A {argument name="outfit" default="pale greige rib camisole with thin shoulder straps"} and {argument name="bottoms" default="black cut-off denim shorts"}. The clothes are wet from the rain, showing the fibers and natural wrinkles of the fabric. The hem of the camisole rests lightly above the abdomen, and the shorts sit naturally along the hip bones. Both arms are crossed in front of the chest, with the person's own right forearm over the left forearm. The right hand is hidden inside the upper left arm, and the left hand lightly grasps the fabric near the right flank. Must have exactly two arms and one hand on each side.

Background/Light:
Place large banana leaves in the foreground and background, with fine raindrops and water streaks on the leaf surfaces. The background is a deep black-green, creating depth through overlapping leaves. Fine rain falls diagonally, and water drops from the tips of the leaves. The main light is a somewhat hard, warm light from the upper left, creating wet reflections on the face, collarbones, shoulders, arms, and abdomen. Add a weak rim light from the rear right to separate the hair and leaf contours. Shadows are kept deep, with only skin reflections emerging from the darkness.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 2:3 ratio. The camera is at eye level near chest height, with a natural perspective equivalent to 50mm. Leaves spread horizontally above the person's head, and a large leaf in the lower right creates a diagonal flow. Focus accurately on the person's face, blurring the background softly. Some raindrops receive light in the foreground, creating three-dimensional depth.

Texture/Style:
Realistic fashion editorial photography. Precisely depict wet skin, hair, ribbed fabric, denim, and leaf surfaces. Avoid excessive skin retouching, leaving pores and fine water droplets naturally. Low-saturation color palette centered on black-green and skin tones, deep contrast, subtle film grain, and a quiet, heavy night atmosphere.

Negative:
Extra arms, extra hands, duplicated fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, unnatural joints, confusion of left and right arms, unnatural chest, clothing failure, floating cloth, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, text, logo, watermark.

zh.title: 雨夜热带雨林人像
zh.description: 这是一组电影感极强且细节丰富的时尚大片提示词，描绘了一位女性在雨夜的热带雨林中，身处茂密芭蕉叶丛下的场景。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="双臂拥抱热带雨"}

主要对象：
描绘一名成年女性在雨夜的热带雨林中淋雨的场景。人物位于画面中心偏左，采用从头顶到大腿中部的竖构图四分之三肖像。人物占据画面约 70% 的比例，周围被上方和右侧巨大的湿润芭蕉叶环绕。

人物/表情：
一位五官精致、皮肤质感自然的女性。她的黑发被雨水打湿并低扎在脑后，几缕发丝贴在额头、脸颊和颈部。脸部微微向左倾斜，双眼静静闭合，双唇微张，神情平静。营造出一种仿佛沉浸在雨声中的放松氛围。

服装/姿势：
身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="浅灰褐色细肩带罗纹吊带衫"} 和 {argument name="bottoms" default="黑色牛仔短裤"}。衣物被雨水打湿，显露出纤维质感和自然的褶皱。吊带衫下摆轻落在腹部上方，短裤自然地贴合在髋骨处。双臂在胸前交叉，右前臂叠在左前臂之上。右手隐藏在左上臂内侧，左手轻轻抓着右侧腰部的衣料。必须确保准确呈现双臂，且每侧各有一只手。

背景/光影：
前景和背景布置巨大的芭蕉叶，叶片表面带有细密的雨滴和水痕。背景为深黑绿色，通过重叠的叶片营造出空间深度。细雨斜向飘落，水珠从叶尖滴落。主光源为来自左上方的略硬暖光，在脸部、锁骨、肩膀、手臂和腹部形成湿润的反光。在右后方添加微弱的轮廓光，以勾勒出头发和叶片的边缘。阴影保持深邃，仅有皮肤的反光从黑暗中显现。

构图/摄影：
竖构图 2:3 比例。相机位于视平线高度（约胸部位置），采用等效 50mm 镜头的自然视角。叶片在人物头顶上方横向展开，右下角的一片大叶子形成对角线流向。焦点准确对准人物面部，背景柔和虚化。前景中部分雨滴受光，营造出三维立体感。

质感/风格：
写实时尚摄影风格。精准刻画湿润的皮肤、发丝、罗纹面料、牛仔布和叶片表面。避免过度磨皮，保留毛孔和细小的水珠质感。以黑绿色和肤色为主的低饱和度色调，对比度深，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感，营造出静谧而沉重的雨夜氛围。

负面提示词：
多余的手臂、多余的手、重复的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、不自然的关节、左右臂混淆、不自然的胸部、服装故障、漂浮的衣物、与光源不一致的阴影、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Gold-Leaf Mineral-Pigment Oriental Illustration
en.description: An elaborate prompt for generating high-quality oriental digital illustrations in a gold-leaf mineral-pigment style, featuring an ethereal goddess in a serene landscape.
en.prompt:
9:16 vertical, high-completion green-blue landscape goddess gold-leaf mineral-pigment digital illustration, {argument name="style description" default="modern oriental gold-leaf mineral-pigment female illustration"}, exquisite oriental female digital painting, mineral-pigment layers, irregular real gold-leaf craftsmanship, combining oriental decorative flat aesthetics with a sense of depth and space.

The main subject is a clearly adult young oriental woman, visual age approximately 20–28, with the identity of a {argument name="character role" default="landscape goddess"}, whose temperament is cool, ethereal, noble, transcendent, quiet, and detached. The figure uses a half-body close-up and a slightly side-facing composition, with the body leaning toward one side of the frame and the face in a three-quarter profile, not looking at the camera, gaze naturally lowered, with a calm and restrained expression, as if looking at the mountains and rivers in the distance or lost in thought.

The figure has an exquisite oriental digital illustration face, a soft small oval face, a full forehead, slender and smooth facial contours, a delicate and three-dimensional mid-face, and a soft and clear jawline. The eyes are long and bright, with the corners slightly upturned, pupils containing restrained highlights, eyebrows finely and comfortably arched, the bridge of the nose delicate and smooth, the lip shape soft and exquisite, with the mouth slightly open, and overall the features are delicate, clean, restrained, and pleasant to look at, with the texture of a high-completion oriental semi-realistic digital illustration figure face.

The facial features emphasize soft and smooth oriental contours, long and bright eyes, a delicate bridge of the nose, soft lip shape, and a clean and transparent skin surface, retaining only the refined digital illustration-style facial sculpting, without using a noticeable 3D CG modeling feel, avoiding plastic highlights, waxy feel, heavy mural-like face, or rough grain covering the face.

The hairstyle is an ethereal half-pinned long hair, with jet-black long hair falling smoothly, clear bun structure, and some strands of hair gently blown by the mountain breeze, creating a natural sense of flow. The headwear is a restrained and exquisite gold-leaf flower branch headpiece, paired with white jade flower ornaments, emerald hairpins, fine small gold tassels, and jade earrings, with a light and layered structure that does not block the facial features, without excessive gemstone piling, and not turning into an opera-style large crown or a magnificent queen-style headpiece.

The makeup uses a jade-white transparent base, with the skin surface being delicate and clean, having a slight soft glow but without excessive skin smoothing; the eye makeup is light stone blue and pale green mineral eyeshadow, with a small amount of indigo blue added to the corners of the eyes and softly elongated, a very fine pale gold highlight used in the inner corner of the eye, a restrained and fine pale gold flower mark decorating the center of the forehead, and the lip color is between soft bean paste pink and light coral, with a delicate moist luster. The makeup is clear and visible, but not modern or influencer-style, and not heavy Western makeup.

The figure wears a layered ancient-style long dress of peacock green, emerald green, and moon white, with the inner layers being jade white and moon white silk, and the outer layer being high-purity peacock green and turquoise light gauze; the clothing has a waist-cinching structure, showing a natural and elegant body proportion. The fabric consists of silk, silk cloth, brocade, and light gauze, soft and draping, with natural folds and wide, light sleeves. The surface of the clothing incorporates green-blue landscape patterns, distant mountain patterns, flowing cloud patterns, mineral-vein-like gold threads, and local gold-leaf collages; the gold texture is naturally distributed along the edges of the clothing, sleeves, waist seal, and the outlines of the landscape patterns, but always maintains a real fabric feel, not turning into hard metal or armor.

The scene is a {argument name="scene" default="high mountain water pavilion and green-blue landscape hidden realm"}, with the figure standing by a waterside building or wooden railing, with layered distant mountains, emerald-colored peaks, clear lake water, waterfalls, streams, distant ancient pavilions, and a sea of clouds unfolding behind. The nearby mountains use rich malachite green, turquoise, stone blue, and deep ink green, the mid-ground mountain bodies retain clear hues and mineral pigment layers, and the distant mountains naturally recede through local clean thin mist, but do not fade into gray-white.

The background has a high-saturation green-blue mineral mineral-pigment texture, with the edges of the mountains, water flows, cloud vapor, pavilion outlines, and parts of the frame locally incorporating irregular gold leaf. The gold leaf shows real foil edges, particles, cracks, slight folds, mottling, and micro-relief undulations, and has levels of bright gold, warm gold, ancient gold, and dark gold. The gold leaf passes through the frame edges, mountain ridges, sea of clouds, clothing patterns, and architectural details like natural mineral veins and flowing mountain and river textures; it is not ordinary yellow outlining, and not cheap glitter.

The overall system uses a green-blue gold-leaf mineral-pigment scheme, high saturation, high contrast, and clear colors. The main colors are malachite green, emerald green, stone blue, turquoise, and deep ink green, with auxiliary colors of moon white, jade white, pale green, and a small amount of black-blue, and metallic colors of bright gold, warm gold, and ancient gold. The image establishes clear brightness zones: the character's skin tone, moon white lining, and local cloud layers are high brightness; peacock green clothing and green-blue mountain bodies are high-saturation medium brightness; black hair, wooden buildings, deep ink-green nearby mountains, and local structures form a stable dark part; gold leaf forms local high-brightness reflections. The bright parts are clear and transparent, the dark parts are rich and stable, and the intermediate colors do not turn gray.

The light uses soft side-front light to illuminate the character's face, creating delicate and clean light and dark transitions on the forehead, bridge of the nose, under the eyes, lips, and neck; at the same time, low-angle gold-leaf grazing light and slight side-backlight are used to sweep across the headpiece, hair strands, clothing gold threads, mountain ridges, and sea of clouds, causing the gold leaf to produce fine and bright metallic reflections. The figure's skin tone remains jade-white and natural, gold reflections do not contaminate the skin color, and the eyes retain clear and restrained highlights.

The composition has a modern oriental poster feel, with the character occupying the main visual area of the frame, the face located near the upper golden ratio, long hair and wide sleeves forming vertical flow lines, and distant mountains, lake surfaces, and pavilions extending into the depths of the frame. Irregular gold-leaf flow patterns and mineral mineral-pigment textures can be added to the edges of the frame as a decorative frame, but do not block the character's face.

The overall effect should be exquisite, magnificent, cool, ethereal, poetic, and restrained, with high-purity mineral pigment concentration, a sense of real gold-leaf craftsmanship, oriental landscape artistic conception, and high-completion digital illustration figure performance. Maintain the main style of ancient-style female gold-leaf mineral-pigment, without turning into ordinary ancient-style photography, obvious 3D CG character rendering, cheap immortal-hero game character art, opera crown palace posters, butterfly phantom queen themes, or stage-style warm gold dreamscapes.

Negative constraints: underage, juvenile, child face, exaggerated anime big eyes, influencer face, Western plastic surgery face, obvious 3D CG, plastic skin, waxy face, heavy mural face, rough particles covering features, blurred features, dull eyes, gold pasted all over face, gold leaf covering face, ordinary yellow outlining, cheap glitter, overall yellowish image, overall grayish-green image, low-saturation gray-green filter, faded old painting feel, large area of gray-white mist, character and background merging in color, dark parts not deep enough, highlights not bright enough, opera large crown, gemstone headpiece piling, butterfly theme, strong glowing wings, stage spotlight, warm gold palace background, clothing armored, hard metal fabric, crowded background, architecture overshadowing subject, text, watermark, logo, finger deformity, limb errors, floating accessories.

zh.title: 金箔矿物颜料风格东方插画
zh.description: 一套用于生成高质量东方数字插画的详细提示词，采用金箔矿物颜料风格，描绘了宁静山水间超凡脱俗的女神形象。
zh.prompt:
9:16 竖构图，高完成度青绿山水女神金箔矿物颜料数字插画，{argument name="style description" default="现代东方金箔矿物颜料女性插画"}，精致的东方女性数字绘画，矿物颜料层叠，不规则真金箔工艺，结合东方装饰性平面美学与空间纵深感。

主体为清晰的成年东方年轻女性，视觉年龄约 20–28 岁，身份为 {argument name="character role" default="山水女神"}，气质清冷、空灵、高贵、超脱、静谧且疏离。人物采用半身特写及微侧身构图，身体倾向画面一侧，面部呈四分之三侧脸，不直视镜头，视线自然下垂，神情平静克制，仿佛在远眺山河或陷入沉思。

人物拥有精致的东方数字插画脸型，柔和的小鹅蛋脸，额头饱满，面部轮廓纤细流畅，中庭精致立体，下颌线柔和清晰。双眼细长明亮，眼角微翘，瞳孔内含克制的亮光，眉毛修剪得体，鼻梁精致平滑，唇形柔美精致，微张，整体五官精致、干净、克制且耐看，具有高完成度东方半写实数字插画人物面部的质感。

面部特征强调柔和流畅的东方轮廓、细长明亮的双眼、精致的鼻梁、柔和的唇形以及干净通透的皮肤表面，仅保留精致的数字插画风格面部雕刻，不使用明显的 3D CG 建模感，避免塑料高光、蜡质感、厚重的壁画感面部或覆盖面部的粗糙颗粒。

发型为灵动的半盘长发，乌黑长发顺滑垂落，发髻结构清晰，几缕发丝被山风轻轻吹拂，营造出自然的流动感。头饰为克制而精致的金箔花枝发饰，搭配白玉花朵点缀、翠玉发簪、细小金流苏及玉质耳坠，结构轻盈且有层次，不遮挡五官，无过度堆砌的宝石，不变成戏曲式大凤冠或华丽的皇后式头饰。

妆容采用玉白通透底妆，皮肤表面细腻干净，带有微弱柔光但无过度磨皮；眼妆为浅石青与淡绿矿物眼影，眼角加入少量靛青并柔和拉长，眼头使用极细的淡金高光，额间饰有克制精致的淡金花钿，唇色介于柔豆沙粉与浅珊瑚色之间，带有细腻的润泽感。妆容清晰可见，但不现代、不网红风，亦非厚重的欧美妆。

人物身着孔雀绿、翠绿与月白色的叠层古风长裙，内层为玉白与月白丝绸，外层为高纯度孔雀绿与绿松石色轻纱；服装采用收腰结构，展现自然优雅的身材比例。面料由丝绸、绢布、锦缎与轻纱组成，柔软垂坠，褶皱自然，袖口宽大轻盈。服装表面融入青绿山水纹样、远山纹、流云纹、矿脉般的金线以及局部金箔拼贴；金纹沿服装边缘、袖口、腰封及山水纹样轮廓自然分布，始终保持真实布料质感，不变成坚硬的金属或盔甲。

场景为 {argument name="scene" default="高山水榭与青绿山水秘境"}，人物立于水边建筑或木质栏杆旁，身后展开层叠的远山、翠色峰峦、清澈湖水、瀑布溪流、远方古亭与云海。近处山体运用丰富的石绿、绿松石色、石青与深墨绿，中景山体保留清晰的色相与矿物颜料层，远山通过局部干净的薄雾自然退远，但不泛灰白。

背景具有高饱和度的青绿矿物颜料质感，山体边缘、水流、云气、亭台轮廓及画面局部融入不规则金箔。金箔呈现真实的箔边、颗粒、裂纹、细微褶皱、斑驳与微浮雕起伏，具有亮金、暖金、古金与暗金的层次。金箔穿插于画面边缘、山脊、云海、衣纹与建筑细节中，如同自然的矿脉与流动的山河纹理；非普通黄色勾边，亦非廉价闪粉。

整体系统采用青绿金箔矿物颜料配色，高饱和度、高对比度，色彩清晰。主色为石绿、翠绿、石青、绿松石色与深墨绿，辅色为月白、玉白、淡绿及少量黑蓝，金属色为亮金、暖金与古金。画面建立清晰的亮度分区：人物肤色、月白内衬与局部云层为高亮度；孔雀绿服装与青绿山体为高饱和度中亮度；黑发、木质建筑、深墨绿近山与局部结构形成稳定的暗部；金箔形成局部高亮度反光。亮部清晰通透，暗部丰富稳定，中间色不发灰。

光影使用柔和的前侧光照亮人物面部，在额头、鼻梁、眼下、唇部与颈部形成细腻干净的光影过渡；同时使用低角度金箔侧逆光扫过头饰、发丝、衣纹金线、山脊与云海，使金箔产生细碎明亮的金属反光。人物肤色保持玉白自然，金光反射不污染肤色，双眼保留清晰克制的亮光。

构图具有现代东方海报感，人物占据画面主要视觉区，面部位于上方黄金分割点附近，长发与宽袖形成竖向流动线条，远山、湖面与亭台向画面深处延伸。画面边缘可添加不规则金箔流纹与矿物颜料质感作为装饰框，但不遮挡人物面部。

整体效果应精致、宏大、清冷、空灵、诗意且克制，具备高纯度矿物颜料浓度、真实的金箔工艺感、东方山水意境以及高完成度数字插画人物表现。保持古风女性金箔矿物颜料的主风格，不变成普通的古风摄影、明显的 3D CG 人物渲染、廉价仙侠网游角色美术、戏曲凤冠宫廷海报、蝴蝶幻影女王主题或舞台式暖金梦境。

负面约束：未成年、幼态、童颜、夸张动漫大眼、网红脸、西式整容脸、明显 3D CG、塑料皮肤、蜡质脸、厚重壁画脸、覆盖五官的粗糙颗粒、五官模糊、眼神呆滞、满脸贴金、金箔遮脸、普通黄色勾边、廉价闪粉、整体发黄、整体灰绿色、低饱和度灰绿滤镜、陈旧古画感、大面积灰白雾气、人物与背景色彩融合、暗部不够深、高光不够亮、戏曲大凤冠、宝石头饰堆砌、蝴蝶主题、强发光翅膀、舞台聚光灯、暖金宫廷背景、服装盔甲化、硬金属面料、背景杂乱、建筑喧宾夺主、文字、水印、Logo、手指畸形、肢体错误、浮空配饰。

en.title: Elegant Floral Portrait with Morning Light
en.description: A highly detailed fashion portrait prompt for a woman standing behind a large bouquet, featuring soft morning light and an editorial aesthetic.
en.prompt: Subject: {argument name="theme" default="Sigh behind a bouquet"} Main subject: Vertical 3:4 indoor fashion portrait. A glass vase containing a large bouquet of {argument name="flower colors" default="ivory and apricot"} flowers is placed in the foreground at the center of the screen, with a woman standing behind it. The bouquet occupies a large portion from the bottom to the center of the screen, naturally covering the person's chest and torso. The person is placed slightly above the center, with only the face, neck, shoulders, and both hands visible above the bouquet. Person/Expression: A natural and elegant woman in her {argument name="age" default="early 20s"}. Bright ivory-beige white skin with a hint of rose color. Delicate highlights of window light on the cheeks, tip of the nose, and collarbone. The face is turned slightly to the right of the screen, the chin is slightly raised, and the gaze is dropped diagonally below the bouquet. The mouth is slightly open, with a calm expression as if quietly breathing out. Faint rose blush, pink-brown eye makeup, natural tear bags, thin eyelashes, and translucent pink-beige lips. Clothing/Pose: Bright milk tea ash brown medium-long hair. Thin see-through bangs and layers around the face, with the ends curled inward loosely. Fine flyaway hairs follow the cheeks and neck, softly translucent one by one in the backlight. A {argument name="clothing" default="white thin robe"} is spread softly from both shoulders, and the person's own left and right hands lightly pinch the edges of the collar. Elveos are gently open outward, a natural posture with shoulders relaxed. The chest is completely covered by the dense flowers and the robe, with no underwear or shoulder straps visible. Background/Light: Behind are floor-to-ceiling windows, white sheer curtains, and thick beige-brown curtains on the left and right. Warm morning sunlight enters from the upper left of the screen, creating a golden border on the hair's outline, shoulders, and cheeks. Soft reflected light from the curtains is placed in front of the face, the background is bright, and the left and right are calm dark areas. The bouquet consists of ivory, apricot, and pale beige garden roses, ranunculus, small flowers, and dark green leaves. Composition/Camera: Frontal shot from a height slightly lower than the person's waist. In the foreground is a polished dark wood round table, with a transparent egg-shaped glass vase and a black pedestal in the center. The stems and water surface in the vase are clearly shown. A wide bright margin is left above the person's head, and the left and right curtains form a vertical frame. 85mm equivalent, slight compression, focus on the face and center of the bouquet, background smoothly blurred. Texture/Style: Realistic editorial photo as if taken in a luxury hotel room. Natural skin texture, soft film grain, modest contrast, and warm cream tones. Meticulously depicts the overlapping petals, the gloss of the leaves, the refraction of the glass, and the thin fabric of the robe. Negative: Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, confusion of left and right hands, fusion with arms or flowers, deformed vase, floating flowers, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 优雅花卉肖像与晨光
zh.description: 一个高度细致的时尚肖像提示词，描绘了一位站在大束花艺后的女性，呈现柔和的晨光与杂志大片质感。
zh.prompt: 主体：{argument name="theme" default="花束后的叹息"} 主要主体：垂直 3:4 室内时尚肖像。画面中央前景放置着一个装有 {argument name="flower colors" default="象牙白与杏色"} 花卉的大型花束，一位女性站在花束后。花束占据了从画面底部到中心的大部分空间，自然地遮挡了人物的胸部和躯干。人物位于画面中心偏上方，仅露出脸部、颈部、肩膀以及双手。人物/表情：一位 {argument name="age" default="20 岁出头"} 的自然优雅女性。明亮的象牙米白色皮肤，透着一丝玫瑰色泽。脸颊、鼻尖和锁骨处有细腻的窗光高光。脸部略微转向画面右侧，下巴微抬，目光斜向下落在花束下方。嘴唇微张，表情平静，仿佛在静静呼气。淡淡的玫瑰色腮红，粉棕色眼妆，自然的卧蚕，纤细的睫毛，以及半透明的粉米色嘴唇。服装/姿势：明亮的奶茶灰棕色中长发。轻薄的透视刘海和脸部周围的层次感，发梢向内自然卷曲。细碎的绒毛沿着脸颊和颈部散落，在逆光下呈现出柔和的半透明感。身上穿着一件 {argument name="clothing" default="白色薄长袍"}，从双肩自然垂下，双手轻轻捏住领口边缘。肘部向外自然张开，肩膀放松。胸部被茂密的花朵和长袍完全遮盖，没有露出内衣或肩带。背景/光影：背景为落地窗、白色薄纱窗帘，左右两侧为厚实的米棕色窗帘。温暖的晨光从画面左上方射入，在头发轮廓、肩膀和脸颊上形成金色的光边。窗帘的柔和反射光投射在脸部前方，背景明亮，左右两侧为沉稳的暗部。花束由象牙白、杏色和浅米色的花园玫瑰、洋牡丹、小花以及深绿色叶片组成。构图/相机：从略低于人物腰部的高度进行正面拍摄。前景是一张抛光的深色圆木桌，中央放着一个透明的蛋形玻璃花瓶和一个黑色底座。花瓶中的花茎和水面清晰可见。人物头顶留有宽阔的明亮留白，左右两侧的窗帘形成垂直框架。85mm 等效焦距，轻微压缩感，焦点对准脸部和花束中心，背景平滑虚化。质感/风格：如同在豪华酒店房间拍摄的写实杂志大片。自然的皮肤纹理，柔和的胶片颗粒感，适中的对比度，以及温暖的奶油色调。细腻地描绘了层叠的花瓣、叶片的质感、玻璃的折射以及长袍的轻薄面料。负面提示词：不自然的脸部、不自然的目光、过度的皮肤修饰、塑料感皮肤、多余的手指、缺失的手指、左右手混淆、与手臂或花朵融合、变形的花瓶、漂浮的花朵、错误的透视、与光源不一致的阴影、乱码、Logo、水印。

en.title: Urban Apartment Room Portrait
en.description: A realistic fashion portrait prompt set in a Japanese urban apartment, utilizing low-angle composition and natural window light for a high-end look.
en.prompt: Subject: {argument name="theme" default="Morning overlooking"} Main subject: A realistic fashion portrait in 9:16 vertical format of an adult woman standing in the living room of a Japanese urban apartment with both arms raised behind her head, viewed from a position close to the floor. The person occupies a large part of the center of the screen, with the waist and thighs in the foreground and the face and upper body at the top of the screen. The legs are naturally cropped at the bottom edge, giving the person a dignified and mature presence. Person/Expression: {argument name="person" default="A woman with a calm and mature vibe"}. A healthy and mature body type with natural roundness and definition. Long dark brown hair with thin see-through bangs and soft layers around the face. The ends of the hair sway lightly, creating a natural Japanese-style look. Makeup consists of pink-brown eyeshadow, natural tear bags, fine brown eyeliner, modest rose blush, and a pink-beige lip with suppressed gloss. She tucks her chin slightly and quietly looks down at the lens. Her eyebrows and mouth are relaxed, with a calm and confident expression. Clothing/Pose: {argument name="tops" default="White ribbed cropped wrap top"}. The neckline is a natural V-neck that is not too deep, with a design where the front overlaps diagonally. The bottom is a {argument name="bottoms" default="navy swim bottom with side ribbons"}. The fabric is not transparent and is an elegant cut that naturally wraps the hip bones. The person's own arms are bent behind her head, with elbows open to the upper left and right. Naturally stretches from shoulders to armpits and waist, tilting the pelvis slightly to the right of the screen. Weight is placed on one leg, with the other knee slightly relaxed. Accurately depicts the stretch of the top, the overlap of the hem, and the knot and drape of the side ribbons according to gravity. Background/Light: A living room in a Japanese apartment based on bright beige and wood grain. To the left is a large window with black sashes and white thin curtains, and a charcoal gray sofa in the lower left foreground. In the right background are a thin tripod floor lamp, a low wooden cabinet, and a small houseplant. Outside the window is a blurred urban housing complex. Soft natural daylight from the window on the left enters, brightly illuminating the contours of the face, chest, abdomen, and left leg. Faint shadows are left on the right side, with weak warm-colored reflected light returning from the wooden furniture. The ceiling is slightly dark, creating a light-dark composition that draws the eye to the person. Composition/Camera: Vertical 9:16. The camera is placed at a low position about 40-60cm from the floor and aimed slightly upward. 24-28mm equivalent wide-angle lens. The waist and thighs are placed large from the center to the bottom of the screen, and the face is kept in the upper center. A narrow margin is left above the head, and margins large enough for the arm contours are left on the left and right. While showing the legs in the foreground large, the body proportions are kept natural. The focus is on the face and upper body, and the background is lightly blurred. Gives a sense of realism like a wide-angle smartphone photo, while avoiding extreme distortion. Texture/Style: Realistic photographic expression. Clearly depicts natural skin texture, fine downy hair, soft shadows on the abdomen and legs, and the difference between the rib fabric and swim material. A low-saturation color scheme centered on white, navy, charcoal gray, and pale wood grain. Avoids excessive skin correction or artificial gloss, aiming for the texture of a high-quality fashion snap taken in an everyday indoor setting. Outlines are not too sharp, emphasizing soft three-dimensionality from natural light. Negative: Minors, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, transparent clothing, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of arms or legs, broken joints, extreme wide-angle distortion, unnatural body type, floating side ribbons, poor contact with clothing, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin.

zh.title: 都市公寓室内人像
zh.description: 一套以日本都市公寓为背景的写实时尚人像提示词，采用低角度构图和自然窗光，营造高端质感。
zh.prompt: 主体：{argument name="theme" default="晨间俯瞰"} 主要对象：一张 9:16 竖构图的写实时尚人像，一位成年女性站在日本都市公寓的客厅中，双臂抬起置于脑后，视角位于靠近地面的位置。人物占据画面中心大部分区域，腰部和大腿位于前景，面部和上半身位于画面顶部。双腿在底部边缘自然裁切，赋予人物端庄成熟的气质。人物/表情：{argument name="person" default="一位气质沉稳成熟的女性"}。健康成熟的体型，带有自然的圆润感和线条感。深棕色长发，配有轻薄的空气刘海，脸部周围有柔和的层次感。发梢轻微摆动，营造出自然的日系风格。妆容包括粉棕色眼影、自然的卧蚕、精致的棕色眼线、适度的玫瑰色腮红，以及光泽感内敛的粉米色唇妆。她微微收下巴，安静地俯视镜头。眉眼和嘴唇放松，表情从容自信。服装/姿势：{argument name="tops" default="白色罗纹短款裹身上衣"}。领口为自然的 V 领，深度适中，采用前襟斜向交叠的设计。下装为 {argument name="bottoms" default="带有侧边系带的海军蓝泳裤"}。面料不透明，剪裁优雅，自然包裹髋骨。人物双臂弯曲置于脑后，手肘向左上方和右上方打开。从肩膀到腋下及腰部自然伸展，骨盆向画面右侧轻微倾斜。重心放在一条腿上，另一侧膝盖微屈。根据重力准确描绘上衣的拉伸感、下摆的重叠以及侧边系带的结扣与垂坠感。背景/光影：以明亮的米色和木纹为基调的日本公寓客厅。左侧是一扇带有黑色窗框和白色薄纱窗帘的大窗户，左下方前景处有一张炭灰色沙发。右侧背景中有一个细长的三脚落地灯、一个低矮的木质柜子和一盆小型室内植物。窗外是模糊的都市住宅区。左侧窗户射入柔和的自然日光，明亮地照亮了面部轮廓、胸部、腹部和左腿。右侧留下淡淡的阴影，木质家具反射出微弱的暖色光。天花板略暗，营造出将视线引向人物的明暗构图。构图/相机：竖向 9:16。相机放置在距离地面约 40-60 厘米的低位，略微仰拍。24-28mm 等效广角镜头。腰部和大腿从画面中心到底部占据较大比例，面部保持在上方中心。头顶留有少量留白，左右两侧留有足够的空间以容纳手臂轮廓。在前景突出双腿的同时，保持自然的人体比例。焦点对准面部和上半身，背景轻微虚化。带来如同广角智能手机拍摄般的真实感，同时避免极端的畸变。质感/风格：写实摄影表现。清晰描绘自然的皮肤纹理、细微的绒毛、腹部和腿部的柔和阴影，以及罗纹面料与泳装材质的区别。以白色、海军蓝、炭灰色和浅木纹为中心的低饱和度配色方案。避免过度的皮肤修饰或人工光泽，旨在呈现日常室内环境中拍摄的高品质时尚快照质感。轮廓不过于锐利，强调自然光带来的柔和立体感。负面提示词：未成年人、不自然的面部、不自然的视线、透明服装、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手臂或腿部融合、关节断裂、极端广角畸变、不自然的体型、漂浮的侧边系带、服装接触不良、不自然的重力、错误的透视、与光源不一致的阴影、文字、Logo、水印、过度的皮肤修饰、塑料质感的皮肤。
