zh.title: 水族馆森林中的小女孩
zh.description: 一个充满魔力的提示词，描绘了一个小女孩手提发光灯笼，在水族馆内的水下森林中探索的场景。
zh.prompt: 一个 {argument name="character" default="小女孩"} 正在探索水族馆森林，手中拿着一个 {argument name="item" default="发光的海洋玻璃灯笼"}。

en.title: Cinematic Oriental Shadow Portrait
en.description: A sophisticated prompt for a high-contrast cinematic portrait featuring a Japanese kimono and a folding fan, using dramatic chiaroscuro lighting.
en.prompt: [Person] Image 1 [Signature] In the bottom right corner, a small Threads logo operated by Meta is located, and above it, "CHAse" is written small in white cursive like a signature. [Pose and Expression] Pose and Composition: A medium bust shot centered on the front, sensually capturing the upper body, the right shoulder line, and the shape of the fan held in the hand. Posture: Wearing the garment naturally falling to reveal the right shoulder, holding a fully unfolded black folding fan in the left hand, slightly covering the left side of the face. The upper body and head are slightly tilted to emphasize the slender neckline and collarbone. Expression: A static gaze looking indifferently down to the left rather than straight ahead. The restrained lip shape and calm mask create an alluring and mysterious aura like a scene from a classic Oriental pictorial. [Outfit and Props] Outfit: Wearing a heavy deep black Oriental kimono/yukata line robe exquisitely embroidered with brilliant pure white chrysanthemum and plum blossom patterns. Shows a chic styling that boldly exposes one shoulder. Props: Black Folding Fan: A matte black folding fan with dense bamboo rib details held in the left hand creates a contrast like an ink wash painting with the character's face. Nail Details: White and gold point tip nail art details faintly sparkling on long, pointedly trimmed nails add visual delicacy. [Hairstyle and Makeup Details] Hair: A half-up style pulled high above the crown. Thin, slender strands of deep black baby hair falling naturally along both cheeks from the part drift over the skin, creating a dreamlike sketch effect. Makeup: Created a semi-matte porcelain skin base where highlights and shadows blend smoothly. The eyes are matched with sophisticated black cat-eye eyeliner with slightly raised corners and deep shading shadows, and the lips are finished with a matte lip in a calm nude dried rose (Brick Rose) tone that enhances the natural complexion. [Lighting and Direction] Light Source: Strong direct pin lighting (Key Light) in amber/golden orange tones hitting diagonally from the top right of the figure (left side of the screen) intensely and warmly. Effect: Chiaroscuro technique is applied to form intense and warm light highlights on the left side of the face, shoulder line, and parts of the background where the light hits strongly, while the right side where light doesn't reach falls into deep, attractive shadows, creating dramatic three-dimensionality. [Texture and Color Mood (Core Texture Details)] Color: A 'Cinematic Oriental Shadow' color mood where warm gold in the light-hit areas, toned-down deep olive khaki/brown in the background, and absolute deep black (Jet Black) of the clothing and fan meet the snow white of the embroidery. Texture Details (Special Analysis): Fabric Texture: Dense embroidery thread texture where the three-dimensionality of each thread can be felt while the silk-cotton blend robe remains matte. Prop Texture: Regular intervals and concave shadow grain of the fan paper/bamboo ribs. Skin and Luster Texture: Soft skin texture and sharp melodies of hair strands created by pin lighting hitting a matte skin that is smooth like porcelain but excludes artificial luster. Grain Noise: Fine high-resolution analog film grain noise spread throughout the screen blends with the plaster texture of the background like a velvet wall to complete a texture like an oil painting. [Film and Camera Lens Depth, Angle] Composition and Angle: A horizontal composition capturing the character's impression and Oriental objects horizontally without distortion from a position close to the subject's eye level. Features: Very shallow depth of field (Shallow DoF) of a top-tier portrait lens is applied. Sharp focus is placed like a blade on the character's left eye, face line, and the rib details of the fan held in the hand, while the textured wall in the back where light passes diagonally and the background beyond the right shoulder are softly blurred (out-focused) to maximize immersion into the character. [Background and Studio Layout Elements] Space: An antique and toned-down vintage studio background where the grain of time is felt. Details: Behind the character, a fine plaster/stone texture wall in deep olive brown tones is placed, and the light coming from the left leaves a diagonal gradient highlight on one side of the wall, giving even the empty space a pictorial depth.

zh.title: 电影感东方光影肖像
zh.description: 一个用于高对比度电影感肖像的精致提示词，以日本和服与折扇为特色，运用戏剧性的明暗对照法照明。
zh.prompt: [人物] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有一个由 Meta 运营的小型 Threads 标志，其上方用白色草书小字写着“CHAse”作为签名。[姿势与表情] 姿势与构图：居中的半身像，感性地捕捉了上半身、右肩线条以及手中折扇的轮廓。姿势：穿着自然垂落的服装露出右肩，左手持一把完全展开的黑色折扇，略微遮住脸部左侧。上半身和头部微微倾斜，以突显纤细的颈部和锁骨。表情：目光静止，冷漠地看向左下方，而非直视前方。克制的唇形和冷静的神态营造出一种如同经典东方画报场景般迷人而神秘的氛围。[服装与道具] 服装：穿着一件厚重的深黑色东方和服/浴衣长袍，上面精致地绣有绚烂的纯白色菊花和梅花图案。展现出大胆露出一侧肩膀的时髦造型。道具：黑色折扇：左手持一把带有细密竹骨细节的哑光黑色折扇，与人物面部形成如同水墨画般的对比。指甲细节：长而修剪尖锐的指甲上，点缀着淡淡闪烁的白金尖端美甲，增添了视觉上的精致感。[发型与妆容细节] 发型：头顶上方高扎的半扎发造型。从发缝处自然垂落在双颊旁的深黑色细碎发丝掠过肌肤，营造出梦幻般的素描效果。妆容：打造出半哑光的瓷肌底妆，高光与阴影平滑融合。眼妆搭配精致的黑色猫眼眼线，眼角微微上扬并带有深邃的阴影，唇妆则选用冷静的裸色干枯玫瑰（砖红色）哑光唇釉，提升自然气色。[光影与指导] 光源：强烈的定向聚光灯（主光）以琥珀色/金橙色调从人物右上方（画面左侧）强烈而温暖地照射。效果：运用明暗对照法，在脸部左侧、肩线以及光线强烈照射的背景部分形成强烈而温暖的光影高光，而未受光照的右侧则陷入深邃迷人的阴影中，营造出戏剧性的立体感。[质感与色彩氛围（核心质感细节）] 色彩：“电影感东方光影”色彩氛围，受光区域的暖金色、背景中调低的深橄榄卡其/棕色，以及服装和折扇的绝对深黑色（喷气黑）与刺绣的雪白色交织。质感细节（特别分析）：织物质感：丝棉混纺长袍保持哑光的同时，能感受到每一根绣线的立体纹理。道具质感：折扇纸面/竹骨的规律间距与凹陷阴影纹理。皮肤与光泽质感：聚光灯照射在如瓷器般平滑但剔除人工光泽的哑光皮肤上，呈现出柔软的皮肤质感和发丝的锐利韵律。颗粒噪点：遍布画面的精细高分辨率模拟胶片颗粒噪点，与如同天鹅绒墙面般的背景石膏质感融合，呈现出油画般的质感。[胶片与相机镜头景深、角度] 构图与角度：水平构图，从接近主体视平线的位置水平捕捉人物印象和东方物件，无畸变。特性：应用了顶级人像镜头极浅的景深（Shallow DoF）。焦点如刀锋般精准地落在人物左眼、脸部轮廓以及手中折扇的扇骨细节上，而光线斜射的后方纹理墙面以及右肩后的背景则被柔和地虚化（背景虚化），以最大化沉浸感。[背景与摄影棚布局元素] 空间：一个能感受到岁月痕迹的复古且色调低沉的摄影棚背景。细节：人物后方是一面深橄榄棕色的精细石膏/石材纹理墙，从左侧射入的光线在墙面一侧留下了对角渐变高光，即使是留白空间也赋予了画报般的深度。

en.title: Hyper-realistic Fashion Portrait of East Asian Woman
en.description: An incredibly detailed prompt for a hyper-realistic outdoor fashion portrait. It describes an elegant East Asian woman standing by a black luxury car, with exhaustive details on skin texture, hair, clothing materials like lace and ribbon, and complex car reflections.
en.prompt:
Hyper-realistic outdoor fashion portrait. A stylish young adult {argument name="gender and ethnicity" default="East Asian woman"} standing next to a {argument name="car background" default="glossy black luxury sedan"}, shot from a three-quarter rear perspective. Centered from the top of the head to just below the hips and upper thighs. The upper body occupies the center of the frame, with the car extending horizontally behind. Body turned away from the lens, head gently turned to the right showing a refined profile. Gaze directed downward toward the car door—a quiet, dignified, natural candid atmosphere.

Character: Slender and elegant build, warm fair skin, soft shoulder lines, natural body proportions. Relaxed and elegant posture—arms behind the back, hands loosely held near the lumbar region, mostly obscured. Shoulders flat, back natural, low-profile stance.

Profile (face visible top right): Delicate features, straight bridge of the nose, soft brow shape, downcast dark eyes, understated rose-red lip color. Minimalist natural makeup: smooth realistic skin, light blush, lightly drawn eyelashes, soft satin lip color. Natural pores, soft tone transitions; no artificial beauty filters.

Hairstyle: Long straight glossy black hair, slightly side-parted, falling smoothly to the upper back and waist. Most hair rests on the left shoulder blade and center of the back; a small section follows the right side of the neck. Fine single hair strands, delicate flyaways, realistic weight, restrained cool daylight highlights. Naturally maintained state, not overly styled.

Clothing: Fitted short camisole in an understated {argument name="clothing color" default="blush beige or light dusty brown"}—extremely thin spaghetti straps, a straight neckline nearly invisible from the back, low square back. Ends above the waist, exposing a narrow area of the lower back. Soft, smooth, slightly elastic fabric with subtle horizontal folds and realistic tension on the back. Opaque, no logo. High-waisted light blue jeans fitting the waist, hips, and upper thighs—light stone-wash texture, golden-beige contrast stitching, center back seam, belt loops, two sharp back pockets. Unique decorative details on the upper edges of the back pockets: delicate white lace trim paired with light pink satin bows. Several delicate pink ribbon ends hang vertically by the pockets, asymmetrical and gently curved by gravity. Decorations sewn onto the denim with visible textile texture and realistic stitch points. Realistic fading, slight scuffing, seam tension, slight worn highlights. Upper legs extend down to the edge of the crop.

Car: Glossy black sedan seen from the side—the rear passenger door fills the central and lower background. Dark tinted windows, chrome trim, curved roofline, glossy black paint. The car surface acts as a mirror: reflecting the woman's silhouette, surrounding trees, light sky, and parts of the street. Layered reflections on the door and window—slightly darker and softer than the subject. No brand logo, no identifiable license plate. The window cuts diagonally behind the shoulders and upper torso—a chrome frame acts as a bright narrow line between the dark glass and the roof. The area below the door is nearly black, with delicate blue-gray highlights and realistic panel seams. Reflections follow the curved geometry of the car body rather than being flat.

Background: Tall dark cast-iron fence—vertical bars, decorative diagonal elements, geometric crosses. Dense evergreen shrubs and fine leaves behind the fence—a deep green-black textured background. Far left: part of a light beige stone or concrete building pillar with visible rectangular panel gaps. Thin dark cables or branches extend loosely by the wall, adding environmental realism.

Lighting: Soft natural daylight, bright overcast sky, or open shade. Diffuse light from above and slightly to the left—illuminating the upper back, shoulders, arms, and hair. Glowing but not overexposed skin. Soft highlights on the crown of the hair, shoulder lines, camisole straps, and denim seams. Soft, detailed shadows around the hair, arms, waist, car door, and fence.

Tones: Glossy black, light blue denim, blush beige, soft pink ribbons, warm fair skin, deep green vegetation, understated stone, cool chrome. Realistic saturation—pink pocket accents serve as the main decorative color detail. No orange skin, no overly vivid blues, no artificial HDR.

Camera: Chest to waist height, full-frame 70–85mm, f/2.8–f/4. The woman, clothing details, and the closest car reflections are sharp and clear; the cast-iron fence and vegetation are slightly softened. Natural perspective compression, accurate body proportions. Natural, feminine, refined, soft cinematic street fashion style.

Negative: No text, no watermarks, no brand logos, no extra people, no repetitive reflections, no deformed car geometry, no deformed hands, no extra limbs, no exaggerated poses, no transparent clothing, no strong flash, no plastic-looking skin, no over-saturated colors, no heavy glamour retouching, no cluttered background.

zh.title: 东亚女性超写实时尚人像
zh.description: 一份极其详尽的超写实户外时尚人像提示词。描述了一位优雅的东亚女性站在黑色豪华轿车旁的场景，涵盖了皮肤纹理、发丝、蕾丝与丝带等服装材质，以及复杂的车身倒影等详尽细节。
zh.prompt:
超写实户外时尚人像。一位时尚的年轻女性 {argument name="gender and ethnicity" default="东亚女性"} 站在一辆 {argument name="car background" default="亮黑色豪华轿车"} 旁，采用四分之三背面视角拍摄。画面中心从头顶延伸至臀部及大腿上部。上半身占据画面中心，轿车在身后横向延伸。身体背对镜头，头部轻微向右转，露出精致的侧脸。视线向下看向车门——营造出一种安静、端庄、自然的抓拍氛围。

人物：身材苗条优雅，肤色白皙红润，肩部线条柔和，身体比例自然。姿态放松优雅——双臂置于身后，双手在腰部附近自然交叠，大部分被遮挡。双肩平直，背部自然，姿态低调。

侧脸（面部可见于右上角）：五官精致，鼻梁挺直，眉形柔和，眼眸低垂，唇色为低调的玫瑰红。极简自然妆容：皮肤细腻真实，轻扫腮红，睫毛描画自然，唇部呈现柔和的丝缎质感。可见自然毛孔，色调过渡柔和；无人工美颜滤镜。

发型：黑色长直发，光泽感强，略带偏分，自然垂落在上背部和腰间。大部分头发落在左肩胛骨和背部中心；一小束头发顺着颈部右侧垂下。发丝细腻，有少量碎发，质感真实，带有克制的冷色调日光高光。保持自然状态，未过度造型。

服装：修身短款吊带背心，颜色为低调的 {argument name="clothing color" default="腮红米色或浅灰棕色"}——极细的肩带，背部几乎不可见的直线领口，大露背设计。长度在腰部以上，露出小面积后腰。面料柔软顺滑，略带弹性，背部呈现细微的横向褶皱和真实的张力感。不透明，无 Logo。高腰浅蓝色牛仔裤，贴合腰部、臀部和大腿上部——浅色石磨洗水纹理，金米色撞色缝线，后中缝，腰带环，两个清晰的后口袋。后口袋上缘有独特的装饰细节：精致的白色蕾丝花边搭配浅粉色缎带蝴蝶结。几条精致的粉色丝带末端垂直悬挂在口袋旁，受重力影响呈现不对称的自然弯曲。装饰物缝在牛仔布上，可见纺织纹理和真实的缝合点。真实的褪色感、轻微磨损、接缝张力及轻微的磨损高光。大腿上部延伸至画面底部边缘。

轿车：侧面可见的亮黑色轿车——后排乘客车门占据了画面中央及下方的背景。深色车窗，镀铬饰条，弧形车顶线条，亮黑色车漆。车身表面如同镜面：反射出女性的剪影、周围的树木、明亮的天空以及部分街道。车门和车窗上的倒影层次分明——比主体略暗且柔和。无品牌 Logo，无可见车牌。车窗在双肩后方呈对角线切割——镀铬边框在深色玻璃和车顶之间形成一条明亮的细线。车门下方区域近乎黑色，带有细腻的蓝灰色高光和真实的面板接缝。倒影遵循车身的弧形几何结构，而非平面的。

背景：高大的黑色铸铁栅栏——竖条栏杆，装饰性对角元素，几何十字花纹。栅栏后方是茂密的常绿灌木和细碎叶片——深绿黑色的纹理背景。最左侧：部分浅米色石材或混凝土建筑立柱，可见矩形面板缝隙。细长的深色电缆或枝条在墙边随意延伸，增加了环境的真实感。

光影：柔和的自然日光，明亮的阴天或开阔的阴影处。来自上方和左前方的漫射光——照亮了后背、肩膀、手臂和头发。皮肤透亮但不曝光过度。发顶、肩线、背心肩带和牛仔裤缝线处有柔和的高光。头发、手臂、腰部、车门和栅栏周围有柔和且细节丰富的阴影。

色调：亮黑色、浅蓝色牛仔、腮红米色、柔粉色丝带、白皙红润的肤色、深绿色植被、低调的石材、冷色调镀铬。饱和度真实——粉色口袋装饰作为主要的装饰色彩点缀。无橘色皮肤，无过度鲜艳的蓝色，无人工 HDR 感。

相机：胸部至腰部高度，全画幅 70–85mm 镜头，f/2.8–f/4 光圈。女性主体、服装细节及最近处的车身倒影清晰锐利；铸铁栅栏和植被略微虚化。自然的透视压缩，准确的身体比例。自然、女性化、精致、柔和的电影感街头时尚风格。

负面提示词：无文字，无水印，无品牌 Logo，无多余人物，无重复倒影，无变形的车身几何结构，无变形的手部，无多余肢体，无夸张姿势，无透明服装，无强闪光灯，无塑料感皮肤，无过度饱和的色彩，无厚重的精修，无杂乱背景。

en.title: Ethereal Lakefront Fashion Photography
en.description: A dreamy fashion prompt for gpt-image-2 featuring a woman in a pink chiffon dress by a serene lake with willow trees and soft, romantic lighting.
en.prompt: Depict {argument name="person" default="an East Asian adult woman over 21"} standing by a serene lake with weeping willows. She has long black curly hair, naturally parted and flowing over her shoulders and back. The hair should be soft and fluffy, with a slight breeze passing through, glowing faintly in the soft sunlight. She wears a pair of small dangling turquoise earrings to add a touch of refinement. There is a clever cutout design at the center of the waist, and the skirt is wrapped in layered chiffon fabric with a high side slit, subtly revealing a leg through the soft folds. The entire gown should appear light, airy, and romantic, as if naturally dancing in the breeze. The setting is {argument name="setting" default="a dreamy lakefront garden"}, with the branches and leaves of weeping willows framing the top and left side of the image. Behind her, there is a soft and hazy green lake surface, misty foliage, and faint sunlight filtering through the treetops. The background should create a lush, tranquil, and picturesque atmosphere with soft bokeh and gentle mist. The lighting should be soft natural light from the top right, scattering through the leaves to create brilliant highlights on her face, collarbone, shoulders, hair, earrings, and pink chiffon fabric. Add soft rim lighting around the hair and tulle sleeves, paired with creamy shadows and pink-green tones. Style: realistic lakefront fashion photography, adult model, light pink tulle dress, off-the-shoulder draped sleeves, willow branches, serene lake background, soft romantic sunlight, poetic downward gaze, ethereal femininity, high detail, vertical aspect ratio, no text, no watermark, no logo, no other characters, no deformed anatomy, no cartoon style, no harsh flash, no clutter, no nudity.

en.title: Minimalist Product Promotional Poster

en.title: Korean Summer Beach Lifeguard Tower
en.description: A nostalgic youth-themed prompt featuring a woman on a coral-pink lifeguard tower with hand-drawn doodles and summer-themed diary text.
en.prompt: An ultra-realistic cinematic dreamy lifestyle photo celebrating {argument name="year text" default="SUMMER ’26"}, featuring a young {argument name="ethnicity" default="Korean"} woman sitting alone on the upper platform of a faded {argument name="tower color" default="coral-pink"} vintage lifeguard tower on a quiet seaside beach, captured from a close low-angle perspective. Use tighter framing focused on her upper body, dangling legs, and the weathered wooden platform, creating an intimate, peaceful, youthful composition. The lifeguard tower should feel naturally aged and sun-faded rather than newly painted or artificial. She sits casually on the edge of the platform, wearing a pale blue-and-white striped sleeveless romper, lightweight white canvas sneakers, and a soft cream bucket hat resting loosely behind her head. A small vintage film camera hangs from one wrist, while she holds a half-melted pastel popsicle in the other hand. She looks toward the distant ocean with a gentle, unposed smile, expressing quiet freedom, summer anticipation, and the feeling of an endless school holiday. Her dark hair is tied in a loose low ponytail, with wispy strands moving naturally in the warm coastal breeze. The striped fabric and hat ribbon flutter softly in the same direction. A translucent yellow kite is tied to the side railing, floating high above her and adding playful movement. Beside her are a folded striped beach towel, a small seashell pouch, and a pair of retro sunglasses. Cute hand-drawn doodles are naturally integrated around the scene: tiny seashells, smiling suns, waves, stars, hearts, sparkles, seagulls, and miniature fish. Add handwritten-style white sketch text floating across the open sky like notes from a summer diary: “SUMMER ’26” “sea you soon” “salt in the air” “stay golden” A vast pale blue summer sky dominates the background with generous negative space. Show only a thin suggestion of the sparkling ocean horizon near the lower edge, keeping the composition airy, uncluttered, and emotionally spacious. Bright coastal daylight, soft overexposed highlights, hazy dreamy glow, subtle lens bloom, pastel film tones, low contrast, smooth highlight roll-off, naturally luminous skin. Color palette: faded coral pink, powder blue, seafoam, translucent yellow, warm white, sandy cream. Style: cinematic editorial lifestyle photography, Korean indie summer aesthetic, nostalgic youth diary mood, Kodak Portra 160 film look, delicate film grain, ultra-detailed dreamy realism, natural skin texture, 8K, vertical aspect ratio 3:4.

zh.prompt: 使用上传的图像作为参考，创作一张超写实电影级特写肖像。在不改变面部、表情、年龄、面部结构、发型、胡须形状、胡须密度、肤色、毛孔、皱纹、细小面部绒毛以及所有自然皮肤瑕疵的前提下，精准保留主体原有的面部特征。保持真实的面部比例和逼真的纹理。添加优雅、纤细的 {argument name="frame material" default="金色"} 边框眼镜，镜片为鲜艳的半透明 {argument name="lens color" default="橙色"} 反光镜片，确保双眼依然清晰可见且锐利。渲染物理上精确的镜片反射、微妙的折射、金属质感的金色高光以及逼真的玻璃透明度。为肖像添加戏剧性的霓虹灯光效果：左侧为 {argument name="left light" default="蓝色"} 轮廓光，右侧为炽热的红色轮廓光，在纯深黑色背景下营造出震撼的赛博朋克电影氛围。使用顶级电影级 HDR 灯光，实现平滑的色彩分离、逼真的光影衰减和高对比度。以非凡的细节捕捉每一个皮肤毛孔、皱纹、胡须、眉毛、睫毛和发丝。呈现逼真的皮肤微纹理、自然的次表面散射、光泽双唇、精致眼部和栩栩如生的面部轮廓。风格定位为奢华时尚摄影，采用极浅的景深，焦点锐利地聚焦于眼睛和眼镜，背景呈现奶油般的虚化效果，具备卓越的动态范围、清脆的金属高光和高级的调色。屡获殊荣的未来赛博朋克美学，不妥协的 8K 超写实画质，超逼真渲染，电影级构图，大师级品质，高度细节化，超写实，HDR，DSLR，中画幅相机品质，影棚灯光，逼真反射，高级修图，专业色彩科学。长宽比：3:4

en.title: Cinematic Glass Reflection Portrait
en.description: A high-fashion street portrait shot through a glass storefront, featuring city light reflections and cinematic bokeh.
en.prompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic street fashion portrait of a stylish young woman standing beside a floor-to-ceiling glass storefront on a bustling city street at blue hour. She wears an {argument name="outfit" default="oversized charcoal-black wool blazer over a fitted black tank top, light-wash high-waisted denim jeans"}, minimal silver hoop earrings, and effortless natural makeup. Her hair is loosely tied back with soft face-framing strands. She gazes confidently toward the camera with a calm editorial expression. The scene is photographed through the glass, creating layered reflections, subtle ghosting, and transparent overlays of the city. Long-exposure traffic creates vibrant red, orange, white, and teal light trails across the frame, while soft neon signs and blurred headlights produce cinematic bokeh. Mixed ambient twilight and storefront lighting illuminate the face with a gentle glow, balancing warm and cool tones. Premium luxury fashion campaign aesthetic, Vogue editorial photography, candid yet refined composition, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, realistic skin texture, optical lens reflections, natural color grading, {argument name="camera" default="Leica SL2-S, Summilux 50mm f/1.4"}, Kodak Portra 400 color palette, ultra-photorealistic, HDR, 8K, masterpiece.

zh.prompt: 超写实电影感街头时尚人像，一位时髦的年轻女性站在蓝色时刻繁华街道的落地玻璃店面旁。她身穿一件超大款 {argument name="blazer color" default="炭黑色"} 羊毛西装外套，内搭修身黑色背心，下着浅色高腰牛仔裤，佩戴极简银色圆环耳环，妆容自然随性。头发松散地扎在脑后，几缕发丝修饰脸庞。她神情自信，带着冷静的杂志大片感凝视镜头。场景透过玻璃拍摄，营造出层叠的倒影、微妙的重影以及城市景观的透明叠加效果。长曝光捕捉到的交通灯光在画面中划出鲜艳的红、橙、白、青色光轨，柔和的霓虹灯和模糊的车灯营造出电影般的焦外成像效果。混合了 {argument name="lighting" default="环境暮光"} 与店面灯光，为面部带来柔和的光泽，平衡了冷暖色调。高端奢侈时尚广告审美，Vogue 杂志摄影风格，构图自然且精致，浅景深，柔和的胶片颗粒感，真实的皮肤质感，光学镜头反光，自然色彩分级，{argument name="camera model" default="Leica SL2-S"}，Summilux 50mm f/1.4 镜头，Kodak Portra 400 色调，超写实，HDR，8K，杰作。

en.title: Natural Japanese Afternoon Nap Portrait
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating soft, Japanese-style aesthetic portraits of a woman waking from a nap, featuring sheer loungewear and warm bedroom sunlight.
en.prompt:
Subject: After a nap

Person/Expression: {argument name="age group" default="a woman in her 20s"}. Natural skin leaning toward bright ivory-beige, a soft oval face, delicate eyes, a natural bridge of the nose, and healthy pink-beige lips. Transparent Japanese-style natural makeup with pale rose blush, long thin eyelashes, subtle tear bags, and naturally glossy lips. The expression is peaceful with a lingering sense of sleepiness in a relaxed side profile. She has her eyes lightly closed and looks as if she is stretching while breathing deeply and quietly. Her hair is dark brown, gathered into a low loose bun, with thin see-through bangs and stray hairs left around her cheeks for a natural and elegant Japanese hairstyle.

Outfit/Pose: Sleeveless loungewear made of very thin sheer material in {argument name="outfit color" default="white to ivory"}. A short long-tank-top style dress with large deep side openings, where the fabric hangs loosely at the sides. The material is light as if filled with air, looking semi-transparent as it lets afternoon light through. The silhouette of the innerwear is faintly visible, but the overall expression remains elegant and domestic. The fabric is soft, with fine drapes falling from the chest to the hem, which sits around the upper thigh. The person stands sideways near a window, facing the window on the left. Both arms are stretched high overhead, with wrists lightly overlapping. She rests her weight on one leg and steps the other slightly forward with a soft knee. A natural standing posture as if loosening the body after waking up.

Background/Light: A bright {argument name="location" default="Japanese apartment bedroom"}. A large window with thin white curtains on the left, and a white linen bed with a wooden headboard on the right. On the bed are white futons, softly wrinkled sheets, and cushions with a faint pattern. A small round wooden side table is placed by the window with a small houseplant and ceramic ornaments. The wall is a pale greige with a simple wooden frame on the top right. Soft afternoon sunlight shines diagonally from the left, warmly illuminating the face, neck, arms, shoulders, and legs. The main light is natural light from the front left, slightly diffused through the curtains. Highlights are bright, and shadows fall softly to the right. Transparent light enters the edges and drapes of the thin fabric, making them glow softly in white. Faint bands of light and shadow stretch across the floor and bed.

Composition/Camera: Vertical composition, 3:4. The person is placed slightly to the right of the center, showing a medium full body including the arms stretched overhead. Naturally framing from the upper thighs to the fingertips overhead. The window on the left and the bed on the right create depth. The camera is shot from the side at a height between the chest and shoulders, a natural eye level not too low. While showing a beautiful side silhouette, the face is at an angle slightly visible to the camera. The window side is bright, and the bed in the background is softly blurred. Focus is on the profile, shoulders, arms, and the drapes of the sheer fabric, with a natural depth of field that is not too shallow.

Texture/Style: Realistic photographic style. A Japanese-style portrait with a quiet afternoon domestic feel. The skin retains natural pore texture and soft color without excessive retouching. Fine stray hairs and delicate highlights where the light hits are depicted. The sheer material of the clothes is thin and light, carefully expressing layers of fabric, seams, hem lines, and nuances of light passing through. Tones are warm neutrals centered around ivory, beige, and wood brown. Clean and smooth gradations, high-definition photography with low noise. A finish that feels like the quiet and soft lingering of early afternoon.

Negative: Facial distortion, unnatural expression, excessive beautification, asymmetrical eyes, collapsing nose or mouth, extra fingers, missing fingers, twisted wrists, joint failure in arms or legs, body distortion, unnatural emphasis on chest or waist, clothing shape collapse, fabric sticking too much to the body, explicit nudity, vulgarity, shadows contradicting the light source, overexposed skin, excessive sharpening, excessive retouching, plastic-like skin, grainy noise, compression noise, garbled text, logos, watermarks, unwanted people, unwanted small items, background distortion, perspective failure of bed or window frame.

zh.title: 日系自然午睡肖像
zh.description: 一份全面的提示词，用于生成女性午睡醒来后的柔和日系美学肖像，包含轻薄家居服和温暖的卧室阳光。
zh.prompt:
主体：午睡后

人物/表情：{argument name="age group" default="20 多岁的女性"}。自然的肤色偏向明亮的象牙米色，柔和的鹅蛋脸，精致的眼眸，自然的鼻梁，以及健康的粉米色嘴唇。透明感的日系自然妆容，带有淡玫瑰色腮红、细长的睫毛、淡淡的卧蚕以及自然光泽的嘴唇。表情宁静，侧脸放松，带着一丝睡意。她双眼微闭，看起来仿佛正在深呼吸并伸懒腰。深棕色头发扎成低松发髻，留有轻薄的空气刘海和脸颊两侧的碎发，呈现出自然优雅的日系发型。

服装/姿势：由极薄的透视材质制成的无袖家居服，颜色为 {argument name="outfit color" default="白色至象牙色"}。短款长背心式连衣裙，两侧有深开叉，布料在两侧松散垂下。材质轻盈如充盈着空气，在午后阳光的照射下呈现半透明感。内衣轮廓隐约可见，但整体氛围依然优雅居家。布料柔软，从胸部到下摆有细密的褶皱，下摆位于大腿上部。人物侧身站在窗边，面向左侧的窗户。双臂高举过头顶，手腕轻轻交叠。重心放在一条腿上，另一条腿微微向前迈出，膝盖弯曲。呈现出刚睡醒时放松身体的自然站姿。

背景/光线：明亮的 {argument name="location" default="日式公寓卧室"}。左侧有一扇带有白色薄纱窗帘的大窗户，右侧是一张带有木质床头的白色亚麻床。床上铺着白色被褥、柔软褶皱的床单和带有淡雅花纹的靠垫。窗边放着一张小型圆形木质边桌，上面摆放着小盆栽和陶瓷装饰品。墙壁为浅灰褐色，右上角挂着一个简单的木质相框。柔和的午后阳光从左侧斜射进来，温暖地照亮了脸部、颈部、手臂、肩膀和腿部。主光源是来自左前方的自然光，透过窗帘略微漫射。高光处明亮，阴影柔和地投射在右侧。透明的光线穿过薄布料的边缘和褶皱，使其发出柔和的白光。淡淡的光影带在地板和床上延伸。

构图/相机：垂直构图，3:4。人物位于中心偏右，展示包括高举双臂在内的中景全身照。自然地从大腿上部到头顶指尖进行取景。左侧的窗户和右侧的床营造出深度感。相机从侧面拍摄，高度介于胸部和肩膀之间，是不过于低沉的自然视线高度。在展示优美侧面轮廓的同时，脸部略微向相机倾斜。窗户一侧明亮，背景中的床呈现柔和的虚化效果。焦点集中在侧脸、肩膀、手臂以及透视布料的褶皱上，景深自然，不会过浅。

质感/风格：写实摄影风格。具有宁静午后居家感的日系肖像。皮肤保留了自然的毛孔质感和柔和的色调，没有过度修图。细碎的头发和光线照射处的精致高光被细腻描绘。衣服的透视材质轻薄，仔细表现了布料的层次、接缝、下摆线条以及光线穿透的细微差别。色调为以象牙色、米色和木棕色为中心的温暖中性色。干净平滑的渐变，低噪点的高清摄影。成品给人一种午后时光宁静而柔和的余韵感。

负面提示词：面部畸变、不自然的表情、过度美化、眼睛不对称、鼻子或嘴巴塌陷、多指、缺指、手腕扭曲、手臂或腿部关节失效、身体畸变、对胸部或腰部的过度强调、服装形状崩坏、布料过度贴身、露骨色情、低俗、与光源矛盾的阴影、皮肤过曝、过度锐化、过度修图、塑料感皮肤、颗粒噪点、压缩噪点、乱码文字、Logo、水印、多余的人、多余的小物件、背景畸变、床或窗框的透视错误。

en.title: Night Park Portrait of Two Dogs
en.description: A photorealistic close-up pet portrait of a black Labrador and German shepherd posing together at night with warm city bokeh.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic square close-up portrait of two friendly dogs sitting cheek-to-cheek in a dark park at night: on the left, a {argument name="left dog breed" default="black Labrador retriever"} with glossy black fur, warm brown eyes, floppy ears, an open smiling mouth with pink tongue visible, and a bright {argument name="collar color" default="red"} collar with a small metal ring; on the right, a {argument name="right dog breed" default="German shepherd"} with tan-and-black fur, upright pointed ears, brown eyes, a slightly tilted head, and an open happy mouth with tongue out. Both dogs face the camera directly, their muzzles touching affectionately, filling most of the frame from chest to ears. Use realistic flash photography with crisp fur detail, wet nose highlights, catchlights in the eyes, and shallow depth of field. The background should be an out-of-focus nighttime urban park with dark grass and warm golden circular bokeh lights from distant streetlamps and buildings. Composition is intimate, centered, symmetrical but natural, with the Labrador occupying the left half and the German shepherd the right half. No text, no humans, no extra animals, no watermark.

zh.title: 夜间公园里的两只狗狗肖像
zh.description: 一张写实的宠物特写肖像，展示了一只黑色拉布拉多犬和一只德国牧羊犬在夜晚并肩合影，背景是温暖的城市光斑。
zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的方形特写肖像，展示两只友好的狗狗在夜晚昏暗的公园里脸贴脸坐着：左侧是一只 {argument name="left dog breed" default="黑色拉布拉多寻回犬"}，有着光亮的黑色皮毛、温暖的棕色眼睛、下垂的耳朵、张开的嘴巴露出粉红色的舌头，以及一条明亮的 {argument name="collar color" default="红色"} 项圈，上面挂着一个小金属环；右侧是一只 {argument name="right dog breed" default="德国牧羊犬"}，有着棕黑相间的皮毛、竖立的尖耳朵、棕色的眼睛、微微倾斜的头部，以及张开的快乐嘴巴，舌头伸出。两只狗都直视镜头，口鼻部亲昵地触碰在一起，占据了从胸部到耳朵的大部分画面。使用写实的闪光灯摄影技术，呈现清晰的皮毛细节、湿润的鼻尖高光、眼睛里的眼神光，以及浅景深效果。背景应为失焦的夜间城市公园，有深色的草地和来自远处路灯与建筑的温暖金色圆形光斑。构图亲密、居中、对称且自然，拉布拉多犬占据左半部分，德国牧羊犬占据右半部分。无文字，无人类，无其他动物，无水印。

en.title: Frozen Time Editorial Portrait
en.description: An ultra-realistic cinematic studio portrait of a confident man surrounded by antique objects suspended in midair for a dramatic gallery-style visual.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic editorial portrait of {argument name="character description" default="a confident young Black man in his early 20s with short cropped black hair and smooth skin"} standing full-body in the center of a dark minimalist studio, facing the camera with a calm serious expression and arms crossed. He wears {argument name="outfit" default="a fitted black ribbed turtleneck sweater, charcoal tailored trousers, and polished black leather Chelsea boots"}. The background is a matte black textured wall and dark reflective stone floor, lit with warm dramatic side lighting, soft rim light, shallow depth of field, and subtle golden highlights. Surround him with exactly 30 suspended or foreground objects, frozen in midair as if time has stopped: 6 antique books, 5 gold pocket watches, 4 vintage cameras, 4 dried flower clusters, 4 white folded paper geometric shapes, 3 brass star or compass ornaments, 2 open paper sheets, 1 brown takeaway coffee cup, and 1 brown leather briefcase. Arrange the objects at varied depths around the subject, with some large blurred foreground elements at the bottom left and right, crisp midground objects framing his torso and head, and smaller background objects near the edges. Use a refined gallery-worthy mood, high fashion editorial composition, realistic shadows under every floating item, dust-like atmosphere, black-and-bronze color palette, 85mm lens look, vertical 2:3 aspect ratio, no text, no watermark. The overall theme is {argument name="theme" default="frozen time, memory, knowledge, and ambition"}.

zh.title: “凝固时间”编辑风格肖像
zh.description: 一张超写实的电影感影棚肖像，一位自信的男士被悬浮在半空中的古董物品环绕，呈现出极具戏剧性的画廊风格视觉效果。
zh.prompt: 创作一张超写实的电影感编辑风格肖像，画面中心是一位 {argument name="character description" default="20 出头、自信的黑人男性，留着黑色短发，皮肤光滑"}，全身站立在深色极简主义影棚中央，面朝镜头，表情冷静严肃，双臂交叉。他身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="修身黑色罗纹高领毛衣、炭灰色定制长裤和抛光黑色皮革切尔西靴"}。背景为哑光黑色纹理墙面和深色反光石材地面，采用温暖且富有戏剧性的侧光照明，配以柔和的轮廓光、浅景深以及微妙的金色高光。在他周围布置 30 个悬浮或前景物品，仿佛时间静止般悬停在半空中：6 本古董书、5 只金质怀表、4 台复古相机、4 束干花、4 个白色折叠纸质几何图形、3 个黄铜星形或指南针装饰品、2 张展开的纸张、1 个棕色外带咖啡杯和 1 个棕色皮质公文包。将这些物品以不同的深度布置在主体周围，左下角和右下角放置一些模糊的大型前景元素，中景处清晰的物品环绕其躯干和头部，背景边缘处则布置较小的物品。营造出精致的画廊级氛围，采用高级时装编辑构图，每个悬浮物品下方均有写实的阴影，带有尘埃感的氛围，黑金配色，85mm 镜头质感，2:3 竖构图，无文字，无水印。整体主题为 {argument name="theme" default="时间凝固、记忆、知识与雄心"}。

en.title: Champion Dragging Eight Rivals
en.description: A humorous sports illustration of one triumphant champion carrying a trophy while eight chibi football opponents tug at her oversized shirt.
en.prompt: Create a vertical 3:4 whimsical semi-realistic digital illustration of {argument name="main character" default="a confident young woman football champion"} walking forward in a studio on a warm beige background. She has long loose brown hair, a calm proud expression, and wears an oversized plain white T-shirt, loose beige trousers, and white sneakers. In her left arm she carries a shiny oversized golden World Cup-style trophy with engraved text reading “World Champion 2026”. The back hem of her white T-shirt stretches far to the right like a triangular cloth cape, and exactly eight tiny chibi football players are desperately clinging to and pulling the fabric in a diagonal stack from upper right to lower right. The eight opponents are: 1) a bearded player in a light blue and white striped Argentina-style kit, 2) an angry player in a red and green Portugal-style kit, 3) a gritting player in a yellow Brazil-style kit, 4) a shouting player in a blue Croatia-style kit, 5) a shouting blond player in a white England-style kit, 6) a tense player in a red Spain-style kit, 7) a small player in a white Germany-style kit, and 8) a blond goalkeeper in an orange Netherlands-style kit. Make the opponents toy-like with oversized heads, expressive angry or panicked faces, small bodies, and dynamic tugging poses, all looking as if they are trying and failing to stop her. Add small hand-drawn doodles around the scene: exactly three red heart outlines, two yellow star doodles, and multiple white motion sweat marks near the chibi players. Use polished 3D-cartoon rendering mixed with fashion editorial realism for the main character, detailed folds in the stretched shirt, soft studio lighting, clean composition, full-body view, high detail, humorous triumphant sports-fantasy mood. No logos, no extra text besides the trophy inscription, no watermark.

zh.title: 冠军拖拽八方对手
zh.description: 一幅幽默的体育插画：一位胜利的冠军怀抱奖杯，八名 Q 版足球对手正拼命拉扯她超大号的 T 恤。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 3:4 竖构图的奇幻半写实数字插画，画面主体为 {argument name="main character" default="一位自信的年轻女足冠军"} 在暖米色背景的摄影棚中阔步前行。她留着棕色长卷发，表情从容而自豪，身穿一件超大号纯白 T 恤、宽松米色长裤和白色运动鞋。她的左臂抱着一座闪闪发光的超大号世界杯风格金杯，杯身上刻有“World Champion 2026”字样。她白色 T 恤的后摆像三角形斗篷一样向右侧大幅拉伸，正好有八名 Q 版足球小人正拼命抓着并拉扯着布料，呈对角线堆叠排列。这八名对手分别是：1) 一名穿着蓝白条纹阿根廷风格球衣的蓄须球员，2) 一名穿着红绿葡萄牙风格球衣的愤怒球员，3) 一名穿着黄色巴西风格球衣、咬牙切齿的球员，4) 一名穿着蓝色克罗地亚风格球衣的大喊球员，5) 一名穿着白色英格兰风格球衣、金发大喊的球员，6) 一名穿着红色西班牙风格球衣的紧张球员，7) 一名穿着白色德国风格球衣的小个子球员，以及 8) 一名穿着橙色荷兰风格球衣的金发守门员。将这些对手设计成玩具般的 Q 版造型，拥有大头、夸张的愤怒或惊慌表情、小巧的身体以及动态的拉扯姿势，表现出他们试图阻止她却以失败告终的样子。在场景周围添加一些手绘涂鸦：正好三个红色心形轮廓、两个黄色星星涂鸦，以及在 Q 版球员附近添加多个白色运动汗滴符号。主体人物采用精致的 3D 卡通渲染与时尚杂志写实风格相结合，展现拉伸衬衫的细腻褶皱，配合柔和的摄影棚灯光、简洁的构图、全身视角、高细节度，营造出幽默且充满胜利感的体育奇幻氛围。画面中不包含任何标志，除奖杯铭文外无额外文字，无水印。

en.title: Sunlit Tea and Blood Orange Still Life
en.description: A warm editorial still-life prompt for creating a calm kitchen scene with glass teapot, citrus, linen, and golden morning light.
en.prompt: Create a quiet Hearth Hush still-life photograph on a warm beige stone countertop beside a textured plaster wall. The scene is lit by low golden morning sunlight from the upper right, casting a bright triangular patch on the wall and long soft shadows across the counter, with restrained contrast and a calm, airy composition. Show exactly 7 main visible objects: 1 clear round glass teapot with a lid, curved handle, and spout, half-filled with {argument name="tea color" default="deep amber orange tea"} with condensation on the glass; 3 cut blood orange halves grouped to the right with vivid ruby-red pulp and orange rind; 1 small rustic paring knife lying diagonally in front of the fruit with a muted wooden handle; 1 rumpled natural linen cloth in the lower left; and 1 matte ceramic vase in the back left holding a sparse olive branch with small leaves. Use a natural palette of cream, sand, honey, terracotta, amber, and muted olive. Emphasize the hearth field through the glowing tea, luminous citrus flesh, and sunlit reflections on the glass; emphasize the hush field through open negative space on the wall, pale stone texture, soft fabric folds, and stillness. Compose in a vertical 4:5 frame, slightly elevated eye-level angle, realistic editorial food photography, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, delicate surface imperfections, no people, no text, no branding, no extra objects.

zh.title: 阳光下的茶与血橙静物
zh.description: 一个温暖的编辑风格静物提示词，用于创作包含玻璃茶壶、柑橘、亚麻布和金色晨光的宁静厨房场景。
zh.prompt: 创作一张宁静的“Hearth Hush”风格静物摄影作品，背景为温暖的米色石质台面，侧面是纹理丰富的灰泥墙。场景由右上角低垂的金色晨光照亮，在墙上投射出一块明亮的三角形光斑，并在台面上拉出柔和的长影，整体对比度克制，构图平静而通透。画面中需精确呈现 7 个主要可见物体：1 个带有盖子、弧形把手和壶嘴的透明圆形玻璃茶壶，壶内半满着 {argument name="tea color" default="深琥珀橙色茶汤"}，玻璃表面带有冷凝水珠；3 个切开的血橙半块，果肉呈鲜艳的宝石红色，果皮橙黄，成组摆放在右侧；1 把带有哑光木质手柄的小型乡村风格削皮刀，斜放在水果前方；1 块褶皱的天然亚麻布位于左下角；以及 1 个位于左后方的哑光陶瓷花瓶，插着一枝稀疏的橄榄枝，带有小叶片。使用奶油色、沙色、蜂蜜色、赤陶色、琥珀色和柔和橄榄色的自然色调。通过发光的茶汤、明亮的柑橘果肉和玻璃上的阳光反射来强调“Hearth”（温馨）感；通过墙面上开阔的留白、浅色石材纹理、柔和的织物褶皱和静谧感来强调“Hush”（静谧）感。采用 4:5 竖构图，略微抬高的平视角度，写实的编辑风格美食摄影，浅至中等的景深，细腻的表面瑕疵，画面中无人、无文字、无品牌标识、无多余物体。

en.title: Futuristic AI Summit Poster
en.description: A dark neon technology conference poster template for an AI summit, forum, exhibition, or annual industry event.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical futuristic AI conference poster for {argument name="event name" default="2025 人工智能行业峰会 · 年度发布与交流"}, with a dark high-tech visual identity and bold Chinese typography.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, dark navy to black background, centered composition, generous empty space around the main title, print-quality crispness.

Visual style: Cyber technology conference aesthetic, deep black-blue background, neon cyan and orange accents, holographic polygon meshes, thin circuit lines, glowing nodes, diagonal HUD interface fragments, sharp geometric borders, premium enterprise summit look. Use strong contrast, subtle chromatic glitch edges, luminous blue/orange highlights, and clean modern sans-serif typography.

Layout: At the top center place a small English slogan reading “FUTURE / CONNECT / INTELLIGENCE”, with FUTURE in light cyan-white, CONNECT in orange, INTELLIGENCE in blue, separated by slashes. In the center place the huge main headline in two stacked lines: first line {argument name="main headline" default="智联未来"}, second line {argument name="subtitle headline" default="共创智能新纪元"}. The headline should be bold white block Chinese characters with slight cyan and orange offset shadows, angular cuts, and subtle glitch strokes. Beneath it place the event name line in small spaced white Chinese text.

Information row: Under the event name, create exactly 3 feature items, evenly spaced horizontally, each with a thin outlined diamond icon and two lines of Chinese text. Item 1: icon with letter “A”, label “前沿发布”, sublabel “洞察技术趋势”. Item 2: connected-nodes icon, label “行业交流”, sublabel “链接生态合作”. Item 3: blue diamond/crystal icon, label “共创未来”, sublabel “赋能产业升级”. Separate the three items with thin vertical dividers.

Bottom details: At the lower center add three short cyan/orange slash marks, then the location {argument name="location" default="中国 · 上海"}, then the date {argument name="date" default="2025.06.20-06.21"} below it in small white text.

Background elements: Frame the poster edges with diagonal futuristic circuit traces and glowing line segments. Include exactly 4 large translucent low-poly crystal structures: one orange-blue triangular crystal at bottom left, one blue angular crystal near lower left center, one orange-blue crystal at bottom right, and one smaller blue crystal in the upper right. Add fine dotted lines, tiny orange and cyan particles, lens glows, and wireframe triangles around the corners while keeping the center readable.

Constraints: Preserve the Chinese text exactly where specified, avoid extra logos or sponsors, no people, no photos, no watermark, no QR code, no additional paragraphs of text.

zh.title: 未来感 AI 峰会海报
zh.description: 一款适用于 AI 峰会、论坛、展览或年度行业活动的深色霓虹科技风格会议海报模板。
zh.prompt:
目标：制作一张竖版未来感 AI 会议海报，主题为 {argument name="event name" default="2025 人工智能行业峰会 · 年度发布与交流"}，采用深色高科技视觉风格及醒目的中文字体设计。

画布：竖版海报，3:4 比例，深海军蓝至黑色背景，居中构图，主标题周围留有充足的空白，具备印刷级清晰度。

视觉风格：赛博科技会议美学，深黑蓝色背景，霓虹青色与橙色点缀，全息多边形网格，纤细电路线条，发光节点，对角线 HUD 界面碎片，锐利几何边框，高端企业峰会质感。使用强对比度、细微的色差故障边缘、发光的蓝/橙色高光，以及简洁的现代无衬线字体。

布局：顶部居中放置一行英文标语“FUTURE / CONNECT / INTELLIGENCE”，其中 FUTURE 为浅青白色，CONNECT 为橙色，INTELLIGENCE 为蓝色，以斜杠分隔。中心位置放置巨大的主标题，分为两行：第一行 {argument name="main headline" default="智联未来"}，第二行 {argument name="subtitle headline" default="共创智能新纪元"}。标题应为粗体白色块状中文字符，带有轻微的青色和橙色偏移阴影、棱角切割及细微的故障笔触。下方放置一行小号字间距的白色中文活动名称。

信息栏：在活动名称下方，横向均匀排列 3 个功能项，每项包含一个细线条菱形图标和两行中文文本。第 1 项：带字母“A”的图标，标签“前沿发布”，副标签“洞察技术趋势”。第 2 项：连接节点图标，标签“行业交流”，副标签“链接生态合作”。第 3 项：蓝色菱形/水晶图标，标签“共创未来”，副标签“赋能产业升级”。三个项目之间用细竖线分隔。

底部详情：在底部中心添加三个短的青色/橙色斜杠，随后是地点 {argument name="location" default="中国 · 上海"}，下方以小号白色字体标注日期 {argument name="date" default="2025.06.20-06.21"}。

背景元素：用对角线未来感电路轨迹和发光线段勾勒海报边缘。包含 4 个大型半透明低多边形水晶结构：左下角一个橙蓝色三角水晶，左下中心附近一个蓝色棱角水晶，右下角一个橙蓝色水晶，右上角一个较小的蓝色水晶。在角落处添加细点线、微小的橙色和青色粒子、镜头光晕及线框三角形，同时保持中心区域清晰易读。

约束：严格保留指定的中文文本，避免添加额外的标志或赞助商信息，不包含人物、照片、水印、二维码，且不添加额外的段落文本。

en.title: Orange Minimalist Lin Daiyu Livestream Illustration
en.description: A warm negative-space ink illustration of a classical Chinese woman styled as a livestream host, useful for poetic editorial or social media visuals.
en.prompt: Create a minimalist wide-format illustration in a refined hand-drawn ink-and-watercolor style, dominated by a warm Hermès-orange monochrome palette with abundant negative space. The canvas is a horizontal 16:9 composition with a softly textured orange sky filling most of the frame and a pale peach ground band across the bottom third. Place a small classical Chinese beauty inspired by {argument name="character concept" default="Lin Daiyu as a livestream host"} in the lower-right quadrant, seated behind a simple long table, drawn with delicate black sketch lines and subtle peach shading. She wears flowing ancient Chinese robes, has long dark hair in an elegant updo with one orange flower hairpin and dangling ornament, and looks down gently with a calm, slightly melancholic expression. On the table include exactly three discrete objects: a smartphone on a small tripod at left facing her, a studio microphone on a short stand in the center, and a small orange teacup at right. Add exactly one large rough orange sun in the upper-left area and exactly two faint white bird strokes beneath it. Scatter exactly five tiny sparse grass tufts across the pale ground, using minimal thin lines. Keep the scene airy, poetic, quiet, and elegant, with visible paper grain, imperfect sketch strokes, no text, no border, no watermark, and no extra props.

zh.title: 橙色极简林黛玉直播插画
zh.description: 一幅温暖的负空间水墨插画，描绘了化身为直播主播的古典中国女性形象，适用于诗意编辑内容或社交媒体视觉素材。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅极简主义宽幅插画，采用精致的手绘水墨水彩风格，以温暖的爱马仕橙单色调为主，并留有大量负空间。画布为 16:9 横向构图，大部分画面由质感柔和的橙色天空填充，底部三分之一处为浅桃色地面。在右下象限放置一位灵感源自 {argument name="character concept" default="林黛玉化身直播主播"} 的古典中国美女，她坐在一张简单的长桌后，以细腻的黑色素描线条勾勒，并带有微妙的桃色阴影。她身着飘逸的中国古装，留着优雅的长发发髻，发间插着一支橙色花朵发簪和垂坠饰品，神情平静而略带忧郁，温柔地向下注视。桌上仅放置三个独立的物品：左侧是一个面向她的微型三脚架手机，中间是一个短支架上的录音室麦克风，右侧是一个小巧的橙色茶杯。在左上方添加一个巨大的粗犷橙色太阳，其下方绘有两道淡淡的白色飞鸟笔触。在浅色地面上零星散布五簇稀疏的草丛，使用极简的细线条勾勒。保持画面空灵、诗意、静谧且优雅，呈现可见的纸张纹理，保留不完美的素描笔触，无文字、无边框、无水印，且不添加额外道具。

en.title: Giant Typography Shanghai Travel Poster
en.description: A bold vertical cultural tourism poster featuring Shanghai landmarks, oversized red city typography, and minimalist vintage print styling.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical cultural tourism poster for {argument name="city name" default="Shanghai"}, combining giant typography, landmark photography, and minimalist travel-poster aesthetics.

Canvas: Tall vertical poster, 9:16 aspect ratio. Warm off-white paper background with subtle grain, slightly vintage print texture, high contrast red/black/cream palette.

Main layout: Place one enormous condensed bold sans-serif word across the middle reading {argument name="giant city text" default="SHANGHAI"}. The letters must be bright red, extremely tall, tightly spaced, and extend beyond the left and right edges so parts are cropped. Center a black-and-white cutout of the Oriental Pearl Tower in front of the red word, towering vertically from the lower skyline to near the top edge, with sharp architectural detail and realistic photo-collage texture.

Foreground skyline: Along the bottom, create a dense black-and-white Shanghai skyline collage with exactly 6 prominent visible landmark/building elements: 1) the Oriental Pearl Tower as the central dominant structure, 2) a historic clock-tower building at lower left, 3) the Shanghai World Financial Center with trapezoid top near right-center, 4) the Shanghai Tower as a twisting skyscraper to its right, 5) a spherical glass pavilion/dome at the lower right, and 6) assorted low-rise Bund waterfront buildings forming a continuous base. Add a sweeping solid red diagonal band across the bottom foreground, rising from lower left to mid-right, partially covering the skyline.

Top text: In the upper left, small widely letter-spaced red uppercase text reads “CITY / OF DREAMS” on two lines. In the upper right, matching red uppercase text reads “FUTURE / METROPOLIS” on two lines.

Information block: On the upper-left side beneath the title, include exactly 3 compact travel-info rows with red icons, red English labels, smaller black Chinese text, and thin divider lines: 1) map pin icon, label “SHANGHAI”, text “中国 · 上海”; 2) calendar icon, label “EST.1291”, text “建城历史”; 3) classical landmark icon, label “LANDMARK”, text “东方明珠塔”.

Style: Modern Chinese travel poster, editorial Swiss-grid influence, brutalist giant typography, photographic monochrome architecture, clean negative space, crisp edges, risograph-like ink grain, premium tourism campaign design.

Constraints: Use only red, black, grayscale, and warm cream. Keep the poster uncluttered. Do not add people, cars, logos, QR codes, watermarks, or extra paragraphs of text. Preserve the exact visible English and Chinese text specified above unless customized with the city-name slots.

zh.title: 上海巨型字体旅游海报
zh.description: 一张大胆的竖版文化旅游海报，融合了上海地标、超大号红色城市字体以及极简复古印刷风格。
zh.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="city name" default="上海"} 创作一张竖版文化旅游海报，结合巨型字体、地标摄影和极简主义旅游海报美学。

画布：高竖版海报，9:16 比例。温暖的米白色纸张背景，带有细微颗粒感和轻微的复古印刷质感，采用红、黑、奶油色高对比度配色。

主体布局：在画面中央放置一个巨大的压缩粗体无衬线单词，内容为 {argument name="giant city text" default="SHANGHAI"}。字母必须为亮红色，极高且间距紧凑，并延伸至左右边缘，使部分字母被裁切。在红色单词前方居中放置一张东方明珠塔的黑白剪影，从下方天际线垂直耸立至接近顶部边缘，展现锐利的建筑细节和写实的照片拼贴质感。

前景天际线：在底部创作一幅密集的黑白上海天际线拼贴画，包含 6 个清晰可见的地标/建筑元素：1) 作为中央主体的东方明珠塔，2) 左下方的历史钟楼建筑，3) 右中附近带有梯形顶部的上海环球金融中心，4) 其右侧呈螺旋状的上海中心大厦，5) 右下方的球形玻璃展馆/穹顶，以及 6) 构成连续基底的各式外滩低层建筑。在底部前景添加一条横跨画面的实心红色对角带，从左下向中右延伸，部分遮盖天际线。

顶部文字：左上角为小型、字间距宽的红色大写文字“CITY / OF DREAMS”，分两行排列。右上角为对应的红色大写文字“FUTURE / METROPOLIS”，分两行排列。

信息板块：在标题下方的左上侧，包含 3 行紧凑的旅游信息，配有红色图标、红色英文标签、较小的黑色中文文本及细分割线：1) 地图定位图标，标签“SHANGHAI”，文本“中国 · 上海”；2) 日历图标，标签“EST.1291”，文本“建城历史”；3) 经典地标图标，标签“LANDMARK”，文本“东方明珠塔”。

风格：现代中国旅游海报，受瑞士网格设计影响，粗野主义巨型字体，黑白建筑摄影，简洁的留白，边缘清晰，类似孔版印刷的油墨颗粒感，高端旅游宣传设计。

约束：仅使用红色、黑色、灰阶和暖奶油色。保持海报简洁。不要添加人物、汽车、Logo、二维码、水印或额外的段落文字。保留上述指定的精确英文和中文文本，除非通过城市名称槽位进行自定义。

en.title: Luxury Chinese Wedding Invitation
en.description: Generates a soft, high-end square Chinese wedding invitation with bridal portrait photography, calligraphy, date, names, and venue details.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a refined luxury Chinese wedding invitation poster with a soft editorial bridal portrait aesthetic for {argument name="couple names" default="Lin Zhao & Shen Zhiyi"}.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, 768×768 or larger, elegant negative space, misty pale gray and ivory background with a subtle film-grain haze.

Layout: Place the bride cropped on the right third only, showing the side of her face from forehead to jaw, brown hair in a soft updo, a delicate floral pearl earring, bare shoulder, and white satin wedding gown. Keep the left and center mostly open for typography. Add a blurred dark gray foreground shadow in the lower left, like an out-of-focus guest or veil, creating depth. Add a soft bouquet in the lower right foreground with pink-purple flowers, tiny white blossoms, and fine green stems, partially blurred.

Typography and text content: Use exactly 7 visible text groups. 1) At the very top center, tiny spaced serif date text: “20  MAY  2026”. 2) Large handwritten white Chinese calligraphy across the center, airy and flowing, with long horizontal strokes: “我愿意，和你一起成为我们。” 3) Lower-left small spaced uppercase serif label: “WEDDING DAY”. 4) Below it, large elegant serif numerals: “2026.05.20”. 5) Smaller Chinese phrase underneath: “宜｜嫁娶”. 6) Couple name line with centered ampersand: “林 昭  &  沈 知 意”. 7) Bottom venue and time line: “杭州 · 白塔公园 · 18:00”. Include two small centered dot separators between the lower text lines.

Visual style: High-end romantic wedding stationery, cinematic soft focus, luminous natural window light, low contrast, creamy whites, warm skin tones, pale gray background, subtle blur, delicate bokeh, understated luxury, minimal and airy. Use thin white serif typography for the English and date text, and expressive white brush-script calligraphy for the central Chinese sentence.

Constraints: Keep all typography white, avoid borders or decorative frames, avoid extra logos or watermarks, keep the bride’s face partially cropped at the right edge, preserve the calm negative-space composition, and make the overall image feel like a premium wedding invitation cover for {argument name="wedding date" default="2026.05.20"} at {argument name="venue and time" default="Hangzhou · White Pagoda Park · 18:00"}.

zh.title: 奢华中式婚礼请柬
zh.description: 生成一张柔和、高端的正方形中式婚礼请柬，包含新娘肖像摄影、书法、日期、姓名及场地详情。
zh.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="couple names" default="Lin Zhao & Shen Zhiyi"} 创建一张精致奢华的中式婚礼请柬海报，呈现柔和的杂志风新娘肖像美学。

画布：正方形 1:1 构图，768×768 或更大，优雅的留白，朦胧的浅灰色和象牙白背景，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感。

布局：将新娘裁剪在右侧三分之一处，仅展示从额头到下颌的侧脸，棕色头发梳成柔和的盘发，佩戴精致的花朵珍珠耳环，露出肩部，身着白色缎面婚纱。左侧和中心区域留白，用于排版。在左下角添加模糊的深灰色前景阴影，营造出如失焦的宾客或面纱般的深度感。在右下角前景添加一束柔和的花束，包含粉紫色花朵、细小的白色花簇和纤细的绿色茎叶，并进行部分虚化处理。

排版与文本内容：使用 7 组清晰可见的文本。1) 顶部正中央，微小的间距衬线字体日期：“20  MAY  2026”。2) 中央大号手写白色中式书法，飘逸灵动，带有长横笔画：“我愿意，和你一起成为我们。” 3) 左下角小号间距大写衬线字体标签：“WEDDING DAY”。4) 其下方，大号优雅衬线数字：“2026.05.20”。5) 下方较小的中文短语：“宜｜嫁娶”。6) 居中带有“&”符号的新人姓名行：“林 昭  &  沈 知 意”。7) 底部场地与时间行：“杭州 · 白塔公园 · 18:00”。在下方的文本行之间加入两个居中的小圆点作为分隔符。

视觉风格：高端浪漫婚礼文具，电影级柔焦，明亮的自然窗光，低对比度，奶油白，温暖肤色，浅灰色背景，细腻模糊，柔美焦外成像，低调奢华，极简且通透。英文和日期文本使用纤细的白色衬线字体，中央中文句子使用富有表现力的白色笔触书法。

约束条件：所有排版保持白色，避免使用边框或装饰性框架，避免添加额外的 Logo 或水印，保持新娘面部在右边缘部分裁剪，保留宁静的留白构图，使整体画面呈现出 {argument name="wedding date" default="2026.05.20"} 在 {argument name="venue and time" default="Hangzhou · White Pagoda Park · 18:00"} 举行的高级婚礼请柬封面质感。

en.title: Premium Spice Jar Product Photo
en.description: A photorealistic luxury food product mockup featuring a labeled glass spice jar on a rustic kitchen table with herbs, chilies, garlic, and warm commercial lighting.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic high-end commercial product advertisement for a transparent glass spice jar centered on a rustic wooden table, filled to the top with a vibrant multicolor blend of crushed peppers, herbs, chili flakes, black peppercorns, yellow seeds, and aromatic spices. The jar has a glossy black screw lid and a premium cream-colored arched label with gold trim; label text reads “NATURAL BLEND” at the top with a small leaf logo, large elegant script “Spice” and bold “MIX,” then “PREMIUM QUALITY,” “100% NATURAL,” “NO PRESERVATIVES,” and “Net Wt. 120g,” decorated with small botanical leaves, red berries, and a red chili illustration. Use warm moody studio lighting, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the jar and label, rich amber-brown tones, realistic glass reflections, and a premium food-photography look. Surround the product with exactly 8 visible supporting prop groups: 1 wooden pepper mill blurred in the left background, 1 small wooden bowl of red ground spice in the left foreground, 1 cluster of red chili peppers behind that bowl, 1 wooden bowl of fresh green basil blurred in the right background, 1 whole garlic bulb on the right, 2 loose garlic cloves in the right foreground, 1 small bunch of thyme sprigs near the garlic, and 1 wooden spoon in the bottom-right foreground holding mixed peppercorns. Scatter mixed peppercorns, chili flakes, seeds, and a small basil sprig naturally across the table. Background is dark rustic wood planks, softly blurred with bokeh, no hands, no people, no extra brands, no watermark. Customize the product name as {argument name="product name" default="Spice Mix"}, label tagline as {argument name="tagline" default="Natural Blend"}, quality line as {argument name="quality line" default="Premium Quality"}, weight text as {argument name="weight text" default="Net Wt. 120g"}, and jar lid color as {argument name="jar lid color" default="glossy black"}.

zh.title: 高端调味品罐产品摄影图
zh.description: 一张照片级逼真的奢华食品产品样机，展示了放置在乡村风格厨房桌面上、带有标签的玻璃调味品罐，周围环绕着香草、辣椒、大蒜，并配以温暖的商业照明。
zh.prompt: 创作一张照片级逼真的高端商业产品广告图，主体为一个放置在乡村风格木桌中央的透明玻璃调味品罐，罐内装满了色彩鲜艳的碎辣椒、香草、辣椒片、黑胡椒粒、黄色种子和芳香香料。罐子配有光面黑色旋盖和带有金色边框的高级奶油色拱形标签；标签顶部印有“NATURAL BLEND”字样及一个小叶子标志，中间为优雅的大号手写体“Spice”和粗体“MIX”，下方依次为“PREMIUM QUALITY”、“100% NATURAL”、“NO PRESERVATIVES”和“Net Wt. 120g”，并装饰有小植物叶片、红浆果和红辣椒插图。使用温暖的电影感摄影棚灯光，浅景深效果，焦点清晰地对准罐身和标签，呈现浓郁的琥珀棕色调、逼真的玻璃反光以及高级食品摄影质感。在产品周围布置 8 组清晰可见的辅助道具：左后方背景中一个模糊的木制胡椒研磨器，左前方一个小木碗盛放着红色调味粉，该木碗后方一簇红辣椒，右后方背景中一个模糊的盛放新鲜绿罗勒的木碗，右侧一个完整的大蒜，右前方两瓣散落的大蒜，大蒜附近一小束百里香，以及右下角前景中一把盛有混合胡椒粒的木勺。在桌面上自然地散落一些混合胡椒粒、辣椒片、种子和一小枝罗勒。背景为深色乡村风格木板，带有柔和的虚化光斑（bokeh），画面中无人手、无人物、无额外品牌标识、无水印。自定义产品名称为 {argument name="product name" default="Spice Mix"}，标签标语为 {argument name="tagline" default="Natural Blend"}，品质说明为 {argument name="quality line" default="Premium Quality"}，重量文本为 {argument name="weight text" default="Net Wt. 120g"}，以及罐盖颜色为 {argument name="jar lid color" default="glossy black"}。

en.title: Electric Blue Yokai Woman Portrait
en.description: A cinematic anime portrait prompt for creating a glowing storm-spirit woman with white hair, kimono, lightning textures, and a dark supernatural mood.
en.prompt: Create a single-panel vertical anime-style portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a mysterious yokai woman"} shown from the chest up in left-facing profile, head tilted slightly upward with a calm, distant expression. She has luminous pure white hair in a loose low bun, with wispy bangs and flyaway strands glowing like overexposed light; one dark hairpin pierces the bun horizontally and has a small dangling chain with a tassel. Her skin and robe are deep electric blue, filled with storm-cloud textures and branching white lightning veins, as if her body is made of a living thunderstorm. She wears a traditional kimono with a pale collar and layered folds, the fabric blending into cloud patches and lightning streaks. Use an intense cyan-blue rim light tracing the entire silhouette, high contrast against a nearly black charcoal background. The composition is centered slightly right, with the face on the left third and the bright hair dominating the upper right. Style: cinematic Japanese anime illustration, ethereal supernatural villain energy, soft painterly edges, glowing bloom, volumetric light, delicate linework, dramatic darkness, no extra characters, no readable text except an optional tiny artist-signature-like scribble in the top right. Color palette should be black, electric blue, cyan, and pure white. Make the image feel like a beautiful thunder spirit inspired by {argument name="mood reference" default="a cold, elegant Spider-Man villain atmosphere"}.

zh.title: 电光蓝妖怪女性肖像
zh.description: 一个电影感动漫肖像提示词，用于创作一位拥有白发、身着和服、带有闪电纹理且充满暗黑超自然氛围的发光风暴精灵女性。
zh.prompt: 创作一张单格竖版动漫风格肖像，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的妖怪女性"}，展示胸部以上部位，呈左侧侧面视角，头部微微向上倾斜，表情冷静而疏离。她留着发光的纯白头发，扎成松散的低发髻，带有凌乱的刘海和像过曝灯光一样发光的碎发；一根深色发簪横向穿过发髻，并挂着一条带有流苏的小链子。她的皮肤和长袍呈深电光蓝色，布满了风暴云纹理和分叉的白色闪电脉络，仿佛她的身体是由活生生的雷暴构成。她身穿带有浅色领口和层叠褶皱的传统和服，布料融入了云朵斑块和闪电条纹。使用强烈的青蓝色轮廓光勾勒出整个剪影，与近乎黑色的炭灰色背景形成高对比度。构图略微偏右，脸部位于左侧三分之一处，明亮的头发占据右上角。风格：电影感日本动漫插画、空灵的超自然反派气质、柔和的绘画边缘、发光晕影、体积光、精致的线条、戏剧性的黑暗感，无额外角色，除右上角可选的微小艺术家签名式涂鸦外，无任何可读文字。调色板应为黑色、电光蓝、青色和纯白色。让画面呈现出一种受 {argument name="mood reference" default="冷峻优雅的蜘蛛侠反派氛围"} 启发的绝美雷电精灵之感。

en.title: Distressed Blind Date Story Poster
en.description: Creates a gritty Chinese old-magazine narrative collage about a melancholic blind-date memory, suitable for emotional social media storytelling.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical old-magazine narrative poster about a past blind-date relationship story, in a gritty Chinese editorial zine style, using one young woman as the only person shown.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 poster, aged off-white paper background with gray stains, black ink smears, torn-paper edges, photocopy grain, rough brush textures, red distressed accent marks, and a slightly messy collage layout.

Subject details: Show one East Asian young woman with {argument name="hair style" default="long straight black hair"}, pale skin, soft makeup, and a quiet distant expression. She wears {argument name="outfit" default="a black off-shoulder knit top"} in every photo. Keep her face consistent across all appearances.

Layout: Use exactly 4 black-and-white/sepia-tinted photo panels of the same woman: 1 large main portrait near the upper center-right where she holds a phone and looks sideways with a cold, reserved expression; 1 small photo at bottom-left where she drinks through a straw while looking down; 1 small tilted photo at mid-right where she rests her chin on her hand and looks down; 1 small tilted photo near the bottom-right where she looks at a phone with a faint restrained smile. Photos should have torn borders, uneven crop edges, taped scrapbook placement, and dark grunge overlays.

Typography and text: Make the poster text-heavy like a Chinese emotional magazine spread. Use bold Chinese headline typography with black body copy and deep red emphasis. Place a huge vertical title on the right reading {argument name="main title" default="相亲往事"}. Add small English subtitle beside it: “PAST DATING STORIES”. Add two slim vertical Chinese side notes near the title: “有些人错过了是遗憾” and “有些人没开始反而是幸运”. On the left and lower center, arrange multiple Chinese story paragraphs in compact columns, resembling an autobiographical dating essay. Include one large bold pull quote near the lower right reading {argument name="pull quote" default="感情里最累的，不是明确的拒绝，而是她冷着你，却有人一直让你再主动一点。"}. Include another bold paragraph on the left with red final line reading {argument name="left emphasis text" default="后来聊天不冷不热，约她出来也总说忙，我慢慢觉得不合适，就不再主动联系了。"}. Add a black rectangular caption block near the lower middle with white Chinese text, plus a red quoted sentence below it reading {argument name="accusation quote" default="你是不是在亲相亲没人要，没人相中你，所以又来找我聊？"}.

Visual style: Melancholy, nostalgic, urban, emotionally restrained, like a 1990s distressed magazine page mixed with modern social-media storytelling. High contrast monochrome portraits, muted red ink, rough halftone texture, torn collage, imperfect alignment, and worn printed-paper grain.

Constraints: Use only the same woman, no other people. Keep exactly 4 photo panels. Keep the overall composition dense but readable. Do not add logos, watermarks, QR codes, or extra decorative characters.

zh.title: 颓废风相亲往事海报
zh.description: 创作一张关于忧郁相亲回忆的中国老式杂志叙事拼贴海报，风格粗粝，适合情感类社交媒体叙事。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张关于过往相亲故事的竖版老式杂志叙事海报，采用粗粝的中国编辑类杂志风格，画面中仅出现一名年轻女性。

画布：2:3 竖版海报，背景为泛黄的旧纸张，带有灰色污渍、黑色墨迹、撕纸边缘、复印颗粒感、粗糙的笔触、红色的做旧强调标记，以及略显凌乱的拼贴布局。

主体细节：展示一名东亚年轻女性，拥有 {argument name="hair style" default="黑色长直发"}，皮肤白皙，妆容清淡，表情安静且疏离。她在每张照片中均穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="黑色露肩针织衫"}。确保她在所有画面中的面部特征保持一致。

布局：使用 4 张黑白/棕褐色调的同一女性照片：1 张大型主肖像位于中上方偏右，她拿着手机，侧头看向一旁，表情冷淡克制；1 张小型照片位于左下角，她低头用吸管喝水；1 张小型倾斜照片位于中右侧，她托腮低头；1 张小型倾斜照片位于右下角附近，她看着手机，带着一丝克制的浅笑。照片应具有撕裂边缘、不规则裁剪、胶带粘贴的剪贴簿质感以及深色的颓废风格叠加效果。

排版与文字：海报需文字密集，呈现出中国情感类杂志内页的质感。使用粗体中文标题排版，正文为黑色，重点内容使用深红色。在右侧放置一个巨大的竖排标题 {argument name="main title" default="相亲往事"}。旁边添加小型英文副标题：“PAST DATING STORIES”。在标题旁添加两行细长的竖排中文侧注：“有些人错过了是遗憾”和“有些人没开始反而是幸运”。在左侧和下部中心，排列多段紧凑的中文叙事段落，如同自传体相亲散文。在右下角附近包含一段醒目的粗体引语 {argument name="pull quote" default="感情里最累的，不是明确的拒绝，而是她冷着你，却有人一直让你再主动一点。"}。在左侧包含另一段粗体段落，最后一行用红色标注 {argument name="left emphasis text" default="后来聊天不冷不热，约她出来也总说忙，我慢慢觉得不合适，就不再主动联系了。"}。在下部中间添加一个黑色矩形说明框，内含白色中文文字，下方配有一句红色引用句 {argument name="accusation quote" default="你是不是在亲相亲没人要，没人相中你，所以又来找我聊？"}。

视觉风格：忧郁、怀旧、都市、情感克制，如同 20 世纪 90 年代的做旧杂志页面与现代社交媒体叙事的结合。高对比度的单色肖像、暗红色墨迹、粗糙的半色调纹理、撕裂拼贴、不完美的对齐以及磨损的印刷纸张颗粒感。

约束条件：仅使用同一名女性，画面中不得出现其他人。保持 4 张照片面板。整体构图需密集但具备可读性。不得添加任何 Logo、水印、二维码或额外的装饰性字符。

en.title: Badass Secretary Dossier Poster
en.description: A cinematic classified-file action poster featuring a sword-wielding executive secretary with bold red dossier typography and grunge spy-thriller styling.
en.prompt: Create a gritty cinematic vertical dossier poster for {argument name="operation title" default="BADASS SECRETARY"}. The artwork shows a fierce young East Asian woman in a black pinstripe business suit and white dress shirt, posed dynamically as if mid-action, gripping a black katana or ornate tactical sword handle in the lower left foreground. She has long black hair with bangs, windblown strands sweeping left across the poster, intense direct eye contact, subtle hoop earring, and a confident dangerous expression. Style it like a classified government action-thriller file: aged beige paper background, cracked and stained texture, red-and-black grunge overlays, censor bars, stamped marks, dossier typography, halftone dirt, scratches, torn-paper shadows, and cinematic rim lighting. Use a portrait 9:16 composition with the character centered slightly right, upper body angled diagonally, sword handle at bottom left, and the huge title occupying the lower middle in bold condensed block letters colored distressed red with black shadowing. Include exactly these visible text elements and labels: top left “OFFICE OF EXECUTIVE OPERATIONS” and “INTERNAL DOSSIER: LEVEL 7 CLEARANCE ONLY”; top right file box “FILE NO. {argument name="file number" default="BDS-0724-A"}”; a circular red “TOP SECRET” stamp with “EYES ONLY”; left subject panel “SUBJECT: {argument name="subject status" default="UNKNOWN. UNSTOPPABLE."}”; small review lines “REVIEWED BY: 7/24” and “DATE: 07/24”; asset card titled “ASSET PROFILE” listing “INTELLIGENCE: EXCEPTIONAL”, “STRATEGY: INGENIOUS”, “DISCRETION: ABSOLUTE”, “OUTCOME: INEVITABLE”; small red tag “BDS-0724-A”; warning strip “// HANDLE WITH EXTREME CAUTION”; right quote block “SHE DOESN’T FOLLOW THE PROTOCOL. SHE IS THE PROTOCOL.”; small label above title “OPERATION:”; main title “BADASS SECRETARY”; subtitle strip “SILENCE. STRATEGY. SUCCESS.”; line below “THREE THINGS SHE DOESN’T OUTSOURCE.”; bottom right stamp “CLASSIFIED / LEVEL 7 CLEARANCE REQUIRED / [NO EXCEPTIONS]”; bottom left “DISTRIBUTION: DIRECTORATE ONLY”; bottom large red stamp “MISSION: RESULTS ONLY”; and a small Japanese-style note in red near the lower right reading “仕事は完璧に。敵は無慈悲に。私は、誰にも従わない。” Keep the poster dense but legible, with many horizontal black redaction bars and red accent blocks, high contrast, dramatic shadows, editorial movie-poster finish, no watermark, no extra characters.

zh.title: “全能秘书”机密档案海报
zh.description: 一张电影质感的机密档案动作海报，主角是一位手持利剑的行政秘书，配以醒目的红色档案字体和粗犷的谍战惊悚风格。
zh.prompt: 创作一张充满电影质感的竖版机密档案海报，主题为 {argument name="operation title" default="BADASS SECRETARY"}。画面展示了一位外表冷峻的东亚年轻女性，身穿黑色细条纹商务西装和白色衬衫，动作动态十足，左下角前景中握着一把黑色武士刀或精致的战术长剑剑柄。她留着黑色长发，带有刘海，发丝随风向左飘动，眼神犀利直视前方，佩戴着精致的圆环耳饰，表情自信且危险。整体风格模仿政府机密动作惊悚档案：采用做旧的米色纸张背景，带有裂纹和污渍纹理，叠加红黑色的粗犷效果、审查遮盖条、印章标记、档案字体、半色调污垢、划痕、撕纸阴影以及电影级的轮廓光。采用 9:16 的竖构图，人物略微偏右，上半身呈对角线倾斜，剑柄位于左下角，巨大的标题以粗体压缩块状字体占据中下部，颜色为做旧的红色并带有黑色阴影。必须包含以下可见的文字元素和标签：左上角“OFFICE OF EXECUTIVE OPERATIONS”（行政行动办公室）和“INTERNAL DOSSIER: LEVEL 7 CLEARANCE ONLY”（内部档案：仅限 7 级权限）；右上角文件框“FILE NO. {argument name="file number" default="BDS-0724-A"}”；一个圆形的红色“TOP SECRET”（绝密）印章，标注“EYES ONLY”（仅限阅览）；左侧主体面板“SUBJECT: {argument name="subject status" default="UNKNOWN. UNSTOPPABLE."}”（主体：身份不明。势不可挡。）；小型审查行“REVIEWED BY: 7/24”（审查人：7/24）和“DATE: 07/24”（日期：07/24）；资产卡片标题“ASSET PROFILE”（资产档案），列出“INTELLIGENCE: EXCEPTIONAL”（情报：卓越）、“STRATEGY: INGENIOUS”（策略：精妙）、“DISCRETION: ABSOLUTE”（谨慎：绝对）、“OUTCOME: INEVITABLE”（结果：必然）；红色小标签“BDS-0724-A”；警告条“// HANDLE WITH EXTREME CAUTION”（// 请极其谨慎处理）；右侧引语块“SHE DOESN’T FOLLOW THE PROTOCOL. SHE IS THE PROTOCOL.”（她不遵循协议。她就是协议本身。）；标题上方的小标签“OPERATION:”（行动：）；主标题“BADASS SECRETARY”；副标题条“SILENCE. STRATEGY. SUCCESS.”（沉默。策略。成功。）；下方一行字“THREE THINGS SHE DOESN’T OUTSOURCE.”（她从不外包的三件事。）；右下角印章“CLASSIFIED / LEVEL 7 CLEARANCE REQUIRED / [NO EXCEPTIONS]”（已归档 / 需 7 级权限 / [无例外]）；左下角“DISTRIBUTION: DIRECTORATE ONLY”（分发：仅限董事会）；底部大型红色印章“MISSION: RESULTS ONLY”（任务：只看结果）；以及右下角附近的一行红色日文小字“仕事は完璧に。敵は無慈悲に。私は、誰にも従わない。”（工作追求完美，对待敌人冷酷无情。我，不服从任何人。）海报内容丰富但清晰易读，包含大量水平黑色遮盖条和红色强调块，高对比度，戏剧性阴影，电影海报级的后期处理，无水印，无多余字符。

en.title: Chibi Prison Break Comic Scene
en.description: Generates a wide chibi anime comic illustration of an idol prisoner kicking through a jail wall while guards react in the corridor.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a wide single-panel chibi anime comic illustration about a prison breakout scene, split visually into two labeled areas: a dark jail cell on the left and a brighter guard corridor on the right.

Canvas: 16:9 horizontal image, polished digital anime style, cute chibi proportions, clean line art, soft cel shading, dramatic lighting from the wall impact, high detail but readable composition.

Layout: The left two-thirds show the prison cell interior with blue-gray stone walls, barred doors, a metal bed, and a toilet. The right third shows the guard corridor outside the bars, lit with warmer beige light. Use a vertical boundary created by the cell bars and wall. Add a large cracked hole being smashed into the stone wall near the center-right of the cell, with debris, dust, and a bright orange impact flash.

Text content: Include exactly 6 visible Japanese text elements: 1 top-left white label box reading {argument name="left area label" default="牢獄"}; 1 top-right white label box reading {argument name="right area label" default="看守通路"}; 1 small label near the toilet reading {argument name="toilet label" default="トイレ"}; 1 bottom-right label reading {argument name="bottom label" default="サムズアップ　看守通路"}; 1 speech bubble above the pink-haired guard reading {argument name="first speech bubble" default="怪しいアイドルね？"}; 1 speech bubble above the lavender-haired guard reading {argument name="second speech bubble" default="怪しすぎる元アイドルですね。"}. Add small stylized sleep sound effects around the sleeping prisoner, including Japanese-style blue “zzz” marks and a sleepy ellipsis.

Characters: Include exactly 5 chibi female characters. Character 1: a blonde idol prisoner in the center of the cell, energetic and smiling, wearing a black-and-gold idol combat outfit with star accessories and thigh-high boots, mid-kick with one leg extended into the stone wall, creating the explosion and cracks. Character 2: a pink-haired twin-tail guard outside the bars near the lower right center, wearing a navy-and-white uniform with a small black cap, giving a thumbs-up while watching the breakout. Character 3: a red/pink-haired guard in a dark military-style uniform and red-star cap, standing to the right with a suspicious worried expression, sweat drops beside her face. Character 4: a lavender-haired bespectacled guard in a white sailor-like uniform and white cap, standing at the far right with a calm skeptical expression. Character 5: a sleeping prisoner on the upper-left metal bed, pale pink hair, wearing a dark outfit and cap, curled on her side with closed eyes and blue sleep symbols.

Props and environment: Include exactly 2 major cell fixtures: 1 metal bed at the upper left and 1 white toilet at the lower left. The toilet has a cloth doll or plush idol with X-shaped eyes sitting on it. Add metal bars in the foreground and background, stone block walls, cracked masonry, scattered rubble, and a small barred window high on the back wall.

Visual style: Cute chibi anime, expressive faces, slight isometric perspective, comic panel composition, detailed prison background, contrast between cool blue prison lighting and warm corridor lighting, no photorealism.

Constraints: Keep the scene as one continuous illustration, not a multi-panel grid. Preserve the exact count of 5 characters, 2 main fixtures, 6 Japanese text elements, and 2 speech bubbles. Do not add extra characters, extra panels, watermarks, or English replacement text.

zh.title: Q 版监狱逃脱漫画场景
zh.description: 生成一张宽幅 Q 版动漫漫画插图，描绘一名偶像囚犯踢破监狱墙壁，走廊里的守卫做出反应的场景。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张宽幅单格 Q 版动漫漫画插图，表现监狱逃脱场景，视觉上分为两个标注区域：左侧阴暗的牢房和右侧明亮的看守通路。

画布：16:9 横向图像，精致的数字动漫风格，可爱的 Q 版比例，干净的线条，柔和的赛璐珞阴影，墙壁撞击产生的戏剧性光效，细节丰富且构图清晰。

布局：左侧三分之二展示牢房内部，包括蓝灰色石墙、铁栏杆门、金属床和马桶。右侧三分之一展示栏杆外的看守通路，灯光为温暖的米色。利用牢房栏杆和墙壁形成垂直边界。在牢房中右侧的石墙上添加一个被砸开的大洞，伴有碎片、灰尘和明亮的橙色撞击闪光。

文本内容：包含 6 个可见的日语文本元素：1 个左上角白色标签框，内容为 {argument name="left area label" default="牢狱"}；1 个右上角白色标签框，内容为 {argument name="right area label" default="看守通路"}；1 个马桶附近的小标签，内容为 {argument name="toilet label" default="トイレ"}；1 个右下角标签，内容为 {argument name="bottom label" default="サムズアップ　看守通路"}；1 个粉发守卫上方的对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="first speech bubble" default="怪しいアイドルね？"}；1 个薰衣草色头发守卫上方的对话气泡，内容为 {argument name="second speech bubble" default="怪しすぎる元アイドルですね。"}。在睡觉的囚犯周围添加小巧的风格化睡眠音效，包括日式蓝色“zzz”符号和困倦的省略号。

角色：包含 5 个 Q 版女性角色。角色 1：牢房中央的金发偶像囚犯，充满活力且面带微笑，身穿黑金配色偶像战斗服，配有星星饰品和过膝长靴，正在踢腿，一只脚伸入石墙，造成爆炸和裂纹。角色 2：栏杆外右下侧的粉发双马尾守卫，身穿海军蓝白制服，戴着小黑帽，一边观看越狱一边竖起大拇指。角色 3：右侧身穿深色军装、戴红星帽的红/粉发守卫，表情怀疑且担忧，脸旁有汗滴。角色 4：最右侧戴眼镜的薰衣草色头发守卫，身穿白色水手风制服和白帽，表情冷静且持怀疑态度。角色 5：左上角金属床上睡觉的囚犯，浅粉色头发，身穿深色服装和帽子，侧身蜷缩，闭着眼睛，带有蓝色睡眠符号。

道具与环境：包含 2 个主要的牢房设施：左上角的金属床和左下角的白色马桶。马桶上坐着一个眼睛呈 X 型的布偶或偶像玩偶。在前景和背景中添加金属栏杆、石块墙、破碎的砖石、散落的瓦砾以及后墙高处的小型带栏杆窗户。

视觉风格：可爱的 Q 版动漫，表情生动，轻微的等轴测视角，漫画分格构图，细致的监狱背景，冷色调监狱光线与暖色调走廊光线的对比，非写实风格。

约束：保持场景为一张连续的插图，而非多格网格。保留 5 个角色、2 个主要设施、6 个日语文本元素和 2 个对话气泡的精确数量。不要添加额外的角色、额外的分格、水印或英文替换文本。

en.title: Burgundy Red Carpet Movie Star
en.description: A photorealistic full-body celebrity red carpet scene featuring an elegant woman in a couture gown, ideal for fashion or movie-premiere visuals.
en.prompt: Create a glamorous full-body red carpet fashion image in a photorealistic live-action style. The sole subject is a poised young female movie star with long dark brown wavy hair, a slim natural figure, and an elegant confident expression, walking down the center of a luxurious international film premiere red carpet. She is captured at the decisive moment just before stopping, facing forward with a very slight natural angle, one leg stepping forward, relaxed shoulders and arms, and subtle motion in her hair and dress hem. Dress her in a luxurious {argument name="dress color" default="deep burgundy"} floor-length couture gown with an asymmetrical one-shoulder neckline, refined draping gathered at the waist, a tasteful front slit that allows natural walking movement, and rich satin fabric with soft highlights; pair it with slim matching strappy high heels. Place her fully inside the frame from head to toe, centered on a long red carpet with strong depth perspective. On both sides of the carpet, include crowds of photographers and spectators behind red velvet ropes with gold stanchions, camera flashes, and black evening attire. In the background, show a grand historic theater entrance or palace-like premiere venue, warm architectural lighting, overhead spotlights, and four tall vertical LED screens displaying abstract red-and-gold sparkling graphics, with two screens on each side of the walkway. Use cinematic event lighting, shallow background blur, crisp focus on the woman, natural body proportions, no exaggerated wide-angle distortion, no text, no watermark, no extra main characters, no cropped feet or dress hem. Use a {argument name="aspect ratio" default="1:1"} composition with enough surrounding space to show the red carpet depth and celebrity atmosphere.

zh.title: 勃艮第红酒色红毯电影明星
zh.description: 一张照片级写实的全身名人红毯场景，主角为身着高级定制礼服的优雅女性，非常适合时尚或电影首映相关的视觉呈现。
zh.prompt: 创作一张照片级写实的真人风格全身红毯时尚图像。画面唯一主体是一位从容优雅的年轻电影明星，留着深棕色长波浪卷发，身材苗条自然，神情优雅自信，正走在豪华国际电影首映红毯的中央。捕捉她即将停步前的决定性瞬间，正面向前并带有极其细微的自然角度，一条腿向前迈出，双肩和手臂放松，头发和裙摆带有细微的动态感。为她穿上一件奢华的 {argument name="dress color" default="深勃艮第红"} 拖地高级定制礼服，采用不对称单肩领口，腰部有精致的褶皱设计，前开叉设计便于自然行走，面料为带有柔和光泽的丝缎；搭配同色系细带高跟鞋。将她全身置于画面中心，背景为具有强烈纵深感的长红毯。红毯两侧设置红丝绒绳和金色立柱，后方是摄影师和观众人群，伴有相机闪光灯，人群身着黑色晚礼服。背景展示宏伟的历史剧院入口或宫殿般的首映场地，配以温暖的建筑灯光、头顶聚光灯，以及四块高大的垂直 LED 屏幕，屏幕上显示抽象的红金闪烁图形，通道两侧各两块。采用电影级活动布光，背景浅景深虚化，焦点清晰聚焦于女性主体，人体比例自然，无夸张的广角畸变，无文字，无水印，无额外主角，无脚部或裙摆裁剪。使用 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="1:1"} 的构图，留出足够的周围空间以展现红毯的纵深感和名人氛围。

en.title: Dark Fantasy AI Gallery UI
en.description: A prompt for creating a vertical mobile gallery interface featuring two enchanted underwater forest illustrations with a lantern girl and goldfish.
en.prompt: Create a vertical dark mobile app-style gallery screenshot showing two fantasy AI-generated images inside a charcoal interface. Canvas is tall 9:16 with rounded corners, dark grey background, subtle vertical pinstripe texture, thin top status-like color strip, and soft UI shadows. At the upper left place one small square user avatar card: an anime-style young person with short dark green hair, beret, light skin, neutral smile, framed by a translucent futuristic ID-card border. Main layout contains exactly 2 large rounded image panels stacked vertically on the right/center: the first smaller square-ish panel near the top, the second larger nearly full-width panel below. Under the first panel include faint grey text reading “KAI generated Image 1”. The artwork in both panels should depict a dark enchanted underwater forest: a little girl in a dress holding a glowing blue lantern, surrounded by dense seaweed, coral-like plants, twisting roots, bubbles, and oversized floating goldfish. Use moody teal, navy, charcoal, copper-orange, and bioluminescent cyan lighting, with highly detailed painterly fantasy illustration style. In the top panel, show the girl from behind walking down a narrow cobblestone path into a tunnel of aquatic plants, holding the lantern low; include exactly 4 prominent fish: 2 orange goldfish near the top, 1 pale grey fish on the right, and 1 small dark fish near the center. In the bottom panel, show a closer vertical underwater scene with the girl in profile looking upward from the lower center-left while holding the glowing lantern; include exactly 6 visible fish: 1 large orange goldfish upper left, 1 small orange fish upper left background, 1 pale fish top center, 1 pale fish upper right, 1 grey fish lower left, and 1 orange-grey fish mid-right. Along the bottom place a floating dark toolbar with exactly 7 circular icon buttons: green OpenAI knot icon, purple sparkle/star icon, orange sunburst icon, multicolor three-circle palette icon, grey broom/brush icon, grey hammer icon, and red feather/quill icon. Make the interface slightly translucent and futuristic, but keep the fantasy images as the visual focus. No extra text, no watermark.

zh.title: 暗黑奇幻风格 AI 画廊 UI
zh.description: 一个用于创建垂直移动端画廊界面的提示词，展示两幅带有灯笼女孩和金鱼的沉浸式水下森林插画。
zh.prompt: 创建一个垂直的暗黑移动端 App 风格画廊截图，在炭灰色界面内展示两幅 AI 生成的奇幻图像。画布为 9:16 的长比例，带有圆角、深灰色背景、细微的垂直细条纹质感、顶部的细长状态栏色带以及柔和的 UI 阴影。在左上角放置一张小型方形用户头像卡片：一位动漫风格的年轻人，留着深绿色短发，戴着贝雷帽，肤色白皙，表情平和，外框为半透明的未来感 ID 卡边框。主要布局包含 2 个垂直堆叠在右侧/中央的大型圆角图像面板：上方为较小的方形面板，下方为几乎全宽的较大面板。在第一个面板下方加入淡淡的灰色文字“KAI generated Image 1”。两幅面板中的艺术作品应描绘一个暗黑的魔法水下森林：一个小女孩穿着裙子，手提发光的蓝色灯笼，周围环绕着茂密的海藻、珊瑚状植物、扭曲的根系、气泡和巨大的漂浮金鱼。使用忧郁的青色、海军蓝、炭灰色、铜橙色以及生物发光的青色照明，呈现高度细腻的绘画风格奇幻插画。在顶部面板中，展示女孩从背后走向水生植物隧道中狭窄鹅卵石小径的场景，灯笼提得很低；包含 4 条显眼的鱼：顶部附近 2 条橙色金鱼，右侧 1 条浅灰色鱼，中心附近 1 条深色小鱼。在底部面板中，展示一个更近距离的垂直水下场景，女孩从左下侧向上仰望，同时手提发光的灯笼；包含 6 条可见的鱼：左上角 1 条大型橙色金鱼，左上背景 1 条橙色小鱼，顶部中心 1 条浅色鱼，右上角 1 条浅色鱼，左下角 1 条灰色鱼，中右侧 1 条橙灰色鱼。沿底部放置一个悬浮的深色工具栏，包含 7 个圆形图标按钮：绿色 OpenAI 结图标、紫色闪光/星星图标、橙色太阳光芒图标、多色三圆调色板图标、灰色扫帚/画笔图标、灰色锤子图标以及红色羽毛/羽毛笔图标。使界面呈现出轻微的半透明感和未来感，但保持奇幻图像作为视觉焦点。不要添加额外文字，不要有水印。

en.title: Urban Winter Sofa Fashion Editorial
en.description: A cinematic fashion photo prompt featuring a moody model on a worn sofa in a wet winter city street.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic fashion editorial photograph in a cold urban street at dusk: a young adult woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long wavy blonde hair with darker roots"} sits curled on a worn olive-tan vintage sofa placed directly in the middle of a wet city road. She wears an oversized {argument name="coat style" default="cream faux-fur coat"}, black fishnet tights, and chunky black lace-up combat boots; her legs are crossed, arms folded close to her body, and she stares intensely into the camera with a moody, slightly defiant expression. The sofa has exactly four visible cushions: one long back cushion, one large seat cushion, and two loose side pillows, with damp stains and scuffed fabric. Surround the scene with gritty downtown architecture: tall brick and stone buildings on both sides, arched windows on the right, parked cars along the curb on the left, exactly two dark mailboxes/trash receptacles behind the sofa, one yellow school bus in the distant center-left, and small piles of melting snow along the sidewalks and curb. The street surface should be wet and reflective, with scattered slush, muted winter colors, and a cold blue-gray atmosphere. Use shallow depth of field with the model and sofa sharp, background softly blurred, wide-angle street perspective, low eye-level camera, realistic film grain, subtle lens flare or blown streetlight glow in the upper left, slight analog scratches, high-end fashion photography styling, natural overcast dusk light, dramatic contrast, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 都市冬季沙发时尚大片
zh.description: 一个电影感时尚摄影提示词，描绘了一位情绪饱满的模特坐在潮湿冬日街道的破旧沙发上。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影感时尚大片，场景设定在黄昏时分寒冷的城市街道：一位年轻女性（{argument name="hair color" default="深发根长波浪金发"}）蜷缩坐在一张放置在潮湿城市道路中央的破旧橄榄棕色复古沙发上。她身穿一件超大款 {argument name="coat style" default="奶油色人造皮草大衣"}，搭配黑色渔网袜和厚底黑色系带马丁靴；她双腿交叉，双臂抱紧身体，眼神忧郁且略带挑衅地凝视着镜头。沙发上清晰可见四个靠垫：一个长靠背垫、一个大坐垫和两个松散的侧枕，布料上有潮湿的污渍和磨损痕迹。场景周围环绕着粗犷的市中心建筑：两侧是高大的砖石建筑，右侧有拱形窗户，左侧路边停放着汽车，沙发后方正好有两个深色的邮箱/垃圾桶，远处左中方有一辆黄色校车，人行道和路缘边堆积着少量融化的积雪。街道表面应湿润且具有反射感，散布着泥泞，色调为柔和的冬季色彩，营造出冷峻的蓝灰色氛围。采用浅景深效果，使模特和沙发保持清晰，背景柔焦处理，广角街道视角，低机位拍摄，呈现真实的胶片颗粒感，左上角有细微的镜头光晕或路灯辉光，带有轻微的模拟划痕，高端时尚摄影风格，自然阴天黄昏光线，戏剧性对比度，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Burgundy Anime Street Silhouette
en.description: Generates a vintage monochrome anime illustration of an elegant woman silhouetted in an old European street, suitable for stylized AI art posters.
en.prompt: Create a vertical 3:4 monochrome anime-style illustration in deep oxblood red ink on a warm cream paper background, like a high-contrast stencil and loose brush sketch. The scene is a romantic old European city street viewed in perspective, with tall narrow medieval buildings on both sides, steep rooftops, pointed towers, clock-tower silhouettes, awnings, shopfronts, and distant pedestrians fading into the bright central street. In the foreground, place a mysterious elegant young woman, {argument name="character name" default="Ouwa Days"}, shown mostly as a dark silhouette from behind and slightly in profile, wearing a very large tilted wide-brim hat decorated with flowers, wavy shoulder-length hair, and a flowing dress or shawl with transparent ribbon-like fabric trailing leftward. Add floral ornamentation on her outfit: exactly 1 flower cluster on the hat and exactly 3 prominent flower clusters on the dress/shawl. Include exactly 2 ornate wall-mounted street lamps, one on the left building and one on the right building. Include small distant human silhouettes in the street, clustered naturally but not detailed. Use dynamic ink splashes, jagged brush edges, sketchy architectural linework, and strong negative space in the sky and street. Keep the palette to only {argument name="ink color" default="dark burgundy red"} and {argument name="paper color" default="warm ivory cream"}. In the bottom-right corner, add a small handwritten signature reading {argument name="signature text" default="ouwa days"} with a small paw-print icon beside it. No additional colors, no photorealism, no modern objects, no border.

zh.title: 酒红色动漫街头剪影
zh.description: 生成一张复古单色动漫风格插画，描绘了一位优雅女性在欧洲古街的剪影，适用于风格化的 AI 艺术海报。
