动作面板及可见标签：面板 01 标签“PROFILE WS / FIRST BREAK”，展示她在街头滑行并向敌人射击。面板 02 标签“LOW PROFILE FS / TRIPLE BURST”，展示低姿态滑行并进行三连发射击。面板 03 标签“HIGH REAR WS / LANE RUSH”，展示她沿着车道向人群冲刺。面板 04 标签“LOW 3-4 FS / RISING ASSAULT”，展示针对无人机的空中上升攻击。面板 05 标签“HIGH SIDE WS / MIDAIR SWEEP”，展示带有激光射击和多架无人机的空中横扫。面板 06 标签“GROUND REAR WS / HEAVY BLOCK”，展示她格挡或抵御重装敌人的攻击。面板 07 标签“PROFILE MS / COUNTER PUSH”，展示针对近身装甲敌人的侧面反击。面板 08 标签“LOW 3-4 FS / POWER DRAW”，展示她双臂高举，身处品红色闪电下，被敌人包围。面板 09 标签“TOP-DOWN EWS / NEON CASCADE”，展示从上方俯瞰，巨大的粉色能量新月波切开大批人群。

文本风格：主要标题使用粗犷的手绘大写字母，注释使用微小的技术性大写标签，面板标题使用红色数字标签。保持主要英文标签的可读性，但允许小型的赛博朋克微型文本作为装饰。

视觉风格约束：拒绝照片写实主义。保持精致的动漫概念艺术风格，具有朋克涂鸦能量、强烈的品红色激光效果、青色服装、黄绿色喷漆效果、黑色垃圾纹理和动态速度线。严格保持数量：3 个三视图，2 个武器图示，5 个武器标注，1 个英雄特写，9 个动作面板。

en.title: Taiki Shuttle Anime Conversion
en.description: Transforms a cosplay reference into a clean full-body Uma Musume-style anime character illustration with a cowgirl pose and revolver prop.
en.prompt: Using the provided reference image as the character and outfit base, transform the cosplay photo into a polished full-body anime illustration in the official Uma Musume-style fan art look. Keep the same cowgirl horse-girl identity, hat with horse ears, blonde ponytail, blue eyes, red neck scarf, green-and-black backless outfit, brown gloves and belt pouch, green skirt with white trim, long tail, and purple thigh-high boots. Change the camera angle into a clean full-body rear three-quarter pose on a plain white background, with the character smiling back over her shoulder. Add one new prop: a silver revolver held upright in her raised right hand near the hat. Make the anatomy stylized and dynamic, with crisp cel shading, glossy highlights, clean line art, vibrant colors, and no photorealism. Character identity: {argument name="character name" default="Taiki Shuttle from Uma Musume"}. Art style: {argument name="art style" default="high-quality anime game character illustration"}. Background: {argument name="background" default="plain white studio background"}. Prop: {argument name="handheld prop" default="silver revolver"}. Pose: {argument name="pose" default="full-body rear three-quarter pose, smiling back with one arm raised"}.

zh.title: Taiki Shuttle 动漫风格转换
zh.description: 将 Cosplay 参考图转换为精致的《赛马娘》风格全身动漫角色插画，包含牛仔姿势及左轮手枪道具。
zh.prompt: 以提供的参考图作为角色和服装基础，将 Cosplay 照片转换为精致的《赛马娘》官方同人风格全身动漫插画。保留其标志性的牛仔赛马娘形象：带有马耳的帽子、金色马尾、蓝色眼睛、红色领巾、绿黑配色露背装、棕色手套和腰包、带白色饰边的绿色短裙、长尾巴以及紫色过膝长靴。将拍摄角度调整为简洁的全身后侧四分之三视角，背景设为纯白色，角色回眸微笑。增加一个新道具：右手举起靠近帽子，手中握有一把银色左轮手枪。人物结构需具备风格化与动态感，采用清晰的赛璐珞上色、光泽高光、利落的线条以及鲜艳的色彩，避免写实风格。角色身份：{argument name="character name" default="《赛马娘》中的 Taiki Shuttle"}。艺术风格：{argument name="art style" default="高质量动漫游戏角色插画"}。背景：{argument name="background" default="纯白色摄影棚背景"}。道具：{argument name="handheld prop" default="银色左轮手枪"}。姿势：{argument name="pose" default="全身后侧四分之三姿势，回眸微笑并单手举起"}。

en.title: Zero-Gravity Survival Storyboard
en.description: A 16-panel retro-futurist anime storyboard for a short zero-gravity survival sequence aboard a failing derelict space station.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a detailed 16-panel storyboard for a 15-second animated zero-gravity survival short in a hard-edged retro-futurist anime style.

Canvas: One wide 4:3 storyboard sheet divided into exactly 16 equal panels in a 4-column by 4-row grid, with thin black gutters. Put a small white panel number in the top-left corner of each panel, numbered 1 through 16. Use gritty cinematic lighting, dense linework, cel-shaded anime rendering, scratched metal textures, teal coolant vapor, floating debris, and red emergency lights throughout.

Setting: The derelict orbital station {argument name="station name" default="the Halcyon"}, a damaged cylindrical maintenance corridor in zero gravity. The environment is dark, industrial, cramped, and full of exposed conduits, cracked panels, warning lights, sparks, drifting bolts, broken tools, and foggy teal coolant clouds.

Characters: Keep the same two original characters in every relevant panel. Character one is {argument name="young survivor" default="a short-haired orange-haired young woman in a rust-orange pressure suit with a mechanical gauntlet and a round chest gauge"}. Character two is {argument name="veteran survivor" default="an older dark-skinned man in a torn navy armored maintenance suit with a headband visor, stubble, and a rugged face"}. Both are floating in zero gravity, battered, urgent, and afraid but determined.

Panel-by-panel action, exactly 16 panels:
1. Wide establishing shot down the dark derelict corridor, teal coolant vapor billowing through the tunnel, red emergency lights glowing, debris drifting in zero gravity.
2. Close-up of a cracked digital warning monitor reading "00:14:87" and "HULL INTEGRITY FAILING" in red blocky text.
3. Dynamic shot of the young survivor flying forward through the corridor, arm outstretched toward the viewer, mechanical gauntlet visible, teal vapor behind her.
4. The veteran survivor braces himself against a wall panel and cuts or welds at a seam, producing bright orange sparks.
5. Wide shot showing both survivors separated in the corridor, the young survivor drifting left while the veteran is farther back, surrounded by teal vapor and debris.
6. Overhead/tilted zero-gravity view of broken station equipment, pipes, floating objects, and a burst of sparks in the distance.
7. Tight action close-up of the young survivor gripping a metal pipe or rail, face tense, orange suit scratched, red lights and smoke behind her.
8. Repeat-angle close shot of the veteran survivor still cutting the wall panel, shower of bright sparks, his torn sleeve and strained expression visible.
9. Side-profile close-up of the young survivor drifting past a cracked framed photograph or reflective panel showing two faces, suggesting a personal memory; she looks focused and worried.
10. Frontal close-up of the veteran survivor pushing forward through a hatchway or narrow passage, red warning lights behind him, one gloved hand raised toward the viewer.
11. Over-the-shoulder action shot from behind the young survivor as she reaches toward the veteran survivor across a corridor opening.
12. Wide shot through a dense teal coolant cloud with both survivors partially visible on opposite sides, debris tumbling between them.
13. Close-up of the veteran survivor reaching desperately toward camera through the floating debris and vapor, face strained.
14. Extreme close-up of the two survivors clasping gloved hands in zero gravity, centered against teal vapor and drifting debris.
15. Wide shot of both survivors pulling themselves toward a bright blue-white escape hatch or airlock at the end of the corridor, red emergency lights and teal smoke around them.
16. Final medium shot framed by a circular/rounded hatch: the young survivor and veteran survivor are side by side, floating toward the viewer, exhausted but alive, surrounded by cool blue hatch light and red station lights.

Visual style: Hard-edged retro-futurist anime storyboard, high-detail inked panels, gritty sci-fi survival mood, dynamic manga-style angles, dramatic foreshortening, heavy shadows, teal-and-red color palette, cinematic motion, no clean modern UI polish.

Constraints: Use exactly 16 numbered panels and no extra panels. Keep the same two characters, same derelict station, same teal coolant vapor, same red emergency lighting, and consistent costumes across the entire storyboard. Avoid speech bubbles, captions, watermarks, logos, or extra text except the panel numbers and the warning monitor text.

zh.title: 零重力生存故事板
zh.description: 一个 16 格的复古未来主义动画故事板，描绘了一段发生在废弃空间站内的零重力生存短片。
zh.prompt:
目标：为一段 15 秒的硬核复古未来主义动画风格的零重力生存短片，创作一个详细的 16 格故事板。

画布：一张宽幅 4:3 的故事板，划分为 16 个相等的格子，呈 4 行 4 列排列，中间有细黑线分隔。在每个格子的左上角标注白色小数字，从 1 到 16 编号。全程使用粗粝的电影感光效、密集的线条、赛璐珞风格的动画渲染、划痕金属质感、青色冷却剂蒸汽、漂浮碎片以及红色应急灯光。

场景：废弃的轨道空间站 {argument name="station name" default="the Halcyon"}，一个受损的零重力圆柱形维护走廊。环境阴暗、工业感强、空间狭窄，布满了裸露的导管、破裂的面板、警示灯、火花、漂浮的螺栓、损坏的工具以及朦胧的青色冷却剂云雾。

角色：在每个相关格子中保持两名原始角色不变。角色一为 {argument name="young survivor" default="一名短发、橘色头发的年轻女性，身穿锈橘色压力服，佩戴机械护手，胸前有圆形仪表"}。角色二为 {argument name="veteran survivor" default="一名年长的深色皮肤男性，身穿破损的深蓝色装甲维护服，戴着头带式护目镜，留着胡茬，面容坚毅"}。两人都在零重力中漂浮，显得狼狈、急迫，虽恐惧但坚定。

逐格动作，共 16 格：
1. 俯瞰阴暗废弃走廊的广角镜头，青色冷却剂蒸汽在通道中翻涌，红色应急灯闪烁，碎片在零重力中漂浮。
2. 破裂数字警示监视器的特写，红色块状文字显示“00:14:87”和“HULL INTEGRITY FAILING”（船体完整性失效）。
3. 年轻幸存者在走廊中向前飞行的动态镜头，手臂向观众伸出，机械护手清晰可见，身后是青色蒸汽。
4. 老兵幸存者靠在墙板上，切割或焊接接缝处，迸发出明亮的橘色火花。
5. 广角镜头展示两名幸存者在走廊中分离，年轻幸存者向左漂浮，老兵在更后方，周围环绕着青色蒸汽和碎片。
6. 俯视/倾斜的零重力视角，展示损坏的空间站设备、管道、漂浮物以及远处的火花喷溅。
7. 年轻幸存者紧握金属管或扶手的动作特写，表情紧张，橘色防护服上有划痕，身后是红光和烟雾。
8. 老兵幸存者继续切割墙板的重复角度特写，明亮火花四溅，可见其破损的袖口和紧绷的表情。
9. 年轻幸存者漂过一张破裂的相框或反光板的侧面特写，映出两张面孔，暗示一段私人记忆；她神情专注且担忧。
10. 老兵幸存者穿过舱门或狭窄通道的正面特写，身后是红色警示灯，一只戴手套的手向观众抬起。
11. 从年轻幸存者身后拍摄的过肩动作镜头，她正向走廊另一侧的老兵幸存者伸出手。
12. 透过浓厚青色冷却剂云雾的广角镜头，两名幸存者在两侧隐约可见，碎片在他们之间翻滚。
13. 老兵幸存者在漂浮的碎片和蒸汽中绝望地向镜头伸手的特写，面部表情紧绷。
14. 两名幸存者在零重力中紧握戴手套双手的极度特写，背景是青色蒸汽和漂浮碎片。
15. 广角镜头展示两名幸存者正奋力向走廊尽头明亮的蓝白色逃生舱门游去，周围是红色应急灯和青色烟雾。
16. 圆形舱门框住的最终中景镜头：年轻幸存者和老兵幸存者并排漂向观众，精疲力竭但依然活着，周围环绕着清冷的蓝色舱门光线和红色的空间站灯光。

视觉风格：硬核复古未来主义动画故事板，高细节线条，粗粝的科幻生存氛围，动态漫画风格角度，戏剧性的透视缩短，浓重的阴影，青色与红色的配色方案，电影般的动感，拒绝现代 UI 的平滑感。

限制：必须使用 16 个编号格子，不得增加额外格子。保持两名角色、废弃空间站、青色冷却剂蒸汽、红色应急灯光以及服装在整个故事板中保持一致。避免使用对话气泡、说明文字、水印、标志或除格子编号及监视器文字之外的任何额外文字。

en.title: Black Wind Fashion Portrait
en.description: A vertical cinematic wind-swept fashion portrait with storm clouds, dramatic hair movement, blurred grass, and minimalist campaign typography.
en.prompt: Create a vertical cinematic fashion campaign portrait titled {argument name="headline text" default="BLACK WIND"}. A solitary {argument name="subject" default="East Asian woman"} stands in a windswept open grassland under a heavy overcast sky, framed from mid-thigh upward in a low-angle editorial composition. She wears a fitted black ribbed turtleneck top and a long flowing black skirt or dress, with her hands held behind her back; her head is turned in profile to the right, eyes closed, calm and introspective. Her very long black hair is blown dramatically to the left by strong wind, with many fine strands trailing across the cloudy sky. The background shows dark rolling hills and moody moorland, with tall dry grasses in the extreme foreground blurred by shallow depth of field and motion, partially crossing the lower center of the image. Use muted cool film tones, blue-gray clouds, soft natural diffused light, subtle grain, realistic skin, high-fashion editorial styling, atmospheric wind movement, and a slightly underexposed dramatic look. Add minimalist thin white typography centered near the bottom: large widely spaced text “{argument name="headline text" default="BLACK WIND"}”, below it smaller spaced text “{argument name="series title" default="WIND FIELD PORTRAITS"}”, and a third tiny line “{argument name="tagline" default="SILENCE MOVES WITH THE WIND"}”. Keep the design clean with no logos or watermarks, portrait aspect ratio 9:16, photographic realism, and ensure the wind, hair, grasses, and clouds define the mood.

zh.title: “黑风”时尚肖像
zh.description: 一张竖构图的电影感风中时尚肖像，包含暴风云、戏剧性的发丝动态、模糊的草地以及极简主义的广告排版。
zh.prompt: 创作一张竖构图的电影感时尚广告肖像，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="BLACK WIND"}。一位孤独的 {argument name="subject" default="东亚女性"} 站在风中开阔的草地上，头顶是厚重的阴云，采用低角度的编辑构图，取景范围从大腿中部向上。她身穿黑色修身罗纹高领上衣和黑色长裙，双手背在身后；头部向右侧转呈侧脸，双眼微闭，神情平静且内敛。她极长的黑发被强风吹向左侧，呈现出戏剧性的动态，许多细碎的发丝掠过阴云密布的天空。背景是暗色起伏的丘陵和忧郁的荒原，极近景处的高大干草因浅景深和运动模糊而虚化，部分遮挡在画面下方中心。采用柔和的冷色调胶片风格、蓝灰色云层、柔和的自然漫射光、细腻的颗粒感、真实的皮肤质感、高级时装编辑风格、充满氛围感的风动效果，以及略微欠曝的戏剧性视觉。在底部中心添加极简的细体白色排版：大号且字间距宽的文字 “{argument name="headline text" default="BLACK WIND"}”，下方是较小且有间距的文字 “{argument name="series title" default="WIND FIELD PORTRAITS"}”，以及第三行微小的文字 “{argument name="tagline" default="SILENCE MOVES WITH THE WIND"}”。保持设计简洁，无 Logo 或水印，肖像比例为 9:16，追求摄影写实主义，并确保风、发丝、草地和云层共同营造出独特的氛围。

en.title: Fallen Wolf in Snowy Forest
en.description: A cinematic photorealistic winter wilderness scene showing a lone gray wolf lying motionless in a blue-toned snowy pine forest.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic widescreen scene in a cold blue winter forest at dusk: exactly 1 large {argument name="animal" default="gray wolf"} lies motionless on its side in the foreground, positioned low and slightly left of center, half-buried in soft snow. The wolf has thick gray, black, and tan fur, pointed ears, pale eyes barely open, its head resting on the snow with its mouth slightly open and a few teeth visible, front paws curled near its muzzle and hind legs stretched back to the right. The surrounding landscape is a quiet snow-covered conifer forest with tall dark pine trunks receding into the background, snow-laden branches, low bushes coated in frost, and a faint snowy trail or open clearing behind the animal. Use a moody {argument name="color grade" default="icy blue"} color palette, soft diffuse overcast light, misty atmospheric depth between the trees, shallow cinematic contrast, realistic fur texture, natural paw impressions in the snow, and a somber survival-drama tone. Frame as a 16:9 film still with the horizon high, the foreground snow occupying the lower half, no people, no buildings, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 雪林中倒下的狼
zh.description: 一幅电影级写实的冬季荒野场景，展示了一只孤独的灰狼静止地躺在蓝调的雪地松林中。
zh.prompt: 创建一个电影级写实的宽屏场景，背景是黄昏时分寒冷的蓝色冬季森林：前景中，恰好 1 只大型 {argument name="animal" default="灰狼"} 侧卧在地面上，位置偏低且略微靠左，半埋在松软的积雪中。狼拥有浓密的灰色、黑色和棕褐色皮毛，耳朵尖耸，浅色的眼睛微微睁开，头部枕在雪地上，嘴巴微张，露出几颗牙齿，前爪蜷缩在吻部附近，后腿向右伸展。周围是宁静的积雪针叶林，高大的深色松树干向背景延伸，树枝上覆盖着积雪，低矮的灌木丛挂着霜，动物身后有一条隐约的雪径或开阔的空地。采用忧郁的 {argument name="color grade" default="冰蓝色"} 色调，柔和的漫射阴天光线，树木间朦胧的大气深度，浅景深的电影对比度，逼真的皮毛质感，雪地上自然的爪印，以及沉重的生存剧情基调。构图为 16:9 的电影剧照，地平线较高，前景的积雪占据下半部分，无人物，无建筑物，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Nefra Desert Oracle Character Sheet
en.description: A detailed fantasy RPG character bible sheet for an anime desert oracle, ideal for concept art and game character design references.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-detailed 16:9 fantasy RPG character design sheet for {argument name="character name" default="NEFRA"}, titled {argument name="character title" default="Desert Oracle"}, presented like an official AAA fantasy game character bible on an elegant ivory background with minimal luxury UI.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 layout, warm off-white parchment/ivory backdrop, refined editorial spacing, thin serif labels in dark brown, soft gold accents, no border, no watermark.

Main character: A young anime-style desert oracle woman with warm brown skin, golden amber eyes, short white bobbed hair with blunt bangs, a large cream feather plume tied at the crown, and ornate gold head jewelry. She wears an elegant white-and-gold desert dancer/oracle outfit: cropped bandeau top, sheer translucent veil sleeves and cape, layered asymmetrical white skirt with gold geometric trim, black and dark charcoal sash panels, many gold chains, tassels, beads, bangles, armlets, anklets, and barefoot sandals. She holds a tall black-and-gold ceremonial staff topped with a crescent moon, circular amber orb, dangling ornaments, and a spear-like bottom finial. Overall palette is ivory, sand, ochre, amber gold, bronze, warm tan, charcoal, and black.

Layout: On the far left, place the title block reading “{argument name="character name" default="NEFRA"}” with the subtitle “— {argument name="character title" default="Desert Oracle"} —” and a short lore paragraph: “A wandering oracle from the endless dunes. She reads the flow of fate in the shifting sands and guides lost souls toward their destiny.” Beneath and beside this text, show one large full-body hero illustration of the character facing forward, holding the staff vertically. At the bottom left, include a color palette row labeled “COLOR PALETTE” with exactly 7 circular swatches: burnt terracotta, orange ochre, pale sand, warm ivory, taupe gray, near-black charcoal, and metallic gold.

Center turnaround section: Show exactly 3 smaller full-body model views labeled “FRONT”, “SIDE”, and “BACK”. They should depict the same character in consistent costume and proportions, standing neutrally, showing outfit construction from each angle.

Right reference section: At the upper right, include one large “HEAD CLOSE-UP” portrait showing her face, white hair, feather plume, gold forehead ornament, amber eyes, and heavy gold rectangular earrings. Below it, create an “EXPRESSIONS” row with exactly 3 small bust portraits: neutral serious expression, happy closed-eye smile, and surprised open-mouth expression.

Bottom reference section: Add an “ACCESSORIES” row with exactly 4 isolated accessory studies: a gold choker/headband-like jewelry piece with dangling tassels, an amber pendant necklace with tassels, a pair of cylindrical gold earrings, and a belt/waist ornament with chains and tassels. Add “STAFF DETAILS” with exactly 2 staff close-ups: one full top section with crescent and orb, and one alternate closer view emphasizing the dangling gold ornaments. Add “PATTERN DETAILS” with exactly 1 vertical rectangular fabric-detail inset showing the white veil and dark sash patterns, gold geometric border motifs, chains, and tassels.

Visual style: High-end Japanese anime fantasy concept art, clean crisp linework, soft cel shading blended with painterly rendering, ornate gold material detail, delicate fabric transparency, luxurious desert-priestess design language, balanced negative space, consistent character proportions across all views.

Constraints: Keep all labels in English uppercase serif text; include exactly 1 hero full-body illustration, exactly 3 turnaround full-body views, exactly 1 head close-up, exactly 3 expression portraits, exactly 4 accessory items, exactly 2 staff-detail drawings, exactly 1 pattern-detail inset, and exactly 7 color swatches. Avoid extra characters, scenery, logos, signatures, or dense background decoration.

zh.title: Nefra Desert Oracle 角色设定表
zh.description: 一份详尽的奇幻 RPG 角色设定集，适用于动漫风格的沙漠先知，是概念艺术和游戏角色设计的理想参考。
zh.prompt:
目标：创建一个超详细的 16:9 奇幻 RPG 角色设计表，用于 {argument name="character name" default="NEFRA"}，标题为 {argument name="character title" default="Desert Oracle"}，呈现效果如同官方 AAA 级奇幻游戏角色设定集，背景为优雅的象牙白，配以极简的奢华 UI。

画布：宽幅 16:9 横向布局，温暖的灰白色羊皮纸/象牙色背景，精致的编辑排版，深棕色细衬线字体标签，柔和的金色点缀，无边框，无水印。

主角：一位年轻的动漫风格沙漠先知女性，拥有温暖的棕色皮肤、琥珀色双眼、白色短波波头配齐刘海，头顶系着巨大的奶油色羽毛饰品，佩戴华丽的金色头饰。她身着优雅的白金配色沙漠舞者/先知服装：短款抹胸上衣、半透明薄纱袖子和披风、层叠的不对称白色裙摆配金色几何饰边、黑色和深炭灰色腰带，饰有大量金链、流苏、珠子、手镯、臂环、脚链和赤足凉鞋。她手持一根高大的黑金配色仪式法杖，顶部为新月形，镶嵌圆形琥珀球，悬挂装饰物，底部为矛状尖端。整体色调为象牙白、沙色、赭石色、琥珀金、青铜色、暖棕褐色、炭灰色和黑色。

布局：最左侧放置标题栏，书写“{argument name="character name" default="NEFRA"}”，副标题为“— {argument name="character title" default="Desert Oracle"} —”，并附上一段简短的背景故事：“一位来自无尽沙丘的流浪先知。她在流动的沙砾中解读命运的轨迹，指引迷途的灵魂走向归宿。” 在此文字下方及侧面，展示一张大型全身英雄插画，角色正面朝向，垂直握持法杖。左下角包含一行标有“COLOR PALETTE”的色板，包含 7 个圆形色块：焦陶土色、橙赭色、浅沙色、暖象牙色、灰褐色、近黑色炭色以及金属金色。

中心三视图部分：展示 3 个较小的全身模型视图，分别标注为“FRONT”、“SIDE”和“BACK”。它们应描绘同一角色，服装和比例保持一致，姿态中立，从各个角度展示服装结构。

右侧参考部分：右上角包含一张大型“HEAD CLOSE-UP”肖像，展示她的面部、白发、羽毛饰品、金色额饰、琥珀色双眼和厚重的长方形金耳环。下方创建一行“EXPRESSIONS”，包含 3 个小型半身肖像：严肃的中性表情、闭眼微笑的快乐表情，以及张嘴的惊讶表情。

底部参考部分：添加一行“ACCESSORIES”，包含 4 个独立的饰品研究：一件带流苏的金色颈饰/头带、一条带流苏的琥珀吊坠项链、一对圆柱形金耳环，以及一个带链条和流苏的腰带/腰部装饰。添加“STAFF DETAILS”，包含 2 个法杖特写：一个是包含新月和球体的完整顶部，另一个是强调悬挂金饰的更近视角。添加“PATTERN DETAILS”，包含 1 个垂直矩形的织物细节插图，展示白色薄纱和深色腰带的纹理、金色几何边框图案、链条和流苏。

视觉风格：高端日本动漫奇幻概念艺术，线条清晰利落，柔和的赛璐珞阴影与绘画渲染相结合，华丽的金色材质细节，精致的织物透明感，奢华的沙漠祭司设计语言，平衡的留白，所有视图中角色比例保持一致。

约束：所有标签保持英文大写衬线字体；包含 1 张英雄全身插画，3 个全身三视图，1 个头部特写，3 个表情肖像，4 个饰品研究，2 个法杖细节图，1 个图案细节插图，以及 7 个色块。避免添加额外的角色、风景、标志、签名或复杂的背景装饰。

en.title: Cyberpunk Samurai Character Sheet
en.description: Generates a dense anime cyberpunk character turnaround, weapon spec, hero art, and nine-panel combat storyboard for concept design use.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-detail cyberpunk anime character sheet and action storyboard for {argument name="character name" default="Katana Echo"}, a rebellious street samurai with techwear styling and a transforming energy nagamaki weapon.

Canvas: Wide horizontal concept art sheet, 16:9 aspect ratio, off-white paper background with black ink, gritty red and teal accents, manga production-board energy. Use thin panel borders, rough sketch construction lines, splattered paint, handwritten labels, and sharp graphic design.

Top layout: Divide the top half into three main sections. Left section shows exactly 3 full-body turnaround views of the character labeled FRONT, SIDE, and BACK. Center section is a weapon spec panel titled "VOID REAPER" with subtitle "ENERGY NAGAMAKI" and exactly 2 weapon states: "RETRACTED" and "EXTENDED". Add small callouts reading "CHAIN LINK" and "ENERGY EDGE". Right section is a dramatic hero illustration of the character holding the weapon, with a large red circular skull emblem behind them and vertical Japanese-style decorative text. Include file text near the title such as "CYBERSTRIKE // IND. FILE 77-K.E" and small katakana-style name text.

Character details: The character is an androgynous punk cyber-samurai with {argument name="hair color" default="black hair with teal bangs"}, shaved-side messy topknot hair, piercings, red eye makeup, cropped layered jacket, exposed midriff, belts, straps, red chains, utility tags, oversized black hakama-style pants, mechanical roller-blade boots, fingerless gloves, and a black-red-white-teal color palette. Their jacket back has a bold red skull/sun graphic. The pose language is aggressive, fast, and cocky.

Weapon details: The weapon is a hybrid chained nagamaki/chainsaw blade with a black handle, red tags, metal hardware, circular mechanical hub, black-and-white seals, red glowing blade edge, and teal cables. Show it compact in the retracted state and long serrated glowing in the extended state.

Bottom layout: The bottom half is a 3 by 3 storyboard grid with exactly 9 action panels. Each panel has a black header strip with a red number and white tactical move label. Depict the character fighting squads of white humanoid robots in industrial streets and overpasses, with speed lines, red energy arcs, teal sparks, and rough monochrome background perspective.

Storyboard panels, exactly 9: 01 "PROFILE WS / FIRST BREAK" shows a side attack blasting one robot while a row of robots waits behind; 02 "LOW PROFILE FS / TRIPLE BURST" shows the character sliding low and slashing through three targets; 03 "HIGH REAR WS / LANE RUSH" shows a rear chase down a lane between two robot lines; 04 "LOW 3-4 FS / RISING ASSAULT" shows the character leaping upward against airborne robots; 05 "HIGH SIDE WS / MIDAIR SWEEP" shows a midair horizontal sweep cutting multiple robots; 06 "GROUND REAR WS / HEAVY BLOCK" shows the character bracing low against a wall of shielded heavy robots; 07 "PROFILE MS / COUNTER PUSH" shows a close side counterstrike against clustered robots; 08 "LOW 3-4 FS / POWER DRAW" shows the character centered with both arms extended, drawing teal lightning while robots surround them; 09 "TOP-DOWN EWS / NEON CASCADE" shows a bird's-eye massive red crescent slash sweeping through a large robot formation.

Visual style: High-energy Japanese game concept art, cyberpunk manga storyboard, gritty ink linework, cel-shaded accents, limited palette of black, bone white, scarlet red, and electric teal. Keep the page dense but readable, with crisp character silhouettes and dynamic weapon trails.

Text constraints: Use the main title {argument name="title text" default="KATANA ECHO"} in a bold brush font at top left, the weapon title {argument name="weapon title" default="VOID REAPER"} in rough black lettering near the center, and the faction/file label {argument name="file label" default="CYBERSTRIKE // IND. FILE 77-K.E"}. Keep all visible labels in English except small decorative katakana/Japanese glyphs, which may be stylized and secondary. Do not add extra panels, extra turnaround views, or extra weapon states.

zh.title: 赛博朋克武士角色设计图
zh.description: 生成高密度的动漫赛博朋克角色三视图、武器规格、英雄插画以及九宫格战斗分镜，用于概念设计。
zh.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="Katana Echo"} 创建一份高细节的赛博朋克动漫角色设计图和动作分镜。该角色是一位叛逆的街头武士，身着机能风服饰，并配备一把可变形的能量长卷刀。

画布：宽幅横向概念设计图，16:9 比例，米白色纸张背景配黑色墨迹，点缀粗犷的红色和青色，呈现漫画制作项目风格。使用细边框、粗糙的草图线条、喷溅颜料、手写标签和锐利的图形设计。

顶部布局：将上半部分分为三个主要区域。左侧区域展示 3 个完整的角色全身三视图，分别标注为 FRONT（正面）、SIDE（侧面）和 BACK（背面）。中心区域为武器规格面板，标题为“VOID REAPER”，副标题为“ENERGY NAGAMAKI”，并展示 2 种武器状态：“RETRACTED”（收起）和“EXTENDED”（展开）。添加小型标注，文字为“CHAIN LINK”和“ENERGY EDGE”。右侧区域为角色手持武器的英雄插画，身后有一个巨大的红色圆形骷髅徽章，并配有日式垂直装饰文字。在标题附近包含文件信息，如“CYBERSTRIKE // IND. FILE 77-K.E”以及小的片假名风格名称文字。

角色细节：该角色是一位中性风朋克赛博武士，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色头发配青色刘海"}、剃边凌乱发髻、穿孔、红色眼妆、短款叠层夹克、露脐装、皮带、绑带、红色链条、功能性标签、超大黑色袴式长裤、机械轮滑靴、露指手套，配色方案为黑、红、白、青。夹克背面印有醒目的红色骷髅/太阳图案。姿态语言表现得极具攻击性、敏捷且狂傲。

武器细节：该武器是一种混合链式长卷刀/链锯刃，配有黑色刀柄、红色标签、金属配件、圆形机械轮毂、黑白封印、红色发光刃口和青色线缆。展示其在收起状态下的紧凑感，以及在展开状态下带有锯齿的发光形态。

底部布局：下半部分为 3x3 的分镜网格，包含 9 个动作面板。每个面板顶部有黑色标题条，配有红色数字和白色战术动作标签。描绘角色在工业街道和立交桥上与成群的白色人形机器人战斗的场景，包含速度线、红色能量弧、青色火花以及粗犷的单色背景透视。

分镜面板，共 9 个：01 “PROFILE WS / FIRST BREAK”展示侧面攻击击碎一个机器人，后方有一排机器人等待；02 “LOW PROFILE FS / TRIPLE BURST”展示角色低姿态滑行并斩断三个目标；03 “HIGH REAR WS / LANE RUSH”展示在两排机器人之间的巷道中进行后方追逐；04 “LOW 3-4 FS / RISING ASSAULT”展示角色向上跳跃对抗空中机器人；05 “HIGH SIDE WS / MIDAIR SWEEP”展示空中水平横扫，切断多个机器人；06 “GROUND REAR WS / HEAVY BLOCK”展示角色低姿态抵御一堵由重型盾牌机器人组成的墙；07 “PROFILE MS / COUNTER PUSH”展示针对集群机器人的近距离侧向反击；08 “LOW 3-4 FS / POWER DRAW”展示角色居中，双臂伸展，在机器人包围中引出青色闪电；09 “TOP-DOWN EWS / NEON CASCADE”展示从鸟瞰视角，巨大的红色新月斩击横扫大片机器人阵型。

视觉风格：高能量日式游戏概念艺术，赛博朋克漫画分镜，粗犷的墨线，赛璐珞风格阴影，黑、骨白、猩红和电青色的有限配色。保持页面内容密集但易读，角色轮廓清晰，武器轨迹动态十足。

文字限制：左上角使用粗体笔刷字体书写主标题 {argument name="title text" default="KATANA ECHO"}，中心附近使用粗糙的黑色字体书写武器标题 {argument name="weapon title" default="VOID REAPER"}，以及阵营/文件标签 {argument name="file label" default="CYBERSTRIKE // IND. FILE 77-K.E"}。除小的装饰性片假名/日文字符（可作为次要装饰）外，所有可见标签均使用英文。请勿添加额外的面板、额外的三视图或额外的武器状态。

en.title: Anime Girl Summer Resort Poster
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a bright anime travel-poster scene of a custom character sitting on a vintage trunk at a tropical resort.
en.prompt:
Create a polished anime-style summer travel poster illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a cheerful original anime girl"} popping out from a bright resort postcard. Show a full-body young woman sitting cutely on top of a vintage cream travel trunk in the foreground, angled slightly toward the viewer. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long golden-blonde twin-tail hair"} flowing in the sea breeze, sparkling amber eyes, a warm smile, rosy cheeks, and delicate jewelry. Dress her in a custom summer resort outfit: a frilly cream-and-pale-yellow crop top with a large bow, matching ruffled mini skirt, translucent mint-green shawl or capelet, flower ornaments, shell and starfish charms, ankle-wrap platform sandals, bracelets, necklace, and dangling turquoise-and-gold earrings. Add a wide woven straw sunhat decorated with white and yellow tropical flowers, ribbons, and small leaves; one hand lightly holds the brim while the other is raised near her hair.

The trunk should be a detailed antique suitcase with cream panels, tan leather straps, brass locks, reinforced corners, handle, and personalized tropical decorations including exactly 3 prominent flower-and-bow ornaments: one near the lower front left sandal area, one hanging on the front-right trunk strap, and one among the hat flowers. Behind her, create a tilted postcard or poster frame with a thin white border, as if the character is stepping out of it into the viewer’s space. The background inside the poster is a sunny luxury seaside resort with turquoise ocean, pool, palm trees, blue sky, fluffy clouds, and white Mediterranean-style buildings with blue domes and flower-covered balconies, evoking {argument name="travel destination" default="a tropical Mediterranean island resort"}. Use bright summer lighting, soft pastel colors, clean line art, high-detail fabric transparency, sparkling highlights, airy motion in the hair and ribbons, and a dreamy vacation atmosphere. Composition should be vertical 4:5, dynamic and slightly diagonal, with the character and trunk breaking the border of the poster. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

zh.title: 动漫少女夏季度假海报
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于生成一张明亮的动漫风格旅行海报，画面展示了一位自定义角色坐在热带度假胜地的复古行李箱上。
zh.prompt:
创作一张精致的动漫风格夏季旅行海报插画，画面中 {argument name="character name" default="一位开朗的原创动漫少女"} 从明亮的度假明信片中跃然而出。展示一位全身年轻女性，可爱地坐在前景的一个米色复古旅行箱上，身体略微朝向观众。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长金发双马尾"}，在海风中飞舞，闪烁的琥珀色眼睛，温暖的笑容，红润的脸颊以及精致的首饰。为她穿上一套定制的夏季度假装束：带有大蝴蝶结的奶油色配浅黄色荷叶边短上衣，配套的荷叶边迷你裙，半透明的薄荷绿披肩或小斗篷，花朵装饰，贝壳和海星挂饰，脚踝绑带厚底凉鞋，手链，项链以及垂坠的绿松石金耳环。戴上一顶宽大的编织草帽，装饰着白色和黄色的热带花朵、丝带和小叶子；一只手轻轻扶着帽檐，另一只手抬起靠近头发。

行李箱应为一个细节丰富的古董手提箱，带有奶油色面板、棕褐色皮带、黄铜锁扣、加固边角、提手，以及个性化的热带装饰，包括 3 个显眼的花朵蝴蝶结装饰：一个靠近左前方的凉鞋区域，一个挂在右前方的行李箱带上，另一个点缀在帽子花朵中。在她身后，创建一个倾斜的明信片或海报边框，带有细白边，仿佛角色正从画框中步入观众的空间。海报背景是一个阳光明媚的豪华海滨度假胜地，拥有绿松石色的海洋、泳池、棕榈树、蓝天、蓬松的云朵以及带有蓝色圆顶和鲜花覆盖阳台的白色地中海风格建筑，营造出 {argument name="travel destination" default="热带地中海岛屿度假村"} 的氛围。使用明亮的夏季光影，柔和的粉彩色调，干净的线条，高细节的织物透明感，闪烁的高光，头发和丝带的飘逸动感，以及梦幻般的度假氛围。构图应为 4:5 竖版，具有动态感和轻微的对角线倾斜，角色和行李箱需打破海报边框。无文字，无水印，无额外角色。

en.title: Cinematic Male Portrait with Blue Lenses
en.description: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait featuring a man in a suit with selectively colorized vibrant blue sunglasses.
en.prompt: A striking, cinematic, and professional-looking portrait of a handsome man in his {argument name="age" default="late 20s or early 30s"}. He is wearing a sharp, modern black suit and a crisp white dress shirt. The man has neatly styled, dark, wavy hair and a well-groomed short beard/stubble. He is wearing thin, wire-rimmed round sunglasses with {argument name="lens color" default="vibrant blue-tinted"} lenses, creating a stark contrast against the black and white aesthetic.The image uses a high-contrast, black-and-white (monochromatic) color scheme, with the only exception being the vivid, electric blue color of the sunglass lenses, which are selectively colorized. He is looking off to the side with a serious, confident, and mysterious expression. The background is a simple, uniform, {argument name="background" default="medium-grey wall"}, providing a clean, minimalist backdrop. Studio lighting, dramatic, high-quality photograph, 8K resolution.

High contrast with smooth falloff into darkness builds a moody atmosphere. Apply heavy film grain and high ISO noise (3200–6400) for a raw analog feel. Add slight softness, subtle blur, and faint highlight bloom. Natural skin texture with visible pores. Monochrome grading with crushed blacks, soft highlights, and shallow depth of field (50mm, f/1.8).

zh.title: 电影感黑白影棚肖像
zh.description: 一款营造情绪感、高对比度黑白肖像的提示词，包含原始胶片质感、厚重的颗粒感以及戏剧性的轮廓光，打造杂志大片般的视觉效果。
zh.prompt: 超写实电影感黑白肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="男士"}，身着 {argument name="clothing" default="正式黑色西装配领带"}，拍摄于 {argument name="setting" default="极简暗调影棚"}。主体略微偏离中心，正对镜头，表情冷静严肃，眼神聚焦柔和。戏剧性的低调照明配合强烈的头顶/背部光源，在发丝和轮廓边缘勾勒出明亮的光晕，面部则隐入深邃阴影中。高对比度与平滑的暗部过渡营造出浓郁的情绪氛围。应用厚重的胶片颗粒和高 ISO 噪点（3200–6400）以呈现原始的胶片质感。添加轻微的柔焦、细腻的模糊效果以及淡淡的高光溢出。展现带有可见毛孔的自然皮肤纹理。黑白调色，压低暗部，柔化高光，并采用浅景深效果（50mm，f/1.8）。

en.title: Anime Lifestyle with Manga Shadows
en.description: A wholesome anime-inspired prompt where a character and their cat's shadows transform into playful manga-style doodles.
en.prompt: Wholesome anime-inspired lifestyle portrait of a {argument name="character" default="cute young woman with a short pastel-pink bob haircut"}, wearing an oversized vintage red plaid flannel shirt, baggy blue jeans, and classic canvas sneakers, interacting with a {argument name="pet" default="fluffy gray-and-white British Shorthair cat wearing a tiny plaid bandana"}. They are bathed in warm golden-hour sunlight against a clean beige wall, creating long, soft shadows. The magical twist: their shadows transform into playful hand-drawn manga doodles—the girl's shadow becomes an adorable chibi anime version of herself striking a joyful pose, while the cat's shadow becomes a funny cartoon cat waving, dancing, or reaching toward her. Pencil-sketch style with expressive line art, motion marks, hearts, stars, butterflies, and playful doodles integrated naturally into the shadows. Cozy slice-of-life aesthetic, {argument name="style" default="Studio Ghibli × modern manga illustration"}, minimalist background, soft cinematic lighting, authentic candid emotion, ultra-detailed fur, natural skin tones, dreamy atmosphere, whimsical storytelling, premium editorial photography, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, Kodak Portra 400 colors, ultra-photorealistic, 8K, masterpiece.

zh.title: 充满奇趣的动漫生活肖像与涂鸦阴影
zh.description: 一个充满创意的动漫生活片段提示词：在黄金时刻的阳光下，女孩和猫咪的影子幻化为俏皮的手绘漫画涂鸦。
zh.prompt: 温馨的动漫风格生活肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位留着粉色短波波头的可爱年轻女性"}，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="超大款复古红格纹法兰绒衬衫、宽松蓝色牛仔裤和经典帆布鞋"}，正与 {argument name="pet" default="一只戴着小格纹领巾、毛茸茸的灰白相间英国短毛猫"} 互动。她们沐浴在温暖的黄金时刻阳光下，背靠干净的米色墙壁，投射出修长柔和的阴影。神奇的转折点在于：她们的影子幻化成了俏皮的手绘漫画涂鸦——女孩的影子变成了一个摆出快乐姿势的可爱 Q 版动漫形象，而猫咪的影子则变成了一只正在挥手、跳舞或向她伸出爪子的滑稽卡通猫。铅笔素描风格，线条生动，运动轨迹、爱心、星星、蝴蝶和俏皮涂鸦自然地融入阴影之中。舒适的生活片段美学，吉卜力工作室 × 现代漫画插画，极简背景，柔和的电影级光效，真实自然的动人情感，超精细毛发，自然肤色，梦幻氛围，奇思妙想的叙事，高级编辑摄影，50mm 镜头，浅景深，Kodak Portra 400 色调，超写实，8K 分辨率，大师级作品。

en.title: Saira Halo Spotlight Portrait
en.description: A high-quality cinematic portrait of a girl featuring a sophisticated script name label and a dramatic circular spotlight background effect.

She is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="stylish dark green ombre textured sweater and trendy sunglasses"}. The background is a {argument name="background" default="solid dark wall with a distinct, dramatic circular spotlight effect"} behind her, creating a halo appearance. The lighting is professional, capturing fine details with a shallow depth of field. The name '{argument name="name" default="Saira"}' is written elegantly in a sophisticated script font on the left side of the frame.

zh.title: Saira Halo 聚光灯肖像
zh.description: 一张高质量的电影感肖像，主角是一位女孩，配有精致的艺术字体姓名标签和戏剧性的圆形聚光灯背景效果。
zh.prompt: 一张高质量的电影感肖像，主角是一位 18 岁的女孩，名为 {argument name="name" default="Saira"}。她身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="时尚的深绿色渐变质感毛衣，并佩戴潮流墨镜"}。背景是她身后的一面 {argument name="background" default="纯色深色墙壁，带有独特的戏剧性圆形聚光灯效果"}，营造出光环般的视觉感。光影效果专业，捕捉了细腻的细节，并呈现出浅景深效果。名字“{argument name="name" default="Saira"}”以优雅的艺术字体书写在画面左侧。

en.title: Human Fragments Editorial Typography Poster
en.description: A creative prompt for designing editorial 9:16 posters that integrate oversized typography into the scene, creating a seamless interaction between text and photography.
en.prompt:
Create a 9:16 editorial typography poster built around one human-centered moment.

Use oversized, cropped letters as the main composition structure. Embed the environment inside the letterforms, while the person, body movement, or a foreground object breaks through the letters with strong perspective. The typography should shape the image, not simply sit on top of it.

Scene: {argument name="scene" default="[roller skating / swimming / cycling / coffee break]"}
Subject: {argument name="subject" default="[young Asian woman / Western man / Asian man / Western woman]"}
Title: {argument name="title" default="[custom two-word title]"}
Series: HUMAN FRAGMENTS
Year: 2026

4 directions:

1. ROLL SIGNAL — a roller skater gliding past the camera, one skate enlarged in the foreground, body and urban scene passing through giant letters.

2. BLUE CURRENT — a swimmer moving through turquoise water, one arm reaching toward the camera, water and splashes filling and breaking beyond the typography.

3. CITY LOOP — a cyclist turning through a city street, the front wheel enlarged by perspective and visually connected with circular letterforms.

4. BREW PAUSE — a quiet café moment, with the hand and coffee cup closer to the camera while the person and window scene are woven into oversized type.

Use realistic photography, natural skin and fabric, believable water and motion, subtle paper grain, strong negative space, and a restrained color palette.

zh.title: Human Fragments 编辑排版海报
zh.description: 一个用于设计 9:16 编辑风格海报的创意提示词，旨在将超大字体融入场景，实现文字与摄影的无缝交互。
zh.prompt:
创作一张以人为核心瞬间的 9:16 编辑排版海报。

使用超大、裁剪过的字母作为主要构图结构。将环境嵌入字体形状中，同时人物、肢体动作或前景物体以强烈的透视感穿透字母。排版应塑造图像，而非仅仅叠加在图像之上。

场景：{argument name="scene" default="[轮滑 / 游泳 / 骑行 / 咖啡小憩]"}
主体：{argument name="subject" default="[年轻亚裔女性 / 西方男性 / 亚裔男性 / 西方女性]"}
标题：{argument name="title" default="[自定义双词标题]"}
系列：HUMAN FRAGMENTS
年份：2026 年

4 个方向：

1. ROLL SIGNAL — 一位轮滑者滑过镜头，一只轮滑鞋在前景放大，身体和城市场景穿过巨大的字母。

2. BLUE CURRENT — 一位游泳者在绿松石色的水中穿行，一只手臂伸向镜头，水流和浪花填充并突破排版的边界。

3. CITY LOOP — 一位骑行者在城市街道转弯，前轮因透视而放大，并与圆形的字体形态在视觉上相连。

4. BREW PAUSE — 一个安静的咖啡馆时刻，手和咖啡杯靠近镜头，而人物和窗外场景则交织在超大字体中。

使用写实摄影，呈现自然的皮肤和织物纹理、逼真的水流与动态、细腻的纸张颗粒感、强烈的留白以及克制的配色方案。

en.title: Modern Japanese Retro Room Portrait
en.description: A detailed Japanese prompt for a high-quality portrait of a woman in a nostalgic, retro-style Japanese room, focusing on soft lighting, rich textures, and a cinematic magazine aesthetic.
en.prompt:
Subject:
Rewinding Time

Main Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="A mature woman sitting cross-legged on a rug in a modern Japanese room, holding a small portable cassette player with both hands."} The figure is positioned slightly to the right of the center, occupying about 70% of the frame.

Character & Expression:
A natural, realistic woman with a soft oval face, calm eyes, and a graceful expression. Her face is turned about 30 degrees to the right, eyes looking diagonally upward following the window light. Long dark brown layered hair with thin see-through bangs. Makeup features pink-beige blush, brown eyeshadow, natural eye bags, and a matte rose-beige lip.

Clothing & Pose:
{argument name="outfit" default="An ivory floral camisole with a thin open-knit cardigan."} The cardigan falls naturally off the shoulders. Bottoms are off-white light shorts and white loose socks. She sits cross-legged with fingers naturally gripping the sides of the player, and the earphone cord hanging loosely.

Background & Light:
{argument name="background" default="A retro-style Japanese room with wooden shoji screens, beige walls, low shelves, records, cassette tapes, an old radio, and a cloth lamp."} Foreground features an open notebook and scattered photos. Warm lamp light from a low position on the right, soft natural light through the shoji on the top left. Warm highlights on the cheek, collarbone, and thighs.

Composition & Camera:
Low camera angle close to floor level, eye-level view. Natural 35mm perspective. About 8% headspace and 20% space for foreground items. Middle depth of field keeping background objects recognizable but slightly blurred.

Texture & Style:
Interior portrait styled like a Japanese magazine. Detailed depiction of skin texture, hair strands, knit fabric, and the aged feel of the cassette player. Palette of pale beige, dusty pink, and brown with fine film grain and subtle contrast. Avoids excessive gloss or a CG look for a quiet, lived-in finish.

zh.title: 现代日式复古房间人像
zh.description: 一份详细的日文提示词，用于生成一张高质量的女性人像，场景设定在怀旧复古风格的日式房间中，侧重于柔和的光影、丰富的质感以及电影杂志般的审美。
zh.prompt:
主题：
时光倒流

主体：
{argument name="subject" default="一位成熟女性盘腿坐在现代日式房间的地毯上，双手拿着一个小巧的便携式卡带播放器。"} 人物位于画面中心偏右位置，占据约 70% 的画幅。

人物与表情：
自然写实的女性，脸型圆润柔和，眼神平静，表情优雅。面部向右转动约 30 度，双眼顺着窗户射入的光线斜向上看。深棕色长发，层次感分明，留着轻薄的空气刘海。妆容采用粉米色腮红、棕色眼影、自然的卧蚕以及哑光玫瑰米色唇妆。

服装与姿态：
{argument name="outfit" default="一件象牙白碎花吊带衫，外搭一件薄款镂空针织开衫。"} 开衫自然地从肩部滑落。下身穿着米白色短裤和白色堆堆袜。她盘腿而坐，手指自然地握住播放器两侧，耳机线随意垂下。

背景与光影：
{argument name="background" default="一间复古风格的日式房间，配有木质障子门、米色墙壁、矮架、黑胶唱片、卡带、旧收音机和布艺台灯。"} 前景摆放着一本打开的笔记本和散落的照片。右侧低处有温暖的灯光，左上方有透过障子门射入的柔和自然光。脸颊、锁骨和大腿处有温暖的高光。

构图与摄影：
低机位，接近地面，与人物视线齐平。自然的 35mm 视角。顶部留白约 8%，前景物品占据约 20% 的空间。中等景深，使背景物体清晰可见但略带虚化。

质感与风格：
日式杂志风格的室内人像。细腻刻画皮肤纹理、发丝、针织面料以及卡带播放器的陈旧感。色调以浅米色、灰粉色和棕色为主，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和微妙的对比度。避免过度光泽感或 CG 感，呈现出一种宁静、充满生活气息的质感。

en.title: Casual East Asian Mirror Selfie
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for a realistic social media-style mirror selfie featuring an East Asian woman in athletic wear.
en.prompt:
Create a photorealistic 9:16 casual mirror selfie of an exceptionally beautiful adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s, standing inside the glass entrance of a modern building during daytime.

She has a refined oval face, fair natural skin, softly arched eyebrows, dark almond-shaped eyes, subtle eyeliner, a small straight nose and softly parted natural pink lips. Her expression is calm, slightly curious and effortlessly confident as she looks at her phone screen rather than directly into the mirror.

She has very long {argument name="hair color" default="honey-blonde"} hair tied into a low side ponytail falling over one shoulder, with a deep side part and soft face-framing strands. She has a fit, naturally curvy hourglass figure with a full bust, narrow waist, rounded hips and long shapely legs.

She wears a fitted pale {argument name="jacket color" default="butter-yellow"} lightweight zip-up athletic jacket with long sleeves, a structured collar and the zipper lowered slightly at the neckline. Pair it with high-waisted light-gray fitted flared yoga pants. A large black quilted leather shoulder bag with a gold chain strap hangs from one shoulder. Add a simple gold bangle and natural pale manicure.

Recreate the pose: she stands facing the mirror with her weight shifted onto one leg. One hand holds a silver smartphone vertically beside her face, while the other hand rests casually inside the jacket pocket. Frame her from the top of her head to near her ankles.

Behind the glass is an outdoor parking area with several parked cars, gray pavement, tall vertical metal flagpoles and dense green trees covering a hillside. Add a large cute cream-colored {argument name="sticker type" default="pixel-art bear"} sticker with pink ears floating over part of the background, clearly appearing as a digital sticker rather than a real object.

Cool natural daylight from outside mixes with the dimmer interior light, leaving her face and body slightly shaded while the outdoor background remains brighter. Realistic phone-camera exposure, subtle glass reflections, mild cool color cast, slight wide-angle perspective and authentic social-media mirror-selfie quality.

No anime rendering, no plastic skin, no excessively exaggerated anatomy, no distorted phone, no malformed hands, no extra fingers, no duplicated body, no random text, logo or watermark.

zh.title: 东亚女性镜面自拍
zh.description: 一个高度精细的写实风格提示词，用于生成一张年轻东亚女性在现代建筑内的竖版镜面自拍，包含具体的服装细节和自然光影效果。
zh.prompt:
创作一张 9:16 的写实风格休闲镜面自拍，主角是一位极其美丽的成年 {argument name="subject" default="东亚女性"}，20 多岁，白天站在现代建筑的玻璃入口内。

她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、白皙自然的皮肤、柔和的拱形眉毛、深色的杏仁眼、精致的眼线、小巧挺直的鼻子和微微张开的自然粉色嘴唇。她的表情平静、略带好奇且充满自信，正看着手机屏幕，而不是直接看向镜子。

她留着非常长的 {argument name="hair style" default="蜂蜜金色头发，扎成低侧马尾"}，垂在一侧肩膀上，深侧分发型，有柔和的修饰脸型的发丝。她身材匀称，拥有自然的沙漏型曲线，胸部丰满，腰部纤细，臀部圆润，双腿修长匀称。

她穿着一件 {argument name="outfit" default="修身浅奶油黄色轻便拉链运动夹克"}，长袖，带有结构感领口，领口拉链微微拉下。搭配高腰浅灰色修身微喇瑜伽裤。一个带有金色链条肩带的大号黑色绗缝皮质单肩包挂在肩上。佩戴一个简单的金手镯，并涂有自然的浅色美甲。

姿势要求：她面对镜子站立，重心偏向一条腿。一只手在脸侧垂直拿着银色智能手机，另一只手随意地插在夹克口袋里。取景范围从头顶到脚踝附近。

玻璃外是室外停车场，停着几辆车，地面为灰色，有高大的垂直金属旗杆，山坡上覆盖着茂密的绿色树木。在背景部分添加一个大型可爱的奶油色像素风小熊贴纸，带有粉色耳朵，看起来明显是数字贴纸，而非真实物体。

室外的冷色调自然光与室内较暗的光线交织，使她的面部和身体略带阴影，而室外背景保持较亮。呈现真实的手机拍摄曝光效果、细腻的玻璃反射、轻微的冷色调、略带广角透视，以及地道的社交媒体镜面自拍质感。

拒绝动漫渲染，拒绝塑料感皮肤，拒绝过度夸张的解剖结构，拒绝扭曲的手机，拒绝畸形的手部，拒绝多余的手指，拒绝重复的身体，拒绝随机文字、Logo 或水印。

en.title: Desert Swimsuit Silhouette Portrait
en.description: A dramatic silhouette portrait of a Japanese woman in a desert at golden hour, featuring a sheer wrap billowing in the wind and film grain textures.
en.prompt: A {argument name="subject" default="young Japanese woman"} wears a {argument name="swimsuit style" default="sand-toned swimsuit, a rose-gold sheer wrap"} billowing above her head like a canopy caught in the golden hour wind. Medium wide shot, dramatic silhouette against a {argument name="setting" default="warm glowing desert horizon"}, subject positioned lower third of frame with the wrap filling negative space above. Vertical portrait orientation, 2:3 aspect ratio. Render with photographic realism: subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, avoid over-smoothed CG textures. Skin: subsurface scattering and micro-texture. Hair: subtle natural imperfection.

zh.title: 沙漠泳装剪影人像
zh.description: 一张在黄金时刻拍摄的沙漠日本女性剪影人像，展现了随风飘动的透明围裹裙，并带有胶片颗粒质感。
zh.prompt: 一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻日本女性"} 穿着 {argument name="swimsuit style" default="沙色泳装，搭配玫瑰金透明围裹裙"}，裙摆在黄金时刻的风中如天幕般在头顶飘扬。中远景镜头，以 {argument name="setting" default="温暖发光的沙漠地平线"} 为背景呈现戏剧性的剪影，主体位于画面下三分之一处，围裹裙填满上方的负空间。垂直人像构图，2:3 纵横比。渲染呈现摄影级真实感：阴影区域带有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒，避免过度平滑的 CG 质感。皮肤：次表面散射和微纹理。头发：细微的自然瑕疵。

en.title: Floraverse Botanical Filament Fusion
en.description: An artistic image-to-image prompt that transforms a reference subject into a complex 3D botanical composition made of petals and organic filaments.
en.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the sole reference while preserving the exact identity, facial structure, expression, eye shape, eyebrows, eyelashes, nose, lips, jawline, ears, hairstyle silhouette, body proportions, pose, composition, camera angle, perspective, framing, and recognizability. Transform the entire subject into a luxurious {argument name="style" default="three-dimensional abstract botanical filament composition"} where the pattern is deeply infused into every visible surface rather than placed on top. Reconstruct the face using flowing layered petal-like contours, delicate organic filaments, elegant floral veins, rippling botanical curves, and sculpted abstract forms that naturally follow the facial anatomy while preserving every defining feature. Transform the hair into dense flowing botanical ribbons composed of layered petals, fine silk-like fibers, graceful leaf structures, curved floral folds, and sweeping organic strands instead of individual hairs, creating rich dimensional volume. Extend the same interconnected floral pattern seamlessly across the clothing, accessories, and background so the entire composition appears organically grown from one continuous botanical structure. Render with silky satin petals, velvety floral textures, translucent layered membranes, fine filament veins, soft sculpted ridges, polished organic surfaces, subtle ambient occlusion, realistic depth, and cinematic lighting for a premium 3D appearance. Use a vibrant palette of {argument name="colors" default="crimson, scarlet, coral, magenta, golden yellow, turquoise, teal, emerald, lime, ivory, and deep sapphire"} with luminous color transitions, ensuring the botanical pattern remains dominant, highly detailed, abstract, and visually integrated throughout the entire subject and scene.

zh.title: Floraverse 植物纤维融合
zh.description: 一个艺术化的图生图提示词，可将参考主体转化为由花瓣和有机纤维构成的复杂 3D 植物组合。
zh.prompt: 请仅使用上传的图像作为参考，同时保留其确切的身份特征、面部结构、表情、眼型、眉毛、睫毛、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、耳朵、发型轮廓、身体比例、姿势、构图、摄像机角度、透视、取景以及辨识度。将整个主体转化为奢华的 {argument name="style" default="三维抽象植物纤维组合"}，使图案深度融入每一个可见表面，而非仅仅覆盖在表面。使用流动的层叠花瓣状轮廓、精致的有机纤维、优雅的植物脉络、起伏的植物曲线以及雕塑般的抽象形式来重构面部，在保留所有定义特征的同时，使其自然贴合面部解剖结构。将头发转化为由层叠花瓣、纤细丝状纤维、优雅叶片结构、弯曲花褶和扫掠有机线条组成的浓密流动植物丝带，而非单根发丝，从而创造出丰富的立体感。将这种相互交织的植物图案无缝延伸至服装、配饰和背景，使整个构图看起来如同从同一个连续的植物结构中自然生长出来。渲染时采用丝绸缎面花瓣、天鹅绒般的花卉质感、半透明层叠膜、精细纤维脉络、柔和的雕塑脊线、抛光的有机表面、微妙的环境光遮蔽、逼真的深度以及电影级光影，以呈现高级的 3D 外观。使用由 {argument name="colors" default="深红、绯红、珊瑚红、洋红、金黄、绿松石色、青色、祖母绿、酸橙绿、象牙白和深蓝宝石色"} 组成的鲜艳调色板，并配以明亮的色彩过渡，确保植物图案在整个主体和场景中始终占据主导地位，且细节丰富、抽象且视觉统一。

en.title: Tropical Garden Yoga Handstand
en.description: A highly detailed photorealistic prompt for generating a scene of a woman performing a yoga handstand in a sunlit tropical garden, focusing on lighting, anatomy, and composition.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Yoga pose"}

Main Subject:
In a sun-drenched {argument name="garden style" default="tropical-style garden"}, an adult woman wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="cream-colored swimsuit"} performs a handstand yoga pose on the grass. The person is positioned large in the center of the screen, with the body from head to fingertips in the lower half and long extended legs in the upper half, forming a vertical composition.

Character/Expression:
An adult woman with a natural, healthy physique. Bright, smooth skin with soft highlights from the sunlight. Her dark brown hair, nearly black, is tied in a casual bun, with thin loose strands hanging toward her cheeks and the ground following the inverted gravity. She is looking diagonally downward with her gaze between her hands, showing a focused and calm expression.

Clothing/Pose:
An ivory-colored separate swimsuit with frills. A light design with thin straps and small side ribbons. Both hands are placed on the grass slightly wider than shoulder width, with fingers spread wide to support the weight. Elbows are kept straight, stabilizing from the shoulders to the waist. One leg is stretched long and straight toward the upper right of the screen with pointed toes, while the other leg is deeply bent at the knee with the foot pointed toward the back in a stag leg pose. A natural twist is added to the pelvis, creating a flexible and dynamic silhouette.

Background/Lighting:
The foreground is a bright lawn where the fine texture of the grass is visible. In the middle ground, a stone path continues diagonally into the distance, surrounded by large tropical plants and shrubs on both sides. Several red flower spikes are placed on the left as accents in the deep green. The background consists of palm leaves, thick trees, and dark stone walls to create natural depth. Warm morning sunlight enters from the top right, brightly illuminating the right side of the legs, back, and arms. Shadows of the body and arms fall onto the lawn at the bottom left, and reflected light from the leaves gently lifts the shadowed side of the skin.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4 orientation. A long shot capturing the entire body, with the person occupying approximately 70% of the screen. The camera shoots almost horizontally from a position slightly lower than the waist to emphasize the upward-stretching legs. Hands are at the bottom, the head is below the center, and the extended toes are near the top edge. The background is slightly blurred while retaining the shapes of the plants, focusing on the person's body and fingers. Natural 50mm lens equivalent, no excessive wide-angle distortion.

Texture/Style:
A real-life lifestyle photograph. Warm natural light, delicate skin texture, fine details of grass and leaves, and subtle film grain. Centered around green and ivory, with red flowers as small accent colors. Healthy, clean, and a calm finish somewhere between a sportswear advertisement and a resort photo.

Negative:
Minors, unnatural joints, bent arms, extra limbs, missing fingers, fused fingers, confusion between left and right legs, unnatural center of gravity, floating, poor contact with tools, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 热带花园瑜伽倒立
zh.description: 这是一个高度详细的写实风格提示词，用于生成一位女性在阳光明媚的热带花园中进行瑜伽倒立的场景，重点关注光影、人体结构和构图。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="瑜伽姿势"}

主要对象：
在阳光普照的 {argument name="garden style" default="热带风格花园"} 中，一位穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="米白色泳装"} 的成年女性正在草地上进行瑜伽倒立。人物位于画面中央，占据较大比例，身体从头部到指尖位于下半部分，修长的双腿伸展至上半部分，形成垂直构图。

人物/表情：
一位拥有自然、健康体魄的成年女性。明亮、光滑的皮肤在阳光下呈现出柔和的高光。她那近乎黑色的深棕色头发随意地盘成发髻，几缕细碎的发丝顺着倒置的重力垂向脸颊和地面。她斜视下方，目光聚焦于双手之间，神情专注而平静。

服装/姿势：
一套带有荷叶边的象牙色分体式泳装。设计轻盈，配有细肩带和侧边小丝带。双手略宽于肩放置在草地上，手指张开以支撑体重。肘部保持笔直，从肩膀到腰部保持稳定。一条腿向画面右上角长长地伸直，脚尖绷紧；另一条腿膝盖深屈，脚尖向后，呈现出“雄鹿式”姿势。骨盆自然扭转，勾勒出柔韧而富有动感的轮廓。

背景/光影：
前景是明亮的草坪，可见草叶的细腻纹理。中景处，一条石径斜向延伸至远方，两侧环绕着大型热带植物和灌木。左侧点缀着几株红色花穗，在深绿色中形成视觉焦点。背景由棕榈叶、茂密的树木和深色石墙组成，营造出自然的景深。温暖的晨光从右上角射入，明亮地照亮了腿部、背部和手臂的右侧。身体和手臂的阴影投射在左下方的草坪上，叶片的反射光柔和地提亮了皮肤的阴影侧。

构图/摄影：
3:4 垂直构图。全身长焦镜头，人物约占画面的 70%。相机从略低于腰部的位置几乎水平拍摄，以强调向上伸展的双腿。双手位于底部，头部低于中心，伸展的脚尖靠近顶部边缘。背景在保留植物轮廓的同时略微虚化，焦点集中在人物身体和手指上。等效 50mm 自然镜头，无过度广角畸变。

质感/风格：
写实生活摄影。温暖的自然光，细腻的皮肤纹理，草叶的精细细节，以及微妙的胶片颗粒感。以绿色和象牙色为主色调，红色花朵作为点缀。整体风格健康、纯净且冷静，介于运动装广告与度假照片之间。

负面提示词：
未成年人、不自然的关节、弯曲的手臂、多余的肢体、手指缺失、手指粘连、左右腿混淆、重心不自然、悬浮、与工具接触不良、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Urban Supermarket Candid Photography
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating clean, candid lifestyle photos in a supermarket setting with a cool CCD film aesthetic using GPT Image 2.
en.prompt:
Photography Style: Cool white clear CCD lifestyle style
Portrait Direction: Urban daily life photography
Scene Direction: {argument name="scene" default="large supermarket refrigerated area / white freezer / bright shelves / cool white ceiling lights"}
Clothing Direction: {argument name="clothing" default="mint white U-neck tight short-sleeved top + slim skirt"}
Temperament Tags: {argument name="temperament" default="pure, bright, daily, natural, slightly seductive"}
Facial Direction: Real clear natural face, fresh and clean, not influencer-style
Facial Details: Soft oval face, naturally elegant contour; bright apricot eyes, clean and quiet gaze; smooth small nose; soft restrained lips, light nude pink lip color; overall fresh, real, and pleasant to look at
Hairstyle Direction: Black long hair flowing naturally, smooth strands, a few stray hairs on the forehead
Body Direction: Light and slender, naturally full bust
Line Emphasis: Strong
Camera Direction: Mid-shot to thighs
Posture: Standing in front of the freezer, body slightly turned, one hand holding a shopping basket, the other hanging naturally
Lighting Atmosphere: Freezer cool white light + top high color temperature lighting + very weak soft flash
Filter Effect: Cool white highlights + blue-white clear CCD colors + light grain + light digital noise
Aspect Ratio: 9:16
Additional Requirements: The U-neck top emphasizes the neck, collarbone, bust, and waistline; the image looks like a frame captured by a CCD in a daily supermarket, clean and transparent, without looking overly posed.

zh.title: 城市超市抓拍摄影
zh.description: 一份使用 GPT Image 2 生成超市场景下干净、抓拍感生活照的详细提示词，呈现冷色调 CCD 胶片美学。
zh.prompt:
摄影风格：冷白清透 CCD 生活风格
人像方向：城市日常生活摄影
场景方向：{argument name="scene" default="大型超市冷藏区 / 白色冷柜 / 明亮货架 / 冷白顶灯"}
服装方向：{argument name="clothing" default="薄荷白 U 领紧身短袖上衣 + 修身半身裙"}
气质标签：{argument name="temperament" default="清纯、明亮、日常、自然、微性感"}
面部方向：真实清晰的自然脸，清新干净，非网红感
面部细节：柔和鹅蛋脸，轮廓自然优雅；明亮杏眼，眼神干净安静；鼻梁小巧平滑；嘴唇柔软内敛，浅裸粉色唇色；整体清新、真实、耐看
发型方向：黑色长发自然垂落，发丝顺滑，额前有少量碎发
身材方向：轻盈纤细，自然丰满
线条强调：强烈
镜头方向：中景至大腿处
姿势：站在冷柜前，身体微侧，一只手提着购物篮，另一只手自然下垂
光影氛围：冷柜冷白光 + 顶部高色温照明 + 极弱柔光闪光灯
滤镜效果：冷白高光 + 蓝白清透 CCD 色调 + 轻微颗粒感 + 淡淡数码噪点
画面比例：9:16
额外要求：U 领上衣强调颈部、锁骨、胸部和腰线；画面看起来像是日常超市中用 CCD 抓拍的瞬间，干净透明，没有过度摆拍感。

en.title: Custom Japanese Itasha Vehicle Designer
en.description: A comprehensive image-to-image prompt that creates a unique, fictional itasha vehicle based on the universe and character of an uploaded illustration.
en.prompt: Create an illustration. Create an original Japanese itasha vehicle based entirely on the uploaded illustration. Design a fully fictional vehicle and manufacturer naturally born from the artwork's universe, never resembling any real vehicle or brand. First, carefully analyze the uploaded illustration and determine the single most suitable vehicle category. The choice must arise naturally from the character, worldbuilding, culture, technology, architecture, personality, lifestyle, and atmosphere. The vehicle may be a {argument name="vehicle type" default="kei car, hatchback, sedan, wagon, coupe, limousine, SUV, pickup, microvan, camper, utility vehicle, military vehicle, luxury vehicle, retro-futuristic vehicle, magical vehicle"}, or another original type. Never default to the same vehicle category. Each illustration must begin from a completely blank design process and produce a vehicle with a unique body architecture, proportions, roofline, cabin position, and driving purpose. Sports cars, race cars, GT cars, and supercars must only be chosen when the uploaded illustration clearly and naturally requires them. The body shape, proportions, cockpit, wheels, lighting, materials, interior, and every design detail must naturally evolve from the illustration's atmosphere, colors, fashion, architecture, magic, technology, and worldbuilding. All decals, logos, symbols, typography, crests, and sponsor-style graphics must be completely original fictional designs inspired only by the uploaded illustration. If a character exists, preserve the original face, hairstyle, clothing style, colors, proportions, and personality, and place the character naturally beside or interacting with the vehicle. Compose the illustration in a {argument name="format" default="vertical 9:16"} format. The full vehicle must remain visible while the character becomes the primary focal point. Use a {argument name="perspective" default="dramatic low-angle perspective"} that emphasizes both the character and the vehicle, creating a powerful smartphone wallpaper composition. Cinematic automotive photography, anime-inspired photorealism, masterpiece quality, ultra detailed, dynamic lighting, dramatic reflections, no watermark.

zh.title: 定制化日式痛车 (Itasha) 设计师
zh.description: 一个综合性的图生图提示词，可根据上传插图中的世界观和角色，创作出独一无二的虚构痛车。
zh.prompt: 创作一张插图。根据上传的插图，完全原创地设计一辆日式痛车。设计一辆完全虚构的车辆及其制造商，使其自然地诞生于该艺术作品的世界观中，且不得与任何现实中的车辆或品牌相似。首先，仔细分析上传的插图，确定最适合的单一车辆类别。该选择必须源于角色的性格、世界观、文化、技术、建筑、生活方式和氛围。车辆可以是 {argument name="vehicle type" default="轻自动车 (kei car)、掀背车、轿车、旅行车、轿跑车、豪华轿车、SUV、皮卡、微型面包车、露营车、多功能车、军用车辆、豪华车、复古未来主义车辆、魔法车辆"} 或其他原创类型。切勿默认使用相同的车辆类别。每张插图都必须从完全空白的设计过程开始，并产出一辆具有独特车身结构、比例、车顶线条、驾驶舱位置和驾驶用途的车辆。仅在上传的插图明确且自然地需要时，才选择跑车、赛车、GT 赛车和超级跑车。车身形状、比例、驾驶舱、车轮、灯光、材质、内饰以及每一个设计细节，都必须从插图的氛围、色彩、时尚、建筑、魔法、技术和世界观中自然演变而来。所有贴纸、标志、符号、排版、徽章和赞助商风格的图形，都必须是完全原创的虚构设计，且仅受上传插图的启发。如果存在角色，请保留其原始面部、发型、服装风格、颜色、比例和个性，并将角色自然地放置在车辆旁边或与车辆互动。以 {argument name="format" default="竖向 9:16"} 的格式构图。确保整辆车保持可见，同时使角色成为主要的视觉焦点。使用 {argument name="perspective" default="具有戏剧性的低角度视角"}，以突出角色和车辆，打造出极具冲击力的智能手机壁纸构图。电影级汽车摄影、动漫风格的写实主义、杰作级质量、超高细节、动态光影、戏剧性反射，无水印。

en.title: Anti-AI Candid iPhone Snapshot
en.description: A sophisticated prompt designed to eliminate the 'AI feel' by simulating real-world imperfections and casual iPhone photography aesthetics with GPT Image 2.
en.prompt: Create a hyper-real vertical lifestyle photo that feels completely indistinguishable from a real casual iPhone snapshot taken at home, preserving the same core scene skeleton: a healthy athletic adult European-looking woman with a naturally beautiful, toned figure stands beside a dining table while pouring water from a glass carafe into a drinking glass. Push the realism, naturalness, and anti-AI quality further so the image feels even more like an unplanned real-life moment captured by someone nearby, not a styled campaign, not a generated image, not a perfect composition. The woman must look fully human and unretouched: healthy, fit, elegant, and believable, with subtle muscle tone in the arms, waist, shoulders, and posture, but without exaggerated definition. Her face should show realistic pores, tiny asymmetries, soft under-eye naturalness, real lip texture, slight variation in skin tone, and ordinary human presence. She should feel attractive in a quiet, realistic way, like a real person with excellent natural features rather than a glossy model. Her body shape should be strong, feminine, and authentic, with a naturally outstanding silhouette that still feels completely real. Keep the same domestic dining-table logic, but make the whole moment more spontaneous and more believable. She stands in a relaxed but natural posture, slightly leaning into the pouring action, with realistic hand tension around the carafe and glass. Her expression should be calm, inward, and unposed, as if she is focused only on the water and unaware of being photographed. Hair is tied back simply with believable flyaways, subtle irregular strands, and no salon perfection. Clothing remains soft, minimal, and light-toned: a fitted ribbed cream long-sleeve top and matching light pants or skirt, but with real fabric creases, slight pull tension, natural fit variation, and everyday softness. The dining table should feel more naturally lived-in and less styled. Keep beautiful objects, but arrange them with more believable randomness: lemons, bread, clear and tinted glasses, ceramic bowls, a bottle, fruit, cut pomegranate, folded cloth, and small everyday table disorder. Nothing should look over-curated. Object spacing should feel imperfect in a human way, like a real home meal setup interrupted mid-moment. The water pour must be especially realistic: true glass refraction, slight spill risk tension, accurate stream thickness, subtle distortion through the carafe, and believable reflections in the receiving glass. Preserve the warm interior setting near a window or glass door, but push the available-light realism further. The light should feel like actual sunlight entering a home and moving across the room, not professional lighting. Use uneven sun patches, soft shadow transitions, realistic highlight clipping in bright glass areas, subtle exposure roll-off, mild dynamic-range imperfection, and slight warm-cool imbalance that real phone cameras often produce in mixed light. The background should include dark reflective glass, curtain shadow, vague outdoor reflection, a chair, and softened interior depth, but all rendered with true-to-life phone-camera softness. Make the image more candid and less composed. The framing should feel slightly accidental: a very subtle crop tension, a tiny handheld tilt or off-center balance, maybe a mild closeness inconsistency that makes it feel genuinely photographed rather than perfectly designed. Keep the woman mostly central to the scene logic, but let the framing breathe in an imperfect, human way. Use realistic iPhone-style image behavior: slight computational depth softness, authentic edge sharpness falloff, natural highlight bloom, ordinary white balance imperfection, modest local contrast, and realistic texture handling. Push the anti-AI realism further through small truthful imperfections: a slightly awkward object angle on the table, tiny smudge or water mark on glass, subtle wrinkle at the waistline, ordinary finger placement, mild skin texture variation, imperfect nail appearance, slight unevenness in fruit skin, not-quite-symmetrical composition, and light behaving differently across surfaces. The image should feel like a real memory, not a “beautiful render.” Color palette should remain understated and natural: cream clothing, warm wood, muted lemon yellow, soft pomegranate red, olive-brown bottle glass, transparent drinking glass, linen beige, and warm interior shadow. Keep colors believable and unforced. Do not over-grade, do not cinematicize too much, do not add heavy stylization. The whole picture should feel like a naturally excellent phone photo. Subtle print grain can be present, but realism must come first. Fine detail should be sharp only where naturally focused and softened elsewhere in a believable phone-camera way. The final image must feel intimate, domestic, elegant, healthy, and absolutely real, with zero obvious AI traces. No readable text, no logo, no branding, no ad layout, no typography, no studio glamour, no artificial symmetry, no plastic skin, no exaggerated pose, no luxury-campaign stiffness, no obvious retouching, no overly perfect object placement.

zh.title: 去 AI 感的 iPhone 抓拍照片
zh.description: 这是一个精心设计的提示词，旨在通过模拟真实世界的瑕疵和随意的 iPhone 摄影美学，配合 GPT Image 2 来消除“AI 味”。
zh.prompt: 创作一张超写实的竖构图生活照，使其看起来与在家中用 iPhone 随手抓拍的照片完全无异。保留核心场景结构：一位外表健康、充满运动感的欧裔女性，身材自然优美且匀称，正站在餐桌旁，将玻璃水瓶中的水倒入水杯。进一步强化真实感、自然感和“去 AI 化”的质感，让照片看起来更像是旁人随手捕捉的真实瞬间，而非精心设计的广告大片、生成的图像或构图完美的艺术品。女性必须看起来完全真实且未经修饰：健康、匀称、优雅且可信，手臂、腰部、肩膀和姿态带有自然的肌肉线条，但没有夸张的肌肉轮廓。面部应呈现真实的毛孔、细微的不对称感、自然的眼下纹路、真实的唇部质感、肤色的细微变化以及普通人的真实感。她应展现出一种安静、写实的美，像是一个拥有出色自然条件的真人，而非精修的模特。她的体型应健美、柔美且真实，拥有自然出众但依然极其真实的轮廓。保持餐桌场景的逻辑，但让整个瞬间显得更随意、更可信。她站姿放松而自然，身体微微前倾，手部握住水瓶和水杯的动作带有真实的张力。表情平静、内敛且未摆拍，仿佛专注于倒水，并未意识到正在被拍摄。头发简单扎起，带有真实的碎发和不规则的发丝，没有沙龙造型的完美感。服装保持简约、浅色调：一件修身的奶油色罗纹长袖上衣搭配同色系长裤或半身裙，呈现出真实的织物褶皱、轻微的拉伸感、自然的贴合度以及日常的柔软感。餐桌应显得更有生活气息，而非刻意摆拍。保留精美的物品，但以更真实、随意的形式摆放：柠檬、面包、透明与有色玻璃杯、陶瓷碗、瓶子、水果、切开的石榴、折叠的餐布以及日常生活中细小的杂乱感。不要有过度修饰的痕迹。物品间的间距应带有不完美的人文感，就像用餐中途被中断的真实场景。倒水的动作必须格外逼真：真实的玻璃折射、轻微的溢出风险感、准确的水流厚度、透过水瓶产生的细微畸变，以及接收水杯中真实的倒影。保留窗边或玻璃门旁的温暖室内环境，但进一步强化自然光的真实感。光线应像真实的阳光射入室内并随时间移动，而非专业的摄影布光。使用不均匀的阳光斑块、柔和的阴影过渡、明亮玻璃区域真实的过曝感、细微的曝光衰减、轻微的动态范围瑕疵，以及真实手机摄像头在混合光线下常有的冷暖色差。背景应包含深色反光玻璃、窗帘阴影、模糊的户外倒影、椅子和柔和的室内纵深感，所有细节均以真实的手机摄像头质感呈现。让照片更具抓拍感，减少构图痕迹。构图应显得略微随意：极细微的裁切张力、轻微的手持倾斜或非中心平衡，甚至是一点点距离上的不一致，使其看起来是真实拍摄而非精心设计。女性主体保持在场景中心，但让构图在不完美的人文感中留有呼吸空间。使用真实的 iPhone 风格成像特征：轻微的计算摄影景深柔化、真实的边缘锐度衰减、自然的溢光效果、普通的白平衡偏差、适度的局部对比度以及真实的纹理处理。通过细微的真实瑕疵进一步强化“去 AI”的写实感：桌上物品角度略显笨拙、玻璃上的细微指纹或水渍、腰部的轻微褶皱、自然的手指摆放位置、皮肤纹理的细微差异、指甲的不完美感、水果表皮的轻微不平整、非完全对称的构图，以及光线在不同表面上的真实漫反射。照片应像一段真实的记忆，而非一张“精美的渲染图”。色调保持低调自然：奶油色服装、暖色木纹、柔和的柠檬黄、柔和的石榴红、橄榄棕色玻璃瓶、透明水杯、亚麻米色和温暖的室内阴影。保持色彩真实且不刻意。不要过度调色，不要过度电影化，不要添加强烈的风格化滤镜。整张照片应呈现出自然且出色的手机摄影质感。可以保留细微的噪点，但真实感必须放在首位。细节仅在自然对焦处保持锐利，其余部分以真实的手机摄像头方式柔化。最终图像必须给人以亲密、居家、优雅、健康且绝对真实的感受，没有任何明显的 AI 痕迹。无文字、无 Logo、无品牌标识、无广告排版、无排版设计、无影棚质感、无人工对称、无塑料感皮肤、无夸张姿势、无奢侈品广告的僵硬感、无明显的后期修图、无过度完美的物品摆放。

en.title: The Galaxy in a Teacup Macro Photography
en.description: A surreal macro photography prompt for GPT Image 2 that generates a hyper-realistic scene of a porcelain teacup containing an entire spiral galaxy.
en.prompt: A hyper-realistic macro shot of a {argument name="cup type" default="delicate porcelain teacup"} sitting on a {argument name="surface type" default="wooden table"}. Instead of tea, the cup contains an {argument name="celestial contents" default="entire spiral galaxy with glowing nebulae, orbiting planets, tiny astronauts floating between stars, and miniature comets streaking across space"}. The swirling galaxy reflects on the rim of the cup. Cinematic lighting, impossible object, photorealistic, masterpiece, 8K.

zh.title: 茶杯中的银河：微距摄影
zh.description: 一个为 GPT Image 2 设计的超现实微距摄影提示词，用于生成一个超写实场景：一只瓷杯中盛放着整个螺旋星系。
zh.prompt: 一张超写实的微距摄影作品，拍摄对象是放置在 {argument name="surface type" default="木桌"} 上的 {argument name="cup type" default="精致瓷杯"}。杯中盛放的不是茶，而是 {argument name="celestial contents" default="整个螺旋星系，包含发光的星云、环绕的行星、在星际间漂浮的微型宇航员，以及划过太空的微型彗星"}。旋转的星系倒映在杯沿上。电影级光效，不可能的物体，照片级真实感，杰作，8K 分辨率。

en.title: Tokyo Bar Candid Street Photography
en.description: A sophisticated street photography prompt for GPT Image 2 that captures a natural, unposed moment of a woman in a low-lit Tokyo bar.
en.prompt:
A three-quarter body shot of a single {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} seated on a bar stool inside a {argument name="location" default="low-lit Tokyo bar"}, authentic daily life photography, natural candid moment. She is mid-turn, glancing toward something off-frame near the entrance — caught in an unposed, un-staged instant.

East Asian young woman in her early 20s. Almond-shaped eyes with a soft natural double eyelid, slightly elongated at the outer corners. Straight refined nose with a delicate bridge. Skin tone fair to light beige (NC10–NC20), smooth and even. Skin subsurface scattering visible under warm lateral bar light, specular micro-highlights on the nose ridge and upper cheekbone, fine foundation powder grain perceptible across the forehead.

She wears an {argument name="outfit" default="oversized off-white satin shirt tucked loosely into dark tailored trousers"} — effortlessly composed. She sits sideways on the stool, one arm resting along the bar counter, her torso mid-rotation, chin turning over her shoulder. Two or three stray hairs catch and scatter the light, displaced by faint air movement, natural unplanned imperfection, not geometrically symmetrical.

Warm amber pendant lights create a soft gold wash across her back and the counter surface. A cool blue-tinted neon glow from a distant sign touches the background bottles, creating a quiet warm-cool contrast. The mood is relaxed and unhurried — soft unfocused gaze, at ease in the moment, unaware of the camera. Subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, photographic noise texture not CG render smoothness. Aspect ratio 2:3. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not digitally painted, not illustration, not anime.

zh.title: 东京酒吧街头纪实摄影
zh.description: 这是一个为 GPT Image 2 设计的高级街头摄影提示词，旨在捕捉东京昏暗酒吧中女性自然、不经意的瞬间。
zh.prompt:
一张 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性"} 的四分之三全身照，她坐在 {argument name="location" default="昏暗的东京酒吧"} 内的吧台椅上，呈现真实的日常生活摄影风格，捕捉自然、不经意的瞬间。她正处于转身过程中，看向入口附近画框外的事物——定格在未摆拍、未设计的瞬间。

20 出头的东亚年轻女性。杏仁眼，双眼皮自然柔和，外眼角略微拉长。鼻梁挺直精致。肤色为白皙至浅米色（NC10–NC20），平滑均匀。在温暖的侧向吧台灯光下可见皮肤的次表面散射，鼻梁和颧骨上方有微小的镜面高光，额头上隐约可见细腻的粉底颗粒感。

她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件宽松的米白色缎面衬衫，随意地塞进深色修身长裤中"} ——造型毫不费力。她侧身坐在吧台上，一只手臂搭在吧台边缘，躯干处于旋转中，下巴越过肩膀转动。两三根散落的发丝捕捉并散射着光线，因微弱的空气流动而位移，呈现出自然的、非计划性的不完美感，而非几何对称。

温暖的琥珀色吊灯在她的背部和吧台表面洒下一层柔和的金光。远处招牌发出的冷蓝色霓虹光映照在背景的酒瓶上，营造出静谧的冷暖对比。氛围轻松从容——眼神柔和且失焦，沉浸在当下的舒适中，并未察觉到相机的存在。阴影区域带有细腻的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，呈现摄影噪点纹理，而非 CG 渲染的平滑感。宽高比 2:3。无水印，无文字覆盖，非卡通，非数字绘画，非插画，非动漫。

en.title: Moody Fine Art Editorial Portrait
en.description: A professional editorial photography prompt for GPT Image 2 creating a moody, painterly portrait of a woman with a book.
en.prompt:
Ultra realistic fine art portrait of a woman with a calm, intense expression, making direct eye contact with the camera. Soft natural freckles, {argument name="eye color" default="light green eyes"}, minimal makeup, and slightly textured natural skin. {argument name="hair style" default="Dark wavy hair loosely pulled back with soft strands framing the face"}. She wears a {argument name="outfit" default="vintage inspired floral dress with a deep neckline and a delicate crescent moon pendant necklace"}. She holds an old worn book partially visible in the lower frame, adding a quiet literary mood.

Moody low key lighting with soft diffused illumination from the front left, creating gentle shadows and subtle depth across the face. Dark muted blue gray studio background with a smooth creamy blur. Cinematic, intimate, painterly portrait look with a shallow depth of field, sharp eyes, softly blurred edges, and rich tonal contrast.

Shot as a close up editorial portrait, chest-up framing, subject centered, symmetrical composition, soft bokeh, full-frame camera, 85mm lens, f/1.8, ISO 200, 1/160s. Fine art photography, emotional realism, quiet mysterious atmosphere, natural skin texture, soft color grading, subtle filmic tones, elegant portrait photography, magazine quality, highly detailed, photorealistic.

zh.title: 情绪化艺术编辑肖像
zh.description: 一个用于 GPT Image 2 的专业编辑摄影提示词，旨在创作一张带有情绪感、油画质感的女性持书肖像。
zh.prompt:
超写实艺术肖像，一位表情沉静而深邃的女性，正与镜头进行直接的眼神交流。自然的淡色雀斑，{argument name="eye color" default="浅绿色眼睛"}，极简妆容，以及带有轻微纹理的自然皮肤。{argument name="hair style" default="深色波浪卷发，松散地向后挽起，几缕发丝柔和地修饰着脸庞"}。她身着 {argument name="outfit" default="复古风格的深领碎花裙，佩戴着精致的新月吊坠项链"}。她手中拿着一本旧书，在画面下方隐约可见，增添了一抹静谧的文学气息。

情绪化低调照明，左前方有柔和的漫射光，在脸部营造出柔和的阴影和微妙的深度。深色调的蓝灰色摄影棚背景，带有平滑细腻的虚化效果。电影感、私密感、油画质感的肖像风格，浅景深，眼神锐利，边缘柔和虚化，色调对比丰富。

拍摄为特写编辑肖像，胸部以上构图，主体居中，对称构图，柔和焦外成像，全画幅相机，85mm 镜头，f/1.8，ISO 200，1/160s。艺术摄影，情感写实主义，静谧神秘的氛围，自然皮肤纹理，柔和的调色，细腻的胶片色调，优雅的肖像摄影，杂志级品质，高度细节，照片级真实感。

en.title: Anime Character Waking Up POV
en.description: A highly detailed prompt designed for GPT models to create a 'candid morning' photo of an anime character. It features a unique setup including the photographer's hand holding a camera that shows the character on its screen, plus polaroid photos on a bedside table, all while maintaining strict character consistency.
en.prompt:
Generate an image with the following requirements.
-> ({argument name="character name" default="character name"})

Important: The character's appearance (hairstyle/hair color/gender/eyes/age/clothing/decorations/atmosphere/species elements/presence and shape of wings) must strictly match the attached image. Do not change the character on your own.
The pajamas should be an arrangement of the clothing in the reference image.
Also, the "character on the screen" shown on the LCD on the back of the camera and the "character in the photos" within the three polaroid shots on the desk must reflect the same character features from the attached image (if the character has wings, they must be shown; if not, do not add them).

▼ Generation Scene Specifications (Fixed)
- Aspect ratio: 4:3
- Art style: anime style / official art
- Quality tags: Score 9, Score 8+, Score 7+, masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, 8k resolution, Sharp focus, (Masterpiece: 1.2), (Highest Quality: 1.2), (Highly Aesthetic: 1.2), (Absurd: 1.2), (Detailed Background)
- Lighting: cinematic lighting, soft morning light, warm sunlight through curtains, shallow depth of field, gentle bokeh
- Subject: "Upper body only" of a sleeping (or waking up) character, close-up on the face, drowsy half-open eyes / sleepy unfocused gaze
- Composition: first-person POV, intimate close range, candid morning shot
- Foreground: The photographer's hand (feminine or neutral, no face or full body) holding a "real camera." The camera strap is visible.
- Camera back: The camera's rear LCD screen is visible, showing the "same character's sleepy face (same scene)" as a live view (thin screen glare, minimal UI).
- On the desk: "Three polaroid instant photos ONLY" are stacked on a bedside table.
- Photos within the polaroids: The same character, but with three different sleeping postures (random poses/angles) showing clear differences.
  Example: lying sideways hugging a pillow / lying on the back kicking the blanket / facing away with a hand at the mouth + blanket up to the chin.
- Memo on polaroid frames: On the white borders of each polaroid, there are handwritten Japanese memos (readable Japanese handwritten memo, JPfont, black ink, short neat handwriting).
  The text should be short and prioritized for legibility. Choose three sleep-talk lines appropriate for the character. **Must be in the character's tone.**
- Background: clean cozy bedroom background, tidy but lived-in, wooden bedside table, (subtle feathers in frame only if present in attached image)
- Additional: instant film texture, slight glare reflection, realistic polaroid frames

▼ Prohibitions (Fixed)
- Number of polaroids increasing beyond three
- Photographer's face or full body being shown
- Text becoming distorted or unreadable (suppress as much as possible)
- Alteration of character features (hair color, eye color, clothing, species elements, wings, etc.)

zh.title: 动漫角色起床视角 (POV)
zh.description: 这是一个为 GPT 模型设计的高精度提示词，旨在创作一张动漫角色的“清晨抓拍”照片。它包含独特的构图设定，包括摄影师手持相机拍摄屏幕中显示的角色，以及床头柜上的拍立得照片，同时严格保持角色的一致性。
zh.prompt:
请根据以下要求生成图像。
-> ({argument name="character name" default="角色名称"})

重要提示：角色的外观（发型/发色/性别/眼睛/年龄/服装/装饰/氛围/物种特征/翅膀的存在与形状）必须严格与附图一致。请勿擅自更改角色。
睡衣应参考附图中的服装进行设计。
此外，相机背面 LCD 屏幕上显示的“屏幕中的角色”以及桌上三张拍立得照片里的“照片中的角色”，都必须反映出附图中角色的相同特征（如果角色有翅膀，则必须显示；如果没有，请勿添加）。

▼ 场景生成规范（固定）
- 宽高比：4:3
- 艺术风格：动漫风格 / 官方画风
- 质量标签：Score 9, Score 8+, Score 7+, masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, 8k resolution, Sharp focus, (Masterpiece: 1.2), (Highest Quality: 1.2), (Highly Aesthetic: 1.2), (Absurd: 1.2), (Detailed Background)
- 光影：电影级光影，柔和的晨光，透过窗帘的温暖阳光，浅景深，柔和的背景虚化
- 主体：正在睡觉（或刚醒来）角色的“上半身”，面部特写，惺忪的半睁眼 / 困倦且失焦的眼神
- 构图：第一人称视角 (POV)，亲密的近距离，清晨抓拍感
- 前景：摄影师的手（女性或中性，不露脸或全身），手持“真实相机”。可见相机背带。
- 相机背面：可见相机的后置 LCD 屏幕，显示着“同一角色睡眼惺忪的脸（相同场景）”作为实时取景（带有轻微屏幕反光，极简 UI）。
- 桌面上：床头柜上仅堆叠着“三张拍立得照片”。
- 拍立得照片内容：同一角色，但呈现三种不同的睡姿（随机姿势/角度），且有明显差异。
  示例：侧卧抱着枕头 / 平躺踢开被子 / 背对镜头手捂嘴 + 被子拉到下巴处。
- 拍立得边框备注：在每张拍立得的白色边框上，有手写的日语备注（清晰可辨的日语手写体，JPfont，黑色墨水，简短整洁的笔迹）。
  文字应简短并优先考虑可读性。请根据角色性格选择三句合适的梦话。**必须符合角色的语气。**
- 背景：干净舒适的卧室背景，整洁但有生活气息，木质床头柜，（仅在附图中有翅膀时，画面中才可出现细微的羽毛）
- 其他：拍立得胶片质感，轻微的反光，逼真的拍立得边框

▼ 禁止事项（固定）
- 拍立得数量超过三张
- 出现摄影师的脸或全身
- 文字扭曲或无法辨认（尽可能抑制此类情况）
- 更改角色特征（发色、瞳色、服装、物种特征、翅膀等）

en.title: Japanese Summer Festival Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for gpt-image-2 featuring a young woman at a traditional Japanese summer festival with water balloons and evening lighting.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Summer Colors Scooped"}

Main Subject:
A 3:4 portrait photo. At a {argument name="background setting" default="summer festival stall"}, a young woman crouches in front of a tank with colorful water balloons. Position her slightly left of center, showing about 80% of her body, while revealing a wide view of the tank and balloons on the right. She holds a small goldfish-scooping net in one hand and a white small bowl in the other.

Person/Expression:
A natural and approachable Japanese face. Translucent bright skin, large rounded eyes, thin soft eyebrows, and pale coral pink lips. The expression is quiet and calm, as if slightly lost in thought. Head tilted slightly to the left, looking directly at the camera. Deep dark brown hair in a soft updo with thin see-through bangs. Small white flower ornament behind the left ear.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="yukata pattern" default="A cool-looking white yukata with light wisteria and blue-purple hydrangea patterns"}. A dull blue-gray obi tied in a large but light bunko knot. Geta sandals with light floral straps. Crouching deeply by the tank with a straight back. Holding the net near her chest with her right hand and the bowl over the tank with her left. Realistic wrinkles in the yukata reflecting her pose.

Background/Lighting:
Night at a Japanese summer festival. A metal-framed tank on the right filled with transparent pink, blue, green, yellow, and orange balloons. Background features wooden stall crates and soft blurred festival lights. Main light source from warm stall lighting at the top right, creating highlights on her cheek and hands, with slight blue reflected light on the left.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 aspect ratio, medium-long shot. Camera slightly above eye level looking down. Focus on the face and hands with a shallow depth of field (50mm equivalent). Smooth bokeh for the background stalls.

Texture/Style:
Natural photographic expression capturing the summer festival atmosphere. Detailed depiction of skin texture, cotton yukata material, and glossy water balloons. Low contrast with fine film grain and gentle halation. Avoid excessive skin retouching to maintain a magazine-style snap look.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, oversized eyes, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, poor contact with objects, floating items, distorted yukata patterns, logo, watermark, plastic skin texture.

zh.title: 日本夏日祭典人像
zh.description: 一个为 gpt-image-2 设计的高细节电影感提示词，描绘了一位在传统日本夏日祭典中手持水气球的年轻女性，配以夜晚灯光效果。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="捞起的夏日色彩"}

3:4 比例的人像照片。在 {argument name="background setting" default="夏日祭典摊位"} 前，一位年轻女性蹲在装满彩色水气球的水槽前。将她置于画面中心偏左位置，展示约 80% 的身体，同时在右侧展现水槽和气球的广角视野。她一手拿着捞金鱼的小网，另一手拿着白色小碗。

人物/表情：
自然且亲切的日本面孔。通透亮白的皮肤，圆润的大眼睛，细长柔和的眉毛，以及淡珊瑚粉色的嘴唇。表情安静平和，仿佛陷入沉思。头部微微向左倾斜，直视镜头。深棕色头发梳成柔和的盘发，留着轻薄的空气刘海。左耳后方别着一朵小白花装饰。

{argument name="yukata pattern" default="一件清爽的白色浴衣，带有淡紫藤花和蓝紫色绣球花图案"}。系着一个暗蓝灰色的腰带，打成大而轻盈的文库结。穿着带有浅色花纹带的木屐。在水槽边深蹲，背部挺直。右手将网置于胸前，左手将碗悬于水槽上方。浴衣上自然的褶皱反映出她的姿势。

背景/灯光：
日本夏日祭典的夜晚。右侧是一个金属框架的水槽，里面装满了透明的粉色、蓝色、绿色、黄色和橙色气球。背景是木质摊位板条箱和柔和模糊的祭典灯光。主光源来自右上方的暖色摊位灯光，在她的脸颊和手上形成高光，左侧带有轻微的蓝色反射光。

构图/摄影：
3:4 纵横比，中远景。相机略高于视线水平向下拍摄。焦点对准面部和手部，具有浅景深（50mm 等效镜头）。背景摊位呈现平滑的虚化效果。

质感/风格：
捕捉夏日祭典氛围的自然摄影表现。细腻刻画皮肤纹理、棉质浴衣材质以及水气球的光泽感。低对比度，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和柔和的光晕。避免过度修饰皮肤，以保持杂志风格的抓拍质感。

不自然的面部、不自然的视线、过大的眼睛、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、与物体接触不良、漂浮的物品、扭曲的浴衣图案、标志、水印、塑料感的皮肤纹理。

en.title: Urban Rooftop Summer Portrait
