Avoid: Cartoon, CG feel, exaggerated body proportions, incorrect fingers, over-smoothed skin, heavy makeup, strong HDR, overly vivid seawater, cluttered background, text, watermarks, or logos.

zh.title: 写实海水人像摄影
zh.description: 一份用于创作写实生活方式摄影作品的详细提示词，描绘了一位年轻女性站在浅海水中，重点呈现自然的皮肤纹理、水珠及柔和的日光照明。
zh.prompt:
一位年轻成年 {argument name="ethnicity" default="东亚女性"} 站在浅海水中，半身特写构图，位于画面中心，面向镜头，肩膀放松，双臂浸入水中至上腹部或下胸部。她表情平静、自然且自信，微微看向镜头，双唇自然闭合。她身材匀称修长，留着长长的、微微湿润的 {argument name="hair color" default="深黑色头发"}，自然垂落，几缕发丝贴在脖颈和锁骨上。五官精致，淡妆，肤色白皙温暖，保留真实的毛孔、细腻的纹理、水珠、湿润的高光以及自然的皮肤变化，无人工磨皮效果。
她身穿一件 {argument name="swimwear style" default="白色连体泳衣"}，深 V 领口，配有黑色细肩带和黑色镶边。面料贴合身形但质感自然，胸部和上半身带有清晰的水珠。她佩戴着一条带有小吊坠的细项链。
背景是柔焦的海面，带有细微涟漪，地平线较高，天空呈现明亮的灰蓝色，无强烈色彩。整体光影为自然日光，低饱和度，低对比度，带有轻微的胶片颗粒感，呈现出真实的海边生活方式摄影风格。
避免：卡通、CG 感、夸张的身体比例、手指错误、过度磨皮、浓妆、强 HDR、过于鲜艳的海水、杂乱的背景、文字、水印或 Logo。

en.title: Elegant Backless Gown Portrait
en.description: A professional fashion-style prompt for a high-end, realistic portrait of an East Asian woman in an ivory backless gown, emphasizing natural skin texture and lighting.
en.prompt: A {argument name="subject" default="young adult East Asian woman"} stands on a classic stone terrace, framed from head to thighs. She faces away from the camera at a three-quarter back angle, slightly turned to the left; her arms extend naturally forward, hands resting lightly on a rough beige-grey stone railing. She looks back naturally over her left shoulder at the camera, head slightly lowered, gaze calm and direct, expression restrained, confident, slightly aloof, lips naturally closed. She has a delicate soft oval face, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender bridge of the nose, and soft nude-pink lips. Light makeup, focused on detailed eyeliner, natural lashes, and a slight warm blush. The skin is warm beige, retaining real pores, fine vellus hair, natural skin tone variations, and slight highlights; no plastic skin smoothing. Deep black hair is loosely gathered into a slightly messy low bun, with natural volume at the crown and fine strands blown by the breeze near the ears and neck. Wearing small gold dangle earrings. She wears an {argument name="outfit style" default="ivory or light cream premium sleeveless gown"}, stand-up collar, sharp shoulder tailoring, made of fine matte silk satin or premium crepe. The gown features a large, flowing, waist-deep oval backless opening, edges clean and snug, fully showcasing the shoulder blades and back lines; naturally cinched at the waist, the skirt hangs vertically and smoothly, no patterns, no extra decorations. The background consists of layered green forests and hills in the distance, softly blurred due to a telephoto lens and atmospheric perspective. The sky is bright but with no visible sun, using natural diffused light from thin clouds or an overcast sky. The skin tone, white gown, and stone railing have soft and delicate light-to-dark transitions, overall low saturation, low contrast, dominated by ivory white, warm skin tones, taupe stone, and soft forest green. Photography style: {argument name="lens" default="85mm portrait lens"}, f/2, eye-level position slightly above the waist, shallow depth of field, clear eyes, real optical bokeh, luxury high-fashion editorial, slight film grain, photorealistic. Avoid: frontal poses, incorrect backless shape, shoulders too narrow, distorted spine, incorrect fingers, plastic skin, heavy makeup, strong sunlight, excessive HDR, CG, illustration, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 优雅露背礼服肖像
zh.description: 一个专业时尚风格的提示词，用于生成一位身着象牙白露背礼服的东亚女性的高端写实肖像，强调自然的皮肤纹理与光影效果。
zh.prompt: 一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻东亚女性"} 站在经典的石砌露台上，取景范围从头部到大腿。她背对镜头呈四分之三侧身，身体微微向左转；双臂自然向前伸展，双手轻放在粗糙的米灰色石栏杆上。她自然地越过左肩回眸看向镜头，头部微垂，目光冷静而直接，表情克制、自信且略带清冷，双唇自然闭合。她拥有精致柔和的鹅蛋脸，杏仁状的深褐色眼睛，自然的细眉，鼻梁挺拔，嘴唇呈柔和的裸粉色。妆容清透，重点在于精致的眼线、自然的睫毛和淡淡的暖色腮红。肤色为暖米色，保留了真实的毛孔、细微的绒毛、自然的肤色变化以及轻微的高光；无塑料感的磨皮效果。乌黑的秀发松散地盘成一个略显凌乱的低发髻，头顶蓬松自然，耳畔和颈部有几缕被微风吹拂的碎发。佩戴小巧的金色垂坠耳环。她身着一件 {argument name="outfit style" default="象牙白或浅奶油色高级无袖礼服"}，立领设计，肩部剪裁利落，采用优质哑光丝绸或高级绉纱制成。礼服背部采用深至腰部的大型流线型露背开口，边缘干净贴合，充分展现肩胛骨和背部线条；腰部自然收紧，裙摆垂直顺滑，无图案，无多余装饰。背景为远处的层叠森林与山丘，由于长焦镜头和大气透视效果呈现出柔和的虚化。天空明亮但无可见太阳，采用薄云或阴天下的自然漫射光。肤色、白色礼服和石栏杆之间有着柔和细腻的明暗过渡，整体低饱和度、低对比度，以象牙白、暖肤色、灰褐色和柔和的森林绿为主色调。摄影风格：{argument name="lens" default="85mm 人像镜头"}，f/2 光圈，平视视角（略高于腰部），浅景深，眼神清晰，真实的镜头虚化效果，奢华高级时尚杂志大片，轻微胶片颗粒感，照片级真实。避免：正面姿势、错误的露背形状、肩膀过窄、脊柱扭曲、手指错误、塑料感皮肤、浓妆、强烈的直射阳光、过度 HDR、CG 感、插画、文字、水印、Logo。

en.title: Summer Uniform Portrait on Pedestrian Bridge
en.description: A comprehensive Japanese prompt for a realistic summer portrait of a woman in a school uniform leaning on a bridge railing, with detailed lighting and texture instructions.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="title" default="Waiting for the Summer Sound"}

Main Subject:
3:4 vertical. In a residential summer street on a pedestrian bridge, a {argument name="age" default="20-something woman"} stands with a guitar case beside her, positioned slightly right of center. The person occupies about 70% of the screen, with a black soft guitar case leaning from the bottom left toward the center.

Character & Expression:
A natural and realistic woman. Long dark brown straight hair with light see-through bangs and thin layers around the face. The hair flows below the chest, falling naturally over the front of the right shoulder. Light rose-toned makeup, natural tear bags, delicate eyelashes, and pale pink-beige lips. The face is tilted slightly to the left, leaning forward as she gazes quietly at the camera. The expression is calm, but with a hint of softness at the corners of the mouth.

Clothing & Pose:
{argument name="clothing style" default="A light Japanese summer school style"}. The white short-sleeved shirt is made of thin cotton with a natural texture that isn't too sheer. A small navy ribbon at the chest. Fine grey and navy checkered pleated skirt, white rib socks, and black loafers. The left hand reaches back to lightly grip the top of a metal railing. The body leans forward from shoulder to waist, with weight on the right leg. The opposite leg is bent deeply at the knee, with toes lifted behind toward the inside of the axis leg. The flow of waist, knee, and ankle connects naturally, with the skirt pleats spreading slightly along the pose.

Background & Light:
A pedestrian bridge in a summer Japanese residential area. In the foreground, white-painted metal railings and a black guitar case placed at the bottom left. Mid-ground shows a narrow local road, low-rise housing, utility poles, shrubbery, and a bicycle parking area. Background features pale grey apartment buildings and a summer blue sky. Signboards and displays are blurred in the distance with illegible text. The main light source is summer sunlight from the upper left. Bright outlines appear on the person's hair, shoulders, arms, and outer legs, with weak reflected light from the railing onto the shirt and legs. Shadows fall toward the lower right, with dappled sunlight creating irregular patterns on the sidewalk.

Composition & Camera:
3:4 vertical full-body portrait. Camera position is roughly eye-level from slightly below waist height. The subject is slightly right of center, with the guitar case extending vertically from the bottom left, mirroring the diagonal line of the body. A bit of blue sky margin is left above the head, capturing the feet completely. Depth is created using the horizontal lines and vertical grids of the railing, with the background road narrowing toward the center. Focus is on the subject's eyes and face, with the background softly blurred using a natural shallow depth of field. Natural compression equivalent to a 50mm lens.

Texture & Style:
High-definition realistic photography. Maintaining the dry summer air and strong sunlight, the skin is not excessively whitened, leaving natural complexion and fine texture. Meticulous depiction of each hair strand, the weave of the thin shirt, the folds of the pleats, the nylon material of the guitar case, and reflections on the metal railing. The overall tone is bright and transparent, avoiding blown-out highlights while settling the contrast between green and navy. Finished like a summer school uniform snap in a magazine.

Negative:
Looking underage, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, joint failure, incorrect bent leg direction, poor contact with railing, floating guitar case, unnatural skirt deformation, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive transparency, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 天桥上的夏季制服人像
zh.description: 一份全面的日语提示词，用于生成女性身穿校服倚靠在天桥栏杆上的写实夏季人像，包含详细的光影和质感说明。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="title" default="等待夏日之声"}

主要对象：
3:4 竖构图。在住宅区的夏季街道天桥上，一位 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁的女性"} 站在那里，身旁放着一个吉他包，位置位于画面中心偏右。人物占据约 70% 的画面，一个黑色软质吉他包从左下角向中心倾斜。

人物与表情：
自然写实的女性。深棕色长直发，带有轻薄的空气刘海，脸部周围有细碎的层次感。头发垂至胸下，自然地落在右肩前。淡玫瑰色妆容，自然的卧蚕，精致的睫毛，以及淡粉米色的嘴唇。头部微微向左倾斜，身体前倾，安静地注视着镜头。表情平静，嘴角带着一丝柔和。

服装与姿势：
{argument name="clothing style" default="日式夏季校服风格"}。白色短袖衬衫由薄棉制成，质感自然，不会过于透视。胸前系着一条深蓝色小领带。灰色与深蓝色细格纹百褶裙，白色罗纹袜，黑色乐福鞋。左手向后伸，轻轻握住金属栏杆的顶部。身体从肩膀到腰部前倾，重心落在右腿上。另一条腿膝盖深弯，脚尖向轴心腿内侧后方抬起。腰部、膝盖和脚踝的线条自然连接，裙褶随着姿势微微散开。

背景与光影：
日本夏季住宅区的天桥。前景是漆成白色的金属栏杆和放置在左下角的黑色吉他包。中景展示了狭窄的当地道路、低层住宅、电线杆、灌木丛和自行车停放处。背景是淡灰色的公寓楼和夏日的蓝天。远处的招牌和展示物模糊不清，文字无法辨认。主要光源是来自左上方的夏日阳光。人物的头发、肩膀、手臂和外侧腿部出现明亮的轮廓光，栏杆上有微弱的反射光投射在衬衫和腿部。阴影向右下方投射，斑驳的阳光在人行道上形成不规则的图案。

构图与摄影：
3:4 竖构图全身人像。相机位置大约在腰部高度略低处的视平线。主体位于中心偏右，吉他包从左下角垂直延伸，与身体的对角线相呼应。头顶留有少许蓝天余白，完整捕捉到双脚。利用栏杆的水平线条和垂直网格营造深度感，背景道路向中心收窄。焦点对准主体的眼睛和脸部，背景使用自然的浅景深进行柔和虚化。相当于 50mm 镜头的自然压缩感。

质感与风格：
高清写实摄影。保持夏季干燥的空气感和强烈的阳光，皮肤不过度美白，保留自然的肤色和细腻的纹理。细致描绘每一根发丝、薄衬衫的编织纹理、百褶裙的褶皱、吉他包的尼龙材质以及金属栏杆上的反光。整体色调明亮通透，避免高光溢出，同时平衡绿色与深蓝色的对比。成品如同杂志上的夏季校服快照。

负面提示词：
看起来未成年、不自然的脸部、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节故障、弯腿方向错误、与栏杆接触不良、吉他包悬浮、裙子变形不自然、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、过度透明、过度皮肤修饰、塑料质感皮肤、乱码文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Symmetrical Urban Fashion Editorial
en.description: A high-fashion editorial prompt featuring a model in a symmetrical urban plaza setting with architectural depth and cold, minimalist tones.
en.prompt:
A {argument name="subject" default="young adult female model"} standing in the center of a {argument name="setting" default="modern urban architectural plaza"}, facing the camera, with a nearly full-body shot and a strictly symmetrical axial composition. She stands on a dark wooden walkway wet from rain, with visible reflections of the ground and buildings. Tall modern glass buildings flank the sides, while a cluster of rectangular high-rise towers stands in the distant center, featuring cold, minimalist, and futuristic lines. The sky is heavily overcast with grayish-blue clouds and no sunlight, creating an overall cold, low-saturation, and low-contrast tone.

The model is tall and slender with a restrained posture, arms hanging naturally at her sides, and a calm, detached, high-fashion expression. Her hair is styled in a sleek low bun or swept back, with delicate facial features and minimal makeup. She wears a set of {argument name="clothing style" default="high-end white fashion"}: a high-neck asymmetrical top or a cape-style long shawl trailing from the left shoulder; paired with high-waisted wide-leg trousers featuring complex jacquard or embroidered textures and a sculptural skirt structure, resembling a blend of haute couture and modern minimalism. The fabric has fine textures and a subtle sheen, maintaining a restrained palette of pure and cold white layers.

Photography style: Full-body fashion editorial with a strong sense of architectural space, shot with an 85mm or slightly longer lens, eye-level perspective, deep to medium depth of field. Both the person and buildings are sharp with realistic optical perspective. Emphasizes the post-rain atmosphere, moist wood textures, glass curtain wall reflections, sky layering, the garment's train, and ground reflections. Photorealistic, authentic skin texture, and slight film grain.

Avoid: Cartoon, CG feel, over-smoothed skin, warm sunset, cluttered crowds, exaggerated poses, colored clothing, deformed limbs, architectural distortion, text, watermarks, or logos.

zh.title: 对称式城市时尚大片
zh.description: 一份高阶时尚大片提示词，以对称的城市广场为背景，展现建筑的纵深感与冷峻的极简色调。
zh.prompt:
一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性模特"} 站在 {argument name="setting" default="现代城市建筑广场"} 的中心，面向镜头，采用近全身构图，严格遵循对称轴线构图。她站在雨后湿润的深色木质步道上，地面与建筑的倒影清晰可见。两侧是高耸的现代玻璃建筑，远方中心矗立着一组矩形高层塔楼，线条冷峻、极简且充满未来感。天空阴云密布，呈现灰蓝色，无阳光直射，整体色调冷冽、低饱和度且低对比度。

模特身材高挑纤细，姿态内敛，双臂自然下垂，表情冷静疏离，极具高级时尚感。发型为利落的低发髻或后梳式，五官精致，妆容极简。她身着一套 {argument name="clothing style" default="高端白色时装"}：高领不对称上衣或从左肩垂下的斗篷式长披肩；搭配高腰阔腿裤，裤身带有复杂的提花或刺绣纹理，并结合雕塑感的裙摆结构，呈现出高级定制与现代极简主义的融合。面料质感细腻，带有微妙的光泽，整体保持纯净冷白色的内敛色调。

摄影风格：全身时尚大片，具有强烈的建筑空间感，使用 85mm 或更长焦镜头拍摄，平视视角，中深景深。人物与建筑均清晰锐利，具有真实的透视效果。强调雨后氛围、湿润的木质纹理、玻璃幕墙的倒影、天空的层次感、服装的拖尾以及地面的反射。照片级真实感，真实的皮肤纹理，带有轻微的胶片颗粒感。

避免：卡通、CG 感、皮肤过度磨皮、温暖的日落、杂乱的人群、夸张的姿势、彩色服装、肢体畸形、建筑畸变、文字、水印或 Logo。

en.title: Summer Fashion with Strawberry Popsicle
en.description: A vibrant summer fashion portrait prompt of a woman holding an ice cream popsicle in a sunny flower field under a blue sky.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="title" default="A Bite in the Flower Field"}

Main Subject:
A full-body fashion portrait of a {argument name="age" default="20-something woman"} leaning forward slightly left of center, holding a {argument name="item" default="pink popsicle"} in a small flower field under a blue sky. The person occupies about 70% of the screen, with wide empty sky remaining on the right and top.

Character & Expression:
Natural female impression. Glossy black hair reaching to the waist, with bangs and thin strands around the face lightly touching the cheeks. Transparent natural makeup, thin eyeliner, pale coral blush, and natural glossy lips. Turning her face to the right while returning her gaze to the camera with a slightly relaxed, playful expression. A neat and healthy adult model physique.

Clothing & Pose:
A halter neck top in a light knit material with a textured feel, mixing pink and pale orange. Faded light blue denim shorts, white rib socks, white low-top sneakers, small silver earrings, and a thin necklace. Leaning the upper body forward, naturally bending at the waist and knees. Holding the popsicle stick with her right hand, bringing it near her mouth. The left arm extends downward, resting her left hand lightly near her left knee. Weight is shifted to one leg, expressing natural gravity in the clothing wrinkles and hair fall.

Background & Light:
In the foreground, pink and white cosmos flowers are heavily blurred; mid-ground shows green grassland and small flowers; background features a low, blurred cityscape. About two-thirds of the background is occupied by a bright blue sky and large white cumulus clouds. Soft daylight shines from the upper right, brightly illuminating the right side of the face, shoulders, arms, and legs. Subtle shadows remain on the left, with slight green reflected light from the grass and flowers on the lower legs.

Composition & Camera:
3:4 vertical orientation. A slight low-angle shot from a position close to the ground. A wide-angle feel equivalent to 24-28mm captures everything from feet to sky. The head is at the top center, feet near the bottom edge, with the body's diagonal line flowing from bottom left to top right. Focus is on the subject's eyes and the popsicle, with foreground flowers and distant buildings softly blurred.

Texture & Style:
Bright and clean summer fashion photography. Leaves natural skin texture, avoiding excessive retouching. Faint film grain, slightly blown-out highlights, and transparent blue and pink tones. A light and realistic finish, somewhere between a magazine snap and a compact digital camera photo.

Negative:
Looking underage, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, joint failure, poor contact with ice cream, unnatural gravity, extreme body deformation, exposed underwear, shadows inconsistent with light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

zh.title: 草莓冰棒与夏日时尚
zh.description: 一组充满活力的夏日时尚肖像提示词，描绘了一位女性在蓝天下的花海中手持冰棒的场景。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="title" default="花田中的一口清凉"}

主要主体：
一张全身时尚肖像，主角为一位 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁的女性"}，身体略微前倾，位于画面中心偏左位置，在蓝天下的花田中手持一支 {argument name="item" default="粉色冰棒"}。人物占据约 70% 的画面，右侧和顶部留有大面积的空白天空。

人物与表情：
自然的女性印象。乌黑亮丽的长发垂至腰间，留有刘海，脸颊两侧有几缕发丝轻触。清透的自然妆容，细眼线，淡珊瑚色腮红，以及自然水润的唇妆。脸部转向右侧，同时回眸看向镜头，表情轻松俏皮。身材匀称且健康的成年模特体态。

服装与姿势：
穿着一件粉色与淡橙色混织的轻薄针织挂脖上衣，质感丰富。搭配水洗浅蓝色牛仔短裤、白色罗纹袜和白色低帮运动鞋，佩戴小巧的银色耳环和细项链。上身前倾，腰部和膝盖自然弯曲。右手拿着冰棒棍，将其靠近嘴边。左臂自然下垂，左手轻放在左膝附近。重心偏向一侧，衣物褶皱和发丝垂落处呈现出自然的重力感。

背景与光影：
前景为大面积虚化的粉色和白色波斯菊；中景为绿草地和小花；背景为虚化的低矮城市景观。背景的三分之二被明亮的蓝天和巨大的白色积云占据。柔和的日光从右上角照射，明亮地照亮了脸部右侧、肩膀、手臂和腿部。左侧保留细微阴影，小腿处带有来自草地和花朵的淡淡绿色反射光。

构图与摄影：
3:4 竖构图。采用接近地面的低角度拍摄。24-28mm 等效焦距的广角感，将从脚部到天空的画面尽收眼底。头部位于顶部中心，脚部靠近底部边缘，身体呈现出从左下到右上的对角线流动感。焦点对准主体的眼睛和冰棒，前景花朵和远方建筑呈现柔和的虚化效果。

质感与风格：
明亮清新的夏日时尚摄影。保留自然的皮肤纹理，避免过度修图。带有淡淡的胶片颗粒感，高光处略微过曝，呈现通透的蓝粉色调。整体风格轻盈写实，介于杂志快照与便携式数码相机拍摄的照片之间。

负面提示词：
看起来未成年、面部不自然、眼神不自然、多指、缺指、肢体融合、关节畸形、与冰淇淋接触不良、重力感不自然、身体极度变形、露出内衣、阴影与光源不一致、乱码、Logo、水印、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤。

en.title: Luxury Hotel Bathroom Mirror Selfie
en.description: Generates a realistic mirror selfie of a woman in a luxury hotel bathroom, featuring details like wet hair, plush towels, and marble surfaces.
en.prompt:
Subject: Post-Bath Mirror Time

Main Subject: 3:4 portrait. In front of a large mirror in a {argument name="location" default="luxurious bathroom"}, a woman is taking a selfie with a smartphone. The person stands slightly to the right of the center, captured from the top of the head to the lower thighs, occupying about 75% of the frame.

Person/Expression: A natural, realistic woman. Bright, smooth skin with fine water droplets and a natural post-bath flush. Dark brown hair tied in a messy high bun, with thin see-through bangs and a few strands of wet hair trailing along the cheeks. Pale pink-beige eye makeup, fine lashes, soft eyebrows, and transparent rose lips. Head tilted slightly, gaze quietly directed at the smartphone screen, with a calm expression and lips slightly pursed.

Clothing/Pose: {argument name="outfit" default="A design with a thick white pile bath towel wrapped tightly around the body from the chest"}. Features small light pink frills on the chest, front overlap, and short hem, with subtle floral embroidery and ribbons. Length goes to the upper thigh, with a natural wrap where the front overlap is diagonal. Holding a dark blue smartphone vertically with the left hand raised, fingers naturally following the side of the device. The opposite arm crosses under the chest, supporting the elbow of the raised arm from below. Hips slightly shifted to one side, standing naturally with legs together. The overlap, tension, and folds of the towel follow the body's movements.

Background/Lighting: A modern bathroom reminiscent of a high-end hotel. Features a large mirror with a thin gold frame, dark brown marble walls, a white sink, folded towels, and on the left, a transparent glass shower booth and a round magnifying mirror. Soft warm lighting from the front ceiling creates smooth highlights on the forehead, cheeks, shoulders, collarbones, and arms. Weak cool reflected light from the left side naturally separates the subject's silhouette from the background. Shadows fall lightly downwards and to the right, leaving subtle reflections on the marble and mirror.

Composition/Camera: 3:4 portrait, mirror shot from slightly below eye level. The subject's face is in the top center, and the smartphone is toward the upper left. Narrow margin above the head, bathroom fixtures visible on the sides, and a natural crop at the mid-thigh at the bottom. Natural perspective similar to a standard lens. Precise focus on the face and upper body, with the background gently blurred to show silhouettes.

Texture/Style: Realistic photographic expression. Precisely depicts the clumping of damp hair, fine water droplets on the skin, soft pile of the towel, thinness of the frills, and three-dimensional embroidery thread. Avoids excessive skin retouching, leaving natural skin texture and a subtle glow. An elegant hotel photo finish harmonizing warm tones with dark brown, white, pale pink, and gold.

Negative: Person appearing underage, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, broken joints, deformed smartphone, mirror image contradictions, floating towel, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 豪华酒店浴室镜前自拍
zh.description: 生成一张女性在豪华酒店浴室镜前的写实自拍，包含湿发、毛绒浴巾和大理石表面等细节。
zh.prompt:
主题：沐浴后的镜前时光

主体：3:4 比例人像。在 {argument name="location" default="豪华浴室"} 的大镜子前，一位女性正拿着智能手机自拍。人物位于画面中心偏右，取景范围从头顶到大腿下部，占据约 75% 的画面。

人物/表情：自然写实的女性形象。明亮光滑的皮肤上带有细小的水珠，呈现出沐浴后自然的红润感。深棕色头发扎成凌乱的高丸子头，留着稀疏的空气刘海，几缕湿发垂在脸颊旁。淡粉米色眼妆，睫毛纤长，眉形柔和，嘴唇呈透明的玫瑰色。头部微微倾斜，目光安静地注视着手机屏幕，神情平静，双唇微抿。

服装/姿势：{argument name="outfit" default="一件厚实的白色毛圈浴巾，从胸部紧紧包裹住身体"}。胸前带有淡粉色小花边，前襟重叠，下摆较短，饰有精致的花卉刺绣和丝带。长度及大腿上部，前襟呈对角线自然重叠。左手举起一部深蓝色智能手机，手指自然地贴合在设备侧面。另一只手臂交叉在胸下，从下方支撑着举起手臂的肘部。臀部微微侧移，双腿并拢，站姿自然。浴巾的重叠处、张力和褶皱随着身体动作自然呈现。

背景/光影：充满现代感的酒店式浴室。配有一面带有细金框的大镜子、深棕色大理石墙面、白色洗手池、折叠好的毛巾，左侧设有一个透明玻璃淋浴间和一面圆形放大镜。来自前上方天花板的柔和暖光，在额头、脸颊、肩膀、锁骨和手臂上营造出平滑的高光。左侧微弱的冷色反射光自然地将人物轮廓与背景区分开来。阴影轻微地投向右下方，在大理石和镜面上留下微妙的倒影。

构图/摄影：3:4 人像，从略低于视平线的位置拍摄的镜面反射。人物面部位于顶部中心，智能手机位于左上方。头顶留白较少，两侧可见浴室设施，底部在大腿中部自然裁剪。视角类似于标准镜头。焦点精准对准面部和上半身，背景轻微虚化以显现轮廓。

质感/风格：写实摄影风格。精准描绘了湿发的束感、皮肤上的细小水珠、浴巾的柔软毛圈、花边的轻薄感以及立体刺绣的纹理。避免过度磨皮，保留自然的皮肤质感和微妙的光泽。整体呈现出优雅的酒店照片质感，和谐地融合了暖色调与深棕色、白色、淡粉色及金色。

负面提示词：未成年人、不自然的脸部、不自然的视线、多指、缺指、手指粘连、关节断裂、变形的智能手机、镜像矛盾、漂浮的浴巾、不符合重力、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、乱码、Logo、水印。

en.title: Playful Interior Selfie Portrait
en.description: A prompt focused on capturing a playful facial expression in a close-up selfie, with emphasis on skin texture, delicate clothing lace, and soft interior lighting.
en.prompt:
Subject: Fingertip Mischief

Main Subject: 3:4 vertical indoor selfie. A single woman in her 20s, positioned large in the center-left, showing from the top of the head to the chest. The face and upper body occupy about 75% of the frame, with a raised hand in the upper right and the flow of hair and shoulders in the lower left.

Person/Expression: Bright ivory-beige fair skin with a very pale pink flush. Natural highlights on the cheeks, nose, shoulders, and collarbones, with a smooth texture that preserves skin grain. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long thin lashes, natural tear bags, and soft light brown eyebrows. Transparent pink-beige gloss lips. A small, clear catchlight in the eyes. Head tilted slightly to the left, looking straight at the camera. Lips slightly open, with a {argument name="expression" default="playful yet elegant look, with just the tip of the tongue peeking out from the center of the lower lip"}.

Clothing/Pose: {argument name="outfit" default="A camisole layered with white dot tulle and fine lace"}. Delicate frills on the shoulder straps and chest, with a small satin ribbon in the center. A small silver flower motif pendant at the neck. The subject's right arm is raised to the side of the head, with the index finger extended horizontally toward the hairline. Other fingers are naturally curled, with no extra tension in the shoulders or arms.

Background/Lighting: A quiet indoor background consisting only of a beige wall and a diagonal dark gray band. The background is slightly blurred, with no everyday objects or text. Soft warm lighting enters from the upper left, creating thin highlights on the hair surface, forehead, bridge of the nose, cheeks, collarbones, and shoulders. Shadows from the hand and arm fall naturally to the lower right, with faint reflected light on the chest.

Composition/Camera: Close-up selfie taken with a smartphone held slightly higher than the face. Slight high-angle, natural perspective equivalent to 35-45mm. Focus on both eyes and lips, with the hair ends and background gently blurred. Narrow margin at the top, and a small amount of margin outside the right hand, with the face, fingertips, and pendant arranged in a triangle.

Texture/Style: Bright milk-tea ash brown medium-long hair. Thin see-through bangs, layers along the face, and ends curled slightly inward. Delicate depiction of individual hair strands, fine highlights, soft shine, and a few stray hairs. Elegant Japanese beauty selfie photography. Maintains a moderate sharpness and natural smartphone photography feel, avoiding excessive blurring or artificial skin retouching.

Negative: Unnatural face, tongue deformation, tooth collapse, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, broken wrists or joints, hair and finger fusion, distorted accessories, shadows inconsistent with light source, plastic-like skin, excessive skin retouching, text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 俏皮室内自拍肖像
zh.description: 一个专注于捕捉近距离自拍中俏皮面部表情的提示词，强调皮肤纹理、精致的蕾丝衣物以及柔和的室内光线。
zh.prompt:
主题：指尖的恶作剧

主要主体：3:4 竖构图室内自拍。一位 20 多岁的女性，位于画面中左侧，占据较大比例，展示从头顶到胸部的范围。面部和上半身占据画面的 75% 左右，右手抬起位于右上角，头发和肩膀的线条延伸至左下角。

人物/表情：明亮的象牙米色白皙皮肤，带有淡淡的粉色红晕。脸颊、鼻梁、肩膀和锁骨处有自然的高光，皮肤纹理细腻，保留了真实的肤质感。淡玫瑰粉色腮红，香槟米色和粉棕色眼影，长而纤细的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和的浅棕色眉毛。透明的粉米色亮面唇妆。双眼中带有清晰的小巧眼神光。头部微微向左倾斜，直视镜头。双唇微张，带有 {argument name="expression" default="俏皮而优雅的神情，下唇中央微微露出一点舌尖"}。

服装/姿势：{argument name="outfit" default="叠穿白色波点薄纱和精致蕾丝的吊带衫"}。肩带和胸前有精致的褶边，中心饰有一条小巧的缎带蝴蝶结。颈部佩戴一枚小巧的银色花朵图案吊坠。主体右手抬起至头部侧面，食指水平指向发际线方向。其余手指自然弯曲，肩膀和手臂没有多余的紧张感。

背景/光线：安静的室内背景，仅由米色墙壁和一条对角线的深灰色带组成。背景轻微虚化，没有日常杂物或文字。柔和的暖光从左上方射入，在发丝表面、额头、鼻梁、脸颊、锁骨和肩膀上形成细微的高光。手部和手臂的阴影自然地投射在右下方，胸前有淡淡的反射光。

构图/相机：使用略高于面部的智能手机拍摄的近距离自拍。轻微的高角度，相当于 35-45mm 的自然视角。焦点对准双眼和嘴唇，发梢和背景轻微虚化。顶部留白较少，右手外侧留有少量空间，面部、指尖和吊坠呈三角形排列。

纹理/风格：明亮的奶茶灰棕色中长发。轻薄的空气刘海，脸颊两侧有层次感，发梢微微内扣。细腻地描绘了单根发丝、细微的高光、柔和的光泽以及几缕碎发。优雅的日系美颜自拍风格。保持适度的清晰度和自然的手机摄影感，避免过度虚化或人工磨皮。

负面提示词：面部不自然、舌头变形、牙齿崩坏、眼神不自然、多指、缺指、手指粘连、手腕或关节断裂、头发与手指融合、配饰扭曲、阴影与光源不一致、塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: High-Angle Leather Chair Portrait
en.description: Captures a sophisticated fashion portrait from a high angle, featuring a woman sitting in a black leather chair with dramatic natural lighting.
en.prompt:
Subject: A Gaze Piercing Through Light

Main Subject: 3:4 portrait. A photo taken from above of a woman sitting on a {argument name="chair" default="black leather chair"} in a bright room. The subject is positioned large in the center, captured from the top of the head to near the thighs. The upper body is slightly leaned forward, with the face and gaze directed toward the camera at the top of the frame.

Person/Expression: An adult woman with calm allure and a strong core. Bright ivory-beige natural skin with subtle flush and highlights on the cheeks and nose. Brown eyes looking straight at the lens from below, with eyelids slightly narrowed in a quiet, heated expression. Lips slightly open with a transparent rose-beige gloss. Delicate lashes, natural tear bags, and soft brown eyebrows.

Clothing/Pose: {argument name="outfit" default="A bustier-style top combining black lace and matte leather"}. A sophisticated design featuring thin straps, small metal rings on the shoulders, and decorative hardware in the center of the chest. Bottoms are black woven high-waisted shorts with a slim belt. Shoulders dropped naturally, arms extended in front of the body and lowered between the knees. Upper body leaning forward naturally without over-arching the back.

Background/Lighting: A quiet modern room based on white and greige. A black window frame in the back left, and a small wooden shelf with blurred bottles in the upper right. Strong warm natural light shines diagonally from the upper-left window, creating thin highlights on the light-receiving surfaces of the hair, shoulders, and arms. Soft shadows remain on the opposite side, projecting geometric light and shadow on the wall.

Composition/Camera: 3:4 portrait, relatively strong high-angle. The camera is higher than the subject's eye level, with the face in the upper center of the frame. Small margin near the top of the head, with the curves of the chair framing the subject on the sides. Precise focus on the face and eyes, with the background gently blurred by a shallow depth of field. 50mm equivalent, close-up fashion portrait.

Texture/Style: Realistic fashion editorial photography. Hair is bright milk-tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, layers along the face, and medium-long hair reaching below the shoulders. Ends curled slightly inward, with careful depiction of individual hair strands, fine highlights, soft shine, natural clumping, and a few stray hairs. Natural skin preserving texture, moderate contrast, and precise textures of lace and leather.

Negative: Young impression, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, asymmetrical eyes, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, unnatural forward lean, clothing clipping issues, deformed hardware, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 高角度皮椅人像
zh.description: 捕捉一张从高角度拍摄的精致时尚人像，展现一位坐在黑色皮椅上的女性，配以戏剧性的自然光影。
zh.prompt:
主题：穿透光影的凝视

主体：3:4 人像。一张从上方拍摄的照片，展现一位坐在 {argument name="chair" default="黑色皮椅"} 上的女性，背景为明亮的房间。主体位于画面中心，取景范围从头顶到大腿附近。上半身微微前倾，面部和视线朝向画面上方的镜头。

人物/表情：一位散发着冷静魅力且内心强大的成年女性。明亮的象牙米色自然肤色，脸颊和鼻尖带有微妙的红晕与高光。棕色双眼从下方直视镜头，眼睑微眯，流露出一种安静而热烈的神情。双唇微张，涂有透明的玫瑰米色唇彩。睫毛纤细，卧蚕自然，眉毛呈柔和的棕色。

服装/姿势：{argument name="outfit" default="结合黑色蕾丝与哑光皮革的胸衣式上衣"}。设计精致，配有细肩带、肩部小金属环以及胸前装饰性五金件。下装为黑色编织高腰短裤，系有细腰带。双肩自然下垂，双臂伸向身体前方并垂于膝盖之间。上半身自然前倾，背部不过度挺直。

背景/光影：以白色和灰褐色为主调的安静现代房间。左后方有黑色窗框，右上角有一个摆放着模糊瓶子的小木架。强烈的暖色自然光从左上方的窗户斜射进来，在头发、肩膀和手臂的受光面上形成细长的高光。对侧保留柔和的阴影，在墙面上投射出几何形状的光影。

构图/相机：3:4 人像，相对强烈的高角度。相机位置高于主体的视线水平，面部位于画面上方中心。头顶留有少量空间，椅子的曲线在两侧环绕主体。焦点精准对准面部和眼睛，背景通过浅景深进行柔和虚化。50mm 等效焦距，特写时尚人像。

质感/风格：写实的时尚编辑摄影。发色为明亮的奶茶灰棕色。薄透的空气刘海，脸部周围有层次感，中长发垂至肩下。发梢微微内扣，细致刻画了单根发丝、细腻高光、柔和光泽、自然的束感以及少量碎发。保留皮肤质感的自然肤色，中等对比度，蕾丝与皮革的纹理清晰可见。

负面提示词：幼态感、不自然的面部、不自然的视线、不对称的眼睛、过度修图、塑料感皮肤、多指、缺指、肢体融合、关节断裂、不自然的前倾、服装穿模、五金变形、透视错误、光影不一致、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Sunny Beach Portrait of a Smiling Woman
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a photorealistic portrait of a young woman at the beach, focusing on natural textures, summer lighting, and a friendly expression.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Smile at the water's edge"}

Main Character:
{argument name="main character" default="A vertical portrait of a woman in her 20s standing on a sunny beach, captured from the top of her head to her upper thighs"}. The person is placed large in the center of the frame, with her upper body occupying about two-thirds of the screen. Set against a background of clear blue sea, white waves, and a bright sandy beach, she is turning a friendly smile toward the camera.

Person/Expression:
Bright ivory-beige fair skin with a subtle pink natural flush. Delicate highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones, with a realistic skin texture that leaves slight pores and texture. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long slender eyelashes, natural tear bags, soft brown eyebrows, and sheer pink-beige gloss lips. Small, clear catchlights in the eyes. A bright and healthy smile with the mouth naturally open, looking directly at the camera.

Clothing/Pose:
An ivory-white halter-neck bikini without decorations. The top has modest gathers and thin shoulder straps, while the bottoms have side ribbon ties at both hips. The person places her own right hand near her ear, lightly adjusting her hair with her fingertips. Her left arm is naturally down by her side, and her upper body is slightly tilted forward. A natural standing posture with relaxed shoulders and a light twist in the hips. Wet stray hairs follow her cheeks and neck.

Background/Light:
The foreground is a pale sandy beach reflecting sunlight. In the middle ground, white waves wash up diagonally, and in the background, a turquoise blue to light blue sea surface stretches out. Warm summer sunlight enters from the top left of the screen, brightly illuminating the face, shoulders, collarbones, and upper surfaces of the arms. Soft shadows are cast under the chin, chest, and inside the arms, with a pale blue reflection from the sea surface added thin to the shadow side of the skin.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 9:16. A light high-angle shot looking down from a slightly high position. The person's face is in the upper center, the torso in the center, and the thighs at the bottom. Very little head space, with soft margins for the sea and sand on the sides. Natural perspective equivalent to 35-50mm. Focus accurately on the eyes and face, softly blurring the waves and sea surface in the background. A bright and open beach portrait.

Texture/Style:
A live-action photograph. Meticulously describes natural fine skin texture, moisture-laden hair clumps, fine vellus hair, and thin wrinkles in the fabric. Avoids excessive skin beautification, maintaining a bright high-key tone while suppressing overexposure. Transparent summer colors, soft contrast, and photo-book quality with a sense of cleanliness.

Negative:
Young-looking face, unnatural smile, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, confusion of left and right hands, broken joints, unnatural body shape, clothing digging in, poor fabric connection, floating strings, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, plastic-like skin, excessive skin correction, text, logo, watermark.

zh.title: 阳光海滩夏季人像
zh.description: 一个明亮、高调的夏季人像提示词，以海滩上的女性为主题，强调阳光亲吻过的肌肤、清澈的绿松石色海水以及愉悦的表情。
zh.prompt:
主题：水边的微笑

主要对象：一位 20 多岁女性的竖构图人像，站在阳光明媚的海滩上，拍摄范围从头顶到大腿上部。主体位于画面中央，上半身占据约三分之二的构图。背景是透明的蓝色大海、白色浪花和明亮的沙滩，她正对着镜头露出友好的微笑。

人物/表情：明亮的象牙米色白皙皮肤，带有淡淡的自然粉色红晕。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀和锁骨处有精致的高光，真实的皮肤纹理略微显露出毛孔和颗粒感。淡玫瑰粉色腮红，香槟米色和粉棕色眼妆，长而细的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和的棕色眉毛，以及透明的粉米色亮面唇妆。眼睛里有清晰的小光点。明亮、健康的笑容，嘴巴自然微张，直视镜头。

服装/姿势：{argument name="swimwear" default="纯象牙白色挂脖比基尼"}。上衣有细微的褶皱和细肩带，下装两侧系有丝带。主体右手放在耳边，指尖轻轻整理头发。左臂自然下垂，上半身略微前倾。肩膀放松，站姿自然，腰部有轻微的扭转。湿润的碎发沿着脸颊和脖子垂下。

背景/光影：前景是反射着阳光的浅色沙滩。中景处白色浪花斜向涌入，背景是 {argument name="sea color" default="从绿松石蓝过渡到浅蓝色的海面"}。温暖的夏季阳光从左上方射入，明亮地照亮了脸部、肩膀、锁骨和上臂。下巴下方、胸部和手臂内侧投下柔和的阴影，皮肤阴影一侧增加了来自大海的淡淡浅蓝色反射光。

构图/相机：竖构图 9:16。从略高的位置进行轻微的高角度拍摄。脸部位于顶部中央，躯干在中心，大腿在底部。头顶留白极少，两侧的海滩留有柔和的余白。相当于 35-50mm 的自然透视。焦点精确对准眼睛和脸部，背景的海浪和大海呈现柔和的虚化效果。一张明亮、开阔的海滩人像。

质感/风格：实拍照片。细腻地描绘了自然皮肤的纹理、湿润头发的聚拢感、细小的汗毛以及织物上的细微褶皱。避免过度磨皮，在保持明亮高调色调的同时抑制高光过曝。通透的夏季色彩，柔和的对比度，具有写真集级别的洁净感。

负面提示词：脸部显得幼态、不自然的微笑、不自然的视线、多指、缺指、手指粘连、左右手混淆、关节断裂、不自然的身体形状、服装穿模、织物连接处处理不当、漂浮的线头、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Anime Character Sheet Reference Prompt
en.description: A complex, structural prompt for generating a multi-angle character sheet (front, side, back) in high-quality theatrical anime style, specifically designed to maintain character consistency from a reference image.
en.prompt:
Reference Use:
One full-body reference image attached to this instruction. Supports both real photos and illustrations.

Text Content:
Using the attached reference image as the sole subject reference, create a simplified character sheet in 1:1 square format for both social sharing and video reference. The sheet should be visually appealing as a standalone image, allowing for the verification of the subject's face, hair, age, body type, uniform, and color scheme. Maintain the subject as the same person across all views without adding different individuals. Do not create a storyboard.

[Reference Image Application Scope]
If the reference is a real photo, convert it into a high-quality theatrical anime style while maintaining the subject's features. If the reference is an illustration, finish it in a high-quality theatrical anime style. Inherit facial features, eye shape, contours, bangs, hairstyle, hair color, perceived age, skin texture, body type, head-to-body ratio, and overall proportions. Maintain the hair state (tied/loose), tie position, parting, length, and hair tufts around the face exactly as in the reference. Do not inherit the costume, shoes, accessories, or background from the reference image. Completely change the attire to the uniform specified in this instruction.

[Body Type Consistency]
Maintain the reference image's proportions, head size, neck length, shoulder width, torso length, waist position/width, arm/leg length, knee position, and overall silhouette. Limit the anime conversion to line, color, shading, and texture; do not redesign the skeletal structure or body dimensions. Do not perform facial slimming, leg lengthening, or any anatomical exaggerations.
Maintain consistent body volume across 01 FRONT, 02 SIDE, 03 BACK, and 04 SPECIAL LOOK. Use standard, natural perspective and eye-level height. Avoid wide-angle distortion or extreme camera angles.

[Expression]
High-quality theatrical anime style. Clean and polished finish. Avoid cheap TV anime styles, generic NPC looks, or simple photo filters.

[Specified Outfit]
Regardless of the reference outfit, change to {argument name="uniform" default="a navy blazer, white shirt, thin red ribbon, and grey pleated skirt"} with dark knee-high socks and {argument name="shoes" default="white-based sneakers"}.

[Fixed Layout]
Two-tier structure: Top 58%, Bottom 42%. Background is plain white to very light grey. Provide sufficient margins.

Top Tier (58%):
01 FRONT (22%): Full-body front view.
02 SIDE (22%): Accurate 90-degree side view.
03 BACK (22%): Full-body back view.
04 SPECIAL LOOK (34%): Larger 3/4 view with a natural, charming pose.

Bottom Tier (42%):
05 FACE (62%): Three facial views (Front, 3/4, Side) at the same size and camera distance.
06 DESIGN GUIDE (38%): Color palette and detail focus (shirt collar/ribbon, bangs, sneakers).

[Headings]
Use only short English headings: 01 FRONT, 02 SIDE, 03 BACK, 04 SPECIAL LOOK, 05 FACE, 06 DESIGN GUIDE, COLOR PALETTE, DETAIL FOCUS.

zh.title: 动漫角色设定图生成器
zh.description: 一个用于根据参考图创建标准化 2D 动漫角色设定图的综合提示词，包含正面、侧面、背面视图及设计指南。
zh.prompt:
参考使用：{argument name="reference image" default="随此说明书附带一张全身参考图"}。适用于真人或角色插画。

文本：使用随附的全身参考图作为唯一的角色参考，创建一个简单的 1:1 正方形角色设定图，用于分享和视频参考。确保设定图固定角色的脸部、发型、年龄、体型、制服和配色方案，同时保持可作为独立图像发布的视觉效果。不要包含不同的人；确保所有角色展示均为参考图中的同一人。不要创建分镜脚本。

[参考图应用范围]
对于真人参考，请转换为高质量的剧场版动漫风格，同时保留参考人物的特征。对于动漫或插画参考，请以高质量的剧场版动漫风格完成，同时保持角色特征。从参考图中继承面部特征、眼睛、轮廓、刘海、发型、发色、年龄、皮肤印象、体型、头身比和整体比例。保持头发扎起/放下、分发位置、分界线、头发长度以及脸部周围发丝的状态与参考图完全一致。不要继承参考图中的服装、鞋子、配饰、小物件、服装配色方案、背景或姿势。不要在最终图像中保留参考服装的形状、材质、装饰或鞋子；请完全更换为本说明中的制服。

请使用一张从头顶到脚尖可见且大部分身体未被遮挡的全身图像。

[体型一致性]
保持参考图的头身比、头部大小、颈部长度、肩宽、胸部、躯干长度、腰部位置和宽度、手臂和腿部长度、膝盖位置、大腿与小腿比例、身体纤细度和体积以及整体轮廓。动漫化转换仅限于线条、颜色、阴影和纹理；不要重新设计骨架、身体尺寸或身体比例。不要缩小脸部、拉长腿部、缩短躯干、改变肩宽或腰部位置、强调腰部、夸大胸部或臀部、使身体变瘦、幼态化身体或更改为其他模特体型。
在 01 FRONT、02 SIDE、03 BACK 和 04 SPECIAL LOOK 中保持相同的头身比、骨架、身体比例和身体体积。使用标准的自然透视和相同的视平线绘制全身展示。不要使用广角透视、强烈的透视夸张、极端的俯视或仰视镜头。

[表情]
高质量剧场版动漫风格。明亮、整洁、有序，具有精致的质感，即使作为独立图像也能传达角色的魅力。不要使用廉价的电视动画风格、量产的 NPC 风格、游戏立绘风格、3D CG 风格，或仅对真人照片应用简单滤镜的表达方式。

[指定服装]
无论参考图中的服装如何，请更换为 {argument name="uniform style" default="海军蓝西装外套、白色衬衫、红色细丝带、灰色百褶裙、深色及膝袜和白色运动鞋"}。
在四个全身展示（01-04）中保持相同的制服、配色方案、长度和鞋子。04 SPECIAL LOOK 也不应更换服装；它应该是穿着相同制服的 3/4 侧视图。05 FACE 中可见的西装外套、白色衬衫和红色丝带也必须与全身展示具有相同的设计和配色方案。不要因服装而改变主体的体型或比例。不要包含校徽、品牌标志、过多的花边或偶像风格的装饰。

[固定布局]
整体为两层结构：顶部 58%，底部 42%。背景为纯白至极浅灰色。预留足够的边距，以确保角色和元素不会重叠。不要更改基本的分层结构、位置、顺序或比例。

[顶层：约 58%]
将顶层分为 4 个水平部分，比例为：
01 FRONT：22%
02 SIDE：22%
03 BACK：22%
04 SPECIAL LOOK：34%
01-03 必须是包含从头到脚的全身展示。01 为全身正面视图，02 为精确的 90 度侧视图，03 为全身背面视图。01-03 必须具有相同的高度、比例、体型、服装、拍摄距离和视平线。使用自然的直立姿势，双臂下垂于身体两侧，不要遮挡身体或制服。
04 为较大的 3/4 侧视图。穿着相同的制服，使用自然的表情和带有轻微动作的静态姿势，以传达魅力。不要使用跑步、跳跃或战斗等动作镜头。仅在 04 的背景后，可以放置简单的、精致的纯色或从制服配色方案中选择的微妙几何色块。不要包含风景、建筑物、室内、道路、故事场景或时间推移。

[底层：约 42%]
将底层分为 05 FACE（左侧 62%）和 06 DESIGN GUIDE（右侧 38%）。

[05 FACE]
将三个面部视图（正面、3/4 侧面、侧面）水平排列，大小相同。对齐相同的拍摄距离、脸部大小和头部位置。使用自然的常态表情，以便于检查特征、眼睛、轮廓、刘海、发型、发色和年龄。这不是为了展示表情差异，而是为了从三个方向检查相同的脸部和发型。

[06 DESIGN GUIDE]
分为 COLOR PALETTE（顶部 40%）和 DETAIL FOCUS（底部 60%）。
COLOR PALETTE：根据参考图和指定的制服，将 5 种主要颜色（头发、皮肤、海军蓝西装外套、红色丝带、灰色裙子）排列为整洁的色块。不要将参考服装的颜色带入调色板。白色衬衫和白色运动鞋显示在 DETAIL FOCUS 中。
DETAIL FOCUS：由 3 个相等的部分组成：
左：白色衬衫领口和红色丝带
中：刘海和发际线
右：白色运动鞋
全部基于指定的制服和角色设计；不要复刻参考图中的服装、鞋子或配饰。

[标题]
仅使用以下简短的英文标题：
01 FRONT, 02 SIDE, 03 BACK, 04 SPECIAL LOOK, 05 FACE, 06 DESIGN GUIDE, COLOR PALETTE, DETAIL FOCUS。将每个标题放置在其区域的左上角，使用统一的小字体和字号。不要与脸部、头发、身体或服装重叠。标题和细分割线可以微妙地使用与红色丝带相匹配的强调色。

[禁止事项]
除指定的 4 个全身视图、3 个面部视图和 3 个细节聚焦视图外，不要添加其他角色展示。不要在最终图像中保留参考服装/颜色。不要在不同展示中更改特征。不要添加背景、场景或事件。不要使用粗边框、过多的装饰、冗长的描述、对话、字幕、标志或水印。

en.title: Black and White Rough Storyboard Style
en.description: A technical prompt for generating minimalist, black and white hand-drawn storyboards with rough sketch lines, optimized for animation planning and movement logic.
en.prompt: Draw all {argument name="drawing style" default="storyboards"} in {argument name="color" default="black and white"}, using a hand-drawn feel like {argument name="texture" default="rough sketches or under-drawings"}. Use minimal lines that only depict the character's pose, movement, and basic background information. No color allowed.

zh.title: 黑白粗略项目风格
zh.description: 一个用于生成极简主义、黑白手绘项目（storyboards）的技术提示词，具有粗略的草图线条，专为动画规划和运动逻辑优化。
zh.prompt: 以 {argument name="color" default="黑白"} 风格绘制所有 {argument name="drawing style" default="项目（storyboards）"}，并采用类似 {argument name="texture" default="粗略草图或底稿"} 的手绘质感。仅使用极简线条来描绘角色的姿势、动作和基本背景信息。禁止使用任何颜色。

en.title: Photorealistic East Asian Woman by Waterfall
en.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for a photorealistic portrait of an East Asian woman sitting on a wooden fence against a misty waterfall background, emphasizing natural skin textures and wet clothing details.
en.prompt:
A {argument name="subject" default="young adult East Asian woman"} sitting sideways on a wet dark brown wooden fence, in a three-quarter to near full-body composition. The person is located slightly to the left of the center, facing right, sitting naturally on the horizontal wooden rail with one leg bent forward and hanging down, and the other leg slightly crossed behind, in a relaxed and realistic posture. Her left hand is supported behind her on the wooden rail, and her right hand is raised to the side of her face, fingers gently playing with her wet hair. Her head is slightly lowered and turned to the bottom left, eyes half-closed or looking down, with a quiet, soft, and natural expression, not looking directly at the camera.

She has a slender and elongated figure with natural proportions. Her deep black long hair is completely wet, with strands sticking to her cheeks, neck, shoulders, and chest, some wet hair reaching her waist, with a small amount of random messy hair. Her features are delicate, with almond eyes, soft eyebrows, a slender nose bridge, and natural coral pink lips, with light makeup. Her skin is fair and neutral-toned, retaining real pores, fine fuzz, slight water droplets, moist highlights, and natural skin tone changes, prohibiting plastic-like smoothing.

She wears a {argument name="top color" default="white"} thin long-sleeved top with a wide round neck and sleeves pushed to the forearms. The fabric, once wet, shows slight skin adherence and a natural translucent texture but remains subtle without showing clear body details. The front of the top is knotted at the waist, revealing a natural waistline and a small amount of the abdomen. On her lower body, she wears {argument name="bottom style" default="light blue high-waisted denim shorts"}, which are fitted but not overly tight, retaining denim textures, stitching, pockets, belt loops, and slight wet marks.

The background is a wide artificial waterfall or rock wall water curtain, with gray water falling vertically, and the pond and tiered water flow behind are softly blurred. The wooden rail is soaked with water vapor and rain, with real reflections, wood grain, and dark water marks on the surface. The overall environment is damp, quiet, and slightly misty.

The lighting is overcast natural diffuse light, with low saturation, low contrast, soft skin tones, very shallow shadows, and no strong sunlight. The tones are dominated by cool gray, light blue, wet wood brown, and soft skin tones. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/2, shallow depth of field, clear subject, softened waterfall, high-end natural environment portrait, real optical imaging, slight film grain, photorealistic.

Avoid: cartoons, illustrations, CG feel, excessive skin smoothing, dry fluffy hair, incorrect fingers, deformed legs, floating poses, exaggerated figures, overly transparent clothing, strong HDR, over-sharpening, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 瀑布旁的写实风格东亚女性
zh.description: 这是一段关于东亚女性坐在木栅栏上、背景为朦胧瀑布的写实肖像的电影级提示词，重点呈现了自然的皮肤纹理和湿润的衣物细节。
zh.prompt:
一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻的东亚女性"} 侧身坐在潮湿的深褐色木栅栏上，构图为四分之三至近乎全身像。人物位于画面中心偏左，面向右侧，自然地坐在水平的木栏杆上，一条腿向前弯曲下垂，另一条腿在后方微微交叉，姿态放松且真实。她的左手撑在身后的木栏杆上，右手抬起至脸侧，手指轻轻拨弄着湿润的头发。她微微低头，视线转向左下方，双眼半闭或向下看，表情安静、柔和且自然，没有直视镜头。

她身材修长，比例自然。乌黑的长发完全湿透，发丝贴在脸颊、脖颈、肩膀和胸前，部分湿发垂至腰间，带有少量凌乱的发丝。她五官精致，拥有杏仁眼、柔和的眉毛、挺拔的鼻梁和自然的珊瑚粉色嘴唇，妆容清淡。她的皮肤白皙，色调中性，保留了真实的毛孔、细微的绒毛、轻微的水珠、湿润的高光以及自然的肤色变化，严禁出现塑料感的磨皮效果。

她身穿一件 {argument name="top color" default="白色"} 薄款长袖上衣，宽圆领设计，袖子推至前臂。衣物被打湿后呈现出轻微的贴肤感和自然的半透明质感，但依然含蓄，不会显露明显的身体细节。上衣前摆在腰间打结，露出自然的腰线和少许腹部。下身穿着 {argument name="bottom style" default="浅蓝色高腰牛仔短裤"}，剪裁合身但不紧绷，保留了牛仔布的纹理、缝线、口袋、腰带环以及轻微的湿痕。

背景是一处宽阔的人造瀑布或岩壁水帘，灰色的水流垂直落下，后方的水池和层叠的水流呈现出柔和的虚化效果。木栏杆被水汽和雨水浸透，表面带有真实的倒影、木纹和深色的水渍。整体环境潮湿、宁静，略带雾气。

光线为阴天下的自然漫射光，低饱和度，低对比度，肤色柔和，阴影极浅，没有强烈的阳光。色调以冷灰色、浅蓝色、湿木褐色和柔和的肤色为主。摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/2 光圈，浅景深，主体清晰，瀑布虚化，高端自然环境人像，真实光学成像，轻微胶片颗粒感，照片级真实感。

避免：卡通、插画、CG 感、过度磨皮、干枯蓬松的头发、手指错误、腿部变形、悬浮姿势、夸张的身材、过度透明的衣物、强烈的 HDR、过度锐化、文字、水印、Logo。

en.title: Sci-Fi Knight of the Order
en.description: A dark, atmospheric narrative prompt for GPT Image 2 describing a knight whose armor is composed of multiple burial shrouds from his past lives.
en.prompt: year {argument name="year" default="2226"}. the order still stands, 200 years after the consortium stopped funding it. this knight has died {argument name="death count" default="fourteen"} times. all {argument name="death count" default="fourteen"} times they copied his memory, printed a new body, and gave him back the same armor. each time he dies they sew a piece of the previous shroud onto his cape. what he drags along are {argument name="death count" default="fourteen"} shrouds sewn one on top of the other. on the sword, the {argument name="rune color" default="red"} runes are names. people he did not reach in time. the cathedral where he stands guard has been without a priest for eighty years.

zh.title: 未来不朽骑士叙事
zh.description: 一个高概念叙事提示词，描述了 2226 年的一位不朽骑士，其盔甲上装饰着历史裹尸布，并配有一把符文之剑。
zh.prompt:
{argument name="year" default="2226"} 年。

在财团停止资助 200 年后，这个组织依然屹立不倒。

这位 {argument name="protagonist" default="骑士"} 已经死过十四次了。

每一次，他们都会复制他的记忆，为他打印一具新的躯体，并将同样的盔甲交还给他。

每当他死去，他们就会将上一件裹尸布的一角缝在他的斗篷上。

他所拖曳的，是十四件层层缝合在一起的裹尸布。

在剑身上，那些 {argument name="sword details" default="红色符文"} 是一个个名字。

那是他没能及时拯救的人。

zh.title: 复古科幻医疗舱中的孕妇
zh.description: 一个用于生成复古未来主义医疗实验场景的竖屏电影感提示词，画面包含孕妇、CRT 显示器、线缆和模拟机械装置。
zh.prompt: 创作一张竖屏 3:4 比例的电影感复古未来主义科幻恐怖肖像：一位明显的孕妇 {argument name="character description" default="留着黑色短卷发、皮肤苍白、戴着黑色猫眼眼镜、涂着红唇、表情焦虑且神情恍惚的年轻女性"} 平躺在一个狭窄的金属医疗舱或实验室内，采用对称构图的俯视视角。她身穿一件光泽感十足的 {argument name="dress color" default="祖母绿"} 孕妇裙，腹部布料褶皱，外罩一件厚重的棕色粗花呢大衣，大衣向两侧敞开；颈部佩戴一条细项链，手腕上戴着一个厚重的金属手环或装置。她赤脚指向画面底部，双臂自然垂放在身体两侧，手指放松。周围环绕着密集的生物机械装置：两个大型倾斜的 CRT 显示器和一个位于顶部中央的小型 CRT 显示器，总共 3 个屏幕，每个屏幕显示着发光的绿色心跳或波形线条，并带有细小且无法辨认的诊断文字；粉色、紫色、红色和黑色的线缆交织在一起，填满了两侧墙壁；两侧靠近她手部的位置各有一个显眼的蓝色罗纹线圈圆柱体；添加金属导轨、铆钉、插座、管道、黄铜配件、裸露的电路和深色工业面板。灯光应为忧郁的洋红色和紫色，显示器的绿光投射在她的脸部和裙子上，高细节，绘画般的写实风格，1980 年代模拟科幻氛围，幽闭的实验室场景，强烈的对比度，清晰的中心焦点，丰富的纹理，画面中没有其他人，没有可辨认的品牌名称，没有水印。

en.title: Magenta Cyber Idol Poster
en.description: Generates a square cyberpunk editorial portrait poster of a young East Asian woman with headphones, glitch UI graphics, and pixel typography for album-cover or social media visuals.
en.prompt: Create a square cyber-fashion editorial poster featuring a young East Asian woman named {argument name="character name" default="Karina"} in a half-body close-up, centered slightly right, looking directly at the viewer with a calm, expressive gaze and a faint soft smile. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair, realistic delicate facial features, natural skin texture, glossy eyes, subtle pink makeup, and an elegant but youthful aura. She wears a black baseball cap with two small round pins on the front, pastel pink over-ear headphones around/over the cap, a gray fitted camisole top, a fluffy black knit cardigan falling off one shoulder, and a tiny silver star pendant necklace; her left hand lightly touches the headphone/hat brim. Use a monochrome magenta and violet cyberpunk palette with soft pink lighting, film grain, halftone dot textures, and a high-fashion K-pop album-cover feeling. The background is a layered digital collage with exactly three large ghosted duplicate portraits of the same woman: one on the upper left partly hidden behind vertical pixel bars, one on the upper right in sunglasses-like shadow, and one smaller portrait on the mid-right lower area. Add thin neon-pink rectangular circuit-line frames and UI connectors around the subject, with small pink glitch bars placed at several intersections. Include pixel/bitmap typography: a large name label reading {argument name="main name text" default="Karina"} in a translucent pink outlined box at the lower right of the face, a vertical left-side label reading “SOFT POWER // CODE : 0411”, a top-right caption reading “DIGITAL ELEGANCE IN MOTION”, a small boxed East Asian character “凛” on the right, a lower-left quote reading {argument name="quote" default="The presence that stays with you, long after the signal fades."}, a large code “[0411]” near the bottom left, a small barcode below it, tiny right-side words “Signal. Emotion. Identity.”, and bottom text reading “NOT JUST A MOMENT / A FREQUENCY.” Add a bottom HUD strip with diagonal warning stripes, a long pink progress bar, and a small checkerboard block in the bottom-right corner. Keep the composition dense but balanced, with crisp realistic portrait detail contrasted against pixelated background faces, no watermark, no extra limbs, no distorted facial features, and all text cleanly integrated as graphic design.

zh.title: 洋红色赛博偶像海报
zh.description: 生成一张正方形的赛博朋克风格编辑肖像海报，主角为一名佩戴耳机的年轻东亚女性，配有故障艺术 UI 图形和像素排版，适用于专辑封面或社交媒体视觉素材。
zh.prompt: 创作一张正方形的赛博时尚编辑海报，主角为一名名为 {argument name="character name" default="Karina"} 的年轻东亚女性，采用半身特写构图，略微偏右居中，直视镜头，眼神平静且富有表现力，嘴角带着浅浅的微笑。她留着一头柔顺的 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色"} 长发，面部特征精致写实，皮肤纹理自然，双眸明亮，妆容为淡粉色调，气质优雅且充满青春活力。她头戴一顶黑色棒球帽，帽前别着两个小圆徽章，帽子上方/周围佩戴着淡粉色头戴式耳机，身穿灰色修身吊带背心，外搭一件滑落至单肩的黑色毛绒针织开衫，颈间佩戴一条精致的银色星星吊坠项链；左手轻轻触碰耳机或帽檐。采用单色洋红色与紫色的赛博朋克色调，辅以柔和的粉色光影、胶片颗粒感、半色调网点纹理，营造出高端 K-pop 专辑封面的质感。背景为层叠的数字拼贴画，包含三张完全相同的该女性虚影肖像：左上方一张部分被垂直像素条遮挡，右上角一张带有类似墨镜的阴影，右侧中部下方一张较小的肖像。在主体周围添加纤细的霓虹粉色矩形电路框和 UI 连接器，并在多个交汇处放置小型粉色故障条。包含像素/位图排版：面部右下方有一个半透明粉色轮廓框，内含大号名称标签 {argument name="main name text" default="Karina"}；左侧垂直标签为“SOFT POWER // CODE : 0411”；右上角标题为“DIGITAL ELEGANCE IN MOTION”；右侧有一个小型方框内的东亚汉字“凛”；左下角引语为 {argument name="quote" default="The presence that stays with you, long after the signal fades."}；左下角附近有大号代码“[0411]”及下方的小型条形码；右侧有微小的文字“Signal. Emotion. Identity.”；底部文字为“NOT JUST A MOMENT / A FREQUENCY.”。底部添加一条带有对角警示条纹的 HUD 栏、一条长粉色进度条以及右下角的一个小型棋盘格方块。保持构图紧凑且平衡，以清晰写实的肖像细节与背景中像素化的面孔形成对比，无水印，无多余肢体，无面部扭曲，所有文字均需作为平面设计元素完美融合。

en.title: Luxury Three-Portrait Gallery Wall
en.description: Creates a realistic upscale interior mockup with three framed portrait photos on a softly lit gallery wall.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic modern gallery wall mockup in a luxury interior, vertical 4:5 composition. Show a smooth matte off-white wall with exactly three framed portrait photographs arranged horizontally in a straight row with equal spacing. Each frame is portrait-oriented, slim black metal or wood frame, white mat border, glass front with subtle reflections, and realistic shadows. The three framed photos show the same {argument name="portrait subject" default="young Black man"} in three different professional portrait styles: left frame shows a front-facing head-and-shoulders portrait wearing a {argument name="left outfit" default="blue and gold patterned African print shirt"}; center frame shows him looking downward while adjusting his cuff or watch, wearing a {argument name="center outfit" default="royal blue traditional-style shirt with glasses and a pocket square"}; right frame shows a formal front-facing business portrait wearing a {argument name="right outfit" default="navy suit, white shirt, navy tie, tie bar, and white pocket square"}. Place one long, thin black picture light centered above the frames, casting a warm soft glow across the wall and the top edges of the frames. Include a blurred green indoor plant in the lower left foreground, a dark modern wooden sideboard cabinet in the lower right, a simple white baseboard, and a gray stone or polished concrete floor. Lighting should be warm, high-end, calm, and gallery-like, with soft natural shadows and shallow depth of field in the foreground. No text, no logos, no watermark, no extra frames, keep exactly three portraits.

zh.title: 奢华三联肖像画廊墙
zh.description: 打造一个逼真的高端室内样机效果，在柔光画廊墙上展示三幅装裱好的肖像照片。
zh.prompt: 创建一个超逼真的现代画廊墙样机，置于奢华室内环境中，采用 4:5 竖构图。展示一面平滑的哑光灰白色墙壁，墙上水平排列着三幅装裱好的肖像照片，间距相等。每幅画框均为竖向，采用纤细的黑色金属或木质边框、白色卡纸边衬，玻璃表面带有细腻的反光和逼真的阴影。这三幅装裱照片展示了同一个 {argument name="portrait subject" default="年轻黑人男性"} 在三种不同的专业肖像风格中：左侧画框展示了一张正面头部和肩部肖像，身穿 {argument name="left outfit" default="蓝金图案非洲印花衬衫"}；中间画框展示了他低头调整袖口或手表的样子，身穿 {argument name="center outfit" default="宝蓝色传统风格衬衫，佩戴眼镜和口袋巾"}；右侧画框展示了一张正式的正面商务肖像，身穿 {argument name="right outfit" default="海军蓝西装、白衬衫、海军蓝领带、领带夹和白色口袋巾"}。在画框上方居中位置放置一盏细长的黑色画灯，将温暖柔和的光芒投射在墙面和画框顶部边缘。前景左下方包含一株模糊的室内绿植，右下方放置一个深色现代木质边柜，配有简约的白色踢脚线和灰色石材或抛光混凝土材质地面。灯光应呈现温暖、高端、宁静的画廊氛围，具有柔和的自然阴影和前景浅景深效果。无文字、无 Logo、无水印、无额外画框，严格保持三幅肖像。

en.title: Cyber Blue Qwen Tech Review Poster
en.description: A high-energy vertical tech review thumbnail featuring a surprised presenter holding a glowing blue token with bold Chinese and model-name typography.
en.prompt: Create a dramatic vertical 4:5 tech influencer poster in a glossy cyber-blue style. A young East Asian man with short black hair, black rectangular glasses, and a surprised open-mouth expression leans toward the camera from the right side, wearing a plain black T-shirt. He holds a large glowing circular blue token close to the lens with his left hand in the lower-left foreground, making it appear oversized; the token has a transparent glassy rim, neon blue highlights, and a raised white geometric logo made of three separate block shapes on its face. His right hand points at the token from the right. Use an extreme wide-angle selfie perspective, strong depth distortion, crisp high-contrast lighting, and a dark black background filled with electric blue light streaks, lens flares, and motion lines. Add exactly 3 visible text elements: a huge 3D metallic-blue Chinese headline in the upper-left background reading {argument name="background Chinese headline" default="大力"}, a large italic white-and-blue title across the bottom reading {argument name="model title" default="Qwen3.8"}, and bold white Chinese text at the lower right reading {argument name="test label" default="实测"}. Make all typography extruded, glossy, beveled, and glowing with blue rim light. The composition should feel like a high-energy YouTube thumbnail or social media tech review announcement, ultra sharp, cinematic, slightly surreal, no extra text, no watermark.

zh.title: Cyber Blue Qwen 技术测评海报
zh.description: 一张充满活力的竖版科技测评缩略图，展示了一位表情惊讶的主讲人，手中拿着发光的蓝色代币，并配有醒目的中文和模型名称排版。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 4:5 比例的竖版科技博主海报，采用光泽感十足的赛博蓝风格。画面中，一位留着黑色短发、戴着黑色方框眼镜的年轻东亚男性，身穿纯黑色 T 恤，从右侧向镜头探身，表情惊讶、嘴巴微张。他的左手在左下角前景处拿着一枚巨大的发光圆形蓝色代币，使其看起来被放大；代币具有透明的玻璃边缘、霓虹蓝高光，正面有一个由三个独立块状结构组成的凸起白色几何标志。他的右手从右侧指向该代币。使用超广角自拍视角，强调景深畸变，采用清晰的高对比度照明，背景为深黑色，充满电光蓝色的光束、镜头光晕和动态线条。添加 3 个清晰可见的文本元素：左上角背景处是一个巨大的 3D 金属蓝中文标题，内容为 {argument name="background Chinese headline" default="大力"}；底部是一个醒目的大号斜体白蓝相间标题，内容为 {argument name="model title" default="Qwen3.8"}；右下角是加粗的白色中文文本，内容为 {argument name="test label" default="实测"}。所有排版均需呈现出挤压、光泽、斜面效果，并带有蓝色轮廓光。整体构图应具有高能量的 YouTube 缩略图或社交媒体科技测评预告风格，画质超清晰、具有电影质感、略带超现实感，不包含额外文本，无水印。

en.title: Shaolin Monk Character Sheet
en.description: Generates a wide professional character reference sheet for a fierce golden-robed Shaolin monk with poses, silhouettes, expressions, and costume detail studies.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a high-end cinematic character design sheet for {argument name="character name" default="MEI LIAN"}, a fierce Shaolin monk character with a shaved head, golden robes, and an unbreakable presence, suitable as a reference sheet for animation or game production.

Canvas: Wide horizontal white studio canvas, approximately 16:9, clean negative space, photorealistic concept-art presentation with soft studio lighting and faint contact shadows under the character. Use a warm ochre, saffron, cream, and weathered gold palette.

Top-left text block: Large title “{argument name="character name" default="MEI LIAN"}” in bold condensed uppercase golden-brown lettering. Under it include three concise lines: “ROLE: Shaolin Monk”, “CORE MOOD: Fierce. Unyielding. Transcendent.”, and “VISUAL SIGNATURE: Shaved head. Golden robes. Unbreakable will.”

Main subject details: The character is a plus-size bald female Shaolin monk with medium-brown skin, intense direct gaze, strong eyebrows, large gold hoop earrings, layered necklaces, bracelets, prayer beads, talismans, and weathered fabric accessories. She wears {argument name="robe color" default="saffron golden-yellow"} layered monk robes wrapped loosely across the shoulders and chest, exposing the belly, with voluminous off-white harem pants printed with subtle gold motifs, wrapped beige boots, and a long torn trailing sash. Her expression is commanding, serene, and intimidating.

Layout and counted elements: Show exactly 15 character/reference elements total. Include 1 large central full-body front view dominating the middle of the sheet. Include 6 additional pose/view studies around it: 1 left side profile full-body view labeled “PROFILE”, 1 small rear full-body view labeled “BACK VIEW”, 1 upper-body forward leaning pose labeled “LEANING POSE”, 1 seated cross-legged pose labeled “SEATED POSE”, 1 low crouching pose labeled “CROUCHING POSE”, and 1 dramatic low-angle view labeled “LOW-ANGLE VIEW”. Include 1 top-down perspective pose in the upper-right labeled “TOP-DOWN ANGLE”. Include 3 black silhouette studies along the lower-left labeled “SILHOUETTE STUDY”: front silhouette with trailing sash, rear silhouette, and side/rear silhouette. Include 5 face expression thumbnails along the lower center labeled “EXPRESSION STUDY”: calm intense stare, shouting open mouth, stern neutral face, worried or tense face, and downward suspicious glare. Include 4 close-up detail thumbnails along the lower-right labeled “DETAIL STUDY”: eyes and earrings, layered chest robe and necklaces, hanging bead/talisman accessories, and wrapped boot.

Visual style: Photorealistic fantasy costume concept sheet with subtle ink-like handwritten labels, realistic fabric texture, frayed robe edges, dusty boots, detailed jewelry, natural skin texture, and consistent studio lighting. The sheet should feel like a professional character reference board, not a comic page.

Constraints: Keep all background areas plain white or very light gray. Do not add scenery, weapons, logos, watermark, UI elements, or extra characters. Maintain the exact counted pose groups and labels. Make the character visually consistent across all views, with the same shaved head, body shape, costume, jewelry, and golden monk identity.

zh.title: 少林僧人角色设定集
zh.description: 生成一份专业且全面的角色参考设定集，展示一位身着金袍、神情威猛的少林僧人，包含姿态、剪影、表情及服饰细节研究。
zh.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="character name" default="MEI LIAN"} 创建一份高端电影级角色设计设定集。该角色为一位剃光头、身穿金袍、气场坚不可摧的威猛少林僧人，适用于动画或游戏制作的角色参考。

画布：宽幅横向白色摄影棚画布，比例约为 16:9，留白简洁，呈现照片级真实感的概念艺术效果，配以柔和的摄影棚灯光，角色下方带有淡淡的接触阴影。使用暖赭色、藏红花色、奶油色和风化金色的配色方案。

左上角文本块：大标题“{argument name="character name" default="MEI LIAN"}”，采用粗体压缩大写金棕色字体。下方包含三行简洁文字：“角色：少林僧人”、“核心气质：威猛。不屈。超凡。”、“视觉特征：光头。金袍。坚不可摧的意志。”

主体细节：角色为一位体型丰满的秃头女性少林僧人，中褐色皮肤，目光直视且强烈，眉毛浓密，佩戴大金环耳环、多层项链、手镯、念珠、护身符及风化织物配饰。她身穿 {argument name="robe color" default="藏红花金黄色"} 的多层僧袍，松散地包裹在肩部和胸前，露出腹部，穿着带有精致金色图案的宽松米白色哈伦裤，缠绕式米色靴子，以及一条长而破损的拖地腰带。她的表情威严、宁静且具有震慑力。

布局与元素统计：总共展示 15 个角色/参考元素。中间包含 1 个占据画面中心的大型全身正面视图。周围包含 6 个额外的姿态/视图研究：1 个左侧全身侧视图，标注为“PROFILE”；1 个小型全身背面视图，标注为“BACK VIEW”；1 个上半身前倾姿态，标注为“LEANING POSE”；1 个盘腿坐姿，标注为“SEATED POSE”；1 个低位蹲姿，标注为“CROUCHING POSE”；以及 1 个戏剧性的低角度视图，标注为“LOW-ANGLE VIEW”。右上角包含 1 个俯视视角姿态，标注为“TOP-DOWN ANGLE”。左下角包含 3 个黑色剪影研究，标注为“SILHOUETTE STUDY”：带拖地腰带的正面剪影、背面剪影以及侧/背面剪影。底部中央包含 5 个面部表情缩略图，标注为“EXPRESSION STUDY”：冷静凝视、张口呐喊、严肃中性、担忧或紧张、以及向下怀疑的目光。右下角包含 4 个特写细节缩略图，标注为“DETAIL STUDY”：眼睛与耳环、多层胸前僧袍与项链、悬挂的念珠/护身符配饰、以及缠绕式靴子。

视觉风格：照片级真实感的奇幻服饰概念设定集，带有细微的墨迹手写标签，真实的织物纹理、磨损的袍边、沾灰的靴子、精细的珠宝、自然的皮肤纹理以及统一的摄影棚灯光。整张设定集应呈现为专业的角色参考项目，而非漫画页面。

约束条件：保持所有背景区域为纯白色或极浅的灰色。不要添加场景、武器、标志、水印、UI 元素或额外角色。保持精确的姿态分组和标签。确保角色在所有视图中视觉一致，拥有相同的光头、体型、服饰、珠宝和金色僧人身份。

en.title: Mech Pilot Cockpit Over City
en.description: A cinematic photorealistic prompt for generating a giant robot pilot seated in a futuristic cockpit overlooking a city with blue holographic HUD displays.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic sci-fi cockpit scene from a rear-centered viewpoint: a lone female pilot, {argument name="pilot description" default="young woman with long straight black hair"}, sits in a high-tech pilot seat facing forward inside the cockpit of a giant robot or advanced mech. She wears a fitted {argument name="pilot suit color" default="light beige flight suit"} with black shoulder harnesses and a bulky rectangular mechanical backpack/seat module attached behind her. The cockpit is dark graphite metal with angular armored window frames and a wide panoramic windshield overlooking a bright futuristic city from high altitude. Outside, show dense modern skyscrapers, roads, a bay or river, distant mountains, blue sky, and scattered clouds in crisp daylight. Fill the cockpit with glowing blue holographic HUD overlays projected on the glass and consoles: include exactly 8 main display clusters visible in the composition—1 long curved top status strip across the ceiling, 1 central horizon/altitude targeting reticle on the windshield, 2 vertical side telemetry panels near the front window pillars, 2 translucent side-window data panels, and 2 large lower console screens showing humanoid mech schematics and system readouts. Add smaller buttons, switches, illuminated panels, and cockpit controls on both left and right arm consoles, using cool cyan-blue UI graphics with fine technical text, charts, waveforms, numeric indicators, and labels such as system online, horizon, altitude, speed, power system, and weapon system. Composition should be symmetrical, immersive, and highly detailed, with the pilot centered in the lower half and the city framed through the cockpit glass. Use realistic lighting with strong daylight outside, blue reflections on glass, deep interior shadows, sharp focus, ultra-detailed hard-surface design, cinematic science-fiction atmosphere, no cartoon styling, no visible watermark, no extra characters, and no exterior view of the robot.

zh.title: 机甲驾驶舱俯瞰城市
zh.description: 一个电影级照片写实风格的提示词，用于生成一名坐在未来感驾驶舱内的巨型机器人驾驶员，俯瞰着带有蓝色全息 HUD 显示屏的城市。
zh.prompt: 从后方居中视角创建一个电影级照片写实风格的科幻驾驶舱场景：一名孤独的女驾驶员，{argument name="pilot description" default="留着黑色长直发的年轻女性"}，坐在巨型机器人或先进机甲内部的高科技驾驶座上，面向前方。她穿着一件合身的 {argument name="pilot suit color" default="浅米色飞行服"}，配有黑色肩部安全带，身后连接着一个笨重的矩形机械背包/座椅模块。驾驶舱采用深石墨色金属材质，配有棱角分明的装甲窗框，以及一个可以从高空俯瞰明亮未来城市的宽阔全景挡风玻璃。窗外展示着密集的现代摩天大楼、道路、海湾或河流、远山、蓝天以及清澈日光下的零星云朵。在驾驶舱内填充投射在玻璃和控制台上的发光蓝色全息 HUD 叠加层：画面中需清晰可见 8 个主要显示集群——顶部天花板上 1 条长弧形状态条、挡风玻璃上 1 个中央水平/高度瞄准十字准线、前窗立柱附近 2 个垂直侧面遥测面板、2 个半透明侧窗数据面板，以及 2 个显示人形机甲示意图和系统读数的下部大型控制台屏幕。在左右扶手控制台上添加较小的按钮、开关、发光面板和驾驶舱控制器，使用冷青蓝色 UI 图形，并配以精细的技术文本、图表、波形、数字指示器以及诸如系统在线 (system online)、水平面 (horizon)、高度 (altitude)、速度 (speed)、动力系统 (power system) 和武器系统 (weapon system) 等标签。构图应保持对称、沉浸且高度细节化，驾驶员位于下半部分中心，城市景观通过驾驶舱玻璃呈现。使用逼真的光影效果，外部为强烈的日光，玻璃上有蓝色反射，内部阴影深邃，焦点清晰，采用超精细的硬表面设计，营造出电影般的科幻氛围，拒绝卡通风格，无可见水印，无额外角色，且不显示机器人外部视图。

en.title: Steampunk Shih Tzu Moonlit City
en.description: A cinematic fantasy prompt for generating a heroic Shih Tzu adventurer overlooking a moonlit steampunk city.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic dark fantasy steampunk illustration in a wide 16:9 landscape format. The scene shows exactly one small Shih Tzu dog hero, {argument name="dog breed" default="Shih Tzu"}, standing on a mossy hill in the left foreground, facing right in a proud adventurous pose. Give the dog long windblown cream-and-gold fur, large dark expressive eyes, and a serious cool expression, dressed in a rugged steampunk adventurer outfit: one dark leather coat with high collar, one belt harness, one small backpack, boots, and a long scarf or torn cape streaming dramatically to the left in the wind. The background is a vast Victorian steampunk city at night with tall spires, smokestacks, domes, bridges, glowing windows, and one prominent clock tower on the right side reflected in dark water below. In the sky include exactly one large yellow full moon near the upper center-right and exactly one zeppelin airship in the upper right, with tiny warm cabin lights. Frame the composition with dark trees on both sides and a large tree trunk on the far left; add windblown yellow leaves in the foreground. Use a moody black-and-golden-yellow limited color palette, high contrast, glowing moonlight, smoky clouds, starry sky, dramatic rim lighting on the dog’s fur, detailed painterly concept-art texture, epic storybook atmosphere, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 蒸汽朋克西施犬与月光之城
zh.description: 一个电影级奇幻提示词，用于生成一只俯瞰月光下蒸汽朋克城市的英勇西施犬冒险家。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅 16:9 宽屏电影级暗黑奇幻蒸汽朋克插画。画面中仅出现一只小型西施犬英雄，{argument name="dog breed" default="Shih Tzu"}，它站在左侧前景长满苔藓的山丘上，面向右侧，呈现出骄傲的冒险姿态。这只狗拥有随风飘动的奶油色与金色长毛、深邃且富有表现力的大眼睛，表情严肃而冷峻，身着粗犷的蒸汽朋克冒险家服装：一件高领深色皮衣、一条皮带背带、一个小背包、靴子，以及一条在风中向左剧烈飘动的长围巾或破损斗篷。背景是一座广阔的维多利亚时代蒸汽朋克城市，夜色中矗立着高耸的尖塔、烟囱、圆顶、桥梁和明亮的窗户，右侧一座显眼的钟楼倒映在下方的深色水域中。天空中包含一轮位于右上方的巨大黄色满月，以及一艘位于右上方的齐柏林飞艇，飞艇上带有微小的暖色舱灯。画面两侧由深色树木环绕，最左侧有一棵大树干；前景中加入随风飘落的黄叶。使用忧郁的黑金黄色调限定配色，高对比度，明亮的月光，烟雾缭绕的云层，星空，狗毛上戏剧性的轮廓光，细腻的绘画感概念艺术纹理，史诗般的绘本氛围，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Anime Swimsuit Poster with Retro Beach Graphics
en.description: Generates a full-body anime swimsuit character poster with pastel retro beach shapes, ideal for summer character art or social media illustration.
en.prompt:
Create a full-body anime-style summer pin-up illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Oyagi"}, a cheerful young woman standing barefoot in a relaxed contrapposto pose on a warm off-white background. She has short wavy {argument name="hair color" default="blonde hair with peach-pink underside tips"}, large violet eyes, a soft smile, light blush on her cheeks, and a purple star hair clip near her bangs. Add a small navy beret tilted on top of her head with a red ribbon accent. She wears a sporty one-piece swimsuit: primarily deep teal-blue with white trim, coral-red side panels, and a lavender side insert, showing carefully drawn anime anatomy with subtle shoulder, arm, waist, hip, thigh, knee, calf, ankle, and foot definition. Her left hand rests on her hip, her right arm hangs naturally with relaxed fingers, and she wears one coral wrist bangle. Keep proportions elegant and slightly idealized, not chibi, with clean line art, soft cel shading, gentle skin highlights, and polished Japanese anime character illustration quality.

Canvas and layout: Vertical poster composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, full body centered with generous margins and feet visible near the bottom. The background is minimalist retro beach graphic design on cream paper.

Decorative background elements: Include exactly 15 abstract graphic elements around the character: 1 large turquoise circle in the upper left with horizontal white stripes across its lower half and a dotted turquoise semicircle beneath it; 1 coral quarter-circle block in the upper right; 1 pale purple grid in the upper right; 1 group of four small yellow triangles near the upper right; 1 blue double zigzag line near the upper right; 1 pale purple dotted rectangular cluster at mid-right; 1 thin pale purple outlined circle at mid-left; 1 coral partial ring arc at lower left; 1 set of five thin black diagonal lines below that arc; 1 lower-left pale purple grid; 1 coral dotted diamond cluster above the lower-left grid; 1 turquoise zigzag line over the lower-left grid; 1 small blue dotted cluster below the lower-left grid; 1 large turquoise stylized water patch in the lower right with white wave lines and a turquoise semicircle behind it; 1 large yellow triangle on the right with a nearby coral circle over a blue dotted semicircle and a turquoise zigzag underneath.

Text content: In the bottom right, add small printed date text reading {argument name="date text" default="July 23, 2026"} above an elegant black cursive signature reading {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}.

Style constraints: bright airy palette, pastel geometric accents, clean manga/anime linework, soft shading, swimsuit fashion illustration, crisp hands and feet, no extra characters, no heavy realism, no watermark beyond the date and signature.

zh.title: 带有复古海滩图形的动漫泳装海报
zh.description: 生成一张带有柔和复古海滩图形的全身动漫泳装角色海报，非常适合夏季角色艺术或社交媒体插画。
zh.prompt:
创作一张全身动漫风格的夏季海报插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Oyagi"}，一位开朗的年轻女性，赤脚站在温暖的米白色背景上，姿态呈现自然的重心转移。她留着短波浪卷的 {argument name="hair color" default="金色头发，发梢带有桃粉色挑染"}，有着大大的紫罗兰色眼睛、温柔的微笑、脸颊微红，刘海旁别着一个紫色星星发夹。她的头顶斜戴着一顶海军蓝贝雷帽，并饰有红色丝带。她穿着一件运动型连体泳衣：主体为深青蓝色，配有白色饰边、珊瑚红侧板和薰衣草色侧插片，展现出精心绘制的动漫人体结构，并细致刻画了肩膀、手臂、腰部、臀部、大腿、膝盖、小腿、脚踝和足部细节。她的左手叉腰，右臂自然下垂，手指放松，手腕上戴着一个珊瑚色手镯。保持比例优雅且略显理想化，非 Q 版风格，线条干净利落，采用柔和的赛璐珞阴影、细腻的皮肤高光，呈现出精致的日系动漫角色插画质感。

画布与布局：垂直海报构图，2:3 比例，全身居中，留有充足的边距，底部可见双脚。背景为米色纸张上的极简复古海滩图形设计。

装饰性背景元素：在角色周围添加 15 个抽象图形元素：左上角 1 个大型绿松石色圆圈，下半部分带有水平白色条纹，下方有一个点状绿松石色半圆；右上角 1 个珊瑚色四分之一圆块；右上角 1 个淡紫色网格；右上角附近 1 组四个黄色小三角形；右上角附近 1 条蓝色双重锯齿线；中右侧 1 个淡紫色点状矩形簇；中左侧 1 个细淡紫色轮廓圆圈；左下角 1 个珊瑚色部分圆环弧线；该弧线下方 1 组五条细黑色斜线；左下角 1 个淡紫色网格；左下角网格上方 1 个珊瑚色点状菱形簇；左下角网格上方 1 条绿松石色锯齿线；左下角网格下方 1 个蓝色小点状簇；右下角 1 个大型绿松石色风格化水域斑块，带有白色波浪线，其后方有一个绿松石色半圆；右侧 1 个大型黄色三角形，附近有一个珊瑚色圆圈覆盖在蓝色点状半圆上，下方有一条绿松石色锯齿线。

文字内容：在右下角，添加小号印刷体日期 {argument name="date text" default="July 23, 2026"}，其上方为优雅的黑色草书签名 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。

风格限制：明亮通透的色调，柔和的几何装饰，干净的漫画/动漫线条，柔和的阴影，泳装时尚插画，清晰的手脚刻画，无额外角色，无厚重写实感，除日期和签名外无任何水印。

en.title: Three Goddesses of Time
en.description: A luminous fantasy portrait prompt for creating three ethereal time goddesses in white gowns with hourglasses in a windswept meadow.
en.prompt: Create a luminous high-fashion fantasy portrait titled {argument name="concept title" default="The Three Goddesses Who Govern Time"}: three ethereal young women standing in a windswept meadow beneath a bright cloudy sky, photographed from a slightly low front angle in a vertical 4:5 composition. They are triplets or sister goddesses with very pale skin, long flowing platinum-blonde hair, serene expressions, and translucent white Greco-Roman chiffon gowns with wrapped waists and trailing gauze. Count exactly three figures: the left goddess stands in profile facing left, calm and distant, holding a small antique hourglass low at her side; the center goddess faces the viewer directly, composed and timeless, holding a brass-framed hourglass in her right hand; the right goddess faces upward to the right with one hand gently raised, surrounded by faint circular strands of glowing white light suggesting time magic. Use a soft overexposed morning backlight, silver-white palette, delicate lens haze, wind-blown fabric and hair, shimmering particles, and thin translucent ribbons of light swirling around their bodies. The setting is an open grassy field with low rolling mountains in the background, pale sunlight breaking through clouds, and a dreamlike cinematic realism style. Emphasize airy fabric textures, radiant halos, elegant mythological beauty, and a quiet sacred mood. Avoid modern objects, text, crowns, weapons, dark colors, harsh shadows, or extra characters.

zh.title: 时间三女神
zh.description: 一个明亮的奇幻肖像提示词，用于创作三位身着白裙、手持沙漏、伫立在风中草甸上的空灵时间女神。
zh.prompt: 创作一张名为 {argument name="concept title" default="掌管时间的三女神"} 的明亮高定奇幻肖像：三位空灵的年轻女性伫立在风中草甸，背景是明亮的云层天空，采用 4:5 竖构图，从略微仰视的正面角度拍摄。她们是三胞胎或姐妹女神，皮肤苍白，留着飘逸的铂金色长发，表情宁静，身穿半透明的白色希腊罗马式雪纺长裙，腰部缠绕，薄纱拖地。画面中必须正好有三个人物：左侧女神侧身向左，神情冷静而疏离，身侧低垂着一个精致的古董沙漏；中间女神直视镜头，沉稳而永恒，右手握着一个黄铜边框的沙漏；右侧女神仰头向右，一只手轻轻抬起，周围环绕着淡淡的白色光环，暗示着时间魔法。使用柔和的过曝晨光逆光，银白色调，轻微的镜头雾化效果，随风飘动的织物与发丝，闪烁的微粒，以及环绕在她们身体周围纤细透明的光带。场景设定为开阔的草地，背景是起伏的低矮山脉，苍白的阳光穿透云层，呈现出梦幻般的电影级写实风格。强调轻盈的织物纹理、耀眼的光环、优雅的神话美感以及宁静神圣的氛围。避免出现现代物品、文字、皇冠、武器、深色、强烈的阴影或多余的角色。

en.title: Watercolor Idol Concert Performance
en.description: Generates a radiant watercolor anime idol singer on a spotlight-filled stage, ideal for character art or emotional music-themed illustrations.
en.prompt: Create a luminous watercolor anime idol concert illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Tachibana Kohaku"}, a single young female singer centered on stage, shown from mid-thigh up in a dynamic three-quarter pose. She has {argument name="hair color" default="short soft blonde hair"} with a blue-and-white flower hair ornament and ribbon on one side, pale skin, sparkling gray-blue eyes, and a warm emotional smile. She wears a white and pale-blue frilled idol dress with exactly 5 main outfit features: a fitted corset bodice with gold crisscross lacing, a blue floral neck accent, off-shoulder ribbon straps, layered ruffled skirt panels, and delicate wrist frills. Her right hand holds exactly 1 black handheld microphone near her mouth, while her left arm reaches toward the viewer with an open palm, creating a heartfelt invitation. The background is a dazzling concert venue filled with misty blue-violet washes, star-shaped sparkles, confetti, and exactly 5 bright overhead spotlights casting visible white beams down from the top of the image. At the bottom edge, include dark audience silhouettes and glowing blue-white concert light sticks, slightly blurred and cropped to emphasize depth. Use a transparent, hand-painted watercolor style with visible brushstrokes, paper texture, soft bleeding pigments, layered washes, luminous whites, and expressive splatter effects to convey radiant light. Color palette: {argument name="main color palette" default="icy white, sky blue, lavender, and pale gold"}. Composition should feel hopeful, emotional, and radiant, like a magical idol performance capturing the idea of light returning. Vertical portrait canvas, high detail, no text, no watermark, no logo, no photorealism.

zh.title: 水彩风偶像演唱会表演
zh.description: 生成一位在聚光灯舞台上熠熠生辉的水彩动漫偶像歌手，非常适合角色艺术或情感丰富的音乐主题插画。
zh.prompt: 创作一张光影灵动的水彩动漫偶像演唱会插画，主角为 {argument name="character name" default="Tachibana Kohaku"}，画面中心为一位年轻的女性歌手，采用大腿以上的半身构图，呈现动态的三分之四侧面。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔软的金色短发"}，一侧装饰着蓝白相间的花朵发饰和丝带，皮肤白皙，灰蓝色的双眸闪烁着光芒，脸上带着温暖动人的微笑。她身穿一件白蓝相间的褶边偶像礼服，服装包含 5 个核心细节：带有金色交叉系带的修身束腰上衣、蓝色花朵颈饰、露肩丝带肩带、多层褶皱裙摆以及精致的袖口花边。她的右手拿着 1 支黑色手持麦克风靠近嘴边，左手向观众伸出，掌心向上，仿佛在发出深情的邀请。背景是绚丽的演唱会现场，充盈着朦胧的蓝紫色水彩晕染、星形闪光、五彩纸屑，以及从画面顶部投射下的 5 道清晰可见的明亮聚光灯光束。画面底部边缘加入深色的观众剪影和发光的蓝白色应援棒，通过轻微的模糊和裁剪来增强景深感。采用透明的手绘水彩风格，保留可见的笔触、纸张纹理、柔和的颜料晕染、层叠的色彩以及富有表现力的喷溅效果，以传达出璀璨的光感。配色方案：{argument name="main color palette" default="冰雪白、天蓝色、薰衣草紫和淡金色"}。构图应充满希望、情感与光芒，如同捕捉到光芒回归瞬间的梦幻偶像表演。竖向肖像画幅，高细节，无文字，无水印，无 Logo，非写实照片风格。

en.title: Celestial Mechanical Dragon Observatory
en.description: Generates an epic fantasy sci-fi scene of a colossal armored dragon manipulating holographic star maps in a glowing cosmic observatory.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic fantasy sci-fi illustration of a colossal {argument name="dragon type" default="mechanical celestial dragon"} inside a vast cosmic arcane observatory. The dragon dominates the frame from chest up, facing slightly left, with a long angular head, crown-like jagged horns, layered black gunmetal and silver armor scales, razor crystalline spines, clawed hands, and enormous partially spread wings made of sharp metallic feathers and translucent gold-lit crystal shards. A brilliant circular golden reactor or magical core glows in the center of its chest, with intricate clockwork rings and filigree around it. The dragon raises its left claw toward a floating translucent holographic blueprint panel filled with star-map lines and architectural diagrams, while its right claw hovers over a delicate golden astrolabe platform. Surround it with exactly 6 major floating magical interface elements: 2 translucent rectangular blueprint screens, 3 circular astrolabe or constellation diagrams, and 1 suspended ornate mechanical sphere. The environment is a grand celestial workshop with reflective dark stone floors, golden rails, miniature cathedral-like spires, armillary spheres, thin towers, and tiny robed humanoid figures for scale. The background is a deep starry night sky filled with glowing constellation networks, orbital rings, sacred geometry circles, sparks, and radiant gold light beams. Visual style: hyperrealistic epic concept art, baroque clockwork design, obsidian black, polished silver, warm gold, electric white-blue holograms, extremely high detail, dramatic rim lighting, volumetric glow, sharp focus, grand vertical composition, awe-inspiring scale, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 天体机械龙天文台
zh.description: 生成一幅史诗级奇幻科幻场景，描绘一只巨大的装甲龙在发光的宇宙天文台操控全息星图。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅超精细的电影级奇幻科幻插画，描绘一只巨大的 {argument name="dragon type" default="机械天体龙"} 位于广阔的宇宙奥术天文台内。龙占据画面胸部以上位置，略微朝左，拥有修长的棱角分明的头部、冠状锯齿角、层叠的黑枪色与银色装甲鳞片、锋利的结晶脊刺、利爪，以及巨大的半展开翅膀，翅膀由锋利的金属羽毛和半透明的金色发光水晶碎片组成。胸部中心有一个明亮的圆形金色反应堆或魔法核心，周围环绕着复杂的发条环和金银丝细工。龙将左爪抬向一块漂浮的半透明全息蓝图面板，上面布满了星图线条和建筑图解，右爪悬浮在一个精致的金色星盘平台上。周围环绕着 6 个主要的漂浮魔法界面元素：2 个半透明矩形蓝图屏幕、3 个圆形星盘或星座图，以及 1 个悬浮的华丽机械球体。环境是一个宏伟的天体工作室，拥有反光的深色石地板、金色轨道、微型大教堂般的尖塔、浑天仪、细长塔楼，以及用于对比比例的微小长袍人形角色。背景是深邃的星夜，充满了发光的星座网络、轨道环、神圣几何圆、火花和灿烂的金色光束。视觉风格：超写实史诗概念艺术、巴洛克发条设计、黑曜石黑、抛光银、暖金、电光蓝白全息图、极高细节、戏剧性轮廓光、体积光、清晰对焦、宏伟的垂直构图、令人敬畏的规模，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Crystalline Cybernetic Anime Girl
en.description: Generates a luminous geometric anime close-up of a cybernetic girl surrounded by glass shards and pastel prismatic light.
en.prompt: Create a luminous vertical anime portrait of {argument name="character name" default="a mysterious cybernetic girl"} in an elegant geometric illustration style. The composition is an extreme close-up from the shoulders up, slightly tilted, with the face centered and cropped tightly by the top and sides. She has soft short wavy {argument name="hair color" default="silvery white hair with pale pink and cyan reflections"}, long wispy bangs covering part of her forehead, a delicate pale face, a tiny neutral mouth, and an expression that feels calm, doll-like, and unsettling. Her left eye is a large glossy black mechanical eye with concentric blue rings, while her right eye glows pale pink with a hypnotic spiral iris; add fine eyelashes and subtle blush around both eyes. She wears a loose translucent white shirt or robe with a low neckline, rendered with iridescent cyan, pink, and lavender highlights. Surround her with exactly 18 visible floating geometric fragments: 6 translucent cyan glass shards, 5 black triangular prism shards, 4 white angular polygon shards, and 3 small gold-edged triangular pieces. Some shards overlap her hair and cheek like fractured crystal plates, including one translucent shard crossing the right eye and cheek. Add thin circular orbit lines and faint technical arcs in the background, plus scattered prismatic light streaks and sparkles. Use a high-key white background flooded with overexposed light, pastel cyan and pink rim lighting, glossy glass refractions, chromatic aberration, soft bloom, and very clean detailed anime linework. The mood should be futuristic, ethereal, fragile, and crystalline, with no text, no watermark, and no extra characters.

zh.title: 几何风格仿生少女肖像
zh.description: 一幅明亮的未来主义动漫肖像，描绘了一位拥有螺旋镜片眼睛、身旁环绕着漂浮水晶几何碎片的白发仿生少女。
