zh.prompt: 创作一幅明亮的竖版动漫肖像，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的仿生少女"}，采用超精细的几何插画风格。构图为略微倾斜的半身特写，面部占据画面大部分空间，背景为明亮的白、青、粉色抽象风格。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="蓬松的短白发，带有淡粉色和冰蓝色的虹彩高光"}，细腻的瓷质皮肤，小巧中性的嘴唇，以及两只不对称的催眠双眼：左眼是带有同心蓝色圆环的黑色光泽圆形镜片，右眼是部分被半透明碎玻璃覆盖的淡粉色螺旋发光镜片。添加精致的腮红、细长的睫毛、纤细的动漫线条以及冷静的表情。她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="一件宽松的半透明白色衬衫或夹克，领口较低"}。在她的周围环绕 12 个醒目的漂浮几何碎片：面部和肩部周围有 5 个青色透明玻璃碎片，边缘和颈部附近有 4 个黑色三棱镜碎片，发丝和领口附近有 3 个小型金边三角形碎片。包含纤细的圆形轨道线、棱镜折射、青色光束、柔和的粉色轮廓光、玻璃质感高光以及色差效果。整体氛围应空灵、前卫、简洁且具有高级时尚感，采用高曝光度、淡青色与粉色的调色，面部细节锐利，并带有梦幻般的水晶光泽。使用竖版 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} 画布，无文字，无水印，无多余角色。

en.title: Ornate Anime 8 of Diamonds Card
en.description: Generates a luxurious anime fantasy playing card with an elegant gothic-lolita heroine, ornate gold filigree, ruby accents, and casino-themed details.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create an ornate vertical fantasy playing card illustration for the {argument name="card rank and suit" default="8 of diamonds"}, featuring a glamorous anime girl as the central character.

Canvas: Tall portrait playing-card format with rounded cream corners, a thin dark outer stroke, and an elaborate antique gold filigree border. Use a symmetrical card composition with the rank and suit repeated in exactly 2 corners: top-left shows a large red “8” above a red diamond pip, and bottom-right shows a large red diamond pip above a red “8”.

Central subject: A beautiful young anime woman seated diagonally in a luxurious pose, one knee raised in the foreground and one hand resting near her lips. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long ash-brown hair with soft waves"}, warm brown eyes, delicate facial features, glossy skin highlights, and a calm slightly wistful expression. Her hair flows across the card and is decorated with a large deep-red patterned bow, jeweled hair ornaments, and small gold accents.

Outfit and accessories: Dress her in a highly detailed gothic-lolita casino-inspired gown using {argument name="main color palette" default="black, burgundy red, antique gold, cream, and jewel ruby"}. The outfit includes exactly 6 prominent outfit/accessory groups: 1 black-and-gold embroidered corset bodice with red heart jewel accents, 1 layered burgundy-and-black ruffled skirt, 2 translucent lace puff sleeves, 1 ornate choker and necklace cluster, 1 pair of dangling diamond-shaped earrings, and 1 decorative thigh garter with gold chains and rose charms. Add many fine gold chains, lace trim, filigree embroidery, tiny beads, ruby gems, and heart motifs.

Background and playing-card details: Behind her, create a dark midnight casino-fantasy background with hanging gold chains, sparkling dust, red gem fragments, and an antique clock face in the upper-right background. Include exactly 5 small floating playing cards around her: 2 on the left side, 1 near the upper-left behind her head, and 2 on the right side. The floating cards should have ornate patterned backs, tilted at different angles, with no readable numbers. Add exactly 4 visible rose clusters integrated into the border: one large cluster at upper-right, one vertical cluster along the right edge, one cluster at lower-left corner, and one small rose accent near the raised leg.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed Japanese anime illustration, elegant shoujo fantasy, luxury tarot-card aesthetics, intricate linework, luminous highlights, warm rim lighting, high contrast between dark background and glowing gold ornamentation, ruby-red accents, painterly polish, delicate sparkle effects, romantic and lavish mood.

Constraints: Keep the composition framed like a single collectible playing card, not a poster. Preserve the exact rank-and-suit corner layout for the {argument name="card rank and suit" default="8 of diamonds"}. Avoid extra text, logos, watermarks, cropped borders, modern UI elements, or photorealism.

zh.title: 华丽动漫风方块 8 扑克牌
zh.description: 生成一张奢华的动漫幻想风格扑克牌，主角为优雅的哥特萝莉少女，配以华丽的金色花丝、红宝石装饰及赌场主题细节。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张华丽的竖版幻想风格扑克牌插画，牌面为 {argument name="card rank and suit" default="方块 8"}，以一位迷人的动漫少女作为核心角色。

画布：高挑的竖版扑克牌构图，带有圆润的奶油色边角、细深色外边框以及精致的古董金丝边框。采用对称的牌面布局，牌面等级和花色在对角重复出现：左上角显示大号红色“8”及下方的红色方块花色，右下角显示大号红色方块花色及下方的红色“8”。

核心主体：一位美丽的年轻动漫女性，以奢华的姿态斜坐，一只膝盖抬起置于前景，一只手轻抚唇边。她拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="长长的灰棕色柔波卷发"}、温暖的棕色双眸、精致的五官、光泽感的皮肤高光，表情平静且略带忧郁。她的秀发流淌在牌面上，装饰着巨大的深红色花纹蝴蝶结、珠宝发饰和细小的金色点缀。

服装与配饰：为她穿上一套细节极其丰富的哥特萝莉赌场风礼服，主色调为 {argument name="main color palette" default="黑色、酒红色、古董金、奶油色和宝石红"}。服装包含 6 组明显的服饰/配饰：1 件带有红色心形宝石装饰的黑金刺绣束腰胸衣、1 条层叠的酒红色与黑色荷叶边裙、2 只半透明蕾丝泡泡袖、1 套华丽的颈圈与项链组合、1 对垂坠的菱形耳环，以及 1 条带有金链和玫瑰吊坠的装饰性大腿袜带。添加丰富的细金链、蕾丝花边、花丝刺绣、细小珠饰、红宝石和心形图案。

背景与扑克牌细节：在她身后营造一个深邃的午夜赌场幻想背景，悬挂着金链，点缀着闪烁的尘埃、红色宝石碎片，右上角背景处设有一个古董钟面。在她周围添加 5 张漂浮的小型扑克牌：左侧 2 张，左上方头部后方 1 张，右侧 2 张。漂浮的扑克牌应带有华丽的花纹背面，以不同角度倾斜，且无可见文字。在边框中集成 4 簇明显的玫瑰：右上角一簇大花束，右侧边缘一簇垂直花束，左下角一簇花束，以及抬起的腿部附近一簇小型玫瑰装饰。

视觉风格：超精细日本动漫插画，优雅少女幻想风，奢华塔罗牌美学，复杂的线条，明亮的高光，温暖的轮廓光，深色背景与发光金色装饰之间的高对比度，红宝石色点缀，绘画质感，精致的闪光效果，浪漫而奢华的氛围。

约束：保持构图如同一张可收藏的扑克牌，而非海报。保留 {argument name="card rank and suit" default="方块 8"} 的精确角标布局。避免出现额外文字、Logo、水印、裁剪边框、现代 UI 元素或写实风格。

en.title: Japanese Clear Wash Skincare Banner
en.description: Creates a polished Japanese facial cleanser advertising banner with a dewy model, product tube, benefit bubbles, and a strong blue CTA bar.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean Japanese skincare web banner for a facial cleanser, emphasizing moisture, clarity, purity, and gentle cleansing.

Canvas: Horizontal rectangular banner, approximately 600×500 px, bright white and pale blue color palette with a soft watery background. Use realistic commercial beauty photography compositing with subtle glow, high-key lighting, and a fresh hygienic atmosphere.

Layout: Place a smiling young East Asian woman on the right half, cropped from shoulders up, facing the viewer with her right hand gently touching her cheek. Her skin should look luminous, smooth, and hydrated; she has dark hair tied back loosely, natural makeup, and a white camisole strap visible. On the left half, place the main headline text in large blue Japanese calligraphy-style lettering. Below it, place a smaller explanatory line in dark gray. Along the lower-left area, place the product and benefit badges. Add a full-width blue gradient call-to-action bar at the bottom with centered white Japanese text and a white triangular play/arrow icon on the right.

Text content: Main headline reads 「{argument name="headline text" default="クリアにする 洗顔、はじまる。"}」 with 「クリア」 especially large and brush-like, and the rest arranged beside and below it. Supporting copy reads 「皮脂・角栓・酸化汚れを やさしく分解し、うるんとした素肌へ」. Bottom call-to-action reads 「{argument name="call to action text" default="今すぐ洗顔ケアを始める"}」.

Product and objects: Include exactly 5 prominent lower visual elements: 1 white facial cleanser tube labeled “CLEAR WASH” standing near the lower left, 1 mound of dense white cleansing foam beside it, and exactly 3 translucent blue water bubbles containing benefit text. The three bubble labels are: 1) 「使用満足度 92%」, 2) 「アルコール・パラベン フリー」, 3) 「皮膚の専門家監修」. Make the bubbles glossy, spherical, lightly refractive, and water-like.

Visual style: Premium Japanese cosmetic advertising, soft gradients, gentle reflections, pale aqua shadows, crisp typography, water ripple texture in the background, clean whitespace, and a trustworthy clinical-beauty feel. Keep the banner polished and Figma-ready, with no extra logos, no watermark, and no additional badges beyond the exactly 3 benefit bubbles.

Customizable details: The product should be a {argument name="product type" default="clear facial cleansing wash"}; the model should be a {argument name="model description" default="smiling young East Asian woman with dewy skin"}; the overall mood should be {argument name="visual mood" default="fresh, moist, clean, and gentle"}.

zh.title: 日式清透洁面护肤横幅
zh.description: 制作一张精致的日式洗面奶广告横幅，包含水润感的模特、产品管、功效气泡以及醒目的蓝色 CTA 栏。
zh.prompt:
目标：制作一张简洁的日式护肤网页横幅，用于推广洗面奶，强调保湿、清透、纯净与温和清洁。

画布：横向矩形横幅，尺寸约为 600×500 px，采用亮白色与淡蓝色配色，背景为柔和的水感设计。使用写实的商业美妆摄影合成技术，营造细腻光泽、高调照明以及清新卫生的氛围。

布局：右侧放置一位面带微笑的年轻东亚女性，半身像，面向观众，右手轻触脸颊。皮肤应呈现出透亮、平滑且水润的质感；深色头发松散扎起，妆容自然，露出白色吊带。左侧放置大型蓝色日式书法风格主标题。下方放置一行较小的深灰色说明文字。左下角区域放置产品及功效标签。底部添加一个全宽度的蓝色渐变行动号召（CTA）栏，居中显示白色日文文本，右侧配有白色三角形播放/箭头图标。

文本内容：主标题为「{argument name="headline text" default="クリアにする 洗顔、はじまる。"}」，其中「クリア」字样应特别放大并呈现笔触感，其余文字排列在其侧面及下方。辅助文案为「皮脂・角栓・酸化汚れを やさしく分解し、うるんとした素肌へ」。底部行动号召为「{argument name="call to action text" default="今すぐ洗顔ケアを始める"}」。

产品与对象：包含 5 个显著的底部视觉元素：左下角放置 1 支标有“CLEAR WASH”的白色洗面奶管，旁边放置 1 团浓密的白色洁面泡沫，以及 3 个包含功效文本的半透明蓝色水滴气泡。三个气泡标签分别为：1) 「使用満足度 92%」，2) 「アルコール・パラベン フリー」，3) 「皮膚の専門家監修」。气泡应具有光泽感、球形外观、轻微折射效果及水感。

视觉风格：高端日式化妆品广告风格，柔和的渐变，细腻的反射，淡水蓝色阴影，清晰的排版，背景带有水波纹理，留白充足，营造出值得信赖的临床美妆感。保持横幅精致且符合 Figma 设计标准，不添加额外 Logo、水印，除指定的 3 个功效气泡外，不添加其他标签。

可定制细节：产品应为 {argument name="product type" default="clear facial cleansing wash"}；模特应为 {argument name="model description" default="smiling young East Asian woman with dewy skin"}；整体氛围应为 {argument name="visual mood" default="fresh, moist, clean, and gentle"}。

en.title: Fantasy Crab Boss Battle UI
en.description: Generates a cinematic JRPG battle screen with three heroes fighting a giant crab boss and a complete fantasy game UI overlay.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic fantasy JRPG / social-mobile-game boss battle screenshot featuring a party fighting a gigantic crab monster casting a beam attack.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 cinematic game battle screen, high-detail anime-realistic fantasy art, dark blue night palette with vivid cyan magic, orange sparks, explosions, rubble, and strong bloom lighting.

Scene: A ruined rocky battlefield under a stormy night sky, with broken stone pillars and burning ruins in the background. Floating debris, embers, lightning-like magical energy, and smoke fill the air. The camera is low and slightly behind the heroes, looking toward the enormous boss.

Boss: A colossal armored crab enemy dominates the upper-right and center of the scene. It has exactly 2 huge raised claws, multiple segmented legs, a hard blue-brown shell, glowing highlights, and an intimidating face. The boss is firing a brilliant cyan-white magical beam from a glowing orb between its claws down toward the heroes, creating a massive impact flare at the center.

Heroes: Show exactly 3 playable characters in the foreground, all facing the crab boss. 1) KAITO, a dark-haired male swordsman in armor, center-left, bracing with a glowing sword against the beam. 2) RINA, a long dark-haired female mage or support fighter, center-right, holding a staff or wand with green-blue magic. 3) YUNA, a blonde female mage in a flowing blue robe, far left, holding a staff and casting a protective blue barrier around the party. Make the party look strong and heroic, like a premium gacha RPG battle scene.

User interface: Add a polished fantasy RPG battle UI overlay. Top-left boss panel contains a small crab portrait icon, the label “BOSS : ENEMY”, the boss name “{argument name="boss name" default="アビサル・クロウ"} Lvl 68”, a long red/orange HP bar, and the HP text “1,450,000/1,450,000 HP”. Bottom-left party status panel lists exactly 3 character rows with portraits, names, levels, HP, MP, and colored bars: “{argument name="hero one name" default="KAITO"} Lvl 65 HP 4820/5500 MP 120/120”, “{argument name="hero two name" default="RINA"} Lvl 63 HP 3550/3900 MP 280/300”, and “{argument name="hero three name" default="YUNA"} Lvl 62 HP 3800/4000 MP 310/320”. Right side command menu contains exactly 5 stacked beveled buttons labeled ATTACK, SKILL, ITEM, DEFEND, OVERDRIVE, with ATTACK highlighted in orange. Above the command menu, add the small location label “岩の廃墟”. Bottom-center attack name plaque with ornate gold trim displays “{argument name="attack name" default="蟹光線"}”.

Visual style: Highly polished AAA anime fantasy illustration, sharp character silhouettes, cinematic action composition, intense motion, volumetric light, magical particles, reflective armor, detailed crab texture, ornate gold UI frames, crisp readable text, no watermark, no extra characters, no extra menu options.

zh.title: 奇幻螃蟹 Boss 战 UI
zh.description: 生成一张电影级的 JRPG 战斗画面，展示三名英雄与巨型螃蟹 Boss 的对决，并包含完整的奇幻游戏 UI 覆盖层。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张极具戏剧性的奇幻 JRPG / 社交手游 Boss 战截图，展示一支小队正在对抗一只释放光束攻击的巨型螃蟹怪物。

画布：16:9 宽屏电影级游戏战斗画面，高细节动漫写实奇幻风格，深蓝色夜间色调，搭配鲜艳的青色魔法、橙色火花、爆炸、碎石以及强烈的泛光照明。

场景：暴风雨夜空下的废弃岩石战场，背景是破碎的石柱和燃烧的废墟。空中充斥着漂浮的碎片、余烬、闪电般的魔法能量和烟雾。镜头处于低位，位于英雄后方略侧，朝向巨大的 Boss。

Boss：一只巨大的装甲螃蟹敌人占据了画面的右上角和中心。它拥有 2 只高高举起的巨螯、多节的腿部、坚硬的蓝褐色甲壳、发光的高光部分以及令人生畏的面部。Boss 正从双螯之间发光的球体向英雄们发射一道耀眼的青白色魔法光束，在中心产生巨大的冲击闪光。

英雄：在前景展示 3 名可玩角色，均面向螃蟹 Boss。1) KAITO，一名深色头发的男性剑士，位于中左侧，正持发光的剑抵御光束。2) RINA，一名长发深色的女性法师或辅助战士，位于中右侧，手持法杖或魔杖，带有青蓝色魔法效果。3) YUNA，一名金发女性法师，身穿飘逸的蓝色长袍，位于最左侧，手持法杖并为小队施加蓝色的保护屏障。让小队看起来强大且英勇，呈现出顶级抽卡类 RPG 的战斗场景。

用户界面：添加精致的奇幻 RPG 战斗 UI 覆盖层。左上角的 Boss 面板包含一个小螃蟹头像图标，标签为“BOSS : ENEMY”，Boss 名称为“{argument name="boss name" default="アビサル・クロウ"} Lvl 68”，一条长长的红/橙色 HP 条，以及 HP 文本“1,450,000/1,450,000 HP”。左下角的小队状态面板列出 3 行角色信息，包含头像、名称、等级、HP、MP 和彩色条：“{argument name="hero one name" default="KAITO"} Lvl 65 HP 4820/5500 MP 120/120”、“{argument name="hero two name" default="RINA"} Lvl 63 HP 3550/3900 MP 280/300”以及“{argument name="hero three name" default="YUNA"} Lvl 62 HP 3800/4000 MP 310/320”。右侧指令菜单包含 5 个堆叠的斜角按钮，分别标注为 ATTACK、SKILL、ITEM、DEFEND、OVERDRIVE，其中 ATTACK 以橙色高亮显示。在指令菜单上方，添加小型的地点标签“岩の廃墟”。底部中央的攻击名称牌带有华丽的金色边框，显示“{argument name="attack name" default="蟹光線"}”。

视觉风格：高度精细的 AAA 级动漫奇幻插画，清晰的角色轮廓，电影级的动作构图，强烈的动感，体积光，魔法粒子，反光的盔甲，细腻的螃蟹纹理，华丽的金色 UI 边框，清晰易读的文字，无水印，无多余角色，无多余菜单选项。

en.title: Anime Mall Fashion Portrait
en.description: Generates a high-detail anime fashion portrait of a shy young woman leaning toward the viewer in a sunlit shopping mall.
en.prompt: Create a polished anime-style vertical portrait of a young woman in a bright modern indoor shopping mall, viewed from a slightly high, close-up perspective with subtle wide-angle distortion so her head and upper body feel near the camera. The character has a petite build, fair skin, soft blush, large brown eyes, a small neutral pouting mouth, and glossy dark brown bobbed hair with straight bangs and one side gathered into a high looped ponytail tied with a small blue band. She leans forward toward the viewer, shoulders slightly hunched in a shy pose, holding the edge of an off-shoulder white lace-trimmed blouse with her right hand; underneath, a turquoise floral camisole is visible. She wears a high-waisted denim skirt and carries a small white quilted shoulder bag with gold hardware on her left side. Include exactly 3 visible accessories on her: a silver ring, a pink beaded bracelet, and the white shoulder bag. The mall background should show a glass arched skylight ceiling, glossy reflective tile floor, storefronts, and softly blurred shoppers walking behind her; include readable but fictional store signs such as {argument name="store sign text" default="Lunessa"} and another partially visible boutique sign. Use warm sunlight streaming through the ceiling, bright highlights on the floor, soft rim lighting on hair and shoulders, detailed linework, delicate lace texture, glossy hair highlights, shallow depth of field, and a clean high-resolution anime illustration style. Character customization: {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"}, {argument name="eye color" default="brown"}, {argument name="outfit top" default="off-shoulder white lace-trimmed blouse over a turquoise floral camisole"}, {argument name="bottom garment" default="high-waisted denim skirt"}. Avoid nudity, keep the pose fashionable and non-explicit, no watermark, no extra text beyond store signage.

zh.title: 动漫商场时尚人像
zh.description: 生成一张在阳光明媚的购物中心里，一位害羞的年轻女性向观众倾身的精细动漫时尚人像。
zh.prompt: 创作一张精致的动漫风格竖版人像，背景为明亮的现代室内购物中心。采用略微俯视的特写视角，带有轻微的广角畸变，使人物头部和上半身显得靠近镜头。角色身材娇小，皮肤白皙，面带柔和的红晕，拥有棕色大眼睛、小巧且表情中性的嘟嘟嘴，以及有光泽的深棕色波波头，留着齐刘海，一侧扎成高高的环状马尾，并系着蓝色小发圈。她向观众前倾，双肩微耸，姿态害羞，右手抓着露肩白色蕾丝边上衣的边缘，内搭可见绿松石色碎花吊带衫。她身穿高腰牛仔裙，左侧背着一个带有金色五金配件的白色小号绗缝单肩包。画面中需包含 3 个清晰可见的配饰：一枚银戒指、一条粉色串珠手链以及那个白色单肩包。商场背景应展示玻璃拱形天窗、光亮的反射瓷砖地面、店面以及身后模糊走动的购物者；包含可读但虚构的店招，例如 {argument name="store sign text" default="Lunessa"} 以及另一个部分可见的精品店招牌。使用透过天窗射入的温暖阳光、地面上的明亮高光、发丝和肩部的柔和轮廓光、细腻的线条、精致的蕾丝纹理、有光泽的头发高光、浅景深，以及干净的高分辨率动漫插画风格。角色自定义：{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}, {argument name="eye color" default="棕色"}, {argument name="outfit top" default="露肩白色蕾丝边上衣内搭绿松石色碎花吊带衫"}, {argument name="bottom garment" default="高腰牛仔裙"}。避免裸露，保持姿势时尚且非色情，无水印，除店招外无额外文字。

en.title: Monochrome Idol Manga Preview Poster
en.description: Creates a dramatic black-and-white Japanese manga teaser poster with two central characters, concert-stage collage panels, and bold Japanese promotional typography.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic black-and-white Japanese manga promotional poster for a continuation preview, with glossy screentone rendering, cinematic lighting, idol-concert atmosphere, and dense collage composition.

Canvas: Vertical poster, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio. High-contrast monochrome manga art with a few selective red glow accents only in the bottom title text. Use rich ink blacks, white sparkle highlights, halftone gradients, speed lines, rain-like particles, stage haze, and lens flares.

Main subject details: Show exactly 2 main female characters in the center. Character 1 is an energetic idol singer on the left, long dark hair, large ribbon and flower hair ornament, frilly plaid idol costume, bracelets, holding a handheld microphone in her left hand while pointing sharply with her right hand, mouth open as if shouting or singing, intense determined eyes. Character 2 is a quiet young woman on the right, shoulder-length dark bob hair, round glasses, dark oversized hoodie, slightly hunched posture, one hand clutching the hoodie near her chest, looking conflicted and vulnerable toward the idol. They stand against a concert stage filled with glow sticks and spotlights, with a circular stage mark visible behind them.

Layout: Put a huge bold manga-style headline across the very top, angled slightly, with thick white lettering, black outline, star decorations, and speed-line background. Beneath it place a small centered tagline. The two main characters dominate the middle, separated by a diagonal emotional confrontation line from the idol’s pointing finger. Add exactly 5 secondary collage panels around the main scene: 1 small left inset showing the idol singing happily onstage with a microphone; 1 lower-left crowd panel filled with many glow sticks; 1 upper-right rectangular panel showing an empty lit stage and a dark long-haired figure watching from backstage, plus a tense hand at the edge; 1 right-middle still-life panel with a short glass of liquor with ice on a table beside rough papers or sketches; 1 lower-right close-up panel of a tearful eye and wet face, partially transparent over a rainy texture.

Text content: Use Japanese text as visible typography. Top headline: {argument name="top headline" default="ここまでのあらすじ"}. Small tagline under headline: {argument name="tagline" default="ステージの光は、まだ胸の奥に刺さっている"}. Center quote in three stacked lines: {argument name="center quote" default="戻りたいんじゃない。\n輝けなかった自分を、\nまだ許せないだけ。"}. Bottom dramatic question: {argument name="bottom question" default="アルバイトしにいったら\nアイドルに就職したのは\n何か間違い？"}. Author name at bottom center: {argument name="author name" default="Kai"}.

Typography: Make the top headline oversized and playful but dramatic. Make the center quote elegant white Mincho-style Japanese lettering. Make the bottom question large, layered, and theatrical, with the word “アイドル” much larger than the surrounding text and glowing red-white in an otherwise monochrome image. Add small starbursts around the bottom title.

Visual style: Professional seinen/shoujo hybrid manga poster, ultra-detailed line art, emotional idol-drama mood, polished magazine advertisement composition, crisp faces, sparkling concert lights, deep blacks, white rim lighting, rain and glass reflections, dramatic contrast. No full color except subtle red accent on the bottom title. Avoid modern UI elements, watermarks, logos, or extra characters beyond the 2 main characters and the silhouetted backstage figure in the inset panel.

zh.title: 黑白偶像漫画预告海报
zh.description: 创作一张极具戏剧性的黑白日本漫画预告海报，包含两位核心角色、演唱会舞台拼贴画格以及醒目的日文宣传排版。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张极具戏剧性的黑白日本漫画宣传海报，用于剧情续篇预告。要求采用光泽网点渲染、电影级光影、偶像演唱会氛围以及紧凑的拼贴构图。

画布：竖版海报，比例约为 2:3。高对比度黑白漫画风格，仅在底部标题文字处加入少许红色光晕点缀。使用浓郁的墨黑色、白色闪光高光、半调渐变、速度线、雨滴状颗粒、舞台烟雾及镜头光晕。

主体细节：画面中心展示 2 位女性角色。左侧角色 1 为充满活力的偶像歌手，留着长黑发，佩戴大蝴蝶结和花朵发饰，身穿褶边格子偶像服装，佩戴手镯，左手持麦克风，右手做出锐利的指向动作，嘴巴微张，仿佛在呐喊或歌唱，眼神坚定。右侧角色 2 为一名文静的年轻女性，留着齐肩黑色波波头，戴圆框眼镜，穿着深色大码连帽衫，姿势略显佝偻，一只手紧抓胸前的连帽衫，神情矛盾且脆弱地看向偶像。她们身后是布满荧光棒和聚光灯的演唱会舞台，背景可见圆形舞台标记。

布局：顶部放置巨大的粗体漫画风格标题，略微倾斜，采用厚实的白色字体，黑色描边，装饰有星星，并以速度线为背景。下方居中放置一行小字标语。两位主角占据画面中部，由偶像指向的手指划出一条情感对峙的对角线。在主场景周围添加 5 个辅助拼贴画格：1 个左侧小插图，展示偶像在舞台上快乐地手持麦克风歌唱；1 个左下角人群画格，填满荧光棒；1 个右上角矩形画格，展示空旷的灯光舞台，一名长发黑影在后台注视，边缘处有一只紧张的手；1 个右中部静物画格，展示桌上一杯加冰的酒，旁边放着粗糙的纸张或草图；1 个右下角特写画格，展示含泪的眼睛和湿润的脸庞，部分透明叠加在雨水纹理上。

文字内容：使用日文作为可见排版。顶部标题：{argument name="top headline" default="ここまでのあらすじ"}。标题下方小标语：{argument name="tagline" default="ステージの光は、まだ胸の奥に刺さっている"}。中心引语（三行堆叠）：{argument name="center quote" default="戻りたいんじゃない。\n輝けなかった自分を、\nまだ許せないだけ。"}。底部戏剧性提问：{argument name="bottom question" default="アルバイトしにいったら\nアイドルに就職したのは\n何か間違い？"}。底部居中作者名：{argument name="author name" default="Kai"}。

排版：顶部标题需超大且具有戏剧张力。中心引语采用优雅的白色明朝体日文。底部提问需大而有层次感，充满戏剧性，其中“アイドル”一词应比周围文字大得多，并在黑白画面中呈现红白发光效果。在底部标题周围添加小星芒。

视觉风格：专业的青年/少女漫画混合风格海报，超精细线稿，充满情感的偶像剧氛围，精致的杂志广告构图，面部清晰，闪烁的演唱会灯光，深邃的黑色，白色轮廓光，雨水与玻璃反射，戏剧性对比。除底部标题的细微红色点缀外，不使用全彩色。避免出现现代 UI 元素、水印、Logo，且除 2 位主角及插图中的后台剪影外，不添加额外角色。

en.title: Dark Noble Warrior Holding Cat
en.description: A cinematic fantasy portrait prompt for generating a handsome black-robed ancient Chinese noble warrior holding a black-and-white cat in a lantern-lit night market.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical fantasy portrait of a handsome young East Asian man, {argument name="character name" default="a mysterious noble warrior"}, standing in a crowded ancient Chinese night market street during light rain. He has pale skin, sharp refined features, a serious melancholic expression, and long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair tied half-up beneath an ornate dark metal crown with jagged black-gold points. He wears layered black hanfu-style robes with subtle embroidered patterns, leather wrist guards, a dark cloak, and a sheathed sword at his waist. He is holding exactly one cat in his arms: a white cat with black markings on the head, ears, back, and tail, alert golden eyes, and one paw extended over his sleeve. The man looks downward toward the cat, protective and introspective. Background: narrow old-town street with traditional wooden buildings on both sides, curved tiled rooftops, warm hanging paper lanterns, blurred pedestrians, wet reflective stone pavement, faint mist and smoke, deep blue night sky. Lighting should contrast warm orange lantern glow with cool moonlit blue shadows, creating dramatic rim light on hair, crown, robe folds, and the cat’s fur. Style: ultra-realistic cinematic historical fantasy, high-detail costume texture, shallow depth of field, atmospheric bokeh, moody romantic drama, vertical 9:16 composition, waist-up framing, centered subject. Avoid text, logos, modern objects, extra animals, distorted hands, or duplicate faces.

zh.title: 怀抱猫咪的暗黑贵族武士
zh.description: 这是一条电影级奇幻肖像提示词，用于生成一位身着黑袍、怀抱黑白猫咪的古代中国贵族武士，背景设定在灯火通明的夜市。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影级竖构图奇幻肖像，画面中是一位英俊的东亚年轻男子，{argument name="character name" default="一位神秘的贵族武士"}，正站在细雨中的古代中国夜市街道上。他皮肤白皙，五官精致凌厉，表情忧郁深沉，一头乌黑的长发半束，戴着一顶带有黑色与金色锯齿状装饰的华丽金属冠。他身着层叠的黑色汉服风格长袍，配有皮革护腕、深色斗篷，腰间佩戴着一把剑。他怀中抱着一只猫：这是一只白猫，头部、耳朵、背部和尾巴上有黑色斑纹，金色的眼睛充满警觉，一只爪子搭在他的袖子上。男子低头看向猫咪，神情充满保护欲且若有所思。背景：狭窄的古镇街道，两侧是传统的木质建筑，屋檐弯曲，悬挂着温暖的纸灯笼，背景中有模糊的行人，湿润的石板路映照着灯光，空气中弥漫着淡淡的雾气和烟火气，深蓝色的夜空。光影效果应形成对比：温暖的橙色灯笼光与清冷的月光蓝影交织，在头发、冠冕、长袍褶皱以及猫咪的毛发上勾勒出戏剧性的轮廓光。风格：超写实电影级历史奇幻，高细节服装纹理，浅景深，氛围感虚化，忧郁浪漫剧风格，9:16 竖构图，半身取景，主体居中。避免出现文字、Logo、现代物品、多余的动物、扭曲的手部或重复的面孔。

en.title: Paris Balcony Selfie
en.description: A photorealistic lifestyle prompt for creating a red-haired woman taking a breakfast selfie on a Paris balcony with the Eiffel Tower behind her.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic wide-angle selfie on a Parisian apartment balcony in warm morning sunlight. A young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="vivid red"} shoulder-length wavy hair, fair skin, blue-green eyes, subtle makeup, and a gentle confident smile holds the camera with her left arm extended toward the viewer, creating strong close-up foreground arm perspective. She wears a fitted short-sleeve {argument name="dress color" default="deep royal blue"} dress and holds a clear glass of orange juice in her right hand at waist level. The background shows an elegant Haussmann-style Paris street with cream stone buildings, wrought-iron balcony railing, leafy green trees, and the Eiffel Tower visible in the distance on the left, softly out of focus. On the right side of the balcony is a small round marble café table with exactly 5 visible breakfast items: 1 vase filled with white daisies, 1 white espresso cup on a saucer, 1 cappuccino cup on a saucer with latte foam, 1 golden croissant on a small plate, and 1 woven café chair behind the table. Use natural golden-hour lighting, realistic skin texture, crisp facial detail, shallow depth of field, vibrant but believable colors, elegant travel lifestyle photography, vertical 4:5 composition, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

zh.title: 巴黎阳台自拍
zh.description: 一个照片级真实感的时尚生活提示词，用于创作一位红发女性在巴黎阳台上以埃菲尔铁塔为背景拍摄早餐自拍的图像。
zh.prompt: 创作一张照片级真实感的广角自拍，场景位于巴黎公寓阳台，沐浴在温暖的晨光中。一位年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜红色"} 的齐肩波浪卷发，皮肤白皙，蓝绿色眼睛，妆容精致，带着自信温柔的微笑。她左臂向镜头方向伸展，营造出强烈的近景手臂透视感。她身穿修身短袖 {argument name="dress color" default="深宝蓝色"} 连衣裙，右手在腰部位置拿着一杯透明的橙汁。背景展示了优雅的奥斯曼风格巴黎街道，有奶油色的石砌建筑、锻铁阳台栏杆、葱郁的绿树，左侧远处可见埃菲尔铁塔，背景虚化柔和。阳台右侧是一张圆形小理石咖啡桌，桌上清晰可见 5 件早餐物品：1 个插满白雏菊的花瓶、1 个带托盘的白色浓缩咖啡杯、1 个带奶泡的卡布奇诺杯、1 个小盘子上的金色牛角面包，以及桌后的一把编织咖啡椅。采用自然的黄金时刻光影，真实的皮肤纹理，清晰的面部细节，浅景深，色彩鲜艳且真实，优雅的旅行生活摄影风格，4:5 竖构图，无文字，无水印，无多余人物。

en.title: Neon Cosmic Anime Portrait
en.description: Generates a dramatic painterly anime-realism portrait of a woman surrounded by red and blue cosmic light, ideal for expressive AI art posts.
en.prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 digital painting portrait of a young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long messy black hair"}, turning her bare shoulder toward the viewer while looking back over it with a soft, melancholic expression. Her face is close to the camera, delicate and luminous, with flushed cheeks, parted glossy lips, fine eyelashes, and large reflective eyes containing tiny star-like multicolor highlights. Strands of windblown hair cross her face and eyes, creating an intimate, slightly chaotic composition. The background is an abstract cosmic darkness filled with energetic paint splashes, glowing particles, and nebula-like strokes, split between fiery red-orange light on the left and deep electric blue-violet light on the right. Use dramatic rim lighting: warm red highlights catching the left side of her hair and skin, cool blue highlights along the right side and shoulder, with painterly brush texture, high contrast, rich saturated color, and a dreamy cinematic anime-realism style. Her clothing is mostly hidden, suggesting a simple black sleeveless top or dress. Add a small elegant artist mark in the bottom-right corner with the date {argument name="date text" default="July 23, 2026"} and a handwritten signature {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}. No other text, no frame, no watermark beyond the small signature.

zh.title: 霓虹宇宙动漫肖像
zh.description: 生成一张极具戏剧性的油画风格动漫写实肖像，描绘一位被红蓝宇宙光芒环绕的女性，非常适合用于表达性 AI 艺术发布。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 2:3 比例的竖版数字绘画肖像，主角是一位年轻女性，拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="凌乱的长黑发"}。她将裸露的肩膀转向观众，同时回头注视，表情柔和而忧郁。她的面部特写镜头细腻且富有光泽，脸颊泛红，双唇微张且带有光泽，睫毛纤细，大眼睛中倒映着细小的星光般的多彩高光。被风吹乱的发丝掠过脸庞和双眼，营造出一种亲密且略带凌乱的构图。背景是抽象的宇宙黑暗，充满了充满活力的颜料飞溅、发光粒子和星云般的笔触，左侧是炽热的红橙色光芒，右侧是深邃的电光紫蓝色光芒。运用戏剧性的轮廓光：温暖的红色高光捕捉她左侧的发丝和皮肤，冷蓝色高光沿着右侧和肩膀延伸，呈现出油画笔触、高对比度、色彩浓郁且梦幻的电影级动漫写实风格。她的衣着大部分被遮挡，暗示着一件简单的黑色无袖上衣或连衣裙。在右下角添加一个优雅的小型艺术家标记，包含日期 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 7 月 23 日"} 和手写签名 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。除该小签名外，不包含其他文字、边框或水印。

en.title: Minimal Studio Fashion Portrait
en.description: A realistic vertical fashion portrait prompt for generating a young woman in a leather jacket, silver crop top, and pleated skirt against a clean studio wall.
en.prompt: Create a realistic full-body studio fashion portrait of {argument name="character description" default="a young East Asian woman with fair skin, long wavy dark brown hair, and straight wispy bangs"} standing against a plain off-white wall. She faces the camera with a calm, slightly serious expression, hands tucked into her skirt pockets, one leg crossed casually in front of the other. The styling has exactly 7 visible fashion/accessory elements: a cropped black leather biker jacket with silver snaps and zippers, a shiny silver twisted-knot crop top exposing the midriff, a high-waisted gray pleated mini skirt, black lace-up ankle boots, layered silver necklaces including a choker, long dangling earrings, and subtle natural makeup. Use soft daylight from the upper left, clean minimal background, gentle wall shadow to her right, realistic skin texture, sharp focus, vertical 3:4 composition, fashion editorial look, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 极简摄影棚时尚人像
zh.description: 一个写实的竖版时尚人像提示词，用于生成一位身穿皮夹克、银色露脐上衣和百褶裙，背景为干净摄影棚墙面的年轻女性。
zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的全身摄影棚时尚人像，主体为 {argument name="character description" default="一位皮肤白皙、留着深棕色长波浪卷发和直薄刘海的年轻东亚女性"}，背景为一面纯净的灰白色墙壁。她面向镜头，表情平静且略带严肃，双手插在裙子口袋里，一条腿随意地交叉在另一条腿前。造型包含 7 个清晰可见的时尚/配饰元素：一件带有银色按扣和拉链的黑色短款皮质机车夹克、一件露出腰部的银色扭结露脐上衣、一条高腰灰色百褶短裙、黑色系带短靴、叠戴的银色项链（含颈圈）、长款吊坠耳环以及精致的自然妆容。使用来自左上方的柔和日光，背景简洁极简，右侧带有柔和的墙面阴影，皮肤纹理真实，焦点清晰，采用 3:4 竖构图，呈现时尚杂志大片质感，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Japanese Pediatric Disease Infographic
en.description: A cute Japanese clinic flyer explaining hand-foot-and-mouth disease and herpangina for parents.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a friendly Japanese medical explanation infographic for parents about {argument name="topic title" default="手足口病とヘルパンギーナ"}, suitable for use in a pediatric clinic consultation room.

Canvas: Vertical portrait flyer, warm off-white paper background, soft hand-drawn watercolor style, rounded corners, pastel colors, clear black handwritten Japanese text. Add small decorative confetti marks around the title. Overall look should be cute, reassuring, and easy to understand.

Layout: Use exactly 5 stacked rounded rectangular information panels, each with a large numbered circle on the left. Panel 1 has a pink border, panel 2 blue, panel 3 yellow-orange, panel 4 green, panel 5 orange with a scalloped decorative border. Keep generous margins and make all text large and legible.

Title: At the top, write 「手足口病とヘルパンギーナ」 in large dark brown handwritten lettering with a pink wavy underline.

Panel 1, number 1, pink: Write 「手・足・口に小さな水疱、おしりにも」. Include exactly 4 medical illustrations in a row: an open palm with small red blisters, a sole of a foot with small red blisters, an open mouth/throat with red spots, and a diapered bottom/thigh area with red spots. At the bottom add a small sun icon and the note 「夏〜秋に小さい子に多い」.

Panel 2, number 2, blue: Write 「原因はコクサッキーウイルス」 and smaller text 「ありふれたかぜのウイルス」. On the right draw exactly 1 cute round blue virus mascot with tiny spikes, eyes, a smiling mouth, and small motion lines.

Panel 3, number 3, yellow-orange: Show a simple Venn diagram with exactly 2 overlapping large translucent circles: left circle pink, right circle light blue, overlap pale green. Left circle text: 「のどの奥に白い水疱→ヘルパンギーナ」. Right circle text: 「手のひら・足のうらに発疹→手足口病」. Under the circles write: 「原因ではなく『どこに出たか』でつけた病名。ヘルパンギーナでも全身に発疹が出ることがあり、厳密には区別できない」.

Panel 4, number 4, green: Write 「特効薬なし・対症療法」 and smaller text 「約1週間で治る」. Include exactly 4 supportive-care illustrations: a glass of water, a sleeping child tucked in bed, a digital thermometer showing 36.6°C, and a smiling child in a green striped shirt raising one fist.

Panel 5, number 5, orange: Headline in large orange text: 「登園の目安」. List exactly 2 numbered conditions: 「① 熱がない」 and 「② 普通にご飯が食べられる」. Add a large emphasized orange message: 「発疹が残っていても 普通の生活・登園OK」. Smaller explanatory text at the bottom: 「ウイルスは治った後も長く出続けるので、発疹が消えるまで待つ意味はありません」. On the right draw a cheerful preschool child wearing a yellow hat, blue backpack, striped shirt, blue shorts, and sneakers, running or waving toward a small school building with flowers.

Constraints: Use exactly 5 numbered panels and the exact Japanese text above. Do not add extra sections, extra medical claims, logos, watermarks, QR codes, or English translations. Keep the illustration soft, pediatric, non-scary, and clinically clear.

zh.title: 日本儿科疾病科普信息图
zh.description: 一张亲切的日本诊所海报，用于科普手足口病、疱疹性咽峡炎、症状、治疗方法及入托指南。
zh.prompt:
目标：为诊所诊室制作一张温馨、适合儿童的日本医疗科普信息图，解释手足口病与疱疹性咽峡炎的区别，并包含入托指南。

画布：竖版海报，纵向布局，奶油色纸张背景，柔和的粉彩色调，圆润的手绘风格，适合儿科诊所。使用粗体深褐色手写体日文，水彩风格的医学插图，以及彩色的圆角矩形。顶部大标题：「手足口病とヘルパンギーナ」，配有小装饰性五彩纸屑标记和粉色波浪下划线。

布局：从上到下垂直排列 5 个编号部分，每个部分置于带有不同强调色的圆角矩形卡片内。左侧使用大型圆形数字徽章：1 号粉色，2 号蓝色，3 号橙色，4 号绿色，5 号橙色。保持设计清晰，方便家长快速阅读。

第 1 部分：粉色边框卡片。标题文字：「手・足・口に小さな水疱、おしりにも」。横向展示 4 个医学插图：带有小红疹的张开手掌、带有红疹的脚底、带有溃疡的张开的嘴/喉咙、以及带有红疹的婴儿臀部/大腿。下方添加一个小太阳图标和文字：「夏〜秋に小さい子に多い」。

第 2 部分：蓝色边框卡片。标题文字：「原因はコクサッキーウイルス」。小字：「ありふれたかぜのウイルス」。右侧绘制一个可爱的圆形蓝色病毒角色，带有小突起、笑脸和蓝色强调标记。

第 3 部分：黄色边框卡片。创建一个包含 2 个重叠半透明圆圈的维恩图：左侧圆圈为粉色，右侧圆圈为蓝色，重叠部分为淡绿色。左侧圆圈文字：「のどの奥に 白い水疱 →ヘルパンギーナ」。右侧圆圈文字：「手のひら・足のうらに発疹 →手足口病」。图表下方添加说明文字：「原因ではなく『どこに出たか』でつけた病名。ヘルパンギーナでも全身に発疹が出ることがあり、厳密には区別できない」。

第 4 部分：绿色边框卡片。标题文字：「特効薬なし・対症療法」。小字：「約1週間で治る」。包含 4 个支持性护理插图：一杯水、一个盖着蓝色毯子（带有月亮和星星）睡觉的孩子、一个显示约 36.6°C 的数字体温计、以及一个穿着绿色条纹衬衫、举起拳头欢呼康复的孩子。

第 5 部分：橙色扇形边框卡片。大标题文字：「登園の目安」。包含 2 个清单条件：「① 熱がない」和「② 普通にご飯が食べられる」。添加一条醒目的橙色信息：「発疹が残っていても 普通の生活・登園OK」。添加小字备注：「ウイルスは治った後も長く出続けるので、発疹が消えるまで待つ意味はありません」。右侧绘制一个快乐的小男孩，戴着黄色帽子，穿着条纹衬衫、短裤，背着蓝色书包，正走向幼儿园；包含一个带有时钟和简单花朵的学校建筑。

视觉风格：可爱的日本托儿所健康宣传单，柔和的水彩阴影，圆角，简洁的间距，粉色/蓝色/黄色/绿色/橙色柔和色调，无生硬的写实感，无恐怖的症状表现。确保所有文字清晰且拼写正确。

可自定义文本槽：使用标题 {argument name="poster title" default="手足口病とヘルパンギーナ"}，主要疾病名称 {argument name="main disease" default="手足口病"}，对比疾病名称 {argument name="comparison disease" default="ヘルパンギーナ"}，病毒名称 {argument name="virus name" default="コクサッキーウイルス"}，以及入托指南标题 {argument name="attendance headline" default="登園の目安"}。

en.title: Morning Selfie With Tabby Cat
en.description: A photorealistic square smartphone-style indoor portrait of a young woman leaning close to the camera with one tabby cat standing behind her in morning light.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic square indoor selfie-style image shot with a wide-angle smartphone camera in warm morning sunlight. In the extreme foreground on the right side, show a young adult Japanese woman with {argument name="hair color" default="short dark brown hair"}, slightly messy bangs, natural makeup, soft brown eyes, and a calm neutral expression, leaning very close toward the camera so only the right half of her face, shoulder, upper torso, and bent legs are visible. She wears a {argument name="top" default="white ribbed tank top"} and {argument name="bottoms" default="dark gray shorts"}. Behind her on the left, show exactly 1 domestic short-haired tabby cat standing on a wooden floor, facing the camera with alert green eyes and a serious expression, positioned like a companion or parent cat watching over her. The room is a bright apartment interior with a large window and pale curtains in the background, soft city buildings outside, a low beige cabinet on the left, warm sun patches and long shadows across the wood floor, and shallow depth of field that keeps both the woman and cat fairly sharp while the background is softly blurred. Use natural skin texture, realistic cat fur, cinematic daylight, intimate casual composition, no extra people or animals. Add a subtle semi-transparent white watermark reading {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"} in the lower-left corner.

zh.title: 与虎斑猫的清晨自拍
zh.description: 一张照片级写实的方形智能手机风格室内肖像，一位年轻女性靠近镜头，身后站着一只虎斑猫，沐浴在清晨的阳光中。
zh.prompt: 创作一张照片级写实的方形室内自拍风格图像，使用智能手机广角镜头在温暖的清晨阳光下拍摄。在右侧的极近景处，展示一位年轻的日本女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色短发"}，刘海略显凌乱，妆容自然，棕色双眸柔和，表情平静自然，身体极度靠近镜头，仅露出她右半边的脸庞、肩膀、上半身和弯曲的双腿。她身穿 {argument name="top" default="白色罗纹背心"} 和 {argument name="bottoms" default="深灰色短裤"}。在她左后方，展示 1 只站在木地板上的短毛虎斑猫，正对着镜头，眼神警觉，表情严肃，如同陪伴者或守护她的猫咪家长。房间为明亮的公寓内景，背景有大窗户和浅色窗帘，窗外可见模糊的城市建筑，左侧有一个低矮的米色柜子，温暖的阳光斑点和长长的阴影投射在木地板上，浅景深效果使女性和猫咪保持清晰，背景则呈现柔和的虚化。使用自然的皮肤纹理、逼真的猫毛质感、电影级日光效果，构图亲密随性，画面中无其他人物或动物。在左下角添加一个微妙的半透明白色水印，文字为 {argument name="watermark text" default="Alconia"}。

en.title: Rainy Night Romantic Street Portrait
en.description: A cinematic photorealistic prompt for creating an intimate couple portrait in warm rain-soaked available light.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic vertical portrait of an intimate rainy-night scene outside an elegant old European storefront or café window. Two adults stand extremely close beneath warm available light: a {argument name="woman description" default="beautiful woman with long wet dark wavy hair, olive skin, wearing an oversized dark charcoal blazer over a low dark top"} leans back against the rain-speckled glass, looking up with parted lips, while a {argument name="man description" default="handsome tall man with wet curly dark hair, light stubble, white dress shirt with sleeves down, black waistcoat and dark trousers"} faces her in profile, head tilted down toward her, one hand in his pocket. Their faces are inches apart, creating romantic tension without kissing. Use only practical available light from the glowing shop window and distant street lamps, with amber reflections, rain droplets on glass, wet fabric, and strong subsurface scattering on wet skin. The window shows partial vintage lettering reading {argument name="window lettering" default="RIVERA"}. Background is a dark narrow street with soft golden bokeh lights and shallow depth of field. Style: high-end cinematic editorial photography, 85mm lens look, natural skin texture, moody warm color grading, realistic rain, glossy highlights, soft shadows, intimate composition, no flash, no studio lighting, no text overlays beyond the storefront lettering.

zh.title: 雨夜浪漫街头肖像
zh.description: 一个电影级写实风格的提示词，用于创作在温暖雨夜自然光下亲密的双人肖像。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影级写实风格的竖版肖像，展现优雅的欧洲老式店面或咖啡馆窗外亲密的雨夜场景。两名成年人站在温暖的自然光下，距离极近：一位 {argument name="woman description" default="美丽的女性，留着湿漉漉的深色长波浪卷发，橄榄色皮肤，穿着超大号深炭灰色西装外套，内搭深色低领上衣"} 靠在布满雨滴的玻璃上，微微仰头，双唇微张；一位 {argument name="man description" default="英俊的高个男性，留着湿漉漉的深色卷发，留着浅浅的胡茬，身穿白色衬衫，袖子放下，搭配黑色马甲和深色长裤"} 侧身面对她，头向下倾斜，一只手插在口袋里。两人的脸仅有几英寸之隔，营造出一种未接吻的浪漫张力。仅使用发光店面橱窗和远处路灯提供的实用自然光，呈现琥珀色的倒影、玻璃上的雨滴、湿润的织物以及湿润皮肤上强烈的次表面散射效果。窗户上显示部分复古字体，写着 {argument name="window lettering" default="RIVERA"}。背景是昏暗狭窄的街道，带有柔和的金色光斑和浅景深。风格：高端电影级编辑摄影，85mm 镜头质感，自然的皮肤纹理，情绪化的暖色调，逼真的雨水，光泽高光，柔和阴影，亲密的构图，无闪光灯，无影棚灯光，除店面文字外无任何文字叠加。

en.title: Explosive Classical Composer Artwork
en.description: A dramatic cinematic prompt for generating a classical composer consumed by fiery musical chaos and emotional intensity.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic widescreen 16:9 digital artwork showing {argument name="character" default="a Romantic-era classical composer and pianist"} in dramatic side-profile at the center-left, wearing a black 19th-century formal suit, white shirt, and cravat, eyes closed and face lifted as if overwhelmed by music. Place a black grand piano in the lower left, partly swallowed by dark ink splatter. The background should be split emotionally: on the left, an aged parchment beige wall with faint stains, scratches, and flowing curved musical staff lines with black notes; on the right, an explosive abstract burst of {argument name="energy color" default="red, orange, and black"} like a violent emotional gunfight, with sparks, shards, ink, smoke, and radial speed lines shooting outward. Add floating sheet-music fragments, bright white and black musical notes, violin/cello silhouettes, strings, and glowing streaks flying through the composition. Make the composer’s hair and upper body dissolve into the explosion, with black splatter transitioning into fiery particles. Use high contrast chiaroscuro lighting, painterly photorealistic textures, intense motion, dramatic orchestral energy, no text, no watermark, no frame.

zh.title: 古典音乐家爆炸艺术风格创作
zh.description: 一个极具戏剧张力的电影感提示词，用于生成沉浸在炽热音乐混沌与强烈情感中的古典音乐家形象。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 16:9 宽屏电影感数字艺术作品，画面左侧中心展示一位 {argument name="character" default="浪漫主义时期的古典音乐家兼钢琴家"} 的戏剧性侧面轮廓，身着 19 世纪黑色礼服、白色衬衫和领结，双眼紧闭，面部向上，仿佛沉浸在音乐的海洋中。画面左下方放置一架黑色三角钢琴，部分被黑色墨迹吞没。背景在情感上呈现分裂感：左侧为带有淡淡污渍、划痕的陈旧羊皮纸米色墙面，上面绘有流动的弯曲五线谱和黑色音符；右侧为 {argument name="energy color" default="红色、橙色和黑色"} 的爆炸性抽象爆发，如同激烈的感官交火，伴随着火花、碎片、墨水、烟雾和向外放射的速度线。画面中加入漂浮的乐谱碎片、明亮的黑白音符、小提琴/大提琴轮廓、琴弦以及穿梭于构图中的发光线条。让音乐家的头发和上半身融入爆炸之中，黑色墨迹渐变为炽热的粒子。采用高对比度的明暗对照法照明，具有绘画感的照片级真实纹理，充满强烈的动感与戏剧性的管弦乐能量，无文字，无水印，无边框。

en.title: Retro Diner Milkshake Portrait
en.description: A nostalgic vertical film photo of a young woman drinking a milkshake on a vintage car outside a neon diner.
en.prompt: Create a candid 35mm film-style lifestyle photo of a young woman at a retro American diner during golden hour. She is sitting casually on the hood of a cream-colored vintage station wagon with wood paneling, parked directly outside the diner. The woman has {argument name="hair color" default="long dark brown wavy hair"}, olive-toned skin, thick eyebrows, and a relaxed, slightly smiling expression while looking off to the side rather than at the camera. She wears a {argument name="jacket style" default="navy varsity jacket with white striped cuffs"}, a light ribbed tank top, high-waisted loose blue jeans, white socks with stripes, and black-and-white sneakers. She holds a tall pale milkshake with whipped cream and a red-and-white striped straw near her mouth. On the car hood beside her is exactly 1 red plastic diner basket lined with paper, containing fries or snacks, plus exactly 1 small paper cup. The background shows a busy old-fashioned diner strip with neon signs and warm signage, including visible diner-themed words like “EAT,” “FRIES,” “DINER,” and a Coca-Cola sign; include large windows with seated customers inside, chrome trim, parked cars, string lights overhead, and a sunset sky. Use warm backlighting, soft haze, natural film grain, muted nostalgic colors, slight lens softness, realistic skin texture, and an unposed documentary feel. Frame vertically in a 2:3 portrait composition, with the woman centered on the car hood and the diner storefront filling the upper left background. Avoid a polished fashion-shoot look, avoid modern cars dominating the scene, and do not add extra text beyond plausible diner signage.

zh.title: 复古餐厅奶昔人像
zh.description: 一张怀旧风格的竖版胶片照片，展示了一位年轻女性在霓虹灯餐厅外的老爷车上喝奶昔的场景。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 35mm 胶片风格的抓拍生活照，展现一位年轻女性在黄金时刻身处复古美式餐厅的场景。她随意地坐在停在餐厅外一辆奶油色木纹复古旅行车的引擎盖上。这位女性拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="一头深棕色长波浪卷发"}、橄榄色皮肤、浓密的眉毛，表情轻松且带着一丝微笑，视线看向侧方而非镜头。她穿着 {argument name="jacket style" default="一件带有白色条纹袖口的深蓝色棒球夹克"}、浅色罗纹背心、高腰宽松牛仔裤、条纹白袜以及黑白运动鞋。她手中拿着一杯插着红白条纹吸管、顶部有奶油的浅色奶昔，靠近嘴边。车引擎盖上放着 1 个铺着衬纸的红色塑料餐厅篮，里面装着薯条或零食，旁边还有 1 个小纸杯。背景是繁忙的老式餐厅街区，带有霓虹灯和暖色调招牌，可见“EAT”、“FRIES”、“DINER”等餐厅主题词汇以及可口可乐标志；背景中还包括带有室内顾客的大窗户、镀铬装饰、停放的车辆、头顶的串灯以及落日余晖。使用温暖的逆光、柔和的雾感、自然的胶片颗粒、低饱和度的怀旧色彩、轻微的镜头柔焦、真实的皮肤纹理，营造出一种非摆拍的纪实感。采用 2:3 的竖构图，女性位于车引擎盖中心，餐厅店面填充左上方背景。避免过于精致的时尚大片感，避免现代车辆占据画面，除合理的餐厅招牌外，请勿添加额外文字。

en.title: Cinematic Mountain Portrait With OpenArt Watermark
en.description: A photorealistic cinematic portrait of a rugged man in a leather jacket against a foggy alpine mountain backdrop, suitable for dramatic ad-style visuals.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic portrait of a rugged {argument name="character description" default="young adult man with dark messy curly hair, light stubble, sharp cheekbones, intense eyes, and a serious expression"} standing outdoors in a misty alpine mountain landscape. He is shown from the chest up in a three-quarter pose, body turned slightly away while looking directly back at the camera over his shoulder. He wears a weathered dark brown-black leather jacket with a raised collar, visible seams, worn texture, and subtle rain or dust marks. The background is a dramatic, desaturated mountain valley with steep gray cliffs, blurred evergreen forest, low clouds, fog, and a cold overcast sky; use shallow depth of field so the man is sharply focused and the landscape is soft and atmospheric. Lighting should feel natural and cinematic, with soft diffused daylight, muted green-gray tones, high detail in skin and jacket texture, and a moody commercial-film aesthetic. Add a large centered semi-transparent white watermark/logo reading {argument name="watermark text" default="OpenArt"} with an abstract infinity-like icon to the left, spanning across the subject’s chest and face area. Square 1:1 composition, close portrait framing, ultra-realistic photography, 35mm cinematic lens feel, no extra text or objects.

zh.title: 带有 OpenArt 水印的电影感山景人像
zh.description: 一张写实风格的电影感人像，展现了一位身穿皮夹克的硬汉，背景为雾气缭绕的高山，适合用于戏剧性的广告风格视觉内容。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影级写实人像，主角为 {argument name="character description" default="一位年轻男性，留着深色凌乱卷发，带有浅胡茬，颧骨轮廓分明，眼神犀利，表情严肃"}，背景为雾气弥漫的高山景观。画面采用半身像构图，主角呈四分之三侧身姿态，身体微微转开，同时转头越过肩膀直视镜头。他身穿一件做旧的深棕黑色皮夹克，领口立起，缝线清晰，质感磨损，并带有细微的雨水或灰尘痕迹。背景是戏剧性的、低饱和度的山谷，有着陡峭的灰色悬崖、模糊的常青森林、低垂的云层、浓雾以及阴冷的天空；使用浅景深效果，使人物焦点清晰，背景柔和且富有氛围感。光线应自然且具有电影感，采用柔和的漫射日光，色调为柔和的灰绿色，皮肤和夹克纹理细节丰富，呈现出一种情绪化的商业电影美学。在画面中心添加一个大型半透明白色水印/Logo，文字为 {argument name="watermark text" default="OpenArt"}，左侧配有一个抽象的类似无限符号的图标，横跨在主体的胸部和面部区域。1:1 正方形构图，特写人像取景，超写实摄影风格，35mm 电影镜头质感，不包含额外文字或物体。

en.title: Cosmic Glitch Rocket Launch
en.description: A vertical neon sci-fi poster of a rocket launching through a cosmic portal above a lone tree, ideal for surreal space fantasy artwork.
en.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 cinematic sci-fi fantasy poster showing a lone black silhouette tree on a grassy hill in the foreground, centered beneath a colossal rocket launch. A slim white rocket rises straight upward from the exact center, its exhaust forming a blinding orange-white flame column that transforms into a towering cascade of glitch-like pixel blocks, vertical light bars, and fragmented digital artifacts in neon red, magenta, orange, cyan, and violet, making the launch plume look like a corrupted digital data stream. Surround the launch with huge glowing red-orange smoke clouds near the horizon and a futuristic luminous grid city or launch complex spreading across the ground. Above, create a vast circular cosmic sky framed by dark storm clouds like a portal, with spiraling star trails around the rocket, a bright purple-blue Milky Way, dense stars, and electric nebula colors. Include exactly eight visible planets or moons: one large striped planet on the upper left, one large Earth-like planet on the upper right, one small moon near the upper right, one small moon on the mid-right, one small orange planet on the lower left of the sky, one small blue planet near the lower-left edge, one tiny dark planet near the far lower-left edge, and one small ringed planet on the lower right. Use extremely high contrast, hyper-detailed digital painting, saturated neon cosmic colors, dramatic lighting, sharp central symmetry, epic scale, no text, no logo, no watermark.

zh.title: 宇宙故障火箭发射
zh.description: 一张垂直霓虹科幻海报，描绘了火箭穿过孤树上方的宇宙传送门发射的场景，是超现实太空奇幻艺术的理想之选。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 9:16 垂直电影感科幻奇幻海报，前景为草丘上的一棵黑色剪影孤树，正下方是巨大的火箭发射场景。一枚纤细的白色火箭从正中心笔直升起，其尾焰形成一道耀眼的橙白色火焰柱，并转化为高耸的故障风格像素块、垂直光条以及霓虹红、洋红、橙色、青色和紫色的碎片化数字伪影，使发射烟流看起来像是一股损坏的数字数据流。在发射点周围，地平线附近环绕着巨大的发光红橙色烟云，地面上铺开着未来感十足的发光网格城市或发射场。上方绘制一个由深色风暴云框住的巨大圆形宇宙天空，如同传送门一般，火箭周围环绕着螺旋状星轨，呈现出明亮的紫蓝色银河、密集的恒星和电光般的星云色彩。画面中需包含正好八颗可见的行星或卫星：左上方一颗巨大的条纹行星，右上方一颗巨大的类地行星，右上方附近一颗小卫星，中右侧一颗小卫星，天空左下方一颗小橙色行星，左下边缘附近一颗小蓝色行星，远左下边缘附近一颗微小的暗色行星，以及右下方一颗带光环的小行星。采用极高对比度、超精细数字绘画、高饱和度霓虹宇宙色彩、戏剧性光影、严谨的中心对称构图、史诗级规模，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

en.title: Anime Yukata Festival Alley
en.description: A cinematic vertical anime scene of a yukata-clad girl holding a candied apple in a lantern-lit rainy festival alley beneath fireworks.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical anime illustration of a young Japanese woman at a summer festival standing in a narrow old-fashioned shopping alley at night. She is shown from behind in a three-quarter turn, looking back softly toward the viewer with a calm, wistful expression, holding one glossy red candied apple on a stick near her face. She wears a dark navy yukata with pale floral patterns and a warm ochre obi tied in a bow at the back; her dark brown hair is loosely pinned up with stray windblown strands and one pale flower hair ornament. The alley is covered by a high arched glass-and-metal arcade roof with an opening to the night sky, where a large golden firework explodes directly above the street. Surround both sides with aged wooden storefronts, closed metal shutters, hanging Japanese shop signs, and glowing orange paper lanterns; include wet stone pavement reflecting lantern light, fireworks, and shop lights after rain. Use exactly these main visible repeated elements: 1 female subject, 1 candied apple, 1 large firework burst, 1 prominent hair flower, 1 back obi bow, multiple Japanese lanterns and shop signs receding into depth. Style should be highly detailed modern anime key visual, dramatic perspective looking down the alley, warm amber lighting mixed with cool blue night shadows, volumetric mist and steam, sparkling firework embers, glossy reflections, shallow depth of field, richly textured architecture, romantic nostalgic mood, no modern cars, no watermark, no readable English text.

zh.title: 动漫浴衣祭典小巷
zh.description: 一幅电影感十足的竖版动漫场景，描绘了一位身着浴衣的女孩在灯火通明的雨后祭典小巷中，手持糖苹果，背景是绚烂的烟花。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅电影感十足的竖版动漫插画，描绘一位年轻日本女性在夏日祭典期间，站在夜晚狭窄的复古商业街小巷中。画面展示她从背后四分之三侧转，温柔地回眸看向观众，表情平静而怀旧，手中拿着一颗光泽诱人的红色糖苹果靠近脸庞。她身穿深蓝色浴衣，上面印有浅色花卉图案，背后系着暖赭色的腰带蝴蝶结；深棕色长发松散地盘起，几缕发丝随风飘动，发间别着一朵浅色花饰。小巷上方覆盖着高大的拱形玻璃金属顶棚，顶棚留有开口通向夜空，一朵巨大的金色烟花在街道正上方绽放。小巷两侧布满了古老的木质店面、关闭的金属卷帘门、悬挂的日式招牌以及发光的橙色纸灯笼；地面是雨后湿漉漉的石板路，倒映着灯笼、烟花和商店的灯光。请严格包含以下主要视觉元素：1 位女性主体、1 颗糖苹果、1 朵巨大的烟花爆裂、1 朵显眼的发饰花朵、1 个背部腰带蝴蝶结、多个向深处延伸的日式灯笼和店招。风格应为细节丰富、现代动漫风格的视觉主图，采用俯瞰小巷的戏剧性视角，暖琥珀色灯光与冷蓝色夜影交织，营造出体积雾和蒸汽感、闪烁的烟花余烬、光泽倒影、浅景深、质感丰富的建筑细节，以及浪漫怀旧的氛围。画面中无现代汽车，无水印，无任何可辨识的英文字符。

en.title: Data Center GPT-X Monster Hunt
en.description: A cinematic cyberpunk poster showing a boar exterminator chasing a black GPT-X creature through a server room.
en.prompt: Create a dramatic cinematic sci-fi action illustration inside a dark data center at night. A stocky anthropomorphic wild boar exterminator lunges from the left, wearing a navy cap labeled 「作者」, black sunglasses, a beige work shirt with a sleeve patch also labeled 「作者」, blue jeans, heavy sandals, gloves, and a large metal pesticide tank strapped to his back. He is swinging a huge circular insect-catching net with motion blur, trying to capture a glossy black liquid-metal insect/bug creature skittering across the wet reflective floor on the right. The creature has a round tar-like body, sharp spider-crab legs, splashing black droplets, and glowing red text {argument name="creature label" default="GPT-X"} on its body. Across the very top, add a large bold Japanese headline in distressed off-white lettering reading {argument name="headline text" default="データセンターからの物体"}, followed by oversized red text {argument name="red title text" default="GPT-X"}. The background should show tall server racks with green and blue indicator lights, industrial cooling units, cables, mist, dramatic shafts of light, and a monitor on the right reading “AI RESEARCH” with a glowing brain diagram. Use a gritty cyberpunk monster-movie poster style, high contrast, teal-blue shadows, red glow accents, dynamic perspective, rain-slick reflections, smoke, debris, and intense motion. Keep exactly two visible Japanese 「作者」 labels on the boar character, exactly one “AI RESEARCH” screen, and exactly two main characters: the boar hunter and the black GPT-X creature.

zh.title: 数据中心 GPT-X 怪兽猎杀
zh.description: 一张电影质感的赛博朋克海报，描绘了一名野猪灭虫员在服务器机房中追捕黑色 GPT-X 生物的场景。
zh.prompt: 创作一张极具电影感的科幻动作插画，场景设定在深夜昏暗的数据中心。画面左侧，一名身材魁梧的拟人化野猪灭虫员正向前猛扑，他头戴印有「作者」字样的海军蓝鸭舌帽，佩戴黑色墨镜，身穿米色工作衬衫（袖口同样印有「作者」字样），下身穿着蓝色牛仔裤，脚蹬厚重的凉鞋，戴着手套，背上背着一个巨大的金属杀虫剂罐。他挥舞着一个巨大的圆形捕虫网，带有动态模糊效果，试图捕捉右侧在湿滑反光地面上疾驰的黑色液态金属昆虫生物。该生物拥有圆形的焦油状躯干、锋利的蜘蛛蟹式长腿，溅起黑色液滴，身上带有发光的红色文字 {argument name="creature label" default="GPT-X"}。在画面最上方，添加一行醒目的粗体日文标题，采用做旧的灰白色字体，内容为 {argument name="headline text" default="データセンターからの物体"}，随后是超大的红色文字 {argument name="red title text" default="GPT-X"}。背景应展示高大的服务器机架，上面闪烁着绿色和蓝色的指示灯，配有工业冷却装置、电缆、薄雾、戏剧性的光束，右侧的显示器上显示着“AI RESEARCH”字样以及一个发光的大脑图示。采用粗粝的赛博朋克怪兽电影海报风格，高对比度，青蓝色阴影，红色光晕点缀，动态视角，雨水打湿的反光效果，烟雾，碎片，以及强烈的动感。请确保野猪角色身上保留两个清晰可见的「作者」标签，画面中仅出现一个“AI RESEARCH”屏幕，且仅包含两个主要角色：野猪猎人和黑色 GPT-X 生物。

en.title: Good Morning Changsha Food Landscape
en.description: A wide cultural food poster showing Changsha breakfast dishes transformed into misty mountains for morning greetings or creative food advertising.
en.prompt: Create a wide cinematic food poster in a fresh Japanese literary aesthetic color palette, pale ivory and light spring green with soft mist. The scene is a surreal miniature landscape where Changsha breakfast foods become mountains: exactly 5 main food-landform elements are visible, including 1 large square stinky-tofu cube mountain on the right topped with chopped green scallions, 1 smaller square tofu block hill on the left, 1 smaller tofu block hill in the lower right foreground, and 2 red chili relish mound hills, one near center-left and one far right. Add steaming white vapor ribbons winding horizontally through the landscape like clouds, with faint ink-wash mountains in the background and a hazy Changsha city skyline: include a pagoda and low buildings on the left and a slender tower silhouette on the right. Along the very bottom, add tiny human silhouettes and exactly 3 small breakfast-stall scenes with parasols and Chinese shop signs, integrated like a miniature marketplace at the foot of the food mountains. Use elegant poster typography: at the top center place a small rounded date capsule reading {argument name="date label" default="09 · 2026-07-22"}; below it, large green Chinese headline text reading {argument name="headline text" default="早安·长沙"}; beneath the headline, small spaced English subtitle reading {argument name="English subtitle" default="GOOD MORNING · CHANGSHA"}. In the vertical center, add a thin column of Chinese quote text reading {argument name="vertical quote" default="今日金句：有烟火气的人生，最有抵达幸福的力气。"}. Keep the composition airy, premium, and calm, with soft morning light, no harsh shadows, realistic food textures, subtle watercolor atmosphere, and clean commercial poster design.

zh.title: 早安长沙美食景观
zh.description: 一张宽幅文化美食海报，将长沙早餐美食幻化为云雾缭绕的山峦，适用于早安问候或创意美食广告。
zh.prompt: 创作一张宽幅电影感美食海报，采用清新的日系文学审美色调，以淡象牙白和浅春绿色为主，伴有柔和雾气。画面是一个超现实的微缩景观，长沙早餐美食化身为山峦：画面中可见 5 个主要的美食地貌元素，包括右侧一座巨大的方形臭豆腐块山，顶部撒有翠绿葱花；左侧一座较小的方形豆腐块山；右下角前景处一座较小的豆腐块山；以及两座红辣椒酱堆成的小山，分别位于中左侧和远右侧。添加缭绕的白色蒸汽带，像云朵一样横向穿过景观，背景中有淡淡的水墨山峦和朦胧的长沙城市天际线：左侧包含一座宝塔和低矮建筑，右侧有一座细长的塔影。在最底部，添加微小的人影和 3 个带有遮阳伞及中文招牌的早餐摊位场景，如同美食山脚下的微缩集市。使用优雅的海报排版：顶部中心放置一个圆角日期胶囊，显示 {argument name="date label" default="09 · 2026-07-22"}；下方为醒目的绿色中文大标题 {argument name="headline text" default="早安·长沙"}；标题下方为间距适中的英文副标题 {argument name="English subtitle" default="GOOD MORNING · CHANGSHA"}。在垂直中心位置，添加一列纤细的中文引言文本 {argument name="vertical quote" default="今日金句：有烟火气的人生，最有抵达幸福的力气。"}。保持构图通透、高级且宁静，光线为柔和的晨光，无生硬阴影，呈现真实的食物质感、微妙的水彩氛围以及简洁的商业海报设计。

en.title: Elegant Mature Woman Portrait
en.description: A high-fashion editorial portrait of an elegant older woman with silver hair, featuring sophisticated styling and soft natural lighting in an urban setting.
en.prompt: Ultra-realistic luxury street-style editorial portrait of an {argument name="subject" default="elegant older woman with timeless beauty"}, photographed in soft natural daylight against a clean, minimalist urban background. She gazes gracefully to the side with a warm, confident smile, radiating sophistication, wisdom, and effortless style. She has beautifully styled silver-gray hair swept into a sleek, low chignon with smooth volume and refined texture. Her skin shows natural mature beauty with delicate expression lines, soft wrinkles, and a luminous healthy complexion. She wears bold matte red lipstick, subtle natural makeup, and oversized round black designer sunglasses with glossy frames, adding a chic high-fashion aesthetic. Her outfit consists of a striking {argument name="outfit color" default="royal-blue"} pleated sleeveless designer dress featuring an elegant asymmetrical folded collar with sculptural architectural lines. She accessorizes with luxurious statement drop earrings in antique silver and black gemstone detailing, along with a thin metallic crossbody chain strap that subtly drapes across her shoulder. Soft diffused daylight creates flattering illumination with gentle highlights on her skin and hair while maintaining realistic textures. The background is artistically blurred with a shallow depth of field, emphasizing her refined profile and sophisticated styling. The overall mood conveys confidence, elegance, and timeless fashion. Style: Ultra-photorealistic luxury fashion photography, street-style editorial portrait, Vogue editorial aesthetic, minimalist composition, authentic mature beauty, cinematic soft lighting, premium designer styling, realistic skin texture, natural {argument name="hair color" default="silver"} hair detail, shallow depth of field, 85mm portrait lens, DSLR quality, HDR, magazine-quality retouching, ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, luxury lifestyle campaign, timeless elegance, award-winning editorial photography.

zh.title: 优雅成熟女性奢华街拍时尚大片
zh.description: 一张精致的时尚肖像，主角是一位留着银灰色头发、身着宝蓝色连衣裙的成熟女性，在柔和的日光下拍摄，背景为极简主义城市风格。
zh.prompt:
超写实奢华街拍时尚大片，展现了一位拥有永恒之美的优雅成熟女性，在干净、极简的城市背景下，于柔和的自然光中拍摄。她优雅地侧目凝视，带着温暖而自信的微笑，散发出成熟、智慧与从容的时尚气息。
她有着精心打理的 {argument name="hair style" default="梳成利落低发髻的银灰色秀发"}，发丝蓬松顺滑，质感考究。她的皮肤展现出自然的成熟之美，带有细腻的表情纹、柔和的皱纹以及健康透亮的光泽。她涂抹着 {argument name="lipstick color" default="大胆的哑光红唇"}，妆容自然清透，佩戴着超大圆形黑色设计师太阳镜，镜框光泽感十足，增添了时髦的高级感。
她的造型是一件引人注目的 {argument name="dress color" default="宝蓝色"} 无袖百褶设计师连衣裙，领口设计优雅，采用不对称折叠与雕塑般的建筑线条。她佩戴着奢华的复古银质黑宝石吊坠耳环，肩上斜挎着一条细金属链条，自然垂落，更显精致。
柔和的漫射光营造出迷人的照明效果，在她的皮肤和发丝上留下柔和的高光，同时保留了真实的纹理。背景经过艺术化虚化处理，景深较浅，突显了她精致的侧颜与高级的造型。整体氛围传达出自信、优雅与永恒的时尚感。
风格：超写实奢华时尚摄影，街拍时尚大片，Vogue 杂志风格，极简构图，真实的成熟之美，电影级柔光，高端设计师造型，真实的皮肤纹理，自然的银发细节，浅景深，85mm 人像镜头，单反相机画质，HDR，杂志级修图，超高清细节，8K 分辨率，奢华生活方式广告大片，永恒的优雅，获奖级时尚摄影。

en.title: Watercolor Illustration of a Woman on a NYC Ferry

en.prompt: An illustration featuring delicate watercolors and rich ink, depicting a {argument name="subject" default="young Korean woman in her 20s"} traveling in {argument name="location" default="New York"}, standing on a ferry deck with the {argument name="landmark" default="Statue of Liberty"} rising in the distance behind her. Hand-drawn-style line art, translucent watercolor rendering, high-quality paper texture, sophisticated sketch-like style, composition automatically adjusted to fit the subject, joyful and warm expression, soft colors, design that makes use of white space, completely white background, large margins on all four sides, subject centered, faint watercolor suggestion of seagulls and gentle water ripples, no text, logos, or watermarks, ultra-high resolution, for wallpaper, 3:4

zh.title: 纽约渡轮上女性的水彩插画
zh.description: 一幅风格化的水彩墨水插画，描绘了一位年轻女性在纽约市乘坐渡轮，背景是自由女神像。
zh.prompt: 一幅融合了细腻水彩与浓郁墨水风格的插画，描绘了 {argument name="subject" default="一位 20 多岁的韩国年轻女性"} 在 {argument name="location" default="纽约"} 旅行的场景。她站在渡轮甲板上，远处的 {argument name="landmark" default="自由女神像"} 巍然耸立。她一手扶着栏杆，长发和轻便的风衣在海风中飘动，抬头露出灿烂愉悦的笑容。斜挎小包和折叠地图完善了她的旅行者造型。手绘风格线条，半透明水彩渲染，高品质纸张纹理，精致的素描风格，构图自动适配主体，表情欢快温暖，色彩柔和，巧妙利用留白，纯白背景，四周留有大面积空白，主体居中，隐约的水彩海鸥和轻柔的水波纹，无文字、Logo 或水印，超高分辨率，适用于壁纸，3:4

en.title: Premium Lifestyle Studio Portrait
en.description: A professional studio portrait prompt for a clean, commercial lifestyle aesthetic featuring an adult in smart-casual school-themed attire.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic, premium lifestyle studio portrait of an {argument name="subject" default="adult"} standing in a relaxed, natural pose against a seamless {argument name="background color" default="warm gray"} studio background. The subject is smiling naturally while looking slightly upward and off-camera, conveying optimism, confidence, and approachability. zh.title: 电影级哥特式大教堂肖像

en.title: 1970s Monochrome Close-up Portrait
en.description: A cinematic prompt for generating 1970s style black-and-white portraits with heavy film grain and high-contrast lighting.
en.prompt: Create a 1970s black-and-white close-up portrait in a {argument name="setting" default="windswept outdoor setting"}, black and white noise . Camera/look: eye-level, front ¾ view (~30° off-axis); 85–105 mm portrait perspective; vertical 2:3, tight head-and-shoulders crop; shallow DoF f/2.8–f/4; subject centered . Lighting: {argument name="lighting" default="hard natural sunlight from upper camera-left"} with minimal fill; crisp shadows; subtle rim on hair; sky as bright mid-tone background; no blown highlights.Pose & expression: subject faces camera, chin slightly down, lips parted with a {argument name="prop" default="cigarette"} held between them; gaze relaxed/half-lidded; hair blown across the face by wind, partially covering one eye.Wardrobe & styling: dark collared shirt with open neck; thin black neck scarf tied loosely; no logos/jewelry.Grade: high-contrast monochrome with rich blacks, bright highlights, medium–heavy film grain (Tri-X/HP5 vibe), slight halation, faint vignette; keep skin texture natural (no plastic smoothing).Composition: simple sky background, no extra props; clean verticals; ensure sharp focus on near eye and cigarette.Output: high-resolution, editorial/classic cinema mood; no text or watermarks.

zh.title: 1970 年代黑白风中肖像
zh.description: 一种复古风格的黑白特写肖像，带有胶片颗粒感、高对比度以及风中户外美学。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 1970 年代的黑白特写肖像，背景为 {argument name="setting" default="风中户外环境"}，带有黑白噪点。相机/视觉：平视角度，正面 ¾ 视角（偏离轴线约 30°）；85–105 mm 肖像透视；垂直 2:3 比例，紧凑的头部和肩部裁剪；浅景深 f/2.8–f/4；主体居中。光影：来自相机左上方强烈的自然阳光，补光极少；阴影清晰；发丝边缘光细腻；天空作为明亮的中调背景；无过曝高光。姿势与表情：主体面向相机，下巴微垂，{argument name="pose" default="双唇微张，衔着一支香烟"}；眼神放松/半闭；风吹乱头发遮住脸庞，部分遮挡一只眼睛。服装与造型：深色翻领衬衫，领口敞开；系着一条松散的黑色细领巾；无标志/珠宝。调色：{argument name="film style" default="高对比度黑白，黑色深邃"}，高光明亮，中等到重度的胶片颗粒感（Tri-X/HP5 风格），轻微的光晕，淡淡的暗角；保持皮肤纹理自然（无塑料感平滑）。构图：简洁的天空背景，无额外道具；垂直线条干净；确保近处的眼睛和香烟焦点清晰。输出：高分辨率，编辑/经典电影质感；无文字或水印。

en.title: Photorealistic Person with Ink-Twin Doodle
en.description: A creative prompt generating a photorealistic person standing beside their chaotic charcoal sketch silhouette on a minimal wall.
en.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the exact identity reference. Keep the face, skin tone, hairstyle, accessories, and outfit exactly the same. Create a vertical full-body image of the real person standing beside their {argument name="twin type" default="ink-twin doodle"}. The real person should look photorealistic with a {argument name="expression" default="playful, slightly embarrassed expression"} and a natural pose. The ink twin should be a {argument name="sketch style" default="rough black charcoal sketch"} on a clean white or light gray wall, matching the person's hairstyle, outfit, and pose only as a silhouette, but with exaggerated, chaotic energy. Add a few simple doodle effects like motion lines, stars, or hearts. Use soft natural daylight with a clean minimal background. Do not change the person's appearance or outfit. Do not make the twin a real person, colored cartoon, or flat shadow. Avoid repeated poses, bad hands, extra limbs, clutter, text, or watermarks.

zh.title: 日本街头夜景抓拍人像
zh.description: 一组充满情绪感与怀旧气息的日本城市夜间街头抓拍提示词，呈现真实的 iPhone 风格低光摄影效果。
zh.prompt: 一组电影感十足的夜间街头抓拍人像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位在日本安静城市人行道上行走的年轻女性"}，由 {argument name="camera" default="iPhone"} 拍摄。她留着深棕色长波浪卷发，脸侧编有一条细辫，妆容自然清透，回眸看向镜头时带着淡淡的微笑。她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="修身灰色无袖背心，搭配浅色宽松直筒牛仔裤，肩背黑色皮包"}。其中一张照片中，她俏皮地将手伸向镜头，营造出自然的前景动态模糊；另一张照片中，她蹲在白色亮面地铁瓷砖墙边，手托下巴；还有一张是她边走边回眸的瞬间。背景为灯光昏暗的日本城市街道，包含瓷砖墙、人行横道、电线杆、远处的交通灯、发光的商店招牌、公寓楼以及柔和的路灯。{argument name="lighting" default="温暖的环境光与清冷的城市灯光交织"}，营造出一种忧郁而怀旧的氛围。肤色自然，瓷砖墙面带有细腻的反光，浅景深，阴影真实，带有轻微的数字噪点，柔和的焦外成像，真实的智能手机低光摄影质感，随性的生活方式美学，极简的调色，静谧的午夜城市氛围，纪录片风格，超写实，35mm 等效镜头，9:16 竖屏构图。

en.title: Japanese High School Yearbook Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for an ultra-realistic Japanese high school graduation photo, capturing a melancholic teenage girl in a traditional uniform.
en.prompt: Ultra-realistic Japanese high school yearbook portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="beautiful teenage girl"}, centered in a formal graduation photo layout. She has {argument name="hair style" default="long, silky jet-black hair styled in a loose side braid draped over one shoulder, soft wispy curtain bangs"}, luminous porcelain-fair skin, subtle rosy cheeks, naturally full pink lips, and large expressive dark brown eyes with a calm, slightly melancholic gaze looking directly into the camera. Her expression is neutral, quiet, and elegant with a gentle, introspective mood. She is wearing a {argument name="uniform" default="traditional Japanese high school uniform consisting of a tailored black blazer, crisp white dress shirt, and a deep burgundy satin ribbon bow"}. The portrait is framed from the chest upward against a smooth light blue-gray studio backdrop with soft, even school-photography lighting, minimal shadows, and true-to-life colors. The portrait is printed on a clean white yearbook page with thin white borders separating neighboring student portraits. Japanese kanji characters are printed beneath the portrait as the student's name, creating an authentic Japanese graduation album aesthetic. Adjacent student portraits are partially visible on both sides, reinforcing the official class yearbook layout. Style: ultra-realistic, Japanese school graduation album photography, minimalist composition, authentic yearbook design, soft natural skin tones, high detail, DSLR quality, shallow depth of field, sharp facial focus, subtle cinematic realism, 8K resolution.

zh.title: 日本高中毕业纪念册肖像
zh.description: 一个用于生成超写实日本高中毕业照的高细节提示词，捕捉了一位身着传统校服、神情忧郁的少女形象。
zh.prompt: 超写实的日本高中毕业纪念册肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="一位美丽的少女"}，居中呈现于正式的毕业照排版中。她拥有 {argument name="hair style" default="乌黑柔顺的长发，编成松散的侧边麻花辫垂在肩头，配有轻盈的八字刘海"}，肤色如瓷般透亮，双颊透着淡淡红晕，嘴唇自然饱满，深棕色的双眸大而有神，目光平静且略带忧郁地直视镜头。她的表情中性、恬静而优雅，流露出一种温柔且内省的氛围。她穿着 {argument name="uniform" default="传统的日本高中校服，包括剪裁合体的黑色西装外套、挺括的白色衬衫以及深酒红色的缎面领结"}。肖像采用胸部以上的取景，背景为平滑的浅蓝灰色摄影棚幕布，光线柔和均匀，呈现出校园摄影的质感，阴影极少，色彩真实自然。肖像印在干净的白色纪念册页面上，边缘有细窄的留白，与其他学生的肖像隔开。肖像下方印有作为学生姓名的日文汉字，营造出地道的日本毕业相册美感。两侧隐约可见其他学生的肖像，强化了正式班级纪念册的排版效果。风格：超写实、日本学校毕业相册摄影、极简构图、地道纪念册设计、柔和自然的肤色、高细节、单反相机画质、浅景深、面部焦点清晰、细腻的电影感写实、8K 分辨率。

en.title: Minimalist Vector Travel Poster
en.description: Create vintage-style travel posters with bold sans-serif typography containing detailed country panoramas and a retro-futuristic aesthetic.
en.prompt: Premium vector travel poster of {argument name="location" default="(county)"} in huge elongated bold sans-serif typography, letters containing continuous {argument name="country" default="COUNTRY"} panorama: temples, BTS skytrain, markets, bridges, river boats, neon streets, cafés, tropical urban scenery. Flat geometric illustration, retro-futuristic travel branding, Swiss poster design, editorial layout, screen-print aesthetic. Color palette: {argument name="colors" default="deep red, coral red, warm ivory, muted charcoal"}. Thin top strip with skyline silhouettes, cars, train, birds, sun. Minimalist vector only, no gradients, no AI text errors, ultra-clean composition, sharp vector lines, 8K poster quality.

zh.title: 极简主义矢量旅行海报
zh.description: 创作带有醒目无衬线字体、包含详细国家全景及复古未来主义美学的复古风格旅行海报。
zh.prompt: 精美矢量旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="location" default="(国家/地区)"}，采用超大加粗的无衬线字体，字母内部包含连续的 {argument name="country" default="COUNTRY"} 全景：寺庙、BTS 轻轨、市场、桥梁、游船、霓虹街道、咖啡馆、热带城市风光。扁平化几何插画，复古未来主义旅行品牌风格，瑞士海报设计，编辑排版，丝网印刷美学。配色方案：{argument name="colors" default="深红、珊瑚红、暖象牙白、柔和炭灰"}。顶部细条纹装饰有天际线剪影、汽车、火车、飞鸟、太阳。极简主义矢量图，无渐变，无 AI 文字错误，构图超简洁，矢量线条锐利，8K 海报画质。

en.title: Premium Skincare Campaign Poster Grid
en.description: A professional skincare advertising prompt for creating a 2x2 grid of high-end product shots, each set in a distinct fantasy natural environment while maintaining brand consistency.
en.prompt:
为海蓝之谜（La Mer）创建一个超高端的 2x2 四格护肤营销海报，保持绝对的品牌一致性，但呈现四个完全不同的梦幻自然环境。每个象限必须感觉像是一个独特的奇幻世界，拥有各自的生态特征、色彩氛围和电影感调性，同时这四个部分又必须明确归属于一个统一的 La Mer 视觉宇宙。产品在每个画格中必须是绝对的主角，并完美融入自然，仿佛生来如此。最终作品应呈现出世界级奢侈护肤品系列的高级感，以及像获奖电影画面般凝固的静态美学：超写实的产品摄影、精湛的环境叙事、优雅的自然互动、微妙的梦幻氛围以及收藏级的视觉打磨。采用精致的英文标题排版、含蓄的官方品牌标识，并在高级社论布局中使用极简的辅助文字。

核心布局：
采用严格的 2x2 四格构图，间距均衡，设计规范统一。每个画格必须包含一件 La Mer 核心产品，以视觉主导但环境融合的方式放置。产品绝不能感觉像是强行粘贴进去的，而必须通过光影、水分、反射、材质接触和构图互动，感觉完全沉浸在每个自然世界中。每个画格必须清晰地表达不同的环境身份，同时保持相同的奢华基调、产品比例逻辑和品牌连贯性。

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit 方向：
进一步强化已确立的最强特质：增强四个不同自然世界之间的对比，精化海洋植物梦幻细节，并将整体视觉语言提升至电影级静物摄影的高度。保留同样的四环境骨架，但让每个画格感觉更像是一个获奖奇幻电影中完美定格的瞬间：更安静、更开阔、更有氛围感、更具情感共鸣。用更强大的电影化环境叙事、更好的深度分层、更自然的光线衰减以及产品周围更受控的视觉留白，取代任何通用的装饰性梦幻感。

系列理念：
四个画格应代表四个完全不同的迷人自然世界，每个都具有强烈的视觉对比和独特的生态特征，但所有画格都必须让人感到奢华、宁静、神奇，且带有鲜明的 La Mer 风格。每个环境必须独立讲述一个自然状态的故事：
1. 潮湿的热带森林避风港；
2. 清凉的海洋悬崖或潮池世界；
3. 薄雾弥漫的月光苔藓森林；
4. 晶莹剔透的海盐矿物植物世界。
这四个世界在色彩、光影、纹理和氛围上必须各具特色，但都应传达出补水、修护、纯净和奢华的护肤语言。

画格 1，热带森林避风港：
将 La Mer 产品放置在温暖湿润的热带雨林林间空地的苔藓石块或天然底座上。周围环绕着优雅的热带叶片、过滤后的阳光、柔和的雾气、露水和郁郁葱葱的深绿色层次感。环境应感觉清新、湿润、阳光明媚，具有极高的自然丰富度。产品应通过柔和的水润光泽、叶片的构图环绕以及金绿色的反射光与环境互动。这个画格应感觉像是充满生机的热带雨林电影剧照中一个宁静的神圣时刻。

画格 2，海洋悬崖或潮池世界：
将 La Mer 产品放置在受潮池、海边悬崖、矿物岩石和海雾启发的清凉海洋环境中。产品可以放置在潮湿的海岩或升起的石块上，周围环绕着温和的海水、海霭、碎海玻璃、矿物水分和冷色调的蓝绿色反射。这个画格应感觉更具水感、通透、海风吹拂且富有电影感，就像清晨在偏远悬崖上捕捉到的画面。

画格 3，月光苔藓森林：
将 La Mer 产品放置在一个更黑暗、更神秘的梦幻苔藓森林中，背景为黄昏或月光下的薄暮。使用深绿黑色的苔藓、湿润的树皮、柔和发光的菌类装饰、微弱的漂浮颗粒、银蓝色的薄雾和宁静的阴影深度。产品应在较暗的环境中发出柔光，营造出一种夜间修护和秘密植物炼金术的感觉。这个画格应感觉像是奇幻故事片中一个隐秘的仪式场景。

画格 4，晶莹剔透的海盐矿物植物世界：
将 La Mer 产品放置在一个精致的梦幻环境中，海洋植物、半透明晶体、海盐矿物构造、湿润的花瓣和淡色发光的自然元素共同营造出一个更加空灵和珍贵的场景。产品应感觉像是从神圣的海洋植物祭坛中生长出来的。这个画格可能是四个画格中最崇高、最神奇的一个，带有微妙的珍珠、翡翠和海泡石色调，但它必须依然感觉优雅且富有电影感，而不是单纯的装饰。

产品写实度：
以极其执着的写实主义和奢侈材质保真度来呈现 La Mer 产品。展示准确的罐体或瓶身比例、精美的玻璃或面霜罐表面、抛光的瓶盖、极高清晰度的标签、洁净的反射和优雅的色调深度。在每个画格中，产品必须感觉纯净、昂贵且带有鲜明的 La Mer 品牌特征。它必须始终是每一格画面的色彩和构图中心。

自然与产品的互动：
在每个画格中，产品和环境必须积极地相互响应。利用石头上的水分、叶片的反射光、玻璃上捕捉到的海雾、触碰底座的苔藓、周围花瓣上的水珠、柔和的薄雾和微妙的自然构图框架。产品必须与周围的自然世界完全协调。这种关系必须感觉是电影般的、有机的，绝不是装饰性或人造的。

水、雾和颗粒的真实感：
以极端的写实感和优雅感呈现水、湿度、水滴、雾气和微粒。每个画格都应包含某种形式的大气水分或自然微粒，但要适应其自身的生态环境：雨林湿度、海浪喷溅、月光森林水汽、矿物薄雾或发光的水润微尘。效果必须感觉干净、高端且符合物理逻辑。保持它们的克制与电影感，仿佛在动作恢复前的静谧空气中暂停。

光影：
在所有四个画格中使用极其细腻、柔和的电影化照明，但要改变光线性质以匹配环境：
1. 温暖的过滤雨林光线；
2. 清凉的海洋日光薄霭；
3. 昏暗的月光森林辉光；
4. 淡雅的神圣矿物照明。
所有照明必须保持奢华、柔和且高度受控。产品必须始终以极高的清晰度被照亮，而环境则支撑其氛围。每个画格应感觉像是精心构思的自然电影照明，而非影棚式的梦幻光效。

电影级的深度与氛围：
让每个画格感觉都像是获奖奇幻自然电影中的静态帧。使用更强的前景-中景-背景分离感、更自然的镜头焦深、受控的薄雾、大气的寂静感以及精心构图的留白区域。避免填满每个角

画格 4，晶莹剔透的海盐矿物植物世界：
将 La Mer 产品放置在一个精致的梦幻环境中，海洋植物、半透明晶体、海盐矿物构造、湿润的花瓣和淡色发光的自然元素共同营造出一个更加空灵和珍贵的场景。产品应感觉像是从神圣的海洋植物祭坛中生长出来的。这个画格可能是四个画格中最崇高、最神奇的一个，带有微妙的珍珠、翡翠和海泡石色调，但它必须依然感觉优雅且富有电影感，而不是单纯的装饰。

产品写实度：
以极其执着的写实主义和奢侈材质保真度来呈现 La Mer 产品。展示准确的罐体或瓶身比例、精美的玻璃或面霜罐表面、抛光的瓶盖、极高清晰度的标签、洁净的反射和优雅的色调深度。在每个画格中，产品必须感觉纯净、昂贵且带有鲜明的 La Mer 品牌特征。它必须始终是每一格画面的色彩和构图中心。

自然与产品的互动：
在每个画格中，产品和环境必须积极地相互响应。利用石头上的水分、叶片的反射光、玻璃上捕捉到的海雾、触碰底座的苔藓、周围花瓣上的水珠、柔和的薄雾和微妙的自然构图框架。产品必须与周围的自然世界完全协调。这种关系必须感觉是电影般的、有机的，绝不是装饰性或人造的。

水、雾和颗粒的真实感：
以极端的写实感和优雅感呈现水、湿度、水滴、雾气和微粒。每个画格都应包含某种形式的大气水分或自然微粒，但要适应其自身的生态环境：雨林湿度、海浪喷溅、月光森林水汽、矿物薄雾或发光的水润微尘。效果必须感觉干净、高端且符合物理逻辑。保持它们的克制与电影感，仿佛在动作恢复前的静谧空气中暂停。

光影：
在所有四个画格中使用极其细腻、柔和的电影化照明，但要改变光线性质以匹配环境：
1. 温暖的过滤雨林光线；
2. 清凉的海洋日光薄霭；
3. 昏暗的月光森林辉光；
4. 淡雅的神圣矿物照明。
所有照明必须保持奢华、柔和且高度受控。产品必须始终以极高的清晰度被照亮，而环境则支撑其氛围。每个画格应感觉像是精心构思的自然电影照明，而非影棚式的梦幻光效。

电影级的深度与氛围：
让每个画格感觉都像是获奖奇幻自然电影中的静态帧。使用更强的前景-中景-背景分离感、更自然的镜头焦深、受控的薄雾、大气的寂静感以及精心构图的留白区域。避免填满每个角落。

en.title: Premium Automotive Lifestyle Poster Layout
en.description: A highly structured 6-panel layout prompt for the Chevrolet Camaro, designed to transform automotive products into a youthful lifestyle campaign with precise composition and realistic human-car interactions.
en.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium 6-panel youth campaign poster for Chevrolet Camaro, fully preserving the exact editorial structure and youthful brand logic of a modern automotive lifestyle layout: a tall vertical poster with two large horizontal hero panels at the top and bottom, and four smaller lifestyle panels arranged in the middle section. The final artwork must feel energetic, stylish, youthful, premium, and globally campaign-ready, while keeping the Chevrolet Camaro as the absolute protagonist. The composition must combine hyper-real car photography, healthy athletic Western youth portraits, clean architectural space, and highly art-directed graphic balance. Use refined English title typography, subtle official-feeling Chevrolet branding, minimal English support text, and a consistent premium layout system across the whole poster.

Core layout:
Use a strict vertical 6-panel composition with:
1. one large hero panel at the top,
2. four smaller panels arranged in a clean 2x2 structure in the middle,
3. one large hero panel at the bottom.
The whole poster must feel unified through one strong visual system: same color palette, same architectural location, same youthful fashion styling, same modern tone, and same brand language. The car must remain visually dominant throughout the entire composition, while the human figures add energy, scale, and youth culture presence.

Critical realism constraints:
Human and car proportions must be fully correct in every panel. The people must have anatomically correct limbs, joints, torso length, head size, hand size, leg proportions, and natural standing or leaning balance. No body deformation, no broken anatomy, no warped perspective on the human figure. The Chevrolet Camaro must keep fully correct real-world proportions, body lines, wheel scale, roofline, hood length, glass shape, and stance. No distorted bodywork, no generic coupe shape, no wrong panel transitions. The people and the car must never intersect incorrectly: no body parts merging into doors, fenders, hood, wheels, windows, mirrors, or seats; no impossible leaning angles; no model clipping; no overlapping geometry errors; no character floating through the vehicle. Every human-car interaction must feel physically believable and spatially correct.

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit direction:
Push the strongest established qualities further: make the Chevrolet Camaro more dominant in the top and bottom hero panels, and refine the middle four panels so they feel less repetitive and more editorial. Keep the exact 6-panel skeleton, but upgrade the internal rhythm: let two of the middle panels emphasize stylish cropped detail-and-attitude moments, while the other two retain more direct human-and-car interaction. The result should feel more layered, more premium, and more magazine-like, with the Camaro clearly acting as the central force of youth, style, and motion.

Campaign concept:
The campaign should feel like a youth portrait of the Chevrolet Camaro lifestyle: freedom, confidence, energy, urban cool, style, and movement. The young people are not random models; they must feel like a coherent youthful cast linked by the same world. Their interactions with the car should feel natural, aspirational, stylish, and alive. The imagery should celebrate youth and the Camaro together, not treat the car as separate from the social energy around it.

Environment:
Use a clean modern architectural environment with strong graphic surfaces, large open urban space, steps, linear paving, bold walls, and geometric perspective lines. The location should feel contemporary, youthful, and premium, with enough visual structure to support the layout. The environment must stay clean and uncluttered, allowing the car and people to dominate. Strong color-blocked architectural planes are encouraged, especially with energetic but refined saturated tones.

Color system:
Use a youthful but premium color palette with bold saturated backgrounds and architectural surfaces, such as vivid red, magenta, electric coral, clean neutral stone, and metallic blue highlights. The Chevrolet Camaro itself should have a high-impact body color, such as electric blue, bright yellow, satin gray, or another bold performance color that works strongly against the environment. The entire poster must feel vibrant and youthful without becoming cheap or chaotic.

Top hero panel:
Create a large top panel featuring the Chevrolet Camaro in a strong hero view with one stylish young person interacting directly with it. The car should feel more dominant and centered than before, sharply detailed and aspirational. The person may lean against the hood, sit casually near the front, or stand with relaxed confidence beside the car, but all body contact must be physically correct and anatomically believable. Add a bold English title and a short English support line in a refined promotional layout.

Middle four panels:
Create four smaller panels, each showing a different youth-and-Camaro interaction while preserving consistent styling and environment.
- Panel A should focus on expressive youthful portraiture with part of the car visible.
- Panel B should highlight a stylish body detail of the Camaro, such as headlights, side line, hood, or grille, with a figure interacting nearby.
- Panel C should show a more social or playful relationship between young people and the vehicle, such as entering, leaning, walking past, or sharing a moment near the car.
- Panel D should be more fashion-editorial, using a cropped part of the Camaro together with a strong youth pose, emphasizing attitude and design rhythm more than narrative.
All interactions must preserve correct scale and believable spatial separation between human and vehicle.

Bottom hero panel:
Create a large bottom panel that resolves the whole series with a wider lifestyle hero shot. Show the Chevrolet Camaro in a strong three-quarter or side-front view with one or two young people interacting around it in a relaxed, fashionable, confident way. The car must remain the center of gravity, while the youth presence reinforces energy and aspiration.
