zh.title: 高端汽车生活方式海报排版
zh.description: 为 Chevrolet Camaro 设计的 6 宫格高结构化布局提示词，旨在通过精准的构图与真实的人车互动，将汽车产品转化为充满活力的青年生活方式广告大片。
zh.prompt:
为 Chevrolet Camaro 创作一张超高端的 6 宫格青年广告海报，完整保留现代汽车生活方式排版的严谨编辑结构与青春品牌逻辑：一张高大的竖版海报，顶部和底部各有一个大型横向主视觉面板，中间部分排列四个较小的生活方式面板。最终画面必须呈现出充满活力、时尚、年轻、高端且具备全球广告水准的质感，同时确保 Chevrolet Camaro 作为绝对主角。构图需结合超写实的汽车摄影、健康运动的西方青年肖像、简洁的建筑空间以及极具艺术感的图形平衡。使用精致的英文标题排版、微妙的 Chevrolet 官方品牌标识、极简的英文辅助文案，并在整张海报中保持统一的高端排版系统。

核心布局：
采用严格的 6 宫格竖版构图：
1. 顶部一个大型主视觉面板；
2. 中间四个较小的面板，采用整洁的 2x2 结构；
3. 底部一个大型主视觉面板。
整张海报必须通过统一的视觉系统保持连贯：相同的配色方案、相同的建筑场景、相同的青年时尚造型、相同的现代基调以及相同的品牌语言。汽车在整个构图中必须保持视觉主导地位，同时人物形象增加活力、比例感和青年文化氛围。

关键写实约束：
每个面板中人物与汽车的比例必须完全准确。人物必须具备解剖学意义上正确的四肢、关节、躯干长度、头部大小、手部尺寸、腿部比例以及自然的站立或倚靠平衡。严禁身体变形、骨骼结构错误、人物透视扭曲。Chevrolet Camaro 必须保持完全真实的现实比例、车身线条、轮毂尺寸、车顶轮廓、引擎盖长度、玻璃形状及姿态。严禁车身扭曲、通用轿跑造型、错误的面板过渡。人物与汽车绝不能出现错误的重叠：严禁身体部位融入车门、挡泥板、引擎盖、车轮、车窗、后视镜或座椅；严禁不符合物理规律的倚靠角度；严禁模型穿模；严禁几何重叠错误；严禁人物漂浮在车辆之上。每一次人车互动都必须在物理上可信且空间上准确。

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit 方向：
进一步强化已确立的优势：让 Chevrolet Camaro 在顶部和底部主视觉面板中更具统治力，并优化中间的四个面板，使其减少重复感，更具杂志编辑感。保持 6 宫格的骨架，但提升内部节奏：让其中两个中间面板强调时尚的局部细节与态度瞬间，另外两个面板则保留更多直接的人车互动。最终效果应更具层次感、更高端、更像杂志大片，清晰地展现 Camaro 作为青春、风格与动感的核心力量。

广告概念：
广告应呈现出 Chevrolet Camaro 生活方式的青年肖像：自由、自信、活力、都市酷感、风格与运动。年轻人不应是随机的模特，他们必须看起来像是一个由同一世界观连接的、连贯的青年群体。他们与汽车的互动应显得自然、令人向往、时尚且生动。影像应共同赞美青春与 Camaro，而非将汽车与周围的社交能量割裂开来。

环境：
使用简洁的现代建筑环境，具备强烈的图形表面、开阔的都市空间、台阶、线性铺装、大胆的墙面以及几何透视线条。场景应感觉现代、年轻且高端，并具备足够的视觉结构来支撑排版。环境必须保持整洁，让汽车和人物成为焦点。鼓励使用强烈的色块建筑平面，尤其是充满活力但精致的饱和色调。

色彩系统：
使用年轻且高端的配色方案，搭配大胆的饱和背景和建筑表面，如鲜艳的红色、洋红色、电光珊瑚色、简洁的中性石色以及金属蓝高光。Chevrolet Camaro 本身应采用高冲击力的车身颜色，如电光蓝、亮黄色、缎面灰或其他能与环境形成强烈对比的性能色彩。整张海报必须充满活力且年轻，同时避免廉价或混乱感。

顶部主视觉面板：
创建一个大型顶部面板，展示 Chevrolet Camaro 的强力主视觉视角，并由一位时尚青年与之互动。汽车应比之前更具统治力和中心感，细节锐利且令人向往。人物可以倚靠在引擎盖上、随意坐在车头附近或自信地站在车旁，但所有身体接触必须在物理上正确且符合解剖学逻辑。在精致的宣传排版中加入醒目的英文标题和简短的英文辅助文案。

中间四个面板：
创建四个较小的面板，每个面板展示不同的人车互动，同时保持一致的造型和环境。
- 面板 A 应聚焦于富有表现力的青年肖像，并露出部分车身。
- 面板 B 应突出 Camaro 的时尚车身细节，如前大灯、侧线条、引擎盖或格栅，并有人物在附近互动。
- 面板 C 应展示年轻人与车辆之间更具社交性或趣味性的关系，如上车、倚靠、走过或在车旁分享时刻。
- 面板 D 应更具时尚编辑感，通过 Camaro 的局部裁剪与强有力的人物姿态相结合，强调态度与设计节奏，而非叙事性。
所有互动必须保持正确的比例以及人与车之间可信的空间距离。

底部主视觉面板：
创建一个大型底部面板，通过更宽广的生活方式主视觉镜头总结整个系列。展示 Chevrolet Camaro 的强力四分之三侧面或前侧视角，并有一到两位年轻人以放松、时尚、自信的方式与之互动。汽车必须保持重心地位，而人物的存在则强化了活力与向往感。在相同的整体排版系统中加入另一句精致的英文广告语和极简的品牌标识。底部面板应感觉稍显沉稳并具有总结性，如同该系列的最终宣言。

人物造型：
使用健康、运动型的西方年轻模特，具备自然美感、前卫的造型和简洁的现代服装选择。造型应具有都市感、高级感和年轻感，而非过度奢侈的秀场风格。避免网红刻板印象。人物必须充满活力、自信、现代且上镜。他们的姿态应显得自然随性，同时经过艺术指导。

车辆写实度：
以极致的写实感和高端的汽车逼真度渲染 Chevrolet Camaro。展示准确的车身比例、漆面深度、反射、轮毂细节、玻璃通透度、前灯特征、肌肉感表面以及强劲的轿跑姿态。Camaro 必须显得清晰可辨、强劲、现代且令人向往。避免通用的轿跑外观。

灯光：
使用极其细腻的商业柔光，呈现电影级的质感。灯光应明亮、年轻且干净，车漆上的反射得到控制，人物轮廓细致。在整张海报中保持相同的灯光逻辑，使六个面板看起来像是一个统一的广告世界。光影必须显得高端且现代。

en.description: A highly descriptive prompt for a realistic portrait of a woman on a rocky beach, featuring intricate details of skin, water droplets, and natural lighting.
en.prompt:
Theme:
{argument name="theme" default="profile cloaked in the tide"}

Subject:

The upper body occupies about 70% of the screen, with the arm and blue sea on the left, and a blurred rocky area on the lower right.

Character and Expression:
Bright ivory-beige skin with natural pale pink color. Realistic skin texture with small glints on cheeks, nose tip, shoulders, and collarbone, showing pores and fine texture. Pale rose blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin eyelashes, natural eye bags, soft light brown eyebrows, and sheer pink-beige lips. A neat profile facing right, chin slightly tucked, gaze cast diagonally downward. Mouth lightly closed with a quiet and calm expression.

{argument name="outfit" default="An ivory triangle bikini with a delicate woven pattern. The left arm is lowered near the waist with the elbow loosely bent. The abdomen is naturally extended, and the center of gravity between the shoulders, ribcage, and hips is continuous.

Environment and Light:
{argument name="environment" default="A clear coastal day. Fine water droplets are scattered on the skin and hair.

{argument name="outfit" default="一件带有精致编织纹理的象牙色三角比基尼。纤细的肩带和侧带自然贴合皮肤，带有轻微的张力和细小的织物褶皱。"} 身体向右扭转约 30 度，左肩略微前倾。左臂垂于腰部附近，手肘自然弯曲。腹部自然舒展，肩膀、胸腔和臀部之间的重心连贯。

{argument name="environment" default="晴朗的海岸日间。前景是人物，中景是深蓝色海面，背景是失焦的礁石和低矮的海岸线。来自左上方的强烈暖阳照亮了额头、鼻梁、肩膀、胸部和腹部左侧。"} 对侧添加了来自天空和海洋的柔和蓝色反射光，在保持立体感的同时避免了过于生硬的阴影。皮肤和头发上散布着细小的水珠。

肤色明亮自然，五官精致。精致的日系妆容，搭配粉米色唇妆、淡玫瑰色腮红、细棕色眼线，睫毛强调长度而不显夸张。深棕色齐肩波波头，带有薄刘海和脸部周围的层次感，发梢和碎发随风飘动。下巴微收，以平静、成熟的目光注视镜头，双唇微启。

服装与姿势：
{argument name="outfit" default="一件微透的象牙白衬衫。柔和的浅 V 领，宽松长袖，袖口纤细。内搭简单的肤色米色吊带背心，透视感恰到好处，展现出胸部和身体轮廓的优雅。"} 下身搭配浅米色高腰百褶短裙。上半身略微前倾，双肩放松，双臂自然垂于身体两侧。衬衫的轻薄面料和裙摆在风中轻轻摇曳，在腰部形成自然的褶皱和阴影。

环境与光影：
{argument name="environment" default="城市公寓楼的天台。腰部高度的金属围栏，远处是低矮的住宅和公寓楼，无文字或标志。背景大部分是鲜艳的蓝天和立体感十足的积云。左下方低角度的暖色逆光为头发、脸颊、颈部和轻薄的衬衫面料勾勒出金色轮廓。"} 来自天空和天台地面的柔和反射光照亮了面部。腰部附近留有一个小圆形的镜头光晕。

en.title: Sunlight Contours Indoor Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for a 2:3 vertical indoor portrait featuring a young woman by a summer window at sunset, focusing on lighting, shadows, and realistic textures.
en.prompt:
Theme:
{argument name="theme" default="Contours of Sunlight"}

Subject:
A vertical 2:3 indoor portrait. A young adult woman sits quietly by a summer window in the center of the frame. Capture from the face down to the chest, arms, and one bent knee, with the person occupying about 80% of the screen. Focus on her gaze and face while clearly showing the streaks of light falling on her shoulders and arms.

Person/Expression:
Fair ivory-beige skin with a pale pink flush and natural texture. Delicate highlights on cheeks, tip of nose, lips, shoulders, and collarbone. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink brown eyeshadow, long slender eyelashes, natural tear troughs, soft light brown eyebrows, and sheer pink beige gloss lips. Lips are slightly parted, head tilted slightly to the right, looking at the camera with calm eyes. Small, clear catchlights in the eyes.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="clothing" default="Layer an ivory lace camisole with thin straps under a thin, sheer gown"}. The gown falls naturally from both shoulders, creating soft drapes on the outside of the arms. Lean the upper body slightly forward and bring both arms toward the front of the body. Include one bent knee in the lower left of the frame, showing natural tension and fine wrinkles in the thin fabric of the clothing. Dainty gold necklace and long dangling earrings.

Background/Light:
A quiet interior with a wooden-framed window in a blend of Japanese and Western styles. In the background, place wooden furniture, glass bottles, and small houseplants out of focus. Strong evening sunlight shines through the window at the top left at a low angle, casting long narrow window frame shadows diagonally across her forehead, cheeks, neck, shoulders, and arms. The light is a deep amber; lit areas are bright and glossy, while the shadow side sinks into deep brown. Add golden rim lighting to the silhouette of the hair and leave warm reflected light in the background.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 2:3, medium close-up leaning toward bust-up. Place the face slightly above the center of the frame, with a small margin at the top of the head and the chest and one knee at the bottom. The camera looks down gently from a position slightly higher than eye level. 85mm equivalent portrait lens, shallow depth of field. Focus on both eyes and lips, softening the background. Vividly depict the three-dimensionality of the face, window shadows, and the flow of hair.

Texture/Style:
Realistic fashion portrait. Cinematic color grading centered on warm tones. Skin is not overly uniform, naturally retaining pores and fine peach fuzz. Hair is {argument name="hair color" default="bright milk tea ash brown"}, with thin see-through bangs, face-framing layers, and medium-long length below the shoulders. Ends are loosely curled inward, with fine highlights, a soft sheen, and naturally rendered stray hairs. Clearly differentiate the material textures of delicate lace, thin fabric, and metal accessories.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, asymmetrical eyes, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, unnatural contact between clothing and body, floating accessories, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 阳光轮廓室内人像
zh.description: 一个高度详细的电影感提示词，用于 2:3 竖构图室内人像，描绘了一位年轻女性在夏日午后的窗边，重点突出光影、阴影和逼真的质感。
zh.prompt:
主题：
{argument name="theme" default="阳光轮廓"}

主体：
2:3 竖构图室内人像。一位年轻女性安静地坐在画面中央的夏日窗边。取景范围从面部到胸部、手臂及一只弯曲的膝盖，人物占据画面约 80%。聚焦于她的眼神和面部，同时清晰展现落在她肩膀和手臂上的光束。

人物/表情：
白皙的象牙米色皮肤，带有淡淡的粉色红晕和自然纹理。脸颊、鼻尖、嘴唇、肩膀和锁骨处有细腻的高光。淡玫瑰粉色腮红，香槟米色和粉棕色眼影，纤长的睫毛，自然的泪沟，柔和的浅棕色眉毛，以及清透的粉米色唇釉。双唇微张，头部略微向右倾斜，眼神平静地注视着镜头。眼中带有清晰的小型眼神光。

服装/姿势：
{argument name="clothing" default="在薄款透视长裙内叠穿一件象牙白蕾丝吊带背心"}。长裙从双肩自然垂落，在手臂外侧形成柔和的褶皱。上身略微前倾，双臂向身体前方靠拢。画面左下方包含一只弯曲的膝盖，展现出薄面料下自然的张力和细微褶皱。佩戴精致的金色项链和长款吊坠耳环。

背景/光影：
安静的室内环境，配有日式与西式风格融合的木框窗户。背景中放置着虚化的木质家具、玻璃瓶和小型室内植物。强烈的傍晚阳光从左上方以低角度射入，在她的额头、脸颊、颈部、肩膀和手臂上投下长而窄的窗框阴影。光线呈深琥珀色；受光面明亮且富有光泽，阴影侧则沉入深棕色。在发丝轮廓上增加金色轮廓光，并在背景中保留温暖的反射光。

构图/相机：
2:3 竖构图，介于中景特写与胸像之间。面部置于画面中心略上方，头顶留有少量空间，胸部和一只膝盖位于底部。相机从略高于视线的位置轻轻俯拍。85mm 等效人像镜头，浅景深。聚焦于双眼和嘴唇，虚化背景。生动地刻画出面部的立体感、窗影以及发丝的流动感。

质感/风格：
写实时尚人像。以暖色调为中心的电影级调色。皮肤不过度磨皮，自然保留毛孔和细微的绒毛。发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="明亮的奶茶灰棕色"}，带有轻薄的空气刘海、修饰脸型的层次感剪裁，长度及肩下。发梢向内自然卷曲，带有细腻的高光、柔和的光泽以及自然呈现的碎发。清晰区分精致蕾丝、薄面料和金属配饰的材质纹理。

负面提示词：
不自然的面部、不自然的眼神、不对称的眼睛、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、服装与身体之间不自然的接触、悬浮的配饰、错误的透视、与光源不一致的阴影、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Profile Portrait with Red Candy
en.description: A mood-driven prompt for an indoor portrait of a woman sitting on a bed, holding a red lollipop, emphasizing soft natural light and a doll-like aesthetic.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Profile through a candy"}

Main Character:
{argument name="main character" default="Vertical 3:4. An adult woman sitting on a bed in a bedroom with soft natural light"}, placed large in the center-right of the screen. Medium-close view from the top of the head to below the thighs. The person occupies most of the frame, showing both legs in the foreground, depicting the moment she silently looks to the side with a red lollipop on her stick against her lips.

Person/Expression:
Bright ivory-beige skin with a smooth texture containing a hint of pink flush. Delicate highlights on the cheeks, nose tip, shoulders, collarbones, and legs. Makeup is elegant doll-like Japanese style, with pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink brown eyeshadow, long thin eyelashes, natural tear bags, light brown soft eyebrows, and glossy pink-beige lips. Small, clear catchlights in the eyes. Face is slightly toward the front, with only the eyes drifting to the left, showing a calm, contemplative expression. Hair is bright milk tea ash brown medium-long. Thin see-through bangs, layers along the face, ends curled loosely inward, with natural bundles and fine stray hairs, meticulously drawing soft gloss.

Clothing/Pose:
A room dress with thin shoulder straps and small floral patterns scattered on a pale ivory background. The chest has a shallow V-line with fine lace trim, gathers in the center, and a small ribbon, naturally reconstructed as a different design with a similar vibe. Without overemphasizing exposure, it depicts the soft drape of the fabric and natural wrinkles along the body. The person sits on the bed with both legs out and slightly bent. She holds the white stick of the candy with her own right hand, and the red candy is lightly touching the center of her lower bottom lip. Her left hand is on the bed by her side, slightly supporting her upper body. Shoulders are relaxed, and the overall physique is supple and mature.

Background/Light:
A white window frame and windowsill shelf on the left of the screen, with a transparent glass vase on top holding pale pink and white small flowers. The bed has pale floral patterned sheets and pillows. The background is a beige wall with few unnecessary items, creating a quiet and lived-in interior. The main light source is soft morning-to-midday natural light coming from the top-left window. Warm light hits the left cheek, shoulder, arm, hair surface, and legs, with shadows falling gently on the right and inside the body. The overall tone is based on cream, beige, and pale pink, with the red candy as a small focal point of color.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Camera is at an almost eye-level position, slightly higher than the person's chest. Face is placed in the upper center, with legs largely in the foreground to create depth. The window and vase are tucked into the left edge, leaving some margin in the direction her gaze is headed. Natural perspective around 50mm, with sharp focus on the face, eyes, candy, and fingertips, while the background is softly blurred.

Texture/Style:
Natural and high-quality indoor portrait photography. Soft film-like atmosphere, low contrast, warm color temperature, and delicate skin texture depiction. Meticulously expresses each strand of hair, fine patterns on the floral fabric, reflections on the glass vase, and the transparent gloss of the candy surface. Avoids excessive skin correction, resulting in a quiet and intimate finish like a magazine room portrait.

Negative:
Young-looking face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, broken limbs or joints, poor contact between candy and lips/fingers, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, overexposure, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logo, watermark.

zh.title: 红色糖果主题人像摄影
zh.description: 一个情绪导向的提示词，用于创作室内女性肖像：画面中女性坐在床上，手持红色棒棒糖，强调柔和的自然光感与玩偶般的审美风格。
zh.prompt:
主题：
{argument name="subject" default="透过糖果看轮廓"}

主要人物：
{argument name="main character" default="竖构图 3:4。一位成年女性坐在卧室的床上，沐浴在柔和的自然光中"}，位于画面中右侧偏大的位置。中景近距离拍摄，从头顶到大腿下方。人物占据了大部分画面，前景展示双腿，描绘她静静地看向一侧，嘴唇抵着一支红色棒棒糖的瞬间。

人物/表情：
明亮的象牙米色皮肤，质感细腻，透着淡淡的粉色红晕。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨和双腿上有精致的高光。妆容为优雅的日系娃娃风，搭配淡玫瑰粉色腮红、香槟米色与粉棕色眼影、细长睫毛、自然的卧蚕、浅棕色柔和眉毛以及光泽感十足的粉米色嘴唇。眼中带有清晰的小型眼神光。面部略微朝向前方，只有双眼向左偏移，呈现出平静、沉思的表情。发色为明亮的奶茶灰棕色中长发。轻薄的空气刘海，脸颊两侧有层次感，发尾向内自然卷曲，呈现出自然的束感和细碎的发丝，细腻地勾勒出柔和的光泽。

服装/姿势：
一件细肩带家居裙，淡象牙色底色上散布着小碎花图案。胸前采用浅 V 领设计，带有精致的蕾丝花边，中间有褶皱和小蝴蝶结，以相似的风格自然重构为另一种设计。在不过分强调暴露的前提下，描绘了面料的柔软垂坠感和沿身体形成的自然褶皱。人物坐在床上，双腿伸出并微微弯曲。她用右手拿着糖果的白色棍子，红色的糖果轻轻触碰着下嘴唇的中央。左手放在身侧的床上，微微支撑着上半身。肩膀放松，整体体态柔和而成熟。

背景/光线：
画面左侧为白色窗框和窗台架，上面放着一个透明玻璃花瓶，插着淡粉色和白色的小花。床上铺着淡碎花图案的床单和枕头。背景是米色的墙壁，几乎没有多余的杂物，营造出安静且充满生活气息的室内环境。主光源是来自左上方窗户的柔和晨间至午间自然光。暖光照射在左侧脸颊、肩膀、手臂、发丝表面和双腿上，阴影柔和地落在右侧和身体内侧。整体色调以奶油色、米色和淡粉色为主，红色的糖果作为小巧的色彩焦点。

构图/摄影：
竖构图 3:4。相机处于几乎与眼睛齐平的位置，略高于人物胸部。脸部位于上方中心，双腿在前景中占据较大比例以营造深度。窗户和花瓶被置于左侧边缘，在她的视线方向留出了一定的留白。采用约 50mm 的自然视角，焦点清晰地落在脸部、眼睛、糖果和指尖上，背景则呈现柔和的虚化效果。

质感/风格：
自然且高质量的室内人像摄影。柔和的胶片感氛围，低对比度，暖色温，细腻的皮肤质感描绘。细致地表现了每一根发丝、碎花面料上的精细纹理、玻璃花瓶上的反光以及糖果表面的透明光泽。避免过度磨皮，呈现出如同杂志室内人像般安静而亲密的质感。

负面提示词：
看起来太年轻的脸、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、粘连的手指、残缺的肢体或关节、糖果与嘴唇/手指接触不良、不符合重力的表现、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、过度曝光、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、乱码文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Shh Finger on Lips Beauty Portrait
en.description: A minimalist beauty portrait prompt featuring a woman making a 'quiet' gesture, emphasizing soft lighting, ivory tones, and high-end photographic quality.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Finger touching lips"}

Main Character:
{argument name="main character" default="A photorealistic vertical 3:4 portrait of a single woman sitting on the floor in a bright room"}. The person is placed center-right, captured from the top of the head to the thighs. The upper body occupies about two-thirds of the frame, with the face, fingertips, and chest naturally drawing the eye.

Person/Expression:
A natural and realistic individual with a calm, mature femininity. Hair is a short milk tea brown bob ending at the chin, with thin clumped bangs and fine stray hairs along the cheeks. Pale rose blush, pink-brown eye makeup, delicate long eyelashes, and sheer pink-beige lips. Head is slightly tilted to the left, looking at the camera with a quiet and somewhat suggestive expression.

Clothing/Pose:
A halter-neck dress with small ivory pleats, tied at the neck. Shoulders and arms are exposed, showing a silhouette with a naturally full, mature feminine bust line and soft body curves. No gloves. A 'shh' gesture where she bends her right elbow and stands her right index finger vertically to lightly touch the center of her lips. Other fingers are relaxed and naturally bent. The left arm is extended from the front of the body toward the knees in a stable sitting posture with one knee slightly raised. Accurately depicts the contact between finger and lip, and the overlapping of shoulders, arms, and chest.

Background/Light:
A minimal interior unified in white and pale beige. A large window in the back left, and a white vase with blurred small plants in the back right. The background is bright and organized, with no text or logos. Soft midday natural light enters from the top-left window, creating faint highlights on the forehead, bridge of the nose, cheeks, shoulders, collarbones, and arms. Shadows fall thinly to the bottom right, with shadows also lifted gently by reflections from the white floor.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. A light low-angle shot from slightly below chest height, with the natural compression of an 85mm portrait lens. Face is in the upper center, fingertips right in front of the face, and the chest in the lower center. Narrow margin above the head, leaving a bright space for the window on the left. Focus on the eyes and lips, with the background largely and softly blurred. Avoid excessive wide-angle distortion.

Texture/Style:
A clean, high-brightness Japanese beauty photo. Soft gradations, low contrast, and a color palette centered on ivory and pale pink. Skin is not made too uniform, naturally leaving fine pores, vellus hair, cheek flush, and lip moisture. Meticulously expresses each strand of hair, the thinness of the pleated fabric, and the delicacy of fingertips and nails.

Negative:
Young-looking face, unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, excessively exaggerated physique, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, poor contact between lips and fingers, broken joints, confusion of left and right arms, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, plastic-like skin, excessive skin correction, garbled text, logo, watermark.

zh.title: “嘘”——指尖轻触双唇的美妆肖像
zh.description: 一个极简主义美妆肖像提示词，展现了一位女性做出“安静”手势的画面，强调柔和光影、象牙色调及高端摄影质感。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="手指轻触双唇"}

主要人物：
{argument name="main character" default="一张写实风格的 3:4 竖版肖像，拍摄一位坐在明亮房间地板上的女性"}。人物位于画面中右侧，取景范围从头顶至大腿。上半身占据画面约三分之二，面部、指尖和胸部自然地吸引视觉焦点。

人物/表情：
一位自然写实的女性，展现出冷静、成熟的女性魅力。奶茶棕色短波波头，发尾及下巴，带有稀疏的束状刘海，脸颊旁有细碎的绒毛。淡玫瑰色腮红，粉棕色眼妆，精致的长睫毛，以及透亮的粉米色双唇。头部微微向左倾斜，正视镜头，表情安静且略带暗示感。

服装/姿势：
挂脖式连衣裙，带有细小的象牙色褶皱，在颈部系带。双肩和手臂裸露，展现出自然丰满、成熟的女性胸部线条和柔和的身体曲线。未佩戴手套。做出“嘘”的手势：右肘弯曲，右食指垂直竖起，轻轻触碰双唇中心。其余手指自然放松弯曲。左臂从身体前方伸向膝盖，呈现稳定的坐姿，其中一侧膝盖微微抬起。准确描绘手指与嘴唇的接触，以及肩膀、手臂和胸部的重叠关系。

背景/光影：
以白色和浅米色为主的极简室内环境。左后方有一扇大窗户，右后方摆放着一个插有模糊小植物的白色花瓶。背景明亮整洁，无文字或标志。午后的柔和自然光从左上方的窗户射入，在前额、鼻梁、脸颊、肩膀、锁骨和手臂上形成淡淡的高光。阴影轻微地投射在右下方，并由白色地板的反射柔和地补光。

构图/相机：
3:4 竖构图。从略低于胸部高度的轻微低角度拍摄，呈现 85mm 人像镜头的自然压缩感。面部位于上方中心，指尖位于面部正前方，胸部位于下方中心。头顶留白较少，左侧窗户处留有明亮的空白空间。焦点对准眼睛和嘴唇，背景呈现大面积的柔和虚化。避免过度广角带来的畸变。

质感/风格：
干净、高亮度的日系美妆摄影风格。柔和的渐变，低对比度，色调以象牙色和淡粉色为中心。皮肤质感不追求过度统一，自然保留细微毛孔、绒毛、脸颊红晕和唇部水润感。细腻地表现每一缕发丝、褶皱面料的轻薄感，以及指尖和指甲的精致细节。

负面提示词：
幼态脸，不自然的五官，不自然的眼神，过度夸张的体型，多指，缺指，粘连手指，关节断裂，左右臂混淆，透视错误，阴影与光源不一致，塑料感皮肤，过度磨皮，乱码文字，标志，水印。

en.title: Futuristic High Fashion Editorial Portrait
en.description: A cinematic, high-fashion prompt for a model in a futuristic architectural setting during golden hour, emphasizing realistic skin textures and architectural lines.
en.prompt:
{argument name="subject" default="A young adult East Asian female model"} walking in a modern landmark plaza, almost full-body shot. en.title: Realistic Backlit Silhouette Portrait of a Young Woman
en.description: A highly detailed Japanese prompt for a realistic, fashion-style photograph of a young woman sitting in a classical room, featuring elegant backlighting and a focus on skin texture and soft fabrics.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Sitting on the edge of light"}

Main Subject:
A photorealistic portrait of a woman in her 20s in a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, sitting on the floor of a bright Western-style room, positioned slightly to the left of the center. The subject occupies about 70% of the frame, showing her back to the camera while turning her upper body to the right to reveal a quiet profile. Her legs are folded to the right side of the screen, naturally overlapping from the knees to the toes. A pale cloth spreads from around her waist to the floor, creating soft curves at the bottom of the frame.

Character/Expression:
A woman in her 20s with naturally bright ivory-beige fair skin, showing a hint of pale pink color on her cheeks and shoulders. The skin texture is realistic, showing fine texture and soft downy hair rather than being blown out white. The face is a three-quarter profile turned to the right, with the gaze directed into the distance slightly below the camera. A quiet, contemplative expression with eyelids slightly lowered and lips naturally parted. Makeup includes pale peach-beige lipstick, soft rose blush, delicate brown-beige eye makeup, long thin eyelashes, and soft brown eyebrows. Small, clear catchlights in the eyes.

Clothing/Pose:
Hair is {argument name="hair color" default="deep natural brown"}, medium-long reaching near the chest, with loose waves and a natural bundled feel. Thin bangs and fine wisps around the face follow the cheeks, each strand outlined by backlighting. Draped in semi-transparent peach-ivory tulle that elegantly covers the chest, waist, and legs. Her left hand rests on the floor behind her to support the upper body, while her right hand lightly holds the fabric at the chest with naturally curved fingertips. Her back is gently straightened with shoulders slightly pulled back, creating a smooth S-curve from waist to back. The fabric creates fine folds following the body's weight and hand contact, flowing softly over the knees and floor.

Background/Lighting:
The background is a classical Western-style room in cream-beige. Behind the figure is a decorative mantelpiece with floral relief patterns. Small white flowers and antique-style ornaments are placed in a soft blur on the upper left and right. The primary light source is warm golden natural light from the upper right rear. Thin rim lighting is created on the hair, cheeks, shoulders, back, knees, and tulle edges, with shadows falling softly toward the lower left. Pale beige reflected light from the floor and walls maintains the skin's brightness and natural three-dimensionality.

Composition/Camera:
A medium full shot taken from nearly the same height as the subject's shoulders. A triangular composition with the face positioned toward the upper left, the back in the center, and the bent knees in the lower right. About 20% negative space is left above the head, and quiet negative space is secured on the right wall. A gentle compression feel equivalent to an 85mm lens. Focus is on the eyes and cheeks of the profile and the hair near the shoulders. The background is smoothly blurred with a shallow depth of field. Leading lines guide the gaze downward via the diagonal from back to knees and the curves of the fabric on the floor.

Texture/Style:
An elegant and quiet fashion editorial photograph. A low-saturation color palette centered on warm caramel beige, pale peach, and ivory. Soft halation, subtle film grain, and gentle contrast. Carefully depicts natural skin texture, individual hair strands, fine mesh of the translucent tulle, transmitted light, and shades created by layering. Avoids excessive skin correction or artificial whiteness, leaving realistic shadows within the light.

Negative Prompt:
Underage-looking person, plastic skin, excessive skin correction, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, asymmetrical eyes, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, poor contact with fabric, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, gibberish text, logos, watermarks.

zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="坐在光影边缘"}

主要主体：
一张 2:3 纵向比例的女性写实肖像，一位 20 多岁的女性坐在明亮的西式房间地板上，位置略微偏向画面中心左侧。主体占据约 70% 的画幅，背对镜头，上身向右转动，露出安静的侧脸。双腿向画面右侧折叠，从膝盖到脚趾自然重叠。一块浅色布料从她腰部周围铺开至地板，在画面底部形成柔和的曲线。

角色/表情：
一位 20 多岁的女性，拥有自然明亮的象牙米色白皙皮肤，脸颊和肩膀透出淡淡的粉色。皮肤质感真实，呈现出细腻的纹理和柔软的绒毛，而非过度曝光的惨白。面部为向右转的三分之二侧脸，视线投向镜头下方稍远处。表情安静沉思，眼睑微垂，双唇自然微张。妆容包括浅桃米色唇膏、柔和的玫瑰色腮红、精致的棕米色眼妆、纤长的睫毛和柔和的棕色眉毛。眼中带有细小清晰的眼神光。

服装/姿势：
发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深自然棕色"}，中长发垂至胸前，带有松散的波浪感和自然的束感。薄刘海和脸颊周围的细碎发丝顺着脸部轮廓，每一根发丝都被背光勾勒出来。身披半透明的桃象牙色薄纱，优雅地覆盖着胸部、腰部和双腿。左手撑在身后地板上支撑上身，右手轻轻捏住胸前的布料，指尖自然弯曲。背部微微挺直，双肩略向后收，从腰部到背部形成平滑的 S 型曲线。布料随着身体重量和手部接触产生细腻的褶皱，柔和地流淌在膝盖和地板上。

背景/光影：
背景为奶油米色的古典西式房间。人物身后是一个带有花卉浮雕图案的装饰性壁炉架。左上角和右上角模糊处理了小白花和古董风格的装饰品。主要光源来自右上后方的温暖金色自然光。头发、脸颊、肩膀、背部、膝盖和薄纱边缘形成了细致的轮廓光，阴影柔和地投向左下方。来自地板和墙壁的浅米色反射光保持了皮肤的亮度和自然的立体感。

构图/摄影：
中全景镜头，拍摄高度与主体肩膀几乎齐平。采用三角形构图，面部位于左上方，背部位于中心，弯曲的膝盖位于右下方。头部上方留有约 20% 的留白，右侧墙壁也保留了安静的负空间。具有 85mm 镜头带来的轻微压缩感。焦点对准侧脸的眼睛、脸颊以及肩膀附近的头发。背景通过浅景深进行平滑虚化。引导线通过从背部到膝盖的对角线以及地板上布料的曲线，将视线引向下方。

质感/风格：
优雅而安静的时尚编辑摄影风格。以暖焦糖米色、浅桃色和象牙色为中心的低饱和度调色板。带有柔和的光晕、细腻的胶片颗粒感和柔和的对比度。细致描绘了自然的皮肤纹理、单根发丝、半透明薄纱的细网格、透射光以及层叠产生的阴影。避免过度磨皮或人工美白，在光影中保留真实的阴影。

负面提示词：
未成年长相、塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、不自然的面部、不自然的视线、不对称的眼睛、多余的手指、手指缺失、肢体融合、关节断裂、与织物接触不自然、重力感不自然、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、乱码文字、Logo、水印。

Natural reflections on the chocolate. ⸻ CAMERA Shot as if captured on an iPhone 16 Pro. 26mm equivalent lens. Natural computational photography. Subtle depth of field. Realistic handheld perspective. Editorial food realism. ⸻ BRAND FEEL Official KitKat social campaign. Modern. Approachable. Comfort-first. Premium yet relatable. Feels like content shared by a lifestyle creator rather than a traditional advertisement. ⸻ NEGATIVE PROMPT Studio backdrop, product floating, fake splash effects, oversized chocolate pieces, plastic-looking food, unrealistic symmetry, excessive props, HDR look, AI-generated skin, cluttered workspace, exaggerated expressions, overdesigned graphics, stock-photo posing, unrealistic lighting, low-resolution textures, distorted packaging, unreadable logo.

zh.title: KitKat 高端 UGC 广告海报
zh.description: 一份全面的提示词，用于制作高转化率、写实的 Instagram 风格 KitKat UGC 广告，主角为一名在现代家庭办公室工作的印度创作者。
zh.prompt: KITKAT — 高端 UGC 产品广告 角色：担任屡获殊荣的 UGC 创意总监、商业美食摄影师、生活方式电影摄影师、快消品（FMCG）品牌策略师以及 Meta 效果广告专家，专注于高转化率的社交媒体营销活动。 ⸻ 格式 4:5 竖屏 Instagram 广告，超写实生活方式摄影，高端 UGC 美学，原生 Instagram 创作者内容，奢华快消品广告，8K 超高清细节。 ⸻ 核心概念 一位真实的创作者在忙碌的工作日中享受应得的休息时光。产品并非在被刻意推销，而是自然地融入了这一时刻。视觉效果应瞬间传达出放松、舒适和享受的氛围。 ⸻ 场景 黄金时段的现代极简风格家庭办公室。温暖的阳光透过大窗户洒在干净的木质书桌上。半开的笔记本电脑、笔记本、咖啡杯、无线耳机和一些日常办公用品营造出真实的工作空间。创作者刚刚暂停了工作，一只手自然地伸向打开的 KitKat，另一只手放在笔记本电脑旁。包装纸旁随意放着几块折断的 KitKat，细小的巧克力碎屑增强了真实感。 ⸻ 主角 年轻的印度专业人士（22-30 岁），表情自然，带着真诚的浅笑，姿态舒适放松，不看镜头。画面应呈现出完全抓拍的即兴感。 ⸻ 产品主角 经典的 KitKat 巧克力棒，包装清晰可见。包装纸微微打开，巧克力质感酥脆且细节丰富。断开的一块巧克力上可见清晰的威化层，带有细腻的巧克力光泽。产品始终是视觉焦点，但看起来并不突兀。 ⸻ 构图 手持创作者视角，构图略带不完美感。前景有咖啡杯带来的虚化效果，书桌层次感自然，为排版留出了平衡的留白空间。 ⸻ 平面设计 高端创作者风格的叠加层，极简圆角 UI 卡片，小巧的“Coffee Break ☕”贴纸，微型时间戳，柔和的投影。采用干净的 Instagram 原生设计语言，避免过度设计。 ⸻ 排版 大标题：HAVE A BREAK。辅助文案：有时候，最好的创意始于离开屏幕的五分钟。行动号召（CTA）：Grab Your KitKat。 ⸻ 色调方案 KitKat 红，暖橡木色，奶油白，咖啡棕，金色阳光，自然肤色，浓郁巧克力棕。 ⸻ 灯光 真实的黄金时段窗光，柔和的自然阴影，温暖的室内氛围。无影棚闪光灯，无人工商业布光，巧克力上有自然的反射光。 ⸻ 摄影设备 模拟 iPhone 16 Pro 拍摄效果，26mm 等效镜头，自然的计算摄影风格，细腻的景深，真实的手持视角，纪实美食摄影质感。 ⸻ 品牌调性 KitKat 官方社交媒体活动，现代、亲和、舒适至上，高端且易于产生共鸣。看起来像是生活方式创作者分享的内容，而非传统的商业广告。 ⸻ 负面提示词 影棚背景、产品悬浮、虚假的溅射效果、过大的巧克力块、塑料感食物、不切实际的对称、过多的道具、HDR 效果、AI 生成的皮肤、杂乱的工作空间、夸张的表情、过度设计的图形、库存照片式的摆拍、不真实的光影、低分辨率纹理、扭曲的包装、无法辨认的 Logo。

en.title: Cinematic Portrait of an East Asian Woman in a Dark Bedroom
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a realistic and moody portrait of a young East Asian woman in silk pajamas, sitting in a minimalist dark bedroom with soft window light.
en.prompt: A young adult East Asian {argument name="gender" default="female"} sits on the edge of a bed in a dark bedroom, captured in a mid-to-full-body composition, positioned slightly left of center. She sits sideways, leaning forward slightly with relaxed shoulders, her head bowed gently, looking down and avoiding the camera with a quiet, restrained, and contemplative expression. Her hands rest naturally in front of her legs, one hand lightly holding the other cuff in a modest and relaxed posture. She has a soft ovoid face, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slim nose, and pale nude pink lips. Her makeup is extremely light, retaining natural lashes, fine eyeliner, and a touch of blush. Her skin is fair with warm tones, preserving real pores, fine vellus hair, natural color variations, and soft highlights, without plastic-like smoothing. She has {argument name="hair color" default="deep black"} long straight hair, flowing naturally with rich volume, some strands falling across her face, shoulders, and chest with a slight messiness. Her attire is a {argument name="clothing" default="black silk or satin pajama set"}, with a long-sleeved short top and high-waisted pants, featuring fine white piping on the collar, placket, cuffs, and chest pocket, with clear white buttons. The fabric is soft and smooth with a light satin sheen. The background is a minimalist dark bedroom: heavy black curtains on the left, a bed with dark gray or black bedding on the right, and a dark gray-brown wall behind, creating a clean and quiet environment. Lighting is soft natural window light from the left, low contrast and low saturation, with delicate transitions on the face and fabric, presenting a quiet cinematic feel. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/2, shallow depth of field, clear eyes and face, soft blurred background, real optical imaging, light film grain, dark editorial lifestyle portrait, photorealistic. Avoid: Cartoon, CG, excessive smoothing, heavy makeup, exaggerated expressions, incorrect fingers, deformed limbs, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered background, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 暗色卧室中东亚女性的电影感肖像
zh.description: 一份高细节提示词，用于生成一张写实且富有情绪感的肖像：一位身着丝绸睡衣的年轻东亚女性，坐在一间极简主义暗色卧室中，伴有柔和的窗光。
zh.prompt: 一位年轻的东亚 {argument name="gender" default="女性"} 坐在暗色卧室的床边，采用中景到全身构图，位置略微偏左。她侧身坐着，肩膀放松，身体微微前倾，低头垂眸，避开镜头，表情安静、克制且沉思。双手自然地放在腿前，一只手轻轻握住另一只袖口，姿态端庄而放松。她拥有柔和的鹅蛋脸，深棕色的杏仁眼，自然的细眉，小巧的鼻梁，以及淡淡的裸粉色嘴唇。妆容极淡，保留了自然的睫毛、细眼线和少许腮红。皮肤白皙且带有暖色调，保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、自然的肤色变化和柔和的高光，没有塑料感的磨皮。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深黑色"} 的长直发，自然垂落，发量丰盈，几缕发丝略显凌乱地散落在脸庞、肩膀和胸前。她身着 {argument name="clothing" default="黑色丝绸或缎面睡衣套装"}，长袖短款上衣搭配高腰裤，领口、门襟、袖口和胸袋处有精致的白色滚边，配有清晰的白色纽扣。面料柔软顺滑，带有淡淡的缎面光泽。背景为极简主义暗色卧室：左侧是厚重的黑色窗帘，右侧是铺着深灰色或黑色床品的床，后方是深灰棕色的墙壁，营造出干净安静的环境。光线为左侧柔和的自然窗光，低对比度、低饱和度，面部和织物上的过渡细腻，呈现出安静的电影感。摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/2 光圈，浅景深，眼睛和面部清晰，背景柔焦，真实光学成像，轻微胶片颗粒感，暗调编辑风格生活肖像，照片级真实感。避免：卡通、CG、过度磨皮、浓妆、夸张表情、手指错误、肢体畸形、强 HDR、过度锐化、背景杂乱、文字、水印、Logo。

en.title: Mirror Selfie in Urban Store
en.description: A candid full-body mirror selfie prompt of a stylish woman in a retail environment, using a reference image for her outfit.
en.prompt: A candid, full-body mirror selfie captures a stylish young woman with {argument name="hair style" default="wavy, dark hair"} and {argument name="sunglasses style" default="trendy sunglasses"}. She is posing in an urban clothing store, wearing a outfit from second image. She is taking the photo with her phone . The background shows retail displays, racks with T-shirts (one featuring a Stussy logo), a mannequin wearing a cap, and an industrial-style ceiling with track lighting.

zh.title: 城市商店中的镜面自拍
zh.description: 一个关于时尚女性在零售环境中进行全身镜面自拍的抓拍提示词，并使用参考图像来展示她的穿搭。
zh.prompt: 一张抓拍的全身镜面自拍，捕捉了一位时尚年轻女性，她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="波浪深色卷发"}，戴着 {argument name="sunglasses style" default="潮流太阳镜"}。她正在一家城市服装店内摆姿势，穿着第二张图片中的服装。她正拿着手机自拍。背景展示了零售陈列架、挂着 T 恤的衣架（其中一件带有 Stussy 标志）、一个戴着帽子的模特，以及带有轨道灯的工业风天花板。

en.title: Gentle Beachside Portrait of an East Asian Woman
en.description: A cinematic and realistic prompt for creating a seaside lifestyle photograph of a young East Asian woman with a gentle smile, featuring soft natural sunlight and a coastal background.
en.prompt: A young adult East Asian woman sits on a {argument name="location" default="beach"}, captured in a waist-to-three-quarter composition, positioned slightly right of center. Her body is turned slightly to the left, and her head is turned toward the upper left of the frame, avoiding the camera, showing a natural bright smile with teeth slightly visible, with a gentle, relaxed, and fresh expression. Her right hand is lightly raised to touch her ear or hair, and her left hand rests naturally on her lap or skirt. She has a soft ovoid face, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slim nose, and pale coral pink lips. Her makeup is extremely light, with natural lashes, light eyeliner, and subtle blush. Her skin is fair with warm tones, preserving real pores, fine vellus hair, natural color variations, and soft highlights, without plastic-like smoothing. She has {argument name="hair style" default="long deep black hair"}, flowing naturally with rich volume and slight waves. The sea breeze blows through her hair, with some strands crossing her forehead, cheeks, and shoulders, maintaining a sense of real weight and natural messiness. She wears a {argument name="clothing" default="white thin embroidered gauze wrap dress"} or tunic-style long dress, with a V-neckline, waist tie, three-quarter sleeves, and delicate white floral embroidery on the cuffs and fabric surface, looking soft, flowing, semi-transparent but modest. She wears a short white pearl necklace and a delicate pearl bracelet. The background is a quiet seaside, with waves and reflections visible to the back left, misty mountains or coastline in the distance, and a light gray-blue sky at dusk or dawn, overall high-key, low saturation, low contrast. Lighting is soft natural daylight, slightly backlit or side-backlit, with soft rim light on her hair, cheeks, and skirt. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, clear eyes and face, soft blurred background, real seaside lifestyle photography, light film grain, photorealistic. Avoid: Cartoon, CG, illustration, excessive smoothing, heavy makeup, exaggerated smiles, incorrect fingers, deformed arms, overexposure with lost details, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered background, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 温柔海滨东亚女性肖像
zh.description: 一个电影感且写实的提示词，用于创作一张年轻东亚女性在海边生活的照片，她面带温柔微笑，画面呈现柔和的自然光和海岸背景。
zh.prompt: 一位年轻的东亚女性坐在 {argument name="location" default="海滩"} 上，采用腰部至四分之三的构图，位于画面中心偏右位置。她的身体略微向左转，头部转向画面的左上方，避开镜头，展现出自然明亮的笑容，牙齿微露，神情温柔、放松且清新。她的右手轻轻抬起触碰耳朵或头发，左手自然地放在膝盖或裙子上。她拥有柔和的鹅蛋脸，杏仁状的深褐色眼睛，自然的细眉，挺拔的鼻梁和淡珊瑚粉色的嘴唇。妆容极其清透，配有自然的睫毛、淡眼线和淡淡的腮红。皮肤白皙且带有暖色调，保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、自然的肤色变化和柔和的高光，没有塑料感的磨皮。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="深黑色长发"}，发丝自然垂落，发量丰盈且带有轻微的波浪感。海风吹拂着她的头发，几缕发丝掠过额头、脸颊和肩膀，保持着真实的质感和自然的凌乱感。她身穿一件 {argument name="clothing" default="白色薄款刺绣纱质裹身裙"} 或长款罩衫裙，V 领设计，腰部系带，七分袖，袖口和面料表面饰有精致的白色花卉刺绣，看起来柔软、飘逸、半透明但端庄。她佩戴着一条短款白色珍珠项链和一只精致的珍珠手链。背景是宁静的海滨，左后方可见海浪和倒影，远处是朦胧的山脉或海岸线，天空呈现出黄昏或黎明时的浅灰蓝色，整体为高调、低饱和度、低对比度风格。光线为柔和的自然日光，略带逆光或侧逆光，头发、脸颊和裙摆上有柔和的轮廓光。摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8 光圈，浅景深，眼睛和面部清晰，背景柔焦，真实的海滨生活摄影，轻微胶片颗粒感，照片级真实。避免：卡通、CG、插画、过度磨皮、浓妆、夸张的笑容、手指错误、手臂畸形、细节丢失的过度曝光、强烈的 HDR、过度锐化、杂乱的背景、文字、水印、Logo。

en.prompt: Above a silent desert, waves hang in the sky while melting arches and mirrored stairways lead somewhere impossible.

zh.title: 未来之光城市
zh.description: 一个电影级的提示词，描绘了一座充满未来感的城市景观，包含悬浮高速公路和位于新世界边缘的超现实建筑。
zh.prompt: 一座光之城，拥有悬浮高速公路和超现实建筑——坐落于新世界的边缘。

en.title: Luxury Boutique Hotel Elevator Mirror Selfie
en.description: A high-fashion mirror selfie prompt set in a contemporary luxury hotel elevator, capturing a Korean idol in a denim corset romper with Hasselblad-style color science.
en.prompt: Authentic luxury mirror selfie inside a {argument name="elevator style" default="contemporary boutique hotel elevator"} during a quiet afternoon. An exceptionally beautiful Korean female idol stands naturally in front of a brushed stainless-steel mirror wearing an {argument name="clothing" default="strapless light-wash denim corset romper with a sculpted waistline and structured tailoring, decorative flap pockets, taupe suede knee-high boots"}. {argument name="hair color" default="Platinum-blonde"} hair with soft movement and delicate flyaway strands, hydrated skin with visible pores, minimal Korean editorial makeup, calm introspective expression. Boutique hotel elevator with brushed steel walls, smoked bronze mirror panels, walnut trim, stone flooring, brass accents, warm architectural LED lighting, subtle daylight entering through opening doors, quiet luxury atmosphere. Documentary-fashion hybrid inspired by Mark Borthwick, Mario Sorrenti, Cass Bird, Lachlan Bailey, and Vogue Korea. Hasselblad X2D, 50–55mm lens, f/1.2, shallow depth of field, creamy cinematic bokeh, Kodak Portra 400 and Kodak Vision3 250D color science, Boutique Hotel Neutral LUT, authentic optical rendering, urban travel fashion diary, lived-in elegance, captured rather than generated, 3:4 aspect ratio.

zh.title: 奢华精品酒店镜面自拍
zh.description: 一个用于生成高端时尚镜面自拍的精美提示词，场景设定在奢华精品酒店电梯内，主角为身着牛仔连体裤的韩国女偶像。
zh.prompt: 在安静的午后，于 {argument name="setting" default="现代精品酒店电梯"} 内拍摄的真实奢华镜面自拍。一位极其美丽的 {argument name="subject" default="韩国女偶像"} 自然地站在拉丝不锈钢镜子前，身穿一件 {argument name="clothing" default="浅色抹胸牛仔束腰连体裤"}，腰部剪裁立体，结构感强，配有装饰性翻盖口袋和灰褐色麂皮过膝靴。白金色的头发呈现出柔和的动感，带有细碎的凌乱发丝，肌肤水润且可见毛孔，精致的韩式杂志风妆容，表情平静而内敛。精品酒店电梯采用拉丝钢墙面、烟熏青铜镜面板、胡桃木装饰、石材地板和黄铜点缀，温暖的建筑 LED 灯光，柔和的日光透过开启的电梯门射入，营造出静谧奢华的氛围。融合了 Mark Borthwick、Mario Sorrenti、Cass Bird、Lachlan Bailey 和《Vogue Korea》风格的纪实时尚摄影。使用 Hasselblad X2D，50–55mm 镜头，f/1.2 大光圈，浅景深，奶油般细腻的电影感虚化，Kodak Portra 400 和 Kodak Vision3 250D 色彩科学，Boutique Hotel Neutral LUT，真实的镜头渲染，都市旅行时尚日记，充满生活气息的优雅感，仿佛真实捕捉而非 AI 生成，3:4 画幅。

en.title: Mischievous Doodle Shadow
en.description: A playful prompt that creates a hand-drawn doodle shadow mimicking a subject in funny poses, creating a humorous contrast.
en.prompt: A mischievous doodle shadow mimics the character with exaggerated funny poses while she stands still wearing {argument name="clothing" default="modern trendy clothes"}. The shadow appears hand-drawn, playful, and full of personality, creating a humorous contrast with the calm subject. She wears a fashionable {argument name="top" default="oversized shirt"}, {argument name="bottom" default="cargo pants"}, and sneakers. Her facial expression is confused, as if she has no idea what the shadow is doing.

zh.title: 调皮的涂鸦影子
zh.description: 一个充满趣味的提示词，可生成模仿主体滑稽姿势的手绘涂鸦影子，营造出幽默的反差感。
zh.prompt: 一个调皮的涂鸦影子正在模仿角色，摆出夸张滑稽的姿势，而她本人则静静地站着，穿着 {argument name="clothing" default="现代潮流服饰"}。影子呈现出手绘风格，俏皮且充满个性，与平静的主体形成了幽默的反差。她穿着时尚的 {argument name="top" default="廓形衬衫"}、{argument name="bottom" default="工装裤"} 和运动鞋。她面露困惑，仿佛完全不知道影子在做什么。

en.title: Asian Digital Influencer Portrait
en.description: Generates hyper-realistic, consistent portraits of a fictional digital influencer in a geeky creator room with neon lighting.
en.prompt:
Create one standalone hyper-realistic portrait per output. Generate four independent image files of the same fictional {argument name="ethnicity" default="Asian"} digital influencer, around {argument name="age" default="28"} years old, with the same face, shoulder-length black hair with subtle blue highlights and {argument name="outfit style" default="black futuristic streetwear"} across the batch.
She is broadcasting from a sophisticated, slightly geeky creator room. Chest-up portrait, direct eye contact, confident friendly expression, professional microphone, headphones, blurred dual monitors, small sci-fi collectibles and tasteful cyan, violet and magenta neon lights. Soft warm key light on her face, realistic skin pores, natural eyes, detailed hair, shallow depth of field and premium 50mm portrait photography.
Vary only her expression, head angle, subtle hand gesture and neon balance between outputs. One woman and one portrait in each image. No grid, collage, contact sheet, split screen, multiple panels, text, logos, watermark, duplicate person, anime or CGI appearance.

zh.title: 亚洲数字博主肖像
zh.description: 生成在带有霓虹灯的极客创作者房间中，虚构数字博主的超写实、一致性肖像。
zh.prompt:
每次输出生成一张独立的超写实肖像。生成四张同一位虚构的 {argument name="ethnicity" default="亚洲"} 数字博主的独立图像文件，年龄约为 {argument name="age" default="28"} 岁，保持相同的面部特征、齐肩黑发（带有微妙的蓝色挑染）以及 {argument name="outfit style" default="黑色未来感街头服饰"}。
她正在一个精致且略带极客风格的创作者房间内进行直播。胸部以上肖像，直视镜头，自信友好的表情，配有专业麦克风、耳机，背景为模糊的双显示器、小型科幻收藏品以及品味高雅的青色、紫色和洋红色霓虹灯。面部有柔和的暖色主光，呈现真实的皮肤毛孔、自然的眼睛、细腻的发丝，采用浅景深和优质的 50mm 肖像摄影效果。
仅在不同输出之间改变她的表情、头部角度、微妙的手势以及霓虹灯光的平衡。每张图像仅包含一名女性和一张肖像。禁止出现网格、拼贴、联系表、分屏、多面板、文字、Logo、水印、重复人物、动漫或 CGI 外观。

en.title: Footballer Then vs Now Transformation
en.description: A split-screen prompt that generates a nostalgic childhood portrait and a modern adult version of the same person, showing the passage of time.
en.prompt: Create a realistic vertical split-screen "Then vs Now" transformation featuring the same famous {argument name="athlete" default="football player"}. The composition is divided into two stacked sections. Top panel: a warm nostalgic childhood portrait set in the player's family home during their birth year (display the year in clean white text on the left, e.g. "{argument name="birth year" default="1985"}"). The child sits naturally facing the camera wearing a simple white T-shirt, soft golden sunlight streaming through a nearby window, authentic 90s/80s home interior, subtle film grain, warm Kodak color grading, emotional and cinematic. Bottom panel: the same person recreated as their present-day adult self in 2026, maintaining recognizable facial structure and identity, wearing a plain white oversized T-shirt inside a modern café with warm ambient lighting and shallow depth of field. Place a small rounded-corner reference portrait of the player in their national team jersey at the bottom-right corner. Match the pose, eye direction, framing, and expression between the child and adult versions to emphasize the passage of time. Hyper-realistic skin, natural facial evolution, consistent identity, cinematic photography, editorial quality, soft depth of field, 85mm lens, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 8K, masterpiece.

zh.title: 足球运动员“过去与现在”的蜕变
zh.description: 一个分屏提示词，用于生成同一个人怀旧的童年肖像与现代成年版本的对比图，展现时光的流逝。
zh.prompt: 创作一张逼真的垂直分屏“过去与现在”蜕变图，主角为同一位著名的 {argument name="athlete" default="足球运动员"}。画面分为上下两部分。上方板块：一张温馨怀旧的童年肖像，背景设定在球员出生年份的家中（在左侧以简洁的白色文字显示年份，例如“{argument name="birth year" default="1985"}”）。孩子自然地面对镜头，身穿简单的白色 T 恤，柔和的金色阳光从窗户射入，呈现 90 年代/80 年代真实的家居内饰，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感和温暖的柯达色调，充满情感与电影感。下方板块：同一个人在 2026 年的现代成年形象，保持可辨识的面部结构和身份特征，身穿纯白色宽松 T 恤，置身于一家现代咖啡馆中，环境光温暖，具有浅景深效果。在右下角放置一张该球员身穿国家队球衣的小型圆角参考肖像。使儿童版与成年版在姿势、视线方向、构图和表情上保持一致，以强调时光的流逝。超写实皮肤纹理，自然的面部演变，一致的身份特征，电影级摄影，编辑级质量，柔和景深，85mm 镜头，超细节，照片级真实，8K，杰作。

en.title: Ink-Twin Doodle Stylization
en.description: A structured JSON-based prompt for stylizing an image with an 'ink-twin' doodle character mimicking the main subject's pose.

zh.title: Ink-Twin 涂鸦风格化

en.title: Realistic Mountain Valley Travel Portrait
en.description: Generates a breathtaking cinematic travel photo of a woman in a European alpine setting, emphasizing natural lighting and autumn aesthetics.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic travel photograph of a young woman standing peacefully behind a rustic weathered wooden fence, facing the camera with her front fully visible while maintaining a calm, serene expression. She gently rests one hand on the wooden fence and naturally gazes toward the camera, creating a timeless editorial travel portrait. She wears a {argument name="sweater" default="cozy oversized moss-green fuzzy knit sweater"} layered over a {argument name="skirt" default="flowing ivory-white skirt"}, creating a soft autumn aesthetic. Her dark brown hair is neatly tied into a low bun with a delicate yellow floral scrunchie, subtly illuminated by warm golden-hour sunlight.
In front of her stretches a {argument name="scenery" default="picturesque European mountain valley"} filled with rolling emerald-green meadows, winding country roads, scattered traditional alpine farmhouses, and a charming white church with a tall pointed steeple nestled in the village below. Golden autumn trees are scattered across the hillsides, adding vibrant seasonal contrast.
The dramatic background features towering jagged snow-capped mountain peaks rising sharply beneath a vast blue sky filled with soft layered clouds. Warm sunlight breaks across the valley, creating beautiful highlights on the grass while deep mountain shadows add depth and atmosphere. The composition emphasizes scale, tranquility, and wanderlust, with the woman positioned in the foreground as the focal point against the magnificent alpine scenery.
Shot in a premium travel-photography style with natural lighting, ultra-realistic textures, crisp mountain details, HDR dynamic range, vibrant yet true-to-life colors, cinematic depth, atmospheric perspective, sharp focus throughout, subtle bokeh, National Geographic quality, luxury travel magazine aesthetic, peaceful mood, breathtaking scenery, 8K ultra-high resolution, photorealistic, vertical composition (3:4 aspect ratio).

zh.title: 写实风格山谷旅行人像
zh.description: 生成一张令人惊叹的电影感旅行照片，展现欧洲高山背景下的女性形象，强调自然光影与秋日美学。
zh.prompt:
一张超写实的电影感旅行摄影作品，画面中一位年轻女性平静地站在质朴的旧木栅栏后，正面对着镜头，神情宁静安详。她的一只手轻轻搭在木栅栏上，自然地注视着镜头，营造出一种永恒的杂志大片质感。她身穿 {argument name="sweater" default="舒适的超大款苔藓绿毛绒针织衫"}，内搭 {argument name="skirt" default="飘逸的象牙白半身裙"}，呈现出柔和的秋日美学。她深棕色的头发整齐地扎成低发髻，系着一个精致的黄色花朵发圈，在温暖的黄金时刻阳光下显得格外柔和。
在她前方延伸开来的是 {argument name="scenery" default="风景如画的欧洲山谷"}，点缀着连绵起伏的翠绿草甸、蜿蜒的乡村小路、散落的传统高山农舍，以及下方村庄里一座拥有高耸尖顶的迷人白色教堂。金色的秋树散落在山坡上，增添了鲜明的季节对比。
壮丽的背景中，高耸入云的锯齿状雪山在广阔的蓝天和层叠的柔云下显得格外锐利。温暖的阳光洒满山谷，在草地上投下美丽的光斑，而深邃的山影则增添了层次感与氛围感。构图强调了尺度感、宁静感与旅行的渴望，女性位于前景，作为壮丽高山背景下的视觉焦点。
采用高端旅行摄影风格拍摄，自然光影，超写实纹理，清晰的山脉细节，HDR 动态范围，色彩鲜艳且真实，电影级景深，大气透视，全画面清晰对焦，细腻的焦外成像，国家地理级品质，奢华旅行杂志美学，宁静氛围，令人屏息的风景，8K 超高分辨率，照片级真实感，竖构图（3:4 比例）。

en.title: Candid Editorial Portrait in Golden Hour
en.description: A detailed lifestyle photography prompt for a high-fashion editorial look featuring a woman with a camera and a whimsical charcoal doodle interaction.
en.prompt: A candid editorial-style full-body portrait of a cute young woman standing against a {argument name="background wall" default="warm beige textured wall"} in soft golden-hour sunlight. She wears a {argument name="top" default="white ruched short-sleeve blouse"}, a {argument name="skirt" default="black pleated mini skirt"}, white crew socks, and black loafers, while holding a compact silver digital camera with a wrist strap. Her long auburn hair falls naturally with soft bangs, and she has a slightly confused, curious expression while looking to the side. Next to her on the wall is a large hand-drawn charcoal doodle of a playful cartoon version of herself, jumping excitedly with both arms raised in peace signs, tongue sticking out, one leg lifted, and energetic sketch lines. A small hand-drawn question mark floats above the real girl, emphasizing the contrast between her calm demeanor and the doodle’s chaotic energy. Minimalist composition, clean background, natural shadows, warm neutral tones, whimsical storytelling, lifestyle photography, ultra-realistic, high detail, authentic skin texture, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic lighting, magazine editorial aesthetic, 8K.

zh.title: 黄金时刻的纪实风时尚肖像
zh.description: 这是一份详细的生活方式摄影提示词，旨在打造具有高级时尚感的纪实大片，画面中包含一位拿着相机的女性以及充满奇思妙想的炭笔涂鸦互动。
zh.prompt: 一张纪实编辑风格的全身肖像照，一位可爱的年轻女性站在 {argument name="background wall" default="温暖的米色纹理墙"} 前，沐浴在柔和的黄金时刻阳光下。她穿着 {argument name="top" default="白色褶皱短袖衬衫"}、{argument name="skirt" default="黑色百褶迷你裙"}、白色中筒袜和黑色乐福鞋，手里拿着一台带有腕带的银色紧凑型数码相机。她留着一头自然的红褐色长发，带有柔和的刘海，侧头看向一旁，表情略显困惑与好奇。墙上紧挨着她的是一幅巨大的手绘炭笔涂鸦，画的是一个俏皮的卡通版自己，正兴奋地跳跃着，双手举起比出 V 字手势，吐着舌头，单腿抬起，线条充满活力。女孩头顶上方漂浮着一个小小的手绘问号，突显了她平静的神态与涂鸦混乱能量之间的对比。极简构图，背景干净，自然阴影，温暖的中性色调，奇幻叙事，生活方式摄影，超写实，高细节，真实的皮肤纹理，35mm 镜头，浅景深，柔和的电影感光效，杂志编辑美学，8K。

Soft {argument name="background" default="gradient deep orange background"} with large bold white “RAMEN” text behind. zh.prompt: 极简主义商业广告，展示了一碗超大份的优质 {argument name="food item" default="日式拉面"}，配有浓郁的豚骨汤底、手工面条、溏心蛋、叉烧、葱花、海苔和芝麻，设计极其简洁。一位穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="优雅全白套装"} 的时尚年轻女性随意地倚靠在巨大的拉面碗旁，手持筷子夹起面条，姿态放松自信，双眼微闭。柔和的 {argument name="background" default="深橙色渐变背景"}，后方有醒目的白色粗体“RAMEN”文字。光亮的反射地面，高级摄影棚灯光，奢华美食摄影，超写实，8K 分辨率。右上角小字“Designed by Mr Das”。底部中心小号白色字体标语：“Comfort served beautifully.”

en.title: Modern Apartment East Asian Woman Portrait
en.description: A photorealistic portrait prompt for a young East Asian woman in a modern apartment setting, emphasizing natural skin texture and soft daylight.
en.prompt:
A young adult East Asian woman standing in a modern apartment dining/living area, half-body to upper-body composition, positioned slightly to the right of the center. She is {argument name="pose" default="naturally leaning back with her body curved, arms extended backward, hands resting on the edge of a dark wooden dining table"}, creating a smooth curve in her waist and abdomen. Her head is tilted slightly back and to the left, facing the camera with a calm, confident, and slightly lazy expression, lips naturally parted.

She has a soft and delicate oval face, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, light nude-pink lips, and light makeup. Her skin is fair and warm-toned, retaining real pores, fine fuzz, natural skin color variations, and soft highlights—no plastic skin smoothing. Her hair is long, dark blackish-brown, naturally flowing, soft and slightly voluminous, with some strands falling on her shoulders and chest.

She is wearing {argument name="outfit" default="a white slim-fit long-sleeved crop top knotted at the chest, made of soft, close-fitting fabric that reveals the waist; paired with white loose-fitting lounge pants"} with a high elastic waistband; a small silver waist chain or pearl-like decoration is around her waist. The overall look is fresh, clean, and lifelike.

The background is a {argument name="interior background" default="modern residential interior"}: curtains and soft window light on the left, a dark door frame behind; transparent shoe boxes stacked in the back right with a white helmet on top, next to a TV and dark furniture; the foreground features a wooden dining table and chairs. The environment is tidy but has a real sense of daily life.

Lighting is natural daylight from the left, soft side lighting, overall low saturation and low contrast, with realistic photographic texture. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/2, shallow depth of field, clear subject, slight background blur, light film grain, photorealistic.

Avoid: Cartoon, CG feel, excessive skin smoothing, exaggerated body shapes, incorrect fingers, deformed limbs, heavy makeup, cluttered background, strong HDR, over-sharpening, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 现代公寓室内人像
zh.description: 一个用于现代公寓宁静生活场景的高细节人像提示词，聚焦于自然光线和逼真的皮肤纹理。
zh.prompt:
一位年轻的东亚女性站在现代公寓的餐厅/起居区，半身至上半身构图，略微偏右居中。她自然地向后倚靠，双臂向后伸展，双手支撑在 {argument name="furniture" default="深色木质餐桌"} 的边缘，形成柔和的曲线。她的头部微微向后并向左倾斜，面向镜头，眼神平静、自信且略带慵懒，双唇自然微张。

她有着柔和精致的椭圆形脸庞，杏仁状的深棕色眼睛，自然的细眉，浅裸粉色的嘴唇，妆容清淡。白皙温暖的皮肤保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、自然的肤色变化和柔和的高光——没有塑料感的磨皮。深黑棕色的长发自然垂落，柔软且略显蓬松，几缕发丝落在肩头和胸前。

身穿 {argument name="top" default="白色修身长袖短款上衣"}，胸前打结，柔软贴身的布料露出腰部；搭配 {argument name="trousers" default="白色宽松休闲裤"}，高腰松紧设计；腰间配有细银色腰链或珍珠状装饰。整体风格清新、整洁，充满生活气息。

背景为现代住宅室内：左侧是窗帘和柔和的窗光，身后是深色门框；右后方堆叠着透明鞋盒，顶部放着一个白色头盔，旁边是电视和深色家具；前景为木质餐桌椅。环境整洁但具有真实的生活感。

光线为来自左侧的自然日光，柔和的侧光，整体低饱和度和低对比度，具有真实的摄影质感。风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/2 光圈，浅景深，主体清晰，背景轻微虚化，细微的胶片颗粒感，照片级真实感。

避免：卡通、CG 感、过度磨皮、夸张的身体比例、手指错误、肢体畸形、浓妆、杂乱的背景、强烈的 HDR、过度锐化、文字、水印、Logo。

en.title: Vintage Car Sofa Design Concept
en.description: A product design prompt for reimagining classic automobiles as luxury sofas, translating signature automotive details like grilles and tailfins into furniture forms with a vintage film aesthetic.
en.prompt: Product design concept: a {argument name="car details" default="[year, make, model]"} reimagined as a sofa, with its signature design details (grille, tailfins, headlights, and trim) translated into upholstery and furniture forms, color-matched to the car's original paint. Split-view layout, 9:16 vertical: top third front perspective, bottom two-thirds isometric view, same sofa design, upholstery, and color consistent in both. Centered rule-of-thirds composition, generous negative space. Full-plan solid background matching the car's color exactly, no gradient, studio product lighting. Vintage LUT: warm faded tones, soft film grain, muted saturation, subtle vignette.

zh.title: 复古汽车沙发设计概念
zh.description: 一个将经典汽车重新构想为豪华沙发的产品设计提示词，旨在将格栅和尾鳍等标志性的汽车细节转化为具有复古胶片美感的家具形态。
zh.prompt: 产品设计概念：将 {argument name="car details" default="[年份, 品牌, 型号]"} 重新构想为沙发，将其标志性的设计细节（格栅、尾鳍、前大灯和装饰条）转化为软装和家具形态，颜色与汽车的原厂漆面相匹配。分屏布局，9:16 竖屏：上三分之一为正面视角，下三分之二为等轴测视图，两部分的沙发设计、软装和颜色保持一致。采用三分法构图，留白充足。纯色背景与汽车颜色完全一致，无渐变，采用摄影棚产品布光。复古 LUT：暖色调褪色，柔和的胶片颗粒感，低饱和度，微弱的暗角效果。

en.title: Coffee Lifestyle Magazine Cover
en.description: An editorial-style prompt for creating a professional magazine cover featuring a woman preparing coffee in a high-end, modern European kitchen.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic coffee lifestyle magazine cover featuring a stylish {argument name="subject" default="Korean woman"} in a {argument name="outfit" default="caramel-toned silk blouse and tailored trousers"}, placing a Nespresso Vertuo Next pod into the machine with one hand, holding the freshly brewed espresso cup to her lips with the other, eyes bright with anticipation. Warm glowing skin, polished casual makeup, terracotta lip. Loose elegant waves. Background: sleek modern European kitchen — brushed gold hardware, cream marble countertop, warm morning window light. "{argument name="magazine title" default="FOOD & WINE"}" masthead in warm editorial serif with "COFFEE CULTURE ISSUE" callout. 50mm lens, ultra-detailed Nespresso machine chrome surface and crema espresso texture, 8K photorealistic. 

Negative: cartoon, blurry, incorrect machine design, watermark, cold light.

zh.title: 咖啡生活方式杂志封面
zh.description: 一个编辑风格的提示词，用于创作一张专业的杂志封面，展示一位女性在高端现代欧式厨房中制作咖啡的场景。
zh.prompt:
超写实咖啡生活方式杂志封面，主角是一位时尚的 {argument name="subject" default="韩国女性"}，身着 {argument name="outfit" default="焦糖色丝绸衬衫和定制长裤"}，单手将 Nespresso Vertuo Next 咖啡胶囊放入机器，另一只手将刚冲泡好的浓缩咖啡杯凑近唇边，眼神中闪烁着期待。皮肤透出温暖光泽，精致的休闲妆容，陶土色唇妆。优雅的蓬松卷发。背景：时尚的现代欧式厨房——拉丝金五金件、奶油色大理石台面、温暖的晨间窗光。"{argument name="magazine title" default="FOOD & WINE"}" 刊名采用温暖的编辑衬线字体，并带有 "COFFEE CULTURE ISSUE"（咖啡文化专刊）的标题标注。50mm 镜头，超细节的 Nespresso 机器镀铬表面和浓缩咖啡油脂纹理，8K 照片级画质。

负面提示词：卡通、模糊、机器设计错误、水印、冷色调光线。

en.title: Full-Body Studio Lifestyle Portrait
en.description: Generates a realistic full-body studio fashion portrait of a casually dressed adult subject on a seamless gray background.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic full-body premium lifestyle studio portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young adult Black man"} standing centered against a seamless {argument name="background color" default="light gray"} studio backdrop. He faces the camera directly with a calm neutral expression, relaxed shoulders, and both hands tucked casually into the side pockets of his shorts. Use a natural confident stance with feet about shoulder-width apart. Outfit: an oversized plain {argument name="shirt color" default="black"} short-sleeve crewneck T-shirt with a tiny square logo patch on the left chest, {argument name="shorts color" default="cream beige"} knee-length casual shorts, and clean white low-top sneakers with white laces. Hair is short, neat, and closely cropped; no accessories, no eyewear, no facial hair. Lighting should be soft, even, high-end studio lighting with gentle shadows under the shoes and subtle falloff on the gray cyclorama floor. Composition is vertical, full body visible from head to shoes with generous negative space around the subject, realistic skin texture, accurate fabric folds, sharp focus, editorial clothing-catalog quality, minimal modern aesthetic, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 全身摄影棚生活方式肖像
zh.description: 生成一张逼真的全身摄影棚时尚肖像，主体为身着休闲装的成年人，背景为无缝灰色背景。
zh.prompt: 创作一张超逼真的全身高级生活方式摄影棚肖像，主体为 {argument name="subject" default="一名年轻的黑人男性"}，居中站立在无缝的 {argument name="background color" default="浅灰色"} 摄影棚背景前。他直视镜头，表情平静自然，双肩放松，双手随意插在短裤侧兜里。采用自信自然的站姿，双脚与肩同宽。服装：一件超大版型的纯色 {argument name="shirt color" default="黑色"} 短袖圆领 T 恤，左胸处有一个小方形 Logo 贴标；一条 {argument name="shorts color" default="米色"} 膝盖长度的休闲短裤；以及干净的白色低帮运动鞋，配白色鞋带。发型短而整洁，修剪利落；不佩戴配饰、眼镜，无胡须。灯光应为柔和、均匀的高端摄影棚布光，鞋底下方有柔和的阴影，灰色无缝背景地板上有微妙的渐变效果。构图为竖向，全身可见，从头部到鞋子，主体周围留有充足的负空间，皮肤纹理真实，织物褶皱准确，焦点清晰，具备编辑类服装目录的品质，极简现代美学，无文字，无水印。
