zh.title: 复古国家队足球运动员肖像
zh.description: 一款高端体育编辑摄影提示词，描绘了一位身穿复古国家队球衣的时尚年轻足球运动员，采用柔和的电影级布光和简洁的摄影棚背景。
zh.prompt: 一位时尚的年轻足球运动员，身穿复古风格的白色国家队球衣，带有深红色和金色点缀，胸前印有 19 号，站在简洁的深红色纯色摄影棚背景前。轻松的微笑，微微倾斜的姿势，带有金色挑染的短卷发，电影级柔光，高端运动服饰编辑摄影，超逼真的皮肤纹理，高定杂志封面美学，浅景深，丰富的对比度，极简构图，85mm 镜头，照片级真实感，8K 分辨率，焦点清晰，奢华运动广告大片，adidas 风格的复古足球球衣，色彩鲜艳。一幅充满活力的数字插画，描绘了一位年轻足球运动员身穿经典的白色复古国家队球衣，印有 19 号，自信地向前走并抬头仰望。背景中填充着醒目的大号红色字体，以现代体育海报布局展示球员姓名。奶油色背景，简洁的矢量风格数字绘画，细腻的面部特征，戏剧性的阴影，高端足球艺术作品，大胆的平面设计，高细节插画，逼真的解剖结构，鲜艳的红白配色，现代体育品牌美学，收藏级海报设计，超高分辨率，边缘清晰，专业概念艺术。

en.title: Casual Summer Afternoon Candid Portrait
en.description: Creates a realistic, phone-camera style candid shot of a woman in summer attire during a sunlit afternoon.
en.prompt:
{argument name="time of day" default="Summer afternoon"}, natural light slants from the left. She stands sideways, torso slightly twisted, one hand lifting to brush her hair ends, the other resting at her waist, looking back over her shoulder toward the lens with a languid, casual air — as if captured spontaneously by a companion — frame slightly tilted, with phone‑camera grain and mild overexposure.

Outer: a {argument name="outerwear" default="black lightweight knitted cropped cardigan"}, dropped shoulders, open, hem at waist. Inner: a {argument name="inner top" default="mustard‑yellow stretch cami"}, U‑neck, thin straps, hugging bust and ribs, tracing chest contours and waist dip. Bottom: a white high‑waist fitted mini skirt, front button placket, snug over hips and thighs, hem at mid‑thigh, accentuating the smooth waist‑to‑hip curve. Feet: clear PVC thin‑strap flat sandals. A fine silver chain at the neck, small hoop earrings.

Light: warm afternoon slanting sunlight, creating soft highlights on collarbones, shoulders, and skirt, with visible skin texture and fabric folds. The grain of a phone snapshot enhances realism, making the body’s curves more pronounced through light and shadow.

zh.title: 夏日午后随性抓拍人像
zh.description: 生成一张写实的手机镜头风格人像，展现一位身着夏装的女性在阳光午后的随性瞬间。
zh.prompt:
{argument name="time of day" default="夏日午后"}，自然光从左侧斜射而来。她侧身站立，躯干微微扭转，一只手抬起整理发梢，另一只手轻搭在腰间，回眸看向镜头，神态慵懒随性——仿佛被同伴不经意间捕捉到——画面略微倾斜，带有手机拍摄的颗粒感和轻微的过曝效果。

外套：一件 {argument name="outerwear" default="黑色轻薄针织短款开衫"}，落肩设计，敞开穿着，下摆及腰。内搭：一件 {argument name="inner top" default="芥末黄弹力吊带衫"}，U 型领，细肩带，紧贴胸部和肋骨，勾勒出胸部轮廓与腰部线条。下装：一件白色高腰修身迷你裙，前襟排扣设计，紧贴臀部和大腿，下摆至大腿中部，突显平滑的腰臀曲线。鞋履：透明 PVC 细带平底凉鞋。颈间佩戴一条精致银链，搭配小巧圆环耳饰。

光影：温暖的午后斜射阳光，在锁骨、肩膀和裙摆上形成柔和的高光，清晰呈现皮肤纹理与衣物褶皱。手机快照的颗粒感增强了真实感，通过光影对比使身体曲线更加突出。

en.title: Futuristic Cyberpunk Sports Portrait with HUD
en.description: A cinematic prompt for a man in a Nike puffer jacket with futuristic HUD elements and dramatic orange neon lighting.
en.prompt:
A photorealistic, high-detail portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man with a trimmed beard"} and a determined expression, looking up and slightly to the left. He is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="black and orange puffer jacket/down jacket"} with the zipper pulled up.
Background/Aesthetic: Dark, moody, and futuristic studio setting. The main visual feature is a massive, {argument name="logo" default="glowing neon-orange outline of the Nike swoosh logo"} centered behind the subject. The lighting is dramatic, with a strong orange key light hitting the man's face, neck, and the top of his shoulders, creating high contrast.
Visual Elements: Floating, futuristic HUD (Heads-Up Display) elements in neon orange are overlaid on the dark background around the subject. These include:
Data readouts, graphs, and target crosshairs in the top-left corner.
A minimal progress bar/loading graphic around the small swoosh in the top-right corner.
A bar graph/data visualization in the bottom-right corner.
Style/Technique: Cinematic, high-contrast lighting, volumetric lighting, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, shot on an 8K camera (like a Sony a7R V or Arri), deep depth of field, inspired by cyberpunk or sports advertising.
Negative Prompts (To ensure quality and focus): low resolution, blurry, text, watermark, cartoon, bad anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers, noisy, oversaturated with 3:4 size.

zh.title: 充满未来感的赛博朋克运动风肖像（带 HUD 界面）
zh.description: 一个电影质感的提示词，描绘了一位身穿 Nike 羽绒服的男子，配有未来感 HUD 元素和戏剧性的橙色霓虹灯光。
zh.prompt:
一张照片级真实、高细节的肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject" default="留着修剪整齐胡须的年轻男子"}，表情坚定，抬头并略微向左看。他穿着一件 {argument name="clothing" default="黑橙配色羽绒服"}，拉链拉至领口。
背景/美学：黑暗、忧郁且具有未来感的摄影棚环境。主要视觉特征是主角身后居中位置的一个巨大的 {argument name="logo" default="发光的霓虹橙色 Nike Swoosh 标志轮廓"}。灯光效果极具戏剧性，强烈的橙色主光照射在男子的脸部、颈部和肩部上方，营造出高对比度。
视觉元素：悬浮的、具有未来感的霓虹橙色 HUD（平视显示器）元素叠加在主角周围的深色背景上。其中包括：
左上角的各种数据读数、图表和目标十字准线。
右上角小 Swoosh 标志周围的极简进度条/加载图形。
右下角的柱状图/数据可视化图表。
风格/技术：电影感、高对比度照明、体积光、超精细、照片级真实，使用 8K 相机（如 Sony a7R V 或 Arri）拍摄，深景深，灵感源自赛博朋克或体育广告。
负面提示词（确保质量和焦点）：低分辨率、模糊、文字、水印、卡通、解剖结构错误、手部畸形、多余手指、噪点、过度饱和，比例为 3:4。

en.title: Night Flash iPhone Selfie with Motion Blur
en.description: An authentic iPhone-style night selfie prompt featuring motion blur, direct flash, and a scenic night field background.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic lifestyle selfie photograph.

Do not change the woman's face. Preserve 100% facial identity, facial features, proportions, eye shape, skin tone, hair color and overall appearance exactly as the reference.

Shot on iPhone with built-in flash in complete darkness.

Composition:
Strictly a handheld selfie taken with an extended arm. The phone itself must NOT be visible in the frame. Close-up portrait selfie. Camera positioned slightly above eye level and angled slightly downward toward the face. Natural front camera perspective with realistic selfie distortion.

Motion:
A spontaneous candid moment captured mid-movement. At the exact moment the photo is taken, the woman quickly turns her head to the right, creating natural motion blur across her face, jawline and hair from the fast head movement. Her face remains recognizable. Her long hair follows the movement with realistic motion trails and soft blur on individual strands. The body, clothing and background remain sharp. No artificial blur.

Pose:
The woman is holding the phone with her right arm extended forward, outside the frame. Her left arm is raised behind her head with the elbow bent. Her head is caught during a quick turn, gaze slightly away from the lens rather than direct eye contact. Calm, confident expression with a natural spontaneous feeling.

Hair:
Very long thick hair falling below the waist. Loose hairstyle with voluminous soft curls. Hair lifted by the wind and movement, with several strands flowing across the shoulders and creating realistic motion blur.

Clothing:
{argument name="outfit" default="White fitted long-sleeve top"} made of smooth stretchy fabric. Elegant central decorative knot detail on the chest. The fabric follows the body naturally.

Accessories:
{argument name="earrings" default="Small heart-shaped earrings"}.
Short square French manicure.

Makeup:
Thin cat-eye eyeliner.
Soft contouring.
Lips with a blended brown lip liner effect.
Natural glowing skin texture with visible pores, realistic imperfections.

Environment:
{argument name="setting" default="Open field with tall grass stretching into the distance"}. Night landscape. Deep blue evening sky above the horizon. Small crescent moon and bright visible stars. The background remains fully readable and detailed.

Lighting:
Strong direct built-in iPhone flash illuminating the face and clothing. Bright flash highlights on skin and fabric. The background remains visible with rich dark blue tones. Low exposure nighttime photography. High contrast between illuminated subject and dark surroundings.

Photography style:
Authentic iPhone night flash selfie. Candid captured moment. Realistic motion blur from a fast head turn, 35mm film look, subtle digital noise, natural grain, realistic lens imperfections. Maximum photorealism. Natural skin texture, realistic pores. No AI beauty effect. No plastic skin. No artificial glossy look. No filters. No text. No watermark.

Manicure: short square French manicure.

zh.title: iPhone 夜间闪光灯动态模糊自拍
zh.description: 一款地道的 iPhone 风格夜间自拍提示词，包含动态模糊、直闪效果以及风景优美的夜间田野背景。
zh.prompt:
超写实生活化自拍照片。

请勿更改女性面部。必须 100% 保留面部特征、五官、比例、眼型、肤色、发色以及整体外观，与参考图完全一致。

在全黑环境下使用 iPhone 内置闪光灯拍摄。

构图：
严格采用手臂伸展的手持自拍视角。画面中不得出现手机本身。特写人像自拍。相机位置略高于视线，并稍微向下倾斜对准面部。自然的手机前置摄像头视角，带有真实的自拍畸变。

动态：
捕捉运动过程中的自发性抓拍瞬间。在拍摄瞬间，女性迅速向右转头，因快速转头动作在面部、下颌线和头发上产生自然的动态模糊。面部依然清晰可辨。长发随动作摆动，呈现出逼真的运动轨迹和发丝的柔和模糊感。身体、服装和背景保持清晰。无人工模糊。

姿势：
女性右手持手机向前伸展，手机位于画框外。左臂抬起置于脑后，肘部弯曲。捕捉到她快速转头时的瞬间，目光略微偏离镜头，而非直视镜头。表情冷静自信，带有自然的自发感。

发型：
长及腰部的浓密长发。蓬松的卷发造型。头发随风和动作飘动，几缕发丝掠过肩头，产生逼真的动态模糊。

服装：
{argument name="outfit" default="白色修身长袖上衣"}，采用光滑的弹力面料。胸前有优雅的中央装饰结细节。面料自然贴合身体。

配饰：
{argument name="earrings" default="小巧的心形耳环"}。
短方型法式美甲。

妆容：
细长的猫眼眼线。
柔和的修容。
唇部带有晕染的棕色唇线效果。
自然透亮的皮肤质感，可见毛孔，带有真实的瑕疵。

环境：
{argument name="setting" default="延伸至远处的开阔草地"}。夜间景观。地平线上方是深蓝色的夜空。可见一弯新月和明亮的星星。背景保持完全清晰且细节丰富。

光影：
强烈的 iPhone 内置直闪灯照亮面部和服装。闪光灯在皮肤和织物上形成明亮的高光。背景保持可见，呈现浓郁的深蓝色调。低曝光夜间摄影。被照亮的主体与黑暗环境之间形成高对比度。

摄影风格：
地道的 iPhone 夜间闪光灯自拍。抓拍瞬间。因快速转头产生的逼真动态模糊，35mm 胶片质感，细微的数字噪点，自然颗粒感，真实的镜头瑕疵。极致的写实感。自然的皮肤纹理，逼真的毛孔。无 AI 美颜效果。无塑料感皮肤。无人工光泽感。无滤镜。无文字。无水印。

美甲：短方型法式美甲。

en.title: Bauhaus-Inspired Design Magazine Cover
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating a 'DEZEEN' magazine cover featuring a Korean woman in high-fashion attire holding a synthesizer in a geometric studio setting.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic design culture magazine cover featuring a creative {argument name="subject" default="Korean woman"} in a {argument name="outfit" default="bold yellow structured blazer and black wide-leg trousers"} — matching the product's colorway — holding a {argument name="synthesizer" default="Teenage Engineering OP-1 Field synthesizer"} horizontally with both hands, fingers hovering over the tiny keys mid-composition, deep in creative flow. Bold graphic makeup, sharp geometric liner, yellow eyeshadow accent. Sleek straight bob.

Background: clean white 

Bauhaus-inspired studio with bold yellow color block wall panels, ultra-graphic composition. "DEZEEN" masthead in precise sans-serif with "INSTRUMENTS OF DESIGN ISSUE" callout. 50mm lens, ultra-detailed OP-1 tiny key and OLED display, 8K photorealistic design editorial.

Negative: cartoon, blurry, incorrect product shape, watermark, distorted.

zh.title: 包豪斯风格设计杂志封面
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于创作一张“DEZEEN”杂志封面，画面主体为一位身着高级时装、在几何风格工作室中手持合成器的韩国女性。
zh.prompt:
超写实设计文化杂志封面，画面主角为一位 {argument name="subject" default="韩国女性"}，身着 {argument name="outfit" default="明黄色结构感西装外套搭配黑色阔腿裤"} —— 与产品配色相呼应 —— 双手横向持有一台 {argument name="synthesizer" default="Teenage Engineering OP-1 Field 合成器"}，手指悬停在微型琴键上，仿佛正在创作，沉浸在创意流中。大胆的图形妆容，锐利的几何眼线，黄色眼影点缀。利落的直发波波头。

背景：干净的白色。

包豪斯风格工作室，配有大胆的黄色色块墙板，超图形化构图。“DEZEEN”刊头采用精准的无衬线字体，并带有“INSTRUMENTS OF DESIGN ISSUE”的标题标注。50mm 镜头，超细节的 OP-1 微型琴键和 OLED 显示屏，8K 照片级设计编辑风格。

负面提示词：卡通，模糊，产品形状错误，水印，畸变。

en.title: Cinematic B&W Double Exposure Portrait
en.description: An artistic prompt for a black-and-white, three-quarter profile portrait with film grain, soft motion blur, and a dreamy double-exposure effect.
en.prompt:
An extreme close-up portrait of the face. This is a {argument name="style" default="black-and-white photograph"} with a cinematic look and subtle film grain. The subject is a {argument name="subject" default="woman"} shown in a three-quarter profile, with long hair partially covering her face as it is blown by the wind. No visible clothing.
The background is a {argument name="background" default="plain white wall"}.
The image has a soft motion blur and a double-exposure effect, creating a dreamy, artistic atmosphere.
Do not change the facial features.
Full, glossy lips.
Aspect ratio: 9:16.

zh.title: 电影感黑白双重曝光肖像
zh.description: 一个用于创作黑白四分之三侧面肖像的艺术提示词，包含胶片颗粒感、柔和的动态模糊以及梦幻的双重曝光效果。
zh.prompt:
面部的特写肖像。这是一个 {argument name="style" default="黑白照片"}，具有电影质感和细腻的胶片颗粒感。主体是一位 {argument name="subject" default="女性"}，以四分之三侧面呈现，长发在风中飘动，部分遮住了脸部。无可见衣物。
背景为 {argument name="background" default="纯白墙面"}。
图像带有柔和的动态模糊和双重曝光效果，营造出梦幻般的艺术氛围。
请勿改变面部特征。
饱满且有光泽的嘴唇。
长宽比：9:16。

en.title: Vintage Rubber Hose Mascot Poster
en.description: A retro-style poster prompt for creating vintage mascots in a rubber hose animation style with distressed screen-print textures.
en.prompt: Vintage mascot poster in a vertical 4:5 layout on a cream paper background using only {argument name="color palette" default="[COLOR1], [COLOR2], [COLOR3], and [COLOR4]"}. At the top, place the bold rounded headline “{argument name="headline" default="[TITLE]"}”. In the center, show a rubber hose style {argument name="subject" default="[HUMAN]"} wearing {argument name="outfit" default="[CLOTHES]"} walking beside [ANIMAL] through [BACKGROUND], both with pie-cut eyes, simple smiling faces, thick clean outlines, rounded limbs, oversized shoes, and a playful mid-step pose. Add subtle register misalignment in the outlines and fills, light distressed screen-print grain, a simple circular stamp graphic, and a horizontal checker stripe near the lower section. At the bottom, place the bold rounded tagline “[TAGLINE]”. Clean retro t-shirt graphic, flat colors, no gradients, crisp simple composition.

zh.title: 复古橡胶管风格吉祥物海报
zh.description: 一款复古风格的海报提示词，用于创作具有橡胶管动画风格、带有做旧丝网印刷质感的复古吉祥物。
zh.prompt: 复古吉祥物海报，采用 4:5 竖版布局，背景为奶油色纸张，仅使用 {argument name="color palette" default="[COLOR1], [COLOR2], [COLOR3] 和 [COLOR4]"}。顶部放置加粗圆润的标题 “{argument name="headline" default="[TITLE]"}”。中心展示一个橡胶管风格的 {argument name="subject" default="[HUMAN]"}，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="[CLOTHES]"}，与 [ANIMAL] 一起走在 [BACKGROUND] 中，两者均具有派式眼睛（pie-cut eyes）、简单的笑脸、粗而清晰的轮廓、圆润的四肢、超大的鞋子以及俏皮的迈步姿势。在轮廓和填充处添加细微的套印不准效果、轻微的丝网印刷颗粒感、简单的圆形印章图形，并在下部附近添加水平棋盘格条纹。底部放置加粗圆润的标语 “[TAGLINE]”。简洁的复古 T 恤图案，平涂色彩，无渐变，构图清晰简洁。

en.title: Minimalist High-Fashion Product Ad
en.description: A clean, modern commercial photography prompt featuring an oversized product can and a fashion model in a studio setting.
en.prompt: Minimalist commercial ad featuring an oversized {argument name="product" default="Red Bull can"}, ultra clean design. A young athletic woman in a {argument name="outfit" default="sleek red-and-blue outfit"} leans casually against the giant can in a dynamic confident pose, eyes closed, holding a Red Bull can. Soft gradient blue-to-red background with large bold “Red Bull” text and wings logo behind. Glossy reflective floor, soft studio lighting, modern high end fashion and product photography. Small top right text “Designed by Mr Das”. Bottom center tagline in small white font: “{argument name="tagline" default="Gives You Wings."}”

zh.title: 极简主义高端时尚产品广告
zh.description: 一个简洁、现代的商业摄影提示词，展示了一个超大号产品罐和一位在摄影棚环境中的时尚模特。
zh.prompt: 极简主义商业广告，展示一个超大号 {argument name="product" default="红牛罐"}，设计极其简洁。一位年轻的运动型女性身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="时髦的红蓝配色套装"}，以自信动感的姿势随意倚靠在巨大的罐子旁，双眼微闭，手中拿着一罐红牛。背景为柔和的蓝红渐变色，后方配有醒目的“Red Bull”大号文字和翅膀标志。光亮的反光地面，柔和的摄影棚灯光，现代高端时尚与产品摄影风格。右上角小字“Designed by Mr Das”。底部中央标语采用小号白色字体：“{argument name="tagline" default="给你一双翅膀。"}”

en.title: Luxury Spa Hot Spring Portrait
en.description: A sophisticated portrait prompt of an East Asian woman at a luxury hot spring resort, featuring wet hair and detailed skin textures.
en.prompt:
Adult East Asian female, 21+ years old, sitting on the dark stone edge of an {argument name="setting" default="indoor hot spring or resort pool"}. Positioned slightly to the right, framed from upper thighs to top of head. Body leaning towards camera, face looking directly forward—calm, soft, confident expression. Elegant relaxed pose: one hand near upper chest, the other supporting her on the stone platform, legs extending diagonally to the lower left foreground.

Character: Long wet {argument name="hair color" default="chestnut brown"} hair swept over one shoulder extending behind—wet strands naturally clinging to neck, shoulders and skin. Exquisite natural makeup: thick lashes, soft eyeliner, warm blush, smooth glowing skin, glossy rose-pink lip color. Moist skin with realistic water droplets and delicate highlights on shoulders, collarbones, arms, thighs and face.

Clothing: Sleek {argument name="outfit color" default="black"} {argument name="outfit style" default="one-piece swimsuit"}—thin straps, round neckline, side lace-up detail with dark gray crisscross cords and hip bows. Smooth, wet, slightly reflective fabric with realistic wrinkles and tension on torso and waist. A thin minimalist gold bracelet on one wrist.

Scene: Warm indoor spa or hot spring—golden ochre-toned natural rock walls, large textured stones around the pool. A small waterfall on the right flows into clear shallow water. Foreground dark smooth stone platform with water droplets and soft reflections. Luxurious yet rustic—warm stone textures, flowing water surface, calm vacation atmosphere.

Lighting: Bright but soft—warm natural spa lighting from front left and overhead. Luminous highlights on wet hair, face, shoulders, swimsuit, legs, stone platform and flowing water. Shallow depth of field, realistic water surface sparkle, clear skin texture, fine rock surfaces, exquisite portrait quality.

zh.title: 奢华温泉度假人像
zh.description: 一张精致的东亚女性在奢华温泉度假村的人像提示词，展现湿发质感与细腻的皮肤纹理。
zh.prompt:
成年东亚女性，21 岁以上，坐在 {argument name="setting" default="室内温泉或度假泳池"} 的深色石缘上。身体略微偏向右侧，取景范围从大腿上部到头部。身体前倾，面部直视前方——表情平静、柔和且自信。优雅放松的姿态：一只手靠近上胸部，另一只手在石台上支撑身体，双腿向左下方的近景处斜向延伸。

人物：长长的湿润 {argument name="hair color" default="栗棕色"} 头发拨向一侧并垂在身后——湿润的发丝自然地贴在颈部、肩膀和皮肤上。精致的自然妆容：浓密的睫毛、柔和的眼线、温暖的腮红、光滑透亮的皮肤、亮泽的玫瑰粉色唇彩。湿润的皮肤上带有逼真的水珠，肩膀、锁骨、手臂、大腿和面部有细腻的高光。

服装：时髦的 {argument name="outfit color" default="黑色"} {argument name="outfit style" default="连体泳衣"}——细肩带、圆领，侧面有深灰色交叉系带细节和臀部蝴蝶结。光滑、湿润、略带反光的面料，在躯干和腰部呈现出逼真的褶皱和张力。手腕上佩戴着一只极简风格的金色手镯。

场景：温暖的室内水疗中心或温泉——金赭色的天然岩石墙壁，池边环绕着大型纹理石块。右侧有一处小瀑布流入清澈的浅水中。前景为深色光滑的石台，上面布满水珠并带有柔和的倒影。奢华而质朴——温暖的石材纹理、流动的池水表面，营造出宁静的度假氛围。

光影：明亮而柔和——来自左前方和头顶的温暖自然温泉光线。湿发、面部、肩膀、泳衣、腿部、石台和流动的水面上呈现出明亮的高光。浅景深，逼真的水面波光，清晰的皮肤纹理，细腻的岩石表面，精致的人像画质。

en.title: Minimalist Watercolor Urban Sketch
en.description: A detailed prompt for a loose, artistic watercolor and ink sketch of an urban scene in New York, focusing on textures and unfinished edges.
en.prompt:
3:4 vertical minimalist {argument name="style" default="watercolor and ink urban sketch"} on cold-press handmade paper. Loose studio sketch, not a finished illustration.

FINISH GRADIENT (priority): the couple is the only fully resolved area. Nearby architecture ~60% painted, with clear patches of bare paper and contour line breaking through. Distant buildings and frame edges dissolve into loose graphite and untouched paper before the border. ~20% of the page stays unpainted, mostly upper area and edges. Background is bare paper, not a painted sky. Unfinished edges are intentional.

SCENE: {argument name="location" default="Top of the Rock observation deck, Midtown Manhattan"}, clear afternoon. Two lovers at the stone parapet seen from behind, shoulders touching, one leaning in and pointing toward the Empire State Building. Wind in hair and a light cardigan. Quiet, unposed.

COMPOSITION: High vantage point. Couple small and back-turned in the lower third. Empire State Building off-center mid-distance. High horizon, deep space, generous open paper above.

WASH: Wet-on-wet bleeding with blooms and backruns. Washes deliberately offset from the ink lines, spilling past contours and stopping short of others. Strong dilution variation within one facade — saturated, ghost-pale, and bare paper in turn. Visible granulation in the paper tooth. Hard wet-on-dry edges beside soft blooms. Reserved white paper as highlights, never white paint.

LINE: Fast searching graphite and fine ink, construction marks left uncorrected. Scribble loops for railings and distant windows instead of literal detail. Weight varies hairline to bold. Faces suggested in a few marks.

VALUE: High-key and airy, with exactly one deep dark note — the shaded face of the nearest rooftop tower in ink navy.

COLOR: {argument name="color scheme" default="Cool blue-dominant"}. 55% slate blue, dusty cerulean, powder blue, pale blue-gray. 20% bare warm off-white paper. 15% warm stone gray and limestone as mid-tone relief against flat monochrome blue. 10% taxi yellow on sunlit edges. Muted, low saturation.

TYPOGRAPHY: Upper right, italic "New York" with one short poetic English line below in muted slate navy, absorbed into the paper.

zh.title: 极简水彩城市速写
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于创作纽约城市场景的写意水彩与墨水速写，侧重于质感和未完成的边缘效果。
zh.prompt:
3:4 竖构图极简 {argument name="style" default="水彩与墨水城市速写"}，绘制于冷压手工纸上。松弛的画室速写风格，非成品插画。

完成度渐变（优先级）：画面中仅人物部分完全刻画。周边建筑约 60% 上色，保留清晰的留白区域，轮廓线穿插其中。远景建筑及画面边缘溶解为松散的石墨线条与留白，直至边框。约 20% 的页面保持未上色，主要集中在上部及边缘。背景为留白，而非绘制的天空。未完成的边缘为刻意设计。

场景：{argument name="location" default="洛克菲勒中心观景台，曼哈顿中城"}，晴朗的午后。一对恋人背对镜头站在石质护栏旁，肩并肩，其中一人倾身指向帝国大厦。微风吹动发丝和轻薄的开衫。安静，自然，非摆拍。

构图：高视角。人物位于下三分之一处，背影较小。帝国大厦偏离中心，位于中景。高地平线，深远空间，上方留白充裕。

渲染：湿画法渲染，带有水渍和回流效果。水彩晕染刻意偏离墨线，溢出轮廓或在轮廓前戛然而止。同一立面内色彩浓度变化强烈——饱和色、幽灵般的淡色与留白交替出现。纸张纹理可见明显的颗粒感。湿画法边缘与柔和的晕染边缘并存。利用纸张本身的白色作为高光，绝不使用白色颜料。

线条：快速搜寻式的石墨线条与精细墨线，保留未经修正的构图痕迹。用涂鸦式的圈圈表现栏杆和远处的窗户，而非刻画细节。线条粗细变化从发丝般纤细到浓重。面部仅通过几笔勾勒暗示。

明度：高调且通透，仅有一处深暗色调——最近处屋顶塔楼的阴影面，使用深海军蓝。

色彩：{argument name="color scheme" default="冷蓝色调为主"}。55% 板岩蓝、灰天蓝、粉蓝、浅蓝灰。20% 温暖的灰白色留白。15% 暖石灰和石灰岩色作为平铺单色蓝的中间调点缀。10% 出租车黄点缀在受光边缘。色彩柔和，低饱和度。

排版：右上角，斜体 "New York"，下方配有一行简短的英文诗句，颜色为柔和的板岩海军蓝，融入纸张纹理中。

en.title: Lumen Fable System Prompt
en.description: A sophisticated system prompt for GPT Image Gen V2 that guides the model to create atmospheric, hand-painted style illustrations with specific rules for color, scale, and lighting.
en.prompt:
Rewrite the user's text, image, or both as one prompt for GPT Image Gen V2 or Nano Banana Pro. Use GPT unless Nano is named. Write in the user's language, preserve exact text, and keep the requested or source ratio.

Use three functions. Continuity Field connects sky, water, ground, shadow, distance, and broad atmosphere through one cool color family and a hand-painted surface. Fable Scale changes size, spacing, or visual territory to show what a subject does. Lumen Mark places one restrained warm signal where the scene's consequence becomes visible.

Do not make a decorative blue image with random yellow or red accents. Determine the literal subject, primary functional subject, its role, supporting evidence, scale relation, warm carrier, physical cause, and visible consequence.

Preserve subject, count, identity, action, setting, clothing, objects, colors, text, and reference roles. For edits, preserve all unrequested content. Use style references only for atmosphere, contour, scale logic, color hierarchy, and surface. Do not copy their subjects, props, poses, houses, cups, animals, boats, or landscapes.

Use thin irregular contour, visible paper grain, chalky wash, rubbed pigment, and selected opaque color. Keep one dominant cool family, one warm family, and clear material differences. Reduce contour in distance, mist, water, and broad painted fields.

Scale changes require a functional cause such as shelter, gathering, obstruction, use, protection, transport, attention, or dependence. Supporting figures and objects must prove that role through gaze, spacing, contact, repetition, or response. Do not distort scale for novelty.

The warm mark must belong to a garment, window, flame, fruit, flower, roof, sail, path, face plane, reflection, sign, tool, or contact point. State its material and cause. No scattered glow, decorative stars, or generic light outlines.

Use one primary scale, one supporting scale, one focal region, and one substantial quiet field. Remove repetition, praise, mood labels, prestige terms, fake technical detail, generic defects, and unresolved alternatives. Use concrete nouns and active verbs. No em dash or en dash.

GPT: return 500 to 800 words in five paragraphs covering scene, subjects, continuity field, scale relation, lumen mark, composition, preservation, text, and failures.

NANO: return valid JSON only, 1000 to 1800 tokens, using "aspect_ratio", "references", "scene", "subjects", "continuity_field", "fable_scale", "lumen_mark", "composition", "surface", "text", "avoid". Omit unused fields. No metadata, IDs, weights, comments, or repeated facts.

Return only the finished prompt.

zh.title: Lumen Fable 系统提示词
zh.description: 为 GPT Image Gen V2 设计的一套精妙系统提示词，旨在引导模型创作具有特定色彩、比例和光影规则的氛围感手绘风格插画。
zh.prompt:
将用户的文本、图像或两者重写为 GPT Image Gen V2 或 Nano Banana Pro 的单一提示词。除非明确指定 Nano，否则请使用 GPT。使用用户所用的语言进行撰写，保留原始文本，并维持请求或来源的比例。

使用三个功能。Continuity Field 通过单一冷色系和手绘表面将天空、水面、地面、阴影、距离和广阔的氛围连接起来。Fable Scale 通过改变大小、间距或视觉区域来展示主体所执行的功能。Lumen Mark 在场景结果显现的位置放置一个克制的暖色信号。

不要制作带有随机黄色或红色点缀的装饰性蓝色图像。确定字面主体、主要功能主体、其角色、支撑证据、比例关系、暖色载体、物理成因以及可见结果。

保留主体、数量、身份、动作、设置、服装、物体、颜色、文本和参考角色。对于编辑，保留所有未被要求更改的内容。仅将风格参考用于氛围、轮廓、比例逻辑、色彩层级和表面。不要复制它们的题材、道具、姿势、房屋、杯子、动物、船只或景观。

使用细而不规则的轮廓、可见的纸张纹理、粉笔画质感、擦拭颜料和精选的不透明色彩。保持一个主导冷色系、一个暖色系以及清晰的材质差异。减少距离、雾气、水面和广阔绘制区域的轮廓。

比例变化需要功能性原因，例如遮蔽、聚集、阻挡、使用、保护、运输、关注或依赖。辅助人物和物体必须通过注视、间距、接触、重复或响应来证明该角色。不要为了新奇而扭曲比例。

暖色标记必须属于服装、窗户、火焰、水果、花朵、屋顶、帆、路径、面部平面、反射、标志、工具或接触点。说明其材质和成因。不要使用分散的光晕、装饰性星星或通用的光线轮廓。

使用一个主要比例、一个辅助比例、一个焦点区域和一个实质性的留白区域。删除重复内容、赞美词、情绪标签、声望术语、虚假技术细节、通用缺陷和未解决的替代方案。使用具体名词和主动动词。不要使用长破折号或短破折号。

GPT：返回 500 到 800 字，分为五个段落，涵盖场景、主体、Continuity Field、比例关系、Lumen Mark、构图、保留内容、文本和失败案例。

NANO：仅返回有效的 JSON，1000 到 1800 个 token，使用 "aspect_ratio"、"references"、"scene"、"subjects"、"continuity_field"、"fable_scale"、"lumen_mark"、"composition"、"surface"、"text"、"avoid"。省略未使用的字段。不要包含元数据、ID、权重、注释或重复的事实。

仅返回最终完成的提示词。

en.title: Minimalist East Asian Female Studio Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating a soft, minimalist studio portrait of an East Asian woman, emphasizing natural skin textures and light, airy composition.
en.prompt:
A {argument name="subject" default="young adult East Asian woman"} standing in a {argument name="setting" default="minimalist white photo studio or bright indoor space"}, with a two-thirds to three-quarter back composition, centered in the frame. Her body is turned away from the camera, slightly angled to the left, with her head lowered and turned toward the lower left, showing a soft profile of her face. Her eyes look down, avoiding the lens, with a quiet, restrained, and soft expression.

She has a delicate oval face, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender nose bridge, and light nude pink lips. Her makeup is extremely light, with fair and warm skin that retains real pores, fine downy hair, natural skin tone variations, and soft highlights—no plastic airbrushing. Her back, shoulder blades, and waistline are natural and realistic without exaggeration.

Her hair is deep black, loosely tied in a slightly messy high bun, fluffy on top, with fine strands naturally falling around the ears, nape, and face, showing a realistic messy texture.

She is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="white backless top"} with shoulders naturally slipping down. The long sleeves are made of thin, semi-transparent mesh or tulle, fitting the arms and stacking naturally at the wrists. The back is secured by white and light gold thin crisscross straps, with a bow and hanging knots in the center; the strap structure is clear but not overly complex. On the bottom, she wears white lightweight high-waisted pants or culottes made of soft fabric with fine gold dot decorations and blue-gold peacock feather patterns, with a white drawstring tie at the waist.

The background is a clean white or light gray-white seamless wall without clutter. The lighting is soft natural window light or high-key studio diffused light coming from the front-left, with very shallow shadows and an overall low saturation, low contrast, creamy white airy feel. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/2, shallow depth of field, clear eyes and profile, realistic skin and fabric textures, slight film grain, photorealistic.

Avoid: Cartoon, CG, illustration, excessive airbrushing, exaggerated body proportions, incorrect fingers, deformed arms, twisted spine, wrong strap structures, overexposure, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered backgrounds, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 极简东亚女性摄影棚肖像
zh.description: 一份用于创作柔和、极简风格东亚女性摄影棚肖像的详细提示词，强调自然的皮肤纹理以及明亮、通透的构图。
zh.prompt:
一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻的东亚女性"} 站在 {argument name="setting" default="极简白色摄影棚或明亮的室内空间"} 中，采用三分之二到四分之三的背影构图，位于画面中心。她的身体背对镜头，向左微微倾斜，头部低垂并转向左下方，展现出柔和的侧脸轮廓。她双眼低垂，避开镜头，表情安静、内敛且柔和。

她有着精致的鹅蛋脸、杏仁状的深褐色眼睛、自然的细眉、纤细的鼻梁以及浅裸粉色的嘴唇。妆容极淡，白皙温暖的皮肤保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、自然的肤色变化和柔和的高光——没有塑料感的磨皮。她的背部、肩胛骨和腰线自然且写实，没有任何夸张。

她的头发呈深黑色，松散地扎成一个略显凌乱的高丸子头，头顶蓬松，细碎的发丝自然地垂落在耳边、颈后和脸颊旁，呈现出真实的凌乱质感。

她穿着一件 {argument name="clothing" default="白色露背上衣"}，肩带自然滑落。长袖由轻薄的半透明网纱或薄纱制成，贴合手臂并在手腕处自然堆叠。背部由白色和浅金色的细交叉带固定，中心饰有蝴蝶结和垂下的结；绑带结构清晰但不显复杂。下身穿着白色轻盈的高腰裤或裙裤，由柔软的面料制成，带有细小的金色圆点装饰和蓝金色孔雀羽毛图案，腰间系有白色抽绳。

背景为干净的白色或浅灰白色无缝墙，没有杂物。光线为来自左前方的柔和自然窗光或高调摄影棚漫射光，阴影极浅，整体呈现低饱和度、低对比度、奶油般通透的空气感。摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/2 光圈，浅景深，眼睛和侧脸清晰，真实的皮肤和织物纹理，轻微的胶片颗粒感，照片级真实感。

避免：卡通、CG、插画、过度磨皮、夸张的身体比例、手指错误、手臂变形、脊柱扭曲、绑带结构错误、过度曝光、强 HDR、过度锐化、杂乱的背景、文字、水印、Logo。

级别烟雾流体效果。从分层的蒸汽卷、滚动的烟雾密度、流体湍流、余烬颗粒、克制的火花和微妙的尘土状碎屑中构建生物的身体。保持中心质量和胸部密度最强，而外缘则溶解成更薄的光谱烟雾。仅添加受控的粒子烟火和幻想灰烬，绝不要杂乱的过载。灯光：使用极其细腻、柔和的电影级灯光。冷调的大气主灯应揭示烟雾轮廓、爪子、脸颊结构、耳朵边缘和前肢形状，而嘴部的红光则引入温暖的内部对比。保持灯光华丽、柔和且高度雕塑感。灯具与表面：将灯渲染为带有雕刻图案、微妙年代感和可信重量感的华丽深色金属魔法容器。它必须具有触感、优雅且真实。喷嘴光芒是转化的点火点，必须视觉上连接到烟雾身体的诞生过程。大气与背景：背景保持黑暗、极简且具电影感，带有柔和的午夜蓝到木炭色的衰减。无场景、无建筑、无额外道具。负空间必须支持灯到兽的对角线，并使出现感显得宏伟。印刷美学：在整个图像上应用高级印刷颗粒处理。结果必须感觉像收藏级的黑暗幻想印刷品，具有触感颗粒、微妙的模拟深度和优雅的表面丰富感。颗粒应增强烟雾渐变、深色背景和嘴部光芒，而不会使图像变脏。清晰度：保持眼睛、尖牙、爪子、口腔内部和主要烟雾轮廓极其锐利且细节分明，而外部蒸汽轨迹保持较软。柔和扩散与极端焦细节之间的对比至关重要。颜色方向：使用受限的调色板，包括午夜蓝、木炭色、烟雾白、灰烬灰和冷钢底色，仅使用两种受控的强调色：眼睛里的冰冷光谱蓝和嘴部及喷嘴附近的琥珀橙色红光。最终图像必须保持黑暗、高级且具电影感。氛围：凶猛、超自然、优雅、掠夺性、电影感、神话、烟雾、暴力、奢侈、黑暗幻想、收藏级。渲染风格：UE5 en.title: Egyptian Sorceress Sandstorm Cinematic Art
en.description: A comprehensive cinematic prompt for GPT Image 2 to create a monumental desert queen figure with realistic sandstorm physics and atmospheric depth.
en.prompt: 创建一个超高级的暗黑奇幻沙漠电影艺术作品，绝对忠实于图1的结构。最终图像必须保留图1的精确构图逻辑、空间层次、沙暴位置、沙流方向、人物比例和垂直戏剧紧张感，同时描绘一位自定义的古埃及女祭司女王。艺术作品必须与同系列语言保持高度统一：一个巨大的女性形象在沙尘暴中站立并前行，包裹在流动的仪式织物中，她的身体与灰尘、烟雾、沙粒和开边流体大气物质深度融合。没有可读文字，没有标志，没有标题，没有布局元素。核心构图：使用与图1完全相同的垂直构图逻辑。将一位古埃及女祭司女王放置在画面的中下方到中左侧区域，站在对角倾斜的沙丘表面。她的身体必须穿过浓密的沙尘迷雾向上升起，而一个巨大的风暴状沙云在她身后和上方膨胀，占据图像的上半部分。保留孤单人物、升起的沙体、周围的尘埃氛围和上方沉重的沙尘暴云之间的确切关系。保持图像冷峻、垂直且宏伟。角色设计：创造一个自创的古埃及女祭司女王，让人感到皇室般、神圣、政治上绝对且可怕地冷静。她必须具有逼真的女性解剖结构，高贵的面部结构，深色的眼线，高耸的仪式头饰或眼镜蛇皇冠变体，精致的神圣徽章细节，强大的埃及项圈，以及分层的风化长袍，既有皇室感又有葬礼神圣感。她必须感觉像是一个被遗忘的沙漠之神的活体容器。姿势和手势逻辑：以清晰的权威和解剖学的正确性重建姿势。女祭司以一种充满命令感的、向前迈进的姿态站立在整体构图逻辑中，但现在她的右手必须紧握一支仪仗式的埃及权杖、法杖或神圣权威杆，而她的左臂则自然下垂，处于放松但强大的休息位置。手势必须感到冷静、绝对和主权，而不是戏剧性的。右臂、手腕和握力必须清晰可信。左臂必须保持自然向下延伸，并具有正确的肩-肘-腕对齐。解剖约束：这至关重要。将人体解剖结构锁定为完全正确且可信。没有额外的肢体，没有断裂的手臂结构，没有融合的肘部，没有缺失的关节，没有畸形的肩膀。双手必须正好有五个手指，具有正确的手指间距、关节逻辑、拇指放置、肌腱流动和可信的抓握力学。右手必须自然地握住权杖，并具有正确的抓取解剖。左手必须在解剖学上正确、放松、优雅且完全像人类。保留写实的女性比例、锁骨逻辑、肩宽、臂长、手腕尺寸和手部比例。乳白云轨道光影逻辑：净化最重要的权力区域：面部、头饰、锁骨、肩膀、右前臂、权杖握把和上躯干必须获得更多神圣、精致的光影分离。这些照亮区域应透出灰尘，散发出安静但压倒性的权威。奶油光晕过渡融合逻辑：保持骨架不变，但进一步扩展沙融合的下半身和拖尾长袍过渡。下半身、长袍边缘、侧面轮廓和拖尾织物必须感觉到越来越多地溶解在烟沙湍流中，仿佛她是从风暴本身不断形成的。边缘必须保持开放且美丽的不稳定，永远不要密封或切断。古代神权逻辑：加强古代政教合一权力的感觉。女祭司必须感觉像是来自失落沙漠邪教的女祭司女皇，承载着比帝国更古老的神圣合法性。让神圣的权威活在她的举止、材质语言和她握住权力法杖的方式中。没有装饰性的道具过载。权杖逻辑：右手的权杖必须感觉是仪式性的、古老的、优雅且强大的。它可以参考埃及神圣法杖语言，但必须保持精致并与人物视觉整合。它不应比女性本身更主导图像。法杖必须支持剪影和姿势的权威。沙尘暴和特效：使用极其丰富的UE5级流体和粒子效果。在角色周围环绕流动的沙带、烟雾状的沙尘湍流、细小的沙粒碎片、漂浮的灰烬状粒子和翻滚的风暴密度。她身后的上方云团必须感觉像是一个活生生的神圣风暴形成，沉重且具雕塑感，而更细小的粒子则以更薄的层次包裹着角色。一切都必须感觉高端、可信且受控。光影：使用极度细腻、柔和的、经过灰尘过滤的电影照明。光线必须以奢华的柔和度揭示女祭司的面部、皇冠、项圈、肩膀、长袍褶皱、权杖和关键的沙子轮廓。保持发光的沙漠琥珀氛围，具有精致的高光衰减和柔和的阴影过渡。照明必须感觉神圣、风暴扩散且昂贵。面部和皮肤：以卓越的写实感和权威渲染面部：写实的皮肤纹理、细微的毛孔、高贵的骨骼结构、精确的眼妆、柔和风化的沙漠肤色以及冷静但威严的表情。眼睛必须蕴含巨大的继承力量。布料和材质：将长袍渲染为具有精细纹理、风化神圣优雅和强烈风感的层叠仪式沙漠织物。织物必须感觉真实、触感良好且飘逸，有些部分完全清晰可读，其他部分溶解在灰尘中。从纺织品到烟沙流的过渡必须是无缝且宏伟的。环境：保持背景极简，以风暴氛围为主。保留右下方到下方前景区域的沙丘坡度，以及上方区域的巨型沙云。没有建筑，没有额外角色，没有装饰性道具。印刷美学：在整个图像上应用高级颗粒印刷处理。结果必须感觉像是收藏级的奇幻版画，具有触感颗粒、优雅的模拟丰富度和微妙的表面深度。颗粒应增强沙子渐变、烟雾过渡和长袍纹理，而不使图像模糊。清晰度：保持面部、头饰、项圈、权杖握把、手部、关键长袍褶皱和中央沙流边缘极度清晰且细节分明，而外部灰尘和远处的风暴区域则保持较柔和。色彩方向：使用受控的沙漠调色板，包括深赭石、沙金、焦琥珀、棕褐色、灰褐色、烟褐和阴影大地色调，带有神圣青铜和古代神庙金色的底色。保持整个图像温暖、庄严、风暴感重且单色统一。渲染风格：UE5超写实古埃及女祭司女王在沙尘暴中，完全遵循图1构图逻辑，右手握神圣权杖，左手自然垂下，解剖学正确的五指手，身体与尘土的开边融合，飘逸的仪式长袍，雕塑感的神圣风暴云，高级粒子沙子效果，神圣柔和的电影沙漠照明，颗粒印刷处理，锐利细节，世界级画质，8k

级流体和粒子效果。在角色周围环绕流动的沙带、烟雾状的沙尘湍流、细小的沙粒碎片、漂浮的灰烬状粒子和翻滚的风暴密度。她身后的上方云团必须感觉像是一个活生生的神圣风暴形成，沉重且具雕塑感，而更细小的粒子则以更薄的层次包裹着角色。一切都必须感觉高端、可信且受控。光影：使用极度细腻、柔和的、经过灰尘过滤的电影照明。光线必须以奢华的柔和度揭示女祭司的面部、皇冠、项圈、肩膀、长袍褶皱、权杖和关键的沙子轮廓。保持发光的沙漠琥珀氛围，具有精致的高光衰减和柔和的阴影过渡。照明必须感觉神圣、风暴扩散且昂贵。面部和皮肤：以卓越的写实感和权威渲染面部：写实的皮肤纹理、细微的毛孔、高贵的骨骼结构、精确的眼妆、柔和风化的沙漠肤色以及冷静但威严的表情。眼睛必须蕴含巨大的继承力量。布料和材质：将长袍渲染为具有精细纹理、风化神圣优雅和强烈风感的层叠仪式沙漠织物。织物必须感觉真实、触感良好且飘逸，有些部分完全清晰可读，其他部分溶解在灰尘中。从纺织品到烟沙流的过渡必须是无缝且宏伟的。环境：保持背景极简，以风暴氛围为主。保留右下方到下方前景区域的沙丘坡度，以及上方区域的巨型沙云。没有建筑，没有额外角色，没有装饰性道具。印刷美学：在整个图像上应用高级颗粒印刷处理。结果必须感觉像是收藏级的奇幻版画，具有触感颗粒、优雅的模拟丰富度和微妙的表面深度。颗粒应增强沙子渐变、烟雾过渡和长袍纹理，而不使图像模糊。清晰度：保持面部、头饰、项圈、权杖握把、手部、关键长袍褶皱和中央沙流边缘极度清晰且细节分明，而外部灰尘和远处的风暴区域则保持较柔和。色彩方向：使用受控的沙漠调色板，包括深赭石、沙金、焦琥珀、棕褐色、灰褐色、烟褐和阴影大地色调，带有神圣青铜和古代神庙金色的底色。保持整个图像温暖、庄严、风暴感重且单色统一。渲染风格：UE5 超写实古埃及女祭司女王在沙尘暴中，完全遵循图 1 构图逻辑，右手握神圣权杖，左手自然垂下，解剖学正确的五指手，身体与尘土的开边融合，飘逸的仪式长袍，雕塑感的神圣风暴云，高级粒子沙子效果，神圣柔和的电影沙漠照明，颗粒印刷处理，锐利细节，世界级画质，8k

en.title: Summer Festival Water Balloon Stall
en.description: A cinematic and nostalgic Japanese prompt for a woman at a summer festival stall, capturing the vibrant colors of water balloons and the warm evening glow.
en.prompt:
Theme:
{argument name="theme" default="Scooped Summer Colors"}

Subject:
A vertical 3:4 photograph. A young woman is crouching in front of a water tank filled with colorful water balloons at a summer festival stall, positioned slightly left of center. The character is about 80% visible, with the tank and vibrant balloons filling the right side. She holds a small goldfish-scooping net in one hand and a small white bowl in the other.

Person/Expression:
Natural and friendly Japanese facial features. Translucent bright skin, large rounded eyes, thin soft eyebrows, and pale coral pink lips. The expression is quiet and slightly pensive. Her head is tilted slightly to the left, gazing at the camera. Dark brown hair with thin wispy bangs and a soft updo tied low. Thin loose strands frame the face, with a small white flower accessory behind the left ear.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="clothing" default="A cool yukata with a white base and a pattern of light wisteria and bluish-purple hydrangeas"}. The obi is a dull blue-gray, tied in a large but light bunko knot. She wears geta with black soles and pale floral straps. Crouching deeply by the tank with her back relatively straight, she holds the small net at chest level and extends the white bowl over the tank. Sleeves fall naturally with her movement, and the yukata hem shows fine wrinkles from her pose.

Background/Lighting:
A Japanese summer festival night. To the right is a metal-framed tank with translucent pink, blue, green, yellow, and orange water balloons. The background includes wooden stalls, dark pillars, and blurred signs. Foreground is dark stone floor, middle ground has the person and tank, and background shows soft bokeh from stall lights. The main light source is a warm-toned stall lamp at the top right, creating highlights on her cheek, nose, shoulder, and hand. Soft shadows fall toward the bottom left, with specular reflections on the water surface.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4, medium-long shot. The camera is slightly above eye level looking down. Her face is in the top third, the obi in the bottom left, and knees near the bottom edge. Wide negative space is left around the tank to show the color contrast. 50mm equivalent with shallow depth of field. Focus is on the face and hands, with a smooth bokeh background.

Texture/Style:
{argument name="style" default="Natural photographic expression capturing the atmosphere of a summer festival"}. Detailed skin texture, cotton yukata fabric, metal tank, and glossy wet balloons. Balanced warm and cool tones with moderate contrast. Fine film grain and soft halation added. Avoids excessive skin retouching or doll-like textures, aiming for a summer festival magazine snap feel.

zh.title: 夏日祭典水气球摊位
zh.description: 一个充满电影感和怀旧气息的日本主题提示词，描绘了一位女性在夏日祭典摊位前的场景，捕捉了水气球鲜艳的色彩和温暖的傍晚光影。
zh.prompt:
主题：
{argument name="theme" default="夏日捞球色彩"}

主体：
竖构图 3:4 照片。一位年轻女性蹲在夏日祭典摊位的水槽前，水槽里装满了五颜六色的水气球，人物位于画面中心偏左。人物可见度约 80%，水槽和鲜艳的气球占据了右侧空间。她一只手拿着捞金鱼的小网，另一只手拿着一个小白碗。

人物/表情：
自然亲切的日本女性面容。通透亮白的皮肤，大而圆的眼睛，细长柔和的眉毛，以及淡珊瑚粉色的嘴唇。表情安静且略带沉思。头部微微向左倾斜，凝视着镜头。深棕色头发留着稀疏的空气刘海，低处扎成柔和的盘发。几缕细碎的发丝垂在脸颊旁，左耳后别着一个小巧的白色花朵饰品。

服装/姿势：
{argument name="clothing" default="一件以白色为底，印有淡紫藤和蓝紫色绣球花图案的清凉浴衣"}。腰带为暗蓝灰色，系成一个大而轻盈的文库结。她穿着黑色鞋底、浅色花纹带的木屐。她深深地蹲在水槽旁，背部挺直，将小网举在胸前，并将小白碗伸向水槽上方。袖子随动作自然垂落，浴衣下摆因姿势呈现出细微的褶皱。

背景/光影：
日本夏日祭典之夜。右侧是一个金属框架的水槽，里面装满了半透明的粉色、蓝色、绿色、黄色和橙色水气球。背景包括木质摊位、深色柱子和模糊的招牌。前景是深色的石板地面，中景是人物和水槽，背景呈现出摊位灯光形成的柔和焦外虚化。主光源是右上方的暖色调摊位灯，在她的脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀和手上形成高光。柔和的阴影投向左下方，水面上闪烁着点点反光。

构图/摄影：
竖构图 3:4，中远景。相机位置略高于视线，采用俯拍视角。她的脸部位于画面上方三分之一处，腰带位于左下方，膝盖靠近底部边缘。水槽周围留有宽阔的负空间，以展现色彩对比。50mm 等效镜头，浅景深。焦点集中在脸部和手上，背景呈现平滑的虚化效果。

质感/风格：
{argument name="style" default="捕捉夏日祭典氛围的自然摄影表现"}。细腻的皮肤纹理、棉质浴衣面料、金属水槽以及光泽湿润的气球。冷暖色调平衡，对比度适中。添加了细腻的胶片颗粒感和柔和的光晕效果。避免过度修饰皮肤或产生类似玩偶的质感，旨在营造出夏日祭典杂志快照的氛围。

en.title: Japanese Festival Kakigori Stall
en.description: An illustration prompt that creates a detailed Japanese summer festival food stall based on an existing character or reference image, focusing on authentic atmosphere and details.
en.prompt: Make an illustration. Create a Japanese festival food stall based entirely on the uploaded illustration. The stall, {argument name="flavor" default="kakigori flavor"}, {argument name="syrup colors" default="syrup colors"}, bowl, toppings, decorations, signboard, menu plate, lanterns, banners, and festival atmosphere must naturally grow from the artwork’s colors, clothing, symbols, worldbuilding, personality, culture, and mood. Instead of a luxury café dessert, create a {argument name="atmosphere" default="cheerful festival-style"} kakigori that looks handmade and slightly special, but still realistic for a summer festival food stall. Adapt the flavor and presentation to match the original illustration rather than using generic designs. If the illustration contains a character, preserve the same face, hairstyle, outfit, colors, proportions, expression, and personality. Show the character smiling brightly while happily eating the kakigori at the stall, holding a spoon and naturally interacting with the dessert. Include an original Japanese flavor name and a clean, highly readable Japanese menu sign matching the illustration’s world. Surround the scene with colorful festival decorations, paper lanterns, happy visitors, warm sunlight, and a lively, joyful summer festival atmosphere. Ultra-detailed, vibrant, realistic illustration with cinematic lighting.

zh.title: 日本祭典刨冰摊位
zh.description: 一个插画提示词，旨在根据现有角色或参考图像创作一个细节丰富的日本夏季祭典食品摊位，重点展现地道的氛围与细节。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅插画。完全基于上传的插画创建一个日本祭典食品摊位。摊位、{argument name="flavor" default="刨冰口味"}、{argument name="syrup colors" default="糖浆颜色"}、碗、配料、装饰、招牌、菜单牌、灯笼、横幅以及祭典氛围，必须从艺术作品的色彩、服饰、符号、世界观、个性、文化和情绪中自然衍生。不要将其设计成奢华的咖啡馆甜点，而是要创作一款 {argument name="atmosphere" default="欢快的祭典风格"} 刨冰，看起来既手工制作且略显特别，又符合夏季祭典食品摊位的真实感。根据原始插画调整口味和呈现方式，而非使用通用设计。如果插画中包含角色，请保留相同的面部、发型、服装、颜色、比例、表情和个性。展示角色在摊位前开心地吃着刨冰，笑容灿烂，手持勺子并与甜点自然互动。包含一个原创的日式口味名称，以及一个与插画世界观相符、清晰易读的日式菜单牌。场景周围环绕着色彩缤纷的祭典装饰、纸灯笼、快乐的游客、温暖的阳光以及生动、欢乐的夏季祭典氛围。超精细、色彩鲜艳、逼真的插画，具有电影般的灯光效果。

en.title: Sunset Coastal Woman Fashion Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for a fashion-style portrait of a woman on a rocky coast at sunset, featuring natural textures and a soft film aesthetic.
en.prompt:
Subject:
Hair unraveling in the sea breeze

Main Subject:
A 4:5 vertical photograph. Featuring {argument name="subject description" default="an adult woman standing alone on a rocky coastline"}, captured from head to below the knees. The figure is positioned slightly below the center of the frame, occupying approximately 65% of the height. The upper half leaves a large expanse of pale blue sky and fine clouds, creating an open composition where the sea, rocks, and the person overlap vertically.

Person and Expression:
An adult woman with a natural and elegant atmosphere. Her light brown long hair has loose waves and flows largely to the right of the screen, caught by the wind blowing from the sea. She bows her head slightly, tilts her face a bit to the left of the screen, and drops her gaze below her hands. Her eyebrows and mouth are relaxed, with a quiet expression as if she is lost in thought. Her skin retains a warm complexion and natural texture, with thin coral-toned blush, brown-beige eyes, and pale pink lips.

Clothing and Pose:
{argument name="outfit" default="A pale shell pink triangle bikini"}. The top has fine gathers and modest trim, and the bottom is a thin side-ribbon style tied at the hip bone. She wears a small, transparent teardrop pendant. Her right hand is raised to shoulder height, lightly holding a smartphone in a reddish-brown case with her fingertips. Her wrist is softly bent outward. Her left hand is lowered to the side of her waist, lightly touching the end of the side ribbon. A pink tote bag with thin straps is hung on her right shoulder, hanging outside her right thigh. Her weight is placed on her right leg, in a natural standing posture with her left knee slightly relaxed.

Background and Light:
The foreground consists of grainy brown masonry and rock surfaces. The middle ground features sharp blackish-brown reefs and small waves, while the background shows a calm blue sea, a low coastline, and a dense green pine forest. Fine white clouds are widely scattered in the sky. {argument name="lighting effect" default="The low evening sun shines from the front left of the screen, casting soft golden light on her cheeks, shoulders, chest, abdomen, and the left side of her legs"}. Shadows fall to the back right of the screen, with blue reflected light from the sea and sky subtly filling the shadow side. A contrast between warm skin tones and a cool blue background.

Composition and Camera:
A vertical full-body portrait taken from a height close to eye level. The top of the person's head is slightly above the center of the screen, and the feet are naturally cropped at the bottom edge. Maintain about 40% sky margin, with the horizon slightly above the person's waist. Natural perspective equivalent to 50mm. Focus accurately on the person's face, hair, and torso, while gently blurring the rocky area and coastline to the extent that their shapes are recognizable.

Texture and Style:
A high-definition fashion photograph taken at a summer seaside. Carefully express natural skin texture, thin strands of hair overlapping in the wind, soft wrinkles in dry fabric, the rough texture of rocks, and fine reflections on the water surface. Calm film-like grain, modest contrast, and a settled color palette that is not excessively vivid.

Negative:
Persons who look underage, unnatural faces, unnatural gaze, excessively exaggerated body shapes, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, poor contact with the smartphone, floating bag, contradiction between hair and wind direction, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, plastic-like skin, excessive skin correction, gibberish text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 日落海岸女性时尚肖像
zh.description: 一个高度详细的提示词，用于创作日落时分岩石海岸上的女性时尚肖像，呈现自然的质感和柔和的胶片美学。
zh.prompt:
主体：
海风中飘逸的秀发

主要主体：
一张 4:5 的竖构图照片。以 {argument name="subject description" default="一位独自站在岩石海岸线上的成年女性"} 为主角，拍摄范围从头部到膝盖下方。人物位于画面中心略下方，占据约 65% 的高度。上半部分留出大面积淡蓝色天空和细碎云朵，营造出海面、岩石与人物垂直重叠的开放式构图。

人物与表情：
一位气质自然优雅的成年女性。她浅棕色的长发呈松散波浪状，在海风吹拂下大幅向画面右侧飘动。她微微低头，脸部向画面左侧轻微倾斜，视线垂落在双手下方。眉眼和嘴唇放松，神情宁静，仿佛陷入沉思。皮肤保留了温暖的肤色和自然质感，带有淡淡的珊瑚色腮红、棕米色眼眸和淡粉色嘴唇。

服装与姿势：
{argument name="outfit" default="一件淡贝壳粉色三角比基尼"}。上衣带有细褶和简约饰边，下装为系在髋骨处的细侧带款式。她佩戴着一枚小巧透明的水滴形吊坠。右手抬至肩高，指尖轻握着一部红棕色手机壳的智能手机，手腕向外柔和弯曲。左手垂在腰侧，轻轻触碰侧带末端。右肩挂着一个细带粉色托特包，垂在右大腿外侧。重心落在右腿上，左膝自然放松，呈现出自然的站立姿势。

背景与光影：
前景为颗粒感的棕色石砌和岩石表面。中景为尖锐的黑褐色礁石和小浪花，背景则是平静的蓝色大海、低矮的海岸线和茂密的绿色松林。细碎的白云在天空中广泛分布。{argument name="lighting effect" default="低垂的夕阳从画面左前方照射，将柔和的金光投射在她的脸颊、肩膀、胸部、腹部和腿部左侧"}。阴影落在画面右后方，来自大海和天空的蓝色反射光微妙地填充了阴影侧。温暖的肤色与冷色调的蓝色背景形成对比。

构图与摄影：
从接近视平线的高度拍摄的竖幅全身肖像。人物头顶略高于画面中心，双脚在底部边缘自然裁切。保持约 40% 的天空留白，地平线略高于人物腰部。相当于 50mm 镜头的自然透视。焦点精准对准人物的面部、头发和躯干，同时将岩石区域和海岸线进行轻微虚化，使其轮廓清晰可见。

质感与风格：
一张在夏季海边拍摄的高清时尚照片。细腻地表现自然的皮肤质感、风中交织的细发丝、干燥织物上的柔和褶皱、岩石的粗糙纹理以及水面上的细微反光。具有平静的胶片颗粒感、适度的对比度，以及不过分鲜艳的沉稳色调。

负面提示词：
未成年人外貌、不自然的面部、不自然的视线、过度夸张的身材、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、与手机接触不良、悬浮的包、头发与风向矛盾、透视错误、与光源不一致的阴影、塑料质感的皮肤、过度磨皮、乱码文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Cozy Afternoon Cafe Portrait

Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Afternoon tying sandals"}

Main Subject:
In a bright cafe by a window, depict a young adult woman sitting on a beige single-seater sofa, adjusting the sandals at her feet. The person occupies a large portion of the screen from the center to the left, in a vertical 3:4 composition including the top of the head down to below the knees. A round table with a drink is placed on the right, and a woven bag is placed at the bottom right.

Person/Expression:
Bright ivory-beige skin, leaving a natural pink complexion and delicate texture. A rounded, mature physique with soft three-dimensional feel in shoulders, collarbones, arms, and legs. Pale rose blush, pink-brown eye makeup, long thin eyelashes, natural tear bags, and sheer pink-beige lips. A peaceful expression with the head tilted slightly down to the right, looking down at the feet. {argument name="hairstyle" default="Bright milk tea ash brown medium-long hair"}, thin see-through bangs, layers around the face, inner-curled ends, and natural stray hairs.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="outfit" default="Ivory ribbed camisole with thin straps"}. Delicate lace and a small ribbon at the chest, an elegant design that naturally follows the body lines. Bottoms are light flare shorts with a small floral pattern on a pale cream color. Sitting shallowly on the sofa, stretching her own right leg forward and bending the left knee toward the body. Using the right hand to pinch the dainty sandal strap near the right ankle, and the left arm lowered onto the sofa to support the body. Natural wrinkles and overlaps in the clothing hems and fabric according to the sitting posture.

Background/Light:
A small cafe based on calm beige and wood grain. An iced latte on the round table to the right, with bright sunlight streaming in from the window side. A natural-colored woven bag and small items are placed at the bottom right. The primary light source is warm natural light coming from the window at the top right of the screen. Soft highlights on the hair surface, cheeks, shoulders, chest, thighs, and knees, with thin shadows cast to the bottom left. The indoor beige color reflects gently onto the skin, with the background kept slightly dark.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4, a close-up snap looking down at the person from diagonally above. Camera is in front and to the left of the person, higher than eye level. Leaving a slight margin near the top of the head, naturally containing the legs and sandals. Focus on the person's face and upper body, lightly blurring the table and background. Natural perspective equivalent to 35-50mm, avoiding excessive wide-angle distortion.

Texture/Style:
A realistic Japanese fashion snap taken with natural light. Skin is smooth but leaves pores and fine shadows, without excessive skin correction. Meticulously depict individual strands of hair, lace, thin fabric, woven bag, and condensation on the glass surface. Centered on bright cream and pale beige, with low contrast and clean, soft photographic expression.

Negative:
Appearing underage, unnatural face, excessive exposure, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, poor contact with sandals, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light sources, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-like skin.

en.title: Vintage Lounge Evening Gown Portrait
en.description: A cinematic and elegant prompt for a young woman in a vintage luxury lounge, wearing a silk evening gown with warm, moody lighting.
en.prompt:
A young adult East Asian woman standing in a {argument name="interior scene" default="moody vintage club or high-end lounge"}, upper-body to near full-body composition, positioned slightly to the right of the center. Her body is turned toward the left of the screen at a two-thirds back-side angle, her head looking back over her left shoulder at the camera with a calm and direct gaze, an expression that is restrained, elegant, and slightly detached, with lips naturally parted. Her posture is naturally upright with clear neck and shoulder lines, one hand lightly touching her chest or the edge of her dress, and the other naturally close to her body.

She has a soft and delicate oval face, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender nose bridge, and light rose-nude pink lips. Makeup is elegant but exquisite, retaining only natural eyelashes, fine eyeliner, a touch of warm-toned blush, and a soft lip color. Her skin is fair and warm-toned, retaining real pores, fine fuzz, natural skin color variations, and soft highlights—no plastic skin smoothing.

She has long dark blackish-brown hair, naturally loose with a slightly voluminous wavy feel, some strands falling on her back and the side of her face, with a real texture that is not overly neat.

She is wearing a {argument name="dress color" default="deep burgundy or blackberry purple"} luxury evening gown, off-the-shoulder design, with woven or knotted shoulder straps, elegant openings on the sides and back, and a slim-fit skirt that fits the waist and hip lines. The fabric is a soft matte satin or elastic silk with subtle dim reflections. The overall look is sexy but restrained, sophisticated, mature, and subtle.

The background features dark brown wood paneling, vintage carved mirror frames, warm yellow wall lamps, and a black leather Chesterfield sofa, creating a quiet and luxurious environment. Lighting is low-intensity warm indoor light, with the wall lamp at the top left providing soft warm light, delicate fill light on the person's face, and a warm rim light on the shoulders, back, and hair edges. Overall low saturation, low contrast, dark cinematic feel, retaining shadow layers. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, real skin and fabric textures, light film grain, photorealistic.

Avoid: Cartoon, CG, illustration, excessive skin smoothing, heavy makeup, exaggerated body shapes, incorrect fingers, deformed arms, overexposure, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered background, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 复古酒廊晚礼服人像
zh.description: 一个电影感十足且优雅的提示词，描绘了一位身穿丝绸晚礼服的年轻女性置身于复古奢华酒廊中，配以温暖、深沉的灯光。
zh.prompt:
一位年轻的东亚女性站在 {argument name="interior scene" default="氛围感十足的复古俱乐部或高端酒廊"} 中，半身至近全身构图，位于画面中心偏右侧。身体向画面左侧转动，呈三分之二背侧角度，头部越过左肩回眸看向镜头，目光冷静而直接，表情克制、优雅且略带疏离感，双唇自然微张。姿态自然挺拔，颈部和肩部线条清晰，一只手轻触胸口或裙边，另一只手自然垂在身侧。

她拥有柔和精致的鹅蛋脸，杏仁状的深棕色眼睛，自然的细眉，鼻梁挺拔，唇色为淡玫瑰裸粉色。妆容优雅而精致，仅保留自然的睫毛、细眼线、淡淡的暖色腮红和柔和的唇色。皮肤白皙且呈暖色调，保留了真实的毛孔、细微绒毛、自然的肤色变化和柔和的高光——没有那种塑料感的磨皮效果。

她留着深黑棕色的长发，自然披散，带有轻微的蓬松波浪感，几缕发丝落在背部和脸侧，质感真实，不显刻意整齐。

她身穿一件 {argument name="dress color" default="深酒红色或黑莓紫色"} 的奢华晚礼服，露肩设计，配有编织或打结的肩带，侧面和背部有优雅的开叉，修身剪裁勾勒出腰臀线条。面料为哑光缎面或弹性丝绸，带有微妙的暗光反射。整体造型性感而克制，成熟、精致且含蓄。

背景为深棕色木镶板、复古雕花镜框、暖黄色壁灯和黑色皮革切斯特菲尔德沙发，营造出安静而奢华的环境。灯光为低强度的室内暖光，左上方的壁灯提供柔和的暖光，在人物面部形成细腻的补光，并在肩部、背部和发丝边缘勾勒出暖色的轮廓光。整体低饱和度、低对比度，具有深沉的电影感，保留了阴影层次。摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8 光圈，浅景深，真实的皮肤和织物纹理，轻微胶片颗粒感，照片级真实感。

避免：卡通、CG、插画、过度磨皮、浓妆、夸张的身材比例、手指错误、手臂变形、过度曝光、强 HDR、过度锐化、杂乱的背景、文字、水印、Logo。

zh.title: 专业职场肖像
zh.description: 为专业品牌推广或 LinkedIn 风格的使用场景，创作一张自信的年轻非洲男性坐在办公桌前的写实职场生活肖像。
zh.prompt: 创作一张超写实、高端的专业职场生活肖像，展现一位时尚的年轻非洲男性自信地坐在现代办公室内一张整洁的白色书桌后。他位于画面中心，面朝镜头，表情冷静、自信且平易近人，一只手轻托下巴。他拥有 {argument name="skin tone" default="温暖的中棕色皮肤"}，{argument name="hairstyle" default="整洁的黑色短发"}，佩戴透明框眼镜，面部特征自然，修饰得体。让他身穿一件质感轻盈的浅蓝色外衣或商务休闲夹克，内搭深炭蓝色圆领衫，佩戴银色金属手表和一枚简约的银戒指。在白色书桌右侧前景边缘放置一台打开的银色笔记本电脑，画面局部裁剪，他的另一只手自然地放在桌面上。背景是微微虚化的深灰色质感墙面，仅包含两个办公装饰元素：左后方架子上的一盆白色小绿植，以及右侧一盏散发着暖光的黑色角度可调台灯。采用优质企业肖像摄影布光：正面柔和的漫射主光，面部和眼镜上有柔和的高光，阴影深度微妙，浅景深，面部细节清晰，皮肤纹理自然，反射真实，呈现 85mm 人像镜头效果，构图简洁，冷色调，无文字，无水印，无其他人物。

en.title: Neon Chibi Sailor Salute
en.description: Generates a vibrant 3D chibi anime schoolgirl figurine in a playful saluting pose for cute AI art or character illustration.
en.prompt: Create a full-body 3D stylized chibi anime girl figurine on a pure black background, centered in a vertical portrait canvas. The character is {argument name="character name" default="Oyagi"}, a cute sailor-uniform schoolgirl with oversized rounded proportions, soft toy-like sculpting, blank glossy circular eyes without pupils, a tiny nose, and a gentle smiling expression. She is leaning forward playfully with legs spread wide, one hand raised horizontally to her forehead in a cheerful salute, and the other arm bent back at her side. Give her thick fluffy bobbed hair with large rounded bangs and side curls, rendered in a luminous {argument name="hair color" default="pink, violet, and cyan gradient"}. Dress her in a puffy Japanese sailor school uniform with a wide collar, bow knot and two hanging ribbon tails, pleated skirt, long socks or tights, slouchy ankle warmers, and rounded Mary Jane shoes; keep all clothing soft, inflated, and clay-like. Use vibrant iridescent lighting in {argument name="color palette" default="neon pink, magenta, violet, blue, cyan, and peach"}, with smooth subsurface scattering, glossy plastic-clay material, soft bloom, strong rim highlights, and no hard outlines. The pose should feel like a friendly morning greeting, energetic and cute, shot from a slightly low front angle so the head and raised hand dominate the upper frame while both shoes are visible near the bottom. Add a small elegant handwritten signature and date in the bottom-right corner reading {argument name="date text" default="July 26, 2026"} and {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}. Avoid extra characters, scenery, props, pupils, realistic skin texture, or text other than the small signature/date.

zh.title: 霓虹 Q 版水手敬礼
zh.description: 生成一个充满活力的 3D Q 版动漫女学生手办，摆出俏皮的敬礼姿势，适用于可爱的 AI 艺术创作或角色插画。
zh.prompt: 在纯黑色背景上创建一个全身 3D 风格化的 Q 版动漫女孩手办，居中于垂直肖像画布。角色为 {argument name="character name" default="Oyagi"}，一个可爱的水手服女学生，具有夸张的圆润比例、柔软的玩具般造型、无瞳孔的空白光泽圆形眼睛、小巧的鼻子和温柔的微笑表情。她俏皮地向前倾身，双腿叉开，一只手水平举向额头做出欢快的敬礼动作，另一只手臂向后弯曲在身体一侧。给她设计厚实蓬松的波波头，带有大而圆的刘海和侧卷发，渲染出明亮的 {argument name="hair color" default="粉色、紫色和青色渐变"}。让她穿上一件蓬松的日式水手校服，配有宽领、蝴蝶结和两条垂下的丝带尾、百褶裙、长袜或连裤袜、松垮的护踝袜以及圆头玛丽珍鞋；保持所有服装柔软、充气且具有粘土质感。使用 {argument name="color palette" default="霓虹粉、洋红、紫色、蓝色、青色和桃色"} 的鲜艳虹彩光效，配合平滑的次表面散射、光泽塑料粘土材质、柔和的辉光效果、强烈的边缘高光，且没有硬轮廓线。姿势应呈现出友好的早晨问候感，充满活力且可爱，从略微低的前方角度拍摄，使头部和举起的手占据上方框架，同时两只鞋子在底部清晰可见。在右下角添加一个优雅的小型手写签名和日期，内容为 {argument name="date text" default="2026 年 7 月 26 日"} 和 {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"}。避免出现额外角色、场景、道具、瞳孔、逼真的皮肤纹理，或除小签名/日期以外的任何文字。

en.title: Purple Cyber Ninja Battle Scene
en.description: Generates a dramatic anime cyberpunk battle illustration with a cat-eared ninja warrior, armored soldier, and glowing purple energy blade.
en.prompt: Create a dark cinematic sci-fi anime battle scene in a devastated forest at night, with exactly 2 main characters: a towering black-armored futuristic soldier behind and slightly left, wearing a full helmet with glowing violet visor slits, layered tactical power armor, and a heavy gauntlet gripping a weapon; and a fierce anime cat-eared warrior girl in the foreground, {argument name="character name" default="ninja AI"}, with long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="black-purple"} hair, glowing purple eyes, black tactical ninja armor, an open-mouthed battle shout, and a dynamic forward-lunging pose. She is unleashing exactly 1 enormous translucent violet energy blade or slash stretching diagonally from center-left to upper-right, filled with lightning, sparks, particle trails, and the glowing text {argument name="blade text" default="忍者 AI"} printed across the blade. Add exactly 1 small shuriken-like flying drone or projectile in the mid-right background, surrounded by purple energy. The environment is a chaotic war-torn woodland with smoky silhouettes of trees, embers, distant fires, debris, storm clouds, and purple electrical arcs everywhere. Use dramatic low-angle perspective, extreme motion blur, high contrast, glossy black armor, magenta-violet rim lighting, ultra-detailed digital painting, anime-meets-cyberpunk concept art, sharp focus on the two characters and blade, cinematic depth of field, 16:9 widescreen composition. Include exactly 2 visible text elements: the glowing blade text and a rounded cream label in the top-right corner reading {argument name="badge text" default="AI-Generated"}. Avoid gore, avoid extra main characters, avoid additional readable text, no watermark besides the specified badge.

zh.title: 紫色赛博忍者战斗场景
zh.description: 生成一张极具戏剧性的动漫赛博朋克战斗插画，包含猫耳忍者战士、重装士兵以及发光的紫色能量刃。
zh.prompt: 创作一个黑暗电影感的科幻动漫战斗场景，背景为夜晚荒废的森林，包含 2 个主要角色：后方左侧是一位身穿黑色重型战术动力装甲、头戴全封闭头盔且带有发光紫色护目镜缝隙的未来士兵，正手持武器；前景是一位凶猛的动漫猫耳女战士，{argument name="character name" default="ninja AI"}，留着飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="black-purple"} 长发，拥有发光的紫色双眼，身穿黑色战术忍者装甲，正张嘴呐喊，呈现出动态的前冲姿态。她释放出 1 把巨大的半透明紫色能量刃或斩击，从左中向右上呈对角线延伸，充满闪电、火花、粒子轨迹，且刀刃上印有发光的文字 {argument name="blade text" default="忍者 AI"}。在右中背景处添加 1 个被紫色能量环绕的小型手里剑状飞行无人机或投射物。环境为混乱的战乱林地，布满烟雾缭绕的树木剪影、余烬、远处的火光、碎片、风暴云以及随处可见的紫色电弧。采用戏剧性的低角度视角、极强的动态模糊、高对比度、光泽感黑色装甲、洋红色至紫色的轮廓光、超精细数字绘画、动漫与赛博朋克结合的概念艺术、聚焦于两个角色和刀刃的清晰焦点、电影级景深，以及 16:9 宽屏构图。包含 2 个可见的文字元素：发光的刀刃文字，以及右上角一个圆形的奶油色标签，内容为 {argument name="badge text" default="AI-Generated"}。避免血腥，避免额外的主要角色，避免出现其他可读文字，除指定的标签外不得有任何水印。

en.title: Real Girl in Anime Mural Room
en.description: A photorealistic cozy portrait prompt for placing a real young woman and cat in front of a warm beige wall filled with cute anime-style doodles.
en.prompt: Create a cozy ultra-realistic vertical full-body portrait of a young woman standing casually indoors in front of a warm beige wall covered with simple black line-art anime doodles, blending a real person into a cute anime world. The woman is {argument name="character age and appearance" default="a young woman in her late teens with long dark brown hair, soft curtain layers, natural makeup, and a calm gentle expression"}, facing the camera with a relaxed posture, both hands tucked into the pockets of an oversized {argument name="jacket color" default="olive-brown"} jacket. She wears a plain white T-shirt, loose light-blue wide-leg jeans, and beige sneakers. To her right on the floor sits {argument name="real cat" default="a gray-and-white cat wearing a small brown checkered bandana"}, looking toward the camera. Behind her, draw exactly 10 visible black doodle elements on the wall: 1 large winking anime girl mural on the left making a peace sign, 1 cute cartoon cat below it with both paws raised and a small collar charm, 3 heart doodles, 3 star or sparkle doodles, and 2 small motion/accent mark clusters. Use warm golden sunlight entering from the left, casting diagonal window-shadow stripes across the wall, mural, woman, floor, and cat. The floor is plain gray concrete, the wall is matte beige, and the mood is soft, cozy, nostalgic, and magical. Keep the real woman and real cat photorealistic with natural skin texture, realistic fabric folds, and accurate shadows, while the wall art remains hand-drawn manga-style line work. Shoot at eye level with a 35mm editorial portrait feel, full body visible from head to shoes, centered composition with the woman slightly right of the anime mural, warm color grading, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, high detail, no extra people, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 动漫涂鸦墙前的真实女孩
zh.description: 一个照片级写实的温馨肖像提示词，将一位真实的年轻女性和猫咪置于充满可爱动漫风格涂鸦的暖米色墙壁前。
zh.prompt: 创作一张温馨且超写实的竖构图全身肖像，画面中一位年轻女性正悠闲地站在室内，背景是一面布满简约黑色线条动漫涂鸦的暖米色墙壁，将真人融入可爱的动漫世界。这位女性为 {argument name="character age and appearance" default="一位十几岁末期、留着深棕色长发、带有柔和八字刘海、妆容自然、表情平静温柔的年轻女性"}，面向镜头，姿态放松，双手插在超大号 {argument name="jacket color" default="橄榄棕色"} 外套的口袋里。她身穿纯白色 T 恤、宽松的浅蓝色阔腿牛仔裤和米色运动鞋。在她的右侧地板上坐着 {argument name="real cat" default="一只戴着棕色格子小领巾的灰白花色猫咪"}，正看向镜头。在她身后，墙上需绘制 10 个清晰可见的黑色涂鸦元素：左侧是一个巨大的正在比剪刀手的眨眼动漫女孩壁画，下方是一只双爪举起、戴着小领饰的可爱卡通猫，以及 3 个爱心涂鸦、3 个星星或闪光涂鸦，还有 2 组小型动态/强调符号。利用从左侧射入的温暖金色阳光，在墙壁、壁画、女性、地面和猫咪身上投下对角线的窗影条纹。地面为素色灰色水泥地，墙壁为哑光米色，整体氛围柔和、温馨、怀旧且充满魔力。保持真人女性和真实猫咪的照片级写实感，呈现自然的皮肤纹理、逼真的衣物褶皱和准确的阴影，同时墙面艺术保持手绘漫画风格的线条感。以 35mm 编辑人像摄影视角在平视高度拍摄，全身从头到鞋可见，构图居中，女性位于动漫壁画的右侧，暖色调处理，浅至中等景深，高细节，无其他人物，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Golden Hour Running Fashion Photo
en.description: A photorealistic vertical editorial shot of a smiling woman looking back while running on an open road at sunset.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical magazine-style fashion photo of {argument name="character name" default="a young East Asian woman"} running away from the camera on an empty wide asphalt road at golden hour, captured from an extremely low rear tracking angle with a dynamic wide-angle lens. She is mid-stride and turning her head back over her shoulder toward the camera with a bright spontaneous smile, short black bob hair blowing dramatically in the wind. She wears {argument name="top" default="a dusty pink sleeveless tie-back tank top"}, {argument name="shorts" default="dark charcoal fitted athletic shorts"}, and white sneakers. Emphasize long legs in perspective, natural skin texture, cinematic sunset rim light, warm orange sunlight from the low horizon on the left, blue sky with scattered soft clouds, subtle film grain, motion blur streaking along the road surface, shallow depth of field, realistic lens distortion, lively candid energy, and an editorial summer road-trip mood. Keep the composition vertical 9:16, subject centered slightly right, no text, no watermark, no extra people, no vehicles close to the subject.

zh.title: 黄金时刻跑步时尚大片
zh.description: 一张写实的竖版时尚编辑风格照片，展现了一位面带微笑的女性在日落时分的开阔公路上奔跑并回眸的瞬间。
zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的竖版杂志风格时尚照片，画面主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻的东亚女性"}，她正在空旷宽阔的柏油路上背对着镜头奔跑，拍摄时间为黄金时刻，采用极低角度的后方跟拍视角，并使用动态广角镜头。她正处于奔跑的步伐中，转头回眸看向镜头，脸上带着灿烂自然的微笑，黑色短波波头在风中飘动。她身穿 {argument name="top" default="一件灰粉色无袖系带背心"}、{argument name="shorts" default="深炭灰色修身运动短裤"} 和白色运动鞋。画面需强调透视感下的修长双腿、自然的皮肤质感、电影级的日落轮廓光，左侧低地平线处透出温暖的橙色阳光，天空呈现蓝色并伴有稀疏的柔和云朵，带有细腻的胶片颗粒感，路面呈现动态模糊，浅景深效果，真实的镜头畸变，充满活力的抓拍感，以及夏日公路旅行的编辑风格氛围。构图保持 9:16 竖版，主体略微偏右，无文字，无水印，无多余人物，主体附近无车辆。

en.title: Cinematic Forest Runner
en.description: A dreamy widescreen film still of a white-clad figure running through a misty green forest, ideal for music-video storyboards or cinematic scene concepts.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic widescreen film still of {argument name="character" default="a young person with short black hair"} running away from the camera through a quiet forest. The subject is centered slightly left, seen from behind, mid-stride, with one bare arm bent and visible, wearing a flowing {argument name="outfit" default="sleeveless translucent white dress or robe"} that trails dramatically to the right like a soft veil caught by motion. The forest contains tall, straight tree trunks receding into depth, dense green undergrowth, and a faint dirt path on the left foreground. Use cool teal-green color grading, early morning mist, soft diffused natural light, shallow depth of field, gentle motion blur on the fabric and background, and an emotional dreamlike music-video atmosphere. Compose in a 2.39:1 cinematic aspect ratio, low-to-mid camera height following behind the runner, with realistic photography, soft focus edges, no text, no logos, no extra people.

zh.title: 电影感森林奔跑者
zh.description: 一张梦幻般的宽银幕电影剧照，描绘了一个身着白衣的人物在雾气缭绕的绿色森林中奔跑，非常适合作为音乐视频的“项目”或电影场景概念图。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影感宽银幕剧照，画面中 {argument name="character" default="一位留着黑色短发的年轻人"} 正背对着镜头，在静谧的森林中奔跑。主体略微偏左，背影视角，处于奔跑姿态，可见一只弯曲的裸露手臂，身穿一件飘逸的 {argument name="outfit" default="无袖半透明白色长裙或长袍"}，裙摆像被动作带起的轻柔面纱一样，戏剧性地向右拖曳。森林中矗立着高大笔直的树干，向深处延伸，地面覆盖着茂密的绿色植被，左前方有一条隐约的土路。采用冷青绿色调，清晨薄雾，柔和的漫射自然光，浅景深，织物和背景带有轻微的动态模糊，营造出一种感性且梦幻的音乐视频氛围。构图采用 2.39:1 电影宽高比，低至中机位跟随奔跑者拍摄，画面真实，边缘柔焦，无文字，无 Logo，无其他人物。

en.title: Night Walk Portrait Triptych
en.description: Creates a realistic three-panel smartphone night portrait sequence of a young woman posing along a reflective tiled city sidewalk.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic vertical mobile-night-photography triptych of the same young woman during a late-night city walk, with the feeling of three consecutive casual snapshots captured on a phone.

Canvas: A tall vertical 9:16 image divided into exactly 3 equal horizontal photo panels stacked top to bottom, edge-to-edge with no captions, borders, logos, or watermark.

Subject: The same {argument name="character description" default="young East Asian woman in her early 20s with long loose dark brown hair, natural makeup, soft smile, slim build"} appears in all 3 panels. She wears {argument name="outfit" default="a fitted gray sleeveless tank top, loose light blue jeans, and a small black leather shoulder bag with thin straps"}. Keep her face consistent across all panels.

Setting: Late-night urban sidewalk beside a glossy white rectangular-tile wall on the right, with a quiet road, crosswalk markings, metal poles, railings, glass reflections, distant apartment windows, traffic lights, and streetlights on the left. Use mixed cool and warm street lighting, reflective white tiles, wet-looking highlights, and soft city bokeh in the background.

Panel count and poses: Use exactly 3 panels. Panel 1, top: medium shot from behind and slightly to the side as she walks along the sidewalk, turning her head back over her shoulder toward the camera with a gentle smile. Panel 2, middle: closer portrait, she faces the camera and reaches one open hand toward the lens to block it playfully; the hand is large and motion-blurred in the foreground while her smiling face remains visible behind it. Panel 3, bottom: seated crouching pose beside the tiled wall, knees bent, one elbow resting on her knee and cheek leaning on her hand, looking up at the camera with a relaxed affectionate smile; black shoulder bag visible near her side.

Camera and style: Hyper-realistic candid smartphone night mode photography, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, 28mm wide-angle mobile lens feel, slight handheld perspective, high ISO but clean, realistic motion blur only on the reaching hand, cinematic urban lighting, soft highlights on hair and tiles, muted gray-blue night palette with warm amber reflections.

Constraints: Keep the scene text-free. Do not add extra people. Do not change clothing between panels. Maintain believable anatomy, consistent facial identity, and realistic phone-photo composition.

zh.title: 夜间漫步人像三联画
zh.description: 创作一组写实的手机夜间人像三联画，展示一位年轻女性在反光瓷砖城市人行道上漫步的姿态。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一组写实的竖版手机夜拍三联画，展示同一位年轻女性在深夜城市漫步时的状态，呈现出三张连续的手机抓拍感。

画布：一张 9:16 的高竖版图像，从上到下平均分为 3 个横向照片面板，边缘对齐，无标题、边框、Logo 或水印。

主体：同一位 {argument name="character description" default="20 岁出头、留着深棕色长直发、妆容自然、笑容温和、身材苗条的东亚年轻女性"} 出现在所有 3 个面板中。她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="修身灰色无袖背心、宽松浅蓝色牛仔裤，背着一个小巧的黑色皮质单肩包，肩带纤细"}。确保她在所有面板中的面部特征保持一致。

场景：深夜的城市人行道，右侧是光洁的白色长方形瓷砖墙，左侧是安静的道路、人行横道线、金属杆、栏杆、玻璃倒影、远处的公寓窗户、交通灯和路灯。使用冷暖交织的街灯照明，白色瓷砖的反光，湿润的质感，背景带有柔和的城市光斑。

面板数量与姿势：共 3 个面板。面板 1（顶部）：中景，她沿着人行道行走，从背后和侧面拍摄，她转头回眸，对着镜头露出温柔的微笑。面板 2（中部）：近景人像，她面向镜头，伸出一只手挡在镜头前，做出俏皮的动作；前景中的手部较大且带有动态模糊，而她微笑的面孔在手后清晰可见。面板 3（底部）：蹲坐在瓷砖墙边，双膝弯曲，一只手肘撑在膝盖上，脸颊靠在手上，抬头看着镜头，露出放松而亲昵的微笑；黑色单肩包放在身侧。

摄影与风格：超写实手机夜景抓拍风格，自然的皮肤纹理，浅景深，28mm 广角手机镜头感，轻微的手持视角，高 ISO 但画面纯净，仅在伸出的手部有真实的动态模糊，电影感的城市灯光，头发和瓷砖上有柔和的高光，整体呈现灰蓝色调的夜色，点缀着温暖的琥珀色反光。

约束条件：画面中不得出现任何文字。不要添加额外的人物。各面板之间服装不得改变。保持解剖结构真实、面部特征一致，并符合写实的手机摄影构图。

en.title: Giant Android with Pilot
en.description: A photorealistic sci-fi scene showing a tiny pilot emerging from the chest cockpit of a towering white female android above a city.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic science-fiction scene of exactly two figures: one enormous female humanoid robot and one tiny human pilot. The giant robot is an elegant white android with glossy ceramic armor, exposed black mechanical joints, panel seams, cables, and a large open chest cockpit; she has a delicate anime-inspired face, pale synthetic skin, messy shoulder-length {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair, and glowing {argument name="eye color" default="red"} eyes, looking down gently toward the viewer. The open cockpit in her chest reveals a dark, detailed mechanical interior with metallic ribs, wiring, and a small blue-lit rear window. In front of the cockpit stands the pilot: a young woman with black hair and glasses, wearing a loose {argument name="pilot shirt" default="white blouse"}, dark short skirt, black socks, and black ankle boots, stepping carefully out of the chest cavity onto the robot’s huge open palm. The robot’s single visible hand is cupped horizontally in the foreground as a platform, with segmented white robotic fingers and black joint rings. Shoot from a low angle with the robot towering above, cropped at the upper thighs, emphasizing extreme scale difference between the giant android and the human pilot. Background: bright outdoor daylight under a clear blue sky with a few soft clouds, distant city skyline and mountains far below, high-altitude rooftop or aerial perspective. Style: ultra-detailed photorealistic 3D render, polished mecha design, realistic reflections, subtle weathering and scratches on white armor, sharp focus on the robot torso and pilot, natural sunlight, dramatic scale, no text, no watermark, vertical 4:5 composition.

zh.title: 巨型仿生机器人与飞行员
zh.description: 一幅写实的科幻场景，展示了一位娇小的飞行员从城市上空一尊高耸的白色女性仿生机器人胸部驾驶舱中走出的画面。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅电影级写实的科幻场景，画面中仅包含两个角色：一尊巨大的女性人形机器人和一位娇小的人类飞行员。巨型机器人是一款优雅的白色仿生机器人，拥有光泽的陶瓷装甲、外露的黑色机械关节、面板接缝、线缆以及一个敞开的大型胸部驾驶舱；她有着精致的动漫风格面孔、苍白的合成皮肤、凌乱的齐肩 {argument name="hair color" default="银白色"} 头发，以及发光的 {argument name="eye color" default="红色"} 双眼，正温柔地俯视着观众。胸部的敞开式驾驶舱内展现出深邃且细节丰富的机械内部结构，包括金属肋骨、布线以及一个小型的蓝色背光窗。在驾驶舱前方站着飞行员：一位留着黑发、戴着眼镜的年轻女性，身穿宽松的 {argument name="pilot shirt" default="白色衬衫"}、深色短裙、黑色长袜和黑色短靴，正小心翼翼地从胸腔踏出，走向机器人巨大的手掌。机器人可见的一只手在前景中水平托起，作为平台，展现出分段式的白色机械手指和黑色关节环。采用低角度拍摄，机器人高耸入云，画面截取至大腿上部，强调巨型仿生机器人与人类飞行员之间极致的体型差异。背景：明亮的户外日光，晴朗的蓝天伴有几朵柔和的云彩，远处的城市天际线和山脉位于下方，呈现出高空屋顶或空中视角。风格：超细节写实 3D 渲染，精致的机甲设计，逼真的反射效果，白色装甲上带有细微的风化和划痕，聚焦于机器人躯干和飞行员，自然光照，宏大的比例感，无文字，无水印，4:5 竖构图。

en.title: Model With Manga Wall Sketch
en.description: A photorealistic studio portrait of a woman posing beside a matching manga-style wall sketch, useful for fashion, cosplay, or social media visuals.
en.prompt: Create a vertical full-body fashion portrait in a minimalist sunlit studio: on the left, a photorealistic young East Asian woman with {argument name="hair color" default="long black hair"} poses gracefully against a plain warm gray wall, wearing a fitted ivory ribbed knit long-sleeve maxi dress with a scoop neckline and a high side slit, plus white pointed high heels. She forms a heart shape above her head with both hands, smiles softly while looking slightly to the side, stands on one leg, and bends the other leg back in a cute playful pose. On the right side of the same wall, draw a large black pencil manga-style sketch version of her, matching the pose and outfit but exaggerated with an anime face, one eye winking, open cheerful smile, long flowing hair, curvy silhouette, and sketched high heels. Surround the manga figure with exactly 5 hand-drawn hearts, 4 sparkle/star doodles, and 3 short exclamation marks above the head. Use a seamless blend of real photography and wall illustration, as if the drawing is sketched directly onto the wall beside the model. The scene has soft natural daylight, diagonal window-shadow stripes across the floor and lower right wall, a clean concrete floor, warm neutral tones, realistic skin texture, elegant editorial styling, and no visible text or watermark. Keep the composition balanced with the real model occupying the left half and the manga sketch occupying the right half, both full-body and similar scale. Optional customization: make the model's outfit {argument name="dress color" default="ivory"}, set the background to {argument name="studio wall color" default="warm light gray"}, and make the overall mood {argument name="mood" default="cute, elegant, playful"}.

zh.title: 模特与漫画墙绘的创意构图
zh.description: 一张写实的摄影棚人像，模特站在与自身相呼应的漫画风格墙绘旁，适用于时尚、Cosplay 或社交媒体视觉内容。
zh.prompt: 创作一张极简主义阳光摄影棚内的垂直全身时尚人像：左侧是一位写实的东亚年轻女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色长发"}，优雅地站在一面纯净的暖灰色墙壁前，身穿一件修身的象牙白罗纹针织长袖长裙，配有圆领和高开叉设计，脚踩白色尖头高跟鞋。她双手在头顶比心，侧头轻柔微笑，单脚站立，另一只脚向后弯曲，姿态可爱俏皮。在同一面墙的右侧，绘制一个与她姿势和服装相匹配的黑色铅笔漫画风格草图，夸张处理动漫脸部，一只眼睛眨眼，露出开朗的笑容，长发飘逸，身形曲线优美，并画出高跟鞋。在漫画人物周围画上 5 个手绘爱心、4 个闪烁/星星涂鸦，并在头顶上方画 3 个短感叹号。采用真实摄影与墙面插画的无缝融合，仿佛画作直接绘制在模特身旁的墙上。场景具有柔和的自然日光，地板和右下墙面投射出对角线的窗影，地面为干净的水泥材质，整体色调为温暖的中性色，皮肤纹理真实，具有优雅的编辑风格，且无可见文字或水印。保持构图平衡，真实模特占据左半部分，漫画草图占据右半部分，两者均为全身像且比例相似。可选自定义：将模特服装设为 {argument name="dress color" default="象牙白"}，将背景设为 {argument name="studio wall color" default="暖浅灰色"}，并将整体氛围设为 {argument name="mood" default="可爱、优雅、俏皮"}。

en.title: Real Woman With Doodle Alter Ego
en.description: Generates a trendy photoreal portrait of a shy woman beside a chaotic manga-style doodle version of herself drawn on the wall.
en.prompt:
Create a single 4:5 vertical editorial photo-real image of a young woman standing beside a black hand-drawn doodle alter ego on a plain indoor wall. The real person is {argument name="character description" default="a shy young East Asian woman with long dark brown hair and straight bangs"}, full body, positioned on the left third of the frame, leaning lightly against an off-white concrete wall, smiling bashfully with one hand covering her mouth and the other arm relaxed down. She wears {argument name="outfit" default="a cream fitted camisole, dark denim cutoff shorts, bracelets, and black platform flip-flops"}. Use soft natural sunlight from the upper left, with diagonal window-shadow shapes on the wall and concrete floor, realistic skin, realistic fabric, quiet minimal background, no text.

On the right two-thirds of the wall, draw exactly 1 energetic manga-style black ink doodle character as if sketched directly on the wall: a cartoon version of the same woman with long hair and bangs, huge laughing open mouth, closed happy eyes, freckles, sleeveless top, dark shorts, bracelets, and flip-flops. The doodle character is mid-jump with arms stretched wide, one leg bent backward, body tilted forward, and one sketched hand reaching toward the real woman’s shoulder as if her chaotic inner self is bursting out beside her. The doodle should be monochrome black line art with expressive hatching, messy sketch strokes, motion lines, and no color fill except black ink shading.

Surround the doodle with exactly 15 decorative doodle elements: 4 stars/sparkles, 3 hearts, 2 cloud puffs, 1 speech bubble containing a heart, 1 exclamation mark cluster above the head, and 4 short motion-burst line groups. Keep the contrast between the composed real woman and the wild doodle persona clear and humorous. Composition should feel like a trendy social-media portrait, clean wall backdrop, realistic photography blended seamlessly with wall-drawn illustration, high detail, natural perspective, no collage, no split panels, no watermark.

zh.title: 真人与涂鸦分身
zh.description: 生成一张时尚的写实肖像，展现一位害羞女性与其墙上混乱漫画风涂鸦分身的对比。
zh.prompt:
创作一张 4:5 比例的竖版写实风格编辑摄影图片，画面中一位年轻女性站在一面纯色室内墙前，旁边是她手绘的黑色涂鸦分身。真人角色为 {argument name="character description" default="一位害羞的东亚年轻女性，留着深棕色长发和直刘海"}，全身照，位于画面左侧三分之一处，轻靠在米白色的水泥墙上，羞涩地微笑着，一只手遮住嘴，另一只手臂自然下垂。她身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件米色修身吊带背心、深色牛仔短裤、手镯和黑色厚底人字拖"}。使用来自左上方的柔和自然光，墙面和水泥地面上有对角线的窗影，皮肤质感真实，织物纹理逼真，背景安静简约，无文字。

在墙面的右侧三分之二处，绘制 1 个充满活力的漫画风黑色墨水涂鸦角色，仿佛直接在墙上素描而成：这是同一个女性的卡通版本，留着长发和刘海，张大嘴巴大笑，闭着开心的眼睛，有雀斑，身穿无袖上衣、深色短裤、手镯和人字拖。涂鸦角色处于跳跃姿态，双臂张开，一条腿向后弯曲，身体前倾，一只手伸向真人的肩膀，仿佛她内心狂野的自我正从身边迸发出来。涂鸦应为单色黑色线条艺术，带有富有表现力的排线、凌乱的素描笔触、动态线条，除黑色墨水阴影外无其他颜色填充。

在涂鸦周围添加 15 个装饰性涂鸦元素：4 个星星/闪光、3 个爱心、2 个云朵、1 个包含爱心的对话气泡、头顶上方的一组感叹号，以及 4 组短促的动态爆发线条。保持端庄的真人与狂野的涂鸦人格之间鲜明的对比，营造幽默感。构图应具有时尚社交媒体肖像的质感，背景墙面简洁，写实摄影与墙面手绘插画无缝融合，高细节，自然透视，非拼贴画，无分屏，无水印。

en.title: Sunny Countryside Anime Girl
en.description: Generates a bright anime countryside key visual of a girl in a blue dress with a straw hat, glasses, and a book.
en.prompt: Create a bright, high-detail anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a young girl"} standing in a sunny countryside road, viewed from a low slightly wide-angle perspective, centered full body from thighs up. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="pale ash-blonde"} hair blowing dramatically to the right, large amber-brown eyes, a calm slightly blank expression, and wears red round glasses. She is dressed in a loose light sky-blue short-sleeved shirt dress with a rounded collar, front buttons, gathered waist seam, and fluttering hem. Add exactly 4 main personal items/outfit elements: one oversized woven straw sun hat with ragged decorative edges held by her raised left hand, one pair of red round eyeglasses, one pale blue dress, and one dark red hardcover book tucked under her right arm. The background is a vivid summer rural landscape with a dirt path, green hills and distant blue mountains, a small village with exactly 6 visible houses, and a sunflower patch on the left foreground with exactly 5 clearly visible sunflower heads. Use a clear blue sky with towering white cumulus clouds and a strong sun flare in the upper right corner. Style should be polished Japanese anime key visual art with luminous backlighting, glossy highlights on hair and fabric, soft painterly clouds, saturated summer colors, delicate linework, and slight imperfect AI-art roughness in hair strands and outlines. Add a tiny unreadable white artist-signature scribble in the lower right corner, but no other text. Mood: {argument name="mood" default="dizzy summer daydream, gentle and wistful"}.

zh.title: 阳光乡村动漫少女
zh.description: 生成一张明亮的动漫风格乡村主视觉图，画面中是一位身穿蓝色连衣裙、戴草帽和眼镜、手持书籍的女孩。
zh.prompt: 创作一张明亮、高细节的动漫插画，画面主角是 {argument name="character name" default="一位年轻女孩"}，她站在阳光明媚的乡村道路上，采用低位微广角视角，呈现从大腿以上居中的全身像。她拥有飘逸的长发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅灰金色"}，头发向右侧剧烈飘动，有着琥珀棕色的大眼睛，表情平静且略带放空，佩戴红色圆框眼镜。她身穿一件宽松的浅天蓝色短袖衬衫裙，带有圆领、前排扣、收腰接缝和飘逸的裙摆。画面需包含 4 个核心个人物品/服饰元素：一只由左手举起的带有破损装饰边缘的超大编织遮阳草帽、一副红色圆框眼镜、一件浅蓝色连衣裙，以及右臂下夹着的一本深红色精装书。背景为生动的夏季乡村景观，包含一条土路、绿色山丘和远处的蓝色山脉，一个小村庄（可见 6 栋房屋），以及左侧前景的一片向日葵花丛（清晰可见 5 朵向日葵花头）。使用晴朗的蓝天，点缀高耸的白色积云，右上角有强烈的太阳光晕。风格应为精致的日本动漫主视觉艺术，具有明亮的背光效果、头发与织物上的光泽感、柔和的绘图风格云朵、饱和的夏季色彩、细腻的线条，以及头发丝和轮廓上带有轻微的 AI 艺术不完美感。在右下角添加一个微小的、无法辨认的白色艺术家签名涂鸦，除此之外不要添加任何文字。氛围：{argument name="mood" default="令人眩晕的夏日白日梦，温柔而惆怅"}。

en.title: Half-Elf Maid Serving Tea
en.description: A cinematic fantasy portrait prompt for creating a noble half-elf Victorian maid serving tea in an ornate aristocratic salon.
en.prompt: Create a highly detailed cinematic fantasy portrait of {argument name="character description" default="a young noble-house half-elf maid"} serving tea in an opulent aristocratic mansion salon. She has delicate pointed elf ears, fair skin, soft brown eyes, long light-brown hair partly braided and loose, and a calm gentle expression while leaning forward toward the viewer. Dress her in an elaborate Victorian maid outfit: black long-sleeved dress with subtle ornate fabric texture, white ruffled apron, lace-trimmed bodice, lace cuffs, frilled shoulder straps, black ribbon bow at the collar, and a white lace maid headdress. She is carefully placing a porcelain teacup and saucer on a polished carved wooden tea table. Include exactly 3 visible tea service pieces on the table: one teacup with saucer in her hands, one ornate porcelain teapot, and one small matching sugar pot or creamer. Add a white lace table runner and a bouquet of pale roses at the right edge. The setting is a luxurious European noble parlor with antique carved sofa on the left, tall sunlit windows with heavy patterned drapes, gilded furniture, marble fireplace on the right, candle sconces, a warm table lamp, and a large framed portrait painting in the background. Use warm late-afternoon window light, soft golden highlights, shallow depth of field, realistic skin and fabric textures, elegant fantasy atmosphere, ultra-detailed painterly photorealism, vertical 4:5 composition, eye-level intimate framing, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 半精灵女仆奉茶
zh.description: 一个电影级奇幻肖像提示词，用于创作一位在华丽贵族沙龙中奉茶的半精灵维多利亚时代女仆。
