en.title: Y2K Nightclub Flash Snapshot
en.description: A raw, 2000s-style digital camera snapshot of an East Asian woman in a mirror-walled nightclub, featuring direct flash and high-grain textures.
en.prompt:
A {argument name="age" default="young adult"} East Asian woman standing in a {argument name="scene" default="dim nightclub or mirrored elevator hall"}, with a composition from the top of the head to the mid-thigh, centered and facing the camera. She stands naturally straight with a slightly relaxed waist, her left arm hanging by her side, and her right hand raised near her right ear, fingers lightly touching her earring or adjusting her hair. She looks directly at the camera with a calm, confident, and slightly aloof expression, lips naturally parted.

She has a delicate oval face, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender nose bridge, and hydrated nude-pink lips. Makeup is early 2000s nightclub style: thin long black eyeliner, natural thick lashes, subtle warm eyeshadow, soft blush, and clear lip gloss. Her skin is fair and warm-toned, with slight sweat and oily highlights on the face and forehead, retaining real pores, fine fuzz, and natural skin variations; plastic-like smoothing is prohibited.

Her deep black long hair is naturally loose, slightly damp and messy, with strands sticking to her forehead, face, neck, and shoulders, with blue light outlines on the top. She wears large silver hoop earrings, two layered thin silver necklaces with small pendants, a silver watch, and minimalist rings. A small metallic silver underarm bag is on her left shoulder.

She wears a {argument name="clothing" default="white slim-fit cropped short-sleeved T-shirt"} with a round neck and a low-saturation light pink vintage oriental pattern or print; the fabric naturally wrinkles at the waist. Paired with a light blue low-waisted pleated denim miniskirt, a silver studded belt with a large metal square buckle, revealing a natural waistline.

The background is a black mirrored wall with vertical metal dividers, showing repetitive reflections, blurred crowds, and scattered white flash glints. Shot with an early 2000s portable digital camera with a direct flash; the strong frontal flash illuminates the subject, skin slightly overexposed, background heavily underexposed; a small amount of blue club lighting at the top. Incorporates real CCD grain, subtle color noise, slight sharpening, vignetting, and a candid snapshot texture. 35mm or 50mm lens, close-up shot, low saturation, medium contrast, photorealistic.

zh.title: Y2K 夜店闪光灯抓拍
zh.description: 一张 2000 年代风格的数码相机原始抓拍照片，拍摄了一位身处镜面墙夜店的东亚女性，呈现出直闪光和高颗粒感的质感。
zh.prompt:
一位 {argument name="age" default="年轻女性"} 东亚女性站在 {argument name="scene" default="昏暗的夜店或镜面电梯厅"} 中，构图从头顶到大腿中部，居中并面向镜头。她自然站立，腰部略微放松，左臂垂在身侧，右手抬起靠近右耳，手指轻轻触碰耳环或整理头发。她直视镜头，表情冷静、自信且略带疏离，双唇自然微张。

她有着精致的鹅蛋脸、杏仁状的深褐色眼睛、自然的细眉、纤细的鼻梁和水润的裸粉色嘴唇。妆容为 2000 年代初的夜店风格：细长的黑色眼线、自然浓密的睫毛、淡淡的暖色眼影、柔和的腮红和透明唇彩。肤色白皙且呈暖色调，面部和额头带有轻微的汗水和油光，保留了真实的毛孔、细小绒毛和自然的皮肤纹理；严禁使用塑料感磨皮。

她乌黑的长发自然披散，略显潮湿凌乱，发丝贴在额头、脸颊、脖颈和肩膀上，顶部带有蓝色光晕。她佩戴着大号银色圆圈耳环、两条叠戴的细银项链（带有小吊坠）、一块银色手表和极简风格的戒指。左肩背着一个小巧的金属银色腋下包。

她穿着一件 {argument name="clothing" default="白色修身短款短袖 T 恤"}，圆领设计，带有低饱和度的浅粉色复古东方图案或印花；面料在腰部自然起皱。搭配浅蓝色低腰百褶牛仔短裙，系着一条带有大型金属方扣的银色铆钉腰带，露出自然的腰线。

背景是带有垂直金属隔断的黑色镜面墙，呈现出重复的倒影、模糊的人群和零星的白色闪光点。使用 2000 年代初的便携式数码相机配合直闪光拍摄；强烈的正面闪光照亮了主体，皮肤略微过曝，背景严重欠曝；顶部带有少量蓝色夜店灯光。融入了真实的 CCD 颗粒感、细微的色彩噪点、轻微的锐化、暗角以及抓拍的质感。35mm 或 50mm 镜头，特写镜头，低饱和度，中等对比度，照片级真实感。

en.title: Minimalist Marker Pen NYC Travel Poster
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating a stylized travel poster of New York City in an editorial marker pen illustration style, featuring romantic urban elements and a folk-art aesthetic.
en.prompt:
Create a vertical 3:4 minimalist marker-pen travel poster of {argument name="city" default="NEW YORK CITY"} on warm ivory paper.

STYLE:
Use a rough, imperfect editorial marker illustration style with a modern folk-art feel. Draw with thick, slightly uneven cobalt-blue contour lines. Apply color with visible felt-tip marker strokes, streaky coverage, pressure variation, dry-skip texture, and patchy density. Do not fill shapes completely. Leave many small and medium uncolored gaps so the warm ivory paper remains visible through clothing, buildings, and street elements. Some outlines should break, skip, or fade.

SCENE:
Depict two lovers walking closely together on a quiet brownstone street in Manhattan. One gently leans toward the other in a natural affectionate pose. Keep the scene intimate and understated.

BACKGROUND SIMPLIFICATION:
Include only 4 essential New York cues: one brownstone stoop, one black fire escape, one small corner deli awning, and one faint yellow taxi. Optionally suggest a very faint distant skyline silhouette, but do not add more city elements. Keep the background visually quiet.

COMPOSITION:
Place the couple slightly below center as the emotional focus. Let the supporting background elements sit loosely behind them with incomplete marker fills and broken contour fragments. At least 40 percent of the page should remain untouched warm ivory paper. Keep the layout airy, elegant, and uncluttered.

FINISH GRADIENT:
The couple is the most resolved area. Nearby background objects are only about 40 to 60 percent rendered. Distant details and outer edges fade into loose marker strokes and untouched paper before reaching the border.

POSTER TYPOGRAPHY:
Add the title "{argument name="title" default="NEW YORK CITY"}" at the top in bold hand-drawn uppercase lettering. Add a small handwritten subtitle such as "{argument name="subtitle" default="summer stroll"}".

COLOR PALETTE:
Use a restrained palette of deep cobalt blue, muted slate blue, mustard ochre, warm brown, taxi yellow, and warm ivory paper. Keep the palette limited and slightly muted.

MOOD:
Romantic, calm, urban, nostalgic, stylish, handmade.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
fully filled marker coloring, solid flat fills, smooth vector color, polished digital finish, clean perfect outlines, overly complete rendering, crowded background, too many city elements, dense architecture, detailed signage, realistic textures, glossy surfaces, photorealism, watercolor, oil painting, airbrush shading, 3D render, cinematic lighting, dramatic shadows, cluttered layout, billboard overload, hyper-detailed buildings, perfect symmetry, extra fingers, extra limbs, distorted anatomy, blurry face

zh.title: 极简马克笔风格纽约旅行海报
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于创作一张纽约市风格化旅行海报，采用编辑类马克笔插画风格，融入浪漫的城市元素与民间艺术美感。
zh.prompt:
创作一张 3:4 竖版极简马克笔风格旅行海报，主题为 {argument name="city" default="NEW YORK CITY"}，背景为暖象牙色纸张。

风格：
采用粗犷、不完美的编辑类马克笔插画风格，带有现代民间艺术感。使用厚重且略显不均匀的钴蓝色轮廓线。上色时需呈现明显的马克笔笔触、条纹状覆盖、压力变化、干擦纹理以及斑驳的密度感。不要完全填满形状，需留出大量大小不一的空白，让暖象牙色纸张透过衣物、建筑和街道元素显露出来。部分轮廓线应呈现断裂、跳跃或淡出的效果。

场景：
描绘一对恋人在曼哈顿安静的褐砂石街道上亲密漫步。其中一人自然地向另一人倾斜，姿态亲昵。保持场景的私密感与低调感。

背景简化：
仅包含 4 个核心纽约元素：一个褐砂石台阶、一个黑色消防梯、一个小型街角熟食店遮阳篷，以及一辆隐约可见的黄色出租车。可选择性地加入极其淡远的城市天际线轮廓，但不要添加更多城市元素。保持背景视觉上的简洁。

构图：
将情侣置于画面中心偏下方作为情感焦点。背景支撑元素应松散地分布在他们身后，采用不完整的马克笔填充和断裂的轮廓碎片。至少 40% 的页面应保留为原始的暖象牙色纸张。保持布局通透、优雅且不杂乱。

完成度渐变：
情侣区域应为刻画最完整的部分。附近的背景物体仅需 40% 到 60% 的渲染度。远处的细节和外边缘在到达边框前应逐渐淡化为松散的马克笔笔触和留白。

海报排版：
在顶部添加标题 "{argument name="title" default="NEW YORK CITY"}"，使用粗体手绘大写字母。添加一行小巧的手写副标题，例如 "{argument name="subtitle" default="summer stroll"}"。

调色板：
使用克制的配色方案：深钴蓝、柔和的板岩蓝、芥末赭色、暖棕色、出租车黄以及暖象牙色纸张。保持色调有限且略显柔和。

氛围：
浪漫、宁静、都市、怀旧、时尚、手工感。

负面提示词：
完全填充的马克笔上色、纯色平涂、平滑的矢量色彩、精致的数字成品、干净完美的轮廓、过度完整的渲染、拥挤的背景、过多的城市元素、密集的建筑、详细的标牌、写实纹理、光泽表面、照片写实主义、水彩、油画、喷笔阴影、3D 渲染、电影级灯光、戏剧性阴影、杂乱的布局、广告牌堆砌、超精细建筑、完美对称、多余的手指、多余的肢体、扭曲的解剖结构、模糊的面部

1. 海边火车站台
一位身穿浅色夏季校服的少女独自在安静的乡村火车站台上等车，身旁是大海，轻柔的海风吹动着她的头发和裙摆，古老的车站时钟，远处的火车正在驶来，波光粼粼的蓝色海水，漂浮的云朵，温暖的午后阳光，怀旧的海岸氛围，宁静的期待。

3. 放学后的天台
两名同学在日落时分坐在学校天台上，靠着铁丝网围栏分享零食聊天，下方是运动场，远处的城市天际线在橙色光芒中闪烁，微风拂过，长长的影子，充满情感的成长氛围，平静而充满希望的心境。

4. 夏日祭小巷
一位开朗的年轻女性身穿色彩斑斓的浴衣，漫步在传统的日本夏日祭中，纸灯笼照亮了狭窄的街道，金鱼摊位，棉花糖，头顶开始绽放的烟花，温暖的节日灯光，热闹而怀旧的氛围，细节丰富的夜晚场景，快乐的童年回忆。

en.title: Elegant lounge floral dress portrait
en.description: A sophisticated low-light portrait of a woman in a floral dress sitting in a hotel lounge, emphasizing warm candlelight and a cinematic magazine aesthetic.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Dress in the shadows of light"}

Main Figure:
{argument name="situation" default="An adult woman sitting on a sofa in a calm lounge"}, captured in a vertical mid-shot from above the knees to the head. The figure is placed slightly to the left of center. A dark wooden table and a candle are included on the right, with the background widely blurred.

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige skin with natural flush and fine textures. Subtle highlights on cheeks, nose tip, collarbone, and shoulders. Pale rose pink blush, pink-brown eyeshadow, delicate long eyelashes, natural tear bags, soft brown eyebrows, and translucent pink-beige lips. Head slightly tilted with a calm, mature gaze. Relaxed mouth, conveying quiet allure and composure.

Clothing/Pose:
An ivory-based cache-coeur dress with a small floral pattern. Elegant V-neck, sheer sleeves, thin waist ribbon, and ruffles at the hem. Expressing natural feminine curves through the garment's structure. Sitting diagonally with knees naturally together. Left hand on the seat, right hand beside her. Relaxed center of gravity. Wearing a small necklace and bracelet.

Background/Light:
A quiet hotel lounge with black and dark brown tones. Foreground has a velvet-style sofa; midground has a wooden table and glass candle holder; background includes blurred bottle shelves and indirect lighting. Warm wall light from the top right and orange candlelight from the right. Face and chest are soft and bright. Shadows fall gently to the lower left.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4 medium shot from above the knees. Photographed from slightly above eye level at 50mm. Precisely focused on the face and chest, background smoothly blurred. Natural body proportions maintained.

Texture/Style:
Sophisticated night portrait photography. Meticulous hair strands, soft skin texture, and fabric sheerness. Effective contrast between warm tones and black. Polished finish like a fashion magazine shoot.

zh.title: 优雅酒廊碎花裙人像
zh.description: 一张精致的低光人像，描绘了一位身着碎花裙的女性坐在酒店酒廊中，突显温暖的烛光与电影杂志般的质感。
zh.prompt:
主题：
{argument name="subject" default="光影中的裙装"}

主体人物：
{argument name="situation" default="一位成年女性坐在宁静酒廊的沙发上"}，采用从膝盖以上到头部的垂直中景拍摄。人物位于画面中心偏左位置。右侧配有深色木桌和蜡烛，背景经过大幅虚化处理。

人物/表情：
20 多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色皮肤，透出自然红润与细腻纹理。脸颊、鼻尖、锁骨和肩膀处带有微妙的高光。淡玫瑰粉腮红，粉棕色眼影，精致的长睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和的棕色眉毛，以及半透明的粉米色嘴唇。头部微倾，目光沉稳成熟。嘴唇放松，流露出安静的魅力与从容。

服装/姿态：
一件象牙白底色的碎花交叉领连衣裙。优雅的 V 领，透视袖子，纤细的腰带，以及裙摆处的荷叶边。通过服装剪裁展现出自然的女性曲线。斜坐姿势，双膝自然并拢。左手放在座位上，右手置于身侧。重心放松。佩戴着小巧的项链和手链。

背景/光影：
安静的酒店酒廊，以黑色和深棕色调为主。前景为天鹅绒质感沙发；中景为木桌和玻璃烛台；背景包含虚化的酒瓶架和间接照明。右上角有温暖的壁灯，右侧有橙色的烛光。面部和胸部光线柔和明亮。阴影柔和地投向左下方。

构图/相机：
3:4 垂直中景，拍摄范围从膝盖以上。使用 50mm 镜头从略高于视线的高度拍摄。焦点精准对准面部和胸部，背景平滑虚化。保持自然的人体比例。

质感/风格：
精致的夜间人像摄影。细致的发丝、柔软的皮肤纹理以及面料的通透感。暖色调与黑色之间形成有效的对比。呈现出如时尚杂志拍摄般的精美质感。

en.title: Infinity pool luxury resort portrait

en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Hair unraveled in the sea breeze"}

Main Figure:
A vertical 3:4 photo of an adult woman sitting on an ivory daybed {argument name="location" default="beside an infinity pool at a luxury resort overlooking the sea"}. The figure is slightly to the right of center, captured from the head to the upper thighs. The background layers a blue pool, sea surface, and distant islands.

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige skin with natural highlights. Rose blush, long thin eyelashes, natural tear bags, and translucent pink-beige lips. Face tilted slightly, looking at the camera with clear eyes. Calm and elegant expression.

Clothing/Pose:
An ivory halter-neck bikini with delicate lace patterns and small crystal ornaments. Thin chain floral earrings and a small flower pendant. Left hand on a cushion supporting her weight, right arm loosely raised behind her head. Naturally seated posture with a slight twist at the waist.

Background/Light:
Foreground has a daybed; midground has a transparent light-blue infinity pool; background softly blurs the sea and resort architecture. Bright natural morning light from the top-left illuminates her face and shoulders. Shadows fall thinly to the bottom-right.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4 medium portrait shot from a slightly high eye level. Focused on the eyes and face, background rendered as circular bokeh. Equivalent to an 85mm portrait lens.

Texture/Style:
High-end resort fashion photography. Natural skin textures, fine lace weave, and individual hair strands. Bright, transparent tones focusing on white and light blue.

zh.title: 无边泳池奢华度假村人像
zh.description: 一张高端度假村时尚摄影作品，展现了一位女性在无边泳池旁的姿态，背景为柔和晨光下的蔚蓝大海与沿海岛屿。
zh.prompt:
主题：
{argument name="subject" default="海风中散落的发丝"}

主体人物：
一张 3:4 比例的竖构图照片，一位成年女性坐在象牙白色的日光浴床上 {argument name="location" default="位于俯瞰大海的奢华度假村无边泳池旁"}。人物位于画面中心偏右，取景范围从头部至大腿上部。背景依次为蓝色的泳池、海面以及远处的岛屿。

人物/表情：
一位 20 多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色皮肤，带有自然的高光。玫瑰色腮红，长而细的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，以及半透明的粉米色嘴唇。头部微微倾斜，眼神清澈地注视着镜头。表情平静而优雅。

服装/姿态：
身穿带有精致蕾丝图案和细小水晶装饰的象牙白色挂脖比基尼。佩戴细链花朵耳环和小花吊坠。左手撑在垫子上支撑身体，右手自然地抬起放在脑后。坐姿自然，腰部略微扭转。

背景/光线：
前景为日光浴床；中景为透明的浅蓝色无边泳池；背景是对大海和度假村建筑的柔和虚化。来自左上方的明亮自然晨光照亮了她的脸庞和肩膀。阴影细长地投射在右下方。

构图/摄影：
3:4 竖构图，采用略高于视平线的机位拍摄。焦点对准眼睛和面部，背景呈现出圆形的焦外成像效果。相当于 85mm 人像镜头。

质感/风格：
高端度假村时尚摄影。自然的皮肤纹理、细腻的蕾丝编织以及清晰的发丝。明亮、通透的色调，以白色和浅蓝色为主。

en.title: East Asian Haute Couture Qipao Model
en.description: A sophisticated professional photography prompt for generating an image of an East Asian fashion model in a custom-designed red Qipao, set in a classical European square during golden hour.
en.prompt:
{argument name="character features" default="A 20-something East Asian woman with high-fashion model proportions, slender build, long legs, narrow waist, straight shoulders and neck, oval face, high cheekbones, almond-shaped eyes, and natural Eastern features. Long dark brown-black hair pulled into a low bun with a few wisps caught in the wind, realistic hair texture."}

She is wearing a {argument name="clothing style" default="modern custom-made red Qipao couture, slim fit with a high slit, featuring gold Chinese embroidery on the chest, waist, and hem, made of silk satin"} that flows naturally as she walks. She wears gold stiletto heels.

The subject is stepping toward the right side of the frame with her front leg extended and back leg naturally pushing off. She has an upright posture, relaxed shoulders, and her head is slightly tilted up, looking into the distance with a firm and confident expression, exuding a supermodel presence.

Location: {argument name="environment setting" default="A classical European square with a circular neo-classical building in the background featuring a gray dome and red window frames. A statue of a horse and rider is on the right, and the wide stone-paved square is surrounded by city buildings, appearing quiet and empty in the early morning."} 

The golden hour sunset shines from the left at a low angle, illuminating the skin, embroidery, and building facade with realistic rim light and long shadows. The sky is deep blue and clear.

Negative Prompt

zh.title: 东亚高级定制旗袍模特
zh.description: 一个专业的摄影提示词，用于生成一位身穿定制红色旗袍的东亚时尚模特，背景设定在黄金时刻的欧洲古典广场。
zh.prompt:
{argument name="character features" default="一位 20 多岁的东亚女性，拥有高级时装模特比例，身材苗条，长腿，细腰，直肩颈，鹅蛋脸，高颧骨，杏仁眼，具有自然的东方特征。深棕黑色长发盘成低发髻，几缕发丝随风飘动，发质真实。"}

她身穿 {argument name="clothing style" default="现代定制红色高级定制旗袍，修身剪裁，高开叉，胸部、腰部和下摆饰有金色中式刺绣，采用丝绸缎面材质"}，行走时自然飘逸。她穿着金色细高跟鞋。

主体正向画面右侧迈步，前腿伸展，后腿自然蹬地。她姿态挺拔，双肩放松，头部微微抬起，目光坚定自信地望向远方，散发出超模气场。

地点：{argument name="environment setting" default="一个古典欧洲广场，背景是一座带有灰色圆顶和红色窗框的新古典主义圆形建筑。右侧有一座骑马雕像，宽阔的石铺广场被城市建筑环绕，清晨时分显得安静而空旷。"} 

黄金时刻的夕阳从左侧低角度照射，以逼真的轮廓光和长长的阴影照亮皮肤、刺绣和建筑外立面。天空呈现深蓝色，清澈明亮。

整体色调采用暖金色与深蓝色作为互补色，呈现出精致的电影质感——低饱和度，但保留了红色丝绸和金色刺绣的层次感。

负面提示词
塑料感皮肤、CGI、AI 感、动漫、插画、HDR、过度饱和、虚假刺绣、虚假丝绸、解剖结构扭曲、多余手指、肢体重复、腿部短小、透视错误、模糊、水印、Logo、文字。

en.title: Retro Train Window Portrait
en.description: A refined prompt for creating a nostalgic portrait of a young Japanese woman in a retro train setting, focusing on soft natural light and delicate textures.
en.prompt: Subject: Gazing from the train window. Main Subject: 3:4 vertical composition. A young woman sitting shallowly on a seat inside an old train car, captured with a focus on her upper body, positioned slightly to the right of the center. Her body from the top of her head to below the chest is largely included, occupying about 70% of the frame as the main subject. Surrounded by train windows, wooden panels, and dark blue seats, a quiet atmosphere of being mid-journey prevails. Person/Expression: A woman in her 20s. Smooth skin with a bright ivory-beige tone and a hint of healthy pink. Soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones, preserving natural skin texture rather than excessive retouching. Sophisticated and delicate doll-like Japanese-style makeup. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long slender lashes, natural eye bags (aegyo-sal), soft light brown eyebrows, and sheer pink-beige lip gloss. Clear, small catchlights in the eyes. Her expression is quiet and soft, with a slightly relaxed mouth, looking directly into the camera. Her head is slightly tilted, exuding a calm presence. Clothing/Pose: A white ribbed halter neck top. Deep V-neck design that naturally creates soft volume. A clean silhouette that follows the body lines, beautifully showcasing the shoulders and collarbones. Arms are down naturally, body slightly angled toward the seat while only the face is turned toward the camera. Slender and mature appearance, avoiding unnatural exaggeration. Small pearl earrings. Background/Lighting: Scene is a retro train passenger cabin. Visible wood-grain walls, old luggage racks, dark blue leather seats, and framed windows. The view outside the window is bright and slightly overexposed, with distant greenery softly blurred. Main light source is natural light coming through the window on the right. Soft white light from a slightly high position gently hits the hair surface, cheeks, shoulders, and chest. The left side retains moderate shadows, with dark areas slightly lifted by reflected light from opposite windows or the interior. Warm brown wood interior and deep navy seats complement the skin and white clothing. Composition/Camera: Vertical portrait photograph. Camera is at a natural close distance, slightly above eye level. Using a medium-telephoto focal length equivalent to 50mm-85mm, the subject is sharply focused while the background has soft bokeh. Composition guides the viewer's gaze toward the face and chest. A small portion of the ceiling is left above the head, with window light on the right and seats in the back left creating depth. Emphasizes a sophisticated photoshoot feel like a magazine gravure, rather than a snapshot. Texture/Style: High-quality photorealistic photo. Captures the airy feel of a natural light portrait, delicate skin texture, soft gradations, individual hair strands, fine highlights, and subtle sheen. Hair color is light milk-tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, layered cut along the face, medium-long length reaching below the shoulders. Ends are loosely curled inward, with an airy feel, natural clumps, and a few stray hairs. The overall finish has high artistic quality, combining transparency with the warmth and nostalgia of a wooden train interior. Negative: Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin, messy hair, asymmetrical eyes, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, gibberish text, logos, watermarks, broken background, distorted clothing shape.

zh.title: 复古列车窗边人像
zh.description: 一个用于创作怀旧风格日本年轻女性列车人像的精炼提示词，侧重于柔和的自然光与细腻的质感。
zh.prompt: 主体：从列车窗边凝视。主要主体：3:4 竖构图。一位年轻女性浅坐在老式列车车厢的座位上，画面聚焦于上半身，位于画面中心偏右位置。从头顶到胸部以下的身躯占据了约 70% 的画面，作为主要主体。周围是列车车窗、木质镶板和深蓝色座椅，营造出一种旅途中的静谧氛围。人物/表情：20 多岁的女性。皮肤光滑，呈现明亮的象牙米色调，透着一丝健康的粉色。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀和锁骨处有柔和的高光，保留了自然的皮肤纹理，而非过度修图。精致细腻的日系娃娃妆容。淡玫瑰粉色腮红，香槟米色与粉棕色眼影，细长的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和的浅棕色眉毛，以及清透的粉米色唇彩。眼睛里有清晰的小型眼神光。表情安静柔和，嘴唇微张，直视镜头。头部微微倾斜，散发出沉稳的气质。服装/姿势：白色罗纹挂脖上衣。深 V 领设计自然地营造出柔和的丰盈感。贴合身体线条的简洁轮廓，完美展现了肩膀和锁骨。双臂自然下垂，身体微微转向座位，只有脸部朝向镜头。外形纤细成熟，避免不自然的夸张。佩戴小巧的珍珠耳环。背景/光影：场景为复古列车客舱。可见木纹墙壁、老式行李架、深蓝色皮质座椅和边框窗户。窗外景色明亮且略微过曝，远处的绿植柔和虚化。主要光源是来自右侧窗户的自然光。来自稍高位置的柔和白光轻柔地洒在发丝、脸颊、肩膀和胸部。左侧保留了适度的阴影，暗部由对面窗户或室内反射的光线轻微提亮。温暖的棕色木质内饰与深海军蓝座椅与皮肤和白色服装相得益彰。构图/相机：竖构图人像摄影。相机处于自然的近距离，略高于视线水平。使用相当于 50mm-85mm 的中长焦焦距，主体对焦清晰，背景呈现柔和的虚化效果。构图引导观众的视线聚焦于脸部和胸部。头顶留有少量空间，右侧的窗光与左后方的座椅营造出空间深度。强调杂志写真般的高级摄影感，而非随手抓拍。质感/风格：高质量写实照片。捕捉自然光人像的空气感、细腻的皮肤纹理、柔和的渐变、单根发丝、精致的高光和微妙的光泽。发色为浅奶茶灰棕色。薄透的空气刘海，脸部周围有层次感的剪裁，中长发长度及肩。发尾向内自然卷曲，具有空气感、自然的束感和几缕碎发。整体呈现出极高的艺术品质，将透明感与木质列车内饰的温暖怀旧感完美融合。负面提示词：不自然的脸部、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、凌乱的头发、不对称的眼睛、透视错误、光影不一致、乱码文字、Logo、水印、背景破损、服装形状扭曲。

zh.title: 身着盔甲的未来科幻女性
zh.description: 一幅细腻的科幻肖像，描绘了一位留着蓝色短发的年轻女性，她身着精致的白银色盔甲，背景是闪烁的星尘。
zh.prompt: 一位来自近未来的年轻女性，以 {argument name="style" default="科幻艺术风格"} 呈现，背景是夜空中闪烁的星尘。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="鲜艳蓝色"} 的短发，身穿一套线条流畅的盔甲，饰有精致的白银色装饰。盔甲贴合身形，材质光滑且富有光泽。值得注意的是，其鞋履采用了赛博朋克风格的高跟设计，突显了她的未来感。盔甲上的银色装饰低调地反射着周围的星尘光芒，营造出具有浅景深效果的戏剧性光影。她周围散布着无数璀璨的星点，宛如银河，营造出梦幻而宏大的氛围。整体色调和谐地融合了蓝色、银色以及星尘发出的暖光，渲染出一种冷峻而神秘的意境。

en.title: Japanese Woman at Outdoor Foot Bath
en.description: A highly detailed portrait of a woman relaxing at an outdoor foot bath in a traditional Japanese hot spring town, featuring soft natural lighting.
en.prompt: Subject: Feet creating ripples. Primary subject: An {argument name="subject" default="adult woman"} sitting in the center of an old wooden bench at an outdoor foot bath in a quiet hot spring town surrounded by greenery, soaking both feet in clear hot water. The person occupies about 75% of the vertical screen, from head to submerged feet. A natural moment of her lightly lifting the front hem of a thin overskirt with both hands to keep it from getting wet. Face/Expression: Bright ivory-beige skin with a pale rose-pink complexion. Smooth texture with visible skin grain, modest highlights on cheeks, tip of nose, and collarbone. Champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin lashes, natural eye bags, soft brown eyebrows, and sheer pink-beige lips. Head tilted slightly down, smiling gently while looking at her feet. {argument name="hair style" default="Milk tea ash-brown medium-long hair"} with thin see-through bangs, face-framing layers, and ends curling slightly inward with fine loose hairs along the cheeks. Clothing/Pose: {argument name="outfit" default="Ivory rib-knit wrap top"}, a thin long cardigan, white high-waisted culotte shorts, and a light chiffon overskirt on top. The entire look is unified in ecru and pale beige. Upper body slightly tilted forward with relaxed shoulders. Both hands pinching the left and right hems with fingertips, knees close together, and legs gently crossed at the shins. Feet from the ankles down are in the water, creating small ripples with movement. Background/Light: A calm foot bath area with an old wooden resting place, wet cobblestones, low wooden fences, and deep green trees. Buildings and signs in the background are slightly blurred with unreadable text. Warm natural light from the top left, hitting the hair surface, cheeks, shoulders, arms, and thighs. Soft shadows under the bench and to the right. Reflections of the sky and trees on the water surface, with transparent ripples and fine streaks of light around the feet. Composition/Camera: 9:16 aspect ratio. Camera slightly lower than the sitting person's chest, from a nearly front-facing light high-angle. Person centered with some greenery and buildings above and the foot bath water surface widely below. Clear focus from face to hands and knees, with natural shallow depth of field in the background. Natural perspective equivalent to 35-50mm. A composition that conveys overall balance and the foot bath space without unnaturally emphasizing legs or hands. Texture/Style: High-reality outdoor portrait photography. Meticulous expression of soft skin texture, individual hair strands, rib-knit and chiffon fibers, dry surfaces of old wood, wet stones, and water refraction. Gentle warm-toned natural light, moderate contrast, and a clean color tone. Avoid excessive skin retouching or artificial HDR. Negative: Underage-looking person, unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, mismatched leg length, poor clothing contact, excessive exposure, unnatural gravity, incorrect water reflections, inconsistent shadows, gibberish text, readable signs, logos, watermarks, excessive skin smoothing, plastic skin.

zh.title: 日本女性在户外足汤
zh.description: 一幅高度细腻的肖像画，描绘了一位女性在传统的日本温泉小镇户外足汤中放松的场景，呈现出柔和的自然光影。
zh.prompt: 主体：足部激起的涟漪。主要主体：一位 {argument name="subject" default="成年女性"} 坐在安静温泉小镇中户外足汤的旧木长凳中央，周围绿意盎然，双脚浸泡在清澈的温泉水中。人物占据垂直屏幕约 75% 的比例，从头部到浸入水中的双脚。捕捉到一个自然瞬间：她用双手轻轻提起薄纱裙的前摆，以防弄湿。面部/表情：明亮的象牙米色皮肤，透着淡淡的玫瑰粉色。质感细腻，可见皮肤纹理，脸颊、鼻尖和锁骨处有柔和的高光。香槟米色与粉棕色眼妆，长而细的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和的棕色眉毛，以及清透的粉米色嘴唇。头部微微下倾，看着双脚，温柔地微笑着。{argument name="hair style" default="奶茶灰棕色中长发"}，留着轻薄的空气刘海，脸侧有修饰脸型的层次感剪裁，发尾微微内扣，脸颊旁散落着细碎的发丝。服装/姿势：{argument name="outfit" default="象牙白针织裹身上衣"}，搭配一件薄款长开衫、白色高腰阔腿短裤，外罩一条轻盈的雪纺裙。整体造型统一为米色系。上半身微微前倾，双肩放松。双手用指尖捏住裙摆左右两侧，膝盖并拢，小腿轻轻交叉。脚踝以下浸在水中，随着动作激起细小的涟漪。背景/光影：宁静的足汤区，配有古旧的木质休息处、湿润的鹅卵石、低矮的木栅栏和深绿色的树木。背景中的建筑和招牌略微模糊，文字不可辨认。温暖的自然光从左上方射入，照亮发丝、脸颊、肩膀、手臂和大腿。长凳下方及右侧有柔和的阴影。水面反射着天空和树木，足部周围有透明的涟漪和细碎的光影。构图/摄影：9:16 纵横比。相机位置略低于坐姿人物的胸部，采用近乎正面的低角度拍摄。人物居中，上方留有绿植和建筑，下方大面积展示足汤水面。从面部到手部和膝盖焦点清晰，背景具有自然的浅景深。等效 35-50mm 的自然透视。构图在不刻意强调腿部或手部的情况下，传达出整体的平衡感和足汤空间氛围。质感/风格：高真实感的户外人像摄影。细腻呈现柔和的皮肤纹理、单根发丝、针织与雪纺纤维、旧木的干燥表面、湿润的石块以及水的折射效果。柔和的暖色调自然光，中等对比度，色彩纯净。避免过度的皮肤修饰或人工 HDR 效果。负面提示词：未成年长相、不自然的脸部、不自然的眼神、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、双腿长度不一、服装接触不自然、过度曝光、不自然的重力、错误的水面反射、不一致的阴影、乱码文字、可读的招牌、Logo、水印、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤。

en.title: Summer Yacht Portrait at Mount Fuji
en.description: A detailed fashion photography prompt for a young woman on a yacht deck with the scenic backdrop of Mount Fuji and a summer lake.
en.prompt:
Theme:
{argument name="subject" default="Shipside overlooking Mount Fuji"}

Subject:
A {argument name="person" default="young woman"} stands leaning against a stainless steel railing on the deck of a white cruiser yacht moving across a clear lake. The person is positioned slightly to the right of center, captured from the top of the head to the thighs. To the left behind her, the green lakeshore and snow-capped Mount Fuji spread out.

Character/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige skin with a pale pink glow and natural texture. Subtle highlights on cheeks, nose, shoulders, and collarbones. Rose pink blush, pink-brown eyeshadow, long thin eyelashes, natural eye bags, soft light eyebrows, and sheer pink-beige lips. Medium-long bright milk tea ash-brown hair with thin see-through bangs and face-framing layers. Fine strands of hair and flyaways drift to the left in the wind. Her face is turned to the left, quietly gazing at the distant lake surface.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="outfit" default="An ivory-white halter-neck bikini top with fine vertical ribbing and light blue high-waisted cutoff denim shorts"}. Natural fringe at the hem. A small gold star necklace and a white scrunchie-style bracelet. Her left hand rests lightly on the railing, while her right hand is placed near the pocket of her shorts. Hips shifted slightly to the right, weight on the left leg, creating a gentle twist in the shoulders and pelvis.

Background/Lighting:
Polished metal railing and white hull in the foreground. Deep blue lake surface with fine wave reflections in the middle ground, and green lakeshore, low buildings, and majestic Mount Fuji in the background. A white yacht canopy and pillars are visible in the upper right. Thin white clouds in a clear daytime blue sky. Strong natural light from the top left illuminates the left side of the face, shoulders, collarbones, abdomen, and thighs. Soft shadows on the right side of the body, with sharp specular highlights on the lake and metal.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Eye-level shot from a position slightly lower than the waist. The person occupies about 65% of the frame, with headspace and margin for the sky and Mount Fuji on the left. Natural 50mm-equivalent perspective. Accurate focus on the face and upper body, with Mount Fuji and the shoreline lightly and softly blurred but recognizable.

Texture/Style:
A bright, clean summer fashion photograph. Precise depiction of natural skin texture, fine peach fuzz, soft dry hair strands, denim weave, metal reflections, and tiny glints on the lake surface. Based on blue and white tones that aren't too saturated, naturally highlighting warm skin tones. Crisp clarity and realistic photo texture reminiscent of a magazine spread.

zh.title: 富士山下的夏日游艇人像
zh.description: 一份详细的时尚摄影提示词，描绘了一位年轻女性在游艇甲板上，以富士山和夏日湖泊为背景的场景。
zh.prompt:
主题：
{argument name="subject" default="俯瞰富士山的船侧视角"}

主体：
一位 {argument name="person" default="年轻女性"} 倚靠在白色巡航游艇的不锈钢栏杆上，游艇正行驶在清澈的湖面上。人物位于画面中心偏右，取景范围从头顶到大腿。在她左后方，绿色的湖岸和积雪覆盖的富士山铺展开来。

人物/表情：
20 多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色皮肤，透着淡淡的粉色光泽，质感自然。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀和锁骨处有细微的高光。玫瑰粉色腮红，粉棕色眼影，长而纤细的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和的浅色眉毛，以及通透的粉米色嘴唇。中长款明亮的奶茶灰棕色头发，配有轻薄的空气刘海和修饰脸型的层次剪裁。细碎的发丝随风向左飘动。她转头看向左侧，静静地凝视着远处的湖面。

服装/姿势：
{argument name="outfit" default="一件带有细竖条纹的象牙白挂脖比基尼上衣，搭配浅蓝色高腰毛边牛仔短裤"}。下摆有自然的流苏。佩戴一条金色小星星项链和一个白色发圈式手环。左手轻放在栏杆上，右手放在短裤口袋附近。臀部略微向右偏移，重心落在左腿上，使肩膀和骨盆形成自然的扭转。

背景/光影：
前景是抛光的金属栏杆和白色船体。中景是深蓝色的湖面，泛着细碎的波光；背景是绿色的湖岸、低矮的建筑和雄伟的富士山。右上角可见白色的游艇遮阳棚和立柱。清澈的日间蓝天，点缀着薄薄的白云。来自左上方的强烈自然光照亮了脸部左侧、肩膀、锁骨、腹部和大腿。身体右侧有柔和的阴影，湖面和金属上有锐利的镜面高光。

构图/摄影：
3:4 竖构图。从略低于腰部的位置进行平视拍摄。人物占据画面约 65%，左侧留有天空和富士山的余地。自然的 50mm 等效视角。焦点精准对准脸部和上半身，富士山和湖岸呈现轻微且柔和的虚化，但清晰可辨。

质感/风格：
一张明亮、干净的夏日时尚照片。精准呈现自然的皮肤纹理、细小的绒毛、柔软干爽的发丝、牛仔布纹理、金属反射以及湖面上细小的闪光。基于不过分饱和的蓝白色调，自然地衬托出温暖的肤色。清晰度高，具有类似杂志大片的真实摄影质感。

en.title: Ultra-Detailed Clean Beauty Portrait
en.description: A 9:16 high-key beauty portrait prompt designed for GPT Image 2, featuring a young Japanese woman in a bright, clean indoor setting with emphasis on realistic skin textures and professional lighting.
en.prompt:
Vertical 9:16, extremely bright and clean photorealistic beauty portrait shot in a white interior. A fictional adult Japanese woman, aged {argument name="age" default="23-28"}. The face is centered and large, in a tight close-up from the top of the head to the upper chest. Shoulders tilted slightly right, neck tilted slightly left, looking directly at the camera. Forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, and chin are all in frame, with hair flowing down to fill the vertical composition.
Glossy long black hair ending below the chest, parted slightly left. Airy see-through bangs on the forehead, delicate strands near the cheeks, and loose waves at the ends. Medium-sized {argument name="eye color" default="dark brown"} eyes, natural double eyelids, delicate eyelashes, peach-beige eye makeup, and light coral blush. A natural smile with slightly parted lips showing even upper teeth. Glossy light pink lips. Rounded cheeks, smooth jawline, healthy bright skin. Retain details like pores, fine facial hair, lip lines, and iris details.
Outfit is a {argument name="clothing style" default="soft white to ivory cotton blouse"} with a round neckline, fine gathers, and small white buttons. No accessories. The background is a very pale gray, a blend of white walls and window light. Soft backlighting from the rear right, with the front of the face illuminated uniformly by a large white reflector. High-key but not overexposed, maintaining the black of the hair and the outline of the pupils.
85-105mm equivalent, f/2.2, eye-level height, focusing primarily on the eyes. No facial perspective distortion; smooth background blur. Balances beauty ad precision with the intimacy of a natural light portrait. No text, logos, watermarks, accessories, flashy nails, extra teeth, mismatched eyes, doll-like skin, or 3DCG effects.

zh.title: 干净的高调美妆肖像
zh.description: 一个用于生成干净、明亮美妆肖像的提示词，描绘了一位在白色房间内、沐浴在柔和自然光下的年轻日本女性。
zh.prompt: 垂直 9:16 比例，在白色室内拍摄的极其明亮、干净且写实的美妆肖像。一位虚构的成年日本女性，年龄设定为 {argument name="age" default="23-28 岁"}。大脸部构图居中，从头顶到上胸部的紧凑特写。肩膀略微向右倾斜，颈部略微向左，直视镜头。额头、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴和下颌均在画面内，长发垂落在两侧，填满垂直构图。{argument name="hair style" default="接近黑色的光泽长发"}，长度延伸至胸部以下，发缝略微偏左。额前有稀疏、轻盈的空气刘海，脸颊旁有几缕精致的发丝，发尾呈自然波浪状。中等大小的深棕色眼睛，自然的双眼皮，精致的上下睫毛，桃米色眼妆，浅珊瑚色腮红。自然的微笑，嘴巴微张，露出整齐的上齿。光泽感的淡粉色嘴唇。圆润的脸颊和流畅的下颌线，健康的亮白肤色。保留毛孔、细小面部绒毛、唇纹和虹膜细节。服装为 {argument name="clothing" default="白色至象牙色的柔软棉质衬衫"}，圆领设计，胸前有细褶和白色小纽扣。无配饰。背景并非纯白，而是白色墙壁与窗光融合后的极淡灰色。主体右后方有柔和的逆光，面部正面由大型白色反光板均匀补光。高调风格但不过曝，保留头发的黑色和眼睛轮廓。相当于 85-105mm 镜头，f/2.2 光圈，平视角度，优先对焦于瞳孔。背景平滑虚化，不扭曲面部透视。平衡了美妆广告的精准度与自然光肖像的亲密感。无文字、标志、水印、配饰、夸张的美甲、多余的牙齿、瞳孔不对称、过度放大的眼睛、蜡像感皮肤、浓重的修容、插画感或 3DCG 感。
