en.title: Photorealistic Character Layout Sheet
en.description: A complex, structured prompt for creating a professional character sheet with consistent photorealistic views (front, side, back) and building references, ideal for character design and consistency.
en.prompt:
[Input Items]
Clothing Type: [{argument name="clothing style" default="business"} / elegant for date]
Color Direction: [{argument name="specified color" default="navy"} / red]
If not entered, use 'business' and 'navy'.

[Reference Usage]
Use one full-body reference image attached to this instruction.

[Body Text]
Use the attached full-body reference image as the sole character reference to create one 1:1 square high-quality photorealistic character sheet. If the reference image is a real photo, maintain the same person. If it is an illustration, convert it into a natural photorealistic person while maintaining the character's features. Maintain the facial features, hairstyle, hair color, age, skin tone, gender impression, height, head-to-body ratio, and body type of the reference person. Do not beautify, rejuvenate, age, change body type, or transform into another person. Only the outfit and shoes should be changed.

[Clothing]
Naturally adapt the specified clothing type to the gender, age, and body type of the reference person.
- Business: A modern, clean business style, including a jacket, suitable for professional outings.
- Elegant for date: Sophisticated and stylish attire suitable for dates at restaurants or in the city. Use outfits that make the body shape easy to see, avoiding uniforms, overly formal wear, excessively long hems, large decorations, complex layering, or brand logos.

[Color Palette]
Use the specified color as the primary or central color of the outfit. A small amount of white, ivory, gray, or black may be added as auxiliary colors, but avoid multi-coloring.
- Navy: Centered on deep navy.
- Red: Centered on deep red, bordeaux, or wine red.

[Overall Layout]
Organize the sheet into a two-tier configuration: approximately 58% for the top tier and 42% for the bottom tier. Do not change the basic placement, order, or ratio.

[Top Tier: ~58%]
01 FRONT: 22%
02 SIDE: 22%
03 BACK: 22%
04 SPECIAL LOOK: 34%
Views 01-03 must be full-body displays at the same scale, including the top of the head to the tips of the toes. Unify the height, head-to-body ratio, body type, outfit, shoes, and camera distance, using a natural standing posture without obscuring the outfit with arms or hands.
- 01 FRONT: Full-body front view.
- 02 SIDE: Full-body side view.
- 03 BACK: Full-body back view.

[04 SPECIAL LOOK]
A larger full-body 3/4 view of the same person in the same outfit. Use a natural expression and a slight action-oriented static pose that best highlights the person's charm. A simple flat color or subtle geometric color plane using the specified color may be placed only behind view 04.

[Bottom Tier: ~42%]
The left 62% is 05 FACE, and the right 38% is 06 BUILDING REFERENCE.

[05 FACE]
Place three facial views (front, 3/4 angle, side) in a horizontal row at the same size, camera distance, and head position. Use natural normal expressions for all three to make facial features, eyes, contours, bangs, hairstyle, and age easy to confirm.

[06 BUILDING REFERENCE]
The entire 06 area should be a single wide-angle exterior image showing the building front, entrance, and outdoor plaza structure. The clothing type and color direction are not reflected in 06. It should be a neutral building reference unaffected by the person's outfit color or the sheet's accent colors. Depict a clean, modern building front and automatic glass entrance under bright, uniform natural daylight. Avoid night scenes, evening views, warm lighting, strong color direction, or specific themes like hotels or restaurants. Do not split the 06 area; it must be a single-screen, single-perspective view without collages or multiple views. It consists of one continuous wall, one ground floor, one continuous ground, one building front, and one clear entrance. Clearly depict either sliding or revolving automatic glass doors without mixing structures.
The bottom 30-40% of the 06 area is a continuous outdoor plaza, and the top 60-70% is the building front. Place the entrance only at the center-bottom, with the entrance width being about 20-30% of the total 06 area. Use a wide-angle composition showing a straight line of movement toward the entrance. Avoid close-ups of the entrance, distant views where the entrance is indistinguishable, multiple entrances, overlapping building fronts, double ground planes, complex stairs, people, cars, or signs.

[Headers]
Use only the following short English labels:
01 FRONT
02 SIDE
03 BACK
04 SPECIAL LOOK
05 FACE
06 BUILDING REFERENCE
Place each header in the upper left of its corresponding area in a small, unified font, ensuring they do not overlap important parts of the person or building. The specified color may be used subtly for headers and thin divider lines.

[Common Design]
The background of the sheet, excluding 06 BUILDING REFERENCE, should be white to very light gray. Ensure sufficient margins to avoid overlap between the person and different areas, creating a clean, organized design. Display only the specified 4 full-body views and 3 facial views, all maintaining the same person and outfit as the reference. Do not include thick frames, excessive decoration, long descriptions, dialogue, subtitles, logos, brand names, or watermarks.

zh.title: 通用 AI 角色设定图生成器
zh.description: 一套全面的系统提示词，旨在创建高质量、一致性强的角色设定图，包含多角度视图、面部细节及建筑环境参考。
zh.prompt:
【输入项】
服装类型：[{argument name="clothing type" default="Business / Elegant Date Style"}]
色彩方向：[{argument name="color scheme" default="Navy / Red"}]
若留空，则默认为“Business”和“Navy”。

【参考使用】
本指令附带一张全身参考图。

【正文】
以附带的全身参考图作为唯一主体参考，创建一张高质量的 1:1 正方形照片级真实感角色设定图。如果参考图是真实照片，请保持为同一人。如果是插画，请将其转换为自然的真实感人物，同时保留角色特征。保持参考人物的面部特征、发型、发色、感知年龄、肤色、性别印象、身高、比例、体型及整体比例。请勿进行美化、减龄、增龄、改变体型或替换角色。原则上仅更改服装和鞋子。

【服装】
将指定的服装类型自然地适配于参考人物的性别、年龄和体型。
- Business
现代、干练的商务风格。包含一件外套，形成整洁实用的户外装束。
- Elegant Date Style
适合餐厅或城市约会的精致迷人户外装束。使用能清晰展现身形的服装；避免制服、过度正式的礼服、过长的下摆、大型装饰、复杂的叠穿或品牌标志。

【配色】
使用指定的颜色作为服装的主色调或核心色。白色、象牙白、灰色或黑色可作为辅助色少量添加，但请勿使用多种颜色。
- Navy：以深海军蓝为主。
- Red：以深红、波尔多红或酒红色为主。

【整体布局】
将整个构图分为两层结构：上层约 58%，下层约 42%。请勿更改基本位置、顺序或比例。

【上层：约 58%】
01 FRONT：22%
02 SIDE：22%
03 BACK：22%
04 SPECIAL LOOK：34%
01-03 必须为相同比例的全身视图，展示从头顶到脚尖的人物形象。统一身高、比例、体型、服装、鞋子和摄像机距离。使用自然的站立姿势，手臂或手部不得遮挡身形或服装。
- 01 FRONT：正面全身
- 02 SIDE：侧面全身
- 03 BACK：背面全身

【04 SPECIAL LOOK】
同一人物身着同一服装的较大 3/4 全身视图。使用自然的表情和带有轻微动态的静态姿势，以最佳方式传达角色的魅力。仅在 04 区域后方，可以使用指定颜色的浅色版本放置简单的纯色或微妙的几何色块。

【下层：约 42%】
左侧 62% 为 05 FACE，右侧 38% 为 06 BUILDING REFERENCE。

【05 FACE】
在同一水平行中放置三个视图（正面、3/4 侧面、侧面），保持相同的大小、摄像机距离和头部位置。三者均使用自然表情，以便于核对面部特征、眼睛、轮廓、刘海、发型和感知年龄。

【06 BUILDING REFERENCE】
将整个 06 区域作为一个宽广的建筑外观图像，展示建筑正面、入口和户外广场的结构。此处不体现服装类型和色彩方向。它应为一个不受人物服装颜色或主题色影响的中性建筑参考。描绘一个干净、现代的建筑立面，以及在均匀自然日光下的户外广场中的自动玻璃入口。避免夜景、日落、暖色灯光或酒店、餐厅等特定的氛围导向。请勿分割 06 区域；将其构建为单一视图。禁止拼贴、分割视图或多角度展示。由一面连续的墙壁、一层地面、一片连续的地面、一个建筑正面和一个清晰的入口组成。清晰描绘滑动或旋转的自动玻璃门，不得混合结构。
06 区域下方的约 30-40% 为户外广场，60-70% 为建筑正面。入口仅放置在底部中心，宽度约为 06 区域的 20-30%。使用广角构图，展示通往入口的清晰线性路径。避免仅拍摄门部的特写、过远的视角、多个入口、重叠的立面，或添加人物、车辆和标志。

【标签】
仅使用以下简短的英文标注：
01 FRONT
02 SIDE
03 BACK
04 SPECIAL LOOK
05 FACE
06 BUILDING REFERENCE
将每个标签放置在其对应区域的左上角，使用统一的小字体，且不得遮挡重要部分。指定颜色可少量用于标签和细分割线。

【通用设计】
设定图背景（06 区域除外）应为白色至极浅的灰色。确保留有足够的边距，使视图互不重叠，从而打造适合单图分享的简洁、专业的设计。仅包含指定的 4 个全身视图和 3 个面部视图，且均保持同一人物和服装。禁止使用粗边框、过度装饰、长篇描述、对话、字幕、标志或水印。

en.title: Realistic Mirror Selfie Photography
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for a realistic mirror selfie of a woman in a minimal indoor setting, focusing on lighting, skin texture, and smartphone photography aesthetics.
en.prompt:
Theme:
{argument name="subject" default="Gaze through the mirror"}

Subject:
In a bright, minimal interior, an {argument name="person" default="adult woman with a mature model physique"} is taking a selfie with a smartphone toward a mirror. She stands slightly to the left of the center, captured vertically from the head to the upper thighs. She holds a pink smartphone in her right hand, positioned slightly to the right of her face so as not to hide her eyes, nose, or mouth.

Character/Expression:
A mature physique with natural three-dimensionality. The bust is full but not unnaturally exaggerated, with a slim waist and soft hip lines. Long dark brown hair flows over her right shoulder, with thin bangs over her forehead. Elegant pink-beige makeup, clear eyes, and a gentle smile. Her face is slightly tilted to the left, looking at the camera through the mirror.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="outfit" default="A white ribbed crop top with a deep but elegant V-neck, fine shirring and drawstring at the center, short puff sleeves, and subtle ruffles. The bottoms are light sand-beige low-rise shorts"}. Thin straps overlap on both sides of the waist, with small ribbon ties and hanging cords on the sides. Her right arm is bent to hold the smartphone, and her left arm is lowered naturally. A natural standing pose with weight shifted to one leg and the waist slightly tilted.

Background/Lighting:
A quiet room with white walls and grey curtains. In the back right is a light wood grain round table, a clear vase with white flowers, and a thin-framed seaside photograph. Botanical prints and cards with unreadable small text decorate the wall subtly. Soft daylight enters from a large window on the left, brightly illuminating the left cheek, shoulder, bust, and abdomen. Subtle reflected light on the right side, with shadows cast softly toward the wall.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical orientation, 2:3. The person occupies about 65% of the screen, with ample headspace and a natural crop at the upper thighs. The camera is at chest height, an eye-level shot representing a smartphone photo through a mirror. Natural 50mm-equivalent perspective. Accurate focus on the face and upper body, with the background slightly softened. A three-layered composition of window, person, and table.

Texture/Style:
A bright, clean, realistic fashion photograph. Detailed depiction of natural skin texture, subtle sheen, fine ribs and shirring of the fabric, and the stitching and strap tension of the shorts. Low contrast, with a calm color palette centered on pale ivory and greige. Maintaining the intimacy of a smartphone snapshot while achieving a polished finish like a magazine snap.

zh.title: 写实风格镜面自拍摄影
zh.description: 一个关于在极简室内环境中拍摄写实女性镜面自拍的高细节提示词，重点关注光影、皮肤质感以及智能手机摄影美学。
zh.prompt:
主题：
{argument name="subject" default="透过镜子凝视"}

主体：
在一个明亮、极简的室内，一位 {argument name="person" default="拥有成熟模特身材的成年女性"} 正拿着智能手机对着镜子自拍。她站在画面中心略偏左的位置，镜头垂直取景，从头部到大腿上部。她右手拿着一部粉色智能手机，位置略偏向脸部右侧，以免遮挡眼睛、鼻子或嘴巴。

人物/表情：
成熟的身材，具有自然的立体感。胸部丰满但不显夸张，腰部纤细，臀部线条柔和。深棕色长发垂在右肩，额前留着薄刘海。优雅的粉米色妆容，眼神清澈，带着温柔的微笑。头部微微向左倾斜，透过镜子注视着镜头。

服装/姿势：
{argument name="outfit" default="一件白色罗纹短款上衣，领口深邃而优雅，呈 V 领设计，中心有精致的褶皱和抽绳，短泡泡袖，带有细微的荷叶边。下身穿着浅沙米色的低腰短裤"}。腰部两侧有重叠的细带，侧面带有小蝴蝶结系带和垂下的绳子。她的右臂弯曲持握手机，左臂自然下垂。自然的站姿，重心偏向一条腿，腰部微微倾斜。

背景/光影：
一个安静的房间，有着白色的墙壁和灰色的窗帘。右后方是一张浅木纹圆桌，摆放着一个透明花瓶和白色花朵，以及一张细边框的海边照片。墙上装饰着植物印花和带有模糊小字的卡片，显得十分雅致。柔和的日光从左侧的大窗户射入，明亮地照亮了左侧脸颊、肩膀、胸部和腹部。右侧有微妙的反射光，阴影柔和地投射在墙上。

构图/相机：
垂直构图，比例 2:3。人物占据画面约 65%，顶部留有充足空间，在大腿上部进行自然裁剪。相机位于胸部高度，模拟通过镜子拍摄的智能手机视角。自然的 50mm 等效透视。焦点准确对准脸部和上半身，背景略微虚化。窗户、人物和桌子构成了三层式构图。

质感/风格：
明亮、干净的写实时尚摄影。细腻地描绘了自然的皮肤质感、微妙的光泽、面料的细罗纹和褶皱，以及短裤的缝线和系带张力。低对比度，以浅象牙色和灰褐色为主的冷静色调。在保持智能手机快照亲密感的同时，实现了如杂志大片般精致的质感。

en.title: Young Woman in Semi-Open-Air Bath
en.description: A detailed realistic portrait prompt for a woman relaxing in a traditional Japanese semi-open-air bath, focusing on natural skin textures, wet hair, and soft lighting.
en.prompt:
Subject:
Hair unraveling on the water surface

Main Subject:
Vertical 2:3. A knee-up portrait of a {argument name="age and gender" default="woman in her 20s"} in a {argument name="setting" default="wooden semi-open-air bath"}, positioned slightly to the right of the center. The person occupies about 70% of the screen, kneeling in shallow water with both hands on the edge of the tub, leaning forward slightly.

Person/Expression:
Bright ivory-beige skin with natural texture and a faint flush. The face is directed towards the camera, chin slightly tucked, gazing quietly with clear eyes. Mouth slightly open, a calm and gentle expression. Pale rose pink blush, pink-brown eye shadow, thin natural eyelashes, subtle tear bags, light brown eyebrows, sheer pink-beige lips. Small catchlights in the eyes.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="clothing" default="A delicate ecru white crochet knit bikini"}. Carefully depict the thin shoulder straps, side ribbons, the sheerness of the knit, and the texture of wet fibers. Both arms are naturally extended, with palms placed on the stone edge of the tub. Fingers slightly open, weight distributed between knees and hands. Shoulders slightly inward, hips remaining back. The water surface touches halfway up the thighs, with small ripples spreading along the body's movement.

Background/Light:
A quiet semi-open-air bath surrounded by wooden pillars, old wood walls, bamboo screens, and small plantings. Light stone tub edge in the foreground, transparent hot water and the person in the midground, wooden architecture and blurred greenery in the background. Warm natural light shines from the top left, softly illuminating hair, cheeks, shoulders, collarbone, and water droplets. Faint reflected light from the wooden wall on the right. White fluctuations reflected on the water surface, with a thin shadow falling beneath the person.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 2:3, small margin at the top of the head, cut at the tub edge at the bottom. A medium-close shot taken from a slightly high eye level. 50mm equivalent, focused on the face and upper body, with a natural background blur. Face at top center, guiding the diagonal lines of the arms downward, creating depth with the water surface and tub edge.

Texture/Style:
High-definition realistic portrait. Wet milk tea ash brown hair, thin see-through bangs, face-framing layers, medium-long hair down to the shoulders. Depict fine hair bundles, wet gloss, and natural stray hairs. Skin is not overly homogenized, leaving pores, fine water droplets, and cheek flush. A calm tone harmonizing warm wood, pale skin, deep green, and blue-green water surface.

Negative:
Minors, unnatural faces, unnatural gazes, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, deformed arms or legs, broken joints, poor contact with the tub, unnatural floating, shadows inconsistent with the water surface, incorrect perspective, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 半露天温泉中的年轻女性
zh.description: 一份详细的写实肖像提示词，描绘了一位在传统日式半露天温泉中放松的女性，重点刻画自然的皮肤纹理、湿发以及柔和的光影效果。
zh.prompt:
主体：
发丝散落在水面上

主要对象：
竖构图 2:3。一位 {argument name="age and gender" default="20 多岁的女性"} 在 {argument name="setting" default="木质半露天温泉"} 中的半身像，位于画面中心偏右位置。人物占据约 70% 的画面，跪在浅水中，双手撑在浴缸边缘，身体微微前倾。

人物/表情：
明亮的象牙米色皮肤，带有自然的纹理和淡淡的红晕。面部朝向镜头，下巴微收，眼神清澈，静静地注视着前方。嘴唇微张，表情平静而温柔。淡玫瑰粉色腮红，粉棕色眼影，纤细自然的睫毛，细微的卧蚕，浅棕色眉毛，透亮的粉米色嘴唇。眼中带有细小的眼神光。

服装/姿势：
{argument name="clothing" default="精致的本白色钩针编织比基尼"}。仔细描绘细肩带、侧边系带、针织品的透视感以及湿润纤维的质感。双臂自然伸展，手掌平放在石质浴缸边缘。手指微张，重心分布在膝盖和双手之间。双肩微内扣，臀部向后。水面没过大腿中部，随着身体的动作泛起细小的涟漪。

背景/光影：
宁静的半露天温泉，周围环绕着木柱、古旧的木墙、竹帘和少量植被。前景为浅色石质浴缸边缘，中景为清澈的温泉水和人物，背景为木质建筑和虚化的绿植。温暖的自然光从左上方射入，柔和地照亮了头发、脸颊、肩膀、锁骨和水珠。右侧木墙有微弱的反射光。水面上反射着白色的波光，人物下方投下淡淡的阴影。

构图/摄影：
竖构图 2:3，头顶留有少量空间，底部在浴缸边缘处截断。从略高的视点拍摄的中近景。50mm 等效焦距，对焦在面部和上半身，背景自然虚化。面部位于顶部中心，引导双臂的对角线向下延伸，通过水面和浴缸边缘营造出空间深度。

质感/风格：
高清写实肖像。湿润的奶茶灰棕色头发，轻薄的透视刘海，修饰脸型的层次感，中长发垂至肩部。刻画细致的发束、湿润的光泽和自然的碎发。皮肤不进行过度磨皮，保留毛孔、细小水珠和脸颊红晕。色调沉稳，融合了温暖的木色、苍白的肤色、深绿色和蓝绿色的水面。

负面提示词：
未成年人、不自然的面部、不自然的目光、过度皮肤修饰、塑料感皮肤、多指、缺指、并指、手臂或腿部畸形、关节断裂、与浴缸接触不良、不自然的悬浮、与水面不一致的阴影、透视错误、乱码文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Miniature Woman on Tea Cup
en.description: A creative prompt generating a miniature woman sitting on the edge of a tea cup, emphasizing scale difference through a giant hand and detailed porcelain textures.
en.prompt:
Subject:
Blue Flower Tea Time

Main Subject:
Vertical 4:5. A tiny {argument name="age and gender" default="woman in her 20s"} sitting on the edge of a {argument name="item" default="white tea cup"}, positioned slightly left of center, with the person and cup occupying about 60% of the lower half. An adult hand naturally pinches the cup handle from the right edge, emphasizing the contrast between giant everyday items and the tiny person.

Person/Expression:
Long dark brown hair nearly black, in loose double braids, with white lace and thin ribbon hair accessories. Looking up to the left, head slightly tilted, with a calm and curious expression watching blue flowers. Natural flush to the skin, subtle pink makeup, clear eyes, and an elegant face that doesn't look overly young.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="clothing" default="A light ivory-based short-sleeved mini dress"}. A large pale blue-grey ribbon at the chest, fine lace and ruffles layered at the cuffs and hem, creating an elegant and clean silhouette despite the above-the-knee length. White ruffled socks and dark brown strap shoes. The person's own left arm is extended diagonally upward, fingers just before touching a flower. The right hand rests on the edge of the cup, and both legs hang naturally with a slight gap. A small rattan pochette worn diagonally with a white rabbit plushie on top.

Background/Light:
A bright garden surrounded by small pale blue flowers and dark green leaves. Slightly blurred flowers in the lower left foreground, person and tea cup in the midground, white fence and soft dappled sunlight bokeh in the background. The cup is white porcelain with a delicate thin blue flower pattern, with a matching saucer placed on a wooden table. Warm morning natural light shines from the top left, creating thin highlights on hair, shoulders, arms, and the cup edge. Shadows fall softly to the lower right, with faint green reflections from the leaves added slightly to the skin and porcelain.

Composition/Camera:
A close-up mid-shot taken from near the person's eye level. The entire cup, saucer, and hand holding the handle are within the frame. A diagonal composition where the person's extended left arm and flower branch flow to the top left, and the cup handle and hand are the center of gravity at the bottom right. Leave white space at the top with flowers and soft background bokeh. 85mm equivalent, shallow depth of field. Focus on the person's face and extended fingertips, background naturally blurred.

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic expression like real miniature photography. Carefully describe the smooth gloss of porcelain, fine weave of rattan, sheerness of lace, thinness of petals, and natural textures of skin and hair. Summarize with bright and clean tones centered on pale blue, ivory, and deep green, avoiding excessive HDR or CG feel.

Negative:
Minors, unnatural faces, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands/feet, broken joints, poor contact with the cup, floating, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, distorted porcelain, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

zh.title: 茶杯上的微缩女性
zh.description: 一个创意提示词，用于生成坐在茶杯边缘的微缩女性，通过巨手与细腻的瓷器纹理强调比例差异。
zh.prompt:
主题：
蓝色花朵茶歇时光

主体：
竖构图 4:5。一位微小的 {argument name="age and gender" default="20 多岁的女性"} 坐在 {argument name="item" default="白色茶杯"} 的边缘，位置略偏左，人物和茶杯占据下半部分约 60% 的空间。一只成年人的手从右侧自然地捏住杯柄，强调日常巨型物品与微小人物之间的对比。

人物/表情：
深棕色长发近乎黑色，梳成松散的双麻花辫，配有白色蕾丝和细丝带发饰。抬头看向左上方，头部微倾，表情平静而好奇地注视着蓝色花朵。皮肤呈现自然红润，妆容淡粉，眼神清澈，面容优雅，不显稚嫩。

服装/姿势：
{argument name="clothing" default="一件浅象牙色短袖迷你连衣裙"}。胸前饰有巨大的浅蓝灰色丝带，袖口和下摆层叠着精致的蕾丝与荷叶边，尽管是膝上长度，却营造出优雅简洁的轮廓。穿着白色荷叶边短袜和深棕色系带鞋。人物左臂向左上方斜伸，指尖即将触碰到花朵。右手搭在杯缘，双腿自然垂下，略有间隙。斜挎着一个小藤编包，包上挂着一只白色兔子玩偶。

背景/光影：
一个被浅蓝色小花和深绿色叶片环绕的明亮花园。左下角前景是略微模糊的花朵，中景是人物和茶杯，背景是白色栅栏和柔和的斑驳阳光光斑。茶杯为白色瓷器，带有精致的细蓝色花纹，配套的茶托放置在木桌上。温暖的晨间自然光从左上方照射，在头发、肩膀、手臂和杯缘上勾勒出细微的高光。阴影柔和地投向右下方，叶片的淡淡绿色反射轻微地映在皮肤和瓷器上。

构图/摄影：
从接近人物视平线的角度拍摄的特写中景。整个茶杯、茶托和握住杯柄的手均在画面内。对角线构图，人物伸出的左臂与花枝向左上方延伸，杯柄和手作为重力中心位于右下方。顶部留白，呈现花朵和柔和的背景光斑。85mm 等效焦距，浅景深。焦点对准人物面部和伸出的指尖，背景自然虚化。

质感/风格：
如同真实微缩摄影般的高清写实表现。精细描绘瓷器的光滑光泽、藤编的细腻纹理、蕾丝的通透感、花瓣的薄度以及皮肤和头发的自然质感。以浅蓝、象牙白和深绿为核心，总结为明亮清新的色调，避免过度的 HDR 或 CG 感。

负面提示词：
未成年人、不自然的面部、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手脚粘连、关节断裂、与杯子接触不良、悬浮、不自然的重力、透视错误、与光源不一致的阴影、瓷器扭曲、乱码、标志、水印、过度的皮肤修饰、塑料感皮肤。

en.title: Parisian Cafe Terrace Portrait
en.description: A cinematic prompt for a sophisticated woman at a Parisian cafe terrace, focusing on linen textures, soft afternoon light, and an ennui expression.
en.prompt:
[Composition/Camera Angle]
Mid-shot, waist-up to medium shot captured at eye level with a slight diagonal. A cinematic horizontal composition (3:4) conveying the openness of a Parisian cafe terrace. Background cityscape and the cafe's red awning are appropriately blurred (depth of field around F1.8 to F2.8), guiding the viewer's gaze to the subject's delicate expression and hand details.

[Subject/Pose/Gesture/Fashion Description]
A woman sitting at a terrace table of a {argument name="cafe location" default="Saint-Germain cafe"}. Wearing {argument name="clothing" default="a loose, oversized white linen shirt"} (several top buttons open to show a natural V-line from neck to décolletage) and tight black skinny pants. Classic black cat-eye sunglasses are casually placed on top of her head. Holding a ceramic coffee cup with beautiful latte art in one hand, she gazes at passersby with a {argument name="expression" default="sophisticated, ennui expression"}. Natural wrinkles in the linen shirt, 3D folds in the fabric swaying gently in the wind, relaxed yet refined posture.

[Exact Application of Features and Structure from Reference Image (Image Reference)]
Face/Expression: Accurately reference and reproduce the facial structure, placement of parts (eye shape, bridge of nose, mouth), skin texture, and nuances of the ennui eyes from the [reference image].
Hairstyle/Hair Color: Completely reproduce the hair length, volume, flow of tips, and hair color from the [reference image].
Body Type/Structure: Apply the neck-to-shoulder line, thickness of the chest, torso silhouette, and length of hands and fingers from the [reference image] as a base.

[Space/Lighting/Atmosphere]
The historic streets of Saint-Germain-des-Prés in Paris and the vivid red cafe awning. Soft afternoon sunlight shines through the roadside trees, casting beautiful dappled light and shadows (Chiaroscuro effect) on the table, her skin, and the linen shirt. The overall tone is a warm natural palette, with lighting that evokes the relaxed, sophisticated flow of time characteristic of Parisian cafes.

zh.title: 巴黎咖啡馆露台肖像
zh.description: 一个为巴黎咖啡馆露台上的精致女性设计的电影感提示词，聚焦于亚麻质感、柔和的午后光线以及慵懒的神情。
zh.prompt:
[构图/摄像机角度]
中景，从腰部以上到中景，以平视视角拍摄，略带对角线构图。电影感的横向构图（3:4），传达出巴黎咖啡馆露台的开阔感。背景城市景观和咖啡馆的红色遮阳篷经过适当虚化（景深约为 F1.8 到 F2.8），引导观众的视线聚焦于主体细腻的表情和手部细节。

[主体/姿势/手势/服装描述]
一位坐在 {argument name="cafe location" default="圣日耳曼咖啡馆"} 露台桌旁的女性。身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="一件宽松的白色亚麻衬衫"}（解开几颗上扣，露出颈部到锁骨的自然 V 领）和紧身黑色长裤。经典的黑色猫眼太阳镜随意地架在头顶。一只手拿着绘有精美拉花的陶瓷咖啡杯，以 {argument name="expression" default="精致而慵懒的神情"} 注视着路人。亚麻衬衫上的自然褶皱，织物随风轻轻摆动的 3D 折痕，姿态放松而优雅。

[参考图像中特征与结构的精确应用（图像参考）]
脸部/表情：准确参考并还原 [参考图像] 中的面部结构、五官位置（眼型、鼻梁、嘴部）、皮肤质感以及慵懒眼神的神韵。
发型/发色：完全还原 [参考图像] 中的头发长度、发量、发梢走向及发色。
体型/结构：以 [参考图像] 中的颈肩线条、胸部厚度、躯干轮廓以及手部和手指长度为基础进行应用。

[空间/光影/氛围]
巴黎圣日耳曼德佩区（Saint-Germain-des-Prés）的历史街道和鲜艳的红色咖啡馆遮阳篷。柔和的午后阳光透过路边的树木，在桌面、她的皮肤和亚麻衬衫上投下斑驳美丽的光影（明暗对照法）。整体色调为温暖的自然色系，光线营造出巴黎咖啡馆特有的那种放松且精致的时间流逝感。

en.title: Night City Lace Halter Portrait
en.description: A photorealistic prompt for a woman in a white lace backless top on a city sidewalk at night, using a reference image for identity matching.
en.prompt:
A highly detailed photorealistic portrait of the person from the reference image, standing on a city sidewalk at night. 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, full-length vertical framing. Match the reference image exactly for gender, body type and proportions, overall build, skin tone and texture, facial features, hair, and all physical characteristics including chest and hip shape. Preserve the subject's identity and physique faithfully.

Pose: Shot from behind, full back view. She stands with her back to the camera and turns her head over her right shoulder, looking directly at the viewer with a soft, gentle expression. Her arms hang naturally at her sides. Weight settled evenly, slight arch in the lower back, long hair falling over one shoulder and down her back.

Outfit: {argument name="top style" default="A white lace halter-style backless top with floral embroidery"}, tied at the neck, leaving the entire back and shoulders bare. Long slender cords hang down the center of her back, finished with small decorative beaded tassels. Paired with {argument name="pants style" default="white high-waisted wide-leg pants"}: a fitted, smooth upper section with a lace-trimmed waistband, flowing into soft pleated, semi-sheer wide-leg bottoms with subtle tonal embroidery.

Background: {argument name="location" default="A nighttime urban street scene"} with illuminated streetlights, trees lining the paved walkway, distant vehicles with lights on, and soft ambient city glow creating a cinematic atmosphere with realistic lighting, shallow depth of field, and natural bokeh.

zh.title: 夜之城蕾丝挂脖肖像
zh.description: 一个用于生成夜间城市人行道上身着白色蕾丝露背上衣女性的超写实提示词，使用参考图进行身份匹配。
zh.prompt:
一张高度精细的超写实肖像，主体为参考图中的人物，站在夜间的城市人行道上。9:16 垂直纵横比，全身垂直构图。在性别、体型与比例、整体骨架、肤色与质感、面部特征、发型以及包括胸部和臀部形状在内的所有身体特征上，均需与参考图完全一致。忠实地保留主体的身份和体格。

姿势：从背后拍摄，全背视图。她背对镜头站立，头部向右肩上方转动，以柔和温婉的表情直视镜头。双臂自然垂在身体两侧。重心均匀分布，下背部略微弯曲，长发垂在一侧肩头并顺着背部散落。

服装：{argument name="top style" default="一件带有花卉刺绣的白色蕾丝挂脖式露背上衣"}，在颈部系带，露出整个背部和肩膀。长而纤细的系带垂在背部中央，末端饰有精致的串珠流苏。搭配 {argument name="pants style" default="白色高腰阔腿裤"}：上部剪裁合身平整，腰部带有蕾丝饰边，下部为柔软褶皱的半透明阔腿设计，并配有细腻的同色系刺绣。

背景：{argument name="location" default="夜间城市街道场景"}，配有照明路灯、人行道两旁的树木、远处亮着车灯的车辆，以及营造出电影般氛围的柔和城市环境光，具有逼真的光影效果、浅景深和自然的背景虚化。

en.title: Hyperrealistic Cinematic Stonehenge Portrait
en.description: A sophisticated prompt for generating a hyperrealistic, cinematic portrait of a woman at Stonehenge during sunset, focusing on natural lighting, silk textures, and ancient atmosphere.
en.prompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic portrait, golden twilight light, {argument name="subject" default="East Asian woman"} standing at {argument name="setting" default="Stonehenge grassland"}, slightly to the right, full body shot, turning back three-quarters with the left shoulder facing the camera, expression calm, mysterious, and confident with lips slightly parted. Warm white skin, slender figure, deep almond eyes with soft brows, translucent peach-pink blush, fine eyeliner, neutral eyeshadow, and rose lips; long dark brown wavy hair flowing down the back, stray hairs on the left blowing in the wind, warm rim lighting. {argument name="attire" default="ivory white silk slip dress reaching the ground"}, extremely low draped open back trailing onto the grass, satin pearlescent champagne highlights, the back draping close to the feet, right arm at the side, left arm partially hidden by the torso. High monolith occupies the left foreground with gray-brown stone surface lichen cracks; three stone towers stand isolated behind, horizontal lintel on the right, another stone circle cropped on the right edge; scattered fallen boulders, olive grassland with mossy pits and long shadows, hazy distant fields. Sunset sky occupies half, sun low in the upper left, golden halo with thin clouds in warm peach, amber, cream, smoky gray, and light purple, warm light beams through gaps, transitioning to blue-gray in the upper right. Light source behind and to the left, creating golden rim light along hair, shoulders, arms, back, waist, and dress, frontal fill light for the face; warm edge light and cold shadows on stone surfaces, long shadows in the lower right. Waist height, full frame 50–70mm, f/2.8–f/4; sharp near stone textures, softened distant stones, cinematic depth and film grain. Color palette: ivory silk, warm skin tones, olive grass, gray-brown stone, gold amber, peach clouds, blue-gray shadows; ancient, romantic, mysterious, and luxurious atmosphere. No text, logos, watermarks, extra people, modern architecture/fences, artificial lighting, deformed limbs, distorted stones, plastic skin, oversaturated orange tones, or artificial HDR.

zh.title: 超写实电影感巨石阵人像
zh.description: 一个用于生成超写实、电影感巨石阵日落时分女性人像的精细提示词，聚焦于自然光影、丝绸质感及古老氛围。
zh.prompt: 超写实电影感人像，金色暮光，{argument name="subject" default="东亚女性"} 站在 {argument name="setting" default="巨石阵草地"}，略微偏右，全身照，背身四分之三侧向镜头，左肩朝向相机，表情平静、神秘且自信，双唇微启。白皙温暖的肤色，身材修长，深邃的杏眼配以柔和的眉毛，半透明的桃粉色腮红，精致的眼线，中性色眼影，玫瑰色双唇；深棕色长卷发垂于背部，左侧几缕发丝随风飘动，温暖的轮廓光。{argument name="attire" default="象牙白丝绸吊带长裙"}，极低的大露背设计拖曳在草地上，缎面珍珠香槟色高光，裙摆垂坠至脚踝，右臂垂于身侧，左臂部分被躯干遮挡。左侧前景为高耸的巨石，表面有灰褐色石纹和苔藓裂缝；后方矗立着三座孤立的石塔，右侧有横梁，右边缘可见另一个石圈的局部；散落的倒塌巨石，橄榄绿草地布满苔藓坑和长长的阴影，远处田野朦胧。夕阳天空占据画面一半，太阳位于左上方低处，金色光晕映衬着暖桃色、琥珀色、奶油色、烟灰色和淡紫色的薄云，暖光从缝隙中穿透，向右上角过渡为蓝灰色。光源位于后方左侧，在头发、肩膀、手臂、背部、腰部和裙装边缘形成金色轮廓光，面部有正面补光；石材表面呈现暖色边缘光和冷色阴影，右下方有长长的投影。腰部高度拍摄，全画幅 50–70mm，f/2.8–f/4；近处石材纹理清晰，远处石块虚化，具有电影级景深和胶片颗粒感。调色板：象牙丝绸色、暖肤色、橄榄绿草地、灰褐色石材、金琥珀色、桃色云彩、蓝灰色阴影；氛围古老、浪漫、神秘且奢华。无文字、标志、水印、多余人物、现代建筑/围栏、人工照明、肢体畸形、石块扭曲、塑料感皮肤、过饱和橙色调或人工 HDR。

en.title: Natural Beach Sunset Portrait
en.description: A high-fidelity prompt for a natural, photorealistic beach portrait of an East Asian woman at sunset, emphasizing realistic skin textures and soft maritime lighting.
en.prompt: A young adult East Asian woman kneeling on a {argument name="setting" default="light beige towel spread on a beach"}, shot from above the head to near the calves. The subject is centered slightly to the right, body turned slightly to the left, kneeling with knees bent, one leg extended forward and the other tucked under; upper body leaning forward naturally, arms straight, hands supporting her on the towel. She looks directly at the camera with a quiet, soft, slightly lazy gaze, lips naturally parted, no obvious smile. She has a delicate oval face, almond deep brown eyes, natural thin brows, a slender nose bridge, and light nude-pink lips. Extremely light makeup, only natural lashes, fine eyeliner, soft blush, and moist lip color. Skin is fair and warm-toned, retaining real pores, fine vellus hair, slight skin tone variations, natural sweat, and sunlight highlights, no plastic skin smoothing. Long dark brown hair flowing naturally with a slight damp look and soft waves; light wispy bangs in front, some hair strands blown by the sea breeze across cheeks, shoulders, and chest, hair edges illuminated by the sunset. She wears a {argument name="attire" default="light sand, nude beige thin-strap triangle bikini"}, matte soft fabric, simple cut, color close to skin tone but with clear edges, natural fit, opaque. Some sand and moisture on the swimwear and skin. Background is a quiet beach, with light blue-green sea and gentle waves in the back left, dark islands or mountains in the distance, and a blurred coastline in the back right. The sun is at a low angle in the back right, creating warm golden side-backlighting, hair rim lighting, and highlights on shoulders, neck, and arms, with bright sparkling spots on the sea. Sky is a gradient of light gray-blue and cream gold, overall low saturation, low contrast, warm and transparent. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, close-up shot slightly below eye level, shallow depth of field, clear eyes, soft sea blur, real textures of sand, towel, skin, and swimwear, slight ISO 200 film grain, soft highlight bloom, a mix of Japanese portraiture and high-end lifestyle photography, photorealistic. Avoid: underage features, nudity, exposure, transparent swimwear, erotic poses, CG, anime, excessive skin smoothing, exaggerated body proportions, incorrect fingers, deformed legs/feet, stiff poses, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered tourists, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 自然海滩日落人像
zh.description: 一个用于生成自然、写实风格海滩人像的高保真提示词，以东亚女性为主角，强调真实的皮肤质感与柔和的海滨光影。
zh.prompt: 一位年轻的东亚女性跪在 {argument name="setting" default="铺在海滩上的浅米色毛巾"} 上，镜头从头顶上方拍摄至小腿附近。主体略微偏右，身体微向左转，双膝弯曲跪地，一条腿向前伸展，另一条腿向内收；上身自然前倾，双臂伸直，双手撑在毛巾上。她直视镜头，眼神安静、柔和且略带慵懒，双唇自然微张，没有明显的笑容。她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、深棕色的杏仁眼、自然的细眉、纤细的鼻梁和浅裸粉色的嘴唇。妆容极淡，仅有自然的睫毛、细眼线、柔和的腮红和水润的唇色。皮肤呈白皙暖色调，保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、细微的肤色差异、自然的汗水和阳光高光，无塑料感磨皮。深棕色长发自然垂落，带有轻微的湿润感和柔和的波浪卷；额前有稀疏的刘海，几缕发丝被海风吹拂在脸颊、肩膀和胸前，发丝边缘被日落光线照亮。她穿着 {argument name="attire" default="浅沙色、裸米色细肩带三角比基尼"}，哑光柔软面料，剪裁简约，颜色与肤色相近但边缘清晰，自然贴合，不透明。泳装和皮肤上带有少许沙粒和水汽。背景是安静的海滩，左后方是浅蓝绿色的海水和轻柔的海浪，远处有深色的岛屿或山脉，右后方是模糊的海岸线。太阳位于右后方低角度，营造出温暖的金色侧逆光，勾勒出头发的轮廓光，并在肩膀、颈部和手臂上形成高光，海面上闪烁着明亮的光斑。天空呈现浅灰蓝与奶油金的渐变色，整体低饱和度、低对比度，温暖而通透。摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8 光圈，略低于视平线的近景拍摄，浅景深，眼神清晰，海景虚化柔和，沙子、毛巾、皮肤和泳装的质感真实，带有轻微的 ISO 200 胶片颗粒感，柔和的高光溢出，融合了日系人像与高端生活方式摄影风格，照片级写实。避免：未成年特征、裸露、走光、透明泳装、色情姿势、CG、动漫、过度磨皮、夸张的身体比例、手指错误、腿部/脚部畸形、僵硬的姿势、强烈的 HDR、过度锐化、杂乱的游客、文字、水印、Logo。

en.title: Moody Black Studio Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating a moody, fine-art studio portrait of an East Asian woman against a pure black background with soft, dramatic lighting.
en.prompt: A young adult East Asian woman standing in front of a {argument name="background" default="pure black studio background"}, the frame is a close-up to half-body portrait, centered slightly to the right. The body is turned two-thirds toward the left, with the left shoulder closer to the lens, head gently turning back to look at the camera in a quiet, natural glance. Head tilted slightly to the right, chin slightly down, expression calm, restrained, slightly detached and melancholic, lips naturally parted, no obvious smile. She has a delicate oval face, almond deep brown eyes, natural thin brows, a slender nose bridge, and light nude-pink lips. Minimalist makeup, only fine eyeliner, natural lashes, light gray-brown eyeshadow, and low-saturation blush. Skin is fair and neutral-cool, retaining real pores, fine vellus hair, slight skin tone variations, and natural highlights, no plastic skin smoothing. She has extremely long, thick dark black hair, flowing naturally with soft waves and a sense of weight. Most of the hair extends from the crown and shoulders to the bottom left, with rich layers; a few stray hairs across the forehead, eyes, and cheeks for a natural, imperfect look. She wears a {argument name="attire" default="black minimalist thin-strap camisole"}, soft matte knit or silk fabric, simple neckline showing neck and collarbones. Wearing an {argument name="accessory" default="ultra-fine silver necklace with a small pendant"}, subtle and non-intrusive. Background is completely black or very deep dark gray, no visible objects. Low-key studio lighting: soft main light from the upper left front, gently illuminating the face, eyes, nose bridge, lips, left shoulder, and arm; most of the right side of the face and body in soft shadow. Only very weak rim separation between black hair and background, no strong rim light. Overall low saturation, low contrast, rich shadows, featuring cool gray-blacks, natural skin tones, and subtle silver layers. Photography style: 85mm or 105mm portrait lens, f/2, shallow depth of field, clear eyes and face, soft hair edges, real optical imaging, slight ISO 400 film grain, delicate shadow noise, Black Pro-Mist 1/8 slight softening, fine-art portrait, moody editorial portrait, photorealistic. Avoid: frontal ID photo pose, exaggerated expressions, heavy makeup, over-neat curls, plastic hair texture, strong rim lighting, gray background.

zh.title: 情绪感黑色影棚人像
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于在纯黑背景下创作一张光影柔和、具有戏剧感的情绪化艺术影棚人像，拍摄对象为一位东亚女性。
zh.prompt: 一位东亚年轻女性站在 {argument name="background" default="纯黑影棚背景"} 前，构图为近景至半身人像，略微偏右居中。身体向左转动三分之二，左肩靠近镜头，头部轻微回转，以安静、自然的目光注视镜头。头部微向右倾，下巴微收，表情冷静、克制，带有一丝疏离感和忧郁，双唇自然微张，没有明显的笑容。她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、深棕色杏眼、自然的细眉、纤细的鼻梁和浅裸粉色的双唇。妆容极简，仅有精致的眼线、自然的睫毛、浅灰棕色眼影和低饱和度腮红。肤色白皙且呈中性冷调，保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、轻微的肤色差异和自然的肤质高光，没有塑料感的磨皮效果。她拥有一头极长且浓密的乌黑秀发，自然垂落，带有柔和的波浪感和垂坠感。大部分头发从头顶和肩部延伸至左下方，层次丰富；额头、眼睛和脸颊处散落几缕发丝，营造出自然、不完美的质感。她身穿 {argument name="attire" default="黑色极简细肩带吊带衫"}，材质为柔软的哑光针织或丝绸，领口简洁，露出颈部和锁骨。佩戴着 {argument name="accessory" default="带有小吊坠的超细银项链"}，低调且不突兀。背景为全黑或极深暗灰色，无可见物体。低调影棚布光：左前方上方有柔和的主光，轻轻照亮面部、眼睛、鼻梁、嘴唇、左肩和手臂；右侧大部分面部和身体处于柔和的阴影中。黑色头发与背景之间仅有极弱的轮廓分离，没有强烈的轮廓光。整体低饱和度、低对比度，阴影丰富，呈现出冷灰黑色调、自然的肤色和细腻的银色层次。摄影风格：85mm 或 105mm 人像镜头，f/2 光圈，浅景深，眼睛和面部清晰，发丝边缘柔和，真实光学成像，轻微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，细腻的阴影噪点，Black Pro-Mist 1/8 柔光滤镜，艺术人像，情绪化编辑人像，照片级真实感。避免：正面证件照姿势、夸张的表情、浓妆、过于整齐的卷发、塑料感的头发质感、强烈的轮廓光、灰色背景。

en.title: Elegant Hotel Bedroom Portrait
en.description: A sophisticated prompt for an elegant, photorealistic portrait of an East Asian woman sitting in a luxury hotel bedroom with soft, warm lighting.
en.prompt: A young adult East Asian woman sitting on a {argument name="setting" default="white bed in a high-end hotel bedroom"}, shot from above the head to mid-thigh. Subject is centered slightly to the left, body slightly sideways and leaning forward, legs together and angled toward the bottom left, hands relaxed and folded on the knees. Shoulders naturally down, head tilted slightly to the left, looking directly at the camera with a soft, quiet gaze and a subtle natural smile, lips relaxed and closed. She has a delicate oval face, deep brown almond eyes, natural thin brows, a slender nose bridge, and coral nude-pink lips. Light makeup, skin is fair and warm-toned, retaining real pores, fine vellus hair, slight skin tone variations, and natural sebum highlights, no plastic skin smoothing. Long dark black hair, center-parted or slightly off-center, smoothly falling to chest and waist, thick volume with a few loose strands. She wears a {argument name="attire" default="white or cream-white slim-fit knit short dress"}, fine vertical ribbing, long sleeves, wrap-style deep V-neck, neckline naturally slipping to the shoulders to show collarbones and neck; hem reaches upper thighs, soft form-fitting fabric with real stretch textures and natural folds, overall subtle, elegant, and cozy. Background is a modern hotel bedroom: white pillows and fluffy bedding, gray-brown upholstered headboard, light gray wall panels; on the right is a wooden nightstand and a warm yellow lamp with a soft cream-white shade providing warm ambient light. Main light is soft natural window light from the front-left, with the bedside lamp providing warm-toned side-back fill, creating a cold-warm balance. Overall low saturation, low contrast, cream white and warm beige tones, soft shadows, natural skin tones. Photography style: 50mm or 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, slight high-angle shot, shallow depth of field, clear eyes, soft background blur, real knit and bedding textures, slight ISO 400 film grain, soft highlight bloom, photorealistic. Avoid: CG, anime, illustration, excessive skin smoothing, heavy makeup, exaggerated figure, incorrect fingers, deformed arms, stiff poses, excessive exposure, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered room, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 优雅酒店卧室人像
zh.description: 一个用于生成优雅、照片级真实感人像的精细提示词，描绘了一位东亚女性坐在豪华酒店卧室中，光线柔和温暖。
zh.prompt: 一位年轻的东亚女性坐在 {argument name="setting" default="高端酒店卧室的白色床上"}，镜头视角从头部上方到大腿中部。主体略微偏左，身体微侧并向前倾，双腿并拢斜向左下方，双手放松交叠在膝盖上。双肩自然下垂，头部微向左倾，直视镜头，眼神柔和安静，带着淡淡的自然微笑，双唇放松闭合。她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸，深棕色杏眼，自然的细眉，鼻梁修长，珊瑚裸粉色嘴唇。淡妆，肤色白皙且呈暖色调，保留真实的毛孔、细微的绒毛、轻微的肤色差异以及自然的皮脂光泽，无塑料感磨皮。深黑色长发，中分或微偏分，顺滑地垂至胸前和腰间，发量浓密，带有几缕碎发。她穿着 {argument name="attire" default="白色或米白色修身针织短裙"}，带有细竖条纹，长袖，裹身式深 V 领，领口自然滑落至肩部，露出锁骨和颈部；裙摆垂至大腿上部，柔软的贴身面料呈现真实的弹力纹理和自然褶皱，整体风格低调、优雅且舒适。背景为现代酒店卧室：白色枕头和蓬松的床上用品，灰棕色软包床头板，浅灰色墙板；右侧是一个木质床头柜和一盏暖黄色台灯，柔和的米白色灯罩营造出温暖的环境光。主光源为左前方柔和的自然窗光，床头灯提供暖色调的侧后方补光，形成冷暖平衡。整体低饱和度，低对比度，奶油白与暖米色调，阴影柔和，肤色自然。摄影风格：50mm 或 85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8，轻微高角度拍摄，浅景深，眼神清晰，背景虚化柔和，真实的针织和床品纹理，轻微 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，柔和的高光晕染，照片级真实感。避免：CG、动漫、插画、过度磨皮、浓妆、夸张的身材、手指错误、手臂变形、姿势僵硬、过度曝光、强 HDR、过度锐化、杂乱的房间、文字、水印、Logo。

en.title: Aria Monroe Urban Action Scene
en.description: A cinematic video prompt for a Korean action-style sequence featuring a female protagonist in a sunlit urban alleyway.
en.prompt: Cinematic Korean action sequence in a narrow sunlit urban alleyway lined with brick buildings, air conditioning units, wooden pallets, and a prominent GS25 convenience store. A young athletic woman with long blonde hair tied in a high ponytail wears a form-fitting pink long-sleeve athletic crop top with a deep square neckline and matching fitted pink athletic leggings paired with clean pink athletic sneakers. Her face, neck, and upper chest have a light sheen of sweat, emphasizing that she has just finished training, while her expression remains calm, focused, and determined. She faces a group of aggressive young men wearing black tracksuits and hoodies. Without hesitation, she charges forward using precise, powerful martial arts techniques with lightning-fast punches, spinning kicks, elbow strikes, knee attacks, sweeps, and perfectly executed throws, taking down each attacker one by one with fluid, realistic choreography. The handheld camera follows closely through the narrow alley with dynamic movement, subtle camera shake, realistic motion blur, and rapid perspective shifts that heighten the intensity of every impact. Bodies crash onto the pavement as the fight escalates with cinematic momentum. In the background, three Korean schoolgirls in neat school uniforms stand near the GS25 entrance, watching the confrontation in stunned silence. Bright natural daylight casts crisp shadows across the brick walls and stacked wooden pallets, highlighting dust, debris, and realistic environmental details. The sequence concludes as the final attacker collapses beside the stacked pallets. The woman pauses, calmly adjusts her fighting stance, straightens her pink athletic crop top, and confidently walks away down the sunlit alley. Hyper-realistic live-action style, Korean action film aesthetic, high-energy choreography, sharp facial detail, physically accurate movement, cinematic handheld camera work, natural lighting, realistic textures, and feature-film quality.

zh.title: Aria Monroe 城市动作场景
zh.description: 一段电影质感的韩式动作序列视频提示词，主角为一名在阳光明媚的城市小巷中的女性。
zh.prompt: 电影质感的韩式动作序列，场景位于一条阳光明媚的狭窄城市小巷，两旁是砖墙建筑、空调外机、木托盘，以及一家显眼的 GS25 便利店。一位年轻健美的女性留着长金发，扎着高马尾，身穿修身的粉色长袖运动短款上衣，领口为深方领，搭配同色系的粉色紧身运动裤和干净的粉色运动鞋。她的脸部、颈部和上胸部带着一层淡淡的汗水，突显出她刚刚结束训练，但神情依然冷静、专注且坚定。她面对着一群身穿黑色运动服和连帽衫的挑衅青年。她毫不犹豫地冲上前去，运用精准、强力的武术技巧，以迅雷不及掩耳之势打出直拳、旋踢、肘击、膝撞、扫腿和完美的过肩摔，动作流畅且写实，将每名攻击者逐一击倒。手持摄像机在狭窄的小巷中紧密跟随，通过动态移动、细微的镜头抖动、逼真的运动模糊以及快速的视角切换，增强了每一次撞击的紧张感。随着战斗升级，身体撞击地面的声音与电影般的节奏感交织在一起。背景中，三名穿着整洁校服的韩国女学生站在 GS25 入口附近，惊愕地注视着这场对峙。明亮的自然光在砖墙和堆叠的木托盘上投下清晰的阴影，突显出灰尘、碎片和逼真的环境细节。序列结束时，最后一名攻击者倒在堆叠的木托盘旁。女子停下脚步，冷静地调整战斗姿态，整理了一下粉色运动短款上衣，随后自信地沿着阳光明媚的小巷走远。超写实真人电影风格，韩式动作片美学，高能量动作编排，清晰的面部细节，符合物理规律的动作，电影级手持摄影，自然光照明，逼真的纹理，具备长篇电影的质量。

en.title: Minimalist Bedroom Lifestyle Portrait
en.description: A natural lifestyle photography prompt for a bedroom setting, focusing on soft lighting and realistic textures.
en.prompt: Medium shot, {argument name="age" default="23-year-old"} East Asian woman, soft natural features, hair loosely down with a few strands across her cheek. {argument name="clothing" default="Dusty lavender-grey lace set beneath an open oversized white shirt"}, sitting on the edge of a bed folding back the duvet, vertical 3:4 frame with subject filling about 55% of a {argument name="bedroom style" default="minimalist bedroom"}. Bedside lamp casting a warm glow against dusk light filtering through sheer curtains, gentle shadow transition across the bedding. Photographic texture and quality: subtle ISO 400 film grain, natural skin subsurface scattering, faint stray hairs near her collarbone. Preserve: lace pattern, duvet texture. Avoid: AI-smoothed skin, unnaturally sharp fabric folds.

zh.title: 极简主义卧室生活方式人像
zh.description: 一个用于卧室场景的自然生活方式摄影提示词，侧重于柔和的光线和逼真的质感。
zh.prompt: 中景镜头，{argument name="age" default="23 岁"} 东亚女性，柔和的自然面部特征，头发自然垂下，几缕发丝散落在脸颊上。{argument name="clothing" default="白色超大款衬衫内搭灰紫色蕾丝套装"}，坐在床边掀开被子，3:4 竖构图，主体占据约 55% 的 {argument name="bedroom style" default="极简主义卧室"}。床头灯投射出温暖的光芒，与透过薄纱窗帘的暮光交相辉映，床品上呈现出柔和的阴影过渡。摄影质感与质量：细腻的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，自然的皮肤次表面散射，锁骨附近有淡淡的碎发。保留：蕾丝图案、被子质感。避免：AI 磨皮后的平滑皮肤、不自然的锐利织物褶皱。

en.title: Reality and Manga Mural Fusion
en.description: A creative prompt designed to generate a scene where a real-life subject interacts with a manga-style mural version of themselves, incorporating a pet cat into both worlds.
en.prompt: Use the attached face reference image as the ONLY facial identity source. Preserve the exact face, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, hairstyle, and overall identity with extremely high accuracy. Do not change the person's identity. Only replace the face with the referenced face while keeping the pose, clothing, composition, and environment exactly as described. Create an ultra-realistic full-body portrait of the {argument name="subject identity" default="subject crouching on the floor beside a gray-and-white cat wearing a small checkered bandana"}. The subject smiles gently while looking at the cat with a warm, affectionate expression. Behind them is a warm cream-colored wall illuminated by soft golden window light. On the wall, create a large hand-drawn manga illustration of the same girl leaning forward and gently touching the cat's paw with one finger. The manga cat should mirror the real cat, standing on its hind legs while reaching out with one paw. The illustration should seamlessly blend into the wall, creating a magical interaction between reality and manga art. The subject wears {argument name="clothing" default="an oversized charcoal-gray zip hoodie over a white T-shirt, loose blue jeans, and beige-and-black casual sneakers"}. The {argument name="manga style" default="manga drawing features elegant black ink line art, pencil sketch textures, expressive anime eyes, soft cross-hatching, flowing hair, realistic proportions, and detailed shading"}. Soft golden-hour sunlight streaming through a window, realistic shadows, cinematic indoor photography, eye-level composition, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, photorealistic skin, realistic hair strands, highly detailed wall texture, HDR lighting, masterpiece, editorial lifestyle photography, manga mural illusion, ultra-detailed, premium quality, 8K, extremely realistic.

zh.title: 现实与漫画壁画的融合
zh.description: 一个创意提示词，旨在生成一个现实人物与漫画风格壁画中的自己互动的场景，并将一只宠物猫融入两个世界。
zh.prompt: 请仅使用随附的面部参考图作为面部身份来源。极其精准地保留原始面部特征、面部比例、眼睛形状、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、肤色、发型以及整体身份。请勿更改人物身份。仅替换为参考图中的面部，同时保持姿势、服装、构图和环境与描述完全一致。创作一张超写实的全身肖像，主角为 {argument name="subject identity" default="蹲在地上，身边有一只戴着小格子围巾的灰白相间猫咪的女孩"}。主角温柔地微笑着，带着温暖而深情的表情看着猫咪。背景是一面温暖的奶油色墙壁，被柔和的金色窗光照亮。在墙上，创作一幅大型手绘漫画插图，画中同样的女孩正向前倾身，用一根手指轻轻触碰猫咪的爪子。漫画中的猫应与现实中的猫相呼应，用后腿站立并伸出一只爪子。插图应与墙壁无缝融合，在现实与漫画艺术之间创造出神奇的互动。主角穿着 {argument name="clothing" default="一件超大号炭灰色拉链连帽衫，内搭白色 T 恤，下身穿着宽松的蓝色牛仔裤和米黑色休闲运动鞋"}。该 {argument name="manga style" default="漫画绘图具有优雅的黑色墨水线条、铅笔素描质感、富有表现力的动漫眼睛、柔和的排线、飘逸的头发、写实的比例和细腻的阴影"}。柔和的黄金时刻阳光透过窗户射入，逼真的阴影，电影级室内摄影，平视构图，50mm 镜头，浅景深，照片级真实皮肤，逼真的发丝，高度细腻的墙壁纹理，HDR 光效，杰作，编辑类生活方式摄影，漫画壁画错觉，超细节，优质，8K，极致写实。

en.title: Museum Art Installation Fashion Editorial
en.description: A high-fashion editorial prompt set in a contemporary art museum, featuring floating glass frames and luxury couture.
en.prompt: An award-winning ultra-luxury fashion editorial photographed inside a breathtaking contemporary art museum where multiple crystal-clear floating glass frames hover effortlessly in mid-air at varying heights and depths, creating an immersive three-dimensional visual installation. Each transparent frame showcases the same exceptionally beautiful {argument name="model origin" default="young European female"} model with refined facial features, luminous skin, expressive blue-green eyes, and elegant natural makeup, captured in completely different haute couture looks and confident editorial poses. Every frame presents a unique luxury fashion story featuring {argument name="clothing type" default="sculptural gowns, modern architectural tailoring, flowing silk, satin, organza, embellished crystal couture, premium textured fabrics, elegant capes, asymmetric silhouettes, sophisticated monochrome styling, and contemporary high-fashion accessories"}. Her hairstyles subtly vary between polished sleek hair, soft waves, elegant updos, and modern runway-inspired looks, giving every portrait its own identity while maintaining the same model. The floating glass panels overlap naturally in perspective, creating dramatic cinematic depth, soft optical refractions, delicate prism effects, and realistic edge highlights. Gentle reflections dance across an immaculate mirror-polished white marble floor, enhancing the illusion of infinite space without becoming distracting. The gallery architecture is {argument name="architecture style" default="minimalist yet monumental"}, featuring soaring ceilings, museum-grade proportions, sculptural concrete walls, hidden architectural lighting, oversized skylights, and abundant soft natural daylight streaming through the space. Warm ivory, champagne gold, pearl white, soft beige, and subtle warm grey tones create an atmosphere of timeless European luxury. The composition is perfectly balanced with layered foreground, midground, and background elements, producing exceptional depth and visual richness. Every glass frame appears to float weightlessly, casting soft realistic shadows and subtle reflections while preserving complete transparency. Ultra-premium Vogue Italia editorial aesthetic, luxury campaign photography, museum-quality fine art composition, cinematic lighting, hyper-realistic DSLR photography, Canon EOS R5, RF 85mm f/1.2L lens, f/1.8, HDR, ultra-shallow depth of field, tack-sharp focus on the floating frames, exquisite skin detail, lifelike fabric textures, realistic glass physics, volumetric light rays, global illumination, soft ambient occlusion, extremely high dynamic range, photorealistic, masterpiece quality, 8K, no text, no logos, no watermark.

zh.title: 博物馆艺术装置时尚大片
zh.description: 一组以当代艺术博物馆为背景的高级时尚大片提示词，包含悬浮玻璃框架与奢华高级定制时装。
zh.prompt: 一组屡获殊荣的超奢华时尚大片，拍摄于令人惊叹的当代艺术博物馆内。多个晶莹剔透的悬浮玻璃框架以不同的高度和深度在半空中轻盈漂浮，营造出沉浸式的三维视觉装置。每个透明框架中都展示着同一位极其美丽的 {argument name="model origin" default="年轻欧洲女性"} 模特，她拥有精致的五官、透亮的肌肤、富有表现力的蓝绿色双眸和优雅的自然妆容，以完全不同的高级定制造型和自信的时尚姿态出镜。每个框架都呈现出一个独特的奢华时尚故事，包含 {argument name="clothing type" default="雕塑感礼服、现代建筑剪裁、飘逸丝绸、缎面、欧根纱、缀满水晶的高定服饰、优质纹理面料、优雅斗篷、不对称廓形、精致的单色造型以及当代高级时尚配饰"}。她的发型在光洁顺滑、柔和波浪、优雅盘发和现代秀场风格之间微妙变化，使每张肖像既保持模特一致性，又拥有独特的个性。悬浮的玻璃面板在透视中自然重叠，营造出极具戏剧性的电影感深度、柔和的光学折射、精致的棱镜效果以及逼真的边缘高光。柔和的倒影在洁净的镜面抛光白色大理石地面上舞动，增强了无限空间的错觉，且不会喧宾夺主。画廊建筑风格为 {argument name="architecture style" default="极简而宏伟"}，拥有高耸的天花板、博物馆级的比例、雕塑感的混凝土墙面、隐藏式建筑照明、超大天窗以及大量柔和的自然光倾泻而入。温暖的象牙白、香槟金、珍珠白、柔和米色和微妙的暖灰色调营造出永恒的欧洲奢华氛围。构图在前景、中景和背景元素之间达到了完美平衡，产生了卓越的深度和丰富的视觉层次。每个玻璃框架看起来都轻盈悬浮，投下柔和逼真的阴影并产生微妙的反射，同时保持了完全的透明度。超高端 Vogue Italia 杂志编辑审美，奢华广告大片摄影，博物馆级艺术构图，电影级布光，超写实 DSLR 摄影，Canon EOS R5，RF 85mm f/1.2L 镜头，f/1.8，HDR，超浅景深，悬浮框架焦点极其锐利，精致的皮肤细节，栩栩如生的面料质感，真实的玻璃物理效果，体积光，全局光照，柔和环境光遮蔽，极高动态范围，照片级真实感，大师级品质，8K，无文字，无 Logo，无水印。

en.title: 3D CG Oriental Fantasy Girl Portrait
en.description: A detailed 3D CG rendering of an oriental fantasy girl with mint green hair, featuring high-quality PBR materials and a dreamlike garden background.
en.prompt:
9:16 vertical orientation, high-precision 3D CG oriental fantasy 'sweet-cool' girl character poster, 3D CG oriental fantasy girl character portrait, anime-style 3D CG character art, semi-realistic 3D character render, full body portrait. The main subject is a young adult female oriental fantasy character, visual age approximately 20–24, with a sweet, lively, energetic, and dreamlike temperament with a touch of little-devil-like cuteness. It is not a flat illustration but a high-completion 3D CG character rendering with exquisite modeling, realistic material expression, transparent colors, soft lighting, and high-end virtual character poster quality.

The character has an exquisite and sweet oriental beauty face, a small oval face, with fair and delicate skin featuring subtle transparency and soft coloring. Eyes are large and bright, with a mixture of pink-purple and light rose-purple, featuring delicate glass highlights and a gentle, agile expression with a hint of playfulness. Eyelashes are long, eye makeup is clear and natural, nose is delicate and small, and lips are soft in a low-saturation cherry blossom pink with a light smile.

The hairstyle is mint blue-green long hair, full and smooth with high-precision hair modeling and bright luster, naturally flowing to the waist with slight curls at the ends. Light wispy bangs cover the forehead, and soft hair on the sides frames the face. The character has delicate light-colored horns, pointed ears, and a slender tail, enhancing the oriental fantasy elf/little devil vibe. A purple bow headpiece and small fantasy decorations are worn, with consistent and exquisite details.

The clothing retains the modern 'sweet-cool' sense and is adjusted to a more refined 3D CG oriental fantasy everyday look: the top is a light pink short hooded sweatshirt with light purple cuffs, purple bow ties, and a semi-transparent heart decoration on the chest, featuring realistic fabric texture; the bottom is light blue ultra-low-waist denim shorts, adjusted to a tighter, more form-fitting wrap design where the denim tightly hugs the waist, hips, and upper thighs. The edges of the shorts slightly indent the skin, creating natural soft flesh-like ripples, especially at the waist, hips, and thighs to show a tight, supportive effect reflecting a realistic denim material expression rather than a loose outline. This highlights the slender waist while reflecting the realistic wrapping of the shorts around the hips and thighs.

Legs are paired with white slouch socks or soft long socks, with purple bows on the cuffs and shoes. A purple leg ring decoration is worn on one thigh, which is clearly tightened against the skin, creating visible soft pressure marks and slight bulges around it, while remaining aesthetic and delicate. Shoes are a mix of white and light purple in a sweet fantasy style. The overall look is sweet, fresh, and playful with a slight oriental fantasy idol feel.

The pose is a natural standing or slight walking posture, one leg slightly forward, body slightly turned, hands hanging naturally or swinging lightly, overall agile and friendly like a young idol. Full-body proportions are slender and balanced, showing natural youthful vitality.

Remove the ring and musical notes from the original reference; no flat background decorations, no floating notes, no geometric rings. The background is changed to a dreamy oriental fantasy scene: a garden courtyard / elf flower room / fantasy corridor surrounded by cherry blossoms and hydrangeas in soft pink-purple and mint tones. Elements include white jade railings, light flower vines, light-colored stone paths, dreamlike flower clusters, floating shimmers, thin mist, and faint pavilions or glass flower houses in the distance, looking like an exquisite oriental fantasy secret realm. The background should be bright, clean, and transparent with rich layers and high-end spatial awareness.

Lighting uses soft and bright high-key dreamlike lighting, face is clear and transparent, with delicate highlights on hair strands, shoulders, skirt edges, and sock folds. Skin, hair, fabric, denim, bows, shoes, and accessories all have realistic and clear PBR material expressions. Colors are mainly light pink, mint green, light purple, milk white, and light blue. The image is sweet, exquisite, fresh, and dreamlike, with the quality of a high-end collectible 3D CG oriental fantasy girl character poster.

high detail 3D CG render, Unreal Engine quality, Octane render look, cinematic soft lighting, PBR materials, subsurface scattering skin, realistic hair strands, pastel fantasy garden background, elegant oriental fantasy vibe, mint green long hair, small horns, elf ears, cute tail, pink cropped hoodie, denim shorts, white leg warmers, purple bows, dreamy atmosphere, volumetric light, cinematic depth of field, soft bloom, ultra detailed, polished anime realism, premium virtual character portrait

zh.title: 3D CG 东方奇幻少女肖像
zh.description: 一张精细的 3D CG 渲染图，描绘了一位拥有薄荷绿长发的东方奇幻少女，采用高质量 PBR 材质，背景为梦幻花园。
zh.prompt:
9:16 竖屏构图，高精度 3D CG 东方奇幻“甜酷”少女角色海报，3D CG 东方奇幻少女角色肖像，动漫风格 3D CG 角色艺术，半写实 3D 角色渲染，全身肖像。主体为一位 20-24 岁左右的年轻东方奇幻女性角色，气质甜美、活泼、充满活力且梦幻，带有一丝小恶魔般的可爱感。非扁平插画，而是高完成度的 3D CG 角色渲染，建模精致，材质表现真实，色彩通透，光影柔和，具备高端虚拟角色海报质感。

角色拥有精致甜美的东方美人面孔，小巧的鹅蛋脸，皮肤白皙细腻，带有微妙的通透感和柔和的色调。眼睛明亮大方，呈现粉紫色与浅玫瑰紫的混合色，带有精致的玻璃质感高光，眼神温柔灵动，透着一丝俏皮。睫毛修长，眼妆清透自然，鼻梁小巧精致，嘴唇呈低饱和度的樱花粉色，带着淡淡的微笑。

发型为薄荷蓝绿色长发，发量丰盈顺滑，高精度发丝建模，光泽明亮，自然垂落至腰间，发梢微卷。额前有轻薄的空气刘海，两侧柔顺的发丝修饰脸型。角色长有精致的浅色角、尖耳朵和纤细的尾巴，增强了东方奇幻精灵/小恶魔的氛围。佩戴紫色蝴蝶结头饰和小巧的奇幻装饰，细节统一且精致。

服装保留了现代“甜酷”感，并调整为更精致的 3D CG 东方奇幻日常装：上身是浅粉色短款连帽卫衣，配有浅紫色袖口、紫色蝴蝶结和胸前半透明心形装饰，呈现真实的织物纹理；下身是浅蓝色超低腰牛仔短裤，调整为更紧身、更贴合的包裹设计，牛仔布紧紧包裹腰部、臀部和大腿上部。短裤边缘轻微勒入皮肤，产生自然的软肉褶皱感，特别是在腰部、臀部和大腿处，展现出紧致的支撑效果，体现出真实的牛仔材质表现，而非松垮的轮廓。这突显了纤细的腰身，同时反映了短裤对臀部和大腿的真实包裹感。

腿部搭配白色堆堆袜或柔软的长袜，袜口和鞋子上装饰有紫色蝴蝶结。大腿处佩戴紫色腿环装饰，紧贴皮肤，产生明显的软肉压痕和轻微的隆起，同时保持美感与精致。鞋子为白色与浅紫色混合的甜美奇幻风格。整体造型甜美、清新、俏皮，带有一丝东方奇幻偶像感。

姿势为自然的站姿或轻微行走姿态，一腿微前，身体微转，双手自然下垂或轻微摆动，整体灵动友好，如同年轻偶像。全身比例纤细匀称，展现出自然的青春活力。

移除原参考图中的圆环和音符；无扁平背景装饰，无漂浮音符，无几何圆环。背景更换为梦幻的东方奇幻场景：花园庭院 / 精灵花房 / 奇幻长廊，周围环绕着粉紫色和薄荷色调的樱花与绣球花。元素包括白玉栏杆、轻盈的花藤、浅色石径、梦幻花丛、漂浮的微光、薄雾，远处隐约可见亭台或玻璃花房，宛如精致的东方奇幻秘境。背景明亮、干净、通透，层次丰富，具有高端的空间感。

光影采用柔和明亮的高调梦幻光效，面部清晰通透，发丝、肩部、裙边和袜褶处有精致的高光。皮肤、头发、织物、牛仔、蝴蝶结、鞋子和配饰均具备真实清晰的 PBR 材质表现。色彩以浅粉、薄荷绿、浅紫、奶白和浅蓝为主。画面甜美、精致、清新且梦幻，具备高端收藏级 3D CG 东方奇幻少女角色海报的品质。

en.title: Lifestyle Blog Style Food Photography
en.description: Prompts for creating cozy, Instagram-style food photography featuring detailed meals with handwritten annotations and doodles.
en.prompt:
A cozy restaurant table filled with a vibrant {argument name="cuisine" default="Taiwanese"} meal, shot in warm natural lighting. A large bowl of {argument name="main dish" default="braised beef noodle soup"} with wide noodles, tender beef chunks, bok choy, and green onions sits in the foreground. Surrounding dishes include a bowl of rice topped with raw egg yolk, seaweed, kimchi, and chopped vegetables; a plate of {argument name="side dish" default="Taiwanese fried chicken"} and tofu with greens; stir-fried water spinach with garlic; and a small dish of marinated vegetables. A tall elegant glass dessert with shrimp salad layered inside stands in the center. Wooden table surface, ceramic bowls, and a teapot in the background create a homely aesthetic. Handwritten-style Chinese text annotations and doodles are scattered around the dishes, adding a playful, lifestyle-blog feel. Soft depth of field, warm tones, high detail, food photography style.

2.A top-down view of a neatly arranged Japanese bento box on a wooden table. The bento is a black lacquered box with red interior compartments. Inside are golden-brown crispy karaage (Japanese fried chicken), plump mutton gyoza dumplings, fluffy white rice topped with colorful furikake seasoning, neatly sliced tamagoyaki (Japanese rolled omelette), and bright red fukujinzuke pickles in the center.
The scene has a warm, cozy aesthetic with soft natural lighting. Hand-drawn doodles and annotations in white are overlaid around the food, including hearts, sparkles, arrows, and handwritten Japanese and English labels describing each item. The style feels playful, cute, and slightly scrapbook-like, as if it’s a social media food post.
Text elements include casual handwritten fonts, with phrases like “Today’s home bento,” and small notes describing texture and taste. Steam lines rise from the hot karaage, emphasizing warmth and freshness.
Highly detailed food textures, vibrant colors, aesthetic composition, Instagram-style food photography, cozy lifestyle vibe, Japanese convenience store-inspired bento.

zh.title: 生活博客风格美食摄影
zh.description: 用于创作温馨、Instagram 风格美食摄影的提示词，包含带有手写注释和涂鸦的精致餐点。
zh.prompt:
1. 一张温馨的餐桌，摆满了丰盛的 {argument name="cuisine" default="台式"} 料理，在温暖的自然光下拍摄。前景是一大碗 {argument name="main dish" default="红烧牛肉面"}，配有宽面条、鲜嫩的牛肉块、青江菜和葱花。周围的配菜包括一碗盖有生蛋黄、海苔、泡菜和碎蔬菜的米饭；一盘 {argument name="side dish" default="台式盐酥鸡"} 和豆腐配青菜；蒜蓉炒空心菜；以及一小碟腌制蔬菜。中心立着一个优雅的高脚玻璃杯，里面盛着分层的虾仁沙拉。木质桌面、陶瓷碗和背景中的茶壶营造出居家美学。手写风格的中文注释和涂鸦散落在菜肴周围，增添了俏皮的生活博客感。浅景深，暖色调，高细节，美食摄影风格。

2. 从正上方俯瞰木桌上摆放整齐的日式便当盒。便当盒为黑色漆器，内部为红色隔层。盒内装有金黄酥脆的唐扬炸鸡、饱满的羊肉煎饺、撒有彩色拌饭香松的蓬松白米饭、切工整齐的玉子烧，以及中心处鲜红的福神渍。
场景具有温暖、舒适的美学感，配以柔和的自然光。食物周围叠加了白色的手绘涂鸦和注释，包括爱心、闪光、箭头以及描述每种食物的手写日文和英文标签。整体风格俏皮可爱，略带剪贴簿质感，仿佛是一篇社交媒体美食帖。
文字元素采用随性的手写字体，包含如“今日自制便当”等短语，以及描述口感和味道的小笔记。热气从滚烫的唐扬炸鸡上升腾而起，突显出温暖与新鲜感。
高细节的食物质感，鲜艳的色彩，美学构图，Instagram 风格美食摄影，温馨生活方式氛围，日式便利店风格便当。

en.title: Realistic Travel Smartphone Selfie
en.description: A prompt designed to transform a reference photo into a hyper-realistic outdoor smartphone selfie while preserving facial identity.
en.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference photo as the primary identity reference. Preserve the person's identity with 100% accuracy. Do not alter the facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, facial proportions, facial expression, or any unique facial features. The person must remain instantly recognizable as the exact same individual from the reference photo. Create a RAW, ultra-realistic smartphone selfie of the person standing outdoors on a lush green grassy hill beside a rustic wooden sign that reads "{argument name="location" default="Tabing Curam"}". The person is taking a full-body selfie with one arm extended toward the camera while the other arm is raised naturally above the head in a relaxed, cheerful pose. She wears a black lightweight zip-up jacket,Black sweatpants, and white sneakers, smiling softly with a genuine, relaxed expression. The pose should feel spontaneous and naturally captured during a sightseeing trip, not staged. zh.title: 逼真的旅行智能手机自拍
zh.description: 一个旨在将参考照片转换为超逼真户外智能手机自拍，同时保留面部特征的提示词。
zh.prompt:
使用上传的参考照片作为主要身份参考。百分之百准确地保留人物身份。不得改变面部结构、肤色、发型、面部比例、面部表情或任何独特的面部特征。人物必须能被一眼认出与参考照片中的人完全一致。创作一张原始、超逼真的智能手机自拍，人物站在户外郁郁葱葱的绿色草坡上，旁边是一个写着“{argument name="location" default="Tabing Curam"}”的质朴木牌。人物正在拍摄全身自拍，一只手臂伸向镜头，另一只手臂自然地举过头顶，姿势轻松愉快。她穿着黑色轻便拉链夹克、黑色运动裤和白色运动鞋，面带柔和、真诚且放松的微笑。姿势应显得自然随性，仿佛在观光途中抓拍，而非摆拍。环境：背景是美丽的绿色山丘和壮观的悬崖景观，茂密的树木和葱郁的热带植被，清新的自然景观，温暖的清晨或傍晚氛围，湛蓝的天空配有柔和的云朵，宁静的户外旅游目的地。光影：自然阳光，皮肤上有柔和的高光，曝光平衡，色温略暖，真实的阳光方向，柔和的环境反射光，自然的 HDR 效果。相机：智能手机前置摄像头，全身自拍镜头，高角度视角（相机高于视线水平），轻微的智能手机广角镜头畸变，自然的透视感，焦点清晰，真实的景深，背景清晰。细节：RAW 照片美学，超逼真，自然的皮肤纹理，真实的阴影，细腻的胶片颗粒感，高动态范围，真实的衣物褶皱，自然的发丝，真实的色彩，无美颜滤镜，无过度磨皮，无 CGI 感，非插画，非动漫，无水印，无 Logo，无文字（除写有“Tabing Curam”的木牌外）。专业旅行摄影质量，看起来就像是在真实户外旅行中拍摄的真实智能手机自拍。

强制文字签名：在底部中心位置，添加清晰、小巧、易读的手写文字，内容为：“{argument name="signature" default="by ArdhiBay007"}”。

en.title: Boudoir Lifestyle Film Portrait
en.description: A soft blue-hour lifestyle portrait prompt for an East Asian woman, focusing on natural textures and cinematic indoor lighting.
en.prompt: Medium shot, 23-year-old East Asian woman, delicate profile, natural skin texture, hair falling loosely over one shoulder. {argument name="clothing" default="Oversized white shirt worn open over the lavender-grey lace set"}, standing by a bedroom window at {argument name="time of day" default="dusk"} adjusting her sleeve, vertical 3:4 composition with subject positioned to one side, window view softly blurred behind her. Soft blue-hour light through the window mixing with a faint warm interior lamp glow, gentle rim light along her arm. Photographic texture and quality: subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, natural subsurface skin scattering, faint hair flyaways caught by the window draft. Preserve: lace pattern, window light quality. Avoid: AI-smoothed skin, artificially perfect symmetry.

zh.title: 闺房生活感胶片人像
zh.description: 一款适用于东亚女性的柔和蓝调时刻生活感人像提示词，聚焦于自然质感与电影感室内光影。
zh.prompt: 中景镜头，23 岁东亚女性，精致侧颜，自然皮肤质感，长发松散地垂在一侧肩头。{argument name="clothing" default="外搭一件敞开的超大号白衬衫，内穿薰衣草灰蕾丝套装"}，站在卧室窗边，于 {argument name="time of day" default="黄昏"} 时分整理袖口，3:4 竖构图，主体位于画面一侧，窗外景色呈现柔和虚化。窗外柔和的蓝调时刻光线与室内微弱的暖色台灯光交织，手臂边缘呈现柔和的轮廓光。摄影质感与质量：阴影区域带有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，自然的皮肤次表面散射，窗边微风吹动细碎的发丝。保留：蕾丝纹理、窗户光影质量。避免：AI 磨皮感、人工合成的完美对称。

en.title: Realistic Cosmetic Beauty Campaign
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating luxury skincare or beauty editorial images using a model and product reference, focusing on natural skin textures and realistic product representation.
en.prompt: Use the uploaded model photo as an exact personality reference. Preserve appearance 1:1: face, features, proportions, skin, hair, and overall look. Do not change the personality. The skin must be maximally natural and alive: real pores, natural texture, soft natural glow, no plastic retouching, no beautify, no excessive smoothing. Use the uploaded product photo as an exact product reference. Preserve the product 1:1: shape, size, proportions, packaging, cap, label, logo, text, material, color, coating, reflections, and all design details. The product must look maximally natural and realistic, like a real physical object in hand, not CGI, without distortions and without reinterpretation. Close-up beauty shot in the style of a {argument name="campaign style" default="modern luxury cosmetic campaign"}. The model from the photo reference holds the product from the uploaded photo near one eye, slightly covering it, and makes a {argument name="facial expression" default="playful facial expression with soft lips in a kissy face style"}. Gaze is directed at the camera. Hair is smoothly combed back. On the ears — {argument name="accessories" default="gold hoop earrings"}. Background — clean minimalist white, without extra objects. Lighting is soft studio, clean beauty lighting, with delicate highlights on skin and product. Makeup is natural and fresh: glowing skin, slightly shiny lips, neat eyebrows, softly emphasized eyes, no heavy makeup. Overall aesthetic — fresh skincare / beauty editorial, glossy, expensive, modern, but at the same time natural and realistic. Frame focus — on the model's face, natural skin, and product. Avoid: changing the face, plastic skin, heavy retouching, CGI product look, unreadable logo, extra objects, bad hand anatomy, cartoonishness.

zh.title: 奢华美妆广告人像
zh.description: 一个高端美妆营销提示词，旨在将特定模特与产品照片融合为专业的美容编辑大片。
zh.prompt:
请将上传的模特照片作为精确的人物参考。1:1 保留其外观：面部、五官、比例、皮肤、发型及整体形象。请勿改变人物特征。皮肤必须呈现出极致的自然与生动感：保留真实毛孔、自然纹理、柔和的自然光泽，拒绝塑料感修图、拒绝美颜、拒绝过度磨皮。
请将上传的产品照片作为精确的产品参考。1:1 保留产品细节：形状、尺寸、比例、包装、瓶盖、标签、Logo、文字、材质、颜色、涂层、反光以及所有设计细节。产品必须看起来极致自然且真实，如同手中的实物，而非 CGI 渲染，严禁变形或重新演绎。
采用现代奢华美妆广告风格的特写镜头。照片中的模特将上传照片中的产品置于一只眼睛附近，略微遮挡，并做出俏皮的表情，双唇微嘟。视线直视镜头。头发向后梳理平整。耳饰为金色圆环耳环。
背景为简洁的极简主义白色，无多余物品。灯光采用柔和的摄影棚光，即干净的美容光，在皮肤和产品上形成细腻的高光。妆容自然清新：光泽感底妆、微亮唇妆、整洁眉形、柔和眼妆，拒绝浓妆艳抹。
整体美学：清新护肤/美容编辑风格，高级、有质感、现代，同时保持自然与真实。画面焦点：聚焦于模特面部、自然皮肤及产品。
避免：改变面部特征、塑料感皮肤、过度修图、CGI 产品质感、Logo 模糊不清、多余物品、手部解剖结构错误、卡通化。

en.title: Sun-Drenched Tennis Court Portrait
en.description: An incredibly detailed professional photography prompt for GPT Image 2 that captures a serene, high-fashion portrait of a woman on a Japanese outdoor tennis court. It specifies lighting, depth of field, and even lens choices to achieve a natural, editorial look.
en.prompt:
Theme:
A gaze unravelling at the white lines.

Subject:
Vertical 3:4 orientation. On a {argument name="setting" default="sunny outdoor tennis court"}, a {argument name="subject" default="woman in her 20s"} stands slightly left of center. The shot captures her from the head to the upper thighs, with the figure occupying about 75% of the frame. She carries a light green tennis racket diagonally behind her right shoulder, supporting the grip near her chest with both hands.

Features & Expression:
Bright ivory-beige skin with a faint pink flush on the cheeks and nose. Retain natural skin texture with delicate highlights on the cheeks, shoulders, and collarbones. Rose-pink blush, pink-brown eyeshadow, long slender eyelashes, natural under-eye bags, light brown eyebrows, and translucent pink-beige gloss on the lips. The mouth is slightly open with a calm and composed expression. The face is mostly forward, the eyes look directly at the camera with small, clear catchlights.

Outfit & Pose:
A {argument name="outfit" default="halter neck dress with a deep V-neckline featuring a pale floral pattern on an ivory base"}. The thin, light fabric follows the body, with a brown braided belt and small wooden beads at the waist. A natural slit on one side creates soft shadows where the fabric overlaps. On the left wrist is a square smartwatch with a lime green band. Shoulders are slightly angled, upper body twisted toward the camera, with elbows bent naturally to support the racket steadily.

Background & Light:
A calm green-toned Japanese outdoor tennis court. The middle ground features a white net, and the background includes a dark green windbreak fence, benches, an umpire's chair, fine wire mesh, and a grove of trees. The background is heavily blurred to create an authentic, lived-in feel of a sports facility. Warm sunlight from a low angle in the upper right creates golden rim lights on hair, shoulders, arms, and the edge of the racket. Soft direct light and faint reflected light from the ground illuminate the face, with shadows falling to the bottom left.

Composition & Camera:
Vertical 3:4, a thigh-up portrait centered on the upper chest. Eye-level shot, 85mm equivalent medium telephoto lens, shallow depth of field. The racket face overlaps largely behind the head, acting as a circular frame for the face. Small margin above the head, with light bokeh and the court background visible on the right. Precise focus on eyes and eyelashes, with smooth blurring of hair ends and background.

Texture & Style:
A high-definition fashion portrait utilizing natural light. Bright and transparent tones, subtle contrast, meticulous depiction of fine hair, natural skin, thin fabric, and the metal frame of the racket. Avoid excessive skin smoothing for a clean, elegant finish like a magazine photograph.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, excessive skin correction, plastic-looking skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands, broken joints, poor contact with the racket, distorted racket face, asymmetrical eyes, shadows inconsistent with light source, gibberish text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 阳光明媚的网球场人像
zh.description: 这是一个为 GPT Image 2 设计的超高细节专业摄影提示词，旨在捕捉一位女性在日本户外网球场上的宁静时尚人像。它详细规定了光照、景深甚至镜头选择，以实现自然、杂志大片般的视觉效果。
zh.prompt:
主题：
凝视在白线间延伸。

主体：
垂直 3:4 构图。在 {argument name="setting" default="阳光明媚的户外网球场"} 上，一位 {argument name="subject" default="20 多岁的女性"} 站在画面中心偏左的位置。镜头捕捉她从头部到大腿上部的画面，人物占据约 75% 的画幅。她将一支浅绿色网球拍斜背在右肩后方，双手在胸前支撑着球拍握把。

特征与表情：
明亮的象牙米色皮肤，脸颊和鼻尖带有淡淡的粉色红晕。保留自然的皮肤纹理，脸颊、肩膀和锁骨处有细腻的高光。玫瑰粉色腮红、粉棕色眼影、细长的睫毛、自然的卧蚕、浅棕色眉毛，以及嘴唇上透亮的粉米色唇彩。嘴唇微张，表情沉稳从容。面部基本朝向正前方，双眼直视镜头，眼中带有细小清晰的眼神光。

服装与姿势：
身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="一件挂脖式深 V 领连衣裙，象牙色底色上印有淡雅花纹"}。轻薄的布料贴合身形，腰间系着棕色编织腰带，配有木质小珠子。一侧的自然开衩在布料重叠处形成了柔和的阴影。左手腕佩戴着一款配有青柠色表带的方形智能手表。肩膀略微倾斜，上身转向镜头，肘部自然弯曲以稳稳支撑球拍。

背景与光影：
宁静的绿色调日本户外网球场。中景处是白色球网，背景包括深绿色防风网、长椅、裁判椅、细铁丝网和一片树林。背景经过深度虚化，营造出真实且充满生活气息的运动场地感。来自右上方的低角度暖阳在头发、肩膀、手臂和球拍边缘形成了金色的轮廓光。柔和的直射光和来自地面的微弱反射光照亮了面部，阴影投向左下方。

构图与摄影：
垂直 3:4，以胸部上方为中心的半身人像。平视拍摄，85mm 等效中焦镜头，浅景深。球拍面大部分重叠在头部后方，作为面部的圆形框架。头顶留有少量空间，右侧可见轻微的虚化效果和球场背景。焦点精准对准眼睛和睫毛，发梢和背景呈现平滑的虚化效果。

质感与风格：
利用自然光拍摄的高清时尚人像。色调明亮通透，对比度细腻，细致刻画了发丝、自然皮肤、轻薄布料以及球拍金属框的质感。避免过度磨皮，呈现出如杂志摄影般干净、优雅的质感。

负面提示词：
不自然的面部、不自然的眼神、过度皮肤修正、塑料感皮肤、多指、缺指、手指粘连、关节断裂、与球拍接触不良、球拍面变形、双眼不对称、阴影与光源不一致、乱码文字、Logo、水印。

Create a premium, modern high-fashion CHARACTER CONCEPT ART SHEET in a 16:9 widescreen layout on a pure white background, following this exact structured composition and visual aesthetic:

en.title: Realistic Character with Doodle Shadow
en.description: This detailed prompt helps generate a creative portrait where a realistic person is accompanied by their own playful and chaotic doodle-style shadow on the wall.
en.prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity and outfit reference.

Preserve the reference character’s:
- face identity
- facial proportions
- eye shape
- nose
- lips
- skin tone
- hairstyle
- hair color
- visible hair accessories
- overall recognizable vibe
- outfit and styling shown in the reference image

Do not hardcode any specific character traits that are not present in the uploaded reference.
All identity, hairstyle, accessories, and clothing details must be inferred directly from the uploaded reference image.

Create a high-quality mixed-style vertical portrait showing:
1. a realistic full-body version of the uploaded character/person
2. a black hand-drawn doodle-shadow version of the same character/person on the wall beside them

Core concept:
The real person and their doodle-shadow are doing a {argument name="pose style" default="playful mischievous pose"} together.
The real person performs a cute realistic version of the pose, while the doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version of the same pose idea.
The mood should feel cute, playful, mischievous, stylish, funny, and social-media-friendly.

Real person:
- Must remain realistic and photogenic
- Must wear the same outfit style and key visible details from the uploaded reference image
- Do not replace the reference styling with unrelated fashion
- Expression should be {argument name="facial expression" default="cute, slightly confused, mildly embarrassed, playful"}, as if thinking: “Why am I doing this with my shadow?”
- The real person should not stand stiffly
- The real person should actively participate in the pose, but in a natural realistic way

Doodle-shadow:
- Must be a black hand-drawn sketch version of the same person, drawn directly on the wall
- Not a realistic second person
- Not a normal physical shadow
- Not a full-color anime character
- Black sketch line-art only
- Should resemble the person through hairstyle silhouette, accessories, outfit silhouette, and pose structure
- The doodle-shadow should look more energetic, sillier, and more chaotic than the real person
- Add manga-like motion lines, hearts, stars, sparkles, and comic marks around the doodle if helpful

Random mischievous pose rule:
The pose must NOT be fixed.

For each generation, invent a new {argument name="new pose" default="playful mischievous pose"} for both the real person and the doodle-shadow.
The real person and the doodle-shadow should share the same general pose idea, but they do not need to match perfectly.
The real person performs a cute realistic version.
The doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version.

Do not repeatedly use pointing poses.
Do not repeatedly use finger-gun poses.
Do not repeatedly use the same standing pose.
Do not always make both figures simply point at each other.

Create a different mischievous pose each time.

Possible pose directions are loose inspiration only, not a fixed menu:
- playful idol pose
- silly dance pose
- leaning sideways with one arm curved overhead
- making

zh.title: 写实人物与涂鸦影子
zh.description: 此详细提示词旨在生成一张创意肖像，画面中写实的人物身旁伴随着墙上俏皮且混乱的涂鸦风格影子。
zh.prompt:
请将上传的角色参考图作为严格的身份和服装参考。

保留参考角色的：
- 面部特征
- 面部比例
- 眼睛形状
- 鼻子
- 嘴唇
- 肤色
- 发型
- 发色
- 可见的头发配饰
- 整体可辨识的氛围
- 参考图中展示的服装和造型

请勿硬编码任何未出现在上传参考图中的特定角色特征。
所有身份、发型、配饰和服装细节必须直接从上传的参考图中推断。

创作一张高质量的混合风格竖版肖像，展示：
1. 上传角色/人物的写实全身版本
2. 墙上同一角色/人物的黑色手绘涂鸦影子版本

核心概念：
真人与其涂鸦影子共同做出 {argument name="pose style" default="俏皮搞怪的姿势"}。
真人做出该姿势的可爱写实版，而涂鸦影子则做出该姿势构思中更夸张、混乱、卡通的版本。
整体氛围应显得可爱、俏皮、搞怪、时尚、有趣且适合社交媒体分享。

真人：
- 必须保持写实且上镜
- 必须穿着与上传参考图中一致的服装风格及关键可见细节
- 不要用不相关的时尚元素替换参考图中的造型
- 表情应为 {argument name="facial expression" default="可爱、略显困惑、轻微尴尬、俏皮"}，仿佛在想：“我为什么要和我的影子一起做这个？”
- 真人不应站得僵硬
- 真人应积极参与姿势互动，但要以自然写实的方式

涂鸦影子：
- 必须是同一人物的黑色手绘草图版本，直接画在墙上
- 不是写实的第二个人
- 不是普通的物理影子
- 不是全彩动漫角色
- 仅限黑色线条画
- 应通过发型轮廓、配饰、服装轮廓和姿势结构来体现人物特征
- 涂鸦影子看起来应比真人更有活力、更傻气、更混乱
- 如有需要，可在涂鸦周围添加漫画风格的动作线、爱心、星星、闪光和漫画符号

随机搞怪姿势规则：
姿势不得固定。

每次生成时，为真人和涂鸦影子构思一个新的 {argument name="new pose" default="俏皮搞怪的姿势"}。
真人和涂鸦影子应共享同一个大致的姿势构思，但无需完全一致。
真人做出可爱的写实版本。
涂鸦影子做出更夸张、混乱、卡通的版本。

不要重复使用指点姿势。
不要重复使用手指枪姿势。
不要重复使用相同的站立姿势。
不要总是让两个形象仅仅是指向对方。

每次创作不同的搞怪姿势。

以下姿势方向仅供灵感参考，非固定选项：
- 俏皮偶像姿势
- 傻气舞蹈姿势
- 向一侧倾斜，一只手臂在头顶弯曲
- 制作

en.title: Floating Mirror Korean Apartment Lifestyle Photo
en.description: Generates a realistic cozy Korean bedroom lifestyle photo with three diagonal floating mirrors showing different casual selfie poses.
en.prompt: A realistic Pinterest and Instagram lifestyle photography scene captured with a professional DSLR camera, 4:3 aspect ratio. Create exactly THREE large transparent floating full-length glass mirrors only, arranged in a diagonal depth-perspective composition inside a modern cozy Korean apartment bedroom. The mirrors should look like frameless vertical glass slabs with subtle thin reflective edges and faint transparency, standing/floating naturally on a warm light wood floor. Mirror 1 is the largest in the left foreground, angled slightly toward camera, reflecting a young Korean woman taking a phone mirror selfie; she wears a {argument name="foreground outfit" default="cream oversized hoodie and light gray shorts"}, has {argument name="hair style" default="dark hair in a relaxed messy bun"}, bare legs and bare feet, soft natural smile, one hand in hoodie pocket, holding a beige smartphone. Mirror 2 is medium sized in the center midground, farther back, reflecting the same woman standing casually in a {argument name="middle outfit" default="loose white T-shirt and black shorts"}, long dark hair down, hands in pockets, barefoot, looking to the side. Mirror 3 is the smallest in the right background, farther away, reflecting the woman seated cross-legged on the floor or bed area in a {argument name="background outfit" default="pale blue hoodie"}, holding a phone selfie pose. The apartment is bright, calm, and airy, with sheer white curtains and beige drapes on the left, soft morning sunlight streaming across the wood floor, a neutral sofa partly visible in the left mirror reflection, a white round rug, framed minimalist wall art, potted green plants including a tall plant in a woven basket, a small wooden stool, beige closet doors in the background, and a blurred blue-gray bed edge in the right foreground. Use warm natural daylight, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, photorealistic skin and fabric textures, clean Korean home decor, cozy minimalism, DSLR lifestyle photography, 35mm lens feel, f/2.8, high-resolution realism. Keep the composition uncluttered and dreamy but believable. Constraints: exactly 3 mirrors, exactly 3 reflected versions of the woman, no extra mirrors, no extra people, no text, no logos, no surreal distortions beyond transparent floating mirror effect.

zh.title: 韩式公寓浮动镜面生活方式摄影
zh.description: 生成一张逼真的韩式温馨卧室生活方式照片，包含三面呈对角线排列的浮动镜子，展示不同的休闲自拍姿势。
zh.prompt: 一张由专业单反相机拍摄的 Pinterest 和 Instagram 风格生活方式摄影作品，比例为 4:3。画面中仅包含三面大型透明浮动全身玻璃镜，以对角线深度透视构图排列在现代温馨的韩式公寓卧室中。镜子呈现为无框垂直玻璃板，带有精致的薄反射边缘和淡淡的透明感，自然地立于或悬浮在温暖的浅色木地板上。第一面镜子位于左侧前景，尺寸最大，略微朝向相机，反射出一位年轻韩国女性正在进行手机镜面自拍；她身着 {argument name="foreground outfit" default="米色超大款连帽衫和浅灰色短裤"}，留着 {argument name="hair style" default="深色随性丸子头"}，光腿赤足，面带柔和自然的微笑，一只手插在连帽衫口袋里，手持米色智能手机。第二面镜子位于中心中景，位置靠后，尺寸中等，反射出同一位女性身着 {argument name="middle outfit" default="宽松白色 T 恤和黑色短裤"} 随意站立，深色长发披肩，双手插兜，赤脚，看向侧方。第三面镜子位于右侧背景，尺寸最小，距离最远，反射出该女性盘腿坐在地板或床区，身着 {argument name="background outfit" default="淡蓝色连帽衫"}，摆出手机自拍姿势。公寓明亮、宁静且通透，左侧挂有白色薄纱窗帘和米色窗帘，柔和的晨光洒在木地板上，左侧镜面反射中可见部分中性色沙发，配有白色圆形地毯、极简主义墙面艺术画、包括编织篮中高大植株在内的盆栽绿植、小木凳、背景中的米色衣柜门，以及右侧前景中模糊的蓝灰色床沿。使用温暖的自然日光、柔和的阴影、浅景深、照片级的皮肤和织物纹理、整洁的韩式家居装饰、温馨极简主义、单反生活方式摄影、35mm 镜头质感、f/2.8 光圈、高分辨率写实效果。保持构图简洁、梦幻且真实可信。限制条件：必须正好 3 面镜子，正好 3 个女性反射版本，不得有额外镜子，不得有额外人物，不得有文字，不得有 Logo，除透明浮动镜面效果外不得有超现实扭曲。

en.title: Luxury Living Room Editorial Portrait
en.description: Generates a cinematic studio-quality portrait of a stylish seated subject in a moody teal-and-amber living room.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic luxury editorial portrait of {argument name="subject" default="a young Black man"} seated naturally in a honey-brown rattan lounge chair in a stylish living room at night. The subject faces the camera with a calm, confident neutral expression, short neat black hair, clean-shaven face, relaxed upright posture, hands loosely clasped near the lap, one arm resting on the chair, legs comfortably apart. Outfit: {argument name="outfit" default="minimal all-black casualwear: black crewneck sweatshirt and black trousers"}, a dark wristwatch on the left wrist, and clean white low-top sneakers.
