zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的温馨夜景照片，画面中 {argument name="pet" default="一只圆滚滚的黑猫"} 正坐在木质厨房地板上，面对着打开的冰箱，沐浴在冰箱发出的清凉蓝白色光芒中，仿佛在享受夏日的凉爽。猫咪是画面的唯一主体，拥有光泽的黑色皮毛和细腻的高光，姿态放松地坐着，后腿向前伸展，前爪靠近冰箱，头部微微上扬，双眼微闭，脸上带着幸福的微笑，长长的白色胡须清晰可见。冰箱位于画面右侧且处于开启状态，内部明亮，精确展示 4 个可见的存储区域：1 个放有各种瓶瓶罐罐的透明门架，1 个放有小型容器的上层隔板，1 个放有塑料盒装浅色蔬菜丝和一盘红樱桃番茄的中层隔板，以及 1 个装满绿叶蔬菜的下层保鲜抽屉。在左侧昏暗的背景中，包含 1 台落地电风扇和一个透出温暖琥珀色灯光的门口或房间，与冰箱发出的冷光形成对比。采用从地板拍摄的低机位视角，竖构图，浅景深，呈现自然的居家杂乱感，具有电影级的写实感，皮毛纹理细节丰富，阴影柔和，木地板反射出温暖的光泽，营造出安静幽默的家庭氛围。无文字，无水印，画面中无人。

en.title: AniFusion Manga Promo Poster
en.description: A structured prompt for generating a Japanese manga-style promotional poster for an all-in-one creator platform with a recurring cat-boy mascot.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a colorful full-page Japanese manga-style promotional comic poster for {argument name="platform name" default="AniFusion"}, a creator platform that helps users make comics, illustrations, videos, drawings, and manage assets. The mascot is {argument name="character name" default="Ai-kun"}, a cheerful anime cat-boy guide.

Canvas: Vertical A4 poster, white outer margin, thick black comic panel borders, high-energy shonen manga advertisement layout, bright pastel accents, clean print-ready composition.

Main character details: A cute young anime cat-boy with fluffy brown hair, large brown cat ears, a fluffy tail, round black glasses, warm brown eyes, small whisker marks, a white hoodie under blue denim overalls, red collar with a gold bell, and a yellow hair clip reading “AI”. He appears repeatedly as the guide mascot, smiling, winking, pointing, waving, and presenting tools.

Layout and counted panels: Use exactly 9 main comic/content panels plus one right-side vertical text strip and one bottom banner. Panel 1, top-left large panel: close-up of Ai-kun winking and pointing a stylus toward the viewer, sparkly speed-line background, speech bubble in Japanese: 「みんなー！マンガやイラストをもっと自由に楽しみたい？それなら…」, name label: 「アイくん」. Panel 2, top-right logo panel: large playful purple and blue “AniFusion” logo with a painter palette incorporated into the letters, Japanese subtitle: 「アニフュージョン」. Panel 3, upper-right small mascot panel: Ai-kun waves beside the logo with speech bubble: 「AniFusionがすべて叶えてくれるよ！」. Panel 4, middle large dashboard panel: central web-app screenshot mockup labeled “Welcome back”, surrounded by Ai-kun presenting it; top jagged caption: 「いろんなツールがぜ〜んぶここに！」. Panel 5, left stack tool card area: exactly 3 stacked feature cards labeled “Comics”, “Canvases”, and “Image”; each has thumbnail grids and Japanese captions respectively: 「マンガを作ろう！」, 「アイデアを広げよう！」, 「高品質なAI生成！」. Panel 6, lower-middle feature card: “Video” red label with a dynamic anime boy thumbnail and Japanese caption: 「イラストを動画に！」. Panel 7, lower-middle feature card: “Drawing” orange label with sketch-to-finished-anime-girl artwork and Japanese caption: 「描いて、整えて、仕上げよう！」. Panel 8, lower-right feature card: “Library & More” green label with exactly 4 simple black icons: bookshelf, open box/cube, checklist/document, sliders/settings; Japanese caption: 「保存も管理もカンタン！」. Panel 9, bottom two-part scene: left side Ai-kun hugs a Shiba Inu dog on a pink heart background with speech bubble: 「AIがキミの創造力をサポートするよ！」; right side Ai-kun sits at a desk with drawing tablet, stylus, monitor showing manga page thumbnails, coffee mug with paw print, and speech bubble: 「さあ、いっしょに楽しい作品を生み出そう！」.

Right vertical strip: Add a narrow white vertical strip on the far right with black Japanese text reading: 「これはよくある案件漫画のフリをしたコンテスト応募作品です(ChatGPT free)」 followed by the name 「大澤基」 and a small blue paw print.

Bottom banner: Full-width light blue banner with paw prints and stars, large orange-and-white Japanese headline: 「クリエイターのための、ぜんぶ入りプラットフォーム！」 and smaller line: 「AniFusionで、きみの物語をカタチにしよう！」.

Visual style: Modern polished anime manga advertisement, glossy cel shading, expressive faces, clean line art, halftone textures, sparkles, starbursts, pastel blue and peach backgrounds, readable Japanese typography, friendly creator-tool branding.

Constraints: Include exactly 6 visible appearances of Ai-kun: pointing close-up, waving by logo, presenting dashboard, small pointing mascot near feature cards, hugging dog, and drawing at desk. Include exactly 3 stacked left feature cards, exactly 3 bottom-row feature cards, and exactly 4 library icons. Keep all Japanese text legible and placed as described. No watermark, no extra characters beyond Ai-kun and the dog.

zh.title: AniFusion 漫画风格宣传海报
zh.description: 一个结构化的提示词，用于生成一张日式漫画风格的宣传海报，旨在推广一个包含猫耳少年吉祥物的多功能创作者平台。
zh.prompt:
目标：为 {argument name="platform name" default="AniFusion"} 创建一张色彩丰富的全页日式漫画风格宣传海报。这是一个帮助用户制作漫画、插画、视频、绘画并管理资产的创作者平台。吉祥物是 {argument name="character name" default="Ai-kun"}，一个活泼的动漫猫耳少年向导。

画布：竖版 A4 海报，白色外边距，粗黑漫画分镜框，充满活力的少年漫画广告布局，明亮的柔和色调点缀，构图简洁，适合印刷。

主要角色细节：一个可爱的动漫猫耳少年，拥有蓬松的棕色头发、大大的棕色猫耳、毛茸茸的尾巴、圆框黑眼镜、温暖的棕色眼睛、小胡须印记，身穿白色连帽衫搭配蓝色牛仔背带裤，佩戴带有金色铃铛的红色项圈，发夹上写着“AI”字样。他作为向导吉祥物多次出现，表现出微笑、眨眼、指向、挥手和展示工具等动作。

布局与分镜数量：使用 9 个主要漫画/内容分镜，外加一个右侧竖排文字条和一个底部横幅。分镜 1（左上大图）：Ai-kun 的特写，眨眼并用手写笔指向观众，背景为闪烁的加速线，对话气泡文字为：「みんなー！マンガやイラストをもっと自由に楽しみたい？それなら…」，姓名标签：「アイくん」。分镜 2（右上 Logo 区）：大型俏皮的紫色和蓝色“AniFusion”Logo，字母中融入了调色板元素，日文副标题：「アニフュージョン」。分镜 3（右上小吉祥物区）：Ai-kun 在 Logo 旁挥手，对话气泡：「AniFusionがすべて叶えてくれるよ！」。分镜 4（中间大仪表盘区）：中央展示 Web 应用截图模拟界面，标注“Welcome back”，Ai-kun 在旁展示；顶部锯齿状标题：「いろんなツールがぜ〜んぶここに！」。分镜 5（左侧堆叠工具卡片区）：包含 3 张堆叠的功能卡片，分别标注“Comics”、“Canvases”和“Image”；每张卡片配有缩略图网格和对应的日文说明：「マンガを作ろう！」、「アイデアを広げよう！」、「高品質なAI生成！」。分镜 6（中下功能卡片）：红色标签“Video”，配有动态动漫男孩缩略图和日文说明：「イラストを動画に！」。分镜 7（中下功能卡片）：橙色标签“Drawing”，配有从草图到完成的动漫少女作品和日文说明：「描いて、整えて、仕上げよう！」。分镜 8（右下功能卡片）：绿色标签“Library & More”，配有 4 个简单的黑色图标：书架、开口箱/立方体、清单/文档、滑块/设置；日文说明：「保存も管理もカンタン！」。分镜 9（底部双场景）：左侧 Ai-kun 在粉色爱心背景下拥抱一只柴犬，对话气泡：「AIがキミの創造力をサポートするよ！」；右侧 Ai-kun 坐在书桌前，桌上有绘图板、手写笔、显示漫画页面缩略图的显示器、带有爪印的咖啡杯，对话气泡：「さあ、いっしょに楽しい作品を生み出そう！」。

右侧竖条：在最右侧添加一条狭窄的白色竖条，上面印有黑色日文文字：「これはよくある案件漫画のフリをしたコンテスト応募作品です(ChatGPT free)」，随后是名字「大澤基」和一个蓝色小爪印。

底部横幅：全宽浅蓝色横幅，带有爪印和星星图案，大型橙白相间的日文标题：「クリエイターのための、ぜんぶ入りプラットフォーム！」以及较小的副标题：「AniFusionで、きみの物語をカタチにしよう！」。

视觉风格：现代精致的动漫漫画广告风格，光泽感赛璐珞阴影，表情生动，线条干净，网点纹理，闪光和星芒效果，柔和的蓝色和桃色背景，清晰易读的日文排版，友好的创作者工具品牌感。

约束条件：Ai-kun 必须出现 6 次：指向特写、Logo 旁挥手、展示仪表盘、功能卡片旁的小向导、拥抱小狗、书桌前绘画。包含 3 张左侧堆叠功能卡片，3 张底部功能卡片，以及 4 个库图标。确保所有日文文字清晰且放置位置符合描述。无水印，画面中除 Ai-kun 和小狗外无其他角色。

en.title: Monochrome Kimono Lantern Portrait
en.description: A detailed black-and-white anime portrait of a kimono-clad woman beside glowing floating lanterns, ideal for elegant monochrome character art.
en.prompt: Create a monochrome anime-style portrait of a beautiful young woman in traditional Japanese clothing, viewed from the waist up in a three-quarter back pose as she turns her head over her shoulder toward the viewer. She wears an elegant {argument name="kimono pattern" default="floral and flowing wave motifs"} kimono with a wide obi visible at the lower left, rendered in glossy grayscale fabric with delicate embroidery and fine linework. Her {argument name="hair color" default="dark black"} hair is swept into a soft updo with loose curled strands framing her face, decorated with exactly 3 visible large daisy-like hair flowers plus several tiny bead ornaments clustered near the bun. Give her a gentle, serene expression with large reflective eyes, soft lips, refined nose, and luminous smooth skin. The setting is a dark nighttime pond or river during a lantern-floating scene, with exactly 5 glowing lotus-shaped paper lanterns visible on the water: one large blurred lantern at lower left foreground, one mid-right lantern near her shoulder, one bright lantern at lower right foreground, one blurred central background lantern, and one distant upper-right lantern. Add shimmering water reflections, bokeh lights in the distance, tiny sparkling particles in the air, and dramatic rim lighting outlining her hair, shoulders, and kimono. Use high-detail manga/anime illustration aesthetics, cinematic grayscale only, strong black-and-white contrast, soft depth of field, romantic atmosphere, vertical portrait composition, no text, no color, no watermark.

zh.title: 单色和服灯笼人像
zh.description: 一幅精致的黑白动漫风格人像，描绘了一位身着和服的女性在漂浮的灯笼旁，非常适合优雅的单色角色艺术创作。
zh.prompt: 创作一幅单色动漫风格的人像，描绘一位身着传统日本服装的年轻美女。画面采用半身像构图，呈现四分之三背影，她转过头看向观众。她穿着一件优雅的 {argument name="kimono pattern" default="花卉与流波纹样"} 和服，左下方可见宽大的腰带，布料呈现出光泽的灰度质感，带有精致的刺绣和细腻的线条。她的 {argument name="hair color" default="深黑色"} 头发盘成柔和的发髻，几缕卷发垂在脸颊两侧，发髻旁装饰着 3 朵清晰可见的大型雏菊状发花，以及几颗簇拥在发髻旁的小珠饰。赋予她温柔宁静的表情，拥有明亮的大眼睛、柔和的嘴唇、精致的鼻梁和细腻透亮的肌肤。背景设定在夜晚的池塘或河流，正举行灯笼漂流仪式，水面上可见 5 盏发光的莲花状纸灯笼：左下角前景处有一盏模糊的大灯笼，肩膀附近有一盏中景灯笼，右下角前景处有一盏明亮的灯笼，背景中心有一盏模糊的灯笼，右上角远处还有一盏灯笼。添加波光粼粼的水面反射、远处的焦外成像光点、空气中细小的闪烁微粒，以及勾勒出她头发、肩膀和和服轮廓的戏剧性边缘光。采用高细节的漫画/动漫插画美学，仅使用电影级灰度，强烈的黑白对比，柔和的景深，浪漫的氛围，竖构图人像，无文字，无色彩，无水印。

en.title: Silver Fox-Eared Winter Mage
en.description: A detailed anime fantasy prompt for generating a silver-haired fox-eared winter mage princess in an icy palace under a galaxy sky.
en.prompt: Create a polished full-body anime fantasy illustration of a cheerful silver-haired fox-eared girl in a cool winter night setting. The character has {argument name="hair color" default="long flowing silver-white hair"}, large fluffy fox ears, violet eyes, soft blush, and a gentle smile while facing the viewer. She is stepping forward gracefully with one leg raised, her left hand open in a friendly wave toward the camera, and her right hand holding an ornate tall magical staff topped with a glowing purple crystal orb inside a silver crescent-and-star filigree frame. Dress her in {argument name="outfit style" default="navy blue and white snow-princess military mage outfit"}: a fitted dark navy jacket with silver buttons and star brooch details, white fur trim on cuffs and cape edges, a silver belt, a short pleated white skirt, dark translucent tights, navy knee-high boots with silver snowflake-like ornaments, and a dramatic flowing navy cape decorated with visible white snowflake motifs. Set the scene in {argument name="background setting" default="an icy crystal palace terrace under a brilliant blue-purple galaxy sky"}, with exactly two tall crystalline spires visible near the left and right edges, luminous arched palace architecture in the distance, a reflective frozen-tile floor sparkling with star-like highlights, and deep space nebula clouds overhead. Use a low-angle heroic composition, centered character, dynamic wind-blown hair and cape, crisp line art, highly detailed anime rendering, luminous blue and violet lighting, glossy ice reflections, magical winter atmosphere, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 银狐耳冬日法师
zh.description: 一个详细的动漫奇幻提示词，用于生成在星系天空下的冰雪宫殿中，一位银发狐耳的冬日法师公主。
zh.prompt: 创作一张精致的全身动漫奇幻插画，描绘一位在凉爽冬夜背景下、神情愉悦的银发狐耳少女。角色拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="飘逸的长银白发"}、一对硕大的毛茸茸狐耳、紫罗兰色的双眸、淡淡的红晕，并面带温柔的微笑注视着观众。她优雅地向前迈步，一条腿微微抬起，左手向镜头挥动，姿态友好；右手握着一根华丽的高大魔法杖，杖顶是一个发光的紫色水晶球，镶嵌在银色的新月与星形花丝框架中。为她穿上 {argument name="outfit style" default="海军蓝与白色雪之公主风格的军事法师装束"}：一件带有银色纽扣和星形胸针细节的修身深海军蓝夹克，袖口和斗篷边缘饰有白色毛领，配以银色腰带、白色短褶裙、深色半透明连裤袜、带有银色雪花装饰的海军蓝过膝长靴，以及一件装饰着明显白色雪花图案、随风飘动的海军蓝斗篷。场景设定在 {argument name="background setting" default="蓝紫色璀璨星空下的冰晶宫殿露台"}，左右两侧边缘可见两座高耸的晶体尖塔，远处是发光的拱形宫殿建筑，地面是反射着星光点点的冰砖，头顶是深邃的星云。采用低角度英雄构图，角色居中，头发与斗篷随风动态飘动，线条清晰，高细节动漫渲染，蓝紫色调的明亮光影，冰面光泽反射，营造出魔法冬日的氛围，无文字，无水印。

en.title: Goth Punk Girl Meets Wall Doodle
en.description: A cinematic urban fashion scene of a goth-punk woman interacting with a matching hand-drawn graffiti character on an alley wall.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic vertical street photograph in a gritty urban alley at golden hour, showing a real young goth-punk woman with {argument name="hair color" default="black teased shaggy hair"} standing on the left side of a concrete utility pole and leaning toward a wall mural on the right as if flirting with or meeting her illustrated alter ego. She wears a dark oversized plaid flannel shirt, black layered top, studded belt, ripped black skinny jeans, fingerless gloves, layered necklaces, heavy eyeliner, dark lipstick, and tall black platform lace-up boots with buckles; one boot is lifted behind her in a playful pose, her hands resting on the pole, gaze turned toward the drawing. The environment is a narrow weathered alley with cracked asphalt, rough stucco walls, metal pipes, stickers, faded graffiti tags, grime, and warm backlit sunlight creating long shadows and shallow depth of field. On the right wall, draw exactly 1 large black ink graffiti-style cartoon character matching her punk aesthetic: wild long black hair, huge laughing smile, plaid shirt, ripped pants, platform boots, one leg kicked up, leaning toward the pole; surround it with exactly 9 doodle elements: 2 hearts above, 1 skull speech bubble, 3 five-point stars, and 3 short motion/emphasis line clusters. Make the mural look hand-drawn directly on the wall in messy expressive black marker lines, while the real person remains photorealistic. Use high-detail textures, natural lens blur, moody fashion-editorial lighting, rebellious cute punk energy, and a realistic color grade with muted browns, charcoal blacks, and warm highlights. No extra people, no readable brand logos, no watermark.

zh.title: 哥特朋克女孩与涂鸦墙的邂逅
zh.description: 一个电影质感的都市时尚场景，展现了一位哥特朋克风格的女性与墙上相呼应的手绘涂鸦角色互动的画面。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影质感的竖构图街头摄影作品，背景设在黄金时刻粗犷的都市小巷中。画面左侧站着一位真实的年轻哥特朋克女性，她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色蓬松凌乱发型"}，身体倚靠在混凝土电线杆上，向右侧的墙面壁画倾斜，仿佛正在与画中的另一个自己调情或邂逅。她身穿深色超大款格子法兰绒衬衫、黑色叠穿上衣、铆钉腰带、破洞黑色紧身牛仔裤，佩戴露指手套和多层项链，画着浓重的眼线和深色唇膏，脚蹬带有搭扣的高帮黑色厚底系带靴；她的一只靴子俏皮地向后抬起，双手扶在电线杆上，目光转向墙上的涂鸦。环境是一条狭窄且饱经风霜的小巷，地面是开裂的沥青，墙面是粗糙的灰泥，配有金属管道、贴纸、褪色的涂鸦标签和污垢，温暖的逆光营造出长长的阴影和浅景深效果。在右侧墙上，绘制 1 个与她朋克风格相符的大型黑色墨水涂鸦风格卡通角色：留着狂野的长黑发，露出大大的笑脸，穿着格子衬衫、破洞裤，脚蹬厚底靴，单腿踢起，向电线杆方向倾斜；在角色周围绘制 9 个涂鸦元素：上方 2 个爱心、1 个骷髅对话气泡、3 个五角星以及 3 组简短的动态/强调线条。壁画看起来像是直接用凌乱且富有表现力的黑色记号笔手绘在墙上的，而真人部分则保持照片级的写实感。采用高细节纹理、自然的镜头模糊、情绪化的时尚编辑灯光、叛逆可爱的朋克能量，以及带有柔和棕色、炭黑色和暖色高光的写实调色。画面中没有其他人，没有可辨认的品牌标志，没有水印。

en.title: Colorful Caribbean Beachwear Storefront
en.description: A photorealistic prompt for generating a bright tropical island shopping street with a vivid beachwear storefront and tourist merchandise displays.
en.prompt: Create a vibrant photorealistic travel-street photograph of a colorful Caribbean beachwear shop on a sunny day. Show a two-story corner storefront named {argument name="shop name" default="Angel Land"} from a low street-level three-quarter angle, with the building painted bright turquoise blue, hot pink trim, yellow shutters, and a thatched palm-frond awning across the front. Include a clear blue sky, hard midday sunlight, crisp shadows on pale stone paving, and a palm tree frond entering from the upper left. The shop façade should have a cursive neon-style sign reading “Angel Land” above the corner and a faded rectangular sign reading “BEACHWEAR” below it. Display exactly 5 magenta patio umbrellas: 1 on the left sidewalk, 3 across the front entrance area, and 1 partially cropped at the far right. Display exactly 3 sidewalk advertising boards: a large pink board on the left reading “ACACHI” with white flower graphics, a turquoise-blue center sandwich board reading “ANGEL LAND,” and a tall blue right sandwich board reading “CRUZ BAY.” Fill the open storefront with tropical tourist merchandise: bright hanging T-shirts, dresses, coverups, beach shirts, and swimwear in pink, yellow, turquoise, blue, orange, and multicolor prints. Show exactly 5 visible clothing rack clusters: 1 far-left sidewalk rack, 1 rack under the left umbrella, 1 central rack with pink and yellow shirts, 1 rack inside the main entrance, and 1 right-side rack of blue garments. Include a small wooden shoe display near the center foreground with rows of sandals. The neighboring buildings should continue down the street on the left in matching tropical colors with balconies and metal roofs, creating a lively island shopping district. Use realistic architectural details, rich saturated colors, natural shadows, sharp focus, no people, no cars, no watermark, and no extra readable text beyond the storefront and sidewalk signs. The overall mood is cheerful, tropical, commercial, and vacation-like in {argument name="location style" default="Caribbean island shopping street"}.

zh.title: 色彩斑斓的加勒比海滩服饰店
zh.description: 一个用于生成明亮热带岛屿购物街的写实提示词，包含生动的海滩服饰店面和旅游商品陈列。
zh.prompt: 创作一张充满活力的写实旅游街景照片，展示一个阳光明媚的加勒比海滩服饰店。从低角度的三分之四视角展示一座名为 {argument name="shop name" default="Angel Land"} 的两层转角店面，建筑漆成明亮的绿松石色，配有亮粉色装饰、黄色百叶窗，正面覆盖着棕榈叶茅草遮阳篷。包含清澈的蓝天、正午强烈的阳光、浅色石板路上的清晰阴影，以及从左上方伸入的棕榈树叶。店面外墙上方应有一个草书霓虹灯风格的招牌写着“Angel Land”，下方有一个褪色的长方形招牌写着“BEACHWEAR”。展示 5 把洋红色露台遮阳伞：左侧人行道 1 把，正门区域 3 把，最右侧部分裁剪掉 1 把。展示 3 个路边广告项目：左侧一个写着“ACACHI”并带有白色花朵图案的大型粉色项目，中间一个写着“ANGEL LAND”的绿松石色三明治项目，以及右侧一个写着“CRUZ BAY”的高大蓝色三明治项目。在开放的店面内填满热带旅游商品：悬挂着粉色、黄色、绿松石色、蓝色、橙色及多色印花的明亮 T 恤、连衣裙、罩衫、沙滩衬衫和泳装。展示 5 组可见的服装架：左侧人行道 1 个，左侧遮阳伞下 1 个，中央粉色和黄色衬衫架 1 个，主入口内 1 个，右侧蓝色服装架 1 个。在中央前景附近包含一个小型木制鞋类展示架，上面摆放着成排的凉鞋。相邻建筑应在左侧街道延伸，采用配套的热带色彩，配有阳台和金属屋顶，营造出热闹的岛屿购物区。使用逼真的建筑细节、浓郁饱和的色彩、自然的阴影、清晰的对焦，画面中无人、无车、无水印，除店面和人行道招牌外无额外可读文字。整体氛围应呈现出 {argument name="location style" default="加勒比岛屿购物街"} 的欢快、热带、商业和度假感。

en.title: Editorial Caricature Redraw
en.description: Transforms a reference portrait illustration into a polished exaggerated editorial caricature while preserving the original layout, text, and design elements.
en.prompt: Using the provided reference image, redraw it as a polished exaggerated editorial caricature while preserving the original Financial Times-style composition and all key elements. Keep the same seated-at-keyboard pose, the hands reaching toward the keyboard, the white grid-paper background, the red/pink dotted side shapes, the blue dotted rounded rectangle in the upper right, and the same lower-left headline text: {argument name="headline text" default="Yang Zhilin, the rock star founder behind China’s Moonshot AI"}. Transform the portrait into a glossy, high-detail digital caricature with an oversized head, fuller cheeks, slightly comical smile, enlarged glasses, stylized black hair, painterly skin texture, and a more satirical magazine-illustration look. Keep the crop tight and vertical, with the face much larger in frame than the reference and the text overlay still readable in large white serif type across the lower third. Maintain the keyboard along the bottom edge and do not add any new objects, logos, watermarks, or extra text.

zh.title: 社论漫画重绘
zh.description: 将参考肖像插图转换为精致且夸张的社论漫画，同时保留原始布局、文本和设计元素。
zh.prompt: 使用提供的参考图像，将其重绘为精致且夸张的社论漫画，同时保留原始的《金融时报》（Financial Times）风格构图及所有关键元素。保持相同的坐姿（手放在键盘上）、白色网格纸背景、红色/粉色点状侧边形状、右上角的蓝色点状圆角矩形，以及左下角相同的标题文本：{argument name="headline text" default="杨植麟，中国 Moonshot AI 背后的摇滚明星创始人"}。将肖像转换为光泽感强、细节丰富的数字漫画，特征包括超大的头部、更饱满的脸颊、略带滑稽的微笑、放大的眼镜、风格化的黑发、绘画感的皮肤纹理，以及更具讽刺意味的杂志插图风格。保持紧凑的垂直裁剪，使面部在画面中的占比远大于参考图，同时确保下方的白色衬线大字体标题文本依然清晰可读。保留底部的键盘，不要添加任何新的物体、Logo、水印或额外文本。

en.title: Telemann Baroque Scandal Poster
en.description: A dramatic Spanish investigative thumbnail poster revealing Telemann as the true composer behind a hidden Baroque masterpiece.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a dramatic investigative YouTube-thumbnail style historical music poster about a hidden Baroque authorship scandal, centered on {argument name="composer name" default="Telemann"}.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal composition, dark black background with a gritty collage texture, high contrast, cinematic lighting, neon magenta and cyan accents, aged parchment and torn paper layers. Make it look like a sensational editorial cover for a Substack column.

Layout: Left third contains the main Spanish headline in very large distressed white uppercase typography: “NOS MINTIERON.” Above it, small magenta spaced text reads “UNA COLUMNA DE SUBSTACK” with a small gold sunburst emblem containing a “T”. Under the headline, add smaller stacked Spanish text: “DURANTE AÑOS, LOS EXPERTOS” then magenta emphasis “OCULTARON LA VERDAD” then “SOBRE UNA OBRA MAESTRA DEL BARROCO.” Below, place a ripped beige note with a magenta circled X icon and the text “UN AFICIONADO SE LLEVÓ EL CRÉDITO.” At the bottom left, add huge magenta brush-script text “TELEMANN” and beneath it small white text “ERA EL VERDADERO COMPOSITOR.”

Central subject: A detailed engraved portrait of an 18th-century Baroque composer, front-facing three-quarter view, powdered curly wig, solemn expression, ornate dark coat with gold embroidery. Add cyan rim light on the left side of his hair and magenta rim light on the right side, with a thin golden halo or radial measuring arc behind his head. Include small handwritten initials “G. P. T.” and a little gold crown sketch near the portrait.

Right side collage: Use exactly 7 main evidence elements: 1) a large torn aged manuscript page in the upper right with sheet music, black censor bars, red correction marks, and a red stamp reading “CORRECCIONES”; 2) handwritten red-brown text on that page reading “Editado por un aficionado”; 3) a magnifying glass over the page showing handwritten text “no por él.” with an underlined phrase and an X beneath it; 4) a torn parchment strip in the middle glowing warm gold, signed “G. P. Telemann” in elegant black calligraphy with a small sunburst above it; 5) a handwritten note on dark paper near the bottom reading “La verdad estaba en la partitura”; 6) a red wax seal stamped with a “T” beside a large gray feather quill; 7) a cropped wooden violin body entering from the far right edge.

Additional visual details: Add subtle music staff lines, ink scratches, dust, cracks, magenta paint splatter, teal waveform circle near the lower center, torn edges, and layered paper shadows. Use dramatic warm highlights on parchment and cool neon accents on the portrait. Spanish text must be legible and placed as described.

Style constraints: Dark investigative documentary thumbnail, grunge editorial collage, realistic engraved portrait mixed with modern graphic design, no extra logos, no watermark, no additional text beyond the specified Spanish phrases.

zh.title: Telemann 巴洛克丑闻海报
zh.description: 一张极具戏剧性的西班牙语调查类缩略图海报，揭露了 Telemann 作为隐藏巴洛克杰作背后真正作曲家的真相。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张极具戏剧性的调查类 YouTube 缩略图风格的历史音乐海报，主题为隐藏的巴洛克时期署名丑闻，核心人物为 {argument name="composer name" default="Telemann"}。

画布：16:9 宽屏横向构图，深黑色背景，带有粗粝的拼贴质感，高对比度，电影级光效，点缀霓虹洋红色和青色，叠加陈旧羊皮纸和撕裂纸张纹理。整体呈现出 Substack 专栏那种耸人听闻的编辑封面感。

布局：左侧三分之一处包含巨大的西班牙语标题，采用做旧的白色大写字体：“NOS MINTIERON。”上方是小号洋红色间距文本“UNA COLUMNA DE SUBSTACK”，配有一个包含“T”字的小型金色太阳徽章。标题下方添加较小的堆叠式西班牙语文本：“DURANTE AÑOS, LOS EXPERTOS”，随后是洋红色强调的“OCULTARON LA VERDAD”，接着是“SOBRE UNA OBRA MAESTRA DEL BARROCO。”底部放置一张撕裂的米色便签，上面有一个洋红色圆圈 X 图标，文字为“UN AFICIONADO SE LLEVÓ EL CRÉDITO。”左下角添加巨大的洋红色笔刷字体“TELEMANN”，下方配以白色小字“ERA EL VERDADERO COMPOSITOR。”

中心主体：一幅精细的 18 世纪巴洛克作曲家雕版肖像，正面四分之三侧面视角，戴着粉状卷发假发，表情庄重，身着饰有金绣的华丽深色外套。在头发左侧添加青色轮廓光，右侧添加洋红色轮廓光，头部后方带有细细的金色光环或放射状测量弧线。肖像附近包含手写缩写“G. P. T.”以及一个小巧的金色皇冠草图。

右侧拼贴：使用 7 个核心证据元素：1) 右上方一张巨大的撕裂陈旧乐谱页，上面有乐谱、黑色审查条、红色修改标记以及盖有“CORRECCIONES”字样的红色印章；2) 该页面上用红褐色手写体写着“Editado por un aficionado”；3) 页面上的放大镜显示出手写文字“no por él.”，下方有下划线短语和一个 X；4) 中间一条泛着暖金色的撕裂羊皮纸带，用优雅的黑色书法签有“G. P. Telemann”，上方有一个小太阳徽章；5) 底部附近深色纸张上的手写便签，写着“La verdad estaba en la partitura”；6) 一个盖有“T”字印章的红色火漆印，旁边是一支巨大的灰色羽毛笔；7) 从右侧边缘切入的木制小提琴琴身。

视觉细节：添加微妙的五线谱线条、墨水划痕、灰尘、裂纹、洋红色油漆溅点、下部中心附近的青色波形圆圈、撕裂边缘以及分层纸张阴影。羊皮纸使用戏剧性的暖色高光，肖像使用冷色调霓虹点缀。西班牙语文本必须清晰可辨，并按所述位置放置。

风格约束：深色调查类纪录片缩略图，颓废编辑拼贴风格，写实雕版肖像与现代平面设计相结合，无额外 Logo，无水印，除指定的西班牙语短语外，不包含任何额外文字。

en.title: Golden Hour Woman Portrait

zh.title: 夜间城市漫步手机自拍
zh.description: 一个用于社交媒体风格夜间自拍的写实提示词，描绘了一位东亚女性在城市人行道上行走，并带有真实的弱光处理效果。
zh.prompt: 由 {argument name="subject" default="美丽的年轻东亚女性"} 在夜间户外 {argument name="setting" default="安静的城市人行道"} 上行走的写实手机自拍。她拥有瓷白色的皮肤、明亮的大眼睛、小巧挺直的鼻梁、自然光泽的粉色嘴唇以及精致年轻的面部特征。深棕色的头发随意扎成一个略显凌乱的高丸子头，脸颊两侧留有几缕碎发。她对着镜头温暖地微笑，一只手比着剪刀手（V 字手势）。她穿着 {argument name="outfit" default="修身的白色细肩带背心，背着一个黑色单肩包"}，包带自然地搭在肩上。背景是昏暗的行人通道，配有金属栏杆、温暖的琥珀色路灯以及向远处延伸的柔和光斑。画面由现代智能手机在行走时以手臂长度拍摄，营造出真实的社交媒体抓拍感。带有轻微的手持抖动、自然的动态模糊、真实的弱光手机处理效果、温暖的路灯照明、HDR 夜景模式、细微的数字噪点、真实的皮肤纹理、自动曝光、26mm 等效移动镜头、轻微的广角透视畸变、随意的构图、不完美的取景、无美颜滤镜、无影棚灯光、无 AI 生成感、日常手机摄影、超写实、RAW 格式手机画质、8K。

en.title: Vintage Soviet Sedan Meadow Portrait
en.description: A retro-themed editorial portrait prompt featuring a subject in the trunk of a vintage car in a rainy meadow, utilizing a reference photo for identity preservation.
en.prompt:
Create a portrait using the provided reference photo. Do not change the woman's facial features in any way. Keep her face exactly as it appears in the reference image, including her face shape, hair color, eye color, and overall identity.
Vertical editorial portrait, 3:4 aspect ratio, shot on iPhone 17 Pro Max, with moody, desaturated film tones, soft rainy overcast lighting, and a lush green wild meadow in the background.
A woman sits inside the open trunk of a {argument name="car" default="cream-colored vintage Soviet sedan"} parked in a {argument name="setting" default="field"}.
The raised trunk lid frames her naturally, with a Russian license plate visible and raindrops scattered across the wet bodywork.
She is drinking from a glass soda bottle, her head tilted back mid-sip, capturing a playful, candid expression.
She wears a matching {argument name="outfit" default="burgundy velvet sweatshirt"}, white over-the-knee socks, and tall black boots. Her legs are casually lifted over the edge of the trunk. Her long hair is worn loose, slightly damp and tousled from the rain, with a center part.
Cinematic nostalgic retro atmosphere, natural muted iPhone colors, soft film grain, editorial fashion photography, authentic candid energy, shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, highly detailed.

zh.title: 复古苏联轿车与草地人像
zh.description: 一个复古主题的编辑人像提示词，描绘了雨中草地上，主角坐在复古汽车后备箱中的场景，并利用参考照片以保持人物身份一致。
zh.prompt:
请使用提供的参考照片创作人像。请勿以任何方式改变该女性的面部特征。保持她的面部与参考图像完全一致，包括脸型、发色、瞳色以及整体身份。
竖版编辑人像，3:4 画幅，使用 iPhone 17 Pro Max 拍摄，呈现忧郁、低饱和度的胶片色调，柔和的雨天阴天光线，背景为郁郁葱葱的野生草地。
一位女性坐在 {argument name="car" default="奶油色复古苏联轿车"} 的后备箱中，车停在 {argument name="setting" default="田野"} 里。
抬起的后备箱盖自然地勾勒出她的轮廓，可以看到俄罗斯车牌，湿润的车身上散落着雨滴。
她正在喝玻璃瓶装汽水，头向后仰，处于啜饮的状态，捕捉到俏皮、自然的表情。
她身穿配套的 {argument name="outfit" default="酒红色天鹅绒卫衣"}，搭配白色过膝袜和黑色高筒靴。她的双腿随意地抬起，搭在后备箱边缘。长发披散，因雨水而略显湿润凌乱，中分发型。
电影感怀旧复古氛围，自然的 iPhone 柔和色彩，细腻的胶片颗粒感，编辑时尚摄影，真实自然的活力，浅景深，逼真的皮肤质感，高度细节化。

en.title: British Shorthair Cat Fashion Portrait
en.description: A humorous and highly detailed prompt for a British Shorthair cat wearing heart-shaped sunglasses and a garbage bag hood, posing with a toy pistol in a luxury editorial style.
en.prompt: Ultra-realistic close-up portrait of a chubby British Shorthair cat, centered and facing directly toward the camera with a completely expressionless, deadpan face. The cat wears oversized heart-shaped sunglasses that perfectly match the color of its outfit ({argument name="color" default="black, pastel blue, yellow, or any chosen color"}). A shiny plastic garbage bag is worn like a hood, with both top corners tied into two round knots resembling ears. The plastic has realistic wrinkles, glossy reflections, and soft folds framing the cat’s face. The cat holds a matching-colored toy pistol pointed directly toward the camera in the foreground, creating dramatic perspective with slight depth-of-field blur on the toy. Soft studio lighting, creamy beige seamless background, symmetrical composition, sharp focus on the cat’s face, highly detailed fur texture, realistic whiskers, reflective sunglasses, premium DSLR quality, shallow depth of field, humorous fashion editorial aesthetic, luxury pet photography, centered framing, 85mm lens, f/1.8, ultra photorealistic, 8K, hyper-detailed, cinematic lighting, clean minimal background, vibrant colors.

zh.title: 英短猫时尚肖像
zh.description: 一个幽默且高度细节化的提示词，描述了一只戴着心形墨镜、披着垃圾袋头套的英短猫，以奢华时尚大片的风格手持玩具手枪摆拍。
zh.prompt: 超写实特写肖像，主角是一只圆润的英短猫，居中面对镜头，表情呆滞且毫无波澜。猫咪戴着超大心形墨镜，颜色与服装完美呼应（{argument name="color" default="黑色、淡蓝色、黄色或任何自选颜色"}）。它披着一个闪亮的塑料垃圾袋作为头套，顶部两侧打成两个圆结，看起来像猫耳朵。塑料材质具有逼真的褶皱、光泽反射和环绕猫脸的柔和折痕。猫咪在前景中手持一把同色系的玩具手枪直指镜头，营造出强烈的透视感，玩具处带有轻微的景深模糊。柔和的摄影棚灯光，奶油米色无缝背景，对称构图，焦点清晰地落在猫脸上，极具细节的毛发质感，逼真的胡须，反光的墨镜，顶级单反相机画质，浅景深，幽默的时尚大片美学，奢华宠物摄影，居中构图，85mm 镜头，f/1.8，超写实，8K 分辨率，超精细细节，电影级灯光，干净简洁的背景，鲜艳的色彩。

en.title: Desert Solar Eclipse Fashion Editorial
en.description: A high-fashion cinematic prompt featuring a female figure sitting on a sports car in the desert during a solar eclipse, focusing on facial consistency.
en.prompt: A breathtaking hyper-realistic digital masterpiece featuring a female figure with the {argument name="reference face" default="uploaded face"} used 100% exactly as the facial reference, sitting alone on the hood of a {argument name="car type" default="black luxury sports car"} parked in the middle of a massive empty desert during a surreal solar eclipse. The exact facial identity must remain perfectly preserved with full face lock—do not alter the face, hairstyle, hairline, skin tone, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, expression, smile, age, or any unique facial features. She wears a premium {argument name="jacket type" default="oversized brown suede jacket"} layered over a fitted black turtleneck, dark cargo pants, elegant silver jewelry, and polished boots lightly covered in fine desert sand. Her confident posture and natural presence create a powerful cinematic fashion editorial look. Behind her, an enormous solar eclipse dominates the sky with a dramatic golden halo illuminating the edges of her silhouette and creating stunning cinematic rim lighting across her face and clothing. The sand surrounding the car is suspended in mid-air as if time has frozen, forming elegant spiraling shapes while glowing orange embers drift through the atmosphere. The desert horizon fades into soft atmospheric haze with subtle heat distortion and dreamlike gradients of deep amber and charcoal tones. The glossy black luxury sports car reflects the eclipse, floating particles, and surrounding environment with ray-traced precision, enhancing the premium cinematic aesthetic. Rendered in ultra-realistic 8K using Octane Render, featuring volumetric lighting, intricate environmental textures, photorealistic skin detail, cinematic depth of field, HDR color grading, global illumination, and a clean high-fashion viral editorial aesthetic. Aspect ratio 9:16

zh.title: 沙漠日食时尚大片
zh.description: 一个高定电影感提示词，描绘了一位女性在日食期间坐在沙漠中的跑车上，重点在于保持面部一致性。
zh.prompt: 一幅令人叹为观止的超写实数字杰作，画面中一位女性以 {argument name="reference face" default="上传的面部"} 作为 100% 精确的面部参考，独自坐在停在广袤荒凉沙漠中央的 {argument name="car type" default="黑色豪华跑车"} 引擎盖上，背景是超现实的日食景象。必须完美保留原始面部特征，实现全脸锁定——严禁改变脸型、发型、发际线、肤色、面部比例、眼形、鼻型、唇形、下颌线、表情、笑容、年龄或任何独特的面部特征。她身穿一件高级 {argument name="jacket type" default="棕色麂皮大衣"}，内搭修身黑色高领衫，下穿深色工装裤，佩戴精致的银饰，靴子上覆盖着一层细细的沙漠沙粒。她自信的姿态和自然的气质营造出强烈的电影感时尚大片氛围。在她身后，巨大的日食笼罩天空，戏剧性的金色光环照亮了她的轮廓边缘，并在她的脸部和服装上投射出令人惊艳的电影级轮廓光。车周围的沙粒仿佛时间静止般悬浮在半空中，形成优雅的螺旋形状，发光的橙色余烬在空气中飘浮。沙漠地平线融入柔和的大气薄雾中，带有微妙的热浪扭曲和深琥珀色与炭灰色的梦幻渐变。光亮的黑色豪华跑车反射着日食、悬浮颗粒和周围环境，呈现出光线追踪般的精准度，增强了高端电影质感。采用 Octane Render 进行 8K 超写实渲染，具备体积光、复杂的环境纹理、照片级皮肤细节、电影级景深、HDR 调色、全局光照以及干净的高级时尚病毒式大片美学。画面比例 9:16

en.title: Watercolor Vintage Map Portraits
en.description: A sophisticated set of watercolor and ink portraits of an elegant woman set against a vintage map background with geometric color bursts.
en.prompt: A series of three stylized watercolor and ink portraits captures a {argument name="subject" default="sophisticated, elegant woman"} in different poses against a {argument name="background" default="vintage map background"}. Each image features an explosion of {argument name="shapes" default="geometric, shard-like shapes in deep blues, purples, and golds"} bursting from behind the subject, creating a dynamic contrast with the classic, aged paper texture. The first portrait presents a full-length view of the woman wearing a tailored charcoal pinstripe three-piece suit with a fitted vest, standing confidently with one hand casually in her pocket and the other gently adjusting her blazer lapel. She looks directly at the camera with a calm, self-assured expression. Her long, neatly styled hair frames her face, adding elegance to the composition. The second image is a close-up portrait highlighting her refined facial features and the intricate paisley pattern of her silk necktie or scarf. Her left hand, adorned with a delicate gold statement ring, rests thoughtfully beneath her chin. A subtle, star-shaped emblem is visible in the lower-right corner, while the watercolor textures and ink detailing emphasize her graceful expression. The third portrait shows the woman in a three-quarter view, seated comfortably on a simple wooden stool with her hands resting naturally on her knees. She wears a darker tailored suit paired with an elegant scarf, gazing confidently toward the viewer with an engaging, composed expression. Her posture conveys sophistication, strength, and timeless style. Across all three variations, the artwork maintains a cohesive hand-drawn aesthetic with expressive watercolor wash effects, visible ink linework, aged paper textures, and dramatic geometric bursts in rich blues, purples, and golds, blending classic elegance with contemporary artistic flair.

zh.title: 水彩复古地图肖像
zh.description: 一套精致的水彩与水墨肖像画，以复古地图为背景，点缀几何色彩爆发，展现优雅女性风采。
zh.prompt: 这一系列三幅风格化的水彩与水墨肖像画，捕捉了 {argument name="subject" default="一位精致优雅的女性"} 在 {argument name="background" default="复古地图背景"} 前的不同姿态。每幅图像的背景中都迸发出 {argument name="shapes" default="深蓝、深紫与金色交织的几何碎片状图形"}，与陈旧纸张的质感形成了强烈的动态对比。第一幅肖像呈现了这位女性的全身照，她身着剪裁合身的炭灰色细条纹三件套西装，内搭修身马甲，单手插兜，另一只手轻轻整理西装翻领，自信地站立着。她神情从容自信，直视镜头。长发打理得整齐利落，衬托出面部轮廓，为构图增添了优雅气息。第二幅图像为特写肖像，突显了她精致的五官以及丝绸领带或丝巾上复杂的佩斯利花纹。她左手托腮，指间佩戴着一枚精致的金色个性戒指，姿态沉思。右下角隐约可见一个星形标志，水彩质感与水墨细节进一步强化了她优雅的神情。第三幅肖像展示了这位女性的三分之四侧面，她舒适地坐在简约的木凳上，双手自然地放在膝盖上。她身着深色剪裁西装，搭配优雅的丝巾，神情专注且从容，自信地注视着观众。她的姿态传达出一种精致、力量感与永恒的风格。这三幅作品共同保持了连贯的手绘美学，融合了富有表现力的水彩渲染效果、可见的水墨线条、陈旧的纸张纹理，以及深蓝、深紫与金色构成的戏剧性几何爆发，将经典优雅与现代艺术风采完美融合。

en.title: Retro Pop Art Anime Illustration
en.description: A vibrant anime fashion editorial prompt inspired by retro pop art, featuring a stylish woman with a black bob and crimson studio background.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-detailed anime fashion editorial portrait inspired by {argument name="style" default="retro pop art and contemporary Japanese character illustration"}. Depict a stylish young woman with fair skin, a sleek {argument name="haircut" default="jet-black chin-length bob"}, bold glossy red lips, and large round silver sunglasses with deep red-tinted lenses. She wears oversized silver over-ear headphones, a fitted {argument name="top" default="red ribbed mock-neck knit top"}, and a sculptural white shoulder accent. Pose her in a relaxed three-quarter profile while looking confidently toward the viewer. Use a clean solid crimson-red studio background with soft diffused lighting, crisp cel shading, elegant linework, vivid color contrast, premium editorial composition, and ultra-detailed 8K illustration quality.

zh.title: 复古波普艺术动漫插画
zh.description: 一个受复古波普艺术启发的活力动漫时尚大片提示词，主角是一位留着黑色波波头、背景为深红色的时尚女性。
zh.prompt: 创作一张超精细的动漫时尚大片肖像，灵感源自 {argument name="style" default="复古波普艺术与当代日本角色插画"}。描绘一位皮肤白皙、留着利落 {argument name="haircut" default="乌黑下巴长度波波头"} 的时尚年轻女性，她有着大胆的亮红色嘴唇，佩戴着深红色镜片的大号圆形银色墨镜。她戴着超大款银色头戴式耳机，身穿修身的 {argument name="top" default="红色罗纹半高领针织衫"}，肩部带有雕塑感的白色装饰。让她以放松的四分之三侧脸姿态示人，自信地看向镜头。使用干净的纯深红色摄影棚背景，配合柔和的漫射光、清晰的赛璐珞阴影、优雅的线条、鲜明的色彩对比、高级的时尚构图以及超精细的 8K 插画质量。

en.title: Cinematic Food Photography Menu
en.description: A specialized prompt for creating luxurious editorial food photography with integrated Korean typography and rustic background.
en.prompt: Create a realistic, premium cinematic food photography image of {argument name="menu name" default="[Menu Name]"} in a vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. If a reference food photo is provided, match its ingredients, shape, plating, colours, textures, and composition exactly; otherwise, create a realistic version based on the menu name. Plate the dish elegantly on a rustic wooden table with suitable props. Use soft natural window light coming from the upper-right, warm highlights, cool soft shadows, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, realistic textures, rising steam, and a 50mm lens perspective with a slightly top-down eye-level angle. Follow the rule of thirds. Display the menu name in {argument name="language" default="Korean"} at the upper-left in a thin, elegant Gungsuh-style font, with a short emotional {argument name="language" default="Korean"} tagline below it and a concise {argument name="language" default="Korean"} description of the dish in the lower-left. Use subtle colours for all text. Add a thin double rectangular border around the image, perfectly aligned and unbroken. Do not include any other text, logos, prices, or watermarks. The overall style should feel luxurious, warm, natural, and editorial, like a high-end gourmet food advertisement.

zh.title: 电影感美食摄影菜单
zh.description: 一个专为创作融合韩语排版与质朴背景的奢华编辑级美食摄影而设计的提示词。
zh.prompt: 创作一张真实、高端的电影感美食摄影图像，展示 {argument name="menu name" default="[菜单名称]"}，比例为竖向 3:4。如果提供了参考食物照片，请精准匹配其食材、形状、摆盘、色彩、质感和构图；否则，请根据菜单名称创作一个写实版本。将菜品优雅地摆放在质朴的木桌上，并配以合适的道具。使用来自右上方的柔和自然窗光，营造温暖的高光和冷色调柔和阴影，采用浅景深、细腻的胶片颗粒感、真实的质感、升腾的热气，以及 50mm 镜头视角，并辅以略微俯视的平视角度。遵循三分法构图。在左上方以纤细优雅的宫书体（Gungsuh-style）显示 {argument name="language" default="韩语"} 菜单名称，下方配以简短且富有情感的 {argument name="language" default="韩语"} 标语，并在左下方添加简洁的 {argument name="language" default="韩语"} 菜品描述。所有文字均使用柔和的色彩。在图像周围添加一个纤细的双矩形边框，要求对齐且完整。请勿包含任何其他文字、Logo、价格或水印。整体风格应呈现出奢华、温暖、自然且具有编辑感，如同高端美食广告一般。

en.title: Modern Flat Vector Avatars
en.description: A versatile prompt for creating clean, geometric flat vector portraits suitable for professional digital profile pictures.
en.prompt: A centered front-facing vector portrait of a person in a {argument name="style" default="modern flat illustration style"}. Clean geometric shapes, smooth gradients, crisp outlines, minimal facial details, symmetrical composition, soft skin tones, expressive eyes, subtle shading, and a simple solid-color background. The subject occupies most of the frame from the banner up. Contemporary digital avatar aesthetic, Adobe Illustrator style, high contrast, professional profile picture, sharp edges, vibrant colors, no texture, no photorealism, no background objects, 1:1 aspect ratio, high resolution. For variations like the examples: Avatar 1: Young man with thick swept-back brown hair, full beard, round black glasses, black crew-neck shirt, orange background. Avatar 2: Young woman with short black bob haircut, round gold glasses, black turtleneck and blazer, blue background. Avatar 3: Young man with curly dark hair, short beard and mustache, round black glasses, black shirt, purple background. Avatar 4: Young woman with shoulder-length wavy brown hair, floral bucket hat, white top, delicate necklace, gray background.

zh.title: 现代扁平化矢量头像
zh.description: 一个多功能的提示词，用于创建简洁、几何风格的扁平化矢量肖像，适用于专业的数字个人资料图片。
zh.prompt: 一张居中的正面人物矢量肖像，风格为 {argument name="style" default="现代扁平化插画风格"}。简洁的几何形状、平滑的渐变、清晰的轮廓、极简的面部细节、对称的构图、柔和的肤色、富有表现力的眼睛、细腻的阴影，以及简单的纯色背景。主体占据了从胸部以上的大部分画面。现代数字头像美学，Adobe Illustrator 风格，高对比度，专业个人资料图片，边缘锐利，色彩鲜艳，无纹理，非写实，无背景物体，1:1 纵横比，高分辨率。如需参考示例进行变化：头像 1：年轻男性，浓密的棕色后梳发型，络腮胡，圆形黑框眼镜，黑色圆领衫，橙色背景。头像 2：年轻女性，黑色短波波头，圆形金丝眼镜，黑色高领衫配西装外套，蓝色背景。头像 3：年轻男性，深色卷发，短胡须和八字胡，圆形黑框眼镜，黑色衬衫，紫色背景。头像 4：年轻女性，齐肩棕色波浪卷发，花卉渔夫帽，白色上衣，精致项链，灰色背景。

en.title: Cinematic Identity Portrait in Lavender
en.description: An ultra-realistic prompt designed to preserve facial identity from a reference image while placing the subject in a cinematic, stormy lavender field.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic portrait using the uploaded image as the exact facial reference. 电影级摄影，超写实，8K 分辨率。在光线昏暗的咖啡馆里，一张 {argument name="surface" default="磨损的木桌"} 上放着一杯 {argument name="drink" default="冒着热气的咖啡"}，背景模糊，可以看到一把靠在椅子上的复古原声吉他以及温暖的串灯。从蒸汽中，一个 {argument name="figure" default="半透明的烟雾人像"} 形成了侧面轮廓，闭着双眼，头部微微后仰，仿佛沉浸在旋律中，头发化作缕缕烟丝向上飘散。

该人像完全由柔软的层叠烟丝构成，具有三维立体感，并从内部散发出微弱的暖光。在人像周围，烟雾卷曲形成音符和柔和的声波涟漪，随着烟雾上升并消散在空气中，穿梭于人像的头发和肩膀之间。氛围温暖、深情且富有沉思感。

柔和的高光，细腻的阴影，平衡的对比度，构图干净，无伪影。

en.title: 90s Grunge Split Identity Composition
en.description: A complex multi-scene composition in a single frame exploring fragmented identity with a 90s rebellious aesthetic.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic multi-scene composition in a single frame, featuring [SUBJECT FROM REFERENCE IMAGE - maintain exact face, hairstyle, and facial structure], portraying a {argument name="theme" default="fragmented identity split"} during a {argument name="context" default="chaotic morning routine"} with strong {argument name="aesthetic" default="90s rebellious energy"}.
The frame contains multiple versions of the same subject, each representing a different personality/emotion. All faces must be clearly visible, sharp, and recognizable, with distinct expressions.
CENTER (MAIN IDENTITY):
Subject sitting on the edge of the bed, just woke up, leaning forward slightly, staring blankly but intense. Expression: empty, tired, emotionally detached.
Messy room, crumpled sheets.
Camera: 35mm lens, eye-level, cinematic close-medium.
IDENTITY SPLIT SCENES (ALL FACES VISIBLE, DIFFERENT EXPRESSIONS):
Left fragment (ANGRY REBEL): subject in front of mirror, slightly aggressive posture, messy movement while brushing teeth or splashing water. Expression: angry, frustrated.
Mirror reflection shows a slightly different expression (more intense).
Camera: 50mm lens, mirror shot.
Right fragment (COOL DETACHED): subject holding coffee, leaning casually, eyes half-lidded, effortless “don’t care” attitude. Expression: cold, numb.
Camera: 85mm lens, shallow depth.
Top fragment (WILD ENERGY): subject near window, shirt half open or layered outfit, body stretching but chaotic, head tilted, eyes sharp. Expression: manic, restless.
Camera: 24mm wide lens, low angle.
Bottom fragment (SELF-AWARE / TIRED): subject crouching or tying shoes, looking up directly to camera with raw, honest gaze. Expression: vulnerable but aware.
Camera: 70mm lens, slight top-down.
Additional floating shards: broken-frame pieces showing close-ups of eyes, smirks, clenched jaw, different micro-expressions across identities.
OUTFIT & STYLE (REBEL 90s):
Grunge / punk / 90s rebel aesthetic:
oversized flannel, ripped jeans, band tee, leather jacket, chain accessories, messy or slightly sweaty look.
Outfit transitions between scenes (sleepwear → grunge streetwear).
Hair slightly messy, natural, imperfect.
CHAOTIC VISUAL EFFECTS:
Fractured mirror aesthetic, overlapping frames, torn film edges, double/triple exposure.
Subtle motion ghosting to show emotional instability.
Some elements breaking out of frame aggressively (hands, shoulders, face edges).
LIGHTING & COLOR GRADING:
Mixed lighting: soft morning light + harsh contrast shadows.
Color grading:
muted warm tones (yellow/orange)
deep teal/green shadows
slight vintage 90s film fade
subtle grain & halation
Inspired by 90s grunge photography + raw cinematic tone.
MOOD:
Rebellious, restless, anti-establishment energy, emotional chaos, identity confusion.
Feels like waking up not knowing which version of yourself will take control.
DETAILS:
Ultra-realistic skin texture, visible pores, fabric detail, dust particles, texture, light leaks.
TECHNICAL:
Ultra-realistic, 8K, HDR, cinematic, no illustration, no cartoon, no stylized abs

zh.title: 90 年代 Grunge 风格分裂身份构图
zh.description: 一种在单帧内呈现的复杂多场景构图，以 90 年代叛逆美学探索碎片化的身份认同。
zh.prompt:
超写实电影级单帧多场景构图，主角为 [参考图中的主体 - 保持面部、发型和面部结构一致]，描绘了 {argument name="theme" default="碎片化身份分裂"} 在 {argument name="context" default="混乱晨间日常"} 中的状态，并带有强烈的 {argument name="aesthetic" default="90 年代叛逆能量"}。
画面包含同一主体的多个版本，每个版本代表不同的个性和情绪。所有面部必须清晰可见、锐利且可辨认，并具有独特的表情。
中心（主要身份）：
主体坐在床边，刚醒来，身体微微前倾，眼神空洞但强烈。表情：空虚、疲惫、情感抽离。
房间杂乱，床单褶皱。
镜头：35mm 镜头，平视，电影级中近景。
身份分裂场景（所有面部可见，表情各异）：
左侧碎片（愤怒叛逆者）：主体在镜子前，姿态略显攻击性，刷牙或泼水时动作杂乱。表情：愤怒、沮丧。
镜中倒影呈现出略微不同的表情（更强烈）。
镜头：50mm 镜头，镜面拍摄。
右侧碎片（冷漠疏离者）：主体手持咖啡，随意倚靠，半眯着眼，流露出毫不费力的“不在乎”态度。表情：冷漠、麻木。
镜头：85mm 镜头，浅景深。
上方碎片（狂野能量）：主体在窗边，衬衫半开或穿着叠搭服装，身体伸展但动作混乱，歪着头，眼神锐利。表情：狂躁、不安。
镜头：24mm 广角镜头，低角度。
下方碎片（自我觉察/疲惫）：主体蹲着或系鞋带，直视镜头，目光原始而真诚。表情：脆弱但清醒。
镜头：70mm 镜头，轻微俯拍。
额外的浮动碎片：破碎的画框片段展示了眼睛、冷笑、紧咬的下巴的特写，以及各身份间不同的微表情。
服装与风格（90 年代叛逆者）：
Grunge / 朋克 / 90 年代叛逆美学：
超大号法兰绒衬衫、破洞牛仔裤、乐队 T 恤、皮夹克、链条配饰，妆容凌乱或略带汗水感。
服装在场景间转换（睡衣 → Grunge 街头服饰）。
头发略显凌乱，自然，不完美。
混乱视觉效果：
破碎的镜面美学、重叠的画框、撕裂的胶片边缘、双重/三重曝光。
微妙的动态重影以表现情绪的不稳定性。
部分元素（手、肩膀、脸部边缘）激进地突破画框。
灯光与调色：
混合光线：柔和的晨光 + 强烈的对比阴影。
调色：
柔和的暖色调（黄/橙）
深青色/绿色阴影
轻微的 90 年代复古胶片褪色
细微的颗粒感与光晕
灵感源自 90 年代 Grunge 摄影 + 原始电影质感。
氛围：
叛逆、躁动、反建制能量、情感混乱、身份困惑。
感觉就像醒来时不知道哪一个版本的自己会占据主导。
细节：
超写实皮肤纹理、可见毛孔、织物细节、灰尘颗粒、质感、漏光。
技术参数：
超写实，8K，HDR，电影级，非插画，非卡通，无风格化腹肌

en.title: Nostalgic 2000s Digicam Portrait

  "subject":"Laughing while shielding face with one forearm, only part of one eye and upper cheek visible; head slightly lowered; messy bun with glowing flyaways; {argument name="clothing" default="oversized faded navy fleece sweatshirt"}; {argument name="accessory" default="tiny stud earrings"}.",

zh.title: 怀旧 2000 年代数码相机人像
zh.description: 一个结构化的 JSON 提示词，用于生成具有强闪光灯和怀旧色调的复古 CCD 卡片机美学图像。
zh.prompt:
{
  "reference":"使用附图作为面部参考；保留可识别的特征、自然比例、不对称性、面部和谐感、个性以及真实的皮肤纹理。",
  "scene":"在 {argument name="sky" default="鲜艳的钴蓝色正午天空"} 下的户外人像；极端的虫眼低角度；2000 年代初的 CCD 卡片数码相机；直闪光灯与强烈的日光混合。",
  "subject":"大笑并用一只前臂遮挡面部，仅露出部分眼睛和上脸颊；头部微低；凌乱的发髻，带有发光的碎发；{argument name="clothing" default="超大号褪色海军蓝抓绒卫衣"}；{argument name="accessory" default="小巧的耳钉"}。",
  "style":"怀旧的高级数码相机快照；梦幻般的复古镜头感；低解析力；球面像差；奶油般的柔和感；轻微的手持运动模糊；光晕；遮蔽眩光；提升的黑色/阴影；轻微的 JPEG 柔和感；温暖的 CCD 色彩；略微偏暖的白平衡；无数字模糊。",
  "lighting":"闪光灯柔和地填充面部阴影；头顶的阳光营造出金色的轮廓光；头发、嘴唇、指尖、卫衣纤维、睫毛和天空上受控的过曝微高光。",
  "skin":"健康、水润、透亮的皮肤，带有真实的毛孔；红润的脸颊；光泽感的桃色嘴唇。",
  "makeup":"玻璃肌妆感；羽毛眉；冷灰色美瞳；根根分明的睫毛；暖灰褐色眼影；颧骨、鼻尖、唇峰、内眼角、眉骨和下巴处带有闪亮的高光，同时保留皮肤纹理。",
  "color":"浓郁的自然色彩；水洗海军蓝卫衣；暖色调皮肤；钴蓝色天空；金色头发；哑光抓绒；有光泽的皮肤和嘴唇。",
  "composition":"轻微的荷兰式倾斜；不完美的手持构图；随性自在的夏日美学。",
  "negative":"改变身份、美颜滤镜、塑料感/蜡质/哑光/油腻皮肤、强烈的清晰度、过度锐化、过度的微对比度、HDR、超清晰的面部、平淡的色彩。",
  "ar":"4:5"
}

en.title: Urban Alley Night Portrait
en.description: A cinematic portrait prompt featuring a young man in a dark hoodie leaning against a graffiti wall under dim streetlights.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young man"} standing under a dim streetlight at night, leaning casually against a {argument name="background" default="graffiti-covered brick wall"} in a narrow urban alley. He is wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="black oversized hoodie"} with no visible branding, layered under a dark washed denim jacket. Messy textured black hair, faint stubble, defined jawline, serious and confident expression, hands in pockets.

Cold blue ambient lighting mixed with warm orange streetlight glow, cinematic shadows, subtle volumetric fog in the background, wet pavement reflecting light, gritty urban atmosphere. Highly detailed realistic skin texture, natural facial features, sharp focus on the subject, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, 50mm lens, f/1.8, high contrast, HDR, subtle film grain, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, color graded, professional fashion photography, premium editorial style, 8K resolution.

Negative prompt: cartoon, anime, CGI, 3D render, painting, illustration, low quality, blurry, noisy, overexposed, underexposed, oversaturated, deformed face, extra limbs, bad anatomy, unrealistic skin, watermark, text, logo, cropped, duplicate, artifacts.

Aspect ratio: 3:4

zh.title: 城市巷弄夜景人像
zh.description: 一个电影感人像提示词，描绘了一名身穿深色连帽衫的年轻男子在昏暗路灯下倚靠在涂鸦墙边的场景。
zh.prompt:
超写实电影感人像，主角为一名 {argument name="subject" default="年轻男子"}，站在夜晚昏暗的路灯下，随意地倚靠在狭窄城市巷弄中的 {argument name="background" default="布满涂鸦的砖墙"} 旁。他身穿一件 {argument name="outfit" default="黑色廓形连帽衫"}，无明显品牌标识，内搭深色水洗牛仔外套。凌乱的黑色质感短发，淡淡的胡茬，轮廓分明的下颌线，神情严肃而自信，双手插兜。

冷蓝色环境光与温暖的橙色路灯光交织，电影级阴影，背景中有淡淡的体积雾，湿润的地面反射着光线，充满粗粝的城市氛围。高度细腻的写实皮肤纹理，自然的五官，焦点清晰地对准主体，浅景深，奶油般虚化的背景，50mm 镜头，f/1.8，高对比度，HDR，细腻的胶片颗粒感，照片级真实，超高细节，专业调色，高端时尚摄影风格，8K 分辨率。

负面提示词：卡通，动漫，CGI，3D 渲染，绘画，插图，低质量，模糊，噪点，曝光过度，曝光不足，饱和度过高，面部畸形，多余肢体，人体结构错误，皮肤不真实，水印，文字，Logo，裁剪，重复，伪影。

长宽比：3:4

zh.title: 韩系美妆编辑风格网格拼图
zh.description: 一个 2x2 网格拼图提示词，展示了一位年轻东亚女性在简洁现代美学背景下的多种俏皮表情。
zh.prompt: 一张高级美妆拼图，包含四张超写实的 {argument name="subject" default="年轻东亚女性"} 肖像，以简洁的 2×2 网格排列。她拥有白皙细腻的肌肤、红润透亮的脸颊、温暖的棕色双眸、自然清晰的眉形、精致的棕色眼影、纤长卷翘的睫毛、水润的粉色嘴唇，浅棕色头发扎成凌乱丸子头，并配有修饰脸型的柔和刘海。她佩戴着 {argument name="accessory" default="精致的银色名字项链"}，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="白色碎花吊带裙"}，肩带处系有丝带，整体配饰简约优雅。每个画面捕捉了不同的俏皮表情：甜美微笑并比出手指爱心、平静自信的凝视、嘟嘴并指向脸颊的可爱模样，以及俏皮眨眼并比出剪刀手吐舌头的活泼神态。背景采用现代黑白几何壁纸，营造出简洁的美学风格。柔和的室内漫射光，平滑的肤色，浅景深，超写实 DSLR 摄影，韩系美妆编辑风格，青春俏皮氛围，自然调色，高度细腻的皮肤纹理，85mm 镜头，f/1.8，HDR，8K，高级人像摄影

en.title: Candid Summer Group Portrait in Milan
en.description: A lively and joyful group photograph of East Asian women enjoying a sunset moment near the Piazza del Duomo, emphasizing natural expressions and skin textures.
en.prompt:
A joyful, candid photograph of {argument name="group description" default="six young Asian women, around 20 years old — four Japanese, one Korean, one Chinese"} — laughing and playfully splashing each other near a fountain area close to the {argument name="landmark" default="Piazza del Duomo"} during {argument name="lighting" default="warm pre-sunset light"}, floral summer dresses catching the breeze mid-motion.

Faces are individually distinct across the group with varied East Asian features, all captured mid-laugh or mid-shout with genuine unposed expressions. Their skin shows realistic subsurface scattering under the warm golden pre-sunset light, specular micro-highlights on their cheekbones, natural texture preserved, dewy minimal makeup appropriate for a casual outing.

Hairstyles vary — some loose and windblown, some in playful half-up styles — several strands displaced dynamically by their motion and the breeze. They wear light floral summer dresses in varied pastel patterns, fabric caught mid-swirl by their movement, some with bare feet near the fountain's edge.

The lighting is warm golden pre-sunset light, soft and directionally warm, gently rim-lighting their hair and the fountain's water spray. Subtle ISO 400 film grain sits in the shadow areas. Aspect ratio 2:3. No watermark, no text overlay, not cartoon, not illustration, not anime.

zh.title: 米兰夏季抓拍集体照
zh.description: 一张生动愉悦的集体照，展现了东亚女性在米兰大教堂广场附近享受日落时光的场景，强调自然的表情和皮肤质感。
zh.prompt:
一张充满欢乐、抓拍风格的照片，画面中是 {argument name="group description" default="六位 20 岁左右的年轻亚洲女性——四位日本人、一位韩国人、一位中国人"} —— 她们在靠近 {argument name="landmark" default="米兰大教堂广场"} 的喷泉区域嬉戏打闹，在 {argument name="lighting" default="温暖的日落前光线"} 下欢笑并互相泼水，碎花夏装在微风中飘动。

群体中每个人的面部特征各异，展现出不同的东亚面孔，所有人都被捕捉到大笑或欢呼的瞬间，表情真实自然。在温暖的金色日落前光线下，她们的皮肤呈现出逼真的次表面散射效果，颧骨处有细微的高光，保留了自然的纹理，妆容清透简约，适合休闲出行。

发型各异——有的随意披散，有的扎成俏皮的半扎发——几缕发丝因动作和微风而动态地飘动。她们穿着各式浅色碎花夏裙，裙摆因动作而旋转，一些人赤脚站在喷泉边缘。

光线为温暖的金色日落前光，柔和且具有方向感，轻柔地勾勒出她们的轮廓光以及喷泉的水雾。阴影区域带有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感。长宽比 2:3。无水印，无文字覆盖，非卡通，非插画，非动漫。

zh.title: 书法风格亚洲概念艺术渲染
zh.description: 一个独特的 3D 概念艺术提示词，展示了覆盖着传统亚洲书法铭文和水墨飞溅效果的模型与场景，背景为古老的羊皮纸。
zh.prompt: {argument name="visual style" default="超写实 3D 渲染"} 附带模型。她的身体和服饰上都覆盖着 {argument name="pattern type" default="精美的亚洲书法铭文"}，采用黑色墨水和传统红色印章。半透明的羊皮纸丝带上书写着文字，垂直悬挂在场景中。背景采用 {argument name="background style" default="古老羊皮纸"} 风格，带有动态的书法笔触、黑色墨水飞溅以及焦橙色的点缀。柔和的电影级灯光，尖端的概念艺术风格，高清晰度，超精细细节。

en.title: Cinematic Beach Walk with Flash
en.description: A realistic smartphone-style photograph capturing a candid moment of a woman walking on a secluded beach at dusk, featuring dramatic wind-swept hair and on-camera flash lighting.
en.prompt: Ultra-realistic smartphone photograph of a {argument name="subject" default="woman"} walking along a {argument name="setting" default="secluded beach"} at dusk, captured in a vertical frame with an on-camera flash that creates the look of an authentic, spur-of-the-moment snapshot. The scene takes place beside the shoreline as the last traces of a deep crimson sunset fade into an almost black night sky. Behind her, dark ocean waves roll onto the sand, leaving bright white foam illuminated by the flash. The setting has a moody coastal atmosphere with cool sea breeze, subtle motion, and the feeling of an unplanned evening moment. A strong gust of wind sweeps her exceptionally long hair dramatically across her face, with loose strands obscuring part of her features. She instinctively lifts one hand to move the hair aside while continuing to walk, creating a candid sense of movement rather than a posed fashion shoot. Her facial details remain softly blurred by motion and wind, adding realism and mystery. She wears a {argument name="outfit" default="flowing black maxi dress"} with delicate spaghetti straps that moves naturally with the breeze, accentuating a graceful hourglass silhouette. High-detail textures, realistic flash reflections, natural skin tones, subtle motion blur, cinematic coastal lighting, authentic smartphone photography, premium lifestyle editorial aesthetic.

zh.title: 闪光灯下的电影感海滩漫步
zh.description: 一张写实的智能手机风格照片，捕捉了一位女性在黄昏时分于僻静海滩漫步的抓拍瞬间，展现了被风吹乱的秀发和机顶闪光灯带来的戏剧性光影。
zh.prompt: 一张超写实的智能手机照片，拍摄了一位 {argument name="subject" default="女性"} 在黄昏时分沿着 {argument name="setting" default="僻静海滩"} 漫步的场景。画面采用竖构图，机顶闪光灯营造出一种真实、随性的抓拍感。场景位于海岸边，深红色的余晖正逐渐褪去，融入近乎漆黑的夜空。她身后，深色的海浪拍打着沙滩，闪光灯照亮了明亮的白色泡沫。整个环境呈现出忧郁的海岸氛围，伴随着凉爽的海风、细微的动态感，以及一种不期而遇的夜晚氛围。一阵强风将她极长的秀发戏剧性地吹过脸庞，零散的发丝遮住了部分五官。她本能地抬起一只手拨开头发，同时继续前行，营造出一种抓拍的动态感，而非摆拍的时尚大片。她的面部细节因动态和风吹而略显模糊，增添了真实感与神秘感。她身着一件 {argument name="outfit" default="飘逸的黑色长裙"}，细肩带随风自然摆动，勾勒出优雅的沙漏型身材。高细节纹理、真实的闪光灯反射、自然的肤色、细微的动态模糊、电影感海岸光影、地道的智能手机摄影风格、高端生活方式编辑美学。

en.title: Cinematic Corporate Editorial Portrait
en.description: A sophisticated corporate portrait prompt designed for luxury business environments, featuring motion-blurred pedestrians and high-end cinematic lighting.
en.prompt:
Use my uploaded face image as the primary facial identity reference with the highest identity weight. Preserve my exact facial identity with absolute accuracy. My face must remain instantly recognizable, including my face shape, hairstyle, hairline, eyebrows, eyes, nose, lips, beard, skin tone, ears, jawline, facial proportions, and every unique facial feature. Do not beautify, stylize, age, de-age, feminize, masculinize, or replace my identity. Maintain perfect facial consistency.

Create an ultra-realistic cinematic editorial portrait of me standing confidently inside a modern luxury corporate lobby or high-end business district corridor. I am wearing a perfectly tailored {argument name="suit" default="matte black suit"}, black dress shirt with the top button open (no tie), slim black trousers, black leather belt with a minimal metallic buckle, and premium black rectangular acetate eyeglasses.

I stand completely still with a relaxed but confident posture, one hand casually inside my trouser pocket while the other rests naturally by my side. My body is angled approximately 30° away from the camera, while my head turns slightly to the left, gazing at something off-frame with a calm, observant, intelligent, and mysterious expression. No smile.

The environment is filled with people walking quickly around me, creating dramatic motion blur that emphasizes my stillness. The blurred pedestrians occupy both the foreground and background, partially crossing the frame, producing a dynamic cinematic effect while I remain perfectly sharp.

The location features elegant modern architecture with dark stone walls, brushed metal panels, warm amber accent lighting, and subtle reflections on polished surfaces. A large warm illuminated wall occupies one side of the frame, casting soft golden highlights across my face and clothing.

Lighting should be cinematic:
•Warm amber key light from the right side
•Soft neutral fill light from the front
•Gentle rim light separating my hair and shoulders
•Natural skin tones with realistic shadows
•Soft reflections on eyeglass lenses without hiding the eyes

Camera settings:
•Full-frame professional cinema camera
•85mm prime lens
•f/1.8 aperture
•ISO 200
•1/20 sec shutter speed to create realistic motion blur in surrounding people
•Subject remains tack sharp
•Eye-level perspective
•Medium-full portrait (mid-thigh to head)
•Vertical composition (4:5)
•Extremely shallow depth of field
•Smooth creamy background bokeh

Color grading:
•Rich blacks
•Warm amber and bronze highlights
•Deep charcoal shadows
•Slight teal in darker areas
•High dynamic range
•Premium luxury editorial color palette
•Soft filmic contrast
•Kodak Portra + cinematic digital look

Textures should be hyper-realistic:
•Natural skin pores
•Individual beard hairs
•Detailed hair strands
•Crisp fabric texture of the suit
•Matte black clothing
•Realistic eyeglass reflections
•Clean cinematic lighting transitions

Mood:
Powerful, sophisticated, mysterious

zh.title: 带有动态模糊的高端商务肖像
zh.description: 一套先进的肖像提示词，场景设定在高端企业大堂，利用特定的相机设置在保持主体清晰的同时，营造出周围人群的动态模糊效果。
zh.prompt:
请将我上传的面部图像作为主要的身份参考，并设置最高的身份权重。请绝对精准地保留我的面部特征。我的面部必须保持极高的辨识度，包括脸型、发型、发际线、眉毛、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、胡须、肤色、耳朵、下颌线、面部比例以及每一个独特的面部特征。请勿进行美颜、风格化、衰老、减龄、女性化、男性化处理或替换我的身份。请保持完美的面部一致性。

创作一张超写实的电影级编辑肖像，画面中我自信地站在 {argument name="location" default="现代奢华企业大堂"} 或高端商务区走廊内。我身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="剪裁完美的哑光黑色西装"}，黑色衬衫且解开领口第一颗纽扣（不系领带），修身黑色长裤，黑色皮带配简约金属扣，并佩戴高档黑色长方形板材眼镜。

我完全静止，姿态放松而自信，一只手随意插在裤兜里，另一只手自然垂在身侧。我的身体与相机呈约 30° 角，头部微微向左转，目光看向画框外，表情冷静、敏锐、睿智且神秘。不要微笑。

周围环境中有行人快速走过，营造出强烈的动态模糊，以突显我的静止感。模糊的行人占据了前景和背景，部分穿过画面，产生动态的电影效果，而我则保持绝对清晰。

场景采用优雅的现代建筑风格，配有深色石墙、拉丝金属面板、温暖的琥珀色重点照明，以及抛光表面上的微妙反射。画面一侧有一面巨大的暖光墙，在我的脸部和衣物上投射出柔和的金色高光。

灯光应呈现电影质感：
• 右侧温暖的琥珀色主光
• 正面柔和的中性补光
• 将头发与肩膀区分开的柔和轮廓光
• 具有真实阴影的自然肤色
• 眼镜镜片上有柔和反射，且不遮挡双眼

相机设置：
• 全画幅专业电影相机
• {argument name="lens type" default="85mm 定焦镜头"}
• f/1.8 光圈
• ISO 200
• 1/20 秒快门速度，以营造周围人群真实的动态模糊
• 主体保持极其清晰
• 平视视角
• 中全景肖像（大腿中部至头部）
• 竖构图 (4:5)
• 极浅的景深
• 柔和细腻的背景虚化

调色风格：
• 浓郁的黑色
• 温暖的琥珀色和青铜色高光
• 深炭色阴影
• 暗部带有轻微的青色
• 高动态范围
• 高端奢华的编辑色调
• 柔和的电影感对比度
• Kodak Portra + 电影级数字质感

纹理应达到超写实级别：
• 自然的皮肤毛孔
• 细致的胡须毛发
• 清晰的发丝细节
• 西装清晰的织物纹理
• 哑光黑色衣物
• 真实的眼镜反射
• 干净的电影级光影过渡

氛围：
强大、精致、神秘

zh.title: 浪漫咖啡馆城市景观约会
zh.description: 一幅电影质感的肖像画，描绘了一对情侣在温馨的咖啡馆中共享亲密时刻，背景是灯火辉煌的滨水城市天际线。
zh.prompt: 一幅电影质感的傍晚咖啡馆肖像，画面中 {argument name="couple type" default="一对时尚的年轻东亚情侣"} 坐在 {argument name="seating" default="舒适的木桌"} 两侧，隔窗相望，共享一段宁静而亲密的时光。男子身穿修身黑色针织衫，单手托腮，目光温柔地注视着女子，脸上带着淡淡的微笑。女子身穿柔软的米色针织衫，下巴抵在袖口上，平静而深情地回望着他。桌上摆放着精致的白色陶瓷咖啡杯，杯中拉花清晰可见，还有一块浓郁的巧克力蛋糕和极简风格的咖啡馆餐具。窗外，{argument name="view" default="令人惊叹的滨水城市天际线"} 闪烁着五彩斑斓的灯光，倒映在水面上，营造出梦幻般的城市夜景。咖啡馆内温暖的环境光与窗外清冷的城市灯光交织，烘托出温馨浪漫的氛围。玻璃上泛着柔和的倒影，浅景深效果，奶油般的虚化背景，电影级调色，奢华生活方式杂志风格，亲密叙事构图，超写实 DSLR 摄影，85mm 镜头，f/1.4，HDR，8K，高细节皮肤纹理，高端时尚杂志美学，舒适现代咖啡馆，优雅的约会之夜氛围。

en.title: Professional Studio Portrait for Executive Branding
en.description: Generates high-end studio portraits with cinematic lighting and realistic skin textures, designed to maintain facial identity from a reference photo while wearing professional attire like a traditional kaftan.
en.prompt:
Using the uploaded photo as the identity reference, create an ultra-realistic professional studio portrait while preserving the subject's exact facial identity, facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, transparent eyeglasses, beard, body proportions, and natural features. Do not beautify, stylize, or alter the face beyond subtle professional retouching.

The subject is seated confidently on a modern wooden stool with one leg crossed over the other. The left elbow rests comfortably on the knee while the left index finger lightly touches the temple in a thoughtful, confident pose. The right hand rests naturally across the crossed leg. Maintain direct eye contact with the camera and a calm, composed facial expression.

Dress the subject in a premium {argument name="clothing color" default="deep burgundy"} traditional kaftan with matching trousers, featuring clean tailoring, subtle embroidered detailing along the front placket, and a chest pocket. Keep elegant {argument name="footwear" default="black leather loafers"} and a sophisticated {argument name="accessory" default="black-and-gold wristwatch"} visible.

Place the subject in a modern minimalist studio featuring a textured grey concrete wall with subtle industrial character. Position a small wooden side cabinet beside the subject with a decorative marble-pattern ceramic vase placed on top. Keep the background uncluttered and softly blurred to maintain focus on the subject.

Use soft cinematic studio lighting with a large octabox as the key light positioned at approximately 45 degrees, balanced by gentle fill lighting to create smooth skin tones and natural shadows. Add a subtle warm rim light behind the subject to create depth and separation from the background.

Capture with a Sony A7R V and an 85mm f/1.4 GM lens at f/2.0, ISO 100, 1/200s. Produce a shallow depth of field with crisp facial details, realistic skin texture, natural colour grading, high dynamic range, and luxury editorial-quality sharpness.

The final image should feel timeless, elegant, professional, and premium, suitable for a high-end fashion editorial or executive branding campaign. Maintain realistic proportions, authentic lighting, and photorealistic quality throughout.

Aspect Ratio: 4:5 (Instagram portrait)
Style: Ultra-realistic, luxury editorial, professional studio photography, cinematic lighting, 8K, photorealistic.

zh.title: 高管品牌形象专业摄影棚肖像
zh.description: 生成具有电影级光影和真实皮肤质感的高端摄影棚肖像，旨在通过参考照片保持面部特征，并身着如传统卡夫坦长袍（kaftan）等专业服饰。
zh.prompt:
以上传的照片作为身份参考，创作一张超写实的专业摄影棚肖像，同时保留主体准确的面部特征、面部结构、肤色、发型、透明眼镜、胡须、身体比例及自然特征。请勿进行美化、风格化处理，或在细微的专业修图之外改变面部。

主体自信地坐在现代木凳上，双腿交叠。左肘舒适地靠在膝盖上，左手食指轻触太阳穴，呈现出深思且自信的姿态。右手自然地放在交叠的腿上。保持与相机的直接眼神交流，面部表情冷静从容。

为模特穿上高品质的 {argument name="clothing color" default="深酒红色"} 传统卡夫坦长袍及配套长裤，剪裁利落，前襟带有精致的刺绣细节，并配有胸袋。保留优雅的 {argument name="footwear" default="黑色皮质乐福鞋"} 和精致的 {argument name="accessory" default="黑金配色腕表"}。

将主体置于现代极简主义摄影棚中，背景为带有细微工业风质感的灰色混凝土墙。在主体旁放置一个小木制边柜，上面摆放一个装饰性的大理石纹陶瓷花瓶。背景保持整洁并进行柔焦处理，以确保焦点集中在主体上。

使用柔和的电影级摄影棚灯光，以大型八角柔光箱作为主光，放置在约 45 度角位置，并辅以柔和的补光，以营造平滑的肤色和自然的阴影。在主体后方添加细微的暖色轮廓光，以营造深度感并使其与背景分离。

使用 Sony A7R V 相机搭配 85mm f/1.4 GM 镜头拍摄，参数设置为 f/2.0、ISO 100、1/200s。呈现浅景深效果，保留清晰的面部细节、真实的皮肤质感、自然的色彩分级、高动态范围以及奢华的编辑级锐度。

最终图像应呈现出永恒、优雅、专业且高端的质感，适用于高端时尚杂志或高管品牌宣传活动。全程保持真实的比例、真实的光影和照片级的画质。

纵横比：4:5 (Instagram 肖像)
风格：超写实、奢华编辑风、专业摄影棚摄影、电影级光影、8K、照片级真实。

en.title: World Cup Soccer Baby in Ancient Style

The subject is {argument name="theme" default="a real-world World Cup soccer baby"}, with ancient-style clothing blending into a sidelines cheering atmosphere. The overall style is cute, bright, and highly shareable. Close-up mobile phone shooting perspective, low angle slightly looking up, the character's body naturally leans forward, one hand holding a small football close to the chest, the other hand lightly lifting the sleeve near the lens, creating foreground layers. Head slightly turned, chin slightly raised, doing a single-eye wink at the camera, playful smile, strong interaction. Adult young Japanese female, agile and exquisite features, real and delicate skin with a natural transparent glow. Slender and well-proportioned figure, elegant neck and shoulders, obvious collarbone. Hairstyle is a high ponytail with ribbon wrapping, paired with football bead hair ties, silver whistle earrings, and net-like tassels. Light and sweet makeup, small football diamond stickers under the eyes, team colors and football contour paintings on the cheeks. Wearing a {argument name="color scheme" default="cream white and sapphire blue"} ancient-style short jacket with real photographic texture, layered with a transparent haori-style cover-up with subtle football patterns, the waist seal has a ball net texture, and the skirt has black and white football patchwork embroidery. Wearing a football bead bracelet on the wrist and a small football sachet hanging from the waist. The background is a real football sideline and billboard area, including grass, sidelines, fences, lighting, distant stands, and fans. The background is slightly blurred, the picture is bright, and it has a strong commercial photography feel.

zh.title: 世界杯足球宝贝摄影
zh.description: 一份详细的摄影提示词，用于创作一张身着传统风格服饰的世界杯“足球宝贝”高清肖像，捕捉可爱且充满活力的场边氛围。
zh.prompt: 生成一张 9:16 竖屏高清写实肖像，主题为现实世界中的世界杯“足球宝贝”。风格融合了传统服饰与场边加油氛围，呈现出可爱、明亮且极具传播力的美感。采用手机摄影近景视角，低角度轻微仰拍，人物自然前倾，一只手将小足球抱在胸前，另一只手轻提袖口靠近镜头以营造前景层次感。头部微侧，下巴微抬，对着镜头单眼眨眼，露出俏皮的微笑，互动感极强。主体为一名 {argument name="subject attribute" default="年轻日本女性"}，五官灵动精致，皮肤真实细腻，散发自然透明的光泽。身材修长匀称，颈部优雅，锁骨突出。高马尾发型，搭配 {argument name="hair accessory" default="足球串珠发圈"}、银色小哨子耳环以及球网风格流苏。甜美妆容，眼下贴有小足球钻石贴纸，脸颊绘有球队配色与足球轮廓图案。身着 {argument name="outfit colors" default="奶油白与宝蓝色"} 传统短外套，质感写实，内搭印有足球图案的透明羽织风格上衣，配以球网质感腰封，以及带有黑白足球拼贴刺绣的裙子。手腕佩戴足球串珠手链，腰间挂着小足球香囊。背景为真实的足球场边与广告牌区域，包含草坪、边线、围栏、灯光、远处的看台及球迷。背景轻微虚化，光线明亮，具有强烈的商业摄影质感。

en.title: Woman with Rabbit Plush Fashion Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed fashion photography prompt for a woman in a mustard yellow ribbed top carrying a rabbit plushie on her head in a cozy boutique.
en.prompt:
Theme:
The day with a rabbit on my head

Subject:
A vertical composition where a {argument name="person" default="mature adult woman"} stands in the center of the frame in a shop surrounded by pale pink rabbit accessories. The figure is shown from the top of the head to the upper thighs, occupying about 70% of the screen. A {argument name="animal" default="small lop-eared rabbit plushie"} is placed on top of her head, gently supported by one hand.

Person/Expression:
A neat face with a natural and realistic feel. Dark brown hair is loosely tied, with thin bangs and some stray hairs around the face. Eyes are slightly large but not overly exaggerated, looking straight at the camera. Eyebrows and mouth are calm, with a composed expression and a very slight smile. Rose-beige lips, soft brown eye makeup, and a natural flush on the cheeks.

Clothing/Pose:
A {argument name="clothing" default="mustard yellow deep V-neck ribbed top"}. A silhouette that naturally follows the body, giving a mature, three-dimensional feminine feel. An ivory long-haired knit cardigan is loosely dropped from the shoulders, paired with white high-waisted shorts. The person's right arm is bent above the head, lightly supporting the area near the ears of the plushie with fingertips. The left arm is lowered in front of the body, with the left hand resting near the waist of the shorts. The waist is slightly tilted to the left of the screen, the upper body is facing front, and the center of gravity is on one leg.

Background/Light:
A warm rabbit-themed variety store with wooden shelves. White and pale pink lop-eared rabbit plushies, transparent cases, gift boxes, and small items are placed in the foreground and background. The items on the shelves maintain density without obstructing the silhouette of the person. Warm natural light shines in from a window in the back right, creating soft highlights on the right side of the face, shoulders, collarbone, and hair. On the opposite side, there is soft reflected light from the wooden shelves. Labels and package text in the background are small, blurred, and unreadable.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 2:3. The camera is at eye level near chest height, slightly angled upwards. The person is slightly to the right of the center, with a narrow margin above the head and enough margin on the left and right to see the rabbit accessories. The curve of the right arm leads the gaze from the top left to the head, making the plushie on the head a secondary focus. A natural focal length around 50mm. The face and upper body are clearly in focus, and the background is slightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
A sophisticated and bright fashion portrait photo. The skin is not too smooth, leaving fine texture and natural shadows. Carefully express the pile of the knit, the ribbed fabric, and the soft fur of the plushie. The overall color tone is warm, centered on cream, mustard, and pale pink. Low contrast and soft, with a sense of cleanliness and realism like a magazine photo.

Negative:
Person looking too young, unnatural chest, excessive exposure, unnatural face, asymmetrical eyes, extra fingers, missing fingers, broken wrists or elbows, poor contact with the plushie, floating, merging of clothes, unnatural gravity, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 头顶兔子玩偶的时尚人像
zh.description: 这是一份高细节的时尚摄影提示词，描述了一位身穿芥末黄罗纹上衣的女性，在温馨的精品店中，头顶着一只兔子玩偶。
zh.prompt:
主题：
头顶兔子的日常

主体：
竖构图，一位 {argument name="person" default="成熟女性"} 站在画面中心，周围是粉色系的兔子配饰。人物从头顶到大腿上部入镜，占据约 70% 的画面。一只 {argument name="animal" default="小型垂耳兔玩偶"} 被放置在她的头顶，由一只手轻轻扶住。

人物/表情：
面容精致，自然且真实。深棕色头发松散地扎起，留有薄刘海和脸颊两侧的碎发。眼睛略大但不夸张，直视镜头。眉眼和嘴唇平静，表情从容，带着极淡的微笑。玫瑰米色唇妆，柔和的棕色眼影，脸颊带有自然的红晕。

服装/姿势：
身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="芥末黄深 V 领罗纹上衣"}。剪裁自然贴合身体，展现出成熟、立体的女性美感。象牙白长毛针织开衫松垮地披在肩上，搭配白色高腰短裤。人物右臂弯曲向上，指尖轻扶玩偶耳部附近。左臂自然下垂，左手轻搭在短裤腰部位置。腰部向画面左侧微倾，上身正对前方，重心落在一侧腿上。

背景/光影：
温馨的兔子主题杂货店，配有木质货架。前景和背景中摆放着白色和淡粉色的垂耳兔玩偶、透明展示盒、礼盒及小物件。货架上的物品排列紧凑，但不会遮挡人物轮廓。温暖的自然光从右后方的窗户射入，在脸部右侧、肩膀、锁骨和头发上形成柔和的高光。另一侧则有来自木质货架的柔和反射光。背景中的标签和包装文字模糊且不可辨认。

构图/相机：
竖构图 2:3。相机位于胸部高度的视平线，略微仰拍。人物位于中心偏右，头顶留白较少，左右两侧留有足够的空间以展示兔子配饰。右臂的曲线引导视线从左上角移向头部，使头顶的玩偶成为次要焦点。使用 50mm 左右的自然焦段。面部和上半身清晰对焦，背景轻微虚化。

质感/风格：
精致明亮的时尚人像摄影。皮肤质感真实，保留了细腻的纹理和自然的阴影。细腻地表现针织衫的绒毛、罗纹织物以及玩偶柔软的毛发。整体色调温暖，以奶油色、芥末黄和淡粉色为主。低对比度，柔和且具有杂志大片般的洁净感与真实感。

负面提示词：
人物看起来太年轻、胸部不自然、过度暴露、面部不自然、眼睛不对称、多指、缺指、手腕或肘部畸形、与玩偶接触不自然、悬浮、衣服融合、重力不自然、阴影与光源不一致、皮肤过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、乱码文字、Logo、水印。
