en.title: Morning Street Breakfast Candid Shot
en.description: A realistic street photography prompt capturing an early morning scene of a young woman at a breakfast stall, designed to look like a candid mobile phone photo.
en.prompt:
Vertical 3:4, a single authentic street mobile phone snapshot, no collage, no poster feel.

In the early morning, a {argument name="subject" default="young adult Asian woman"} stands in front of an ordinary street breakfast stall, wearing a {argument name="top" default="light gray sleeveless knitted top"}, a dark loose long skirt, and white sneakers. She is holding a phone in one hand ready to pay, and the other hand is receiving a transparent plastic bag containing {argument name="food" default="soy milk and steamed buns"}.

She has just woken up, her long black hair is slightly fluffy, her expression is quiet and slightly sleepy, she is not wearing heavy makeup, she is not looking at the camera, and there is no obvious smile.

On the stall, there are steamers, plastic bags, paper cups, folding tables, and rising steam. The background is a city street just waking up, with electric bikes, commuting pedestrians, and faint morning light. The shot is taken from a diagonal side behind the queueing crowd, with part of a passerby's shoulder in the foreground to enhance the sense of on-site realism.

Negative keywords: breakfast advertisement, holding food looking at camera, overly exquisite stall, luxury block, steam covering the whole face, finger deformity, plastic bag fusion, text, watermark.

zh.title: 清晨街头早餐抓拍
zh.description: 一个写实的街头摄影提示词，捕捉清晨年轻女性在早餐摊前的场景，旨在呈现出手机抓拍的真实感。
zh.prompt:
比例 3:4，一张真实的街头手机抓拍照片，非拼贴画，无海报感。

清晨，一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻亚裔女性"} 站在普通的街头早餐摊前，身穿 {argument name="top" default="浅灰色无袖针织上衣"}、深色宽松长裙和白色运动鞋。她一只手拿着手机准备付款，另一只手接过装有 {argument name="food" default="豆浆和包子"} 的透明塑料袋。

她刚起床，黑色长发略显蓬松，表情安静且带着一丝睡意，未化浓妆，没有看向镜头，脸上没有明显的笑容。

摊位上有蒸笼、塑料袋、纸杯、折叠桌以及升腾的蒸汽。背景是刚刚苏醒的城市街道，有电动自行车、通勤的行人以及微弱的晨光。镜头从排队人群的侧后方拍摄，前景中包含部分路人的肩膀，以增强现场的真实感。

负面关键词：早餐广告，手持食物看向镜头，过于精致的摊位，豪华街区，蒸汽遮挡全脸，手指畸形，塑料袋融合，文字，水印。

en.title: Oriental Aesthetic Dunhuang Silk Wallpaper
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a minimalist oriental wallpaper featuring cascading transparent silk, Dunhuang murals, and swallows.
en.prompt: {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} vertical, {argument name="style" default="new Chinese oriental minimalist illustration"}, a fusion of Dunhuang murals and modern national trend visuals, an oriental classical Silk Road atmosphere poster. The scene features a highly saturated {argument name="background color" default="cinnabar red"} and crimson gradient background, with large areas of clean negative space in the upper and left sections. Below is an open expanse of warm white and ivory ground, with only faint grey ink-wash hills and light mist in the distance, creating a quiet and vast space. A set of giant, light, and airy transparent silk and tulle hangs from the top right of the frame, cascading down to form elegant S-curves and multi-layered overlapping spiral structures. The gauze material is crystal clear, with a translucent texture like glass, organza, or pearlescent film, with soft glowing edges and delicate reflections of pale pink, moon white, light gold, cyan-green, and iridescent colors. High-light transparency and rich layers resemble celestial ribbons blown by the wind. Some ribbons are embedded with exquisite Dunhuang patterns and traditional brocade motifs, including cyan-green flower branches, baoxiang flowers, auspicious clouds, lotuses, vermilion peonies, gold-leaf borders, and vintage mineral colors. The patterns use stone blue, stone green, cinnabar, gold, and rice yellow, interspersed with the transparent gauze, combining classical mural decorativeness with a modern high-fashion feel. Several black-blue swallows soar around the ribbons, featuring simple and delicate traditional gongbi illustration styles with deep indigo feathers, white bellies, and vermilion beaks. Their long tails are spread out in various flight movements—some soaring upward, some diving down, and some circling the ribbons, creating a rhythmic visual guide. In the lower-left near the horizon, a tiny ancient traveler in white robes rides a white horse slowly. The figures are simple and refined, blending traditional gongbi painting with modern flat illustration. Soft, long grey shadows under the horse emphasize the silent journey and vast space. The overall composition is heavy at the top and light at the bottom, dense on the right and sparse on the left, with the giant ribbons and the tiny traveler creating a strong sense of scale. Large negative space gives a poetic narrative. Highly saturated but not harsh, with clear colors where red, cyan-green, moon white, and gold form sharp contrasts. Refined oriental decorative painting, national style art poster, Dunhuang flying apsaras elements, Silk Road fantasy, gongbi line drawing, mineral pigment texture, slight rock-color particles, soft halo, delicate gold outlining, high-end graphic design, clean background, no text, no borders, high completion.

zh.title: 东方美学敦煌丝绸壁纸
zh.description: 一个用于生成极简东方壁纸的详细提示词，包含层叠透明丝绸、敦煌壁画及燕子等元素。
zh.prompt: {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16"} 竖构图，{argument name="style" default="新中式东方极简插画"}，融合敦煌壁画与现代国潮视觉，呈现东方古典丝绸之路风格海报。场景采用高饱和度的 {argument name="background color" default="朱砂红"} 与深红渐变背景，上方及左侧留有大面积干净的负空间。下方为开阔的暖白与象牙白地面，远处仅有淡淡的灰调水墨山峦与轻雾，营造出宁静辽阔的空间感。一组巨大、轻盈且通透的丝绸与薄纱从画面右上角垂下，层叠交织成优雅的 S 型曲线与多层螺旋结构。纱质晶莹剔透，具有玻璃、欧根纱或珠光膜般的半透明质感，边缘散发柔和光泽，并带有淡粉、月白、浅金、青绿及虹彩的细腻反光。高透明度与丰富的层次感如同风中飘动的仙带。部分丝带上嵌入了精致的敦煌纹样与传统织锦图案，包括青绿花枝、宝相花、祥云、莲花、朱砂牡丹、金箔边饰及复古矿物色彩。图案运用石青、石绿、朱砂、金色与米黄色，与透明纱质交织，将古典壁画的装饰性与现代高级时尚感完美结合。几只青黑色燕子在丝带间穿梭，采用简约细腻的传统工笔插画风格，羽毛呈深靛蓝色，腹部洁白，喙部朱红。它们长尾舒展，姿态各异——有的向上翱翔，有的俯冲而下，有的环绕丝带，形成富有节奏感的视觉引导。在左下角地平线附近，一位身着白袍的古代旅人骑着白马缓缓前行。人物造型简约洗练，融合了传统工笔画与现代扁平插画风格。马下柔和细长的灰色阴影强调了静谧的旅程与广阔的空间。整体构图上重下轻、右密左疏，巨大的丝带与渺小的旅人形成了强烈的比例对比。大面积的留白赋予了画面诗意的叙事感。色彩高饱和度但不刺眼，红、青绿、月白与金色形成鲜明对比。精致东方装饰画，国风艺术海报，敦煌飞天元素，丝绸之路幻想，工笔线描，矿物颜料质感，微弱岩彩颗粒，柔光晕，细腻金线勾勒，高端平面设计，干净背景，无文字，无边框，高完成度。

en.title: Night Alley Cinematic Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a realistic, 1990s street photography style portrait of a woman in a dimly lit night alley with warm street lighting.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Unraveling Night Contours"}

Main Subject:
Vertical position 4:5. In a narrow night alley, a woman stands slightly left of the center. Capturing from the top of the head to the middle of the thighs, the person occupies about 75% of the screen. She leans lightly against an old concrete wall on the left, standing naturally with one hip pushed forward.

Person/Expression:
Wet dark brown medium hair irregularly clings to her cheeks and neck, with the tips finely disheveled around her shoulders. Her face is slightly upturned, chin raised a bit, looking down quietly at the camera with half-closed eyes. Brows and mouth are relaxed, with a moist natural gloss on the lips. Maintains a mature bone structure and healthy, realistic skin texture without excessive skin correction.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="clothing" default="An off-white thin-strap ribbed camisole. The neckline is a natural V-neck that isn't too deep, made of soft cotton material that follows the body. Wearing faded blue denim high-waisted shorts with only the top button undone."} Pushing her left hip forward, leaning her upper body slightly toward the wall. Both arms hang naturally at her sides, with shoulders at slightly different heights.

Background/Light:
{argument name="background" default="A night back alley with old concrete walls, pipes, wet leaves, and building exteriors continuing narrowly into the distance."} A strong warm-colored streetlight in the upper right illuminates the person's right shoulder, cheek, wet hair, chest, arms, and edges of the thighs in gold. The left side and deep background are in deep black and olive shadows.

Composition/Camera:
Low angle looking up. A stable triangular composition with the face in the upper center, waist in the lower center, and legs spreading to the bottom corners. Wide-angle shot equivalent to 28-35mm, close range. Focus on the face and upper body, with the background softly blurred by a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
A photographic expression reminiscent of 1990s night street photography. Warm tungsten lighting, low-saturation blue-green shadows, modest film grain, and soft contrast. Meticulously depicts the textures of wet hair, ribbed fabric, faded denim, and damp walls.

Negative:
Minors, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, clothing clipping, structural failures of buttons or zippers, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light sources, plastic-like skin, excessive skin correction, gibberish text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 夜巷电影感人像
zh.description: 一个高度详细的提示词，用于生成 1990 年代街头摄影风格的写实人像，描绘了一位女性在昏暗夜巷中，伴有温暖路灯照明的场景。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="夜色轮廓的解构"}

主要主体：
画面比例 4:5。在狭窄的夜巷中，一位女性站在画面中心偏左的位置。镜头从头顶覆盖至大腿中部，人物占据约 75% 的画面。她轻靠在左侧斑驳的混凝土墙上，单侧胯部微挺，姿态自然。

人物/表情：
湿润的深棕色中长发不规则地贴在脸颊和颈部，发梢在肩头凌乱而细腻。她微微仰头，下巴轻抬，半闭双眼静静地俯视镜头。眉眼与嘴唇放松，唇部带有湿润的自然光泽。保留成熟的骨相与健康、真实的皮肤质感，无过度磨皮。

服装/姿态：
{argument name="clothing" default="一件米白色的细肩带罗纹吊带衫。领口为自然的 V 领，深度适中，柔软的棉质面料贴合身形。穿着褪色的蓝色高腰牛仔短裤，仅解开最上方的一颗纽扣。"} 左胯部微挺，上半身轻靠墙壁。双臂自然垂于身体两侧，双肩高度略有差异。

背景/光影：
{argument name="background" default="一条夜间后巷，布满老旧的混凝土墙、管道、湿润的落叶，建筑外观向远处狭窄延伸。"} 右上方强烈的暖色路灯将人物的右肩、脸颊、湿发、胸部、手臂及大腿边缘勾勒出金色轮廓。左侧及深处背景沉浸在深黑与橄榄色的阴影中。

构图/摄影：
低角度仰拍。稳定的三角形构图，脸部位于上方中心，腰部位于下方中心，双腿向底部两侧延伸。相当于 28-35mm 的广角近距离拍摄。对焦于脸部及上半身，背景通过浅景深进行柔和虚化。

质感/风格：
令人联想到 1990 年代夜间街头摄影的影像表现。温暖的钨丝灯光、低饱和度的蓝绿色阴影、适度的胶片颗粒感以及柔和的对比度。细腻地刻画了湿发、罗纹面料、褪色牛仔布及潮湿墙面的质感。

负面提示词：
未成年人、多余手指、手指缺失、肢体粘连、关节断裂、服装穿模、纽扣或拉链结构错误、不自然的重力、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、乱码文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: White Satin Studio Fashion Portrait
en.description: A professional studio fashion prompt designed for a minimalist pink aesthetic, focusing on lighting, fabric texture, and elegant posing.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Gaze Dissolving into White"}

Main Subject:
A vertical full-body fashion portrait of a female model sitting on a square platform of the same color in a pale pink studio. Positioned slightly right of center, capturing from the top of the head to the tips of black pumps. The person occupies about 75% of the frame, with wide negative space on the top left and left side.

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Light ivory-beige skin with natural pink complexion and delicate texture. Champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin lashes, soft brown eyebrows, and glossy pink-beige lips. Chin slightly tucked, looking at the front camera with a calm expression.

Clothing/Pose:
{argument name="outfit" default="A white satin mini-dress with thin straps. Elegant V-neckline with delicate white lace trim. Black pointed-toe high heels."} Sitting on the right side of the platform, right leg extended long forward, left leg bent high and crossed over the right. Right hand on the thigh, left elbow bent with fingertips lightly touching under the chin.

Background/Light:
{argument name="background" default="A minimalist photo studio with uniform dusty pink background and floor. A large circular spotlight is positioned behind the person, gradient from pale ivory center to pink edges."} Primary light is a slightly hard warm light from the upper left.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4, full-body long shot. Camera at a height slightly lower than the waist, near eye-level with slight telephoto compression. Focus on the face and upper body while clearly depicting down to the toes.

Texture/Style:
A realistic studio photograph combining Japanese beauty magazines and fashion catalogs. Carefully depicts the soft luster of satin, fine lace patterns, natural pores, and individual hair strands. Milk tea ash brown hair with thin see-through bangs.

Negative:
Minors, unnatural face, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, unnatural leg crossing, deformed shoes, floating, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light sources, plastic-like skin, excessive skin correction, text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 白色缎面影棚时尚人像
zh.description: 一款专为极简粉色美学设计的专业影棚时尚提示词，专注于光影、布料质感及优雅姿态的呈现。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="凝视消融于纯白"}

核心主体：
一张竖构图的全身时尚人像，模特坐在浅粉色影棚内同色系的方形平台上。模特位于画面中心偏右位置，取景范围从头顶至黑色高跟鞋尖。人物占据约 75% 的画面，左上方及左侧留有大面积负空间。

人物/表情：
20 多岁的女性。浅象牙米色皮肤，透着自然的粉色气色，肤质细腻。香槟米色与粉棕色眼妆，长而纤细的睫毛，柔和的棕色眉毛，以及光泽感的粉米色嘴唇。下巴微收，神情平静地注视着正前方的镜头。

服装/姿态：
{argument name="outfit" default="一件白色缎面吊带迷你裙。优雅的 V 领设计，配有精致的白色蕾丝边。黑色尖头高跟鞋。"} 坐在平台右侧，右腿向前伸展，左腿高高弯曲并叠放在右腿上。右手放在大腿上，左手肘弯曲，指尖轻触下巴下方。

背景/光影：
{argument name="background" default="极简摄影棚，背景和地面均为统一的灰粉色。人物后方设有一个大型圆形聚光灯，光线从中心浅象牙色向边缘粉色渐变。"} 主光源为来自左上方的微硬暖光。

构图/相机：
竖构图 3:4，全身远景。相机高度略低于腰部，接近视平线，带有轻微的长焦压缩感。对焦于面部及上半身，同时清晰呈现至脚尖。

质感/风格：
写实风格的影棚摄影，融合了日本美容杂志与时尚目录的风格。细腻刻画缎面的柔和光泽、精细的蕾丝纹理、自然的毛孔以及每一根发丝。奶茶灰棕色发色，配有轻薄的空气刘海。

负面提示词：
未成年人、不自然的脸部、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、不自然的交叉腿、变形的鞋子、悬浮、透视错误、与光源不一致的阴影、塑料质感皮肤、过度磨皮、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Joyful Fast-food Restaurant Crossover Scene
en.description: A creative animated scene featuring a man with Tom and Jerry in a modern fast-food setting, blending cartoon charm with vibrant restaurant decor.
en.prompt: Create a Joyful animated fast-food restaurant scene: A smiling man with a goatee and {argument name="hair color" default="black hair"} (use uploaded photo don't alter the face or appearance), sits at a table, holding a big {argument name="food item" default="juicy burger"}, wearing a black poloshirt and gray shorts. Beside him, {argument name="cartoon character" default="Jerry the mouse"} stands happily beside a metal tray of golden French fries, while Tom the cat leans over the counter dressed as a chef in a white uniform, tall hat, and bright red bow tie, grinning widely. Warm diner lights, burger menu boards, and bright orange decor fill the background — capturing fun, laughter, and a delightful crossover with beloved cartoon characters.

zh.title: 欢乐快餐店联动场景
zh.description: 一个充满创意的动画场景，展现了一名男子与《猫和老鼠》角色在现代快餐店的互动，融合了卡通魅力与充满活力的餐厅装潢。
zh.prompt: 创建一个欢乐的快餐店动画场景：一名留着山羊胡、拥有 {argument name="hair color" default="黑色头发"} 的男子（请使用上传的照片，不要改变面部或外貌）坐在桌旁，手里拿着一个巨大的 {argument name="food item" default="多汁汉堡"}，身穿黑色 Polo 衫和灰色短裤。在他身旁，{argument name="cartoon character" default="杰瑞鼠"} 开心地站在一盘金黄的炸薯条旁；而汤姆猫则身穿白色厨师制服、戴着高高的厨师帽和鲜红色的领结，靠在柜台上咧嘴大笑。背景中充满了温暖的餐厅灯光、汉堡菜单项目以及明亮的橙色装饰，捕捉到了乐趣、欢笑以及与深受喜爱的卡通角色之间美妙的联动。

en.title: Photorealistic Mountain Stream Portrait
en.description: A high-quality photorealistic portrait of a woman standing in a lush, green mountain stream, focusing on natural light and water ripples.
en.prompt:
Subject:
Fingertips releasing water droplets

Main Subject:
A photorealistic 3:4 vertical portrait. A {argument name="subject description" default="mature adult woman"} stands alone in the shallow waters of a deep green mountain stream, immersed up to her knees. The figure is positioned prominently slightly to the left of the center, captured from the top of her head to below the knees. She faces away from the camera in a diagonal rear posture, naturally twisting her upper body to look over her shoulder at the lens.

Character and Expression:
A calm and mature facial features with a soft oval contour, bright skin retaining natural texture, and a serene, slightly glossy gaze. Long semi-wet brown hair flows down her back with thin bangs naturally falling on her forehead. Makeup consists of rose-beige blush, delicate brown eye makeup, and pale pink-beige lips, with the mouth slightly relaxed in a quiet expression.

Attire and Pose:
{argument name="attire" default="A ruffled bikini in pale ivory with small floral patterns"}. The top has thin straps and a bow tie at the back, while the bottom features side ties and modest ruffles. A mature womanly proportion that isn't too thin, with natural curves at the chest, waist, hips, and thighs. Weight is slightly on the left leg with the right knee relaxed. She extends her right arm downward, letting water fall from her fingertips. The droplets form a continuous thin trail, creating small ripples on the water surface.

Background and Lighting:
The foreground features highly transparent shallow water with soft reflections of her legs. Wet gray rocks in the middle ground and {argument name="background" default="deep green trees"} in the background, which is significantly blurred. Warm natural light streams from the upper right rear, creating thin rim lights on the hair contour, shoulders, arms, and waist. Soft reflected light from the water illuminates her face, with shadows falling gently toward the lower left. The water surface is scattered with white light grains and green reflections.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical 3:4, a full-body leaning portrait up to the knees. The camera is at an angle close to eye level, slightly higher than her waist. Ample margin is left at the top of her head, with space on the right to capture the light and water droplets. Equivalent to an 85mm medium telephoto lens with a shallow depth of field. Focus is sharp on the eyes and face, with rocks and trees rendered in smooth circular bokeh.

Texture and Style:
High-quality photographic expression utilizing natural light. Skin is not overly homogenized, retaining fine texture and soft shadows. Precise depiction of wet hair, water droplets, fabric ruffles, the damp texture of rocks, and water surface reflections. Based on bright greens and ivory with a calm low contrast, transparent tones, and delicate film grain.

zh.title: 写实风格山间溪流人像
zh.description: 一张高质量的写实风格人像，描绘了一位站在郁郁葱葱的山间溪流中的女性，聚焦于自然光线与水波纹的质感。
zh.prompt:
主体：
指尖滴落的水珠

主体描述：
一张 3:4 比例的写实风格竖构图人像。一位 {argument name="subject description" default="成熟女性"} 独自站在深绿色山间溪流的浅滩中，水深没过膝盖。人物主体位于画面偏左侧，取景范围从头顶至膝盖下方。她背对镜头呈斜向站姿，上半身自然扭转，回眸看向镜头。

人物与表情：
面部轮廓柔和，五官成熟沉稳，明亮的皮肤保留了自然的纹理，眼神宁静且带有微光。长长的棕色半湿发披散在背部，稀疏的刘海自然垂落在额前。妆容采用玫瑰米色腮红、精致的棕色眼妆和淡粉米色唇妆，嘴唇微张，神情宁静。

服装与姿态：
{argument name="attire" default="一件带有小碎花图案的象牙白荷叶边比基尼"}。上衣采用细肩带设计，后背有蝴蝶结系带，下装两侧带有系带和简约的荷叶边。身材比例成熟匀称，胸部、腰部、臀部和大腿线条自然。重心略微偏向左腿，右膝放松。她将右臂向下伸展，让水珠从指尖滴落。水珠连成细线，在水面上激起层层涟漪。

背景与光影：
前景为清澈见底的浅水，倒映着她双腿的柔和影像。中景为湿润的灰色岩石，背景为 {argument name="background" default="深绿色树木"}，并经过了大幅虚化处理。温暖的自然光从右后上方射入，在头发轮廓、肩膀、手臂和腰部勾勒出细致的轮廓光。水面的反射光柔和地照亮了她的脸庞，阴影轻柔地投向左下方。水面上散布着白色的光斑和绿色的倒影。

构图与摄影：
3:4 竖构图，膝盖以上的全身侧身人像。相机视角接近视平线，略高于腰部。头顶留有充足空间，右侧留白以捕捉光线和水珠。相当于 85mm 中焦镜头，具有浅景深效果。焦点清晰地落在眼睛和面部，岩石和树木呈现出平滑的圆形焦外成像。

质感与风格：
利用自然光呈现的高质量摄影作品。皮肤质感真实，未过度磨皮，保留了细腻的纹理和柔和的阴影。精准刻画了湿发、水珠、衣物褶皱、岩石的潮湿质感以及水面反射。整体色调以明亮的绿色和象牙白为主，对比度柔和，色调通透，并带有细腻的胶片颗粒感。

en.title: Modern Architecture Fashion Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed fashion photography prompt featuring a model leaning against a concrete wall in a modern architectural setting, emphasizing clean lines, natural light, and high-end textures.
en.prompt:
Theme: Outlines Drawn in Black

Subject: A vertical 2:3 fashion portrait. A woman leans against a {argument name="wall material" default="concrete wall"} slightly to the right of the center, her body occupying about 70% of the frame. On the left, a long corridor leading deep into the background creates ample negative space, highlighting the architectural lines from floor to ceiling.

Person & Expression: Fine, bright skin with natural whiteness and subtle rosiness. Avoid excessive whitening; leave soft highlights and natural texture on the cheeks, collarbone, arms, and legs. Long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} wavy hair flows to the waist, with bangs naturally framing the face. An adult, composed expression, with the chin slightly raised and the face turned slightly left. The gaze is just off-camera. Rose-beige lips, delicate eyeliner, and natural makeup.

Outfit & Pose: A deep V-neck {argument name="dress color" default="black"} tight mini dress. Short cap sleeves, an elegant wrap bodice, small cut-outs at the waist, and a thin drawstring with subtle gathers at the right hip. Matte stretch fabric that highlights a mature model's long legs and curves. Leaning her back and right shoulder against the wall, hips shifted slightly right. The left leg is extended forward, weight on the right leg. Holding a black half-moon leather handbag by the straps. Black pointed slingback heels and delicate gold jewelry.

Background & Light: A modern architectural corridor of exposed concrete. Floor and ceiling are gray. No furniture or text. Strong natural light from the top right illuminates the face and right side of the body. Long shadows fall toward the bottom left, with the corridor's depth sinking into darkness. High contrast between cold gray, deep black, and warm skin tones.

Composition & Camera: Low-angle shot from the waist. Full body including feet. 50mm equivalent focal length, vertical orientation. Focus on the face and outfit with a soft background blur.

Texture & Style: Photorealistic, reminiscent of a high-end Japanese fashion magazine. Skin appears transparent yet natural with visible pores. Sharp resolution without being overly processed.

zh.title: 现代建筑时尚人像
zh.description: 这是一份高细节的时尚摄影提示词，描绘了一位模特倚靠在现代建筑背景下的混凝土墙边，强调简洁的线条、自然光线和高端质感。
zh.prompt:
主题：黑色勾勒的轮廓

主体：2:3 纵向时尚人像。一位女性略微偏向画面中心右侧，倚靠在 {argument name="wall material" default="混凝土墙"} 上，其身体占据了约 70% 的画面。左侧是一条通向背景深处的长廊，营造出充足的留白，突显了从地面到天花板的建筑线条。

人物与表情：细腻、明亮的皮肤，带有自然的白皙感和淡淡的红润。避免过度美白；在脸颊、锁骨、手臂和腿部保留柔和的高光和自然纹理。长款 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 波浪卷发垂至腰间，刘海自然地修饰脸型。成熟、沉稳的表情，下巴微抬，脸部略微转向左侧。视线看向镜头外。玫瑰米色嘴唇，精致的眼线，妆容自然。

服装与姿势：深 V 领 {argument name="dress color" default="黑色"} 修身迷你裙。短盖袖，优雅的裹身胸衣，腰部有小镂空设计，右臀部有细抽绳和微妙的褶皱。哑光弹力面料，突显成熟模特的修长双腿和曲线。背部和右肩倚靠在墙上，臀部略微向右偏移。左腿向前伸展，重心落在右腿上。手提黑色半月形皮包。黑色尖头露跟高跟鞋，佩戴精致的金色首饰。

背景与光影：清水混凝土构成的现代建筑长廊。地面和天花板均为灰色。无家具或文字。来自右上方的强烈自然光照亮了脸部和身体右侧。长长的阴影投向左下方，长廊深处沉入黑暗。冷灰色、深黑色与温暖肤色之间形成高对比度。

构图与相机：腰部高度的低角度拍摄。全身照，包含双脚。50mm 等效焦距，纵向构图。焦点对准脸部和服装，背景带有柔和的虚化效果。

质感与风格：照片级真实感，令人联想到高端日本时尚杂志。皮肤呈现出通透且自然的质感，可见毛孔。分辨率清晰，且不过度后期处理。

en.title: Y2K Japanese Purikura Sticker Album
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for creating a nostalgic Y2K-style Japanese purikura (photo booth) sticker album, featuring couple photos, neon doodles, and glitter textures.
en.prompt:
[SCENE]
A romantic Y2K Japanese gyaru-style purikura sticker album.
An overhead view of an open physical ring-bound notebook.

Arrange {argument name="number of photos" default="5 to 8"} rectangular couple purikura photos cleanly across the notebook page.
Each photo features the same couple and no one else.
No overlapping photos and no excessively tiny photos.
Keep the people clearly visible and unobstructed.
No extra people, duplicated faces, or extra limbs.

[HANDS & POSES]
Use simple, natural couple poses.
Keep visible hands clearly connected to the correct person.

No floating or detached hands.
No duplicated hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, malformed fingers, or oversized foreground hands.
Do not add unnecessary hands or gestures.

[GYARU DECORATION]
Heavily decorate the notebook margins and empty paper spaces with vibrant Y2K Japanese gyaru-style decorations.

Include:
{argument name="decoration styles" default="bright neon gel-pen doodles, milky opaque pen strokes, fine glitter-pen accents, handwritten hearts, stars, sparkles, swirls"},
cute symbols such as “♡”, “☆”, “✦”, and “✧”,
glossy puffy deco stickers,
holographic heart and star stickers,
small gem-like stickers,
bows, flowers, and playful retro motifs.

Add several large, bold handwritten headings and {argument name="romantic phrases" default="short romantic phrases"} chosen freely to match the cute couple mood.

Make the main lettering noticeably larger, thicker, and more eye-catching than the surrounding doodles.
Use hot pink, purple, aqua, and bright neon gel-pen colors with milky highlights and fine glitter accents.

Place all text and decorations only on the exposed notebook paper, margins, and spaces between the photos.
Do not overlap or cover the people’s faces.

[ATMOSPHERE & TEXTURE]
Bright soft lighting and a cheerful romantic atmosphere.
Vibrant hot pink, purple, aqua, and neon color palette.
Detailed physical notebook paper, glossy printed photo stickers, slightly raised gel-pen ink, pearlescent shimmer, fine glitter, and shiny deco-sticker textures.

Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.

zh.title: Y2K 日式大头贴贴纸相册
zh.description: 一个用于创作怀旧 Y2K 风格日式大头贴（Purikura）贴纸相册的高细节提示词，包含情侣照片、霓虹涂鸦和闪光纹理。
zh.prompt:
[场景]
一本浪漫的 Y2K 日式辣妹（Gyaru）风格大头贴贴纸相册。
一本打开的环装笔记本的俯视图。

在笔记本页面上整齐地排列 {argument name="number of photos" default="5 到 8"} 张长方形情侣大头贴照片。
每张照片中仅包含同一对情侣，没有其他人。
照片之间不重叠，也没有过小的照片。
保持人物清晰可见，不被遮挡。
没有多余的人、重复的面孔或多余的肢体。

[手部与姿势]
使用简单、自然的情侣姿势。
确保可见的手部清晰地连接到正确的人身上。

没有悬浮或脱离的手。
没有重复的手、多余的手指、缺失的手指、融合的手指、畸形的手指或前景中过大的手。
不要添加不必要的手势。

[辣妹装饰]
在笔记本边缘和空白处大量使用鲜艳的 Y2K 日式辣妹风格装饰。

包括：
{argument name="decoration styles" default="明亮的霓虹凝胶笔涂鸦、乳白色不透明笔触、精致的闪光笔点缀、手写爱心、星星、闪光、漩涡"}，
可爱的符号，如“♡”、“☆”、“✦”和“✧”，
光泽感的立体装饰贴纸，
全息爱心和星星贴纸，
小巧的宝石状贴纸，
蝴蝶结、花朵和俏皮的复古图案。

添加几个醒目的大号手写标题和 {argument name="romantic phrases" default="简短的浪漫短语"}，可自由选择以匹配可爱的情侣氛围。

使主要字体明显比周围的涂鸦更大、更粗、更引人注目。
使用亮粉色、紫色、水蓝色和明亮的霓虹凝胶笔颜色，并带有乳白色高光和精致的闪光点缀。

所有文字和装饰仅放置在露出的笔记本纸张、边缘和照片之间的空白处。
不要重叠或遮挡人物的脸部。

[氛围与纹理]
明亮柔和的灯光和欢快浪漫的氛围。
鲜艳的亮粉色、紫色、水蓝色和霓虹色调色板。
细腻的实体笔记本纸张、光面打印照片贴纸、略微凸起的凝胶笔墨迹、珠光闪烁、细微闪光和闪亮的装饰贴纸纹理。

垂直 3:4 纵横比。

zh.prompt: 用一张日语信息图来展现 {argument name="subject" default="VibeThinker3B"} 的卓越之处。

en.title: East Asian Fashion Model in Greek Island Alleyway
en.description: A detailed prompt for a high-fashion photography scene featuring an East Asian woman in a cobalt blue couture gown walking through a Mykonos-style stone alley.
en.prompt:
A young adult East Asian woman walking in a narrow alley of a Greek island-style white village, in a full-body composition. The subject is slightly to the right of center, body facing right, captured mid-stride: the front leg is extended far to the right, the back leg naturally pushing off the ground, steps powerful and following realistic gravity. Upper body upright, shoulders relaxed, arms hanging naturally and swinging slightly with the pace. Head slightly raised and turned towards the top right of the frame, looking into the distance, not looking at the camera, with a calm, confident, and restrained expression, possessing a high-fashion model aura.

She has a refined oval face, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender bridge of the nose, and low-saturation nude red lips. Makeup is exquisite but light, skin tone is fair and warm, preserving real pores, fine vellus hair, natural skin tone variations, and sunlight highlights, no plastic airbrushing. Deep brown-black long hair flowing naturally with soft waves, blown to the left side of the frame by the sea breeze, clear hair edges, with a few stray hairs across the cheek. Wearing small gold earrings.

She is wearing a high-saturation cobalt blue haute couture short dress, with a high stand collar, sleeveless, slim waistline, and a three-dimensional asymmetric wrap skirt structure; a very long, large trailing cape is attached to the back of the skirt, made of thick silk satin or high-grade matte crepe satin, spreading out largely to the left with the wind, forming a strong dynamic curve. On her feet are matching cobalt blue pointed-toe stiletto slingbacks with slender metal heels.

The environment is Mykonos-style architecture: pure white lime walls, narrow alleys, white stone steps, deep cobalt blue doors and windows, blue outdoor stairs, and wooden beams. The sky is pure deep blue, and the ground is irregular light gray-white flagstone. Uses strong noon Mediterranean sunlight from the upper left, forming clear hard shadows, high-contrast white walls, and saturated blue layers, with dry and clear air.

Photography style: 28mm or 35mm wide-angle lens, low angle slightly shooting upwards, lens height about knee level, f/5.6, medium deep depth of field, both subject and architecture are clear, realistic wide-angle perspective, accurate leg proportions, real fabric physical movement, slight ISO 100 grain, high-end Vogue Mediterranean fashion advertisement, photorealistic.

zh.title: 希腊岛屿巷弄中的东亚时尚模特
zh.description: 一份详细的高级时装摄影场景提示词，描述了一位身着钴蓝色高级定制礼服的东亚女性，走在米科诺斯风格石砌巷弄中的画面。
zh.prompt:
一位年轻的东亚女性走在希腊岛屿风格的白色村庄狭窄巷弄中，全身构图。主体位于画面中心偏右，身体朝向右侧，捕捉迈步瞬间：前腿大幅向右延伸，后腿自然蹬地，步伐有力且符合真实重力。上身挺拔，双肩放松，双臂自然下垂并随步伐轻微摆动。头部微抬，转向画面右上角望向远方，未注视镜头，神情冷静、自信且内敛，具备高级时装模特的气质。

她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、杏仁状深棕色双眸、自然的细眉、纤细的鼻梁以及低饱和度的裸红色双唇。妆容精致但清透，肤色白皙且温暖，保留了真实的毛孔、细微绒毛、自然的肤色变化以及阳光高光，无塑料感磨皮。深棕黑色长发随海风向画面左侧自然飘动，发丝边缘清晰，几缕发丝拂过脸颊。佩戴着小巧的金色耳环。

她身着高饱和度钴蓝色高级定制短裙，高立领、无袖、收腰设计，配有立体不对称裹裙结构；裙后连着一件超长的大型拖地斗篷，由厚实的丝绸缎面或高级哑光绉缎制成，随风向左大幅铺开，形成强烈的动态曲线。脚穿同色系钴蓝色尖头细跟露跟鞋，配有纤细的金属鞋跟。

环境为米科诺斯风格建筑：纯白石灰墙、狭窄巷弄、白色石阶、深钴蓝色门窗、蓝色户外楼梯以及木梁。天空呈现纯净的深蓝色，地面为不规则的浅灰白色石板路。采用左上方强烈的地中海正午阳光，形成清晰的硬朗阴影，白墙与饱和的蓝色层次形成高对比度，空气干燥清澈。

摄影风格：28mm 或 35mm 广角镜头，低角度微仰拍，镜头高度约在膝盖位置，f/5.6 光圈，中等景深，主体与建筑均清晰可见，真实的广角透视，准确的腿部比例，真实的织物物理运动，轻微的 ISO 100 颗粒感，高端 Vogue 地中海时尚广告质感，照片级真实。

en.title: Extreme Close-up Cat Portrait with Person
en.description: A wide-angle photographic prompt capturing a cat's nose in extreme close-up alongside a person, creating a unique distorted depth of field effect.
en.prompt: Create an image of {argument name="subject" default="me"} in the same frame as a cat. In a realistic photographic style, use a low-angle composition to capture a soft, curious cat. The cat’s nose is extremely close to the camera lens and dominates the foreground of the image. Its eyes are positioned symmetrically on the left and right. Show the cat’s entire body. The background is {argument name="background color" default="light pink"}, with the exaggerated sense of depth created by a distorted ultra-wide-angle lens, producing a unique visual effect. Because the nose is so close to the lens, it appears slightly out of focus, highlighting the natural texture of the nose, fur, and whiskers. I am also visible in the same frame. Aspect ratio: 9:16.

zh.title: 人与猫的超近距离肖像
zh.description: 一个广角摄影提示词，捕捉猫咪鼻子与人同框的超近距离特写，营造出独特的畸变景深效果。
zh.prompt: 创作一张包含 {argument name="subject" default="我"} 与猫咪同框的图像。采用写实摄影风格，使用低角度构图来捕捉一只温顺且好奇的猫。猫的鼻子极度靠近相机镜头，占据了图像的前景。猫的双眼对称分布在左右两侧。展示猫的全身。背景颜色为 {argument name="background color" default="浅粉色"}，通过畸变超广角镜头营造出夸张的景深感，产生独特的视觉效果。由于鼻子非常靠近镜头，看起来略微失焦，突显了鼻子、毛发和胡须的自然质感。我也出现在同一个画面中。长宽比：9:16。

en.title: Minimalist Japanese Fashion Studio Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed studio photography prompt for a minimalist fashion portrait of a woman sitting on a wooden stool with natural window lighting and shadows.
en.prompt:
Subject: Wooden stool and lines of light.

Main Subject: A minimalist fashion portrait of a {argument name="model" default="woman"} sitting on a tall wooden stool. The figure is placed slightly to the right of the center of the screen, with a full-body composition from head to toe. The figure and stool occupy about 75% of the vertical frame, leaving ample blank space on the left side and above the head.

Person/Expression: Natural and sophisticated Japanese vibe. Soft brown hair tied in a casual updo, leaving thin see-through bangs and strands around the face. Light coral-beige makeup, natural skin texture, and lips with a subtle gloss. Chin slightly raised, head tilted slightly to the left, looking at the camera with a calm expression.

Clothing/Pose: No outerwear. Greige rib-knit top with thin straps. Elegant shallow cache-coeur design at the chest, with a modern silhouette featuring a diagonal seam at the waist. Bottoms are nude-beige high-waisted shorts with thin three-dimensional side seams. Beige mules with transparent straps. Sitting toward the front of the stool, leaning slightly forward. Knees together, legs extended naturally diagonally downward, hands lightly overlapped between thighs. Shoulders and arms relaxed, natural center of gravity at the waist.

Background/Light: Undecorated pale ivory-beige painted wall and matte light gray floor. Warm natural light streams in from a window at the top left, casting a large rectangular window frame shadow on the wall. Soft highlights on the left cheek, collarbone, shoulder, and thigh, with thin, gentle shadows on the right side. Faint reflected light on the floor, a quiet studio space with minimal signs of life.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Full-body long shot. Camera is positioned slightly lower than waist height, nearly front-on, looking up slightly. The figure is slightly right of center, stool legs completely within the frame. 50mm equivalent, low distortion, clear focus on eyes and upper body. Background is slightly soft, with contours and clothing lines delicately resolved.

Texture/Style: A clean studio photo reminiscent of Japanese fashion magazines. Low-saturation color scheme centered on beige, greige, and light brown. Meticulous expression of natural skin texture, fine rib-knitting, wood knots, and fine irregularities on the wall. Soft contrast, subtle film grain, and an elegant finish avoiding excessive retouching.

zh.title: 极简日系时尚摄影棚人像
zh.description: 一份高细节的摄影棚拍摄提示词，用于创作一张极简风格的时尚人像，描绘一位坐在木凳上的女性，配以自然窗光与阴影。
zh.prompt:
主体：木凳与光影线条。

主要拍摄对象：一张极简时尚人像，主角为一位坐在高脚木凳上的 {argument name="model" default="女性"}。人物位于画面中心偏右位置，采用全身构图。人物与木凳占据垂直画面的 75% 左右，在左侧及头部上方留出充足的空白。

人物/表情：自然且精致的日系氛围。棕色软发扎成随意的盘发，留有轻薄的空气刘海和脸颊两侧的发丝。浅珊瑚米色妆容，呈现自然的皮肤质感，唇部带有淡淡的光泽。下巴微抬，头部略向左倾，神情平静地注视着镜头。

服装/姿势：无外套。灰米色针织吊带上衣，胸前采用优雅的浅交叉设计，腰部有斜向接缝，剪裁现代。下身搭配裸米色高腰短裤，侧面有立体的细缝线。穿着透明带子的米色穆勒鞋。坐在木凳前端，身体微微前倾。双膝并拢，双腿自然向斜下方伸展，双手轻叠于大腿之间。双肩与手臂放松，重心自然落在腰部。

背景/光线：未经装饰的浅象牙米色墙面与哑光浅灰色地面。温暖的自然光从左上方窗户射入，在墙上投下大面积的长方形窗框阴影。左侧脸颊、锁骨、肩膀和大腿处有柔和的高光，右侧则带有淡淡的柔和阴影。地面上有微弱的反射光，营造出一个极简、静谧的摄影棚空间。

构图/摄影：垂直 3:4 画幅。全身长焦镜头。相机位置略低于腰部，近乎正面拍摄，带有轻微的仰角。人物位于中心偏右，木凳腿部完整包含在画面内。50mm 等效焦距，低畸变，焦点清晰地落在眼睛和上半身。背景略微虚化，轮廓与衣物线条细腻清晰。

质感/风格：一张干净的摄影棚照片，令人联想到日系时尚杂志。以米色、灰米色和浅棕色为主的低饱和度配色。细腻呈现自然的皮肤纹理、细密的针织纹路、木材结疤以及墙面的细微不平整感。柔和的对比度，带有淡淡的胶片颗粒感，整体风格优雅，避免了过度修图。

en.title: Minimalist Japanese Aesthetic Portrait
en.description: A professional and highly detailed prompt for generating a serene, minimalist portrait of an East Asian woman using GPT Image 2, focusing on soft lighting and realistic textures.
en.prompt:
A {argument name="subject" default="young adult East Asian woman"} sitting on the light-colored micro-cement floor of a {argument name="minimalist interior space"}, leaning gently against a beige-gray micro-cement wall. Medium-long shot, from head to near feet. She sits cross-legged naturally, one leg forward and one leg relaxed to the side, leaning slightly to the right. Her right hand naturally supports her body on the ground, and her left hand rests lightly near her left knee, fingertips relaxed. Her head is slightly lowered, gaze directed to the lower left, not looking at the camera, with a quiet, contemplative, and restrained expression, lips slightly parted, showing a faint sense of melancholy and relaxation.

She has an exquisite oval face, a soft jawline, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, slender natural eyebrows, a straight nose, and light mauve-colored lips. The makeup is extremely light, retaining only the natural skin tone, light blush, and nude lip color. The skin is fair and warm, with real pores, fine fuzz, skin tone gradients, and natural highlights fully preserved, without plastic-like smoothing.

Deep brownish-black long hair is tied in a high ponytail, the tail naturally falling on her shoulders and back, with a few messy strands in front of the forehead and sides, gently lifted by soft air, adding a sense of life.

She wears a {argument name="garment" default="light taupe-brown knitted halter neck sleeveless top"}, made of soft fine-ribbed cotton fabric, with a cross-wrap design at the neckline, naturally fitting the body, and slight folds at the waist. She wears loose cream-white linen or cotton drawstring trousers, the fabric is soft, and the trouser legs are naturally stacked to form rich folds, overall following a minimalist Japanese lifestyle aesthetic.

The environment is an empty modern minimalist interior, with light beige-gray micro-cement walls and floors, no furniture, no decoration, using only the architectural space to shape the atmosphere. The overall colors consist of cream, oat gray, light warm gray, and skin tones in a low-saturation Morandi palette.

Soft natural sunlight enters obliquely from a high window on the left side of the frame, forming large areas of diffuse light. Soft highlights are formed on the character's left shoulder, collarbone, arms, and trousers, while the right side remains in natural shadow, with very light light-and-shadow transitions on the wall. Low contrast, low saturation, high dynamic range, quiet and sophisticated.

Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/2.0, eye-level slightly high angle, shallow depth of field but overall clear, real fabric texture, skin texture, hair layers, and delicate light and shadow, slight ISO 100 film grain, Fine Art Editorial, Japanese minimalist lifestyle photography, photorealistic, ultra realistic, natural imperfections, soft cinematic grading.

Avoid: plastic skin, over-smoothing, exaggerated body, wrong fingers, deformed limbs, strong HDR, over-sharpening, CG feel, anime feel, cluttered background, furniture, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 极简日式美学人像
zh.description: 一份专业且高度详尽的提示词，旨在通过 GPT Image 2 生成一张宁静、极简的东亚女性肖像，重点呈现柔和的光影与真实的质感。
zh.prompt:
一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻东亚女性"} 坐在 {argument name="极简室内空间"} 的浅色微水泥地面上，轻轻倚靠在米灰色微水泥墙面。中远景镜头，从头部到近脚部。她自然地盘腿而坐，一条腿在前，另一条腿向侧面放松，身体微微向右倾斜。右手自然撑地支撑身体，左手轻放于左膝附近，指尖放松。头部微垂，视线投向左下方，不看镜头，表情安静、沉思且克制，双唇微启，流露出一丝淡淡的忧郁与松弛感。

她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、柔和的下颌线、杏仁状的深棕色双眸、纤细的天然眉毛、挺直的鼻梁以及淡藕粉色的嘴唇。妆容极淡，仅保留自然的肤色、淡淡的腮红和裸色唇妆。皮肤白皙且温暖，真实保留了毛孔、细微绒毛、肤色渐变和自然高光，没有塑料感的磨皮。

深棕黑色长发扎成高马尾，发尾自然垂落在肩头和背部，额前和两侧有几缕凌乱的发丝，被柔和的空气轻轻拂动，增添了生活气息。

她身穿一件 {argument name="garment" default="浅灰褐色针织挂脖无袖上衣"}，采用柔软的细罗纹棉质面料，领口为交叉包裹设计，自然贴合身体，腰间有轻微褶皱。下身穿着宽松的奶油白色亚麻或棉质抽绳长裤，面料柔软，裤脚自然堆叠形成丰富的褶皱，整体遵循极简日式生活美学。

环境为空旷的现代极简室内，墙面和地面均为浅米灰色微水泥，无家具，无装饰，仅利用建筑空间塑造氛围。整体色调由奶油色、燕麦灰、浅暖灰和肤色组成，呈现低饱和度的莫兰迪色系。

柔和的自然光从画面左侧的高窗斜射入内，形成大面积的漫射光。人物的左肩、锁骨、手臂和裤子上形成柔和的高光，而右侧处于自然阴影中，墙面上有极淡的光影过渡。低对比度、低饱和度、高动态范围，安静而高级。

摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/2.0，平视略微俯角，浅景深但整体清晰，真实的织物纹理、皮肤质感、发丝层次以及细腻的光影，轻微的 ISO 100 胶片颗粒感，艺术编辑风格，日式极简生活摄影，照片级真实，超写实，自然的瑕疵，柔和的电影级调色。

避免：塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、夸张的身材、错误的手指、畸形的肢体、强烈的 HDR、过度锐化、CG 感、动漫感、杂乱的背景、家具、文字、水印、Logo。

en.title: Cozy Izakaya Beer and Ramen Portrait
en.description: A warm, photorealistic prompt for a woman enjoying beer and ramen at a traditional Japanese izakaya counter.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="The signal for the first glass"}

Main Subject:
A 9:16 vertical photo. A woman with a mature and calm atmosphere sits alone at a {argument name="location" default="wooden counter seat in an old-fashioned izakaya"}, lifting a transparent beer mug next to her face with her left hand for a toast. The person is positioned slightly to the left of center, with the upper body occupying about 55% of the frame. A large white noodle bowl is placed in the lower right, creating a triangular composition of person, beer, and noodles.

Character/Expression:
A woman with natural realism. Short dark brown bob with reduced roundness, ends along the chin, thin bangs, and fine flyaways along the cheeks. Face tilted slightly to the right, shoulders facing nearly front. Gaze directed straight at the camera, mouth in a relaxed, modest smile. Elegant brown eye makeup, pale coral blush, and natural glossy beige-pink lips. Skin not overly corrected, leaving warm light highlights on cheeks and collarbone.

Clothing/Pose:
Ivory V-neck blouse dress, not too deep. Elegant wrap-style chest, softly cinched waist, and long puffed sleeves. Thin fabric with fine wrinkles reflects the warm light around the wooden table. Overall a natural silhouette of a mature woman. Her right hand firmly grips the handle of the {argument name="drink" default="beer mug"}, elbow slightly bent and raised to shoulder height. Opposite arm rests naturally near the table. Wearing a thin silver necklace.

Background/Lighting:
A small izakaya with old wooden pillars, handwritten-style menu tags, paper lanterns, and liquor bottles. Foreground includes a dark-grained wooden table, white noodle bowl, black chopsticks, white lotus spoon, nori, chopped green onions, and small condiment containers. Person in middle ground, counter and bottles in background, with the back kitchen dimly blurred. Sign text is for atmosphere only, partly blurred to the point of being unreadable. Main light is soft warm light from the lanterns and ceiling lights in the upper right. Amber light on the right side of the face, shoulders, collarbone, and beer surface, with weak ambient light on the opposite side. Shadows fall naturally toward the lower left.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical position, medium shot from upper chest to near the waist. Camera slightly higher than eye level, nearly frontal. Natural angle of view equivalent to 35-50mm, focusing on the face and beer mug. Noodle bowl captured somewhat large in the front right to create depth. Lanterns and wooden menus at the top, table and vessels sufficient at the bottom. Medium background blur, with sharp texture on hair, eyes, beer foam, and noodles.

Texture/Style:
Natural live-action expression like a magazine snap photo. Carefully depicts wood sheen, beer transparency and bubbles, fine wrinkles in white cloth, and noodle surface with a sense of steam. Calm warm-toned color scheme, soft skin, and slightly dark background. Modest film grain, natural contrast, avoiding excessive HDR or strong sharpening.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, wrist or elbow failure, poor contact of hand holding mug, floating liquid, deformed bowl or chopsticks, wrong perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, readable brand logos, gibberish text, watermarks, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin.

zh.title: 温馨居酒屋啤酒与拉面人像
zh.description: 一个温暖、写实的提示词，描绘了一位女性在传统日式居酒屋吧台享用啤酒和拉面的场景。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="第一杯酒的信号"}

主要主体：
9:16 竖构图照片。一位气质成熟沉稳的女性独自坐在 {argument name="location" default="老式居酒屋的木质吧台座位"} 上，左手举起透明啤酒杯至脸庞侧面，做出干杯的姿势。人物位于画面中心偏左，上半身占据约 55% 的画幅。右下方放置着一个白色大面碗，形成人物、啤酒与面条的三角形构图。

人物/表情：
具有自然写实感的女性。深棕色短波波头，减少了圆润感，发尾垂至下巴，薄刘海，脸颊两侧有细碎的碎发。头部微微向右倾斜，双肩近乎正对镜头。目光直视镜头，嘴角带着放松、内敛的微笑。优雅的棕色眼妆，淡珊瑚色腮红，自然的亮面米粉色嘴唇。皮肤未经过度修饰，保留了脸颊和锁骨上的暖光高光。

服装/姿势：
象牙白 V 领衬衫裙，领口不过深。优雅的裹身式胸前设计，腰部轻微收紧，长泡泡袖。薄面料上的细微褶皱反射着木桌周围的暖光。整体呈现出成熟女性的自然轮廓。她的右手稳稳握住 {argument name="drink" default="啤酒杯"} 的把手，手肘微曲并抬高至肩部高度。另一只手臂自然地放在桌边。佩戴着一条细银项链。

背景/光影：
一家拥有老旧木柱、手写风格菜单牌、纸灯笼和酒瓶的小型居酒屋。前景包括深纹理木桌、白色面碗、黑色筷子、白色莲花勺、海苔、葱花和小型调味品容器。人物位于中景，吧台和酒瓶位于背景，后厨区域模糊处理。招牌文字仅为营造氛围，部分模糊至无法辨认。主光源来自右上方的灯笼和天花板灯，光线柔和温暖。脸部右侧、肩膀、锁骨和啤酒表面呈现琥珀色光泽，对侧有微弱的环境光。阴影自然地投向左下方。

构图/相机：
竖构图，中景拍摄，从胸部上方到腰部附近。相机位置略高于视线，近乎正面。相当于 35-50mm 的自然视角，聚焦于面部和啤酒杯。右前方的面碗拍摄得稍大，以营造景深感。顶部为灯笼和木质菜单，底部为充足的桌面和餐具。中等程度的背景虚化，头发、眼睛、啤酒泡沫和面条的质感清晰锐利。

质感/风格：
如同杂志抓拍照片般的自然写实表现。细腻地描绘了木材的光泽、啤酒的透明感与气泡、白布上的细微褶皱以及带有热气感的面条表面。冷静的暖色调配色，柔和的皮肤质感，背景略暗。带有适度的胶片颗粒感，自然对比度，避免过度 HDR 或强锐化。

负面提示词：
不自然的面部、不自然的目光、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手腕或手肘畸形、握杯手势不自然、液体悬浮、碗或筷子变形、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、可辨认的品牌标志、乱码文字、水印、过度皮肤修饰、塑料感皮肤。

en.title: High-End Beauty Portrait with Window Light
en.description: An ultra-detailed prompt for a photorealistic 9:16 beauty portrait of a woman with sophisticated lighting and precise hand anatomy.
en.prompt:
9:16 vertical photorealistic beauty portrait taken in a bright white interior. Fictional adult Japanese female, appearing {argument name="age" default="25-31 years old"}. Close-up half-body shot from top of head to below chest. Person in center, body slightly right, face slightly down. Gaze directed to the lower right, with a soft smile showing teeth modestly. Right hand placed at the lower left of the chin, index and middle fingers along the neck. Wrist naturally bent, five fingers with accurate length, joints, and nails.
Hair is deep dark brown near black, longer than collarbone, straight to loose inward curls. Left-leaning side part, left side tucked behind ear, right side flowing thickly in front of shoulder. A few natural stray hairs on the surface. Not too large dark brown eyes, thin eyeliner, natural lashes, light pink-beige eyeshadow, coral blush, and pale rose-pink lips. Soft highlights on the bridge of the nose and cheekbones. Skin is bright and clean but retains pores, fine hairs, and lip texture.
Outfit is an {argument name="outfit" default="ivory long-sleeved blouse"}. Fine vertical pleats, round neckline, small matching buttons, and fine gathers at the cuffs. No accessories. Background is a {argument name="background" default="white wall and pale beige windowsill"}, with very small greenery of a houseplant blurred in the distance. Soft diffused light from a large window in the front left, with a white reflector on the right to keep shadows shallow. High key, warm cream color, and gradations that are not overexposed.
85mm equivalent, f/2.0, camera slightly higher than eye level. Precise focus on the near eye, eyelashes, and fingertips, with background and back side of hair softly blurred. No text, logos, watermarks, jewelry, dark nails, extra fingers, fused fingers, distorted wrists, asymmetrical eyes, excessive skin smoothing, porcelain skin, strong sharpness, or CG feel.

zh.title: 高端窗边光影美妆人像
zh.description: 一份超详细的提示词，用于生成 9:16 比例的写实风格美妆人像，包含精致的光影效果和精准的手部解剖结构。
zh.prompt:
9:16 竖构图写实美妆人像，拍摄于明亮的白色室内。虚构的成年日本女性，年龄设定为 {argument name="age" default="25-31 岁"}。从头顶到胸部下方的半身特写镜头。人物居中，身体略微偏右，面部微低。视线看向右下方，带着柔和的微笑，露出牙齿。右手置于下巴左下方，食指和中指贴合颈部。手腕自然弯曲，五指长度、关节和指甲精准。
头发为深棕色近黑色，长度过锁骨，直发至内扣卷发。左侧偏分，左侧头发别在耳后，右侧头发厚实地垂在肩前。表面有少量自然的碎发。深棕色双眼大小适中，画着细眼线，睫毛自然，浅粉米色眼影，珊瑚色腮红，淡玫瑰粉色嘴唇。鼻梁和颧骨处有柔和的高光。皮肤明亮洁净，但保留了毛孔、细小绒毛和唇纹。
服装为 {argument name="outfit" default="象牙白长袖衬衫"}。带有细密的垂直褶皱，圆领设计，配有同色小纽扣，袖口有细致的褶皱。无配饰。背景为 {argument name="background" default="白色墙壁和淡米色窗台"}，远处有模糊的室内绿植。柔和的漫射光从左前方的大窗户射入，右侧配有白色反光板以保持阴影浅淡。高调摄影，暖奶油色调，过渡自然，不过曝。
85mm 等效焦距，f/2.0 光圈，相机位置略高于视线水平。焦点精准对准近处的眼睛、睫毛和指尖，背景和后脑勺头发柔和虚化。无文字、Logo、水印、珠宝、深色指甲、多余手指、手指粘连、手腕扭曲、双眼不对称、过度磨皮、瓷器感皮肤、过强锐化或 CG 感。

en.title: Retro 80s City Pop Anime Illustration
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating 1980s Japanese City Pop style illustrations that maintain the subject's identity while applying a vintage anime aesthetic. It focuses on specific fashion items like camp-collar shirts and high-waisted trousers against a nostalgic sunset waterfront background.
en.prompt: A detailed medium-long shot retro anime illustration in the style of {argument name="art style" default="1980s Japanese City Pop"} artwork with a textured paper surface and vintage screen-print finish. Transform the uploaded reference photo into the same person while preserving his facial identity, hairstyle, beard, facial proportions, smile, skin tone, and recognizable features. He has short dark wavy hair, a neatly trimmed beard, and wears oversized black square sunglasses with dark lenses. He is casually leaning against a dark wooden railing on a waterfront promenade or ship deck, with one hand resting in his trouser pocket and the other on the railing, gazing thoughtfully to his right. He wears an unbuttoned {argument name="shirt style" default="light beige short-sleeved camp-collar shirt"} with a relaxed fit, dark indigo high-waisted pleated trousers secured with a black leather belt, and a classic stainless-steel watch with a brown leather strap. The background features a {argument name="background" default="vast, tranquil waterfront beneath a dramatic salmon-pink, orange, and peach gradient sunset sky"}. A large pale circular sun hangs high in the sky while stylized fluffy clouds drift across the horizon. Calm deep blue-green water reflects the warm evening light, with dark distant mountain ranges stretching across the background. The scene is illuminated with soft golden-hour lighting, cinematic shadows, and rich nostalgic colors. Composition emphasizes relaxed confidence and timeless summer fashion, rendered with crisp anime linework, subtle cel shading, authentic 80s City Pop aesthetics, slight film grain, textured paper, muted retro color palette, and a premium vintage Japanese illustration style.

zh.prompt: 一张详细的中景复古动漫插画，采用 {argument name="art style" default="1980 年代日本 City Pop"} 艺术风格，具有纹理纸张质感和复古丝网印刷效果。将上传的参考照片转换为相同人物，同时保留其面部特征、发型、胡须、面部比例、笑容、肤色及可辨识的特征。他留着深色短卷发，胡须修剪整齐，佩戴超大号黑色方形墨镜，镜片颜色较深。他正随意地倚靠在水岸步道或船甲板的深色木质栏杆上，一只手插在裤兜里，另一只手扶在栏杆上，若有所思地望向右侧。他穿着一件解开扣子的 {argument name="shirt style" default="浅米色短袖古巴领衬衫"}，版型宽松，搭配深靛蓝色高腰打褶长裤，系着黑色皮带，佩戴一款经典的棕色皮表带不锈钢手表。背景为 {argument name="background" default="在鲑鱼粉、橙色和桃色渐变日落天空下，广阔而宁静的水岸"}。一轮巨大的淡色圆形太阳高悬天际，风格化的蓬松云朵飘浮在天边。平静的深蓝绿色水面映照着温暖的晚霞，远处深色的山脉横亘在背景中。场景采用柔和的黄金时刻光影、电影感阴影和浓郁的怀旧色彩。构图强调轻松自信与永恒的夏季时尚，通过清晰的动漫线条、细腻的赛璐珞阴影、地道的 80 年代 City Pop 美学、轻微的胶片颗粒感、纹理纸张、柔和的复古色调以及高级的日式复古插画风格呈现。

en.title: Cinematic Chinese Alleyway Selective Color Portrait
en.description: A cinematic prompt for creating a stylized grayscale portrait of a model in a traditional Chinese alleyway with vivid red selective color highlights.
en.prompt: A cinematic photograph of the {argument name="model type" default="attached model"} seated on the floor of an old, traditional Chinese alleyway, rendered with a dramatic selective color desaturation effect. Subject: The girl, posing seated with her legs crossed in front of her, wears a black tank top with an {argument name="clothing pattern" default="oriental floral pattern"}, a black striped tie with three metal badges, a black tiered miniskirt, black sheer lace stockings, and chunky black platform shoes. Her makeup features bold, intense red eyeshadow, winged eyeliner, red lips, and a red mark on her forehead. She is leaning back with a contemplative expression and downcast eyes. Setting: She is surrounded by traditional Chinese architecture of gray brick and dark wood. Several {argument name="decorative element" default="red paper lanterns"} hang above the scene. To the left are a large red lantern with black Chinese characters and a long, vertical wooden sign with gold characters. The floor is made of weathered stone slabs. Effects and Style: The image is primarily in grayscale. The only elements with color are the bright red of the lanterns, the girl's makeup, and the subtle gold of the sign. The shot is taken from ground level (a low angle), with soft ambient lighting. It focuses on the subject in the foreground, capturing the texture of the clothing and the stone.

en.title: High-End Street Style Twin Fashion

en.prompt: A high-end street style fashion photography shot, capturing {argument name="subject" default="two confident twin models"} in their late 20s walking down a {argument name="location" default="European cobblestone street"}. zh.title: 高端街头风双胞胎时尚大片
zh.description: 一份精致的时尚编辑提示词，捕捉两位双胞胎模特走在欧洲奢华街道上的电影级调色画面。
zh.prompt: 一张高端街头风时尚摄影作品，捕捉了 {argument name="subject" default="两位自信的双胞胎模特"}（20 多岁）走在 {argument name="location" default="欧洲鹅卵石街道"} 上的画面。街道两旁是模糊的奢华精品店和露天咖啡馆。模特穿着相同的服饰：一件 {argument name="outerwear" default="超大廓形、做旧感强烈的蓝色牛仔夹克"}，采用露肩穿法；内搭黑色不对称紧身胸衣式上衣，带有系带细节；下身穿着海军蓝高腰百褶超短裙，内搭黑色骑行短裤；脚踩时髦的黑色皮革及膝长靴。她们佩戴着醒目的粗金链项链和手链，以及经典的黑色猫眼设计师太阳镜。每人手提一个小巧的黑色设计师手袋，配有金色五金件（一个配有金链肩带，另一个配有黑色皮质肩带）。模特们并肩行走，一人略微靠前，构图极具动态感。光线为柔和的自然光，非常适合时尚大片。景深较浅，使模特保持清晰对焦，背景呈现出美丽的城市虚化效果。专业电影级调色。Canon EOS R5

en.title: Cinematic Abandoned Room Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed cinematic prompt for creating a melancholic portrait of a woman in an abandoned concrete room, focusing on realistic lighting and texture.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman (approximately 25–30 years old)"} sitting on the floor against a rough, stained concrete wall inside a dimly lit abandoned room. She has a slim build, fair skin, shoulder-length {argument name="hair style" default="dark brown hair that is messy and slightly damp"}, {argument name="eye color" default="greenish-hazel"} eyes, natural eyebrows, subtle bruising and dark circles beneath her eyes, and a tired, emotionally drained expression. She looks directly toward the camera with a vacant, exhausted gaze—no smile. She wears a fitted charcoal-gray sleeveless tank top and light blue ripped skinny jeans with large tears at both knees. A delicate silver necklace with a small pendant hangs around her neck, and she wears thin silver rings on her fingers. Her clothing appears slightly worn but realistic. She is seated on the dusty concrete floor with her back resting against the wall. One knee is bent upward while the other leg extends naturally toward the camera. Her arms rest loosely across her knees, with one hand hanging relaxed between her legs. Her posture conveys emotional fatigue, loneliness, and quiet resilience. The setting is minimal and gritty, featuring aged concrete walls with stains, cracks, and subtle texture. The floor is dusty and slightly dirty. No furniture, decorations, or distracting objects are present. Lighting is soft natural window light entering from the left side, creating gentle Rembrandt-style shadows across her face and body while leaving much of the background in darkness. The mood is intimate, melancholic, and cinematic. Composition: vertical portrait (4:5), medium-full body framing, eye-level camera angle, subject centered slightly left of frame. Shot with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the eyes, smooth background blur. Color grading: muted earthy tones, desaturated palette, subtle filmic contrast, realistic skin texture, visible pores, natural imperfections, soft highlights, and rich shadow detail. Style: Hollywood drama film still, documentary realism, ultra-detailed photorealism, HDR, 8K, lifelike anatomy, realistic proportions, no glamour retouching, no makeup emphasis, no text, no watermark, no extra people, no fantasy elements.

zh.title: 电影感废弃房间肖像
zh.description: 一个高细节的电影感提示词，用于创作一位女性在废弃混凝土房间中的忧郁肖像，重点在于逼真的光影和质感。
zh.prompt: 创作一张超写实的电影感肖像，主体为一位 {argument name="subject" default="年轻女性（约 25–30 岁）"}，她坐在昏暗废弃房间内粗糙且有污渍的混凝土墙边。她身材苗条，皮肤白皙，留着齐肩的 {argument name="hair style" default="凌乱且微湿的深棕色头发"}，拥有 {argument name="eye color" default="青褐色"} 的双眼，眉毛自然，眼下有细微的淤青和黑眼圈，表情疲惫且心力交瘁。她直视镜头，眼神空洞而疲惫，没有笑容。她穿着一件修身的炭灰色无袖背心和浅蓝色破洞紧身牛仔裤，双膝处有大面积破损。颈间戴着一条带有小吊坠的精致银项链，手指上戴着细银戒指。衣物看起来略显陈旧但真实。她坐在布满灰尘的混凝土底面上，背靠墙壁。一只膝盖弯曲向上，另一条腿自然地向镜头方向伸展。双臂松弛地搭在膝盖上，一只手自然垂在两腿之间。她的姿态传达出情感上的疲惫、孤独和静谧的韧性。场景极简且粗粝，墙面为带有污渍、裂纹和细微纹理的陈旧混凝土。地面布满灰尘且略显脏乱。没有家具、装饰或其他干扰物体。光线为从左侧射入的柔和自然窗光，在她的面部和身体上投下柔和的伦勃朗式阴影，同时使大部分背景隐没在黑暗中。氛围私密、忧郁且具有电影感。构图：竖构图肖像（4:5），中全景，平视视角，主体位于画面略偏左的位置。使用 85mm 镜头，光圈 f/1.8，浅景深，焦点清晰对准眼睛，背景虚化平滑。调色：柔和的大地色调，低饱和度，微妙的电影质感对比，真实的皮肤质感，可见毛孔，自然瑕疵，柔和的高光，丰富的阴影细节。风格：好莱坞剧情片剧照，纪录片写实风格，超细节超写实主义，HDR，8K，栩栩如生的解剖结构，真实的比例，无美颜修图，无妆容强调，无文字，无水印，无多余人物，无奇幻元素。

en.title: Candid Motion Blur Head Turn
en.description: A sophisticated prompt for GPT Image 2 designed to simulate a candid 35mm film shot with realistic motion blur from a sudden head turn.
en.prompt: Preserve the subject's appearance 100%. Do not alter the facial features, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, bone structure, skin texture, hair color, hair length, or hair texture. Maintain the person's unique identity and complete resemblance to the reference, even during motion. A photorealistic candid shot captured in motion. {argument name="framing" default="Close-up, waist-up framing"}. The {argument name="subject" default="woman"} is standing with her back to the camera at the exact moment she sharply turns her head over her shoulder. She suddenly looks back, her gaze directed off to the side. Her expression naturally reflects the movement, creating the feeling of a genuine, unposed snapshot rather than a staged photoshoot. SHARPNESS TECHNIQUE: The rapid head turn creates natural motion blur—subtle blur across the face, hair, and individual strands, with slight softening along the edges of the silhouette due to the speed of the movement. The face remains clearly recognizable, with all key features preserved. Her curls sweep outward with the motion, creating a dynamic trail that conveys realistic movement, as if captured by a real camera with a slightly delayed shutter. The body posture is natural, with slight asymmetry in the composition and realistic movement in the shoulders and neck. No fashion-model posing or studio-like stiffness. Cinematic directional lighting with soft shadows, rich atmospheric depth, and a textured environment. Realistic skin with visible pores and subtle natural imperfections. Captured as if on a real 35mm film camera: pronounced film grain, subtle optical imperfections, a muted, low-saturation color palette, natural depth of field, and the authentic look of a real-life photograph.

zh.title: 抓拍动态模糊转头
zh.description: 这是一个为 GPT Image 2 设计的高级提示词，旨在模拟 35mm 胶片抓拍效果，呈现因突然转头而产生的真实动态模糊。
zh.prompt: 100% 保留主体外观。不得改变面部特征、面部比例、眼型、鼻子、嘴唇、骨骼结构、皮肤纹理、发色、发长或发质。即使在运动过程中，也要保持人物的独特身份和与参考图的高度相似。这是一张在运动中抓拍的写实照片。{argument name="framing" default="特写，腰部以上构图"}。{argument name="subject" default="女性"} 背对镜头站立，就在她猛然回头看向肩后的瞬间。她突然回眸，视线投向侧方。她的表情自然地反映了这一动作，营造出一种真实、非摆拍的快照感，而非刻意安排的摄影作品。清晰度技巧：快速转头产生了自然的动态模糊——面部、头发和发丝上带有细微的模糊，由于运动速度快，轮廓边缘略显柔和。面部依然清晰可辨，所有关键特征均得到保留。卷发随动作向外扫动，形成动态轨迹，传达出真实的运动感，仿佛由一台快门略有延迟的真实相机捕捉到。身体姿态自然，构图略显不对称，肩部和颈部的动作真实。没有时尚模特的摆拍感或摄影棚般的僵硬感。电影级的定向照明，带有柔和的阴影、丰富的氛围深度和富有质感的环境。真实的皮肤，可见毛孔和细微的自然瑕疵。拍摄效果如同使用真实的 35mm 胶片相机：明显的胶片颗粒感、细微的光学瑕疵、柔和低饱和的色调、自然的景深，以及真实照片的质感。

en.title: Cinematic Roman Bath Fashion Portrait
en.description: A sophisticated cinematic prompt for an elegant fashion portrait set in an ancient Roman bath at sunset, emphasizing textures, lighting, and architectural depth.
en.prompt: A cinematic fashion portrait set in an {argument name="environment" default="ancient and weathered stone bathhouse"}, bathed in the golden afterglow of the sunset. An {argument name="subject description" default="elegant young woman"} stands slightly to the left of the center of the frame, next to a massive sandstone pillar, in a three-quarter profile pose with her back to the camera. Her body is facing away from the lens, her head turned toward her left shoulder, her gaze directed straight at the viewer, with a calm and slightly vulnerable expression and lips slightly parted. She has delicate features, skin with a natural glow, and dark hair loosely pulled into a romantic bun, with a few strands gently falling on both sides of her face, shining in the backlighting. She is dressed in an elegant backless floor-length gown made of a shimmering {argument name="gown color" default="antique gold"} fabric. The dress features thin jeweled straps, a dramatic low-cut back design, with soft folds draping between the shoulder blades, and exquisite metallic embroidery shimmering in the warm sunlight. The entire gown should exhibit an aura of luxury, sophistication, and eternity, featuring a low-key shimmering texture rather than modern sequin decorations. One arm hangs naturally by the pillar, while the other is slightly extended down to her side, outlining an elegant yet natural silhouette. Surround her with grand ancient Roman or Byzantine architecture: thick cylindrical stone pillars, mottled capitals, weathered rectangular column bases, rough ochre walls, dark arches, and rows of intersecting columns, creating a deep depth of field. In the bottom right corner of the frame, place a serene turquoise bath, its surface softly reflecting amber light. Fine mist, steam, and sunlit dust particles float around the woman and the pillars. The background should be softly blurred but still show the repeating architectural structures and dark niches. Use warm amber, bronze, honey, soft terracotta, and antique gold, contrasting with the cool blue-green pool water. Use strong directional sunlight from the upper left to shine behind the figure, creating a bright rim light around her hair, shoulders, and gown. Add soft volumetric lighting, a hazy atmosphere, deep architectural shadows, and subtle reflections on the water surface. Maintain high contrast, rich and vivid colors, realistic skin textures, detailed stone weathering, and finely rendered fabric textures. Compose the photo as an intimate half-length portrait, with the camera positioned around waist level, using an 85mm cinematic lens, shallow depth of field, soft background bokeh, natural perspective, and elegant editorial composition. Create a romantic, mysterious, nostalgic yet quiet and noble atmosphere, like a luxury perfume advertisement shot in a forgotten ancient holy place. Pursue photorealistic realism, cinematic realism, fine color grading, delicate film grain, ultra-high detail, soft highlight blooming, and realistic anatomy. The frame should not contain modern objects, text, watermarks, extra people, distorted hands, or exaggerated fantasy elements.

zh.title: 电影感罗马浴场时尚肖像
zh.description: 一个精致的电影感提示词，用于创作以日落时分古罗马浴场为背景的优雅时尚肖像，强调质感、光影和建筑深度。
zh.prompt: 一张电影感时尚肖像，背景设定在 {argument name="environment" default="古老且斑驳的石砌浴场"}，沐浴在日落的金色余晖中。一位 {argument name="subject description" default="优雅的年轻女性"} 站在画面中心偏左侧，紧邻一根巨大的砂岩柱，呈四分之三侧面姿势，背对镜头。她的身体背对镜头，头部转向左肩，目光直视观众，表情平静且略带一丝脆弱，双唇微启。她五官精致，皮肤散发着自然光泽，深色头发随意地盘成一个浪漫的发髻，几缕发丝轻柔地垂在脸颊两侧，在逆光下闪闪发光。她身着一件优雅的露背长裙，由闪烁着微光的 {argument name="gown color" default="古金色"} 面料制成。裙子带有纤细的珠宝肩带，背部采用大胆的低领设计，肩胛骨之间有柔和的褶皱垂坠，精致的金属刺绣在温暖的阳光下熠熠生辉。整件礼服应展现出奢华、精致和永恒的气息，呈现出低调的微光质感，而非现代亮片装饰。一只手臂自然地垂在柱子旁，另一只手臂微微向侧下方伸展，勾勒出优雅而自然的轮廓。周围环绕着宏伟的古罗马或拜占庭式建筑：粗壮的圆柱、斑驳的柱头、风化的矩形柱基、粗糙的赭石色墙壁、深邃的拱门以及成排的交叉圆柱，营造出深邃的景深。在画面右下角，放置一个宁静的绿松石色浴池，水面柔和地反射着琥珀色的光芒。细微的雾气、蒸汽和阳光下的尘埃颗粒在女性和柱子周围漂浮。背景应柔和虚化，但仍能展现出重复的建筑结构和深邃的壁龛。使用温暖的琥珀色、青铜色、蜂蜜色、柔和的赤陶色和古金色，与冷色调的蓝绿色池水形成对比。使用来自左上方的强烈定向阳光照射在人物身后，在她的头发、肩膀和礼服周围营造出明亮的轮廓光。添加柔和的体积光、朦胧的氛围、深邃的建筑阴影以及水面上微妙的倒影。保持高对比度、丰富生动的色彩、逼真的皮肤质感、细致的石材风化效果以及精细渲染的织物纹理。将照片构图为亲密的半身肖像，相机位置约在腰部高度，使用 85mm 电影镜头，浅景深，柔和的背景虚化，自然的透视感和优雅的编辑风格构图。营造出浪漫、神秘、怀旧而宁静高贵的氛围，宛如在被遗忘的古老圣地拍摄的奢华香水广告。追求照片级的写实感、电影级真实感、精细的调色、细腻的胶片颗粒感、超高细节、柔和的高光溢出以及逼真的解剖结构。画面中不应包含任何现代物品、文字、水印、额外人物、扭曲的手部或夸张的奇幻元素。

en.title: Elegant Bathhouse Fashion Portrait
en.description: A sophisticated fashion photography prompt for a portrait of an East Asian woman at the Roman Baths in Bath, England, focusing on lighting, textures, and high-fashion aesthetics.
en.prompt: A {argument name="subject description" default="young adult East Asian woman"} stands by the hot spring pool of the ancient Roman Baths in Bath, England, with the shot taken from above the head to near the hips. The figure is slightly to the right of center, with their back to the camera, facing the right side of the frame at a two-thirds back angle; their waist is near an old rough stone railing, with arms stretched forward and hands resting naturally on the top of the railing. She looks back gently over her left shoulder, with her side profile facing toward the far right of the frame, not looking directly at the camera. Her expression is calm, restrained, and elegant, with lips slightly parted naturally. She has a delicate oval face, almond-shaped deep brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender bridge of the nose, and naked rose-colored lips. The makeup is light and exquisite, with a warm white skin tone, preserving real pores, fine downy hair, natural skin tone variations, and sunlight highlights, without plastic skin smoothing. Her dark brown-black hair is loosely gathered into a slightly messy low bun, with wet wisps of hair by the ears, forehead, and back of the neck, and a few strands sticking to her cheeks and shoulders. She wears small gold earrings. She wears a {argument name="dress description" default="high-end silk slip dress in bronze-gold or warm brownish-gold"}, with very thin straps and a large low-draped open back. The fabric at the neckline and back naturally stacks, featuring fine metal sequins, embroidery, or shimmering woven textures; the skirt fits the waist and hips, with the wet hem partially entering the hot spring water. The styling is vintage, luxurious, and subtle, like a high-end fashion magazine spread. The background is the {argument name="architectural setting" default="real Roman Bath architecture"}: creamy yellow old stone walls, arcades, columns, statue railings, and a towering Gothic abbey tower in the distance. The hot spring water is a soft grayish-green, with a large amount of mist and steam on the surface, and a few tourists in the distance only as blurred small silhouettes. The foreground stone railing is full of rough textures, cracks, and wet dark spots. Golden hour sunlight shines obliquely from the top right of the frame, illuminating the side of the figure's face, shoulders, back, hair, and golden dress, creating warm highlights on the stone walls; shadows maintain depth, and steam is illuminated by backlighting. The overall tone is low-saturated, warm gold, ancient stone gray, and grayish-green water, with a strong but natural cinematic feel. Photography style: 50mm or 85mm lens, f/2, eye-level position slightly below the shoulders, shallow depth of field, with the figure's face, shoulders, and back clear, and the architectural background soft but recognizable. Real stone, water, steam, skin, and silk textures, slight ISO 400 film grain, soft highlight blooming, cinematic editorial portrait, photorealistic. Avoid: modern swimming pools, incorrect architecture, frontal poses, incorrect look-back direction, excessive exposure, transparent dresses, exaggerated body shapes, plastic skin, incorrect fingers, distorted arms, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cartoons, CG, text, watermarks, logos.

zh.title: 优雅浴场时尚肖像
zh.description: 一个精致的时尚摄影提示词，用于拍摄一位东亚女性在英国巴斯罗马浴场的肖像，重点关注光影、质感和高级时尚美学。
zh.prompt: 一位 {argument name="subject description" default="年轻的东亚女性"} 站在英国巴斯古罗马浴场的温泉池边，镜头从头顶上方拍摄至髋部附近。人物位于画面中心偏右，背对镜头，以三分之二背影的角度面向画面右侧；腰部靠近古老的粗糙石栏杆，双臂向前伸展，双手自然地放在栏杆顶部。她轻轻回眸，侧脸朝向画面最右侧，没有直视镜头。她的表情平静、内敛且优雅，双唇自然微启。她拥有精致的鹅蛋脸、深棕色的杏仁眼、自然的细眉、挺拔的鼻梁和裸粉色的双唇。妆容清透精致，呈现温暖的白皙肤色，保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、自然的肤色变化和阳光高光，没有塑料感的磨皮效果。她深棕黑色的头发松散地盘成一个略显凌乱的低发髻，耳边、额头和颈后有湿润的发丝，几缕发丝贴在脸颊和肩膀上。她佩戴着小巧的金耳环。她身穿一件 {argument name="dress description" default="青铜金或暖棕金色的高级丝绸吊带裙"}，带有极细的肩带和大幅度低垂的露背设计。领口和背部的面料自然堆叠，带有精致的金属亮片、刺绣或闪烁的编织纹理；裙摆贴合腰臀，湿润的裙边部分浸入温泉水中。造型复古、奢华且含蓄，宛如高级时尚杂志的内页。背景是 {argument name="architectural setting" default="真实的罗马浴场建筑"}：奶油黄色的古老石墙、拱廊、圆柱、雕像栏杆，远处是高耸的哥特式修道院塔楼。温泉水呈柔和的灰绿色，水面弥漫着大量的雾气和蒸汽，远处的几名游客仅呈现为模糊的小剪影。前景的石栏杆充满了粗糙的纹理、裂缝和湿润的深色斑点。黄金时刻的阳光从画面右上方斜射而来，照亮了人物的侧脸、肩膀、背部、头发和金色裙装，在石墙上投下温暖的高光；阴影保持深度，蒸汽在逆光下被照亮。整体色调为低饱和度的暖金、古石灰和灰绿色水面，具有强烈而自然的电影质感。摄影风格：50mm 或 85mm 镜头，f/2 光圈，平视位置略低于肩膀，浅景深，人物的面部、肩膀和背部清晰，建筑背景柔和但可辨认。真实的石头、水、蒸汽、皮肤和丝绸质感，轻微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒，柔和的高光晕染，电影级编辑肖像，照片级真实感。避免：现代游泳池、错误的建筑、正面姿势、错误的回眸方向、过度曝光、透明裙装、夸张的身材、塑料感皮肤、错误的手指、扭曲的手臂、强烈的 HDR、过度锐化、卡通、CG、文字、水印、Logo。

en.title: Oriental Zen Minimalist Wallpaper
en.description: A serene new Chinese-style aesthetic wallpaper prompt featuring a woman by a window with elegant floral shadows.
en.prompt: Theme: Oriental Zen minimalist poster. Style: Feminine aesthetic New Chinese style. Main content: {argument name="subject" default="An ancient-style woman standing in front of a window, with a quiet and reserved posture"}. Emotion: Elegant, soft, light luxury. Scene and imagery: {argument name="imagery" default="Jade green window, rose red flower shadows, woman, light gold ornaments, clean white space"}. Composition: Center-bottom composition, the window as the main background, the person in the middle-lower part, with sufficient white space at the top and sides. Color control: {argument name="color control" default="Warm white as a bright base, jade green for the window and parts of the background, rose red only for flower shadows and a few highlights, light gold for small ornament highlights"}; clothing can be pearl white or light pink white. Lighting and texture: Soft natural light, clean flat poster feel, slight paper texture, vivid and clear colors. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Additional requirements: Overall feminine aesthetic, clean and high-end, no darkening.

zh.title: 东方禅意极简壁纸
zh.description: 一款宁静的新中式美学壁纸提示词，描绘了一位女子伫立窗前，伴有优雅花影。
zh.prompt: 主题：东方禅意极简海报。风格：女性美学新中式。主要内容：{argument name="subject" default="一位古风女子伫立窗前，姿态静谧内敛"}。情感：优雅、柔和、轻奢。场景与意象：{argument name="imagery" default="玉色窗棂，玫红色花影，女子，浅金色饰品，大面积留白"}。构图：中下部构图，以窗为主要背景，人物位于中下部，顶部及两侧留白充足。色彩控制：{argument name="color control" default="暖白色作为明亮基调，玉色用于窗棂及部分背景，玫红色仅用于花影及少量点缀，浅金色用于小饰品高光"}；服装可选用珍珠白或浅粉白。光影与质感：柔和自然光，干净的平面海报质感，轻微纸张纹理，色彩鲜明清晰。长宽比：9:16。额外要求：整体呈现女性美学，干净高级，无暗化处理。

en.title: High Fashion Character Concept Sheet
en.description: A specialized prompt for generating professional character concept art sheets with a focus on modern high-fashion aesthetics and layout consistency.
en.prompt: Create a premium, {argument name="fashion style" default="modern high-fashion"} {argument name="subject" default="CHARACTER CONCEPT ART SHEET"} in a 16:9 widescreen layout on a pure white background. THE ATTACHED REFERENCE IMAGE DEFINES THE ART STYLE — treat it as a strict style bible and reproduce its exact rendering

zh.title: 高级时尚角色概念设计图
zh.description: 一个专门用于生成专业角色概念设计图的提示词，专注于现代高级时尚美学与布局一致性。
zh.prompt: 创建一个优质的、{argument name="fashion style" default="现代高级时尚"} {argument name="subject" default="角色概念设计图"}，采用 16:9 宽屏布局，背景为纯白色。所附参考图像定义了艺术风格——请将其视为严格的风格准则，并复刻其精确的渲染效果。

en.title: Quiet Girl with Wild Doodle Alter Ego
en.description: A vertical mixed-media fashion portrait showing a calm real young woman beside an expressive hand-drawn graffiti version of herself on a beige wall.
en.prompt: Create a vertical realistic photography image combined with hand-drawn wall doodle art. A young East Asian woman stands quietly on the left side against a plain warm beige indoor wall, full body visible from head to sneakers, softly lit like a casual fashion portrait. She has long straight black hair with bangs, a calm slightly shy expression, and looks sideways toward the doodle. She wears an oversized {argument name="shirt color" default="white"} T-shirt, very loose {argument name="pants color" default="khaki"} cargo pants with large side pockets, and black-and-white chunky sneakers. Her hands are tucked in her pants pockets, posture relaxed and neat. On the right side of the wall, draw a large black charcoal-pencil graffiti version of the same girl, roughly life-size and slightly taller than the real person, but more mischievous and expressive: big surprised eyes, messy long hair, oversized T-shirt, baggy cargo pants, hands in pockets, exaggerated loose stance. Include exactly 5 separate doodle accent elements around the drawn character: three short exclamation rays above the head, one “?!” mark near the upper right of the head, one small star to the right of the torso, one larger star to the right of the hip area, and one curved motion line near the left pocket. Keep the doodle sketchy, energetic, black-gray, with visible scribble shading and imperfect pencil strokes, as if drawn directly on the wall. The real woman casts a soft shadow on the wall to her left. Minimal studio-like room with smooth concrete floor, low white baseboard, no extra props, no watermark, no caption text. Use natural proportions, realistic fabric folds, gentle warm light, and a playful contrast between the quiet real person and her wild illustrated alter ego.

zh.title: 文静少女与狂野涂鸦分身
zh.description: 一张竖构图的混合媒介时尚肖像，展示了一位安静的年轻女性，以及她身旁墙面上充满表现力的手绘涂鸦形象。
zh.prompt: 创作一张竖构图的写实摄影与手绘墙面涂鸦艺术相结合的图像。画面左侧站着一位年轻的东亚女性，背景是一面简洁的暖米色室内墙壁，全身可见，从头部到运动鞋，光线柔和，宛如一张随性的时尚肖像。她留着黑色长直发，带有刘海，表情文静略带羞涩，侧头看向涂鸦。她穿着一件超大号的 {argument name="shirt color" default="白色"} T 恤，非常宽松的 {argument name="pants color" default="卡其色"} 工装裤，裤侧带有大口袋，脚穿黑白拼色厚底运动鞋。她的双手插在裤兜里，姿态放松而整洁。在墙面的右侧，画一个与真人等大、略高一些的黑色炭笔涂鸦版女孩，形象更调皮且富有表现力：大大的惊讶双眼、凌乱的长发、超大号 T 恤、宽松工装裤、双手插兜，姿态夸张松散。在涂鸦角色周围精确添加 5 个独立的装饰元素：头顶上方三道短促的感叹射线，头部右上方一个“?!”符号，躯干右侧一颗小星星，臀部区域右侧一颗较大的星星，以及左侧口袋附近的一条弧形动感线。涂鸦要保持草图感和活力，呈现黑灰色调，带有明显的涂鸦阴影和不完美的铅笔笔触，仿佛直接画在墙上一样。真人女性在左侧墙面上投下柔和的阴影。极简的工作室风格房间，地面为平滑的水泥地，配有低矮的白色踢脚线，无额外道具，无水印，无说明文字。运用自然的比例、逼真的织物褶皱、柔和的暖光，展现文静真人与她狂野插画分身之间的趣味对比。

en.title: 12-Tile Ceramic Mug Contact Sheet
en.description: Generates a clean 12-image studio contact sheet of a minimalist ceramic mug for product photography variation previews.
en.prompt: Create a clean contact-sheet collage showing exactly 12 photorealistic studio product photos of the same minimalist ceramic coffee cup, arranged in a 4-column by 3-row grid with narrow white gutters and a white page border. The cup is a plain warm off-white stoneware mug with a rounded cylindrical body, slightly thick rim, subtle speckled matte ceramic texture, and a simple C-shaped handle; no logo, no decoration, no liquid, no saucer. Vary the camera angle and lighting in each tile while keeping the cup consistent. Tile 1: side view on a warm beige background, handle on the right, soft shadow cast left. Tile 2: top-down view on a pale blue background, circular opening centered, handle pointing right. Tile 3: dramatic side view on a nearly black background, handle on the right, low-key lighting and strong rim highlight. Tile 4: side view on a dusty pink background, handle on the right, soft warm lighting. Tile 5: side view on a muted sage green background, handle on the right, calm diffused shadow. Tile 6: three-quarter side view on a cream background, handle on the right, bright softbox lighting. Tile 7: low-angle side view on a medium gray background with the mug sitting on a curved gray tabletop edge, handle on the right, sculptural shadow. Tile 8: high three-quarter view on a tan ochre background, handle on the right, visible inside of cup. Tile 9: side view on a cool gray-blue background, handle on the right, long horizontal shadow. Tile 10: side view on a caramel brown background, handle on the right, warm studio lighting. Tile 11: overhead three-quarter view on an off-white background, handle near the upper right, visible empty interior. Tile 12: side view on a pale sky-blue background, handle on the right, bright airy lighting. Add small centered serif text below the grid reading “{argument name="caption text" default="12 of 400 generations"}”. Use a 3:2 landscape canvas, high-resolution editorial product photography, soft natural shadows, subtle paper-like backgrounds, consistent white spacing, and no extra objects or text. The customizable product is {argument name="product" default="minimalist ceramic coffee cup"}; keep the main color {argument name="cup color" default="warm off-white"} and overall style {argument name="visual style" default="photorealistic studio product photography"}.

zh.title: 12 格陶瓷马克杯样片表
zh.description: 为极简陶瓷马克杯生成一张包含 12 张照片的简洁摄影样片表，用于展示产品摄影变体。
zh.prompt: 创建一张简洁的样片拼贴图，展示 12 张完全相同的极简陶瓷咖啡杯的写实摄影产品照，以 4 列 3 行的网格排列，带有窄白色间隙和白色页面边框。该杯子为素色暖米白色炻器马克杯，具有圆柱形杯身、略厚的杯沿、细腻的磨砂陶瓷质感和简单的 C 型把手；无标志、无装饰、无液体、无杯托。在每个网格中改变拍摄角度和光线，同时保持杯子外观一致。第 1 格：暖米色背景下的侧视图，把手在右侧，柔和阴影投向左侧。第 2 格：浅蓝色背景下的俯视图，圆形杯口居中，把手指向右侧。第 3 格：近黑色背景下的戏剧性侧视图，把手在右侧，低调光效和强烈的边缘高光。第 4 格：灰粉色背景下的侧视图，把手在右侧，柔和暖光。第 5 格：柔和鼠尾草绿背景下的侧视图，把手在右侧，平静的漫反射阴影。第 6 格：奶油色背景下的四分之三侧视图，把手在右侧，明亮的柔光箱照明。第 7 格：中灰色背景下的低角度侧视图，马克杯放置在弯曲的灰色桌面边缘，把手在右侧，雕塑感阴影。第 8 格：黄褐色背景下的高位四分之三视图，把手在右侧，可见杯子内部。第 9 格：冷灰蓝色背景下的侧视图，把手在右侧，长水平阴影。第 10 格：焦糖棕色背景下的侧视图，把手在右侧，温暖的摄影棚光效。第 11 格：米白色背景下的俯视四分之三视图，把手靠近右上角，可见空杯内部。第 12 格：浅天蓝色背景下的侧视图，把手在右侧，明亮通透的光效。在网格下方居中添加小型衬线字体，内容为“{argument name="caption text" default="12 of 400 generations"}”。使用 3:2 横向画布，采用高分辨率编辑级产品摄影风格，柔和的自然阴影，细腻的纸质背景，一致的白色间距，且不包含额外物体或文字。可定制产品为 {argument name="product" default="minimalist ceramic coffee cup"}；保持主色调为 {argument name="cup color" default="warm off-white"}，整体风格为 {argument name="visual style" default="photorealistic studio product photography"}。

en.title: Macro Japanese Beauty Portrait
en.description: Creates a clean ultra-close photorealistic beauty portrait from a reference screenshot, preserving the subject while removing UI and intensifying the macro art-photography look.
en.prompt: Using REFERENCE_0 as the visual base, extract only the portrait subject from the screenshot and regenerate it as a clean standalone photorealistic image with no interface, no text, no borders, and no watermark. Transform the portrait into an ultra-close macro beauty photograph of the same Asian woman, with the composition rotated slightly and pushed closer so the visible focus is one brown eye, part of the nose, cheek, and soft lips. Keep the natural windblown hair crossing the face, delicate skin texture, pores, fine facial hairs, subtle freckles, and realistic uneven sunlight-and-shadow pattern, but make the final image feel more like high-end Japanese art photography. Use shallow depth of field, strong natural sunlight, rich skin detail, authentic lens rendering, and a vertical mobile crop at {argument name="image size" default="900x1600"}. Camera feel: {argument name="lens" default="58mm prime lens"}, {argument name="aperture" default="f/1.4"}, Sony-style high-resolution realism. Subject style: {argument name="subject" default="a beautiful Asian woman with brown eyes"}. Lighting mood: {argument name="lighting" default="bright natural sunlight with dramatic shadows across the face"}.

zh.title: 日系微距美妆人像
zh.description: 基于参考截图创作一张干净、超近距离的写实美妆人像，在保留主体人物的同时去除 UI 界面，并强化微距艺术摄影风格。
zh.prompt: 以 REFERENCE_0 作为视觉基础，仅从截图中提取人像主体，并将其重新生成为一张干净、独立的写实图像，不包含任何界面、文字、边框或水印。将人像转换为同一位亚洲女性的超近距离微距美妆摄影，构图略微旋转并拉近，使视觉焦点集中在一只棕色眼睛、部分鼻梁、脸颊和柔和的嘴唇上。保留自然吹拂、掠过面部的发丝、细腻的皮肤纹理、毛孔、细微的脸部绒毛、淡淡的雀斑以及真实且错落有致的日光阴影效果，同时让最终图像呈现出更具高端日系艺术摄影的质感。采用浅景深、强烈的自然日光、丰富的皮肤细节、真实的镜头渲染，以及 {argument name="image size" default="900x1600"} 的竖屏手机画幅。镜头感：{argument name="lens" default="58mm 定焦镜头"}，{argument name="aperture" default="f/1.4"}，索尼风格的高分辨率写实感。主体风格：{argument name="subject" default="一位拥有棕色眼睛的漂亮亚洲女性"}。光影氛围：{argument name="lighting" default="明亮的自然日光，面部带有戏剧性的阴影"}。

en.title: Soho DV Street Portrait
en.description: A nostalgic editorial portrait prompt for creating a realistic Soho street-fashion image with old camcorder warmth and romantic window-light atmosphere.
en.prompt: Create a realistic editorial street portrait of a young East Asian woman in Soho, London, styled like a soft old DV/camcorder frame. She wears the same {argument name="dress" default="red plaid spaghetti-strap summer dress"}, with one shoulder strap slipped down and loose fabric draping off her upper arm. She has long slightly messy {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, natural dewy makeup, glossy lips, and a quiet pensive expression, looking slightly off-camera to the left as if caught between thoughts. Pose her close to a dark reflective shop window, one hand lightly touching the glass near her face and the other gently holding the front of her dress strap. The storefront glass should include understated typography reading “window light afterglow” near the upper left and “SOHO” with “city romance” below near the lower left, plus a small vertical orange DV-style timestamp mark. Set the scene on a narrow cobblestone sidewalk lined with dark columns and storefronts receding into the distance, warm afternoon light grazing her hair and shoulders, subtle reflections in the glass, shallow depth of field, nostalgic film grain, muted warm tones, slight haze, candid fashion editorial realism, vertical 4:5 composition, no extra people in focus, no watermark.

zh.title: Soho DV 街头人像
zh.description: 一个怀旧风格的社论人像提示词，旨在创作一张具有老式摄像机质感和浪漫窗光氛围的写实 Soho 街头时尚照片。
zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的社论风格街头人像，拍摄对象为一名年轻的东亚女性，地点位于伦敦 Soho 区，画面呈现出柔和的老式 DV/摄像机质感。她穿着 {argument name="dress" default="红色格纹吊带夏裙"}，一侧肩带滑落，宽松的布料垂在手臂上。她留着凌乱的 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 长发，妆容自然水润，嘴唇带有光泽，表情安静沉思，眼神略微看向镜头左侧，仿佛陷入了沉思。让她靠近深色的反光店面橱窗，一只手轻轻触碰脸部附近的玻璃，另一只手轻轻扶着裙子的肩带。橱窗玻璃上应包含低调的排版文字，左上方写着“window light afterglow”，左下方写着“SOHO”以及下方的“city romance”，并附带一个小的垂直橙色 DV 风格时间戳。场景设定在狭窄的鹅卵石人行道上，两侧是延伸至远处的深色柱子和店面，温暖的午后阳光掠过她的头发和肩膀，玻璃上有微妙的倒影，浅景深，怀旧胶片颗粒，柔和的暖色调，轻微的雾感，坦率的时尚社论写实风格，4:5 垂直构图，背景中没有其他清晰的人物，无水印。

en.title: Luxury Poolside Fashion Portrait
en.description: A cinematic prompt for generating a glossy high-fashion poolside portrait with reflective sunglasses, diamond jewelry, and resort luxury styling.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic luxury editorial portrait of {argument name="character description" default="a stylish young Black man with medium-brown skin and high tied dreadlocks"} lounging on a white poolside chaise beside a bright turquoise swimming pool at a modern resort. He wears oversized reflective blue wraparound sunglasses with a sharp starburst glint, an open glossy navy-blue leather or vinyl jacket and matching loose pants, with exactly 3 large white star patches visible down the right sleeve. His bare chest is covered with layered diamond necklaces and pendants, diamond bracelets, and rings; add exactly 3 intense sparkle flares on the jewelry and sunglasses.
