en.title: Summer Light Reading on a Train
en.description: A detailed cinematic portrait prompt of a woman reading on a vintage train, capturing warm summer afternoon lighting and film aesthetics.
en.prompt:
Subject: Reading Seat in Summer Light

Subject Body: A vertical 2:3 photograph. A woman sitting by a train window, reading a wide-open Western book on her lap, positioned slightly right of the center. The subject is captured from the crown of her head to her thighs, occupying about 75% of the frame. The open book crosses the lower foreground, naturally leading the viewer's gaze toward the person's face and chest.

Character and Expression: A calm young woman. Long dark brown straight hair with thin bangs and fine wisps of hair swaying around her cheeks and glasses from the air coming through the window. She wears delicate gold-rimmed round glasses, tilts her head slightly down, and concentrates on the pages. Her lips are slightly parted in a quiet, intellectual expression. Her skin retains natural color and fine texture, with the soft body lines of a mature adult.

Clothing and Pose: A {argument name="outfit" default="natural-colored thin-strapped ribbed camisole"}. The neckline is a shallow V-line decorated with delicate lace. Bottoms are pale blue denim shorts. She is seated deeply, with knees together and pointing forward. She supports the left edge of the book with her left hand and holds the thick stack of pages with her right. Her fingers are naturally curved, showing the weight of the book in the bend of her wrist and the pages.

Background and Light: Interior of a slightly old local train. A large window on the left, deep blue-green upholstered seats, and metal handrails on the right. Posters in the back are softly blurred with unreadable text. Warm, low sunlight streams from the top-left window, highlighting the hair's silhouette, cheeks, nose, shoulders, collarbones, arms, and the book's edge in golden light. The right side of the face and the train interior are slightly darker, softly lifted by reflected light from the window side. Shadows fall toward the bottom right, with fine dust floating in the light beams.

Composition and Camera: Vertical orientation, natural close-up shot from slightly above eye level. About 8% margin above the head, framed by window frames and seats on the sides, and cropped near the thighs at the bottom. 50mm equivalent, shallow depth of field. Focus is on the face, glasses, and hands holding the book, with the background smoothly blurred. Stable triangular composition created by the window frame, diagonal lines of the book, and the flow of hair.

Texture and Style: Film photography style reminiscent of a {argument name="seasonal feel" default="summer"} evening. Warm-toned natural color temperature, gentle contrast, fine grain, and soft highlights. Precise depiction of each hair strand, lace, ribbed fabric, denim weave, and the thickness of the book's paper. Avoids excessive skin smoothing for a quiet, realistic finish with a sense of daily life.

Negative: Underage-looking persons, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands, poor contact with the book, floating pages, joint breakdowns, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light sources, readable text, garbled text, logos, watermarks, plastic-like skin.

zh.title: 夏日列车上的轻阅读
zh.description: 一份详细的电影感肖像提示词，描绘了一位女性在复古列车上阅读的场景，捕捉了温暖的夏日下午光影与胶片美学。
zh.prompt:
主题：夏日阳光下的阅读位

主体描述：一张 2:3 的竖构图照片。一位女性坐在列车窗边，膝盖上放着一本翻开的西方书籍，位置略微偏向画面中心右侧。主体从头顶到大腿被捕捉入镜，占据了约 75% 的画面。翻开的书籍横跨前景下方，自然地引导观众的视线看向人物的面部和胸部。

人物与表情：一位沉静的年轻女性。深棕色长直发，留着薄刘海，几缕细碎的发丝随着窗外吹入的风在脸颊和眼镜旁飘动。她戴着精致的金丝圆框眼镜，头微微低垂，专注于书页。双唇微启，流露出安静、知性的神情。皮肤保留了自然的肤色和细腻的纹理，展现出成熟女性柔和的身材线条。

服装与姿态：身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="自然色细肩带罗纹吊带衫"}。领口为浅 V 领，饰有精致的蕾丝。下身穿着浅蓝色牛仔短裤。她深坐在座位上，双膝并拢向前。左手支撑着书的左侧边缘，右手托着厚厚的书页。手指自然弯曲，手腕的弯曲度和书页的质感体现了书籍的重量。

背景与光影：略显陈旧的当地列车车厢内部。左侧有一扇大窗户，深蓝绿色的软垫座椅，右侧有金属扶手。背景中的海报经过柔化处理，文字模糊不清。温暖的低角度阳光从左上方的窗户射入，勾勒出头发、脸颊、鼻梁、肩膀、锁骨、手臂以及书本边缘的金边。脸部右侧和车厢内部光线稍暗，被窗侧的反射光柔和地提亮。阴影投向右下方，光束中有细微的尘埃浮动。

构图与摄影：竖向构图，略高于视角的自然特写镜头。头部上方留有约 8% 的空间，两侧由窗框和座椅框定，底部在靠近大腿处裁剪。等效 50mm 镜头，浅景深。焦点集中在面部、眼镜和持书的手上，背景平滑虚化。由窗框、书本的对角线以及头发的流向构成了稳定的三角形构图。

质感与风格：让人联想到 {argument name="seasonal feel" default="夏季"} 傍晚的胶片摄影风格。暖色调的自然色温，柔和的对比度，细腻的颗粒感，以及柔和的高光。精确描绘每一根发丝、蕾丝、罗纹面料、牛仔布纹理以及书页的厚度。避免过度磨皮，呈现出一种安静、写实且充满生活气息的质感。

负面提示词：未成年长相、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手指粘连、与书本接触不良、漂浮的书页、关节畸形、透视错误、与光源不一致的阴影、可辨认的文字、乱码、Logo、水印、塑料感皮肤。

en.title: Rose Garden Portrait with Lace Parasol
en.description: A highly detailed image generation prompt for a fashion-style portrait of a woman in a rose garden, featuring specific instructions for a lace parasol and lighting.
en.prompt:
Generate one 4:5 vertical real-life photograph.

[Subject]
Use the person in the attached image as the sole standard for identity. Maintain facial features, age, skin tone/texture, body type, and overall balance. Do not carry over clothing, background, or pose from the reference; prioritize the scene described below.

[Hairstyle]
Maintain hair color and texture from the reference while letting long hair hang naturally. Do not flatten the top; leave fine strands around the face and let the back hair flow straight. Show natural layering and fine strands, avoiding wig-like or overly styled looks.

[Scene]
An outdoor garden on a sunny day. The path is surrounded by {argument name="flower color" default="pale pink and white flowers"} and dense green leaves. The path continues behind the subject into the distance toward green hills and a clear blue sky. Ensure flowers are abundant at waist-to-shoulder height.

[Clothing]
An opaque {argument name="clothing color" default="ivory white"} bodice with short puff sleeves made of thin white organza. Sleeves are sheer; shoulders and torso are not. Pair with a two-tiered white mini-skirt. Ensure the distinction between blouse and skirt is clear.

[Pose/Expression]
Subject takes a step forward, back to the camera, twisting the upper body to look back over the left shoulder. Not a profile shot—ensure eyes and mouth are visible. A natural smile with a gentle gaze at the camera, capturing a candid moment of being called out to.

[Parasol]
An elegant Western-style parasol held overhead. {argument name="parasol design" default="Black fabric overlaid with white floral lace"}, with a double-layered rim of black lace and white scallops. Hold the black shaft naturally near the shoulder. The entire parasol should be within the frame.

[Composition/Camera]
35mm equivalent vertical fashion snap. Shot from a slightly high position behind the left shoulder at a medium distance. The subject and parasol should occupy 72% of the frame height, leaving margins above and below.

[Light]
Harsh midday natural light. Bright highlights on petals, white clothing, and hair outlines, with soft shadows on the face under the parasol. Ensure eyes and mouth remain legible without deep shadows.

[Finish]
High-quality but not over-processed fashion photography. Clear textures for skin, hair, organza, lace, and petals. Avoid a composite look; integrate the subject naturally with the path and background.

zh.title: 玫瑰花园蕾丝遮阳伞人像
zh.description: 这是一个高细节的图像生成提示词，用于创作一张女性在玫瑰花园中的时尚风格人像，包含关于蕾丝遮阳伞和光影的具体指令。
zh.prompt:
生成一张 4:5 的竖版写实照片。

[主体]
以附件图片中的人物作为身份的唯一标准。保持面部特征、年龄、肤色/质感、体型和整体比例。不要沿用参考图中的服装、背景或姿势；优先考虑下文描述的场景。

[发型]
保持参考图中的发色和质感，让长发自然垂落。顶部不要扁塌；在脸部周围保留细碎发丝，背后的头发自然顺直。展现自然的层次感和细碎发丝，避免假发感或过度造型。

[场景]
阳光明媚的户外花园。小径周围环绕着 {argument name="flower color" default="淡粉色和白色的花朵"} 以及茂密的绿叶。小径在主体后方延伸至远处的青山和湛蓝天空。确保腰部到肩部高度的花朵繁茂。

[服装]
一件不透明的 {argument name="clothing color" default="象牙白色"} 上衣，带有由薄白欧根纱制成的短泡泡袖。袖子呈半透明状，但肩部和躯干部分不透。搭配一件双层白色迷你裙。确保上衣和裙子之间的界限清晰。

[姿势/表情]
主体向前迈出一步，背对镜头，上半身扭转，回头看向左肩方向。非侧面拍摄——确保眼睛和嘴巴可见。自然的微笑，温柔地注视着镜头，捕捉被呼唤时瞬间的抓拍感。

[遮阳伞]
一把优雅的西式遮阳伞撑在头顶。{argument name="parasol design" default="黑色面料覆盖白色花卉蕾丝"}，边缘带有双层黑色蕾丝和白色扇形花边。自然地在肩部附近握住黑色伞柄。整把遮阳伞应完整包含在画面内。

[构图/相机]
35mm 等效竖版时尚快照。从中距离、左后方略高的位置拍摄。主体和遮阳伞应占据画面高度的 72%，在顶部和底部留出边距。

[光影]
强烈的正午自然光。花瓣、白色服装和头发轮廓上有明亮的高光，遮阳伞下的面部有柔和的阴影。确保眼睛和嘴巴清晰可见，没有过深的阴影。

[成品效果]
高质量但不过度处理的时尚摄影。皮肤、头发、欧根纱、蕾丝和花瓣的质感清晰。避免合成感；将主体与小径和背景自然融合。

en.title: Cinematic Night Hotel Room Portrait
en.description: An atmospheric prompt for a high-end nighttime photoshoot in a hotel suite, featuring soft lighting and realistic textures.
en.prompt:
Specified Character: Refer only to the face and style of the girl in the attached image.

Image Type: 3:4 vertical, ultra-realistic smartphone night photo shoot, fine art material research.

Main Subject:
A live-action version of the girl in the attached image. A distinct adult female character not resembling any existing celebrity, influencer, or public figure.

Character Elements:
Maintain the hairstyle, hair color, eye color, representative colors, signature accessories, atmosphere, and symbols of the girl's world from the attached image. Translate into a realistic and convincing high-end night photo shoot look, not cheap cosplay.

Scene:
Lounge bed in a hotel suite at night, white linen bedding, fluffy down pillows, dark walnut headboard, a small candle and pale white flowers on the side table, pale blue moonlight streaming through a large window, warm glow from a night lamp. The background is blurred but retains bedding, lighting, furniture, the night view through the window, and props to indicate her world.

Pose and Composition:
Lying on her side on the lounge bed, back to the camera, twisting her upper body slightly to look back over her shoulder. The lower body is draped with white linen sheets from the waist to the legs, the fabric acting as the primary visual obstruction, with the contours of the legs and hips only faintly implied by light reflections. One knee is bent, the other leg extends straight under the sheet. The posture is soft, stable, quiet, and intimate.

Clothing (Visual Elements / Optical Material Design):
An haute couture garment made of layered premium white sheer mesh and ultra-thin chiffon with high light transmittance. The micro-fibrous structure of the material scatters and partially transmits moonlight and lamp light, with light passing through the fabric physically implying the tones and contours of the skin on the shoulders and back. Optical overlapping where the skin's color temperature is softly transferred through the material.

Off-shoulder drapes expose the shoulder and neckline, with delicate pearl bead straps on both shoulders. Long, flowing sheer sleeves with French tulle lace trim at the cuffs and hem. Open-back design showing the arch of the back beautifully along the light. From the waist down, covered in linen with minimal thin cord accents tied over the cloth. A contemporary fine art study exploring the geometric dialogue between material, light, and the human body. Maintaining a modest, clean, photo-shoot-like look overall. No close-ups of body parts or voyeuristic angles.

Expression:
Quietly looking at the camera with slightly narrowed eyes and lips very faintly parted, a restrained expression asking "Still awake?" as if waiting for something. Brows slightly drawn together, soft emotions containing a story. A realistic, soft moment as if caught off guard by a friend's smartphone, yet calm. Not an exaggerated anime face.

Makeup:
Delicate and transparent makeup: creamy glowing skin, realistic skin texture. Small highlights on the bridge of the nose, cheeks, Cupid's bow, shoulders, neck, and near the shoulder blades. Lips are hydrated but not heavy. Eye makeup is clean, lashes are natural.

Hairstyle:
Translate while maintaining the hairstyle, hair color, bangs, accessories, highlights, and contour features of the girl in the attached image. Long silky waves flow from one shoulder to the back, with moonlight silver-lining the edges of the hair. A few strands of hair fall naturally onto the pillow, side of the face, shoulder, neck, and bedding, enhancing the soft and intimate atmosphere.

Lighting:
Consistent with a night scene. A mix of pale blue moonlight from the window and warm low-ambient light from candles/night lamps, creating a moody and elegant low-key lighting. Face, shoulders, neck, and back lines are edged with soft side light, and beautiful rim light borders the hair, shoulders, and back arch. Background is low-exposure and blurred. The subject is clearly brighter than the environment, but without overexposure that loses skin or linen texture. Deep soft shadows, moonlight reflections on linen. Creamy, slightly warm skin tones.

Image Quality:
Ultra-realistic smartphone night close-up. Slight SNS compression, soft focus lens, shallow depth of field, background bokeh. Clear details of skin, lips, hair, sheer material fibers, linen wrinkles, pearl beads, and lace trim. Overall soft, intimate, quiet, and nighttime mood. An image as if a friend captured a realistic moment of her looking back while on the bed.

zh.title: 电影感夜间酒店客房人像
zh.description: 一个用于高端酒店套房夜间拍摄的氛围感提示词，包含柔和的灯光和逼真的质感。
zh.prompt:
指定角色：仅参考附件图片中女孩的面部和风格。

图像类型：3:4 竖构图，超逼真智能手机夜间摄影，美术素材研究。

主体：
附件图片中女孩的真人写实版本。一个独特的成年女性角色，不应与任何现有的名人、网红或公众人物相似。

角色元素：
保持附件图片中女孩的发型、发色、瞳色、代表色、标志性配饰、氛围以及其世界观的符号。将其转化为写实且令人信服的高端夜间摄影造型，而非廉价的 Cosplay。

场景：
夜间酒店套房的休息床，白色亚麻床品，蓬松的羽绒枕，深胡桃木床头板，床头柜上有一支小蜡烛和淡白色花朵，淡蓝色月光透过大窗户洒入，床头灯散发出温暖的光芒。背景经过虚化处理，但保留了床品、灯光、家具、窗外夜景及暗示其世界观的道具。

姿势与构图：
侧卧在休息床上，背对镜头，上半身微微扭转，回眸看向镜头。下半身从腰部到腿部覆盖着白色亚麻床单，织物作为主要的视觉遮挡，腿部和臀部的轮廓仅通过光影反射隐约显现。一膝弯曲，另一条腿在床单下伸直。姿态柔和、稳定、宁静且亲密。

服装（视觉元素 / 光学材质设计）：
一件由多层优质白色透明网纱和超薄雪纺制成的高定服装，具有高透光性。材质的微纤维结构散射并部分透射月光和灯光，光线穿过织物，物理性地暗示出肩部和背部的肤色与轮廓。光学重叠效果使肤色温度柔和地通过材质传递。

露肩设计露出肩部和颈部线条，双肩配有精致的珍珠串带。长款飘逸的透明袖子，袖口和下摆饰有法式薄纱蕾丝。露背设计展示出背部优美的弧线，顺着光影延伸。腰部以下覆盖亚麻布，布料上系有极简的细绳装饰。这是一项当代美术研究，探索材质、光线与人体之间的几何对话。整体保持端庄、干净、摄影般的质感。无身体部位特写或窥视视角。

表情：
安静地注视着镜头，双眼微眯，双唇微启，一种克制的表情，仿佛在问“还没睡吗？”，像是在等待着什么。眉头微蹙，柔和的情绪中蕴含着故事感。这是一个逼真的、柔和的瞬间，仿佛被朋友用手机抓拍到，但神态从容。并非夸张的动漫脸。

妆容：
精致透明的妆容：奶油般透亮的肌肤，逼真的皮肤纹理。鼻梁、脸颊、唇峰、肩部、颈部及肩胛骨附近有细微的高光。双唇水润但不厚重。眼妆干净，睫毛自然。

发型：
在翻译过程中保持附件图片中女孩的发型、发色、刘海、配饰、挑染及轮廓特征。长长的丝滑波浪卷发从一侧肩膀垂向背后，月光为发丝边缘勾勒出银边。几缕发丝自然地落在枕头、脸侧、肩膀、颈部和床品上，增强了柔和而亲密的氛围。

灯光：
符合夜间场景。窗外的淡蓝色月光与蜡烛/床头灯的暖色低环境光混合，营造出忧郁而优雅的低调照明。面部、肩部、颈部和背部线条被柔和的侧光勾勒，美丽的轮廓光点缀着发丝、肩膀和背部弧线。背景曝光较低并经过虚化。主体明显比环境更亮，但没有因过度曝光而丢失皮肤或亚麻的质感。深邃柔和的阴影，月光在亚麻布上的反射。奶油色调，略带暖意的肤色。

图像质量：
超逼真智能手机夜间近景。轻微的社交媒体压缩感，柔焦镜头，浅景深，背景虚化。清晰呈现皮肤、嘴唇、头发、透明材质纤维、亚麻褶皱、珍珠和蕾丝花边的细节。整体氛围柔和、亲密、安静且充满夜色感。画面仿佛是朋友抓拍到她躺在床上回眸的真实瞬间。

en.title: Low Angle Summer Sky Fashion Shot
en.description: A dynamic low-angle outdoor portrait prompt with a focus on a summer dress and high-contrast sunlight against a deep blue sky.
en.prompt: Subject: A step onto the blue sky. Main Subject: A 3:4 vertical outdoor fashion photograph. A woman is positioned slightly above the center of the screen, posing at a bold low angle looking up from near the ground. The single leg stretching from the bottom left to the top right is shown the largest, with the leg and gold sandals occupying about half of the foreground. The face and upper body are placed near the top center of the screen, leaving a wide margin of blue sky above the head. Person/Expression: Bright ivory-beige white skin with natural texture and a faint pink glow. Delicate highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, collarbones, and light-receiving surfaces of the legs. Pale rose blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin eyelashes, natural eye bags, soft bright eyebrows, and transparent pink-beige lips. A calm and confident expression looking at the camera, with the chin slightly tucked. Medium-long milk tea ash brown hair, thin see-through bangs, layers around the face, inward-curled ends, and natural stray hairs. Clothing/Pose: A light ivory-white camisole mini dress. Thin shoulder straps, low-luster satin fabric, and a tiered structure of about three layers with delicate floral lace on the chest and hem. The hem is short, covering the upper part of the thighs, but ensures a length and volume that completely hides the waist area and interior even from a low angle, naturally covered with an inner skirt of the same color. One leg is stretched greatly toward the camera, and the body is supported by the other leg. One hand lightly touches the side of the dress near the waist, and the other hand has the fingers softly interlaced in front of the face, with the pinky finger near the lips. Gold thin strap sandals, elegant heels, and a reddish pedicure. Background/Lighting: Clear deep blue midsummer sky and small white clouds. Dark green trees are placed on the right and bottom of the screen, and a dark gray metal structure on the bottom left. Strong natural light from a high position illuminates the front-left side of the person, creating a clear gloss on the skin and satin. Tight shadows are cast on the back of the legs and the overlapping parts of the dress, with blue ambient light from the sky and weak reflected light from the ground added. Composition/Camera: Ultra-low angle just above the ground, wide-angle around 24mm. Strong perspective showing the toes in the foreground large and the face slightly small. The extended leg runs diagonally from bottom-left to top-right, and the lines of the metal structure and the leg guide the gaze to the face. Focus accurately on the face and eyes, while sufficiently resolving the sandals and legs in the foreground. Take a wide margin of the sky in the upper half and limit the trees to the left and right edges. Texture/Style: A sophisticated live-action photograph reminiscent of Japanese fashion magazines. Clear color contrast of vivid blue sky, near-pure white ivory, deep green, and gold. Precisely depict natural skin texture, thin hair flow, satin reflections, lace transparency, and embroidery. High contrast due to strong sunlight, but suppress blown-out highlights and maintain a sense of cleanliness and realistic texture. Negative: People who look like minors, excessive leg elongation, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of hands and feet, broken joints, poor contact with sandals, floating, unnatural gravity, exposure of underwear, exposure around the waist, overly transparent costumes, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, blown-out highlights, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

zh.title: 低角度夏日天空时尚摄影
zh.description: 一个充满动感的低角度户外人像提示词，聚焦于夏日连衣裙，并在深蓝色天空背景下呈现高对比度的阳光效果。
zh.prompt: 主体：迈向蓝天。主要内容：一张 3:4 的竖构图户外时尚摄影作品。女性位于画面中心偏上方，采用大胆的低角度仰拍姿势。从左下角延伸至右上角的一条腿被放大展示，腿部和金色凉鞋占据了前景约一半的位置。面部和上半身位于画面顶部中心，头顶上方留有大面积的蓝天。人物/表情：明亮的象牙米白色皮肤，具有自然质感和淡淡的粉色光泽。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨以及腿部受光面有细腻的高光。淡玫瑰色腮红，香槟米色和粉棕色眼妆，细长的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，柔和明亮的眉毛，以及透明的粉米色嘴唇。表情冷静自信，注视着镜头，下巴微收。中长款奶茶灰棕色头发，轻薄的空气刘海，脸部周围有层次感，发尾内扣，带有自然的碎发。服装/姿势：一件浅象牙白吊带迷你裙。细肩带，低光泽缎面材质，三层叠层结构，胸部和下摆饰有精致的花卉蕾丝。裙摆较短，覆盖大腿上部，但长度和蓬松度确保即使在低角度下也能完全遮盖腰部和内部，并自然地覆盖了同色的内衬裙。一条腿向镜头方向大幅伸展，身体由另一条腿支撑。一只手轻轻触碰腰部附近的裙边，另一只手的手指在脸前轻柔交叠，小指靠近嘴唇。金色细带凉鞋，优雅的高跟，涂有红色的脚趾甲油。背景/光影：清澈的深蓝色盛夏天空和少量白云。画面右侧和底部有深绿色树木，左下角有一个深灰色金属结构。来自高位的强自然光照亮了人物的左前方，在皮肤和缎面上形成清晰的光泽。腿部后侧和裙子重叠部分投下浓重的阴影，并加入了来自天空的蓝色环境光和来自地面的微弱反射光。构图/相机：贴近地面的超低角度，约 24mm 广角。强烈的透视效果使得前景的脚趾显得很大，而脸部略小。伸展的腿部从左下角向右上角呈对角线延伸，金属结构的线条和腿部引导视线看向面部。焦点准确对准面部和眼睛，同时前景的凉鞋和腿部也保持足够清晰。上半部分留出大面积天空，树木仅限于左右边缘。质感/风格：一张令人联想到日本时尚杂志的精致实拍照片。鲜艳的蓝天、近乎纯净的象牙白、深绿色和金色的色彩对比鲜明。精准描绘自然的皮肤纹理、细发流向、缎面反光、蕾丝透明度和刺绣细节。强烈的阳光带来高对比度，但抑制了高光溢出，保持了洁净感和真实的质感。负面提示词：看起来像未成年人、腿部过度拉长、多余的手指、手指缺失、手脚融合、关节断裂、凉鞋接触不良、漂浮、不自然的重力、内衣走光、腰部走光、服装过于透明、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、高光溢出、塑料感皮肤、文字、Logo、水印。

en.title: Realistic Beach Portrait with Wet Hair
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for generating a realistic 9:16 portrait of a woman at the beach, featuring wet hair and a joyful expression with cinematic lighting.
en.prompt:
A realistic 9:16 beach portrait. A fictional adult woman, not a real person, appearing in her {argument name="age" default="mid-20s"}. Position the woman in the center of the screen, with the center of her face aligned to approximately 50% of the width, and the visual center including her wet hair, shoulders, and upper body also at 50%. The top of her head is just inside the upper edge, her face around the top 18%, her upper body in the center, with her leaning forward naturally connecting her arms and hands to the bottom. She faces the camera, lowering her hips and leaning forward slightly, laughing openly without shrugging. A bright smile that makes her eyes squint, mouth naturally open, teeth aligned but not overly uniform. Healthy contours, natural rounded cheeks, subtle glow on wet skin, and a bright complexion. Dark brown medium hair, nearly black, wet from seawater with thin strands irregularly along her forehead, temples, and cheeks, the rest flowing behind her shoulders. Do not make the hair voluminous or dry; draw wet clumps and tiny water droplets for each strand.

Her outfit is a solid {argument name="swimsuit color" default="deep navy blue"} halter neck bikini top. Express thin straps, natural fabric stretch, and subtle shades of wet fabric, avoiding excessive exposure or unnatural body exaggeration. The posture is innocent and sporty, making summer fun and freshness the main focus rather than sexiness. Both arms lowered in front of the body, with anatomically accurate connections of elbows, wrists, and fingers. Do not cut off important fingers at the edge; ensure five fingers per hand with natural overlap and joint direction.

Foreground is pale white sand and very shallow transparent seawater, the woman in the middle ground, and the background is a bright sea surface dissolving from white into light turquoise. Horizon lines and buildings are not emphasized, blurring the background into a clean, minimal aesthetic. Small white reflections and soft blue-green gradients on the sea surface, with tiny waves and bubbles near her feet. Camera slightly higher than the woman's chest, frontal, close range. Focal length around 50mm, natural perspective on face and upper body, no extreme wide-angle distortion. Shallow depth of field but face, hair, shoulders, and the front of the bikini are sufficiently resolved, with only the background smoothly blurred.

Light is a large, soft daylight like an overcast sky or bright shade from the top front. Avoid hard shadows, leaving uniform light on both sides of the face and faint shadows under the chin and inside the arms. Color temperature is slightly cool and neutral, exposure leaning high-key but without blowing out whites, and skin tone is natural. Overall color scheme is navy, white, and pale aqua blue. Natural pores, fine water droplets, and slight redness remain on the skin, avoiding excessive smoothing or plastic feel. Tiny, natural catchlights in the eyes, low moist gloss on the hair, and fine weave and wet texture on the fabric.

High-quality commercial photography, clean background, natural smile, realistic human body, consistent light and shadow. No text, logos, brand names, signatures, or watermarks. Avoid extra people, extra arms or fingers, missing fingers, fused hands, asymmetrical eyes, double teeth, unnatural chest area, melted fabric, floating droplets, doll-like skin, excessive HDR, over-sharpening, or illustrative style.

zh.title: 湿发海滩写实人像
zh.description: 一份高细节提示词，用于生成 9:16 的写实海滩女性人像，包含湿发、愉悦表情及电影级光影效果。
zh.prompt:
一张 9:16 的写实海滩人像。一位虚构的成年女性（非真实人物），年龄设定为 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁"}。将人物置于画面中心，脸部中心对齐画面宽度的 50% 左右，视觉中心（包括湿发、肩膀和上半身）同样位于 50% 处。头顶位于画面上边缘内侧，脸部位于上方约 18% 处，上半身位于中心，身体自然前倾，双臂和双手自然衔接至画面底部。她面向镜头，降低臀部并微微前倾，开怀大笑，不耸肩。明亮的笑容使双眼微眯，嘴巴自然张开，牙齿整齐但不显刻意。轮廓健康，脸颊圆润自然，湿润的皮肤带有微妙的光泽，肤色明亮。深棕色中长发（近乎黑色），被海水打湿，细碎的发丝不规则地散落在额头、太阳穴和脸颊上，其余头发垂在肩后。头发不要过于蓬松或干燥，画出湿润的发束感，每根发丝都要有细小的水珠。

她穿着一件纯色的 {argument name="swimsuit color" default="深海军蓝"} 挂脖比基尼上衣。表现出细肩带、自然的织物弹力以及湿润布料的细腻阴影，避免过度暴露或不自然的身体夸张。姿态天真且充满运动感，重点在于夏日的乐趣与清新，而非性感。双臂垂在身前，肘部、手腕和手指的连接处符合解剖学结构。不要在边缘切断重要的手指，确保每只手有五根手指，且手指重叠和关节方向自然。

前景为浅白色沙滩和极浅的透明海水，人物位于中景，背景是明亮的海面，从白色过渡到浅绿松石色。不强调地平线和建筑物，将背景虚化，呈现简洁、极简的美感。海面上有细小的白色反光和柔和的蓝绿色渐变，脚边有细小的波浪和泡沫。相机位置略高于女性胸部，正面，近距离拍摄。焦距约为 50mm，脸部和上半身视角自然，无极端广角畸变。浅景深，但脸部、头发、肩膀和比基尼前部足够清晰，仅背景平滑虚化。

光线为大面积柔和的日光，如同阴天或明亮的阴影，来自前方上方。避免硬阴影，使脸部两侧光线均匀，下巴下方和手臂内侧有淡淡的阴影。色温略偏冷且中性，曝光倾向于高调但不过曝，肤色自然。整体配色为海军蓝、白色和浅水蓝色。保留自然的毛孔、细小水珠和轻微的皮肤红润感，避免过度磨皮或塑料感。眼睛中有细小自然的眼神光，头发带有湿润的低光泽，布料呈现出细密的织物纹理和湿润感。

高质量商业摄影，背景干净，自然笑容，写实人体，光影一致。无文字、标志、品牌名称、签名或水印。避免出现多余的人、多余的手臂或手指、缺失的手指、手部粘连、双眼不对称、双排牙、不自然的胸部区域、布料融化、漂浮的水滴、玩偶般的皮肤、过度的 HDR、过度锐化或插画风格。

en.title: Japanese Yukata Summer Festival Snapshot
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a nostalgic summer snapshot of a woman in a yukata offering a ramune soda in an old shopping district.
en.prompt:
Generate one 4:5 vertical live-action photograph.

[Person]
Use the person in the attached image as the sole reference for identity. Maintain the facial features, age, skin, body type, overall balance, and personality visible in the attached image. Keep the hair color from the image, but prioritize the hairstyle specified below. Do not inherit the clothing, background, composition, or pose from the attached image; prioritize the scene below. Create a single finished photograph rather than a reference sheet or multiple cuts.

[Hairstyle]
Gather long hair into a loose bun at a low position just above the nape of the neck. The volume should be a messy low side chignon or a low ponytail-style updo, shifted slightly towards the person's left shoulder from the lower back of the head. Do not tie it high above the ears. Do not leave the majority of the hair hanging long down the back. Avoid short bobs, high buns at the crown, stiff traditional Japanese styles, or a single straight braid.
Leave thin, curled strands of hair on both sides of the face, softly framing from the cheeks to the outside of the chin. Also leave thin strands around the nape and ears, making fine flyaways glow golden in backlighting.
Attach one small white flower decoration behind the person's left ear at the base of the low bun, with a thin white ribbon hanging shortly from it. Thin brown-toned sunglasses rest on top of the head. Small, swinging silver earrings.
In the final check, ensure these three points are visible: 'hair is loosely gathered low at the nape,' 'there are curled strands around the face,' and 'there is a white flower and thin ribbon beside the low bun.'

[Scene]
A sunny summer afternoon in a narrow alley of an old Japanese shopping district. Low wooden shop fronts, eaves, plants, and stone or tile paving stretching into the distance. A traditional street with a lived-in feel, not overly commercialized. The background behind the person is naturally blurred with a shallow depth of field, turning shop fronts and greenery into soft bokeh. Blur text on signs so it's illegible, and do not draw meaningful text or logos.

[Expression/Posture]
The person from the attached image looks straight at the camera with a bright, natural smile as if handing a ramune soda to someone close. A joyful way of laughing with the mouth open slightly wide and eyes smiling too. Skin should have a realistic natural texture, avoiding excessive smoothing or doll-like expressions.
The person is slightly to the right of the center. Tilt the upper body forward slightly to create a sense of dynamic movement as if approaching.

[Yukata]
A summer yukata with a ground color of {argument name="yukata base color" default="white to off-white"}. Large flower patterns are placed sparsely, with flowers in {argument name="flower color" default="pale coral pink, salmon orange, light aqua, and minty turquoise"}. Include multiple flat, cute black cat silhouette patterns between the flower designs.
The obi belt is tied correctly around the waist. A calm color scheme featuring a black belt on top, a wider ivory to light beige in the middle, and a thin deep red accent visible. Ensure the collar alignment, sleeves, and obi structure are natural and consistent.

[Pose and Ramune]
The person's right arm is extended largely towards the camera, offering an old-fashioned transparent glass ramune bottle. The arm and bottle appear large in the foreground with strong perspective. The bottle has a blue to turquoise cap, a narrow neck, and a unique shape where you can feel the marble stopper. Do not use ordinary PET bottles or water bottles.
Place the bottle and hand in the left foreground, slightly softer in focus than the face. Fingers should grip the bottle naturally without merging hand and bottle.

[Basket]
The opposite left hand, next to the thigh, holds a small Japanese summer-style handbag.
It is not just a cloth tote bag. The exterior is a rigid, oval to small cylindrical lattice basket frame made of brown bamboo or rattan, with short brown handles. Inside the rattan lattice, a cloth drawstring pouch with a {argument name="inner bag" default="yellow and white gingham check pattern"} is clearly visible. Always maintain the two-layer structure of 'brown rattan basket outer frame + yellow and white gingham cloth inner bag'; do not replace it with just a soft cloth bag.

[Composition/Camera]
A close-up vertical snapshot. Light wide-angle equivalent to 24mm to 28mm. Slightly above or nearly at eye level. Emphasize the perspective of the extended arm and ramune bottle.
Within the 4:5 frame, include from a small margin above the head down to near the knees. The face is around the top third. The ramune bottle is in the front left and the basket is in the bottom right, both recognizable without being cut off too much. Maintain a natural snapshot feel while making the yukata, bottle, and basket identifiable.

[Light]
Strong summer backlighting from the top right background. Warm rim light on hair, cheeks, shoulders, and sleeves. The sky area in the background is bright and white, with subtle lens flare and bokeh. Keep the face bright with soft natural light, not crushed into darkness. Limit blowouts to the area around the light source in the background.

[Finish]
High quality but not overproduced, with an intimate realistic feel like it was taken with a smartphone or small camera. Clarify natural skin, fine hair, yukata weave, glass bottle, and bamboo or rattan textures. Colors should be fresh, with white, coral, light aqua, and yellow harmonizing in a summery way.

[Completion Conditions]
Maintain the identity of the person in the attached image. Do not include long hanging hair, short bobs, high updos, ordinary PET bottles, bags without a rattan frame, extra people, extra limbs or fingers, broken hands, merging of bottle and hand, messy yukata or obi, readable text, logos, watermarks, collage, illustrative style, or excessive CG feel.

zh.title: 日本浴衣夏日祭快照
zh.description: 一份全面的提示词，用于创作一张怀旧的夏日快照：一位身穿浴衣的女性在古老的商业街递上一瓶弹珠汽水。
zh.prompt:
生成一张 4:5 的竖版写实照片。

[人物]
使用附件图片中的人物作为身份的唯一参考。保持附件图片中可见的面部特征、年龄、肤质、体型、整体比例和个性。保留图片中的发色，但优先采用下方指定的发型。不要继承附件图片中的服装、背景、构图或姿势；优先考虑下方的场景。创作一张完整的成品照片，而不是参考表或多张剪辑图。

[发型]
将长发在颈背上方的位置松散地盘成一个低发髻。发量应呈现为凌乱的低侧发髻或低马尾式盘发，从后脑勺下方稍微向人物的左肩偏移。不要扎在耳朵上方的高处。不要让大部分头发垂在背部。避免短波波头、头顶高发髻、僵硬的传统日式发型或单条直辫子。
在脸部两侧留下细细的卷发丝，从脸颊到下巴外侧进行柔和修饰。颈背和耳朵周围也要留下细发丝，让细小的碎发在逆光下呈现金色的光泽。
在人物左耳后方、低发髻根部别上一朵小白花装饰，并垂下一条细细的白色丝带。头顶架着一副棕色调的细框太阳镜。佩戴小巧的银色吊坠耳环。
在最终检查中，确保这三点清晰可见：“头发在颈背处松散地盘起”、“脸部周围有卷发丝”以及“低发髻旁有一朵小白花和细丝带”。

[场景]
一个阳光明媚的夏日午后，位于日本古老商业街的一条狭窄巷子里。低矮的木制店面、屋檐、植物以及延伸至远处的石板或瓷砖路面。这是一条具有生活气息的传统街道，而非过度商业化。人物身后的背景通过浅景深自然虚化，将店面和绿植转化为柔和的虚化光斑。将招牌上的文字虚化，使其无法辨认，且不要绘制有意义的文字或标志。

[表情/姿态]
附件图片中的人物直视镜头，带着明亮、自然的微笑，仿佛正在将一瓶弹珠汽水递给亲近的人。笑容欢快，嘴巴微张，眼睛也在笑。皮肤应具有真实的自然质感，避免过度磨皮或像玩偶一样的表情。
人物位于画面中心偏右。上身微微前倾，营造出一种仿佛正在靠近的动态感。

[浴衣]
一件夏日浴衣，底色为 {argument name="yukata base color" default="白色至米白色"}。稀疏地分布着大型花卉图案，花卉颜色为 {argument name="flower color" default="浅珊瑚粉、鲑鱼橙、浅水蓝和薄荷青色"}。在花卉图案之间加入多个扁平、可爱的黑猫剪影图案。
腰间的腰带系法正确。配色沉稳，上方为黑色腰带，中间为较宽的象牙白至浅米色，并露出一条细细的深红色点缀。确保领口对齐、袖子和腰带结构自然且协调。

[姿势与弹珠汽水]
人物的右臂大幅向镜头伸出，递出一瓶复古的透明玻璃弹珠汽水。手臂和瓶子在前景中显得较大，具有强烈的透视感。瓶子带有蓝色至青色的瓶盖，瓶颈细长，形状独特，能让人感受到内部的玻璃珠。不要使用普通的塑料瓶或水瓶。
将瓶子和手放置在左侧前景，焦点比面部稍微柔和一些。手指应自然地握住瓶子，不要让手和瓶子融合在一起。

[篮子]
大腿旁边的左手提着一个小巧的日式夏日风格手提包。
它不仅仅是一个布制托特包。外部是一个由棕色竹子或藤条制成的坚硬椭圆形至小型圆柱形编织框架，配有短棕色提手。在藤编格栅内，可以清晰地看到一个 {argument name="inner bag" default="黄白格纹"} 的布制抽绳内袋。始终保持“棕色藤编篮外框 + 黄白格纹布内袋”的双层结构；不要将其替换为普通的软布包。

[构图/相机]
一张特写竖版快照。相当于 24mm 到 28mm 的轻型广角。视角略高于或接近视平线。强调伸出的手臂和弹珠汽水的透视感。
在 4:5 的画幅内，包含从头顶上方的一小段留白到膝盖附近。面部位于上方三分之一处。弹珠汽水瓶位于左前方，篮子位于右下方，两者均可辨认且不会被过度裁切。在保持自然快照感的同时，使浴衣、瓶子和篮子清晰可辨。

[光影]
来自右上方背景的强烈夏日逆光。头发、脸颊、肩膀和袖子上带有温暖的轮廓光。背景的天空区域明亮且呈白色，带有细微的镜头光晕和虚化效果。保持面部明亮，光线自然，不要陷入阴影中。将过曝限制在背景光源周围的区域。

[成品效果]
高质量但不显过度制作，具有像用智能手机或小型相机拍摄的那种亲切的真实感。清晰呈现自然肤质、细发、浴衣纹理、玻璃瓶和竹藤质感。色彩清新，白色、珊瑚色、浅水蓝和黄色以夏日风格和谐统一。

[完成条件]
保持附件图片中人物的身份。不要包含长垂发、短波波头、高盘发、普通塑料瓶、没有藤编框架的包、额外的人、多余的肢体或手指、残缺的手、瓶子与手融合、凌乱的浴衣或腰带、可读文字、标志、水印、拼贴画、插画风格或过度的 CG 感。
