en.title: Realistic Portrait with Chibi Wall Art
en.description: A complex prompt for generating a realistic character next to their own chibi illustration on a wall.
en.prompt: Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity and outfit reference. Preserve the reference character’s: - face identity - facial proportions - eye shape - nose - lips - skin tone - hairstyle - hair color - visible hair accessories - overall recognizable vibe - outfit and styling shown in the reference image. Do not hardcode any specific character traits that are not present in the uploaded reference. All identity, hairstyle, accessories, clothing, colors, and styling details must be inferred directly from the uploaded reference image. Create a high-quality mixed-style vertical portrait showing: 1. a realistic full-body version of the uploaded character/person 2. a cute colorful 2D chibi illustration version of the same character/person drawn on the wall beside them. Core concept: The real person is posing cutely beside a large colorful chibi wall illustration of themselves. The real person and the illustrated chibi version are doing a similar playful pose together. The chibi illustration should look like a cute hand-drawn anime-style wall art version of the same person, not a separate real person. The mood should feel cute, playful, bright, trendy, charming, and social-media-friendly. Main style direction: This is not a black doodle-shadow concept. This is a realistic person + colorful cute chibi wall illustration concept. The wall illustration should look like a polished but hand-drawn 2D anime/chibi drawing placed directly on the wall. Real person: - realistic human photography - full-body or nearly full-body framing - same recognizable identity as the uploaded reference - same outfit style and key visible details from the uploaded reference - natural photogenic pose - cute, playful, slightly shy, or mischievous expression - the person should actively perform a cute pose that matches the wall illustration - do not make the person stand stiffly - do not replace the outfit with unrelated fashion. Real person pose: Choose one cute playful pose that works well beside a wall illustration: - both hands near cheeks like cute paws - one leg lifted slightly - playful idol-like pose - shy but cute pose - tiny heart gesture - playful bounce pose - leaning slightly with a sweet smile - cute “nyan” pose with hands curled near the face - soft jump-like pose while still realistic and balanced. The pose should feel natural for the real person, not exaggerated or physically awkward. Chibi wall illustration: - the illustration must be a cute colorful 2D chibi version of the same uploaded person - it should be drawn directly on the wall beside the real person - not a realistic second person - not a 3D character - not a black shadow - not a simple stick figure - not a random anime character - not a separate unrelated girl - it should clearly resemble the real person through hairstyle silhouette, hair color, accessories, outfit silhouette, color palette, and overall vibe - use large expressive eyes, rounded cute face, small body proportions, and soft anime-style coloring - the chibi should perform a more exaggerated cute version of the real person’s pose - the chibi may look like it is happily jumping, posing, or floating slightly as part of the wall illustration. Wall illustration details: - soft clean linework - warm pastel colors - cute anime/chibi rendering - light hand-drawn texture - subtle shading - charming expressive face - same outfit impression as the real person - same hairstyle and accessory cues if visible in the reference - playful motion lines around the chibi - small hearts, stars, sparkles, soft doodle accents, or tiny decorative marks around the illustration. Interaction: The real person and the chibi illustration should feel connected. They should share the same pose idea, but not match perfectly. The real person performs a realistic cute pose. The chibi performs a more exaggerated, adorable, anime-like version. The connection must be instantly readable, like a fun photo taken beside a personalized wall illustration. Composition: - vertical 4:5 or 9:16 - simple clean indoor wall - real person on one side - colorful chibi wall illustration on the other side - both figures visible in full-body or nearly full-body framing - chibi illustration roughly similar height to the real person or slightly larger - enough negative space around both figures - keep the wall illustration fully visible - avoid cropping the real person’s feet or the chibi’s body. Background: - clean white, cream, pale beige, or light gray wall - simple floor - minimal indoor studio or clean room setting - soft natural light - uncluttered background - no TikTok UI, no social media interface, no text overlay. Lighting: - soft natural studio lighting - bright, clean, warm, and flattering - realistic shadow under the real person - wall illustration should look naturally placed on the wall - no harsh shadows - no dramatic dark lighting. Style quality: - realistic human photography - colorful 2D chibi wall illustration - cute anime-style wall art - strong identity resemblance - outfit and styling faithfully based on the uploaded reference - playful matching its pose - soft pastel mood - social-media-friendly - clean composition - high detail - no obvious AI artifacts. Negative prompt: black doodle shadow, black line-art only, normal shadow, realistic second person, 3D character, random anime girl, unrelated chibi, weak resemblance, different hairstyle, different outfit, outfit change unrelated to reference, hardcoded traits not in reference, messy wall, cluttered background, TikTok UI, social media interface, text, caption, handwritten text, watermark, logo, cropped feet, cropped chibi, stiff pose, boring standing pose, aggressive pose, horror mood, creepy illustration, distorted body, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad hands, bad anatomy, pasted face, frozen expression, overly artificial AI face

zh.title: 写实人像与 Q 版墙绘
zh.description: 一个复杂的提示词，用于生成一个写实角色与其墙上 Q 版插画并排的图像。
zh.prompt: 请将上传的角色参考图作为严格的身份和服装参考。保留参考角色的：- 面部特征 - 面部比例 - 眼睛形状 - 鼻子 - 嘴唇 - 肤色 - 发型 - 发色 - 可见的头发配饰 - 整体可辨识的氛围 - 参考图中展示的服装和造型。请勿硬编码任何参考图中不存在的特定角色特征。所有身份、发型、配饰、服装、颜色和造型细节必须直接从上传的参考图中推断得出。创作一张高质量的混合风格竖版人像，展示：1. 上传角色/人物的写实全身版本；2. 在其身旁墙上绘制的同一个角色/人物的可爱彩色 2D Q 版插画。核心概念：真人站在自己巨大的彩色 Q 版墙绘旁摆出可爱的姿势。真人与 Q 版插画角色正在一起做类似的俏皮动作。Q 版插画看起来应该是同一个人的可爱手绘动漫风格墙绘，而不是另一个真人。氛围应感觉可爱、俏皮、明亮、时尚、迷人且适合社交媒体分享。主要风格方向：这不是黑色涂鸦阴影概念。这是一个“写实人物 + 彩色可爱 Q 版墙绘”的概念。墙绘看起来应像是直接画在墙上的精致手绘 2D 动漫/Q 版画作。真人：- 写实人像摄影 - 全身或近全身构图 - 与上传参考图具有相同的可辨识身份 - 与参考图相同的服装风格和关键可见细节 - 自然上镜的姿势 - 可爱、俏皮、略带羞涩或调皮的表情 - 人物应积极做出与墙绘相呼应的可爱姿势 - 不要让人物站姿僵硬 - 不要将服装替换为不相关的时尚单品。真人姿势：选择一个适合在墙绘旁展示的可爱俏皮姿势：- 双手靠近脸颊像可爱的爪子 - 一条腿微微抬起 - 俏皮的偶像式姿势 - 害羞但可爱的姿势 - 比心手势 - 俏皮的跳跃姿势 - 带着甜美微笑微微倾斜 - 双手在脸旁蜷缩的可爱“猫咪”姿势 - 柔和的跳跃式姿势，同时保持写实和平衡。姿势对真人来说应感觉自然，不夸张或肢体僵硬。Q 版墙绘：- 插画必须是同一个上传人物的可爱彩色 2D Q 版版本 - 它应该直接画在真人身旁的墙上 - 不是写实的人 - 不是 3D 角色 - 不是黑色阴影 - 不是简单的火柴人 - 不是随机的动漫角色 - 不是不相关的女孩 - 它应通过发型轮廓、发色、配饰、服装轮廓、配色方案和整体氛围清晰地还原真人 - 使用大而有神的眼睛、圆润可爱的脸庞、小巧的身体比例和柔和的动漫风格配色 - Q 版角色应做出比真人更夸张的可爱姿势 - Q 版角色看起来可以像是在快乐地跳跃、摆姿势或作为墙绘的一部分微微悬浮。墙绘细节：- 柔和干净的线条 - 温暖的马卡龙色系 - 可爱的动漫/Q 版渲染 - 轻微的手绘质感 - 细腻的阴影 - 迷人且富有表情的脸庞 - 与真人相同的服装印象 - 如果参考图中可见，则需包含相同的发型和配饰线索 - Q 版角色周围有俏皮的动感线条 - 插画周围有小爱心、星星、闪光、柔和的涂鸦装饰或微小的装饰符号。互动：真人与 Q 版插画应感觉相互关联。他们应共享同一个姿势创意，但不必完全一致。真人做出写实的可爱姿势，Q 版角色做出更夸张、更可爱的动漫版姿势。这种联系必须是一眼就能看出来的，就像在个性化墙绘旁拍摄的趣味照片。构图：- 竖版 4:5 或 9:16 - 简洁干净的室内墙面 - 一侧为真人 - 另一侧为彩色 Q 版墙绘 - 两个形象均以全身或近全身构图呈现 - Q 版插画高度与真人大致相同或略大 - 两个形象周围留有足够的负空间 - 保持墙绘完整可见 - 避免裁剪真人的脚部或 Q 版角色的身体。背景：- 干净的白色、奶油色、浅米色或浅灰色墙面 - 简单的地板 - 极简的室内摄影棚或干净的房间环境 - 柔和的自然光 - 不杂乱的背景 - 无 TikTok UI，无社交媒体界面，无文字遮挡。灯光：- 柔和的自然摄影棚灯光 - 明亮、干净、温暖且修饰肤色 - 真人下方有写实的阴影 - 墙绘看起来应自然地置于墙上 - 无强烈的硬阴影 - 无戏剧性的暗光。风格质量：- 写实人像摄影 - 彩色 2D Q 版墙绘 - 可爱的动漫风格墙绘 - 强烈的身份辨识度 - 服装和造型忠实于上传的参考图 - 姿势俏皮且相互呼应 - 柔和的马卡龙色调 - 适合社交媒体 - 构图简洁 - 高细节 - 无明显的 AI 伪影。负面提示：黑色涂鸦阴影，仅黑色线条画，普通阴影，写实的第二个人，3D 角色，随机动漫女孩，不相关的 Q 版，辨识度弱，发型不同，服装不同，与参考图无关的服装更换，参考图中不存在的硬编码特征，杂乱的墙面，杂乱的背景，TikTok UI，社交媒体界面，文字，标题，手写文字，水印，Logo，裁剪的脚部，裁剪的 Q 版，僵硬的姿势，无聊的站姿，攻击性姿势，恐怖氛围，诡异的插画，身体扭曲，多余的肢体，多余的手指，糟糕的手部，糟糕的解剖结构，粘贴的脸部，僵硬的表情，过度人工化的 AI 脸

en.title: Explosion Effect Commercial Poster
en.description: An ultra-premium commercial poster prompt designed to create a dramatic, high-tension central explosion effect for a product.
en.prompt: * 压缩中心破裂，锐利外壳断裂。所有爆发集中在产品中段：外壳先出现清晰、厚薄可见的断裂面，再从裂口向外张开，中心才会有“压力瞬间释放”的力量。 * 定向碎片层级，由大到小的放射状扩散。大块巧克力、花生和内馅先围绕爆点做放射状主碎片；外围再接中碎屑和粉尘，不能所有物体等大小、均匀散开。 * 弹性焦糖桥，稀疏的碎屑和发光粉尘。焦糖用拉丝把断裂面和飞出的碎片重新连接，少量可见的小颗粒延续运动方向；既有爆发力，又不会显得凌乱。 为BABY RUTH制作一张顶级商业海报，将“奶云轨道”方向推向极致，同时进一步扩大深色负空间，强化红金对比度，并放大中心爆发的张力。图像必须以一根垂直立于画面正中心的 Baby Ruth 巧克力棒作为绝对主角，完全可见、正面朝前且品牌标识清晰。巧克力棒的中部必须以超写实的爆炸方式炸开，展示出具有极致触感丰富度的烤花生、浓郁焦糖、牛轧糖和破碎的巧克力涂层。最终作品必须显得大胆、令人垂涎、如珠宝般精致、具有电影感且达到收藏级，具备更强的中心压力、更丰富的奢华色彩对比以及更具戏剧性的暗场呈现。仅使用英文品牌元素，活动文字极简，使图像以视觉效果为主导。核心构图：使用高垂直构图，将一根 Baby Ruth 巧克力棒精确放置在中心轴线上，保持直立且完全清晰可见。将爆炸紧密集中在中段，使所有视觉能量从中心向外辐射。进一步扩大周围的黑色空白区域，让核心产品和爆发区域占据更小、更集中的中心地带。构图必须感觉像是一个珍贵的物体在奢华的黑暗中引爆，中心承受着最大的压力。核心产品逻辑：Baby Ruth 巧克力棒必须能被立即且明确地识别为核心产品。保留可辨识的包装纸可见度和品牌层级，同时通过中心破裂以极致写实的方式展示其标志性内馅：厚实的焦糖丝、浓密的烤花生、丰富的牛轧糖核心以及锐利断裂的巧克力外壳。产品必须显得沉重、有质感、诱人且物理真实，仿佛是内部压力将其炸开。奶云轨道增强：进一步强化所有触感品质。焦糖必须感觉更厚、更亮、更有弹性且更有物理重量感。花生必须感觉更像烘烤过的、更自然、略带油感且更有立体感。巧克力外壳必须展现更锐利的断裂边缘、更厚的涂层厚度以及更光滑的高级饰面。牛轧糖必须感觉更致密、更诱人。细小的碎屑、可可粉和微粒必须显得更奢华、精准且悬浮在真实空间中。每个表面都应感觉触手可及且达到收藏级。中心爆发张力：这至关重要。强化中心爆发，使其感觉更紧凑、更剧烈且视觉压缩感更强。巧克力外壳必须伴随力量向外裂开，焦糖必须在分裂的表面之间像拉紧的张力一样伸展，花生必须带着可信的定向能量从核心喷出。海报的中心必须感觉像是破裂瞬间最富戏剧性的千分之一秒，冻结在高级活动图像中。深色负空间：大幅扩大周围的深色区域。外框应陷入丰富、奢华的黑暗中，使视线被迫直接投向中心的爆炸。空白空间必须显得是有意为之、具有电影感且昂贵，使核心产品看起来更像是黑暗舞台上闪亮的珠宝。不要在画面中堆砌额外的道具或大段文字。红金色彩冲击：大幅强化红金色的活动氛围。保持原汁原味的 Baby Ruth 包装辨识度，但让周围的光影、阴影氛围和爆炸场转向更强烈的深红、深樱桃红、古铜金和深可可色调。深红色阴影与金色焦糖高光之间的对比必须比以前更丰富、更炽热、更奢华，同时保持高级感和克制。排版与品牌：仅使用英文排版，配以极短的标题，如“BREAK THE CRAVE”或“GOLDEN IMPACT”。保持文字极简、含蓄，并处于产品的次要地位。包装纸上的 Baby Ruth 标志仍是主要的可读品牌元素。布局必须感觉像是精美的全球糖果广告，而非零售促销海报。背景：使用由深红褐色、黑樱桃色、深可可色和温暖阴影渐变构成的简洁抽象奢华背景。背景必须保持舞台感且整洁，仅在需要时添加柔和的大气深度和细微的色调变化。一切都必须支撑中心的产品及其爆发。光影：使用极其细腻且高影响力的商业照明。用温暖的受控主光塑造包装纸、焦糖光泽、巧克力裂痕、花生表面和悬浮微粒的高级感高光过渡。在爆炸区域周围添加微妙的金调分离光，将碎片从深红背景中勾勒出来。光影必须感觉具有电影感、丰富且昂贵。材质真实感：将真实感推向极致。包装纸必须感觉有触感且物理真实。巧克力外壳必须显示出可信的厚度、平滑的涂层和锐利的断裂边缘。焦糖必须感觉粘稠、沉重、有弹性和光泽。花生必须显示出烘烤的表面纹理、自然的随机性和细微的油光。牛轧糖必须感觉致密而丰富。灰尘和碎屑必须感觉物理上是悬浮的且有重量感。氛围：爆炸般的纵享、红金奢华张力、顶级糖果剧场、珠宝般的中心冲击、电影感的渴望、收藏级零食广告。渲染风格：顶级糖果广告海报，奶云轨道增强，居中垂直 Baby Ruth 巧克力棒，强化的中部爆发展示，扩大的深色负空间，更强的红金对比，飘浮的花生与焦糖喷发，破碎的巧克力外壳，极简活动文字，电影级商业照明，世界级产品真实感，8k。负向提示词：卡通爆炸，虚假焦糖，品牌识别度弱，模糊的包装，杂乱的构图，廉价超市传单风格，明亮繁忙的背景，低细节花生，塑料感的巧克力，文字过多，裁剪的产品，扭曲的徽标，低分辨率纹理，混乱的碎片，中心冲击力弱，负空间不足。

标志仍是主要的可读品牌元素。布局必须感觉像是精美的全球糖果广告，而非零售促销海报。背景：使用由深红褐色、黑樱桃色、深可可色和温暖阴影渐变构成的简洁抽象奢华背景。背景必须保持舞台感且整洁，仅在需要时添加柔和的大气深度和细微的色调变化。一切都必须支撑中心的产品及其爆发。光影：使用极其细腻且高影响力的商业照明。用温暖的受控主光塑造包装纸、焦糖光泽、巧克力裂痕、花生表面和悬浮微粒的高级感高光过渡。在爆炸区域周围添加微妙的金调分离光，将碎片从深红背景中勾勒出来。光影必须感觉具有电影感、丰富且昂贵。材质真实感：将真实感推向极致。包装纸必须感觉有触感且物理真实。巧克力外壳必须显示出可信的厚度、平滑的涂层和锐利的断裂边缘。焦糖必须感觉粘稠、沉重、有弹性和光泽。花生必须显示出烘烤的表面纹理、自然的随机性和细微的油光。牛轧糖必须感觉致密而丰富。灰尘和碎屑必须感觉物理上是悬浮的且有重量感。氛围：爆炸般的纵享、红金奢华张力、顶级糖果剧场、珠宝般的中心冲击、电影感的渴望、收藏级零食广告。渲染风格：顶级糖果广告海报，奶云轨道增强，居中垂直 Baby Ruth 巧克力棒，强化的中部爆发展示，扩大的深色负空间，更强的红金对比，飘浮的花生与焦糖喷发，破碎的巧克力外壳，极简活动文字，电影级商业照明，世界级产品真实感，8k。负向提示词：卡通爆炸，虚假焦糖，品牌识别度弱，模糊的包装，杂乱的构图，廉价超市传单风格，明亮繁忙的背景，低细节花生，塑料感的巧克力，文字过多，裁剪的产品，扭曲的徽标，低分辨率纹理，混乱的碎片，中心冲击力弱，负空间不足。

en.title: Pencil Sketch RPG Character Concept
en.description: A stylized prompt blending traditional graphite sketching with neon digital effects for high-end RPG character design.
en.prompt: Create a direct contrast between traditional pencil sketches and high-purity digital lighting effects. * Aggressive graphite cross-hatching, smudged charcoal Skin, fabric, and armor are all shaped using visible cross-hatching, graphite smudges, and charcoal smudges; the rough texture of the paper is preserved, and no smooth shading is applied. * Pure white negative space, cool-gray monochrome base Keep the background clean and pure white, with the subject rendered in cool gray and blue-gray tones; the more white space left, the more the line art and modeling will resemble a high-end RPG art book. * blinding flat amber glow, unblended digital overlay Allow the amber glow to appear only suddenly in the form of cracks, particles, and light sources, with hard edges and pure color; avoid soft gradients—the clash between cool gray and golden light is what makes the composition truly impactful. Create a completely original ultra-premium character concept art illustration with a newly invented theme: "The Amber-Bound Eidolon," a powerful, athletic female phantom guardian holding a vintage glass astrolabe filled with glowing golden moths, with her lower body dissolving into smudged charcoal and glowing golden sand. The subject and lore must be fully original, but the visual style must maintain 100% exact fidelity to high-end RPG tabletop character design sheets, isolated on a pure white background. The absolute highest priority is the extreme visual collision between raw, dry, cool-grey pencil sketching (graphite hatching) and blinding digital luminescence. No environment, no readable text, no logo. Style direction: This is the absolute priority. Fully recreate the exact image-family style: premium fantasy character concept art isolated on a stark white negative-space background, heavily emphasizing "Graphite Hatching" and "Smudged Charcoal" effects. All shadow areas on the female character's skin, armor, and clothing must feature highly visible, aggressive pencil cross-hatching. The illustration must feel like a master-level traditional graphite drawing on textured paper that has been violently interrupted by blazing, flat digital colors. The contrast between the extremely dry, cool-grey pencil rendering and the piercing, neon-bright digital amber glow is the core of the image. Core composition: Use a tall vertical composition focused entirely on a single female character floating in a void of pure white paper space. The figure is posed dynamically: one arm is raised, holding a heavy, dangling, brilliantly glowing glass astrolabe. Her upper torso is muscular and solidly drawn, while from the waist down, her draped clothing and legs completely unravel and disintegrate into rising, stylized smoke. This smoke must look like aggressive charcoal smudging mixed with glowing, particle-like golden sand fading into the white background. Theme & Character design: Design the Amber-Bound Eidolon: She must have a strong, healthy Western athletic female physique with firm, defined muscle lines (strong shoulders, sculpted core), projecting fierce dignity and power—absolutely avoiding any generic, soft, or "internet-celebrity" facial features. Her body is rendered almost entirely in cool slate-grey and ash-blue pencil tones. Deep, piercing, blindingly bright cracks of liquid amber run across her athletic chest, shoulders, and arms. She wears tattered waist wrappings and extremely intricate, aged bronze bracers featuring razor-sharp pencil filigree. Prop design: Hanging from her hand is a massive, ornate vintage glass astrolabe or lantern. Its interior blazes with a blinding, intensely hot neon-gold and pure yellow light, swarming with magical glowing moths. Wisps of golden heat drift upward from it, casting a harsh, luminous orange-gold rim-light that cuts aggressively across the dry graphite textures of her arm and athletic torso. Texture and finish: The surface tactility is everything. The white background must be pure and clean. The character's matte surfaces must show visible paper grain, dry graphite drag, and raw hatching lines. The glowing liquid amber cracks and the astrolabe fire must look like pure, unblended, intensely bright digital overlays that pop aggressively against the desaturated sketch. Mood: Epic, raw, aggressive contrast, dark fantasy, powerful feminine strength, imposing, highly detailed studio-grade sketch. Rendering style: ultra-premium RPG character concept art, isolated on pure white background, extreme graphite cross-hatching, smudged charcoal smoke, blinding digital amber glow, stark cool-grey vs neon-gold contrast, intricate bronze filigree, athletic female warrior, lower body dissolving into pencil strokes and golden sand, world-class illustration, 8k. Negative prompt: background environment, scenery, readable text, logo, photorealism, 3D render, smooth airbrushing, plastic texture, generic beauty face, weak anatomy, soft anime girl, full solid legs, flat cartoon shading, muddy colors, soft glowing gradients.

zh.title: 铅笔素描 RPG 角色概念设计
zh.description: 一款将传统石墨素描与霓虹数字特效融合的风格化提示词，适用于高端 RPG 角色设计。
zh.prompt: 创造传统铅笔素描与高纯度数字光效之间的直接对比。* 强烈的石墨交叉排线，涂抹的炭笔质感：皮肤、织物和盔甲均通过可见的交叉排线、石墨涂抹和炭笔涂抹来塑造；保留纸张的粗糙纹理，不使用平滑的阴影。* 纯白负空间，冷灰色单色基底：保持背景干净纯白，主体以冷灰和蓝灰色调呈现；留白越多，线条和造型就越像高端 RPG 艺术画册。* 刺眼的琥珀色平涂光效，未混合的数字叠加：让琥珀色光芒仅以裂纹、颗粒和光源的形式突然出现，边缘锐利且色彩纯正；避免柔和的渐变——冷灰色与金色光芒的碰撞才是构图最具冲击力的地方。创作一幅完全原创的超高端角色概念艺术插画，主题为全新构思的“琥珀之缚幻影（The Amber-Bound Eidolon）”：一位强大、健美的女性幻影守护者，手持一个装满发光金色飞蛾的复古玻璃星盘，下半身消散为涂抹的炭笔痕迹和发光的金色沙砾。主体和背景设定必须完全原创，但视觉风格必须 100% 精确还原高端 RPG 桌游角色设计图纸，并置于纯白背景中。绝对优先考虑原始、干燥、冷灰色铅笔素描（石墨排线）与刺眼数字发光效果之间极端的视觉碰撞。无环境，无易读文字，无 Logo。风格导向：这是绝对优先事项。完全重现该图像系列的精确风格：置于纯白负空间背景下的高端奇幻角色概念艺术，重点强调“石墨排线”和“炭笔涂抹”效果。女性角色的皮肤、盔甲和衣物上的所有阴影区域必须具有高度可见、强烈的铅笔交叉排线。插画必须呈现出一种大师级的传统石墨画质感，仿佛在纹理纸张上被炽热、平涂的数字色彩猛烈地打断。干燥、冷灰色的铅笔渲染与刺眼、霓虹般明亮的数字琥珀光之间的对比是图像的核心。核心构图：采用高纵向构图，完全聚焦于漂浮在纯白纸张虚空中的单一女性角色。人物姿态动态：一只手臂抬起，握着一个沉重、悬垂、闪耀着明亮光芒的玻璃星盘。她的上半身肌肉发达且刻画扎实，而从腰部以下，她垂下的衣物和双腿完全解体并消散为上升的风格化烟雾。这种烟雾必须看起来像强烈的炭笔涂抹与发光的颗粒状金沙混合，并逐渐消失在白色背景中。主题与角色设计：设计“琥珀之缚幻影”：她必须拥有强健、健康的西方女性运动员体格，肌肉线条紧致分明（强壮的肩膀、雕塑般的躯干），展现出强悍的尊严与力量——绝对避免任何大众化、柔弱或“网红脸”的面部特征。她的身体几乎完全以冷板岩灰和灰蓝色铅笔色调渲染。深邃、刺眼、明亮的液态琥珀裂纹横跨她健美的胸部、肩膀和手臂。她穿着破烂的腰部缠带，佩戴着极其复杂、带有锋利铅笔花丝工艺的古铜色护腕。道具设计：手中悬挂着一个巨大、华丽的复古玻璃星盘或灯笼。其内部闪烁着刺眼、炽热的霓虹金和纯黄色光芒，成群的魔法发光飞蛾在其中涌动。金色的热气从中向上飘散，投射出强烈的、发光的橙金色轮廓光，猛烈地切割过她手臂和健美躯干上干燥的石墨纹理。纹理与质感：表面触感是一切。白色背景必须纯净整洁。角色的哑光表面必须显示出可见的纸张纹理、干涩的石墨拖拽痕迹和原始的排线。发光的液态琥珀裂纹和星盘火焰必须看起来像纯净、未混合、极其明亮的数字叠加，在去饱和的素描背景下产生强烈的视觉冲击。氛围：史诗感、原始、强烈的对比、黑暗奇幻、强大的女性力量、威严、高细节度的专业级素描。渲染风格：超高端 RPG 角色概念艺术，置于纯白背景，极端的石墨交叉排线，炭笔涂抹烟雾，刺眼的数字琥珀光，冷灰色与霓虹金的强烈对比，复杂的青铜花丝，健美女性战士，下半身消散为铅笔笔触与金沙，世界级插画，8k。负面提示词：背景环境，风景，易读文字，Logo，照片写实，3D 渲染，平滑喷笔，塑料质感，大众化美女脸，解剖结构薄弱，柔弱动漫少女，完整的实心腿，扁平卡通阴影，浑浊色彩，柔和的发光渐变。

en.title: Qilin Watermelon Commercial Poster
en.description: A commercial-grade prompt for creating Qilin watermelon themed posters, featuring vibrant colors, vector illustration style, and retro screen printing textures.
en.prompt: Vertical 3:4 Qilin watermelon theme commercial poster, front-view graphic design, {argument name="background color" default="creamy yellow"} full background, with low-contrast light orange sunburst patterns and light green melon seed scatters. A whole oval Qilin watermelon, a half-cut watermelon, and two scattered melon slices are placed in the bottom right, accurately depicting dark green longitudinal stripes, thin green rind, bright red delicate pulp, a few natural black seeds, and glistening juice; the top left features a bold, rounded, and playful hand-drawn font for '{argument name="main title" default="Qilin Watermelon"}', with pulp-red fill, creamy white inner lines, and dark green outlines, where a melon seed cleverly interacts with partial strokes without affecting legibility; the subtitle '{argument name="subtitle" default="Red Pulp, Juicy, Sweet and Refreshing"}' is placed on a green wavy ribbon, with the English 'QILIN WATERMELON' as a curved small seal. The background adds melon field ridge lines, curling vines, melon flowers, small water droplets, and halftone dots, while the foreground uses enlarged leaves to frame the edges. High-saturation Q-version vector illustration, retro screen printing grain, clear flat painting layers, maintaining print bleed areas, no black background.

zh.title: 西瓜商业海报设计
zh.description: 一款用于商业西瓜海报的高饱和度矢量插画提示词，融合了复古丝网印刷质感与趣味排版。
zh.prompt: 一张 3:4 竖版 {argument name="subject" default="麒麟西瓜"} 商业海报，采用正面图形设计，背景为 {argument name="background color" default="奶油黄"} 全底色，点缀低对比度的浅橙色放射状光芒图案和淡绿色瓜子点。右下角放置一颗完整的椭圆形西瓜、半颗西瓜以及错落有致的瓜片，精准呈现深绿色纵向条纹、薄薄的浅绿色瓜皮、鲜红细腻的果肉、几粒天然黑色瓜子以及晶莹剔透的汁水。左上角以粗体、圆润且俏皮的手绘字体展示产品名称“{argument name="product name" default="麒麟西瓜"}”，字体采用果肉红色填充、奶油白色内描边和深绿色外描边；一颗瓜子巧妙地与笔画互动，且不影响阅读。副标题“红瓤多汁，清甜爽口”置于绿色波浪形丝带上，并配有“QILIN WATERMELON”英文弧形小印章。背景添加了田垄线、卷曲藤蔓、瓜花、小水滴和半调网点，放大的叶片环绕前景边缘。高饱和度 Q 版矢量插画，带有复古丝网印刷颗粒感，图层清晰平整，保留印刷出血位，禁止使用黑色背景。

en.title: Artistic Hollow Line Font Redraw
en.description: A specialized prompt for transforming text into artistic hollow line graphics that weave through the composition like a roadmap.
en.prompt: Deconstruct the theme keywords into giant hollow single-line glyphs and guiding strokes. The lines span the entire frame and weave between the foreground and background of the main subject. The glyph interiors remain transparent, allowing the background and subject to be visible. Use uniform line thickness, right-angle turns, long arcs, arrow endpoints, and dot nodes to form a reading path from the top title to the central subject and then to the bottom info area, appearing like both text and a roadmap. A small amount of body text should be divided into clean sans-serif blocks, placed near character white space or on both sides of the subject, with clear hierarchy. Small info tags and signatures can be at the bottom. All text serves the rhythm and scale without overpowering the main subject.\n\nText: {argument name="text" default="I give my heart to the moon"}

zh.title: 艺术感空心线条字体重绘
zh.description: 一个专门用于将文本转换为艺术空心线条图形的提示词，这些线条如同路线图一般穿梭于整个构图中。
zh.prompt:
将主题关键词解构为巨大的空心单线字形和引导笔触。线条跨越整个画面，并在主体的前景与背景之间穿梭。字形内部保持透明，以便显现背景和主体。使用统一的线条粗细、直角转折、长弧线、箭头端点和圆点节点，形成从顶部标题到中心主体，再到底部信息区域的阅读路径，使其既像文字又像路线图。少量正文应划分为整洁的无衬线字体块，放置在角色留白处或主体两侧，并具有清晰的层级。底部可放置小型信息标签和签名。所有文本均服务于节奏和比例，且不会喧宾夺主。

文本：{argument name="text" default="I give my heart to the moon"}

en.title: Workplace Anxiety Emotion Monster Portrait
en.description: A creative photography prompt that visualizes office stress as a hand-drawn cartoon monster looming over a realistic female worker.
en.prompt: Vertical version 3:4, a single creative portrait image combining realistic photography with hand-drawn animated monster elements, no collage, no grids, no infographics, no text. A {argument name="person" default="young Asian woman"} sits at an office desk wearing a simple {argument name="clothing" default="white shirt"}, black hair in a low ponytail, looking tired and quiet with one hand on her face. She looks calm but her eyes show exhaustion and mental stress. Behind her stands a huge {argument name="emotion monster" default="'emotion little monster'"} in a hand-drawn style with a plush 3D texture, large and clumsy yet oppressive. The monster is gray-blue, has big eyes, and is covered in sticky notes and reminders symbolizing pressure. Realistic office details on the desk like a laptop and coffee. Cold gray lighting in the background, creating a contrast between the real woman and the exaggerated animated monster. A creative poster vibe evoking workplace empathy. Negative prompts: no horror, no blood, no children's book style, no overly cute chibi style, no messy office, no multiple people, no distorted faces, no watermarks.

zh.title: 职场焦虑情绪怪兽肖像
zh.description: 一个创意摄影提示词，将办公室压力可视化为一只手绘卡通怪兽，笼罩在一位写实风格女性员工的身后。
zh.prompt: 垂直版本 3:4，一张结合了写实摄影与手绘动画怪兽元素的创意肖像，无拼贴，无网格，无信息图表，无文字。一位 {argument name="person" default="年轻亚裔女性"} 坐在办公桌前，穿着一件简单的 {argument name="clothing" default="白衬衫"}，黑色头发扎成低马尾，神情疲惫而安静，一只手托着脸。她看起来很平静，但眼神中流露出疲惫与精神压力。在她身后站着一只巨大的 {argument name="emotion monster" default="“情绪小怪兽”"}，采用手绘风格并带有毛绒 3D 质感，体型庞大笨拙却充满压迫感。怪兽呈灰蓝色，有着大眼睛，身上贴满了象征压力的便利贴和提醒事项。桌上有笔记本电脑和咖啡等写实的办公细节。背景为冷灰色调，营造出真实女性与夸张动画怪兽之间的对比。具有创意海报感，引发职场共鸣。负面提示词：无恐怖元素，无血腥，非儿童绘本风格，非过度可爱的 Q 版风格，无凌乱办公室，无多人，无扭曲面部，无水印。

en.title: Realistic Morning Subway Commute
en.description: A highly realistic prompt for capturing the everyday atmosphere of a crowded morning subway commute in an Asian city, emphasizing natural poses, lighting, and skin textures.
en.prompt:
Standing in a crowded subway | Morning rush hour realism

Vertical 3:4, a single realistic mobile phone snapshot of a commute, no collages, no grids, no poster feel, no text.

Only refer to the facial features, face shape, long straight black hair, and natural skin texture of the {argument name="character features" default="young adult Asian female"} in the uploaded image, keeping the appearance consistent. Only refer to the person's appearance, completely reconstructing the {argument name="subway scene" default="crowded morning rush hour subway scene"}.

Early morning rush hour, a young adult Asian female stands in a crowded city subway car, {argument name="clothing" default="wearing a light gray sleeveless knit top, dark gray loose long skirt and flat shoes"}, with a light-colored canvas bag on her shoulder. The carriage is full of passengers, and the distance between people is close, but the posture is natural, no squeezing or deformation.

She naturally raises one hand to grab the overhead ring, while the other hand is looking down at the phone, and her body tilts slightly as the train sways. She is looking at her phone seriously, her eyes focused with a bit of drowsiness from just waking up, her lips naturally closed, not looking at the camera, and not deliberately smiling.

Long black hair naturally hangs on her shoulders and chest, with a small amount of loose hair spreading gently due to the swaying of the carriage. The canvas bag is pressed to one side of her body, slightly squeezed by surrounding passengers, and the clothes have natural wrinkles. The person's standing posture is relaxed and real, no model pose, no chest-thumping pose.

There are a large number of normal commuting passengers around, some grabbing handrails, some looking down at their phones, some carrying backpacks. Passengers stand naturally along the carriage space, not surrounding the female lead, and not all looking at the camera.

The background is an ordinary city subway car, including doors, overhead rings, handrails, route maps, cool white ceiling lights, and blurry advertisements. No thick vertical iron pillars facing the camera should appear in the frame, and iron pillars should not block the person's face or body.

Ordinary mobile phone rear camera, about 26mm wide angle, shot from one or two meters diagonally in front, medium close-up composition. Retain real skin texture, slight fatigue under the eyes, loose hair, clothing wrinkles, and the clutter of the morning rush hour environment.

**Negative Prompt:** Empty carriage, too few passengers, person standing alone, model posing, commercial photography, smiling directly at the camera, all passengers looking at the camera, passengers watching the female lead, body clipping through each other, person deformed by squeezing, arm overlap errors, extra arms, extra fingers, incorrect ring-holding posture, suspended overhead rings, deformed phone, clear text on phone screen, thick iron pillars blocking the face, foreground iron pillars centered, passenger direction chaotic, over-smoothed skin, strong beauty filters, severe background blur, face swapping, facial feature drifting, text, watermarks.

zh.title: 逼真的地铁早高峰人像
zh.description: 一份用于生成逼真、抓拍风格的女性早高峰地铁通勤照片的综合提示词，侧重于真实的氛围感和角色一致性。
zh.prompt:
地铁站立 | 逼真的早高峰

竖构图 3:4，单张逼真的手机通勤抓拍，无拼贴，无四宫格，无海报感，无文字。

仅参考上传图片中 {argument name="character description" default="年轻亚裔女性"} 的面部特征、脸型、黑色长直发和自然皮肤纹理以保持一致性。仅参考外貌，完全重构拥挤的早高峰地铁场景。

清晨高峰时段，一位年轻亚裔女性站在拥挤的城市地铁车厢内，身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="浅灰色无袖针织上衣、深灰色宽松长裙，搭配平底鞋"}，肩上背着一个浅色帆布包。车厢拥挤，人们彼此靠近但姿态自然，没有挤压变形。

一只手自然抬起抓着上方吊环，另一只手拿着手机低头看，身体随着列车晃动轻微倾斜。她正认真地看着手机，眼神专注，带着一丝刚睡醒的困倦，嘴唇自然闭合，没有看镜头，也没有刻意微笑。

黑色长发自然垂落在肩头和胸前，几缕发丝因车厢晃动而轻微散乱。帆布包紧贴身体一侧，被周围乘客轻微挤压；衣服有自然的褶皱。站姿放松且真实，非模特摆拍，无挺胸姿势。

周围有大量普通的通勤乘客，有的抓着扶手，有的低头看手机，有的背着双肩包；乘客根据车厢空间自然站立，没有围着女主角，也没有全部看向镜头。前景可以有一两个乘客的肩膀或背包轻微遮挡画面边缘以增强拥挤感，但不能遮挡主角的脸部或关键动作。

背景为 {argument name="background environment" default="普通的城市地铁车厢"}，包括车门、吊环、扶手、路线图、冷白色的顶灯和模糊的广告。画面中没有正对镜头的粗大垂直铁柱；不要让铁柱遮挡角色的脸部或身体。手机屏幕内容模糊，不显示清晰的文字、聊天记录或品牌。

普通手机后置摄像头，约 26mm 广角，从斜前方一两米处拍摄，中近景构图。画面看起来像是同车的路人在人群中抓拍的，构图略微倾斜，带有轻微的车厢晃动和自然的运动模糊；角色脸部保持清晰。保留真实的皮肤纹理、轻微的眼下疲态、散乱的发丝、衣物褶皱以及早高峰环境的杂乱感。

**负面提示词：** 空旷的车厢、乘客太少、角色独自站立、模特摆拍、商业摄影、对着镜头微笑、所有乘客看向镜头、乘客注视女主角、身体裁剪、角色被挤压变形、手臂重叠错误、多余的手臂、多余的手指、错误的抓环姿势、漂浮的吊环、变形的手机、手机屏幕上有清晰文字、粗大的铁柱遮挡脸部、前景铁柱居中、乘客方向混乱、过度磨皮、强力美颜滤镜、严重的背景虚化、换脸、五官漂移、文字、水印。

en.title: Morning Indoor Lifestyle Portrait
en.description: A natural and bright lifestyle portrait of a woman spending a quiet morning at home, focusing on soft sunlight and realistic textures.
en.prompt:
Vertical 9:16, a realistic and bright indoor lifestyle portrait. Depict only one fictional {argument name="person" default="adult East Asian woman"}, not a real person. Appearance is in {argument name="age" default="late 20s"}. Place the center of the woman's face at about 48% of the screen width, and the visual center of the upper body including hair, shoulders, and chest at about 50%, without centering the person too much to either side. Fit the person naturally from the top of the head to below the chest within the vertical frame, with the face at about 20-43% from the top, shoulders and chest in the center, and the white top continuing to the bottom. Leave a very thin margin above the head. Include a portion of a bent right arm and pale beige knee at the right edge of the screen, naturally suggesting the action of a hand touching the back of the head. Do not unnaturally cut the forehead, chin, hair, shoulders, or main outfit.

The woman is kneeling on one knee on a bright sofa or bed, slightly raising her upper body. Her face is in a two-thirds profile facing the left of the screen. Her gaze is set outside the left window, with eyes not too narrowed and a very small, calm smile on her lips. A quiet and composed emotion, as if absentmindedly looking outside on a holiday morning. Do not raise the chin, and relax the neck and shoulders.

The facial features are naturally oval. Align the height and size of the left and right eyes, and place a small window catchlight in the dark brown pupils. Eyebrows are not too thin, naturally dark brown. Makeup is light, with pale coral lips, natural cheek color, and modest brown at the outer corners of the eyes. Skin is bright and healthy, leaving natural pores and slight fine hairs on the cheeks and nose. Avoid excessive skin correction or plastic-like uniformity.

Hair is dark brown to near black. Gathered in a loose small chignon at a slightly high position on the back of the head. Naturally part the center-leaning bangs to the left and right, leaving a few thin stray hairs at the temples, in front of the ears, and at the nape of the neck. The right hand lightly touches the hair at the back of the head, with the finger positions naturally hidden in the hair. Do not create extra fingers or fused hands.

The outfit is a {argument name="clothing" default="plain white ribbed tank top"}. Thick shoulder straps, not-too-deep round neckline, soft cotton knit. Draw fine vertical ribs and natural wrinkles along the body's posture at the chest, sides, and waist. Do not include transparency, logos, patterns, or decorations. The lower body is soft lounge pants in light beige. Show wrinkles in the fabric of the bent knee in the lower right of the screen.

The foreground is the woman's shoulders, face, and white top. The middle ground is a bright ivory sofa or bed. Place a large white window frame in the back left, with faint daylight outside that is not too blown out. In the back right, modestly arrange a white wall, a thin wooden frame, blurred houseplants, and small wooden furniture. Make background objects less prominent than the person, and do not generate text or logos.

The camera is at chest height, slightly lower than the woman's eye level. Shoot from a medium-close distance, circling slightly to the left from the front. The focal length feels around 50mm. Avoid wide-angle face stretching or arm exaggeration. Focus on the face and the near shoulder, with a shallow to medium depth of field that gracefully blurs the back of the head, right arm, knee, and background. Keep the facial contours, pupils, lips, and stray hairs clear.

The primary light source is soft natural light coming from the large window on the left. The light brightly wraps the left cheek, bridge of the nose, lips, neck, and left shoulder, leaving faint shadows on the right cheek and right arm. The light is diffused and does not create hard shadows. The color temperature is slightly neutral to warm. The exposure is high-key, but retains gradations in the white top and window. Add very thin warm tones to the wood and skin in the back right. The overall color scheme is white, ivory, pale beige, soft brown, and dull green of plants.

Realistically depict skin pores, natural moisture of the lips, transparency of the pupils, fine hair flow, ribbed fibers, and the soft fabric of the lounge pants. Commercial photo quality feeling clean and calm morning wellness, loungewear, beauty, and holiday living. Do not include text, logos, brand names, signatures, or watermarks. Avoid extra persons, extra arms or fingers, missing hands, fused fingers, broken shoulders, twisted necks, asymmetrical eyes, distorted window frames, repetitive background objects, excessive chest emphasis, doll-like skin, excessive skin smoothing, overly strong HDR, or illustration style.

zh.title: 清晨室内生活方式肖像
zh.description: 一张自然明亮的生活方式肖像，展现了一位女性在家里度过宁静清晨的场景，聚焦于柔和的阳光和真实的质感。
zh.prompt:
竖构图 9:16，一张写实且明亮的室内生活方式肖像。仅描绘一名虚构的 {argument name="person" default="成年东亚女性"}，而非真实人物。外貌设定为 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁后期"}。将女性面部中心置于屏幕宽度约 48% 的位置，包含头发、肩膀和胸部的上半身视觉中心置于约 50% 的位置，避免人物过度偏向某一侧。在竖构图中自然地容纳从头顶到胸部以下的人物，面部位于顶部约 20-43% 处，肩膀和胸部居中，白色上衣延伸至底部。头顶上方留出极窄的边距。在屏幕右边缘包含部分弯曲的右臂和淡米色膝盖，自然地暗示手触碰后脑勺的动作。请勿不自然地切割额头、下巴、头发、肩膀或主要服装。

女性单膝跪在明亮的沙发或床上，上身微微抬起。面部呈三分之二侧面，面向屏幕左侧。视线投向左侧窗外，双眼不要眯得太紧，唇角带着极轻微、平静的微笑。展现一种安静、沉稳的情绪，仿佛在假日清晨心不在焉地望向窗外。请勿抬起下巴，放松颈部和肩膀。

面部特征呈自然的椭圆形。左右眼的高度和大小对齐，深棕色瞳孔中带有小小的窗户反光。眉毛不要太细，呈自然的深棕色。妆容清淡，唇色为淡珊瑚色，脸颊颜色自然，眼角处有适度的棕色。皮肤明亮健康，保留脸颊和鼻翼上自然的毛孔和细微绒毛。避免过度修饰皮肤或产生塑料般的统一感。

头发为深棕色至接近黑色。在后脑勺稍高的位置扎成一个松散的小发髻。刘海向左右自然偏分，在鬓角、耳前和颈后留出几缕细碎的发丝。右手轻轻触碰后脑勺的头发，手指位置自然地隐藏在发丝中。请勿生成多余的手指或融合的手部。

服装为 {argument name="clothing" default="纯白色罗纹背心"}。肩带较宽，圆领深度适中，材质为柔软的棉质针织面料。在胸部、侧面和腰部勾勒出细致的垂直罗纹和自然的褶皱。请勿包含透明度、标志、图案或装饰。下半身穿着浅米色的柔软休闲裤。在屏幕右下方的弯曲膝盖处展示织物的褶皱。

前景为女性的肩膀、面部和白色上衣。中景为明亮的象牙白沙发或床。左后方放置一个大白色窗框，窗外有淡淡的日光，亮度不过曝。右后方适度布置一面白墙、细木框、模糊的室内植物和小件木质家具。背景物体应比人物更不显眼，请勿生成文字或标志。

相机位于胸部高度，略低于女性视线水平。从中近距离拍摄，从正面略微向左环绕。焦距感约为 50mm。避免广角带来的面部拉伸或手臂夸张。聚焦于面部和近处的肩膀，采用浅至中等的景深，优雅地虚化后脑勺、右臂、膝盖和背景。保持面部轮廓、瞳孔、嘴唇和碎发的清晰度。

主要光源是来自左侧大窗户的柔和自然光。光线明亮地包裹着左脸颊、鼻梁、嘴唇、颈部和左肩，在右脸颊和右臂上留下淡淡的阴影。光线经过漫反射，不会产生生硬的阴影。色温略偏中性至暖色。曝光为高调，但保留了白色上衣和窗户的层次感。在右后方的木材和皮肤上添加极淡的暖色调。整体配色方案为白色、象牙白、淡米色、柔和的棕色以及植物的暗绿色。

真实地描绘皮肤毛孔、嘴唇的自然湿润感、瞳孔的透明度、细发流向、罗纹纤维以及休闲裤的柔软质感。商业摄影品质，营造出干净、平静的清晨健康感、家居服、美感和假日生活氛围。请勿包含文字、标志、品牌名称、签名或水印。避免出现多余的人物、多余的手臂或手指、缺失的手、融合的手指、破碎的肩膀、扭曲的脖子、不对称的眼睛、扭曲的窗框、重复的背景物体、过度的胸部强调、玩偶般的皮肤、过度的皮肤平滑、过强的 HDR 或插画风格。

en.title: Corporate Call Center Portrait
en.description: An extremely detailed prompt for generating a photorealistic portrait of a call center operator, focusing on lighting, headset details, and professional atmosphere.
en.prompt: Portrait aspect ratio 9:16, a photorealistic business portrait of a fictional adult Japanese woman, appearing to be {argument name="age" default="24-30 years old"}, handling a phone call in a bright office. Large facial placement slightly to the right of the center, close-up composition from top of head to upper chest. Body slightly turned left, face slightly left of the camera, wearing a gentle smile naturally showing teeth while listening to the other person. Left hand lightly touching the headset on the left ear, fingers naturally aligned behind the ear. Hair is a glossy {argument name="hair color" default="light brown to chestnut"}, long hair tied low, with loose curled strands on both sides of the cheeks. Thin flowing bangs on the forehead. Black over-ear headset, headband not too thick, symmetrical ear pads covering the ears. A thin boom mic extends along the right cheek, ending in a small round black sponge just before the mouth. Realistic equipment connections and angles. {argument name="eye color" default="dark brown"} eyes, natural double eyelids, thin beige-toned makeup, pink coral lips. White collared blouse and pale beige cardigan. The background is a warm-toned call center or customer support room, completely blurring monitors, desks, round lighting, and human-like shapes. Small yellow-orange bokeh in the back left, small blue-green bokeh in the back right. 50-85mm equivalent, f/1.8, eye level. Natural light from a large window from the front left, warm indoor light hitting the edge of the hair. Precise focus on eyes, eyelashes, and mic tip. Leave natural skin pores and fine peach fuzz for a clean look suitable for a corporate site. Do not include text, logos, company names, readable screens, extra cables, double mics, devices sticking in ears, extra fingers, distorted hands, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, or a CG feel.

zh.title: 企业呼叫中心人物肖像
zh.description: 一个用于生成呼叫中心接线员写实肖像的超详细提示词，重点关注光影、耳机细节及专业氛围。
zh.prompt: 肖像比例 9:16，一张虚构的日本成年女性商务写实肖像，年龄设定为 {argument name="age" default="24-30 岁"}，正在明亮的办公室中接听电话。面部位于画面中心偏右，构图为从头顶到上胸部的特写。身体微向左转，脸部略微偏向镜头左侧，带着自然的微笑，露齿倾听对方说话。左手轻触左耳佩戴的耳机，手指自然地贴在耳后。发色为亮眼的 {argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色至栗色"}，长发低扎，脸颊两侧留有松散的卷发丝。额头有轻薄的空气刘海。佩戴黑色头戴式耳机，头梁不过厚，对称的耳罩覆盖双耳。细长的麦克风支架沿右脸颊延伸，末端是一个位于嘴部前方的小型圆形黑色海绵。设备连接与角度真实。{argument name="eye color" default="深棕色"} 双眼，自然的双眼皮，淡米色调妆容，珊瑚粉色唇色。身着白色翻领衬衫和浅米色开衫。背景为暖色调的呼叫中心或客户支持室，显示器、办公桌、圆形灯具和人物轮廓完全虚化。左后方有细小的黄橙色光斑，右后方有细小的蓝绿色光斑。50-85mm 等效焦距，f/1.8 光圈，平视视角。自然光从左前方的大窗户射入，暖色室内光打在发丝边缘。焦点精准对准眼睛、睫毛和麦克风尖端。保留自然的皮肤毛孔和细微的绒毛，以呈现适合企业网站的清爽外观。不要包含文字、Logo、公司名称、可辨认的屏幕内容、多余的线缆、双麦克风、插入耳朵的设备、多余的手指、扭曲的手部、塑料质感皮肤、过度磨皮或 CG 感。

en.title: Woman Relaxing on Balcony
en.description: A detailed realistic prompt for a scene of a woman relaxing in a chair on an apartment balcony, featuring backlighting, specific textures, and a cinematic film aesthetic.
en.prompt:
Subject: Balcony Rest

Body: A full-body vertical snap shot of a {argument name="age" default="woman in her 20s"} leaning deeply back into a low black folding chair on the narrow balcony of an old apartment building, stretching both legs toward a large outdoor AC unit on the left. The woman is positioned diagonally in the dark area at the bottom right, with her head at the right center, upper body at the bottom right, waist at the bottom center, and her two legs extending long from the center to the left. She has her right arm bent behind her head, her left arm hanging relaxed outside the chair, and her left fingertips touching the top edge of a silver beverage can on the floor. Her ankles are slightly offset, with bare soles and toes resting on the top of the AC unit.

Character/Expression: A {argument name="hairstyle" default="short black hair bob"} with thin bangs and soft ends along the cheeks. Her profile faces left, eyes closed, chin slightly raised, and lips slightly parted in a relaxed expression. Bright natural skin with thin eyebrows, subtle eye makeup, and pale coral lips. Strong light from behind creates a thin bright outline on the bridge of the nose, lips, chin, shoulders, chest, arms, and thighs, while the front of the face and torso fall into soft shadows. A pale backlit contour is also created around the hair.

Clothing/Pose: A {argument name="outfit" default="white mini dress with thin shoulder straps"}. The neckline is a deep V-shape with symmetrical vertical pin-tucks and lace, and fine gathers from below the chest to the waist. The thin white fabric skirt wrinkles under the seated hips, showing part of the upper thighs. A sheer white long-sleeved shirt hangs loosely from the shoulders, with the right sleeve pushed up near the elbow and the left sleeve off the shoulder, its long cuff hanging near the wrist. Barefoot, with the right leg on top and the left leg below, stretched toward the AC unit with knees slightly bent. The black chair's fabric and metal frame support the back, waist, and thighs, with the body sinking in accordance with gravity.

Background/Light: In the left foreground is a large gray vertical air conditioner outdoor unit showing a black rectangular intake, horizontal louvers, a thick top surface, and a bottom stand. In the center is a gray metal railing with thin vertical bars, the horizontal top bar crossing the screen. Outside the railing, white to pale beige apartment buildings overlap, with windows, balconies, and eaves blurred in the strong sunlight. The balcony floor is dark gray rough waterproofing, with the black frame of the chair, a pair of black sandals in the bottom center, and a silver elongated can in the bottom right. Small potted plants are placed behind the AC unit and near the railing, with a thin-stemmed plant on the far right. Strong natural light from the bright outdoor background backlights the figure, turning the floor and the wall near the room into deep blue-gray shadows.

Composition/Camera: A vertical shot near 2:3, a full-body snap from a slightly low eye level looking out across the balcony from the indoor opening. The top half is mostly bright sky and negative space of the apartment buildings, while the woman and AC unit are grouped in the bottom half. The AC unit on the left serves as a large foreground element, the stretched legs as a diagonal, and the woman and chair on the right as the dark main subject. A black window frame is placed vertically at the right edge, with the left wall and railing creating depth. The woman's full body, feet, left hand and can, sandals, and the chair's contact with the ground are all contained within the frame. Focus on the person, with the buildings outside brightly and softly blurred. Natural compression of a standard lens with subtle grain.

Texture/Style: A realistic photo of summer life. Uses white blurred light, deep blue-gray shadows, warm beige skin, thin white cloth, a black chair and sandals, and green potted plants. Distinguishes fine glints on the skin under backlighting, short hair bundles, pin-tucks and lace on the dress, sheerness and wrinkles of the shirt, painted metal of the AC unit, dull reflections on the railing, rough floor, and metallic luster of the beverage can. The background is slightly overexposed, keeping detail in the shadows of the person, with gradations and light grain like a quiet film photograph.

Negative: Avoid profile collapse, eye asymmetry when closed, extra fingers, fusion of the hand and can, arm or leg deformation, reverse bending of knees or ankles, increase/decrease of toes, poor contact with the AC unit, contradiction between chair support and gravity, unnatural clothing tucks, perspective failure of railings and buildings, contradiction between backlighting and shadows, text, logo, watermark, and excessive skin processing.

zh.title: 在阳台上放松的女性
zh.description: 一份详细且逼真的提示词，用于描绘一位女性在公寓阳台的椅子上放松的场景，包含背光效果、特定纹理以及电影胶片质感。
zh.prompt:
主题：阳台休憩

正文：一张全身垂直快照，拍摄一位 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁的女性"}，她深深地倚靠在老旧公寓楼狭窄阳台上一把低矮的黑色折叠椅中，双腿向左侧的一台大型室外空调外机伸展。女性位于右下方的阴影区域，呈对角线分布，头部位于右侧中心，上半身在右下方，腰部在底部中心，双腿从中心向左延伸。她的右手弯曲在脑后，左手自然垂在椅子外，左手指尖触碰着地板上一罐银色饮料的顶部边缘。双脚脚踝略微错开，赤裸的脚掌和脚趾搭在空调外机上方。

人物/表情：留着 {argument name="hairstyle" default="黑色短发波波头"}，带有稀疏的刘海，发梢在脸颊处呈现柔和的弧度。侧脸朝向左侧，双眼紧闭，下巴微抬，双唇微张，神情放松。明亮的自然肤色，眉毛纤细，眼妆淡雅，嘴唇呈淡珊瑚色。来自后方的强光在鼻梁、嘴唇、下巴、肩膀、胸部、手臂和大腿上勾勒出一道明亮的轮廓线，而面部正面和躯干则落入柔和的阴影中。头发周围也形成了一圈淡淡的背光轮廓。

服装/姿势：穿着一件 {argument name="outfit" default="白色细肩带迷你连衣裙"}。领口为深 V 型，带有对称的垂直褶皱和蕾丝装饰，从胸部下方到腰部有细密的褶皱。薄薄的白色布料裙摆在坐姿的臀部下产生褶皱，露出部分大腿上部。一件透明的白色长袖衬衫松散地挂在肩上，右袖推至肘部附近，左袖滑落肩头，长袖口垂在手腕附近。赤脚，右腿在上，左腿在下，膝盖微屈，向空调外机方向伸展。黑色椅子的布料和金属框架支撑着背部、腰部和大腿，身体因重力而下沉。

背景/光影：左侧前景是一台大型灰色立式空调室外机，展示了黑色矩形进气口、水平百叶窗、厚实的顶部表面和底部支架。中心是一道带有细长垂直栏杆的灰色金属护栏，水平顶杆横穿画面。护栏外，白色至淡米色的公寓楼重叠在一起，窗户、阳台和屋檐在强烈的阳光下显得模糊。阳台地板是深灰色的粗糙防水层，底部中心有一双黑色凉鞋，右下方有一罐银色长条形饮料。空调外机后方和护栏附近放置着小型盆栽植物，最右侧有一株细茎植物。来自明亮室外背景的强烈自然光为人物打上背光，使地板和靠近房间的墙壁呈现出深蓝灰色的阴影。

构图/摄影：近 2:3 的垂直构图，从室内开口处向阳台拍摄的略微低视角的全身快照。上半部分主要是明亮的天空和公寓楼的负空间，女性和空调外机被组合在下半部分。左侧的空调外机作为大型前景元素，伸展的双腿形成对角线，右侧的女性和椅子作为深色的主体。右边缘垂直放置着一个黑色窗框，左侧墙壁和护栏营造出深度感。女性的全身、双脚、左手和饮料罐、凉鞋以及椅子与地面的接触点都包含在画面内。焦点在人物身上，室外的建筑明亮且柔和地模糊处理。标准镜头的自然压缩感，带有细微的颗粒感。

纹理/风格：一张夏季生活的写实照片。运用白色模糊光、深蓝灰色阴影、温暖的米色皮肤、轻薄的白布、黑色椅子和凉鞋，以及绿色盆栽。展现了背光下皮肤的细微光泽、短发束、连衣裙上的褶皱和蕾丝、衬衫的透视感和褶皱、空调外机的漆面金属感、护栏上暗淡的反射、粗糙的地板以及饮料罐的金属光泽。背景略微过曝，保留了人物阴影中的细节，具有静谧胶片摄影般的渐变和轻微颗粒感。

负面提示词：避免侧脸崩坏、闭眼时眼睛不对称、多余的手指、手与饮料罐融合、手臂或腿部变形、膝盖或脚踝反向弯曲、脚趾数量异常、与空调外机接触不良、椅子支撑与重力矛盾、不自然的衣物褶皱、护栏和建筑的透视错误、背光与阴影矛盾、文字、Logo、水印以及过度处理皮肤。

en.title: Minimalist Indoor Portrait with Oblique Light
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for a minimalist fashion portrait in a white room, focusing on natural light, material textures, and precise character posing.
en.prompt:
Subject: Oblique Light in a White Room

Main Subject: A realistic vertical portrait of a {argument name="age" default="woman in her 20s"} sitting alone on the floor of a minimalist interior unified in white and light gray. The woman occupies the area slightly to the right of the center, with her head in the middle of the upper half, her waist at the bottom center, and her crossed legs spreading wide from the bottom left to the bottom right. She sits upright, supporting her weight with her left hand on the floor to the right, and her right hand raised near her cheek with thin fingers slightly bent. Her right knee is raised high toward the front, while her left leg is folded beneath it, with both feet flowing in opposite directions.

Character/Expression: A small oval face, bright ivory skin, thin brown eyebrows, large hazel-brown eyes, long delicate eyelashes, pale pink cheeks, and glossy coral-beige lips. She stares at the front camera while tilting her head slightly to her left, with a gentle expression and lips slightly parted. Her hair is a {argument name="hair color" default="pale milk tea ash brown"} reaching below the chest, with thin straight bangs and fine layers around the face, the ends swaying naturally inward and outward. Thin streaks of light fall on the top of her head and the hair on the left side of the screen.

Clothing/Pose: A white fine-ribbed wrap-style top. The bottom is a {argument name="skirt" default="charcoal-black high-waisted pleated mini skirt"} with distinct folds of varying widths and waist stitching. A thin black belt hangs from her left waist with a small gold fitting. On her feet are glossy black Mary Jane chunky heels, showing thin ankle straps and square buckles.

Background/Light: The center background is a seamless white wall, the right edge of the screen has a thin vertical lattice extending from floor to top, and the back left features a rectangular white low platform and a wall corner. The floor consists of large light-gray tiles with thin joints converging into the distance. Somewhat hard, warm-toned natural light entering from the top left creates a large diagonal triangle on the left wall and bright squares on the bottom left and right of the floor.

Composition/Camera: A 3:4 vertical full-body fashion portrait from a low camera position close to the floor. Natural perspective from a standard to short portrait lens, leaving a wide white negative space above the figure's head and a large wall area on the left. The eyes and face are the sharpest focus, while the background wall and lattice are lightly and softly blurred.

Texture/Style: A high-resolution realistic fashion photograph. Based on white, light gray, and charcoal black, with warm beige tones of skin and hair as accent colors. Distinguishes specular reflections on enamel shoes and the smoothness of floor tiles. A bright, clean exposure that preserves highlight gradations, resulting in a polished commercial photo finish.

Negative: Avoid face distortion, misaligned gaze, extra fingers, finger fusion, deformed wrists or elbows, fusion of crossed legs, reverse bending of joints, poor contact with the floor, clothing clipping, gravity defiance, horizontal reversal, strong wide-angle distortion, perspective failure of tiles and lattice, unnatural light and shadow, text, logo, watermark, and excessive skin processing.

zh.title: 极简室内斜射光人像
zh.description: 一份用于白色房间内极简时尚人像的高细节提示词，侧重于自然光、材质纹理及精准的人物姿态。
zh.prompt:
主题：白色房间内的斜射光

主体：一张写实的竖构图人像，拍摄一位 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁的女性"} 独自坐在白色与浅灰色调统一的极简室内地板上。女性位于画面中心偏右侧，头部位于上半部分中央，腰部位于底部中心，双腿交叉从左下角向右下角舒展。她坐姿挺拔，左手撑在右侧地板上支撑身体，右手抬起靠近脸颊，手指纤细微弯。右膝高高抬起朝向前方，左腿折叠在下方，双脚向相反方向自然延伸。

人物/表情：小巧的鹅蛋脸，明亮的象牙白肤色，细长的棕色眉毛，大而明亮的榛棕色眼睛，长而精致的睫毛，淡粉色的脸颊，以及光泽感的珊瑚米色嘴唇。她微微向左侧头，凝视着前方的镜头，表情温柔，双唇微启。头发为 {argument name="hair color" default="浅奶茶灰棕色"}，长度过胸，留着细碎的直刘海，脸部周围有细致的层次感，发梢自然地向内和向外摆动。细微的光束洒在她的头顶和屏幕左侧的头发上。

服装/姿态：白色细罗纹裹身式上衣。下装为 {argument name="skirt" default="炭黑色高腰百褶迷你裙"}，带有不同宽度的明显褶皱和腰部缝线。左腰处垂下一条细黑腰带，配有小巧的金色配件。脚穿光泽感黑色玛丽珍粗跟鞋，露出细脚踝带和方形扣。

背景/光影：背景中央为无缝白墙，屏幕右边缘有一条从地面延伸至顶部的细长垂直格栅，左后方设有一个长方形白色矮台和墙角。地面由大块浅灰色瓷砖铺成，细小的接缝向远处汇聚。从左上方射入的略显硬朗的暖色调自然光，在左侧墙壁上投射出一个巨大的对角三角形，并在地板的左下角和右下角形成明亮的光斑。

构图/相机：3:4 竖构图全身时尚人像，采用贴近地面的低机位拍摄。使用标准至短焦人像镜头的自然透视，在人物头部上方留出大面积的白色负空间，左侧留有大面积墙面。焦点清晰地聚焦在眼睛和面部，背景墙面和格栅则呈现轻柔的虚化效果。

纹理/风格：高分辨率写实时尚摄影。以白色、浅灰色和炭黑色为基调，肤色和发色的暖米色作为点缀色。突显漆皮鞋面的镜面反射和地砖的平滑质感。明亮、干净的曝光保留了高光层次，呈现出精致的商业摄影质感。

负面提示词：避免面部扭曲、视线偏移、多余手指、手指粘连、手腕或肘部畸形、双腿交叉处粘连、关节反向弯曲、与地面接触不良、衣服穿模、违背重力、水平翻转、强烈的广角畸变、瓷砖和格栅的透视错误、不自然的光影、文字、Logo、水印以及过度的皮肤处理。

en.title: Lace Dress Woman Dancing in the Park
en.description: A poetic prompt for a fashion portrait of a woman in a long lace dress spinning in a sunlit park, emphasizing movement and backlit textures.
en.prompt:
Subject: Hem Dancing in the Shade

Main Subject: A full-body vertical fashion portrait of a {argument name="age" default="woman in her 20s"} lightly spinning while lifting the hem of a long {argument name="dress color" default="ecru-colored"} lace dress with both hands on a cobblestone path in a park surrounded by summer greenery. The woman occupies the center of the screen, with her head at the top center, her thin waist in the middle, the spreading skirt at the bottom center, and her bare legs extending to the bottom. She pinches the left hem with her right hand and the right hem with her left hand, spreading both arms softly diagonally downward. She tilts her upper body and face slightly to her right, crosses her left leg behind her right leg using it as an axis, and lifts her left foot slightly off the ground. During the rotation, her hair and thin hem flow to the right of the screen.

Character/Expression: A small oval face, bright ivory skin, thin light-brown eyebrows, downcast brown eyes, long delicate eyelashes, pale pink cheeks, and soft coral-beige lips. Her face is tilted to her left, and her hair is {argument name="hair color" default="milk tea brown"} reaching below the chest, flowing heavily from left to right due to wind and rotation. Backlighting from the top right creates a thin golden edge on the top of her head, hair periphery, cheeks, shoulders, and arms.

Clothing/Pose: A fishtail-style dress made of multiple layers of transparent tulle and lace in ecru to pale champagne. The entire hem features white floral embroidery, vertical weave lines, and multiple waving ruffles, drawing a large arc to the left and right as she spins. She is barefoot, with her right sole touching the cobblestones and her left toes pointing downward while floating.

Background/Light: The foreground is a park path paved with small gray-brown stones. The background left features a thick tree trunk and deep green leaves, while the back right features a hexagonal gazebo with a gray roof. Strong natural light shines from the top right behind her, illuminating her hair, shoulders, sleeves, transparent layers of the skirt, legs, and cobblestones in gold. Round dapples of sunlight through leaves are scattered on the ground and her outfit.

Composition/Camera: A vertical shot near 2:3, a full-body fashion portrait from a camera position slightly lower than the waist of the standing figure. The hem of the dress is brought close to the left and right edges but the entire arc is kept within the frame, making the floating left foot and grounded right foot clear. The face, upper body, both hands, and lace are sharpened, with a very slight sense of motion given to the moving hem and hair ends.

Texture/Style: A high-resolution realistic summer fashion photograph. Distinguishes natural skin texture with soft sunlight glow, sheer tulle layers, floral embroidery, lace threads, waving ruffles, bare feet, and rough cobblestones. Maintains high contrast between the backlit contours of the clothing and the dappled sunlight, resulting in a bright commercial photo with light movement.

Negative: Avoid distortion of face or downcast eyes, extra fingers, fusion of hands and hem, deformed wrists or arms, fusion of crossed legs, reverse bending of knees or ankles, increase/decrease of toes, poor contact of the right foot, contradiction of floating left foot with gravity, excessive flipping of the dress, failure of hem or lace, text, logo, watermark, and excessive skin processing.

zh.title: 身穿蕾丝裙在公园翩翩起舞的女性
zh.description: 这是一段富有诗意的时尚人像提示词，描绘了一位身穿长款蕾丝裙的女性在阳光明媚的公园中旋转的画面，强调动态美感与逆光下的纹理细节。
zh.prompt:
主题：树荫下的裙摆舞动

主体：一张全身垂直时尚人像，画面中一位 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁的女性"} 正在轻盈地旋转，双手提起一件长款 {argument name="dress color" default="米色"} 蕾丝裙的裙摆。背景是公园里铺满鹅卵石的小径，周围环绕着夏日的绿植。女性位于画面中心，头部位于上方中央，纤细的腰部位于中间，散开的裙摆位于下方中央，赤裸的双脚延伸至底部。她用右手捏住左侧裙摆，左手捏住右侧裙摆，双臂柔和地向斜下方伸展。她将上半身和脸部微微向右倾斜，左腿交叉在右腿后方作为轴心，左脚轻盈离地。旋转过程中，她的头发和轻薄的裙摆向画面右侧飘动。

人物/表情：小巧的椭圆形脸庞，明亮的象牙色肌肤，细长的浅棕色眉毛，低垂的棕色眼眸，长而精致的睫毛，淡粉色的脸颊，以及柔和的珊瑚米色双唇。她的脸向左倾斜， {argument name="hair color" default="奶茶棕色"} 的长发垂至胸下，因风力和旋转而从左向右大幅飘动。来自右上方的逆光在她的头顶、发丝边缘、脸颊、肩膀和手臂上勾勒出纤细的金边。

服装/姿态：鱼尾款连衣裙，由多层透明薄纱和米色至浅香槟色的蕾丝制成。整个裙摆饰有白色花卉刺绣、垂直编织纹理和多层波浪荷叶边，旋转时在左右两侧画出巨大的弧线。她赤着双脚，右脚掌触碰鹅卵石，左脚脚尖向下悬空。

背景/光影：前景是铺着灰褐色小石头的公园小径。左侧背景是一棵粗壮的树干和深绿色的叶片，右后方是一座带有灰色屋顶的六角凉亭。强烈的自然光从她身后的右上方射入，将她的头发、肩膀、袖子、透明裙层、双腿和鹅卵石照亮成金色。透过树叶洒下的圆形斑驳阳光散落在地面和她的服装上。

构图/摄影：近 2:3 的垂直构图，全身时尚人像，相机位置略低于站立人物的腰部。裙摆靠近画面的左右边缘，但完整的弧线保持在取景框内，使悬空的左脚和着地的右脚清晰可见。脸部、上半身、双手和蕾丝细节锐利，飘动的裙摆和发梢带有极轻微的动态感。

纹理/风格：高分辨率写实夏季时尚摄影。展现了带有柔和阳光光泽的自然皮肤纹理、透明薄纱层、花卉刺绣、蕾丝线迹、波浪荷叶边、赤足以及粗糙的鹅卵石质感。保持了服装逆光轮廓与斑驳阳光之间的高对比度，呈现出一张充满轻盈动态感的明亮商业照片。

负面提示：避免脸部或低垂眼眸的扭曲、多余的手指、手部与裙摆的融合、手腕或手臂变形、交叉双腿的融合、膝盖或脚踝的反向弯曲、脚趾数量异常、右脚接触地面不自然、左脚悬空违背重力、裙摆过度翻转、裙摆或蕾丝破损、文字、Logo、水印以及过度磨皮。

en.title: Summer Street Coffee Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for a high-resolution, realistic street photograph of a woman with a coffee cup, set against a summer backdrop with orange flowers and dappled sunlight.
en.prompt:
Subject: {argument name="subject" default="Coffee in the shade of flowers"}

Main Body: In a summer street corner with vibrant orange flowers, a woman in her 20s is leaning her right shoulder against a grey-white pillar, holding a paper cup, captured in a vertical knee-up portrait. She occupies the right half of the screen. She holds the lidded paper cup at chest height. Her left arm is down by her side, leaning slightly against the pillar, looking toward the street on the left.

Character/Expression: Small oval face, light ivory skin, light brown eyes, coral orange lips. A calm expression looking away. Medium-length ash brown hair with soft flips. Dappled sunlight on her forehead, hair, and shoulders. Small gold necklace and stud earrings.

Clothing/Pose: {argument name="top" default="A white ribbed knit top with thin shoulder straps"}. Deep V-neck with lace edging and a small bow. {argument name="bottom" default="A light cream-beige floral mini skirt"} with shirring and double frills. Her right hand supports the cup naturally, while the left hand is relaxed.

Background/Light: Left half filled with green branches and small orange flowers. Blurred sidewalk and streetlights in the background. Right half is a textured pillar with an old beige button box and a fire extinguisher sign. Warm natural light from the top left creating dappled patterns and soft shadows.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4 ratio, knee-up fashion portrait at chest height. Shallow depth of field focusing on the face and cup. The background street is heavily blurred.

Texture/Style: High-resolution realistic summer street photography. Precise depiction of skin texture, hair reflections, knit ribs, and floral fabric. Colors are cream, ivory, and warm skin tones with accents of deep green and orange-red.

Negative: Avoid distorted faces, extra fingers, deformed arms, messy floral patterns, or excessive skin smoothing.

zh.title: 夏日街头咖啡人像
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于生成一张高分辨率、写实的街头摄影作品，画面中一位女性手持咖啡杯，背景为盛开的橙色花朵与斑驳阳光下的夏日街景。
zh.prompt:
主体：{argument name="subject" default="花荫下的咖啡"}

主体描述：在夏日街头一角，橙色花朵竞相绽放，一位 20 多岁的女性右肩倚靠在灰白色立柱上，手持纸杯，画面为竖构图的膝上人像。她位于画面右侧。她将带盖纸杯置于胸前高度。左臂自然下垂，轻靠在立柱上，目光望向左侧街道。

人物/表情：小巧的鹅蛋脸，象牙白肤色，浅棕色双眸，珊瑚橙色双唇。神情平静，视线看向别处。中长款灰棕色发型，发梢微卷。斑驳的阳光洒在她的额头、发丝和肩头。佩戴精致的金色项链和耳钉。

服装/姿势：{argument name="top" default="白色罗纹针织吊带衫"}。深 V 领口饰有蕾丝花边和一个小蝴蝶结。{argument name="bottom" default="浅奶油米色碎花迷你裙"}，带有褶皱和双层荷叶边设计。右手自然托住杯子，左手放松垂放。

背景/光影：画面左侧布满绿植枝叶和橙色小花。背景为虚化的人行道和路灯。右侧为带有纹理的立柱，上面挂着旧米色按钮盒和灭火器标志。来自左上方的温暖自然光营造出斑驳的光影和柔和的阴影。

构图/摄影：竖构图 3:4 比例，胸部高度拍摄的膝上时尚人像。浅景深，焦点集中在面部和咖啡杯上。背景街道经过深度虚化处理。

质感/风格：高分辨率写实夏日街头摄影。精准呈现皮肤纹理、发丝反光、针织罗纹及花卉面料质感。色调以奶油色、象牙白和温暖的肤色为主，点缀深绿色和橙红色。

负面提示词：避免面部扭曲、多余的手指、手臂畸形、杂乱的花卉图案或过度磨皮。

en.title: Golden Hour Nape Portrait
en.description: A hyper-detailed prompt for capturing a photorealistic close-up of a woman's nape and hair during the golden hour, emphasizing backlight and fine textures.
en.prompt:
Vertical 9:16, a photorealistic ultra-close-up portrait of a back view shot outdoors in the evening. A fictional adult Japanese woman, looking {argument name="age group" default="24-32 years old"}. The frame includes only the left ear, back of the head, tied hair, neck, nape, and left shoulder, with facial features completely out of frame. The head is turned slightly to the left with the chin slightly down. The ear is in the top left, nape in the center, and shoulder in the bottom left, with a bright backlit margin in the top right.

Hair is {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown near black"}, tied in a loose chignon with a single black U-pin visible. The surface is not overly neat, with many fine hairs and stray strands around the neck and ear. A small single pearl stud earring is in the left ear. The skin shows pores, fine hairs, and small natural moles. The clothing is a {argument name="clothing" default="white cotton blouse"} or thin shirt visible only on the left shoulder.

Strong golden hour backlight from the low evening sun. Golden rim lights on the hair outline, ear edge, and right side of the neck. The background features large white to pale gold bokeh suggesting a beach or riverside. Shot with an 85-105mm equivalent lens at f/1.8. Precise focus on the nape hairs, ear, and hair knot, with a smooth blur on the shoulder and background. Skin is natural and not overly sexualized or smoothed.

zh.title: 黄金时刻颈背肖像
zh.description: 一个超详细的提示词，用于在黄金时刻捕捉女性颈背和头发的写实特写，强调背光和细腻质感。
zh.prompt:
竖屏 9:16，一张在傍晚户外拍摄的写实超近距离肖像。一位虚构的成年日本女性，年龄为 {argument name="age group" default="24-32 岁"}。画面仅包含左耳、后脑勺、束起的头发、颈部、颈背和左肩，面部特征完全在画面之外。头部略微向左转，下巴微垂。耳朵位于左上角，颈背位于中心，肩膀位于左下角，右上角有明亮的背光边缘。

头发颜色为 {argument name="hair color" default="接近黑色的深棕色"}，扎成松散的发髻，可见一枚黑色 U 型发卡。表面并不十分整洁，颈部和耳周有许多细小的碎发。左耳佩戴一枚小巧的单颗珍珠耳钉。皮肤可见毛孔、细小汗毛和天然的小痣。服装为 {argument name="clothing" default="白色棉质衬衫"} 或薄衬衫，仅在左肩可见。

来自低位夕阳的强烈黄金时刻背光。头发轮廓、耳缘和颈部右侧有金色的边缘光。背景呈现出大面积的白色至浅金色虚化效果，暗示着海滩或河边场景。使用 85-105mm 等效镜头，光圈 f/1.8 拍摄。焦点精准对准颈背发丝、耳朵和发髻，肩膀和背景呈现柔和的虚化。皮肤质感自然，未经过度性化处理或磨皮。

en.title: Cosmic Universe Umbrella Fantasy Scene
en.description: A breathtaking cinematic prompt for creating a magical scene where a woman's umbrella reveals a living universe, complete with spiral galaxies and falling stars on a rainy European street.
en.prompt:
Create a breathtaking cinematic fantasy scene on a charming {argument name="setting" default="European street"} just after sunset during a gentle rain. A {argument name="subject" default="beautiful young woman"} wearing an elegant long coat and flowing dress slowly opens a classic {argument name="object" default="black umbrella"}. Instead of ordinary fabric, the inside of the umbrella reveals an entire living universe filled with magnificent spiral galaxies, glowing nebulae, colorful planets, distant moons, comets, constellations, and brilliant stars stretching infinitely overhead.

As she gazes upward in quiet wonder, tiny stars begin falling from the umbrella like delicate raindrops, glowing softly before disappearing into the wet cobblestone street. Every raindrop reflects miniature galaxies, while the puddles mirror the entire universe above. Soft golden street lamps blend beautifully with the cool blue, violet, turquoise, and magenta light radiating from the cosmic umbrella, creating a magical harmony between reality and space.

Around her, historic European architecture, flower-filled balconies, vintage cafés, and glowing windows create a timeless atmosphere. A few curious birds fly through the cosmic sky inside the umbrella while gentle mist drifts across the street. The rain remains soft and elegant, with sparkling droplets suspended in the air. Rich reflections cover the wet pavement, enhancing the dreamlike lighting.

The composition should feel peaceful, emotional, and impossible yet completely believable. Hyper-realistic, cinematic masterpiece, impossible realism, volumetric lighting, god rays, atmospheric perspective, ultra-detailed textures, HDR, 8K, Unreal Engine quality, award-winning fantasy photography, magical realism, National Geographic meets fantasy cinema, dramatic color contrast, no text, no logos, no watermark, vertical 4:5 composition.

zh.title: 宇宙星空雨伞奇幻场景
zh.description: 一个令人惊叹的电影级提示词，用于创作一个魔法场景：一位女性的雨伞展现出一个鲜活的宇宙，包含螺旋星系和流星，背景为雨中的欧洲街道。
zh.prompt:
创作一个令人惊叹的电影级奇幻场景，背景设定在日落后细雨绵绵的迷人 {argument name="setting" default="欧洲街道"}。一位 {argument name="subject" default="美丽的年轻女子"} 身穿优雅的长外套和飘逸的连衣裙，缓缓撑开一把经典的 {argument name="object" default="黑色雨伞"}。伞内并非普通的布料，而是展现出一个完整的鲜活宇宙，充满了壮丽的螺旋星系、发光的星云、多彩的行星、遥远的卫星、彗星、星座以及在头顶无限延伸的璀璨繁星。

当她静静地抬头仰望时，细小的星星像精致的雨滴一样从伞中落下，发出柔和的光芒，随后消失在湿漉漉的鹅卵石街道上。每一滴雨水都倒映着微型星系，而水洼则映射出头顶的整个宇宙。柔和的金色路灯与从宇宙雨伞中散发出的冷蓝色、紫色、青色和洋红色光芒完美融合，在现实与太空之间创造出一种奇妙的和谐。

在她周围，历史悠久的欧洲建筑、鲜花盛开的阳台、复古咖啡馆和发光的窗户营造出一种永恒的氛围。几只好奇的鸟儿在伞内的宇宙天空中飞翔，轻柔的薄雾在街道上飘荡。雨势保持着轻柔优雅，闪烁的雨滴悬浮在空中。湿润的地面上布满了丰富的倒影，增强了梦幻般的灯光效果。

构图应给人以宁静、感性、不可思议却又完全真实的感觉。超写实、电影级杰作、不可能的现实主义、体积光、耶稣光、大气透视、超精细纹理、HDR、8K、虚幻引擎画质、获奖奇幻摄影、魔幻现实主义、《国家地理》与奇幻电影的结合、戏剧性的色彩对比、无文字、无 Logo、无水印、垂直 4:5 构图。

en.title: Trendy Lifestyle Magazine Cover
en.description: A lifestyle magazine cover prompt featuring a stylish Korean woman in a sage green outfit holding a Stanley tumbler, set in a college campus autumn scene.

Ultra-realistic vibrant lifestyle magazine cover featuring a trendy {argument name="ethnicity" default="Korean"} woman in a coordinated Stanley-brand colorway outfit — matching {argument name="outfit color" default="sage green"} oversized hoodie and joggers — holding a Stanley Quencher H2.0 tumbler in both hands mid-sip, straw at lips, laughing eyes. zh.title: 韩国女性 Stanley Tumbler 杂志封面
zh.description: 一个超写实的时尚生活杂志封面提示词，描绘了一位在大学校园里手持品牌保温杯的女性，采用 Z 世代审美风格。
zh.prompt:
超写实且充满活力的时尚生活杂志封面，主角是一位潮流 {argument name="subject" default="韩国女性"}，身穿与 Stanley 品牌配色协调的服装 —— 搭配 {argument name="outfit" default="鼠尾草绿廓形连帽衫和慢跑裤"} —— 双手捧着 Stanley Quencher H2.0 保温杯，正准备饮用，吸管触碰嘴唇，笑眼盈盈。皮肤水润清透，精致的 Z 世代极简妆容，透明唇彩。扎着哪吒头，脸颊两侧留有修饰发丝。背景：{argument name="background" default="明亮的大学校园户外广场"} —— 温暖的金色秋叶虚化效果，充满校园活力。"EATER" 刊头采用醒目的现代无衬线字体，并带有 "HYDRATION NATION ISSUE" 标题。35mm 镜头，超细节的 Stanley 保温杯凹槽纹理和手柄细节，8K 照片级写实生活风格。

en.title: Consistent Character and Chibi Wall Art
en.description: A complex prompt for maintaining character identity while creating a realistic portrait standing next to a hand-drawn chibi illustration version on a wall.
en.prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity and outfit reference.

Preserve the reference character’s:
- face identity
- facial proportions
- eye shape
- nose
- lips
- skin tone
- hairstyle
- hair color
- visible hair accessories
- overall recognizable vibe
- outfit and styling shown in the reference image

Do not hardcode any specific character traits that are not present in the uploaded reference.
All identity, hairstyle, accessories, clothing, colors, and styling details must be inferred directly from the uploaded reference image.

Create a high-quality mixed-style vertical portrait showing:
1. a realistic full-body version of the uploaded character/person
2. a cute colorful 2D chibi illustration version of the same character/person drawn on the wall beside them

Core concept:
The real person is posing cutely beside a large colorful chibi wall illustration of themselves.
The real person and the illustrated chibi version are doing a similar playful pose together.
The chibi illustration should look like a cute hand-drawn anime-style wall art version of the same person, not a separate real person.
The mood should feel cute, playful, bright, trendy, charming, and social-media-friendly.

Main style direction:
This is not a black doodle-shadow concept.
This is a realistic person + colorful cute chibi wall illustration concept.
The wall illustration should look like a polished but hand-drawn 2D anime/chibi drawing placed directly on the wall.

Real person:
- realistic human photography
- full-body or nearly full-body framing
- same recognizable identity as the uploaded reference
- same outfit style and key visible details from the uploaded reference
- natural photogenic pose
- cute, playful, slightly shy, or mischievous expression
- the person should actively perform a cute pose that matches the wall illustration
- do not make the person stand stiffly
- do not replace the outfit with unrelated fashion

Real person pose:
Choose one cute playful pose that works well beside a wall illustration:
- both hands near cheeks like cute paws
- one leg lifted slightly
- playful idol-like pose
- shy but cute pose
- tiny heart gesture
- playful bounce pose
- leaning slightly with a sweet smile
- cute “nyan” pose with hands curled near the face
- soft jump-like pose while still realistic and balanced

The pose should feel natural for the real person, not exaggerated or physically awkward.

Chibi wall illustration:
- the illustration must be a cute colorful 2D chibi version of the same uploaded person
- it should be drawn directly on the wall beside the real person
- not a realistic second person
- not a 3D character
- not a black shadow
- not a simple stick figure
- not a random anime character
- not a separate unrelated girl
- it should clearly resemble the real person through hairstyle silhouette, hair color, accessories, outfit silhouette, color palette, and overall vibe
- use large expressive eyes, rounded cute face, small body proportions, and soft anime-style coloring
- the chibi should perform a more exaggerated cute version of the real person’s pose
- the chibi may look like it is happily jumping, posing, or floating slightly as part of the wall illustration

Wall illustration details:
- soft clean linework
- warm pastel colors
- cute anime/chibi rendering
- light hand-drawn texture
- subtle shading
- charming expressive face
- same outfit impression as the real person
- same hairstyle and accessory cues if visible in the reference
- playful motion lines around the chibi
- small hearts, stars, sparkles, soft doodle accents, or tiny decorative marks around the illustration

Interaction:
The real person and the chibi illustration should feel connected.
They should share the same pose idea, but not match perfectly.
The real person performs a realistic cute pose.
The chibi performs a more exaggerated, adorable, anime-like version.
The connection must be instantly readable, like a fun photo taken beside a personalized wall illustration.

Composition:
- vertical 4:5 or 9:16
- simple clean indoor wall
- real person on one side
- colorful chibi wall illustration on the other side
- both figures visible in full-body or nearly full-body framing
- chibi illustration roughly similar height to the real person or slightly larger
- enough negative space around both figures
- keep the wall illustration fully visible
- avoid cropping the real person’s feet or the chibi’s body

Background:
- clean white, cream, pale beige, or light gray wall
- simple floor
- minimal indoor studio or clean room setting
- soft natural light
- uncluttered background
- no TikTok UI, no social media interface, no text overlay

Lighting:
- soft natural studio lighting
- bright, clean, warm, and flattering
- realistic shadow under the real person
- wall illustration should look naturally placed on the wall
- no harsh shadows
- no dramatic dark lighting

Style quality:
- realistic human photography
- colorful 2D chibi wall illustration
- cute anime-style wall art
- strong identity resemblance
- outfit and styling faithfully based on the uploaded reference
- playful matching pose
- soft pastel mood
- social-media-friendly
- clean composition
- high detail
- no obvious AI artifacts

Negative prompt:
black doodle shadow, black line-art only, normal shadow, realistic second person, 3D character, random anime girl, unrelated chibi, weak resemblance, different hairstyle, different outfit, outfit change unrelated to reference, hardcoded traits not in reference, messy wall, cluttered background, TikTok UI, social media interface, text, caption, handwritten text, watermark, logo, cropped feet, cropped chibi, stiff pose, boring standing pose, aggressive pose, horror mood, creepy illustration, distorted body, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad hands, bad anatomy, pasted face, frozen expression, overly artificial AI face

zh.title: 保持角色一致性与 Q 版墙绘艺术

- 眼睛形状
- 鼻子
- 嘴唇
- 肤色
- 发型
- 发色
- 可见的头发饰品

不要硬编码任何未出现在上传参考图中的特定角色特征。

创作一幅高质量的混合风格竖版肖像，展示：
1. 上传角色/人物的写实全身版本
2. 墙上绘制的与该角色/人物相同的可爱彩色 2D Q 版插画版本

核心概念：
真人正俏皮地站在自己巨大的彩色 Q 版墙绘旁。
真人与 Q 版插画角色正在一起摆出相似的俏皮姿势。
Q 版插画应看起来像是墙上可爱的手绘动漫风格艺术作品，而不是另一个真人。
氛围应显得可爱、俏皮、明亮、时尚、迷人且适合社交媒体分享。

主要风格方向：
这不是黑色涂鸦阴影概念。
这是一个“写实人物 + 彩色可爱 Q 版墙绘”的概念。
墙绘应看起来像是直接绘制在墙上的精致手绘 2D 动漫/Q 版画作。

真人：
- 写实人像摄影
- 全身或近全身构图
- 与上传参考图具有相同的辨识度
- 与上传参考图相同的服装风格及关键可见细节
- 自然且上镜的姿势
- 可爱、俏皮、略带羞涩或调皮的表情
- 人物应积极摆出与墙绘相呼应的可爱姿势
- 不要让人物站得僵硬
- 不要将服装替换为无关的时尚款式

真人姿势：
选择一个适合在墙绘旁展示的可爱俏皮姿势：
- 双手靠近脸颊，像可爱的爪子一样
- 一条腿微微抬起
- 俏皮的偶像式姿势
- 害羞但可爱的姿势
- 比心手势
- 俏皮的跳跃姿势
- 微微倾斜身体，带着甜美的微笑
- 双手在脸旁蜷缩的可爱“喵”姿势
- 轻柔的跳跃式姿势，同时保持写实与平衡

姿势应让真人感觉自然，不要过度夸张或显得身体僵硬。

Q 版墙绘：
- 插画必须是上传人物的可爱彩色 2D Q 版版本
- 它应直接绘制在真人旁边的墙上
- 不是写实的第二个人
- 不是 3D 角色
- 不是黑色阴影
- 不是简单的火柴人
- 不是随机的动漫角色
- 不是无关的女孩
- 它应通过发型轮廓、发色、配饰、服装轮廓、色调和整体氛围清晰地呈现出该人物的特征
- 使用大而有神的眼睛、圆润可爱的脸庞、小巧的身体比例和柔和的动漫风格上色
- Q 版角色应摆出比真人更夸张的可爱姿势
- Q 版角色看起来可以像是正在快乐地跳跃、摆姿势或作为墙绘的一部分微微漂浮

墙绘细节：
- 柔和干净的线条
- 温暖的柔和色调
- 可爱的动漫/Q 版渲染
- 轻微的手绘质感
- 细腻的阴影
- 迷人且富有表情的脸庞
- 与真人相同的服装印象
- 若参考图中可见，需包含相同的发型和配饰线索
- Q 版角色周围有俏皮的动态线条
- 插画周围有小爱心、星星、闪光、柔和的涂鸦点缀或微小的装饰符号

互动感：
真人与 Q 版插画之间应有连接感。
他们应共享同一个姿势构思，但不必完全一致。
真人摆出写实的可爱姿势。
Q 版角色摆出更夸张、更可爱、更像动漫的版本。
这种连接必须一眼就能看出来，就像在个性化墙绘旁拍摄的有趣照片一样。

构图：
- 竖版 4:5 或 9:16
- 简洁干净的室内墙面
- 一侧为真人
- 另一侧为彩色 Q 版墙绘
- 两个形象均以全身或近全身构图呈现
- Q 版插画的高度与真人大致相当或略大
- 两个形象周围留有足够的负空间
- 保持墙绘完整可见
- 避免裁剪掉真人的脚或 Q 版角色的身体

背景：
- 干净的白色、奶油色、浅米色或浅灰色墙面
- 简单的地板
- 极简的室内摄影棚或干净的房间环境
- 柔和的自然光
- 无杂物的背景
- 无 TikTok UI、无社交媒体界面、无文字遮盖

光影：
- 柔和的自然摄影棚灯光
- 明亮、干净、温暖且修饰肤色
- 真人下方有写实的阴影
- 墙绘应看起来自然地置于墙面上
- 无强烈的硬阴影
- 无戏剧性的暗光

风格质量：
- 写实人像摄影
- 彩色 2D Q 版墙绘
- 可爱的动漫风格墙面艺术
- 极高的身份辨识度
- 服装和造型忠实于上传的参考图
- 俏皮的匹配姿势
- 柔和的粉彩色调
