Match the exact facial structure, forehead, eyebrows, eye shape and spacing, eyelashes, nose shape and proportions, lips, smile, jawline, chin, ears, skin tone, skin texture, facial proportions, and every unique facial characteristic. Do not beautify, redesign, stylize, or generate a different person. Only change the hairstyle—do not use the hairstyle from the reference image. Give her a {argument name="hairstyle" default="natural medium-length soft wavy hairstyle with gentle volume and loose strands framing the face"}. Keep the {argument name="outfit color" default="sky-yellow"} outfit with a matching cap. Full-body pose with one hand touching the cap brim. Ultra-photorealistic DSLR image, natural lighting, realistic skin pores, editorial fashion photography, warm sunlight casting diagonal shadows on a light-colored wall, {argument name="flower type" default="blooming pink and white flowers"}, shallow depth of field, RAW, 8K, true human appearance, no anime, no stylization, exact same person.

zh.title: 保持面部特征的时尚肖像
zh.description: 一个高保真提示词，用于在改变发型和服装的同时，在阳光明媚的编辑摄影场景中重现特定人物的面部。
zh.prompt: 使用上传的面部参考图作为确切的身份依据。以最大程度的身份保持力重现同一个人。面部必须保持不变且一眼即可辨认。匹配确切的面部结构、前额、眉毛、眼睛形状和间距、睫毛、鼻子形状和比例、嘴唇、微笑、下颌线、下巴、耳朵、肤色、皮肤纹理、面部比例以及每一个独特的面部特征。请勿美化、重新设计、风格化或生成不同的人。仅更改发型——不要使用参考图中的发型。为她设置 {argument name="hairstyle" default="自然中长款柔和波浪发型，带有轻盈的蓬松感，发丝自然垂落在脸颊两侧"}。保持 {argument name="outfit color" default="天黄色"} 的服装及配套帽子。全身姿势，一只手轻触帽檐。超写实 DSLR 图像，自然光，逼真的皮肤毛孔，时尚编辑摄影，温暖的阳光在浅色墙壁上投下斜影，{argument name="flower type" default="盛开的粉白色花朵"}，浅景深，RAW，8K，真实人物外观，无动漫感，无风格化，确保是同一个人。

en.title: Minimalist Doodle Illustration
en.description: Converts any photo into a charming, hand-drawn doodle with imperfect brush-pen outlines and a playful sketchbook aesthetic.
en.prompt:
Transform the image into a {argument name="art style" default="minimalist hand-drawn doodle illustration"}. Use {argument name="outlines" default="simple black brush-pen outlines with slightly wobbly, imperfect strokes"}. Reduce all details to cute, childlike shapes while preserving the main subject and composition. 

Naive sketchbook aesthetic, playful and whimsical character design, clean white background, minimal linework, expressive simplicity, handmade doodle style, black ink drawing, charming imperfections, simple cartoon illustration. Format 3:4.

zh.title: 极简涂鸦插画
zh.description: 将任何照片转换为迷人的手绘涂鸦，呈现出不完美的毛笔勾线和俏皮的速写本美学。
zh.prompt:
将图像转换为 {argument name="art style" default="极简手绘涂鸦插画"}。使用 {argument name="outlines" default="带有轻微抖动、不完美笔触的简约黑色毛笔勾线"}。在保留主体和构图的同时，将所有细节简化为可爱、稚拙的形状。

天真的速写本美学，俏皮且异想天开的角色设计，干净的白色背景，极简线条，富有表现力的简洁感，手工涂鸦风格，黑色墨水画，迷人的不完美感，简单的卡通插画。比例 3:4。

en.title: Alternative Character Graphic Illustration
en.description: A stylized 2D illustration prompt featuring unique character features, thick ink contours, and a worn-paper texture.
en.prompt: Two-dimensional alternative character illustration of {argument name="character" default="the subject"}, occupying approximately seventy-five percent of the frame in {argument name="pose" default="a dynamic stance"}, with [HAIR] and [EXPRESSION]. Oversized rounded cranium, a short flattened lower face, a narrow jaw, a long thin neck, slightly oversized ears, huge pale oval eyes with tiny off-center pupils, extremely thick horizontal black eyebrows, heavy black upper eyelids, muted mauve under-eye rings, a tiny broad triangular nose, and a wide asymmetrical grin showing individually drawn irregular rectangular teeth, one clearly missing upper tooth, one chipped tooth and deep black gaps. Dress the character in {argument name="clothing" default="simplified graphic clothing"}, simplified into broad graphic shapes with chunky seams, minimal folds and small hand-drawn accessories. Confident black ink contours using thick outer silhouettes, medium-weight facial lines, thin angular hair strands and only a few short scratch marks around the eyes, hair and clothing seams; use flat opaque color fields, one hard-edged cel-shadow shape per form, sparse pencil hatching, subtle ink wobble, slight color misregistration and restrained worn-paper texture. Controlled [COLORS] palette, keeping every color clearly separated and moderately saturated. Place the character against [BACKGROUND], reduced to large flat shapes, a few loosely drawn environmental details and oversized rough hand-painted lettering reading “[TEXT]”; use an off-center waist-up composition, a slight camera tilt, cropped background typography, loose poster margins and lightly weathered printed edges. 4:5 AR.

zh.title: 另类角色图形插画
zh.description: 一种风格化的 2D 插画提示词，具有独特的角色特征、粗犷的墨水轮廓和磨损的纸张纹理。
zh.prompt: 关于 {argument name="character" default="主体"} 的二维另类角色插画，占据画面约 75% 的空间，呈现 {argument name="pose" default="动态姿势"}，带有 [HAIR] 和 [EXPRESSION]。超大的圆形颅骨、短而扁平的下半脸、窄下巴、细长脖子、略大的耳朵、巨大的苍白椭圆形眼睛配以微小的偏心瞳孔、极粗的水平黑色眉毛、厚重的黑色上眼睑、柔和的紫红色眼圈、微小宽阔的三角形鼻子，以及宽大且不对称的露齿笑，展示出单独绘制的不规则矩形牙齿，其中一颗上牙明显缺失，一颗牙齿有缺口，并有深黑色的牙缝。为角色穿上 {argument name="clothing" default="简约图形服装"}，简化为宽大的图形形状，带有厚实的接缝、极少的褶皱和少量手绘配饰。使用自信的黑色墨水轮廓，包括粗犷的外轮廓、中等重量的面部线条、细长且有棱角的发丝，以及在眼睛、头发和服装接缝周围仅有的几处短划痕；使用平坦的不透明色块、每个形状仅一个硬边缘的赛璐珞阴影、稀疏的铅笔排线、细微的墨水抖动、轻微的色彩套印偏差以及克制的磨损纸张纹理。受控的 [COLORS] 色调，保持每种颜色清晰分离且饱和度适中。将角色置于 [BACKGROUND] 前，背景简化为大面积的平坦形状、少量随意绘制的环境细节以及超大的粗糙手绘文字 “[TEXT]”；采用偏心的半身构图、轻微的镜头倾斜、被裁剪的背景排版、宽松的海报页边距和轻微风化的印刷边缘。4:5 纵横比。

en.title: South Asian Woman Indoor Selfie
en.description: A realistic portrait prompt for gpt-image-2 that uses a reference image for facial identity while generating a new hairstyle and traditional South Asian attire in a cozy indoor setting.
en.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as the ONLY face reference and preserve 100% exact facial identity, including the face shape, skin tone, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, facial proportions, expression, smile, age, and all unique facial features. Do not copy or reference the hairstyle, hairline, or hair volume from the uploaded image. Generate the hairstyle exactly as described below, independent of the reference image.

Create an ultra-realistic indoor selfie of the same young woman sitting at a wooden desk in warm ambient lighting. She has {argument name="hair style" default="long, wavy dark brown hair"} with a middle part and loose strands framing her face. She wears large thin gold-rimmed round glasses, soft natural makeup with glossy pink lips, gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace with a star pendant. On her wrist, she wears a gold watch paired with a charm bracelet.

She is dressed in a {argument name="outfit" default="cream/off-white kurta featuring elegant blue floral prints"}, lace trim along the neckline, and pearl buttons. A matching sheer blue-and-white floral dupatta is gracefully draped over one shoulder.

She is posing naturally with one hand gently raised to her hair, while a spiral notebook rests on the wooden desk in front of her.

The background features a {argument name="setting" default="cozy room with a window ledge"} holding a small green potted plant, a white board/wall decorated with pinned travel photos, and dark wooden cabinetry, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

Capture the scene with warm indoor lighting, a candid lifestyle aesthetic, photorealistic quality, ultra-detailed realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, natural color grading, and 8K resolution. The final image must maintain perfect facial identity consistency with the uploaded reference while using only the newly described hairstyle, not the hairstyle from the uploaded image.

zh.title: 南亚女性室内自拍
zh.description: 这是一个用于 gpt-image-2 的写实肖像提示词，利用参考图进行面部特征识别，同时生成全新的发型和传统的南亚服饰，营造舒适的室内环境。
zh.prompt:
请仅使用上传的参考图作为面部参考，并 100% 保留其面部特征，包括脸型、肤色、眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇、下颌线、面部比例、表情、笑容、年龄以及所有独特的面部特征。请勿复制或参考上传图片中的发型、发际线或发量。请严格按照下文描述生成发型，使其独立于参考图。

创作一张超写实的室内自拍，画面中的年轻女性正坐在木质书桌前，环境光线温暖。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="长款波浪深棕色秀发"}，中分发型，几缕发丝自然垂落在脸颊两侧。她戴着大号细金框圆眼镜，妆容自然清新，涂着亮面粉色唇釉，佩戴金质圆圈耳环和一条带有星星吊坠的精致金项链。手腕上佩戴着一块金表，并搭配了一条串珠手链。

她身穿一件 {argument name="outfit" default="米色/灰白色库尔塔（kurta），饰有优雅的蓝色花卉印花"}，领口处有蕾丝装饰，并配有珍珠纽扣。一条相衬的蓝白花卉薄纱披肩（dupatta）优雅地搭在肩上。

她姿态自然，一只手轻轻抬起触碰头发，面前的木桌上放着一本螺旋笔记本。

背景设定为 {argument name="setting" default="带有窗台的温馨房间"}，窗台上摆放着一盆绿色小盆栽；背景中的白色项目墙上装饰着钉好的旅行照片，并配有深色木质橱柜，营造出温暖舒适的氛围。

画面需采用温暖的室内光线，呈现自然的生活化美感，具备照片级真实画质、超细腻的真实皮肤纹理、浅景深效果、自然的色彩分级以及 8K 分辨率。最终生成的图像必须与上传的参考图保持完美的面部特征一致性，同时仅使用新描述的发型，而非参考图中的发型。

en.title: Cinematic Coffee Campaign Collage
en.description: A complex luxury advertising campaign prompt featuring a 2x2 grid collage of four distinct coffee themes and miniature worlds.
en.prompt:
Ultra-realistic cinematic commercial advertising poster featuring the {argument name="subject" default="same confident young man"} appearing across four premium coffee brand-inspired posters arranged in a {argument name="grid layout" default="clean 2×2 grid collage"}. Each panel has its own unique color palette, {argument name="typography style" default="oversized bold typography"}, and fantasy world emerging from a coffee cup while maintaining a cohesive luxury advertising aesthetic.

Top Left – Green Nature Theme: The man confidently extends a branded coffee cup toward the camera using dramatic forced perspective. From the cup grows a lush miniature forest with towering pine trees, rocky cliffs, cascading waterfalls, mist, floating leaves, and magical sunlight. Deep emerald-green background with oversized bold typography behind the subject. Luxury eco-premium coffee campaign style.

Top Right – Urban City Theme: The man holds a red coffee cup toward the viewer while a futuristic metropolitan skyline emerges from the cup. Roads transform into flowing coffee streams with cinematic traffic, glowing skyscrapers, dramatic clouds, volumetric smoke, golden-hour lighting, and warm amber tones. Bold oversized typography in the background with premium editorial branding.

Bottom Left – Cozy Winter Theme: The man presents a coffee cup that opens into a warm wooden cabin with glowing fireplaces, snow-covered pine forests, warm interior lighting, soft snowfall, floating steam, and cozy cinematic atmosphere. Earthy beige and brown color palette with nostalgic premium coffee branding and elegant typography.

Bottom Right – Energy Explosion Theme: The man dynamically leaps beside a coffee cup bursting with colorful coffee splashes, donuts, sprinkles, planets, swirling liquid, glowing particles, neon energy trails, and vibrant orange-pink gradients. Bold oversized typography fills the background, creating a youthful, energetic campaign with playful motion and excitement.

The same man appears in every panel with short textured black hair, neatly trimmed beard and mustache, warm brown eyes, friendly confident smile, wearing outfits matching each theme. Each coffee cup is held close to the lens for a dramatic forced-perspective effect, making the cup appear oversized.

Design style: premium global advertising campaign, magazine cover quality, luxury branding, photorealistic fantasy compositing, cinematic storytelling, surreal miniature worlds, hyper-detailed textures, HDR, volumetric lighting, atmospheric fog, realistic reflections, depth of field, sharp focus, vibrant color grading, professional product photography, Adobe Photoshop compositing, Octane Render, Unreal Engine, 8K ultra-HD, award-winning commercial poster, clean modern layout, bold typography, premium editorial finish.

zh.title: 电影感咖啡广告拼贴画
zh.description: 一个复杂的奢华广告宣传提示词，包含四个不同咖啡主题和微缩世界的 2x2 网格拼贴画。
zh.prompt:
超写实电影感商业广告海报，展示了 {argument name="subject" default="同一位自信的年轻人"} 出现在四个受高端咖啡品牌启发的拼贴海报中，并以 {argument name="grid layout" default="整洁的 2×2 网格拼贴"} 排列。每个面板都有其独特的配色方案、{argument name="typography style" default="超大粗体排版"} 以及从咖啡杯中浮现的奇幻世界，同时保持了统一的奢华广告美学。

左上角 – 绿色自然主题：男子自信地将印有品牌的咖啡杯伸向镜头，运用了戏剧性的强制透视手法。杯中生长出一片郁郁葱葱的微缩森林，有高耸的松树、岩石峭壁、层叠的瀑布、薄雾、漂浮的叶片和梦幻般的阳光。深翡翠绿色背景，主体后方配有超大粗体排版。奢华生态高端咖啡广告风格。

右上角 – 都市城市主题：男子向观众展示红色的咖啡杯，杯中浮现出未来派的都市天际线。道路转化为流动的咖啡溪流，伴有电影感的车流、发光的摩天大楼、戏剧性的云层、体积烟雾、黄金时刻的灯光和温暖的琥珀色调。背景为大胆的超大排版，带有高端编辑品牌风格。

左下角 – 舒适冬季主题：男子展示的咖啡杯中呈现出一间温暖的木屋，有发光的壁炉、白雪覆盖的松林、温暖的室内灯光、柔和的降雪、漂浮的蒸汽和舒适的电影氛围。大地色系的米色和棕色调，带有怀旧的高端咖啡品牌感和优雅的排版。

右下角 – 能量爆发主题：男子在咖啡杯旁动态跳跃，杯中喷涌出色彩缤纷的咖啡溅射、甜甜圈、糖针、行星、旋转的液体、发光的粒子、霓虹能量轨迹和充满活力的橙粉色渐变。大胆的超大排版填满背景，营造出充满活力、动感十足且令人兴奋的年轻化广告风格。

同一名男子出现在每个面板中，留着短而有质感的黑发，修剪整齐的胡须，温暖的棕色眼睛，自信友好的微笑，穿着与每个主题相匹配的服装。每个咖啡杯都靠近镜头，以产生戏剧性的强制透视效果，使杯子看起来超大。

设计风格：高端全球广告宣传、杂志封面质量、奢华品牌、照片级真实感奇幻合成、电影叙事、超现实微缩世界、超精细纹理、HDR、体积光、大气雾、逼真的反射、景深、清晰对焦、充满活力的色彩分级、专业产品摄影、Adobe Photoshop 合成、Octane Render、Unreal Engine、8K 超高清、获奖商业海报、简洁现代布局、大胆排版、高端编辑质感。

en.title: Moody Salt Flat Fashion Film Still
en.description: A moody film-still style prompt for gpt-image-2 featuring an East Asian woman in a leather corset on a salt flat, inspired by diaristic photography.
en.prompt: A stunning mid-20s {argument name="ethnicity" default="Japanese or Korean"} woman wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="structured leather corset outfit"}, standing with a one-leg weight shift and relaxed asymmetrical body balance; her head is turned into a three-quarter side profile facing out of the frame, set in a {argument name="location" default="white salt flat playa edge"} with cracked salt crust ground under a harsh midday environment with hard direct sunlight on the subject, captured as a moody film still inspired by Nobuyoshi Araki, featuring raw intimate diaristic imagery, macro close-focus detail, a 1/250s handheld shutter look, lens-only mist-filter haze, and a neon-tinted Japanese portrait color grade with protected bright skin tones.

zh.title: 情绪感盐湖时尚电影剧照
zh.description: 这是一个为 gpt-image-2 设计的情绪感电影剧照风格提示词，画面主体为一位身着皮质束胸的东亚女性，背景设定在盐湖，灵感源自日记体摄影。
zh.prompt: 一位令人惊艳的 20 多岁 {argument name="ethnicity" default="日本或韩国"} 女性，身着 {argument name="outfit" default="结构感皮质束胸套装"}，单腿重心偏移，身体姿态呈现出放松的不对称平衡感；她转头呈四分之三侧面，视线看向画框外，背景设定在 {argument name="location" default="白色盐湖滩边缘"}，地面为龟裂的盐壳，正午强烈的直射光照在主体上，呈现出受荒木经惟启发的电影剧照质感，具有原始、私密的日记体影像风格，微距特写细节，1/250 秒手持快门感，镜头自带柔光滤镜雾感，以及带有霓虹色调的日式人像调色，并保留了明亮的肤色。

en.title: Silk Camisole Lingerie Poster
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating high-end, realistic lingerie posters featuring silk camisoles with morning light and luxury bedroom aesthetics.
en.prompt:
High-end realistic female lingerie poster with a {argument name="theme" default="silk camisole"} theme. A young adult female model sits by a {argument name="setting" default="morning bedroom window"}, wearing an {argument name="color" default="ivory white"} silk camisole with matching shorts or trousers. The fabric features delicate silk luster and natural drape, with thin straps, chest lines, and hem flowing gently. The model has one hand lightly supporting the side of her knee and the other hand gathering her hair. The overall vibe is gentle, homey, and luxury, resembling a high-end sleepwear and loungewear advertisement. Features realistic silk surface reflections, authentic skin texture, and natural morning light layers. Portrait 3:4.

Poster text content:
Brand Name: Silken Rest
Product Name: Silk Camisole
English Subtitle: SILK CAMISOLE
Slogan: Let the night become soft starting from the skin first
Short Labels: Silk shimmer / Lightweight skin-hugging feel

Layout requirements: The brand name is placed in the top blank area, the product name as the main title is in the lower-middle part, and the English subtitle and short labels are at the bottom, avoiding covering the shoulder straps and highlights on the chest line.

zh.title: 真丝吊带睡衣海报
zh.description: 一份用于创作高端写实风格睡衣海报的详细提示词，包含真丝吊带、晨光氛围及奢华卧室美学。
zh.prompt:
高端写实风格女性睡衣海报，主题为 {argument name="theme" default="真丝吊带"}。一位年轻女性模特坐在 {argument name="setting" default="清晨的卧室窗边"}，身穿 {argument name="color" default="象牙白"} 真丝吊带及配套短裤或长裤。面料呈现细腻的真丝光泽与自然垂坠感，细肩带、胸部线条及下摆轻盈流动。模特一只手轻托膝盖侧面，另一只手整理头发。整体氛围温柔、居家且奢华，类似于高端睡衣与家居服广告。具备逼真的丝绸表面反光、真实的皮肤质感以及自然的清晨光影层次。比例 3:4。

海报文字内容：
品牌名称：Silken Rest
产品名称：Silk Camisole
英文副标题：SILK CAMISOLE
标语：让夜晚从亲肤开始变得柔软
短标签：丝绸微光 / 轻盈亲肤感

排版要求：品牌名称置于顶部留白处，产品名称作为主标题置于中下部，英文副标题和短标签置于底部，避免遮挡肩带及胸部线条的高光区域。

en.title: Natural Couple Interaction Snapshot
en.description: An advanced image-to-image prompt to generate a natural, candid-style interaction between a couple in a dessert shop while maintaining character consistency.
en.prompt:
Vertical 3:4, a single authentic mobile phone lifestyle snapshot, no collages, no grids, no text, no watermarks.

Refer only to the {argument name="female features" default="Asian female's facial features, face shape, long straight black hair, natural skin texture"} and overall temperament from the uploaded image to maintain consistency in appearance. Reconstruct a two-person interaction scene in a dessert shop, not copying the single-person pose from the original.

A young adult Asian male and female are sitting at a window seat in a quiet, cozy dessert shop, both clearly visible. The woman is in a light brown sofa chair by the window, wearing a {argument name="female outfit" default="light grey-brown sleeveless knit maxi dress"}, with her long straight black hair naturally over her shoulders, body slightly turned toward the man, looking happy yet slightly shy.

The man sits next to or diagonally across from her, wearing a clean, simple light-colored short-sleeved shirt or white T-shirt, with short black hair and a fresh appearance—no celebrity faces and not overshadowing the woman. He holds a dessert cup in one hand and a small spoon in the other, naturally offering a bite of {argument name="dessert type" default="light green ice cream"} to the woman's mouth.

The woman leans forward slightly, opening her mouth to eat the ice cream, looking at the man with smiling eyes or briefly at the camera, capturing a natural moment as if suddenly snapped by a friend. The man looks at her sideways with a gentle, relaxed expression and a natural smile. Their movements should show a genuine interactive relationship with natural distance, not stiff posing.

On the table, there can be tissues, another dessert, and a mobile phone, retaining real-life dessert shop details. The background features a wooden tabletop, light-colored walls, frosted glass windows, and warm brown seating, with soft natural light coming through the window mixing with warm indoor lighting.

Shot with a phone at close range, with a casual snapshot composition, lens height close to eye level. The woman is the main visual focus, the man's face and upper body are fully visible, and the relationship between their hands, spoon, and dessert cup is clear and accurate. Realistic skin texture, fine pores, natural stray hairs, and authentic clothing wrinkles, no excessive skin smoothing. The overall atmosphere is relaxed, sweet, and lifelike, like a moment caught by a friend during a date, avoiding a wedding photo or commercial ad feel.

## Negative Prompt

Do not have only the man's hand in frame, do not crop out the man's face, no third person, woman should not be holding the spoon herself, spoon should not be floating, spoon should not pass through the mouth, no finger deformities, no extra arms, no shared hands, no facial distortion, no excessive mouth opening, no exaggerated intimate actions, no kissing, no studio-posed feel, no fake smiles, no plastic skin, no excessive skin smoothing, no anime feel, no cluttered background, no garbled text on dessert cups.

zh.title: 自然情侣互动快照
zh.description: 一个高级的图生图提示词，用于在甜品店生成情侣间自然、抓拍风格的互动场景，同时保持角色一致性。
zh.prompt:
竖构图 3:4，单张真实的手机生活快照，无拼图，无网格，无文字，无水印。

仅参考上传图片中的 {argument name="female features" default="亚裔女性面部特征、脸型、长直黑发、自然皮肤纹理"} 以及整体气质，以保持外观一致性。重构一个甜品店内的双人互动场景，不要照搬原图的单人姿势。

一位年轻的亚裔男性和女性坐在一间安静、舒适的甜品店靠窗位置，两人均清晰可见。女性坐在窗边的浅棕色沙发椅上，身穿 {argument name="female outfit" default="浅灰棕色无袖针织长裙"}，长直黑发自然垂在肩上，身体微微转向男性，看起来既开心又略带羞涩。

男性坐在她旁边或斜对面，穿着干净、简约的浅色短袖衬衫或白色 T 恤，留着黑色短发，外表清爽——不要使用明星脸，也不要抢了女性的风头。他一手拿着甜品杯，另一只手拿着小勺子，自然地将 {argument name="dessert type" default="浅绿色冰淇淋"} 喂到女性嘴边。

女性微微前倾，张嘴吃冰淇淋，眼神含笑看着男性或短暂看向镜头，捕捉仿佛被朋友随手抓拍的自然瞬间。男性侧头看着她，表情温柔放松，面带自然微笑。他们的动作应展现出真实的互动关系，保持自然的距离感，不要僵硬摆拍。

桌上可以有纸巾、另一份甜品和手机，保留真实的甜品店细节。背景包括木质桌面、浅色墙壁、磨砂玻璃窗和暖棕色座椅，窗外透进的柔和自然光与室内暖光交织。

使用手机近距离拍摄，采用随意的快照构图，镜头高度接近视平线。女性是主要的视觉焦点，男性的脸部和上半身完全可见，手部、勺子和甜品杯之间的关系清晰准确。呈现真实的皮肤纹理、细微毛孔、自然的碎发和真实的衣物褶皱，不要过度磨皮。整体氛围轻松、甜蜜且逼真，就像约会时被朋友捕捉到的瞬间，避免婚纱照或商业广告的感觉。

## 反向提示词 (Negative Prompt)

画面中不能只有男性的手，不能裁掉男性的脸，没有第三者，女性不应自己拿着勺子，勺子不能悬空，勺子不能穿过嘴部，没有手指畸形，没有多余的手臂，没有共享的手部，没有面部扭曲，没有过度张嘴，没有夸张的亲密动作，没有接吻，没有影棚摆拍感，没有虚假的笑容，没有塑料质感的皮肤，没有过度磨皮，没有动漫感，背景不杂乱，甜品杯上没有乱码文字。

en.title: Sustainable Material Workshop Website Hero
en.description: A professional web design prompt for creating a responsive hero section for a circular manufacturing company, focusing on textures and modern workshop aesthetics.
en.prompt: Create a responsive website homepage visual for a corporate site with the theme: 'Telling the story of a manufacturing company that makes {argument name="material type" default="recyclable materials"} as a modern workshop that breathes slowly.' The image is not a traditional industrial site but a horizontal hero section visual: the foreground features neatly cut recyclable material samples, embossed boards, pulp molded parts, and metal fixtures; the middle ground is a translucent data card and brand title; the background is a modern workshop space with controlled lighting. The composition uses a desktop Hero ratio, with an information area on the left, product/material display on the right, and clear navigation spacing at the top, while naturally extending to a mobile hero screen. Lighting is a mix of large-scale skylight and a few warm work lights, highlighting material textures, cross-sectional structures, and brand credibility. The color system must include specific hex codes: Pulp Cream #E9E1D4, Workshop Grey #A9ACA8, Deep Olive Green #66715F, Metallic Grey-Blue #8897A0, Structural Brown #8B7058, Title Charcoal Black #2C2F31. Focus on describing fiber embossing, cut edges, metal fixtures, frosted acrylic, and workshop tabletop scratches. Requires a small amount of Chinese-led text, including the company name, core value proposition, a very short English auxiliary phrase, and two functional labels, with the layout serving the website hierarchy.

zh.title: 可持续材料工坊网站首页 Hero 区设计
zh.description: 一个专业的网页设计提示词，旨在为循环制造企业创建一个响应式 Hero 区，侧重于纹理表现与现代工坊美学。
zh.prompt: 创建一个响应式网站首页视觉图，主题为：“讲述一家制造 {argument name="material type" default="可回收材料"} 的企业故事，将其呈现为一个呼吸感十足的现代工坊。” 该图像并非传统的工业现场，而是一个横向的 Hero 区视觉图：前景展示整齐切割的可回收材料样本、压纹项目、纸浆模塑件及金属固定件；中景为半透明数据卡片与品牌标题；背景为光线可控的现代工坊空间。构图采用桌面端 Hero 比例，左侧为信息区，右侧为产品/材料展示区，顶部留有清晰的导航间距，并能自然适配移动端 Hero 屏幕。灯光结合了大面积天窗光与少量暖色工作灯，突显材料纹理、横截面结构及品牌可信度。配色方案需包含以下十六进制色值：纸浆奶油色 #E9E1D4、工坊灰 #A9ACA8、深橄榄绿 #66715F、金属蓝灰 #8897A0、结构棕 #8B7058、标题炭黑 #2C2F31。重点描述纤维压纹、切割边缘、金属固定件、磨砂亚克力及工坊桌面划痕。需要包含少量中文主导的文字，包括公司名称、核心价值主张、一句极简的英文辅助短语以及两个功能标签，布局需服务于网站的层级结构。

en.title: Character Reference Sheet Layout
en.description: Creates a professional character reference sheet to maintain identity consistency across different angles and expressions using a visual storyboard layout.
en.prompt:
Create a "Fixed Character Identity Reference Sheet" based on the attached original character image, landscape {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:10"}, with a {argument name="background color" default="light gray-white"} background and a professional visual data board layout. The primary goal is to ensure that all panels clearly represent the exact same character at a glance, rather than multiple similar individuals.

Treat the character's identity from the reference image as an unchangeable hard constraint. Strictly lock: face width-to-height ratio, cheekbones, cheeks, jawline, chin, eye contour, eye distance, eyelid structure, gaze, eyebrow arch, thickness, color, eye-brow distance, bridge of the nose, tip, nostrils, profile nose shape, lip thickness, peaks, corners, skin tone, pores, hairline, parting, bangs, hair length, flow, age impression, skeletal structure, shoulder width, limb length, and overall body type, as well as original clothing, art style, and lighting atmosphere.

Use large panels in the center to show: Full body front, side, back; Face front, left profile, right profile, left tilt, right tilt, and back of head. Maintain consistent skull structure, facial feature positions, hair volume, and body proportions. The profile must accurately extend the frontal structures.

Configure a small expression matrix on the right: Normal, Smile, Serious, Surprised, Shy, Thinking, Troubled, Slightly Sad, Calm. Maintain the same pupil and eye base dimensions.

Configure fine identity anchors at the bottom: Left eye, right eye, eyebrows, nose front/side, lips, ears, jawline, skin texture, bangs structure, side hair, back hair, hair tip flow, and hands.

Add 5–7 accurate color samples on the left: hair color, pupil color, skin color, lip color, clothing color, shadow color, and tone. Include minimalist "Fixed Points" like face shape fixed, eye area fixed, etc. The background should be clean with soft even lighting, no cinematic lighting or strong depth of field. Use only {argument name="label language" default="clear Simplified Chinese"} for all labels.

Negative Prompt: Different characters, similar faces but not the same person, identity drift, face swapping between panels, changes in facial proportions or hair, excessive beauty filters, magazine photography lighting, garbled text, watermarks, distorted anatomy, or style transitions.

zh.title: 角色参考图排版
zh.description: 创建一个专业的角色参考图，通过视觉项目布局，确保角色在不同角度和表情下的身份一致性。
zh.prompt:
基于附件中的原始角色图像，创建一个“固定角色身份参考图”，横向比例为 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="16:10"}，背景颜色为 {argument name="background color" default="浅灰白色"}，并采用专业的视觉数据项目布局。主要目标是确保所有面板一眼望去都能清晰体现出完全相同的角色，而不是多个相似的个体。

将参考图像中的角色身份视为不可更改的硬性约束。严格锁定：面部宽高比、颧骨、脸颊、下颌线、下巴、眼廓、眼间距、眼睑结构、视线、眉弓、眉毛厚度、颜色、眉眼间距、鼻梁、鼻尖、鼻孔、侧面鼻型、唇厚、唇峰、嘴角、肤色、毛孔、发际线、发缝、刘海、头发长度、发流、年龄感、骨骼结构、肩宽、肢体长度、整体体型，以及原始服装、艺术风格和光影氛围。

使用中心的大面板展示：全身正面、侧面、背面；面部正面、左侧面、右侧面、左倾斜、右倾斜以及后脑勺。保持一致的颅骨结构、五官位置、发量和身体比例。侧面必须准确延伸正面结构。

在右侧配置一个小型的表情矩阵：正常、微笑、严肃、惊讶、害羞、思考、困扰、微忧、冷静。保持瞳孔和眼部基础尺寸一致。

在底部配置精细的身份锚点：左眼、右眼、眉毛、鼻子正面/侧面、嘴唇、耳朵、下颌线、皮肤纹理、刘海结构、侧发、后发、发梢流向以及手部。

在左侧添加 5–7 个准确的色样：发色、瞳孔色、肤色、唇色、服装色、阴影色和色调。包含极简的“固定点”，如脸型固定、眼部区域固定等。背景应干净且光线柔和均匀，避免电影级布光或强烈的景深效果。所有标签仅使用 {argument name="label language" default="清晰的简体中文"}。

负面提示词：不同的角色、相似但非同一人、身份偏移、面板间换脸、面部比例或头发变化、过度美颜滤镜、杂志摄影光效、乱码文字、水印、解剖结构扭曲或风格突变。

en.title: Lingerie Product Design Proposal
en.description: Generates a detailed multi-view design proposal for lingerie, featuring product shots, model previews, and material close-ups in a structured layout.
en.prompt: Generate a multi-view design proposal for women's lingerie with a single diagonal flowing composition, fully presenting a set of {argument name="color scheme" default="terracotta copper and deep chocolate"} front-buckle halter lingerie. Features: soft-wired half-cup bra with micro-arched cups, bias-cut terracotta copper satin panels, deep chocolate stretch mesh side panels, adjustable halter straps, a bronze-colored rotating buckle at the front center, narrow underband, and low-back structure; paired with low-rise Brazilian panties with an asymmetrical diagonal front, thin side straps, and scalloped back. Abstract lava flow-line embroidery passes from one side of the bra cup through the underband and forms a corresponding curve on the opposite side of the panties. A stepped editorial composition extends from top-left to bottom-right. The largest module in the top-left (approx. 38% of the frame) presents the main product visual on a terracotta metal surface. A large vertical center module shows the fit on a {argument name="model age" default="21-year-old"} adult female model, slightly turning to show the halter straps and low-back silhouette with a mature, sharp demeanor. Diagonal modules include front/back structure views, flat-lay view, macro shots of embroidery and buckles, and material boards for the satin and mesh. All modules are connected by light/dark copper color blocks and thin arcs, sharing consistent design elements and a warm side-lit evening wear photography texture.

zh.title: 内衣产品设计提案
zh.description: 生成一份详细的内衣多视角设计提案，包含产品展示图、模特预览图以及结构化布局中的材质特写。
zh.prompt: 生成一份女性内衣的多视角设计提案，采用单一对角线流动构图，完整呈现一套 {argument name="color scheme" default="赤陶铜色与深巧克力色"} 前扣式挂脖内衣。产品特色：软钢圈半杯文胸，配有微拱形罩杯、斜裁赤陶铜色缎面拼接、深巧克力色弹力网眼侧翼、可调节挂脖肩带、前中心青铜色旋转扣、窄底围及低背结构；搭配低腰巴西式内裤，前片呈不对称斜线剪裁，配有细侧带及扇形后摆。抽象的熔岩流线型刺绣从文胸一侧罩杯延伸至底围，并在内裤对侧形成呼应的曲线。采用从左上角延伸至右下角的阶梯式编辑构图。左上角最大的模块（约占画面 38%）在赤陶金属表面展示产品主视觉。大型垂直中心模块展示 {argument name="model age" default="21 岁"} 成年女性模特上身效果，模特微微转动以展示挂脖肩带和低背轮廓，展现成熟、干练的气质。对角线模块包含正/背面结构视图、平铺视图、刺绣与扣件的微距镜头，以及缎面与网眼的材质项目。所有模块通过浅色/深色铜色色块和细弧线连接，共享统一的设计元素，并呈现出温暖的侧光晚装摄影质感。

en.title: High-End Realistic Peach Canned Food Poster
en.description: Creates professional-grade advertising posters for canned fruit, focusing on realistic textures, reflections, and sophisticated typographic layout.

zh.title: 高端写实风黄桃罐头海报
zh.description: 为水果罐头制作专业级广告海报，专注于写实纹理、光影反射以及精致的排版设计。

en.title: Realistic Countryside Lotus Pond Snapshots
en.description: Designed for realistic, candid lifestyle shots of people walking by a rural lotus pond, mimicking the unpolished look of a modern smartphone camera.
en.prompt: Using the facial features of the people in the reference photos as the sole identity anchor: three adult Asian women (Woman 1 on the left refers to Photos 1, 2, and 3; Woman 2 in the middle refers to Photos 4, 5, and 6; Woman 3 on the right refers to Photos 7, 8, 9, and 10). A {argument name="phone model" default="iPhone 17 Pro"} mobile snapshot without any design sense. Very realistic style, without any artistic processing, no cinematic feel, no influencer filters, no deliberate composition, no photography techniques, restoring the real life record as seen by the naked eye. Three young women strolling by a rural lotus pond. {argument name="outfits" default="The girl on the left is wearing a light green modified qipao skirt. The girl in the middle is wearing a white camisole and jeans. The girl on the right is wearing a light purple floral dress."} The background is a large lotus pond in a Jiangnan village, wooden plank paths, small bridges, and white-walled farmhouses. Natural lighting presents a sense of real-life recording.

zh.title: 写实风格乡村荷塘抓拍
zh.description: 专为乡村荷塘边行人抓拍的写实生活照而设计，模拟现代智能手机拍摄的自然随性效果。
zh.prompt: 以参考照片中人物的面部特征作为唯一的身份锚点：三位成年亚洲女性（左侧的女性 1 参考照片 1、2、3；中间的女性 2 参考照片 4、5、6；右侧的女性 3 参考照片 7、8、9、10）。一张 {argument name="phone model" default="iPhone 17 Pro"} 手机抓拍照片，没有任何设计感。风格非常写实，没有任何艺术加工，没有电影感，没有网红滤镜，没有刻意构图，没有摄影技巧，还原肉眼所见的真实生活记录。三位年轻女性在乡村荷塘边漫步。{argument name="outfits" default="左侧女孩身穿浅绿色改良旗袍裙。中间女孩身穿白色吊带背心搭配牛仔裤。右侧女孩身穿浅紫色碎花连衣裙。"} 背景是江南乡村的大片荷塘、木质栈道、小桥和白墙农舍。自然光呈现出真实的生活记录感。

en.title: High-Fashion Hotel Mirror Photography
en.description: A detailed fashion photography prompt for sophisticated hotel mirror portraits, incorporating double-composition techniques and high-end editorial styling.
en.prompt:
• Photography Positioning
2:3 vertical version, ultra-realistic cinematic fashion photography, high-end Editorial style, authentic photographic work, medium format texture, {argument name="lens" default="85mm lens"}, F2.0, large aperture, shallow depth of field, soft natural light, real skin texture, real silk luster, real fabric drape, slight film grain, low saturation tones, high-end hotel indoor environment.

• {argument name="scene" default="High-end hotel suite"} Setting
Inside a high-end hotel suite, in front of a large full-length mirror, off-white walls, warm gray curtains, floor-to-ceiling windows, natural light entering the room, light-colored carpet, modern furniture (sofa, side table, floor lamp), clean and simple space, quiet, exquisite, and light luxury atmosphere.

• {argument name="character setting" default="East Asian female around 24 years old"}
An East Asian female around 24 years old, cool white skin, small and delicate face, light brown large eyes, delicate features.
Long straight black hair, light airy bangs, side hair naturally fits the cheeks. Wearing fine metal-rimmed glasses, cool, gentle, and intellectual temperament.

• Makeup Setting
Natural and clear: Creamy skin texture, gray-pink eye makeup, fine eyeliner, distinct eyelashes, light pink blush, soft matte rose lip makeup. Calm eyes looking at the camera, with a slight sense of thought.

• {argument name="outfit" default="White long-sleeved lapel shirt with a black silk bow tie and black suspenders"} Setting
White long-sleeved lapel shirt, paired with a black silk bow tie and black suspenders; the bottom is a black high-waisted mini skirt (with double-breasted gold buttons at the waist), the hem is slightly flared; paired with black pantyhose and black high heels.

• Action Setting
The person stands in front of the full-length mirror, body three-quarters sideways, one leg supporting, the other leg slightly bent forward and touching the ground with the tip of the toe, forming an elegant S-curve. The left hand naturally touches the hair or the side of the ear, while the right hand hangs naturally or is placed lightly on the side of the thigh.
The head turns slightly towards the camera, forming a dual composition through the reflection in the mirror, an elegant, natural, and confident posture.

• Visual Details
The mirror truly reflects the whole body of the character and the indoor environment, maintaining a natural perspective without mirror errors. The composition is simple and high-end, the character is on the right side of the frame, and the mirror occupies the left side, forming a balanced dual composition. The light is soft and natural, slight film grain, low saturation tones, and the overall atmosphere is quiet, high-end, light luxury, and intellectual.

Negative Prompt:
Anime style, illustration, CG feel, fake face, plastic skin, over-smoothed skin, excessive beauty filter, wrong body proportions, extra hands, extra legs, mirror distortion, reflection errors, repeating clothing textures, procedural textures, cheap fabrics, cluttered background, text, Logo, watermark.

zh.title: 高端酒店镜面时尚摄影
zh.description: 一份详尽的时尚摄影提示词，专为精致的酒店镜面人像拍摄设计，融合了双重构图技巧与高端杂志风造型。
zh.prompt:
• 摄影定位
2:3 竖构图，超写实电影感时尚摄影，高端杂志风，真实摄影作品，中画幅质感，{argument name="lens" default="85mm 镜头"}，F2.0，大光圈，浅景深，柔和自然光，真实皮肤纹理，真实丝绸光泽，真实面料垂坠感，轻微胶片颗粒，低饱和色调，高端酒店室内环境。

• {argument name="scene" default="高端酒店套房"} 设置
位于高端酒店套房内，大型全身镜前，米白色墙面，暖灰色窗帘，落地窗，自然光洒入室内，浅色地毯，现代家具（沙发、边几、落地灯），空间简洁干净，氛围安静、精致且轻奢。

• {argument name="character setting" default="24 岁左右东亚女性"} 设置
24 岁左右东亚女性，冷白皮，小巧精致的脸型，浅棕色大眼睛，五官精致。
黑色长直发，轻盈空气刘海，侧发自然贴合脸颊。佩戴精致金属细框眼镜，气质清冷、温柔且知性。

• 妆容设置
自然清透：奶油肌质感，灰粉色眼影，精致眼线，根根分明的睫毛，淡粉色腮红，柔雾玫瑰色唇妆。眼神平静地注视镜头，略带思考感。

• {argument name="outfit" default="白色长袖翻领衬衫，搭配黑色丝绸领结和黑色背带"} 设置
白色长袖翻领衬衫，搭配黑色丝绸领结和黑色背带；下身着黑色高腰迷你裙（腰间饰有双排金色纽扣），裙摆微张；搭配黑色连裤袜和黑色高跟鞋。

• 动作设置
人物站在全身镜前，身体呈四分之三侧面，单腿支撑，另一条腿微微前屈，脚尖点地，形成优雅的 S 型曲线。左手自然轻抚发丝或耳侧，右手自然下垂或轻放在大腿侧。
头部微微转向镜头，通过镜面反射形成双重构图，姿态优雅、自然且自信。

• 视觉细节
镜面真实反映人物全身及室内环境，保持自然视角，无镜面错误。构图简洁高端，人物位于画面右侧，镜面占据左侧，形成平衡的双重构图。光线柔和自然，带有轻微胶片颗粒，低饱和色调，整体氛围安静、高端、轻奢且知性。

负面提示词 (Negative Prompt)：
动漫风格，插画，CG 感，假脸，塑料感皮肤，过度磨皮，过度美颜，身体比例错误，多余的手，多余的腿，镜面畸变，反射错误，重复的服装纹理，程序化纹理，廉价面料，杂乱背景，文字，Logo，水印。

en.title: Tea Packaging Terrain Visual Concept
en.description: An abstract packaging design prompt inspired by mountain topography and tea fermentation. It uses contour lines and tea-colored gradients to create a sophisticated, minimalist landscape on high-end tea boxes.
en.prompt: Design a set of tea packaging key visuals for a packaging design proposal, with the concept '{argument name="design concept" default="mountain mist folding a sip of tea into a miniature terrain inside a paper box"}'. The products are a series of high-mountain oolong teas with three different fermentation levels. The visual shows a combination of three elongated drawer boxes and small tins, placed on a grey-white pedestal resembling a rock strata cross-section. The graphics on the boxes are not traditional landscape illustrations but an abstract terrain system composed of tea soup colors, altitude contour lines, and layered mist relationships. The composition uses horizontal display photography with clear foreground, midground, and background layers; the main box faces the camera, while side boxes and tins create structural variety. The background remains mostly low-contrast white space, suitable for packaging proposal presentations. The lighting is soft, side-angled morning mist light, emphasizing paper texture, local silver foil stamping, sealing paper, foil inner bags, and tea leaf textures rather than high contrast. The color system is divided into {argument name="color scheme" default="cold mist grey-green, roasted brown-grey, and pale gold amber"} by series, but overall it remains low-saturation, restrained, and mature. Material descriptions focus on {argument name="material details" default="specialty paper fibers, embossed contour lines, spot UV, aluminum sealing film, brushed metal tin lids, and tea leaf vein patterns"}. A small amount of dominant Chinese text is needed, including the series name, product name, a very short English identifier, and altitude batch info in the corner, with the text integrated directly into the front packaging system. Applicable for tea brand packaging proposals, retail display renderings, e-commerce packaging showcases, and brand investment materials.

zh.title: 极简抽象茶叶包装视觉设计
zh.description: 生成极简且抽象的茶叶包装概念，运用地形纹理与特定材质质感，打造高端品牌形象。
zh.prompt: 为包装设计方案构思一套茶叶包装主视觉，核心概念为“山雾将一口茶折叠进纸盒中的微缩地形”。产品为 {argument name="product series" default="三款不同发酵程度的高山乌龙系列"}。画面展示了三组细长的抽屉式礼盒与小罐，陈列在如同岩层切面的灰白色基座上。包装图案并非传统的山水插画，而是由茶汤色泽、海拔等高线与雾气层叠组成的抽象地形系统。构图采用横向展示摄影，前、中、后景层次分明。主包装盒正对镜头，侧边盒与小罐形成结构上的错落变化。背景保留大面积低对比度的留白，适合包装提案展示。光线采用柔和的侧向晨雾光，不追求高对比度，而是着重表现纸张压纹、局部烫银、封口贴、锡箔内袋以及茶叶干叶的质感。{argument name="color scheme" default="配色方案根据系列分为冷雾灰绿、焙火褐灰与浅金琥珀色"}，整体色调需保持低饱和度、克制且成熟。材质重点描述特种纸纤维、压印等高线、局部 UV、封口铝膜、茶罐拉丝金属盖以及茶叶叶脉。画面需包含少量中文为主的文字，包括系列中文名称、单品名称、极简的英文辅助标识以及角落的海拔批次信息。文字应直接融入包装正面的设计系统中。

en.title: Cozy Sunlit Interior Lifestyle Portrait
en.description: A comprehensive and descriptive prompt for a realistic portrait of a woman in a sunlit living room, focusing on lighting, textures, and a relaxed atmosphere.
en.prompt:
Subject: {argument name="theme" default="Sunlight and Photo Books"}

Main Character: A realistic lifestyle portrait of a {argument name="model age" default="20-something"} woman sitting on a beige long-pile rug in a living room filled with warm sunlight, leaning her upper body against an ivory fabric sofa on the left side of the frame. The woman is positioned diagonally from the top left to the bottom right, with her head and shoulders at the top left, chest at the center-left, waist at the center-right, and her bent and layered legs extending significantly through the lower half to the bottom right. Her right elbow rests on the sofa seat, with her right hand lightly supporting the back of her head. Her left arm follows her body from the side to the waist, but the forearm is hidden by her body and the edge of the frame. Her upper body tilts to her right, her waist is slightly twisted, and her knees are deeply bent with her legs layered front to back.

Person/Expression: A small, slightly long face, light beige skin, finely groomed brown eyebrows, large dark brown eyes, delicate eyeliner and long lashes, pale coral pink cheeks, and natural pink-beige lips. She gazes at the camera with a calm expression, her face tilted slightly to her right and her lips parted slightly. Her hair is medium-length, reaching past the shoulders in a reddish light brown, with thin bangs falling lightly on her forehead, layered around the face, and ends waving softly inward and outward. Light from the upper right of the frame creates thin golden highlights on the crown, bangs, cheeks, bridge of the nose, and collarbone, with window shadows falling faintly on her cheeks. She wears small single-stud earrings in both ears.

Clothing/Pose: {argument name="clothing" default="A pale salmon pink ribbed knit camisole with thin shoulder straps"}. The neckline is a deep henley with small matching buttons lined up vertically on a short center placket, and dense vertical ribbing throughout. The hem is short, flaring slightly above the abdomen, revealing the waist and navel. The bottoms are soft white shorts with a thick elastic waist, fine gathers around the hips, double-frilled edges at the leg openings and sides, and thin fabric creating natural wrinkles where the waist is twisted. Her right fingers touch her hair and the back of her head, naturally connecting the shoulder to the elbow and wrist. The foreground thigh and knee are shown prominently, with the back leg bent beneath, and both feet partially cut off at the bottom right edge.

Background/Light: A large open photo book is placed in the bottom left foreground, showing multiple portraits of women on the spread. Another thin photo book with a white cover and visible portraits is placed diagonally behind the woman's waist in the bottom right. The middle ground on the left is a thick ivory sofa with a natural-colored patterned knit blanket and cushion on the backrest. In the center back is a tall indoor plant with long leaves spreading upward. On the right back is a honey-colored wooden low board/bookshelf with books of different colors lined up vertically in the top right section, a small white pot with a green plant in the center, and stacked books on the bottom right. The right edge shows part of a low wooden table leg and top, with a bright window and blurred greenery visible above. The primary light is warm natural light streaming from the window in the top right, brightly illuminating the hair, face, shoulders, chest, abdomen, thighs, and rug, while casting soft brown shadows under the sofa and behind furniture.

Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical orientation, an indoor lifestyle portrait taken from a low position near the floor, looking slightly up at the woman's eye level. The face is positioned in the top-left third, the chest in the center, the white shorts in the center-right, and the bright foreground thigh and layered knees occupying a large area in the lower half. The subject occupies about three-quarters of the frame, with parts of the right arm, both feet, and the foreground photo book naturally cut off by the frame edges. The eyes and face are the sharpest focus, maintaining detail through the hair, clothes, foreground leg, and open photo book. The indoor plant, bookshelf, and window in the back are smoothly blurred with a shallow depth of field. A standard lens feel gives a natural perspective to the foreground leg, avoiding extreme wide-angle distortion.

Texture/Style: High-resolution realistic digital photograph. Dominated by warm creams, beiges, pale pinks, whites, and wood browns, with the green of the indoor plant as a small accent color. The skin is not overly smoothed, retaining faint color on the cheeks, soft sheen on the shoulders and legs, and smooth gradations between sun and shade. Distinctly rendered details include individual hair reflections, dense vertical ribbing of the camisole, thin fabric and frills of the shorts, the weave of the sofa, long fibers of the rug, glossy paper of the photo books, and wood grain of the furniture. Achieves a balance of soft background blur and foreground resolution for a clean, natural lifestyle finish.

Negative: Avoid face distortion, misaligned eyes, unnatural fingers or wrists, incorrect number of fingers, merging of arms and hair, deformation of shoulders or ribcage, broken leg layering, reversed joint angles, poor grounding on the rug, clothing clipping, strong wide-angle distortion, perspective failure in background furniture, unnatural shadows, readable text in photo books, logos, watermarks, or excessive skin smoothing.

zh.title: 温馨阳光室内生活方式肖像
zh.description: 一份全面且详尽的提示词，用于生成一位女性在阳光明媚的客厅中的写实肖像，重点在于光影、质感和轻松的氛围。
zh.prompt:
主题：{argument name="theme" default="阳光与摄影集"}

主要人物：一张写实的生活方式肖像，一位 {argument name="model age" default="20 多岁"} 的女性坐在铺满温暖阳光的客厅里，身下是一块米色的长绒地毯，上半身倚靠在画面左侧的象牙白织物沙发上。女性呈对角线分布，从左上角延伸至右下角，头部和肩部位于左上，胸部位于中左，腰部位于中右，弯曲且交叠的双腿在下半部分显著延伸至右下角。她的右肘靠在沙发座垫上，右手轻轻托住后脑勺。左臂从身体侧面延伸至腰部，但前臂被身体和画面边缘遮挡。她的上半身向右倾斜，腰部微微扭转，双膝深弯，双腿前后交叠。

人物/表情：脸型小巧且略长，肤色呈浅米色，棕色眉毛修剪精致，深棕色大眼睛，精致的眼线和长睫毛，脸颊呈淡珊瑚粉色，嘴唇为自然的粉米色。她以平静的表情注视着镜头，脸部微微向右倾斜，双唇微张。头发为中长发，长度过肩，呈红棕色，薄刘海轻垂在额前，脸部周围有层次感，发梢向内和向外柔和地卷曲。来自画面右上方的光线在发顶、刘海、脸颊、鼻梁和锁骨处营造出纤细的金色高光，窗影淡淡地落在她的脸颊上。双耳佩戴着小巧的单颗耳钉。

服装/姿势：{argument name="clothing" default="一件淡三文鱼粉色的罗纹针织吊带背心，配有细肩带"}。领口为深亨利领，短前襟上垂直排列着几颗同色小纽扣，全身布满密集的竖向罗纹。下摆较短，在腹部上方微微外扩，露出腰部和肚脐。下身穿着柔软的白色短裤，配有厚实的松紧腰带，臀部周围有细密的褶皱，裤腿和侧面边缘带有双层荷叶边，腰部扭转处呈现出薄织物带来的自然褶皱。她的右手触碰着头发和后脑勺，自然地连接起肩膀、手肘和手腕。前景中的大腿和膝盖表现突出，后腿弯曲在下方，双脚在右下边缘被部分裁切。

背景/光影：左下角前景处放置着一本打开的摄影集，跨页展示着多张女性肖像。另一本带有白色封面的薄摄影集斜放在右下角女性腰部后方。左侧中景是一张厚实的象牙白沙发，靠背上铺着一条自然色调的图案针织毯和靠垫。后方中心是一株叶片向上舒展的高大室内植物。右后方是一个蜂蜜色的木质矮项目/书架，右上部分垂直排列着不同颜色的书籍，中间放着一个绿色植物的小白盆，右下角堆放着书籍。右边缘显示出部分矮木桌的桌腿和桌面，上方可见明亮的窗户和模糊的绿植。主要光源是来自右上角窗户的温暖自然光，明亮地照亮了头发、脸部、肩膀、胸部、腹部、大腿和地毯，同时在沙发下方和家具后方投下柔和的棕色阴影。

构图/摄影：3:4 竖构图，室内生活方式肖像，从靠近地面的低角度拍摄，略微仰视女性的视线水平。脸部位于左上三分之一处，胸部位于中心，白色短裤位于中右，明亮的前景大腿和交叠的双膝占据了下半部分的大面积区域。主体占据了约四分之三的画面，右臂、双脚和前景的摄影集部分被画面边缘自然裁切。眼睛和脸部是焦点最清晰的地方，同时保持了头发、衣服、前景腿部和打开的摄影集的细节。背景中的室内植物、书架和窗户呈现出浅景深带来的柔和模糊效果。标准镜头的视角为前景腿部提供了自然的透视感，避免了极端的广角畸变。

质感/风格：高分辨率写实数码摄影。以温暖的奶油色、米色、淡粉色、白色和木棕色为主调，室内植物的绿色作为小面积点缀。皮肤没有过度磨皮，保留了脸颊淡淡的红晕、肩膀和腿部柔和的光泽，以及光影之间平滑的过渡。清晰呈现的细节包括单根头发的反光、吊带背心密集的竖向罗纹、短裤的薄织物和荷叶边、沙发的编织纹理、地毯的长纤维、摄影集的亮面纸张以及家具的木纹。实现了背景柔焦与前景清晰度之间的平衡，呈现出干净、自然的生活方式质感。

负面提示词：避免脸部畸变、眼睛不对齐、手指或手腕不自然、手指数量错误、手臂与头发融合、肩膀或胸腔变形、腿部交叠断裂、关节角度反转、在地毯上着地感差、衣服穿模、强烈的广角畸变、背景家具透视错误、不自然的阴影、摄影集中可辨认的文字、Logo、水印或过度磨皮。

en.title: Premium Spirits Packaging Design Proposal Board
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a professional packaging design proposal board for high-end Chinese spirits, including hero shots, structural diagrams, and material swatches.
en.prompt:
Design a professional packaging proposal board for a {argument name="product concept" default="unofficial concept"} {argument name="capacity" default="500ml"} high-end {argument name="flavor profile" default="sauce-aroma"} Chinese spirit (Baijiu). The category is premium spirits/liquor gift packaging, targeting high-net-worth gifting, personal collection, corporate gifts, and business banquets. The sales and transport scenarios include boutique retail display, festival gifting, e-commerce shipping, and secondary outer carton transport. The style is a combination derived from 'Auto Mode': the primary style is traditional heritage craft, supplemented by modern international information hierarchy and modular order, emphasizing brewing techniques, aging, origin culture, and modern premium brand expression, avoiding cliché black-and-gold, red-and-gold, or over-traditional symbols. The core concept is 'Contemporary Expression of Ancient Craftsmanship': using a restrained high-end color palette of kiln brown, rice paper ivory, deep indigo, and oxidized copper accents. The visual has an oriental charm but is not dated, with an international luxury feel that is not cold.
Main packaging uses a vertical rigid gift box structure. Recommended values for prototype: lift-off lid with a neck shoulder structure made of greyboard wrapped in specialty paper, holding one 500ml glass bottle inside. The gift box body is a high-rigidity structure, slender and stable, opening vertically. The inner tray clearly supports the bottle, suitable for luxury display. The bottle is a 500ml transparent or light smoky grey glass bottle, with proportions typical of high-end Baijiu (approx. 280–320 mm height, 85–95 mm diameter, total weight 1.2–1.5 kg). Internal protection must follow glass bottle safety logic: bottom load-bearing support + body stabilization + independent neck control, avoiding stress solely on the cap. The insert should be molded pulp or high-density paper, fitting the bottle contour with specific slots for shoulders and neck, ensuring no movement, glass-on-glass collision, or lid compression during transit. Must clearly distinguish between the main gift box and e-commerce shipping protection, including a B-flute or reinforced corrugated outer shipper with cushioning.
Brand identity and graphics must fit high-end spirits: restrained and recognizable vertical or centered composition. Use conceptual placeholders for names like 'Heritage Collection' and brief English labels like 'SAUCE-AROMA BAIJIU', 'HERITAGE CRAFT', '500 mL'. Text must be minimal and precise. The font style combines oriental calligraphy charm with modern high-end serif/sans-serif typography. Materials should be realistic: specialty paper with fiber texture or rice paper feel, using restrained copper/matte gold foil, embossing, debossing, spot UV, or micro-relief, but only on logos or seals. Abstract brewing tools, fermentation textures, or landscape contours can be used, but must be abstract and high-end, avoiding realistic illustrations or cliché dragon/phoenix symbols.
The board must be a 16:9 landscape composition on a clean white or light warm grey studio background. Place a large main packaging 45° perspective view in the center as the primary focal point (45%–60% of visual). Surround it with 7–9 smaller modular auxiliary views: front/back/side projections, unboxing effect, exploded view of the insert, bottle placement, e-commerce shipper structure, production-intent dieline, material swatches, and labels. Maintain clear professional order without clutter.
Must include a production-intent visualization dieline with professional legend: red for trim, blue dashed for creases, green for bleed, purple for safety, grey for reference, yellow for adhesive, light brown for insert, gold for foil, and bright white for spot UV. Use placeholders for barcodes, QR codes, and regulatory marks. Technical specs include units in mm, 3mm bleed, 5mm safety margin, and standard tolerances, presented as a concept board, not a dense blueprint.
Lighting and rendering must combine hyper-realistic 3D packaging with high-end paper photography. Paper fibers, embossing, corner details, board thickness, and glass reflections must be credible. Use a professional product photography angle, slightly above the table (45° tilt). The overall look is clean, expensive, and award-level, matching top-tier international packaging design standards. Keywords: premium sauce-aroma baijiu packaging proposal board, heritage craft inspired luxury liquor gift box, oversized hero rigid box mockup, molded pulp insert structure, ecommerce protective shipper, production-intent dieline visualization, elegant oriental contemporary packaging, premium Chinese spirits brand concept, tactile specialty paper, realistic emboss and foil details, photorealistic packaging design presentation, clean studio background, ultra detailed, high resolution.

zh.title: 高端白酒包装设计项目
zh.description: 一份针对高端白酒包装设计项目的专业详细提示词，包含 3D 透视图、结构爆炸图以及奢华礼盒的材质规格说明。
zh.prompt:
设计一份针对 500ml {argument name="product type" default="高端酱香白酒"} 的专业包装设计提案项目，作为非官方概念方案。产品类别为高端酒类 / 酱香型白酒 / 玻璃瓶液体礼品包装，目标受众为高净值人群礼赠、个人收藏、企业馈赠及商务宴请。销售与运输场景涵盖精品零售陈列、节日礼赠、电商配送及二级外箱运输。风格采用 Auto Mode 衍生组合：主风格为“古法非遗”，辅以现代国际化的信息层级与模块化秩序，强调酿造工艺、陈年窖藏、产地文化及现代高端品牌表达，避免陈词滥调的黑金、红金、宫廷堆砌及过度传统的符号化。整体视觉以“古法工艺的当代表达”为核心概念：采用克制的奢华色调，包含 {argument name="color scheme" default="窑土棕、宣纸米白、深靛蓝及氧化铜金属色点缀"}，营造出既不陈旧的东方氛围，又不冰冷的高端国际质感。

主包装采用竖式硬质礼盒结构。建议数值/打样确认：采用特种纸裱糊硬纸板的礼盒，结构为天地盖加护肩，内含一瓶 500ml 白酒玻璃瓶；盒体为高刚性纸板结构，比例修长稳重，顶盖竖向开启，内部托盘清晰支撑瓶身，适合高端礼品展示。瓶身定义为 500ml 透明或浅烟灰色玻璃瓶，高度与直径基于常见高端白酒比例。建议数值/打样确认：瓶高约 280–320 mm，最大瓶径约 85–95 mm，毛重建议在 1.2–1.5 kg 级别。内部包装必须采用适合玻璃瓶的保护逻辑：底部主承重支撑 + 瓶身稳定性限位 + 独立瓶颈控制结构，避免仅由瓶盖受力；内托建议采用模塑环保纸浆托或高密度纸托结构，托底贴合瓶身轮廓，在肩部和颈部进行局部定位，顶部留有安全间隙和手指空间，确保运输过程中瓶身不晃动、不与玻璃碰撞，且不受顶盖压力。礼盒与电商运输保护必须有明确区分：除主礼盒外，在辅助模块中增加独立的电商运输外箱建议，使用 B 楞或加固瓦楞外箱，配有缓冲垫和底部加固，解释礼盒之外的实际快递解决方案。

品牌标识与图形语言必须具备高端酱香白酒的气质：品牌 Logo 区域采用克制且易识别的竖向或居中构图。产品名称应使用概念占位文本，如“{argument name="brand copy" default="酱香典藏"}”，英文辅助信息仅作为简短占位，例如“SAUCE-AROMA BAIJIU”、“HERITAGE CRAFT”、“500 mL”等。文字必须精简准确，清晰易读，避免大段虚假参数。字体风格结合东方书写美学与现代高端衬线/无衬线字体，平衡传统工艺感与国际化精致感。材质表达需写实：特种纸裱糊纸板，带有细微纤维纹理或宣纸质感，局部使用克制的烫铜/哑金、压印、凹印、局部 UV 或微浮雕工艺，但仅在 Logo、产品名称、工艺图案或印章上点缀。可添加少量图形 DNA，如酿造工具、发酵曲块、山水地形线条或窖藏痕迹的抽象纹理，但必须是抽象且高级的，而非写实插画或陈词滥调的龙凤纹样。

提案项目需采用横向 16:9 或类似的宽屏构图，背景为干净的白色或极浅暖灰色摄影棚背景。中心放置一张大型主包装 45° 透视渲染图，占据视觉的 45%–60% 作为核心焦点。主包装必须展示盒体外观与高级材质纹理，可部分露出瓶身或呈现开盒状态，并允许少量高级场景点缀，如封口贴、产地纹样纸、宣纸标签或抽象铜质细节，但绝不能喧宾夺主。周围环绕 7–9 个辅助模块，尺寸显著小于主包装，整齐排列以展示：正/背/侧三视图、开箱效果、内托爆炸图、瓶身放置示意图、独立电商外箱结构、生产意图刀模线、材质与工艺色卡、尺寸/信息标签。辅助模块应具备专业提案项目的清晰秩序，避免杂乱或技术图纸盖过主包装。

必须包含生产意图可视化风格的刀模线/结构图，并配有简洁专业的图例：红色实线为模切，蓝色虚线为压痕/折叠，绿色为出血，紫色为安全线，灰色为参考线，黄色为粘胶位，浅棕色为内托/缓冲，金色为烫金版，亮白色为局部 UV。若无真实开窗，PET 开窗非强制，但若出现透明视窗，必须标注为占位结构。所有尺寸、工艺、公差、条形码、二维码、追踪码、物流标签及食品/酒类相关标识均为占位符，不生成可扫描代码或虚假认证。技术说明建议数值：单位为 mm，出血 3 mm，安全边距 5 mm，尺寸公差 ±1 mm，模切公差 ±0.5 mm，印刷套印公差 ±0.3 mm，但视觉上必须是概念提案项目，而非密集的工程蓝图。

灯光与渲染要求结合超写实 3D 包装渲染与高端纸品摄影：纸张纤维、压印、边角、纸板厚度、开合间隙、托盘接触点及瓶身玻璃反射均需真实可信。相机采用专业产品摄影视角，略高于桌面，以 45° 向下俯视，确保主结构清晰可读。整体画面干净、昂贵、克制，具有国际顶级设计公司获奖级包装提案的质感。关键词：高端酱香白酒包装提案项目，古法工艺灵感奢华酒礼盒，超大英雄硬盒模型，模塑纸浆内托结构，电商保护外箱，生产意图刀模线可视化，优雅东方当代包装，高端中国白酒品牌概念，触感特种纸，写实压印与烫金细节，照片级包装设计展示，干净摄影棚背景，超精细，高分辨率。

en.title: Lisbon Travel Fashion Character Sheet
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for generating a detailed character sheet of a female traveler in Lisbon, featuring three distinct outfits for different times of the day with consistent facial features based on a reference image.
en.prompt:
Reference Image:
One full-body reference image attached to this instruction.
Compatible with both real persons and character illustrations.

Text:
Use the attached full-body reference image as the sole subject reference to create a simple 1:1 square character sheet for sharing and character reference. The final image should be high-quality and visually appealing as a standalone post, clearly showing the face, hair, age, body type, three travel outfits, color scheme, shoes, and bag of one {argument name="gender" default="woman"} traveling in {argument name="destination" default="Lisbon"}. Do not include different people; maintain all figure displays as the same individual from the reference image. This is not a storyboard. Do not depict time progression, scene transitions, tourist landscapes, or narrative events.

[Reference Image Application]
For real-life references, finish with a high-quality, natural realistic expression while maintaining the features of the subject. For anime or illustration references, convert into a natural, high-quality realistic person while maintaining features.
Inherit the following from the reference image:
- Facial features
- Eyes
- Face shape
- Nose and mouth
- Bangs
- Hairstyle
- Hair color
- Hair length
- Hair parting
- Hair strands around the face
- Age feeling
- Skin impression
- Height perception
- Head-to-body ratio
- Body type
- Shoulder width
- Arm and leg length
- Overall proportions
- Unique atmosphere of the subject

Do not excessively beautify, juvenilize, age, or change the subject to someone else. No small-face effects, leg-lengthening, thinning, or body exaggeration. Do not inherit the outfit, shoes, accessories, props, color scheme, background, or pose from the reference. Completely change to the three travel outfits specified in this instruction.

[Expression and Finish]
High-quality, natural realistic expression. Bright, clean, and sophisticated, ensuring the charm of the person and fashion is conveyed at a glance. Maintain clarity as a practical resource without sacrificing design aesthetics. Avoid the look of bland mail-order catalogs, mass-produced fashion EC images, conservative clothing ads, or monotonous ID photo sets.

[Common State of Subject]
Maintain the same face, hairstyle, hair color, age, body type, height, and proportions across all views. Hairstyle and color should strictly follow the reference; do not change styling or parting between outfits. The facial expression should be a natural, calm default to convey charm. Avoid forced smiles or different personalities between outfits.

[Outfit Concept]
The theme is a young, sophisticated traveler enjoying a trip from morning to night. The three outfits should be individually attractive but designed as a cohesive wardrobe chosen by the same woman for a single trip. Direction:
- Clean/sophisticated style
- Not too casual
- Not too conservative
- Young and refined
- Feminine
- Photogenic for travel
- Suited for bright light, blue/white tiles, warm streets, and night riverside
Avoid plain tourist clothes focused only on comfort. No logos, brand names, text patterns, excessive decorations, or over-the-top frills.

[Length and Silhouette Variations]
Clearly vary the length and silhouette of the three outfits. Avoid using the same midi length or dress shape for all three.
- Outfit A: Long midi length near the lower calf.
- Outfit B: Slightly asymmetrical midi length, knee-length in front and mid-calf in back.
- Outfit C: Short length above the knee.
Ensure morning, noon, and night changes are obvious when aligned.

[Specified Outfits]
01 OUTFIT A
Refreshing morning style for viewpoints or slopes.
- Ivory sophisticated sleeveless rib-knit top.
- High-waist flare skirt with blue and white Azulejo-style patterns.
- Skirt length: Long midi (lower calf).
- Sophisticated flat sandals with thin straps.
- Small camel-colored cross-body bag.
- Understated refined accessories.
No white sneakers.

02 OUTFIT B
Bright and cheerful midday style for cafes or city walks.
- Terracotta/coral wrap dress.
- Natural V-neck.
- Short flutter sleeves.
- Side-tie at waist.
- Soft drapes and moving hem.
- Asymmetrical midi length.
- Delicate low-heel sandals.
- Small sophisticated woven bag.

03 OUTFIT C
Elegant evening style for the riverside.
- Deep wine-red sleeveless draped dress.
- Design that naturally beautifies shoulders and décolletage.
- Sophisticated side-flowing drape from waist to hip.
- Short length above the knee.
- Subtle asymmetrical hem.
- Delicate strap low-heel sandals.
- Small bordeaux shoulder bag.
- Understated metallic accessories.
No cardigans or wraps. The dress should stand alone as sophisticated evening wear.

04 SPECIAL LOOK
Not a fourth outfit. Use the exact same items as Outfit B. A 3/4 full-body view larger than the others. Natural, light static pose. No narrative actions like running or dancing.

[Color Scheme]
Fixed as follows:
- Outfit A: Azulejo blue, white, ivory, camel
- Outfit B: Coral terracotta, camel, natural brown
- Outfit C: Deep wine red, bordeaux

zh.title: 里斯本旅行角色设定集
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于生成高质量的里斯本女性旅行者角色参考图，包含早、中、晚三套不同风格的穿搭。
zh.prompt:
输入参考：请使用本说明附带的一张全身参考图。兼容真实照片或角色插画。

主要指令：仅使用附带的全身参考图作为主体参考，创建一个用于分享和角色参考的 {argument name="aspect ratio" default="1:1 正方形"} {argument name="image type" default="角色设定集"}。最终图像应具有高质量，适合独立发布，清晰展示在 {argument name="location" default="里斯本"} 旅行的女性的面部、发型、年龄、体格以及三套不同的旅行穿搭（包括颜色、鞋子和包袋）。保持所有视图中人物身份的一致性，不要添加其他人。不要创建故事板，避免描绘时间流逝、场景转换、风景或叙事事件。

[参考图应用]
对于真实照片参考，在保持人物特征的同时，呈现高质量、自然的写实表现。对于动漫或插画参考，将其转换为自然、高质量的写实人物，同时保留其特征。从参考图中继承以下内容：面部特征、眼睛、下颌线、鼻子/嘴巴、刘海、发型、发色、长度、发缝、脸颊旁的发丝、年龄感、皮肤质感、身高、比例、体格、肩宽、四肢长度以及整体氛围。不要过度美化、返老还童、显老或将主体变成其他人。不要夸大身体或改变模特类型。不要继承参考图中的服装、鞋子或背景；请将其完全替换为指定的里斯本三套旅行穿搭。

[表现与质感]
高质量、自然的写实表现。明亮、整洁且精致。设计应能一眼传达出人物的魅力与时尚感。作为实用文档，它应易于理解，同时不失审美吸引力。避免看起来像枯燥的邮购目录、批量生产的电商时尚图或单调的证件照。

[主体通用状态]
在所有描绘中保持一致的面部特征、发型、年龄和体格。不要在不同穿搭之间改变发型或发缝。面部表情应自然平静，展现主体魅力，无需夸张的笑容或戏剧性的姿势。

[穿搭概念]
主题：一位年轻、精致的女性旅行者在里斯本从早到晚享受一天的时光。这三套穿搭应各自具有吸引力，但设计上应统一为一次旅行的衣橱。整体风格应优雅，不过于随意，也不过于保守，年轻且具有女性魅力。它们在里斯本明亮的光线、蓝白瓷砖、温暖的街道和河岸背景下拍照会非常出色。避免平庸、沉闷的游客装束。无 Logo、品牌名称或过多的褶边。

[剪影变化]
明确区分三套穿搭的长度和剪影。避免三套均为相同的中长款或裙型。
- 穿搭 A：长款中裙，触及小腿下部。
- 穿搭 B：轻盈的不对称中裙（前短至膝下，后长至小腿中部）。
- 穿搭 C：膝盖以上的短款。

[指定穿搭]
01 穿搭 A（早晨：俯瞰与山间漫步）
- 优雅的象牙白无袖针织上衣。
- 高腰阔摆裙，带有蓝白相间的 Azulejo（葡式瓷砖）风格图案。
- 长款中裙，触及小腿下部。
- 优雅的细带平底凉鞋。
- 小巧的驼色斜挎包。
- 低调、精致的配饰。

02 穿搭 B（中午：咖啡馆与城市漫步）
- 珊瑚陶土色裹身裙。
- 自然的 V 领和短喇叭袖。
- 侧系腰带设计，勾勒优美剪影。
- 柔软的垂坠感和带有动感的裙摆。
- 不对称长度（前短至膝下，后长至小腿中部）。
- 精致的低跟凉鞋。
- 小巧、精致的编织包。

03 穿搭 C（傍晚：河畔或阿尔法玛区）
- 深酒红色无袖垂坠连衣裙。
- 完美展现肩部和锁骨线条的设计。
- 从腰部到臀部向一侧流动的优雅褶皱。
- 膝盖以上的短款，带有轻微的不对称下摆。
- 带有细带的低跟凉鞋。
- 小巧的波尔多红单肩包。
- 低调的金属配饰。

04 特别造型
这不是一套新穿搭。使用与穿搭 B 完全相同的服装和配饰。采用更大的 3/4 全身视图。展示主体处于自然的、轻微的静态姿势，以传达服装的动感。在此造型后方，仅使用珊瑚色的纯色或几何背景。无风景或建筑。

[配色方案]
固定颜色：
- 穿搭 A：Azulejo 蓝、白色、象牙白、驼色。
- 穿搭 B：珊瑚陶土色、驼色、自然棕色。
- 穿搭 C：深酒红色、波尔多红。

en.title: Early Summer Sunlight Portrait
en.description: Captures a natural, atmospheric portrait of a young woman in an early summer park, focusing on the interplay of sunlight through leaves, wind-blown hair, and realistic textures.
en.prompt:
Subject: Tree shade in the breeze.

Main Subject: A vertical fashion portrait captured at close range in a sunny early summer {argument name="location" default="tree-lined park"}. A {argument name="age" default="20-something"} {argument name="gender" default="woman"} stands in front of a dark wooden bench, squinting slightly as she feels the breeze. The subject occupies a large portion of the center frame from the top of the head to the upper thighs, twisting her torso slightly to her left and placing her right hand on the backrest of the bench at the right edge of the frame. Short dark brown hair flutters vigorously to the left. She wears an ivory lace camisole and light tiered shorts that stand out brightly in the green shade. The background features a straight sandy path receding into the distance, rows of large trees on both sides, green grass, and soft dappled sunlight, capturing the summer wind, light, and natural movement in a single photograph.

Person and Expression: A woman in her 20s with bright skin, a healthy glow, and a slender, naturally curved physique. A dark brown bob with a wet, textured look reaching below the jaw; thin bangs are scattered on the forehead with the left side spreading horizontally in the wind. Looking slightly upward, eyes narrowed as if closed very thin, natural eyebrows, sunlit bridge of the nose, pale pink cheeks, and slightly parted glossy coral-pink lips, showing a calm and liberating expression savoring the warm wind. A natural sheen suggesting sweat or fine moisture is placed on the cheeks, nose, jaw, neck, collarbone, and shoulders. Facial features are not overly youthful, retaining realistic skin texture, fine hairs, and shadows on the neck.

Clothing and Pose: Wearing a ribbed ivory camisole with thin shoulder straps. The chest has a deep V-shape with delicate floral lace on the triangular edges, a small tie in the center, and a thin lace band under the bust, with the hem following the waist. The bottoms are light ivory shorts with an elastic waist and thin drawstring, featuring a matching botanical pattern, two tiers of ruffles, and a sheer lace hem. Her right arm extends diagonally downward with the hand on the far right edge of the bench. Her left arm is hidden behind her body, chest slightly open as she leans against the bench. The torso has the left shoulder forward and right shoulder back, expressing natural weight shifting in response to the wind.

Background and Light: Deciduous trees with thick trunks line the frame regularly, covered in light to deep green leaves. Behind the person, a straight sandy path disappears in the center, with grass on the sides and small signs and trees in the distance. A dark, matte wooden bench enters diagonally from her waist to the lower right, showing wood grain, wear, and metal fasteners. Warm sunlight near noon shines from the upper left, creating bright highlights on the hair outline, cheeks, shoulders, chest, arms, and thighs. Leaf shadows fall as fine spots on the collarbone and clothes, and the background melts into golden-green circular bokeh. Highlights on the face are not blown out, balancing deep green shade with warm skin tones.

Composition and Camera: 3:4 vertical aspect ratio. The camera is at a slightly low position looking up from the chest toward the face, shot at close range. The head is at the top center, face in the upper third, waist at the lower center, and shorts/thighs at the bottom. The right arm stretches to the lower right to connect with the bench. The hair fluttering left fills the left whitespace, balancing the thick trunk on the right. 50mm equivalent lens, around F2.0, focusing on the eyes, face, and chest lace, with the path and trees blurred into a smooth, shallow depth of field.

Texture and Style: High-definition realistic fashion photo, a cross between a Japanese summer magazine editorial and a natural light portrait. Realistic depiction of wet-looking hair strands, fine skin texture and sheen, vertical rib-knit weave, delicate lace threads, thin cloth wrinkles of the shorts, scratches on the wooden bench, and layers of green in the leaves. Colors center on ivory, warm beige, vivid yellow-green, deep forest green, and dark brown, expressing the contrast between strong summer sun and cool shade. Transparent highlights, deep but detailed shadows, fine grain, and natural lens bokeh for a life-like finish.

Negative: Underage-looking person, childish physique, unnatural shoulders, missing bench parts, excessive background people, anime/illustration style, 3DCG look, excessive HDR, plastic skin, watermarks, text.

zh.title: 初夏阳光人像
zh.description: 捕捉初夏公园里一位年轻女性自然、充满氛围感的人像，聚焦于透过树叶的阳光、随风飘动的发丝以及逼真的质感。
zh.prompt:
主题：微风中的树荫。

主要对象：一张在阳光明媚的初夏 {argument name="location" default="林荫公园"} 近距离拍摄的竖构图时尚人像。一位 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁"} 的 {argument name="gender" default="女性"} 站在一张深色木长椅前，感受着微风，微微眯起双眼。主体占据了画面中心的大部分区域，从头顶到大腿上部，身体向左微转，右手搭在画面右边缘长椅的靠背上。深棕色的短发在风中向左剧烈飘动。她身穿象牙白蕾丝吊带背心和浅色多层短裤，在绿荫中显得格外明亮。背景是一条向远处延伸的笔直沙路，两侧是成排的大树、绿草和柔和的斑驳阳光，将夏日的风、光影和自然动态定格在这一张照片中。

人物与表情：一位 20 多岁的女性，肤色明亮，散发着健康的红润感，身材修长，线条自然。深棕色波波头，带有湿润的质感，长度及下颌以下；稀疏的刘海散落在额前，左侧在风中向水平方向散开。微微仰头，双眼眯起，仿佛闭目养神，眉毛自然，鼻梁上有阳光洒下，脸颊呈淡粉色，珊瑚粉色的嘴唇微微张开，带着享受暖风的宁静与惬意。脸颊、鼻尖、下颌、颈部、锁骨和肩膀上带有暗示汗水或细微湿润感的自然光泽。面部特征不过分幼态，保留了真实的皮肤纹理、细小的绒毛以及颈部的阴影。

服装与姿势：身穿罗纹象牙白吊带背心，肩带纤细。胸前呈深 V 字形，边缘饰有精致的花卉蕾丝，中心有一个小蝴蝶结，胸下有细蕾丝带，下摆贴合腰部。下身是象牙白短裤，腰部有松紧带和细抽绳，配有相呼应的植物图案、两层荷叶边和透明蕾丝下摆。她的右臂斜向下伸展，手搭在长椅的最右边缘。左臂隐藏在身体后方，倚靠长椅时胸部微微舒展。躯干左肩在前，右肩在后，展现出随风而动的自然重心偏移。

背景与光影：树干粗壮的落叶乔木整齐地排列在画面中，覆盖着从浅绿到深绿的叶片。人物身后，一条笔直的沙路在中心消失，两侧是草地，远处有小指示牌和树木。一张深色哑光木长椅从她的腰部斜向右下方延伸，显露出木纹、磨损痕迹和金属紧固件。近午的暖阳从左上方照射下来，在发丝轮廓、脸颊、肩膀、胸部、手臂和大腿上形成明亮的高光。树叶的阴影如细小的斑点落在锁骨和衣服上，背景融化成金绿色的圆形光斑。面部高光不过曝，平衡了深绿色的阴影与温暖的肤色。

构图与摄影：3:4 竖构图。相机位置略低，从胸部向上仰拍面部，近距离拍摄。头部位于顶部中心，面部位于上方三分之一处，腰部位于下方中心，短裤/大腿位于底部。右臂向右下方伸展以连接长椅。向左飘动的头发填补了左侧的留白，与右侧粗壮的树干形成平衡。50mm 等效镜头，光圈约 F2.0，对焦于眼睛、面部和胸部蕾丝，路径和树木虚化为平滑、浅景深的效果。

质感与风格：高清写实时尚摄影，融合了日本夏日杂志大片与自然光人像的风格。逼真呈现湿润的发丝、细腻的皮肤纹理与光泽、竖罗纹针织纹理、精致的蕾丝线头、短裤轻薄的布料褶皱、木长椅上的划痕以及叶片的层次感。色彩以象牙白、暖米色、鲜艳的黄绿色、深森林绿和深棕色为中心，表现出夏日烈日与凉爽阴影之间的对比。通透的高光、深邃但细节丰富的阴影、细腻的颗粒感以及自然的镜头光斑，营造出栩栩如生的质感。

负面提示：看起来未成年的人、幼稚的身材、不自然的肩膀、缺失的长椅部分、背景中过多的人群、动漫/插画风格、3DCG 感、过度 HDR、塑料质感皮肤、水印、文字。

en.title: Summer Wellness Self-Care Portrait
en.description: A realistic and clean lifestyle prompt for a summer wellness theme, showing a woman in a sage green tank top performing a self-care check by a window with natural lighting.
en.prompt:
9:16 vertical, realistic indoor body care and wellness portrait. 
Draw only one fictional adult East Asian woman who is not a real person.
Appearance is {argument name="subject age" default="late 20s"}.
Place the woman's face center at approximately 50% of the screen width, and the visual center of the upper body including hair, shoulders, chest, and raised arm within the central band of 40-60% width.
Naturally fit from the top of the head to below the chest in the vertical screen, not unnaturally cutting off the head, chin, neck, shoulders, main costume, or raised arm.
Leave the inside of the raised arm and armpit at the left edge of the screen, and the silhouette of the black hair and shoulder on the right.

The woman is raising one arm above her head by a bright window, quietly checking the condition of her armpit.
The face is a two-thirds frontal view turned slightly down and to the left.
Lower her gaze to her armpit, looking down without closing her eyes.
Include a small smile of relief at the corners of the mouth, showing it naturally as a self-check after exercise or on a hot day, rather than shame or disgust.
Do not tuck the chin too much; relax the neck and shoulders.

Facial features are a natural oval shape.
Align the positions of the left and right eyes, eyebrows, nose, and lips.
The pupils are dark brown, and the eyelashes of the downcast eyes are delicately drawn.
Eyebrows are a natural dark brown.
Makeup is thin, with pale pink-beige lips, natural cheek color, and subtle brown eye makeup.
The skin is bright and healthy, leaving natural pores, slight fine hair, and a fine gloss of sweat on the forehead, cheeks, nose, neck, and arms.
Represent sweat as clean water droplets and thin moisture, not looking like excessive oil film or dirt.

Hair color is dark brown to near black.
Tie it in a low ponytail or updo at the back of the head, leaving thin bangs slightly clumped with sweat at the forehead and temples.
Show a few short stray hairs in front of the ears and at the nape of the neck.
Naturally draw the hairline, individual hair flow, and thin clumping caused by humidity.

The outfit is a {argument name="outfit" default="plain sage green tank top"}.
Soft absorbent cotton blend material, with a round neckline, thick shoulder straps, and a daily silhouette that is not too loose.
Naturally include a gradient of deep moisture near the chest and armpits indicating aftermath of exercise or heat.
Do not make the boundary between wet and dry parts hard; realistically draw the fabric fibers, fine wrinkles, and differences in weight.
Do not include logos, patterns, text, or transparency.

The foreground is the inside of the raised arm, face, and sage green top.
The middle ground is the woman's shoulder and chest.
{argument name="background" default="Place a bright window frame and white blurred outdoor light in the background left, and make the background right a pale gray to beige indoor wall and curtain."}
Suppress the amount of information in the background, leaving a clean and quiet indoor atmosphere.

The camera is at height from the woman's chest to face.
A near-distance shot wrapped slightly to the left from the front.
Focal length feel is around 70mm, not distorting the face or arms with a wide angle.
Focus on the face, eyelashes, lips, armpit skin, and moisture of the top, with the window and background softly blurred.
Shallow to medium depth of field.

The main light source is soft natural light entering from the large window on the left.
The light brightens the raised arm, left cheek, bridge of the nose, lips, neck, collarbone, and fabric of the top, leaving subtle shadows on the right side of the hair and cheek.
Color temperature is neutral to slightly warm.
Exposure is bright, but does not lose the highlights of the skin and the gradations of the wet cloth.
Overall color tone is sage green, natural skin color, black hair, pale gray, and white.

Realistically depict skin pores, small water droplets of sweat, natural moisture of the lips, eyelashes, fine hair, and the fiber and moisture of cotton cloth.
Clean commercial photo quality suitable for summer deodorant, sweat measures, post-sport care, wellness, and beauty articles.
Do not include text, logos, brand names, signatures, or watermarks.
Avoid extra people, extra arms or fingers, missing hands, fused fingers, broken shoulders, twisted necks, distorted faces, asymmetrical pupils, over-emphasized armpits, sweat looking like dirt, doll-like skin, over-beautified skin, too strong HDR, or illustration style.

zh.title: 夏季健康自我护理肖像
zh.description: 一个写实且简洁的夏季健康主题生活方式提示词，展示了一位身穿鼠尾草绿背心的女性在窗边进行自我护理检查，并配有自然光照明。
zh.prompt:
9:16 竖屏，写实室内身体护理与健康肖像。
仅绘制一位虚构的成年东亚女性，非真实人物。
外貌为 {argument name="subject age" default="20 多岁后期"}。
将女性面部中心置于屏幕宽度约 50% 处，并将包括头发、肩膀、胸部和抬起手臂在内的上半身视觉中心置于屏幕宽度 40-60% 的中心带内。
在竖屏中自然地从头顶到胸部下方进行构图，不要不自然地切断头部、下巴、颈部、肩膀、主要服装或抬起的手臂。
将抬起的手臂内侧和腋下留在屏幕左边缘，黑色头发和肩膀的轮廓留在右侧。

这位女性在明亮的窗边抬起一只手臂过头，安静地检查腋下状况。
面部为四分之三正面视角，略微向下并向左转。
视线向下看向腋下，睁着眼睛向下看。
嘴角带着一丝释然的微笑，自然地表现出运动后或炎热天气下的自我检查，而非羞耻或厌恶。
不要过度收下巴；放松颈部和肩膀。

面部特征为自然的椭圆形。
左右眼、眉毛、鼻子和嘴唇的位置对齐。
瞳孔为深褐色，下垂眼帘的睫毛刻画细腻。
眉毛为自然的深褐色。
妆容清淡，配有淡粉米色嘴唇、自然的腮红和精致的棕色眼妆。
皮肤明亮健康，保留自然的毛孔、细微的绒毛，额头、脸颊、鼻子、颈部和手臂上有细微的汗水光泽。
汗水表现为干净的水珠和薄薄的湿气，看起来不像是过多的油膜或污垢。

发色为深褐色至接近黑色。
在脑后扎成低马尾或盘发，额头和太阳穴处留有几缕被汗水微微打湿的碎发。
耳朵前和颈后露出几根凌乱的短发。
自然地绘制发际线、单根发丝的流向以及因潮湿导致的细微粘连。

服装为 {argument name="outfit" default="简约鼠尾草绿背心"}。
柔软的吸汗棉混纺材质，圆领，宽肩带，日常剪裁，不过于宽松。
在胸部和腋下附近自然地包含深色湿痕，以体现运动后或炎热后的状态。
湿区和干区的边界不要过于生硬；写实地绘制织物纤维、细微褶皱和重量感差异。
不包含任何标志、图案、文字或透明度。

前景是抬起的手臂内侧、面部和鼠尾草绿背心。
中景是女性的肩膀和胸部。
{argument name="background" default="背景左侧放置明亮的窗框和白色的模糊户外光，背景右侧为浅灰色至米色的室内墙壁和窗帘。"}
抑制背景中的信息量，营造干净安静的室内氛围。

相机高度从女性胸部到面部。
从正面略微向左侧的近距离拍摄。
焦距感约为 70mm，不会因广角而导致面部或手臂变形。
聚焦于面部、睫毛、嘴唇、腋下皮肤和背心的湿润感，窗户和背景进行柔焦处理。
浅至中等景深。

主光源是来自左侧大窗户的柔和自然光。
光线照亮了抬起的手臂、左脸颊、鼻梁、嘴唇、颈部、锁骨和背心面料，在头发和脸颊的右侧留下细微阴影。
色温为中性至略暖。
曝光明亮，但没有丢失皮肤的高光和湿布的渐变。
整体色调为鼠尾草绿、自然肤色、黑发、浅灰和白色。

写实地描绘皮肤毛孔、细小的汗珠、嘴唇的自然湿润感、睫毛、绒毛以及棉布的纤维和湿润感。
干净的商业摄影质量，适用于夏季除臭、止汗措施、运动后护理、健康和美容文章。
不包含文字、标志、品牌名称、签名或水印。
避免出现多余的人、多余的手臂或手指、缺失的手部、融合的手指、破碎的肩膀、扭曲的脖子、扭曲的面部、不对称的瞳孔、过度强调的腋下、看起来像污垢的汗水、玩偶般的皮肤、过度美化的皮肤、过强的 HDR 或插画风格。

en.title: Japanese Riverside Summer Picnic Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a high-quality, realistic portrait of a woman having a summer picnic by a river, featuring specific details like snacks and a film camera.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Summer picnic by the river"}

Main Figure:
A vertical portrait featuring a woman in her 20s sitting on a reddish-brown and off-white checkered picnic mat in the shade of a tree by a river in midsummer. The subject occupies a large portion of the center to the right of the frame, with both knees pulled up near her chest, legs crossed diagonally, and holding a silver potato chip bag in front of her knees with both hands. The bag enters largely from the bottom left, made of silver glossy material, with the bold black text "{argument name="brand" default="Calbee"}", "Potato Chips", white text "{argument name="flavor" default="Consomme Punch"}", a small "5-vegetable package" in the top left, and "55g" at the bottom clearly legible from the front. In the bottom right, there is a shallow rattan basket containing a clear plastic bottle of unsweetened tea, a small silver and black film camera, a blue and white cloth, and yellowish-green grapes. The scene is depicted as a complete moment of a peaceful summer picnic, including the person, snack bag, drink, basket, and small items.

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s with fair, smooth skin and a slender, healthy build. Her soft ash-brown long hair reaches below her chest in loose waves with a fine clumped texture, with thin bangs falling naturally over her forehead, and delicate outlines of sunlight filtering through the crown and tips. Her face is slightly tilted toward her own right while looking directly at the camera, with rounded dark brown eyes, natural parallel eyebrows, pale coral pink cheeks, and glossy pink-beige lips slightly parted, showing a soft expression as if quietly speaking. In her right ear, she wears a small silver hoop and a swinging earring with four white flowers, a thin silver chain with a four-white-flower pendant around her neck, and a delicate bracelet with the same flowers on her left wrist. The skin is not excessively washed out, leaving a natural complexion and fine texture on the cheeks, shoulders, arms, and legs.

Clothing/Pose:
Wears an ivory-colored thin-strapped ribbed knit camisole and short pants of the same color. The camisole has a deep round neck and naturally follows the body, while the shorts are made of soft fabric with thin frills at the hem and a tie string on her left side. She sits with her upper body almost facing forward, her left knee raised high in the center, and her right leg folded in front of it to keep both legs compact. Her arms extend naturally in front of her knees, lightly wrapping around the bottom edges of the bag. Long fingers and pale pink nails are clearly shown, with the joints and number of fingers drawn accurately. The exposure is natural for summer casual wear, with the posture, clothing boundaries, and leg overlap anatomically correct.

Background/Light:
The background consists of a bright green lawn, followed by a calm blue river surface, a low concrete bridge, and distant grayish-blue urban architecture. A thick tree trunk and branches enter from the top right, spreading green leaves at the top and creating cool shade around the person. On a clear afternoon, strong natural light from the top left brightly illuminates the background grass and water, while sunlight filtering through the leaves creates small, soft spots on the hair, shoulders, arms, knees, and mat. The person's face is shown uniformly in the diffused light of the shade, while maintaining catchlights in the eyes and fine highlights on the bridge of the nose, lips, and hair. The river surface in the background has fine sparkling reflections, the grass has gradations from yellowish-green to deep green, and the shade adds cool blue-green nuances.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4, a slightly wide seated portrait capturing from the top of the head to near the ankles with a small amount of leaves and space above. The camera is slightly higher than the person's eye level, looking down lightly from a close distance. A stable triangular arrangement with the person's face in the top center, raised knees in the center, the silver snack bag in the bottom left, and the rattan basket and tea bottle in the bottom right. Equivalent to 50mm, around F2.8, resolving the face and foreground bag sufficiently while blurring the river, bridge, and buildings with a smooth shallow depth of field. Maintain natural perspective, not distorting the face or limbs with a wide angle. The top of the frame is filled with leaf bokeh and a pale blue sky, while the bottom is dense with details of the checkered cloth and small items.

Texture/Style:
High-definition realistic fashion photo, in the style of a clean and transparent Japanese summer magazine gravure. Avoid excessive skin correction or artificial facial features, and realistically depict fine downy hair, individual strands of hair, the weave of the ribbed knit, the seams of the shorts, the folds and reflections of the silver packaging, the weave of the rattan, the pale amber color inside the clear bottle, the translucency of the grapes, and the fibers of the checkered cloth. The color scheme is based on ivory, bright yellowish-green grass, pale blue river, and silver, balancing the warmth of natural light with the coolness of the shade. Moderate fine contrast, soft highlight roll-off, low noise, natural dynamic range, and a sophisticated film-like finish.

Negative:
People who look underage, immature physique, extra arms or legs, fused legs, missing fingers, extra fingers, collapsed hands, reversed accessories, excessive HDR, anime style, 3DCG feel, watermark.

zh.title: 日本河畔夏日野餐肖像
zh.description: 一份详细的提示词，用于生成高质量、写实的女性河畔夏日野餐肖像，包含零食和胶片相机等特定细节。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="河畔夏日野餐"}

主要人物：
一张竖构图肖像，描绘了一位 20 多岁的女性，坐在盛夏时节河边树荫下的红棕色与灰白色格子野餐垫上。主体占据了画面中心偏右的大部分区域，双膝弯曲靠近胸前，双腿交叉，双手抱住膝盖前的一个银色薯片袋。袋子从左下角大面积切入，采用银色亮面材质，上面清晰可见加粗的黑色文字“{argument name="brand" default="Calbee"}”、“Potato Chips”，白色文字“{argument name="flavor" default="Consomme Punch"}”，左上角有小型的“5-vegetable package”标志，底部印有“55g”。右下角有一个浅藤篮，里面装有一瓶透明塑料瓶装的无糖茶、一台银黑色胶片相机、一块蓝白相间的布和黄绿色的葡萄。场景呈现了宁静夏日野餐的完整瞬间，包括人物、零食袋、饮料、篮子和各种小物件。

人物/表情：
一位 20 多岁的女性，皮肤白皙光滑，身材苗条健康。她柔软的灰棕色长发呈松散的波浪状垂至胸前，发丝质感细腻，稀疏的刘海自然地垂在额前，阳光透过发顶和发梢勾勒出细腻的轮廓。她的脸微微向右侧倾斜，直视镜头，有着圆润的深棕色眼睛、自然的平眉、淡珊瑚粉色的脸颊，以及微微张开的粉米色光泽嘴唇，展现出一种仿佛正在安静交谈的柔和表情。右耳戴着一个小银圈和带有四朵小白花的垂坠耳环，颈部佩戴一条带有四花吊坠的细银链，左手腕上戴着同款花朵的精致手链。皮肤没有过度磨皮，保留了脸颊、肩膀、手臂和腿部的自然肤色和细腻纹理。

服装/姿势：
身穿象牙色细肩带罗纹针织吊带背心和同色短裤。吊带背心采用深圆领设计，自然贴合身体，短裤由柔软面料制成，下摆带有细褶边，左侧系有系带。她坐着，上半身几乎正对前方，左膝高高抬起位于中心，右腿折叠在前面，使双腿保持紧凑。双臂自然地伸展在膝盖前，轻轻环绕着袋子的底部边缘。手指修长，指甲呈淡粉色，关节和手指数量描绘准确。曝光度符合夏日休闲装扮，姿势、服装边界和腿部重叠在解剖学上是正确的。

背景/光线：
背景由明亮的绿色草坪、平静的蓝色河面、低矮的混凝土桥和远处的灰蓝色城市建筑组成。一根粗壮的树干和枝条从右上角延伸进来，顶部散布着绿叶，在人物周围营造出清凉的树荫。在晴朗的午后，来自左上方的强烈自然光照亮了背景草地和水面，透过树叶的阳光在头发、肩膀、手臂、膝盖和野餐垫上形成了细小、柔和的光斑。人物面部均匀地处于树荫的漫射光中，同时保持了眼睛里的眼神光以及鼻梁、嘴唇和头发上的细腻高光。背景中的河面有细碎的闪烁反光，草地呈现出从黄绿色到深绿色的渐变，树荫增添了冷蓝绿色的色调。

构图/相机：
竖构图 3:4，稍微宽广的坐姿肖像，捕捉范围从头顶到脚踝附近，上方留有少量树叶和空间。相机位置略高于人物视线，从近距离微微俯拍。形成一个稳定的三角形构图：人物面部位于顶部中心，抬起的膝盖位于中心，银色零食袋位于左下角，藤篮和茶瓶位于右下角。等效 50mm 焦距，光圈约 F2.8，在充分解析面部和前景袋子的同时，通过平滑的浅景深虚化河流、桥梁和建筑物。保持自然透视，避免使用广角导致面部或四肢变形。画面顶部充满了叶影虚化和淡蓝色的天空，底部则充满了格子布和小物件的细节。

质感/风格：
高清写实时尚摄影，风格为清新透明的日本夏日杂志写真。避免过度皮肤修饰或人工面部特征，真实地描绘细小的绒毛、单根发丝、罗纹针织的纹理、短裤的缝线、银色包装的褶皱和反光、藤编的纹理、透明瓶内的淡琥珀色液体、葡萄的半透明感以及格子布的纤维。配色方案以象牙白、明亮的黄绿色草地、淡蓝色河流和银色为基础，平衡了自然光的温暖与树荫的清凉。中等精细对比度，柔和的高光过渡，低噪点，自然的动态范围，以及精致的胶片质感。

负面提示词：
未成年长相、发育不成熟的身材、多余的手臂或腿、腿部融合、缺指、多指、手部塌陷、饰品反转、过度 HDR、动漫风格、3DCG 感、水印。
