en.title: 3D Pixar Chibi Character Transformation
en.description: A complex prompt for turning a reference portrait into a high-quality 3D Pixar-style chibi scene with custom text and multiple mini characters.
en.prompt:
Transform the uploaded person into a heartwarming Pixar-inspired 3D chibi scene while preserving the exact facial identity, facial structure, hairstyle, skin tone, expression, outfit, colors, and recognizable appearance from the reference image.

FORMAT LOCK
Vertical 3:4 composition. Clean white seamless studio background. Bright centered composition. Premium greeting-card aesthetic. The giant text remains the central structure of the scene.

IDENTITY LOCK
Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, outfit, shoes, and overall identity from the uploaded image. Do not redesign the face or change the clothing.

MAIN CHARACTER
Create a premium Pixar-style 3D chibi version of the uploaded person sitting comfortably on top of giant pastel 3D letters spelling "{argument name="text" default="GOOD MORNING"}." The character should have a warm smile and {argument name="character pose" default="relaxed pose while holding a ceramic coffee mug"}. The mug should remain simple with no visible text or logo.

MINI CHARACTERS
Surround the main character with multiple adorable miniature versions of the same person, each {argument name="mini activities" default="performing a different cheerful morning activity: pouring coffee, holding an encouraging sign, enjoying a coffee, reading a book, watering a small plant, hugging a pink heart, serving a cupcake, and raising a motivational chalkboard"}. Every mini character must preserve the same recognizable facial identity in a playful Pixar-style design.

DECORATION
Include cute coffee cups, latte art, tiny plants, tulips, a small orange kitten, wooden signs with positive messages, soft hearts, subtle doodles, and cozy decorative elements. Keep the scene balanced, clean, and uncluttered.

LIGHTING & STYLE
Soft natural studio lighting. Warm pastel color palette. Premium Pixar-inspired 3D character design. Expressive faces. High-quality textures. Cozy morning atmosphere. Minimal yet vibrant composition. Luxury animated-film aesthetic. Ultra-detailed 8K rendering.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
Avoid low quality, blurry details, distorted face, changed identity, altered outfit, extra limbs, duplicate main character, bad anatomy, plastic textures, cluttered composition, dark lighting, harsh shadows, logos, watermarks, text artifacts, or unrealistic 3D rendering.

创建一个高级 Pixar 风格的 3D Q 版人物，让其舒适地坐在巨大的 3D 柔和色调字母上方，字母拼写为“{argument name="text" default="GOOD MORNING"}”。角色应面带温暖的微笑，并保持“{argument name="character pose" default="relaxed pose while holding a ceramic coffee mug"}”。马克杯应保持简洁，无可见文字或 Logo。

光影与风格

负面提示词

en.title: Ultra-Realistic Fashion Portrait with Extreme Perspective
en.description: A cinematic and dynamic fashion prompt featuring a woman with purple hair in a bug's eye perspective, crawling toward the camera.
en.prompt:
A dramatic, ultra-realistic fashion photograph of a young woman with a {argument name="hair style" default="short vibrant purple bob haircut"}, soft bangs, fair skin, natural freckles across her cheeks and nose, and expressive brown eyes. She wears a {argument name="outfit" default="bright red open unbuttoned long-sleeve cotton shirt"} over a fitted white scoop-neck crop top, distressed blue denim cut-off shorts, and stylish red cat-eye sunglasses.

The camera is placed on the floor in an extreme low-angle "bug's eye" perspective, looking directly upward. The character is kneeling on all fours, crawling forward with urgency. Her right hand reaches dramatically toward the camera, appearing huge due to strong foreshortening, with fingers spread as if trying to grab something. Her left hand is firmly planted on the glossy floor, supporting her body.

A {argument name="object" default="red discount coupon ticket"} with a perforated edge floats in the foreground beneath her extended hand. The coupon features a large bold white "%" symbol and appears to be falling through the air.

The environment is a seamless minimalist white studio with glossy white floors and two bold parallel red stripes running across the floor toward the background. High-contrast professional studio lighting creates deep, crisp shadows beneath the character and emphasizes the dramatic perspective.

The foreground hand and floating coupon are razor sharp, while the character's face has a slightly softer focus for cinematic depth. The mood is energetic, urgent, dynamic, and modern, resembling a premium commercial advertisement. zh.title: 具有极致透视感的超写实时尚人像
zh.description: 一个电影感十足且充满动感的时尚提示词，展现了一位留着紫色头发的女性以虫眼视角向镜头爬行的画面。
zh.prompt:
一张极具戏剧张力、超写实的时尚摄影作品，主角是一位留着 {argument name="hair style" default="短款亮紫色波波头"} 的年轻女性，配有柔和的刘海，皮肤白皙，脸颊和鼻梁上布满自然的雀斑，棕色的双眸充满神采。她身穿一件 {argument name="outfit" default="鲜红色敞开式长袖纯棉衬衫"}，内搭修身白色圆领露脐上衣，下着做旧蓝色牛仔短裤，并佩戴着时尚的红色猫眼太阳镜。

相机被放置在地面上，采用极致的低角度“虫眼”视角，直接向上仰拍。角色正四肢着地，急切地向前爬行。她的右手戏剧性地伸向镜头，由于强烈的透视缩短效果显得格外巨大，手指张开，仿佛试图抓住什么。她的左手稳稳地撑在光亮的地面上，支撑着身体。

一张带有穿孔边缘的 {argument name="object" default="红色优惠券"} 漂浮在伸出的手下方的前景中。优惠券上印有一个醒目的白色“%”符号，看起来正从空中飘落。

环境是一个极简主义的无缝白色摄影棚，地面为光亮的白色，两条醒目的红色平行线条贯穿地面延伸至背景。高对比度的专业摄影棚灯光在角色下方投下深邃清晰的阴影，并强调了戏剧性的透视效果。

前景的手和漂浮的优惠券极其锐利，而角色的面部则采用了略微柔焦的处理，以营造电影般的景深感。整体氛围充满活力、紧迫感、动感且现代，宛如一则高端商业广告。超写实的皮肤纹理、细腻的织物褶皱、逼真的发丝、物理准确的灯光、HDR、浅景深、24mm 超广角镜头、极致的透视畸变、杰作、最佳质量、8K、照片级真实感。

en.title: 3D Pixar-Style Caricature Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating a Pixar-quality 3D caricature of a joyful woman with high-end digital illustration textures and cinematic lighting.
en.prompt:
Create an ultra-premium, hyper-detailed 3D caricature portrait of an irresistibly cheerful young woman with an oversized head and a tiny, perfectly proportioned body. She has a {argument name="hair style" default="stylish short tousled dark-brown pixie haircut"} with soft textured layers, huge sparkling dark brown eyes looking playfully upward, long curled eyelashes, naturally thick eyebrows, glowing porcelain skin, rosy cheeks, and a dazzling open smile with perfectly aligned white teeth that instantly radiates happiness.
She wears elegant pearl stud earrings, a {argument name="outfit" default="shimmering rose-pink satin button-up blouse"} with subtle glitter highlights and rolled sleeves, a luxurious flowing black midi skirt with realistic fabric movement, and glossy mustard-yellow designer heels. She playfully holds the sides of her blouse while standing in a lively, confident pose with one knee slightly bent, creating an energetic and charming silhouette.
Behind her is an enormous semi-transparent monochrome portrait of the same joyful face, softly blended into a {argument name="background" default="breathtaking background of fiery orange, golden yellow, and warm amber watercolor textures"} with glowing particles, paint splashes, dreamy bokeh lights, and subtle light rays that create depth and visual drama.
Elegant hand-lettered white calligraphy reading "You Look Beautiful" appears in the lower-right corner, surrounded by delicate butterflies, tiny hearts, sparkling stars, floral flourishes, and graceful ornamental swirls, seamlessly integrated into the composition.
Style: Pixar-quality 3D caricature, Disney-inspired charm, premium digital illustration, cinematic lighting, volumetric glow, HDR color grading, glossy rendering, ultra-realistic textures, expressive facial features, vibrant warm palette, luxury poster design, immaculate composition, crisp focus, magazine-cover aesthetics, social-media optimized, highly shareable, emotionally uplifting, masterpiece, award-winning artwork, 8K ultra-HD, razor-sharp details, vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.

zh.title: 3D 皮克斯风格卡通肖像
zh.description: 一个用于创作皮克斯级 3D 卡通肖像的详细提示词，描绘了一位快乐的女性，具有高端数字插画质感和电影级光效。
zh.prompt:
创作一张超高端、超精细的 3D 卡通肖像，主角是一位极具感染力的快乐年轻女性，拥有夸张的大头和比例完美的小巧身体。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="时尚的深棕色凌乱短发精灵头"}，发丝层次柔软且富有质感；一双巨大的深棕色明眸俏皮地向上看，配以长长的卷翘睫毛、自然浓密的眉毛、透亮的瓷肌、红润的脸颊，以及露出整齐洁白牙齿的灿烂笑容，瞬间传递出幸福感。
她佩戴着优雅的珍珠耳钉，穿着一件 {argument name="outfit" default="闪烁着玫瑰粉色光泽的缎面衬衫"}，衣物带有细微的闪光高光和卷起的袖口，搭配一条质感奢华、垂坠感极佳的黑色中长裙，脚踩亮面芥末黄设计师高跟鞋。她俏皮地提着衬衫两侧，以自信活泼的姿态站立，单膝微屈，勾勒出充满活力且迷人的轮廓。
在她身后，是一个巨大的半透明单色肖像，呈现出同样的快乐面容，与 {argument name="background" default="由火橙色、金黄色和暖琥珀色水彩纹理构成的绝美背景"} 柔和融合，背景中点缀着发光粒子、油漆飞溅、梦幻的焦外成像光斑和微妙的光束，营造出深度与视觉张力。
右下角呈现出优雅的手写白色书法字样“You Look Beautiful”，周围环绕着精致的蝴蝶、小爱心、闪烁的星星、花卉装饰和优美的涡旋纹饰，与整体构图完美融合。
风格：皮克斯级 3D 卡通，迪士尼风格魅力，高端数字插画，电影级光效，体积光，HDR 调色，光泽渲染，超写实纹理，生动的面部特征，鲜艳的暖色调，奢华海报设计，完美的构图，清晰对焦，杂志封面美学，社交媒体优化，极具分享价值，情感治愈，杰作，获奖艺术品，8K 超高清，极致细节，3:4 竖屏比例。

en.title: Ceremonial Celebration Visual Poster
en.description: A refined prompt for creating elegant celebration posters with dramatic cinematic lighting and glowing handwritten typography.
en.prompt: Create a thematic visual with a sense of celebration centered around {argument name="theme" default="any subject"}: the subject occupies the lower-middle part of the frame with a close-up main form, maintaining a quiet and stable frontal posture, with edges allowed to be slightly swallowed by shadows for a composed presence. The background is a restrained pure space, with {argument name="base color" default="low-brightness primary base color"} and clear lighting layers derived from the theme's mood; one side is pressed with a large soft-edged oval shadow, while the other retains a brighter breathing area. Colors are extracted from the material, season, and identity of the subject, maintaining a large area of clean structural base colors and clear highlight information colors. At the bottom, use a line of huge {argument name="glowing title" default="luminous handwriting"} as an emotional heading with long, coherent strokes and a neon-like soft white halo. The surface features slight film grain and soft focus vignetting, resulting in a private and formal commemorative image built on light, shadow, and restrained color scales.

zh.title: 庆典仪式感视觉海报
zh.description: 一个用于创作优雅庆典海报的精炼提示词，包含戏剧性的电影级光影和发光手写字体效果。
zh.prompt: 创建一个以 {argument name="theme" default="任意主题"} 为核心的庆典主题视觉图：主体位于画面中下部，采用近景特写，保持安静稳定的正面姿态，边缘可略微隐入阴影中，以呈现沉稳的质感。背景为克制的纯净空间，采用 {argument name="base color" default="低亮度主基色"}，并根据主题氛围营造清晰的光影层次；一侧压入大面积柔边椭圆阴影，另一侧保留明亮的呼吸感区域。色彩从主体的材质、季节和身份中提取，保持大面积干净的结构基色和清晰的重点信息色。底部使用一行巨大的 {argument name="glowing title" default="发光手写字"} 作为情感标题，笔触连贯修长，带有类似霓虹灯的柔和白光晕。画面表面呈现轻微的胶片颗粒感和柔焦暗角效果，打造出一张基于光影与克制色阶的私密且正式的纪念性图像。

en.title: Zen-Style Oolong Tea Ecommerce Detail Page
en.description: A meticulous prompt for generating a high-end mobile-first ecommerce detail page for a conceptual tea brand, following a structured customer conversion path with Zen aesthetics.
en.prompt:
Design a high-end mobile-first ecommerce detail page for the conceptual brand '{argument name="brand name" default="LANXU"}', targeting a complete conversion path for {argument name="product name" default="High Mountain Oolong Tea"}. The product is a two-can gift set, with each can containing {argument name="net content" default="100g"}.
Strictly maintain consistency: brand 'LANXU', two cylindrical metal tea cans (approx. 135mm height, 78mm diameter) in a rock-grey matte finish with antique copper lids. Vertical brand logo 'LANXU' and product labels must be identical across both cans. Visual system: 'Zen Luxury + Natural Organic', core concept 'Mountain Mist in a Cup'. Color palette: rock grey, mist white, sprout green, amber tea, and oxidized copper. Graphic language: abstract valley contours, thin morning mist, and diffusing tea layers. Typography: modern Songti and clean sans-serif with ample white space.
Layout: approx. 1242px wide, vertical long-form (1:5 ratio). Seven continuous modules: 
1. 'Hero Value': two cans with gift box against abstract misty valley, headline 'Mountain Mist in a Cup'.
2. 'Why It's Worth Drinking': macro shots of dry leaves, wet leaves, and clear amber tea, labeled 'Flavor Profile: Subject to actual evaluation'.
3. 'Origin & Raw Material': abstract tea garden slopes and harvesting details, placeholders for origin and altitude.
4. 'Production Process': four steps (Harvest, Withering, Roasting, Packaging) with placeholder names.
5. 'Brewing Experience': realistic scene with white porcelain Gaiwan, pitcher, and pouring tea; placeholders for temperature and time.
6. 'Packaging & Specs': clearly show box, two cans, opened state, and '100g x 2 cans' label.
7. 'Purchase Trust': gift scenario, placeholder specs, and logistics info.
Style: Premium ecommerce art direction combining real commercial photography with refined graphic design. All items must have realistic proportions and contact points. Tea leaves must not float, and mist must not block product visibility.
Only display core text: 'LANXU', 'High Mountain Oolong', 'Mountain Mist in a Cup', 'Original Leaf Form', 'Flavor Profile: Placeholder', 'Origin Info: Placeholder', 'Process Info: Placeholder', 'Brewing Suggestion: Placeholder', '100g x 2 cans', 'Product Info: Placeholder'.

zh.title: 禅意乌龙茶电商详情页
zh.description: 一份精心设计的提示词，旨在为概念茶品牌生成高端移动端优先的电商详情页，遵循具有禅意美学的结构化客户转化路径。
zh.prompt:
为概念品牌“{argument name="brand name" default="LANXU"}”设计一个高端移动端优先的电商详情页，针对“{argument name="product name" default="高山乌龙茶"}”打造完整的转化路径。该产品为两罐装礼盒，每罐净含量为“{argument name="net content" default="100g"}”。
严格保持一致性：品牌“LANXU”，两罐圆柱形金属茶罐（高约 135mm，直径 78mm），采用岩灰色哑光饰面，配以古铜色盖子。垂直品牌标识“LANXU”和产品标签在两个罐子上必须完全一致。视觉系统：“禅意奢华 + 自然有机”，核心概念“杯中云雾”。配色方案：岩灰、雾白、芽绿、琥珀茶色和氧化铜色。图形语言：抽象的山谷轮廓、稀薄的晨雾和扩散的茶汤层次。排版：现代宋体搭配简洁的无衬线字体，留白充裕。
布局：宽度约 1242px，垂直长图（比例 1:5）。包含七个连续模块：
1. “核心价值”：两罐茶叶与礼盒置于抽象的云雾山谷背景中，标题为“杯中云雾”。
2. “饮用价值”：干茶、叶底和清澈琥珀茶汤的微距摄影，标注“风味特征：以实际测评为准”。
3. “产地与原料”：抽象的茶园坡地与采摘细节，预留产地和海拔信息位置。
4. “制作工艺”：四个步骤（采摘、萎凋、烘焙、包装），预留工艺名称位置。
5. “冲泡体验”：白瓷盖碗、公道杯和注茶的写实场景；预留温度和时间信息位置。
6. “包装与规格”：清晰展示礼盒、两罐茶叶、开启状态及“100g x 2 罐”标签。
7. “购买信任”：礼赠场景、规格占位符及物流信息。
风格：结合真实商业摄影与精致平面设计的高端电商艺术指导。所有物品必须具备真实的比例和接触点。茶叶不得悬浮，雾气不得遮挡产品可见度。
仅展示核心文本：“LANXU”、“高山乌龙”、“杯中云雾”、“原叶形态”、“风味特征：占位符”、“产地信息：占位符”、“工艺信息：占位符”、“冲泡建议：占位符”、“100g x 2 罐”、“产品信息：占位符”。

en.title: Dessert Livestream Branding Cover System
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a marketing design matrix for baking livestreams, featuring specific color hex codes and kitchen textures.
en.prompt: Create a marketing and operational design-focused livestream cover system main image with the theme "{argument name="livestream theme" default="Every Wednesday at 8 PM, follow the pastry chef to turn failed cakes into the next surprise"}." The visual is not a single cover but a matrix of six vertical covers with a unified channel language, spread out as if pinned to a baking workstation backboard. Each cover showcases a moment of transformation from a failed scenario (e.g., collapsed cream, cracked chiffon, burnt caramel, failed cookies), maintaining a relaxed, professional, and authentic atmosphere. The composition features one main cover enlarged in the center, with others arranged around it, featuring small episode numbers, durations, and column badges on the edges. Lighting varies slightly within each cover but is unified by kitchen warm white light and reflections on stainless steel surfaces. The color system must include hex values: Cream White #F3E9DA, Butter Gold #D9B46B, Caramel Brown #9A6644, Stainless Steel Gray #B8BABC, Berry Dark Red #8F4B4E, Mint Ash Green #9AA99B. Material focus includes {argument name="material details" default="cream texture, baking paper, mixing bowl reflections, icing particles, and channel card lamination"}. Requires a small amount of Chinese text for series name, episode, and time, with short English subtitles, in a unified layout suitable for social platform distribution.

zh.title: 甜点直播品牌封面系统
zh.description: 一套用于创建烘焙直播营销设计矩阵的综合提示词，包含具体的颜色十六进制代码和厨房纹理。
zh.prompt: 创建一个以营销和运营设计为核心的直播封面系统主图，主题为“{argument name="直播主题" default="每周三晚 8 点，跟随甜点师将失败的蛋糕变成下一个惊喜"}”。视觉效果并非单一封面，而是一个包含六个垂直封面的矩阵，具有统一的频道语言，如同钉在烘焙工作台的项目板上。每个封面展示一个从失败场景（例如：塌陷的奶油、开裂的戚风、焦糊的焦糖、失败的饼干）到成功的转变瞬间，保持轻松、专业且真实的氛围。构图以一个放大的主封面为中心，其余封面围绕排列，边缘带有小的集数、时长和栏目徽章。每张封面内的光线略有不同，但统一为厨房暖白光和不锈钢表面的反射。色彩系统必须包含以下十六进制数值：奶油白 #F3E9DA、黄油金 #D9B46B、焦糖棕 #9A6644、不锈钢灰 #B8BABC、浆果深红 #8F4B4E、薄荷灰绿 #9AA99B。材质重点包括 {argument name="材质细节" default="奶油质感、烘焙纸、搅拌碗反射、糖霜颗粒和频道卡片覆膜"}。需要少量中文文本用于系列名称、集数和时间，并配以简短的英文副标题，采用适合社交平台分发的统一布局。

en.title: Oriental Embroidery Workshop Artistic Portrait
en.description: A sophisticated prompt for an artistic portrait of an Oriental woman in a traditional embroidery workshop, utilizing circular frames and thread textures.
en.prompt: 9:16 vertical orientation, artistic makeup portrait in an Oriental antique embroidery workshop, high-precision realistic photography using a giant circular embroidery frame as the foreground framing device. {argument name="subject" default="A clearly adult young Oriental female, visually aged about 25–28 years"} stands behind a large embroidery frame, her face and upper body visible through the floral patterns being embroidered. Colored silk threads extend from the edges toward the center, with an embroidery needle resting near her fingertips, capturing a moment in creation. One hand holds a slender gold needle, the other gently touches the falling threads, body leaning slightly forward, gaze looking straight through the frame into the camera—focused and soft, combining the poise of a noblewoman with the quiet power of a female creator. The character has a mature, natural Oriental classical bone structure, soft oval face, clear almond eyes with quiet light, and full lips. The makeup features a porcelain white base, preserving real skin texture. Eyeshadow is in peach pink and plum rose, with gold shimmer. Lips are finished with peach-red rose glass glaze. Black hair is styled in a lush classical bun with gold needles, white jade hairpins, and pearls. The clothing uses {argument name="clothing colors" default="pearl white, soft lotus purple, and light gold"}. The workshop is filled with wooden spools and metal needles, with a giant frame creating a natural scenic frame of embroidered peonies and butterflies. Soft warm white light falls from a skylight, with colored threads reflecting hues onto her face. Side lighting highlights her collarbone and waist, while the dark workshop background enhances the brightness of her skin and clothing.

zh.title: 东方刺绣工坊艺术人像
zh.description: 一个用于创作东方女性在传统刺绣工坊中艺术人像的精细提示词，巧妙运用圆形构图与丝线质感。
zh.prompt: 9:16 竖屏构图，东方古风刺绣工坊中的艺术妆造人像，采用高精度写实摄影风格，以巨大的圆形绣绷作为前景构图装置。{argument name="subject" default="一位外表年龄约 25–28 岁的成年东方女性"} 站在大型绣绷后方，她的面部和上半身透过正在绣制的繁花图案显现。彩色丝线从边缘向中心延伸，绣花针停留在指尖附近，捕捉创作瞬间。一只手捏着纤细的金针，另一只手轻触垂下的丝线，身体微微前倾，目光穿过绣绷直视镜头——神情专注而柔和，兼具贵族气质与女性创作者的静谧力量。人物拥有成熟、自然的东方古典骨相，柔和的鹅蛋脸，杏眼明亮且透着静谧光泽，双唇饱满。妆容采用瓷白底妆，保留真实皮肤质感。眼影为桃粉色与梅瑰色，带有金色细闪。唇妆为桃红玫瑰色玻璃唇釉。黑发梳成丰盈的古典发髻，饰以金针、白玉发簪和珍珠。服装采用 {argument name="clothing colors" default="珍珠白、柔莲紫和浅金色"}。工坊内摆放着木质线轴和金属针，巨大的绣绷自然形成了一个绣有牡丹与蝴蝶的取景框。柔和的暖白光从天窗洒下，彩色丝线将光影反射在她的脸上。侧光突显出她的锁骨与腰身，深色的工坊背景进一步衬托出皮肤与衣物的明亮度。

en.title: MiniDV Retro Arcade Photography Frames
en.description: A detailed multi-scene prompt simulating the low-fidelity aesthetic of millennium-era MiniDV home video captures in a nostalgic arcade setting.
en.prompt:
Core Intent:
Capture natural interactions between an adult woman and various arcade machines as a series of authentic MiniDV home video frames from around the millennium. 

Common Settings:
{argument name="video texture" default="Vertical portrait, clearly adult original female, authentic arcade environment. MiniDV home video quality, slight interlaced scan lines, color bleeding, dark noise, motion blur, and a timestamp/recording feel."} Characters preserve natural skin texture and slight asymmetries, avoiding excessive skin smoothing or commercial model posing. Arcade lights serve as ambient lighting, with soft top-mounted fill light illuminating the face; random light spots covering facial features are prohibited.

Frame 1:
Narrow claw machine aisle after closing. Slight high-angle shot from the top left; the woman has just finished restocking and is closing the glass door with one hand, body forming a diagonal line along the machine as she looks back at the camera. Shiny pink-white service uniform with an opaque low collar, cinched waist skirt, and stockings. Contrast between cool white cabinet light and dark hallway shadows.

Frame 2:
Old-school dance machine platform. Side-tracking shot from waist height; the woman has just finished the last beat, feet landed stably on two pedals, body still in slight motion with ponytail and skirt retaining inertia. Silver-blue stage uniform, with blue-purple reflections from the arcade screen and pedal lights; blur only appears on hair tips and background.

Frame 3:
Red and black racing simulator cockpit. Low-angle close-up from the side-front of the dashboard; the woman leans back naturally into the bucket seat after the race, shoulders relaxed, turning to look at the camera. Red and black racing-style uniform, with clear wheel, gauge, and seat structures; accurate physical interaction between body and equipment without clipping.

Frame 4:
Inside a pink photo booth. Camera near the outer curtain; the woman peeks her upper body out from between two pink plastic curtains, as if checking for friends after a photo. Black and white lace uniform, hands hidden behind curtains, focus on eyes, slightly parted lips, and close-range flash lighting.

Negative:
{argument name="negative prompt" default="Underage feel, doll-like face, excessive skin smoothing, plastic skin, random facial light spots, perfect commercial ad, modern HD cinema look, floating characters, clipping between equipment and body, deformed steering wheels, incorrect pedal placement, unnaturally enlarged foreground limbs, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, garbled text, real brand logos, watermarks."}

zh.title: MiniDV 复古街机摄影画框
zh.description: 一个详细的多场景提示词，旨在模拟千禧年代 MiniDV 家庭录像的低保真美学，营造怀旧的街机厅氛围。
zh.prompt:
核心意图：
捕捉一名成年女性与各种街机设备之间的自然互动，呈现为一系列千禧年前后真实的 MiniDV 家庭录像画框。

通用设置：
{argument name="video texture" default="竖屏人像，清晰的成年女性原貌，真实的街机环境。MiniDV 家庭录像画质，轻微的隔行扫描线、色彩溢出、暗部噪点、运动模糊以及时间戳/录制感。"} 人物保留自然的皮肤纹理和轻微的不对称感，避免过度磨皮或商业模特摆拍。以街机灯光作为环境光，配合顶部柔和的补光照亮面部；禁止面部出现随机光斑。

画框 1：
打烊后的狭窄抓娃娃机通道。左上方轻微高角度拍摄；女性刚完成补货，单手关闭玻璃门，身体沿机器呈对角线，回头看向镜头。身着闪亮的粉白色服务制服，配不透明低领、收腰裙和丝袜。冷白色柜台灯光与走廊阴影形成对比。

画框 2：
老式跳舞机平台。腰部高度的侧向平移镜头；女性刚完成最后一拍，双脚稳稳落在两个踏板上，身体仍保持轻微晃动，马尾辫和裙摆带有惯性。银蓝色舞台制服，映衬着街机屏幕和踏板发出的蓝紫色反光；仅发梢和背景出现模糊。

画框 3：
红黑配色赛车模拟器驾驶舱。仪表盘侧前方的低角度特写；比赛结束后，女性自然地靠在桶形座椅上，双肩放松，转头看向镜头。红黑赛车风格制服，方向盘、仪表盘和座椅结构清晰；身体与设备之间有准确的物理交互，无穿模现象。

画框 4：
粉色大头贴照相亭内。相机位于外侧帘子附近；女性从两片粉色塑料帘子间探出上半身，仿佛在拍照后寻找朋友。黑白蕾丝制服，双手藏在帘子后，焦点对准眼睛，嘴唇微张，带有近距离闪光灯效果。

负面提示词：
{argument name="negative prompt" default="未成年感、玩偶脸、过度磨皮、塑料感皮肤、随机面部光斑、完美的商业广告感、现代高清电影质感、人物悬浮、设备与身体穿模、变形的方向盘、错误的踏板位置、不自然放大的前景肢体、多指、肢体重复、乱码文字、真实品牌 Logo、水印。"}

en.title: Sun-Drenched Resort Fashion Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed, multi-section prompt for a professional resort fashion photograph featuring a woman in a white bikini on a wooden deck by the sea.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="theme" default="Unwinding by the Blue Waters at Noon"}

Main Subject:
A vertical resort portrait of a woman lounging in {argument name="clothing" default="white swimwear"} on a black wooden deck jutting out over a highly transparent blue sea, basking in the sunlight. One leg dangles toward the water's surface, while she sits with the other knee raised.

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Her face is tilted diagonally upward, and her eyes are covered with large brown sunglasses. A peaceful expression with lips slightly parted. Natural, glossy skin with light coral lips and a subtle healthy glow. Her hair is {argument name="hair style" default="lustrous black long hair"} reaching below her chest, spreading out behind her in the breeze.

Clothing/Pose:
An ivory-white bikini top featuring thin shoulder straps, ruffles, and a central ribbon tie. Paired with matching short bottoms with fine ruffles and a thin white striped cover-up draped loosely over her shoulders. She leans her upper body back, supporting herself with one hand on the deck. One knee is bent high, while the other leg is stretched long with the foot lowered near the water. Delicate silver anklets on both ankles.

Background/Light:
The majority of the frame is occupied by a clear sea surface transitioning from turquoise to deep blue. The shallow seabed and fine ripples are visible through the water, with strong summer sunlight creating white glints on the surface. Beside her on the deck are a lace-trimmed straw hat and a soft mustard-beige cloth. Bright natural light from a high position creates soft shadows with distinct outlines.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. The subject is positioned toward the bottom right of the screen, leaving wide open sea space from the top left to the top. A full-body-oriented composition capturing from head to toe, with the corner of the deck extending diagonally from the bottom right to the center. A slightly elevated perspective looking down diagonally. Captured clearly, the patterns on the subject and the water surface are sharp, while the distant sea surface becomes gently soft.

Texture/Style:
A high-resolution realistic resort fashion photograph. Precise depiction of natural skin texture, sheer thin fabric, fine ruffles, and the glistening water surface. A bright and refreshing color palette centered on vibrant blue and soft ivory.

Negative:
Deformed hands or feet; unnatural contact between legs and water; distorted sunglasses

zh.title: 阳光明媚的度假风时尚人像
zh.description: 这是一份高度详细、多板块的专业度假风时尚摄影提示词，描绘了一位身穿白色比基尼的女性在海边木质露台上休憩的场景。
zh.prompt:
主题：
{argument name="theme" default="正午时分，在蔚蓝水畔放松身心"}

主体：
一张竖构图的度假风人像，一位女性身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="白色泳装"}，在延伸至清澈湛蓝海面上的黑色木质露台上休憩，沐浴在阳光下。她的一条腿垂向水面，另一条腿膝盖弯曲抬起。

人物/表情：
一位 20 多岁的女性。面部微微斜向上仰，戴着一副棕色大墨镜。表情宁静，双唇微张。皮肤自然且富有光泽，涂着浅珊瑚色唇膏，散发着淡淡的健康光彩。她的头发是 {argument name="hair style" default="垂至胸下的乌黑长发"}，在微风中向身后散开。

服装/姿势：
象牙白比基尼上衣，带有细肩带、荷叶边和中央系带设计。搭配同款带有细密荷叶边的短裤，肩上松松地披着一件白色细条纹罩衫。她上半身向后倾斜，一只手撑在露台上。一条膝盖高高弯曲，另一条腿伸展，脚尖垂向水面附近。双脚脚踝处戴着精致的银色脚链。

背景/光影：
画面大部分被从青绿色过渡到深蓝色的清澈海面占据。透过水面可以看到浅浅的海床和细微的涟漪，强烈的夏日阳光在水面上投射出点点白光。她身旁的露台上放着一顶带有蕾丝边的草帽和一块柔软的芥末米色布料。来自高位的明亮自然光营造出轮廓清晰的柔和阴影。

构图/摄影：
竖构图 3:4。主体位于画面右下方，从左上角到顶部留出广阔的海面空间。全身构图，从头到脚完整呈现，露台的一角从右下角向中心斜向延伸。略微俯视的斜向视角。画面清晰，主体细节和水面纹理锐利，远处的海面则呈现出柔和的虚化效果。

质感/风格：
高分辨率写实度假风时尚摄影。精准刻画自然的皮肤纹理、轻薄的面料、精致的荷叶边以及波光粼粼的水面。以鲜艳的蓝色和柔和的象牙色为核心的明亮清爽色调。

负面提示词：
畸形的手或脚；腿部与水面的接触不自然；墨镜变形

en.title: Dynamic Jumping Summer Portrait
en.description: A highly detailed prompt for a realistic fashion portrait of a woman in a white dress jumping at the seaside under a bright summer sky.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="White jumping into the blue sky"}

Main Subject:
A vertical live-action fashion portrait of a woman in a {argument name="clothing" default="white mini dress"} jumping high on a {argument name="location" default="seaside promenade"} under a vivid blue sky. She is arching her body gracefully against the wind, with one leg bent back and arms stretched up and down.

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Face tilted diagonally upward, with a calm and liberating expression with eyes closed. Soft contours, natural eyebrows, thin eyeliner, light coral cheeks and lips, and transparent, modest Japanese-style makeup. Long black hair spreads widely to the left of the screen, caught by a strong wind.

Clothing/Pose:
Ivory white mini dress with thin shoulder straps. The chest has three-dimensional lace and fine embroidery, the torso has a corset-style transition that follows the body, and the skirt is designed with light ruffles and multiple layers of translucent fabric. Wearing white short boots. Jumps off the leg on the right side of the screen, with the other leg bent deep and raised back. One arm stretches in an arc overhead, and the other arm spreads to the bottom left of the screen.

Background/Light:
A summer seaside promenade. In the middle ground are black metal fences and flower beds, and in the distance is a white suspension bridge, the sea surface, and city buildings. Green trees enter on the left end, and reddish-brown brick paving spreads underfoot. Dark blue sky with few clouds and strong natural light. Bright direct light hits the person's skin and white costume, casting a clear shadow on the ground.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Dynamic low-angle composition showing the whole body. The person occupies a large portion from the center to the right side of the screen, leaving wide blue sky margins at the top and left. Light wide-angle perspective emphasizing the height of the jump and long legs. The person and costume are sharp, while the distant bridge and buildings are slightly soft and blurred.

Texture/Style:
High-resolution live-action fashion photography. Precisely expresses natural skin texture, fine lace, layers of thin fabric, and hair moving in the wind. Vivid contrast between the blue sky and white costume, clean summer colors, and natural photographic expression without excessive HDR or strong filters.

Negative:
Collapsed jumping posture; unnatural deformation of limbs or joints; unnatural fusion of dress hem and legs

zh.title: 夏日动态跳跃人像
zh.description: 一份高细节提示词，用于生成一张写实风格的时尚人像，描绘一位身穿白裙的女性在明亮的夏日天空下于海边跳跃的场景。
zh.prompt:
主体：
{argument name="subject" default="跃入蓝天的白色身影"}

主要主体：
一张竖构图的写实时尚人像，描绘了一位身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="白色迷你裙"} 的女性在 {argument name="location" default="海滨步道"} 上，于明亮的蓝天下高高跃起。她迎着风优雅地拱起身体，一条腿向后弯曲，双臂上下舒展。

人物/表情：
20 多岁的女性。面部微微斜向上仰，闭着双眼，表情平静而自由。轮廓柔和，眉毛自然，画着细眼线，脸颊和嘴唇带有淡淡的珊瑚色，呈现出透明、简约的日系妆容。乌黑的长发被强风吹起，向画面左侧大幅散开。

服装/姿势：
象牙白细肩带迷你裙。胸部饰有立体蕾丝和精细刺绣，躯干部分采用贴合身体的紧身胸衣式剪裁，裙摆设计有轻盈的荷叶边和多层半透明面料。脚穿白色短靴。右腿蹬地跳起，另一条腿向后深弯。一只手臂在头顶上方划出一道弧线，另一只手臂向画面左下方伸展。

背景/光线：
夏日海滨步道。中景处有黑色金属围栏和花坛，远处可见白色悬索桥、海面和城市建筑。左侧有绿树入画，脚下铺着红棕色砖块。深蓝色的天空中云朵稀疏，自然光强烈。明亮的直射光照射在人物皮肤和白色服装上，在地面投下清晰的阴影。

构图/摄影：
竖构图 3:4。动态低角度构图，展示全身。人物占据了从画面中心到右侧的大部分空间，顶部和左侧留出大面积的蓝天余白。轻微的广角透视强调了跳跃的高度和修长的双腿。人物和服装清晰锐利，远处的桥梁和建筑略显柔和模糊。

质感/风格：
高分辨率写实时尚摄影。精准表现出自然的皮肤纹理、精致的蕾丝、轻薄的面料层次以及随风飘动的发丝。蓝天与白色服装形成鲜明对比，色彩清新明快，呈现出自然的摄影质感，无过度 HDR 或强滤镜效果。

负面提示词：
崩坏的跳跃姿势；肢体或关节不自然的变形；裙摆与腿部不自然的融合

en.title: Salon Fresh Beauty Portrait
en.description: A professional-grade photographic prompt for a woman's portrait in a hair salon, focusing on lighting, hair texture, and realistic skin details.
en.prompt:
9:16 aspect ratio, a realistic beauty portrait taken {argument name="location" default="by a hair salon window"}.
Depict only one fictional adult East Asian female who is not a real person.
Appearance is {argument name="age" default="mid-20s"}.
Place the center of the woman's face at approximately 50% of the screen width, and the visual center of the upper body including hair, shoulders, and chest at approximately 50% to create a natural centered composition.
Leave approximately 2-3% margin from the top edge for the top of the head, the face occupies approximately 18-47% from the top, and the long hair and shoulders are contained from the center to the bottom edge.
Do not unnaturally cut off the forehead, chin, main hair, shoulders, or the knit top at the chest.
At the bottom edge, cut where the hair and knit naturally continue, making sure the background is less prominent than the person.

The woman sits straight in a salon chair, facing the upper body toward the front.
The face is almost front-on, turned very slightly toward the right of the screen.
Steady expression with dark brown eyes looking directly at the camera and lips slightly parted.
Not smiling too much, conveying a sense of satisfaction and quiet confidence immediately after a salon treatment.
Keep the neck long, shoulders relaxed, and posture natural and elegant.

Face shape is a natural oval.
Level the height and size of both eyes, and place thin window catchlights in the pupils.
Eyebrows are a soft dark brown matching the hair color.
Eye area has light brown and rose beige tones, thin eyelashes, and subtle eyeliner.
Faint pink flush on the cheeks, and transparent rose pink on the lips.
Skin is bright and healthy, leaving fine pores and natural color variations on the cheeks, nose, and forehead.
Do not overemphasize the bridge of the nose or cheekbones, and avoid overly uniform porcelain skin.

Hair is long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair reaching the chest.
Add loose S-shaped waves throughout, flowing naturally over both shoulders.
The bangs are thin, see-through bangs, with parts of the eyebrows and forehead visible.
Create thin layers around the face from the cheeks to the chin, with the ends swaying irregularly inward and outward.
The surface of the hair catches the window light with thin warm highlights, while the interior maintains deep brown shadows.
Do not repeat hair bundles in the same shape, leave a small amount of flyaway hairs.

The outfit is a solid {argument name="clothing color" default="muted rose"} or mauve pink thin knit top.
A boat neck-style round neckline that isn't too wide.
Realistic fine knit weave, natural wrinkles around the collarbone, and gentle drapes falling over the shoulders and chest.
Add one thin gold necklace at the neckline.
No logos, text, patterns, excessive decoration, or transparency.

Foreground is the woman's hair, face, and knit chest area.
Middle ground is the salon chair and window frame.
On the background left, place a long rounded rectangular mirror, a small warm light, and a blurred brown salon chair.
On the background right, softly blur a large window, a light gray concrete pillar, outside tree branches, and a blue-gray cityscape.
Do not show unnatural people, faces, hands, cameras, or text in the mirror reflection.
Subtly convey the salon atmosphere through the chair, mirror, and lighting.

Camera is at approximately the same height as the woman's eye level.
Shot from a short distance directly in front, containing from the upper chest to the top of the head in a vertical frame.
Focal length feel is 55-70mm.
Avoid wide-angle face stretching, nose exaggeration, or shoulder distortion.
Focus clearly on both eyes, eyelashes, lips, and hair bundles around the face, with a shallow depth of field that gracefully blurs the chest, background mirror, chair, and outside window.

Main light source is soft afternoon natural light coming from the large window on the right.
The light brightens the right side of the bangs, forehead, cheek, bridge of the nose, lips, and hair surface, leaving faint warm shadows on the left side hair and cheek.
The salon lighting on the background left is used as a weak warm fill light.
Avoid hard shadows, blown-out highlights, or too strong rim lighting.
Color temperature naturally mixes the neutral light from the window with the faint warmth of the room.
Overall color palette is mauve pink, dark brown, ivory, light gray, and low-saturation blue from outside the window.

Realistically depict skin pores, natural moisture on the lips, transparency of the eyes, thin eyelashes, individual strands of bangs, the flow of the waves, the knit weave, and reflections in the mirror and window.
Clean and sophisticated quality suitable for commercial hair salon, haircare, cosmetics, beauty, or fashion visuals.
No text, logos, brand names, signatures, or watermarks.
Avoid extra people, extra faces, incorrect mirror reflections, extra arms or fingers, asymmetrical eyes, distorted mouths, fused hair, repeating hair bundles, melted knits, broken chairs, doll-like skin, excessive beautification, overly strong HDR, or illustration styles.

zh.title: 沙龙清新美妆肖像
zh.description: 一款专业级的摄影提示词，用于拍摄发廊环境下的女性肖像，重点呈现光影、发质细节及真实的皮肤质感。
zh.prompt:
9:16 比例，一张真实的精美肖像，拍摄地点为 {argument name="location" default="发廊窗边"}。
仅描绘一名虚构的成年东亚女性，非真实人物。
外貌设定为 {argument name="age" default="20 多岁"}。
将女性面部中心置于屏幕宽度约 50% 处，包括头发、肩膀和胸部在内的上半身视觉中心也置于约 50% 处，以营造自然的居中构图。
头顶上方留出约 2-3% 的边距，面部占据从顶部起约 18-47% 的空间，长发和肩膀包含在从中心到下边缘的区域内。
不要不自然地截断额头、下巴、主要发束、肩膀或胸前的针织上衣。
在下边缘处，在头发和针织衫自然延伸的位置截断，确保背景比人物主体更虚化。

女性端坐在沙龙椅上，上半身朝向前方。
面部几乎正对镜头，略微转向屏幕右侧。
表情沉稳，深棕色的双眼直视镜头，嘴唇微张。
不要过度微笑，传达出刚做完沙龙护理后的满足感与从容自信。
保持颈部修长，肩膀放松，姿态自然优雅。

脸型为自然的椭圆形。
双眼高度和大小一致，瞳孔中有细长的窗户反光。
眉毛为与发色相称的柔和深棕色。
眼部采用浅棕色和玫瑰米色调，睫毛纤细，带有淡淡的眼线。
脸颊带有淡淡的粉色红晕，嘴唇呈现透明的玫瑰粉色。
皮肤明亮健康，保留脸颊、鼻尖和额头上的细小毛孔及自然的肤色变化。
不要过度强调鼻梁或颧骨，避免过于均匀的陶瓷肌效果。

发型为长款 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 秀发，长度及胸。
整体添加松散的 S 型波浪卷，自然地垂落在双肩上。
刘海为轻薄的空气刘海，隐约可见眉毛和额头。
从脸颊到下巴处修剪出细碎的层次，发尾呈现不规则的内外翻卷。
发丝表面捕捉窗户光线，带有细微的暖色高光，内部保持深棕色的阴影。
不要重复相同形状的发束，保留少量自然凌乱的碎发。

服装为纯色 {argument name="clothing color" default="柔和玫瑰色"} 或藕粉色薄款针织上衣。
船领风格的圆领，领口不宜过宽。
真实的细针织纹理，锁骨周围有自然的褶皱，衣物柔和地垂落在肩膀和胸前。
领口处佩戴一条细金项链。
无任何标志、文字、图案、过度装饰或透明感。

前景为女性的头发、面部和针织衫胸部区域。
中景为沙龙椅和窗框。
背景左侧放置一个长圆角矩形镜子、一盏暖色小灯以及模糊的棕色沙龙椅。
背景右侧柔和虚化一扇大窗户、浅灰色混凝土柱、窗外树枝以及蓝灰色的城市景观。
镜面反射中不得出现不自然的人物、面孔、手部、相机或文字。
通过椅子、镜子和灯光微妙地传达沙龙氛围。

相机高度与女性视线平齐。
从正前方近距离拍摄，垂直构图包含从上胸部到头顶的区域。
焦距感约为 55-70mm。
避免广角镜头导致的面部拉伸、鼻子夸张或肩膀畸变。
清晰对焦于双眼、睫毛、嘴唇和脸周发束，浅景深效果优雅地虚化胸部、背景镜子、椅子和窗外景色。

主光源为来自右侧大窗户的柔和午后自然光。
光线照亮刘海右侧、额头、脸颊、鼻梁、嘴唇和头发表面，在左侧头发和脸颊留下淡淡的暖色阴影。
背景左侧的沙龙灯光作为微弱的暖色补光。
避免强烈的阴影、过曝的高光或过强的轮廓光。
色温自然融合了窗户的中性光与室内的微弱暖意。
整体色调为藕粉色、深棕色、象牙白、浅灰色以及窗外的低饱和度蓝色。

真实呈现皮肤毛孔、嘴唇的自然润泽感、眼睛的通透感、纤细的睫毛、刘海的单根发丝、波浪的流向、针织纹理以及镜子和窗户的反射。
画面干净精致，适用于商业发廊、护发、化妆品、美妆或时尚视觉内容。
无文字、标志、品牌名称、签名或水印。
避免出现多余人物、多余面孔、错误的镜面反射、多余的手臂或手指、不对称的眼睛、扭曲的嘴部、发丝粘连、重复的发束、融化的针织纹理、破损的椅子、玩偶般的皮肤、过度美颜、过强的 HDR 或插画风格。

en.title: Sword Princess Character Reference Sheet
en.description: A specialized prompt for GPT Image 2 to create a high-quality fantasy character reference sheet featuring a 'Sword Princess' and a 'General', including full-body views, facial details, and weapon guides in a theatrical anime style.
en.prompt:
# Reference and Purpose
- Attach one {argument name="reference" default="full-body female reference image"} owned by the user.
- Apply the reference image only to the {argument name="subject" default="Princess"}, not to the General.
- Create one 1:1 square character sheet suitable for sharing and video production reference.
- Balance visual appeal with practical utility for identifying persons, outfits, and weapons.
- No storyboards; no depictions of background such as castle or throne.

# Inheritance of Reference Subject
Inherit the Princess's facial features, eyes, face shape, nose/mouth, hairstyle, color, bangs, parting, length, age, skin, height, proportions, and body type from the reference image. Maintain identity across all views without excessive beautification or aging. Do not inherit outfit, color scheme, or background from the reference.

# Expression
- Delicate lines equivalent to theatrical anime, high-quality cel shading, and refined texture for metal, cloth, and gems.
- Sophisticated finish equivalent to an official artbook.
- Avoid 3D, realistic, or cheap TV anime styles.

# Fixed Character Design
## Princess
- Slender and elegant royal fencer.
- Pearl-white high-grade combat attire, avoiding excessive exposure.
- Chrome silver shoulder/arm/waist armor. Do not cover the entire chest in metal.
- Royal crimson short divided tabard and long sash.
- Pearl-white knee-high boots with crimson/chrome accents.
- Champagne gold trim, royal crest motifs, small emeralds, and a thin circlet.

## Royal Sword
Slender silver straight sword with a curved gold guard, dark green grip, crown pommel, and dark brown scabbard.

## General
- Mature male, taller and broader than the Princess, stern angular face, short black hair with grey.
- Heavy armor made of blackened steel and high-quality gunmetal.
- Multi-layered breastplate, broad pauldrons, high collar, gold inlay, lion/raptor reliefs.
- Black velvet cloak with dark green lining, dark brown leather belt.

# Layout
1:1 square. Top 6% title, upper section 56%, lower section 38%.
Background is white to light ivory. Titles: `{argument name="title" default="SWORD PRINCESS"}` and `CHARACTER REFERENCE` only.

## Upper Section
- `01 PRINCESS HERO` (45%): Full-body 3/4 view in battle-ready pose.
- `02 PRINCESS FRONT` (22%): Full-body front view.
- `03 GENERAL COMBAT` (33%): Full-body 3/4 view of the General.

## Lower Section
- `04 PRINCESS FACE` (32%): Two facial views (front and 3/4).
- `05 GENERAL FACE` (16%): One facial view of the General.
- `07 ASSET GUIDE` (24%): Weapons and color palette.
- `06 GENERAL SURRENDER` (28%): General kneeling on one knee.

zh.title: 剑之公主角色参考图
zh.description: 为 GPT Image 2 设计的专用提示词，旨在创作高质量的奇幻角色参考图，包含“剑之公主”与“将军”，涵盖全身视图、面部细节及武器指南，呈现剧场版动画风格。
zh.prompt:
# 参考与目的
- 附上一张用户拥有的 {argument name="reference" default="全身女性参考图"}。
- 参考图仅应用于 {argument name="subject" default="公主"}，不应用于将军。
- 创建一张 1:1 的方形角色参考图，适用于分享及视频制作参考。
- 在视觉美感与识别人物、服装及武器的实用性之间取得平衡。
- 无需分镜；不包含城堡或王座等背景描绘。

# 参考主体继承
从参考图中继承公主的面部特征、眼睛、脸型、鼻/嘴、发型、颜色、刘海、发缝、长度、年龄、肤色、身高、比例及体型。在所有视图中保持身份一致，避免过度美化或显老。不要继承参考图中的服装、配色方案或背景。

# 表现手法
- 细腻的线条，等同于剧场版动画，高质量赛璐珞着色，以及金属、布料和宝石的精致质感。
- 等同于官方设定集的精细完成度。
- 避免 3D、写实或廉价的电视动画风格。

# 固定角色设计
## 公主
- 纤细优雅的皇家剑士。
- 珍珠白高级战斗服，避免过度暴露。
- 铬银色肩甲/臂甲/腰甲。金属部分不要覆盖整个胸部。
- 皇家深红色短款开叉罩衫及长腰带。
- 珍珠白及膝长靴，配有深红/铬色装饰。
- 香槟金镶边、皇家纹章图案、小颗祖母绿及细头环。

## 皇家之剑
纤细的银色直剑，配有弯曲的金色护手、深绿色握柄、皇冠剑首及深棕色剑鞘。

## 将军
- 成熟男性，比公主更高大魁梧，面部轮廓刚毅，黑色短发夹杂灰发。
- 由黑钢和优质枪金属制成的重甲。
- 多层胸甲、宽大肩甲、高领、金饰镶嵌、狮子/猛禽浮雕。
- 黑色天鹅绒斗篷，内衬深绿色，配有深棕色皮带。

# 布局
1:1 方形。顶部 6% 为标题，上部区域 56%，下部区域 38%。
背景为白色至浅象牙色。标题仅限：`{argument name="title" default="SWORD PRINCESS"}` 和 `CHARACTER REFERENCE`。

## 上部区域
- `01 PRINCESS HERO` (45%)：战斗姿态的全身 3/4 视图。
- `02 PRINCESS FRONT` (22%)：全身正面视图。
- `03 GENERAL COMBAT` (33%)：将军的全身 3/4 视图。

## 下部区域
- `04 PRINCESS FACE` (32%)：两个面部视图（正面和 3/4）。
- `05 GENERAL FACE` (16%)：将军的一个面部视图。
- `07 ASSET GUIDE` (24%)：武器和调色板。
- `06 GENERAL SURRENDER` (28%)：将军单膝跪地的姿态。

en.title: Gothic Art Nouveau Tarot Card
en.description: A prompt to transform an original character into a mystical tarot card using a fusion of Art Nouveau and Gothic fantasy styles, complete with golden frames and holographic effects.

Create an illustration using the quoted character image as the protagonist, selecting one random card from the {argument name="card group" default="Major Arcana (22 cards)"} based on the {argument name="tarot style" default="Rider-Waite Tarot"} motif.

[Basic Rules]
- Replace the figure with the quoted character.
- Maintain the character's face, hairstyle, color scheme, and unique features.
- Follow the Rider-Waite composition, symbols, props, poses, and worldview.
- Change the outfit.
- Design the background fantastically according to the card's meaning.
- High-definition fantasy illustration.
- Luxurious design fusing Art Nouveau and Gothic fantasy.

masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, highly detailed, fantasy illustration, magical atmosphere, cinematic lighting, intricate gold ornament, tarot card style, holographic foil finish, rainbow reflections, prismatic diffraction, embossed gold foil, reflective gemstone highlights.

zh.description: 一个将原创角色转化为神秘塔罗牌的提示词，融合了新艺术运动与哥特式奇幻风格，并配有金色边框和全息效果。

以引用的角色图像为主角创作一幅插画，从 {argument name="card group" default="大阿卡纳 (22 张)"} 中随机选择一张卡牌，并基于 {argument name="tarot style" default="韦特塔罗牌 (Rider-Waite Tarot)"} 的主题进行设计。

- 根据卡牌含义设计奇幻背景。
- 高清奇幻插画。

[质量关键词]
杰作 (masterpiece), 最佳质量 (best quality), 超精细 (ultra detailed), 高度细节 (highly detailed), 奇幻插画 (fantasy illustration), 魔法氛围 (magical atmosphere), 电影级光效 (cinematic lighting), 复杂的金色装饰 (intricate gold ornament), 塔罗牌风格 (tarot card style), 全息箔面处理 (holographic foil finish), 彩虹反射 (rainbow reflections), 棱镜衍射 (prismatic diffraction), 浮雕金箔 (embossed gold foil), 反光宝石高光 (reflective gemstone highlights).

en.title: English Vocabulary Study Card Template
en.description: A detailed prompt for creating professional educational flashcards with a vibrant, editorial illustration style. It features organized layouts for definitions, pronunciations, examples, and collocations, set against a warm classroom-inspired color palette.
en.prompt:
Create an exquisite 4:5 vertical English vocabulary study card for A2–B1 level learners.

Card Type: Comprehensive Vocabulary Card
Theme: {argument name="card theme" default="vibrant editorial illustration"}
Palette: Sunshine Classroom
Colors: {argument name="color scheme" default="Primary Cobalt Blue #2563EB, Secondary Coral Red #FF6B5C, Secondary Lemon Yellow #FFD84D, Secondary Sky Blue #7DD3FC, Dark Text #17324D, Warm Cream Background #FFF9E8"}.

Accurately display the following text:

{argument name="word" default="library"}
/ˈlaɪ.brər.i/
noun

图书馆

Places where people can read or borrow books and other materials.

We borrowed two books from the library.
We borrowed two books from the library.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS
Go to the library (go to the library)
Borrow from the library (borrow from the library)
Public library (public library)
Library card (library card)

GRAMMAR
Countable noun (a countable noun)
Plural form: libraries (plural: libraries)

RELATED WORDS
Librarian (librarian) · Shelf (shelf) · Catalogue (catalogue)

Create a warm, modern library flat vector cross-section illustration. Show a learner borrowing two books from a librarian, naturally including bookshelves and a library card. Keep character figures friendly but editorial rather than childish.

Arrange information like a professionally published learner's dictionary page: prominent headword, compact pronunciation line, clear definitions, highlighted example sentences, and neatly grouped learning modules. Use generous white space.

Use pure flat colors and clean line art. No gradients, shadows, 3D, gloss effects, photorealism, visual clutter, logos, or watermarks. Keep all body text dark and legible. Accurately replicate provided English, IPA, and Simplified Chinese without adding extra text.

zh.title: 英语词汇学习卡片模板
zh.description: 一个用于创建专业教育类闪卡的详细提示词，采用生动且具有编辑风格的插画设计。该模板包含针对定义、发音、例句和搭配的有序布局，并采用温暖的课堂风格配色方案。
zh.prompt:
创建一个精致的 4:5 竖版英语词汇学习卡片，适用于 A2–B1 级别的学习者。

卡片类型：综合词汇卡
主题：{argument name="card theme" default="生动的编辑风格插画"}
调色板：阳光课堂
颜色：{argument name="color scheme" default="主色钴蓝色 #2563EB，辅色珊瑚红 #FF6B5C，辅色柠檬黄 #FFD84D，辅色天蓝色 #7DD3FC，深色文字 #17324D，温暖奶油色背景 #FFF9E8"}。

准确显示以下文本：

{argument name="word" default="library"}
/ˈlaɪ.brər.i/
noun

图书馆

Places where people can read or borrow books and other materials.

We borrowed two books from the library.
We borrowed two books from the library.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS
Go to the library (go to the library)
Borrow from the library (borrow from the library)
Public library (public library)
Library card (library card)

GRAMMAR
Countable noun (a countable noun)
Plural form: libraries (plural: libraries)

RELATED WORDS
Librarian (librarian) · Shelf (shelf) · Catalogue (catalogue)

创建一个温暖、现代的图书馆扁平矢量剖面插画。展示一名学习者从图书管理员处借阅两本书的场景，自然地融入书架和借书卡元素。人物形象应保持亲和力，风格偏向编辑类插画而非低幼化。

像专业出版的学习者词典页面一样排列信息：突出的词条、紧凑的发音行、清晰的定义、高亮显示的例句以及整齐分组的学习模块。使用充足的留白。

使用纯扁平色彩和简洁的线条艺术。禁止使用渐变、阴影、3D、光泽效果、照片写实风格、视觉杂乱、Logo 或水印。确保所有正文清晰易读。准确复刻提供的英语、IPA 和简体中文内容，不要添加额外文本。

en.title: Musang King Durian Commercial Poster
en.description: A commercial illustration prompt for a Musang King durian poster. It features a paper-cut texture, layered composition, and vibrant yellow-green tones, including detailed fruit textures and stylized hand-drawn typography.
en.prompt: Vertical 3:4 {argument name="subject" default="Musang King Durian"} themed commercial poster, with a {argument name="background color" default="warm cream-white full background"}, overlaid with low-contrast mustard yellow sunburst patterns, light green leaf silhouettes, and small spiky geometric patterns. On the bottom right, place a whole Musang King durian and one naturally split open; the whole fruit is a plump oval with a yellow-green to olive-green shell covered in dense, thick, orderly conical spikes; the split shell reveals several clear fruit chambers with golden-yellow plump pulp inside, featuring a thick, dense, and smooth texture. The top left uses {argument name="font style" default="thick and whimsical hand-drawn fonts"} to present '猫山王榴莲' (Musang King Durian) with golden-yellow fill, cream-white inner lines, and dark green outer strokes; the subtitle '金黄绵密 浓香细滑' is placed on an olive-green wavy ribbon, with the English 'MUSANG KING DURIAN' in a circular seal format. Add tropical leaves, fruit aroma curves, pulp color blocks, starlight, and small shell icons to the background. High-saturation Q-style vector illustration, layered paper-cut texture, small amount of screen-print grain, background must not be black.

zh.title: 猫山王榴莲商业海报
zh.description: 一份用于猫山王榴莲海报的商业插画提示词。包含剪纸质感、分层构图以及鲜艳的黄绿色调，并涵盖细腻的水果纹理和风格化的手绘字体。
zh.prompt: 垂直 3:4 {argument name="subject" default="猫山王榴莲"} 主题商业海报，采用 {argument name="background color" default="暖奶油白色全背景"}，叠加低对比度的芥末黄放射状图案、浅绿色叶片剪影以及小型尖刺几何图案。右下角放置一个完整的猫山王榴莲和一个自然裂开的榴莲；完整果实呈饱满的椭圆形，黄绿色至橄榄绿色的外壳上覆盖着密集、粗壮且整齐的圆锥形尖刺；裂开的果壳露出几个清晰的果室，内部是金黄饱满的果肉，呈现出浓厚、绵密且顺滑的质感。左上方使用 {argument name="font style" default="粗体且充满趣味的手绘字体"} 展示“猫山王榴莲”，字体填充金黄色，带有奶油白色内描边和深绿色外描边；副标题“金黄绵密 浓香细滑”置于橄榄绿色的波浪丝带上，并配有圆形印章格式的英文“MUSANG KING DURIAN”。背景添加热带叶片、果香曲线、果肉色块、星光及小型果壳图标。高饱和度 Q 版矢量插画，分层剪纸质感，带有少量丝网印刷颗粒，背景不得为黑色。

en.title: Premium 6-Panel Grilled Meat Campaign
en.description: A master layout prompt for a high-end food brand, creating a disciplined 2x3 grid poster. It focuses on tactile realism for grilled meats and flatbreads with a sophisticated, saturated color rhythm.
en.prompt:
为名为 EMBER WRAP 的虚构烤肉品牌创建一张超高端的 2x3 六格商业海报。结合 Milk Cloud Orbit 的触感丰盈与 Cream Halo Transit 的结构严谨，同时扩大负空间，加强色块节奏，并使烤肉与大饼之间的互动更具雕塑感和高端感。最终画面必须具有世界级旗舰街头美食营销广告的质感：图形化、超写实、令人垂涎且具有收藏级品质，六个高度自律的微型海报共同构成一个高端的整体布局。仅使用英文品牌标识。

核心布局：
采用严格的 2x3 六格网格，六个面板大小一致。整体布局必须极具控制感、宽敞且高端，每个面板内部留白更多，且在整个 2x3 结构中具有更强的视觉节奏。每个面板都应被视为成熟品牌活动的一部分，而非随机拼贴。最终海报必须具有图形感、有序感并可直接发布。

Milk Cloud Orbit 强化：
在每个面板中进一步推向触感真实。烤肉必须显示出更丰富的纤维、更深的焦边、更好的油脂渲染、更多汁的切面以及更高端的烘烤光泽。大饼必须感觉更温暖、更柔软、有更多焦斑且更具触感。白酱、奶油或浓郁酱汁的细节在应用处必须感觉更粘稠、更有物理重量感。蔬菜、碎屑、香料点缀、香料粉末和微小的油脂高光都必须感觉更锐利，达到收藏级品质。

Cream Halo Transit 精炼：
加强所有六个面板的品牌系统纪律。统一标题层级、描述文字位置、品牌组合标识、可选辅助文字以及视觉节奏。六个面板必须感觉像是一个精致的高端美食品牌系列。食物、文字和色彩的排列必须感觉更加一致、成熟且经过精心的艺术指导。

面板内容逻辑：
六个面板必须包含：
1. 垂直肉串或堆叠烤肉主角图
2. 卷起的大饼肉卷
3. 带有高端酱汁浇筑的盘装切片肉
4. 铺满肉和新鲜蔬菜的开口大饼
5. 雕刻或刀切肉的特写主角图
6. 带有配菜互动的盘装肉饼组合
三个面板应强调独立的烤肉主角形式，三个面板应强调肉与大饼的搭配。每个面板必须保持独特，同时明确属于同一系列。

负空间：
增加每个面板内的内部呼吸空间。不要让食物或文字显得拥挤。让烤肉、大饼和配菜结构占据更清晰、更独立的视觉区域，使构图感觉更高端、更具营销价值。留白必须感觉是刻意而为且昂贵的。

色块节奏：
至关重要。将六格背景系统推向更强、更自律的节奏。使用协调的高端饱和色调，如深红、焦橙、炭黑、鼠尾草绿、暖芥末色和深酒红，按照视觉上的音乐顺序排列在网格中。六个面板的色彩强度必须平衡，光暗色块交替更加清晰。

雕塑感食物互动：
至关重要。在组合面板中，使烤肉与大饼之间的关系更具雕塑感和设计感。饼不应只是垫在肉下面；它应该以一种优雅高端的方式包裹、承托、环绕、框定或层叠肉类。观众应能感受到肉饼关系是一种经过设计的食物形态，而非杂乱的休闲卷饼。

主角食物逻辑：
烤肉必须感觉超写实且高端：焦边、多汁纤维、焦糖色泽、鲜嫩切面、逼真的油脂渲染和浓郁的烘烤色彩。大饼必须感觉温暖、柔软、略带焦斑且物理真实感强。蔬菜如生菜、番茄、洋葱、香草或腌制配料应感觉新鲜且受控。

排版与品牌：
使用英文品牌标识，虚构一个高端身份：
品牌：EMBER WRAP
广告语：FIRE. SLICE. WRAP.
根据需要添加简短的面板特定名称，例如：
SPIT ROAST（串烤）
WRAP SUPREME（至尊卷饼）
CREAMY CARVE（奶油切肉）
STACKED FLATBREAD（堆叠大饼）
CHAR KNIFE CUT（焦香刀切）
MEAT & BREAD FEAST（肉饼盛宴）
排版必须大胆、图形化且经过艺术指导，具有比以往更严谨的层级和间距系统。文字必须支撑食物，而非压过食物。

灯光：
使用极其细腻但具有高冲击力的商业灯光。每个面板必须具有丰富的空间感，通过高端的高光衰减来塑造烤肉质地、饼面、酱汁、蔬菜和碎屑。所有六个面板的灯光必须足够连贯以统一整个广告活动，同时允许细微的面板内部变化。

材质写实：
将写实度推向极致。肉必须感觉多汁、微焦、纹理清晰且刚下火。大饼必须感觉柔软温暖，带有褐色的焦斑。酱汁或奶油淋汁必须感觉有光泽且有物理重量感。蔬菜必须感觉清脆新鲜。所有表面必须呈现出物理上令人信服且令人垂涎的质感。

氛围：
大胆的烤肉痴迷感、高端街头美食的精致、六格广告系列秩序、雕塑般的食物互动、收藏级的食欲写实、现代品牌自信。

渲染风格：
超高端烤肉广告海报，2x3 六格营销设计，Milk Cloud Orbit 触感增强，Cream Halo Transit 品牌系统精炼，扩大的负空间，更强的色块节奏，更多雕塑感的肉饼互动，精炼的英文品牌，柔和的电影级商业灯光，极端的肉类和面包纹理写实，世界级美食广告审美，8k。

负向提示词：
廉价外卖传单，拥挤的网格，低细节肉类，虚假面包质感，凌乱的酱汁，卡通渲染，过大的文字，不一致的品牌标识，低分辨率纹理，油腻的混乱，面板区分度弱，廉价快餐风格，负空间不足，色彩节奏弱
