en.title: Blue Weather Skincare Visual Proposal
en.description: A conceptual skincare brand visual prompt titled 'Night Skincare as a Slow Descending Blue Weather'. It uses translucent textures, midnight blue tones, and mist-like layering to create a moody, sophisticated brand proposal cover.
en.prompt: Design a brand visual proposal homepage for a beauty brand, themed '{argument name="design theme" default="interpreting nighttime skincare as a slow descending blue weather"}'. The visual serves a fictional skincare brand's Key Visual (KV), avoiding common splashes or large facial models. Instead, it uses a translucent blue essence bottle, soft mist glass countertop, nighttime window view, and a thin film structure unfolding like a weather layer as the main visual. The composition adopts a vertical brand proposal cover feel, with the main product in the center and restrained layer relationships at the top-left and bottom-right, featuring ample white space. The lighting is low-illumination cold blue ambient light with extremely thin white bottle rim lighting, emphasizing glass thickness, liquid refraction, and packaging edges. The color system must include specific values: {argument name="color palette" default="Midnight Blue #24364A, Frost Blue #9EB9CA, Bottle Cold White #E8EEF2, Deep Graphite #2F3138, a touch of Moonlight Silver #BDC6CD, very light Grey-Purple #8A8395"}. Material descriptions focus on {argument name="material details" default="glass refraction, soft mist acrylic, liquid suspension feel, packaging box embossing, and silver foil stamped logos"}. A small amount of dominant Chinese text is needed, including the brand name, a very short brand slogan, one English auxiliary subtitle, and a small function label, with a light, thin, and breathable layout. Suitable for brand KVs, website splash screens, launch event main visuals, and brand case study covers.

zh.title: Blue Weather 护肤品视觉提案
zh.description: 一个名为“将夜间护肤解读为缓慢降临的蓝色天气”的概念性护肤品牌视觉提示词。它利用半透明质感、午夜蓝调和雾状层叠，营造出一种情绪化且精致的品牌提案封面。
zh.prompt: 为美妆品牌设计一个品牌视觉提案首页，主题为“{argument name="design theme" default="将夜间护肤解读为缓慢降临的蓝色天气"}”。该视觉作为虚构护肤品牌的关键视觉（KV），避免使用常见的溅射效果或大面积人脸模特。取而代之的是，以半透明的蓝色精华液瓶、柔雾玻璃台面、夜间窗景以及像天气层一样展开的薄膜结构作为主视觉。构图采用竖版品牌提案封面感，主产品居中，左上角和右下角保持克制的层级关系，并留有充足的留白。灯光采用低照度冷蓝色环境光，配合极细的白色瓶身轮廓光，强调玻璃厚度、液体折射和包装边缘。配色方案必须包含特定数值：{argument name="color palette" default="午夜蓝 #24364A、霜蓝色 #9EB9CA、瓶身冷白 #E8EEF2、深石墨灰 #2F3138、少许月光银 #BDC6CD、极浅灰紫色 #8A8395"}。材质描述重点在于 {argument name="material details" default="玻璃折射、柔雾亚克力、液体悬浮感、包装盒压纹以及银箔烫印 Logo"}。需要少量醒目的中文文本，包括品牌名称、极简的品牌口号、一个英文辅助副标题以及一个小型的功能标签，布局轻盈、纤细且具有呼吸感。适用于品牌 KV、网站启动页、发布会主视觉及品牌案例研究封面。

en.title: Minimalist Editorial Graphic Design Prompt
en.description: A sophisticated minimalist prompt for creating professional editorial-style graphic designs with high-contrast imagery, geometric color blocks, and strong typography.
en.prompt: Generate a minimalist, editorial-style graphic image centered around {argument name="subject" default="any subject"}. It features large areas of clean white space for "breathing," with the core subject rendered as a high-contrast black-and-white icon at the visual center with sharp edges. Part of the subject overlaps a {argument name="color block" default="solid color"} rectangular field, creating a stage-like layering effect. The information layer uses a heavy dark text block at the bottom, creating a visual impact where the image is truncated by text, which in turn supports the image. The main sentence uses bold, sans-serif light-colored characters in a tight multi-line layout with clean spacing and strong leading. An enlarged quotation mark or theme symbol serves as a rhythmic anchor at the top, while thin, lightweight credits at the bottom provide contrast, finishing with a tiny logo. Colors are extracted from the theme's material and mood: a high-brightness, clean background, black and white for the main subject's structure, and a mid-to-high saturation emotional color for the color field. The overall tone is bright, direct, and modern, with the energy of a public statement and the order of a publication. Avoid complex scenes, decorative textures, vintage filters, and loose layouts.

zh.title: 极简主义编辑图形设计提示词
zh.description: 一套精致的极简主义提示词，用于创作具有高对比度图像、几何色块和强力排版的专业编辑风格图形设计。
zh.prompt: 生成一张极简主义、编辑风格的图形图像，以 {argument name="subject" default="任意主题"} 为中心。画面留有大面积的干净留白以实现“呼吸感”，核心主题以高对比度的黑白图标形式呈现于视觉中心，边缘锐利。主题的一部分与 {argument name="color block" default="纯色"} 矩形色块重叠，营造出舞台般的层叠效果。信息层在底部使用厚重的深色文本块，形成图像被文本截断的视觉冲击力，而文本又反过来支撑图像。主句采用粗体、无衬线浅色字符，以紧凑的多行布局呈现，间距整齐且行距适中。顶部放置放大的引号或主题符号作为节奏锚点，底部配以纤细轻盈的署名信息形成对比，最后以一个小巧的 logo 收尾。色彩提取自主题的材质与氛围：高亮度、干净的背景，黑白用于主体的结构，中高饱和度的情感色彩用于色块。整体基调明亮、直接且现代，兼具公共声明的能量与出版物的秩序感。避免复杂的场景、装饰性纹理、复古滤镜和松散的布局。

en.title: Lin Daiyu Character Concept Design Board
en.description: A detailed character asset board for Lin Daiyu from Dream of the Red Chamber, featuring multiple views, expressions, and clothing textures for film production use.
en.prompt: Character asset setting board for a short drama themed on the Chinese classic "Dream of the Red Chamber," featuring the character Lin Daiyu. It uses a fictional classical family art style, not replicating any existing film or TV versions. An adult Chinese actress presents the delicate youth of a teenage girl, with a thin oval face, "frown-like" eyebrows, and clear, emotional eyes with slightly red corners, a slender nose, pale lips, and a pale but naturally flushed complexion. Long black hair is styled in a light low bun. Her figure is slender with slightly pulled-in shoulders, a posture like a willow swaying in the wind, intelligent and sensitive rather than sickly. Pure white seamless background, 16:9 cinematic character asset board. A fixed identity info card in the top left accurately displays the name "Lin Daiyu" and the bio: "An orphaned girl living in the Rong Mansion, guarding sensitive true feelings with a poetic heart." The name is in bold black simplified Chinese, and the bio is in smaller dark gray text, left-aligned in up to two lines, with no typos or garbled characters. The largest module shows a full-body main view of her wearing a smoky-blue cross-collar long robe, moon-white pleated skirt, light lotus-root colored silk stole, and plain embroidered shoes, holding a silk pouch for fallen flowers. It displays the same main look from full-body front, left and right sides, back, and three-quarter perspectives, locking the face, eyes, body type, bun, stole, skirt length, and shoe type. It includes front, side, and three-quarter facial close-ups, plus five expressions: cautious upon first entering the mansion, a slight smile when understanding Baoyu, sarcastic, mourning flowers, and clear focus while writing poetry. Costume assets show the simple travel outfit, daily look at Xiaoxiang Pavilion, and the gathering look at the Begonia Poetry Society, showing structure, layers, footwear, weaving patterns, and wear. Makeup and hair assets show light pale foundation, red eye corners, light bean-paste lips, the structure of the low bun, and a few flower ornaments. Items like the silk pouch, poem manuscripts, old handkerchief, brush, medicine bottle, and bamboo-leaf sachet are displayed independently, with color swatches of smoky blue, moon white, lotus root, bamboo green, and ink gray, along with samples of silk, satin, Xuan paper, and white porcelain. Realistic Chinese actor classical cinematic photography, only one character, no Baoyu, maids, gardens, or flower-burying scenes, no replication of existing actors, no exaggerated tear makeup, social media faces, studio hanfu, sexy poses, watermarks, or redundant text. The character's appearance and situation are based on the description of Daiyu in Chapter 3 of "Dream of the Red Chamber."

zh.title: 林黛玉角色概念设计项目
zh.description: 一份详尽的《红楼梦》林黛玉角色资产项目，包含多角度视图、表情及服装纹理，专为影视制作设计。
zh.prompt: 这是一份为中国经典名著《红楼梦》主题短剧设计的角色资产项目，主角为林黛玉。采用虚构的古典家族艺术风格，不复刻任何现有的影视版本。由一位成年中国女演员呈现出少女的娇柔感，面容为瘦削的鹅蛋脸，眉如蹙眉，双眸清澈且富有情感，眼角微红，鼻梁纤细，唇色浅淡，肤色苍白但透着自然红润。黑色长发梳成简约的低发髻。身形纤细，双肩微收，姿态如弱柳扶风，展现出聪慧敏感而非病态的气质。纯白色无缝背景，16:9 电影级角色资产项目。左上角设有固定的身份信息卡，准确显示名称“林黛玉”及简介：“寄居荣府的孤女，以诗心守护敏感真情。”名称为加粗黑色简体中文，简介为较小的深灰色文字，左对齐，最多两行，无错别字或乱码。最大模块展示了她的全身主视图，身着烟青色交领长袍、月白色百褶裙、浅藕荷色丝绸披帛，脚穿素雅绣花鞋，手持葬花丝囊。展示了全身正面、左右侧面、背面及四分之三视角的统一主造型，锁定了面部、眼睛、体型、发髻、披帛、裙长及鞋型。包含正面、侧面及四分之三面部特写，以及五种表情：初入府时的谨慎、理解宝玉时的浅笑、讥讽、葬花时的哀愁，以及吟诗时的专注。服装资产展示了简便行装、潇湘馆日常装束及海棠诗社聚会装束，呈现了结构、层次、鞋履、织物纹理及磨损细节。妆发资产展示了清透底妆、红眼角、豆沙色唇妆、低发髻结构及少量花饰。丝囊、诗稿、旧手帕、毛笔、药瓶及竹叶香囊等物品独立展示，并附有烟青、月白、藕荷、竹青及墨灰的色卡，以及丝绸、缎面、宣纸和白瓷的材质样本。写实中国演员古典电影摄影风格，仅含单一角色，不包含宝玉、丫鬟、园林或葬花场景，不复刻现有演员，无夸张泪妆、网红脸、影楼汉服、性感姿势、水印或冗余文字。角色外观与情境基于《红楼梦》第三回中对黛玉的描写。

en.title: Tang Dynasty Spring Fantasy Portrait
en.description: A detailed cinematic prompt for a traditional Tang Dynasty-style portrait of a young woman in a spring garden, featuring delicate silk textures and soft natural lighting.
en.prompt: 9:16 vertical orientation, Tang Dynasty fantasy spring lady portrait. A 20–28 year old adult East Asian woman with a slender and long figure, naturally full bust, and soft, clear waist and abdominal lines; a bright and friendly temperament with a clear sense of adulthood. A bright, slightly rounded face, only slightly short, with a complete lower face length and natural, non-overfilled cheekbones; gently arched long eyebrows, smooth and rounded eyes, a short straight nose bridge, and lips that are thin on top and full on bottom. The top of the hair is moderately raised, the sides are not puffy, and there are no thick bangs; a single-sided gold flower branch with long pearl tassels. The upper garment is a short, light peach-colored single-layer sheer gauze, without lining, tube top, or a second layer on the chest; the hem is above the natural waistline, revealing a slender waist and abdomen. The wrap-style low collar forms a soft vertical line, with a stable collar edge and full coverage on the sides of the armpits, maximizing the presentation of the upper chest, natural cleavage, and rounded outer contours of the breasts. The nipple area is covered using the natural overlapping folds of the same layer of thin gauze and dense begonia hidden patterns, without adding extra fabric layers. The lower body is paired with a pearl white high-waisted long skirt and a fine light gold waistband. The figure stands sideways on floral steps, one hand lightly touching a begonia branch, the other resting naturally at her side, looking back over her shoulder at the camera with a smile. The background consists of begonia flower steps, vermilion palace walls, deep stone stairs, and a distant palace gate; late morning light passes through the flower branches from diagonally behind, while the subject's front is illuminated by soft reflected light. Two-thirds body realistic retouch.

zh.title: 唐风春日幻想肖像
zh.description: 一份详细的电影级提示词，用于创作一幅唐代风格的春日庭院少女肖像，展现细腻的丝绸质感与柔和的自然光影。
zh.prompt: 9:16 竖屏构图，唐代幻想春日仕女肖像。一位 20 至 28 岁的东亚女性，身材修长，胸部自然丰满，腰腹线条柔和清晰；气质明媚亲和，具有成熟感。面部明亮圆润，略显短小，下庭长度适中，颧骨自然、无过度填充；眉毛细长微弯，双眼圆润平滑，鼻梁短直，唇形上薄下厚。发顶适度隆起，两侧不蓬松，无厚重刘海；佩戴单侧金质花枝，垂下长珍珠流苏。上身穿着浅桃色单层透明薄纱短衫，无内衬、无抹胸，胸前无第二层遮挡；衣摆位于自然腰线以上，露出纤细的腰腹。交领设计形成柔和的垂直线条，领缘稳固，腋下两侧覆盖严密，最大程度展现上胸部、自然的乳沟以及圆润的胸部外轮廓。乳头区域通过同层薄纱的自然重叠褶皱与致密的海棠暗纹遮盖，无需额外增加布料层。下身搭配珍珠白高腰长裙，系细金腰带。人物侧身立于花阶之上，一手轻触海棠枝，另一手自然垂于身侧，回眸望向镜头微笑。背景为海棠花阶、朱红宫墙、深色石阶及远处的宫门；上午的阳光从斜后方穿过花枝，人物正面由柔和的反射光照亮。三分之二身位，写实修图风格。

en.title: High-End Summer Fashion Poster Prompt
en.description: A professional fashion advertising prompt for resort wear, featuring specific layout and typography instructions for a cohesive brand campaign look.
en.prompt: High-end realistic summer fashion poster, featuring a camisole wide-leg jumpsuit. A young adult female model stands in the shadow of a white corridor or by a pool in a resort hotel, wearing a misty pink camisole wide-leg jumpsuit. The fabric is soft and draped, the pant leg lines are smooth, and the waist is naturally cinched. The model rests one hand on a railing and lightly lifts the fabric on the side of the pants with the other, in a relaxed and elegant pose. The overall feel is one of luxury resort wear and summer airiness, like a high-end resort wear poster, with realistic fabric drape and spatial lighting, in a 3:4 vertical format. Poster text content: Brand Name: {argument name="brand name" default="Soft Isle"}, Product Name: {argument name="product name" default="Camisole Wide-leg Jumpsuit"}, English Subtitle: WIDE-LEG JUMPSUIT, Slogan: {argument name="slogan" default="Step into the holiday state in one step"}, Short labels: Lightweight fabric / Resort relaxation. Layout requirements: The brand name and English subtitle are placed in the white space at the top, the product name is in the main visual area at the bottom, and the short labels are at the very bottom, avoiding blocking the waistline and the flow of the pant legs.

zh.title: 高端夏季时尚海报提示词
zh.description: 一份专业的度假风时尚广告提示词，包含针对品牌统一视觉风格的排版与字体设计说明。
zh.prompt: 高端写实夏季时尚海报，展示一款吊带阔腿连体裤。一位年轻女性模特站在度假酒店白色走廊的阴影中或泳池边，身穿雾粉色吊带阔腿连体裤。面料柔软垂坠，裤腿线条流畅，腰部自然收紧。模特一只手扶在栏杆上，另一只手轻轻提起裤侧面料，姿态从容优雅。整体氛围呈现出奢华度假风与夏季的轻盈感，如同高端度假系列海报，具备写实的面料垂坠感与空间光影，采用 3:4 竖构图。海报文字内容：品牌名称：{argument name="brand name" default="Soft Isle"}，产品名称：{argument name="product name" default="吊带阔腿连体裤"}，英文副标题：WIDE-LEG JUMPSUIT，标语：{argument name="slogan" default="一步迈入度假状态"}，短标签：轻盈面料 / 度假休闲。排版要求：品牌名称与英文副标题置于顶部留白处，产品名称位于底部主视觉区，短标签置于最底部，避免遮挡腰线及裤腿的流动感。

en.title: Summer Afternoon with Chibi Characters
en.description: A charming and high-definition photo-style portrait of a young woman on a traditional Japanese engawa porch during summer. She is surrounded by several small, 3D chibi versions of herself performing various summer activities, blended with whimsical hand-drawn line art and bright summer colors.
en.prompt:
Subject: Cool Summer Time on the Porch

Main Subject: A woman in her 20s sitting on a bright summer engawa porch, smiling while holding a transparent Ramune bottle next to her face. She is surrounded by several small chibi-style characters with the same hairstyle and outfit, each performing different actions like holding a fan, pointing, drawing, or hugging. A glass wind chime hangs on the top left, and a goldfish bowl with a round floral fan sits on the bottom right.

Character/Expression: Faces slightly left while looking at the camera with a gentle, friendly smile. Soft oval face, almond-shaped light brown eyes, and natural thin brows. Her brown long hair is in a high half-up style with thin bangs and small {argument name="hair ornament" default="light blue flower decorations"}.

Clothing/Pose: A sleeveless knit top in {argument name="top color" default="light blue"} with a V-neck and lace-style patterns, paired with a white long flared skirt. She holds the bottle with her right hand and supports herself with her left hand on the floor.

Background/Light: A {argument name="background" default="traditional wooden house porch"} with open shoji doors and a vibrant green garden. Soft natural light from the top left creates warm dapples on the skin, hair, and floor.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio. Knee-up to full-body portrait with the person centered. Chibi characters are scattered rhythmically around her. Shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style: High-definition photorealistic expression for the main person and porch. Small characters are rendered as refined 3D chibi models. Hand-drawn line art in white, pink, and yellow is overlaid with doodles like hearts, suns, and text like "SUMMER" and "HAPPY".

Negative: Do not mix faces of main subject and chibis; keep hand/bottle grip natural; do not omit wind chime or goldfish bowl.

zh.title: 夏日午后的 Q 版角色时光
zh.description: 一张迷人且高清的照片风格肖像，展现了一位年轻女性在夏季传统的日式缘侧（engawa）上休憩的场景。她被几个小巧的 3D Q 版自己所环绕，这些 Q 版角色正在进行各种夏日活动，画面融合了奇思妙想的手绘线条艺术和明亮的夏日色彩。
zh.prompt:
主题：缘侧上的清凉夏日时光

主要对象：一位 20 多岁的女性坐在明亮的夏日缘侧上，面带微笑，脸旁拿着一瓶透明的弹珠汽水。她周围环绕着几个发型和服装与她相同的小巧 Q 版角色，每个角色都在做不同的动作，比如拿扇子、指点、绘画或拥抱。左上方挂着一个玻璃风铃，右下方放着一个金鱼缸和一把圆形花卉团扇。

人物/表情：脸部微向左转，同时注视着镜头，带着温柔友好的微笑。柔和的鹅蛋脸，杏仁状的浅棕色眼睛，自然的细眉。棕色长发梳成高半扎发，留着薄刘海，并配有小巧的 {argument name="hair ornament" default="浅蓝色花朵装饰"}。

服装/姿势：一件 {argument name="top color" default="浅蓝色"} 无袖针织上衣，V 领设计，带有蕾丝风格图案，搭配白色长款大摆裙。她右手拿着汽水瓶，左手撑在木地板上。

背景/光线：一个 {argument name="background" default="传统的木制房屋缘侧"}，推拉门敞开，可以看到充满活力的绿色花园。来自左上方的柔和自然光在皮肤、头发和地板上投下温暖的斑驳光影。

构图/摄影：垂直 3:4 比例。膝盖以上至全身的肖像，人物居中。Q 版角色有节奏地散布在她周围。浅景深。

质感/风格：主体人物和缘侧采用高清写实表现手法。小角色渲染为精致的 3D Q 版模型。叠加了白色、粉色和黄色的手绘线条艺术，以及爱心、太阳等涂鸦，并带有“SUMMER”和“HAPPY”等文字。

负面提示：不要混淆主体和 Q 版角色的脸部；保持手部/瓶子的抓握自然；不要遗漏风铃或金鱼缸。

en.title: Perspective Typography Product Poster Prompt
en.description: A high-impact commercial advertising prompt that uses giant perspective typography as a structural element to showcase products in a professional campaign style.
en.prompt: Please generate a high-definition commercial advertising poster in vertical 3:4 format, single image, no collage, no grids. The theme is a {argument name="product type" default="new product"} promotion poster. This is a fictional brand advertisement; do not use real brand logos. Brand Name: {argument name="brand name" default="[Brand Name]"}, Product Name: {argument name="product name" default="[Product Name]"}, Main Heading: {argument name="heading" default="VISION"}, Subheading: A short slogan, Color Palette: Primary + Secondary + Accent. The overall style is a "Product Promotional Giant Text Perspective Poster." The image should look like a formal brand campaign visual, with a commercial feel, strong layout design, youthful energy, product launch vibe, and visual impact. [Core Visual] The main subject is the product, which must be clear, exquisite, and like a hero product in an ad. Add suitable characters or usage scenarios based on the product type (e.g., mobile phone model, runner, rider, skater, athlete, outdoor player). Characters should have natural movement, and there must be a real spatial relationship between the product and characters. [Giant Text Perspective] The main heading must be the core visual skeleton, using extra-large bold sans-serif font, occupying the main space. The text shouldn't just be a title; it should become the spatial structure of the scene (e.g., a background wall, ground track, road, ramp, motion trail, or futuristic installation). Characters and products must be within this giant text space, forming real depth, occlusion, contact shadows, and perspective. [Formal Poster Information System] The image needs a complete hierarchy of brand advertising info. Top: Add brand name and "NEW RELEASE / PRODUCT CAMPAIGN" in small print. Side: Add vertical small text, series number, product number, or campaign ID. Near Product: Add 3-5 feature tags. Bottom: Formal ad info bar with product name, slogan, launch date, parameters, credits, thin line dividers, and decorative barcodes. Typography should be refined and follow brand standards. [Visual Texture] Sharp, commercial photography quality, realistic materials, accurate perspective, clear products, natural people, unified lighting. Fits scenarios like phones, digital gear, sneakers, motorcycles, sports brands, and events. [Avoid] Collages, real brand logos, cheap e-commerce look, generic stock photos, messy backgrounds, cartoonish feel, small product size, or flat titles.

zh.title: 透视排版产品海报提示词
zh.description: 一个极具冲击力的商业广告提示词，利用巨型透视排版作为结构元素，以专业广告风格展示产品。
zh.prompt: 请生成一张 3:4 竖版高清商业广告海报，单图，无拼贴，无网格。主题为 {argument name="product type" default="新品"} 推广海报。这是一个虚构的品牌广告，请勿使用真实品牌 Logo。品牌名称：{argument name="brand name" default="[品牌名称]"}，产品名称：{argument name="product name" default="[产品名称]"}，主标题：{argument name="heading" default="VISION"}，副标题：一句简短的口号，配色方案：主色 + 辅色 + 点缀色。整体风格为“产品推广巨型文字透视海报”。画面应呈现出正式的品牌广告视觉效果，具有商业感、强烈的排版设计、青春活力、新品发布氛围及视觉冲击力。[核心视觉] 主体为产品，必须清晰、精致，如同广告中的主角产品。根据产品类型添加合适的人物或使用场景（例如：手机模特、跑步者、骑行者、滑板手、运动员、户外玩家）。人物动作应自然，且产品与人物之间必须存在真实的物理空间关系。[巨型文字透视] 主标题必须作为核心视觉骨架，使用超大号粗体无衬线字体，占据主要空间。文字不应仅仅是标题，而应成为场景的物理结构（例如：背景墙、地面轨道、道路、坡道、运动轨迹或未来感装置）。人物和产品必须置于这些巨型文字空间内，形成真实的景深、遮挡、接触阴影和透视关系。[正式海报信息系统] 画面需要完整的品牌广告信息层级。顶部：添加品牌名称及小字“NEW RELEASE / PRODUCT CAMPAIGN”。侧边：添加垂直小字、系列编号、产品编号或活动 ID。产品附近：添加 3-5 个功能标签。底部：正式的广告信息栏，包含产品名称、口号、发布日期、参数、制作人员名单、细线分割符及装饰性条形码。排版应精致并符合品牌规范。[视觉质感] 锐利、商业摄影品质、真实的材质、准确的透视、清晰的产品、自然的人物、统一的布光。适用于手机、数码装备、运动鞋、摩托车、运动品牌及活动等场景。[避免] 拼贴画、真实品牌 Logo、廉价电商感、通用的素材图、杂乱的背景、卡通感、产品尺寸过小或扁平化的标题。

en.title: Neon Dual-Lighting Beauty Portrait
en.description: A close-up studio beauty portrait with a striking dual-lighting setup. The subject is a young woman looking over her shoulder against a purple background, illuminated with cool blue-violet light on one side and warm pink light on the other.
en.prompt:
Subject: Turning in Purple Light

Main Subject: Reproduce facial features, turning over the shoulder, camera eye contact, right hand on neck, ultra-thin black strap, brown hair, {argument name="left light color" default="blue-violet light"} on the left and {argument name="right light color" default="pink light"} on the right. A photorealistic beauty portrait in vertical orientation of a woman in her 20s captured extremely close from shoulders to crown in a dark studio with a solid {argument name="background color" default="purple background"}. The person has her back to the right and turns her face over her left shoulder to the camera. Large rounded left shoulder in foreground.

Character/Expression: Oval face, smooth chin, small nose, and rose-beige lips. Head turned roughly 40 degrees, looking straight at the lens with dark brown eyes. Quiet expression with lips slightly parted. Skin is bright neutral ivory with highlights on nose, cheekbones, and shoulder. Hair is medium brown with thin bangs.

Clothing/Pose: Black satin or matte stretch camisole with a single ultra-thin strap. The person twists her upper body, bringing the left shoulder close to the camera. Her right hand touches the right side of her neck. 

Background/Light: Background transitions from lavender to medium purple to dark reddish-purple. Main light is soft pink to reddish-purple from the front right. Auxiliary light is cool cyan-blue to blue-violet from the front left. Magenta rim light on the hair.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4 tight close-up. Camera at eye level. Mid-telephoto lens perspective. Focus strictly on the foreground eye, nose, and lips.

Texture/Style: High-resolution photorealistic studio beauty photography. Detailed pores, hair strands, and smooth light gradients. Catchlights in eyes are small and natural.

Negative: Do not change dual lighting or purple background; avoid extra fingers/limbs; no text, logos, or watermarks.

zh.title: 霓虹双色光美妆人像
zh.description: 一张采用醒目双色光布光方案的影棚特写美妆人像。主体是一位年轻女性，背景为紫色，她回眸看向镜头，一侧被冷蓝紫色光照亮，另一侧则被暖粉色光照亮。
zh.prompt:
主体：紫色光下的回眸

主要主体：还原面部特征，回眸，眼睛注视镜头，右手放在颈部，超细黑色肩带，棕色头发，左侧为 {argument name="left light color" default="蓝紫色光"}，右侧为 {argument name="right light color" default="粉色光"}。一张 20 多岁女性的超近距离垂直构图写实美妆人像，从肩膀到头顶，背景为纯色 {argument name="background color" default="紫色背景"} 的暗色影棚。人物背对右侧，转头越过左肩看向镜头。前景为圆润的左肩。

人物/表情：椭圆形脸，下巴线条平滑，小巧的鼻子，玫瑰米色嘴唇。头部转动约 40 度，深棕色眼睛直视镜头。表情安静，双唇微启。肤色为明亮的中性象牙白，鼻梁、颧骨和肩膀处有高光。中棕色头发，留有薄刘海。

服装/姿势：黑色缎面或哑光弹力吊带衫，配有一根超细肩带。人物扭转上半身，将左肩靠近镜头。右手触碰颈部右侧。

背景/光影：背景从薰衣草紫过渡到中紫色，再到深红紫色。主光为正面右侧的柔和粉色至红紫色。辅光为正面左侧的冷青蓝色至蓝紫色。头发上有洋红色轮廓光。

构图/相机：垂直 3:4 紧凑特写。相机处于平视角度。中长焦镜头视角。焦点严格对准前景的眼睛、鼻子和嘴唇。

质感/风格：高分辨率写实影棚美妆摄影。细节丰富的毛孔、发丝和柔和的光影渐变。眼睛里的眼神光自然且细小。

负面提示：请勿更改双色光或紫色背景；避免出现多余的手指/肢体；无文字、标志或水印。

en.title: Sun-Dappled Park Bench Portrait
en.description: A bright and airy outdoor portrait of a young woman sitting on a wooden park bench. She wears a white chiffon outfit with intricate details, as warm sunlight filters through the trees to create beautiful dapples across her skin and clothes.
en.prompt:
Subject: Bench in Dappled Sunlight

Main Subject: A bright portrait of a woman in her 20s sitting on a dark wooden bench in a {argument name="background" default="lush green park"}, captured vertically from head to crossed knees. The subject takes up much of the center frame. She faces forward with her head slightly tilted to her left, supporting herself with her hands on the bench seat. Her right leg is crossed over the left, creating a soft sitting posture.

Character/Expression: Small oval face, light ivory skin, brown eyes, and rose-colored cheeks. A calm smile looking at the camera. Her light brown hair is styled in a {argument name="hairstyle" default="low braided updo"} with thin bangs. Golden backlighting on her hair and round sun dapples on her skin.

Clothing/Pose: A white {argument name="dress type" default="wrap-style mini dress"} with a deep V-neck and a ribbon tie at the waist. She wears a sheer white chiffon long cardigan over it, falling off the shoulders. Detailed puff sleeves with frilled cuffs. Her hands rest naturally on the bench seat.

Background/Light: Foreground features a dark brown wooden bench with visible grain. An ivory square bag sits on the right. Background is a park with deep green lawn and large trees. Strong warm natural light from the top-left-back creates sun dapples through the leaves. Background trees have circular bokeh.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 2:3 ratio, knee-up portrait from chest height. Face in the upper center. Shallow depth of field with a portrait lens.

Texture/Style: High-resolution realistic outdoor fashion photo. Ivory, warm skin tones, dark brown, and vibrant green are the main colors. Highlights on shoulders and knees. Detailed fabric textures and wooden bench grain.

Negative: Avoid distortion of face or smile, extra fingers, merging of limbs, unnatural shadows, logos, or watermarks.

zh.title: 阳光斑驳的公园长椅肖像
zh.description: 一张明亮通透的户外肖像，一位年轻女性坐在木质公园长椅上。她身着细节精致的白色雪纺服装，温暖的阳光透过树叶洒下，在她的皮肤和衣物上形成美丽的斑驳光影。
zh.prompt:
主题：阳光斑驳下的长椅

主体：一张明亮的肖像，一位 20 多岁的女性坐在 {argument name="background" default="郁郁葱葱的公园"} 的深色木质长椅上，采用竖构图，拍摄范围从头部到交叉的双膝。主体占据了画面的大部分中心位置。她面向前方，头部微微向左倾斜，双手支撑在长椅座面上。右腿叠在左腿上，呈现出柔和的坐姿。

角色/表情：小巧的鹅蛋脸，象牙白肤色，棕色眼睛，玫瑰色脸颊。带着平静的微笑注视着镜头。浅棕色头发梳成 {argument name="hairstyle" default="低盘发辫"}，留着薄刘海。金色的背光照亮了她的头发，圆形的阳光斑点映在她的皮肤上。

服装/姿势：一件白色的 {argument name="dress type" default="裹身式迷你裙"}，深 V 领，腰间系有丝带。外搭一件白色半透明雪纺长开衫，从肩部滑落。精致的泡泡袖，带有荷叶边袖口。双手自然地放在长椅座面上。

背景/光线：前景是带有明显纹理的深棕色木质长椅。右侧放着一个象牙白方形包。背景是拥有深绿色草坪和大树的公园。来自左后上方的强烈暖色自然光透过树叶形成斑驳光影。背景树木呈现圆形焦外成像。

构图/相机：竖构图 2:3 比例，从胸部高度拍摄的膝上肖像。脸部位于上方中心。使用人像镜头，浅景深。

质感/风格：高分辨率写实户外时尚摄影。象牙白、暖肤色、深棕色和鲜艳的绿色是主要色调。肩部和膝盖处有高光。细腻的织物纹理和木质长椅纹理。

负面提示：避免脸部或笑容扭曲、多余的手指、肢体粘连、不自然的阴影、标志或水印。

en.title: Low-Angle Urban Summer Fashion Shot
en.description: An extreme low-angle fashion portrait of a young woman in white summer attire, posed at a city intersection under a vivid blue sky. The wide-angle perspective emphasizes the scale of the urban environment and the dynamic pose of the subject.
en.prompt:
Subject: White Stepping on the Blue Sky

Main Subject: A realistic vertical fashion portrait of a woman in her 20s kneeling on one knee with the other knee raised high in front of a camera at ground level at a {argument name="location" default="wide city intersection in Japan"} in midsummer. Features a {argument name="outfit color" default="white outfit"}, intense blue sky, and feet/sandals looming large in the foreground.

Character/Expression: A calm gaze looking down at the low-angle camera. Soft oval face, brown eyes, and coral pink lips. Natural Japanese-style makeup. {argument name="hair color" default="Light brown"} medium-length hair with thin bangs and light movement.

Clothing/Pose: White ribbed cropped camisole with lace trim. White high-waist wrap-style mini skort with gathers. White platform lace-up sandals. Right knee is on the ground, left knee is raised toward the camera. Left hand rests on the raised knee.

Background/Light: Wide urban intersection with office buildings, street trees, utility poles, and complex power lines. Vibrant blue sky with puffy white cumulus clouds. Strong summer sunlight creates sharp shadows on the asphalt.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4. Extreme low-angle wide-angle close-up shot with camera at asphalt height. Foreground legs and feet are emphasized by wide-angle perspective. Buildings converge toward the sky.

Texture/Style: High-definition realistic photography. Natural skin texture and subtle glow, detailed rib fabric, lace, and rough asphalt. Summer color palette based on blue and white.

Negative: No horizontal flipping; keep the contact between hand and knee; avoid distortion of toes or sandal straps.

zh.title: 低角度城市夏日时尚摄影
zh.description: 一张极低角度的时尚肖像，拍摄了一位身着白色夏装的年轻女性，她摆姿于城市十字路口，背景是湛蓝的天空。广角透视突显了城市环境的宏大感以及主体动感的姿态。
zh.prompt:
主题：蓝天下的白色足迹

主要主体：一张写实的竖构图时尚肖像，拍摄了一位 20 多岁的女性，她单膝跪地，另一侧膝盖高高抬起，面对着位于地面的相机，背景为盛夏时节的 {argument name="location" default="日本宽阔的城市十字路口"}。画面包含 {argument name="outfit color" default="白色服装"}、浓郁的蓝天，以及前景中显得巨大的双脚/凉鞋。

人物/表情：平静的目光俯视着低角度相机。柔和的椭圆形脸庞，棕色眼睛，珊瑚粉色嘴唇。自然的日系妆容。{argument name="hair color" default="浅棕色"} 中长发，带有轻薄刘海，发丝微动。

服装/姿势：白色罗纹短款吊带背心，带有蕾丝饰边。白色高腰裹身式迷你短裙裤，带有褶皱设计。白色厚底系带凉鞋。右膝着地，左膝向相机方向抬起。左手放在抬起的膝盖上。

背景/光线：宽阔的城市十字路口，可见办公楼、行道树、电线杆和复杂的电线。充满活力的蓝天，漂浮着蓬松的积云。强烈的夏日阳光在柏油路面上投下锐利的阴影。

构图/相机：竖构图 3:4。极低角度广角特写，相机位于柏油路面高度。前景的腿部和脚部通过广角透视得到强调。建筑物向天空汇聚。

质感/风格：高清写实摄影。自然的皮肤质感和细腻光泽，细节丰富的罗纹面料、蕾丝以及粗糙的柏油路面。以蓝色和白色为主调的夏日色彩盘。

负面提示：禁止水平翻转；保持手与膝盖的接触；避免脚趾或凉鞋带的畸变。

en.title: Royal Blue Summer Sea Beauty Shot
en.description: A vibrant beauty portrait of a woman at the beach, featuring deep royal blue colors from her satin dress and sunglasses. The shot captures a refreshing summer vibe with the sea and sky as a backdrop, enhanced by sharp focus and natural sunlight.
en.prompt:
Subject: Eyes Reflecting Ultramarine

Main Subject: A realistic vertical beauty portrait of a woman in her 20s with her hand on {argument name="sunglasses color" default="blue round sunglasses"} against a midsummer sea background. Wind-blown short hair, a vibrant {argument name="dress color" default="royal blue"} satin dress, blue accessories, and the shimmering sea surface are the core elements.

Character/Expression: Faces almost forward with the chin slightly up, looking calmly at the camera. Small oval face with a smooth chin and coral pink lips. Fine natural Japanese-style makeup. Bright ash-beige {argument name="hairstyle" default="short bob hair"} with light bangs blowing in the breeze. Eyes are slightly visible through the blue lenses.

Clothing/Pose: Shiny royal blue satin dress with thin straps and a wrap-style V-neck with soft drapes. Her right hand is raised, touching the outer frame of the sunglasses with her thumb and forefinger. Gold earrings with small blue stones and a thin necklace.

Background/Light: Vibrant blue sea in the background with blurry island shadows on the horizon. White seagulls flying above in shallow depth of field. Strong summer sun from top left creates highlights on hair and skin. Shimmering reflections on the water.

Composition/Camera: Vertical 3:4. Close-up bust shot from head to chest. Subject occupies the center. Camera at a slightly low position. Sea and seagulls are heavily blurred.

Texture/Style: High-definition photorealistic fashion photography. Natural skin texture, fine hair strands, transparent blue lenses, and smooth satin sheen. Bright and clear summer natural light.

Negative: Do not change round blue lenses to black or square; keep hand-to-sunglasses contact; do not change hair to long hair.

zh.title: 皇家蓝夏日海滩美妆大片
zh.description: 一张充满活力的海滩女性美妆肖像，以缎面连衣裙和太阳镜的深皇家蓝色调为特色。画面以大海和天空为背景，捕捉到清爽的夏日氛围，并辅以清晰的对焦和自然阳光。
zh.prompt:
主题：倒映群青色的双眸

主体：一张写实的女性垂直美妆肖像，年龄 20 多岁，手部触碰 {argument name="sunglasses color" default="蓝色圆框太阳镜"}，背景为盛夏的海景。被风吹拂的短发、充满活力的 {argument name="dress color" default="皇家蓝"} 缎面连衣裙、蓝色配饰以及波光粼粼的海面是核心元素。

人物/表情：面部几乎正对镜头，下巴微抬，平静地注视着镜头。小巧的鹅蛋脸，下巴线条平滑，珊瑚粉色嘴唇。精致的日系自然妆容。明亮的灰米色 {argument name="hairstyle" default="短波波头"}，轻薄的刘海在微风中飘动。透过蓝色镜片可隐约看到双眼。

服装/姿势：闪亮的皇家蓝缎面吊带连衣裙，V 领裹身式设计，带有柔和的褶皱。右手抬起，拇指和食指轻触太阳镜外框。佩戴镶有蓝色小宝石的金色耳环和细项链。

背景/光影：背景为充满活力的蓝色大海，地平线上有模糊的岛屿阴影。白色海鸥在浅景深中飞翔。来自左上方的强烈夏日阳光在头发和皮肤上形成高光。水面闪烁着波光。

构图/相机：垂直 3:4 比例。从头部到胸部的半身特写。主体位于中心。相机位置略低。大海和海鸥经过重度模糊处理。

质感/风格：高清写实时尚摄影。自然的皮肤纹理、细致的发丝、透明的蓝色镜片以及顺滑的缎面光泽。明亮清晰的夏日自然光。

负面提示：不要将蓝色圆框镜片改为黑色或方形；保持手部与太阳镜的接触；不要将发型改为长发。

en.title: Silver-haired Warrior in Moonlight Forest
en.description: A visual prompt for gpt-image-2 featuring a female warrior with a staff in a misty, moonlit forest with glowing fairies.
en.prompt: A {argument name="hair color" default="silver-haired"} {argument name="profession" default="female warrior"} standing in a {argument name="location" default="misty forest"}, with pale moonlight illuminating her armor and fairy lights dancing at the tip of her staff.

zh.title: 月光森林中的银发女战士
zh.description: 这是一个用于 gpt-image-2 的视觉提示词，描绘了一位手持法杖的女战士，置身于雾气缭绕、月光洒满且有发光精灵环绕的森林中。
zh.prompt: 一位 {argument name="hair color" default="银发"} 的 {argument name="profession" default="女战士"} 站在 {argument name="location" default="雾气森林"} 中，清冷的月光照亮了她的盔甲，精灵之光在她的法杖顶端舞动。

en.title: Train Travel Portrait 9:16 Cinematic Prompt
en.description: A vertical format realistic portrait prompt for a young woman sitting by a train window, focusing on natural light, expression of anticipation, and high-fidelity textures.
en.prompt:
Vertical 9:16, photorealistic travel portrait taken at a window seat of a daytime train. An imaginary adult Japanese woman, appearing to be {argument name="age group" default="24-30 years old"}. Close-up half-body shot from the top of the head to below the chest. Position the person slightly to the left of the center, with the body facing more to the right than the front. Face directed toward the window in the upper right, not looking at the camera. Lightly place the base of the right index finger under the right side of the chin, thumb under the chin, and other fingers naturally curved. A {argument name="expression" default="modest smile of anticipation with teeth slightly visible"}, as if imagining the destination outside the window.
Long dark brown hair nearly black. Side part on the left, face-framing hair following the cheeks without being tucked behind ears, and ends curled inward at the chest. Dark brown eyes with vertical window catchlights, thin brown eyeliner, light coral beige makeup, and natural rose lips. Skin in bright natural light, retaining textures of pores, fine hairs, and lips.
Costume consists of a {argument name="outfit" default="light gray thin ribbed tank top under an ivory thin cardigan"}. The cardigan is open, showing small round matching buttons and natural fabric folds. Exposure is elegant and everyday. The background shows part of the train window frame and blue seats, while the outside view is a flowing blur of cityscapes in pale blue, white, and beige. Soft window light from the front right, weak warm interior reflections on the left.
85mm equivalent, f/2.0, eye-level height with the seated person. Precise focus on the near eye, eyelashes, and fingertips; background and far hair are smoothly blurred. No text, route names, logos, ads, readable signs, extra fingers, fingers stabbing the chin, distorted windows, asymmetrical eyes, excessive skin smoothing, strong HDR, or CG feel.

zh.title: 火车旅行肖像 9:16 电影感提示词
zh.description: 一款适用于年轻女性坐在火车窗边的竖屏写实肖像提示词，侧重于自然光影、期待的神情以及高保真纹理。
zh.prompt:
竖屏 9:16，在日间火车靠窗座位拍摄的写实旅行肖像。一位虚构的成年日本女性，年龄设定为 {argument name="age group" default="24-30 岁"}。从头顶到胸部以下的半身特写镜头。人物位于画面中心偏左，身体朝向右侧多于正前方。面部朝向右上方的窗户，不看镜头。右手食指根部轻抵下巴右侧，拇指托住下巴，其余手指自然弯曲。表情为 {argument name="expression" default="带着期待的矜持微笑，微露牙齿"}，仿佛正在想象窗外的目的地。
深棕色长发近乎黑色。左侧分缝，修饰脸型的发丝顺着脸颊垂下，未别在耳后，发梢在胸前向内卷曲。深棕色眼眸中带有竖向的窗户反光，细棕色眼线，浅珊瑚米色妆容，自然的玫瑰色嘴唇。皮肤处于明亮的自然光下，保留了毛孔、细小绒毛和唇纹的质感。
服装为 {argument name="outfit" default="象牙色薄开衫内搭浅灰色细罗纹背心"}。开衫敞开，露出小巧的同色系圆扣和自然的衣褶。曝光优雅且具有生活气息。背景可见部分火车窗框和蓝色座椅，窗外是淡蓝色、白色和米色交织的流动城市景观。柔和的窗光从右前方射入，左侧有微弱的室内暖光反射。
85mm 等效焦距，f/2.0 光圈，与坐姿人物平视。焦点精准对准近处的眼睛、睫毛和指尖；背景和远处的头发呈现平滑的虚化效果。无文字、路线名称、Logo、广告、可辨识的标志、多余的手指、手指戳入下巴、扭曲的窗户、不对称的眼睛、过度磨皮、强烈的 HDR 或 CG 感。

en.title: Tropical Bay Bikini Portrait with White Flowers
en.description: An open and bright realistic portrait prompt of a woman in an ivory bikini standing in a tropical bay with clear emerald water.
en.prompt:
Theme: Opening into the Emerald Bay

Subject:
A bright and open realistic beach portrait of a woman in her 20s wearing an {argument name="outfit" default="ivory white bikini"} standing in the shallows of a quiet tropical bay, with her arms spread wide and one leg bent back. The scene consists of highly transparent emerald blue sea, a white sandy beach, and a cliff wall approaching on the right background.

Character and Expression:
Facing forward, {argument name="expression" default="smiling softly"} while looking at the camera. Small oval face, rounded cheeks, almond-shaped eyes, and glossy coral pink lips. Transparent Japanese-style makeup with pale pink blush and natural teardrop bags. Long brown hair reaching below the chest with thin bangs and gentle waves at the ends. A {argument name="accessory" default="small white flower"} decorates one side of her hair.

Pose and Clothing:
An ivory white triangle bikini with thin straps, small ruffles, a center ribbon, and side ties. The material has delicate gathers and a light sheen. She extends both arms diagonally up and out, opening her chest and tilting her torso slightly. Standing on one leg in the shallow water with the other knee bent behind her as if about to skip.

Background and Light:
Transparent shallows spread from the foreground to the middle ground with fine ripples and reflections. A dark gray rocky wall covered in plants is on the right, and a horizon with small reefs on the left. Bright blue sky with white clouds. Strong summer sunlight from the upper left creates highlights on skin, water, and hair.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical 3:4 frame. The person is positioned slightly to the right of center in a full-body composition. Wide arms extend to the edges, leaving space in the blue sky above. Natural perspective focused on the face and torso with medium depth of field.

Texture and Style:
High-resolution realistic resort photography. Detailed textures of skin, wet water, sand grains, and rock. Refreshing summer colors based on blue and turquoise harmonized with ivory and skin tones. Natural finish without excessive filters.

Negatives:
Deformed arms or fingers; unnatural leg joints or center of gravity; missing bikini strings or ruffles.

zh.title: 热带海湾比基尼人像，点缀白色花朵
zh.description: 一个明亮开阔的写实人像提示词，描绘了一位身穿象牙白比基尼的女性，站在拥有清澈翡翠色海水的热带海湾中。
zh.prompt:
主题：拥抱翡翠海湾

主体：
一张明亮开阔的写实海滩人像，描绘了一位 20 多岁的女性，身穿 {argument name="outfit" default="象牙白比基尼"}，站在宁静热带海湾的浅滩中，双臂张开，一条腿向后弯曲。场景包含高度透明的翡翠蓝色海水、白色沙滩，以及右侧背景中延伸过来的悬崖峭壁。

人物与表情：
面向前方，{argument name="expression" default="温柔微笑"} 并注视着镜头。小巧的鹅蛋脸，圆润的脸颊，杏仁眼，水润的珊瑚粉色嘴唇。清透的日系妆容，配有淡粉色腮红和自然的卧蚕。棕色长发垂至胸下，留有薄刘海，发尾微卷。一朵 {argument name="accessory" default="小白花"} 装饰在发侧。

姿势与服装：
象牙白三角比基尼，带有细肩带、小荷叶边、中心蝴蝶结和侧边系带。材质有精致的褶皱和微光感。她双臂向斜上方伸展，挺起胸膛，躯干微微倾斜。单脚站在浅水中，另一条膝盖在身后弯曲，仿佛正准备跳跃。

背景与光影：
透明的浅滩从前景延伸至中景，水面有细微的涟漪和倒影。右侧是覆盖着植被的深灰色岩壁，左侧是带有小型礁石的地平线。明亮的蓝天白云。来自左上方的强烈夏日阳光在皮肤、水面和头发上投下高光。

构图与摄影：
3:4 竖构图。人物位于画面中心偏右位置，全身构图。张开的双臂延伸至画面边缘，上方蓝天留有空间。自然的透视感，焦点集中在面部和躯干，中等景深。

质感与风格：
高分辨率写实度假摄影。皮肤、湿润的水珠、沙粒和岩石的质感细节丰富。以蓝色和绿松石色为主调的清爽夏日色彩，与象牙白和肤色和谐统一。自然呈现，无过度滤镜。

负面提示词：
手臂或手指畸形；腿部关节或重心不自然；比基尼系带或荷叶边缺失。

en.title: Healing Japanese Style 4-Panel Manga
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a character-consistent four-panel Japanese manga with clean line art and accurate Chinese dialogue bubbles, depicting warm domestic scenes between a couple.
en.prompt:
Generate a set of four-panel Japanese-style warm comics, clean hand-drawn anime line art style, warm rice-brown and light brown monochromatic tones, soft cream background, simple soft shadows, overall warm and healing atmosphere. Aspect ratio: square 1:1, standard 2x2 four-panel layout, separated by thin brown borders between each panel. Top title: large characters "{argument name="title" default="Couple's Day"}", with a small heart on each side, handwritten dark brown feel.
[Four-panel content]
Panel 1: Standing portrait of a young Asian couple. The {argument name="male character" default="man"} stands behind the {argument name="female character" default="woman"}, hands gently on her shoulders, both smiling at the camera.
Panel 2: The couple sitting in a cozy interior, holding mugs with both hands, smiling at each other. The woman has a clear Chinese dialogue bubble: "Thank you for always being with me." White rounded dialogue bubble, clear black text.
Panel 3: The couple cooking together in the kitchen. Standing side by side at the stove, the man stirring, the woman helping, expressions focused and happy.
Panel 4: The couple hugging tightly. The man bows his head to gently kiss the woman's forehead, the woman closes her eyes and smiles.
[Character Consistency Mandatory Requirements]
The two characters must maintain exactly the same face, hairstyle, clothing, and body proportions from Panel 1 to Panel 4. No drifting allowed.
Man: short hair, gentle looks, wearing a simple sweater or shirt.
Woman: medium-length hair, gentle looks, wearing home-style clothes.
[Style and Texture]
Clean hand-drawn anime line art, monochromatic warm rice-brown + light brown + cream white, simple shadows, like Japanese lifestyle manga or healing illustrations.
[Text Requirements]
The Chinese in the dialogue bubbles must be correct, clear, without garbled characters or deformation. Avoid: realistic photography, 3D rendering, bright colors, complex backgrounds, character face collapse, garbled text, cheap sticker feel.

第 1 格：一对年轻亚洲情侣的站立肖像。{argument name="male character" default="男性"} 站在 {argument name="female character" default="女性"} 身后，双手轻轻搭在她的肩膀上，两人都对着镜头微笑。

干净的手绘动漫线条艺术，单色温暖米棕色 + 浅棕色 + 奶油白，简单的阴影，类似于日式生活漫画或治愈系插画。

对话气泡中的中文必须准确、清晰，不得出现乱码或变形。避免：写实摄影、3D 渲染、鲜艳色彩、复杂背景、角色面部崩坏、乱码文字、廉价贴纸感。
