成年 {argument name="subject" default="年轻日本女性"}，五官精致耐看，皮肤真实细腻，自然光。身材苗条匀称，颈部修长，锁骨明显。发型为侧编高马尾，搭配足球珠饰发圈、亚克力耳环和细链项链。妆容为 {argument name="makeup style" default="粉嫩感"}，眼下贴有足球亮片贴纸，脸颊绘有球队配色条纹和足球彩绘。

身穿 {argument name="clothing" default="浅粉色与银白色露肩短上衣"}，搭配高腰 A 字短裙和轻薄透明的应援外套，服装上点缀着足球图案、数字补丁、奖杯和草坪印花。手腕佩戴足球珠饰和硅胶应援手环。

背景为真实的世界杯球场室内观赛区，包含座椅、栏杆、标识牌和球迷人群。背景轻微虚化，画面清新且引人注目。

en.title: Stylized Footballer Concept Art
en.description: Generates a full-body painterly concept illustration of a heroic footballer in a red jersey and black shorts for character design or sports art use.
en.prompt: Create a full-body stylized digital character illustration of a tall athletic male footballer resembling {argument name="character name" default="Cristiano Ronaldo"}, standing in a confident fashion-pose on a plain light gray-white background. Use a painterly concept-art style with sharp angular brushwork, exaggerated heroic proportions, long muscular legs, broad shoulders, narrow waist, and a stern focused facial expression. He has short dark cropped hair, tan skin, strong cheekbones, and looks slightly downward with a serious attitude. Outfit: an oversized red Manchester United-inspired football jersey with a dark diagonal shoulder stripe, white pointed collar detail, small crest on the left chest, and loose rolled sleeves; the shirt is lifted high to reveal the abdomen and midriff. Add black football shorts with red side stripes and a large white number {argument name="shorts number" default="7"} on the front right leg. Pose: one hand planted on the hip, the other arm hanging down, torso leaning slightly back, legs long and asymmetrical with one knee relaxed. Footwear: mismatched football boots, one bright {argument name="left boot color" default="red"} boot and one {argument name="right boot color" default="black"} boot, with black socks and loose shin-guard-like folds around the ankles. Lighting should be soft studio lighting with minimal shadow, muted colors, high-contrast dark red and black sportswear, no crowd, no field, no text, no watermark, no extra characters. Preserve the rough fashion-concept sketch feel rather than photorealism.

zh.title: 风格化足球运动员概念艺术
zh.description: 生成一张全身油画风格的概念插图，描绘一名身穿红色球衣和黑色短裤的英勇足球运动员，适用于角色设计或体育艺术创作。
zh.prompt: 创作一张全身风格化的数字角色插图，描绘一名高大健壮的男性足球运动员，外形类似于 {argument name="character name" default="Cristiano Ronaldo"}，以自信的时尚姿势站在纯浅灰白色的背景上。采用油画概念艺术风格，运用锐利的棱角笔触、夸张的英雄比例、修长的双腿、宽阔的肩膀、窄腰以及严肃专注的面部表情。他留着短发，肤色黝黑，颧骨突出，神情严肃，目光略微向下。服装：一件超大号的曼联风格红色足球球衣，带有深色斜向肩带、白色尖领细节、左胸前有小徽章，袖口宽松卷起；球衣向上撩起，露出腹部和腰部。黑色足球短裤，侧面有红色条纹，右腿前侧印有巨大的白色数字 {argument name="shorts number" default="7"}。姿势：一只手叉腰，另一只手臂下垂，躯干微微后倾，双腿修长且不对称，一只膝盖放松。鞋类：鸳鸯足球鞋，一只为亮 {argument name="left boot color" default="red"} 色，另一只为 {argument name="right boot color" default="black"} 色，搭配黑色球袜，脚踝处有类似护腿板的松散褶皱。光照应为柔和的摄影棚灯光，阴影极少，色彩柔和，采用高对比度的深红色和黑色运动装，无观众，无球场，无文字，无水印，无额外角色。保持粗犷的时尚概念草图质感，而非写实风格。

en.title: Calm Beach Portrait
en.description: A photorealistic vertical fashion portrait of a calm young man standing by foamy ocean waves on an overcast beach.
en.prompt: Create a realistic full-body editorial portrait of {argument name="person description" default="a young Black man with short black hair, smooth medium-brown skin, natural facial proportions, clean-shaven face, calm introspective expression, eyes looking downward"} standing alone at the edge of the ocean on a misty overcast beach. He is centered slightly left of frame, photographed from head to shoes, with both hands tucked casually into his trouser pockets and his posture relaxed, head bowed gently as if in quiet thought. Dress him in exactly 4 visible outfit/accessory elements: a muted slate-blue short-sleeve linen camp-collar button-up shirt worn untucked and partly open at the neck, loose off-white linen trousers, clean white loafers, and a subtle bracelet or watch at one wrist. The shoreline curves diagonally behind and beside him, with dark wet sand under his feet, shallow reflective water, white sea foam wrapping around the foreground, and soft grey-blue waves receding into a hazy horizon. Use a calm, minimalist, cinematic mood that communicates quiet strength rather than drama. Lighting should be soft natural daylight under a pale grey sky, with low contrast, gentle shadows, muted colors, and shallow-to-moderate depth of field; background waves slightly blurred while the subject remains crisp. Composition should be vertical 4:5, eye-level to slightly low perspective, plenty of negative space in the sky, no text, no logos, no other people, no props, no stylization, photorealistic fashion photography with accurate fabric texture and natural skin detail.

zh.title: 宁静海滩肖像
zh.description: 一张写实的竖版时尚肖像，描绘了一位年轻男子站在阴天海滩的泡沫海浪旁，神情平静。
zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的全全身编辑类肖像，主角为 {argument name="person description" default="一位留着黑色短发、肤色为中等棕色且光滑、面部比例自然、面容清爽、神情平静内敛、双眼向下看的年轻黑人男性"}，他独自站在雾气弥漫的阴天海滩边。构图上，他位于画面偏左侧，从头到脚全身入镜，双手随意插在裤兜里，姿态放松，头部微微低垂，仿佛陷入沉思。请为他搭配 4 件清晰可见的服饰/配饰：一件哑光石板蓝短袖亚麻古巴领衬衫（下摆自然垂下，领口微敞）、宽松的米白色亚麻长裤、干净的白色乐福鞋，以及手腕上的一款精致手链或手表。海岸线在他身后及身侧呈对角线延伸，脚下是深色的湿沙，浅滩处有倒影，白色的海浪泡沫环绕在前景，灰蓝色的海浪退向朦胧的地平线。采用平静、极简、电影感的氛围，传达出一种静谧的力量而非戏剧性。光线应为阴天苍白天空下的柔和自然光，低对比度，阴影柔和，色彩沉稳，景深适中；背景海浪略微虚化，主体保持清晰。构图采用 4:5 竖版，平视至微仰视角，天空留白充足，无文字，无 Logo，无其他人物，无道具，无风格化处理，呈现具有真实织物纹理和自然皮肤细节的写实时尚摄影效果。

en.title: Bloom in Silence Portrait Poster
en.description: Generates a photorealistic new Chinese-style editorial portrait poster with magnolia blossoms, qipao styling, and elegant magazine-cover typography.
en.prompt: Create a refined editorial portrait poster for a new Chinese-style photo collection. A graceful middle-aged East Asian woman with {argument name="facial features" default="soft oval face, bright almond eyes, natural brows, gentle smile, fair skin, elegant mature beauty"} stands slightly left of center, turned three-quarters toward the camera, looking directly at the viewer with a calm, warm expression. She wears a sleeveless pale gray-beige qipao/cheongsam with subtle botanical print, muted green piping, and traditional frog closures at the collar and chest. Her {argument name="hairstyle" default="black hair loosely pinned in a low updo with a white magnolia flower tucked behind one ear"} is elegant and slightly wispy. Surround her with white magnolia blossoms: count 5 visible flower clusters on branches, including 2 soft blurred foreground clusters at the lower left and left edge, 2 sharp upper-left branching clusters arching across the top, and 1 branch held near the lower right. Use a dark blue-gray textured studio backdrop, cinematic soft side lighting, shallow depth of field, delicate haze, realistic skin texture, high-end portrait photography, quiet poetic Chinese aesthetic, muted cool tones, fine art magazine cover composition. Add large elegant thin serif title text across the bottom reading {argument name="main title" default="BLOOM IN SILENCE"}; beneath it add smaller Chinese text reading {argument name="subtitle text" default="静放花开"} with thin horizontal divider lines and a small floral icon. In the upper right, add small refined vertical typography: Chinese text “新中式写真作品集”, below it small English text “NEW CHINESE STYLE PHOTO COLLECTION”, a short horizontal line, then vertical Chinese words “静温 / 水柔 / 戴有 / 心骨”, followed by a small flower icon and a thin vertical line. Keep typography pale gray-white, minimal and airy. Portrait orientation 3:4, luxury editorial poster, photorealistic, no watermark, no extra people, no modern props.

zh.title: “静放花开”人像海报
zh.description: 生成一张包含玉兰花、旗袍造型及优雅杂志封面排版的新中式写实人像海报。
zh.prompt: 为全新的新中式摄影作品集创作一张精致的杂志风人像海报。一位优雅的东亚中年女性，拥有 {argument name="facial features" default="柔和的鹅蛋脸、明亮的杏眼、自然的眉形、温婉的笑容、白皙的皮肤，展现出优雅成熟之美"}，站在画面偏左位置，身体侧向镜头四分之三处，直视镜头，表情平静而温暖。她身着一件无袖浅灰米色旗袍，饰有淡雅的植物印花、柔和的绿色滚边，领口和胸前配有传统盘扣。她的 {argument name="hairstyle" default="黑色秀发松散地盘成低发髻，耳后别着一朵白玉兰花"}，造型优雅且带有几分灵动。周围环绕着白玉兰花：画面中可见 5 簇花枝，包括左下角和左边缘 2 簇柔焦前景花丛，左上方 2 簇横跨顶部的清晰花枝，以及右下方手持的 1 簇花枝。背景采用深蓝灰色纹理摄影棚背景，运用电影感柔和侧光、浅景深、细腻雾气，呈现真实皮肤质感、高端人像摄影风格、静谧诗意的新中式美学、低饱和冷色调以及艺术杂志封面构图。在底部添加大型优雅纤细的衬线标题文字 {argument name="main title" default="BLOOM IN SILENCE"}；下方添加较小的中文副标题 {argument name="subtitle text" default="静放花开"}，并配以纤细的水平分割线和小型花卉图标。在右上角添加精致的竖排文字：中文“新中式写真作品集”，下方为小型英文“NEW CHINESE STYLE PHOTO COLLECTION”，配以短横线，随后是竖排中文“静温 / 水柔 / 戴有 / 心骨”，末尾点缀小型花卉图标和纤细竖线。排版保持浅灰白色，风格简约通透。人像比例 3:4，奢华杂志海报质感，照片级真实，无水印，无无关人物，无现代道具。

en.title: Cozy Morning Pillow Portrait
en.description: Generates a warm candid bedroom portrait of a young woman in pajamas holding a pillow with whimsical doodles, suitable for lifestyle or social media visuals.
en.prompt: Create a soft, naturalistic lifestyle portrait of a {argument name="character description" default="young East Asian woman in her twenties"} spending a lazy weekend morning in a cozy vintage bedroom. She stands centered in a doorway or closet nook, facing the camera with a calm, slightly playful sleepy expression, clear eyes, subtle makeup, and realistic skin texture. Her {argument name="hair style" default="long black hair loosely tied in a low ponytail with wispy strands falling around her face"} should look casual and slightly messy. She wears a loose plain white short-sleeve V-neck T-shirt and {argument name="pants" default="blue-black gingham plaid loose pajama pants"}. Her arms are raised above her head, holding a large cream-colored pillow horizontally like a soft cushion resting over the top of her head. Use warm diffused morning light from the left, with a sheer white curtain occupying the left edge of the frame and creating a hazy, gentle glow. The room is small and homey with dark wooden trim, off-white walls, hanging clothes in the background including a dark striped sweater, a crocheted vest, and denim fabric, plus a dark suitcase or storage box near the floor. Add delicate white hand-drawn doodles overlaying the photo: exactly 13 visible doodle elements consisting of the handwritten words {argument name="doodle text" default="morning chaos"}, four small stars near the text and upper right, two tiny hearts, one small bunny-like scribble, one crescent moon, one dashed curved trail on the left, one dashed curved trail on the right, and two small sparkle marks. Style the image as an intimate candid film photograph with soft focus, mild grain, pastel warmth, vertical 4:5 composition, no harsh contrast, no glamour retouching, no extra people, no watermark, and no additional readable text beyond the doodle phrase.

zh.title: 舒适晨间枕头肖像
zh.description: 生成一张温暖自然的卧室肖像，画面中一位穿着睡衣的年轻女性抱着绘有奇趣涂鸦的枕头，适合生活方式或社交媒体视觉素材。
zh.prompt: 创作一张柔和、自然的生活方式肖像，画面中一位 {argument name="character description" default="二十多岁的东亚年轻女性"} 正在舒适的复古卧室中度过慵懒的周末早晨。她站在门口或衣橱角落的中心位置，面向镜头，表情平静且带有一丝俏皮的睡意，双眼清澈，妆容淡雅，皮肤纹理真实。她的 {argument name="hair style" default="黑色长发随意扎成低马尾，几缕碎发散落在脸颊旁"} 看起来随意且略显凌乱。她穿着一件宽松的纯白色短袖 V 领 T 恤和 {argument name="pants" default="蓝黑色格纹宽松睡裤"}。她双手举过头顶，横向抱着一个大大的奶油色枕头，就像一个柔软的靠垫放在头顶上方。使用来自左侧温暖的漫射晨光，画面左边缘有半透明的白色窗帘，营造出朦胧柔和的光晕。房间小巧温馨，带有深色木质装饰，墙面呈灰白色，背景中挂着衣服，包括一件深色条纹毛衣、一件钩针编织背心和牛仔布料，地板附近还有一个深色的行李箱或储物盒。在照片上添加精致的白色手绘涂鸦：共 13 个可见的涂鸦元素，包括手写文字 {argument name="doodle text" default="morning chaos"}、文字附近及右上角的四颗小星星、两个小爱心、一个像小兔子一样的涂鸦、一个月牙、左侧一条虚线弧形轨迹、右侧一条虚线弧形轨迹以及两个小闪光标记。图像风格为亲密自然的胶片摄影，具有柔焦、轻微颗粒感、柔和的暖色调，采用 4:5 竖构图，无强烈对比，无精修美颜，无额外人物，无水印，且除涂鸦短语外无其他可读文字。

en.title: Realistic Korean Mirror Selfie
en.description: Generates a polished vertical bathroom mirror selfie portrait of a fashionable young East Asian woman for social media-style imagery.
en.prompt: Create a highly realistic vertical mirror selfie portrait of {argument name="character description" default="a woman in her 20s with delicate Korean-inspired East Asian features, fair natural skin, soft dimensional facial structure, large deep brown eyes, subtle pink eye makeup, natural aegyo-sal, fine eyelashes, muted rosy-mauve lips, slight blush, and visible realistic skin texture"}. She has {argument name="hair style" default="voluminous long black wavy hair with a center part and airy curtain bangs, slightly messy strands falling naturally over the shoulders"}. She stands indoors in a small tiled bathroom or dressing-room mirror, looking slightly downward and to the side with a calm, shy, photogenic expression while holding a white/silver triple-camera smartphone close to her face for a selfie. Composition is waist-up, vertical 4:5, intimate social-media aesthetic, the phone covers part of the right side of her face, her hand and fingers are prominent with glossy brown manicured nails and a delicate ring. Outfit: fitted {argument name="top color and style" default="plain white short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt"} tucked into high-waisted white bottoms with a visible button and belt loops. Accessories include exactly 4 visible items: a thin necklace with a tiny pendant, a gold ring, a gold chain bracelet, and a black shoulder bag strap with metal hardware on her right side. Background: beige and cream square mosaic wall tiles reflected in the mirror, a warm wooden frame along the left edge, a chrome towel bar on the upper right, and faint handwritten mirror text reading {argument name="mirror quote" default="Be your own kind of beautiful"} with a small heart. Lighting is soft warm indoor light, gentle highlights on skin and hair, realistic smartphone photo quality, shallow natural depth, no exaggerated glamour retouching, no extra people, no watermark, no distorted hands or phone.

zh.title: 写实韩系镜面自拍
zh.description: 生成一张精致的竖版浴室镜面自拍肖像，展现时尚的东亚年轻女性，适用于社交媒体风格的图像。
zh.prompt: 创作一张高度写实的竖版镜面自拍肖像，主角为 {argument name="character description" default="一位 20 多岁的女性，拥有精致的韩系东亚面容、白皙自然的肤色、柔和立体的面部轮廓、深邃的大棕眼、淡雅的粉色眼妆、自然的卧蚕、纤细的睫毛、柔和的玫瑰豆沙色嘴唇、淡淡的腮红以及清晰可见的写实皮肤纹理"}。她留着 {argument name="hair style" default="蓬松的黑色长卷发，中分发型搭配空气感八字刘海，几缕发丝自然地垂落在肩头"}。她身处室内，站在小型瓷砖浴室或更衣室的镜子前，微微低头看向一侧，表情平静、羞涩且上镜，手中拿着一部白色/银色的三摄智能手机进行自拍。构图为腰部以上，竖版 4:5 比例，呈现亲密的社交媒体美学；手机遮挡住她右脸的部分区域，手部和手指清晰可见，指甲修剪整齐并涂有亮面棕色指甲油，佩戴着精致的戒指。服装：修身的 {argument name="top color and style" default="纯白色短袖圆领 T 恤"}，扎进高腰白色下装中，可见纽扣和腰带环。配饰包含 4 件清晰可见的物品：一条带有小吊坠的细项链、一枚金戒指、一条金链手链，以及右侧可见带有金属扣件的黑色单肩包背带。背景：镜中反射出米色和奶油色的方形马赛克墙砖，左侧边缘有温暖的木质边框，右上角有镀铬毛巾杆，镜面上写有模糊的手写文字 {argument name="mirror quote" default="Be your own kind of beautiful"} 并配有一个小爱心。光线为柔和的室内暖光，皮肤和头发上有细腻的高光，呈现写实的智能手机拍摄画质，具有自然的浅景深，无夸张的精修美颜，无多余人物，无水印，无扭曲的手部或手机。

en.title: Chibi Chimera Demon Girl
en.description: Generates a whimsical watercolor anime full-body fantasy chimera girl character sheet-style illustration with cute spooky companion details.
en.prompt: Create a full-body fantasy chibi character illustration on a clean white background in a delicate watercolor-and-ink anime style. The subject is {argument name="character name" default="Kurumi"}, a cute carnivorous chimera demon girl with a small childlike body, oversized head, warm blush, happy open-mouth smile, and large sparkling {argument name="eye color" default="blue"} eyes. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} hair with loose strands, two large black twisted ram-like horns, wide animal ears with dark outer fur and reddish inner fur, small black-purple bat wings, furry spotted animal arms ending in little claws, furry legs with dark paws and claws, and a long striped feline tail curling to the right with small golden flower/star charms. Dress her in a black ruffled off-shoulder crop top, dark denim mini skirt with frayed hem, black belt with a round gold buckle, dangling chain with a star charm, star earrings, and a small star necklace. Add exactly 12 decorative fantasy elements around her: 1 small floating crown above her head, 1 tiny bat flying on the upper left, 5 scattered golden stars/sparkles around the body, 1 tiny black cat at lower right with yellow eyes, 1 small scarecrow-like ghost doll at lower left wearing a tall crooked witch hat with a gold star, 1 wooden crate behind the doll, 1 tiny blue-roofed tower at the lower right, and 1 distant miniature castle silhouette near her feet. Use a soft sketchy line quality, translucent watercolor washes, warm beige shadows, subtle paper texture, and whimsical storybook charm. Place a handwritten signature reading {argument name="signature text" default="Kurumi"} near the bottom right. Keep the composition vertical, centered, airy, cute rather than scary, with no borders, no UI elements, and no extra text.

zh.title: Q 版奇美拉恶魔少女
zh.description: 生成一张充满奇幻色彩的水彩动漫风格全身奇美拉少女角色设定图，并包含可爱的幽灵同伴细节。
zh.prompt: 在干净的白色背景上，创作一张精致的水彩墨水动漫风格全身 Q 版奇幻角色插画。主体是 {argument name="character name" default="Kurumi"}，一个可爱的食肉奇美拉恶魔少女，拥有娇小的孩童身体、超大的头部、温暖的红晕、开心的张嘴笑容，以及闪烁的 {argument name="eye color" default="blue"} 大眼睛。她留着飘逸的 {argument name="hair color" default="blonde"} 长发，发丝自然垂落，头上长着两只巨大的黑色扭曲羊角，宽大的动物耳朵外侧覆盖深色毛发，内侧为红棕色，背部有小巧的黑紫色蝙蝠翅膀，毛茸茸的斑点动物手臂末端是小爪子，毛茸茸的双腿长着深色爪足，身后是一条向右卷曲的条纹猫科动物尾巴，上面装饰着金色小花/星星挂件。为她穿上黑色荷叶边露肩短款上衣、深色牛仔迷你裙（带磨损边）、带有圆形金扣的黑色腰带，并佩戴带有星星挂件的垂坠链条、星星耳环和一条小星星项链。在角色周围添加 12 个装饰性奇幻元素：头顶上方 1 个悬浮的小皇冠，左上方 1 只飞翔的小蝙蝠，身体周围散落 5 颗金色星星/闪光，右下方 1 只黄色眼睛的小黑猫，左下方 1 个戴着金色星星歪斜高帽的稻草人式幽灵玩偶，玩偶后方 1 个木箱，右下方 1 座蓝色屋顶的小塔，以及脚边 1 个远处的微型城堡剪影。采用柔和的素描线条、半透明水彩晕染、温暖的米色阴影、细腻的纸张纹理，营造出奇幻的绘本魅力。在右下角添加手写签名 {argument name="signature text" default="Kurumi"}。保持垂直构图，居中，画面通透，风格可爱而非恐怖，无边框，无 UI 元素，无额外文字。

en.title: Rainy Coastal Schoolgirl Scene
en.description: A cinematic photorealistic prompt for generating a Japanese schoolgirl standing on a wet seaside road at blue hour.
en.prompt: Create a cinematic photorealistic wide shot of {argument name="character name" default="a Japanese high school girl"} standing on the left side of a wet seaside road at blue hour after rain. She is full-body, facing slightly toward the camera with a gentle smile, long straight black hair with bangs, wearing a navy school blazer, white shirt, red ribbon tie, blue plaid pleated skirt, navy knee-high socks, and black loafers. The setting is a quiet coastal road curving to the right, with the ocean on the left behind a metal guardrail, a large dark rocky sea stack near the horizon, and exactly 2 lit streetlamps casting warm orange reflections across the rain-slick asphalt. Add distant utility poles, a small dark roadside shelter on the far right, low greenery along the roadside, deep blue cloudy dusk sky, and calm moody atmosphere. Use realistic Japanese live-action drama photography, 16:9 horizontal composition, shallow but natural depth of field, soft cinematic lighting, wet pavement reflections, cool blue color grade contrasted with warm lamp glow, no text, no watermark, no extra people or vehicles.

zh.title: 雨中海岸女学生场景
zh.description: 一个电影级照片写实风格的提示词，用于生成在蓝调时刻站在潮湿海滨道路上的日本女学生。
zh.prompt: 创建一个电影级照片写实风格的广角镜头，画面主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一名日本女高中生"}，她站在雨后蓝调时刻潮湿的海滨道路左侧。全身镜头，身体微向镜头侧转，面带温柔微笑，留着黑色长直发并带有刘海，身穿海军蓝校服西装外套、白衬衫、红色领结、蓝色格纹百褶裙、海军蓝过膝袜和黑色乐福鞋。背景是一条向右弯曲的宁静海岸公路，左侧金属护栏外是海洋，地平线附近有一座巨大的深色海蚀柱，画面中恰好有 2 盏路灯，将温暖的橙色光影投射在雨后湿滑的沥青路面上。添加远处的电线杆、右侧远处的一个小型深色路边遮雨棚、路边的低矮绿植、深蓝色的多云黄昏天空，营造出平静而忧郁的氛围。采用写实风格的日本真人剧摄影质感，16:9 横向构图，浅而自然的景深，柔和的电影级布光，湿润路面的倒影，冷蓝色调与温暖灯光形成对比，无文字，无水印，画面中无其他人物或车辆。

en.title: Realistic City Selfie
en.description: Generates a natural Instagram-style lifestyle selfie of a young woman walking through a sunny Japanese city street.
en.prompt: Create a highly realistic casual smartphone selfie that looks like an authentic Instagram Story lifestyle snap taken outdoors in a Japanese city. The subject is a cheerful young woman, {argument name="character name" default="unnamed"}, with {argument name="hair color" default="short blonde hair with soft face-framing bangs"}, warm natural makeup, clear glowing skin, small hoop earrings, and a gentle closed-mouth smile while looking directly into the phone camera. She is holding the phone high and slightly wide-angle, arm extended toward the lower-left foreground, creating a natural selfie distortion and an intimate candid feel. She wears a plain white crew-neck T-shirt tucked into light blue high-waisted denim shorts, a thin silver necklace, a white watch or bracelet, and carries a beige canvas tote bag over one shoulder. In her other hand she holds exactly 2 visible items: an iced coffee in a clear plastic cup with a domed lid and black straw, and a white plastic shopping bag. Set the scene on a sunny sidewalk near a crosswalk, with urban storefronts, leafy street trees, a cafe terrace with warm interior lights, tiled pavement, tactile paving, and exactly 1 parked bicycle visible on the right side. Include a few distant pedestrians in the background, softly blurred. Use late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight, natural shadows, realistic skin texture, subtle lens distortion, smartphone HDR look, shallow but not overly artificial depth of field, and a candid everyday fashion-photo mood. The overall atmosphere should be {argument name="overall mood" default="natural, friendly, stylish, and unposed"}. No text overlays, no watermark, no beauty-pageant posing, no studio lighting, no fantasy elements.

zh.title: 写实城市自拍
zh.description: 生成一张自然、Instagram 风格的年轻女性漫步于日本城市街头的日常自拍。
zh.prompt: 创作一张极具真实感的手机自拍，呈现出如同在 Instagram Story 上发布的日本城市户外生活照。主角是一位开朗的年轻女性，{argument name="character name" default="未命名"}，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="修饰脸型的短金发刘海"}，妆容自然温暖，皮肤清透有光泽，佩戴小巧的圆环耳饰，对着手机镜头露出温柔的闭口微笑。她将手机举高并以略微广角的方式拍摄，手臂向左下方延伸，营造出自然的自拍畸变和亲切的抓拍感。她身穿纯白色圆领 T 恤，搭配浅蓝色高腰牛仔短裤，戴着细银项链和白色手表或手链，肩上背着一个米色帆布托特包。她的另一只手拿着 2 件清晰可见的物品：一杯带圆顶盖和黑色吸管的透明塑料杯装冰咖啡，以及一个白色塑料购物袋。场景设定在阳光明媚的人行道旁，靠近人行横道，背景可见城市店面、茂密的行道树、带有温暖室内灯光的咖啡馆露台、瓷砖路面、盲道，以及右侧停放的 1 辆自行车。背景中包含几位模糊处理的远景行人。采用午后黄金时段的阳光、自然阴影、真实的皮肤纹理、细微的镜头畸变、智能手机 HDR 质感、适度且不刻意的景深，以及随性时尚的抓拍氛围。整体氛围应为 {argument name="overall mood" default="自然、友好、时尚且不刻意摆拍"}。画面中不得包含文字叠加、水印、选美式摆拍、摄影棚灯光或奇幻元素。

en.title: Pastel Anime Virtual Singer Debut Poster
en.description: Generates a glossy anime idol single-release poster with a central virtual singer, holographic UI elements, track list, release date, and tour information.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished vertical anime music debut advertisement poster for a virtual singer named {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"}, themed around a crystalline pastel debut single.

Canvas: Tall vertical poster, portrait orientation, high-resolution, airy white background with pale sky-blue, lavender, and pink gradients. Use a glossy idol-advertising layout with translucent UI panels, holographic shards, sparkles, bokeh, and soft music-wave graphics.

Main subject: A single beautiful anime girl shown from bust to head, slightly turned over her shoulder toward the viewer. She has fluffy ash-blonde/light beige hair in a loose low side bun with windblown strands and long bangs, large golden-brown sparkling eyes, pink blush, and a delicate open-mouthed expression. Add a pastel flower hair arrangement on the left side of her head with exactly 5 visible flower/color clusters: pink cherry blossoms, pale blue hydrangea, tiny white baby’s breath, small yellow-green buds, and soft green leaves. She wears an iridescent white-and-silver futuristic idol outfit with translucent straps, lace trim, a crystal choker, shoulder harness, small buckles, glowing cyan and pink accents, and a headset microphone with a glowing blue earpiece and clear mic tip. Her mood is pure, gentle, dreamy, and slightly melancholic.

Central title design: Place a large glowing cursive song title {argument name="song title" default="Lumière"} across the lower middle in neon white-pink script, with a faint underline light trail and sparkles. Beneath it add small Japanese katakana reading “ルミエール”. Add a small diagonal blue label above the title reading “のぞむ Debut Single”.

Poster text and layout: Top left: large artist name “NOZOMU” in pale blue gradient, with smaller Japanese “のぞむ” below. Under it create a debut number block reading exactly “DEBUT NUMBER” and a huge “01”, with barcode-style lines. Left mid profile panel: include exactly 4 profile lines: “HEIGHT _ 158cm”, “BIRTHDAY _ 4.24”, “VOICE _ Soft & Clear”, “CHARM _ Smile”, plus a small waveform. Left side vertical slogan in a translucent panel: “キミの心に、やさしい歌を。” Top right release panel: “NEW DIGITAL SINGLE”, large date {argument name="release date" default="2026 06.26 FRI"}, “RELEASE”, and a barcode. Right mid track-list card: include exactly 5 numbered tracks: “01. Lumière”, “02. 雨上がりの花束”, “03. Mirage”, “04. 透明なメロディ”, “05. 小さな願いごと”, plus total time “18:42”. Right lower music player widget: waveform display, “NOW PLAYING”, “Lumière”, time “00:26”, and exactly 3 round control buttons: previous, play, next. Bottom left: large Japanese name “のぞむ”, a blue tag “Next Generation Virtual Singer”, and the English tagline with exactly 3 lines: “Your voice,” “my light.” “Our future.” Bottom center: live tour information “LIVE TOUR 2026” and tour name {argument name="tour title" default="Starlight ‘Bloom ✦’"}. Under it list exactly 5 tour dates/cities: “07.18 TOKYO”, “08.02 OSAKA”, “08.16 NAGOYA”, “08.30 FUKUOKA”, “09.13 SAPPORO”. Bottom right: a small white card labeled “SPECIAL SITE & MUSIC” containing a QR-code-like square.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed modern anime illustration, delicate linework, soft watercolor-like skin shading, glossy eyes, high-key lighting, translucent holographic overlays, glassmorphism panels, pastel cyber-idol aesthetic, elegant typography mixing clean sans-serif UI text and large glowing cursive title. Add floating crystal shards and petals throughout; use exactly 3 prominent cyan crystal shards near the upper/right areas and many tiny pink petals and sparkles as atmospheric accents.

Constraints: Keep the character as the clear focal point, avoid dark heavy colors, keep all text integrated like a real Japanese idol single poster, preserve the exact counts for profile lines, tracks, player buttons, tour stops, and flower clusters, and do not add extra characters.

zh.title: 粉彩动漫虚拟歌手出道海报
zh.description: 生成一张精美的动漫偶像单曲发布海报，包含核心虚拟歌手、全息 UI 元素、曲目列表、发布日期及巡演信息。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张精致的竖版动漫音乐出道宣传海报，主角为虚拟歌手 {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"}，主题为晶莹剔透的粉彩风格出道单曲。

画布：高竖版海报，肖像构图，高分辨率，以轻盈的白色为背景，辅以淡天蓝色、薰衣草紫和粉色的渐变。采用亮面偶像宣传布局，包含半透明 UI 面板、全息碎片、闪光、虚化效果及柔和的音乐波形图形。

主体：一位美丽的动漫少女，半身像，身体略微转向观众。她留着蓬松的灰金色/浅米色头发，扎成松散的低侧发髻，有随风飘动的发丝和长刘海；拥有金色大眼睛，闪烁着光芒，脸颊泛红，表情细腻，微张着嘴。在头部左侧添加一个粉彩花卉发饰，包含 5 簇清晰可见的花朵/颜色组合：粉色樱花、淡蓝色绣球花、细小的白色满天星、嫩黄色小花蕾和柔嫩的绿叶。她身穿虹彩白银色的未来感偶像服装，配有半透明肩带、蕾丝边、水晶颈圈、肩部束带、小扣环、发光的青色和粉色装饰，以及带有发光蓝色耳机和透明麦克风头的头戴式麦克风。整体氛围纯净、温柔、梦幻且略带忧郁。

标题设计：在下方中部放置一个巨大的发光连体字歌名 {argument name="song title" default="Lumière"}，采用霓虹白粉色手写体，下方带有淡淡的拖影光效和闪光。下方添加小号日文片假名“ルミエール”。在标题上方添加一个蓝色小斜标，写着“のぞむ Debut Single”。

海报文字与布局：左上角：巨大的艺名“NOZOMU”，采用淡蓝色渐变，下方附带较小的日文“のぞむ”。下方创建出道编号块，明确写着“DEBUT NUMBER”和巨大的“01”，并配有条形码风格线条。左侧中间资料面板：包含 4 行个人资料：“HEIGHT _ 158cm”、“BIRTHDAY _ 4.24”、“VOICE _ Soft & Clear”、“CHARM _ Smile”，以及一个小波形图。左侧垂直标语面板（半透明）： “キミの心に、やさしい歌を。” 右上角发布面板：“NEW DIGITAL SINGLE”、大号日期 {argument name="release date" default="2026 06.26 FRI"}、“RELEASE”以及条形码。右侧中间曲目列表卡片：包含 5 首编号曲目：“01. Lumière”、“02. 雨上がりの花束”、“03. Mirage”、“04. 透明なメロディ”、“05. 小さな願いごと”，以及总时长“18:42”。右下角音乐播放器组件：波形显示、“NOW PLAYING”、“Lumière”、时间“00:26”，以及 3 个圆形控制按钮：上一曲、播放、下一曲。左下角：巨大的日文名“のぞむ”、蓝色标签“Next Generation Virtual Singer”，以及 3 行英文标语：“Your voice,” “my light.” “Our future.” 底部中心：巡演信息“LIVE TOUR 2026”及巡演名称 {argument name="tour title" default="Starlight ‘Bloom ✦’"}。下方列出 5 个巡演日期/城市：“07.18 TOKYO”、“08.02 OSAKA”、“08.16 NAGOYA”、“08.30 FUKUOKA”、“09.13 SAPPORO”。右下角：一张标有“SPECIAL SITE & MUSIC”的小白卡，包含一个二维码形状的方块。

视觉风格：超精细现代动漫插画，细腻的线条，柔和的水彩质感皮肤阴影，明亮的眼睛，高调照明，半透明全息叠加，玻璃拟态面板，粉彩赛博偶像美学，优雅的排版（混合简洁的无衬线 UI 文字和巨大的发光连体字标题）。在画面中加入漂浮的水晶碎片和花瓣；在上方/右侧区域使用 3 块醒目的青色水晶碎片，并以大量细小的粉色花瓣和闪光作为氛围点缀。

约束条件：保持角色作为清晰的视觉焦点，避免使用深沉厚重的颜色，确保所有文字像真实的日本偶像单曲海报一样自然融合，严格遵守个人资料行数、曲目数、播放器按钮数、巡演站数和花簇数量，且不得添加额外角色。

en.title: Pastel Anime Maid Senpai
en.description: Generates a soft vertical anime illustration of a pink-haired glasses-wearing maid character in a cute pastel frame.
en.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 soft pastel anime illustration of {argument name="character name" default="Senpai-chan"}, an adult young woman sitting on a fluffy white cushion in a shy forward-leaning pose, knees apart but modestly framed, both hands placed together on the cushion in front of her. She has {argument name="hair color" default="pale pink"} short bob hair with long face-framing bangs, a small side hair clip, large gray-lavender eyes, thin round glasses, and a sleepy, slightly embarrassed expression as if she just woke up. Dress her in a detailed black-and-white frilly maid outfit: exactly 7 main outfit pieces are visible, consisting of a white ruffled maid headband, black puff-sleeve dress with white ruffle trim, white apron, small gray bow at the chest, layered ruffled skirt, white thigh-high stockings with garter straps, and white wrist cuffs. Use delicate line art, smooth cel shading, soft blush tones, and a cute high-quality Japanese anime style with a gentle romantic mood. The composition is centered, full body from head to thighs/feet cropped near the bottom, with prominent frills and lace but no explicit nudity. Background is very pale pink with a thin decorative pink rectangular border and exactly 8 simple decorations: 4 corner flourish curls, 1 dashed heart on the upper left, 1 small heart on the lower right, and 2 sparkle stars on the right side. Use a clean airy aesthetic, soft lighting, subtle shadows, no text, no watermark, and keep the overall palette {argument name="palette" default="pink, white, black, and soft gray"}.

zh.title: 柔和色调动漫学姐女仆
zh.description: 生成一张带有可爱柔和边框、粉色头发戴眼镜的女仆角色竖版动漫插画。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 9:16 竖版柔和色调动漫插画，主角是 {argument name="character name" default="Senpai-chan"}，一位成年年轻女性，正以害羞且身体前倾的姿势坐在蓬松的白色坐垫上，双膝分开但姿态端庄，双手交叠放在身前的坐垫上。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="淡粉色"} 的短波波头，带有修饰脸型的长刘海，侧边别着一个小发夹，拥有一双灰紫色的明亮大眼睛，戴着细圆框眼镜，表情困倦且带着一丝刚睡醒般的羞涩。为她穿上一套精致的黑白荷叶边女仆装：画面中清晰可见 7 个主要服装部件，包括白色荷叶边女仆头饰、带有白色荷叶边装饰的黑色泡泡袖连衣裙、白色围裙、胸前的小灰蝴蝶结、多层荷叶边裙摆、白色过膝袜配吊带，以及白色腕饰。采用细腻的线条、平滑的赛璐珞上色、柔和的腮红调，呈现出高质量的日系动漫风格，营造出温柔浪漫的氛围。构图居中，展示从头部到大腿/脚部的全身像（底部略微裁切），突出荷叶边和蕾丝细节，无任何裸露内容。背景为极淡的粉色，带有细长的粉色装饰矩形边框，以及 8 个简单的装饰元素：4 个角落的卷草纹、左上角 1 个虚线心形、右下角 1 个小爱心，以及右侧 2 个闪耀的星星。整体风格干净通透，光影柔和，阴影细腻，无文字，无水印，色调保持为 {argument name="palette" default="粉色、白色、黑色和柔灰色"}。

en.title: Fantasy Dryad RPG Character Card
en.description: Generates an ornate forest-themed RPG trading card portrait with stats, skills, class title, and collectible fantasy styling.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a highly detailed fantasy RPG character card featuring {argument name="character name" default="Kris"} as a forest-themed dryad warlock, suitable for a social media avatar or collectible game card.

Canvas: Vertical portrait trading-card format, 4:5 ratio, dark black outer background, ornate fantasy card frame filling the image. Use cinematic high-detail digital painting, realistic fantasy illustration, dramatic forest lighting, moss, vines, bark, flowers, and antique metal trim.

Main character: Centered bust portrait of a female dryad with green glowing eyes, cracked bark-like olive skin, serious neutral expression, long wild dark brown hair intertwined with vines, leaves, twigs, and pink flowers. She wears organic armor made of bark, roots, moss, and layered leaves. Behind her is a dense enchanted forest with golden sunlight rays filtering through tall trees and green mist.

Card frame and icons: The border is an elaborate carved wooden-and-metal frame overgrown with vines and leaves, decorated with pink-purple blossoms. Include exactly 3 circular top emblems: top-left level badge reading “LVL 45”, top-center small green leaf crest, and top-right larger green leaf emblem. Include large flowers in the lower corners and scattered blossoms along both sides.

Text layout: Place the character name “{argument name="character name" default="Kris"}” in large elegant white serif type near the lower center. Under it, place the class title “{argument name="class title" default="WARLOCK"}” in spaced green capitals with small leaf ornaments. Below that, add the subtitle line “{argument name="species and role" default="Dryad • Guardian of the Grove"}”.

Left stat panel: Include exactly 5 stats in a vertical list with small colored icons and white numbers: STR 38, INT 92, WIS 87, DEX 64, CON 76.

Right stat panel: Include exactly 5 resource/defense values in a vertical list with small fantasy shield/gem icons: HP 1,140, MP 920, DEF 412, RES 489, SPD 72.

Skill panel: Include exactly 4 ability rows, each with a square icon on the left, a bold ability name, and a one-line description: 1) “Grove Ward” — “Summon vines to shield allies.” 2) “Nature’s Grasp” — “Entangle enemies with ancient roots.” 3) “Verdant Renewal” — “Heal and cleanse allies over time.” 4) “Sporebloom” — “Release toxic spores to weaken foes.”

Footer: Add a small flavor quote at the bottom: “✦ {argument name="footer quote" default="Rooted in silence. I rise."} ✦” with a small green leaf medallion centered beneath it.

Constraints: Keep all text legible and correctly spelled, preserve the exact counts of 3 top emblems, 5 left stats, 5 right values, and 4 skills. Do not add extra characters, extra cards, logos, watermarks, modern UI elements, or unrelated text.

zh.title: 奇幻树精 RPG 角色卡
zh.description: 生成一张华丽的森林主题 RPG 交易卡肖像，包含属性、技能、职业头衔及可收藏的奇幻风格。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张高度精细的奇幻 RPG 角色卡，以 {argument name="character name" default="Kris"} 为主角，塑造一位森林主题的树精术士，适用于社交媒体头像或收藏类游戏卡牌。

画布：竖向肖像交易卡格式，4:5 比例，深黑色外背景，华丽的奇幻卡牌边框填满画面。采用电影级高细节数字绘画、写实奇幻插画风格，运用戏剧性的森林光影、苔藓、藤蔓、树皮、花朵及古董金属装饰。

主要角色：居中的女性树精半身像，拥有绿色发光的双眼、如裂纹树皮般的橄榄色皮肤，表情严肃中性，长长的深棕色乱发中缠绕着藤蔓、叶片、细枝和粉色花朵。她身着由树皮、树根、苔藓和层叠叶片组成的有机盔甲。背景是茂密的魔法森林，金色的阳光透过高大的树木和绿色薄雾倾泻而下。

卡牌边框与图标：边框为精致的雕花木质与金属框架，上面长满了藤蔓和叶片，并装饰着粉紫色花朵。包含 3 个精确的顶部圆形徽章：左上角显示“LVL 45”的等级徽章，顶部中央的小型绿叶纹章，以及右上角较大的绿叶徽章。在下角包含大型花朵，两侧散布着花簇。

文字布局：将角色名称“{argument name="character name" default="Kris"}”以优雅的大号白色衬线字体置于下方中央。在其下方，放置职业头衔“{argument name="class title" default="WARLOCK"}”，使用带有叶片装饰的绿色大写字母，并保持字间距。在其下方，添加副标题行“{argument name="species and role" default="Dryad • Guardian of the Grove"}”。

左侧属性面板：包含 5 项精确的属性，以垂直列表形式排列，配有小型彩色图标和白色数字：STR 38, INT 92, WIS 87, DEX 64, CON 76。

右侧属性面板：包含 5 项精确的资源/防御数值，以垂直列表形式排列，配有小型奇幻盾牌/宝石图标：HP 1,140, MP 920, DEF 412, RES 489, SPD 72。

技能面板：包含 4 行精确的技能，每行左侧配有一个方形图标、加粗的技能名称以及一行描述：1) “Grove Ward” — “召唤藤蔓保护盟友。” 2) “Nature’s Grasp” — “用古老的树根缠绕敌人。” 3) “Verdant Renewal” — “持续治疗并净化盟友。” 4) “Sporebloom” — “释放毒孢子以削弱敌人。”

页脚：在底部添加一句简短的背景引言：“✦ {argument name="footer quote" default="Rooted in silence. I rise."} ✦”，并在其下方居中放置一个小型的绿叶奖章。

约束条件：确保所有文字清晰且拼写正确，保留 3 个顶部徽章、5 个左侧属性、5 个右侧数值以及 4 个技能的精确数量。请勿添加额外角色、额外卡牌、Logo、水印、现代 UI 元素或无关文字。

en.title: Three Mecha Combination Lineup
en.description: A cinematic sci-fi hangar scene showing three labeled transformable mecha units lined up for a robot combination sequence.
en.prompt:
Create a high-detail vertical sci-fi concept art scene showing a “combination sequence” lineup of three futuristic transformable combat mecha vehicles inside a vast white-and-silver orbital hangar. Use a centered, perfectly symmetrical top-down / high three-quarter perspective looking down a long runway, with the three units aligned in a straight vertical column from top to bottom, as if waiting to combine into one giant robot. The hangar floor is glossy pale metal with panel seams, blue illuminated guide strips, recessed tracks, and tall mechanical support pylons along both left and right sides. Add electric blue energy arcs, glowing thruster halos, and holographic aura effects around each unit.

Subject details: include exactly 3 discrete mecha units, each with a visible floor label directly beneath or near it: 1) top unit labeled “UNIT 03 SHADOW”, a sleek white, black, and blue winged stealth fighter-drone mecha with eight sharp radiating wing/fin assemblies and a pointed nose; 2) middle unit labeled “UNIT 02 BULLDOG”, a heavy black, gray, and white tank-like armored mecha with caterpillar treads, bulky rectangular shoulder weapons, large articulated mechanical arms raised outward, and a central cannon barrel; 3) bottom unit labeled “UNIT 01 RAIJIN”, the largest red, white, black, and gunmetal jet-mecha with twin cylindrical engine pods, angular red wing armor, a long dark cockpit nose, and blue thruster glow. Make the bottom unit dominate the foreground, the middle unit occupy the center, and the top unit appear smaller in the distance.

Text content: render the three labels clearly in a compact futuristic HUD font on the floor: “UNIT 03 SHADOW” in blue, “UNIT 02 BULLDOG” in orange, and “UNIT 01 RAIJIN” in red and white. Optional customization: the unit names may be {argument name="unit names" default="UNIT 03 SHADOW, UNIT 02 BULLDOG, UNIT 01 RAIJIN"}.

Visual style: ultra-detailed hard-surface mecha design, cinematic Japanese robot-anime inspiration, photorealistic CGI rendering, crisp panel lines, micro decals, metallic bevels, exposed pistons, weapon mounts, glowing blue LEDs, volumetric light, clean futuristic industrial environment, high contrast but bright white hangar lighting. Use a vertical 4:5 composition, symmetrical layout, sharp focus throughout, no people, no smoke obscuring the units, no extra robots beyond the three listed units.

zh.title: 三机合体阵容
zh.description: 一个电影级的科幻机库场景，展示了三台带有标签、可变形的机甲单元，正排队准备进行机器人合体序列。
zh.prompt:
创作一张高细节的竖版科幻概念艺术图，展示三台未来派可变形战斗机甲在巨大的白银色轨道机库内进行“合体序列”的排队场景。采用居中、完全对称的俯视/高角度四分之三视角，沿长跑道向下望去，三台单元从上到下排成一条直线，仿佛正在等待合体成一个巨大的机器人。机库地面为带有面板接缝的光泽浅色金属，配有蓝色发光引导条、嵌入式轨道以及左右两侧高大的机械支撑塔。在每个单元周围添加电蓝色能量弧、发光的推进器光环和全息光晕效果。

主体细节：包含 3 台独立的机甲单元，每台单元下方或附近都有清晰的地面标签：1) 顶部单元标记为“UNIT 03 SHADOW”，是一台流线型的白、黑、蓝三色翼状隐形无人机机甲，带有八个锋利的放射状机翼/鳍片组件和尖锐的机头；2) 中间单元标记为“UNIT 02 BULLDOG”，是一台厚重的黑、灰、白三色坦克式装甲机甲，带有履带、笨重的矩形肩部武器、向外抬起的巨大铰接式机械臂以及中央炮管；3) 底部单元标记为“UNIT 01 RAIJIN”，是最大的红、白、黑及枪灰色喷气式机甲，带有双圆柱形引擎舱、棱角分明的红色翼甲、长长的深色驾驶舱机头以及蓝色推进器光芒。让底部单元占据前景，中间单元位于中心，顶部单元在远处显得较小。

文字内容：在地面上以紧凑的未来派 HUD 字体清晰渲染三个标签：“UNIT 03 SHADOW”为蓝色，“UNIT 02 BULLDOG”为橙色，“UNIT 01 RAIJIN”为红白相间。可选自定义：单元名称可为 {argument name="unit names" default="UNIT 03 SHADOW, UNIT 02 BULLDOG, UNIT 01 RAIJIN"}。

视觉风格：超精细硬表面机甲设计，电影级日本机器人动画灵感，照片级 CGI 渲染，清晰的面板线条、微型贴花、金属斜角、外露活塞、武器挂架、发光蓝色 LED、体积光、干净的未来工业环境、高对比度但明亮的白色机库照明。使用 4:5 竖构图，对称布局，全景清晰对焦，无人物，无遮挡单元的烟雾，除上述三台单元外无额外机器人。

en.title: Ballerina Studio Stretch Portrait
en.description: Generates a realistic vertical ballet studio portrait of a poised dancer performing a high leg stretch at the barre.
en.prompt: Create a realistic vertical portrait photograph of {argument name="subject" default="a young adult East Asian ballerina"} practicing in a bright ballet studio. She is shown full body in an elegant standing needle stretch: one foot planted en pointe or demi-pointe on the gray studio floor, the other leg lifted straight upward beside her head, and one hand holding the raised ballet slipper above her head while the other hand lightly rests on a wooden ballet barre to the right. She wears {argument name="leotard color" default="a navy blue camisole leotard"}, pale pink tights, and pale pink ballet slippers. Her hair is neatly pulled into a sleek black ballet bun, her expression is calm and focused, and she gazes slightly to the right rather than at the camera. The studio has soft natural daylight, a pale beige wall, a glossy gray floor, wooden barres running horizontally in the background, and a blurred wall logo reading {argument name="studio wall text" default="Madame YUKO Ballet Studio"} with a small ballerina silhouette. Use shallow depth of field, clean professional photography, soft skin tones, gentle highlights, realistic anatomy, graceful posture, and a serene rehearsal atmosphere. Frame the dancer centrally in a 9:16 vertical composition with no extra people, no watermark, and no dramatic stage lighting.

zh.title: 芭蕾舞室拉伸人像
zh.description: 生成一张写实的竖版芭蕾舞室人像，展示一位舞者在把杆上进行高难度腿部拉伸的优雅姿态。
zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的竖版人像摄影作品，展示 {argument name="subject" default="一位年轻的东亚裔芭蕾舞者"} 在明亮的芭蕾舞室中练习。画面呈现她全身优雅的站立针式拉伸姿态：一只脚以足尖或半足尖着地于灰色地板上，另一条腿在身侧垂直向上伸展，一只手握住举过头顶的芭蕾舞鞋，另一只手轻扶右侧的木质把杆。她身穿 {argument name="leotard color" default="深蓝色吊带练功服"}，搭配浅粉色连裤袜和浅粉色芭蕾舞鞋。她的头发整齐地盘成利落的黑色芭蕾发髻，神情平静而专注，目光略微看向右侧，而非直视镜头。舞室环境光线柔和自然，背景为浅米色墙面和光亮的灰色地板，木质把杆水平延伸，背景墙上有一个模糊的墙面标识，写着 {argument name="studio wall text" default="Madame YUKO Ballet Studio"} 以及一个小巧的芭蕾舞者剪影。采用浅景深、干净的专业摄影风格，呈现柔和的肤色、细腻的高光、写实的身体结构、优雅的姿态以及宁静的排练氛围。将舞者置于 9:16 竖版构图的中心，画面中无其他人物，无水印，且不使用戏剧性的舞台灯光。

en.title: Explorer in a Vast Blue Ice Cave
en.description: A cinematic photorealistic prompt for generating an immense glowing glacier cave with a lone explorer for scale.
en.prompt: Create a breathtaking photorealistic wide-angle scene inside a colossal natural ice cave, viewed from ground level looking down a snowy tunnel toward a glowing opening in the distance. The cave walls and ceiling are translucent layered glacier ice in rich cyan, turquoise, teal, and deep blue, with sweeping curved striations, frozen ripples, glossy wet surfaces, icicles, embedded bubbles, and sparkling frost particles suspended in the air. Bright white sunlight pours through an oval skylight high in the upper right, forming visible shafts of light and lens-like glints across the icy ceiling, while a second intense glow illuminates the far end of the tunnel. The foreground is a rough snow-covered floor with scattered ice boulders and chunks on both sides, crisp footprints leading inward, and reflective patches of frozen surface. Place exactly one tiny human explorer near the center bottom of the composition, wearing {argument name="jacket color" default="red"} outerwear, dark pants, a backpack, and holding trekking poles, emphasizing the immense scale of the cave. Use a {argument name="camera perspective" default="ultra wide angle low perspective"}, cinematic adventure photography style, high dynamic range, sharp detail, cool blue color grading, realistic volumetric light, natural textures, and awe-inspiring arctic atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no extra people, no animals, no artificial structures.

zh.title: 广袤蓝色冰洞中的探险者
zh.description: 一个电影级照片写实风格的提示词，用于生成巨大的发光冰川洞穴，并以一名孤独的探险者来衬托规模。
zh.prompt: 创作一个令人惊叹的照片写实广角场景，展示巨大的天然冰洞内部，从地面视角看向远处发光的洞口。洞壁和洞顶是半透明的层叠冰川，呈现出浓郁的青色、绿松石色、蓝绿色和深蓝色，带有优美的弧形条纹、冰冻的涟漪、光泽湿润的表面、冰柱、嵌入的气泡以及悬浮在空气中的闪烁霜粒。明亮的白色阳光从右上方的椭圆形天窗倾泻而下，在冰冷的洞顶形成可见的光束和镜头光晕，而隧道的尽头则散发出第二道强烈的光芒。前景是粗糙的积雪地面，两侧散布着冰块和碎石，清晰的脚印通向洞穴深处，地面上还有反光的冰面。在构图底部中心附近放置一名微小的探险者，身穿 {argument name="jacket color" default="红色"} 外套、深色裤子，背着背包，手持登山杖，以突显洞穴的宏伟规模。使用 {argument name="camera perspective" default="超广角低视角"}，电影级探险摄影风格，高动态范围，细节锐利，冷蓝色调，逼真的体积光，自然纹理，以及令人敬畏的北极氛围。无文字，无水印，无额外人物，无动物，无人工建筑。

en.title: Menacing Leather Muzzle Portrait
en.description: A cinematic photorealistic thriller portrait of a hostile man glaring upward while wearing a rugged leather cage muzzle.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic cinematic close-up portrait of a menacing adult man, shot from a high overhead angle looking down at him as he glares upward directly into the camera. He has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown almost black"} hair in a blunt short fringe with a sharp center part, shaved or tightly faded sides, intense pale gray-green eyes, heavy brow, sweaty textured skin, stubble, and a fresh diagonal scar above one eyebrow. His lower face is covered by a rugged brown leather cage muzzle mask made from horizontal and vertical leather straps, secured with small dark metal rivets and buckles; the mask should feel handmade, worn, and slightly grimy. He wears a dark distressed denim or canvas jacket with broad shoulders fading into shadow. The mood is hostile, claustrophobic, and gritty, like a psychological thriller or dystopian character portrait. Use {argument name="lighting style" default="low-key dramatic overhead lighting"}, strong contrast, dark vignette edges, shallow depth of field, warm brown and charcoal color grading, sharp focus on the eyes and mask, blurred dark industrial floor background, realistic skin pores, hair strands, leather grain, metal rivets, sweat, dirt, and cinematic lens distortion. Compose tightly with the top of the head near the upper edge, eyes centered, shoulders cropped, and no text, no watermark, no extra characters.

zh.title: 佩戴皮革口枷的凶狠男子肖像
zh.description: 一张电影级写实惊悚风格的肖像，展现了一名神情敌对的男子佩戴着粗犷的皮革笼式口枷，正向上怒视。
zh.prompt: 创作一张电影级写实特写肖像，拍摄一名神情凶狠的成年男子。镜头从高处俯拍，捕捉他向上直视镜头的神态。他留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕近黑"} 的短发，平齐刘海，中间有明显的发缝，两侧剃光或修剪得极短；有着深邃的灰绿色双眼、厚重的眉毛、带有汗渍的粗糙皮肤、胡茬，以及眉毛上方的一道新鲜斜向伤疤。他的下半张脸被一个粗犷的棕色皮革笼式口枷遮住，口枷由横竖交错的皮革带制成，并用小型深色金属铆钉和扣环固定；面罩应呈现出手工制作、磨损且略带污垢的质感。他穿着一件深色做旧牛仔或帆布夹克，宽阔的肩膀隐入阴影中。整体氛围充满敌意、压抑且粗粝，如同心理惊悚片或反乌托邦题材的角色肖像。使用 {argument name="lighting style" default="低调戏剧性的顶光"}，强对比度，暗角边缘，浅景深，暖棕色与炭灰色调，焦点清晰地聚焦在眼睛和面罩上，背景为模糊的工业风地面，展现真实的皮肤毛孔、发丝、皮革纹理、金属铆钉、汗水、污垢以及电影级镜头畸变。构图紧凑，头顶靠近上边缘，双眼居中，肩膀被裁剪，画面中无文字、无水印、无额外字符。

en.title: Bright Bedroom Portrait
en.description: A realistic editorial bedroom portrait of a young woman in white satin by a sunlit window, useful for fashion or lifestyle visual generation.
en.prompt: Create a realistic vertical portrait photo of a young East Asian woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} short bob hair, clear oversized eyeglasses, soft natural makeup, and a calm direct gaze toward the camera. She is seated on a cream chair at the edge of a bed in a bright bedroom, leaning slightly forward with both arms extended down between her knees, wearing a {argument name="outfit" default="white satin spaghetti-strap slip dress"} with a low V neckline and delicate jewelry: exactly 2 visible accessories, a thin necklace and one small dangling earring. The room has a large window on the left with sheer white curtains, blue sky with clouds and green treetops outside, white bedding on the right, and tall white built-in bookshelves in the background filled with many upright books plus a few small decor objects. Use soft daylight from the window, gentle shadows, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, high-end editorial photography, intimate indoor lifestyle mood, vertical 3:4 composition, subject centered from thighs upward, crisp focus on face and glasses, natural colors, no text, no watermark.

zh.title: 明亮卧室人像
zh.description: 一张写实的卧室编辑风格人像，展示了一位身穿白色缎面裙的年轻女性在阳光明媚的窗边，适用于时尚或生活方式类视觉生成。
zh.prompt: 创作一张写实的竖构图人像照片，主角是一位年轻的东亚女性，留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的波波头短发，戴着透明的大框眼镜，妆容清透自然，神情平静地直视镜头。她坐在卧室床边的一张米色椅子上，身体微微前倾，双臂自然垂在膝盖之间，身穿一件 {argument name="outfit" default="白色缎面细肩带吊带裙"}，领口呈低 V 字型，佩戴精致的首饰：共 2 件可见配饰，包括一条细项链和一只小巧的垂坠耳环。房间左侧有一扇大窗户，挂着白色薄纱窗帘，窗外可见蓝天白云和绿色树梢；右侧是白色床品，背景是高大的白色嵌入式书架，架上摆满了竖放的书籍和少量装饰品。采用窗户透进的柔和日光，光影自然，皮肤纹理真实，浅景深效果，高端编辑摄影风格，营造出亲密的室内生活氛围。竖构图 3:4，主体位于画面中心，展示大腿以上部位，面部和眼镜焦点清晰，色彩自然，无文字，无水印。

en.title: AI Image Degradation Collage
en.description: Creates a dark documentary-style collage showing repeated fantasy image generations degrading across a session.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark social-media style evidence collage illustrating iterative AI image degradation and repeated pattern accumulation, using a fantasy castle scene as the repeated subject.

Canvas: Tall vertical screenshot format, approximately 490 × 957 px, charcoal-black background with narrow margins and a feed-post look.

Layout: At the top, place a 2 × 2 grid of exactly 4 small landscape thumbnails with thin dark gutters. Beneath the grid, add a tiny two-character mark that looks like “**” or two small white dots. Below that, place 1 large landscape fantasy image spanning almost the full width. Under the large image, add exactly 3 short lines of white caption text aligned left. At the bottom, place 1 final large landscape fantasy image spanning almost the full width. Total visible image panels: exactly 6, consisting of 4 small thumbnails, 1 middle large panel, and 1 bottom large panel.

Fantasy image subject: Each panel should depict a similar epic gothic fantasy avenue leading toward a floating black spired castle or citadel, with wet reflective cobblestone paving, ornate lamp posts and railings, red and orange autumn trees on both sides, misty blue atmospheric depth, waterfalls or vertical light beams, and a luminous swirling rainbow vortex in the sky above the castle. The style should resemble highly detailed digital fantasy concept art with dramatic perspective, painterly lighting, and ornate architecture.

Degradation concept: The 4 thumbnails should look very similar to each other, as if the same scene is being regenerated repeatedly. The middle large image should be sharper and grand, but already show repeated texture patterns and overlaid effects. The bottom image should look noticeably degraded: noisy, smeared, oversaturated, speckled, warped details, doubled edges, crunchy textures, and excessive accumulated brush-like artifacts, while still recognizable as the same fantasy castle avenue.

Text content: Use exactly these 3 caption lines under the middle image in small bold white sans-serif text: “Here every prompt was different, this is the 5 generation:” “Same effect, it keeps data from the previous pictures.” “The destruction is even worse, because of the differences of the image data each step.”

Visual style: Dark UI screenshot aesthetic, no decorative border, compact spacing, high contrast white text, images cropped as landscape rectangles. Make the collage feel like a forum or tweet screenshot documenting a model failure.

Customizable details: Use {argument name="main scene" default="floating gothic castle avenue under a rainbow vortex"}, {argument name="caption line one" default="Here every prompt was different, this is the 5 generation:"}, {argument name="caption line two" default="Same effect, it keeps data from the previous pictures."}, {argument name="caption line three" default="The destruction is even worse, because of the differences of the image data each step."}, and {argument name="background color" default="charcoal black"}.

zh.title: AI 图像退化拼贴画
zh.description: 创作一张深色纪录片风格的拼贴画，展示重复生成的奇幻图像在整个会话过程中的退化过程。
zh.prompt:
目标：创作一张深色社交媒体风格的证据拼贴画，以奇幻城堡场景为重复主体，展示 AI 图像的迭代退化和重复模式的累积。

画布：高垂直截图格式，约 490 × 957 像素，炭黑色背景，窄边距，呈现信息流帖子的外观。

布局：顶部放置一个 2 × 2 的网格，包含 4 张精确的小型横向缩略图，中间有细窄的深色间隙。在网格下方，添加一个看起来像“**”或两个小白点的微小双字符标记。在此下方，放置 1 张几乎横跨整个宽度的巨幅横向奇幻图像。在大图下方，添加 3 行左对齐的白色短标题文本。底部放置 1 张最终的巨幅横向奇幻图像，几乎横跨整个宽度。可见图像面板总数：共 6 个，包括 4 个小型缩略图、1 个中间大图面板和 1 个底部大图面板。

奇幻图像主体：每个面板应描绘一条相似的史诗级哥特式奇幻大道，通向一座漂浮的黑色尖顶城堡或要塞，配有潮湿反光的鹅卵石路面、华丽的灯柱和栏杆、两侧红橙色的秋树、朦胧的蓝色大气深度、瀑布或垂直光束，以及城堡上方发光的漩涡状彩虹。风格应类似于高度精细的数字奇幻概念艺术，具有戏剧性的视角、绘画般的灯光和华丽的建筑。

退化概念：4 个缩略图看起来应非常相似，仿佛同一场景被反复重新生成。中间的大图应更清晰、更宏伟，但已显示出重复的纹理图案和叠加效果。底部图像应看起来明显退化：带有噪点、涂抹感、过度饱和、斑点、扭曲的细节、重影边缘、粗糙的纹理以及过度累积的画笔状伪影，但仍能辨认出是同一个奇幻城堡大道。

文本内容：在中间图像下方使用 3 行小号加粗白色无衬线文本，内容如下：“Here every prompt was different, this is the 5 generation:”、“Same effect, it keeps data from the previous pictures.”、“The destruction is even worse, because of the differences of the image data each step。”

视觉风格：深色 UI 截图美学，无装饰边框，紧凑间距，高对比度白色文本，图像裁剪为横向矩形。使拼贴画看起来像是一张记录模型故障的论坛或推文截图。

可自定义细节：使用 {argument name="main scene" default="floating gothic castle avenue under a rainbow vortex"}，{argument name="caption line one" default="Here every prompt was different, this is the 5 generation:"}，{argument name="caption line two" default="Same effect, it keeps data from the previous pictures."}，{argument name="caption line three" default="The destruction is even worse, because of the differences of the image data each step."} 以及 {argument name="background color" default="charcoal black"}。

en.title: Neon Tokyo Street Portrait
en.description: A cinematic photorealistic portrait prompt for creating a stylish woman against glowing Japanese nightlife signage at dusk.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic cinematic street portrait in a busy Japanese nightlife district at dusk. The frame is a wide 16:9 landscape image with the subject occupying the right half, tightly cropped so only the right side of her face, neck, shoulder, and hair are visible while the left half opens into a deep city street perspective. Show a young {argument name="character ethnicity" default="East Asian"} woman with {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} shoulder-length slightly wind-tousled hair, soft natural makeup, closed or downcast eyes, relaxed lips, a delicate dangling teardrop earring, pale sunglasses resting on top of her head, and a dark leather jacket catching magenta neon reflections. She should look calm, introspective, and stylish, facing slightly downward and away from the camera. The background is a dense urban street lined with tall buildings and many vertical illuminated Japanese signs, including red, orange, green, white, and blue kanji/kana restaurant and entertainment signs; keep the signage authentic-looking but not the main focus. Add a large bright pink-red marquee or lightbox glow behind her head on the upper right, rows of small bulbs along a sign edge, and a cloudy gray evening sky visible above the street. Use shallow depth of field with the woman sharply detailed and the street signs slightly softened, realistic skin texture, natural lens perspective, rich neon color contrast, moody overcast ambient light, high dynamic range, and documentary fashion-photography realism. No watermark, no extra people in the foreground, no cartoon or illustration style.

zh.title: 霓虹东京街头肖像
zh.description: 一款电影级写实肖像提示词，用于创作一位在黄昏时分、背景为发光日本夜生活招牌的时尚女性。
zh.prompt: 创作一张在黄昏时分日本繁华夜生活街区的电影级写实街头肖像。画面采用 16:9 宽画幅，主体位于画面右侧，采用紧凑构图，仅露出她右侧的脸庞、颈部、肩膀和头发，左侧则延伸出深邃的城市街道视角。画面中的年轻 {argument name="character ethnicity" default="东亚裔"} 女性留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"} 的齐肩发，发丝略显凌乱，妆容自然柔和，双眼微闭或低垂，双唇放松，佩戴着精致的垂坠泪滴状耳环，头顶架着一副浅色太阳镜，身穿的深色皮夹克映衬出洋红色霓虹灯光。她神情平静、内敛且时尚，面部略微朝下，背对镜头。背景是密集的城市街道，两侧高楼林立，挂满了许多垂直发光的日文招牌，包括红色、橙色、绿色、白色和蓝色的日文餐厅及娱乐场所招牌；招牌需保持真实感，但不要喧宾夺主。在画面右上角她头部后方添加一个巨大的亮粉红色灯箱光晕，招牌边缘排列着一排小灯泡，街道上方可见多云的灰色傍晚天空。采用浅景深效果，使人物细节清晰，街道招牌略显柔和，呈现真实的皮肤质感、自然的镜头透视、丰富的霓虹色彩对比、忧郁的阴天环境光、高动态范围，以及纪实时尚摄影的真实感。无水印，前景无其他路人，非卡通或插画风格。

en.title: Elf Cosplayer Mirror Selfie
en.description: Generates a realistic indoor fantasy elf cosplay mirror selfie with a strong foreground foot perspective and soft natural lighting.
en.prompt: Create a realistic vertical smartphone mirror selfie of an adult fantasy elf cosplayer sitting on a soft white sheet on a gray carpet in a minimal beige room. The subject is {argument name="character name" default="an elf princess cosplayer"}, wearing a delicate white draped fantasy outfit with gold chain details, thin arm jewelry, gold leg bands, and pale blue flower accessories. She has {argument name="hair color" default="long silver-gray"} hair styled in twin ponytails, pointed elf ears, and a blue-and-white floral crown. Pose her seated with one knee bent close to the body and the other leg extended toward the mirror, creating strong foreground perspective with the bare sole and toes large in the lower left foreground; the other foot is visible near the bottom edge. She holds a light gray smartphone in front of her face, obscuring facial features, with her other hand touching her hair near the ear. Use soft natural window light, muted neutral tones, shallow casual indoor realism, visible mirror edge at the far left, baseboard along the back wall, and a slightly candid cosplay photography aesthetic. Keep the composition intimate but non-explicit, with realistic skin texture, fabric folds, carpet detail, and no added text or watermark.

zh.title: 精灵 Cosplayer 镜面自拍
zh.description: 生成一张逼真的室内奇幻精灵 Cosplay 镜面自拍，具有强烈的足部前景透视感和柔和的自然光效果。
zh.prompt: 创作一张逼真的竖屏智能手机镜面自拍，画面主体为一位成年的奇幻精灵 Cosplayer，正坐在灰色地毯上的白色软布上，背景为极简风格的米色房间。主体为 {argument name="character name" default="一位精灵公主 Cosplayer"}，身穿精致的白色垂坠感奇幻服饰，配有金色链条细节、纤细的手臂饰品、金色腿环以及淡蓝色花朵配饰。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="长款银灰色"} 双马尾发型，佩戴精灵尖耳和蓝白相间的花环。姿势设定为坐姿，一侧膝盖弯曲靠近身体，另一条腿向镜子方向伸展，在左下角前景处形成强烈的足部透视效果，使赤裸的脚底和脚趾显得较大；另一只脚在底部边缘可见。她手持一部浅灰色智能手机遮挡面部，另一只手轻触耳边的头发。采用柔和的自然窗光，色调柔和中性，呈现随意的室内写实风格，画面最左侧可见镜子边缘，后墙配有踢脚线，整体具有一种随性的 Cosplay 摄影美感。构图保持亲密但非露骨，注重真实的皮肤纹理、布料褶皱和地毯细节，画面中不添加任何文字或水印。

en.title: Summer Japanese Street Fashion Portrait
en.description: A photorealistic full-body street fashion portrait set on a sunny Japanese residential road with vending machines and dramatic clouds.
en.prompt: Create a full-body photorealistic fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman standing in the middle of a quiet Japanese residential street on a bright summer day. She has {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown-black"} long hair styled half-up in a loose messy ponytail with soft bangs and wispy strands, a slim build, fair skin, and a calm slightly serious expression while looking directly at the camera. She wears oversized translucent pale-pink square glasses, a simple {argument name="dress color" default="white"} sleeveless mini slip dress with thin spaghetti straps, and chunky lace-up combat boots in {argument name="boot color" default="mint turquoise"}. Her hands are gently clasped in front of her hips, feet apart in a relaxed pose. The setting is a narrow suburban street in Japan with low houses and apartment buildings, concrete walls, utility poles, overhead power lines, road markings, and exactly two vending machines on the right side: one blue machine and one white machine filled with colorful drinks. Use a low-to-mid eye-level camera, vertical 9:16 composition, centered subject, 35mm realistic lens feel, crisp sunlight, hard shadows on asphalt, vivid blue sky with large fluffy cumulus clouds, distant hills at the end of the road, high-detail skin and fabric texture, natural color grading, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, ultra-realistic editorial street photography. Avoid text overlays, logos, watermarks, extra people, distorted anatomy, or unrealistic proportions.

zh.title: 夏季日系街头时尚人像
zh.description: 一张超写实的全身街头时尚人像，背景设定在阳光明媚的日本住宅街道，配有自动售货机和极具张力的云层。
zh.prompt: 创作一张超写实的全身时尚人像，画面中一位年轻的东亚女性站在阳光明媚的夏日午后，位于一条宁静的日本住宅街道中央。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕黑色"} 的长发，发型为随性的半扎马尾，配有柔和的刘海和碎发；她身材苗条，肤色白皙，神情平静且略带严肃，直视镜头。她佩戴着大框透明浅粉色方形眼镜，身穿一件简约的 {argument name="dress color" default="白色"} 无袖吊带迷你裙，脚蹬一双 {argument name="boot color" default="薄荷绿"} 的厚底系带马丁靴。她的双手轻扣在髋部前方，双脚分开，姿态放松。背景是一条狭窄的日本郊区街道，两侧有低矮的房屋和公寓楼、混凝土墙、电线杆、架空电线、道路标线，右侧设有两台自动售货机：一台蓝色和一台白色，里面装满了色彩缤纷的饮料。采用中低视平线拍摄，9:16 竖构图，主体居中，35mm 真实镜头感，明亮的阳光，沥青路面上的硬投影，湛蓝的天空点缀着巨大的蓬松积云，道路尽头可见远山，皮肤和织物纹理细节丰富，自然色彩分级，浅至中等景深，超写实街头时尚摄影。避免文字叠加、标志、水印、多余人物、解剖结构扭曲或比例不真实的情况。

en.title: VHS Paris Balcony Portrait
en.description: A cinematic vertical prompt for creating a nostalgic camcorder-style fashion portrait on a rainy Paris balcony.
en.prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 cinematic VHS-style fashion photograph of a young woman seated on a small Parisian balcony café terrace above a narrow wet city street after rain. She has {argument name="hair color" default="soft denim blue"}, shoulder-length tousled wavy hair with airy flyaways, pale skin, delicate features, and a calm slightly melancholic expression as she looks up toward the camera. Shoot from a high, close, wide-angle perspective, as if the photographer is standing over her on the balcony; her body is turned sideways on a bentwood café chair, one hand resting at her waist. Dress her in a pale blue-gray long-sleeve blouse tucked into a flowing high-waisted pleated skirt, creating a soft monochrome blue-gray outfit. Include exactly 2 visible café furniture pieces: one round metal café table on the left foreground and one woven rattan café chair at the lower left. The balcony has a weathered stone railing, and beyond it are classic Haussmann-style buildings, a narrow reflective street, parked cars, and moody overcast backlight. Use desaturated cool tones, film grain, slight motion blur, lens vignetting, subtle chromatic aberration, imperfect analog focus, and a nostalgic 1990s camcorder look. Add white vertical VHS on-screen display text: at upper left, a small play triangle with “PLAY” and the timecode “00:08:17”; at lower left, “AM 11:23” and “JUN 13 2024”. No extra people, no modern signage emphasis, no watermark, keep the image photorealistic and atmospheric.

zh.title: VHS 巴黎阳台肖像
zh.description: 一个电影感竖屏提示词，用于创作雨后巴黎阳台上怀旧摄像机风格的时尚肖像。
zh.prompt: 创作一张 9:16 竖屏电影感 VHS 风格时尚摄影作品，画面中一位年轻女性坐在雨后巴黎狭窄潮湿街道上方的小型阳台咖啡露台上。她留着 {argument name="hair color" default="柔和牛仔蓝"}、及肩凌乱波浪卷发，带有轻盈的碎发，皮肤白皙，五官精致，抬头看向镜头时表情平静且略带忧郁。采用高机位、近距离、广角视角拍摄，仿佛摄影师正站在阳台上俯拍她；她的身体侧坐在曲木咖啡椅上，一只手放在腰间。为她穿上一件浅蓝灰色长袖衬衫，束进飘逸的高腰百褶裙中，打造出柔和的单色蓝灰色造型。画面中包含 2 件可见的咖啡家具：左侧前景处的一张圆形金属咖啡桌，以及左下方的一把藤编咖啡椅。阳台有风化的石栏杆，背景是经典的奥斯曼风格建筑、狭窄且带有倒影的街道、停放的汽车以及阴郁的背光。使用低饱和度冷色调、胶片颗粒感、轻微运动模糊、镜头暗角、细微色差、不完美的模拟对焦，呈现 90 年代怀旧摄像机的质感。添加白色 VHS 屏幕显示文字：左上角为一个小的播放三角形，旁边标注“PLAY”和时间码“00:08:17”；左下角标注“AM 11:23”和“JUN 13 2024”。画面中不要出现其他人，不要强调现代标识，不要有水印，保持照片的真实感与氛围感。

en.title: Summer Sailor Uniform Fountain Portrait
en.description: Generates a bright realistic portrait of a smiling young woman in a light blue sailor uniform splashing through a sunny plaza fountain.
en.prompt: Create a bright, naturalistic full-body fashion photo of a cheerful young Japanese woman, {argument name="character name" default="Hina"}, wearing a refreshing summer Japanese sailor-style school uniform in a public plaza fountain. She has shoulder-length dark brown hair with soft bangs, a friendly open smile, clear youthful features, and a playful pose with both arms slightly extended for balance. Her outfit is a crisp white short-sleeve sailor blouse with light aqua-blue collar and sleeve stripes, a matching aqua-blue necktie, and a high-waisted aqua-blue pleated mini skirt with white stripe trim; add white ankle socks and shiny black loafers. She is stepping through shallow water, one foot lifted and splashing, surrounded by many vertical fountain jets and glittering water droplets. Use a sunny summer daytime setting with wet reflective stone pavement, blurred people in the background, green trees, and a softly out-of-focus classical city building behind the fountain. Style should be realistic Japanese idol photo / fresh summer portrait, soft natural skin tones, bright airy lighting, shallow depth of field, crisp subject focus, sparkling highlights, gentle bokeh, vertical 2:3 composition, no text, no watermark, no extra limbs, keep the uniform modest and clean.

zh.title: 夏季水手服喷泉人像
zh.description: 生成一张明亮写实的肖像，描绘了一位身穿浅蓝色水手服的年轻女性在阳光明媚的广场喷泉中戏水的欢快场景。
zh.prompt: 创作一张明亮、写实的全身时尚照片，主角是一位开朗的日本年轻女性，{argument name="character name" default="Hina"}，身穿清爽的夏季日式水手校服，置身于公共广场的喷泉中。她留着齐肩深棕色短发，配有柔和的刘海，笑容亲切开朗，五官清秀年轻，姿态俏皮，双臂微微张开以保持平衡。她的服装是一件挺括的白色短袖水手衫，配有浅水蓝色衣领和袖条，系着同色系水手领带，下身穿着高腰水蓝色百褶短裙，裙边带有白色条纹；搭配白色短袜和亮面黑色乐福鞋。她正迈步走在浅水中，一只脚抬起溅起水花，周围环绕着许多垂直喷射的喷泉水柱和闪烁的水珠。场景设定在阳光明媚的夏日白天，地面是湿润且带有倒影的石板路，背景中有模糊的人群、绿树，以及喷泉后方虚化的古典城市建筑。风格应为写实的日本偶像摄影 / 清新夏日人像，肤色自然柔和，光线明亮通透，浅景深，主体清晰，高光闪烁，带有柔和的焦外成像效果，采用 2:3 竖构图，无文字，无水印，无多余肢体，保持制服整洁得体。

en.title: Neon Hooded Street Portrait
en.description: A photorealistic urban night portrait prompt for creating a hooded street-fashion woman with headphones in cinematic neon lighting.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical street-fashion portrait of a young East Asian woman standing at the base of an outdoor escalator in a neon-lit urban night scene. She wears an oversized {argument name="hoodie color" default="pale baby blue"} zip-up hoodie with the hood up, a fitted {argument name="crop top color" default="white"} ribbed crop tank top, loose gray high-waisted sweatpants, and white over-ear headphones resting around her neck. She has long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair with soft bangs, natural dewy makeup, glossy red lips, warm brown eyes, and a calm slightly wistful expression while looking directly at the camera. Frame her from mid-thigh to head in a close portrait, centered slightly right, with hands tucked into the hoodie pockets and relaxed shoulders. The background shows exactly 3 prominent urban light zones: a dark escalator and stairway rising behind her on the left, red neon reflections along the left rail and wall, and bright cyan-blue storefront signage with Chinese characters on the right; include wet pavement, scattered debris, glass railings, and shallow depth of field bokeh. Use cinematic night photography, realistic skin texture, soft frontal key light, red rim light from the left, cool blue ambient light from the right, high detail, 35mm portrait perspective, f/1.8 shallow depth of field, natural proportions, no text overlay, no watermark, no extra people.

zh.title: 霓虹连帽街头肖像
zh.description: 一个逼真的城市夜景肖像提示词，用于创作佩戴耳机、身着街头时尚连帽衫的女性，并呈现电影质感的霓虹灯光效果。
zh.prompt: 创作一张逼真的竖构图街头时尚肖像，画面主体为一名年轻的东亚女性，她站在霓虹闪烁的城市夜景中，身后是一部户外自动扶梯。她身穿一件超大款 {argument name="hoodie color" default="淡婴儿蓝"} 拉链连帽衫，兜帽戴在头上；内搭一件修身的 {argument name="crop top color" default="白色"} 罗纹短款背心，下身穿着宽松的灰色高腰运动裤，脖子上挂着白色头戴式耳机。她留着波浪长发，发色为 {argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}，留着柔和的刘海；妆容自然水润，涂着亮面红唇，有着温暖的棕色眼眸，直视镜头时表情平静且略带忧郁。采用中景构图，从大腿中部到头部取景，主体略微偏右，双手插在连帽衫口袋里，双肩放松。背景包含 3 个明显的城市光区：左侧是上升的深色自动扶梯和楼梯，左侧扶手和墙壁上有红色霓虹灯反射，右侧是带有中文字符的明亮青蓝色店面招牌；画面包含湿润的地面、散落的碎片、玻璃栏杆以及浅景深虚化效果。采用电影级夜景摄影风格，呈现真实的皮肤质感，柔和的正面主光，左侧红色轮廓光，右侧冷蓝色环境光，高细节，35mm 肖像视角，f/1.8 浅景深，自然比例，无文字叠加，无水印，无其他人物。

en.title: Pink Tracksuit T-Shirt Mockup
en.description: A photorealistic lifestyle apparel mockup showing a blank fitted T-shirt styled with a pink velour tracksuit at a football field.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic fashion product mockup of a stylish young woman standing outdoors at an American football field in bright afternoon sunlight, framed waist-up in a square 1:1 composition. She has long wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair, glossy makeup, hoop earrings, and translucent pink-tinted sunglasses, posing confidently with her head slightly tilted while holding open a plush velour zip hoodie. Her outfit is a coordinated {argument name="tracksuit color" default="hot pink"} velour tracksuit with matching jogger pants, and a plain blank {argument name="shirt color" default="cream white"} fitted T-shirt centered clearly on her torso for print-on-demand apparel placement. Add one metallic novelty purse shaped like glossy lips hanging from a chain strap on her shoulder. The background should be softly blurred but recognizable: green turf field, red running track, chain-link fence in the foreground, distant scoreboard, yellow goalposts, and tall pine trees under a clear blue sky. Use a premium lifestyle streetwear editorial look, realistic skin texture, natural shadows, shallow depth of field, vibrant but believable colors, and product-accurate blank shirt fabric with no logo, no graphic, no text, and no watermark.

zh.title: 粉色运动套装 T 恤样机
zh.description: 一款照片级逼真的生活方式服装样机，展示了在足球场背景下，搭配粉色丝绒运动套装的空白修身 T 恤。
zh.prompt: 创建一个照片级逼真的时尚产品样机，画面中一位时尚的年轻女性站在户外美式足球场上，沐浴在明亮的午后阳光下，采用 1:1 正方形构图，半身取景。她留着一头波浪长发（发色：{argument name="hair color" default="深棕色"}），妆容精致，佩戴圆环耳环和透明粉色墨镜，自信地微微侧头，双手敞开展示着一件毛绒丝绒拉链连帽衫。她身穿一套协调的 {argument name="tracksuit color" default="亮粉色"} 丝绒运动套装，搭配同款慢跑裤，内搭一件纯色空白 {argument name="shirt color" default="米白色"} 修身 T 恤，T 恤位于躯干中心，清晰可见，适合按需打印（POD）的服装展示。在她的肩上增加一个金属质感的唇形创意手提包，配有链条肩带。背景应呈现柔和的虚化效果但清晰可辨：绿色的草坪、红色的塑胶跑道、前景的铁丝网围栏、远处的计分牌、黄色的球门柱以及蓝天下的高大松树。采用高端街头服饰编辑风格，呈现真实的皮肤纹理、自然的阴影、浅景深、鲜艳且真实的色彩，并确保空白 T 恤的面料质感准确，无 Logo、无图案、无文字且无水印。

en.title: Black Cat Under Personal Rain Cloud
en.description: A photorealistic whimsical scene of a soaked black cat jumping beneath its own private storm cloud on a sunny suburban street.
en.prompt: Create a photorealistic, whimsical action shot of a {argument name="cat color" default="black"} domestic cat leaping upright in the middle of a quiet suburban street while being drenched by its own tiny personal rain cloud. The cat is the single main subject, centered and low-angle, frozen mid-jump with both front paws raised, hind legs splayed, tail curved, mouth open in a surprised meow, wide green eyes, soaked spiky fur, visible whiskers, water droplets clinging to the paws and face, and a {argument name="collar color" default="red"} collar with a small gold bell. Directly above the cat is one large dark charcoal storm cloud, isolated from the otherwise sunny sky, pouring dense vertical rain only onto the cat; show countless bright rain streaks, splashes, mist, and sparkling droplets around the body. The background is a realistic Japanese-style residential street on a bright summer day, with blue sky, scattered fluffy white clouds, low houses on both sides, utility poles and power lines receding into the distance, hedges, road markings, and wet asphalt reflecting the cat and rain. Use dramatic wide-angle perspective from near ground level, sharp focus on the cat and rain, slight motion energy in the water, high-speed photography feel, natural sunlight from the clear sky contrasting with the dark cloud, humorous magical realism, ultra-detailed fur and water simulation, vertical 4:5 composition. No text, no people, no extra animals, no umbrella, no watermark.

zh.title: 个人雨云下的黑猫
zh.description: 一幅照片级逼真的奇幻场景：一只被淋湿的黑猫在阳光明媚的郊区街道上，跳跃在属于它自己的私人风暴云下。
zh.prompt: 创作一张照片级逼真、充满奇幻色彩的动作特写：一只 {argument name="cat color" default="black"} 家猫在宁静的郊区街道中央垂直跃起，被它头顶上方一朵微小的个人雨云淋得湿透。猫是唯一的中心主体，采用低角度拍摄，定格在跳跃瞬间，双前爪抬起，后腿张开，尾巴弯曲，嘴巴微张发出惊讶的喵喵声，圆圆的绿眼睛，湿漉漉的尖刺状毛发，清晰可见的胡须，爪子和脸上挂着水珠，戴着一个 {argument name="collar color" default="red"} 的项圈，上面挂着一个小金铃。猫的正上方是一朵巨大的深炭色风暴云，与周围晴朗的天空形成鲜明对比，密集的垂直雨水只倾泻在猫的身上；展现出无数明亮的雨迹、水花、薄雾以及环绕身体的闪烁水滴。背景是明媚夏日里写实的日式住宅街道，蓝天白云，两侧是低矮的房屋，电线杆和电线向远处延伸，还有树篱、道路标线以及倒映着猫和雨水的湿润柏油路面。采用近地面的戏剧性广角透视，焦点清晰地对准猫和雨水，水流带有轻微的动感，呈现高速摄影的质感，晴空的自然阳光与深色云层形成对比，充满幽默的魔幻现实主义风格，超精细的毛发和水体模拟，4:5 垂直构图。画面中无文字、无人、无其他动物、无雨伞、无水印。

en.title: Tiny Dragon Rainbow Flame Storyboard
en.description: A cinematic eight-panel animated storyboard showing a baby dragon accidentally sneezing rainbow flames in an enchanted forest.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished cinematic storyboard sheet for a short animated fantasy scene about {argument name="character name" default="a tiny dragon"} discovering an unexpected magical ability.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 storyboard board, eight panels arranged in a clean 4-by-2 grid. Each panel has a vivid image area on top and a black caption strip beneath it. Use thin black dividers between panels. Overall look: high-end 3D animated family-film style, warm forest lighting, shallow depth of field, expressive character acting, glowing particles, lush flowers, moss, butterflies, and soft golden sunbeams.

Main subject details: The main character is a cute small orange baby dragon with a cream belly, big green eyes, tiny horns, small bat wings, rounded snout, soft scales, and childlike proportions. The story takes place in an enchanted woodland clearing full of flowers, mossy stones, firefly-like sparkles, and friendly animals. The dragon is trying to breathe fire, but instead creates {argument name="magical breath effect" default="rainbow flame"}.

Layout and exact panel count: Use exactly 8 storyboard panels, numbered 1 through 8, with these visible captions and actions:

Panel 1 caption: “1. (0–2s) Establishing Shot” with subcaption “A tiny dragon stands alone, looking determined.” Image: wide establishing shot of the dragon standing on a forest path in a glowing magical clearing, butterflies and flowers around it.

Panel 2 caption: “2. (2–4s) Determination” with subcaption “The dragon puffs its cheeks, takes a huge breath, and spreads its wings.” Image: medium close-up of the dragon squeezing its eyes shut, cheeks inflated, wings open, preparing dramatically.

Panel 3 caption: “3. (4–6s) Failure” with subcaption “It exhales with all its strength… but only a tiny puff of smoke comes out.” Image: close-up of one winking eye and puckered mouth releasing a small gray smoke cloud.

Panel 4 caption: “4. (6–8s) Embarrassment” with subcaption “The dragon feels shy while a bird tilts its head, watching curiously.” Image: the dragon scratches its head sheepishly while a cute blue bird perches on a branch nearby.

Panel 5 caption: “5. (8–10s) The Sneeze” with subcaption “The smoke tickles its nose. It builds up… and prepares for the biggest sneeze ever!” Image: extreme close-up of the dragon’s face, wide eyes, smoky swirl around its nostril, about to sneeze.

Panel 6 caption: “6. (10–12s) Magical Surprise” with subcaption “It sneezes! Instead of fire, a HUGE burst of rainbow flames explodes out!” Image: side view of the dragon sneezing a massive sparkling rainbow blast, bright saturated colors, glittering embers.

Panel 7 caption: “7. (12–14s) Wonder” with subcaption “Animals stare in amazement as the rainbow flames light up the whole forest.” Image: wider shot with the dragon in the center, surrounded by exactly 5 visible woodland animals watching in awe: a rabbit, a squirrel, a deer-like fawn, a hedgehog, and a small bird. Rainbow fire arcs above them through the trees.

Panel 8 caption: “8. (14–15s) Happy Ending” with subcaption “The dragon laughs with joy as a tiny rainbow flame dances above its nose. Everyone celebrates!” Image: joyful close-up of the dragon laughing open-mouthed, eyes sparkling, tiny rainbow flame curling above its nose, cheering forest animals blurred behind.

Visual style: Cinematic 3D animation, cute Pixar-like character appeal, detailed scales and soft skin texture, warm orange-and-gold lighting, magical rainbow glow, volumetric sun rays, bokeh, expressive faces, high production value, family-friendly tone.

Text constraints: Keep all captions in English exactly as written. Use clean white sans-serif text centered on each black caption strip. Maintain legibility. Do not add extra panels, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or unrelated text.

zh.title: 小龙彩虹火焰分镜故事板
zh.description: 一个电影感十足的八格动画分镜故事板，展示了一只幼龙在魔法森林中意外喷出彩虹火焰的场景。
zh.prompt:
目标：为一段关于 {argument name="character name" default="一只小龙"} 发现意外魔法能力的奇幻动画短片，创建一个精致的电影感分镜项目。

画布：宽屏 16:9 分镜项目，八个分镜格以整洁的 4x2 网格排列。每个分镜格上方为生动的图像区域，下方为黑色标题栏。分镜格之间使用细黑色线条分隔。整体风格：高端 3D 动画家庭电影风格，温暖的森林光影，浅景深，富有表现力的角色表演，发光的粒子，繁茂的花朵、苔藓、蝴蝶和柔和的金色阳光。

主体细节：主角是一只可爱的小橙色幼龙，有着奶油色的肚子、大大的绿眼睛、小小的角、小蝙蝠翅膀、圆润的吻部、柔软的鳞片以及孩童般的比例。故事发生在一个充满花朵、长满苔藓的石头、萤火虫般的闪光和友好动物的魔法林间空地。幼龙试图喷火，但却喷出了 {argument name="magical breath effect" default="彩虹火焰"}。

布局与精确格数：使用 8 个分镜格，编号为 1 到 8，并包含以下可见的标题和动作：

Panel 1 标题：“1. (0–2s) Establishing Shot”，副标题：“A tiny dragon stands alone, looking determined.” 图像：幼龙站在发光的魔法林间空地小径上的广角全景，周围环绕着蝴蝶和花朵。

Panel 2 标题：“2. (2–4s) Determination”，副标题：“The dragon puffs its cheeks, takes a huge breath, and spreads its wings.” 图像：幼龙紧闭双眼、鼓起腮帮、张开翅膀，进行戏剧性准备的中景特写。

Panel 3 标题：“3. (4–6s) Failure”，副标题：“It exhales with all its strength… but only a tiny puff of smoke comes out.” 图像：幼龙一只眼睛微眯，噘起嘴巴吐出一小团灰色烟雾的特写。

Panel 4 标题：“4. (6–8s) Embarrassment”，副标题：“The dragon feels shy while a bird tilts its head, watching curiously.” 图像：幼龙羞涩地抓着头，一只可爱的小蓝鸟在附近的树枝上好奇地歪着头观察。

Panel 5 标题：“5. (8–10s) The Sneeze”，副标题：“The smoke tickles its nose. It builds up… and prepares for the biggest sneeze ever!” 图像：幼龙面部的极度特写，双眼圆睁，鼻孔周围有烟雾缭绕，正准备打出一个史上最大的喷嚏。

Panel 6 标题：“6. (10–12s) Magical Surprise”，副标题：“It sneezes! Instead of fire, a HUGE burst of rainbow flames explodes out!” 图像：幼龙喷出巨大闪耀彩虹火焰的侧视图，色彩明亮饱和，火星四溅。

Panel 7 标题：“7. (12–14s) Wonder”，副标题：“Animals stare in amazement as the rainbow flames light up the whole forest.” 图像：以幼龙为中心的广角镜头，周围有 5 只清晰可见的森林动物正惊叹地注视着：一只兔子、一只松鼠、一只小鹿、一只刺猬和一只小鸟。彩虹火焰在树木间划出弧线。

Panel 8 标题：“8. (14–15s) Happy Ending”，副标题：“The dragon laughs with joy as a tiny rainbow flame dances above its nose. Everyone celebrates!” 图像：幼龙开心地张嘴大笑的特写，眼睛闪闪发光，鼻尖上方盘旋着一簇小小的彩虹火焰，背景中模糊的森林动物们正在欢呼。

视觉风格：电影级 3D 动画，皮克斯风格的可爱角色魅力，细腻的鳞片与柔软的皮肤质感，温暖的橙金色光影，魔法彩虹光效，体积光，焦外成像，表情丰富，高制作水准，适合家庭观看的基调。

文本限制：所有标题必须保持为英文原样。在每个黑色标题栏中使用居中的简洁白色无衬线字体。保持清晰易读。请勿添加额外的分镜格、Logo、水印、UI 元素或无关文本。

en.title: Dark Ghost Spirit Turnaround
en.description: Generates a grayscale three-view dark fantasy creature concept sheet for a ragged masked ghost spirit design.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark fantasy character concept sheet for a ghostly faceless spirit, shown as a full-body costume/creature design turnaround.

Canvas: Wide horizontal studio concept-art canvas, approximately 16:9, grayscale monochrome, neutral light-gray background, soft even lighting, no environment, no props, no text.

Layout: Show exactly 3 full-body views of the same character, evenly spaced from left to right: 1 front view, 1 left side profile view, and 1 rear view. All three figures stand upright with arms hanging slightly away from the body, feet hidden under long trailing robes, centered vertically with their hems nearly touching the bottom edge.

Subject details: The character is {argument name="character archetype" default="a No-Face-like dark ghost spirit"}, tall and slender, fully covered in layered black tattered robes. The garment is made of many ragged, shredded strips of cloth, with torn triangular edges, frayed holes, draping folds, and long trailing hems that pool and taper near the floor. The silhouette is hooded, cloaked, and ominous, with no visible skin except pale claw-like fingers. The front and side views show a smooth white oval mask under the hood, featuring two narrow horizontal black eye slits, two short cheek marks, and a wide dark grinning mouth. The back view shows only the black hood and layered ragged cloak with no mask visible.

Hands and claws: Each visible hand has exactly 5 long curved white claws, thin and talon-like, extending from ragged black sleeves. In the front view, both hands are visible with 10 total claws; in the side view, the nearer hand is visible with 5 claws and a few partially obscured claws from the far hand; in the rear view, both hands hang at the sides with 10 total claws visible.

Material and texture: Emphasize rough cloth texture, torn gauze, distressed fabric, heavy folds, matte black layers, subtle gray highlights, and worn edges. The mask is smooth, porcelain-like, stark white, and contrasts strongly with the dark robes.

Visual style: {argument name="visual style" default="cinematic grayscale creature concept art"}, realistic costume design, high-detail horror character sheet, symmetrical studio presentation, soft shadows under the figures, sharp silhouette, eerie but elegant mood.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 views and no extra characters. Keep the image monochrome except for tonal gray shading. Do not add scenery, weapons, typography, logos, or watermarks. Maintain a clean neutral background and a professional production-design reference sheet look.

zh.title: 暗影幽灵三视图
zh.description: 生成一张灰度三视图暗黑奇幻生物概念图，设计一个衣衫褴褛的蒙面幽灵。
zh.prompt:
目标：为无面幽灵创建一个暗黑奇幻角色概念图，展示全身服装/生物设计三视图。

画布：宽幅横向工作室概念艺术画布，比例约为 16:9，灰度单色，中性浅灰色背景，柔和均匀的灯光，无环境，无道具，无文字。

布局：展示同一个角色的 3 个全身视图，从左到右均匀排列：1 个正面视图、1 个左侧面视图和 1 个背面视图。三个形象均直立，手臂轻微下垂远离身体，双脚隐藏在长长的拖地长袍下，垂直居中，下摆几乎触及底部边缘。

主体细节：该角色为 {argument name="character archetype" default="类似无脸男的暗黑幽灵"}，身材高大修长，全身覆盖着层层叠叠的黑色破烂长袍。服装由许多破烂、撕碎的布条组成，带有撕裂的三角形边缘、磨损的破洞、垂坠的褶皱以及在地面汇聚并收窄的长拖尾下摆。轮廓带有兜帽和斗篷，阴森恐怖，除了苍白的爪状手指外，没有可见的皮肤。正面和侧面视图显示兜帽下有一个光滑的白色椭圆形面具，面具上有两条狭窄的水平黑色眼缝、两个短脸颊标记和一个宽大的深色咧嘴笑口。背面视图仅显示黑色兜帽和层层叠叠的破烂斗篷，看不到面具。

手部与爪子：每只可见的手都有 5 个长而弯曲的白色爪子，纤细如鹰爪，从破烂的黑色袖子中伸出。在正面视图中，双手可见，总共 10 个爪子；在侧面视图中，可见靠近的一只手有 5 个爪子，以及另一只手部分被遮挡的爪子；在背面视图中，双手垂在身体两侧，总共可见 10 个爪子。

材质与纹理：强调粗糙的布料纹理、撕裂的纱布、做旧的织物、厚重的褶皱、哑光黑色层、微妙的灰色高光和磨损的边缘。面具光滑如瓷，纯白色，与深色长袍形成强烈对比。

视觉风格：{argument name="visual style" default="电影级灰度生物概念艺术"}，写实服装设计，高细节恐怖角色图，对称工作室展示，人物下方有柔和阴影，轮廓清晰，氛围阴森而优雅。

约束：使用 3 个视图，不要添加额外角色。保持图像为单色，仅使用灰色调阴影。不要添加场景、武器、排版、Logo 或水印。保持干净的中性背景和专业的制作设计参考图外观。

en.title: Fantasy Creature Meadow Ensemble
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a whimsical hand-painted group portrait of friendly fantasy creatures in a lush mountain meadow.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a richly detailed hand-painted fantasy creature group portrait in a whimsical storybook animation style, featuring {argument name="central creature" default="a giant fluffy cream-white rabbit with long upright ears, tiny black oval eyes, and a gentle smile"} surrounded by many friendly imaginary animals.

Canvas: Wide 3:2 landscape illustration, full-bleed, high detail, no border, no text. The composition is a dense, symmetrical ensemble portrait with the central rabbit slightly forward and centered, framed by larger creatures behind and smaller creatures along the foreground.

Setting: A lush magical meadow at the edge of a shallow reflective pond, filled with reeds, grasses, mossy rocks, tropical leaves, pink lotus-like flowers, purple blossoms, and small petals scattered near the water. In the background, place a windswept tree on the upper left, cactus-like plants and shrubs behind it, soft blue hills, a pale blue sky with puffy white clouds, and a distant snow-capped mountain on the right. Use {argument name="background setting" default="a bright alpine fantasy meadow with a pond, flowering plants, a lone tree, and a snowy mountain"}.
