Goal: Create a clean anime character reference sheet in a loose hand-drawn concept-art style for {argument name="character name" default="an elegant androgynous swordsman"}.

Canvas: Wide horizontal white background, high-resolution, no scenery, no title text, no labels, plenty of negative space. Use thin sketchy ink lines, slightly rough edges, flat cel shading, restrained painterly texture, and a polished Japanese fantasy game character-design aesthetic.

Layout: Show exactly 6 discrete character views arranged across the canvas: 1 full-body front view on the far left, 1 full-body three-quarter front view beside it, 1 full-body right side profile in the center, 1 full-body back view slightly right of center, 1 large bust portrait facing forward in the upper right, and 1 large head-and-shoulders side-profile portrait in the lower right. Keep proportions consistent across all views.

Subject details: The character is a slim young adult with pale skin, sharp golden amber eyes, a calm serious expression, and very long layered {argument name="hair color" default="deep navy blue"} hair with messy bangs, side locks, and a long flowing back section reaching past the waist. Add long red dangling earrings visible on both portraits and front views. The face is refined and slightly melancholic, with narrow eyes and a small mouth.

Costume: Design an ornate East Asian-inspired fantasy outfit in {argument name="main outfit colors" default="white, black, antique gold, and deep red"}. Include a high black collar with gold knot-like ornamentation, structured black-and-gold shoulder armor with filigree cutouts, wide white sleeves, black gloves, layered black trousers, fitted black boots with gold trim, a long white outer robe or coat with elaborate gold cloud-and-scroll patterns, black inner panels, red lining, and multiple red tassels and cords around the waist and shoulders. Add a prominent red knotted waist ornament with hanging tassels and gold details. The back view should clearly show the long white coat panels with symmetrical gold embroidery and the character’s long hair falling down the back.

Style constraints: Keep the sheet clean and model-sheet focused, with no weapons, no props, no background objects, no decorative frame, and no text. Maintain accurate costume continuity between all 6 views, emphasize the ornate gold embroidery and red tassel accents, and make the image feel like a production-ready hand-drawn character turnaround for animation or game development.

en.title: Crimson Moon Witch Manga Page
en.description: A four-panel vertical fantasy manga page showing a blonde witch departing through a magical gate beneath a crimson moon.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical fantasy manga page about a young witch traveling to the Lion's Gate under a giant crimson moon, in a richly detailed anime style with dramatic lighting and Japanese speech bubbles.

Canvas: Tall vertical comic page, smartphone ratio about 9:16, full bleed art with thin black outer border. Use four diagonal manga panels separated by thick white gutters slanting downward from left to right. Color palette: deep violet night sky, magenta clouds, glowing red moon, blue-black castle silhouettes, warm gold magical light.

Layout and panels: Use exactly 4 panels.
1. Top wide establishing panel: a vast alternate-world sky city beneath an enormous red full moon. Floating gothic castles, spires, magical purple circles, bats, debris, and multiple witches flying on broomsticks. Show about 7 visible flying witch silhouettes at different depths, with one larger blonde witch on a broom in the left foreground seen from behind. Add a vertical narration box on the right with {argument name="opening narration" default="地球とは異なる世界――『紅き月』"}.
2. Second wide panel: rear view of the same blonde witch standing before a gigantic ancient stone gate with ornate pillars and a glowing red portal inside. Her long blonde hair streams in the wind, she wears a large black witch hat and dark academy robe, and holds a staff with a small blue gem. Around the gate are 3 glowing pink magic circles and floating rocks. Add a vertical narration box on the left with {argument name="gate narration" default="年に一度だけ開く、蒼き星への門"}. The gate itself has faint Japanese-style lettering carved above the arch.
3. Third medium panel: conversation scene with exactly 5 young witches visible. Left foreground: back/side of the blonde protagonist with her black hat and golden hair. Facing her are 4 witch classmates: a purple-haired serious girl, a silver-haired girl in a pointed hat, a small pink-haired girl, and a long dark-haired girl in a pointed hat. All wear dark magical school uniforms with capes and gold trim. Include two speech bubbles: one near the group with {argument name="classmate line" default="とうとう修行の日ね。"}, and one near the protagonist with {argument name="protagonist reply" default="うん！"}.
4. Bottom large hero panel: close-up of the blonde protagonist smiling brightly with sparkling red-gold eyes, long flowing blonde hair, black witch hat with red lining, black robe, white collar, and large crimson bow. She raises one fist excitedly. Behind her, the red moon and the blazing golden Lion's Gate form a radiant circular halo. Add one large vertical speech bubble on the right with {argument name="final speech" default="蒼き星へ行ってきます！"}.

Subject details: The protagonist is a cheerful teenage witch with fair skin, very long wavy blonde hair, amber-red eyes, a black pointed witch hat, black magical academy uniform, red bow tie, and adventurous expression. The atmosphere should feel like a polished serialized Japanese fantasy manga, cinematic, highly detailed, luminous, emotional, and magical.

Constraints: Keep exactly 4 panels, exactly 5 witches in the third panel, and exactly 5 text boxes/bubbles total. Use Japanese text only inside the specified narration and speech areas. Do not add extra captions, logos, watermarks, or page numbers.

en.title: Gothic AI Stack Diagram
en.description: Creates a dark gothic illustrated AI-tool stack diagram for social posts, tech commentary, or personal workflow branding.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark gothic hand-painted infographic poster titled {argument name="headline text" default="THE AI STACK"}, showing an interconnected personal AI-tool stack as a mysterious occult network.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, black and charcoal textured canvas with visible rough brush strokes, scratched chalk marks, muted cream ink, and subtle sepia highlights. The mood is eerie, nocturnal, vintage, and slightly haunted.

Layout: Place a large central circular node labeled {argument name="main tool" default="CLAUDE"} with a simple eight-point starburst symbol inside it. Four rounded rectangular tool cards connect to the central node with pale hand-drawn cables and small circular connector dots. Use exactly 4 outer cards: top-left card labeled {argument name="tool 1" default="CODEX"} with a browser-window code icon, top-right card labeled {argument name="tool 2" default="GPT IMAGE 2"} with a framed landscape/image icon, bottom-left card labeled {argument name="tool 3" default="ANTIGRAVITY"} with a starry mountain or sparkling night icon, and bottom-right card labeled {argument name="tool 4" default="HERMES"} with a crossed-arrows or janitor-like routing symbol. Keep all text in uppercase, widely spaced, distressed serif/typewriter lettering.

Scene details: Add a glowing full moon centered above the main node, a small spiderweb and tiny spider in the upper-left corner, a dark gothic castle silhouette in the right background, fog and smoky clouds along the bottom, a wilted flower with a bent stem leaning across the left side of the central node, one fallen brown leaf near the base of the flower, and an antique skeleton key lying at the bottom right. Include a tiny creator handle centered at the bottom: @AunySillyMe.

Visual style: Painterly gothic chalkboard illustration, rough impasto texture, off-white linework on black, muted gold-brown accents on the dead flower and leaf, softly glowing moon, handmade imperfect borders, no clean vector polish.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 central circle, exactly 4 connected outer cards, exactly 4 outer tool labels, exactly 1 moon, exactly 1 spiderweb, exactly 1 spider, exactly 1 wilted flower, exactly 1 fallen leaf, exactly 1 castle silhouette, and exactly 1 key. Do not add extra cards, extra tools, bright colors, modern UI gloss, or photorealism.

en.title: DNA Nucleotides 3D Infographic
en.description: A detailed 3D educational biology infographic showing a labeled DNA double helix with nucleotide base pairs, hydrogen bonds, backbone, and emerging RNA.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a polished 3D scientific educational infographic titled {argument name="headline text" default="DNA Nucleotides"}, showing a close-up view of a DNA double helix with labeled nucleotide bases and molecular structure.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 composition, bright white laboratory-style background with soft depth-of-field molecular clusters in pale blue, lavender, mint, and purple around the edges. Use a clean, high-resolution textbook/medical visualization style with realistic glossy translucent spheres and rods, soft shadows, and shallow depth of field.

Layout: Center the title at the top in large dark navy bold type, with the subtitle {argument name="subtitle text" default="A close-up view of the DNA double helix"} directly beneath in smaller medium-blue type. Fill the frame with a large twisting DNA double helix running from the left foreground through the center to the right side, with a second orange strand crossing diagonally through the lower right foreground. Keep the central base-pair region open and readable for labels.

Subject details: Render the DNA as a molecular ball-and-stick model combined with translucent bead-like backbone surfaces. The sugar-phosphate backbone should be two twisting chains made of semi-transparent bluish-gray spheres with orange/gold connector rods and small red atoms. In the center, show exactly 4 labeled nucleotide bases: Adenine (A) in green at upper left center, Thymine (T) in purple at upper right center, Guanine (G) in blue at lower left center, and Cytosine (C) in orange at lower right center. Adenine pairs with Thymine across the top using dotted pale blue hydrogen bonds, and Guanine pairs with Cytosine below using three dotted pale blue hydrogen-bond rows. Molecular rings should be flat aromatic ring structures with small colored atom spheres and white hydrogen atoms.

Text content and labels: Include exactly 7 callout labels with thin black pointer lines: “Adenine (A)” in green pointing to the green upper-left base; “Thymine (T)” in purple pointing to the purple upper-right base; “Guanine (G)” in blue pointing to the blue lower-left base; “Cytosine (C)” in orange pointing to the orange lower-right base; “Sugar-phosphate backbone” in black pointing to the right-side helical backbone; “Hydrogen bonds” in black pointing to the dotted bond lines between base pairs; and “Emerging RNA” in orange pointing to the orange strand crossing the lower foreground. Use crisp sans-serif typography and avoid crowding.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed scientific 3D render, glossy translucent molecular beads, realistic refraction, soft bokeh background, professional biology textbook infographic, balanced educational clarity and cinematic depth.

Constraints: Use exactly the 4 nucleotide labels and exactly the 3 structural labels listed above; do not add extra labels, icons, captions, legends, watermarks, or borders. Keep all text sharp and correctly spelled.

en.title: Chinese Home Compute Buying Guide
en.description: A vertical Chinese infographic comparing four home computing purchase options with prices, power usage, audiences, and drawbacks.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Chinese product comparison infographic on a white background with a clean flat-design style. The main title at the top is {argument name="headline text" default="2026 家庭算力采购指南"}, in large bold black Chinese type, centered.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, approximately 768×1152 px. Use generous white margins, crisp vector lines, and a balanced grid layout.

Layout: Place exactly 4 tall rounded-rectangle comparison cards in one horizontal row beneath the title. Each card has a colored header bar, a matching thin border, a simple line icon near the top, then five stacked information sections separated by pale gray horizontal divider lines. Use neat left-aligned Chinese text inside each card.

Cards, colors, icons, and text content:
1. Blue card header: “Mac mini M4”. Icon: simple blue outline Mac mini with Apple logo and two small front dots. Sections: “型号:” / “M4 10核 CPU / 10核 GPU”; “参考价 (¥):” / “4,499 起”; “功耗 (W):” / “约 65”; “适合人群:” / “开发、轻量 AI、家庭服务器”; “一句话缺点:” / “内存与硬盘升级成本高”.
2. Green card header: “RTX 5090 主机”. Icon: green outline desktop tower with four fan circles and side panel. Sections: “型号:” / “RTX 5090 32GB”; “参考价 (¥):” / “30,000 起”; “功耗 (W):” / “约 800–1,000”; “适合人群:” / “本地大模型、渲染、重度创作”; “一句话缺点:” / “价格高，耗电与散热压力大”.
3. Purple card header: “云 GPU 包月”. Icon: purple outline cloud containing a server rack. Sections: “型号:” / “按需选择 GPU”; “参考价 (¥):” / “1,000–8,000 / 月”; “功耗 (W):” / “本地几乎为 0”; “适合人群:” / “短期项目、弹性需求、团队协作”; “一句话缺点:” / “长期使用成本不可控”.
4. Orange card header: “二手矿卡”. Icon: orange outline dual-fan graphics card. Sections: “型号:” / “RTX 3090 等”; “参考价 (¥):” / “3,500–6,000”; “功耗 (W):” / “约 350–500”; “适合人群:” / “预算有限、愿意折腾的玩家”; “一句话缺点:” / “寿命、保修与稳定性风险高”.

Footer: Center a small gray footnote along the bottom: “数据仅供参考 · 更新于 2026-08-08 · 非投资建议”.

Visual style: Minimal flat infographic, Chinese sans-serif font, high readability, accurate alignment, consistent spacing, no shadows, no photos, no decorative background. Ensure all Chinese text is sharp and legible, with the section labels colored to match each card’s header.

[DESTINATION] = {argument name="destination" default="[CITY NAME]"}

Create a charming vertical 4:5 mid-century travel picture-book illustration of [DESTINATION], inspired by playful 1950s–60s European city books.

Depict the city as an affectionate, imperfect travel memory—not a map, postcard, architectural rendering, landmark collage, or cinematic panorama.

Include:
• 1 distinctive primary landmark
• 1 smaller secondary landmark
• 1 distant/partially hidden local feature
• 1 recognizable local vehicle
• 3–5 subtle everyday city details
• 5–6 ordinary people doing simple local activities

Compress these naturally into one imaginary street, plaza, park, or waterfront. Keep the primary landmark slightly off-center, with open foreground, shallow theatrical depth, gentle curves, and generous museum-white negative space. The city should be recognizable without feeling geographically accurate.

STYLE:
Hand-drawn picture-book illustration with loose charcoal/navy ink, trembling contours, crooked architecture, uneven proportions, sparse windows, simplified silhouettes, occasional double strokes, and minimal detail. Use the fewest lines necessary. Slightly awkward, intelligent, warm, humorous, and handmade.

PEOPLE:
Simple expressive figures with oversized heads, thin legs, narrow bodies, tiny faces, tilted accessories, and awkward but readable gestures. Show ordinary local life, not celebrities, models, stereotypes, or tourist clichés.

COLOR:
Use a restrained 6–7 color destination-specific palette with flat matte gouache shapes, uneven brush edges, white gaps, slight misregistration, and occasional color spilling beyond ink. Mostly unpainted sky/paper. No gradients or realistic shading.

MEMORY DISTORTION:
Gently compress geography and distort scale: distant landmarks may appear nearby, roads may curve strangely, buildings may overlap, and people/vehicles may be slightly oversized or undersized. Keep it balanced, affectionate, and culturally respectful.

OPTIONAL TEXT:
“[DESTINATION]” in small uneven hand-drawn capitals near the bottom. No slogans, dates, labels, logos, or promotional text.

AVOID:
Photorealism, map-like accuracy, landmark checklists, aerial views, cinematic lighting, technical perspective, dense crowds, detailed ornament, polished vector art, CGI, 3D rendering, gradients, sepia/beige paper, artificial aging, distressed textures, and hyper-detailed watercolor.

Overall feeling: [DESTINATION] remembered lovingly-recognizable, spacious, human, humorous, slightly improbable, and beautifully imperfect.

en.title: Oriental Fantasy Noble Cosplay Photography
en.description: A realistic and high-quality photography prompt of a young East Asian noblewoman in a crimson mermaid dress, posing elegantly in a creamy coral-themed room.
en.prompt: {argument name="aspect ratio" default="9:16 vertical"}, high-completion realistic oriental fantasy noble Cosplay photography, with only one {argument name="age" default="24-year-old"} adult East Asian female in the picture, close-up slightly high angle, the character is fully in frame from the top of the head to the middle of the thighs. She has fair and soft skin, a rounded oval face, dark brown almond eyes, and naturally full bean-paste colored lips, with coral pink eyeshadow softly smudged on the lower eyelids and warm pink blush on her cheeks; her dark brown long hair is braided into a loose low bun, with pearl and shell pattern hair combs fixed behind her ears, and a few strands of long hair falling along the sides of her face. The character is sitting sideways on the edge of a cream-colored curved chair, her left hand supporting the seat surface, palm down and fingers naturally spread, her right elbow close to her body, and her right fingertips lightly touching her chin; her torso is slightly tilted back, shoulders relaxed, waist kept straight, and legs angled towards the bottom right of the screen. Her eyes are slightly lowered, eyelids soft, and the corners of her mouth are slightly lifted, showing a gentle and slightly smug expression. She is wearing a {argument name="outfit color" default="coral red"} off-the-shoulder curved neckline wrap dress, with thin gauze pleated layers on the chest covering complete curved cups, the gauze layers showing a looming natural breast shape with the light; three-dimensional chest darts connect to a cream-colored narrow waistband, accurately tightening at the narrowest waist point, the waist-fitting mermaid skirt outlining the waist and hips before naturally spreading out, decorated with pearl-white wave embroidery on the surface. Shoulder decorations consist of shell layers and short pearl chains fixed on the sleeve base, pearl waterfall earrings are worn on both ears, a fine pearl short chain on the neck, a coral-colored gemstone pendant hanging at the waist, and a double-layer fine pearl bracelet on the left wrist. The background is a cream-colored coral showroom, with white sculptures displayed in arched niches in the back, a glass display cabinet on the left reflecting soft light, and a pearl table lamp on the right emitting amber light, the light-colored terrazzo floor with fine particles and weak reflections. Soft overhead light illuminates the face, collarbones, and bodice pleats, side light emphasizes the waist and hip curves, and the textures of skin, long hair, thin gauze, pearls, and satin are clear and natural.

en.title: Wuhan Paper Cut Illustration Poster
en.description: A sophisticated prompt for creating layered paper-cut style posters featuring Wuhan's iconic landmarks with professional layout and lighting.
en.prompt: Create a high-end layered paper-cut illustration poster for the original cultural tourism brand "{argument name="brand name" default="Hewang Wuhan"}", with the communication theme "Gaze at the River from the Tower, Seeing Wuhan's Landscape Skeleton at a Glance", 3:4 vertical version. The image uses a foreground window composition, with five to seven layers of thick textured paper forming Snake Hill, Yellow Crane Tower, the Yangtze River, Wuhan Yangtze River Bridge, and the city skyline on the opposite bank; Yellow Crane Tower is located on the background ridge, with accurate overlapping eaves, gold glazed tiles, and vermilion columns; the mid-ground Yangtze River Bridge extends horizontally, with two small ferries on the river at a restrained scale, and Qingchuan Pavilion must not be merged with Yellow Crane Tower. The paper edges are clean, with unified soft light from the top left and realistic inter-layer shadows. The overall colors are {argument name="color palette" default="cyan, warm off-white, and cinnabar red"} with a small amount of gilded yellow, where gold is only used for visual focal points. The main title "{argument name="main title" default="Denglunjian Jiangcheng"}" is placed in a large white space on the top right in two lines of modern Songti font; the subtitle "The Grand Daily Life Glimpsed from Snake Hill to the Yangtze" is arranged horizontally below the title; the brand name "{argument name="brand name" default="Hewang Wuhan"}" is placed in a paper seal-shaped brand position on the bottom left, maintaining a modern rather than archaic style. Use standard Simplified Chinese with no typos, only Chinese; prohibit cheap red and gold templates, sky full of auspicious clouds, characters in ancient costumes, distorted architectural proportions, plastic materials, heavy glowing borders, well-known logos, watermarks, and extra copy.

en.title: Morning Greeting City Poster Design
en.description: A sophisticated layout prompt for GPT Image 2 to create minimalist morning greeting posters with geometric shapes, urban themes, and high-contrast color fields.
en.prompt:
Generate a design for {argument name="subject" default="Good Morning"} featuring flat poster order and realistic focal imagery: first, establish open white space with a large area of vivid, high-brightness color at the top, followed by a nearly equal, low-saturation light-colored paper area at the bottom to form a clean, clear horizontal color boundary. Translate the theme's core form into two sets of oversized, low-detail, heavy, and rounded light-colored character graphics that cross the boundary and bleed to the edges, serving as visual skeletons rather than decoration. Compress the subject into a small-to-medium-scale concrete focal point placed near the boundary, partially obscuring the giant graphics to create clear front-to-back layering. The focal object should be rendered with natural photography or high-texture detail, retaining realistic surfaces, soft top-side lighting, and grounded shadows. Place two lines of theme-related short titles near the left boundary using bold, compact, geometric sans-serif uppercase characters, left-aligned in black to form a strong anchor. Add micro-sized, wide-spaced metadata tags on the upper edges of the graphics for design rhythm. The overall look should feel like clean offset printing on matte paper with fine fibers. Avoid heavy aging, yellowing, or modern gradients. 

Theme: {argument name="quote" default="Good Morning + Greeting"} + {argument name="city" default="Beijing"}

en.title: Coral Chiffon Floral Dress Portrait
en.description: A professional fashion photography prompt for a top-down view of a woman in a coral floral dress, featuring intricate pleats and realistic lighting.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Coral floral dress"}

Subject:
A vertical fashion photograph capturing {argument name="number of people" default="a single woman"} lying on a smooth mauve-pink floor from directly above, with a giant coral and light-beige dress spreading out like petals across the entire frame. A deep slit reveals her right thigh.

Character/Expression:
The upper body lies diagonally from the top left to the bottom right, with the face looking directly up at the camera. The character has brown eyes staring straight ahead, glossy coral lips slightly parted, and a calm expression. Features include a small oval face, almond-shaped eyes, thin parallel eyebrows, a slender nose bridge, and a glossy, bright complexion. Long light-brown hair is fanned out to the left with soft bangs and large waves.

Costume/Pose:
A strapless long dress with a light-beige pleated chest area and a thick coral fabric sash crossing diagonally from the right breast to a large floral ornament at the waist. Multiple layers of translucent vertical pleats with a deep slit on the right hip. The left arm is bent over the head with the forearm on the forehead, and the right arm rests on the waist with fingers overlapped. Both legs are crossed and cropped at the bottom.

Background/Lighting:
The background is a smooth, light mauve-pink floor. Chiffon fabrics in coral, light peach, and beige wave outwards toward the corners. Hard yet soft primary lighting comes from the top left, creating highlights on the arms, face, chest, and legs, and casting distinct shadows on the fine pleats of the fabric.

Composition/Camera:
A 3:4 vertical fashion portrait shot from a {argument name="angle" default="direct overhead bird's-eye view"} capturing the body from the head to the crossed legs. The face is positioned toward the top left, the exposed thigh at the bottom right, with the wide drapes filling the remaining space. Focus is on the face and floral ornaments with a deep depth of field to keep the fabric details clear.

Texture/Style:
High-quality photorealistic live-action photography. Precise rendering of translucent chiffon, micro-pleats, 3D floral ornaments, skin, and hair, unified in a coral to mauve color palette.

Negative:
Do not change the overhead view to a front standing pose; do not omit the wide drapes or deep slit.

en.title: Summer Window Ledge Scene
en.description: A detailed photorealistic prompt depicting a girl sitting on a window ledge of a white wall house surrounded by vines and lemon branches.
en.prompt:
Subject: Shoes swinging from a {argument name="fruit" default="lemon"} window

Main Subject: A full-body environmental portrait of a young woman in {argument name="clothing color" default="white"} clothes sitting on the edge of an open second-floor window of an old white-walled house covered in vines and white flowers, with both legs hanging outside. The subject is placed slightly above the center of the frame, showing white socks stretching down, {argument name="shoe color" default="black"} loafers, and yellow lemons in the upper right foreground.

Person/Expression: Small oval face directed toward the upper right, chin raised to look at the sky. A quiet profile with dark brown eyes, thin bangs, and slightly parted coral lips. Brown hair reaching below the shoulder is wavy and flows to the left shoulder.

Attire/Pose: A white thin-strap cropped top and short skirt or shorts. Soft double frills at the chest and hem, with a thin white long-sleeved cardigan draped over the arms. Knee-high white socks and black platform loafers. Sitting on the window frame, right hand on the window sill, both knees aligned and extended downward, toes slightly crossed and hanging outside the wall.

Background/Light: Background features rough white plaster walls, white wooden double-hung windows with peeling paint, and a brown roof edge. Dark green vines and white star-shaped flowers surround the walls and windows. In the upper right foreground, leaves and several large yellow lemons hang blurred. Harsh direct sunlight from the upper left illuminates the wall, face, clothes, and legs, casting fine leaf shadows.

Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical ratio. A strong low-angle shot looking up from the ground to the second-floor window, capturing the blue sky, roof, and lower wall surface. The person occupies about half the height of the screen, with the window in the center, face in the top half, and hanging legs/black shoes in the lower center. Focus on the person and window, with foreground lemons and side leaves softly blurred.

Texture/Style: High-definition photorealistic photo based on white, plant green, lemon yellow, sky blue, and shoe black. Realistically depicts old plaster and wooden frames, thin fabric, leaves and flowers, leather shoes, and strong summer light.

Negative: Do not omit the hanging legs and black loafers outside the window; do not change the strong low angle to a horizontal perspective

en.title: Yukata Character Sheet Generator
en.description: A comprehensive prompt for creating a realistic character sheet for a specific person wearing different colored yukatas. It handles multiple views (front, side, back) and ensures character and hairstyle consistency based on a reference image.
en.prompt:
[Final Product Objective] Using the attached female full-body reference image as the sole subject reference, and the attached yukata reference image group, create a high-quality realistic character sheet of the same person wearing a yukata in a specified color scheme. The sheet should be visually appealing for sharing and practical for checking the person, yukata, obi, and face.
[Input Items]
Aspect Ratio: {argument name="aspect ratio" default="1:1 / 9:16"}
Color Scheme Type: {argument name="color scheme" default="White / Indigo / Red"}
Defaults to 1:1 and White if not specified.
[Reference Usage]
Image A = 1 female full-body reference image. Sole person reference.
Image B = Reference for white color scheme. White to light base, pale cool-toned patterns, light obi.
Image C = Reference for indigo color scheme. Indigo base, white to light patterns, dark obi.
Image D = Main reference for red color scheme and common pattern structure. White to light base, red to dark red patterns, dark red obi.
Image E = Supplementary reference for back obi knot and footwear.
[Person Consistency]
Maintain the same person as Image A, preserving facial features, eyes, contours, nose, mouth, hairstyle, hair color, length, bangs, parting, age, skin tone, height, shoulder width, chest, torso length, waist position, curves, hip roundness, body type, proportions, and limb length. Maintain a natural, slender feminine 3D form and avoid shortening the torso or making it boxy/flat. Do not inherit clothing, background, or pose from the original image.
[Hairstyle Consistency]
Keep Image A's hairstyle consistent across all views. Forbidden: updos, bun styles, braids, adding hair ornaments, or different hairstyles for SIDE/BACK views. Keep hair tidy, avoiding messiness, spread, flyaways, wind-blown looks, or chaotic clustering. The back view must show natural hair flow, looking like the same person with the same hairstyle.
[Yukata Design]
All three color schemes use the same design with different colors. Fix the pattern structure using Image D as the main reference, only changing the base, pattern, and obi colors. Do not change the type of pattern, main floral designs, or streamline composition for different colors. Ensure natural collar alignment, sleeves, body, hem, and obi placement/wrapping for beautiful dressing. Sleeves and body should have a natural drape.
[Coloring]
White: Main reference Image B. White to light cream base, common pattern in pale cool colors like light blue/gray-blue, light blue obi. Cool and elegant.
Indigo: Main reference Image C. Indigo to dusty blue base, common pattern in white/light colors, navy to deep indigo obi. Calm and dignified.
Red: Main reference Image D. White to light cream base, common pattern in red to maroon, maroon to deep reddish-purple obi. Vibrant, mature, and elegant.
[Obi and Footwear]
The obi should be a half-width belt suitable for a yukata, firmly cinched at the waist. Do not unnaturally flatten the torso, and avoid a loose, cylindrical look. The BACK view must clearly show a natural knot shape based on Image E. Footwear should follow the shape and atmosphere of Image E.
[Fixed Layout]
Do not change the specified layout. Overall: Top section ~58%, Bottom section ~42%.
Top: 01 FRONT ~22% / 02 SIDE ~22% / 03 BACK ~22% / 04 SPECIAL LOOK ~34%.
Bottom: 05 FACE ~62% / 06 REFERENCE / DETAIL ~38%.
01-04 must include full body from head to footwear. 04 is a large 3/4 full-body view. 05 consists of 3 face shots: front, oblique 3/4, and light side. 06 is an auxiliary frame for checking obi, footwear, and patterns.
[02 SIDE Critical Condition]
Must be a clear full-body profile, not a stiff standing pose. The silhouette should transition smoothly from the natural forward volume of the chest to the cinched waist at the obi, light waist curve, and posterior hip roundness. Do not make the torso look like a cylinder or a flat board. Neck should be naturally long, shoulders relaxed, with a stable back and pelvis. Combine feminine 3D form with beautiful yukata fit.
[Text Rules]
The only allowed text is "01 FRONT", "02 SIDE", "03 BACK", "04 SPECIAL LOOK", "05 FACE", and "06 REFERENCE / DETAIL". Do not add Japanese notes, descriptions, footnotes, captions, comments, color explanations, or decorative text. Font, color, size, and tone of headers must be uniform.
[Background and Quality]
Background is white or very light neutral. Photorealistic, high quality, natural human body/face/hands/feet, no structural flaws in yukata/obi. Consistent identity, body type, and hairstyle across all views. Maintain layout for both 1:1 and 9:16, only adjusting margins and frame dimensions naturally.
[Prohibitions]
Person change, excessive beautification/rejuvenation/aging, small-face distortion, leg lengthening, body change, flattening, hairstyle change/mess, different patterns per color, loose obi causing cylindrical torso, turning it into a kimono/dress/cosplay, unauthorized text, busy backgrounds, information overload, extreme poses.
[Most Important]
Maintain Image A's identity, body type, and hairstyle across all views, and establish the Image D pattern in white, indigo, or red. Specifically, do not break the obi cinching, feminine profile, hair stability, or beautiful dressing.

irritated disbelief
full rage

calculating menace

same facial proportions

She wears the same {argument name="wardrobe" default="ivory cream dress with a light beige cardigan"} in every image. Preserve her identity consistently in all scenes; no duplicate characters and no face drift.

Layout: Each of the 6 scene cards should contain cinematic thumbnail frames along the top and small production notes underneath. Use black uppercase section labels and compact readable text. The thumbnails should alternate between drone-wide landscape views, close-up portrait/selfie shots, basket/burner details, and aerial balloon views.

Scene cards: Include exactly 6 numbered storyboard sections:

Sunrise Introduction (0–4 sec): three thumbnails showing a sunrise drone-wide view of dozens of balloons, the woman walking toward the launch area, and a close selfie-style smiling portrait with balloons behind her. Dialogue: “This has to be one of the most beautiful views I've ever seen.” Camera/movement: 360° orbit, close-up, ultra-wide drone, POV over basket edge.
5. Magical Mid-Flight Moments (18–24 sec): three thumbnails showing basket ropes/burner hardware in close-up, the woman holding the camera selfie-style, and her waving toward another colorful balloon nearby. Dialogue: “I never imagined it would feel this peaceful.” Camera/movement: macro, handheld selfie, wide aerial, tracking side angle.

Notes: balloon lands, she steps out, thanks the crew, and waves goodbye as the drone pulls away. Dialogue: “What an unforgettable experience. Thanks for coming along, and I'll see you in the next adventure!” Camera/movement: wide landing, medium follow, close-up, drone pull-away.

en.title: SCP Detainee Manga Introduction
en.description: Creates a five-panel vertical anime manga page introducing a rebellious pink-haired SCP-style detainee through courtroom, interrogation, transport, and mugshot scenes.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a dark cinematic vertical manga page introducing an SCP-style detainee character, {argument name="character name" default="Michelle"}, with a serious institutional trial-to-prison sequence that ends in a rebellious mugshot.

Canvas: Tall vertical comic page, smartphone aspect ratio about 9:16, full bleed, no outer white margin. Use five horizontal widescreen panels stacked from top to bottom, separated by clean white gutters. Overall mood is high-detail anime realism with dramatic lighting, dark browns, grays, and prison orange accents.

Main character: A young adult woman with long messy {argument name="hair color" default="pink"} hair, golden-yellow eyes, pale skin, slim build, and a defiant expression. She wears a gray prison/institution jumpsuit in the early panels and an orange prison jacket in the later panels. Her personality should read as dangerous, sarcastic, charming, and unafraid.

Panel count and layout: Use exactly 5 panels.
1. Top panel: A wide shot from behind the woman standing alone at the center of an imposing dark wooden courtroom or council chamber. Judges sit elevated at the far end, officials and suited observers line both sides, and warm lamps illuminate carved wood and gothic windows. Add a white vertical narration box on the left with Japanese text: 「あたしはミシェル 列車強盗という容疑を 繰り返してきた女だ」. Add a small black circular close icon with a white X at the extreme top-left corner, as if captured from a social media image viewer.
2. Second panel: A gray concrete interrogation room. The woman sits at a metal table in profile facing a stern man in a black suit and sunglasses; a heavily armed tactical guard in black armor stands behind her holding a rifle. Add a white vertical narration box near the center-left with Japanese text: 「懲役125年 そんなあたしに 刑務所の話があり 当然迷わず受け入れた」.
3. Third panel: The woman sits by a barred train or prisoner transport window, looking out at a barren desert landscape with distant mountains and a small facility under a bright sky. She is shown in close side view, thoughtful and slightly bored. Add a white vertical narration box on the left with Japanese text: 「なにかの研究だか実験だか それに付き合うのが 条件らしく まぁ、モルモットってこった」.
4. Fourth panel: Dynamic medium close-up inside a transport or holding area. The woman grins widely, pulling on or lifting an orange prison jacket, hair flowing dramatically. Her expression is mischievous and cocky. Add a white vertical speech/narration box on the left with Japanese text: 「ふん、寛みたいな 場所だってんなら 抜け出してやんよ」.
5. Bottom panel: Large dramatic mugshot close-up filling the lower third of the page. The woman wears the orange prison jacket, winks one eye, sticks out her tongue, and holds a mugshot board toward the viewer. Behind her is a height chart marked roughly 140, 150, 160, 170. The board must display large black ID text {argument name="mugshot ID" default="D-882006"} and huge graffiti-style name {argument name="graffiti name" default="MICK"}, crossed with a red X spray-painted diagonally. Add a white hexagonal speech box on the right with Japanese text: 「お前の名前に もう意味はない。 お前は今日から D-882006だ」.

Visual style: Highly polished GPT-image-2 anime manga illustration, cinematic composition, realistic lighting and materials, crisp linework, detailed backgrounds, dramatic shadows, subtle film grain, strong depth of field. Use dark courtroom and prison tones contrasted with vivid pink hair and saturated orange jacket. Japanese manga text boxes should be vertical, black text on white boxes, clean and legible.

Constraints: Keep exactly five horizontal panels. Do not add extra characters beyond courtroom officials, interrogator, tactical guard, and the main woman. Preserve the listed Japanese text exactly inside the boxes. No watermark, no artist signature, no extra captions outside the panels.

en.title: Chaotic Shibuya Scramble Crossing
en.description: A highly detailed photorealistic prompt for generating an absurdly crowded Tokyo scramble crossing full of surreal events and countable visual details.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create an ultra-dense, chaotic photorealistic wide-angle street scene at a huge Japanese scramble crossing, like Shibuya in Tokyo, packed with absurd events happening simultaneously. The image should feel like a single candid news photograph with extreme information density, realistic lighting, and many tiny details.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image, street-level perspective, slightly fisheye wide-angle lens, daytime under a bright blue sky. Dense city buildings, billboards, traffic lights, crosswalk stripes, signs, and crowds fill the background. Add a small white “GPT” watermark in the bottom-right corner.

Setting and background: Use {argument name="location" default="a busy Shibuya-style Tokyo scramble crossing"}. Surround the crossing with mid-rise commercial buildings, digital billboards, rooftop spectators, traffic signals, and urban signage. In the sky include exactly 8 aerial features: 1 heart-shaped skywriting trail, 1 blimp, 1 small helicopter, 1 airplane, 1 drone, 1 flock of tiny birds, 1 lightning bolt striking from clouds on the right, and 1 large cluster of colorful balloons in the upper-right corner. On one tall glass building, make lit windows form a large smiling face.

Main crowd and vehicles: Fill the intersection with a dense crowd of pedestrians and performers. Include exactly 5 main vehicles: 1 elaborately decorated neon parade truck with a dragon on top, 1 colorful graffiti-covered sports car, 1 green taxi, 1 small bus or van, and 1 silver fish-shaped parade float or vehicle at the far right. Add photographers and camera operators on the right edge documenting the chaos.

Foreground incidents and objects: Show exactly 12 prominent foreground details: 1 large taiko drum player on the far left, 1 seated guitarist near the drum, 1 transparent phone-booth-like glass box packed with people, 1 businessman dropping loose papers, 1 man in a black suit fallen beside a bicycle, 1 construction worker emerging from a round manhole, 1 overturned birdcage with green contents, 1 scattered group of pigeons, 1 row of ducklings crossing the road, 1 tan Shiba Inu dog on a leash, 1 large black crow in the lower-right foreground, and 1 man spilling noodles or creamy food from a bowl on the far right.

Costumed characters and performers: Include exactly 7 standout characters among the crowd: 1 Santa Claus, 1 panda mascot, 1 bride in a white wedding dress running through the crossing, 1 brown dinosaur mascot, 1 red superhero or sentai character, 1 schoolgirl in uniform, and 1 police officer trying to manage the scene.

Additional surreal details: Add exactly 7 extra chaotic props or actions: 1 giant soap bubble floating on the left, 1 shopping cart abandoned in the middle road, 1 microphone stand and speakers for street performance, 1 traffic cone near the vehicles, 1 airborne suitcase or box on the right, 1 small animal or mascot peeking from a vehicle roof, and scattered toilet paper rolls, apples, bottles, and debris across the crosswalk.

Visual style: Photorealistic, high-resolution documentary photography, crisp detail everywhere, natural shadows, realistic Japanese city atmosphere, no anime styling. Use {argument name="time of day" default="bright afternoon"}, {argument name="weather mood" default="sunny blue sky with dramatic lightning"}, {argument name="crowd density" default="extremely crowded"}, and {argument name="chaos level" default="maximum but still readable"}. Keep the composition balanced so every counted object is visible.

en.title: Friendly ChatGPT Robot Introduction
en.description: A square 3D promotional illustration of a cute ChatGPT robot explaining OpenAI with friendly handwritten annotations, useful for AI education or product announcement visuals.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a cheerful square promotional 3D illustration introducing {argument name="assistant name" default="ChatGPT"} as a friendly AI robot created by {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"}, mixing a polished product-render look with hand-drawn whiteboard-style annotations.

Canvas: 1:1 square image, warm indoor office/classroom setting, shallow depth of field, cozy natural light, wooden desk foreground, dark blue presentation board in the background.

Main subject: Center-right, show exactly 1 cute glossy white robot mascot with a rounded rectangular black face screen, glowing cyan happy crescent eyes, rounded white headphones/ear pods, segmented black-and-white arms, and one raised waving hand with 5 fingers. The robot holds exactly 1 white placard in front of its body. Add a teal OpenAI-knot style emblem on the robot chest.

Placard text and design: The placard should have a teal knot logo at top, large bold black "OpenAI" in the middle, and handwritten text above and below: "I was created by", "An AI research and deployment company", and in teal "Better AI. A brighter future." Add small teal doodle rays around the bottom slogan.

Left side handwritten intro panel: Use casual hand-lettering as if written on glass or a board. Large top text says "Hi there!" then "I'm" and a big mint-green underlined "ChatGPT". Under it, include exactly 3 explanatory bullet callouts with icons: 1 speech bubble icon with "A large language model (AI assistant)", 1 lightbulb icon with "I can answer questions, explain things, help you create, solve problems, and much more!", and 1 heart icon with "I'm here to be helpful, honest, and friendly." Include small decorative doodle rays around the headline.

Background board: On the right rear dark blue board, display a large white OpenAI knot logo above the word "OpenAI". Beneath it, handwritten stacked text reads exactly 4 lines: "Research", "Safety", "Useful AI", "for everyone" with an underline and small radiating doodles. Above the robot head, add handwritten text "That's me!" with an arrow pointing down to the robot.

Desk objects: Include exactly 4 stacked books on the left, spine labels from top to bottom: "BETTER QUESTIONS", "CLEARER ANSWERS", "A MORE HELPFUL TOMORROW", and a fourth dark book marked with a small heart. Include exactly 1 open laptop in the lower-left foreground with small writing on the back: "Curiosity builds a better world" plus a heart. Include exactly 1 white coffee mug on the right with text: "Same team. A brighter future." and a smiley face. Along the front edge of the desk, add a small handwritten footer: "OpenAI × ChatGPT = More possibilities for everyone" with doodle rays and a heart.

Visual style: High-quality gpt-image-2 style, cute 3D character rendering, soft reflections on plastic, realistic desk materials, bokeh background, bright teal accents, friendly educational startup branding, hand-drawn white marker typography and simple doodle icons. Keep text legible and correctly spelled.

Constraints: No extra characters, no extra logos beyond the OpenAI-style knot marks described, no watermark, no photorealistic human hands, keep the robot centered and welcoming, preserve the exact count of 1 robot, 1 placard, 4 books, 1 laptop, 1 mug, and 3 left-side bullet callouts.

en.title: Tiny Traveler Mango Beach Collage
en.description: Generates a six-panel surreal tropical collage featuring a tiny character interacting with giant mango-themed objects for playful social media visuals.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a whimsical six-panel surreal photo-real comic collage about a tiny curly-haired traveler and giant mangoes on a tropical beach.

Canvas: Wide 3:2 horizontal image divided into exactly 6 equal rectangular panels in a clean 3-column by 2-row grid, with thin invisible or minimal seams. Bright tropical daylight, turquoise ocean, sandy beach, palm trees, blue sky, warm cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, glossy high-detail food textures.

Main subject: A small young adult with {argument name="hair style" default="short dark curly hair"}, expressive face, tan/light-brown skin, wearing {argument name="outfit" default="an oversized dark olive-brown jacket, dark shirt, beige pants, and brown shoes"}. Keep the same character consistent in all panels, scaled tiny compared with the giant mango objects.

Panel count and contents: Use exactly 6 distinct scenes.
1. Top-left: The character laughs joyfully while sitting inside a gigantic sliced mango half filled with cubed mango flesh; thick golden mango juice pours from above and drips over the fruit, glossy and sticky.
2. Top-middle: A giant whole red-yellow mango is held close to the viewer by a large human hand; the mango is wrapped with coarse rope, and the tiny character pulls the rope with a surprised determined expression on the beach.
3. Top-right: Close-up of the character sipping from a tall orange-yellow juice carton labeled {argument name="carton text" default="MANGO"} in large red letters, using a pink straw, with palm trees and ocean behind.
4. Bottom-left: A large human hand reaches in from the upper left and presses a fingertip onto the top of a huge mango that the tiny character hugs affectionately with closed eyes and a content smile.
5. Bottom-middle: A glossy orange mango gelatin dessert on a white plate sits on the sand; a hand places a green mint leaf garnish on top, while the excited tiny character stands behind it holding a spoon.
6. Bottom-right: The character rides a giant mango like a rocket through the sky above the beach, pointing forward and smiling; a metallic rocket nozzle is attached to the back of the mango with a bright pink-orange flame trail.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic yet playful miniature scale illusion, crisp commercial photography, saturated mango orange and ocean turquoise palette, soft sunlight, detailed reflections, realistic hands, realistic fruit fibers and syrup, cinematic fantasy advertising aesthetic.

Constraints: No extra panels, no captions except the single carton word, no watermark, no borders or logos, preserve consistent beach environment and character identity across all six panels.

en.title: Friendly ChatGPT Robot Introduction
en.description: A warm 3D promotional scene of a cute ChatGPT robot mascot explaining OpenAI and its helpful AI assistant role.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a friendly educational promotional image introducing {argument name="character name" default="ChatGPT"} as a cute AI robot assistant created by {argument name="company name" default="OpenAI"}.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, warm realistic 3D render with soft depth of field, cozy office desk setting, dark blurred background, natural window light from the left, polished wood tabletop.

Main subject: A glossy white rounded robot mascot sits centered slightly right, with a black glass face screen showing two glowing cyan happy closed-eye arcs. The robot has rounded over-ear side panels, segmented white arms with black joints, a small teal OpenAI knot logo on its chest, and a raised right hand waving with five black-tipped fingers. Its left hand holds a white placard in front of its body.

Placard text and design: The placard shows handwritten-style text at top, “I was created by”, a large teal OpenAI knot logo, bold black “OpenAI”, smaller text “An AI research and deployment company”, and teal slogan “Better AI. A brighter future.” Add small teal decorative rays near the slogan.

Left chalkboard-style overlay: On the left side of the image, add hand-drawn white and mint typography and doodles. Text reads: “Hi there!” at the top with little emphasis marks; below it “I’m” in white and “ChatGPT” in large mint green letters with an underline. Include exactly 3 informational bullet blocks with icons: 1) speech bubble icon with “A large language model (AI assistant)”, 2) lightbulb icon with “I can answer questions, explain things, help you create, solve problems, and much more!”, 3) heart icon with “I’m here to be helpful, honest, and friendly.”

Right background branding: On a dark blue wall panel behind the robot, place the OpenAI knot logo and the word “OpenAI” in pale gray. Under it, add four stacked handwritten words/phrases: “Research”, “Safety”, “Useful AI”, “for everyone”, with a small underline and doodle rays. Above the robot head, add handwritten text “That’s me!” with an arrow pointing to the robot.

Desk objects: Include exactly 4 stacked books on the left, each with readable spine text: 1) “BETTER QUESTIONS” on a blue book, 2) “CLEARER ANSWERS” on a green book, 3) “A MORE HELPFUL TOMORROW” on a purple book, 4) a dark bottom book with a small heart symbol. Place an open laptop in the lower left foreground with text on the back reading “Curiosity builds a better world” and a small heart. On the right, place a white coffee mug with text reading “Same team. A brighter future.” plus a smiley face.

Bottom caption: Along the bottom edge of the desk, add a thin handwritten line with small doodle rays and text: “OpenAI × ChatGPT = More possibilities for everyone” followed by a small heart.

Visual style: Charming product-announcement illustration, high-quality 3D mascot, realistic reflections, rounded shapes, handwritten whiteboard annotations, mint green accent color, optimistic and approachable tone. Keep all typography legible, playful, and hand-lettered except the bold OpenAI logo text. Avoid extra logos, watermarks, or additional characters.

en.title: The Last Train From the Night Café
en.description: A cinematic photorealistic prompt for generating a rainy European station café scene filled with vintage details, passengers, signage, and warm nocturnal atmosphere.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a single coherent ultra-detailed photorealistic cinematic 16:9 image titled “THE LAST TRAIN FROM THE NIGHT CAFÉ,” set at exactly 21:47 on a rainy autumn night inside an elegant old European station café. The scene must be one continuous view, not a collage, split screen, or triptych.

Canvas and composition: Wide horizontal frame, viewed from just outside or at the open doorway of the café, looking inward and slightly right toward the adjacent train platform. Use deep perspective: wet glass and dark doorframes at the edges, a marble café table in the foreground center-left, warm café interior in the middle ground, and the blue rainy station platform visible through the open doors on the right. The atmosphere is melancholic, literary, and magical-real but still photorealistic.

Setting details: The café is called {argument name="café sign text" default="NACHTCAFÉ – LETZTER ZUG"}, shown on a large glowing cream sign above an ornate mirrored bar. Interior materials are dark polished wood, brass trim, antique mirrors, patterned wall tiles, marble tabletop, bentwood chairs, and glossy wet mosaic floor tiles. Rain streaks cover the windows and door glass, with red and blue city reflections outside. Warm globe pendant lamps hang from the ceiling; include exactly 5 visible round glowing globe lamps: 1 large lamp near the top left-center, 1 large lamp near the top center-right, 2 smaller hanging lamps near the timetable area, and 1 small lamp reflection/glow near the platform side. Add an antique wall clock above the timetable showing about 21:47.

Foreground characters and table: At the marble table sit exactly 2 café customers. Customer 1 is an elderly Black man in a textured brown tweed suit, white shirt, glasses, and gray beard, seated left in profile, writing in a cream notebook with a fountain pen. The notebook has legible handwritten text beginning “The future arrived seven minutes late.” Customer 2 is a pale red-haired woman in a dark emerald velvet coat seated center, gently pouring amber tea from a glass teapot into a white cup while holding a gold pocket watch. Give her a calm, wistful expression. On the table include exactly 6 main tabletop items: 1 open notebook, 1 fountain pen in the man’s hand, 1 glass teapot with amber tea, 2 white cups with saucers, and 1 small metal table-number stand displaying “12.” Under the table place exactly 1 black cat with bright eyes and a small white chest patch. Beside the table lean exactly 1 closed red umbrella with a curved handle.

Background figures and action: Include exactly 2 background human figures. One is a blurred café patron or staff reflection near the mirror/bar at left, partially turned away. The second is a female train conductor standing in the open doorway on the right, wearing a dark navy uniform and peaked cap, holding a ticket or sign. The ticket should read approximately {argument name="conductor ticket text" default="GLEIS 7 - SITZ 12A"}. She stands upright and solemn, framed by the wet station platform beyond.

Visible signage and text: Include exactly 1 main café sign reading {argument name="café sign text" default="NACHTCAFÉ – LETZTER ZUG"}. Include exactly 1 black departure board with 3 route rows: “BERLIN → PRAG 22:15 GLEIS 7,” “WIEN → ZÜRICH 22:40 GLEIS 4,” and “PARIS → BRÜSSEL 23:05 GLEIS 2.” Include exactly 1 tabletop number card reading “12.” Preserve the multilingual European station feel with German words on signage.

Decorative details: Suspend exactly 7 red origami cranes in the upper middle of the café, arranged as if gently drifting from left to right. Behind the bar include a small pastry display with croissants and a vase of autumn flowers. Add brass coffee urns, dark green plants, and delicate reflections in mirrors and wet surfaces.

Lighting and style: Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, cinematic, 35mm lens feel, warm amber interior lighting contrasted with cool blue rainy exterior station light. High dynamic range, realistic reflections, fine raindrops on glass, shallow-to-medium depth of field, crisp foreground details, soft atmospheric background. Autumn night mood, nostalgic European rail travel, magical realism without fantasy creatures beyond the subtle origami cranes and symbolic timing.

Constraints: Must remain one continuous scene. Do not create panels or collage divisions. Keep all people anatomically realistic. Avoid modern digital screens except the vintage-style departure board. No logos, no watermark, no extra readable text beyond the specified signs unless incidental and indistinct.

en.title: Traditional Stewed Pear Dessert Poster
en.description: A detailed macro photography prompt for a Chinese-style dessert poster featuring snow pears in a glass pot with warm morning light and elegant typography.
en.prompt: A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of translucent snow pear from a stewing pot, with clear syrup forming a small backflow along the tip of the spoon. Design a 3:4 vertical rock sugar stewed pear poster for an original nourishing dessert brand "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}". The scene is set exclusively on a warm white stone window sill on an autumn morning. A 15cm diameter transparent heat-resistant glass stewing pot is placed slightly to the right of the center, with the glass lid lying flat to the back left. The pot is 70% full of clear light-gold syrup, precisely containing eight pieces of cut snow pear, six pieces of transparent rock sugar, and three dried osmanthus flowers. A transparent glass spoon scoops a piece of pear from the right, stopping about 4cm above the rim of the pot, with the syrup backflow controlled at 3cm. The center of the pot is at 62% horizontal and 64% vertical, occupying about 38% of the frame width. The area from 7% to 42% horizontal and 9% to 47% vertical on the left remains a warm white text zone. The foreground contains only half a fresh snow pear with the cut side facing up, while the background features a soft white sheer curtain; do not add red dates, wolfberries, or tremella. The camera is 12cm above the middle of the pot, using a 90mm macro lens shooting from the front left at a 14-degree angle from a distance of 72cm. The focus is locked on the pear fibers in the spoon, the transparency of the syrup, and the edge of the glass pot, with the lid remaining recognizable. A large window-shaped soft light of about 5500K from the back left penetrates the syrup and pear meat, while a warm white reflector at the front right restores the glass contours. Two strands of very faint steam rise towards the window. The color scheme is 52% warm white background, 18% transparent light-gold syrup, 20% pear milk white, 5% glass gray, and 5% dark brown text. Pear meat should be soft and slightly translucent but retain its chunk shape; syrup should be clear and low-viscosity, not a thick jam or milky soup. Text is limited to brand name "{argument name="brand name" default="Pear Stewed Slowly"}", product name "{argument name="product name" default="Rock Sugar Stewed Pear"}", main copy "{argument name="main copy" default="Pear fragrance stewed slowly, sweetness falls clearly"}", and English sub-title "ROCK SUGAR STEWED PEAR". The main text on the left uses a dark brown fine Song font in three lines, brand name at the top, product name and English at bottom left. Lock one pot, one lid, eight pear chunks, six rock sugar pieces, three osmanthus flowers, one glass spoon, and back-left window light; do not add herbs, a second pot, excessive condensation, thick steam, or floating pear chunks.

en.title: Urban Basketball Sneaker Poster Design
en.description: A high-impact advertising poster prompt for street basketball sneakers, blending hyper-realistic product photography with aggressive black-ink sports illustration.
en.prompt: Create an ultra-premium street basketball sneaker advertising poster for an original brand called VANTAGE X, designed as a Cannes-level key visual that fuses luxury product photography, aggressive black-ink sports illustration, and explosive urban editorial typography. Preserve the exact core structure and camera logic of the image: one monumental hyper-real high-top basketball sneaker dominates the lower foreground in an extreme low-angle perspective, while a giant hand-drawn basketball player erupts across the upper background in a violent forward-driving action pose. The final image must now combine stronger Orbit impact, tighter Transit system control, and bolder Port-level concept integration, so the shoe feels like the source of all motion, power, and graphic force in the poster. Core composition: Use a tall vertical poster with one oversized sneaker in the lower-left to lower-center foreground, pushed slightly closer to the viewer for greater visual pressure. The toe box, side emblem, collar, laces, and outsole must feel monumental and tactile, as if the shoe is stepping directly into the viewer’s space. Behind and above it, place one huge black-ink sketch basketball player in an extreme explosive drive, jump, or pre-dunk attack moment, twisting through the frame with sharp momentum. Add one smaller secondary sketched player in the mid-background for layered court rhythm. The shoe must be the first thing seen; the illustrated players act as amplified motion ghosts generated by the shoe’s energy. Orbit impact enhancement: Increase the visual aggression of the foreground shoe. Make the sole impact at the base feel like it detonates the composition through bold black brush bursts, ink spray, fractured motion streaks, and launch-like ground energy. Tighten the distance between camera and shoe so the product feels heavier, closer, and more dominant. The poster must hit instantly with a “one step breaks the frame” sensation. Transit system enhancement: Keep the same skeletal layout, but unify the entire visual language into a mature black-and-white street-illustration system with one controlled hero product color event. The background athlete linework, speed lines, sketch shading, annotation marks, headline typography, secondary text, and impact splashes must all follow one disciplined graphic grammar: consistent ink weight, consistent roughness, consistent motion direction, and coordinated negative-space balance. The whole piece must feel like an official international sports campaign poster, not a collage of separate ideas. Port concept enhancement: Push the concept so the athlete’s motion visibly originates from the sneaker. Let selected ink lines, force strokes, and motion arcs extend from the shoe edges, outsole, and side emblem into the illustrated player’s limbs and trajectory, creating a clear idea that the player’s explosive action is being driven by the sneaker itself. The giant player can be captured in a more extreme airborne breakthrough or pre-slam moment, with the action lines visually tethered back to the shoe. The concept must feel bold and intelligent, not gimmicky. Product design: Design the shoe as a premium globally market-ready high-top street basketball sneaker from VANTAGE X. Use a bold colorway of metallic bronze-gold, matte black, off-white, and subtle silver technical accents. The upper should combine structured leather, engineered support panels, padded ankle protection, reinforced lace wings, sculpted heel geometry, and performance-driven outsole logic. Add an original VANTAGE X emblem on the lateral side. The shoe must feel elite, urban, muscular, and collectible. Material realism: Render the sneaker with exceptional realism and sharp commercial detail. The bronze-gold leather must feel smooth, rich, and premium with controlled highlights. Black areas must feel deep and performance-oriented with distinct texture separation. Show crisp stitching, lace weave, rubber density, sole grip, collar padding, and precise panel edges. The product must feel expensive, durable, and technically believable. Illustration style: Render the players and court world in expressive black ink sketch style with editorial sports aggression: raw contour lines, scratch shading, manga-like force marks, speed streaks, splatter accents, rough court geometry, and brush-impact sweeps. The drawn world should remain powerful but clearly secondary to the shoe. Keep the illustration highly art-directed, not messy. Typography and copy: Add fully original English typography integrated into the composition. Use one powerful headline such as “OWN THE ASPHALT” or “RISE ABOVE IMPACT,” rendered in a sharp custom street-sport editorial style. Add a refined support line such as “Engineered for explosive lift, locked grip, and court-born dominance.” Include a small premium VANTAGE X brand mark. Typography must feel dynamic, urban, aggressive, and compositionally precise. No copied wording, no generic font block. Background and environment: Keep the environment mostly white and minimal, constructed from perspective court lines, urban fragments, black ink slashes, motion scratches, and negative space. Use explosive black brushwork near the shoe base to anchor the product and visually launch the athlete upward. The environment must feel graphic and fast, never cluttered. Lighting: Use premium studio lighting on the sneaker, with soft directional highlights from upper-left and front-left, giving the metallic bronze-gold surfaces a luxurious glow. The illustration can remain flatter and more graphic, but should align with the shoe’s motion and shadow logic. The contrast between hyper-real product lighting and raw ink energy is essential. Color direction: Keep the overall palette tightly controlled: white field, black illustration system, bronze-gold hero product surfaces, black technical components, off-white sole accents, and minimal silver highlights. The shoe must remain the dominant color event in the frame. Mood: explosive, urban, dominant, athletic, rebellious, premium, graphic, collectible, aggressive, editorial, high-performance, street-basketball energy. Rendering style: ultra-premium sneaker campaign poster, oversized hyper-real basketball shoe, extreme low-angle perspective, giant black-ink sketch athlete, unified street illustration system, motion lines extending from shoe into athlete action, luxury material realism, dynamic editorial typography, 8k, world-class advertising image quality. Negative prompt: copied logos, copied slogans, generic shoe design, weak foreground shoe, cluttered background, soft blurry sneaker, cheap comic style, flat materials, plastic-looking bronze panels, messy typography, low-resolution sketch lines, weak motion, generic sports ad, over-rendered city background

en.title: Dreamy Kimono Action Photography
en.description: Dynamic low-angle action shot of an adult female in a stylized kimono jumping through clouds and petals, featuring dream-like lighting and wide-angle perspective.
en.prompt: Subject: {argument name="subject" default="Flower clouds in the sky"} Main Body: A 2:3 vertical realistic solo portrait. A clearly adult female leaping between floating flower clouds and a sea of clouds, with the character occupying about 70% of the screen. Clouds, giant flowers, a full moon, falling petals, and distant floating torii gates are naturally included. Adult fashion editorial photography and cosplay themes; characters maintain an adult age feel and must not represent underage images. Extreme camera positions only change the viewing angle and are not allowed to damage the natural human structure: the head-to-body ratio is about 6.8 to 7, limbs are realistically proportioned, and the jumping action conforms to the center of gravity and weight. Characters/Expression: The expression uses 'called out to during action': called out while leaping, eyes lifting from the front toward the camera, lips slightly open as if about to respond. Clothing/Posture: Low-cut deep V white-purple improved kimono, the main neckline on the chest is directly visible, and key areas are covered by a complete opaque inner layer; purple belt, white flower embroidery, white tabi socks, and straw sandals constitute the outfit. The low collar only shows the collarbone and neckline, not enlarging body contours. The character completes a turning action in the air, the body rotates sideways but the thorax faces the camera at about a three-quarter angle, legs naturally apart, one foot raised, and the other extended backward; kimono sleeves, belt ends, hair ends, and petals rise simultaneously. A replica blunt katana is swung horizontally to the right of the screen, the tip far from the character and camera, one hand gripping the hilt, the other naturally open to maintain balance. Hands have complete, naturally separated five fingers, no complex gripping. Background/Lighting: Floating flower clouds, sea of clouds, giant flowers, full moon, falling petals, and distant floating torii gates form the space. The main light comes from the frontal moonlight and soft fill light, the character's face receives continuous light with uniform transitions, and the clouds and petals maintain dreamy layers without forming light spots on the face. Composition/Lens: Full body, extremely low ground-level upward shot, elevation angle about 60 to 75 degrees, using 14-24mm ultra-wide angle but strictly suppressing distortion. The character is located in the center-right of the screen, the airborne action occupies the main subject, the deep V neckline on the chest remains visible as a clothing detail, and the face is still the only visual center. Character's head, shoulder line, upper body, waist/hips, legs, and sword body maintain the same movement perspective axis. Texture/Style: Extreme dreamy kimono portrait. Sea of clouds, giant flowers, petals, moonlight, and slight grain; strong motion but not plastic. Negative: Underage look, childlike face, real celebrity face, abnormal body proportions, unnatural head-to-body ratio, head too large, torso too long, legs too short, inconsistent shoulder/hip perspective, limb distortion, ultra-wide angle distortion, head deformation, large turn-back, back-view, thorax facing away from camera, neckline magnifying body contours, clothing tight/pulled up, sword tip pointing at character or camera, live weapons, violence/gore, nudity, key parts exposed, transparent lining, clothing displacement, body part close-ups, provocative poses, random light spots on face, partial bleaching, second set of main light, complex gestures, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate hands, third hand, limb fusion, cheap cosplay, plastic skin, text, watermark.

en.title: Professional Mascara Brand Key Visual

en.prompt: A 9:16 vertical brand Key Visual (KV) directly usable for mobile full-screen splash ads. The theme centers on {argument name="theme" default="makeup and lip cosmetics"}, with the main product being {argument name="product" default="mascara"}. The overall brand language is urban sophisticated, using a full-screen vertical immersive composition. The subject is oriented to the left, with a large horizontal text white space on the right. The background is a low-illumination cosmetics studio space, incorporating low-density floating particles to establish brand spatial hierarchy. Focus on representing the brush structure and tube body highlights using cold white futuristic volumetric light, allowing the subject's outline, material reflection, and brand mood to exist simultaneously. en.title: Precise Anime Character Concept Reference Sheet
en.description: A technical character design prompt for generating consistent three-view reference sheets, including specific hex codes for color palettes and detailed anatomical constraints.
en.prompt:
Please generate one character sheet (three-view design specification). Aspect ratio 16:9.

[Art Style (Most Important)]
Maintain the exact style of the reference image. Lines, shading, texture, lighting, hair detail, and eye rendering must match the reference image exactly. Do not deviate from the reference style. Do not use different anime styles, 3D CG, photographic, or heavy oil painting styles.

[Color Scheme]
Use the exact colors from the reference image. Do not change hue, saturation, or brightness.
- {argument name="hair color" default="Hair: Shadows #1D1F1D, Base #1C2325, Highlights #1F2B37. A blue-tinged black (blue-black). Do not use pure solid black, brown, or purple."}
- {argument name="eye color" default="Eyes: Shadows #52788B, Base #7094A7, Highlights #6BA6C3. A muted sky blue. Do not use vibrant primary blue, green, or purple."}
- Skin: Bright skin tone around #FDD3B6.
- {argument name="clothing" default="Clothing base: #FDF2D7 ecru (slightly yellowish off-white). Do not use pure white. Floral pattern: Coral #F08F69 flowers, muted blue small flowers, muted green leaves."}

[Composition]
A design sheet for only one person from the reference image. Three full-body poses (front, side, back) arranged at equal intervals from the left, with one close-up of the face on the right end. Exactly three full-bodies and exactly one face close-up. Do not draw other people. Align the three figures at the same height and baseline. Ensure hair tips, fingertips, and toes are completely within the frame.

[Proportions]
Approximately 7-head-tall standard anime illustration. Do not use a chibi style with a large head. Do not use extreme 9-head-tall fashion drawing proportions.

[Background]
Pure white solid background. Do not draw floors, ground, horizons, baselines, shadows, gradients, borders, or text. Do not draw horizontal lines at the feet. Do not draw the flower fields, blue sky, clouds, or alphabet at the top from the reference image. Draw only one person.

[Forms (Unify clothing as follows)]
- Hair is blue-black, nearly black. A messy medium bob ending just below the chin. Strands are finely divided and flip outward. Long bangs covering the eyes.
- Eyes are almond-shaped with long eyelashes. Eyebrows are thin and natural.
- Upper body is a loose short-sleeved blouse in ecru with a watercolor-style floral print. Round neckline with fine frills on shoulders and cuffs. Hem covers the waist.
- Lower body is a plain ecru long skirt. Mid-calf length showing ankles. Gathered detail.
- Feet are ecru strap sandals. Bare feet.
- No accessories, hats, or bags. Carry nothing.
- Clothing is worn correctly in all poses, completely covering the body. Skin exposure only for face, neck, arms, and ankles down.
- Expression is a calm, natural smile.

en.title: Night Kitchen Glow Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a cinematic, photorealistic image of a woman standing in a dimly lit kitchen, illuminated by the soft white light of an open refrigerator.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="subject" default="Night refrigerator light"}

Main Scene:
A full-body photograph of a woman in a warm wooden night interior, peeking sideways into an open refrigerator at the center of the screen. The refrigerator door and bottles inside are in the left foreground, while a Japanese-style dining table and night view are visible in the far right.

Character and Expression:
The face is in profile looking left, eyes cast down into the refrigerator with a quiet expression and lips lightly closed. Smooth egg-shaped face with a slender jaw, almond-shaped eyes, natural eyebrows, a straight nose, and subtly glossy lips. Smooth skin under warm light with minimal makeup. Long dark brown hair with thin bangs and some wisps over the cheeks, flowing gently down her back.

Outfit and Pose:
{argument name="outfit" default="A short beige camisole top with thin straps, a shallow V-neck and visible front center seam, paired with greige tight shorts"}. The subject's right arm (screen left) reaches into the refrigerator, while the left hand is in a pocket. Weight is on the left leg, with the right knee slightly bent.

Background and Lighting:
Inside the refrigerator on the left, beverage bottles, jars, and condiments are arranged on several shelves. The right background features wooden frames, shoji-style sliding doors, a round lantern light, a low dining table, floor cushions, plants, and city lights through the window. Soft white light from the refrigerator illuminates her face and torso from the left, while warm indoor lighting wraps shadows in amber.

Composition and Camera:
{argument name="composition" default="A 3:4 vertical, eye-level portrait capturing the subject from head to below the thighs"}. The person occupies most of the center, with the refrigerator vertically cutting the left edge, leaving a deep interior on the right. Focus is on the person, with a medium depth of field so background shapes are legible.

Texture and Style:
Cinematic photorealistic live-action photo. Detailed rendering of skin, stretch fabric, wood, glass bottles, and metal textures, with a gentle contrast between amber and the refrigerator's white light.

Negative:
Do not close the refrigerator; do not turn the warm night lighting blue
