en.title: Sunlight and Water Ripple Portrait
en.description: A poetic and highly detailed prompt for generating a high-definition realistic photograph of a woman standing in a forest stream, featuring intricate lighting and water effects.
en.prompt:
Subject: 
{argument name="subject" default="Dance of Water in dappled sunlight"}

Primary Figure: 
A vertical full-body photograph of a single woman standing on one leg in a shallow stream within a deep green forest. Water droplets fall from her long pale beige dress, creating circular ripples at her feet.

Person/Expression: 
Face slightly turned toward the lower left of the frame, with downcast eyes and a quiet expression with closed lips. Small oval face with a slender chin, downward-slanting almond-shaped eyes, thin gentle eyebrows, a straight nose bridge, and pale coral lips. Fair skin with subtle makeup. Long light brown hair parted in the middle, flowing in soft waves over her back and shoulders.

Clothing/Pose: 
A pale greige halter-neck dress. The neckline is a deep V, with fabric crossing in front of the torso, flowing from the waist into layered sheer ruffles and a long asymmetrical hem. Both arms are bent overhead with hands resting on the back of the head; she stands on her right leg with the left leg bent at the knee, resting against the right leg.

Background/Lighting: 
The entire background consists of dark green leaves and a deep forest, while the bottom of the frame shows a transparent shallow stream with reflections. Soft, dappled sunlight from above illuminates her hair, shoulders, dress, and legs, while the surroundings fall into deep shadow. Water droplets and ripples glisten in the backlight.

Composition/Camera: 
Vertical 3:4 portrait, viewed almost horizontally from near the low water surface. The person is framed centrally from head to toe, with the ripples at her feet placed near the bottom edge. Focus is on the person and the water droplets, with the background leaves softly blurred by a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style: 
High-definition photorealistic live-action photograph. Delicately depicts semi-transparent wet fabric, water droplets, skin, and a quiet water surface, cinematically contrasting the deep green with warm dappled sunlight.

Negative: 
Change of one-legged standing pose; do not omit the long asymmetrical hem of the dress.

en.title: Mesh Top and Checkered Skirt Outfit
en.description: A highly technical fashion generation prompt for a classical girlie look, detailing the fabric textures, seams, and construction of a mesh knit crop top and a checkered A-line mini skirt.
en.prompt: Wardrobe: Top: One solid muted cocoa-taupe sleeveless mock-neck crop top made from a fine-gauge stretch mesh knit with tightly regular micro-openings, a lightweight semi-sheer section, a smooth low-luster face, soft close drape, and resilient multidirectional recovery. Cut a close straight-to-lightly-tapered body ending at the upper waist, with matching front and rear lower-edge levels and minimal bulk. Form a narrow circular self-fabric mock neck whose finished height is between one-tenth and one-sixth of the shoulder-to-hem length, using a double-layer return and one low-bulk rear join. Continue two narrow shoulder sections into high-cut sleeveless armholes and uninterrupted front and rear body panels. Finish both armhole circuits with narrow self-fabric turned bindings less than one-tenth of the shoulder-section width, join the body through two clean side seams, and complete the lower circumference with one narrow straight double-turn hem. Use the knit recovery and complete neck opening for a pull-on construction without exterior fastening. Keep the mesh scale evenly legible, the semi-sheer density consistent, the mock neck softly upright, the armhole edges flat, and the lower hem free of heavy opaque bulk. Bottom: One camel-tan wrap-front mini skirt made from medium-weight brushed twill with a compact diagonal weave, a short soft nap, a matte low-luster surface, firm shape retention, and rounded low-bulk folds; confine espresso brown, ivory, and muted dusty-rose to the woven geometric check and matte black to two front buttons. Cut a high-rise upper-thigh mini length with a close waist and upper hip, then widen gently into a compact A-line hem whose laid-flat width is between one-and-one-fifth and one-and-two-fifths of the top-edge width. Form a clean curved faced upper edge without a separate exterior waistband. Build smooth front and rear bodies with two equal rear waist darts, one at product-right and one at product-left, two side seams, and one full-height product-left front overlap panel spanning between one-half and two-thirds of the front width; keep its vertical free edge straight from the top edge to the hem and its underlap continuous behind it. Cover every front, overlap, side, and rear panel with a woven repeat of large upright camel rectangles bounded by single espresso lines and paired ivory lines, then add one fine dusty-rose pinstripe only to alternating vertical and horizontal corridors so the rose intersections shift by one cell on every second row; each complete repeat spans between one-quarter and one-third of the laid-flat front width, with straight orthogonal lines and clean registration across darts, seams, and the overlap. Mount two circular matte-black four-hole buttons in one vertical product-left-front line, each between one-tenth and one-eighth of the waist-to-hem depth in diameter; place the upper station within the upper quarter of that depth and the lower station between one-half and two-thirds of the depth. Secure the overlap through two matching reinforced buttonholes on the underlap, keeping both stations fully engaged and the panel flat, and finish the complete lower edge with one narrow turned hem. Preserve the short brushed nap, readable diagonal weave, crisp A-line outline, stable overlap depth, aligned geometric repeat, flat button seating, and material-correct hem thickness. Footwear: One matching pair of predominantly black combat boots built from medium-thick semi-matte coated leather-like upper material with a fine shallow grain and broad flexible crease response, black flat woven cord, silver-tone metal, and deep black molded rubber. Each boot is knee-high with a tall straight shaft, a broad rounded toe, a substantial forefoot platform, and a slightly deeper rear block, with shaft volume remaining open and stable near the top before compressing into broad slouch folds through the lower shaft and ankle. A wide straight topline forms the shaft opening and retains a clean finished edge. The upper consists of tall side and rear shaft panels joined to a rounded forefoot, broad vamp, quarters, and a central tongue; the vamp stays close while the shaft carries relaxed vertical volume. Paired rows of black lace holes run from the forefoot into the lower shaft and hold flat black laces, while two separate narrow wrap straps encircle each boot, one near the upper shaft and one at the ankle, each ending at its own compact rectangular silver-tone buckle. Tonal topstitching defines the panel joins, and the sole forms a thick continuous sidewall above a deeply cut lugged contact face. The laces close in compact tied bows and both buckle straps remain fastened through their rectangular frames. Both boots are identical anatomical mirror counterparts with the same panel layout, lace path, strap count, buckle placement, shaft height, slouch distribution, toe shape, and sole stack. Preserve the coated fine grain through the broad folds, keep the two buckle circuits physically separate from the lace closure, and maintain crisp sole edges, deep lug relief, firm toe volume, and material-correct seam bulk. Bag: Styling — highest priority: - Bag carry: Hang the strap from the wearer-right shoulder only without crossing the chest, and let the bag body lie flat along the right flank between the lower ribs and outer hip. Let the strap bear the full weight and keep both hands off the bag and strap. Keep the complete strap and bag body entirely outside and visibly separate from every garment, routing the strap over, never beneath or through, the outermost clothing. Do not pass it through any neckline, sleeve, knit opening, seam, or rear panel, and do not merge, attach, weave, replace, or reinterpret any bag material as part of a garment. - Finish — Natural: Adjust only material-correct slack and body contact along the exact selected strap route. Keep the selected route and all attachment points exact while allowing limited material-correct slack and natural body contact. One warm-ivory soft gathered chain-strap pouch bag made from lightweight lightly padded matte woven fabric, constructed as one medium rounded crescent-like body with softly tapered upper corners, a broad curved lower edge, shallow expandable side depth, and controlled flexible volume. Gather the complete upper body into one reinforced top-edge opening, producing repeated soft vertical folds that release through the front, rear, and side surfaces without rigid quilting lines. Add one long warm-gold-tone curb-chain strap attached through two small polished gold-tone D-rings and reinforced matching fabric tabs at the upper sides, preserving identical attachment height and hardware construction on both ends. Complete the front, rear, side panels, curved base, gathered upper edge, reinforced top opening, chain strap, D-rings, attachment tabs, hidden seam allowances, and internal soft support as one coherent bag with no visible exterior closure hardware, exterior pocket, readable branding, detachable charm, keychain, plush ornament, mascot, or additional decoration. Preserve lightweight textile response, softly padded body volume, even gather distribution, clean upper-edge reinforcement, secure chain anchoring, low seam bulk, and restrained warm-gold reflections. Necklace: One short silver fine-chain necklace built as one continuous closed circuit with a shallow curved ornament centered on one product axis. Keep most of the circuit as a slender uniform chain and confine the ornament to a short lower arc substantially shorter than the complete chain path. Construct the ornament from a closely spaced row of uniform short rounded cylindrical beads aligned radially to form a gentle crescent, connecting both ornament terminals directly into compact polished chain links. en.title: White Swimsuit Beach Portrait
en.description: A detailed prompt for generating a high-key photorealistic portrait of a woman sitting on a sunny beach, shielding her eyes from the sun. It specifies the subject's features, clothing, and the vibrant turquoise sea background.
en.prompt:
Subject:
{argument name="swimsuit color" default="White swimsuit"} and summer light

Main Subject:
Vertical portrait of a single woman sitting in the center of a bright sandy beach, shading her eyes with her right hand. The main color surfaces are the {argument name="swimsuit color" default="white swimsuit"}, {argument name="bottoms" default="denim shorts"}, and the blue sea in the background.

Person/Expression:
Upper body tilted slightly to the left of the screen, face almost front-facing, quietly gazing at the camera with brown eyes. Rounded oval face with a small chin, wide almond-shaped eyes, thin parallel eyebrows, slender nose bridge and small tip, thin upper lip and soft lower lip. Fair skin with pale pink cheeks and subtle eye makeup. {argument name="hair color" default="Brown hair"} with thin bangs down, tied in a low side bun with a white lace ribbon, and thin wet stray hairs along the cheeks and neck.

Clothing/Pose:
White triangle bikini swimsuit with thin shoulder straps, lace edges, and a central knot visible. Unbuttoned light blue denim shorts and a small pendant. Sitting on the sand, supporting herself with her left arm extended downward, right arm (screen right) bent, palm held horizontally above the eyebrows.

Background/Light:
Light sand at the bottom, white waves in the center background, vivid turquoise to blue sea and narrow sky in the upper half. Hard summer direct sunlight from slightly above right, brightly illuminating the skin and white fabric, with shadows being light and slightly overexposed.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical, close-up portrait from head to upper thigh from a slightly high-angle perspective. The person occupies the center of the frame, with the right hand overlapping the face. Focus on the face and swimsuit, with the sea surface softly blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
High-key photorealistic live-action photo. High-definition expression of soft skin, white lace, denim, sand, and wave textures in clean, light tones.

Negative:
Do not omit the right hand shading the forehead; do not remove the central knot of the swimsuit.

Canvas: 16:9 landscape storyboard sheet divided into exactly 8 rounded rectangular panels in a 2-row by 4-column grid, with thin white gutters between panels. Add a small bottom caption centered under the grid: “10 SAAT STORYBOARD – Glad2Glow Glycolic Acid Facial Wash”.

Panel details:
1. Product hero: A hand in a cream ribbed sweater holds a pale green squeeze tube of Glad2Glow facial wash upright in front of a blurred beige bathroom and plant leaves. Add a small white heart doodle. Sticker text: “Pencuci muka kegemaran!”
2. Flip cap opening: Close-up of the green tube tilted downward, cap flipped open, with gel beginning to dispense. Add animated motion lines, bubbles, hearts, and a sticker label reading: “Flip & squeeze senang sangat!”
3. Gel texture: Close-up of translucent gel being squeezed onto an open palm, showing soft, smooth gel. Add small bubble and flower doodles. Sticker text: “Gel lembut buih halus”.
4. Foam lather: Close-up of both hands covered in dense white foam, wet and sparkling. Add bright star glints. Sticker text: “Bersih mendalam tanpa keringkan kulit!”
5. Face cleansing: Side close-up of a cheek and jawline with cleanser foam being massaged across the skin, implying removal of makeup and dirt. Add sparkle and star doodles. Sticker text: “Angkat minyak & kotoran dengan mudah!”
6. Rinsing: Two cupped wet hands with water droplets in a sink area, clean and refreshed. Add water-drop doodles. Sticker text: “Bilas bersih, kulit rasa segar!”
7. Final glow product shot: Hand in cream sweater holds the green tube again in a softly lit bathroom with flowers in the background. Add a pink heart doodle. Sticker text: “Kulit cerah berseri”.
8. Benefits card: A pale green rectangular checklist card on a green background with a decorative white dashed border at the top. Headline: “Kenapa wajib cuba?” Include exactly 4 checklist items: “Gel Cleanser”, “Glycolic Acid”, “Low pH Formula”, “Sesuai untuk semua jenis kulit”. Add bold section text: “Glow setiap hari!” and smaller text: “Kulit bersih, cerah & sihat”. Include a simple smiling face doodle and sparkles.

Subject details: The product tube should be pastel lime green with dark green vertical “glad2glow” branding, a translucent green flip cap, and small label text suggesting glycolic acid facial wash. Hands should look natural, soft, clean, and well-lit.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 4:5 aspect ratio, off-white outer margin around a saturated hot-pink rectangular field. Use a clean print-design composition with slight risograph/thermal-paper grain and subtly imperfect ink edges.

Layout: Place one huge cream-white uppercase background title reading {argument name="product name" default="TABLE LAMP"}, spanning nearly the full width across the upper third; crop the letters heavily at the left and right edges so the title feels oversized and partially hidden. Center-right, overlay exactly one tall narrow cream thermal receipt running from near the top to near the bottom, with zigzag torn edges at the top and bottom. Add one thin vertical microtext line beside the receipt, rotated 90 degrees, reading like an archive/design ID. Along the bottom of the pink field place exactly two separate cream barcode blocks, one at bottom left and one at bottom right. The receipt itself contains exactly one black barcode near its bottom.

Receipt details: The receipt header has a large condensed black title {argument name="receipt header" default="TABLE LAMP"}. Under it, include the subtitle “AESTHETICS, SWITCHED ON”. Fill the receipt with monospaced thermal-printer text, dashed divider lines, and pseudo-transaction metadata. Include design-spec lines such as design registration number, date, time, terminal, transaction, attendant, product, object type, form study, material study, surface finish, light quality, curve ratio, form revision, assembly check, aesthetic value, archive index, subtotal, tax, payment method, authorization, thank-you note, return policy, and “KEEP THIS LIGHT RECEIPT”. Highlight exactly one line in a translucent pink marker strip: “GRAND TOTAL--BEAUTY, SWITCHED ON”.

Subject image on receipt: At the lower half of the receipt, print exactly one cute glossy flower-shaped table lamp illustration with a pink fluted pedestal stem, six rounded pink petals, a blue inner glow, a small orange-red circular center, and a thin pale power cord trailing left. Keep it centered above the receipt barcode.

Typography and style: Use condensed bold sans-serif for the massive background title, monospaced receipt type for all receipt text, black ink on warm cream paper, and a fashionable editorial graphic-design aesthetic. Main colors are {argument name="background color" default="hot pink"}, cream white, black, soft pink, blue, and orange-red. The image should feel like a modern poster generated from the structural idea of a thermal-paper receipt, not a realistic store receipt photo.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 visible barcodes total: 2 large background barcode blocks and 1 receipt barcode. Use exactly 1 receipt, exactly 1 product illustration, and exactly 1 highlighted grand-total line. Do not add people, logos, watermarks, QR codes, extra products, or extra receipts.

en.title: Lipstick Recommendation and Analysis Infographic
en.description: A comprehensive prompt that transforms the AI into a professional makeup consultant. It analyzes a user's selfie to provide a visual infographic report featuring skin tone analysis, specific color recommendations from high-end brands, and usage suggestions.
en.prompt:
You are a professional makeup consultant, image analyst, and infographic designer.

Please generate a "Lipstick Recommendation Report Infographic" based on the selfie uploaded by the user and the specified lipstick brand.

Objective:
Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades based on the person's overall temperament, skin tone tendency, makeup suitability, and lip characteristics, and present them in a clear, professional way that matches the brand's identity.

Brand:
{argument name="brand name" default="Dior / YSL / Armani / Chanel / Tom Ford"}

The visual content includes the following structures:

1. Top-left area: User selfie and basic analysis
- Display the user's selfie avatar
- Extract skin tone tendency, overall temperament, and suitable color directions
- Summarize with short Chinese labels, such as: cool-toned, soft, commuting, powerful, etc.

2. Middle main area: Lipstick recommendation matrix
- Recommend 3-5 suitable lipstick shades
- Show the lip swatching effect for each shade
- Keep the same person, same angle, and same lighting, only changing the lip color
- Each shade is accompanied by a Chinese name or number
- Mark the color impression, such as: gentle bean paste, commuting nude red, temperament rose, brightening red-brown, date berry, etc.

3. Right or bottom area: Usage scenario suggestions
- Match suitable scenarios for each recommended shade
- For example: commuting, dating, shopping, banquet, photography, daily bare-faced look

4. Bottom summary area: Conclusion and suggestions
- Give summaries such as "most recommended color," "most versatile color," "best complexion-enhancing color"
- Write a short Chinese purchase or selection suggestion

- Dior: Elegant French gray-white + silver accents
- YSL: High-contrast black-gold, sexy and strong
- Armani: Low-saturation gray tones, high-end and restrained

- Visual language can be extended automatically according to the brand

- Chinese text must be clear and accurate
- Clean layout, complete information, suitable for social media sharing
- Keep the character identity consistent, only comparing lip color differences
- High-end style, avoid looking like common e-commerce screenshots

The hem and drape extend in the wind on the bridge, but do not block the perspective direction of the bridge. The dream carrier is: a suspended paper-art sky bridge. Dream imagery includes: sky bridge, cloud sea, temple, flying birds, distant mountains, glowing cloud layers. All bridges, temples, clouds, mountains, birds, and characters must be unified in a high-quality 3D paper sculpture language; realistic characters with paper-cut backgrounds or ordinary CG architecture are not allowed. The overall paper-cut structure adopts: a surrounding dreamscape style. Composition and camera requirements: the camera is located on the bridge surface, using a low-angle or eye-level shot, high-angle top-down shots cannot be used. The line of sight extends along the bridge surface toward the distant temple, forming a strong single-point perspective and epic depth. The sky bridge extends from the foreground at the bottom of the screen to the far center, leading directly to the temple. The bridge width is moderate but visually extremely long, with exquisite hollowed railings, suspension chains, carvings, and paper-art components on both sides. The character is located in a small position in the middle-lower part of the bridge, facing away from or semi-facing away from the camera, walking towards the distant temple. The character must be significantly smaller than the bridge and the temple to highlight the oppressive sense of the scene and the scale of the bridge. The main subject of the scene is an extremely long and narrow suspended paper-art sky bridge. The bridge body floats above an infinite sea of clouds, and the bridge surface is composed of silver-white, moon-white, and light-gold details, with rich oriental hollowed patterns, paper-sculpted railings, layered structures, and translucent edges. In the distance is a huge, multi-layered glowing paper-sculpted temple. The volume of the temple is much larger than the person and even much larger than the bridge entrance porch, possessing a clear sense of oppression and divine scale. The temple is composed of multiple halls, arches, towers, corridors, and a central glowing entrance, with a complex and exquisite structure, layered and situated between the sea of clouds and the mountains. There is a glowing doorway or main hall entrance at the center of the temple, becoming the final visual focus. The temple should be like the ultimate center in a dream, not a common courtyard building. On both sides of the bridge are a huge sea of clouds and high-altitude white space. The sea of clouds is composed of a large number of paper layers of different thicknesses, forming surging layers and a massive sense of volume. Distant paper-art mountains rise from the clouds, the peaks are cyan and misty blue, with fine gold-line hollowed decorations. A few birds may fly by in the high sky to enhance the sense of scale and airspace, but do not stack too many. The overall color scheme is: moon white, cyan-green, silver white as primary colors, with a small amount of light gold accents. Moon white is used for the bridge body, bright parts of the temple, outer layers of character clothing, and highlights of the sea of clouds; cyan-green is used for distant mountains, inner layers of clothing, and partial decorations; silver white is used for temple highlights, bridge surface highlights, and the sky atmosphere; light gold is only used for railing chains, hollowed patterns, clothing outlines, and partial highlights. The overall look must be bright, transparent, and clear, not gray, not darkened, not overall blueish, and not yellowish. Light and paper texture: bright daylight with a blend of cold and warm tones at high altitude illuminates the sky bridge and the temple, the edges of the bridge surface are slightly translucent, the shadow layers of the temple paper are clear, and the paper fibers and layered structures are exquisite and obvious. The distant temple entrance emits a soft but strong light, extending toward the foreground along the bridge. The bridge railings, character's shoulders, hair strands, and skirt edges have soft rim lighting. The paper surface must have clearly visible fiber textures, manual cutting marks, slight creases, layered shadows, and translucent edges, overall looking like a high-quality museum-grade paper sculpture art installation. The atmosphere of the image is: epic, solemn, sacred, vast, quiet, and firm. The focus is not on exaggerated character postures, but on creating a strong sense of pilgrimage and oppression through the extremely long sky bridge, giant temple, massive sea of clouds, and high-altitude space. The scene must look like a paper-art mythological epic scene, not an ordinary dreamscape.

en.title: Reaching Hand in Neon Night Cityscape
en.description: A cinematic high-angle prompt depicting a woman reaching her hand towards the camera against a vibrant, bokeh-filled neon street background.
en.prompt:
Subject:
Hand reaching towards the neon lights

Primary Subject:
A vertical wide-angle photo of a single woman in the lower right corner, leaning forward and reaching her right hand out significantly toward the camera beside a {argument name="location" default="downtown pedestrian bridge"}. She is wearing {argument name="clothing color" default="pink"} ruffled clothes, in a pose with one leg raised behind her, against a night road with cars and glowing signs.

Character/Expression:
The upper body and head lean heavily to the left of the frame, with {argument name="eye color" default="brown"} eyes looking up toward the camera, and glossy pink lips lightly closed in a serious yet soft expression. A small oval face with a rounded chin, large almond-shaped eyes, thin parallel eyebrows, and a small, well-shaped nose. Eyeliner extending from the outer corners of the eyes with pink lower eyelids and bright glossy skin. Long light-brown hair with thin bangs and large waves flowing over the left shoulder.

Clothing/Pose:
A short camisole top with a light pink floral pattern, thin shoulder straps, lace trim, and a ribbon tie at the chest. A pink belt and a short pleated skirt layered with sheer plaid fabric, lace, and ruffles. White high socks and white/pink platform sneakers. A pink shoulder bag with a small stuffed animal charm. She is holding a black handrail with her left hand, standing on her left leg with her right knee bent back and shoe raised to the lower left, extending her right arm toward the camera at the upper right of the frame.

Background/Lighting:
A large night street with cars lined up from the left to the center background, colorful vertical signs and window lights on both sides, and a single man standing in the right middle ground. In addition to the diffused light from streetlamps and signs, a soft white light source on the camera side brightly illuminates the face and torso. The background consists of blue dusk and warm-colored bokeh.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical orientation, a wide-angle portrait with a strong high-angle view looking down at the subject. The person occupies a large portion from the bottom right to the center, with the extended right hand appearing extremely large in the upper right foreground, while the head and torso recede and appear smaller. The entire figure from head to the raised shoe is within the frame, with focus on the face and a slight blur on the hand and night scenery.

Texture/Style:
A photorealistic live-action photo with a flash feel. High-definition rendering of lace, transparent ruffles, metal charms, skin, road surface, and neon reflections, with a strong contrast between pink and the blue night.

Negative:
Do not make the foreground right hand small; do not lower the right leg raised behind.

en.title: Photography Tutorial and Camera Setup Infographic
en.description: An advanced prompt for generating instructional infographics for photography. It takes a reference image and breaks down the camera position, distance, height, and angle, providing a clear 'how-to' guide for recreating the shot.
en.prompt:
Using [{argument name="reference image" default="Image 1 Reference"}] as the sole visual basis, generate a vertical 3:4 {argument name="teaching topic" default="street photography knowledge analysis chart"} (educational infographic poster). Goal: Use clear and interesting diagrams to explain "subject position, camera position, lens/distance, camera height, shooting angle, and composition points" for the purpose of teaching others how to recreate the shot. Overall style: Clean and high-end photography tutorial infographic + light scrapbook-style annotations; light off-white paper texture or light gray background; mainly black, white, and gray; automatically extract 1–2 colors from Image 1 as accents; sharp lines, high information density but not cluttered, unified alignment, and strong readability.

Mandatory Rules:
- Must preserve the following from Image 1: subject pose, relative position between subject and environment, main background structural lines, lighting direction, and spatial logic.
- Do not change the pose or the scene; only provide an "analytical diagrammatic presentation."
- Faces are not the focus: they can be lightly blurred/simplified, no realistic beautification, no emphasis on facial features.
- Full Chinese; no English, no brand names, no watermarks, no UI interface elements.

Fixed Layout (remains the same every time, does not change with Image 1):
1) Main Visual Area (upper half or large image on the left): Place the "Reference Scene Display" (lightly stylized/illustrated based on Image 1, but with recognizable scene and posture), overlaid with: rule-of-thirds grid, subject outline box, leading line prompts, vertical/horizontal line correction prompts; use numbered dots + hand-drawn arrows to mark key points (subject landing point, negative space direction, leg extension direction, background leading line source).
2) Diagram Area (two side-by-side images on the right or bottom half):
- Top View: Use minimalist icons to draw wall/street/building boundaries (abstracted from Image 1), subject position (person icon), camera position (camera icon); must show shooting direction arrows, distance between subject and camera (dashed line + numerical range), recommended position points A/B (two alternative positions); camera orientation must match Image 1 (front/side/oblique, etc.).
- Side View: Draw ground line, subject height示意, camera height示意, tilt angle sector; must show camera height range from ground (reasonably inferred from Image 1), lens tilt angle range (reasonably inferred from Image 1); low angle/eye level/high angle must be correct.
3) Parameter Card Area (three fixed rounded-corner cards at the bottom):
- Card 1: Lens and Distance (give recommended equivalent focal length range + shooting distance range).
- Card 2: Camera Height and Angle (give camera height range + tilt angle range).
- Card 3: Pose and Body Points (summarize key points of the pose in Image 1 using short sentences).
4) Error Demonstration Area (fixed at the bottom right): 3 red-cross error prompts (automatically generated based on the most relevant issues in Image 1, short sentences), for example: don't use ultra-wide angle too close to the face, don't crop toes/fingers, don't use a camera position that's too high resulting in distorted proportions (adjust automatically based on Image 1's actual situation).

Automatic Inference Requirements (to make it usable for any replacement of Image 1):
- Automatically infer and write into the diagrams based on Image 1: camera orientation, camera height, shooting distance interval, equivalent focal length interval, subject landing point and cropping strategy, background leading line source.
- All numerical values should be expressed as "ranges" (credible and reproducible), do not provide a single fixed number.

Output Requirements:
High definition, sharp lines, natural shadows, unified icons, neat layout, readable information; no garbled text, no logos, no watermarks, no excessive decoration.

Negative Constraints:
No watermarks, no logos, no English, no garbled text, no overly realistic faces, no exaggerated cartoon proportions, no limb deformities/extra fingers, no cluttered layouts, no low resolution, no heavy filters, no changes to the subject pose or scene relationship of Image 1.

en.title: Three-View Character Reference Sheet Layout
en.description: A structural prompt for generating a character design sheet with a specific 25/75 split, featuring three-view full-body diagrams and face close-ups on a gray background.
en.prompt: A {argument name="aspect ratio" default="2:1 horizontal"} image. Divide the whole into left and right, with the left being 25% of the total width and the right being 75%. The right side is a 3:2 area using the full height, containing a three-view diagram on a {argument name="background color" default="gray background"} arranged side-by-side in the order of front, side, and back. The three-view diagrams should all be {argument name="standing poses" default="standing poses"} where the full body is visible. However, in all three cuts, the top should be cut slightly below the jaw, showing only from the jaw down. Everything above the neck is completely out of frame, and the face, head, and hair are not shown at all. The left side is divided into two parts, top and bottom, with two squares of the same size. Both are close-ups of faces on a gray background. The top shows a serious expression facing the camera, and the bottom shows a face looking away. The three-view diagram on the right is configured for full-body costume verification.

en.title: Pistachio Crochet Cardigan and Plaid Mini Dress
en.description: A complex outfit prompt detailing the textures of a crochet cardigan paired with a multiscale plaid skater dress featuring lace trim.
en.prompt: Wardrobe: Outerwear / layers: One solid pistachio short-sleeve crochet cardigan built from fine softly matte yarn. Upper-hip length with a close straight body, lightly shaped waist, and two independent front panels. A deep rounded V opening continues into narrow scalloped front bands. Two short set-in sleeves have compact fitted upper sections, softly expanded lower edges, and narrow scalloped cuffs. The body and sleeves use a consistent openwork construction of slim vertical chain ladders alternating with dense shell-like crochet columns, preserving small irregular apertures and a clearly fibrous looped surface. A narrow scalloped crochet border completes the neckline, both front edges, cuffs, and lower hem. Five evenly spaced pistachio four-hole buttons run down one front band, with aligned crochet buttonholes on the opposite band; all five buttons remain released. Keep the open cells distinct, the shell columns vertically coherent, the front panels balanced, the buttons flat and evenly aligned, and the soft yarn texture clean rather than fuzzy or melted together. Dress / all-in-one: One olive-green, smoky-charcoal, muted-lavender, beige, and black spaghetti-strap mini dress made from lightweight fine-gauge semi-sheer mesh with soft fluid drape. Across the complete plaid shell, an all-over oblique multiscale check places broad smoky-charcoal bands, narrower muted-lavender bands, and fine beige lines over an olive ground, creating a regular field of unequal rectangular cells with stable band order and crisp intersections. The dress is close through the shaped bust and waist, then widens immediately below the fitted waist into a full upper-thigh-length skater skirt with rounded fluid flare and unpleated volume. The front upper edge forms a deep sweetheart V from two shaped bust panels, while the rear upper edge follows a low soft curve. Shaped front, side, and rear bodice panels continue below the curved underbust line, and the fitted torso releases into the full bias-cut skirt with evenly distributed soft folds. Two very narrow constant-width straps join the upper front corners to corresponding rear anchors. Black scalloped floral lace traces the complete bust edge and rear upper edge; a broader black scalloped lace band follows the curved underbust seam, with a compact flat black ribbon knot at the center front. A narrow black mesh binding finishes the full undulating hem. Elastic recovery in the lace bands and pliant bias mesh forms a clean pull-on closure with a continuous fitted upper circuit. The rear lace edge and underbust band continue uninterrupted between the paired strap anchors, and the checked skirt retains its full flare across the rear. Preserve the fine mesh grain, slight translucency through single layers, denser tone at overlaps, delicate lace openwork, crisp scallops, slim seam allowances, stable check-band widths, and thin flexible edge depth throughout. Footwear: One matching pair of solid dark brown platform Mary Jane shoes built from smooth low-luster structured upper material with shallow natural creasing, clean rounded edge returns, and dense molded dark brown rubber at the base. Each shoe has a broad rounded-square overall front envelope and a low substantial platform profile. The low upper opening has a shallow curved rear arc and continues forward into two narrow transverse unfilled instep slots. A broad rounded-square closed toe box and low side quarters form the upper, while a one-piece platform sole follows the full perimeter, projects slightly beyond the toe and sides, and combines a softly rounded sidewall with a nearly level lower profile and a low integrated heel. One wide flat crosswise instep strap spans between the two open slots and anchors directly into both side quarters. Maintain the same wearer-left-downward diagonal across the front and back; do not mirror it to image-left or twist the band. Preserve any separately selected buckle or knot position and tail treatment, and do not invent unregistered hardware. One pistachio crochet cord belt built from a long slender round braided cord and a dimensional yarn rosette. The flexible cord forms one complete adjustable circuit and retains a consistently narrow circular section. A large rosette is constructed from three concentric tiers of tightly crocheted scalloped petals around a compact spiral center. Two narrow unequal free tails end in clean bound yarn terminals, with the longer tail substantially exceeding the rosette diameter. Beside the rosette, the cord and tails are secured into a compact single-loop knot. Keep the cord smooth and untwisted, the knot compact, the petal tiers clearly separated, the spiral center legible, and the yarn color and stitch scale consistent across every component. Necklace: One fine silver-tone oval-link pendant necklace with a compact single-loop envelope; the pendant is distinctly broader than the chain and its drop remains short compared with the complete chain circuit. Small polished black bead stations punctuate the fine link path. The central pendant is a solid polished black heart with two rounded upper lobes and one clean lower point, framed by a narrow silver-tone rim and joined to the chain by a compact polished bail. Keep the links fine and individually resolved, the bead stations spherical, the heart face smooth and opaque, the rim uniform, and the metal joins precise with controlled reflections. Earrings: One matching pair of small pale warm-gold-tone round stud earrings, each constructed with one compact domed front face carrying subtle fine textured relief, one concealed straight post, and one matching friction clutch. Keep both earrings identical in diameter, section thickness, mounting depth, color, finish, and fastening construction. Complete the rear surfaces, post anchoring, clutches, hidden joins, and polished edges as one coherent matching pair with no chain, drop, pearl, colored enamel, readable branding, or additional component. Preserve precise bilateral matching, clean circular geometry, secure post construction, consistent relief depth, uniform plated finish, and restrained material-correct highlights. Bracelet: Styling: - Bracelet placement: VIEW-CONDITIONAL HARD SIDE MAP — choose one case by facing direction. FRONT OR NEAR-FRONT: IMAGE-RIGHT wrist = TARGET and IMAGE-LEFT wrist = NON-TARGET. BACK OR NEAR-BACK: IMAGE-LEFT wrist = TARGET and IMAGE-RIGHT wrist = NON-TARGET. PROFILE, CROSSED ARMS, OR AMBIGUOUS IMAGE SIDE: trace the subject's left arm from the left shoulder to its wrist; do not choose by screen side. TARGET is always the subject's anatomical left wrist; NON-TARGET is the anatomical right wrist. Render one complete instance of the registered bracelet item described directly below around TARGET only; keep NON-TARGET free of this bracelet and do not duplicate it. Preserve the registered design and count. Keep other separately selected wrist items unchanged. One delicate gold-tone chain bracelet with a fine flexible closed circuit and a sparse sequence of small translucent oval beads separated by exposed chain spans. en.title: Toy Poodle Summer Festival Triptych
en.description: A photorealistic three-panel collage of a gray toy poodle in a pastel yukata enjoying candied apples, goldfish scooping, and fireworks at a Japanese summer festival.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a photorealistic vertical triptych collage showing a small gray toy poodle enjoying a Japanese summer festival at night.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 image divided into exactly 3 horizontal photo panels of equal height, edge-to-edge with no borders. Use a cinematic shallow-depth-of-field look, warm lantern bokeh, realistic night lighting, and a low dog-level camera perspective.

Subject details: The same small gray toy poodle appears in all 3 panels, with fluffy curly fur, floppy ears, dark expressive eyes, a black nose, and a cute gentle expression. The dog wears a pastel Japanese yukata with colorful floral and morning-glory patterns in pink, mint, lavender, and light blue, tied neatly like a summer festival outfit. The dog should look like {argument name="dog description" default="a small gray toy poodle with fluffy curly fur"} and wear {argument name="festival outfit" default="a pastel floral Japanese yukata"}.

Panel 1: The dog sits centered in the foreground at a night festival walkway, looking directly at the camera. A human hand enters from the lower left holding a glossy red candied apple on a wooden stick close to the dog's face. Behind the dog are softly blurred yatai food stalls, glowing paper lantern strings overhead, and festival visitors as indistinct silhouettes.

Panel 2: The dog leans over the near edge of a bright blue plastic goldfish-scooping pool, peering down curiously. The pool contains exactly 7 visible goldfish in orange, red, and white tones, plus exactly 1 small circular paper scooping net floating on the water at the right. Water reflections and droplets on the pool edge should look realistic. Background remains a blurred summer festival with warm stalls and lanterns.

Panel 3: The dog trots happily toward the camera on a paved festival plaza, mouth slightly open as if smiling, one front paw lifted mid-step. Fireworks burst in the dark sky behind it, with exactly 4 major visible firework blooms in pink, gold, green, and white. Festival stalls and people remain softly out of focus along the sides, with strings of lanterns adding warm bokeh.

Visual style: Ultra-realistic DSLR photography, 35mm wide-angle lens feel, low-angle perspective, soft background blur, warm orange festival lights contrasted with deep navy night sky, crisp detail on the dog and yukata, joyful nostalgic Japanese matsuri atmosphere.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 panels, exactly 1 dog per panel, exactly 1 candied apple in the first panel, exactly 7 goldfish and 1 scoop in the second panel, and exactly 4 major fireworks in the third panel. No captions, no text, no watermark, no extra animals.

en.title: Overworked Office Hamster Manga
en.description: A monochrome six-panel Japanese manga diary page showing a cute hamster salaryman being interrupted during lunch at the office.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a black-and-white Japanese manga diary page about an overworked office hamster employee, in a humorous slice-of-life tone. Use detailed pencil/ink shading, screentone texture, thick black panel borders, expressive manga speech balloons, and a clean modern office background.

Canvas: Vertical manga page, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, monochrome grayscale, high-resolution print look. Arrange exactly 6 panels: three narrow panels across the top row, two panels across the middle row, and one large dramatic panel spanning the full bottom row.

Setting and main character: The protagonist is a small round fluffy hamster office worker with shiny black eyes, tiny paws, soft fur, and a serious but cute expression. The office has rows of desks, monitors, swivel chairs, fluorescent ceiling lights, filing cabinets, glass entrance doors, a landline telephone, and an analog wall clock. The visual humor comes from treating the hamster like a normal salaryman.

Panel layout and content:
1. Top-left panel: Empty office after hours. The hamster has collapsed into a melted exhausted heap on the floor beside a small low desk with stationery. Add steam-like fatigue lines rising from the body. Vertical label reads {argument name="four hours later label" default="4時間経過"}.
2. Top-middle panel: Same office, one hour after arriving. The hamster sits upright at a desk, still cute but blank and tired, with papers and a pencil cup. Vertical label reads {argument name="one hour later label" default="1時間経過"}.
3. Top-right panel: Morning entrance scene by glass office doors. The hamster walks in carrying a small black business bag and politely greets the office. Include a speech balloon reading {argument name="morning greeting" default="おはようございまーす"}. Vertical label reads {argument name="third obon day label" default="お盆三日目"}.
4. Middle-left panel: The hamster holds an oversized black landline phone receiver with both paws, standing beside the phone base. It looks earnest and professional. Include two speech balloons: one calm balloon saying {argument name="phone answer text" default="はい、〇〇のハムです"}, and one jagged loud reply balloon from the other party saying 「あー！ハムさんいたぁ!!」.
5. Middle-right panel: Lunch break at the desk. The hamster happily eats noodles from a bowl with chopsticks; steam rises from the bowl. A large landline phone sits in the foreground, and an analog wall clock shows noon. Add sound effect text 「プルルルル」 near the phone. Vertical label reads 「昼休み」.
6. Bottom full-width panel: Dramatic dark background with strong radial speed lines and heavy contrast. The hamster is now angry and intense, gripping the oversized phone receiver, with a manga anger mark on its forehead. On the left, add a large white burst caption reading 「このための出勤とかマジでふざけんな」. On the right, add an ornate flower-decorated thought/speech bubble containing vertical Japanese complaint text: 「あのぉ〜、急ぎ対応してほしいものがあってぇ。お昼中なのにごめんなさい。えっとぉ、私の作った資料ダメ出しされちゃってぇ……ハムさんに直して欲しいんですぅ。あっ、私お昼中なんで、お昼終わるまでにください！」

Style constraints: Use authentic seinen/josei manga diary aesthetics, grayscale pencil crosshatching, soft fur detail, office realism, readable Japanese lettering, and strong comedic timing. Keep exactly 6 panels and exactly the listed text elements; do not add color, extra characters, watermark, or extra captions.

en.title: Bird Shaman Character Turnaround
en.description: Creates a four-view T-pose fantasy bird-shaman character sheet for 3D modeling, rigging, or concept art reference.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a clean 3D character design turnaround sheet for a dark fantasy humanoid bird-shaman character, suitable for modeling and rigging reference.

Canvas: Wide horizontal canvas, 16:9 aspect ratio, light warm gray studio background with no props, no shadows beyond soft contact shading, centered full-body figures with generous spacing.

Layout: Show exactly 4 full-body character views in a straight row, all in a rigid T-pose with arms extended horizontally: 1 front view, 2 left side profile view, 3 back view, 4 right side profile view. Keep all four views the same height and scale, evenly spaced, feet aligned on the same baseline.

Character details: The character is {argument name="character archetype" default="a dark fantasy bird-masked tribal shaman"} with a slim humanoid body, black fitted under-suit or dark skin-tight body layer, birdlike plague-doctor mask or long beak helmet, and a crown of thin red-orange feather or tendril plumes emerging from the head. The face is hidden by the mask; the front mask has a long pale bone-colored beak, dark eye openings, and carved ornamental markings. The back view shows a darker head with red tendrils visible from behind.

Outfit: The costume has exactly these visible main clothing pieces: 1 long open sleeveless olive-green robe or coat with split front and pointed tails, 2 short pale green sleeves over the upper arms, 3 black fitted forearm guards or gloves, 4 black leggings, 5 open-toe sandals, 6 layered dark feather collar around the shoulders, 7 pale leaf-like feather necklace around the neck, 8 circular bronze ring ornaments at the waist and knees, 9 hanging strap details at the hips, 10 a vertical laced panel down the upper back. The robe color is {argument name="robe color" default="muted olive green"} with weathered fabric texture and faded salmon-pink circular patterns on the sides and lower back. Use bronze, bone, leather, and dark charcoal materials.

Pose and anatomy: T-pose character sheet, arms perfectly straight and level, palms facing down or slightly inward, legs straight, feet shoulder-width apart. The figure should feel game-ready and sculptural, with consistent proportions across all views.

Visual style: High-quality 3D render, realistic stylized fantasy design, matte materials, subtle worn fabric texture, crisp details, neutral orthographic camera, no dramatic lighting, no text labels, no grid, no watermark. Emphasize symmetry, readable silhouettes, and production-art clarity. Use {argument name="render style" default="realistic stylized 3D game character turnaround"}.

en.title: Mesoamerican Warrior Character Sheet
en.description: A wide photorealistic fantasy character sheet showing an Indigenous Mesoamerican female warrior with braided hair, obsidian face paint, armor, and multiple reference angles.
en.prompt:
Goal: Create a cinematic character design sheet for a {argument name="character name" default="21-year-old Indigenous Mesoamerican female warrior"}, showing her costume, face paint, hairstyle, and multiple angles for concept-art reference.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 3:1 character sheet on a neutral medium-gray studio background, high-resolution photorealistic fantasy concept art with soft cinematic lighting and sharp fabric/leather detail.

Layout: Use exactly 11 visible views arranged across the canvas: 4 small stacked portrait studies on the far left, 1 large central front-facing three-quarter body portrait, 5 smaller full-body turnaround/action reference views in the middle-right, and 1 large close-up face portrait on the far right.

Subject details: The warrior is a young Indigenous Mesoamerican woman with olive-tan skin, intense pale hazel-green eyes, strong brows, full lips, and an alert, controlled warrior expression. Her {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair is intricately braided into many tight braids with a center part, long length, braided side sections, and loose baby hairs at the hairline. She wears subtle dark obsidian war paint: a smoky horizontal mask-like band across the bridge of the nose and under both eyes, with faint red accent marks around the eyes in some portrait studies. Add natural skin texture, light sweat or dew on the close-up face, and realistic pores.

Costume: Dress her in a dark-gray fitted leather warrior tunic with sculpted paneling, high neck, layered chest armor, ribbed seams, long sleeves in muted gray woven fabric, dark bracers, black fitted pants, and dark boots. The shoulders have dramatic carved obsidian-black feather or scale-like pauldrons with glossy jagged pieces, giving a volcanic stone armor look. Overall palette: charcoal, graphite, black obsidian, muted gray fabric, and warm natural skin tones.

Exact view count and descriptions: 1) far-left top small frontal head-and-shoulders portrait looking forward; 2) far-left second small three-quarter portrait looking to the viewer's right; 3) far-left third small three-quarter portrait with sterner expression and red eye accents; 4) far-left bottom small side-profile portrait facing right; 5) large central front-facing half-to-three-quarter body view with hands on hips; 6) middle-right rear full-body turnaround view showing long braids down the back; 7) middle-right side full-body view facing left; 8) lower middle top-down full-body view looking down at the head and shoulders; 9) lower right top-down full-body view in a slightly different stance; 10) far-right large cinematic close-up of the face, cropped from forehead to upper chest; 11) include the central figure as the main hero view, larger than all reference views.

Visual style: Photorealistic AAA game character concept sheet, realistic materials, detailed leather stitching and armor paneling, clean studio presentation, subtle depth of field on the close-up, dramatic but controlled lighting, no weapons visible, no text labels, no watermark, no extra characters. Emphasize the {argument name="mood" default="alert warrior stance"} and the cultural-fantasy warrior identity without adding modern accessories.
